  limitations: string[];
}

/**
 * Detects a post-activity transition to resting state and calculates HR drop at 1-minute and 2-minute marks.
 * Returns detailed transition, peak HR, window, and lineage metadata.
 */
export function calculateRecoveryHrDetailed(
  hrsOrPoints: number[] | Array<{ hr: number; timeMs?: number; timestampMs?: number }>, 
  timestampsMs?: number[]
): DetailedRecoveryHrResult {
  const method = 'src/backend/analytics/cardio.ts:calculateRecoveryHrDetailed';
  const version = '1.2.0';

  let hrs: number[];
  let times: number[];

  if (Array.isArray(hrsOrPoints) && hrsOrPoints.length > 0 && typeof hrsOrPoints[0] === 'object' && hrsOrPoints[0] !== null) {
    const pts = hrsOrPoints as Array<{ hr: number; timeMs?: number; timestampMs?: number }>;
    hrs = pts.map(p => p.hr);
    times = pts.map(p => p.timeMs ?? p.timestampMs ?? 0);
  } else {
    hrs = (hrsOrPoints as number[]) || [];
    times = timestampsMs || [];
  }

  if (hrs.length === 0 || hrs.length !== times.length) {
    return {
      transition_detected: false,
      peak_hr_bpm: null,
      recovery_start_seconds: null,
      recovery_1min: null,
      recovery_2min: null,
      target_time_1min_ms: null,
      target_time_2min_ms: null,
      hr_at_1min_bpm: null,
      hr_at_2min_bpm: null,
      method,
      version,
      limitations: ['Empty or mismatched HR series; recovery cannot be computed.']
    };
  }

  // Check timestamp monotonicity and duplicates
  for (let i = 1; i < times.length; i++) {
    if (times[i] === times[i - 1]) {
      return {
        transition_detected: false,
        peak_hr_bpm: null,
        recovery_start_seconds: null,
        recovery_1min: null,
        recovery_2min: null,
        target_time_1min_ms: null,
        target_time_2min_ms: null,
        hr_at_1min_bpm: null,
        hr_at_2min_bpm: null,
        method,
        version,
        limitations: ['Duplicate timestamps detected in heart rate series; recovery calculation rejected.']
      };
    }
    if (times[i] < times[i - 1]) {
      return {
        transition_detected: false,
        peak_hr_bpm: null,
        recovery_start_seconds: null,
        recovery_1min: null,
        recovery_2min: null,
        target_time_1min_ms: null,
        target_time_2min_ms: null,
        hr_at_1min_bpm: null,
        hr_at_2min_bpm: null,
        method,
        version,
        limitations: ['Non-monotonic timestamps detected in heart rate series; recovery calculation rejected.']
      };
    }
  }

  // Find a candidate transition point:
  // Scans the HR timeseries for a significant drop (>= 25 bpm) from a high level (>= 115 bpm).
  // Once a drop is confirmed, the recovery start is marked by the LAST point of local maximum HR before the drop.
  for (let i = 0; i < hrs.length; i++) {
    const hrStart = hrs[i];
    if (hrStart < 115) continue;

    const timeStart = times[i];
    let dropIndex = -1;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < hrs.length; j++) {
      if (times[j] - timeStart > 180000) break;
      const hrDrop = hrStart - hrs[j];
      if (hrDrop >= 25) {
        dropIndex = j;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (dropIndex !== -1) {
      // Find the last index of the local maximum HR in the window [i, dropIndex]
      let maxHrVal = -1;
      let maxHrIdx = -1;
      for (let k = i; k <= dropIndex; k++) {
        if (hrs[k] >= maxHrVal) {
          maxHrVal = hrs[k];
          maxHrIdx = k;
        }
      }

      const recoveryStartTimeMs = times[maxHrIdx];
      const hrStartPeak = hrs[maxHrIdx];
      const targetTime1MinMs = recoveryStartTimeMs + 60000;
      const targetTime2MinMs = recoveryStartTimeMs + 120000;

      // Verify continuous window across nominal 1 Hz stream:
      // Single-step delta must satisfy 850ms <= deltaMs <= 1150ms (per hr_qc.ts canonical 1-Hz contract).
      // Target samples must exist within ±1500ms of target elapsed timestamps.
      // Mean cadence must satisfy 950ms..1050ms, with >= 57 samples for 60s and >= 114 samples for 120s.
      let idxAt1Min = -1;
      let minDiff1 = Infinity;
      let idxAt2Min = -1;
      let minDiff2 = Infinity;

      for (let k = maxHrIdx; k < times.length; k++) {
        const diff1 = Math.abs(times[k] - targetTime1MinMs);
        if (diff1 < minDiff1 && diff1 <= 1500) {
          minDiff1 = diff1;
          idxAt1Min = k;
        }
        const diff2 = Math.abs(times[k] - targetTime2MinMs);
        if (diff2 < minDiff2 && diff2 <= 1500) {
          minDiff2 = diff2;
          idxAt2Min = k;
        }
      }

      let has_continuous_60s = idxAt1Min !== -1;
      let max_gap_60s_ms = 0;
      let min_gap_60s_ms = Infinity;
      let max_cadence_dev_60s_ms = 0;
      let gap_count_60s = 0;
      let sample_count_60s = 0;

      if (has_continuous_60s) {
        for (let k = maxHrIdx + 1; k <= idxAt1Min; k++) {
          const delta = times[k] - times[k - 1];
          if (delta > max_gap_60s_ms) max_gap_60s_ms = delta;
          if (delta < min_gap_60s_ms) min_gap_60s_ms = delta;
          const dev = Math.abs(delta - 1000);
          if (dev > max_cadence_dev_60s_ms) max_cadence_dev_60s_ms = dev;

          if (delta < 850 || delta > 1150) {
            has_continuous_60s = false;
            gap_count_60s++;
          }
          sample_count_60s++;
        }

        const span_60s_ms = times[idxAt1Min] - times[maxHrIdx];
        const avgInterval60s = sample_count_60s > 0 ? span_60s_ms / sample_count_60s : 0;
        if (sample_count_60s < 57 || avgInterval60s < 950 || avgInterval60s > 1050) {
          has_continuous_60s = false;
        }
      }

      let has_continuous_120s = has_continuous_60s && (idxAt2Min !== -1);
      let max_gap_120s_ms = max_gap_60s_ms;
      let min_gap_120s_ms = min_gap_60s_ms;
      let max_cadence_dev_120s_ms = max_cadence_dev_60s_ms;
      let gap_count_120s = gap_count_60s;
      let sample_count_120s = sample_count_60s;

      if (has_continuous_120s) {
        for (let k = idxAt1Min + 1; k <= idxAt2Min; k++) {
          const delta = times[k] - times[k - 1];
          if (delta > max_gap_120s_ms) max_gap_120s_ms = delta;
          if (delta < min_gap_120s_ms) min_gap_120s_ms = delta;
          const dev = Math.abs(delta - 1000);
          if (dev > max_cadence_dev_120s_ms) max_cadence_dev_120s_ms = dev;

          if (delta < 850 || delta > 1150) {
            has_continuous_120s = false;
            gap_count_120s++;
          }
          sample_count_120s++;
        }

        const span_120s_ms = times[idxAt2Min] - times[maxHrIdx];
        const avgInterval120s = sample_count_120s > 0 ? span_120s_ms / sample_count_120s : 0;
        if (sample_count_120s < 114 || avgInterval120s < 950 || avgInterval120s > 1050) {
          has_continuous_120s = false;
        }
      }

      const closest1min = has_continuous_60s ? hrs[idxAt1Min] : null;
      const closest2min = has_continuous_120s ? hrs[idxAt2Min] : null;

      const drop1 = closest1min !== null ? Math.max(0, hrStartPeak - closest1min) : null;
      const drop2 = closest2min !== null ? Math.max(0, hrStartPeak - closest2min) : null;

      const recoveryLimitations = [
        'Heart rate recovery is an experimental descriptive metric with explicit transition detection.',
        'Evaluates heart rate drop at 60s and 120s following exercise peak (HR >= 115 bpm with drop >= 25 bpm).',
        'Descriptive athletic metric only; not intended for medical use or automated training readiness claims.'
      ];
      if (!has_continuous_60s) {
        recoveryLimitations.push('Discontinuous heart rate stream in 60s window (gap > 1150ms or cadence deviation from 1 Hz); 1-minute recovery unavailable.');
      }
      if (!has_continuous_120s) {
        recoveryLimitations.push('Discontinuous heart rate stream in 120s window (gap > 1150ms or cadence deviation from 1 Hz); 2-minute recovery unavailable.');
      }

      const lineage: RecoveryWindowLineage = {
        source_channel: 'HR',
        transition_start_index: maxHrIdx,
        transition_start_time_ms: recoveryStartTimeMs,
        transition_start_offset_seconds: Math.round((recoveryStartTimeMs - times[0]) / 1000),
        selected_60s_index: idxAt1Min !== -1 ? idxAt1Min : null,
        selected_60s_time_ms: idxAt1Min !== -1 ? times[idxAt1Min] : null,
        selected_60s_offset_seconds: idxAt1Min !== -1 ? Math.round((times[idxAt1Min] - times[0]) / 1000) : null,
        actual_elapsed_offset_60s_ms: idxAt1Min !== -1 ? times[idxAt1Min] - targetTime1MinMs : null,
        selected_120s_index: idxAt2Min !== -1 ? idxAt2Min : null,
        selected_120s_time_ms: idxAt2Min !== -1 ? times[idxAt2Min] : null,
        selected_120s_offset_seconds: idxAt2Min !== -1 ? Math.round((times[idxAt2Min] - times[0]) / 1000) : null,
        actual_elapsed_offset_120s_ms: idxAt2Min !== -1 ? times[idxAt2Min] - targetTime2MinMs : null,
        gap_count_60s,
        gap_count_120s,
        max_cadence_deviation_ms: Math.max(max_cadence_dev_60s_ms, max_cadence_dev_120s_ms)
      };

      const window_continuity: RecoveryWindowContinuity = {
        has_continuous_60s,
        has_continuous_120s,
        cadence_contract: '1.1.0-strict-1hz',
        max_interval_ms: Math.max(max_gap_60s_ms, max_gap_120s_ms),
        min_interval_ms: min_gap_60s_ms === Infinity ? 0 : min_gap_60s_ms,
        max_cadence_deviation_ms: Math.max(max_cadence_dev_60s_ms, max_cadence_dev_120s_ms),
        sample_count_60s,
        sample_count_120s,
        bin_coverage_60s: has_continuous_60s ? sample_count_60s : 0,
        bin_coverage_120s: has_continuous_120s ? sample_count_120s : 0,
        gap_count_60s,
        gap_count_120s,
        average_interval_60s_ms: sample_count_60s > 0 && idxAt1Min !== -1 ? Math.round(((times[idxAt1Min] - times[maxHrIdx]) / sample_count_60s) * 10) / 10 : null,
        average_interval_120s_ms: sample_count_120s > 0 && idxAt2Min !== -1 ? Math.round(((times[idxAt2Min] - times[maxHrIdx]) / sample_count_120s) * 10) / 10 : null
      };

      return {
        transition_detected: true,
        peak_hr_bpm: Math.round(hrStartPeak),
        recovery_start_seconds: Math.round((recoveryStartTimeMs - times[0]) / 1000),
        recovery_1min: drop1,
        recovery_2min: drop2,
        target_time_1min_ms: targetTime1MinMs,
        target_time_2min_ms: targetTime2MinMs,
        hr_at_1min_bpm: closest1min !== null ? Math.round(closest1min) : null,
        hr_at_2min_bpm: closest2min !== null ? Math.round(closest2min) : null,
        window_continuity,
        lineage,
        method,
        version,
        limitations: recoveryLimitations
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    transition_detected: false,
    peak_hr_bpm: null,
    recovery_start_seconds: null,
    recovery_1min: null,
    recovery_2min: null,
    target_time_1min_ms: null,
    target_time_2min_ms: null,
    hr_at_1min_bpm: null,
    hr_at_2min_bpm: null,
    method,
    version,
    limitations: [
      'No post-exercise transition to recovery detected in recording.',
      'Requires peak heart rate >= 115 bpm followed by >= 25 bpm drop within 3 minutes.'
    ]
  };
}

/**
 * Detects a post-activity transition to resting state and calculates HR drop at 1-minute and 2-minute marks.
 * Scans the HR timeseries for a significant drop (>= 25 bpm) from a high level (>= 115 bpm) that stabilizes.
 */
export function calculateRecoveryHr(
  hrs: number[], 
  timestampsMs: number[]
): { recovery_1min: number | null, recovery_2min: number | null } {
  const res = calculateRecoveryHrDetailed(hrs, timestampsMs);
  return { recovery_1min: res.recovery_1min, recovery_2min: res.recovery_2min };
}

export interface CardiacDriftCalculationOptions {
  isWorkloadPower?: boolean;
  isSteadyState?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Calculates Cardiac Drift (Aerobic Decoupling) per Frozen Protocol v1.1.0 Target cardiac_drift_ratio.
 * 
 * Normative specification:
 * - Requires aligned external workload power (Watts) series; Polar H10 ACC motion is strictly
 *   rejected and yields null (no numeric drift from ACC).
 * - Requires explicit steady-state exercise eligibility (isSteadyState: true).
 * - Requires >= 20 minutes (1200 seconds) continuous exercise duration.
 * - Formula: ((HR2 / W2) - (HR1 / W1)) / (HR1 / W1) * 100.
 */
export function calculateCardiacDrift(
  hrs: number[],
  hrTimesMs: number[],
  workloadOrAccSeries?: number[],
  workloadTimesMs?: number[],
  options?: CardiacDriftCalculationOptions
): number | null {
  // Protocol conformance: reject any calculation where workload power is missing or derived from ACC
  if (!options || options.isWorkloadPower !== true || options.isSteadyState !== true) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!hrs || !workloadOrAccSeries || hrs.length === 0 || workloadOrAccSeries.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!hrTimesMs || !workloadTimesMs || hrTimesMs.length === 0 || workloadTimesMs.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const startMs = Math.max(hrTimesMs[0], workloadTimesMs[0]);
  const endMs = Math.min(hrTimesMs[hrTimesMs.length - 1], workloadTimesMs[workloadTimesMs.length - 1]);
  const overlapSeconds = (endMs - startMs) / 1000;

  // Enforce normative >= 20 minutes (1200s) duration requirement
  if (overlapSeconds < 1200) {
    return null;
  }

  const halfTime = startMs + (endMs - startMs) / 2;

  // Compute averages for first half
  let hrSum1 = 0, hrCount1 = 0;
  let wSum1 = 0, wCount1 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < hrs.length; i++) {
    if (hrTimesMs[i] >= startMs && hrTimesMs[i] < halfTime) {
      hrSum1 += hrs[i];
      hrCount1++;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < workloadOrAccSeries.length; i++) {
    if (workloadTimesMs[i] >= startMs && workloadTimesMs[i] < halfTime) {
      wSum1 += workloadOrAccSeries[i];
      wCount1++;
    }
  }

  // Compute averages for second half
  let hrSum2 = 0, hrCount2 = 0;
  let wSum2 = 0, wCount2 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < hrs.length; i++) {
    if (hrTimesMs[i] >= halfTime && hrTimesMs[i] <= endMs) {
      hrSum2 += hrs[i];
      hrCount2++;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < workloadOrAccSeries.length; i++) {
    if (workloadTimesMs[i] >= halfTime && workloadTimesMs[i] <= endMs) {
      wSum2 += workloadOrAccSeries[i];
      wCount2++;
    }
  }

  if (hrCount1 === 0 || hrCount2 === 0 || wCount1 === 0 || wCount2 === 0) return null;

  const avgHr1 = hrSum1 / hrCount1;
  const avgHr2 = hrSum2 / hrCount2;
  const avgW1 = wSum1 / wCount1;
  const avgW2 = wSum2 / wCount2;

  if (avgW1 <= 0 || avgW2 <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(avgW1) || !Number.isFinite(avgW2)) {
    return null;
  }

  const ratio1 = avgHr1 / avgW1;
  const ratio2 = avgHr2 / avgW2;

  const decoupling = ((ratio2 - ratio1) / ratio1) * 100;
  return Math.round(decoupling * 10) / 10;
}

/**
 * CohortAnalysisEngine.ts
 *
 * Implements deterministic descriptive aggregation and same-cohort version comparison
 * for pre-specified technical endpoints across frozen validation cohorts.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-634ad96b79e740879439b4fb4314ebfc
 * - Action Packet ECA-04
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 * - Local-first, fail-closed projection (no recalculation of primary metrics)
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  StudyAnalysisRun,
  StudyEndpoint,
  EndpointMetricType,
  EndpointAggregateSummary,
  MemberEndpointResult,
  AlgorithmCandidateComparison,
  CohortRevision,
  ValidationStudy,
  CohortMember
} from '../../shared/canonical/StudyCohortContract';
import { EmpiricalValidationRun } from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';
import { StudyCohortService } from '../study/StudyCohortService';
import { StudyGovernanceService } from '../study/StudyGovernanceService';

export interface RunCohortAnalysisOptions {
  study_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  revision_number?: number;
  candidate_head: string;
  candidate_id?: string;
  evaluation_plan_id?: string;
  comparison_candidate_head?: string;
  executed_at_utc?: string;
}

export interface CompareCandidatesOptions {
  study_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  revision_number?: number;
  baseline_candidate_head: string;
  comparison_candidate_head: string;
}

export class CohortAnalysisEngine {
  private static instance: CohortAnalysisEngine;

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): CohortAnalysisEngine {
    if (!CohortAnalysisEngine.instance) {
      CohortAnalysisEngine.instance = new CohortAnalysisEngine();
    }
    return CohortAnalysisEngine.instance;
  }

  public getAnalysisRun(analysisId: string): StudyAnalysisRun | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE analysis_id = ?').get(analysisId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;
    return this.mapAnalysisRunRow(row);
  }

  public listAnalysisRuns(studyId?: string, cohortId?: string): StudyAnalysisRun[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (studyId && cohortId) {
      rows = db.prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE study_id = ? AND cohort_id = ? ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC'
      ).all(studyId, cohortId);
    } else if (studyId) {
      rows = db.prepare(
        'SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC'
      ).all(studyId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC').all();
    }
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapAnalysisRunRow(r));
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates pre-specified technical endpoints across a frozen cohort revision.
   * Fail-closed: requires frozen cohort revision to guarantee scientific determinism.
   */
  public runCohortAnalysis(options: RunCohortAnalysisOptions): StudyAnalysisRun {
    const cohortService = StudyCohortService.getInstance();
    const governanceService = StudyGovernanceService.getInstance();

    const study = cohortService.getStudy(options.study_id);
    if (!study) {
      throw new Error(`STUDY_NOT_FOUND: Validation study '${options.study_id}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const cohort = cohortService.getCohort(options.cohort_id);
    if (!cohort) {
      throw new Error(`COHORT_NOT_FOUND: Cohort '${options.cohort_id}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const revNum = options.revision_number !== undefined ? options.revision_number : cohort.current_revision;
    const revision = cohortService.getCohortRevision(options.cohort_id, revNum);
    if (!revision) {
      throw new Error(`REVISION_NOT_FOUND: Cohort revision ${revNum} not found.`);
    }

    if (!revision.is_frozen) {
      throw new Error(
        `COHORT_NOT_FROZEN: Revision ${revNum} of cohort '${options.cohort_id}' is not frozen. Formal cohort analysis requires a frozen revision to prevent membership drift.`
      );
    }

    const endpoints = cohortService.listEndpoints(study.study_id);
    const members = cohortService.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);
    const deviations = cohortService.listDeviations(study.study_id, cohort.cohort_id);

    // Compute endpoint aggregate summaries for candidate_head
    const endpointSummaries = this.computeEndpointSummaries(endpoints, members, options.candidate_head);

    // If comparison candidate specified, compute comparison summaries and deltas
    let comparisons: AlgorithmCandidateComparison[] | undefined = undefined;
    if (options.comparison_candidate_head) {
      comparisons = this.compareCandidatesOnRevision(
        revision,
        endpoints,
        members,
        options.candidate_head,
        options.comparison_candidate_head
      );
    }

    // Completeness Matrix
    const completenessMatrix = governanceService.computeCompletenessMatrix(
      options.study_id,
      options.cohort_id,
      revNum
    );

    const analysisId = `ANALYSIS-${Date.now()}-${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const executedAt = options.executed_at_utc || new Date().toISOString();

    // Compute deterministic results digest
    const digestPayload = JSON.stringify({
      study_id: options.study_id,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      revision_number: revNum,
      revision_hash: revision.revision_hash,
      candidate_head: options.candidate_head,
      comparison_candidate_head: options.comparison_candidate_head || null,
      endpoint_summaries: endpointSummaries.map((s) => ({
        endpoint_id: s.endpoint_id,
        metric_type: s.metric_type,
        aggregated_value: s.aggregated_value,
        total_numerator: s.total_numerator,
        total_denominator: s.total_denominator
      })),
      completeness_matrix: completenessMatrix.summary,
      executed_at: executedAt
    });

    const resultsDigestSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(digestPayload).digest('hex');

    const analysisRun: StudyAnalysisRun = {
      analysis_id: analysisId,
      study_id: options.study_id,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      revision_number: revNum,
      candidate_head: options.candidate_head,
      candidate_id: options.candidate_id,
      evaluation_plan_id: options.evaluation_plan_id,
      comparison_candidate_head: options.comparison_candidate_head,
      status: 'completed',
      results_digest_sha256: resultsDigestSha,
      endpoint_summaries: endpointSummaries,
      completeness_matrix: completenessMatrix,
      deviations_present: deviations,
      comparisons,
      executed_at_utc: executedAt
    };

    // Persist to database
    const db = getDb();
    const summariesJson = JSON.stringify(analysisRun.endpoint_summaries);
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO study_analysis_runs (
        analysis_id, study_id, cohort_id, revision_number, candidate_head,
        comparison_candidate_head, status, results_digest_sha256,
        results_json, endpoint_summaries_json, completeness_matrix_json, deviations_json,
        comparisons_json, executed_at_utc, candidate_id, evaluation_plan_id
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      analysisRun.analysis_id,
      analysisRun.study_id,
      analysisRun.cohort_id,
      analysisRun.revision_number,
      analysisRun.candidate_head,
      analysisRun.comparison_candidate_head || null,
      analysisRun.status,
      analysisRun.results_digest_sha256,
      summariesJson,
      summariesJson,
      JSON.stringify(analysisRun.completeness_matrix),
      JSON.stringify(analysisRun.deviations_present),
      analysisRun.comparisons ? JSON.stringify(analysisRun.comparisons) : null,
      analysisRun.executed_at_utc,
      analysisRun.candidate_id || null,
      analysisRun.evaluation_plan_id || null
    );

    return analysisRun;
  }

  /**
   * Compares two algorithm candidates on the exact same cohort revision.
   */
  public compareCandidates(options: CompareCandidatesOptions): AlgorithmCandidateComparison[] {
    const cohortService = StudyCohortService.getInstance();
    const cohort = cohortService.getCohort(options.cohort_id);
    if (!cohort) {
      throw new Error(`COHORT_NOT_FOUND: Cohort '${options.cohort_id}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const revNum = options.revision_number !== undefined ? options.revision_number : cohort.current_revision;
    const revision = cohortService.getCohortRevision(options.cohort_id, revNum);
    if (!revision) {
      throw new Error(`REVISION_NOT_FOUND: Cohort revision ${revNum} not found.`);
    }

    if (!revision.is_frozen) {
      throw new Error(
        `COHORT_NOT_FROZEN: Comparison requires frozen cohort revision to ensure identical dataset boundaries.`
      );
    }

    const endpoints = cohortService.listEndpoints(options.study_id);
    const members = cohortService.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);

    return this.compareCandidatesOnRevision(
      revision,
      endpoints,
      members,
      options.baseline_candidate_head,
      options.comparison_candidate_head
    );
  }

  private compareCandidatesOnRevision(
    revision: CohortRevision,
    endpoints: StudyEndpoint[],
    members: CohortMember[],
    baselineCandidateHead: string,
    comparisonCandidateHead: string
  ): AlgorithmCandidateComparison[] {
    const baselineSummaries = this.computeEndpointSummaries(endpoints, members, baselineCandidateHead);
    const comparisonSummaries = this.computeEndpointSummaries(endpoints, members, comparisonCandidateHead);

    const comparisons: AlgorithmCandidateComparison[] = [];

    for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
      const bSum = baselineSummaries.find((s) => s.endpoint_id === endpoint.endpoint_id);
      const cSum = comparisonSummaries.find((s) => s.endpoint_id === endpoint.endpoint_id);

      const bVal = bSum?.aggregated_value ?? null;
      const cVal = cSum?.aggregated_value ?? null;

      let absDelta: number | null = null;
      let relDeltaPct: number | null = null;

      if (bVal !== null && cVal !== null) {
        absDelta = Math.round((cVal - bVal) * 10000) / 10000;
        if (Math.abs(bVal) > 1e-7) {
          relDeltaPct = Math.round(((cVal - bVal) / bVal) * 10000) / 100;
        } else {
          relDeltaPct = 0;
        }
      }

      const direction = this.determineComparisonDirection(endpoint.metric_type, bVal, cVal);

      comparisons.push({
        cohort_id: revision.cohort_id,
        cohort_revision: revision.revision_number,
        cohort_revision_hash: revision.revision_hash,
        baseline_candidate_head: baselineCandidateHead,
        comparison_candidate_head: comparisonCandidateHead,
        endpoint_id: endpoint.endpoint_id,
        metric_type: endpoint.metric_type,
        baseline_value: bVal,
        comparison_value: cVal,
        absolute_delta: absDelta,
        relative_delta_percent: relDeltaPct,
        direction
      });
    }

    return comparisons;
  }

  /**
   * Computes summaries for each endpoint across cohort members.
   * Projection-only: reads existing empirical_validation_runs.
   */
  private computeEndpointSummaries(
    endpoints: StudyEndpoint[],
    members: CohortMember[],
    candidateHead: string
  ): EndpointAggregateSummary[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const summaries: EndpointAggregateSummary[] = [];

    // Pre-fetch validation runs for this candidate head across all enrolled datasets
    const runCache = new Map<string, EmpiricalValidationRun>();
    for (const member of members) {
      const row = db.prepare(`
        SELECT * FROM empirical_validation_runs
        WHERE dataset_id = ? AND candidate_head = ?
        ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
      `).get(member.dataset_id, candidateHead) as any;

      if (row) {
        const benchmarks = JSON.parse(row.benchmarks_json);
        runCache.set(member.dataset_id, {
          run_id: row.run_id,
          dataset_id: row.dataset_id,
          dataset_class: row.dataset_class,
          executed_at_utc: row.executed_at_utc,
          candidate_head: row.candidate_head,
          protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
          alignment: JSON.parse(row.alignment_json),
          qrs_benchmark: benchmarks.qrs_benchmark,
          ecg_rr_agreement: benchmarks.ecg_rr_agreement,
          external_workload_drift: benchmarks.external_workload_drift,
          maturity_state: row.maturity_state,
          evidence_debt_recorded: Boolean(row.evidence_debt_recorded),
          debt_description: row.debt_description || undefined,
          run_digest_sha256: row.run_digest_sha256
        });
      }
    }

    for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
      const memberResults: MemberEndpointResult[] = [];

      for (const member of members) {
        const isEligibleMember = member.eligibility_status === 'eligible';
        const valRun = runCache.get(member.dataset_id);

        if (!valRun) {
          memberResults.push({
            member_id: member.member_id,
            subject_id: member.subject_id,
            dataset_id: member.dataset_id,
            stratum: member.stratum,
            metric_type: endpoint.metric_type,
            observed_value: null,
            is_eligible: false,
            notes: 'No validation run found for candidate head.'
          });
          continue;
        }

        const memberMetric = this.extractMemberMetric(endpoint.metric_type, valRun);
        memberResults.push({
          member_id: member.member_id,
          subject_id: member.subject_id,
          dataset_id: member.dataset_id,
          stratum: member.stratum,
          metric_type: endpoint.metric_type,
          observed_value: memberMetric.observed_value,
          numerator: memberMetric.numerator,
          denominator: memberMetric.denominator,
          is_eligible: isEligibleMember && memberMetric.observed_value !== null,
          notes: !isEligibleMember ? member.exclusion_reason : undefined
        });
      }

      // Aggregate across eligible member results
      const eligibleResults = memberResults.filter((r) => r.is_eligible && r.observed_value !== null);
      const excludedCount = memberResults.length - eligibleResults.length;

      let totalNum = 0;
      let totalDenom = 0;
      let hasRatios = false;

      for (const res of eligibleResults) {
        if (res.numerator !== undefined && res.denominator !== undefined) {
          totalNum += res.numerator;
          totalDenom += res.denominator;
          hasRatios = true;
        }
      }

      let aggregatedVal: number | null = null;
      const validObservedValues = eligibleResults.map((r) => r.observed_value as number);

      if (eligibleResults.length > 0) {
        if (endpoint.aggregation_mode === 'pooled' && hasRatios && totalDenom > 0) {
          // Weighted pooled ratio (e.g. total true positives / total reference peaks)
          aggregatedVal = Math.round((totalNum / totalDenom) * 10000) / 10000;
        } else if (endpoint.aggregation_mode === 'dataset_mean') {
          if (endpoint.weighting_mode === 'sample_count_weighted' && hasRatios && totalDenom > 0) {
            let weightedSum = 0;
            for (const res of eligibleResults) {
              weightedSum += (res.observed_value as number) * (res.denominator || 1);
            }
            aggregatedVal = Math.round((weightedSum / totalDenom) * 10000) / 10000;
          } else {
            // Unweighted mean
            const sum = validObservedValues.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
            aggregatedVal = Math.round((sum / validObservedValues.length) * 10000) / 10000;
          }
        } else {
          // Default unweighted mean
          const sum = validObservedValues.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
          aggregatedVal = Math.round((sum / validObservedValues.length) * 10000) / 10000;
        }
      }

      const distribution = this.computeDistribution(validObservedValues);

      summaries.push({
        endpoint_id: endpoint.endpoint_id,
        metric_type: endpoint.metric_type,
        aggregation_mode: endpoint.aggregation_mode,
        weighting_mode: endpoint.weighting_mode,
        total_members_considered: memberResults.length,
        eligible_members_count: eligibleResults.length,
        excluded_members_count: excludedCount,
        total_numerator: totalNum,
        total_denominator: totalDenom,
        aggregated_value: aggregatedVal,
        distribution,
        member_results: memberResults
      });
    }

    return summaries;
  }

  /**
   * Projects endpoint metric from existing validation run benchmarks.
   */
  private extractMemberMetric(
    metricType: EndpointMetricType,
    run: EmpiricalValidationRun
  ): { observed_value: number | null; numerator?: number; denominator?: number } {
    const qrs = run.qrs_benchmark?.windows_50ms;
    const agree = run.ecg_rr_agreement;
    const drift = run.external_workload_drift;

    switch (metricType) {
      case 'qrs_sensitivity':
        if (!qrs) return { observed_value: null };
        return {
          observed_value: qrs.sensitivity,
          numerator: qrs.true_positives,
          denominator: qrs.reference_count
        };

      case 'qrs_ppv':
        if (!qrs) return { observed_value: null };
        return {
          observed_value: qrs.positive_predictive_value,
          numerator: qrs.true_positives,
          denominator: qrs.detected_count
        };

      case 'qrs_f1':
        if (!qrs) return { observed_value: null };
        return {
          observed_value: qrs.f1_score,
          numerator: qrs.true_positives,
          denominator: qrs.reference_count + qrs.detected_count
        };

      case 'timing_error_median_ms':
        if (!qrs || qrs.median_absolute_error_ms === undefined) return { observed_value: null };
        return { observed_value: qrs.median_absolute_error_ms };

      case 'timing_error_p95_ms':
        if (!qrs || qrs.p95_absolute_error_ms === undefined) return { observed_value: null };
        return { observed_value: qrs.p95_absolute_error_ms };

      case 'review_technical_agreement_rate':
        if (!agree || agree.match_rate_50ms === null) return { observed_value: null };
        return {
          observed_value: agree.match_rate_50ms,
          numerator: agree.matched_beats_count,
          denominator: agree.total_evaluated_beats
        };

      case 'workload_steady_state_eligibility':
        if (!drift) return { observed_value: null };
        return {
          observed_value: drift.is_steady_state ? 1.0 : 0.0,
          numerator: drift.is_steady_state ? 1 : 0,
          denominator: 1
        };

      case 'workload_oracle_max_deviation':
        if (!drift || drift.discrepancy_percent === null || drift.discrepancy_percent === undefined) {
          return { observed_value: null };
        }
        return { observed_value: Math.abs(drift.discrepancy_percent) };

      default:
        return { observed_value: null };
    }
  }

  private computeDistribution(values: number[]): {
    min: number | null;
    median: number | null;
    p25: number | null;
    p75: number | null;
    p95: number | null;
    max: number | null;
  } {
    if (values.length === 0) {
      return { min: null, median: null, p25: null, p75: null, p95: null, max: null };
    }

    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const min = sorted[0];
    const max = sorted[sorted.length - 1];

    const p25 = sorted[Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) * 0.25)];
    const median = sorted[Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) * 0.5)];
    const p75 = sorted[Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) * 0.75)];
    const p95 = sorted[Math.floor((sorted.length - 1) * 0.95)];

    return {
      min: Math.round(min * 10000) / 10000,
      p25: Math.round(p25 * 10000) / 10000,
      median: Math.round(median * 10000) / 10000,
      p75: Math.round(p75 * 10000) / 10000,
      p95: Math.round(p95 * 10000) / 10000,
      max: Math.round(max * 10000) / 10000
    };
  }

  private determineComparisonDirection(
    metricType: EndpointMetricType,
    baselineVal: number | null,
    compVal: number | null
  ): 'improved' | 'regressed' | 'unchanged' | 'inconclusive' {
    if (baselineVal === null || compVal === null) return 'inconclusive';
    const delta = compVal - baselineVal;
    if (Math.abs(delta) < 1e-6) return 'unchanged';

    const higherIsBetter = [
      'qrs_sensitivity',
      'qrs_ppv',
      'qrs_f1',
      'review_technical_agreement_rate',
      'workload_steady_state_eligibility'
    ].includes(metricType);

    if (higherIsBetter) {
      return delta > 0 ? 'improved' : 'regressed';
    } else {
      return delta < 0 ? 'improved' : 'regressed';
    }
  }

  private mapAnalysisRunRow(r: any): StudyAnalysisRun {
    const rawSummaries = r.endpoint_summaries_json || r.results_json || '[]';
    return {
      analysis_id: r.analysis_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id,
      revision_number: r.revision_number,
      candidate_head: r.candidate_head,
      candidate_id: r.candidate_id || undefined,
      evaluation_plan_id: r.evaluation_plan_id || undefined,
      comparison_candidate_head: r.comparison_candidate_head || undefined,
      status: r.status,
      results_digest_sha256: r.results_digest_sha256,
      endpoint_summaries: JSON.parse(rawSummaries),
      completeness_matrix: JSON.parse(r.completeness_matrix_json),
      deviations_present: r.deviations_json ? JSON.parse(r.deviations_json) : [],
      comparisons: r.comparisons_json ? JSON.parse(r.comparisons_json) : undefined,
      executed_at_utc: r.executed_at_utc
    };
  }
}

import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export type RootCauseCode =
  | 'ecg_noise_or_drift_detected'
  | 'high_motion_artifact'
  | 'low_overlap'
  | 'rr_timeline_uncertain'
  | 'qrs_detector_low_confidence'
  | 'timestamp_alignment_issue'
  | 'native_rr_quality_limited'
  | 'ecg_quality_limited'
  | 'unknown';

export interface RootCauseHypothesis {
  code: RootCauseCode;
  confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  evidence: string[];
  recommendation: string[];
}

export interface HrRrAgreement {
  match_rate_20ms: number | null;
  match_rate_50ms: number | null;
  median_abs_error_ms: number | null;
  mean_abs_error_ms: number | null;
  p95_abs_error_ms: number | null;
  estimated_lag_ms: number | null;
  estimated_lag_confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'not_applicable';
  overlap_coverage_percent: number;
  compared_intervals_count: number;
  quality: 'good' | 'usable' | 'poor' | 'invalid' | 'not_applicable';
  reason?: string;
  root_cause_hypotheses: RootCauseHypothesis[];
}

/**
 * Calculates ECG/RR match metrics, including lag alignment, match rates, errors, and root cause hypotheses.
 */
export function calculateEcgRrMatchMetrics(
  qrsPeaksMs: number[],
  nativeRrs: number[],
  nativeTimesMs: number[],
  qcMetrics?: {
    ecg_noise_ratio?: number;
    ecg_clipping_seconds?: number;
    ecg_baseline_drift_ratio?: number;
    acc_motion_severity?: string;
    missing_samples_count?: number;
  }
): HrRrAgreement {
  const defaultAgreement: HrRrAgreement = {
    match_rate_20ms: null,
    match_rate_50ms: null,
    median_abs_error_ms: null,
    mean_abs_error_ms: null,
    p95_abs_error_ms: null,
    estimated_lag_ms: null,
    estimated_lag_confidence: 'not_applicable',
    overlap_coverage_percent: 0,
    compared_intervals_count: 0,
    quality: 'not_applicable',
    reason: 'Недостаточно данных для сопоставления',
    root_cause_hypotheses: []
  };

  if (qrsPeaksMs.length < 3 || nativeRrs.length < 3 || nativeTimesMs.length < 3) {
    return defaultAgreement;
  }

  // 1. Build cumulative native RR timeline
  const cumulativeNativeTimes: number[] = [];
  let lastTime = nativeTimesMs[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < nativeRrs.length; i++) {
    // If there is a massive gap in phone receipt timestamps (> 5 seconds), sync up time origin to prevent accumulating drift
    if (i > 0 && (nativeTimesMs[i] - nativeTimesMs[i - 1] > 5000)) {
      lastTime = nativeTimesMs[i];
    } else if (i > 0) {
      lastTime += nativeRrs[i];
    }
    cumulativeNativeTimes.push(lastTime);
  }

  // Build ECG-derived RR intervals from QRS peaks
  const ecgRrs: number[] = [];
  const ecgTimes: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < qrsPeaksMs.length; i++) {
    ecgRrs.push(qrsPeaksMs[i] - qrsPeaksMs[i - 1]);
    ecgTimes.push(qrsPeaksMs[i]);
  }

  // Calculate overlap duration
  const ecgStart = qrsPeaksMs[0];
  const ecgEnd = qrsPeaksMs[qrsPeaksMs.length - 1];
  const natStart = cumulativeNativeTimes[0];
  const natEnd = cumulativeNativeTimes[cumulativeNativeTimes.length - 1];
  const overlapStart = Math.max(ecgStart, natStart);
  const overlapEnd = Math.min(ecgEnd, natEnd);
  
  const totalSpan = Math.max(ecgEnd, natEnd) - Math.min(ecgStart, natStart);
  const overlapSpan = overlapEnd > overlapStart ? (overlapEnd - overlapStart) : 0;
  const overlap_coverage_percent = totalSpan > 0 ? Math.round((overlapSpan / totalSpan) * 1000) / 10 : 0;

  if (overlapSpan === 0 || overlap_coverage_percent < 10.0) {
    return {
      ...defaultAgreement,
      overlap_coverage_percent,
      reason: 'Недостаточное перекрытие сигналов ЭКГ и ЧСС/RR (< 10%)'
    };
  }

  // Helper to evaluate alignment for a specific lag
  function evaluateAlignment(lag: number) {
    const shiftedEcgTimes = ecgTimes.map(t => t + lag);
    const errors: number[] = [];
    let match20 = 0;
    let match50 = 0;
    let compared = 0;

    let nativeIdx = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < ecgRrs.length; i++) {
      const tEcg = shiftedEcgTimes[i];
      const vEcg = ecgRrs[i];

      // Scan native timeline to find the closest timestamp (within 1 second)
      let minDiff = 1000;
      let closestIdx = -1;

      // Optimize search: start scanning from last known position
      while (nativeIdx < cumulativeNativeTimes.length && cumulativeNativeTimes[nativeIdx] < tEcg - 1000) {
        nativeIdx++;
      }

      for (let j = nativeIdx; j < cumulativeNativeTimes.length; j++) {
        const diff = Math.abs(cumulativeNativeTimes[j] - tEcg);
        if (diff > 1000 && cumulativeNativeTimes[j] > tEcg) {
          break; // past window, stop scanning
        }
        if (diff < minDiff) {
          minDiff = diff;
          closestIdx = j;
        }
      }

      if (closestIdx !== -1) {
        const vNat = nativeRrs[closestIdx];
        const err = Math.abs(vEcg - vNat);
        errors.push(err);
        compared++;
        if (err <= 20) match20++;
        if (err <= 50) match50++;
      }
    }

    if (compared === 0) return null;

    // Calculate mean time offset (difference between closest matched timestamps)
    let totalTimeOffset = 0;
    let timeOffsetCount = 0;
    let nativeIdx2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < ecgRrs.length; i++) {
      const tEcg = shiftedEcgTimes[i];
      let minDiff = 1000;
      let closestIdx = -1;

      while (nativeIdx2 < cumulativeNativeTimes.length && cumulativeNativeTimes[nativeIdx2] < tEcg - 1000) {
        nativeIdx2++;
      }
      for (let j = nativeIdx2; j < cumulativeNativeTimes.length; j++) {
        const diff = Math.abs(cumulativeNativeTimes[j] - tEcg);
        if (diff > 1000 && cumulativeNativeTimes[j] > tEcg) {
          break;
        }
        if (diff < minDiff) {
          minDiff = diff;
          closestIdx = j;
        }
      }
      if (closestIdx !== -1) {
        totalTimeOffset += minDiff;
        timeOffsetCount++;
      }
    }
    const meanTimeOffset = timeOffsetCount > 0 ? totalTimeOffset / timeOffsetCount : 1000;

    const sortedErrors = [...errors].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const medianAbsError = sortedErrors[Math.floor(sortedErrors.length / 2)];
    const meanAbsError = errors.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / errors.length;
    const p95AbsError = sortedErrors[Math.floor(sortedErrors.length * 0.95)] || sortedErrors[sortedErrors.length - 1];

    return {
      comparedCount: compared,
      matchRate20: match20 / compared,
      matchRate50: match50 / compared,
      medianAbsError,
      meanAbsError,
      p95AbsError,
      meanTimeOffset
    };
  }

  // Grid search lag checks: -2000 ms to +2000 ms with 20 ms steps
  let bestLag = 0;
  let bestMatchRate50 = -1;
  let bestMetrics: any = null;

  for (let lag = -2000; lag <= 2000; lag += 20) {
    const res = evaluateAlignment(lag);
    if (res && res.comparedCount > 0) {
      if (res.matchRate50 > bestMatchRate50) {
        bestMatchRate50 = res.matchRate50;
        bestLag = lag;
        bestMetrics = res;
      } else if (res.matchRate50 === bestMatchRate50 && bestMetrics) {
        if (res.medianAbsError < bestMetrics.medianAbsError) {
          bestLag = lag;
          bestMetrics = res;
        } else if (res.medianAbsError === bestMetrics.medianAbsError && res.meanTimeOffset < bestMetrics.meanTimeOffset) {
          bestLag = lag;
          bestMetrics = res;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (!bestMetrics || bestMetrics.comparedCount < 5) {
    return {
      ...defaultAgreement,
      overlap_coverage_percent,
      reason: 'Недостаточно совпадающих интервалов для точной синхронизации'
    };
  }

  const compared_intervals_count = bestMetrics.comparedCount;
  const match_rate_20ms = Math.round(bestMetrics.matchRate20 * 1000) / 10;
  const match_rate_50ms = Math.round(bestMetrics.matchRate50 * 1000) / 10;
  const median_abs_error_ms = Math.round(bestMetrics.medianAbsError * 10) / 10;
  const mean_abs_error_ms = Math.round(bestMetrics.meanAbsError * 10) / 10;
  const p95_abs_error_ms = Math.round(bestMetrics.p95AbsError * 10) / 10;

  // Determine lag confidence
  let estimated_lag_confidence: HrRrAgreement['estimated_lag_confidence'] = 'low';
  if (match_rate_50ms >= 85 && compared_intervals_count >= 50) {
    estimated_lag_confidence = 'high';
  } else if (match_rate_50ms >= 70 && compared_intervals_count >= 20) {
    estimated_lag_confidence = 'medium';
  }

  // Determine agreement quality
  let quality: HrRrAgreement['quality'] = 'poor';
  if (match_rate_50ms >= 90 && median_abs_error_ms <= 15) {
    quality = 'good';
  } else if (match_rate_50ms >= 75 && median_abs_error_ms <= 30) {
    quality = 'usable';
  } else if (match_rate_50ms < 40) {
    quality = 'invalid';
  }

  // 4. Classify root causes and generate recommendations
  const hypotheses: RootCauseHypothesis[] = [];
  const addHypothesis = (code: RootCauseCode, confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low', evidence: string[], recs: string[]) => {
    hypotheses.push({ code, confidence, evidence, recommendation: recs });
  };

  const isPoor = quality === 'poor' || quality === 'invalid';

  if (overlap_coverage_percent < 40) {
    addHypothesis('low_overlap', 'medium', 
      [`Коэффициент временного перекрытия каналов составляет ${overlap_coverage_percent}%`],
      ['Проверить одновременность запуска регистрации каналов.']
    );
  }

  if (Math.abs(bestLag) > 500 && match_rate_50ms >= 75) {
    addHypothesis('timestamp_alignment_issue', 'medium',
      [`Обнаружен сдвиг временных меток между каналами на ${bestLag} мс`],
      ['Проверить единую временную шкалу и задержку пакетов источника.']
    );
  }

  if (isPoor) {
    const noiseRatio = qcMetrics?.ecg_noise_ratio ?? 0;
    const clippingSec = qcMetrics?.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? 0;
    const driftRatio = qcMetrics?.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio ?? 0;
    const motionSeverity = qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity ?? 'low';

    if (noiseRatio > 0.15 || clippingSec > 10.0 || driftRatio > 0.20) {
      addHypothesis('ecg_noise_or_drift_detected', 'medium',
        [`Повышенный уровень высокочастотного шума ЭКГ (${Math.round(noiseRatio * 100)}%) или дрейфа изоэлектрической линии (${Math.round(driftRatio * 100)}%)`],
        ['Техническое примечание: проверить уровень шума и стабильность изолинии ЭКГ на выбранном отрезке.']
      );
    }

    if (motionSeverity === 'high' || motionSeverity === 'medium') {
      addHypothesis('high_motion_artifact', 'medium',
        [`Зафиксирована повышенная динамическая активность акселерометра (контекст движения: ${motionSeverity})`],
        ['Техническое примечание: учитывать влияние динамического движения на устойчивость сигнала.']
      );
    }

    if (qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count && qcMetrics.missing_samples_count > 10) {
      addHypothesis('rr_timeline_uncertain', 'low',
        [`Зафиксированы пропуски отсчетов во временном ряду (${qcMetrics.missing_samples_count})`],
        ['Техническое примечание: проверить непрерывность временного ряда.']
      );
    }

    // Default general hypotheses
    if (hypotheses.length === 0) {
      addHypothesis('unknown', 'low',
        ['Согласованность каналов снижена по неустановленным техническим факторам'],
        ['Техническое примечание: требуется дополнительная оценка непрерывности и качества записи.']
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    match_rate_20ms,
    match_rate_50ms,
    median_abs_error_ms,
    mean_abs_error_ms,
    p95_abs_error_ms,
    estimated_lag_ms: bestLag,
    estimated_lag_confidence,
    overlap_coverage_percent,
    compared_intervals_count,
    quality,
    reason: quality === 'good' ? 'Высокая согласованность каналов ЭКГ и ЧСС/RR' : 'Согласованность каналов снижена, имеются расхождения',
    root_cause_hypotheses: hypotheses
  };
}

/**
 * Legacy wrapper to maintain backward compatibility.
 * Returns decimal consistency rating derived from match_rate_50ms.
 */
export function calculateEcgRrConsistency(
  qrsPeaksMs: number[],
  nativeRrs: number[],
  nativeTimesMs: number[]
): number | null {
  const res = calculateEcgRrMatchMetrics(qrsPeaksMs, nativeRrs, nativeTimesMs);
  if (res.match_rate_50ms === null) return null;
  return res.match_rate_50ms / 100;
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/analytics/EmpiricalValidationEngine.ts
================================================================================
/**
 * EmpiricalValidationEngine.ts
 *
 * Coordinates empirical validation runs, produces inspectable evidence packages,
 * enforces claims maturity boundaries, and generates deterministic reports (EVI-07 / EVI-08).
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  EmpiricalDatasetRecord,
  EmpiricalValidationRun,
  EvidenceMaturityState
} from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';
import { TimebaseSynchronizationService } from './TimebaseSynchronizationService';
import { PairedBenchmarkHarness } from './PairedBenchmarkHarness';
import { ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator, ExternalWorkloadInput } from './ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator';
import { FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY, FeatureMaturityLevel } from '../../shared/canonical/FeatureMaturityRegistry';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';

export interface ExecuteRunOptions {
  dataset: EmpiricalDatasetRecord;
  ecgSamples?: Float32Array | number[];
  ecgTimestampsMs?: number[];
  detectedPeaksMs?: number[];
  referencePeaksMs?: number[];
  rawRrIntervalsMs?: number[];
  rawRrTimestampsMs?: number[];
  workloadInput?: ExternalWorkloadInput;
  candidateHead: string;
  frozenReferenceId?: string;
  referenceSha256?: string;
}


export class EmpiricalValidationEngine {
  private static instance: EmpiricalValidationEngine;

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): EmpiricalValidationEngine {
    if (!EmpiricalValidationEngine.instance) {
      EmpiricalValidationEngine.instance = new EmpiricalValidationEngine();
    }
    return EmpiricalValidationEngine.instance;
  }

  public clearRunsForTest(): void {
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM empirical_validation_runs').run();
  }

  public getRun(runId: string): EmpiricalValidationRun | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM empirical_validation_runs WHERE run_id = ?').get(runId) as any;
    if (!row) return undefined;
    return this.mapRunRow(row);
  }

  public listRuns(): EmpiricalValidationRun[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM empirical_validation_runs ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC').all() as any[];
    return rows.map(r => this.mapRunRow(r));
  }

  private mapRunRow(row: any): EmpiricalValidationRun {
    const benchmarks = JSON.parse(row.benchmarks_json);
    return {
      run_id: row.run_id,
      dataset_id: row.dataset_id,
      dataset_class: row.dataset_class as any,
      executed_at_utc: row.executed_at_utc,
      candidate_head: row.candidate_head,
      protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
      alignment: JSON.parse(row.alignment_json),
      qrs_benchmark: benchmarks.qrs_benchmark,
      ecg_rr_agreement: benchmarks.ecg_rr_agreement,
      external_workload_drift: benchmarks.external_workload_drift,
      maturity_state: row.maturity_state as any,
      evidence_debt_recorded: Boolean(row.evidence_debt_recorded),
      debt_description: row.debt_description || undefined,
      run_digest_sha256: row.run_digest_sha256,
      study_lineage: row.study_lineage_json ? JSON.parse(row.study_lineage_json) : undefined,
      frozen_reference_id: row.frozen_reference_id || undefined,
      reference_sha256: row.reference_sha256 || undefined
    };
  }

  /**
   * Executes a validation run and computes maturity state without promoting synthetic to empirical.
   */
  public executeRun(options: ExecuteRunOptions): EmpiricalValidationRun {
    const runId = `valrun_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const { dataset, candidateHead } = options;

    // 1. Timebase synchronization
    const alignment = TimebaseSynchronizationService.alignTimebases({
      primary_channel: 'ECG',
      secondary_channel: 'RR',
      primary_timestamps_ms: options.ecgTimestampsMs || [],
      secondary_timestamps_ms: options.rawRrTimestampsMs || []
    });

    // 2. QRS Benchmark (if reference peaks present)
    let qrsBenchmark: EmpiricalValidationRun['qrs_benchmark'] = undefined;
    if (options.detectedPeaksMs && options.referencePeaksMs && options.referencePeaksMs.length > 0) {
      // Circularity rejection: prohibit algorithm output from serving as its own reference ground truth (QRA-06)
      if (
        (options.frozenReferenceId || dataset.dataset_class === 'paired_empirical') &&
        options.detectedPeaksMs.length === options.referencePeaksMs.length &&
        options.detectedPeaksMs.every((val, idx) => Math.abs(val - options.referencePeaksMs![idx]) < 1e-6)
      ) {
        throw new Error('CIRCULAR_VALIDATION_REJECTED: detected peaks cannot serve as their own reference ground truth');
      }

      const w20 = PairedBenchmarkHarness.evaluateQrsDetection(
        options.detectedPeaksMs,
        options.referencePeaksMs,
        { toleranceMs: 20 }
      );
      const w50 = PairedBenchmarkHarness.evaluateQrsDetection(
        options.detectedPeaksMs,
        options.referencePeaksMs,
        { toleranceMs: 50 }
      );
      qrsBenchmark = {
        windows_20ms: w20,
        windows_50ms: w50
      };
    }

    // 3. ECG vs RR Agreement
    let ecgRrAgreement: EmpiricalValidationRun['ecg_rr_agreement'] = undefined;
    if (
      options.detectedPeaksMs &&
      options.rawRrIntervalsMs &&
      options.rawRrTimestampsMs &&
      options.rawRrIntervalsMs.length > 0
    ) {
      ecgRrAgreement = PairedBenchmarkHarness.evaluateEcgRrAgreement(
        options.detectedPeaksMs,
        options.rawRrIntervalsMs,
        options.rawRrTimestampsMs
      );
    }

    // 4. External Workload Drift
    let externalDrift: EmpiricalValidationRun['external_workload_drift'] = undefined;
    if (options.workloadInput) {
      externalDrift = ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator.validateCardiacDrift(options.workloadInput);
    }

    // 5. Determine Maturity State
    let maturity: EvidenceMaturityState = 'not_evaluated';
    let debtRecorded = false;
    let debtDesc = '';

    if (dataset.dataset_class === 'synthetic_fixture') {
      maturity = 'synthetic_validated';
      debtRecorded = true;
      debtDesc = 'Synthetic dataset passed infrastructure tests; real empirical validation remains outstanding (Validation Debt).';
    } else if (dataset.dataset_class === 'public_benchmark') {
      maturity = 'benchmark_validated';
    } else if (dataset.dataset_class === 'paired_empirical' || dataset.dataset_class === 'local_deidentified_real') {
      if (alignment.is_aligned && qrsBenchmark && qrsBenchmark.windows_50ms.sensitivity > 0.8) {
        maturity = 'empirically_validated';
      } else {
        maturity = 'quality_limited';
        debtRecorded = true;
        debtDesc = 'Paired stream quality or alignment uncertainty limited validation confidence.';
      }
    } else if (dataset.dataset_class === 'external_workload_empirical') {
      if (externalDrift && externalDrift.protocol_tolerance_passed) {
        maturity = 'empirically_validated';
      } else {
        maturity = 'quality_limited';
        debtRecorded = true;
        debtDesc = 'External workload did not satisfy steady-state or duration requirements.';
      }
    }

    // Gating check: fail-closed reference ground truth (QRAFIX-03)
    if (options.frozenReferenceId) {
      const db = getDb();
      const refRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM frozen_consensus_references WHERE reference_id = ?').get(options.frozenReferenceId) as any;
      if (refRow) {
        if (refRow.is_superseded) {
          throw new Error(`SUPERSEDED_REFERENCE_REJECTED: reference ${options.frozenReferenceId} is superseded by ${refRow.superseded_by}`);
        }
        if (refRow.consensus_eligibility && refRow.consensus_eligibility !== 'authoritative') {
          if (maturity === 'empirically_validated') {
            maturity = 'quality_limited';
            debtRecorded = true;
            debtDesc = `Consensus reference ${options.frozenReferenceId} is not authoritative (status: ${refRow.consensus_eligibility}). Promotion to empirical maturity blocked.`;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const digestSource = `${runId}|${dataset.dataset_id}|${dataset.content_sha256}|${candidateHead}|${maturity}|${options.frozenReferenceId || 'none'}`;
    const digestSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(digestSource).digest('hex');

    const runRecord: EmpiricalValidationRun = {
      run_id: runId,
      dataset_id: dataset.dataset_id,
      dataset_class: dataset.dataset_class,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      candidate_head: candidateHead,
      protocol_version: '1.1.0',
      alignment,
      qrs_benchmark: qrsBenchmark,
      ecg_rr_agreement: ecgRrAgreement,
      external_workload_drift: externalDrift,
      maturity_state: maturity,
      evidence_debt_recorded: debtRecorded,
      debt_description: debtDesc,
      run_digest_sha256: digestSha,
      study_lineage: dataset.study_lineage,
      frozen_reference_id: options.frozenReferenceId,
      reference_sha256: options.referenceSha256
    };

    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO empirical_datasets (
        dataset_id, name, dataset_class, provenance_json, timebase_json, channels_json, files_json, admission_status, total_duration_seconds, content_sha256, admitted_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      dataset.dataset_id,
      dataset.name || dataset.dataset_id,
      dataset.dataset_class || 'synthetic_fixture',
      JSON.stringify(dataset.provenance || {}),
      JSON.stringify(dataset.timebase || {}),
      JSON.stringify(dataset.channels || []),
      JSON.stringify(dataset.files || []),
      dataset.admission_status || 'eligible',
      dataset.total_duration_seconds || 0,
      dataset.content_sha256 || 'synthetic',
      dataset.admitted_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
    );

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO empirical_validation_runs (
        run_id, dataset_id, dataset_class, candidate_head, protocol_version,
        maturity_state, evidence_debt_recorded, debt_description, run_digest_sha256,
        alignment_json, benchmarks_json, study_lineage_json, frozen_reference_id,
        reference_sha256, executed_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      runRecord.run_id,
      runRecord.dataset_id,
      runRecord.dataset_class,
      runRecord.candidate_head,
      runRecord.protocol_version,
      runRecord.maturity_state,
      runRecord.evidence_debt_recorded ? 1 : 0,
      runRecord.debt_description || null,
      runRecord.run_digest_sha256,
      JSON.stringify(runRecord.alignment),
      JSON.stringify({
        qrs_benchmark: runRecord.qrs_benchmark,
        ecg_rr_agreement: runRecord.ecg_rr_agreement,
        external_workload_drift: runRecord.external_workload_drift
      }),
      runRecord.study_lineage ? JSON.stringify(runRecord.study_lineage) : null,
      runRecord.frozen_reference_id || null,
      runRecord.reference_sha256 || null,
      runRecord.executed_at_utc
    );

    return runRecord;
  }


  /**
   * Generates a deterministic, data-only evidence report (Markdown and JSON).
   */
  public generateEvidenceReport(run: EmpiricalValidationRun): {
    markdown: string;
    json_summary: Record<string, any>;
  } {
    const jsonSummary = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      run_id: run.run_id,
      dataset_id: run.dataset_id,
      dataset_class: run.dataset_class,
      executed_at_utc: run.executed_at_utc,
      candidate_head: run.candidate_head,
      protocol_version: run.protocol_version,
      evidence_maturity: run.maturity_state,
      evidence_debt_recorded: run.evidence_debt_recorded,
      debt_description: run.debt_description || null,
      alignment_quality: run.alignment.alignment_quality,
      qrs_benchmark: run.qrs_benchmark || null,
      ecg_rr_agreement: run.ecg_rr_agreement || null,
      external_workload_drift: run.external_workload_drift || null,
      run_digest_sha256: run.run_digest_sha256
    };

    const lines: string[] = [
      `# Empirical Validation Evidence Report: ${run.run_id}`,
      '',
      `**Dataset ID:** \`${run.dataset_id}\`  `,
      `**Dataset Class:** \`${run.dataset_class}\`  `,
      `**Executed UTC:** \`${run.executed_at_utc}\`  `,
      `**Candidate Head:** \`${run.candidate_head}\`  `,
      `**Protocol Version:** \`${run.protocol_version}\` (Normative & Frozen)  `,
      `**Evidence Maturity:** \`${run.maturity_state}\`  `,
      `**Integrity Digest SHA-256:** \`${run.run_digest_sha256}\`  `,
      '',
      '## Non-Diagnostic Limitation Disclaimer',
      '> This report represents technical verification and benchmark agreement data only.',
      '> Polar H10 and CardioLab are not clinical or diagnostic medical devices.',
      '> ACC motion magnitude is not mechanical workload power.',
      ''
    ];

    if (run.study_lineage) {
      lines.push(
        '## Study Operations Lineage',
        `- **Plan ID:** \`${run.study_lineage.plan_id}\` (rev ${run.study_lineage.plan_revision})`,
        `- **Capture Session ID:** \`${run.study_lineage.session_id}\``,
        `- **Admitted At UTC:** \`${run.study_lineage.admitted_at_utc}\``,
        ''
      );
    }

    if (run.evidence_debt_recorded) {
      lines.push(
        '## Evidence Debt Notification',
        `> **Status:** Validation Debt Recorded  `,
        `> **Reason:** ${run.debt_description}`,
        ''
      );
    }

    lines.push(
      '## 1. Time Alignment & Clock Evidence',
      `- **Primary Channel:** \`${run.alignment.primary_channel}\``,
      `- **Secondary Channel:** \`${run.alignment.secondary_channel}\``,
      `- **Method:** \`${run.alignment.alignment_method}\``,
      `- **Offset:** \`${run.alignment.offset_ms} ms\``,
      `- **Residual Uncertainty:** \`${run.alignment.residual_uncertainty_ms} ms\``,
      `- **Quality:** \`${run.alignment.alignment_quality}\``,
      ''
    );

    if (run.qrs_benchmark) {
      const b20 = run.qrs_benchmark.windows_20ms;
      const b50 = run.qrs_benchmark.windows_50ms;
      lines.push(
        '## 2. Paired QRS Detection Benchmark',
        '| Window | Ref Beats | Detected | TP | FP | FN | Sensitivity | PPV | F1 | Mean Error |',
        '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |',
        `| ±20 ms | ${b20.reference_count} | ${b20.detected_count} | ${b20.true_positives} | ${b20.false_positives} | ${b20.false_negatives} | ${b20.sensitivity} | ${b20.positive_predictive_value} | ${b20.f1_score} | ${b20.mean_absolute_error_ms} ms |`,
        `| ±50 ms | ${b50.reference_count} | ${b50.detected_count} | ${b50.true_positives} | ${b50.false_positives} | ${b50.false_negatives} | ${b50.sensitivity} | ${b50.positive_predictive_value} | ${b50.f1_score} | ${b50.mean_absolute_error_ms} ms |`,
        ''
      );
    }

    if (run.ecg_rr_agreement) {
      const agr = run.ecg_rr_agreement;
      lines.push(
        '## 3. ECG vs RR Multi-modal Technical Agreement',
        `- **Total Evaluated Beats:** ${agr.total_evaluated_beats}`,
        `- **Matched Beats:** ${agr.matched_beats_count}`,
        `- **Match Rate (±50ms):** ${agr.match_rate_50ms !== null ? `${agr.match_rate_50ms}%` : 'N/A'}`,
        `- **Mean Difference:** ${agr.mean_abs_difference_ms !== null ? `${agr.mean_abs_difference_ms} ms` : 'N/A'}`,
        `- **Agreement State:** \`${agr.agreement_state}\``,
        `- **Quality Stratum:** \`${agr.quality_stratum}\``,
        ''
      );
    }

    if (run.external_workload_drift) {
      const dr = run.external_workload_drift;
      lines.push(
        '## 4. External Workload Cardiac Drift Validation',
        `- **Status:** \`${dr.status}\``,
        `- **Workload Channel:** \`${dr.workload_channel}\``,
        `- **Duration:** ${dr.duration_seconds}s`,
        `- **Production Measured Drift:** ${dr.measured_drift_percent !== null ? `${dr.measured_drift_percent}%` : 'N/A'}`,
        `- **Independent Oracle Drift:** ${dr.independent_oracle_drift_percent !== null ? `${dr.independent_oracle_drift_percent}%` : 'N/A'}`,
        `- **Discrepancy:** ${dr.discrepancy_percent !== null ? `${dr.discrepancy_percent}%` : 'N/A'}`,
        `- **Protocol Tolerance Passed:** \`${dr.protocol_tolerance_passed}\``,
        ''
      );
    }

    return {
      markdown: lines.join('\n'),
      json_summary: jsonSummary
    };
  }
}

FILE: src/backend/analytics/ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator.ts
================================================================================
/**
 * ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator.ts
 *
 * Implements external-workload cardiac drift validation harness (EVI-06).
 * Accepts ONLY approved external workload power or pace data.
 * Rejects ACC motion as mechanical workload power.
 * Compares production calculation against an independent reference oracle.
 */

import {
  ExternalWorkloadDriftResult
} from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';
import { calculateCardiacDrift } from './cardio';

export interface ExternalWorkloadInput {
  hrs: number[];
  hr_timestamps_ms: number[];
  workload_series: number[];
  workload_timestamps_ms: number[];
  channel_type: 'WORKLOAD_POWER' | 'WORKLOAD_PACE' | 'ACC';
  is_steady_state: boolean;
}

export class ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator {
  /**
   * Evaluates cardiac drift against the production implementation and an independent oracle.
   */
  public static validateCardiacDrift(input: ExternalWorkloadInput): ExternalWorkloadDriftResult {
    const ineligibilityReasons: string[] = [];
    const scientificLimitation =
      'Cardiac drift (aerobic decoupling) requires >= 20 minutes (1200s) of steady-state exercise with aligned external workload power/pace. Polar H10 ACC motion is not a substitute.';

    // 1. Channel verification: ACC motion is strictly rejected
    if (input.channel_type === 'ACC') {
      ineligibilityReasons.push('ACC motion magnitude is not mechanical workload power. External power or pace meter is required.');
      return {
        evaluation_id: `drift_eval_${Date.now()}`,
        status: 'ineligible',
        workload_channel: 'WORKLOAD_POWER',
        duration_seconds: 0,
        is_steady_state: false,
        early_segment: null,
        late_segment: null,
        measured_drift_percent: null,
        independent_oracle_drift_percent: null,
        discrepancy_percent: null,
        protocol_tolerance_passed: false,
        ineligibility_reasons: ineligibilityReasons,
        scientific_limitation: scientificLimitation
      };
    }

    // 2. Steady state verification
    if (!input.is_steady_state) {
      ineligibilityReasons.push('Exercise protocol must be steady-state (constant pace or power). Non-steady effort invalidates drift ratio.');
    }

    // 3. Duration check
    const startMs = Math.max(input.hr_timestamps_ms[0] || 0, input.workload_timestamps_ms[0] || 0);
    const endMs = Math.min(
      input.hr_timestamps_ms[input.hr_timestamps_ms.length - 1] || 0,
      input.workload_timestamps_ms[input.workload_timestamps_ms.length - 1] || 0
    );
    const durationSec = Math.max(0, (endMs - startMs) / 1000);

    if (durationSec < 1200) {
      ineligibilityReasons.push(`Exercise duration ${Math.round(durationSec)}s is under normative 1200s (20 min) protocol threshold.`);
    }

    if (ineligibilityReasons.length > 0) {
      return {
        evaluation_id: `drift_eval_${Date.now()}`,
        status: 'ineligible',
        workload_channel: input.channel_type,
        duration_seconds: durationSec,
        is_steady_state: input.is_steady_state,
        early_segment: null,
        late_segment: null,
        measured_drift_percent: null,
        independent_oracle_drift_percent: null,
        discrepancy_percent: null,
        protocol_tolerance_passed: false,
        ineligibility_reasons: ineligibilityReasons,
        scientific_limitation: scientificLimitation
      };
    }

    // 4. Production calculation
    const prodResult = calculateCardiacDrift(
      input.hrs,
      input.hr_timestamps_ms,
      input.workload_series,
      input.workload_timestamps_ms,
      {
        isWorkloadPower: true,
        isSteadyState: true
      }
    );

    // 5. Independent Oracle calculation
    const oracleResult = ExternalWorkloadDriftValidator.computeOracleDrift(
      input.hrs,
      input.hr_timestamps_ms,
      input.workload_series,
      input.workload_timestamps_ms,
      startMs,
      endMs
    );

    let discrepancy = 0;
    let passed = false;

    if (prodResult !== null && oracleResult.driftPercent !== null) {
      discrepancy = Math.abs(prodResult - oracleResult.driftPercent);
      // Tolerance: within 0.1% drift
      passed = discrepancy <= 0.15;
    }

    return {
      evaluation_id: `drift_eval_${Date.now()}`,
      status: 'evaluated',
      workload_channel: input.channel_type,
      duration_seconds: durationSec,
      is_steady_state: true,
      early_segment: oracleResult.early,
      late_segment: oracleResult.late,
      measured_drift_percent: prodResult,
      independent_oracle_drift_percent: oracleResult.driftPercent,
      discrepancy_percent: Math.round(discrepancy * 100) / 100,
      protocol_tolerance_passed: passed,
      ineligibility_reasons: [],
      scientific_limitation: scientificLimitation
    };
  }

  private static computeOracleDrift(
    hrs: number[],
    hrTimes: number[],
    workloads: number[],
    wTimes: number[],
    startMs: number,
    endMs: number
  ) {
    const halfMs = startMs + (endMs - startMs) / 2;

    let hrSum1 = 0, hrCount1 = 0;
    let wSum1 = 0, wCount1 = 0;
    let hrSum2 = 0, hrCount2 = 0;
    let wSum2 = 0, wCount2 = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < hrs.length; i++) {
      const t = hrTimes[i];
      if (t >= startMs && t < halfMs) {
        hrSum1 += hrs[i];
        hrCount1++;
      } else if (t >= halfMs && t <= endMs) {
        hrSum2 += hrs[i];
        hrCount2++;
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < workloads.length; i++) {
      const t = wTimes[i];
      if (t >= startMs && t < halfMs) {
        wSum1 += workloads[i];
        wCount1++;
      } else if (t >= halfMs && t <= endMs) {
        wSum2 += workloads[i];
        wCount2++;
      }
    }

    if (hrCount1 === 0 || hrCount2 === 0 || wCount1 === 0 || wCount2 === 0) {
      return { driftPercent: null, early: null, late: null };
    }

    const avgHr1 = hrSum1 / hrCount1;
    const avgW1 = wSum1 / wCount1;
    const avgHr2 = hrSum2 / hrCount2;
    const avgW2 = wSum2 / wCount2;

    const ratio1 = avgHr1 / avgW1;
    const ratio2 = avgHr2 / avgW2;

    const drift = ((ratio2 - ratio1) / ratio1) * 100;

    return {
      driftPercent: Math.round(drift * 10) / 10,
      early: {
        start_sec: 0,
        end_sec: (halfMs - startMs) / 1000,
        avg_hr_bpm: Math.round(avgHr1 * 10) / 10,
        avg_workload: Math.round(avgW1 * 10) / 10,
        ratio: Math.round(ratio1 * 1000) / 1000
      },
      late: {
        start_sec: (halfMs - startMs) / 1000,
        end_sec: (endMs - startMs) / 1000,
        avg_hr_bpm: Math.round(avgHr2 * 10) / 10,
        avg_workload: Math.round(avgW2 * 10) / 10,
        ratio: Math.round(ratio2 * 1000) / 1000
      }
    };
  }
}
