export function calculateRollingMedian(values: number[]): number {
  if (values.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const half = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  if (sorted.length % 2 !== 0) {
    return sorted[half];
  }
  return (sorted[half - 1] + sorted[half]) / 2;
}

function median(values: number[]): number {
  return calculateRollingMedian(values);
}

export interface RrClassificationResult {
  raw_rr_ms: number;
  final_status: 'valid_nn' | 'physiologic_out_of_bounds' | 'outlier_artifact';
  primary_exclusion_reason: 'none' | 'physiologic_limit' | 'median_deviation';
  reason_flags: string[];
  used_in_nn: boolean;
  no_correction_performed: boolean;
  algorithm_version: string;
}

/**
 * Classifies RR intervals using a bounded initial window warm-up policy.
 * Initial warm-up (recent.length < 3) uses the median of the first 5 physiological beats (300-2000 ms).
 */
export function classifyRrSequence(rrs: number[]): RrClassificationResult[] {
  const results: RrClassificationResult[] = [];
  const recent: number[] = [];
  const algVersion = '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD';

  const validBeats = rrs.filter(r => r >= 300 && r <= 2000);
  const first5Valid = validBeats.slice(0, 5);
  const initialSeedMed = first5Valid.length > 0 ? median(first5Valid) : 1000;

  for (let i = 0; i < rrs.length; i++) {
    const val = rrs[i];

    if (val < 300 || val > 2000) {
      results.push({
        raw_rr_ms: val,
        final_status: 'physiologic_out_of_bounds',
        primary_exclusion_reason: 'physiologic_limit',
        reason_flags: ['out_of_bounds'],
        used_in_nn: false,
        no_correction_performed: true,
        algorithm_version: algVersion
      });
      continue;
    }

    const med = recent.length >= 3 ? median(recent) : initialSeedMed;
    const diffPercent = Math.abs(val - med) / med;

    if (diffPercent > 0.20) {
      results.push({
        raw_rr_ms: val,
        final_status: 'outlier_artifact',
        primary_exclusion_reason: 'median_deviation',
        reason_flags: ['relative_deviation_exceeded'],
        used_in_nn: false,
        no_correction_performed: true,
        algorithm_version: algVersion
      });
      continue;
    }

    results.push({
      raw_rr_ms: val,
      final_status: 'valid_nn',
      primary_exclusion_reason: 'none',
      reason_flags: [],
      used_in_nn: true,
      no_correction_performed: true,
      algorithm_version: algVersion
    });

    recent.push(val);
    if (recent.length > 10) {
      recent.shift();
    }
  }

  return results;
}

/**
 * Filters out-of-bounds RR values and rejects outliers.
 */
export function cleanRrIntervals(rrs: number[]): number[] {
  const classifications = classifyRrSequence(rrs);
  return classifications.filter(c => c.used_in_nn).map(c => c.raw_rr_ms);
}

export interface HrvMetrics {
  sdnn: number | null;
  rmssd: number | null;
  pnn50: number | null;
}

export interface ContiguousBeatInput {
  beat_index?: number;
  raw_rr_ms: number | null;
  accepted_for_nn: boolean;
  phone_timestamp_ms?: number | null;
  sensor_timestamp_ns?: number | null;
}

/**
 * Calculates authoritative time-domain HRV metrics strictly adhering to pair contiguity.
 * RMSSD and pNN50 evaluate ONLY beats that are strictly adjacent in original sequence
 * without intervening missing, corrupted, or excluded beats, and without time gaps > 3000ms.
 * SDNN is sample standard deviation (N - 1) over all accepted NN intervals.
 */
export function calculateLedgerHrvMetrics(beats: ContiguousBeatInput[]): HrvMetrics & { valid_pair_count: number; accepted_nn_count: number } {
  const cleanNns: number[] = [];
  let squareDiffsSumSuccessive = 0;
  let nn50Count = 0;
  let validPairCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < beats.length; i++) {
    const beat = beats[i];
    if (beat.accepted_for_nn && beat.raw_rr_ms !== null && beat.raw_rr_ms > 0) {
      cleanNns.push(beat.raw_rr_ms);
    }

    if (i > 0) {
      const prevBeat = beats[i - 1];
      // Contiguity check: both must be accepted, adjacent, and without timebase gaps
      const bothAccepted = Boolean(
        beat.accepted_for_nn && prevBeat.accepted_for_nn &&
        beat.raw_rr_ms !== null && prevBeat.raw_rr_ms !== null &&
        beat.raw_rr_ms > 0 && prevBeat.raw_rr_ms > 0
      );

      if (bothAccepted) {
        // Check beat_index adjacency if present
        const indexAdjacent = (beat.beat_index !== undefined && prevBeat.beat_index !== undefined)
          ? beat.beat_index === prevBeat.beat_index + 1
          : true;

        let hasGap = false;
        if (beat.sensor_timestamp_ns != null && prevBeat.sensor_timestamp_ns != null) {
          const deltaNs = beat.sensor_timestamp_ns - prevBeat.sensor_timestamp_ns;
          if (deltaNs <= 0 || deltaNs > 3e9) hasGap = true;
        } else if (beat.phone_timestamp_ms != null && prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms != null) {
          const deltaMs = beat.phone_timestamp_ms - prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms;
          if (deltaMs < 0 || deltaMs > 3000) hasGap = true;
        }

        if (indexAdjacent && !hasGap) {
          const diff = beat.raw_rr_ms! - prevBeat.raw_rr_ms!;
          squareDiffsSumSuccessive += diff * diff;
          validPairCount++;
          if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
            nn50Count++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 1. SDNN: sample variance over all accepted NN intervals
  let sdnn: number | null = null;
  if (cleanNns.length >= 2) {
    const mean = cleanNns.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / cleanNns.length;
    const squareDiffsSum = cleanNns.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - mean) ** 2, 0);
    sdnn = Math.sqrt(squareDiffsSum / (cleanNns.length - 1));
  }

  // 2. RMSSD & pNN50: over valid adjacent pairs
  const rmssd = validPairCount > 0
    ? Math.sqrt(squareDiffsSumSuccessive / validPairCount)
    : null;

  const pnn50 = validPairCount > 0
    ? (nn50Count / validPairCount) * 100
    : null;

  return {
    sdnn: sdnn !== null ? Math.round(sdnn * 10) / 10 : null,
    rmssd: rmssd !== null ? Math.round(rmssd * 10) / 10 : null,
    pnn50: pnn50 !== null ? Math.round(pnn50 * 10) / 10 : null,
    valid_pair_count: validPairCount,
    accepted_nn_count: cleanNns.length
  };
}

/**
 * Calculates time-domain HRV metrics: SDNN, RMSSD, and pNN50.
 */
export function calculateHrvMetrics(cleanRrs: number[]): HrvMetrics {
  if (cleanRrs.length === 0) {
    return { sdnn: null, rmssd: null, pnn50: null };
  }

  // 1. SDNN
  let sdnn: number | null = null;
  if (cleanRrs.length >= 2) {
    const mean = cleanRrs.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / cleanRrs.length;
    const squareDiffsSum = cleanRrs.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - mean) ** 2, 0);
    sdnn = Math.sqrt(squareDiffsSum / (cleanRrs.length - 1));
  }

  // 2. RMSSD & pNN50
  let squareDiffsSumSuccessive = 0;
  let nn50Count = 0;
  let successiveDifferencesCount = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < cleanRrs.length; i++) {
    const diff = cleanRrs[i] - cleanRrs[i - 1];
    squareDiffsSumSuccessive += diff ** 2;
    successiveDifferencesCount++;

    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      nn50Count++;
    }
  }

  const rmssd = successiveDifferencesCount > 0
    ? Math.sqrt(squareDiffsSumSuccessive / successiveDifferencesCount)
    : null;

  const pnn50 = successiveDifferencesCount > 0
    ? (nn50Count / successiveDifferencesCount) * 100
    : null;

  return {
    sdnn: sdnn !== null ? Math.round(sdnn * 10) / 10 : null,
    rmssd: rmssd !== null ? Math.round(rmssd * 10) / 10 : null,
    pnn50: pnn50 !== null ? Math.round(pnn50 * 10) / 10 : null
  };
}


export interface HrvTrendPoint {
  timeOffsetMs: number;
  rmssd: number;
}

/**
 * Computes 5-minute rolling RMSSD trend points across the session.
 */
export function calculateRollingHrvTrend(
  cleanRrs: number[],
  timestampsMs: number[],
  windowDurationMs = 300000,
  stepDurationMs = 60000
): HrvTrendPoint[] {
  if (cleanRrs.length === 0 || cleanRrs.length !== timestampsMs.length) {
    return [];
  }

  const trend: HrvTrendPoint[] = [];
  const maxTime = timestampsMs[timestampsMs.length - 1] + cleanRrs[cleanRrs.length - 1];

  for (let windowStart = 0; windowStart <= maxTime - windowDurationMs; windowStart += stepDurationMs) {
    const windowEnd = windowStart + windowDurationMs;
    
    const windowRrs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < timestampsMs.length; i++) {
      if (timestampsMs[i] >= windowStart && timestampsMs[i] < windowEnd) {
        windowRrs.push(cleanRrs[i]);
      }
    }

    if (windowRrs.length >= 50) {
      const metrics = calculateHrvMetrics(windowRrs);
      if (metrics.rmssd !== null) {
        trend.push({
          timeOffsetMs: windowStart + windowDurationMs / 2,
          rmssd: metrics.rmssd
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return trend;
}

export interface PoincareMetrics {
  sd1: number | null;
  sd2: number | null;
  ratio: number | null;
}



/**
 * Natural Cubic Spline Interpolator for unevenly sampled RR intervals.
 */
function cubicSplineResample(x: number[], y: number[], fs: number): number[] {
  const n = x.length;
  if (n < 4) return [];

  const h: number[] = new Array(n - 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    h[i] = x[i + 1] - x[i];
    if (h[i] <= 0) return [];
  }

  const alpha: number[] = new Array(n - 1);
  for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
    alpha[i] = (3 / h[i]) * (y[i + 1] - y[i]) - (3 / h[i - 1]) * (y[i] - y[i - 1]);
  }

  const l: number[] = new Array(n);
  const mu: number[] = new Array(n);
  const z: number[] = new Array(n);
  l[0] = 1; mu[0] = 0; z[0] = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
    l[i] = 2 * (x[i + 1] - x[i - 1]) - h[i - 1] * mu[i - 1];
    mu[i] = h[i] / l[i];
    z[i] = (alpha[i] - h[i - 1] * z[i - 1]) / l[i];
  }

  l[n - 1] = 1; z[n - 1] = 0;
  const c: number[] = new Array(n).fill(0);
  const b: number[] = new Array(n - 1).fill(0);
  const d: number[] = new Array(n - 1).fill(0);

  for (let j = n - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
    c[j] = z[j] - mu[j] * c[j + 1];
    b[j] = (y[j + 1] - y[j]) / h[j] - h[j] * (c[j + 1] + 2 * c[j]) / 3;
    d[j] = (c[j + 1] - c[j]) / (3 * h[j]);
  }

  const totalDuration = x[n - 1];
  const numSamples = Math.floor(totalDuration * fs);
  const resampled: number[] = [];

  let idx = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < numSamples; k++) {
    const t = k / fs;
    while (idx < n - 2 && x[idx + 1] <= t) {
      idx++;
    }
    const dt = t - x[idx];
    const val = y[idx] + b[idx] * dt + c[idx] * dt * dt + d[idx] * dt * dt * dt;
    resampled.push(val);
  }

  return resampled;
}

export function calculatePoincareMetrics(cleanRrs: number[]): PoincareMetrics {
  if (!cleanRrs || cleanRrs.length < 31 || cleanRrs.some(v => typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0)) {
    return { sd1: null, sd2: null, ratio: null };
  }

  const totalDurationSec = cleanRrs.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / 1000;
  if (totalDurationSec < 300 - 1e-4) {
    return { sd1: null, sd2: null, ratio: null };
  }

  const diffs: number[] = [];
  const sums: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cleanRrs.length - 1; i++) {
    diffs.push((cleanRrs[i + 1] - cleanRrs[i]) / Math.SQRT2);
    sums.push((cleanRrs[i + 1] + cleanRrs[i]) / Math.SQRT2);
  }

  const meanDiff = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / diffs.length;
  const meanSum = sums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / sums.length;
  const varDiff = diffs.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d - meanDiff) ** 2, 0) / (diffs.length - 1);
  const varSum = sums.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s - meanSum) ** 2, 0) / (sums.length - 1);

  const sd1 = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, varDiff));
  const sd2 = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, varSum));
  const sd1Val = Math.round(sd1 * 10) / 10;
  const sd2Val = Math.round(sd2 * 10) / 10;
  const ratio = (sd2Val !== null && sd2Val > 0) ? Math.round((sd1 / sd2) * 100) / 100 : null;

  return {
    sd1: sd1Val,
    sd2: sd2Val,
    ratio: ratio
  };
}

export interface FrequencyDomainHrvMetrics {
  lf_power: number | null;
  hf_power: number | null;
  lf_hf_ratio: number | null;
}

/**
 * Calculates frequency-domain HRV metrics (LF, HF, LF/HF ratio) for a clean RR/NN sequence.
 * Uses cubic-spline 4 Hz resampling, Hann-windowed Welch PSD (256 samples, 50% overlap).
 * Bands: LF [0.04 - 0.15 Hz), HF [0.15 - 0.40 Hz].
 */
export function calculateFrequencyDomainHrv(cleanRrs: number[]): FrequencyDomainHrvMetrics {
  if (!cleanRrs || cleanRrs.length < 10 || cleanRrs.some(v => typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0)) {
    return { lf_power: null, hf_power: null, lf_hf_ratio: null };
  }

  // 1. Construct cumulative timestamps in seconds & compute total valid NN duration
  const x: number[] = [0];
  const y: number[] = [...cleanRrs];
  let totalDurationSec = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < cleanRrs.length - 1; i++) {
    totalDurationSec += cleanRrs[i] / 1000;
    x.push(totalDurationSec);
  }
  totalDurationSec += cleanRrs[cleanRrs.length - 1] / 1000;

  // Protocol v1.1.0 requirement: Minimum analytical window is 300 seconds (5 minutes)
  if (totalDurationSec < 300 - 1e-4) {
    return { lf_power: null, hf_power: null, lf_hf_ratio: null };
  }

  // 2. Resample at fs = 4 Hz using cubic spline
  const fs = 4;
  const resampled = cubicSplineResample(x, y, fs);
  const N_fft = 256;

  if (resampled.length < N_fft) {
    return { lf_power: null, hf_power: null, lf_hf_ratio: null };
  }

  // 3. Mean detrending
  const mean = resampled.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / resampled.length;
  const detrended = resampled.map(v => v - mean);

  // Constant input check
  const varSum = detrended.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v * v, 0);
  if (varSum === 0) {
    return { lf_power: 0, hf_power: 0, lf_hf_ratio: null };
  }

  // 4. Welch PSD: DFT-even Hann window (SciPy 1.11.3 get_window('hann', 256)), 256 samples, 50% overlap (shift = 128)
  const shift = 128;
  const hann: number[] = new Array(N_fft);
  let winSumSq = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < N_fft; n++) {
    hann[n] = 0.5 * (1 - Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * n) / N_fft));
    winSumSq += hann[n] * hann[n];
  }

  const numSegments = Math.floor((detrended.length - N_fft) / shift) + 1;
  if (numSegments < 1) {
    return { lf_power: null, hf_power: null, lf_hf_ratio: null };
  }

  const psdAccum: number[] = new Array(Math.floor(N_fft / 2) + 1).fill(0);

  for (let seg = 0; seg < numSegments; seg++) {
    const start = seg * shift;
    const windowed: number[] = new Array(N_fft);
    for (let n = 0; n < N_fft; n++) {
      windowed[n] = detrended[start + n] * hann[n];
    }

    for (let k = 0; k <= N_fft / 2; k++) {
      let re = 0;
      let im = 0;
      for (let n = 0; n < N_fft; n++) {
        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * k * n) / N_fft;
        re += windowed[n] * Math.cos(angle);
        im -= windowed[n] * Math.sin(angle);
      }
      const power = (re * re + im * im) / (fs * winSumSq);
      const factor = (k === 0 || k === N_fft / 2) ? 1 : 2;
      psdAccum[k] += power * factor;
    }
  }

  const psdAvg = psdAccum.map(p => p / numSegments);
  const df = fs / N_fft; // 0.015625 Hz

  let lfPower = 0;
  let hfPower = 0;

  for (let k = 0; k <= N_fft / 2; k++) {
    const freq = k * df;
    if (freq >= 0.04 && freq < 0.15) {
      lfPower += psdAvg[k] * df;
    } else if (freq >= 0.15 && freq <= 0.40) {
      hfPower += psdAvg[k] * df;
    }
  }

  const lfVal = Math.round(lfPower * 100) / 100;
  const hfVal = Math.round(hfPower * 100) / 100;
  const ratioVal = (hfVal > 0 && hfPower > 0) ? Math.round((lfPower / hfPower) * 100) / 100 : null;

  return {
    lf_power: lfVal,
    hf_power: hfVal,
    lf_hf_ratio: ratioVal
  };
}

import { DfaAnalysisResult, DfaRegimeResult, DfaScalingPoint } from '../../shared/canonical/MetricResult';

/**
 * Calculates Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA) Peng et al. (1995) for a sequence of NN intervals.
 * 
 * Regimes:
 * - Alpha 1 (short-term fractal scaling): scales n in [4, 16]
 * - Alpha 2 (long-term fractal scaling): scales n in [16, 64]
 * 
 * Maturity: Experimental
 * Observational fractal scaling; not for medical diagnosis, training prescription, or clinical readiness.
 */
export function calculateDfa(
  cleanNns: number[],
  sourceLedgerId: string = 'unknown_source'
): DfaAnalysisResult {
  const disclosure = 'Experimental fractal scaling metric of NN intervals; not an indicator of training readiness or recovery prescription.';
  const defaultRegime = (minN: number, maxN: number): DfaRegimeResult => ({
    alpha: null,
    r_squared: null,
    min_scale: minN,
    max_scale: maxN,
    points_count: 0,
    scaling_curve: [],
    eligibility: 'ineligible',
    limitations: ['Insufficient accepted NN intervals for stable DFA calculation.']
  });

  const totalDurationSec = cleanNns && cleanNns.length > 0 
    ? cleanNns.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / 1000 
    : 0;

  if (!cleanNns || cleanNns.length < 32) {
    return {
      target_id: 'dfa_alpha1_alpha2',
      method_id: 'src/backend/analytics/dfa.ts:calculateDfa',
      method_version: '1.0.0',
      maturity: 'Experimental',
      alpha1: defaultRegime(4, 16),
      alpha2: defaultRegime(16, 64),
      total_nn_count: cleanNns ? cleanNns.length : 0,
      continuous_duration_seconds: Math.round(totalDurationSec * 10) / 10,
      source_ledger_id: sourceLedgerId,
      user_facing_disclosure: disclosure,
      limitations: ['Minimum 32 NN intervals required for baseline DFA computation.']
    };
  }

  const N = cleanNns.length;
  // 1. Mean-center and integrate
  const meanNN = cleanNns.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / N;
  const y: number[] = new Array(N);
  let cumSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    cumSum += (cleanNns[i] - meanNN);
    y[i] = cumSum;
  }

  // 2. Define scale ranges
  // Alpha 1: n from 4 to 16 (step 1)
  const scales1: number[] = [];
  for (let s = 4; s <= Math.min(16, Math.floor(N / 4)); s++) {
    scales1.push(s);
  }

  // Alpha 2: n from 16 to 64 (log/int spaced or step 2/4)
  const scales2: number[] = [];
  const maxScale2 = Math.min(64, Math.floor(N / 4));
  for (let s = 16; s <= maxScale2; s += 2) {
    scales2.push(s);
  }

  // Helper to compute fluctuation F(n) for scale n
  function computeFluctuation(scale_n: number): number {
    const numBoxes = Math.floor(N / scale_n);
    if (numBoxes === 0) return 0;

    let totalSqError = 0;
    for (let b = 0; b < numBoxes; b++) {
      const start = b * scale_n;
      // Least-squares fit of y over [start, start + scale_n - 1]
      // x_k = 0, 1, ..., scale_n - 1
      let sumX = 0;
      let sumY = 0;
      let sumXY = 0;
      let sumX2 = 0;

      for (let k = 0; k < scale_n; k++) {
        const val = y[start + k];
        sumX += k;
        sumY += val;
        sumXY += k * val;
        sumX2 += k * k;
      }

      const denom = (scale_n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX);
      const slope = denom !== 0 ? (scale_n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denom : 0;
      const intercept = (sumY - slope * sumX) / scale_n;

      for (let k = 0; k < scale_n; k++) {
        const trend = slope * k + intercept;
        const err = y[start + k] - trend;
        totalSqError += err * err;
      }
    }

    const meanSqError = totalSqError / (numBoxes * scale_n);
    return Math.sqrt(meanSqError);
  }

  // Helper to fit linear log-log regression: log(F(n)) = alpha * log(n) + c
  function fitRegime(scales: number[], minRecommendedN: number, minN: number, maxN: number): DfaRegimeResult {
    if (scales.length < 4 || N < minRecommendedN) {
      const limitations: string[] = [];
      if (N < minRecommendedN) {
        limitations.push(`Recording length (${N} NN intervals) is below recommended threshold (${minRecommendedN}) for stable regime regression.`);
      } else {
        limitations.push('Insufficient scale points in regime range.');
      }
      return {
        alpha: null,
        r_squared: null,
        min_scale: minN,
        max_scale: maxN,
        points_count: scales.length,
        scaling_curve: [],
        eligibility: 'ineligible',
        limitations
      };
    }

    const curve: DfaScalingPoint[] = [];
    const logScales: number[] = [];
    const logFlucts: number[] = [];

    for (const s of scales) {
      const f = computeFluctuation(s);
      if (f > 0 && Number.isFinite(f)) {
        const lnS = Math.log(s);
        const lnF = Math.log(f);
        curve.push({
          scale_n: s,
          fluctuation_f_n: Math.round(f * 1000) / 1000,
          log_scale: Math.round(lnS * 10000) / 10000,
          log_fluctuation: Math.round(lnF * 10000) / 10000
        });
        logScales.push(lnS);
        logFlucts.push(lnF);
      }
    }

    const nPoints = curve.length;
    if (nPoints < 4) {
      return {
        alpha: null,
        r_squared: null,
        min_scale: minN,
        max_scale: maxN,
        points_count: nPoints,
        scaling_curve: curve,
        eligibility: 'ineligible',
        limitations: ['Non-zero fluctuation points insufficient for log-log regression.']
      };
    }

    let sumX = 0;
    let sumY = 0;
    let sumXY = 0;
    let sumX2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nPoints; i++) {
      sumX += logScales[i];
      sumY += logFlucts[i];
      sumXY += logScales[i] * logFlucts[i];
      sumX2 += logScales[i] * logScales[i];
    }

    const denom = (nPoints * sumX2 - sumX * sumX);
    if (denom === 0) {
      return {
        alpha: null,
        r_squared: null,
        min_scale: minN,
        max_scale: maxN,
        points_count: nPoints,
        scaling_curve: curve,
        eligibility: 'inconclusive',
        limitations: ['Zero variance across scale window.']
      };
    }

    const slope = (nPoints * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denom;
    const intercept = (sumY - slope * sumX) / nPoints;

    // Compute R^2
    const meanY = sumY / nPoints;
    let ssTot = 0;
    let ssRes = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nPoints; i++) {
      const pred = slope * logScales[i] + intercept;
      const res = logFlucts[i] - pred;
      const tot = logFlucts[i] - meanY;
      ssRes += res * res;
      ssTot += tot * tot;
    }

    const r2 = ssTot > 0 ? Math.max(0, 1 - (ssRes / ssTot)) : 1;
    const roundedAlpha = Math.round(slope * 1000) / 1000;
    const roundedR2 = Math.round(r2 * 1000) / 1000;

    const limitations: string[] = [];
    let eligibility: 'eligible' | 'ineligible' | 'inconclusive' = 'eligible';

    if (r2 < 0.85) {
      eligibility = 'inconclusive';
      limitations.push(`Scaling linearity R² (${roundedR2}) is below stability threshold 0.85; indicates non-ideal power-law scaling.`);
    }

    return {
      alpha: roundedAlpha,
      r_squared: roundedR2,
      min_scale: minN,
      max_scale: maxN,
      points_count: nPoints,
      scaling_curve: curve,
      eligibility,
      limitations
    };
  }

  // Alpha 1 requires minimum ~64 intervals (recommended >= 100)
  const alpha1 = fitRegime(scales1, 64, 4, 16);
  // Alpha 2 requires minimum ~128 intervals (recommended >= 256)
  const alpha2 = fitRegime(scales2, 128, 16, 64);

  const limitations: string[] = [];
  if (alpha1.eligibility !== 'eligible') {
    limitations.push(...alpha1.limitations);
  }
  if (alpha2.eligibility !== 'eligible') {
    limitations.push(...alpha2.limitations);
  }

  return {
    target_id: 'dfa_alpha1_alpha2',
    method_id: 'src/backend/analytics/dfa.ts:calculateDfa',
    method_version: '1.0.0',
    maturity: 'Experimental',
    alpha1,
    alpha2,
    total_nn_count: N,
    continuous_duration_seconds: Math.round(totalDurationSec * 10) / 10,
    source_ledger_id: sourceLedgerId,
    user_facing_disclosure: disclosure,
    limitations
  };
}

import { LombScargleResult, LombScargleBandResult } from '../../shared/canonical/MetricResult';

/**
 * Calculates Lomb-Scargle Periodogram (Scargle 1982 / Press & Rybicki 1989) for unevenly sampled RR/NN intervals.
 * Evaluates spectral power directly on timestamped points without uniform cubic spline interpolation.
 * 
 * Frequency Bands:
 * - VLF: 0.0033 - 0.04 Hz
 * - LF:  0.04 - 0.15 Hz
 * - HF:  0.15 - 0.40 Hz
 * 
 * Maturity: Experimental
 * Does not replace Welch FFT as default; provided as an explicit alternative method.
 */
export function calculateLombScargle(
  cleanRrs: number[],
  sourceLedgerId: string = 'unknown_source'
): LombScargleResult {
  const disclosure = 'Experimental spectral periodogram for unevenly sampled cardiac intervals; alternative method to Welch FFT.';
  const defaultBand = (): LombScargleBandResult => ({
    power_ms2: null,
    peak_freq_hz: null,
    relative_power_percent: null
  });

  if (!cleanRrs || cleanRrs.length < 10) {
    return {
      target_id: 'lomb_scargle_periodogram',
      method_id: 'src/backend/analytics/lombScargle.ts:calculateLombScargle',
      method_version: '1.0.0',
      maturity: 'Experimental',
      vlf: defaultBand(),
      lf: defaultBand(),
      hf: defaultBand(),
      total_power_ms2: null,
      lf_hf_ratio: null,
      frequency_points_count: 0,
      oversampling_factor: 4,
      max_frequency_hz: 0.40,
      duration_seconds: 0,
      included_rr_count: cleanRrs ? cleanRrs.length : 0,
      source_ledger_id: sourceLedgerId,
      user_facing_disclosure: disclosure,
      limitations: ['Insufficient interval points (< 10) for spectral evaluation.']
    };
  }

  // 1. Compute cumulative time array in seconds
  const N = cleanRrs.length;
  const t: number[] = new Array(N);
  const y: number[] = new Array(N);
  let cumTime = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    t[i] = cumTime;
    y[i] = cleanRrs[i];
    cumTime += cleanRrs[i] / 1000;
  }
  const totalDurationSec = cumTime;

  // 2. Mean-center signals and sample variance
  let sumY = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) sumY += y[i];
  const meanY = sumY / N;

  let varY = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const diff = y[i] - meanY;
    varY += diff * diff;
  }
  const variance = varY / (N - 1);

  if (variance <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(variance)) {
    return {
      target_id: 'lomb_scargle_periodogram',
      method_id: 'src/backend/analytics/lombScargle.ts:calculateLombScargle',
      method_version: '1.0.0',
      maturity: 'Experimental',
      vlf: defaultBand(),
      lf: defaultBand(),
      hf: defaultBand(),
      total_power_ms2: 0,
      lf_hf_ratio: null,
      frequency_points_count: 0,
      oversampling_factor: 4,
      max_frequency_hz: 0.40,
      duration_seconds: Math.round(totalDurationSec * 10) / 10,
      included_rr_count: N,
      source_ledger_id: sourceLedgerId,
      user_facing_disclosure: disclosure,
      limitations: ['Signal has zero variance; spectral power is null.']
    };
  }

  // 3. Define frequency grid
  // f_min = 0.0033 Hz, f_max = 0.40 Hz
  // df = 1 / (oversampling * T)
  const oversampling = 4;
  const df = 1 / (oversampling * Math.max(totalDurationSec, 10));
  const fMin = 0.0033;
  const fMax = 0.40;
  const numFreqs = Math.floor((fMax - fMin) / df) + 1;

  const frequencies: number[] = new Array(numFreqs);
  const powerDensity: number[] = new Array(numFreqs);

  // 4. Compute Lomb-Scargle power for each frequency:
  // For each omega = 2*pi*f:
  // tan(2*omega*tau) = sum(sin(2*omega*t_i)) / sum(cos(2*omega*t_i))
  // P(omega) = 0.5 * [ (sum( (y_i - ybar)*cos(omega*(t_i - tau)) ))^2 / sum(cos^2(omega*(t_i - tau)))
  //                  + (sum( (y_i - ybar)*sin(omega*(t_i - tau)) ))^2 / sum(sin^2(omega*(t_i - tau))) ]
  for (let k = 0; k < numFreqs; k++) {
    const freq = fMin + k * df;
    frequencies[k] = freq;
    const omega = 2 * Math.PI * freq;

    let sumSin2 = 0;
    let sumCos2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const angle2 = 2 * omega * t[i];
      sumSin2 += Math.sin(angle2);
      sumCos2 += Math.cos(angle2);
    }
    const tau = Math.atan2(sumSin2, sumCos2) / (2 * omega);

    let sumCos = 0;
    let sumSin = 0;
    let sumCosSq = 0;
    let sumSinSq = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const diff = y[i] - meanY;
      const term = omega * (t[i] - tau);
      const c = Math.cos(term);
      const s = Math.sin(term);

      sumCos += diff * c;
      sumSin += diff * s;
      sumCosSq += c * c;
      sumSinSq += s * s;
    }

    const termCos = sumCosSq !== 0 ? (sumCos * sumCos) / sumCosSq : 0;
    const termSin = sumSinSq !== 0 ? (sumSin * sumSin) / sumSinSq : 0;
    const pVal = 0.5 * (termCos + termSin);
    // Unnormalized periodogram power P(f) has units of variance / Hz when integrated across df
    // Or standard PSD scaling: factor = 2 / (N * var) or dimensional power
    // Dimensional spectral power density in ms^2/Hz: (2 * pVal / (N * df)) or direct band integration
    // Standard Press & Rybicki: power density = 2 * pVal / N (unit variance normalized: pVal / variance)
    // To match ms^2 units with Welch FFT, band power = sum(pVal * df) normalized or dimensional integral.
    // In physical units (Scargle 1982 eq 10): total integrated power over positive frequencies equals signal variance.
    powerDensity[k] = pVal;
  }

  // 5. Band power integration and peak finding
  // Normalize power so that total integral across all frequencies equals total variance
  let rawIntegral = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < numFreqs; k++) {
    rawIntegral += powerDensity[k] * df;
  }
  const normFactor = rawIntegral > 0 ? (variance / rawIntegral) : 1;

  let vlfPower = 0;
  let lfPower = 0;
  let hfPower = 0;
  let peakVlfP = -1, peakVlfF = 0;
  let peakLfP = -1, peakLfF = 0;
  let peakHfP = -1, peakHfF = 0;

  for (let k = 0; k < numFreqs; k++) {
    const f = frequencies[k];
    const p = powerDensity[k] * normFactor;
    const dPower = p * df;

    if (f >= 0.0033 && f < 0.04) {
      vlfPower += dPower;
      if (p > peakVlfP) {
        peakVlfP = p;
        peakVlfF = f;
      }
    } else if (f >= 0.04 && f < 0.15) {
      lfPower += dPower;
      if (p > peakLfP) {
        peakLfP = p;
        peakLfF = f;
      }
    } else if (f >= 0.15 && f <= 0.40) {
      hfPower += dPower;
      if (p > peakHfP) {
        peakHfP = p;
        peakHfF = f;
      }
    }
  }

  const totalBandPower = vlfPower + lfPower + hfPower;
  const round2 = (val: number | null) => val !== null ? Math.round(val * 100) / 100 : null;
  const round4 = (val: number | null) => val !== null ? Math.round(val * 10000) / 10000 : null;

  const lfRatio = (hfPower > 0) ? round2(lfPower / hfPower) : null;

  const vlfPct = totalBandPower > 0 ? round2((vlfPower / totalBandPower) * 100) : null;
  const lfPct = totalBandPower > 0 ? round2((lfPower / totalBandPower) * 100) : null;
  const hfPct = totalBandPower > 0 ? round2((hfPower / totalBandPower) * 100) : null;

  const limitations: string[] = [];
  if (totalDurationSec < 300) {
    limitations.push('Recording duration (< 300s) limits spectral resolution in VLF and LF bands.');
  }

  return {
    target_id: 'lomb_scargle_periodogram',
    method_id: 'src/backend/analytics/lombScargle.ts:calculateLombScargle',
    method_version: '1.0.0',
    maturity: 'Experimental',
    vlf: {
      power_ms2: round2(vlfPower),
      peak_freq_hz: round4(peakVlfF),
      relative_power_percent: vlfPct
    },
    lf: {
      power_ms2: round2(lfPower),
      peak_freq_hz: round4(peakLfF),
      relative_power_percent: lfPct
    },
    hf: {
      power_ms2: round2(hfPower),
      peak_freq_hz: round4(peakHfF),
      relative_power_percent: hfPct
    },
    total_power_ms2: round2(totalBandPower),
    lf_hf_ratio: lfRatio,
    frequency_points_count: numFreqs,
    oversampling_factor: oversampling,
    max_frequency_hz: fMax,
    duration_seconds: Math.round(totalDurationSec * 10) / 10,
    included_rr_count: N,
    source_ledger_id: sourceLedgerId,
    user_facing_disclosure: disclosure,
    limitations
  };
}

import { getHrZones } from './cardio';
import { CustomHeartRateZones } from '../../shared/hrZones';
import { validateCustomHeartRateZones } from '../../shared/hrZoneValidation';

import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export interface ResolvedHeartRateZones {
  boundariesBpm: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  mode: 'custom_bpm' | 'karvonen' | 'percent_hrmax';
  updatedAt: string | null;
  source: 'user_custom' | 'computed_from_profile' | 'fallback' | 'unknown';
  configHash: string;
}

export interface HrZoneBoundariesValidationResult {
  isValid: boolean;
  boundaries: [number, number, number, number, number, number] | null;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Validates that an HR zone boundary array satisfies authoritative structural requirements:
 * - Must be an array of length exactly 6.
 * - All values must be finite, non-NaN, strictly positive (> 0) numbers.
 * - Values must be strictly monotonic increasing (b0 < b1 < b2 < b3 < b4 < b5).
 */
export function validateHrZoneBoundaries(
  boundaries: any
): HrZoneBoundariesValidationResult {
  if (!boundaries || !Array.isArray(boundaries)) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      boundaries: null,
      error: 'Zone boundaries must be a non-null array'
    };
  }

  if (boundaries.length !== 6) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      boundaries: null,
      error: `Zone boundaries must contain exactly 6 elements (found ${boundaries.length})`
    };
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const val = boundaries[i];
    if (typeof val !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(val) || Number.isNaN(val)) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        boundaries: null,
        error: `Boundary at index ${i} is not a finite number: ${val}`
      };
    }
    if (val <= 0) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        boundaries: null,
        error: `Boundary at index ${i} must be strictly positive: ${val}`
      };
    }
  }

  for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    if (boundaries[i] <= boundaries[i - 1]) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        boundaries: null,
        error: `Zone boundaries must be strictly increasing: boundary[${i}] (${boundaries[i]}) <= boundary[${i-1}] (${boundaries[i-1]})`
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    isValid: true,
    boundaries: [
      boundaries[0],
      boundaries[1],
      boundaries[2],
      boundaries[3],
      boundaries[4],
      boundaries[5]
    ]
  };
}

function computeHash(
  source: string,
  mode: string,
  boundaries: number[],
  updatedAt: string | null
): string {
  const payload = `${source}:${mode}:${boundaries.join(',')}:${updatedAt || ''}`;
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
}

export function resolveHeartRateZones(
  userPref: { max_hr?: number | null; resting_hr?: number | null; custom_zones?: string | null } | null,
  age: number = 35
): ResolvedHeartRateZones {
  const hasProfile = userPref && (userPref.max_hr || userPref.resting_hr);
  const maxHr = userPref?.max_hr || (220 - age);
  const restingHr = userPref?.resting_hr || 60;
  
  if (userPref && userPref.custom_zones) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(userPref.custom_zones) as CustomHeartRateZones;
      const validation = validateCustomHeartRateZones(parsed);
      if (validation.isValid) {
        if (parsed.mode === 'custom_bpm') {
          const boundariesBpm = parsed.boundariesBpm;
          const mode = 'custom_bpm';
          const source = 'user_custom';
          const updatedAt = parsed.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
          const configHash = computeHash(source, mode, boundariesBpm, updatedAt);
          return { boundariesBpm, mode, updatedAt, source, configHash };
        } else if (parsed.mode === 'percent_hrmax') {
          const boundariesBpm = calculatePercentMaxHrZones(maxHr);
          const mode = 'percent_hrmax';
          const source = 'user_custom'; // selected custom setting by user
          const updatedAt = parsed.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
          const configHash = computeHash(source, mode, boundariesBpm, updatedAt);
          return { boundariesBpm, mode, updatedAt, source, configHash };
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse custom zones, falling back to default', e);
    }
  }

  // Fallback to Karvonen
  const boundaries = getHrZones(maxHr, restingHr) as [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  const mode = 'karvonen';
  const source = hasProfile ? 'computed_from_profile' : 'fallback';
  const updatedAt = null;
  const configHash = computeHash(source, mode, boundaries, updatedAt);
  
  return {
    boundariesBpm: boundaries,
    mode,
    updatedAt,
    source,
    configHash
  };
}

export function calculatePercentMaxHrZones(maxHr: number): [number, number, number, number, number, number] {
  return [
    Math.round(maxHr * 0.50),
    Math.round(maxHr * 0.60),
    Math.round(maxHr * 0.70),
    Math.round(maxHr * 0.80),
    Math.round(maxHr * 0.90),
    maxHr
  ];
}

export interface SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  session_id: string;
  boundaries_bpm: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  mode: 'custom_bpm' | 'karvonen' | 'percent_hrmax' | 'legacy_inferred' | 'unknown';
  provenance_source: 'user_custom' | 'computed_from_profile' | 'fallback' | 'legacy_snapshot_inferred' | 'unknown';
  config_hash: string;
  max_hr_used: number | null;
  resting_hr_used: number | null;
  custom_zones_updated_at: string | null;
  captured_at_utc: string;
  migration_provenance_class: 'direct_capture' | 'legacy_metrics_migration' | 'fallback_reconstructed' | 'missing';
}

export function computeZoneConfigHash(
  source: string,
  mode: string,
  boundaries: number[],
  updatedAt: string | null
): string {
  const payload = `${source}:${mode}:${boundaries.join(',')}:${updatedAt || ''}`;
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Validates the complete integrity of a persisted or reconstructed SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot.
 * Enforces schema version, session ID matching, exactly 6 ascending boundaries,
 * valid mode/source enums, non-NaN numbers, mode-specific input consistency,
 * and exact config_hash recomputability.
 */
export function validateSessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot(
  snapshot: any,
  expectedSessionId?: string
): { isValid: boolean; error?: string; snapshot?: SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot } {
  if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') {
    return { isValid: false, error: 'Snapshot is not a valid object' };
  }

  if (snapshot.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Unsupported schema_version: ${snapshot.schema_version}` };
  }

  if (typeof snapshot.session_id !== 'string' || !snapshot.session_id.trim()) {
    return { isValid: false, error: 'Invalid or missing session_id' };
  }

  if (expectedSessionId && snapshot.session_id !== expectedSessionId) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Session ID mismatch: expected ${expectedSessionId}, found ${snapshot.session_id}` };
  }

  const allowedModes = ['custom_bpm', 'karvonen', 'percent_hrmax', 'legacy_inferred', 'unknown'];
  if (!allowedModes.includes(snapshot.mode)) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Invalid mode: ${snapshot.mode}` };
  }

  const allowedSources = ['user_custom', 'computed_from_profile', 'fallback', 'legacy_snapshot_inferred', 'unknown'];
  if (!allowedSources.includes(snapshot.provenance_source)) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Invalid provenance_source: ${snapshot.provenance_source}` };
  }

  const allowedClasses = ['direct_capture', 'legacy_metrics_migration', 'fallback_reconstructed', 'missing'];
  if (!allowedClasses.includes(snapshot.migration_provenance_class)) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Invalid migration_provenance_class: ${snapshot.migration_provenance_class}` };
  }

  const valRes = validateHrZoneBoundaries(snapshot.boundaries_bpm);
  if (!valRes.isValid || !valRes.boundaries) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Invalid boundaries_bpm: ${valRes.error || 'structural error'}` };
  }

  // Validate non-finite or NaN numbers
  if (snapshot.max_hr_used !== null && snapshot.max_hr_used !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(snapshot.max_hr_used) || isNaN(snapshot.max_hr_used) || snapshot.max_hr_used <= 0) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Invalid max_hr_used: must be a positive finite number or null' };
    }
  }

  if (snapshot.resting_hr_used !== null && snapshot.resting_hr_used !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(snapshot.resting_hr_used) || isNaN(snapshot.resting_hr_used) || snapshot.resting_hr_used <= 0) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Invalid resting_hr_used: must be a positive finite number or null' };
    }
  }

  // Mode-specific input validation (Finding AB)
  if (snapshot.mode === 'custom_bpm') {
    if (snapshot.max_hr_used !== null && snapshot.migration_provenance_class === 'direct_capture') {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'custom_bpm mode must have null max_hr_used in direct capture' };
    }
    if (snapshot.resting_hr_used !== null) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'custom_bpm mode must have null resting_hr_used' };
    }
  } else if (snapshot.mode === 'percent_hrmax') {
    if (snapshot.resting_hr_used !== null) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'percent_hrmax mode must have null resting_hr_used' };
    }
  }

  // Config hash recomputation check
  const recomputedHash = computeZoneConfigHash(
    snapshot.provenance_source,
    snapshot.mode,
    valRes.boundaries,
    snapshot.custom_zones_updated_at || null
  );

  if (snapshot.config_hash !== recomputedHash) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      error: `Config hash mismatch: stored ${snapshot.config_hash}, recomputed ${recomputedHash}`
    };
  }

  return { isValid: true, snapshot: snapshot as SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot };
}

/**
 * Pure READ-ONLY resolution of the persisted per-session zone configuration snapshot.
 * Reads existing session_metrics snapshot or reconstructs from stored legacy boundaries.
 * NEVER writes to the database, never borrows from live user profile, never creates side-effects.
 * Missing or corrupt historical snapshots return null fail-closed.
 */
export function resolvePersistedSessionZoneSnapshot(
  db: any,
  sessionId: string
): SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot | null {
  if (!sessionId || !db || typeof db.prepare !== 'function') return null;

  try {
    const metrics = db.prepare('SELECT zones_snapshot_json, zones_boundaries_bpm, zones_source, zones_updated_at FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!metrics) return null;

    // 1. Prefer persisted zones_snapshot_json
    if (metrics.zones_snapshot_json) {
      try {
        const parsed = typeof metrics.zones_snapshot_json === 'string'
          ? JSON.parse(metrics.zones_snapshot_json)
          : metrics.zones_snapshot_json;

        const integrity = validateSessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot(parsed, sessionId);
        if (integrity.isValid && integrity.snapshot) {
          return integrity.snapshot;
        }
        // If snapshot JSON is corrupt or tampered, fail-closed. Do NOT silently fallback to profile!
        return null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }

    // 2. Bounded reconstruction from historical persisted zones_boundaries_bpm only (Finding AA)
    if (metrics.zones_boundaries_bpm) {
      try {
        const rawBoundaries = typeof metrics.zones_boundaries_bpm === 'string'
          ? JSON.parse(metrics.zones_boundaries_bpm)
          : metrics.zones_boundaries_bpm;
        const valRes = validateHrZoneBoundaries(rawBoundaries);
        if (valRes.isValid && valRes.boundaries) {
          // Map legacy zones_source (Finding T compatibility mapper)
          const rawSource = (metrics.zones_source || '').trim();
          let mode: 'custom_bpm' | 'karvonen' | 'percent_hrmax' | 'legacy_inferred' | 'unknown' = 'legacy_inferred';
          let source: 'user_custom' | 'computed_from_profile' | 'fallback' | 'legacy_snapshot_inferred' | 'unknown' = 'legacy_snapshot_inferred';

          if (rawSource === 'custom_bpm' || rawSource === 'user_custom') {
            mode = 'custom_bpm';
            source = 'user_custom';
          } else if (rawSource === 'karvonen') {
            mode = 'karvonen';
            source = 'legacy_snapshot_inferred';
          } else if (rawSource === 'percent_hrmax') {
            mode = 'percent_hrmax';
            source = 'legacy_snapshot_inferred';
          } else if (rawSource === 'computed_from_profile') {
            mode = 'karvonen';
            source = 'computed_from_profile';
          } else if (rawSource === 'fallback') {
            mode = 'karvonen';
            source = 'fallback';
          }

          const updatedAt = metrics.zones_updated_at || null;
          const configHash = computeZoneConfigHash(source, mode, valRes.boundaries, updatedAt);

          // Finding AA: legacy migration must NOT borrow today's profile max/resting HR
          const candidateSnapshot: SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot = {
            schema_version: '1.0.0',
            session_id: sessionId,
            boundaries_bpm: valRes.boundaries,
            mode,
            provenance_source: source,
            config_hash: configHash,
            max_hr_used: null, // Strictly null: historical inputs were not stored
            resting_hr_used: null, // Strictly null: historical inputs were not stored
            custom_zones_updated_at: updatedAt,
            captured_at_utc: metrics.zones_updated_at || new Date(0).toISOString(),
            migration_provenance_class: 'legacy_metrics_migration'
          };

          const integrity = validateSessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot(candidateSnapshot, sessionId);
          if (integrity.isValid && integrity.snapshot) {
            return integrity.snapshot;
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  } catch {}

  return null;
}

/**
 * Backward-compatible alias for resolvePersistedSessionZoneSnapshot.
 * Enforces pure read-only semantics. Does NOT write to DB or borrow from live user profile.
 */
export function resolveSessionZoneSnapshot(
  db: any,
  sessionId: string,
  _sessionRow?: any,
  _userPref?: any,
  _userAge?: number
): SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot | null {
  return resolvePersistedSessionZoneSnapshot(db, sessionId);
}

/**
 * Idempotent capture-once session zone configuration snapshot resolver (Finding AH, AI, AJ).
 * Contract:
 * 1. If valid persisted direct snapshot exists: return it unchanged, never overwrite it.
 * 2. If valid legacy per-session boundaries exist: preserve/reconstruct the historical snapshot;
 *    persist that SAME migration snapshot into zones_snapshot_json if missing; never replace with current profile.
 * 3. If session already has historical analysis metrics in session_metrics but no trustworthy zone snapshot/boundaries:
 *    fail closed / snapshot unavailable; do NOT borrow current user profile.
 * 4. Only if this is genuinely a FIRST analysis for a new session:
 *    capture current configuration once with real capture timestamp (captured_at_utc).
 */
export function ensureSessionZoneSnapshot(
  db: any,
  sessionId: string,
  userPref: any,
  userAge: number = 35,
  _sessionStartTime?: string
): SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot | null {
  if (!sessionId) return null;

  // 1. Check if a valid snapshot is already persisted or resolvable
  const existingSnapshot = resolvePersistedSessionZoneSnapshot(db, sessionId);
  if (existingSnapshot) {
    // If it's a legacy migration and zones_snapshot_json is not yet stored, store the exact same migration snapshot
    if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function' && existingSnapshot.migration_provenance_class === 'legacy_metrics_migration') {
      try {
        const row = db.prepare('SELECT zones_snapshot_json FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
        if (row && !row.zones_snapshot_json) {
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_metrics SET zones_snapshot_json = ? WHERE session_id = ? AND zones_snapshot_json IS NULL')
            .run(JSON.stringify(existingSnapshot), sessionId);
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    return existingSnapshot;
  }

  // 2. Check if this session already has historical analysis metrics
  if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
    try {
      const existingMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, zones_boundaries_bpm, zones_snapshot_json FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
      if (existingMetrics) {
        // Session already has historical metrics, but no trustworthy zone snapshot/boundaries could be resolved
        // Finding AH step 3: Fail closed / snapshot unavailable; do NOT borrow current profile!
        return null;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  // 3. Genuine FIRST analysis: capture current configuration once
  const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
  return captureSessionZoneSnapshot(db, sessionId, userPref, userAge, nowUtc);
}

/**
 * Explicit WRITE PATH: Captures and validates an immutable zone configuration snapshot.
 * Used during session analysis and QC processing.
 * Idempotent: Refuses to overwrite an existing valid snapshot.
 * Persists the snapshot into session_metrics atomically.
 */
export function captureSessionZoneSnapshot(
  db: any,
  sessionId: string,
  userPref: any,
  userAge: number = 35,
  capturedAtUtc?: string
): SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot | null {
  if (!sessionId) return null;

  // Finding AH: Refuse to overwrite an existing valid snapshot
  const existing = resolvePersistedSessionZoneSnapshot(db, sessionId);
  if (existing) {
    return existing;
  }

  // Check if historical metrics row already exists without trustworthy zones
  if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
    try {
      const existingMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT session_id FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
      if (existingMetrics) {
        return null;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  const resolved = resolveHeartRateZones(userPref, userAge);
  const valRes = validateHrZoneBoundaries(resolved.boundariesBpm);
  if (!valRes.isValid || !valRes.boundaries) return null;

  // Mode-specific input provenance (Finding AB)
  let maxHrUsed: number | null = null;
  let restingHrUsed: number | null = null;

  if (resolved.mode === 'custom_bpm') {
    maxHrUsed = null;
    restingHrUsed = null;
  } else if (resolved.mode === 'percent_hrmax') {
    maxHrUsed = userPref?.max_hr || (220 - userAge);
    restingHrUsed = null;
  } else if (resolved.mode === 'karvonen') {
    maxHrUsed = userPref?.max_hr || (220 - userAge);
    restingHrUsed = userPref?.resting_hr || 60;
  }

  const actualCaptureTime = capturedAtUtc || new Date().toISOString();

  const snapshot: SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    session_id: sessionId,
    boundaries_bpm: valRes.boundaries,
    mode: resolved.mode,
    provenance_source: resolved.source,
    config_hash: resolved.configHash,
    max_hr_used: maxHrUsed,
    resting_hr_used: restingHrUsed,
    custom_zones_updated_at: resolved.updatedAt,
    captured_at_utc: actualCaptureTime,
    migration_provenance_class: 'direct_capture'
  };

  const integrity = validateSessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot(snapshot, sessionId);
  if (!integrity.isValid || !integrity.snapshot) return null;

  // Persist into session_metrics if db is provided - only if not already present
  if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO session_metrics (session_id, zones_source, zones_boundaries_bpm, zones_updated_at, zones_snapshot_json)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
          zones_source = excluded.zones_source,
          zones_boundaries_bpm = excluded.zones_boundaries_bpm,
          zones_updated_at = excluded.zones_updated_at,
          zones_snapshot_json = excluded.zones_snapshot_json
        WHERE session_metrics.zones_snapshot_json IS NULL
      `).run(
        sessionId,
        snapshot.mode,
        JSON.stringify(snapshot.boundaries_bpm),
        snapshot.custom_zones_updated_at,
        JSON.stringify(snapshot)
      );
    } catch {}
  }

  return integrity.snapshot;
}

/**
 * Forcefully recalculates and updates the session zone configuration snapshot.
 * Used during explicit zone recomputation jobs.
 * Overwrites existing snapshot in session_metrics with the new resolved profile configuration.
 */
export function recomputeSessionZoneSnapshot(
  db: any,
  sessionId: string,
  userPref: any,
  userAge: number = 35,
  recomputedAtUtc?: string
): SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot | null {
  if (!sessionId) return null;

  const resolved = resolveHeartRateZones(userPref, userAge);
  const valRes = validateHrZoneBoundaries(resolved.boundariesBpm);
  if (!valRes.isValid || !valRes.boundaries) return null;

  let maxHrUsed: number | null = null;
  let restingHrUsed: number | null = null;

  if (resolved.mode === 'custom_bpm') {
    maxHrUsed = null;
    restingHrUsed = null;
  } else if (resolved.mode === 'percent_hrmax') {
    maxHrUsed = userPref?.max_hr || (220 - userAge);
    restingHrUsed = null;
  } else if (resolved.mode === 'karvonen') {
    maxHrUsed = userPref?.max_hr || (220 - userAge);
    restingHrUsed = userPref?.resting_hr || 60;
  }

  const actualCaptureTime = recomputedAtUtc || new Date().toISOString();

  const snapshot: SessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    session_id: sessionId,
    boundaries_bpm: valRes.boundaries,
    mode: resolved.mode,
    provenance_source: resolved.source,
    config_hash: resolved.configHash,
    max_hr_used: maxHrUsed,
    resting_hr_used: restingHrUsed,
    custom_zones_updated_at: resolved.updatedAt,
    captured_at_utc: actualCaptureTime,
    migration_provenance_class: 'direct_capture'
  };

  const integrity = validateSessionZoneConfigurationSnapshot(snapshot, sessionId);
  if (!integrity.isValid || !integrity.snapshot) return null;

  if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO session_metrics (session_id, zones_source, zones_boundaries_bpm, zones_updated_at, zones_snapshot_json)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
          zones_source = excluded.zones_source,
          zones_boundaries_bpm = excluded.zones_boundaries_bpm,
          zones_updated_at = excluded.zones_updated_at,
          zones_snapshot_json = excluded.zones_snapshot_json
      `).run(
        sessionId,
        snapshot.mode,
        JSON.stringify(snapshot.boundaries_bpm),
        snapshot.custom_zones_updated_at,
        JSON.stringify(snapshot)
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to update session zone snapshot on recompute', e);
    }
  }

  return integrity.snapshot;
}

/**
 * HR Signal Quality Control & Canonical 1-Hz Timebase Validation
 * Provides strict cadence checking, gap detection, bin coverage calculation,
 * data-derived monotonicity diagnostics, and continuous 1-Hz segment extraction
 * for Heart Rate Zone Distribution analysis.
 */

export interface HrCadencePoint {
  timeMs: number;
  hrBpm: number;
}

export interface HrContinuousSegment {
  segmentIndex: number;
  startMs: number;
  endMs: number;
  startOffsetSeconds: number;
  endOffsetSeconds: number;
  timestampSpanSeconds: number;
  binCoverageSeconds: number;
  sampleCount: number;
  averageIntervalMs: number;
  hrSamples: number[];
  timestampsMs: number[];
}

export interface HrCadenceValidationResult {
  isEligible: boolean;
  totalRawSamples: number;
  valid1HzSamplesCount: number;
  sourceCleanSamplesCount: number;
  qualifyingSegmentIndex: number | null;
  qualifyingBinCoverageSeconds: number;
  excludedOutsideWindowSamplesCount: number;
  sourceEnvelopeSeconds: number;
  totalEnvelopeDurationSeconds: number; // backward compatibility alias
  hasMonotonicTimebase: boolean;
  nonMonotonicEventCount: number;
  duplicateTimestampCount: number;
  gapCount: number;
  totalGapSeconds: number;
  cadenceContractVersion: '1.1.0-strict';
  continuousSegments: HrContinuousSegment[];
  qualifyingSegment: HrContinuousSegment | null;
  cadenceStatus: 'valid_1hz' | 'irregular_cadence' | 'insufficient_duration' | 'empty_series';
  ineligibilityReason?: string;
}

/**
 * Validates HR samples against a canonical 1-Hz cadence contract:
 * - Expected nominal interval: 1000 ms.
 * - Allowable single-sample packet window: 850 ms <= deltaMs <= 1150 ms (accommodates real BLE transmission jitter).
 * - Disallows gaps (deltaMs > 1150 ms), duplicates / bursts (deltaMs < 850 ms), and non-monotonic timestamps (deltaMs <= 0).
 * - Verifies segment-level average cadence (950 ms <= meanDelta <= 1050 ms), rejecting systematic non-1-Hz series.
 * - Distinguishes timestamp_span_seconds ((endMs - startMs)/1000) from bin_coverage_seconds (count of contiguous 1-s bins).
 * - Evaluates data-derived monotonicity: counts non-monotonic and duplicate events explicitly.
 * - Records exact analytical lineage: distinguishes selected qualifying segment coverage from whole-source envelope and excluded outside-window samples.
 */
export function validateHr1HzCadenceAndExtractSegments(
  points: HrCadencePoint[],
  minimumDurationSec: number = 60.0
): HrCadenceValidationResult {
  if (!points || points.length === 0) {
    return {
      isEligible: false,
      totalRawSamples: 0,
      valid1HzSamplesCount: 0,
      sourceCleanSamplesCount: 0,
      qualifyingSegmentIndex: null,
      qualifyingBinCoverageSeconds: 0,
      excludedOutsideWindowSamplesCount: 0,
      sourceEnvelopeSeconds: 0,
      totalEnvelopeDurationSeconds: 0,
      hasMonotonicTimebase: true,
      nonMonotonicEventCount: 0,
      duplicateTimestampCount: 0,
      gapCount: 0,
      totalGapSeconds: 0,
      cadenceContractVersion: '1.1.0-strict',
      continuousSegments: [],
      qualifyingSegment: null,
      cadenceStatus: 'empty_series',
      ineligibilityReason: 'Empty HR point array provided.'
    };
  }

  // Check source-level monotonicity and duplicates
  let nonMonotonicEventCount = 0;
  let duplicateTimestampCount = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const d = points[i].timeMs - points[i - 1].timeMs;
    if (d === 0) {
      duplicateTimestampCount++;
    } else if (d < 0) {
      nonMonotonicEventCount++;
    }
  }
  const hasMonotonicTimebase = nonMonotonicEventCount === 0 && duplicateTimestampCount === 0;

  // Filter valid finite positive HR samples
  const cleanPoints: HrCadencePoint[] = [];
  for (const pt of points) {
    if (
      typeof pt.hrBpm === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(pt.hrBpm) &&
      pt.hrBpm > 0 &&
      typeof pt.timeMs === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(pt.timeMs)
    ) {
      cleanPoints.push(pt);
    }
  }

  if (cleanPoints.length === 0) {
    return {
      isEligible: false,
      totalRawSamples: points.length,
      valid1HzSamplesCount: 0,
      sourceCleanSamplesCount: 0,
      qualifyingSegmentIndex: null,
      qualifyingBinCoverageSeconds: 0,
      excludedOutsideWindowSamplesCount: 0,
      sourceEnvelopeSeconds: 0,
      totalEnvelopeDurationSeconds: 0,
      hasMonotonicTimebase,
      nonMonotonicEventCount,
      duplicateTimestampCount,
      gapCount: 0,
      totalGapSeconds: 0,
      cadenceContractVersion: '1.1.0-strict',
      continuousSegments: [],
      qualifyingSegment: null,
      cadenceStatus: 'empty_series',
      ineligibilityReason: 'No valid positive finite HR samples found.'
    };
  }

  const sessionOriginMs = cleanPoints[0].timeMs;
  const continuousSegments: HrContinuousSegment[] = [];
  let currentSegmentSamples: number[] = [cleanPoints[0].hrBpm];
  let currentSegmentTimes: number[] = [cleanPoints[0].timeMs];
  let gapCount = 0;
  let totalGapSeconds = 0;

  const pushCurrentSegment = () => {
    if (currentSegmentSamples.length === 0) return;
    const startMs = currentSegmentTimes[0];
    const endMs = currentSegmentTimes[currentSegmentTimes.length - 1];
    const timestampSpanSeconds = currentSegmentTimes.length > 1
      ? (endMs - startMs) / 1000.0
      : 1.0;
    const binCoverageSeconds = currentSegmentSamples.length;
    const avgInterval = currentSegmentTimes.length > 1
      ? (endMs - startMs) / (currentSegmentTimes.length - 1)
      : 1000.0;
    const startOffsetSeconds = (startMs - sessionOriginMs) / 1000.0;
    const endOffsetSeconds = (endMs - sessionOriginMs) / 1000.0;

    continuousSegments.push({
      segmentIndex: continuousSegments.length,
      startMs,
      endMs,
      startOffsetSeconds: Math.round(startOffsetSeconds * 1000) / 1000,
      endOffsetSeconds: Math.round(endOffsetSeconds * 1000) / 1000,
      timestampSpanSeconds: Math.round(timestampSpanSeconds * 1000) / 1000,
      binCoverageSeconds,
      sampleCount: currentSegmentSamples.length,
      averageIntervalMs: Math.round(avgInterval * 10) / 10,
      hrSamples: [...currentSegmentSamples],
      timestampsMs: [...currentSegmentTimes]
    });
  };

  for (let i = 1; i < cleanPoints.length; i++) {
    const prevTime = cleanPoints[i - 1].timeMs;
    const currTime = cleanPoints[i].timeMs;
    const deltaMs = currTime - prevTime;

    // Strict 1-Hz single-interval window: 850ms <= deltaMs <= 1150ms
    if (deltaMs >= 850 && deltaMs <= 1150) {
      currentSegmentSamples.push(cleanPoints[i].hrBpm);
      currentSegmentTimes.push(currTime);
    } else {
      pushCurrentSegment();

      if (deltaMs > 1150) {
        gapCount++;
        totalGapSeconds += (deltaMs - 1000.0) / 1000.0;
      }

      currentSegmentSamples = [cleanPoints[i].hrBpm];
      currentSegmentTimes = [currTime];
    }
  }

  // Push trailing segment
  pushCurrentSegment();

  // Find longest qualifying segment >= minimumDurationSec with validated mean cadence (950..1050 ms)
  // Deterministic rule: among qualifying segments, select the longest; if equal, select the earliest.
  let qualifying: HrContinuousSegment | null = null;
  for (const seg of continuousSegments) {
    if (seg.binCoverageSeconds >= minimumDurationSec && seg.averageIntervalMs >= 950 && seg.averageIntervalMs <= 1050) {
      if (!qualifying || seg.binCoverageSeconds > qualifying.binCoverageSeconds) {
        qualifying = seg;
      }
    }
  }

  let totalValid1HzSamples = 0;
  for (const seg of continuousSegments) {
    if (seg.averageIntervalMs >= 950 && seg.averageIntervalMs <= 1050) {
      totalValid1HzSamples += seg.sampleCount;
    }
  }

  const envelopeDurationSec = cleanPoints.length > 1
    ? (cleanPoints[cleanPoints.length - 1].timeMs - cleanPoints[0].timeMs) / 1000.0
    : cleanPoints.length;

  const isEligible = qualifying !== null;
  const excludedOutsideWindowSamplesCount = qualifying
    ? totalValid1HzSamples - qualifying.sampleCount
    : totalValid1HzSamples;

  let cadenceStatus: HrCadenceValidationResult['cadenceStatus'] = 'valid_1hz';
  let ineligibilityReason: string | undefined;

  if (!isEligible) {
    if (totalValid1HzSamples < minimumDurationSec) {
      cadenceStatus = 'insufficient_duration';
      ineligibilityReason = `Total valid 1-Hz HR sample count (${totalValid1HzSamples}) is less than required minimum of ${minimumDurationSec} seconds.`;
    } else {
      cadenceStatus = 'irregular_cadence';
      ineligibilityReason = `HR timeseries contains cadence interruptions, non-1-Hz intervals, or gaps; no uninterrupted continuous 1-Hz segment reached ${minimumDurationSec} seconds.`;
    }
  }

  return {
    isEligible,
    totalRawSamples: points.length,
    valid1HzSamplesCount: totalValid1HzSamples,
    sourceCleanSamplesCount: cleanPoints.length,
    qualifyingSegmentIndex: qualifying ? qualifying.segmentIndex : null,
    qualifyingBinCoverageSeconds: qualifying ? qualifying.binCoverageSeconds : 0,
    excludedOutsideWindowSamplesCount,
    sourceEnvelopeSeconds: Math.round(envelopeDurationSec * 10) / 10,
    totalEnvelopeDurationSeconds: Math.round(envelopeDurationSec * 10) / 10,
    hasMonotonicTimebase,
    nonMonotonicEventCount,
    duplicateTimestampCount,
    gapCount,
    totalGapSeconds: Math.round(totalGapSeconds * 10) / 10,
    cadenceContractVersion: '1.1.0-strict',
    continuousSegments,
    qualifyingSegment: qualifying,
    cadenceStatus,
    ineligibilityReason
  };
}

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Advanced Analysis Lifecycle Service (AAL-02, AAL-03, AAL-04)
 * ============================================================================
 * Manages durable revisions, payload hashing, atomic transaction activation,
 * invalidation tracking, and recompute queue for DFA, Lomb-Scargle, and Activity Segmentation.
 */
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  AdvancedMetricFamily,
  AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState,
  AdvancedAnalysisInvalidationCause,
  AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision,
  AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleEvent,
  AdvancedRecomputeJob
} from '../../shared/canonical/MetricResult';

export function canonicalJsonStringify(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return '[' + obj.map(canonicalJsonStringify).join(',') + ']';
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  const pairs = keys.map(k => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJsonStringify(obj[k])}`);
  return '{' + pairs.join(',') + '}';
}

export class AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService {
  public static computePayloadSha256(payload: any): string {
    const jsonStr = canonicalJsonStringify(payload ?? {});
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(jsonStr, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all active revisions for a session across metric families.
   */
  public static getActiveRevisionsForSession(sessionId: string): Record<AdvancedMetricFamily, AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision | null> {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_revisions 
      WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    const result: Record<AdvancedMetricFamily, AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision | null> = {
      dfa: null,
      lomb_scargle: null,
      activity_segmentation: null
    };

    for (const row of rows) {
      const family = row.metric_family as AdvancedMetricFamily;
      if (family in result) {
        result[family] = {
          revision_id: row.revision_id,
          session_id: row.session_id,
          metric_family: family,
          revision: Number(row.revision),
          lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState,
          invalidation_cause: row.invalidation_cause,
          source_bundle_id: row.source_bundle_id,
          source_fingerprint: row.source_fingerprint,
          candidate_manifest_sha256: row.candidate_manifest_sha256,
          protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
          method_id: row.method_id,
          method_version: row.method_version,
          parameter_digest: row.parameter_digest,
          maturity: row.maturity,
          payload: row.payload_json ? JSON.parse(row.payload_json) : null,
          payload_sha256: row.payload_sha256,
          is_active: Boolean(row.is_active),
          superseded_by_revision: row.superseded_by_revision ? Number(row.superseded_by_revision) : null,
          error_message: row.error_message,
          created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
          activated_at_utc: row.activated_at_utc,
          retired_at_utc: row.retired_at_utc
        };
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves a specific revision by ID with payload integrity verification.
   */
  public static getRevisionById(revisionId: string): AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_revisions 
      WHERE revision_id = ?
    `).get(revisionId) as any;

    if (!row) return null;

    const payload = row.payload_json ? JSON.parse(row.payload_json) : null;
    if (payload && row.payload_sha256) {
      const computed = this.computePayloadSha256(payload);
      if (computed !== row.payload_sha256) {
        console.warn(`[AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService] Integrity check failed for revision ${row.revision_id}: payload hash mismatch`);
      }
    }

    return {
      revision_id: row.revision_id,
      session_id: row.session_id,
      metric_family: row.metric_family as AdvancedMetricFamily,
      revision: Number(row.revision),
      lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState,
      invalidation_cause: row.invalidation_cause,
      source_bundle_id: row.source_bundle_id,
      source_fingerprint: row.source_fingerprint,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: row.candidate_manifest_sha256,
      protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
      method_id: row.method_id,
      method_version: row.method_version,
      parameter_digest: row.parameter_digest,
      maturity: row.maturity,
      payload,
      payload_sha256: row.payload_sha256,
      is_active: Boolean(row.is_active),
      superseded_by_revision: row.superseded_by_revision ? Number(row.superseded_by_revision) : null,
      error_message: row.error_message,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      activated_at_utc: row.activated_at_utc,
      retired_at_utc: row.retired_at_utc
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verifies that the payload in a revision matches its stored payload_sha256.
   */
  public static verifyRevisionPayloadIntegrity(rev: AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision): boolean {
    if (!rev.payload || !rev.payload_sha256) return true;
    return this.computePayloadSha256(rev.payload) === rev.payload_sha256;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all historical and active revisions for a session.
   */
  public static getAllRevisionsForSession(sessionId: string): AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_revisions 
      WHERE session_id = ? 
      ORDER BY revision ASC
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    return rows.map(row => ({
      revision_id: row.revision_id,
      session_id: row.session_id,
      metric_family: row.metric_family as AdvancedMetricFamily,
      revision: Number(row.revision),
      lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState,
      invalidation_cause: row.invalidation_cause,
      source_bundle_id: row.source_bundle_id,
      source_fingerprint: row.source_fingerprint,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: row.candidate_manifest_sha256,
      protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
      method_id: row.method_id,
      method_version: row.method_version,
      parameter_digest: row.parameter_digest,
      maturity: row.maturity,
      payload: row.payload_json ? JSON.parse(row.payload_json) : null,
      payload_sha256: row.payload_sha256,
      is_active: Boolean(row.is_active),
      superseded_by_revision: row.superseded_by_revision ? Number(row.superseded_by_revision) : null,
      error_message: row.error_message,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      activated_at_utc: row.activated_at_utc,
      retired_at_utc: row.retired_at_utc
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all audit lifecycle events for a session.
   */
  public static getLifecycleEventsForSession(sessionId: string): AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleEvent[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_lifecycle_events 
      WHERE session_id = ? 
      ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    return rows.map(row => ({
      event_id: row.event_id,
      session_id: row.session_id,
      metric_family: row.metric_family as AdvancedMetricFamily,
      revision: Number(row.revision),
      previous_state: row.previous_state,

      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
    }));
