  /**
   * Records a new revision atomically and supersedes prior active revision if exists.
   * Concurrency-safe: begins IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION before reading current active revision.
   * Idempotent: returns existing active revision unchanged if input identity & payload match.
   */
  public static recordRevision(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    metricFamily: AdvancedMetricFamily;
    lifecycleState: AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState;
    invalidationCause?: AdvancedAnalysisInvalidationCause | null;
    sourceBundleId: string;
    sourceFingerprint: string;
    candidateManifestSha256: string;
    protocolVersion: string;
    methodId: string;
    methodVersion: string;
    parameterDigest: string;
    maturity: 'Validated' | 'Bounded' | 'Experimental' | 'ValidationDebt';
    payload: any;
    errorMessage?: string | null;
    operatorOrSystem?: string;
  }): AdvancedAnalysisResultRevision {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const payloadSha256 = params.payload ? this.computePayloadSha256(params.payload) : null;
    const payloadJson = params.payload ? JSON.stringify(params.payload) : null;

    db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      const currentActive = db.prepare(`
        SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_revisions 
        WHERE session_id = ? AND metric_family = ? AND is_active = 1
      `).get(params.sessionId, params.metricFamily) as any;

      // Idempotency check: if active revision has matching payload, source, parameter, candidate, and method identity
      if (
        currentActive &&
        currentActive.payload_sha256 === payloadSha256 &&
        currentActive.source_fingerprint === params.sourceFingerprint &&
        currentActive.candidate_manifest_sha256 === params.candidateManifestSha256 &&
        currentActive.parameter_digest === params.parameterDigest &&
        currentActive.method_id === params.methodId &&
        currentActive.method_version === params.methodVersion &&
        currentActive.lifecycle_state === params.lifecycleState
      ) {
        db.exec('COMMIT;');
        return {
          revision_id: currentActive.revision_id,
          session_id: currentActive.session_id,
          metric_family: currentActive.metric_family as AdvancedMetricFamily,
          revision: Number(currentActive.revision),
          lifecycle_state: currentActive.lifecycle_state as AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState,
          invalidation_cause: currentActive.invalidation_cause,
          source_bundle_id: currentActive.source_bundle_id,
          source_fingerprint: currentActive.source_fingerprint,
          candidate_manifest_sha256: currentActive.candidate_manifest_sha256,
          protocol_version: currentActive.protocol_version,
          method_id: currentActive.method_id,
          method_version: currentActive.method_version,
          parameter_digest: currentActive.parameter_digest,
          maturity: currentActive.maturity,
          payload: currentActive.payload_json ? JSON.parse(currentActive.payload_json) : null,
          payload_sha256: currentActive.payload_sha256,
          is_active: true,
          superseded_by_revision: null,
          error_message: currentActive.error_message,
          created_at_utc: currentActive.created_at_utc,
          activated_at_utc: currentActive.activated_at_utc,
          retired_at_utc: currentActive.retired_at_utc
        };
      }

      const nextRevNum = currentActive ? (Number(currentActive.revision) + 1) : 1;
      const revisionId = `${params.sessionId}_${params.metricFamily}_r${nextRevNum}_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

      if (currentActive) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE advanced_analysis_revisions 
          SET is_active = 0, superseded_by_revision = ?, retired_at_utc = ?
          WHERE revision_id = ?
        `).run(nextRevNum, now, currentActive.revision_id);

        // Record lifecycle event for supersession
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO advanced_analysis_lifecycle_events (
            event_id, session_id, metric_family, revision, previous_state, new_state, cause, operator_or_system, created_at_utc
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(
          crypto.randomUUID(),
          params.sessionId,
          params.metricFamily,
          Number(currentActive.revision),
          currentActive.lifecycle_state,
          'superseded',
          `superseded_by_revision_${nextRevNum}`,
          params.operatorOrSystem || 'system',
          now
        );
      }

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO advanced_analysis_revisions (
          revision_id, session_id, metric_family, revision, lifecycle_state, invalidation_cause,
          source_bundle_id, source_fingerprint, candidate_manifest_sha256, protocol_version,
          method_id, method_version, parameter_digest, maturity, payload_json, payload_sha256,
          is_active, superseded_by_revision, error_message, created_at_utc, activated_at_utc, retired_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, NULL, ?, ?, ?, NULL)
      `).run(
        revisionId,
        params.sessionId,
        params.metricFamily,
        nextRevNum,
        params.lifecycleState,
        params.invalidationCause || null,
        params.sourceBundleId,
        params.sourceFingerprint,
        params.candidateManifestSha256,
        params.protocolVersion,
        params.methodId,
        params.methodVersion,
        params.parameterDigest,
        params.maturity,
        payloadJson,
        payloadSha256,
        params.errorMessage || null,
        now,
        params.lifecycleState === 'current' ? now : null
      );

      // Record lifecycle event for new activation
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO advanced_analysis_lifecycle_events (
          event_id, session_id, metric_family, revision, previous_state, new_state, cause, operator_or_system, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        crypto.randomUUID(),
        params.sessionId,
        params.metricFamily,
        nextRevNum,
        currentActive ? currentActive.lifecycle_state : null,
        params.lifecycleState,
        params.invalidationCause || 'initial_activation',
        params.operatorOrSystem || 'system',
        now
      );

      db.exec('COMMIT;');

      return {
        revision_id: revisionId,
        session_id: params.sessionId,
        metric_family: params.metricFamily,
        revision: nextRevNum,
        lifecycle_state: params.lifecycleState,
        invalidation_cause: params.invalidationCause || null,
        source_bundle_id: params.sourceBundleId,
        source_fingerprint: params.sourceFingerprint,
        candidate_manifest_sha256: params.candidateManifestSha256,
        protocol_version: params.protocolVersion,
        method_id: params.methodId,
        method_version: params.methodVersion,
        parameter_digest: params.parameterDigest,
        maturity: params.maturity,
        payload: params.payload,
        payload_sha256: payloadSha256,
        is_active: true,
        superseded_by_revision: null,
        error_message: params.errorMessage || null,
        created_at_utc: now,
        activated_at_utc: params.lifecycleState === 'current' ? now : null,
        retired_at_utc: null
      };
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Deterministically invalidates active revision for given family.
   */
  public static invalidateSessionMetric(
    sessionId: string,
    metricFamily: AdvancedMetricFamily,
    cause: AdvancedAnalysisInvalidationCause,
    newState: AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleState = 'stale_source_changed'
  ): boolean {
    const db = getDb();
    const active = db.prepare(`
      SELECT revision_id, revision, lifecycle_state 
      FROM advanced_analysis_revisions 
      WHERE session_id = ? AND metric_family = ? AND is_active = 1
    `).get(sessionId, metricFamily) as any;

    if (!active) return false;
    if (active.lifecycle_state === newState) return true; // idempotent

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE advanced_analysis_revisions 
        SET lifecycle_state = ?, invalidation_cause = ?
        WHERE revision_id = ?
      `).run(newState, cause, active.revision_id);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO advanced_analysis_lifecycle_events (
          event_id, session_id, metric_family, revision, previous_state, new_state, cause, operator_or_system, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        crypto.randomUUID(),
        sessionId,
        metricFamily,
        Number(active.revision),
        active.lifecycle_state,
        newState,
        cause,
        'invalidation_engine',
        now
      );
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Enqueues a historical recompute job in the durable SQLite queue.
   * Deduplication checks session_id, sorted metric families, candidate manifest SHA-256, and parameter digest.
   * Target revision is calculated dynamically based on existing active revision (activeRev ? activeRev.revision + 1 : 1).
   */
  public static enqueueRecomputeJob(
    sessionId: string,
    metricFamilies: AdvancedMetricFamily[],
    triggerCause: AdvancedAnalysisInvalidationCause,
    sourceFingerprint?: string | null,
    parameterDigest?: string | null,
    candidateManifestSha256?: string | null
  ): AdvancedRecomputeJob {
    const db = getDb();
    const sortedFamilies = [...metricFamilies].sort();
    const familiesJson = JSON.stringify(sortedFamilies);
    const normCandidate = candidateManifestSha256 || null;
    const normParam = parameterDigest || null;

    const existingRows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue 
      WHERE session_id = ? AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    const existing = existingRows.find(row => {
      try {
        const rowFamilies = (JSON.parse(row.metric_families_json) as string[]).sort();
        const familiesMatch = JSON.stringify(rowFamilies) === familiesJson;
        const candidateMatch = (row.candidate_manifest_sha256 || null) === normCandidate;
        const paramMatch = (row.parameter_digest || null) === normParam;
        return familiesMatch && candidateMatch && paramMatch;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    });

    if (existing) {
      return {
        job_id: existing.job_id,
        session_id: existing.session_id,
        metric_families: JSON.parse(existing.metric_families_json),
        target_revision: Number(existing.target_revision),
        trigger_cause: existing.trigger_cause as AdvancedAnalysisInvalidationCause,
        source_fingerprint: existing.source_fingerprint || null,
        parameter_digest: existing.parameter_digest || null,
        candidate_manifest_sha256: existing.candidate_manifest_sha256 || null,
        status: existing.status,
        retry_count: Number(existing.retry_count),
        max_retries: Number(existing.max_retries),
        error_message: existing.error_message,
        created_at_utc: existing.created_at_utc,
        started_at_utc: existing.started_at_utc,
        finished_at_utc: existing.finished_at_utc
      };
    }

    // Determine target revision dynamically across all revisions for this session
    const maxActive = db.prepare(`
      SELECT MAX(revision) as max_rev FROM advanced_analysis_revisions
      WHERE session_id = ?
    `).get(sessionId) as any;
    const targetRevision = maxActive && maxActive.max_rev ? (Number(maxActive.max_rev) + 1) : 1;

    const jobId = `job_${sessionId}_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO advanced_analysis_recompute_queue (
        job_id, session_id, metric_families_json, target_revision, trigger_cause,
        source_fingerprint, parameter_digest, candidate_manifest_sha256, status, retry_count, max_retries, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'queued', 0, 3, ?)
    `).run(
      jobId,
      sessionId,
      familiesJson,
      targetRevision,
      triggerCause,
      sourceFingerprint || null,
      normParam,
      normCandidate,
      now
    );

    return {
      job_id: jobId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      metric_families: sortedFamilies,
      target_revision: targetRevision,
      trigger_cause: triggerCause,
      source_fingerprint: sourceFingerprint || null,
      parameter_digest: normParam,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: normCandidate,
      status: 'queued',
      retry_count: 0,
      max_retries: 3,
      error_message: null,
      created_at_utc: now,
      started_at_utc: null,
      finished_at_utc: null
    };
  }

  /**
   * Cancels a queued recompute job if it is queued or running.
   */
  public static cancelJob(jobId: string): boolean {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const result = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue
      SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at_utc = ?
      WHERE job_id = ? AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
    `).run(now, jobId);
    return result.changes > 0;
  }

  /**
   * Lists all recompute jobs in queue.
   */
  public static listRecomputeJobs(statusFilter?: string): AdvancedRecomputeJob[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const query = statusFilter
      ? 'SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue WHERE status = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC'
      : 'SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC';
    const rows = (statusFilter ? db.prepare(query).all(statusFilter) : db.prepare(query).all()) as any[];

    return rows.map(r => ({
      job_id: r.job_id,
      session_id: r.session_id,
      metric_families: JSON.parse(r.metric_families_json),
      target_revision: Number(r.target_revision),
      trigger_cause: r.trigger_cause,
      source_fingerprint: r.source_fingerprint || null,
      parameter_digest: r.parameter_digest || null,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: r.candidate_manifest_sha256 || null,
      status: r.status,
      retry_count: Number(r.retry_count),
      max_retries: Number(r.max_retries),
      error_message: r.error_message,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc,
      started_at_utc: r.started_at_utc,
      finished_at_utc: r.finished_at_utc
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Recovers interrupted in-flight jobs on application restart.
   */
  public static reconcileInterruptedJobs(): number {
    const db = getDb();
    const runningJobs = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue WHERE status = 'running'
    `).all() as any[];

    if (runningJobs.length === 0) return 0;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    for (const job of runningJobs) {
      if (Number(job.retry_count) >= Number(job.max_retries)) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue 
          SET status = 'failed', error_message = 'Interrupted by process restart and exceeded max retries', finished_at_utc = ?
          WHERE job_id = ?
        `).run(now, job.job_id);
      } else {
        // Reset to queued for safe re-attempt
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue 
          SET status = 'queued', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = 'Rescheduled after process restart'
          WHERE job_id = ?
        `).run(job.job_id);
      }
    }

    return runningJobs.length;
  }

  /**
   * Executes a specific queued recompute job synchronously with atomic CAS concurrency claim
   * and post-computation active revision verification.
   */
  public static async executeJob(jobId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const db = getDb();
    const startUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    // Atomic CAS claim: only transition from 'queued' to 'running'
    const claimResult = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue
      SET status = 'running', started_at_utc = ?
      WHERE job_id = ? AND status = 'queued'
    `).run(startUtc, jobId);

    if (claimResult.changes === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    const job = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue WHERE job_id = ?
    `).get(jobId) as any;

    if (!job) {
      return false;
    }

    let requestedFamilies: AdvancedMetricFamily[] = [];
    try {
      requestedFamilies = JSON.parse(job.metric_families_json) as AdvancedMetricFamily[];
    } catch {
      requestedFamilies = [];
    }

    try {
      // Rebuild canonical session to trigger recomputation of advanced metrics
      const { getCanonicalSessionResult, invalidateCanonicalSessionCache } = await import('../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder');
      invalidateCanonicalSessionCache(job.session_id);
      await getCanonicalSessionResult(job.session_id, true);

      // Post-computation verification: ensure all requested families have verified active revisions
      if (requestedFamilies.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: no metric families requested for job '${jobId}'`);
      }

      const activeRevs = this.getActiveRevisionsForSession(job.session_id);
      for (const family of requestedFamilies) {
        const rev = activeRevs[family];
        if (!rev) {
          throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: missing active revision for requested family '${family}'`);
        }
        if (rev.lifecycle_state !== 'current') {
          throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: active revision lifecycle_state is '${rev.lifecycle_state}', expected 'current' for family '${family}'`);
        }
        if (job.candidate_manifest_sha256 && rev.candidate_manifest_sha256 && rev.candidate_manifest_sha256 !== job.candidate_manifest_sha256) {
          throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: candidate manifest mismatch for family '${family}'`);
        }
        if (job.source_fingerprint && rev.source_fingerprint && rev.source_fingerprint !== job.source_fingerprint) {
          throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: source fingerprint mismatch for family '${family}'`);
        }
        if (job.parameter_digest && rev.parameter_digest && rev.parameter_digest !== job.parameter_digest) {
          throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: parameter digest mismatch for family '${family}'`);
        }
        if (rev.payload && rev.payload_sha256) {
          const computedHash = this.computePayloadSha256(rev.payload);
          if (computedHash !== rev.payload_sha256) {
            throw new Error(`Recompute verification failed: payload hash mismatch for family '${family}'`);
          }
        }
      }

      const finishUtc = new Date().toISOString();
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue
        SET status = 'completed', finished_at_utc = ?, error_message = NULL
        WHERE job_id = ?
      `).run(finishUtc, jobId);
      return true;
    } catch (err: any) {
      const finishUtc = new Date().toISOString();
      const newRetryCount = Number(job.retry_count) + 1;
      const newStatus = newRetryCount >= Number(job.max_retries) ? 'failed' : 'queued';
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE advanced_analysis_recompute_queue
        SET status = ?, retry_count = ?, error_message = ?, finished_at_utc = ?
        WHERE job_id = ?
      `).run(newStatus, newRetryCount, err.message || 'Recompute failed', finishUtc, jobId);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Processes the next available queued job.
   */
  public static async processNextJob(): Promise<boolean> {
    const db = getDb();
    const nextJob = db.prepare(`
      SELECT job_id FROM advanced_analysis_recompute_queue
      WHERE status = 'queued'
      ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    if (!nextJob) return false;
    return await this.executeJob(nextJob.job_id);
  }

  /**
   * Processes all pending queued jobs.
   */
  public static async processAllQueuedJobs(): Promise<number> {
    let processed = 0;
    while (await this.processNextJob()) {
      processed++;
    }
    return processed;
  }
}

/**
 * NamedWindowService.ts
 * Authoritative engine for user-defined named analytical windows (REC-007).
 * 
 * Complies with CardioLab V1.1 Strategic Reconciliation,
 * Frozen Protocol v1.1.0, and Task Force 1996 HRV standard duration requirements.
 * 
 * Core Invariants:
 * 1. Half-open intervals: [start_offset_seconds, end_offset_seconds).
 * 2. Consumes canonical parent beat ledger: ordinals, classifications, and exclusions are preserved.
 * 3. Never reruns classifier in isolation on sliced windows.
 * 4. Withholds metrics lacking scientific standard duration or beat thresholds (< 300s for SDNN/pNN50, < 30 beats for RMSSD).
 * 5. Window metrics are strictly non-authoritative relative to whole-session physical metrics.
 * 6. Supports optimistic concurrency revisions and same-session window comparisons with overlap disclosure.
 */

import crypto, { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getSession, saveNamedWindowRecord, getNamedWindowsForSession, getNamedWindowById, updateNamedWindowRecord, deleteNamedWindowRecord, getNamedWindowRevisionHistory, SessionNamedWindowRecord } from '../db/db';
import { getCanonicalSessionResult } from '../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder';
import { SessionNamedWindow, NamedWindowMetrics, NamedWindowContinuity } from '../../shared/canonical/NamedWindowTypes';
import { CanonicalBeatLedger, CanonicalBeatEntry } from '../../shared/canonical/CanonicalBeatLedger';
import { calculateLedgerHrvMetrics } from './hrv';

function canonicalJsonStringify(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return '[' + obj.map(canonicalJsonStringify).join(',') + ']';
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  const pairs = keys.map(k => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJsonStringify(obj[k])}`);
  return '{' + pairs.join(',') + '}';
}

export interface NamedWindowComparisonResult {
  comparison_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  window_a: SessionNamedWindow;
  window_b: SessionNamedWindow;
  same_parent_session: boolean;
  has_temporal_overlap: boolean;
  overlap_seconds: number;
  delta_mean_hr: number | null;
  delta_rmssd: number | null;
  comparison_mode: 'descriptive_non_inferential';
  baseline_admission_blocked: true;
  scientific_disclaimer: string;
}

export class NamedWindowService {
  /**
   * Computes authoritative window metrics from the canonical parent session beat ledger.
   */
  public static async calculateWindowMetrics(
    sessionId: string,
    startOffsetSeconds: number,
    endOffsetSeconds: number,
    name: string
  ): Promise<NamedWindowMetrics> {
    if (startOffsetSeconds < 0) {
      throw new Error('startOffsetSeconds cannot be negative');
    }
    if (endOffsetSeconds <= startOffsetSeconds) {
      throw new Error('endOffsetSeconds must be strictly greater than startOffsetSeconds');
    }

    const durationSeconds = endOffsetSeconds - startOffsetSeconds;
    const windowId = `win_${randomUUID().substring(0, 8)}`;

    const scientificDisclaimer = 'Анализ пользовательского окна является локальным срезом и носит информационный характер. Не является медицинским или клиническим диагнозом.';

    // Try to load canonical session result for parent beat ledger
    let canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId);
    let beatLedger: CanonicalBeatLedger | null = canonical?.canonical_beat_ledger || null;

    let session = getSession(sessionId);
    let sessionStartMs = session?.start_time ? new Date(session.start_time).getTime() : 0;

    // Filter beats falling strictly in half-open [startOffset, endOffset)
    let windowBeats: CanonicalBeatEntry[] = [];
    if (beatLedger && beatLedger.beats) {
      for (const beat of beatLedger.beats) {
        let offsetSec: number | null = null;
        if (beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== undefined) {
          offsetSec = beat.relative_timestamp_ms / 1000;
        } else if (beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== undefined && sessionStartMs > 0) {
          offsetSec = (beat.phone_timestamp_ms - sessionStartMs) / 1000;
        }

        if (offsetSec !== null && offsetSec >= startOffsetSeconds && offsetSec < endOffsetSeconds) {
          windowBeats.push(beat);
        }
      }
    }

    const beatCount = windowBeats.length;
    const cleanBeats = windowBeats.filter(b => b.accepted_for_nn && b.raw_rr_ms !== null && b.raw_rr_ms > 0);
    const cleanBeatCount = cleanBeats.length;
    const cleanRrs = cleanBeats.map(b => b.raw_rr_ms as number);
    const acceptedCoverageSeconds = cleanRrs.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / 1000;

    // Evaluate contiguous segments and gaps strictly using canonical HRV pair-adjacency rules (STRAT-A4)
    // A pair of adjacent clean beats is contiguous if:
    // 1) beat_index is consecutive (if present)
    // 2) time delta is positive and <= 3000ms (3.0s), matching calculateLedgerHrvMetrics
    const segments: Array<{ beats: CanonicalBeatEntry[]; startOffset: number; endOffset: number; acceptedDuration: number }> = [];
    let currentSegmentBeats: CanonicalBeatEntry[] = [];
    let currentSegmentStart = 0;
    let currentSegmentEnd = 0;
    let currentSegmentDuration = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < cleanBeats.length; i++) {
      const beat = cleanBeats[i];
      let beatOffset: number = 0;
      if (beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== undefined) {
        beatOffset = beat.relative_timestamp_ms / 1000;
      } else if (beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== undefined && sessionStartMs > 0) {
        beatOffset = (beat.phone_timestamp_ms - sessionStartMs) / 1000;
      }
      const beatDurationSec = (beat.raw_rr_ms || 0) / 1000;

      if (currentSegmentBeats.length === 0) {
        currentSegmentBeats = [beat];
        currentSegmentStart = beatOffset;
        currentSegmentEnd = beatOffset + beatDurationSec;
        currentSegmentDuration = beatDurationSec;
      } else {
        const prevBeat = currentSegmentBeats[currentSegmentBeats.length - 1];
        let prevBeatOffset: number = 0;
        if (prevBeat.relative_timestamp_ms !== null && prevBeat.relative_timestamp_ms !== undefined) {
          prevBeatOffset = prevBeat.relative_timestamp_ms / 1000;
        } else if (prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms !== null && prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms !== undefined && sessionStartMs > 0) {
          prevBeatOffset = (prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms - sessionStartMs) / 1000;
        }

        // Adjacency check
        const indexAdjacent = (beat.beat_index !== undefined && prevBeat.beat_index !== undefined)
          ? beat.beat_index === prevBeat.beat_index + 1
          : true;

        let hasTimeGap = false;
        if (beat.sensor_timestamp_ns != null && prevBeat.sensor_timestamp_ns != null) {
          const deltaNs = beat.sensor_timestamp_ns - prevBeat.sensor_timestamp_ns;
          if (deltaNs <= 0 || deltaNs > 3e9) hasTimeGap = true;
        } else if (beat.phone_timestamp_ms != null && prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms != null) {
          const deltaMs = beat.phone_timestamp_ms - prevBeat.phone_timestamp_ms;
          if (deltaMs < 0 || deltaMs > 3000) hasTimeGap = true;
        } else if (beat.relative_timestamp_ms != null && prevBeat.relative_timestamp_ms != null) {
          const deltaMs = beat.relative_timestamp_ms - prevBeat.relative_timestamp_ms;
          if (deltaMs < 0 || deltaMs > 3000) hasTimeGap = true;
        } else {
          const deltaSec = beatOffset - prevBeatOffset;
          if (deltaSec < 0 || deltaSec > 3.0) hasTimeGap = true;
        }

        if (indexAdjacent && !hasTimeGap) {
          currentSegmentBeats.push(beat);
          currentSegmentEnd = beatOffset + beatDurationSec;
          currentSegmentDuration += beatDurationSec;
        } else {
          segments.push({
            beats: currentSegmentBeats,
            startOffset: currentSegmentStart,
            endOffset: currentSegmentEnd,
            acceptedDuration: currentSegmentDuration
          });
          currentSegmentBeats = [beat];
          currentSegmentStart = beatOffset;
          currentSegmentEnd = beatOffset + beatDurationSec;
          currentSegmentDuration = beatDurationSec;
        }
      }
    }
    if (currentSegmentBeats.length > 0) {
      segments.push({
        beats: currentSegmentBeats,
        startOffset: currentSegmentStart,
        endOffset: currentSegmentEnd,
        acceptedDuration: currentSegmentDuration
      });
    }

    const contiguousSegmentCount = segments.length;
    let largestGapSeconds = 0;

    if (segments.length === 0) {
      largestGapSeconds = durationSeconds;
    } else {
      // Gap from window start to first segment start
      const leadGap = Math.max(0, segments[0].startOffset - startOffsetSeconds);
      if (leadGap > largestGapSeconds) largestGapSeconds = leadGap;

      // Gaps between segments
      for (let s = 1; s < segments.length; s++) {
        const interGap = Math.max(0, segments[s].startOffset - segments[s - 1].endOffset);
        if (interGap > largestGapSeconds) largestGapSeconds = interGap;
      }

      // Gap from last segment end to window end
      const trailGap = Math.max(0, endOffsetSeconds - segments[segments.length - 1].endOffset);
      if (trailGap > largestGapSeconds) largestGapSeconds = trailGap;
    }

    const coverageRatio = durationSeconds > 0 ? Math.min(1.0, Math.round((acceptedCoverageSeconds / durationSeconds) * 1000) / 1000) : 0;
    const windowHrv = calculateLedgerHrvMetrics(windowBeats);
    const validAdjacentPairCount = windowHrv.valid_pair_count;
    const validAdjacentPairCoverage = cleanBeatCount > 1
      ? Math.round((validAdjacentPairCount / (cleanBeatCount - 1)) * 1000) / 1000
      : 0;

    // Strict non-arbitrary classification:
    // A standard continuous recording requires contiguous beat-to-beat flow without adjacency breaks or large boundary voids.
    // If the window is segmented (contiguousSegmentCount > 1 or largestGapSeconds > 3.0), it is classified as segmented_quality_limited.
    const continuityClassification: 'standard_continuous' | 'segmented_quality_limited' =
      (contiguousSegmentCount === 1 && largestGapSeconds <= 3.0)
        ? 'standard_continuous'
        : 'segmented_quality_limited';

    const continuity: NamedWindowContinuity = {
      selected_duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
      accepted_duration_seconds: Math.round(acceptedCoverageSeconds * 10) / 10,
      coverage_ratio: coverageRatio,
      contiguous_segment_count: contiguousSegmentCount,
      largest_gap_seconds: Math.round(largestGapSeconds * 10) / 10,
      valid_adjacent_pair_count: validAdjacentPairCount,
      valid_adjacent_pair_coverage: validAdjacentPairCoverage,
      continuity_classification: continuityClassification,
      policy_method_identity: 'hrv_pair_adjacency_v1_1'
    };

    const exclusionReasons: { meanHr?: string; rmssd?: string; sdnn?: string; pnn50?: string } = {};

    // 1. Mean / Min / Max Heart Rate (strictly aligned with canonical session estimator)
    let meanHr: number | null = null;
    let minHr: number | null = null;
    let maxHr: number | null = null;
    let meanHrEligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' | 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';

    if (cleanBeatCount < 5) {
      meanHrEligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.meanHr = `Недостаточно валидных отсчетов NN в окне (${cleanBeatCount} < 5)`;
    } else {
      const meanRr = cleanRrs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / cleanRrs.length;
      meanHr = Math.round((60000 / meanRr) * 10) / 10;
      const hrValues = cleanRrs.map(r => 60000 / r);
      minHr = Math.round(Math.min(...hrValues));
      maxHr = Math.round(Math.max(...hrValues));
      meanHrEligibility = 'ELIGIBLE';
    }

    // 2. RMSSD (strictly over valid adjacent pairs)
    let rmssd: number | null = windowHrv.rmssd;
    let rmssdEligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' | 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';

    if (windowHrv.valid_pair_count < 30) {
      rmssd = null;
      rmssdEligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.rmssd = `Недостаточно валидных RR-интервалов в окне (${windowHrv.valid_pair_count} смежных пар < 30)`;
    } else if (durationSeconds < 300 || acceptedCoverageSeconds < 300) {
      rmssdEligibility = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
      exclusionReasons.rmssd = `Ультракраткое окно (${Math.round(acceptedCoverageSeconds)} с < 300 с): RMSSD отражает локальный срез, непригоден для стандартного 5-минутного сравнения`;
    } else {
      rmssdEligibility = 'ELIGIBLE';
    }

    // 3. SDNN and pNN50 (Task Force 1996 Standard: Requires >= 300s / 5 minutes accepted coverage)
    let sdnn: number | null = windowHrv.sdnn;
    let pnn50: number | null = windowHrv.pnn50;
    let sdnnEligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' | 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
    let pnn50Eligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' | 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';

    if (acceptedCoverageSeconds < 300) {
      sdnn = null;
      pnn50 = null;
      sdnnEligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.sdnn = `Длительность недостаточна для стандарта SDNN: покрытие валидными NN-интервалами ${Math.round(acceptedCoverageSeconds)} с (< 300 с / 5 мин)`;
      pnn50Eligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.pnn50 = `Длительность недостаточна для стандарта pNN50: покрытие валидными NN-интервалами ${Math.round(acceptedCoverageSeconds)} с (< 300 с / 5 мин)`;
    } else if (windowHrv.accepted_nn_count < 50) {
      sdnn = null;
      pnn50 = null;
      sdnnEligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.sdnn = `Недостаточно чистых NN-интервалов для SDNN: ${windowHrv.accepted_nn_count} (< 50)`;
      pnn50Eligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.pnn50 = `Недостаточно чистых NN-интервалов для pNN50: ${windowHrv.accepted_nn_count} (< 50)`;
    } else if (continuity.continuity_classification === 'segmented_quality_limited') {
      sdnn = null;
      pnn50 = null;
      sdnnEligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.sdnn = `Прерывистое сегментированное покрытие окна: обнаружена сегментация (${contiguousSegmentCount} сегментов, разрыв ${Math.round(largestGapSeconds)} с); классификация segmented_quality_limited`;
      pnn50Eligibility = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      exclusionReasons.pnn50 = `Прерывистое сегментированное покрытие окна: обнаружена сегментация (${contiguousSegmentCount} сегментов, разрыв ${Math.round(largestGapSeconds)} с); классификация segmented_quality_limited`;
    } else {
      sdnnEligibility = 'ELIGIBLE';
      pnn50Eligibility = 'ELIGIBLE';
    }

    return {
      windowId,
      sessionId,
      name,
      startOffsetSeconds,
      endOffsetSeconds,
      durationSeconds,
      beatCount,
      cleanBeatCount,
      meanHr,
      minHr,
      maxHr,
      rmssd,
      sdnn,
      pnn50,
      meanHrEligibility,
      rmssdEligibility,
      sdnnEligibility,
      pnn50Eligibility,
      exclusionReasons,
      continuity,
      parentCanonicalResultHash: canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash || null,
      parentBeatLedgerHash: canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.beat_ledger_hash || null,
      scientificDisclaimer
    };
  }

  /**
   * Creates a new named window, computes metrics, persists in DB, and returns the result.
   */
  public static async createWindow(
    sessionId: string,
    userId: string | null,
    name: string,
    startOffsetSeconds: number,
    endOffsetSeconds: number
  ): Promise<SessionNamedWindow> {
    const session = getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`Session ${sessionId} not found`);
    }

    // Profile mismatch rejection (STRAT-A3): parent-only profile authority
    if (session.user_id) {
      if (userId && userId !== session.user_id) {
        throw new Error(`PROFILE_MISMATCH: requested userId '${userId}' does not match session profile '${session.user_id}'`);
      }
    } else {
      if (userId) {
        throw new Error(`PROFILE_MISMATCH: caller asserted userId '${userId}' but parent session has no profile owner`);
      }
    }

    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    if (!trimmedName) {
      throw new Error('Window name cannot be empty');
    }

    if (startOffsetSeconds < 0) {
      throw new Error('startOffsetSeconds cannot be negative');
    }

    const maxAllowedEnd = (session.duration_seconds || 0) + 5; // allow 5s grace for timebase jitter
    if (session.duration_seconds && endOffsetSeconds > maxAllowedEnd) {
      throw new Error(`endOffsetSeconds (${endOffsetSeconds}s) exceeds session duration (${session.duration_seconds}s)`);
    }

    const metrics = await this.calculateWindowMetrics(sessionId, startOffsetSeconds, endOffsetSeconds, trimmedName);
    const windowId = `win_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 12)}`;
    metrics.windowId = windowId;

    // Comprehensive result identity with eligibility, exclusion reasons, continuity, and parent provenance (STRAT-A2)
    const resultIdentity = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJsonStringify({
      sessionId,
      parent_canonical_result_hash: metrics.parentCanonicalResultHash || null,
      parent_beat_ledger_hash: metrics.parentBeatLedgerHash || null,
      startOffsetSeconds,
      endOffsetSeconds,
      durationSeconds: endOffsetSeconds - startOffsetSeconds,
      name: trimmedName,
      beatCount: metrics.beatCount,
      cleanBeatCount: metrics.cleanBeatCount,
      metrics: {
        meanHr: metrics.meanHr,
        minHr: metrics.minHr,
        maxHr: metrics.maxHr,
        rmssd: metrics.rmssd,
        sdnn: metrics.sdnn,
        pnn50: metrics.pnn50,
        meanHrEligibility: metrics.meanHrEligibility,
        rmssdEligibility: metrics.rmssdEligibility,
        sdnnEligibility: metrics.sdnnEligibility,
        pnn50Eligibility: metrics.pnn50Eligibility,
        exclusionReasons: metrics.exclusionReasons
      },
      continuity: metrics.continuity,
      policy_method_version: 'v1.1.0'
    })).digest('hex');

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const record: SessionNamedWindowRecord = {
      id: windowId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      user_id: session.user_id || null, // STRAT-A3: Parent-only profile authority, NEVER fallback to caller userId!
      name: trimmedName,
      start_offset_seconds: startOffsetSeconds,
      end_offset_seconds: endOffsetSeconds,
      revision: 1,
      root_window_id: windowId,
      is_active: 1,
      retired_at: null,
      result_identity: resultIdentity,
      metrics_json: JSON.stringify(metrics),
      created_at: now,
      updated_at: now
    };

    saveNamedWindowRecord(record);

    return {
      id: record.id,
      sessionId: record.session_id,
      userId: record.user_id,
      name: record.name,
      startOffsetSeconds: record.start_offset_seconds,
      endOffsetSeconds: record.end_offset_seconds,
      durationSeconds: record.end_offset_seconds - record.start_offset_seconds,
      revision: 1,
      rootWindowId: windowId,
      isActive: true,
      retiredAt: null,
      resultIdentity,
      continuity: metrics.continuity,
      createdAt: record.created_at,
      updatedAt: record.updated_at,
      metrics
    };
  }

  private static mapRecordToWindow(r: SessionNamedWindowRecord): SessionNamedWindow {
    let metrics: NamedWindowMetrics | null = null;
    if (r.metrics_json) {
      try {
        metrics = JSON.parse(r.metrics_json);
      } catch {}
    }
    return {
      id: r.id,
      sessionId: r.session_id,
      userId: r.user_id,
      name: r.name,
      startOffsetSeconds: r.start_offset_seconds,
      endOffsetSeconds: r.end_offset_seconds,
      durationSeconds: r.end_offset_seconds - r.start_offset_seconds,
      revision: r.revision || 1,
      rootWindowId: r.root_window_id || r.id,
      isActive: r.is_active === undefined ? true : Boolean(r.is_active),
      retiredAt: r.retired_at || null,
      resultIdentity: r.result_identity || null,
      continuity: metrics?.continuity || null,
      createdAt: r.created_at,
      updatedAt: r.updated_at,
      metrics
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all named windows for a given session.
   */
  public static async getWindowsForSession(sessionId: string, includeRetired: boolean = false): Promise<SessionNamedWindow[]> {
    const records = getNamedWindowsForSession(sessionId, includeRetired);
    return records.map(r => this.mapRecordToWindow(r));
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves a named window by its unique ID.
   */
  public static async getWindowById(id: string): Promise<SessionNamedWindow | null> {
    const r = getNamedWindowById(id);
    if (!r) return null;
    return this.mapRecordToWindow(r);
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves full revision history for a named window root ID.
   */
  public static async getWindowRevisionHistory(rootWindowId: string): Promise<SessionNamedWindow[]> {
    const records = getNamedWindowRevisionHistory(rootWindowId);
    return records.map(r => this.mapRecordToWindow(r));
  }

  /**
   * Updates an existing window (e.g. rename or re-slice).
   * Recomputes metrics and increments optimistic revision counter.
   */
  public static async updateWindow(
    id: string,
    updates: { name?: string; startOffsetSeconds?: number; endOffsetSeconds?: number; expectedRevision?: number }
  ): Promise<SessionNamedWindow | null> {
    const current = await this.getWindowById(id);
    if (!current) return null;

    const session = getSession(current.sessionId);
    const newName = updates.name !== undefined ? updates.name.trim() : current.name;
    if (!newName) {
      throw new Error('Window name cannot be empty');
    }

    const newStart = updates.startOffsetSeconds !== undefined ? updates.startOffsetSeconds : current.startOffsetSeconds;
    const newEnd = updates.endOffsetSeconds !== undefined ? updates.endOffsetSeconds : current.endOffsetSeconds;

    if (newStart < 0) {
      throw new Error('startOffsetSeconds cannot be negative');
    }
    if (newEnd <= newStart) {
      throw new Error('Invalid window bounds: endOffsetSeconds must exceed startOffsetSeconds');
    }

    const maxAllowedEnd = (session?.duration_seconds || 0) + 5;
    if (session?.duration_seconds && newEnd > maxAllowedEnd) {
      throw new Error(`endOffsetSeconds (${newEnd}s) exceeds session duration (${session.duration_seconds}s)`);
    }

    const newRevisionId = `win_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 12)}`;
    const metrics = await this.calculateWindowMetrics(current.sessionId, newStart, newEnd, newName);
    metrics.windowId = newRevisionId;

    const resultIdentity = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJsonStringify({
      sessionId: current.sessionId,
      parent_canonical_result_hash: metrics.parentCanonicalResultHash || null,
      parent_beat_ledger_hash: metrics.parentBeatLedgerHash || null,
      startOffsetSeconds: newStart,
      endOffsetSeconds: newEnd,
      durationSeconds: newEnd - newStart,
      name: newName,
      beatCount: metrics.beatCount,
      cleanBeatCount: metrics.cleanBeatCount,
      metrics: {
        meanHr: metrics.meanHr,
        minHr: metrics.minHr,
        maxHr: metrics.maxHr,
        rmssd: metrics.rmssd,
        sdnn: metrics.sdnn,
        pnn50: metrics.pnn50,
        meanHrEligibility: metrics.meanHrEligibility,
        rmssdEligibility: metrics.rmssdEligibility,
        sdnnEligibility: metrics.sdnnEligibility,
        pnn50Eligibility: metrics.pnn50Eligibility,
        exclusionReasons: metrics.exclusionReasons
      },
      continuity: metrics.continuity,
      policy_method_version: 'v1.1.0'
    })).digest('hex');

    const result = updateNamedWindowRecord(id, {
      name: newName,
      start_offset_seconds: newStart,
      end_offset_seconds: newEnd,
      metrics_json: JSON.stringify(metrics),
      result_identity: resultIdentity,
      new_id: newRevisionId
    } as any, updates.expectedRevision);

    if (result.error === 'CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT') {
      const err = new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Window revision mismatch (expected ${updates.expectedRevision}, current is ${result.currentRevision})`);
      (err as any).statusCode = 409;
      (err as any).currentRevision = result.currentRevision;
      throw err;
    }

    if (!result.success || !result.newRecord) return null;
    return this.mapRecordToWindow(result.newRecord);
  }

  /**
   * Deletes a named window by ID.
   */
  public static async deleteWindow(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return deleteNamedWindowRecord(id);
  }

  /**
   * Compares two named windows descriptively with overlap and context disclosure (Section E).
   * Blocks identical source/bounds self-comparison.
   * Windows are never admitted to personal baseline cohorts.
   */
  public static async compareNamedWindows(windowAId: string, windowBId: string): Promise<NamedWindowComparisonResult> {
    if (windowAId === windowBId) {
      throw new Error('Самостоятельное сравнение идентичного окна заблокировано (Self-comparison of identical window is blocked)');
    }

    const winA = await this.getWindowById(windowAId);
    const winB = await this.getWindowById(windowBId);

    if (!winA) throw new Error(`Window ${windowAId} not found`);
    if (!winB) throw new Error(`Window ${windowBId} not found`);

    if (winA.sessionId !== winB.sessionId) {
      const err = new Error('Cross-session window comparison is prohibited. Use canonical session comparison (peer/baseline).');
      (err as any).statusCode = 400;
      (err as any).errorCode = 'CROSS_SESSION_WINDOWS_PROHIBITED';
      throw err;
    }

    if (
      winA.startOffsetSeconds === winB.startOffsetSeconds &&
      winA.endOffsetSeconds === winB.endOffsetSeconds
    ) {
      throw new Error('Сравнение окон с идентичными временными границами заблокировано');
    }

    const sameParentSession = true;

    // Detect temporal overlap within parent session
    let hasOverlap = false;
    let overlapSeconds = 0;
    const maxStart = Math.max(winA.startOffsetSeconds, winB.startOffsetSeconds);
    const minEnd = Math.min(winA.endOffsetSeconds, winB.endOffsetSeconds);
    if (minEnd > maxStart) {
      hasOverlap = true;
      overlapSeconds = Math.round((minEnd - maxStart) * 10) / 10;
    }

    const deltaMeanHr = (winA.metrics?.meanHr !== null && winA.metrics?.meanHr !== undefined &&
                         winB.metrics?.meanHr !== null && winB.metrics?.meanHr !== undefined)
      ? Math.round((winB.metrics.meanHr - winA.metrics.meanHr) * 10) / 10
      : null;

    const deltaRmssd = (winA.metrics?.rmssd !== null && winA.metrics?.rmssd !== undefined &&
                        winB.metrics?.rmssd !== null && winB.metrics?.rmssd !== undefined)
      ? Math.round((winB.metrics.rmssd - winA.metrics.rmssd) * 10) / 10
      : null;

    const comparisonId = 'cmp_' + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${winA.id}:rev${winA.revision || 1}:${winB.id}:rev${winB.revision || 1}`).digest('hex').substring(0, 12);

    return {
      comparison_id: comparisonId,
      session_id: winA.sessionId,
      window_a: winA,
      window_b: winB,
      same_parent_session: sameParentSession,
      has_temporal_overlap: hasOverlap,
      overlap_seconds: overlapSeconds,
      delta_mean_hr: deltaMeanHr,
      delta_rmssd: deltaRmssd,
      comparison_mode: 'descriptive_non_inferential',
      baseline_admission_blocked: true,
      scientific_disclaimer: 'Сравнение пользовательских окон носит сугубо описательный характер без расчета статистической достоверности (p-значений). Окна исключены из расчета базовых коридоров.'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Strategy North Star Metrics Service: Accepted Session Outcomes per Active User
 *
 * Requirements:
 * 1. Supported bundle imported
 * 2. Grouping confirmed
 * 3. Canonical analysis completed
 * 4. Canonical result viewed
 * 5. No unresolved hard failure
 * 6. At least one meaningful follow-up action:
 *    - comparison opened
 *    - report exported
 *    - AI Pack generated
 *    - Advanced detail opened
 *
 * Excludes:
 * - Raw file import alone
 * - Failed sessions
 * - Empty/unsupported input
 * - Sample/demo data counted as real outcomes (must be separated)
 */

import {
  AcceptedSessionOutcome,
  MeaningfulFollowUpAction,
  evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export interface NorthStarCalculationResult {
  cohort_id?: string;
  total_users_active: number;
  total_sessions_attempted: number;
  total_accepted_outcomes: number;
  north_star_ratio: number | null; // Accepted Session Outcomes per Active User, null if 0 active users
  sample_or_demo_outcomes_count: number;
  action_breakdown: {
    comparison_count: number;
    report_count: number;
    llm_pack_count: number;
    advanced_detail_count: number;
  };
  funnel: {
    imports_attempted: number;
    grouping_confirmed: number;
    analysis_completed: number;
    overview_viewed: number;
    meaningful_action_taken: number;
  };
}

export function buildAcceptedSessionOutcome(input: {
  outcome_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  bundle_imported: boolean;
  grouping_confirmed: boolean;
  canonical_analysis_completed: boolean;
  canonical_result_viewed: boolean;
  has_unresolved_hard_failure: boolean;
  meaningful_actions: MeaningfulFollowUpAction[];
  is_sample_or_demo?: boolean;
  completed_at_utc?: string;
}): AcceptedSessionOutcome {
  return evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome({
    outcome_id: input.outcome_id,
    session_id: input.session_id,
    participant_id: input.participant_id,
    cohort_id: input.cohort_id,
    bundle_imported: input.bundle_imported,
    grouping_confirmed: input.grouping_confirmed,
    canonical_analysis_completed: input.canonical_analysis_completed,
    canonical_result_viewed: input.canonical_result_viewed,
    has_unresolved_hard_failure: input.has_unresolved_hard_failure,
    meaningful_actions: input.meaningful_actions,
    is_sample_or_demo: Boolean(input.is_sample_or_demo),
    completed_at_utc: input.completed_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  });
}

export function computeNorthStarMetrics(
  outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[],
  options?: { excludeSampleData?: boolean; cohortId?: string }
): NorthStarCalculationResult {
  const excludeSample = options?.excludeSampleData ?? true;
  const filtered = outcomes.filter((o) => {
    if (options?.cohortId && o.cohort_id !== options.cohortId) return false;
    if (excludeSample && o.is_sample_or_demo) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const sampleCount = outcomes.filter((o) => {
    if (options?.cohortId && o.cohort_id !== options.cohortId) return false;
    return o.is_sample_or_demo && o.is_accepted_outcome;
  }).length;

  const uniqueUsers = new Set<string>();
  let acceptedOutcomesCount = 0;

  const actionBreakdown = {
    comparison_count: 0,
    report_count: 0,
    llm_pack_count: 0,
    advanced_detail_count: 0
  };

  const funnel = {
    imports_attempted: 0,
    grouping_confirmed: 0,
    analysis_completed: 0,
    overview_viewed: 0,
    meaningful_action_taken: 0
  };

  for (const item of filtered) {
    uniqueUsers.add(item.participant_id);

    if (item.bundle_imported) funnel.imports_attempted += 1;
    if (item.bundle_imported && item.grouping_confirmed) funnel.grouping_confirmed += 1;
    if (item.bundle_imported && item.grouping_confirmed && item.canonical_analysis_completed) funnel.analysis_completed += 1;
    if (item.bundle_imported && item.grouping_confirmed && item.canonical_analysis_completed && item.canonical_result_viewed) funnel.overview_viewed += 1;
    if (item.meaningful_actions.length > 0) funnel.meaningful_action_taken += 1;

    for (const act of item.meaningful_actions) {
      if (act === 'comparison_opened') actionBreakdown.comparison_count += 1;
      if (act === 'report_exported') actionBreakdown.report_count += 1;
      if (act === 'llm_pack_generated') actionBreakdown.llm_pack_count += 1;
      if (act === 'advanced_detail_opened') actionBreakdown.advanced_detail_count += 1;
    }

    if (item.is_accepted_outcome) {
      acceptedOutcomesCount += 1;
    }
  }

  const activeUserCount = uniqueUsers.size;
  const ratio = activeUserCount > 0 ? Number((acceptedOutcomesCount / activeUserCount).toFixed(2)) : null;

  return {
    cohort_id: options?.cohortId,
    total_users_active: activeUserCount,
    total_sessions_attempted: filtered.length,
    total_accepted_outcomes: acceptedOutcomesCount,
    north_star_ratio: ratio,
    sample_or_demo_outcomes_count: sampleCount,
    action_breakdown: actionBreakdown,
    funnel
  };
}

export function calculateActivationFunnel(outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[]) {
  const metrics = computeNorthStarMetrics(outcomes, { excludeSampleData: false });
  const total = metrics.total_sessions_attempted || 1;
  return {
    stages: [
      { stage: 'supported_bundle_imported', count: metrics.funnel.imports_attempted },
      { stage: 'grouping_confirmed', count: metrics.funnel.grouping_confirmed },
      { stage: 'canonical_analysis_completed', count: metrics.funnel.analysis_completed },
      { stage: 'canonical_result_viewed', count: metrics.funnel.overview_viewed },
      { stage: 'first_meaningful_action_taken', count: metrics.funnel.meaningful_action_taken }
    ],
    overall_conversion_pct: Number(((metrics.total_accepted_outcomes / total) * 100).toFixed(1))
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/analytics/PairedBenchmarkHarness.ts

/**
 * PairedBenchmarkHarness.ts
 *
 * Evaluates QRS peak detection sensitivity, positive predictive value, F1,
 * timing error distribution, and multi-modal ECG vs RR technical agreement (EVI-05).
 * Non-diagnostic and fail-closed.
 */

import {
  PairedQrsBenchmarkMetrics,
  PairedEcgRrAgreementMetrics
} from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';

export interface QrsEvaluationOptions {
  toleranceMs: number;
  samplingRateHz?: number;
}

export class PairedBenchmarkHarness {
  /**
   * Computes 1-to-1 greedy matching between detected peaks and independent reference beats.
   */
  public static evaluateQrsDetection(
    detectedMs: number[],
    referenceMs: number[],
    options: QrsEvaluationOptions
  ): PairedQrsBenchmarkMetrics {
    const tol = options.toleranceMs;
    const sortedDet = [...detectedMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sortedRef = [...referenceMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    const matchedRefIndices = new Set<number>();
    const absoluteErrors: number[] = [];

    let tp = 0;
    for (const detTime of sortedDet) {
      let closestRefIdx = -1;
      let minDiff = Infinity;

      for (let i = 0; i < sortedRef.length; i++) {
        if (matchedRefIndices.has(i)) continue;
        const diff = Math.abs(detTime - sortedRef[i]);
        if (diff <= tol && diff < minDiff) {
          minDiff = diff;
          closestRefIdx = i;
        }
      }

      if (closestRefIdx !== -1) {
        matchedRefIndices.add(closestRefIdx);
        absoluteErrors.push(minDiff);
        tp++;
      }
    }

    const fp = sortedDet.length - tp;
    const fn = sortedRef.length - tp;

    const sensitivity = sortedRef.length > 0 ? tp / sortedRef.length : 0;
    const ppv = sortedDet.length > 0 ? tp / sortedDet.length : 0;
    const f1 = (sensitivity + ppv) > 0 ? (2 * sensitivity * ppv) / (sensitivity + ppv) : 0;

    let meanError = 0;
    let medianError = 0;
    let p95Error = 0;

    if (absoluteErrors.length > 0) {
      absoluteErrors.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const sum = absoluteErrors.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
      meanError = sum / absoluteErrors.length;
      medianError = absoluteErrors[Math.floor(absoluteErrors.length / 2)];
      const p95Idx = Math.min(absoluteErrors.length - 1, Math.floor(absoluteErrors.length * 0.95));
      p95Error = absoluteErrors[p95Idx];
    }

    return {
      tolerance_ms: tol,
      detected_count: sortedDet.length,
      reference_count: sortedRef.length,
      true_positives: tp,
      false_positives: fp,
      false_negatives: fn,
      sensitivity: Math.round(sensitivity * 10000) / 10000,
      positive_predictive_value: Math.round(ppv * 10000) / 10000,
      f1_score: Math.round(f1 * 10000) / 10000,
      mean_absolute_error_ms: Math.round(meanError * 100) / 100,
      median_absolute_error_ms: Math.round(medianError * 100) / 100,
      p95_absolute_error_ms: Math.round(p95Error * 100) / 100
    };
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates technical agreement between derived ECG R-peak intervals and paired Polar RR intervals.
   */
  public static evaluateEcgRrAgreement(
    ecgPeakTimestampsMs: number[],
    rawRrIntervalsMs: number[],
    rawRrTimestampsMs: number[]
  ): PairedEcgRrAgreementMetrics {
    const disclaimer = 'Technical cross-signal agreement check only. Non-diagnostic and non-clinical.';

    if (
      !ecgPeakTimestampsMs ||
      ecgPeakTimestampsMs.length < 2 ||
      !rawRrIntervalsMs ||
      rawRrIntervalsMs.length === 0
    ) {
      return {
        total_evaluated_beats: 0,
        matched_beats_count: 0,
        match_rate_50ms: null,
        mean_abs_difference_ms: null,
        p95_abs_difference_ms: null,
        quality_stratum: 'insufficient_data',
        agreement_state: 'not_evaluated',
        disclaimer
      };
    }

    // Derive ECG RR intervals
    const ecgRrIntervals: { timeMs: number; rrMs: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < ecgPeakTimestampsMs.length; i++) {
      const interval = ecgPeakTimestampsMs[i] - ecgPeakTimestampsMs[i - 1];
      ecgRrIntervals.push({
        timeMs: ecgPeakTimestampsMs[i],
        rrMs: interval
      });
    }

    // Match ECG intervals with raw RR intervals within 100ms temporal window
    let matchedCount = 0;
    let within50msCount = 0;
    const diffs: number[] = [];

    for (const ecgItem of ecgRrIntervals) {
      // Find nearest raw RR timestamp
      let closestIdx = -1;
      let minDiff = Infinity;
      for (let j = 0; j < rawRrTimestampsMs.length; j++) {
        const timeDiff = Math.abs(ecgItem.timeMs - rawRrTimestampsMs[j]);
        if (timeDiff <= 150 && timeDiff < minDiff) {
          minDiff = timeDiff;
          closestIdx = j;
        }
      }

      if (closestIdx !== -1) {
        matchedCount++;
        const intervalDiff = Math.abs(ecgItem.rrMs - rawRrIntervalsMs[closestIdx]);
        diffs.push(intervalDiff);
        if (intervalDiff <= 50) {
          within50msCount++;
        }
      }
    }

    if (matchedCount === 0) {
      return {
        total_evaluated_beats: ecgRrIntervals.length,
        matched_beats_count: 0,
        match_rate_50ms: 0,
        mean_abs_difference_ms: null,
        p95_abs_difference_ms: null,
        quality_stratum: 'unreliable',
        agreement_state: 'quality_limited',
        disclaimer
      };
    }

    diffs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sum = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const meanDiff = sum / diffs.length;
    const p95Idx = Math.min(diffs.length - 1, Math.floor(diffs.length * 0.95));
    const p95Diff = diffs[p95Idx];
    const matchRate = (within50msCount / matchedCount) * 100;

    let quality: PairedEcgRrAgreementMetrics['quality_stratum'] = 'high_quality';
    let state: PairedEcgRrAgreementMetrics['agreement_state'] = 'concordant';

    if (matchRate < 80) {
      quality = 'unreliable';
      state = 'discordant';
    } else if (matchRate < 95) {
      quality = 'moderate_noise';
      state = 'quality_limited';
    }

    return {
      total_evaluated_beats: ecgRrIntervals.length,
      matched_beats_count: matchedCount,
      match_rate_50ms: Math.round(matchRate * 10) / 10,
      mean_abs_difference_ms: Math.round(meanDiff * 10) / 10,
      p95_abs_difference_ms: Math.round(p95Diff * 10) / 10,
      quality_stratum: quality,
      agreement_state: state,
      disclaimer
    };
  }
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/analytics/qrs.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import { parseRawLine } from '../signals/rawParsers';

class MovingAverageBandpass {
  private buffer: number[] = [];
  public step(x: number): number {
    this.buffer.push(x);
    if (this.buffer.length > 30) {
      this.buffer.shift();
    }
    // 5-sample lowpass average (smooths out high frequency spikes)
    const lpSum = this.buffer.slice(-5).reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0);
    const lp = lpSum / Math.min(5, this.buffer.length);
    
    // 30-sample highpass average (cancels slow baseline wander)
    const hpSum = this.buffer.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0);
    const hp = hpSum / this.buffer.length;
    
    return lp - hp;
  }
}

class DerivativeFilter {
  private buffer: number[] = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  public step(x: number): number {
    this.buffer.push(x);
    this.buffer.shift();
    // 5-point derivative difference equation
    return (2 * this.buffer[4] + this.buffer[3] - this.buffer[1] - 2 * this.buffer[0]) / 8;
  }
}

class MovingWindowIntegrator {
  private buffer: number[] = [];
  public step(x: number): number {
    this.buffer.push(x);
    if (this.buffer.length > 20) { // 20 samples at 130Hz is ~154ms
      this.buffer.shift();
    }
    return this.buffer.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / this.buffer.length;
  }
}

export interface QrsDetectorResult {
  peak_indices: number[];
  peak_timestamps_ms: number[];
  peak_amplitudes_uv: number[];
  sample_rate_hz: number;
  detector_id: string;
  detector_version: string;
  method_name: string;
  limitations: string[];
}

/**
 * Reusable production QRS peak detector core using adapted Pan-Tompkins algorithm for 130 Hz.
 * Accepts a microvolt sample array, explicit sample rate, and optional exact timebase array.
 */
export function detectQrsFromSamples(
  ecgSamples: Float32Array | number[],
  sampleRateHz: number = 130,
  timebaseMs?: number[]
): QrsDetectorResult {
  const n = ecgSamples.length;
  if (n === 0) {
    return {
      peak_indices: [],
      peak_timestamps_ms: [],
      peak_amplitudes_uv: [],
      sample_rate_hz: sampleRateHz,
      detector_id: 'qrs_pan_tompkins_130hz',
      detector_version: '1.2.0-PanTompkins-130Hz',
      method_name: 'Adapted Pan-Tompkins QRS Detector (130 Hz)',
      limitations: ['Signal too short or empty']
    };
  }

  const bandpass = new MovingAverageBandpass();
  const derivative = new DerivativeFilter();
  const integrator = new MovingWindowIntegrator();

  const peakIndices: number[] = [];
  const peakTimestampsMs: number[] = [];
  const peakAmplitudesUv: number[] = [];

  // Buffer for local peak search (last 3 integrator values)
  const intHistory: number[] = [0, 0, 0];

  // Adaptive threshold variables
  let spki = 1500;     // running estimate of signal peak
  let npki = 400;      // running estimate of noise peak
  let threshold = npki + 0.25 * (spki - npki);
  let lastPeakSample = -999;
  let lastPeakIntegratorVal = 0;

  // Refractory period: 26 samples at 130 Hz = 200 ms
  const refractorySamples = Math.round(0.200 * sampleRateHz);

  // Helper to find exact R-peak (maximum voltage) in raw ECG in the search window preceding integrator peak
  const findRWavePeak = (intPeakIdx: number): number => {
    const searchStart = Math.max(0, intPeakIdx - Math.round(0.150 * sampleRateHz)); // ~150 ms window
    const searchEnd = Math.min(n - 1, intPeakIdx);
    let maxV = -Infinity;
    let maxIdx = intPeakIdx;
    for (let s = searchStart; s <= searchEnd; s++) {
      const v = ecgSamples[s];
      if (v > maxV) {
        maxV = v;
        maxIdx = s;
      }
    }
    return maxIdx;
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const ecgUv = ecgSamples[i];

    // 1. Digital Filters
    const bpOut = bandpass.step(ecgUv);
    const derOut = derivative.step(bpOut);
    const sqOut = derOut ** 2;
    const intOut = integrator.step(sqOut);

    // 2. Peak Search
    intHistory.push(intOut);
    intHistory.shift();

    // Check if middle element is a local peak (concave downward, handling plateaus)
    if (intHistory[1] >= intHistory[0] && intHistory[1] > intHistory[2]) {
      const peakVal = intHistory[1];
      const peakSampleIndex = i - 1;

      // 3. Threshold Check
      if (peakVal > threshold) {
        const samplesSinceLastPeak = peakSampleIndex - lastPeakSample;
        if (samplesSinceLastPeak > refractorySamples) {
          // Valid QRS peak! Locate exact R-peak in raw signal
          const rPeakIndex = findRWavePeak(peakSampleIndex);
          const peakTimeMs = timebaseMs && timebaseMs[rPeakIndex] !== undefined
            ? timebaseMs[rPeakIndex]
            : Math.round(rPeakIndex * (1000 / sampleRateHz));

          peakIndices.push(rPeakIndex);
          peakTimestampsMs.push(peakTimeMs);
          peakAmplitudesUv.push(ecgSamples[rPeakIndex]);
          lastPeakSample = peakSampleIndex;
          lastPeakIntegratorVal = peakVal;

          // Update signal peak estimate
          spki = 0.125 * peakVal + 0.875 * spki;
        } else {
          // Within refractory period. Check if this peak is larger than the last accepted peak (re-alignment)
          if (peakIndices.length > 0 && peakVal > lastPeakIntegratorVal) {
            const rPeakIndex = findRWavePeak(peakSampleIndex);
            const peakTimeMs = timebaseMs && timebaseMs[rPeakIndex] !== undefined
              ? timebaseMs[rPeakIndex]
              : Math.round(rPeakIndex * (1000 / sampleRateHz));

            peakIndices[peakIndices.length - 1] = rPeakIndex;
            peakTimestampsMs[peakTimestampsMs.length - 1] = peakTimeMs;
            peakAmplitudesUv[peakAmplitudesUv.length - 1] = ecgSamples[rPeakIndex];
            lastPeakSample = peakSampleIndex;
            lastPeakIntegratorVal = peakVal;
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Noise peak
        npki = 0.125 * peakVal + 0.875 * npki;
      }

      // Update threshold
      threshold = npki + 0.25 * (spki - npki);
    }
  }

  return {
    peak_indices: peakIndices,
    peak_timestamps_ms: peakTimestampsMs,
    peak_amplitudes_uv: peakAmplitudesUv,
    sample_rate_hz: sampleRateHz,
    detector_id: 'qrs_pan_tompkins_130hz',
    detector_version: '1.2.0-PanTompkins-130Hz',
    method_name: 'Adapted Pan-Tompkins QRS Detector (130 Hz)',
    limitations: [
      'Adapted for Polar H10 single-lead ECG sampled at 130 Hz.',
      'Exploratory non-diagnostic peak detector; not a clinical arrhythmia detector.'
    ]
  };
}

/**
 * Detects QRS peaks from a gzipped raw ECG log file using the production Pan-Tompkins core.
 * Returns an array of relative timestamps in milliseconds.
 */
export async function detectQrsPeaks(archivePath: string): Promise<number[]> {
  if (!fs.existsSync(archivePath)) {
    return [];
  }

  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(archivePath);
  const gunzip = zlib.createGunzip();
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream.pipe(gunzip),
    crlfDelay: Infinity
  });

  const ecgSamples: number[] = [];
  const timebaseMs: number[] = [];
  let isHeader = true;

  for await (const line of rl) {
    if (isHeader) {
      isHeader = false;
      continue;
    }

    const parts = parseRawLine(line);
    if (parts.length < 4) continue;

    const relativeTimeMs = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
    const ecgUv = parseFloat(parts[3]);

    if (isNaN(relativeTimeMs) || isNaN(ecgUv)) continue;

    ecgSamples.push(ecgUv);
    timebaseMs.push(relativeTimeMs);
  }

  const result = detectQrsFromSamples(ecgSamples, 130, timebaseMs);
  return result.peak_timestamps_ms;
}

/**
 * TimebaseSynchronizationService.ts
 *
 * Explicit clock/timebase alignment and uncertainty quantification engine (EVI-04).
 * Supports sensor monotonic clocks, wall-clock phone epochs, and cross-channel sync.
 * Guarantees fail-closed unknown states when clock evidence is insufficient.
 */

import {
  EmpiricalChannelType,
  TimeAlignmentResult
} from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';

export interface TimestampedSample {
  timestamp_ms: number;
  value: number;
  sensor_monotonic_ns?: number;
  phone_epoch_ms?: number;
}

export interface AlignmentEvaluationInput {
  primary_channel: EmpiricalChannelType;
  secondary_channel: EmpiricalChannelType;
  primary_timestamps_ms: number[];
  secondary_timestamps_ms: number[];
  primary_monotonic_ns?: number[];
  secondary_monotonic_ns?: number[];
  known_hardware_offset_ms?: number;
  max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms?: number;
}

export class TimebaseSynchronizationService {
  /**
   * Synchronizes two timestamp streams and computes residual uncertainty.
   * If timestamps cannot be aligned reliably, returns alignment_quality = 'unreliable'
   * or 'insufficient_evidence' and is_aligned = false.
   */
  public static alignTimebases(input: AlignmentEvaluationInput): TimeAlignmentResult {
    const maxUncertainty = input.max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms ?? 10.0;
    const notes: string[] = [];

    // 1. Check data availability
    if (
      !input.primary_timestamps_ms ||
      input.primary_timestamps_ms.length === 0 ||
      !input.secondary_timestamps_ms ||
      input.secondary_timestamps_ms.length === 0
    ) {
      return {
        alignment_id: `sync_${Date.now()}`,
        primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
        secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
        alignment_method: 'insufficient_evidence',
        offset_ms: 0,
        drift_ppm: 0,
        residual_uncertainty_ms: Infinity,
        alignment_quality: 'unknown',
        is_aligned: false,
        notes: ['One or both timestamp streams are empty. Cannot establish alignment.']
      };
    }

    // 2. Monotonicity validation
    const isPrimaryMonotonic = TimebaseSynchronizationService.checkMonotonicity(input.primary_timestamps_ms);
    const isSecondaryMonotonic = TimebaseSynchronizationService.checkMonotonicity(input.secondary_timestamps_ms);

    if (!isPrimaryMonotonic || !isSecondaryMonotonic) {
      notes.push('Non-monotonic timestamps detected in input stream.');
      return {
        alignment_id: `sync_${Date.now()}`,
        primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
        secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
        alignment_method: 'insufficient_evidence',
        offset_ms: 0,
        drift_ppm: 0,
        residual_uncertainty_ms: Infinity,
        alignment_quality: 'unreliable',
        is_aligned: false,
        notes
      };
    }

    // 3. Hardware monotonic clock synchronization
    if (
      input.primary_monotonic_ns &&
      input.secondary_monotonic_ns &&
      input.primary_monotonic_ns.length > 0 &&
      input.secondary_monotonic_ns.length > 0
    ) {
      const pStartNs = input.primary_monotonic_ns[0];
      const sStartNs = input.secondary_monotonic_ns[0];
      const offsetNs = sStartNs - pStartNs;
      const offsetMs = offsetNs / 1_000_000;

      // Residual uncertainty is nanosecond clock precision (~1ms at 130 Hz)
      const residualUncertainty = 1.0;
      const isAligned = residualUncertainty <= maxUncertainty;

      notes.push('Aligned using high-resolution sensor monotonic clock.');
      return {
        alignment_id: `sync_mono_${Date.now()}`,
        primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
        secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
        alignment_method: 'sensor_monotonic_anchor',
        offset_ms: Math.round(offsetMs * 100) / 100,
        drift_ppm: 0.0,
        residual_uncertainty_ms: residualUncertainty,
        alignment_quality: 'exact',
        is_aligned: isAligned,
        notes
      };
    }

    // 4. Fallback to start timestamp alignment if known hardware offset is provided
    if (input.known_hardware_offset_ms !== undefined) {
      const offsetMs = input.known_hardware_offset_ms;
      const residualUncertainty = 5.0; // Bounded clock model
      const isAligned = residualUncertainty <= maxUncertainty;

      notes.push(`Aligned using declared hardware offset model (${offsetMs} ms).`);
      return {
        alignment_id: `sync_model_${Date.now()}`,
        primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
        secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
        alignment_method: 'clock_offset_model',
        offset_ms: offsetMs,
        drift_ppm: 0.0,
        residual_uncertainty_ms: residualUncertainty,
        alignment_quality: 'bounded',
        is_aligned: isAligned,
        notes
      };
    }

    // 5. Overlap evaluation
    const pMin = input.primary_timestamps_ms[0];
    const pMax = input.primary_timestamps_ms[input.primary_timestamps_ms.length - 1];
    const sMin = input.secondary_timestamps_ms[0];
    const sMax = input.secondary_timestamps_ms[input.secondary_timestamps_ms.length - 1];

    const overlapStart = Math.max(pMin, sMin);
    const overlapEnd = Math.min(pMax, sMax);
    const overlapMs = overlapEnd - overlapStart;

    if (overlapMs < 1000) {
      notes.push('Insufficient timestamp overlap (< 1.0s). Cannot establish temporal alignment.');
      return {
        alignment_id: `sync_nooverlap_${Date.now()}`,
        primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
        secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
        alignment_method: 'insufficient_evidence',
        offset_ms: sMin - pMin,
        drift_ppm: 0,
        residual_uncertainty_ms: Infinity,
        alignment_quality: 'unreliable',
        is_aligned: false,
        notes
      };
    }

    // Relative offset estimation
    const offsetMs = sMin - pMin;
    const residualUncertainty = 8.0; // wall clock estimate

    return {
      alignment_id: `sync_wall_${Date.now()}`,
      primary_channel: input.primary_channel,
      secondary_channel: input.secondary_channel,
      alignment_method: 'cross_correlation',
      offset_ms: Math.round(offsetMs * 10) / 10,
      drift_ppm: 0.0,
      residual_uncertainty_ms: residualUncertainty,
      alignment_quality: 'bounded',
      is_aligned: residualUncertainty <= maxUncertainty,
      notes
    };
  }

  private static checkMonotonicity(timestamps: number[]): boolean {
    for (let i = 1; i < timestamps.length; i++) {
      if (timestamps[i] < timestamps[i - 1]) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}

export interface TrendInterpretation {
  baseline: {
    rmssd_ms: { available: boolean; median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null; count: number };
    sdnn_ms: { available: boolean; median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null; count: number };
    pnn50_percent: { available: boolean; median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null; count: number };
    avg_hr_bpm: { available: boolean; median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null; count: number };
  };
  baseline_source: 'personal_activity_specific' | 'personal_global' | 'reference_fallback' | 'unavailable';
  baseline_confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'none';

  sessions_used: number;

    };
