function calculateMedian(values: number[]): number {
  if (values.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const half = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  if (sorted.length % 2 !== 0) {
    return sorted[half];
  }
  return (sorted[half - 1] + sorted[half]) / 2.0;
}

function calculatePercentile(values: number[], p: number): number | null {
  if (values.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  const idx = (n - 1) * p;
  const low = Math.floor(idx);
  const high = Math.ceil(idx);
  const weight = idx - low;
  return Math.round((sorted[low] * (1 - weight) + sorted[high] * weight) * 10) / 10;
}

export function interpretTrends(allSessions: TrendSession[], currentSessionId?: string): TrendInterpretation {
  // 1. Calculate per-metric eligible sessions (leave-one-out)
  const isRmssdValid = (s: TrendSession) => {
    if (s.id === currentSessionId) return false;
    if (s.rmssd === null || s.rmssd === undefined) return false;
    if (s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') return false; // Strict canonical requirement
    return s.rmssd_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE';
  };

  const isSdnnValid = (s: TrendSession) => {
    if (s.id === currentSessionId) return false;
    if (s.sdnn === null || s.sdnn === undefined) return false;
    if (s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') return false;
    return s.sdnn_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE';
  };

  const isPnn50Valid = (s: TrendSession) => {
    if (s.id === currentSessionId) return false;
    if (s.pnn50 === null || s.pnn50 === undefined) return false;
    if (s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') return false;
    return s.pnn50_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE';
  };

  const isAvgHrValid = (s: TrendSession) => {
    if (s.id === currentSessionId) return false;
    if (s.avg_hr === null || s.avg_hr === undefined) return false;
    if (s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') return false;
    return s.mean_hr_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || s.mean_hr_eligibility === undefined;
  };

  const histRmssd = allSessions.filter(isRmssdValid).map(s => s.rmssd!).filter(v => v !== null);
  const histSdnn = allSessions.filter(isSdnnValid).map(s => s.sdnn!).filter(v => v !== null);
  const histPnn50 = allSessions.filter(isPnn50Valid).map(s => s.pnn50!).filter(v => v !== null);
  const histAvgHr = allSessions.filter(isAvgHrValid).map(s => s.avg_hr!).filter(v => v !== null);

  // Baseline corridors with global fallback constants
  const minSessions = 5;
  const rmssdBand = {
    available: histRmssd.length >= minSessions,
    median: histRmssd.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histRmssd, 0.5) : 35.0,
    p25: histRmssd.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histRmssd, 0.25) : 25.0,
    p75: histRmssd.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histRmssd, 0.75) : 45.0,
    count: histRmssd.length
  };

  const sdnnBand = {
    available: histSdnn.length >= minSessions,
    median: histSdnn.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histSdnn, 0.5) : 50.0,
    p25: histSdnn.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histSdnn, 0.25) : 35.0,
    p75: histSdnn.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histSdnn, 0.75) : 65.0,
    count: histSdnn.length
  };

  const pnn50Band = {
    available: histPnn50.length >= minSessions,
    median: histPnn50.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histPnn50, 0.5) : 15.0,
    p25: histPnn50.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histPnn50, 0.25) : 5.0,
    p75: histPnn50.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histPnn50, 0.75) : 25.0,
    count: histPnn50.length
  };

  const avgHrBand = {
    available: histAvgHr.length >= minSessions,
    median: histAvgHr.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histAvgHr, 0.5) : 70.0,
    p25: histAvgHr.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histAvgHr, 0.25) : 60.0,
    p75: histAvgHr.length >= minSessions ? calculatePercentile(histAvgHr, 0.75) : 80.0,
    count: histAvgHr.length
  };

  const baseline = {
    rmssd_ms: { available: rmssdBand.available, median: rmssdBand.median, p25: rmssdBand.p25, p75: rmssdBand.p75, count: rmssdBand.count },
    sdnn_ms: { available: sdnnBand.available, median: sdnnBand.median, p25: sdnnBand.p25, p75: sdnnBand.p75, count: sdnnBand.count },
    pnn50_percent: { available: pnn50Band.available, median: pnn50Band.median, p25: pnn50Band.p25, p75: pnn50Band.p75, count: pnn50Band.count },
    avg_hr_bpm: { available: avgHrBand.available, median: avgHrBand.median, p25: avgHrBand.p25, p75: avgHrBand.p75, count: avgHrBand.count }
  };

  // 2. Summary statistics calculations
  const total_sessions = allSessions.length;
  const qualityScores = allSessions.map(s => s.overall_quality_score).filter(v => v !== null) as number[];
  const average_quality = qualityScores.length > 0 ? Math.round((qualityScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / qualityScores.length) * 10) / 10 : null;

  const qualityLimitedSessions = allSessions.filter(s => s.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited');
  const quality_limited_percent = total_sessions > 0 ? Math.round((qualityLimitedSessions.length / total_sessions) * 1000) / 10 : 0;

  const durations = allSessions.map(s => s.duration_seconds).filter(v => v !== null) as number[];
  const avg_duration_minutes = durations.length > 0 ? Math.round((durations.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / durations.length) / 60 * 10) / 10 : null;

  const cardioSessions = allSessions.filter(s => s.activity_type === 'cardio');
  const validDrifts: number[] = [];
  
  for (const s of cardioSessions) {
    const sSession = { duration_seconds: s.duration_seconds ?? 0 };
    const sMetrics = { hr_drift_ratio: s.hr_drift_ratio };
    const dAnalysis = getDriftAnalysis(sSession, sMetrics, s.activity_type);
    if (dAnalysis.status === 'valid_experimental' && dAnalysis.value_percent !== null) {
      validDrifts.push(dAnalysis.value_percent);
    }
  }

  const valid_count = validDrifts.length;
  const totalCardioCount = cardioSessions.length;
  const valid_fraction = totalCardioCount > 0 ? valid_count / totalCardioCount : 0;
  const coverage_ok = valid_count >= 3 && valid_fraction >= 0.6;

  let aggregateStatus: 'valid_experimental' | 'invalid_calculation' | 'not_applicable' | 'insufficient_valid_samples' | 'missing_workload_proxy' = 'valid_experimental';
  let aggregateReasons: string[] = [];
  let avgCardiacDriftValue: number | null = null;

  if (totalCardioCount === 0) {
    aggregateStatus = 'not_applicable';
    aggregateReasons = ['no_cardio_sessions'];
  } else if (valid_count === 0) {
    aggregateStatus = 'insufficient_valid_samples';
    aggregateReasons = ['no_valid_drift_sessions'];
  } else if (valid_count < 3) {
    aggregateStatus = 'insufficient_valid_samples';
    aggregateReasons = ['valid_count_less_than_three'];
  } else if (valid_fraction < 0.6) {
    aggregateStatus = 'insufficient_valid_samples';
    aggregateReasons = ['valid_fraction_less_than_sixty_percent'];
  } else if (!coverage_ok) {
    aggregateStatus = 'insufficient_valid_samples';
    aggregateReasons = ['coverage_not_ok'];
  } else {
    aggregateStatus = 'valid_experimental';
    aggregateReasons = [];
    avgCardiacDriftValue = calculateMedian(validDrifts);
  }

  const avg_cardiac_drift = config.enableExperimentalDriftProxy ? {
    value_percent: avgCardiacDriftValue,
    status: aggregateStatus,
    reasons: aggregateReasons
  } : {
    value_percent: null,
    status: 'not_applicable' as const,
    reasons: ['disabled_by_feature_flag']
  };

  const avg_hr_drift_percent = null; // deprecated null

  // 2b. Target session resolution
  let currentSession = allSessions.find(s => s.id === currentSessionId);
  if (!currentSession && allSessions.length > 0) {
    const sorted = [...allSessions].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.start_time).getTime() - new Date(a.start_time).getTime());
    currentSession = sorted[0];
  }

  const isCurrentCanonical = currentSession?.evidence_mode === 'canonical' || currentSession?.hr_zone_provenance_mode === 'canonical_v1_1';

  // Isolate recovery observations: canonical sessions aggregate ONLY compatible canonical observations
  let recoveryCandidateSessions: TrendSession[] = [];
  let recovery_compatible_sessions_count = 0;
  let recovery_excluded_sessions_count = 0;

  if (isCurrentCanonical) {
    const targetMethod = currentSession?.recovery_method;
    const targetVersion = currentSession?.recovery_version;

    for (const s of allSessions) {
      if (s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') {
        recovery_excluded_sessions_count++;
        continue;
      }
      // Fail closed: require explicit eligibility in allowed states (no defaulting)
      const hasExplicitEligibility = s.recovery_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || s.recovery_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
      // Fail closed: require explicit recovery method and version matching target (no defaulting)
      const hasExplicitMethod = typeof s.recovery_method === 'string' && s.recovery_method.length > 0;
      const hasExplicitVersion = typeof s.recovery_version === 'string' && s.recovery_version.length > 0;
      const isMethodCompatible = Boolean(hasExplicitMethod && hasExplicitVersion && targetMethod && targetVersion &&
                                 s.recovery_method === targetMethod &&
                                 s.recovery_version === targetVersion);

      if (hasExplicitEligibility && isMethodCompatible && s.recovery_1min !== null && s.recovery_1min !== undefined) {
        recoveryCandidateSessions.push(s);
        recovery_compatible_sessions_count++;
      } else {
        recovery_excluded_sessions_count++;
      }
    }
  } else {
    recoveryCandidateSessions = allSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical' && s.recovery_1min !== null && s.recovery_1min !== undefined);
  }
  const recovery1mins = recoveryCandidateSessions.map(s => s.recovery_1min).filter(v => v !== null) as number[];
  const avg_recovery_1min = recovery1mins.length > 0 ? Math.round((recovery1mins.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recovery1mins.length) * 10) / 10 : null;

  // 2c. Production-grade HR-zone trend aggregation with strict configuration compatibility (Findings J & K)
  const average_zones_distribution: Record<string, number> = { zone1: 0, zone2: 0, zone3: 0, zone4: 0, zone5: 0 };
  let hr_zones_summary: TrendHrZoneDistributionSummary;

  if (isCurrentCanonical) {
    const targetConfigHash = currentSession?.hr_zone_config_hash;
    const isTargetEligible = currentSession?.hr_zone_eligibility === 'eligible' && currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution !== null && currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution !== undefined;

    if (!isTargetEligible || !targetConfigHash) {
      hr_zones_summary = {
        status: 'ineligible',
        average_zones_distribution: { zone1: 0, zone2: 0, zone3: 0, zone4: 0, zone5: 0 },
        compatible_sessions_count: 0,
        compatible_peer_count: 0,
        target_session_included_in_aggregate: false,
        excluded_incompatible_sessions_count: allSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical' && s.hr_zone_config_hash).length,
        current_config_hash: targetConfigHash || null,
        current_mode: currentSession?.hr_zone_mode || null,
        current_source: currentSession?.hr_zone_source || null,
        provenance_mode: 'canonical_v1_1',
        distribution_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution_maturity || null,
        configuration_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_configuration_maturity || null,
        reason: 'Текущая каноническая сессия не содержит применимого распределения пульсовых зон или конфигурации.'
      };
    } else {
      // Find all eligible canonical sessions sharing the exact same config hash
      const compatibleSessions: TrendSession[] = [];
      let incompatibleCount = 0;

      for (const s of allSessions) {
        if (s.evidence_mode === 'canonical' || s.hr_zone_provenance_mode === 'canonical_v1_1') {
          const isEligible = s.hr_zone_eligibility === 'eligible';
          const matchesConfig = s.hr_zone_config_hash === targetConfigHash;
          const hasDistribution = s.hr_zone_distribution && s.hr_zone_distribution.z1_seconds !== null;

          if (isEligible && matchesConfig && hasDistribution) {
            compatibleSessions.push(s);
          } else {
            incompatibleCount++;
          }
        } else {
          incompatibleCount++;
        }
      }

      // Late Finding U: A comparative trend summary requires at least ONE compatible peer in addition to the target session.
      const compatiblePeers = currentSession 
        ? compatibleSessions.filter(s => s.id !== currentSession.id)
        : (compatibleSessions.length > 1 ? compatibleSessions.slice(1) : []);
      const compatiblePeerCount = compatiblePeers.length;

      if (compatibleSessions.length >= 2 && compatiblePeerCount >= 1) {
        for (const s of compatibleSessions) {
          const dist = s.hr_zone_distribution!;
          const z1 = dist.z1_seconds || 0;
          const z2 = dist.z2_seconds || 0;
          const z3 = dist.z3_seconds || 0;
          const z4 = dist.z4_seconds || 0;
          const z5 = dist.z5_seconds || 0;
          const totalSec = z1 + z2 + z3 + z4 + z5;
          if (totalSec > 0) {
            average_zones_distribution.zone1 += (z1 / totalSec) * 100;
            average_zones_distribution.zone2 += (z2 / totalSec) * 100;
            average_zones_distribution.zone3 += (z3 / totalSec) * 100;
            average_zones_distribution.zone4 += (z4 / totalSec) * 100;
            average_zones_distribution.zone5 += (z5 / totalSec) * 100;
          }
        }

        for (const k of ['zone1', 'zone2', 'zone3', 'zone4', 'zone5']) {
          average_zones_distribution[k] = Math.round((average_zones_distribution[k] / compatibleSessions.length) * 10) / 10;
        }

        hr_zones_summary = {
          status: 'available',
          average_zones_distribution: { ...average_zones_distribution },
          compatible_sessions_count: compatibleSessions.length,
          compatible_peer_count: compatiblePeerCount,
          target_session_included_in_aggregate: true,
          excluded_incompatible_sessions_count: incompatibleCount,
          current_config_hash: targetConfigHash,
          current_mode: currentSession?.hr_zone_mode || null,
          current_source: currentSession?.hr_zone_source || null,
          provenance_mode: 'canonical_v1_1',
          distribution_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution_maturity || 'Validated',
          configuration_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_configuration_maturity || 'Bounded'
        };
      } else {
        hr_zones_summary = {
          status: 'insufficient_compatible_sessions',
          average_zones_distribution: { zone1: 0, zone2: 0, zone3: 0, zone4: 0, zone5: 0 },
          compatible_sessions_count: compatibleSessions.length,
          compatible_peer_count: compatiblePeerCount,
          target_session_included_in_aggregate: false,
          excluded_incompatible_sessions_count: incompatibleCount,
          current_config_hash: targetConfigHash,
          current_mode: currentSession?.hr_zone_mode || null,
          current_source: currentSession?.hr_zone_source || null,
          provenance_mode: 'canonical_v1_1',
          distribution_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution_maturity || null,
          configuration_maturity: currentSession?.hr_zone_configuration_maturity || null,
          reason: compatibleSessions.length === 1
            ? 'Для расчета тренда пульсовых зон требуется как минимум одна сопоставимая сессия-аналог с такой же конфигурацией зон.'
            : 'Недостаточно сессий с совместимой конфигурацией пульсовых зон (требуется одинаковый config_hash).'
        };
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Legacy sessions only (historical unverified summary)
    let legacyCount = 0;
    for (const s of allSessions) {
      if (s.time_in_zones && s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical') {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(s.time_in_zones);
          let sum = 0;
          for (const k of ['zone1', 'zone2', 'zone3', 'zone4', 'zone5']) {
            sum += parsed[k] || 0;
          }
          if (sum > 0) {
            legacyCount++;
            for (const k of ['zone1', 'zone2', 'zone3', 'zone4', 'zone5']) {
              average_zones_distribution[k] += ((parsed[k] || 0) / sum) * 100;
            }
          }
        } catch {}
      }
    }
    if (legacyCount > 0) {
      for (const k of ['zone1', 'zone2', 'zone3', 'zone4', 'zone5']) {
        average_zones_distribution[k] = Math.round((average_zones_distribution[k] / legacyCount) * 10) / 10;
      }
    }

    hr_zones_summary = {
      status: legacyCount >= 2 ? 'available' : (legacyCount === 1 ? 'insufficient_compatible_sessions' : 'not_applicable'),
      average_zones_distribution: { ...average_zones_distribution },
      compatible_sessions_count: legacyCount,
      compatible_peer_count: Math.max(0, legacyCount - 1),
      target_session_included_in_aggregate: legacyCount >= 2,
      excluded_incompatible_sessions_count: 0,
      current_config_hash: null,
      current_mode: null,
      current_source: null,
      provenance_mode: 'legacy_unverified',
      distribution_maturity: null,
      configuration_maturity: null,
      reason: legacyCount >= 2 ? undefined : (legacyCount === 1 ? 'Для расчета тренда требуется более одной исторической сессии.' : 'Отсутствуют записи с информацией о зонах пульса.')
    };
  }

  // Activity distribution
  const activity_distribution: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const s of allSessions) {
    const act = s.activity_type || 'unknown';
    activity_distribution[act] = (activity_distribution[act] || 0) + 1;
  }

  // 3. Formulate interpretation cards
  const interpretation_cards: InterpretationCard[] = [];
  
  const personal_baseline_available = rmssdBand.available || sdnnBand.available || pnn50Band.available || avgHrBand.available;
  const sessions_required = minSessions;
  const sessions_used = rmssdBand.count;
  const quality_limited_excluded_count = allSessions.filter(s => s.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' || s.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data').length;

  const activities = new Set(allSessions.map(s => s.activity_type).filter(Boolean));
  const isActivitySpecific = activities.size === 1 && !activities.has('unknown');

  const duplicate_sessions_count = allSessions.filter(s => (s as any).is_duplicate).length;
  const nonDuplicateSessions = allSessions.filter(s => !(s as any).is_duplicate);
  const legacy_unverified_count = nonDuplicateSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode !== 'canonical').length;
  const calibration_short_count = nonDuplicateSessions.filter(s => (s.duration_seconds || 0) < 60).length;
  const source_unavailable_count = nonDuplicateSessions.filter(s => (s as any).recompute_status === 'source_unavailable_for_recompute').length;
  const quality_excluded_count = nonDuplicateSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical' && (s.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' || s.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data')).length;
  const ineligible_metrics_count = nonDuplicateSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical' && s.rmssd_eligibility !== 'ELIGIBLE' && s.hrv_quality !== 'quality_limited' && s.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data').length;
  const accepted_baseline_sessions_count = histRmssd.length;
  const target_session_excluded = Boolean(currentSessionId && allSessions.some(s => s.id === currentSessionId));
  const sessions_needed = Math.max(0, minSessions - accepted_baseline_sessions_count);

  let explanation_ru = `Доступно для baseline: ${accepted_baseline_sessions_count} из ${minSessions}.`;
  if (accepted_baseline_sessions_count < minSessions) {
    const parts = [];
    if (duplicate_sessions_count > 0) parts.push(`дубликатов: ${duplicate_sessions_count}`);
    if (legacy_unverified_count > 0) parts.push(`требуют канонического перерасчета (legacy): ${legacy_unverified_count}`);
    if (source_unavailable_count > 0) parts.push(`сырые файлы недоступны: ${source_unavailable_count}`);
    if (calibration_short_count > 0) parts.push(`калибровочных (< 60 с): ${calibration_short_count}`);
    if (quality_excluded_count > 0) parts.push(`с ограничениями качества: ${quality_excluded_count}`);
    if (parts.length > 0) {
      explanation_ru += ` Детали: ${parts.join(', ')}.`;
    }
  }

  let explanation_en = `Eligible for baseline: ${accepted_baseline_sessions_count} of ${minSessions}.`;
  if (accepted_baseline_sessions_count < minSessions) {
    const partsEn = [];
    if (duplicate_sessions_count > 0) partsEn.push(`${duplicate_sessions_count} duplicate(s) filtered`);
    if (legacy_unverified_count > 0) partsEn.push(`${legacy_unverified_count} require canonical recalculation (legacy)`);
    if (source_unavailable_count > 0) partsEn.push(`${source_unavailable_count} raw files unavailable`);
    if (calibration_short_count > 0) partsEn.push(`${calibration_short_count} short calibration (< 60s)`);
    if (quality_excluded_count > 0) partsEn.push(`${quality_excluded_count} quality limited`);
    if (partsEn.length > 0) {
      explanation_en += ` Details: ${partsEn.join(', ')}.`;
    }
  }

  const baseline_qualification_breakdown: BaselineQualificationBreakdown = {
    total_sessions,
    duplicate_sessions_count,
    legacy_unverified_count,
    source_unavailable_count,
    calibration_short_count,
    quality_excluded_count,
    ineligible_metrics_count,
    accepted_baseline_sessions_count,
    target_session_excluded,
    sessions_needed,
    explanation_ru,
    explanation_en
  };

  const baseline_source = allSessions.length === 0 ? 'unavailable' 
    : personal_baseline_available ? (isActivitySpecific ? 'personal_activity_specific' : 'personal_global')
    : 'reference_fallback';

  const baseline_confidence = personal_baseline_available 
    ? (histRmssd.length >= 5 ? 'high' : 'medium')
    : (allSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical').length >= 3 ? 'low' : 'none');

  // Determine reliability from authoritative evidence availability
  let reliability: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' = 'low';
  if (personal_baseline_available && histRmssd.length >= 5) {
    reliability = 'high';
  } else if (personal_baseline_available || allSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical').length >= 3) {
    reliability = 'medium';
  }

  if (total_sessions === 0) {
    interpretation_cards.push({
      title: 'Нет записей в выбранном периоде',
      type: 'info',
      message: 'Для построения трендов и анализа записей выберите другой период или импортируйте новые логи Polar H10.',
      reliability: 'low'
    });
  } else {
    if (!personal_baseline_available) {
      interpretation_cards.push({
        title: 'Личный baseline недоступен',
        type: 'warning',
        message: `Для расчета надежного персонального коридора требуется не менее 5 качественных сессий. Сейчас доступно: ${sessions_used}. ${explanation_ru}`,
        reliability: 'low'
      });
    } else {
      // RMSSD check (only if personal baseline is available)
      if (currentSession && currentSession.rmssd !== null) {
        const val = currentSession.rmssd;
        const p25 = baseline.rmssd_ms.p25!;
        const p75 = baseline.rmssd_ms.p75!;
        const isCurrentQualityLimited = currentSession.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited';
        
        if (isCurrentQualityLimited) {
          if (val > p75) {
            interpretation_cards.push({
              title: 'Показатель RMSSD выше личного диапазона (справочно)',
              type: 'info',
              message: `RMSSD (${val} мс) превышает верхнюю границу (p75 = ${p75} мс). Запись содержит артефакты, оценка носит ориентировочный характер.`,
              metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
              reliability: 'low'
            });
          } else if (val < p25) {
            interpretation_cards.push({
              title: 'Показатель RMSSD ниже личного диапазона (справочно)',
              type: 'info',
              message: `RMSSD (${val} мс) ниже границы коридора (p25 = ${p25} мс). Запись содержит артефакты, оценка носит ориентировочный характер.`,
              metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
              reliability: 'low'
            });
          }
        } else {
          if (val > p75) {
            interpretation_cards.push({
              title: 'RMSSD выше личного диапазона',
              type: 'success',
              message: `По доступным качественным сессиям значение находится в личном диапазоне; интерпретация ограничена качеством записи и сопоставимостью условий. Значение RMSSD (${val} мс) находится выше типичного коридора (p75 = ${p75} мс).`,
              metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
              reliability
            });
          } else if (val < p25) {
            interpretation_cards.push({
              title: 'RMSSD ниже личного диапазона',
              type: 'warning',
              message: `По доступным качественным сессиям значение находится в личном диапазоне; интерпретация ограничена качеством записи и сопоставимостью условий. Значение RMSSD (${val} мс) находится ниже типичного коридора (p25 = ${p25} мс).`,
              metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
              reliability
            });
          } else {
            interpretation_cards.push({
              title: 'RMSSD в рамках личного диапазона',
              type: 'info',
              message: `По доступным качественным сессиям значение находится в личном диапазоне; интерпретация ограничена качеством записи и сопоставимостью условий. Значение RMSSD (${val} мс) находится в границах типичного коридора (${p25}–${p75} мс).`,
              metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
              reliability
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Cardiac Drift warning card
    if (avg_cardiac_drift.status === 'valid_experimental' && avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent !== null && avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent > 10.0 && avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent <= 50.0) {
      interpretation_cards.push({
        title: 'Аэробное рассогласование (дрейф пульса)',
        type: 'warning',
        message: `Среднее значение дрейфа ЧСС составляет ${avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent}%. Показатель носит экспериментальный характер.`,
        reliability: 'medium'
      });
    }

    // Descriptive, non-prescriptive HR-zone observation card (Finding L)
    if (hr_zones_summary.status === 'available') {
      const highIntensityPercent = (hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone4 || 0) + (hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone5 || 0);
      if (highIntensityPercent > 35.0) {
        interpretation_cards.push({
          title: 'Распределение времени высокой интенсивности',
          type: 'info',
          message: `В совместимых канонических тренировках (выборка: ${hr_zones_summary.compatible_sessions_count} сессий) зоны Z4+Z5 составили ${highIntensityPercent}% классифицированного времени. Модель зон: ${hr_zones_summary.current_mode || 'karvonen'} (${hr_zones_summary.current_source || 'computed_from_profile'}, статус конфигурации Bounded).`,
          reliability: 'medium'
        });
      }
    } else if (currentSession?.hr_zone_distribution && currentSession.hr_zone_eligibility === 'eligible') {
      const dist = currentSession.hr_zone_distribution;
      const z1 = dist.z1_seconds || 0;
      const z2 = dist.z2_seconds || 0;
      const z3 = dist.z3_seconds || 0;
      const z4 = dist.z4_seconds || 0;
      const z5 = dist.z5_seconds || 0;
      const totalSec = z1 + z2 + z3 + z4 + z5;
      if (totalSec > 0) {
        const pct = Math.round(((z4 + z5) / totalSec) * 1000) / 10;
        if (pct > 35.0) {
          interpretation_cards.push({
            title: 'Распределение времени высокой интенсивности',
            type: 'info',
            message: `В текущей тренировке зоны Z4+Z5 составили ${pct}% классифицированного времени. Модель зон: ${currentSession.hr_zone_mode || 'karvonen'} (${currentSession.hr_zone_source || 'computed_from_profile'}, статус конфигурации Bounded).`,
            reliability: 'medium'
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Generate Text Summary Markdown
  const formattedSummary = `# Longitudinal Trends and Baseline Report
**Анализируемый профиль**: ${currentSession?.activity_type || 'default'}
**Общее число сессий в выборке**: ${total_sessions}
**Исключено сессий с ограниченным качеством из baseline**: ${quality_limited_excluded_count}

## Параметры Baseline (Личный физиологический коридор)
${personal_baseline_available ? `
- **RMSSD (мс)**: Медиана = ${baseline.rmssd_ms.median}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${baseline.rmssd_ms.p25}–${baseline.rmssd_ms.p75}
- **SDNN (мс)**: Медиана = ${baseline.sdnn_ms.median}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${baseline.sdnn_ms.p25}–${baseline.sdnn_ms.p75}
- **pNN50 (%)**: Медиана = ${baseline.pnn50_percent.median}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${baseline.pnn50_percent.p25}–${baseline.pnn50_percent.p75}
- **Ср. ЧСС (уд/мин)**: Медиана = ${baseline.avg_hr_bpm.median}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p25}–${baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p75}
` : `
*Личный физиологический коридор (baseline) недоступен: записано ${sessions_used} сессий с высоким качеством из ${sessions_required} требуемых.*

### Справочный ориентир (Reference Fallback)
- **RMSSD (мс)**: Медиана = 35.0, Диапазон = 25.0–45.0
- **SDNN (мс)**: Медиана = 50.0, Диапазон = 35.0–65.0
- **pNN50 (%)**: Медиана = 15.0, Диапазон = 5.0–25.0
- **Ср. ЧСС (уд/мин)**: Медиана = 70.0, Диапазон = 60.0–80.0

*Внимание: Справочный ориентир является популяционным ориентиром и не должен использоваться как личный baseline.*
`}

## Сводные параметры тренировок и активности
- **Средняя длительность сессии**: ${avg_duration_minutes !== null ? `${avg_duration_minutes} мин` : 'н/д'}
- **Средний технический индекс качества (legacy rollup, справочно)**: ${average_quality !== null ? `${average_quality}%` : 'н/д'}
- **Среднее восстановление ЧСС (1-я мин, эксперим.)**: ${avg_recovery_1min !== null ? `${avg_recovery_1min} уд/мин (описательно, не для оценки готовности)` : 'н/д'}
- **Средний кардиоваскулярный дрейф**: ${avg_cardiac_drift.status === 'valid_experimental' && avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent !== null ? `${avg_cardiac_drift.value_percent}%` : 'показатель неприменим / требует проверки условий записи'}

### Распределение времени по зонам ЧСС (${hr_zones_summary.provenance_mode === 'canonical_v1_1' ? `Канонические совместимые сессии: ${hr_zones_summary.compatible_sessions_count}, исключено несовместимых: ${hr_zones_summary.excluded_incompatible_sessions_count}` : 'Исторические неавторитетные данные'})
${hr_zones_summary.status === 'available' ? `
- **Зона 1 (Очень легкая)**: ${hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone1}%
- **Зона 2 (Легкая)**: ${hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone2}%
- **Зона 3 (Умеренная)**: ${hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone3}%
- **Зона 4 (Высокая)**: ${hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone4}%
- **Зона 5 (Максимальная)**: ${hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution.zone5}%
` : `
*Сводное распределение зон ЧСС недоступно: ${hr_zones_summary.reason || 'недостаточно совместимых сессий'}.*
`}

### Распределение видов активности
${Object.entries(activity_distribution).map(([act, cnt]) => `- **${act}**: ${cnt} сессий`).join('\n')}

## Рекомендации и наблюдения по тренду
${interpretation_cards.length > 0 ? interpretation_cards.map(c => `### ${c.title} [Надежность: ${c.reliability}]\n${c.message}`).join('\n\n') : '*Наблюдения отсутствуют.*'}
`;

  return {
    baseline,
    baseline_source,
    baseline_confidence,
    personal_baseline_available,
    sessions_required,
    sessions_used,
    quality_limited_excluded_count,
    baseline_qualification_breakdown,
    interpretation_cards,
    summary_metrics: {
      total_sessions,
      valid_sessions_count: histRmssd.length,
      average_quality,
      quality_limited_percent,
      avg_duration_minutes,
      avg_hr_drift_percent,
      avg_cardiac_drift,
      avg_recovery_1min,
      recovery_compatible_sessions_count,
      recovery_excluded_sessions_count,
      average_zones_distribution: hr_zones_summary.average_zones_distribution,
      hr_zones_summary,
      activity_distribution
    },
    text_summary: formattedSummary
  };
}

/**
 * src/backend/api/RouteAuthorizationRegistry.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G13 Active Route Authorization Registry.
 * Complete executable registry of all active internal routes with:
 * - Route path pattern and HTTP method
 * - Security classification: athlete_core | participant_bound | pilot_operator_bound | research_bound | internal_test_only | legacy_read_only | superseded_disabled
 * - Required role / permission
 * - Study scoping requirement
 * - Allowed credential transport (headers only, never query strings)
 *
 * Conforms to Section 6 of G13 AGENT_TASK.md.
 */

export type RouteClassification =
  | 'athlete_core'
  | 'participant_bound'
  | 'pilot_operator_bound'
  | 'research_bound'
  | 'internal_test_only'
  | 'legacy_read_only'
  | 'superseded_disabled'
  | 'release_governance';

export type CredentialTransport =
  | 'none'
  | 'header:x-research-capability'
  | 'header:x-operator-secret'
  | 'header:x-release-governance-secret'
  | 'header:x-reviewer-token'
  | 'header:x-owner-scientific-authorization'
  | 'body:enrollment_payload';

export interface RouteAuthorizationSpec {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE';
  path: string;
  classification: RouteClassification;
  requiredPermission?: string;
  enforcesStudyScope: boolean;
  credentialTransport: CredentialTransport[];
  negativeExpectedStatus: 401 | 403 | 410;
  negativeErrorCode: string;
  description: string;
}

  {
    method: 'GET',
    path: '/study/kit/:id',

    requiredPermission: 'study:read',
    credentialTransport: ['header:x-research-capability'],
    enforcesStudyScope: false,
    negativeExpectedStatus: 401,
    negativeErrorCode: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',
    description: 'Get kit template for study plan'
  },
  {
    method: 'GET',
    path: '/study/sessions',
    classification: 'research_bound',
    requiredPermission: 'study:read',
    credentialTransport: ['header:x-research-capability'],
    enforcesStudyScope: false,
    negativeExpectedStatus: 401,
    negativeErrorCode: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',

  },
  {
    method: 'POST',

    classification: 'research_bound',
    requiredPermission: 'study:write',

export const ACTIVE_ROUTE_AUTHORIZATION_REGISTRY = ACTIVE_INTERNAL_ROUTES;

export function getRouteAuthorizationConfig(method: string, path: string): RouteAuthorizationSpec | undefined {
  const normMethod = method.toUpperCase();
  return ACTIVE_INTERNAL_ROUTES.find(r => {
    if (r.method !== normMethod) return false;
    const regexPattern = '^' + r.path.replace(/:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g, '[^/?]+') + '$';
    return new RegExp(regexPattern).test(path);
  });
}

export interface BetaParticipantEventsStore {
  acceptedOutcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[];
  ttvRecords: TimeToValueRecord[];
  featureEvents: FeatureUsageEvent[];
  trustEvents: TrustFailureEvent[];
  wtpInteractions: WtpOfferInteraction[];
  feedbackSubmissions: BetaFeedbackSubmission[];
  supportIncidents: BetaSupportIncident[];
}

export function loadParticipantEventsFromDb(participantId: string): BetaParticipantEventsStore {
  const records = getBetaEvents({ participant_id: participantId });
  const store: BetaParticipantEventsStore = {
    acceptedOutcomes: [],
    ttvRecords: [],
    featureEvents: [],
    trustEvents: [],
    wtpInteractions: [],
    feedbackSubmissions: [],
    supportIncidents: []
  };

  for (const r of records) {
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(r.payload_json);
      switch (r.event_type) {
        case 'outcome':
          store.acceptedOutcomes.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'ttv':
          store.ttvRecords.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'feature':
          store.featureEvents.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'trust':
          store.trustEvents.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'wtp':
          store.wtpInteractions.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'feedback':
          store.feedbackSubmissions.push(payload);
          break;
        case 'support':
          store.supportIncidents.push(payload);
          break;
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return store;
}

export function getOrCreateParticipantStore(participantId: string): BetaParticipantEventsStore {
  return loadParticipantEventsFromDb(participantId);
}

function testConnection(source: any): { success: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (source.type === 'local') {
    if (!source.path) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Путь к папке не указан' };
    }
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(source.path)) {
        return { success: true };
      } else {
        return { success: false, error: `Путь ${source.path} не существует` };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  } else if (source.type === 'ftp') {
    if (!source.url) {
      return { success: false, error: 'FTP URL не указан' };
    }
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(source.url);
      if (parsed.protocol !== 'ftp:') {
        return { success: false, error: 'Протокол должен быть ftp:' };
      }
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: `Некорректный FTP URL: ${err.message}` };
    }
  }
  return { success: false, error: 'Неизвестный тип источника' };
}

function validateSourceSyntax(source: any): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (!source.label || typeof source.label !== 'string' || source.label.trim() === '') {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Название источника обязательно' };
  }
  if (source.type !== 'local' && source.type !== 'ftp') {
    return { valid: false, error: 'Тип источника должен быть local или ftp' };
  }
  if (source.type === 'local') {
    if (!source.path || typeof source.path !== 'string' || source.path.trim() === '') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Путь к папке обязателен' };
    }
  } else if (source.type === 'ftp') {
    if (!source.url || typeof source.url !== 'string' || source.url.trim() === '') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'FTP URL обязателен' };
    }
    try {
      new URL(source.url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Некорректный FTP URL: ${err.message}` };
    }
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

apiRouter.post('/data-sources', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { label, type, path, url } = req.body;
    const validation = validateSourceSyntax({ label, type, path, url });
    if (!validation.valid) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error });
      return;
    }
    
    const id = `ds_${Date.now()}`;
    const newSource = {
      id,
      label,
      type,
      path: type === 'local' ? path : null,
      url: type === 'ftp' ? url : null,
      is_active: 0,
      last_status: 'not_checked',
      last_checked_at: null,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveDataSource(newSource);
    res.status(201).json(newSource);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.put('/data-sources/:id', (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = req.params.id;
    const existing = getDataSource(id);
    if (!existing) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Источник не найден' });
      return;
    }
    const { label, type, path, url } = req.body;
    const validation = validateSourceSyntax({
      label: label !== undefined ? label : existing.label,
      type: type !== undefined ? type : existing.type,
      path: type === 'local' ? (path !== undefined ? path : existing.path) : null,
      url: type === 'ftp' ? (url !== undefined ? url : existing.url) : null
    });
    if (!validation.valid) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error });
      return;
    }
    
    const updated = {
      ...existing,
      label: label !== undefined ? label : existing.label,
      type: type !== undefined ? type : existing.type,
      path: type === 'local' ? (path !== undefined ? path : existing.path) : null,
      url: type === 'ftp' ? (url !== undefined ? url : existing.url) : null,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveDataSource(updated);
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.delete('/data-sources/:id', (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = req.params.id;
    const source = getDataSource(id);
    if (!source) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Источник не найден' });
      return;

    if (source.is_active) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Нельзя удалить активный источник' });
      return;
    }
    deleteDataSource(id);
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Ingestion State Machine
export type SyncState = 'idle' | 'preflight' | 'listing' | 'copying' | 'processing' | 'failed' | 'completed';

interface SyncStatus {
  state: SyncState;
  startedAt: string | null;
  lastUpdatedAt: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  progress: {
    scanned: number;
    imported: number;
    skipped: number;
    failed: number;
    currentFile?: string;
  };
  details: any[];
}

let syncStatus: SyncStatus = {
  state: 'idle',
  startedAt: null,
  lastUpdatedAt: null,
  error: null,
  progress: { scanned: 0, imported: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 },
  details: []
};

let cancelRequested = false;

function checkStaleLock() {
  if (syncStatus.state !== 'idle' && syncStatus.state !== 'completed' && syncStatus.state !== 'failed') {
    const lastUpdate = syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt ? new Date(syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt).getTime() : 0;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastUpdate > 120000) { // 2 minutes TTL
      syncStatus.state = 'idle';
      syncStatus.error = 'Синхронизация зависла и была автоматически сброшена по тайм-ауту (2 минуты)';
      syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    }
  }
}

async function runIngestionAsync() {
  try {
    const updateProgress = (prog: any) => {
      syncStatus.state = prog.state;
      syncStatus.progress = {
        scanned: prog.scanned,
        imported: prog.imported,
        skipped: prog.skipped,
        failed: prog.failed,
        currentFile: prog.currentFile
      };
      if (prog.details) {
        syncStatus.details = prog.details;
      }
      syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    };

    const checkCancel = () => cancelRequested;

    const adapter = await createActiveSourceAdapter();

    // Ingest files via pipeline
    const ingestSummary = await runIngestionPipeline(
      adapter,
      (prog) => {
        updateProgress(prog);
      },
      checkCancel
    );

    if (cancelRequested) throw new Error('Синхронизация отменена пользователем');
    updateProgress({ ...syncStatus.progress, state: 'processing', scanned: ingestSummary.totalScanned });

    // Step 2: Group sessions
    await groupIngestedFilesIntoSessions();

    // Step 3: Run QC + analytics
    const db = getDb();
    const sessions = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT s.id FROM sessions s
         LEFT JOIN session_qc_metrics q ON s.id = q.session_id
         WHERE q.session_id IS NULL`
      )
      .all() as { id: string }[];

    for (const s of sessions) {
      if (cancelRequested) throw new Error('Синхронизация отменена пользователем');
      await runQcForSession(s.id);
    }

    syncStatus.state = 'completed';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  } catch (err: any) {
    syncStatus.state = 'failed';
    syncStatus.error = err.message || 'Ошибка синхронизации';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  }
}

let ingestRunning = false;
let lastIngestResult: object | null = null;

apiRouter.post('/ingest', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
  if (!isNewAnalysisPermitted(entState)) {
    res.status(403).json({
      error: 'Trial expired or analysis allowance exceeded. Historical sessions and reports remain fully accessible.',
      code: 'TRIAL_EXPIRED_NEW_ANALYSIS_GATED',
      tier: entState.tier,
      trial_status: entState.trial_status
    });
    return;
  }

  checkStaleLock();
  if (syncStatus.state !== 'idle' && syncStatus.state !== 'completed' && syncStatus.state !== 'failed') {
    res.status(409).json({ error: 'Синхронизация уже выполняется' });
    return;
  }
  
  if (ingestRunning) {
    res.status(409).json({ error: 'Синхронизация уже выполняется' });
    return;
  }

  ingestRunning = true;
  syncStatus.state = 'preflight';
  syncStatus.startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  try {
    const adapter = await createActiveSourceAdapter();
    const preflight = await adapter.preflight();
    if (!preflight.success) {
      syncStatus.state = 'failed';
      syncStatus.error = preflight.error || 'Preflight check failed';
      syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      res.status(503).json({ error: `Источник недоступен: ${preflight.error}` });
      return;
    }

    syncStatus.state = 'listing';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const ingestSummary = await runIngestionPipeline(adapter);

    syncStatus.state = 'processing';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await groupIngestedFilesIntoSessions();
    const db = getDb();
    const sessions = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT s.id FROM sessions s
         LEFT JOIN session_qc_metrics q ON s.id = q.session_id
         WHERE q.session_id IS NULL`
      )
      .all() as { id: string }[];

    for (const s of sessions) {
      await runQcForSession(s.id);
    }

    lastIngestResult = ingestSummary;
    syncStatus.state = 'completed';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    res.json({
      success: true,
      scanned: ingestSummary.scanned,
      ingested: ingestSummary.ingested,
      skipped: ingestSummary.skipped,
      failed: ingestSummary.failed,
      sessionsProcessed: sessions.length,
      alreadyImportedExact: ingestSummary.alreadyImportedExact,
      alreadyImportedLogical: ingestSummary.alreadyImportedLogical,
      ignoredByUser: ingestSummary.ignoredByUser,
      details: ingestSummary.details,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    syncStatus.state = 'failed';
    syncStatus.error = err.message || 'Ошибка синхронизации';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка при синхронизации' });
  } finally {
    ingestRunning = false;
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/start', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  checkStaleLock();

  if (syncStatus.state !== 'idle' && syncStatus.state !== 'completed' && syncStatus.state !== 'failed') {
    res.status(409).json({ error: 'Синхронизация уже выполняется', status: syncStatus });
    return;
  }

  cancelRequested = false;
  syncStatus = {
    state: 'preflight',
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    lastUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    error: null,
    progress: { scanned: 0, imported: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 },
    details: []
  };

  runIngestionAsync().catch(err => {
    logger.error('sync', 'Async Ingest error', { details: { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) } });
  });

  res.json({ success: true, status: syncStatus });
});

apiRouter.get('/ingest/status', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  checkStaleLock();
  res.json({
    running: syncStatus.state !== 'idle' && syncStatus.state !== 'completed' && syncStatus.state !== 'failed',
    state: syncStatus.state,
    error: syncStatus.error,
    progress: syncStatus.progress,
    details: syncStatus.details,
    startedAt: syncStatus.startedAt,
    lastUpdatedAt: syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt
  });
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/cancel', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  if (syncStatus.state !== 'idle' && syncStatus.state !== 'completed' && syncStatus.state !== 'failed') {
    cancelRequested = true;
    syncStatus.error = 'Отмена синхронизации запрошена пользователем';
    syncStatus.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    res.json({ success: true, status: syncStatus });
  } else {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Синхронизация не выполняется' });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/reset-stale-lock', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  syncStatus = {
    state: 'idle',
    startedAt: null,
    lastUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    error: 'Состояние блокировки сброшено пользователем вручную',
    progress: { scanned: 0, imported: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 },
    details: []
  };
  res.json({ success: true, status: syncStatus });
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/guided-preview', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { folderPath, filePaths, flow_id, flowId } = req.body || {};
    const flowIdentifier = flow_id || flowId || `flow_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
    let targetPath = folderPath ? String(folderPath).trim() : '';
    if (!targetPath && (!filePaths || filePaths.length === 0)) {
      targetPath = SOURCE_DIR;
    }

    if (!targetPath && (!filePaths || !Array.isArray(filePaths) || filePaths.length === 0)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Папка не указана. Выберите локальную папку или файлы для импорта.' });
      return;
    }

    createGuidedFlow({ flow_id: flowIdentifier, started_at_utc: new Date().toISOString() });

    let result: GuidedDiscoveryResult;
    if (filePaths && Array.isArray(filePaths) && filePaths.length > 0) {
      result = await discoverBundlesFromFiles(filePaths, { flowId: flowIdentifier });
    } else if (targetPath) {
      const isAccessible = await isDirectoryAccessible(targetPath, 800);
      if (!isAccessible) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: `Папка не найдена или недоступна: ${targetPath}` });
        return;
      }
      result = await discoverBundlesFromDirectory(targetPath, { flowId: flowIdentifier });
    } else {
      res.status(400).json({ error: `Папка не найдена или не указана: ${targetPath || 'не задана'}` });
      return;
    }

    updateGuidedFlow(flowIdentifier, {
      preview_ready_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      selected_bundle_count: result.bundles.length
    });

    res.json({ success: true, flow_id: flowIdentifier, result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Ошибка предварительного сканирования пакетов' });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/guided-import', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { bundles, sync, flow_id, flowId } = req.body || {};
    if (!bundles || !Array.isArray(bundles) || bundles.length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Не переданы пакеты для импорта' });
      return;
    }

    const explicitParticipantId = req.body?.participantId || req.body?.participant_id;
    const flowIdentifier = flow_id || flowId || bundles.find((b: any) => b.flow_id)?.flow_id;

    // Validate participant assignment via resolveGuidedImportParticipantContext.
    // If unauthorized participant reassignment, throws Error -> caught and returned as 400 Bad Request
    try {
      resolveGuidedImportParticipantContext(explicitParticipantId);
    } catch (assignErr: any) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: assignErr.message });
      return;
    }

    // Synchronous execution if explicitly requested
    if (sync === true || req.query.sync === 'true') {
      const imported = await importDiscoveredBundles(bundles, {
        participantId: explicitParticipantId,
        flowId: flowIdentifier
      });
      if (flowIdentifier) {
        updateGuidedFlow(flowIdentifier, {
          completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          imported_session_ids: imported.map(s => s.sessionId)
        });
      }
      res.json({ success: true, importedSessions: imported, flow_id: flowIdentifier });
      return;
    }

    const { jobId } = startGuidedImportJob(bundles, {
      participantId: explicitParticipantId,
      flowId: flowIdentifier
    });
    const job = getGuidedImportJob(jobId);
    res.json({ success: true, jobId, job, flow_id: flowIdentifier });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Ошибка импорта пакетов' });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/ingest/guided-import/:jobId/status', async (req: ReqParam<{ jobId: string }>, res: Response) => {
  const job = getGuidedImportJob(req.params.jobId);
  if (!job) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Задача импорта не найдена' });
    return;
  }
  res.json({ success: true, job });
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/guided-import/:jobId/cancel', async (req: ReqParam<{ jobId: string }>, res: Response) => {
  const cancelled = cancelGuidedImportJob(req.params.jobId);
  const job = getGuidedImportJob(req.params.jobId);
  if (!job) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Задача импорта не найдена' });
    return;
  }
  res.json({ success: true, cancelled, job });
});

apiRouter.post('/ingest/relink', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const {
      relink_type,
      source_sha256,
      original_path,
      current_path,
      affected_session_ids,
      lineage_action,
      notes_ru,
      notes_en,
      idempotency_key
    } = req.body || {};

    if (!source_sha256) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'source_sha256 is required' });
      return;
    }

    const decision: SourceRelinkDecision = {
      schema_version: SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      decision_id: `relink-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      relink_type: relink_type || 'reuse_existing',
      source_sha256,
      original_path,
      current_path,
      affected_session_ids: affected_session_ids || [],
      lineage_action: lineage_action || 'preserve_historical',
      notes_ru: notes_ru || 'Связывание источника по хэшу байтов',
      notes_en: notes_en || 'Relinked source by byte hash',
      idempotency_key,
      timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    saveSourceRelinkRecord(decision);
    res.json({ success: true, decision });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Ошибка связывания источника' });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/ingest/relink/:sha256', (req: ReqParam<{ sha256: string }>, res: Response) => {
  const record = getSourceRelinkRecordByHash(req.params.sha256);
  if (!record) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Запись связывания не найдена' });
    return;
  }
  res.json({ success: true, record });
});

apiRouter.get('/diagnostics/workstation-events', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const events = getRecentWorkstationEvents(100);
  res.json({ success: true, events });
});

export const ALLOWED_CLIENT_WORKSTATION_EVENTS = new Set<string>([
  'canonical_overview_viewed',
  'advanced_tab_opened',
  'compare_action',
  'bundle_grouping_corrected',
  'report_action',
  'ai_pack_action'
]);

const RESTRICTED_SUCCESS_KEYS = new Set([
  'format',
  'format_type',
  'packid',
  'pack_id',
  'compiled',
  'downloaded',
  'exported',
  'success',
  'is_success',
  'status',
  'completed'
]);

const RESTRICTED_SUCCESS_VALUES = new Set([
  'exported',
  'compiled',
  'downloaded',
  'success',
  'completed'
]);

export function validateClientWorkstationMetadata(metadata: Record<string, any> = {}): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(metadata)) {
    const normKey = key.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (RESTRICTED_SUCCESS_KEYS.has(normKey)) {
      return { isValid: false, error: `Client diagnostics cannot submit restricted completion metadata key: ${key}` };
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      const normVal = value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (RESTRICTED_SUCCESS_VALUES.has(normVal)) {
        return { isValid: false, error: `Client diagnostics cannot submit restricted completion status value: ${value}` };
      }
    }
    if (typeof value === 'boolean' && value === true && (normKey.includes('success') || normKey.includes('compiled') || normKey.includes('downloaded') || normKey.includes('export'))) {
      return { isValid: false, error: `Client diagnostics cannot submit restricted completion flag: ${key}` };
    }
  }
  return { isValid: true };
}

apiRouter.post('/diagnostics/workstation-events', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const { eventType, metadata, durationMs } = req.body || {};
  if (!eventType) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'eventType is required' });
    return;
  }
  if (!ALLOWED_CLIENT_WORKSTATION_EVENTS.has(eventType)) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: `Event type ${eventType} is restricted: authoritative milestones cannot be emitted by client` });
    return;
  }
  const metaCheck = validateClientWorkstationMetadata(metadata || {});
  if (!metaCheck.isValid) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: metaCheck.error });
    return;
  }
  const cleanMeta = { ...(metadata || {}), source: 'client_diagnostics' };
  const event = recordWorkstationEvent(eventType, cleanMeta, durationMs);
  res.json({ success: true, event });
});

  try {
    const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(req.params.id);
    recordWorkstationEvent('canonical_overview_viewed', { sessionId: req.params.id });
    res.json({ success: true, canonicalSession: canonical });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: err.message || 'Каноническая сессия не найдена' });
  }
});

function getMissingRmssdReasonLabel(reason: string | null): string | null {
  if (!reason) return null;
  switch (reason) {
    case 'insufficient_data':
      return 'Недостаточно данных';
    case 'no_valid_nn_intervals':
      return 'Нет пригодных NN-интервалов';
    case 'legacy_metadata_missing':
      return 'Старый расчет без новых метаданных';
    case 'quality_limited_not_recalculated':
      return 'Ограничено качеством (требуется пересчет)';
    case 'hrv_source_unavailable':
      return 'Источник ВСР недоступен';
    case 'needs_reanalysis':
      return 'Требуется пересчет';
    default:
      return reason;
  }
}

function getHrvQualityLabel(quality: string | null): string {
  if (!quality) return 'Недостаточно данных';
  switch (quality) {
    case 'excellent':
      return 'Отличное';
    case 'good':
      return 'Хорошее';
    case 'usable':
      return 'Приемлемое';
    case 'poor':
      return 'Низкое';
    case 'quality_limited':
      return 'Ограничено качеством';
    case 'insufficient_data':
      return 'Недостаточно данных';
    default:
      return quality;
  }
}

apiRouter.get('/library/sessions', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const tagsParam = req.query.tags;
    let tags: string[] | undefined = undefined;
    if (typeof tagsParam === 'string') {
      tags = tagsParam.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    } else if (Array.isArray(tagsParam)) {
      tags = tagsParam.map(t => String(t).trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }

    const query = {
      profile_id: (req.query.profile_id as string) || (req.query.user_id as string),
      search: req.query.search as string,
      activity_type: req.query.activity_type as string,
      date_from: req.query.date_from as string,
      date_to: req.query.date_to as string,
      readiness: req.query.readiness as any,
      baseline_eligible: req.query.baseline_eligible as any,
      source_available: req.query.source_available as any,
      signal_type: req.query.signal_type as string,
      tags,
      include_ignored: req.query.include_ignored === 'true' || req.query.include_ignored === '1',
      include_duplicates: req.query.include_duplicates === 'true' || req.query.include_duplicates === '1',
      review_preset: req.query.review_preset as any,
      sort_by: req.query.sort_by as any,
      sort_dir: req.query.sort_dir as any,
      limit: req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : 25,
      offset: req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : 0,
      cursor: req.query.cursor as string
    };

    const page = SessionLibraryRepository.queryPage(query);
    res.json(page);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_QUERY', message: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/library/curate', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const receipt = SessionLibraryService.executeCommand(req.body);
    if (receipt.status === 'conflict') {
      res.status(409).json(receipt);
    } else if (receipt.status === 'rejected') {
      res.status(400).json(receipt);
    } else {
      res.json(receipt);
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CurationIdempotencyConflictError || err.code === 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT') {
      res.status(409).json({ error: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', message: err.message });
    } else {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'CURATION_FAILED', message: err.message });
    }
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/library/sessions/:id/refresh-source', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const sessionId = String(req.params.id);
    const newState = SessionLibraryRepository.refreshSourceState(sessionId);
    res.json({ session_id: sessionId, source_lifecycle_state: newState });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'REFRESH_SOURCE_FAILED', message: err.message });
  }
});


apiRouter.get('/sessions', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.query.user_id as string | undefined;
    const includeIgnored = req.query.include_ignored === 'true';
    const searchQuery = ((req.query.search || req.query.query || '') as string).trim().toLowerCase();
    const activityType = req.query.activity_type as string | undefined;
    const dateFrom = req.query.date_from as string | undefined;
    const dateTo = req.query.date_to as string | undefined;
    const readinessFilter = req.query.readiness as string | undefined;
    const baselineEligibleFilter = req.query.baseline_eligible as string | undefined;
    const signalTypeFilter = req.query.signal_type as string | undefined;
    const tagFilter = req.query.tag as string | undefined;
    const tagsFilter = req.query.tags ? (req.query.tags as string).split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
    const sourceAvailableFilter = req.query.source_available as string | undefined;
    const sortBy = (req.query.sort_by as string) || 'start_time';
    const sortDir = ((req.query.sort_dir as string) || 'desc').toLowerCase() === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';
    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;
    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : 0;
    const includeDuplicates = req.query.include_duplicates === 'true';

    const db = getDb();

    let sessions: SessionMetadata[];
    if (userId && userId !== 'all') {
      const query = includeIgnored
        ? (userId === 'unassigned' ? 'SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE user_id IS NULL ORDER BY start_time DESC' : 'SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY start_time DESC')
        : (userId === 'unassigned' ? 'SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE user_id IS NULL ORDER BY start_time DESC' : 'SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY start_time DESC');
      const stmt = db.prepare(query);
      sessions = userId === 'unassigned' ? (stmt.all() as any as SessionMetadata[]) : (stmt.all(userId) as any as SessionMetadata[]);
    } else {
      sessions = getSessions(includeIgnored);
    }

    const sessionIds = sessions.map(s => s.id);
    let metricsMap = new Map<string, any>();
    let annMap = new Map<string, any>();
    const signalsMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    const usersMap = new Map<string, string>();

    try {
      const allUsers = db.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users').all() as any[];
      for (const u of allUsers) {
        usersMap.set(u.id, u.display_name);
      }
    } catch {}

    if (sessionIds.length > 0) {
      const allMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, rmssd, sdnn, pnn50, hrv_quality, hrv_quality_json, hrv_source, valid_nn_count, canonical_observation_json FROM session_metrics').all() as any[];
      metricsMap = new Map(allMetrics.map(m => [m.session_id, m]));

      const allAnns = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, activity_type, user_notes, tags_json FROM session_annotations').all() as any[];
      annMap = new Map(allAnns.map(a => [a.session_id, a]));

      const allSignals = db.prepare('SELECT s.session_id, f.id, f.signal_type, f.filename FROM session_signals s JOIN ingested_files f ON s.file_id = f.id').all() as any[];
      for (const sig of allSignals) {
        const list = signalsMap.get(sig.session_id) || [];
        list.push(sig);
        signalsMap.set(sig.session_id, list);
      }
    }

    const duplicateMap = getDuplicateSessionMap(db);
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

    let enriched = sessions.map((s) => {
      const sigList = signalsMap.get(s.id) || [];
      const signals = sigList.map(x => x.signal_type);
      const metrics = metricsMap.get(s.id);
      const ann = annMap.get(s.id);
      const dupInfo = duplicateMap.get(s.id);

      // Check source availability on disk
      let sourceAvailable = false;
      if (sigList.length > 0 && fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        sourceAvailable = sigList.every(sig => {
          const expectedP = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sig.id}_${sig.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
          const directP = sig.filename ? path.join(rawLogsDir, sig.filename) : '';
          return fs.existsSync(expectedP) || (directP && fs.existsSync(directP));
        });
      }

      // Parse tags
      let tags: string[] = [];
      if (ann?.tags_json) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(ann.tags_json);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            tags = parsed.filter(t => typeof t === 'string' && t.trim().length > 0);
          }
        } catch {}
      }

      // Determine readiness and baseline eligibility
      let readiness: 'ready' | 'limited' | 'unavailable' = 'unavailable';
      let baselineEligible = false;

      let obs: any = null;
      if (metrics?.canonical_observation_json) {
        try { obs = JSON.parse(metrics.canonical_observation_json); } catch {}
      }

      if (obs) {
        const isReady = Boolean(obs.baseline_included_rmssd && obs.baseline_included_sdnn);
        const isLimited = (obs.rmssd !== null || obs.sdnn !== null || obs.avg_hr !== null) && !isReady;
        readiness = isReady ? 'ready' : (isLimited ? 'limited' : 'unavailable');
        baselineEligible = isReady;
      } else {
        const hasRmssd = metrics?.rmssd != null;
        const hasSdnn = metrics?.sdnn != null;
        const isValid = metrics?.hrv_quality === 'valid';
        const isReady = hasRmssd && hasSdnn && isValid;
        const isLimited = (hasRmssd || hasSdnn || s.avg_hr != null) && !isReady;
        readiness = isReady ? 'ready' : (isLimited ? 'limited' : 'unavailable');
        baselineEligible = isReady;
      }

      // Criterion 2: Explicit synthetic sample is strictly excluded from personal baseline
      if ((s as any).is_sample === 1 || Boolean((s as any).is_sample) || s.device_id?.includes('Демонстрационная') || s.id?.includes('synthetic_sample')) {
        baselineEligible = false;
      }

      let missingRmssdReason: string | null = null;
      if (metrics?.rmssd == null) {
        if (!metrics) {
          missingRmssdReason = 'legacy_metadata_missing';
        } else if (metrics.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data') {
          const hrvQualityJson = metrics.hrv_quality_json ? JSON.parse(metrics.hrv_quality_json) : null;
          if (hrvQualityJson?.reason?.includes('NN-интервалов') || hrvQualityJson?.reason?.includes('intervals') || metrics.valid_nn_count === 0) {
            missingRmssdReason = 'no_valid_nn_intervals';
          } else {
            missingRmssdReason = 'insufficient_data';
          }
        } else if (metrics.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
          missingRmssdReason = 'quality_limited_not_recalculated';
        } else if (metrics.hrv_source === 'none') {
          missingRmssdReason = 'hrv_source_unavailable';
        } else {
          missingRmssdReason = 'insufficient_data';
        }
      }

      const cleanSession = { ...s };
      delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_json;
      delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_version;
      delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_status;

      const profileName = s.user_id ? (usersMap.get(s.user_id) || s.user_id) : 'Без профиля';

      return {
        ...cleanSession,
        signal_types: [...new Set(signals)],
        rmssd: metrics?.rmssd ?? null,
        sdnn: metrics?.sdnn ?? null,
        pnn50: metrics?.pnn50 ?? null,
        activity_type: ann?.activity_type ?? 'unknown',
        user_notes: ann?.user_notes ?? null,
        tags,
        readiness,
        baseline_eligible: baselineEligible,
        source_available: sourceAvailable,
        profile_name: profileName,
        missing_rmssd_reason: missingRmssdReason,
        missing_rmssd_reason_label: getMissingRmssdReasonLabel(missingRmssdReason),
        hrv_quality: metrics?.hrv_quality ?? 'insufficient_data',
        hrv_quality_label: getHrvQualityLabel(metrics?.hrv_quality ?? 'insufficient_data'),
        activity_segmentation_json: null,
        activity_segmentation_status: 'not_applicable',
        activity_segmentation_version: null,
        is_duplicate: dupInfo?.is_duplicate ?? false,
        has_duplicates: dupInfo?.has_duplicates ?? false,
        duplicate_count: dupInfo?.duplicate_count ?? 1,
        canonical_representative_id: dupInfo?.canonical_representative_id ?? s.id
      };
    });

    // 1. Deduplication filter: canonical representatives only by default
    if (!includeDuplicates) {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => !s.is_duplicate);
    }

    // 2. Activity filter
    if (activityType && activityType !== 'all' && activityType !== 'Все активности') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.activity_type === activityType);
    }

    // 3. Date range filter
    if (dateFrom) {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.start_time >= dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.start_time <= dateTo);
    }

    // 4. Readiness filter
    if (readinessFilter && readinessFilter !== 'all') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.readiness === readinessFilter);
    }

    // 5. Baseline eligible filter
    if (baselineEligibleFilter === 'true') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.baseline_eligible === true);
    } else if (baselineEligibleFilter === 'false') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.baseline_eligible === false);
    }

    // 6. Signal type filter
    if (signalTypeFilter && signalTypeFilter !== 'all') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.signal_types.map(x => x.toUpperCase()).includes(signalTypeFilter.toUpperCase()));
    }

    // 7. Tags filter
    if (tagFilter && tagFilter !== 'all') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.tags.includes(tagFilter));
    }
    if (tagsFilter.length > 0) {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => tagsFilter.some(t => s.tags.includes(t)));
    }

    // 8. Source availability filter
    if (sourceAvailableFilter === 'true') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.source_available === true);
    } else if (sourceAvailableFilter === 'false') {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => s.source_available === false);
    }

    // 9. Free-text search
    if (searchQuery) {
      enriched = enriched.filter(s => {
        if (s.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.device_id && s.device_id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.start_time && s.start_time.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.activity_type && s.activity_type.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.profile_name && s.profile_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.user_notes && s.user_notes.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return true;
        if (s.tags && s.tags.some(t => t.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery))) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }

    // 10. Sorting
    enriched.sort((a, b) => {
      let av: any = (a as any)[sortBy] ?? 0;
      let bv: any = (b as any)[sortBy] ?? 0;
      if (sortBy === 'start_time') {
        av = new Date(a.start_time).getTime();
        bv = new Date(b.start_time).getTime();
      } else if (typeof av === 'string') {
        av = av.toLowerCase();
        bv = (bv as string).toLowerCase();
      }
      if (av < bv) return sortDir === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (av > bv) return sortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    res.setHeader('X-Total-Count', String(enriched.length));

    // 11. Pagination
    if (limit !== undefined && !isNaN(limit) && limit > 0) {
      const pageSlice = enriched.slice(offset, offset + limit);
      if (req.query.paginated === 'true') {
        res.json({
          sessions: pageSlice,
          total_count: enriched.length,
          limit,
          offset,
          page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,
          total_pages: Math.ceil(enriched.length / limit)
        });
        return;
      }
      res.json(pageSlice);
      return;
    }

    res.json(enriched);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/sessions/:id/tags', (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const { tags, addTag, removeTag } = req.body || {};
    let resultTags: string[];
    if (Array.isArray(tags)) {
      resultTags = setSessionTags(id, tags);
    } else if (addTag) {
      resultTags = addSessionTag(id, String(addTag));
    } else if (removeTag) {
      resultTags = removeSessionTag(id, String(removeTag));
    } else {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Параметр tags, addTag или removeTag обязателен' });
      return;
    }
    CanonicalTrendObservationService.clearCache();
    res.json({ success: true, sessionId: id, tags: resultTags });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

  try {
    const { sessionIds, addTags, removeTags } = req.body || {};

      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Массив sessionIds обязателен' });
      return;
    }
    const result = bulkUpdateSessionTags(sessionIds, addTags || [], removeTags || []);
    CanonicalTrendObservationService.clearCache();
    res.json({ success: true, updatedCount: result.updatedCount });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

    });
    CanonicalTrendObservationService.clearCache();
    res.json({ success: true, updatedCount: result.updatedCount });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});
