apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id/rr-inspection', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(id) as SessionMetadata | undefined;
    if (!session) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Сессия ${id} не найдена` });
      return;
    }

    const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(id, false).catch(() => null);
    const ledger = canonical?.canonical_beat_ledger || null;
    const qcMetrics = getSessionQcMetrics(id);

    const filter = (String(req.query.filter || 'all').toLowerCase()) as 'all' | 'accepted' | 'excluded';
    const reasonCode = req.query.reasonCode ? String(req.query.reasonCode) : undefined;
    const timeFromMs = req.query.timeFromMs ? Number(req.query.timeFromMs) : undefined;
    const timeToMs = req.query.timeToMs ? Number(req.query.timeToMs) : undefined;

    const limit = req.query.limit ? Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(String(req.query.limit), 10) || 50, 1), 20000) : 500;
    const offset = req.query.offset ? Math.max(parseInt(String(req.query.offset), 10) || 0, 0) : 0;

    const clockEvidence = {
      monotonicity_status: qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status || (canonical?.timing?.timebase_monotonic ? 'MONOTONIC' : 'UNKNOWN'),
      duplicate_timestamps_count: qcMetrics?.duplicate_timestamps_count || 0,
      missing_samples_count: qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count || 0,
      start_time: session.start_time,
      end_time: session.end_time,
      duration_seconds: session.duration_seconds || canonical?.timing?.duration_seconds || 0
    };

    if (!ledger || !ledger.beats || ledger.beats.length === 0) {
      res.json({
        schema_version: '1.0.0',
        status: 'unavailable',
        unavailability_reason: 'canonical_beat_ledger_unavailable',
        session_id: id,
        canonical_result_identity: canonical?.canonical_result_identity || null,
        canonical_source_identity: canonical?.source_bundle_id || null,
        stable_ordering_identity: 'empty',
        clock_evidence: clockEvidence,
        coverage_summary: {
          total_beats: 0,
          accepted_nn_beats: 0,
          excluded_beats: 0,
          artifact_percentage: 0,
          accepted_coverage_seconds: 0,
          accepted_coverage_ratio: 0,
          longest_contiguous_seconds: 0,
          gap_count: 0
        },
        method_eligibility: canonical?.task_eligibility || {},
        pagination: {
          total: 0,
          offset,
          limit,
          has_more: false,
          filter
        },
        beats: [],
        scientific_disclaimer: 'Просмотр первичного реестра кардиоциклов RR предназначен для верификации и аудита исходных отсчетов. Не является медицинским заключением или диагностикой. Значения без валидного отсчета не интерполируются нулями.'
      });
      return;
    }

    // Evaluate canonical sequential segments, gaps, and successive pair status over FULL ledger first
    let currentSegmentId = 0;
    let gapCount = 0;
    const evaluatedBeats: any[] = [];

    const firstValidPhoneBeat = ledger.beats.find(x => x.phone_timestamp_ms !== null);
    const startBasePhoneMs = firstValidPhoneBeat?.phone_timestamp_ms ?? 0;

    const getBeatRelTime = (beat: any): number => {
      if (beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.relative_timestamp_ms !== undefined) {
        return beat.relative_timestamp_ms;
      }
      if (beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== null && beat.phone_timestamp_ms !== undefined) {
        return Math.max(0, beat.phone_timestamp_ms - startBasePhoneMs);
      }
      return 0;
    };

    for (let i = 0; i < ledger.beats.length; i++) {
      const b = ledger.beats[i];
      const relTime = getBeatRelTime(b);

      if (i === 0) {
        evaluatedBeats.push({
          ordinal: i,
          source_row_index: b.source_row_index,
          relative_timestamp_ms: relTime,
          phone_timestamp_ms: b.phone_timestamp_ms,
          sensor_timestamp_ns: b.sensor_timestamp_ns,
          raw_rr_ms: b.raw_rr_ms,
          instantaneous_hr_bpm: b.instantaneous_hr_bpm,
          classification_status: b.classification_status,
          exclusion_reasons: b.exclusion_reasons || [],
          accepted_for_nn: b.accepted_for_nn,
          read_only_guarantee: true,
          segment_id: currentSegmentId,
          is_gap_start: false,
          successive_pair_status: 'broken_first_beat',
          pair_diff_ms: null,
          successive_pair_reason_code: 'first_beat_in_sequence'
        });
        continue;
      }

      const prev = ledger.beats[i - 1];
      const prevRelTime = getBeatRelTime(prev);
      const timeDiffMs = relTime - prevRelTime;
      const isNonMonotonic = relTime <= prevRelTime;
      const isGap = timeDiffMs > 3000;

      let pairStatus = 'valid_pair';
      let pairDiff: number | null = null;
      let reasonCode = 'contiguous_accepted_pair';
      let isGapStart = false;

      if (isGap) {
        currentSegmentId++;
        gapCount++;
        isGapStart = true;
        pairStatus = 'broken_gap';
        reasonCode = 'gap_exceeds_3000ms';
      } else if (isNonMonotonic) {
        pairStatus = 'broken_nonmonotonic';
        reasonCode = 'non_monotonic_timestamp';
      } else if (!b.accepted_for_nn || !prev.accepted_for_nn) {
        pairStatus = 'broken_exclusion';
        reasonCode = !b.accepted_for_nn ? (b.exclusion_reasons?.[0] || 'current_beat_excluded') : (prev.exclusion_reasons?.[0] || 'previous_beat_excluded');
      } else {
        pairStatus = 'valid_pair';
        pairDiff = Math.round(((b.raw_rr_ms ?? 0) - (prev.raw_rr_ms ?? 0)) * 10) / 10;
        reasonCode = 'contiguous_accepted_pair';
      }

      evaluatedBeats.push({
        ordinal: i,
        source_row_index: b.source_row_index,
        relative_timestamp_ms: relTime,
        phone_timestamp_ms: b.phone_timestamp_ms,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: b.sensor_timestamp_ns,
        raw_rr_ms: b.raw_rr_ms,
        instantaneous_hr_bpm: b.instantaneous_hr_bpm,
        classification_status: b.classification_status,
        exclusion_reasons: b.exclusion_reasons || [],
        accepted_for_nn: b.accepted_for_nn,
        read_only_guarantee: true,
        segment_id: currentSegmentId,
        is_gap_start: isGapStart,
        gap_duration_ms: isGap ? timeDiffMs : undefined,
        successive_pair_status: pairStatus,
        pair_diff_ms: pairDiff,
        successive_pair_reason_code: reasonCode
      });
    }

    // Now apply user filters to evaluated beats
    let filteredBeats = evaluatedBeats;

    if (filter === 'accepted') {
      filteredBeats = filteredBeats.filter(b => b.accepted_for_nn);
    } else if (filter === 'excluded') {
      filteredBeats = filteredBeats.filter(b => !b.accepted_for_nn);
    }

    if (reasonCode) {
      filteredBeats = filteredBeats.filter(b => b.exclusion_reasons.includes(reasonCode) || b.successive_pair_reason_code === reasonCode);
    }

    if (timeFromMs !== undefined && !isNaN(timeFromMs)) {
      filteredBeats = filteredBeats.filter(b => b.relative_timestamp_ms >= timeFromMs);
    }

    if (timeToMs !== undefined && !isNaN(timeToMs)) {
      filteredBeats = filteredBeats.filter(b => b.relative_timestamp_ms <= timeToMs);
    }

    const totalFiltered = filteredBeats.length;
    const pagedBeats = filteredBeats.slice(offset, offset + limit);

    const sessionDuration = session.duration_seconds || canonical?.timing?.duration_seconds || 1;
    const acceptedCoverageSec = canonical?.timing?.rr_accepted_coverage_duration_seconds ?? 
      Math.round((ledger.clean_nn_intervals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / 1000) * 10) / 10;
    const acceptedCoverageRatio = Math.round((acceptedCoverageSec / sessionDuration) * 1000) / 1000;

    const stableOrderingIdentity = crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(`${id}:${filter}:${offset}:${limit}:${totalFiltered}:${canonical?.canonical_result_identity || 'canonical'}`)
      .digest('hex');

    res.json({
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      status: 'available',
      session_id: id,
      canonical_result_identity: canonical?.canonical_result_identity || null,
      canonical_source_identity: canonical?.source_bundle_id || null,
      stable_ordering_identity: stableOrderingIdentity,
      clock_evidence: clockEvidence,
      coverage_summary: {
        total_beats: ledger.total_beats,
        accepted_nn_beats: ledger.accepted_nn_beats,
        excluded_beats: ledger.excluded_beats,
        artifact_percentage: ledger.artifact_percentage,
        accepted_coverage_seconds: acceptedCoverageSec,
        accepted_coverage_ratio: acceptedCoverageRatio,
        longest_contiguous_seconds: canonical?.timing?.rr_longest_contiguous_seconds || 0,
        gap_count: gapCount
      },
      method_eligibility: canonical?.task_eligibility || {},
      pagination: {
        total: totalFiltered,
        offset,
        limit,
        has_more: offset + limit < totalFiltered,
        filter
      },
      beats: pagedBeats,
      scientific_disclaimer: 'Просмотр первичного реестра кардиоциклов RR предназначен для верификации и аудита исходных отсчетов. Не является медицинским заключением или диагностикой. Значения без валидного отсчета не интерполируются нулями.'
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(id) as SessionMetadata | undefined;
    if (!session) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }

    const qcMetrics = getSessionQcMetrics(id);
    const analyticsMetrics = getSessionMetrics(id);
    const flags = getCandidateFlags(id);
    const signals = getSessionSignals(id);

    // Fetch canonical session result as single source of truth
    const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(id, false).catch(() => null);

    const metrics = db
      .prepare('SELECT rmssd, sdnn, hrv_quality, hrv_quality_json, hrv_source FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?')
      .get(id) as any;
    let missingRmssdReason: string | null = null;
    if (metrics?.rmssd == null) {
      if (!metrics) {
        missingRmssdReason = 'legacy_metadata_missing';
      } else if (metrics.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data') {
        const hrvQualityJson = metrics.hrv_quality_json ? JSON.parse(metrics.hrv_quality_json) : null;
        if (hrvQualityJson?.reason?.includes('NN-интервалов') || hrvQualityJson?.reason?.includes('intervals') || metrics.valid_nn_count === 0) {
          missingRmssdReason = 'no_valid_nn_intervals';
        } else {
          missingRmssdReason = 'insufficient_data';
        }
      } else if (metrics.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
        missingRmssdReason = 'quality_limited_not_recalculated';
      } else if (metrics.hrv_source === 'none') {
        missingRmssdReason = 'hrv_source_unavailable';
      } else {
        missingRmssdReason = 'insufficient_data';
      }
    }

    const cleanSession = { ...session };
    delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_json;
    delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_version;
    delete (cleanSession as any).activity_segmentation_status;

    const duplicateMap = getDuplicateSessionMap(db);
    const dupInfo = duplicateMap.get(id);

    const enrichedSession = {
      ...cleanSession,
      missing_rmssd_reason: missingRmssdReason,
      missing_rmssd_reason_label: getMissingRmssdReasonLabel(missingRmssdReason),
      hrv_quality: metrics?.hrv_quality ?? 'insufficient_data',
      hrv_quality_label: getHrvQualityLabel(metrics?.hrv_quality ?? 'insufficient_data'),
      activity_segmentation_json: null,
      activity_segmentation_status: 'not_applicable',
      activity_segmentation_version: null,
      is_duplicate: dupInfo?.is_duplicate ?? false,
      has_duplicates: dupInfo?.has_duplicates ?? false,
      duplicate_count: dupInfo?.duplicate_count ?? 1,
      canonical_representative_id: dupInfo?.canonical_representative_id ?? session.id
    };

    const sanitizedQcMetrics = qcMetrics ? {
      ...qcMetrics,
      ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: 0.0,
      ecg_rr_consistency: null,
      ecg_rr_match_metrics_json: null
    } : null;

    const sanitizedAnalyticsMetrics = analyticsMetrics ? {
      ...analyticsMetrics,
      hr_drift_ratio: null
    } : null;

    res.json({
      session: enrichedSession,
      canonical_session: canonicalSession,
      qcMetrics: sanitizedQcMetrics,
      analyticsMetrics: sanitizedAnalyticsMetrics,
      flags,
      signalFiles: signals.map((f) => ({
        id: f.id,
        signal_type: f.signal_type,
        start_time: f.start_time,
        end_time: f.end_time,
        row_count: f.row_count,
      })),
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Recalculation state cache to support async-like status checks
const recalculationStatusMap = new Map<string, 'started' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'needs_source_files'>();

apiRouter.post('/sessions/:id/recalculate', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = String(req.params.id);
  recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'started');
  logger.info('analytics', `Starting recalculation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
  
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    const signals = getSessionSignals(id);
    if (signals.length === 0) {
      recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'needs_source_files');
      logger.warn('analytics', `Skipped recalculation: source files missing for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
      res.json({ status: 'needs_source_files' });
      return;
    }
    
    // Check if files exist locally on disk
    for (const f of signals) {
      const filePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${f.id}_${f.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'needs_source_files');
        logger.warn('analytics', `Skipped recalculation: file ${f.id} missing for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
        res.json({ status: 'needs_source_files' });
        return;
      }
    }

    await runQcForSession(id);
    
    recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'completed');
    logger.info('analytics', `Completed recalculation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
    res.json({ status: 'completed' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'failed');
    logger.error('analytics', `Failed recalculation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id, details: { error: err.message } });
    res.json({ status: 'failed', error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id/recalculate/status', (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = String(req.params.id);
  const status = recalculationStatusMap.get(id) || 'completed';
  res.json({ status });
});

apiRouter.post('/sessions/:id/named-windows', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const { name, startOffsetSeconds, endOffsetSeconds, userId } = req.body || {};
    if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Window name is required' });
      return;
    }
    if (typeof startOffsetSeconds !== 'number' || typeof endOffsetSeconds !== 'number') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'startOffsetSeconds and endOffsetSeconds must be numbers' });
      return;
    }
    const created = await NamedWindowService.createWindow(id, userId || null, name, startOffsetSeconds, endOffsetSeconds);
    res.status(201).json(created);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.put('/sessions/:id/named-windows/:windowId', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string; windowId:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const windowId = String(req.params.windowId);
    const { name, startOffsetSeconds, endOffsetSeconds, expectedRevision } = req.body || {};
    const updated = await NamedWindowService.updateWindow(windowId, { 
      name, 
      startOffsetSeconds, 
      endOffsetSeconds, 
      expectedRevision 
    });
    if (!updated) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Window not found' });
      return;
    }
    res.json(updated);
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err.statusCode === 409 || err.message?.includes('CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT')) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, currentRevision: err.currentRevision });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id/named-windows/compare', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const sessionId = String(req.params.id);
    const windowA = String(req.query.windowA || req.query.windowAId || '');
    const windowB = String(req.query.windowB || req.query.windowBId || '');
    if (!windowA || !windowB) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Both windowA and windowB query parameters are required', errorCode: 'MISSING_WINDOW_PARAMS' });
      return;
    }
    const winA = await NamedWindowService.getWindowById(windowA);
    const winB = await NamedWindowService.getWindowById(windowB);
    if (!winA) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Window ${windowA} not found`, errorCode: 'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND' });
      return;
    }
    if (!winB) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Window ${windowB} not found`, errorCode: 'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND' });
      return;
    }
    if (winA.sessionId !== sessionId || winB.sessionId !== sessionId) {
      res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Cross-session window comparison is prohibited. Both windows must belong to the path session. Use canonical session comparison (peer/baseline).',
        errorCode: 'CROSS_SESSION_WINDOWS_PROHIBITED'
      });
      return;
    }
    const comparison = await NamedWindowService.compareNamedWindows(windowA, windowB);
    res.json(comparison);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.statusCode || 400;
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message, errorCode: err.errorCode || 'WINDOW_COMPARE_FAILED' });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/settings/preferences', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const preferences = getUserPreferences();
    res.json({ success: true, preferences });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.put('/settings/preferences', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { expected_revision, ...patch } = req.body || {};
    const updated = updateUserPreferences(patch, expected_revision);
    res.json({ success: true, preferences: updated });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof OptimisticConcurrencyError) {
      res.status(409).json({
        error: err.message,
        code: err.code,
        current_revision: err.currentRevision,
        expected_revision: err.expectedRevision
      });
      return;
    }
    const status = err.statusCode || (err.message && err.message.includes('Unsupported') ? 400 : 500);
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/settings/preferences/migrate', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { localStorageLang } = req.body || {};
    const preferences = migratePreferencesFromLocalStorage(localStorageLang);
    res.json({ success: true, preferences });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/settings/onboarding', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    let shown = getAppSetting('onboarding_completed') === 'true';
    if (!shown) {
      try {
        const db = getDb();
        const countRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM sessions').get() as { count: number } | undefined;
        if (countRow && countRow.count > 0) {
          shown = true;
          setAppSetting('onboarding_completed', 'true');
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    res.json({ success: true, onboarding_completed: shown });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/settings/onboarding/dismiss', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    setAppSetting('onboarding_completed', 'true');
    res.json({ success: true, onboarding_completed: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/sessions/:id/purge-local-derived', (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const { confirmText } = req.body || {};
    if (confirmText !== 'DELETE LOCAL DERIVED DATA') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Неверный текст подтверждения' });
      return;
    }
    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (!session) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }
    // Hard delete local derived data (cascade deletes session signals, metrics, qc)
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    invalidateCanonicalSessionCache(id);
    logger.info('sessionizer', 'Hard deleted local derived data for session', { sessionId: id });
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Signal data — ECG (LTTB downsampled)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function resolveSignalPath(fileId: string, signalType: string): string {
  return path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${fileId}_${signalType.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
}

function getSessionChannelSync(fileId: string): ChannelSynchronizationResult {
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    const signalRow = db.prepare('SELECT session_id FROM session_signals WHERE file_id = ?').get(fileId) as { session_id: string } | undefined;
    if (!signalRow) {
      return {
        is_synchronized: false,
        sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
        ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        channel_offset_seconds: 0,
        common_origin_ns: null,
        common_origin_ms: null,
        limitations: ['File is not associated with an active session']
      };
    }

    const siblingFiles = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.id, f.signal_type 
      FROM ingested_files f 
      JOIN session_signals ss ON f.id = ss.file_id 
      WHERE ss.session_id = ?
    `).all(signalRow.session_id) as { id: string; signal_type: string }[];

    const ecgFile = siblingFiles.find(f => f.signal_type === 'ECG');
    const accFile = siblingFiles.find(f => f.signal_type === 'ACC');

    if (!ecgFile || !accFile) {
      return {
        is_synchronized: false,
        sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
        ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        channel_offset_seconds: 0,
        common_origin_ns: null,
        common_origin_ms: null,
        limitations: ['Session does not contain both ECG and ACC channels']
      };
    }

    const ecgSyncPoints: { timeMs?: number; sensorTsNs?: number }[] = [];
    const accSyncPoints: { timeMs?: number; sensorTsNs?: number }[] = [];

    const ecgPath = resolveSignalPath(ecgFile.id, 'ecg');
    if (fs.existsSync(ecgPath)) {
      try {
        const compressedBuf = fs.readFileSync(ecgPath);
        const decompressed = zlib.gunzipSync(compressedBuf);
        const series = parseCanonicalEcgText(decompressed.toString('utf8'));
        const firstPhone = (series.phone_timestamps_ms && series.phone_timestamps_ms.length > 0)
          ? series.phone_timestamps_ms[0]
          : undefined;

        if (series.sensor_timestamps_ns && series.sensor_timestamps_ns.length > 0) {
          let prevNs = series.sensor_timestamps_ns[0];
          ecgSyncPoints.push({ timeMs: firstPhone, sensorTsNs: prevNs });
          for (let i = 1; i < series.sensor_timestamps_ns.length; i++) {
            const ns = series.sensor_timestamps_ns[i];
            if (ns < prevNs) {
              ecgSyncPoints.push({ timeMs: series.phone_timestamps_ms?.[i], sensorTsNs: ns });
              break;
            }
            prevNs = ns;
          }
        } else if (firstPhone !== undefined) {
          ecgSyncPoints.push({ timeMs: firstPhone });
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const accPath = resolveSignalPath(accFile.id, 'acc');
    if (fs.existsSync(accPath)) {
      try {
        const accCompressed = fs.readFileSync(accPath);
        const accDecomp = zlib.gunzipSync(accCompressed).toString('utf8');
        const lines = accDecomp.split('\n');
        let prevAccNs: number | null = null;
        for (const line of lines) {
          const trimmed = line.trim();
          if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
          const parts = trimmed.split(/[;,]/).map(s => s.trim());
          if (parts.length >= 4) {
            let pMs: number | undefined;
            let sNs: number | undefined;
            const phoneTs = new Date(parts[0]).getTime();
            if (!isNaN(phoneTs) && parts[0].includes('T')) {
              pMs = phoneTs;
              const parsedNs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
              if (!isNaN(parsedNs)) sNs = parsedNs;
            } else {
              const val0 = parseFloat(parts[0]);
              if (!isNaN(val0)) {
                if (val0 > 1e15) {
                  sNs = val0;
                  if (parts.length >= 5) {
                    const parsedMs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
                    if (!isNaN(parsedMs)) pMs = parsedMs;
                  }
                } else if (val0 > 1e11) {
                  pMs = val0;
                }
              }
            }

            if (accSyncPoints.length === 0) {
              if (sNs !== undefined || pMs !== undefined) {
                accSyncPoints.push({ timeMs: pMs, sensorTsNs: sNs });
                if (sNs !== undefined) prevAccNs = sNs;
              }
            } else if (sNs !== undefined && prevAccNs !== null && sNs < prevAccNs) {
              accSyncPoints.push({ timeMs: pMs, sensorTsNs: sNs });
              break;
            } else if (sNs !== undefined) {
              prevAccNs = sNs;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    return calculateChannelSynchronization(ecgSyncPoints, accSyncPoints);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      is_synchronized: false,
      sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
      ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
      acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
      channel_offset_seconds: 0,
      common_origin_ns: null,
      common_origin_ms: null,
      limitations: ['Synchronization calculation encountered an unexpected error']
    };
  }
}

// In-memory overview ECG downsample cache (fileId -> response payload)
const overviewEcgCache = new Map<string, any>();
const inFlightEcgMap = new Map<string, Promise<any>>();

// ECG endpoint with LTTB downsampling
apiRouter.get('/signals/:fileId/ecg', async (req: ReqParam<{fileId:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const fileId = String(req.params.fileId);
    const targetPoints = Math.min(parseInt(req.query['points'] as string) || 4000, 20000);
    const startMs = req.query['start'] ? parseInt(req.query['start'] as string) : undefined;
    const endMs = req.query['end'] ? parseInt(req.query['end'] as string) : undefined;

    const isOverview = !startMs && !endMs && targetPoints === 4000;
    if (isOverview && overviewEcgCache.has(fileId)) {
      res.json(overviewEcgCache.get(fileId));
      return;
    }
    if (isOverview && inFlightEcgMap.has(fileId)) {
      const cachedPayload = await inFlightEcgMap.get(fileId);
      res.json(cachedPayload);
      return;
    }

    const filePath = resolveSignalPath(fileId, 'ecg');
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'ЭКГ файл не найден' });
      return;
    }

    const computeWork = async () => {
      const compressedBuf = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);
      const decompressed = await new Promise<Buffer>((resolve, reject) => {
        zlib.gunzip(compressedBuf, (err, res) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(res);
        });
      });
      const rawText = decompressed.toString('utf8');
      const series = parseCanonicalEcgText(rawText);

      const syncResult = getSessionChannelSync(fileId);

      const ecgNormOptions = syncResult.is_synchronized ? {
        commonOriginNs: syncResult.common_origin_ns ?? undefined,
        commonOriginMs: syncResult.common_origin_ms ?? undefined,
        preserveGaps: true
      } : { preserveGaps: true };

      const rawEcgPoints = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < series.total_samples; i++) {
        rawEcgPoints.push({
          timeMs: series.canonical_timestamps_ms[i],
          ecgUv: series.samples_uv[i],
          sensorTsNs: series.sensor_timestamps_ns ? series.sensor_timestamps_ns[i] : undefined
        });
      }
      const normalizedEcg = normalizeEcgTimestamps(rawEcgPoints, ecgNormOptions);

      // Filter points by canonical millisecond axis: series.canonical_timestamps_ms
      const pointsInSeconds: [number, number][] = [];
      const baseMs = series.canonical_timestamps_ms[0] ?? 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < series.total_samples; i++) {
        const tMs = series.canonical_timestamps_ms[i];
        if (startMs !== undefined && tMs < startMs) continue;
        if (endMs !== undefined && tMs > endMs) continue;
        if (syncResult.is_synchronized) {
          pointsInSeconds.push(normalizedEcg[i]);
        } else {
          const elapsedSec = (tMs - baseMs) / 1000;
          pointsInSeconds.push([elapsedSec, series.samples_uv[i]]);
        }
      }

      const downsampled = lttb(pointsInSeconds, targetPoints);

      let best_offset_ms = 0;
      if (!startMs && series.total_samples > 0) {
        const formattedPoints = series.canonical_timestamps_ms.map((t, idx) => ({ timeMs: t, ecgUv: series.samples_uv[idx] }));
        const bestStrip = getBestEcgStrip(formattedPoints);
        if (bestStrip.length > 0) {
          best_offset_ms = bestStrip[0].timeMs - series.canonical_timestamps_ms[0];
        }
      }

      const canonicalTimeOriginMs = series.canonical_timestamps_ms.length > 0 ? series.canonical_timestamps_ms[0] : 0;
      const phoneTimeOriginMs = series.phone_timestamps_ms && series.phone_timestamps_ms.length > 0 ? series.phone_timestamps_ms[0] : 0;

      return {
        points: downsampled,
        totalRaw: series.total_samples,
        timebase_type: series.timebase_type,
        time_unit: 'seconds',
        time_origin: syncResult.is_synchronized ? 'shared_session_origin' : series.timebase_type,
        canonical_time_origin_ms: canonicalTimeOriginMs,
        phone_time_origin_ms: phoneTimeOriginMs,
        best_offset_ms,
        time_origin_ms: syncResult.common_origin_ms ?? canonicalTimeOriginMs,
        synchronization: syncResult,
        provenance: series.timebase_provenance
      };
    };

    let responsePayload: any;
    if (isOverview) {
      const p = computeWork();
      inFlightEcgMap.set(fileId, p);
      try {
        responsePayload = await p;
      } finally {
        inFlightEcgMap.delete(fileId);
      }
      if (overviewEcgCache.size > 20) {
        const firstKey = overviewEcgCache.keys().next().value;
        if (firstKey) overviewEcgCache.delete(firstKey);
      }
      overviewEcgCache.set(fileId, responsePayload);
    } else {
      responsePayload = await computeWork();
    }

    res.json(responsePayload);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/signals/:fileId/ecg/peaks', async (req: ReqParam<{fileId:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const fileId = String(req.params.fileId);
    const filePath = resolveSignalPath(fileId, 'ecg');
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'ЭКГ файл не найден' });
      return;
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const sessionFile = db.prepare('SELECT session_id FROM session_signals WHERE file_id = ?').get(fileId) as { session_id: string } | undefined;
    
    if (!sessionFile) {
      res.json({
        file_id: fileId,
        time_origin: 'unavailable',
        peaks: [],
        quality_limited: false,
        warnings: ['ECG file is not linked to an authoritative canonical session.']
      });
      return;
    }

    const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionFile.session_id, false).catch(() => null);
    const ecgEvidence = canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence;

    if (!ecgEvidence || !ecgEvidence.qrs_detector) {
      res.json({
        file_id: fileId,
        time_origin: 'unavailable',
        peaks: [],
        quality_limited: false,
        warnings: ['No canonical ECG evidence available for this session.']
      });
      return;
    }

    const qrs = ecgEvidence.qrs_detector;
    const peaks = qrs.peaks.map(p => {
      const peakTime = p.time_ms;
      const peakVal = p.ecg_uv !== undefined ? Math.round(p.ecg_uv) : null;
      return {
        sample_index: p.sample_index,
        time_ms: peakTime,
        ecg_uv: peakVal,
        confidence: qrs.quality_limited ? ('quality_limited' as const) : ('uncalibrated_bounded' as const),
        source: 'qrs_detector' as const,
        detector_version: qrs.detector_version,
        // Backwards compatibility aliases
        timeMs: peakTime,
        voltageUv: peakVal
      };
    });

    res.json({
      file_id: fileId,
      time_origin: ecgEvidence.timebase_type,
      timebase_provenance: ecgEvidence.timebase_provenance,
      detector_version: qrs.detector_version,
      maturity: qrs.maturity,
      peaks,
      quality_limited: qrs.quality_limited,
      limitations: qrs.limitations,
      warnings: qrs.warnings
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// HR endpoint
apiRouter.get('/signals/:fileId/hr', async (req: ReqParam<{fileId:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const fileId = String(req.params.fileId);
    const startMs = req.query['start'] ? parseInt(req.query['start'] as string) : undefined;
    const endMs = req.query['end'] ? parseInt(req.query['end'] as string) : undefined;

    const filePath = resolveSignalPath(fileId, 'hr');
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'HR файл не найден' });
      return;
    }

    const rawPoints = await readHRGz(filePath);
    const normalized = normalizeHrTimestamps(rawPoints);

    let filtered = normalized;
    if (startMs !== undefined || endMs !== undefined) {
      const filteredIndexes: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
        const pt = rawPoints[i];
        if (startMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs < startMs) continue;
        if (endMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs > endMs) continue;
        filteredIndexes.push(i);
      }
      filtered = filteredIndexes.map(idx => normalized[idx]);
    }

    res.json({ points: filtered });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// ACC magnitude endpoint
apiRouter.get('/signals/:fileId/acc', async (req: ReqParam<{fileId:string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const fileId = String(req.params.fileId);
    const startMs = req.query['start'] ? parseInt(req.query['start'] as string) : undefined;
    const endMs = req.query['end'] ? parseInt(req.query['end'] as string) : undefined;

    const filePath = resolveSignalPath(fileId, 'acc');
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'ACC файл не найден' });
      return;
    }

    const rawPoints = await readACCGz(filePath);

    // Detect ACC sample rate
    let sampleRateHz = 200;
    if (rawPoints.length > 1) {
      const durationMs = rawPoints[rawPoints.length - 1].timeMs - rawPoints[0].timeMs;
      if (durationMs > 0) {
        const calculatedRate = (rawPoints.length / durationMs) * 1000;
        const rates = [25, 50, 100, 200];
        sampleRateHz = rates.reduce((prev, curr) => 
          Math.abs(curr - calculatedRate) < Math.abs(prev - calculatedRate) ? curr : prev
        );
      }
    }

    const syncResult = getSessionChannelSync(fileId);

    const normOptions = syncResult.is_synchronized ? {
      commonOriginNs: syncResult.common_origin_ns ?? undefined,
      commonOriginMs: syncResult.common_origin_ms ?? undefined,
      preserveGaps: true
    } : { preserveGaps: true };

    const { points: normalizedPoints, axes: normalizedAxes } = normalizeAccTimestamps(rawPoints, sampleRateHz, normOptions);

    let filteredPoints = normalizedPoints;
    let filteredX = normalizedAxes.x;
    let filteredY = normalizedAxes.y;
    let filteredZ = normalizedAxes.z;

    if (startMs !== undefined || endMs !== undefined) {
      const filteredIndexes: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
        const pt = rawPoints[i];
        if (startMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs < startMs) continue;
        if (endMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs > endMs) continue;
        filteredIndexes.push(i);
      }
      filteredPoints = filteredIndexes.map(idx => normalizedPoints[idx]);
      filteredX = filteredIndexes.map(idx => normalizedAxes.x[idx]);
      filteredY = filteredIndexes.map(idx => normalizedAxes.y[idx]);
      filteredZ = filteredIndexes.map(idx => normalizedAxes.z[idx]);
    }

    const targetPoints = Math.min(filteredPoints.length, 2000);
    const downMag = lttb(filteredPoints, targetPoints);

    // Map elapsed_seconds back to index or directly use downsampled coordinates since we have aligned lists
    const elapsedToIdx = new Map<number, number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < filteredPoints.length; i++) {
      elapsedToIdx.set(filteredPoints[i][0], i);
    }

    const downX: Point[] = [];
    const downY: Point[] = [];
    const downZ: Point[] = [];

    for (const [elapsed, _] of downMag) {
      const idx = elapsedToIdx.get(elapsed);
      if (idx !== undefined && idx < filteredX.length) {
        downX.push([elapsed, filteredX[idx][1]]);
        downY.push([elapsed, filteredY[idx][1]]);
        downZ.push([elapsed, filteredZ[idx][1]]);
      } else {
        downX.push([elapsed, 0]);
        downY.push([elapsed, 0]);
        downZ.push([elapsed, 0]);
      }
    }

    res.json({
      points: downMag,
      axes: {
        x: downX,
        y: downY,
        z: downZ
      },
      time_unit: 'seconds',
      synchronization: syncResult,
      sampleRateHz
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// RR intervals (for Poincaré plot)
apiRouter.get('/signals/:fileId/rr', async (req: ReqParam<{fileId:string}>, res: Response) => {

    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Background Recompute Job State definition
export interface RecomputeJobState {
  job_id?: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'queued' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
  user_id: string;
  zones_config_hash: string;
  total_sessions: number;
  processed_sessions: number;
  failed_sessions: number;
  started_at: string | null;
  updated_at: string | null;
  last_error: string | null;
  current_session_id: string | null;
  cancel_requested: boolean;
  affected_session_ids: string[];
  session_results: { session_id: string; status: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'needs_source_files'; error?: string }[];
}

function initRecomputeJobsTable(db: any): void {
  try {
    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recompute_jobs (
        job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        zones_config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        total_sessions INTEGER NOT NULL,
        processed_sessions INTEGER NOT NULL,
        failed_sessions INTEGER NOT NULL,
        started_at TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT,
        last_error TEXT,
        current_session_id TEXT,
        cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        affected_session_ids_json TEXT,
        session_results_json TEXT
      );
    `);
  } catch {}
}

function persistJobState(job: RecomputeJobState): void {
  if (!job.job_id) return;
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    initRecomputeJobsTable(db);
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO recompute_jobs (
        job_id, user_id, zones_config_hash, status, total_sessions,
        processed_sessions, failed_sessions, started_at, updated_at,
        last_error, current_session_id, cancel_requested,
        affected_session_ids_json, session_results_json
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET
        status = excluded.status,
        total_sessions = excluded.total_sessions,
        processed_sessions = excluded.processed_sessions,
        failed_sessions = excluded.failed_sessions,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
        last_error = excluded.last_error,
        current_session_id = excluded.current_session_id,
        cancel_requested = excluded.cancel_requested,
        session_results_json = excluded.session_results_json
    `).run(
      job.job_id,
      job.user_id,
      job.zones_config_hash,
      job.status,
      job.total_sessions,
      job.processed_sessions,
      job.failed_sessions,
      job.started_at,
      job.updated_at,
      job.last_error,
      job.current_session_id,
      job.cancel_requested ? 1 : 0,
      JSON.stringify(job.affected_session_ids || []),
      JSON.stringify(job.session_results || [])
    );
  } catch {}
}

function loadLatestJobState(): RecomputeJobState | null {
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    initRecomputeJobsTable(db);
    const row = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM recompute_jobs ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1`).get() as any;
    if (!row) return null;
    let status = row.status as any;
    let lastError = row.last_error;
    // Server restart recovery: if job was left in running or queued, mark as failed due to restart
    if (status === 'running' || status === 'queued') {
      status = 'failed';
      lastError = lastError || 'Процесс пересчёта прерван перезапуском сервера';
      try {
        db.prepare('UPDATE recompute_jobs SET status = ?, last_error = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE job_id = ?')
          .run(status, lastError, new Date().toISOString(), row.job_id);
      } catch {}
    }
    return {
      job_id: row.job_id,
      status,
      user_id: row.user_id,
      zones_config_hash: row.zones_config_hash,
      total_sessions: row.total_sessions,
      processed_sessions: row.processed_sessions,
      failed_sessions: row.failed_sessions,
      started_at: row.started_at,
      updated_at: row.updated_at,
      last_error: lastError,
      current_session_id: row.current_session_id,
      cancel_requested: Boolean(row.cancel_requested),
      affected_session_ids: row.affected_session_ids_json ? JSON.parse(row.affected_session_ids_json) : [],
      session_results: row.session_results_json ? JSON.parse(row.session_results_json) : []
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

let activeJob: RecomputeJobState = {
  status: 'idle',
  user_id: '',
  zones_config_hash: '',
  total_sessions: 0,
  processed_sessions: 0,
  failed_sessions: 0,
  started_at: null,
  updated_at: null,
  last_error: null,
  current_session_id: null,
  cancel_requested: false,
  affected_session_ids: [],
  session_results: []
};

apiRouter.put('/user', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { age, resting_hr, max_hr, custom_zones } = req.body;
    if (
      age === undefined ||
      resting_hr === undefined ||
      max_hr === undefined ||
      typeof age !== 'number' ||
      typeof resting_hr !== 'number' ||
      typeof max_hr !== 'number'
    ) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Необходимо передать age, resting_hr и max_hr' });
      return;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(age) || age <= 0 || age > 120 ||
      !Number.isFinite(resting_hr) || resting_hr < 30 || resting_hr > 220 ||
      !Number.isFinite(max_hr) || max_hr < 60 || max_hr > 250 ||
      resting_hr >= max_hr
    ) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректные параметры профиля: возраст (1-120), пульс покоя (30-220), макс. пульс (60-250), пульс покоя должен быть строго меньше максимального' });
      return;
    }

    const db = getDb();
    
    // Get current resolved zones configuration
    const currentUser = getUser(DEFAULT_USER_ID);
    const currentResolved = resolveHeartRateZones(currentUser, currentUser?.age || 35);

    let customZonesStr: string | null = null;
    let customZonesUpdatedAt: string | null = null;
    if (custom_zones) {
      const parsedObj = typeof custom_zones === 'string' ? JSON.parse(custom_zones) : custom_zones;
      const validation = validateCustomHeartRateZones(parsedObj);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error || 'Неверный формат зон ЧСС' });
        return;
      }
      customZonesUpdatedAt = parsedObj.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
      if (!parsedObj.updatedAt) {
        parsedObj.updatedAt = customZonesUpdatedAt;
      }
      customZonesStr = JSON.stringify(parsedObj);
    }

    // Resolve new hypothetical config
    const draftUser = {
      max_hr,
      resting_hr,
      custom_zones: customZonesStr
    };
    const newResolved = resolveHeartRateZones(draftUser, age || 35);

    // Calculate if recompute is required: check if boundaries differ or mode differs
    const currentBounds = currentResolved.boundariesBpm;
    const newBounds = newResolved.boundariesBpm;
    const boundsDiffer = currentBounds.some((val: number, idx: number) => val !== newBounds[idx]);
    const modeDiffer = currentResolved.mode !== newResolved.mode;
    const recompute_required = boundsDiffer || modeDiffer;

    // Get affected session count for DEFAULT_USER_ID, excluding ignored sessions
    const affectedSessions = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM sessions 
      WHERE user_id = ? 
        AND id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM ignored_sessions)
    `).all(DEFAULT_USER_ID) as { id: string }[];
    const affected_sessions_count = affectedSessions.length;

    // Save user settings (atomic save block)
    saveUser({
      id: DEFAULT_USER_ID,
      age,
      resting_hr,
      max_hr,
      custom_zones: customZonesStr,
      custom_zones_updated_at: customZonesUpdatedAt
    });

    // Detect zone narrowness warnings
    const rawWarnings = checkZoneWarnings(newBounds);
    const warnings = rawWarnings.map(w => w.message);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      zones_config_hash: newResolved.configHash,
      recompute_required,
      affected_sessions_count,
      warnings
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/jobs/recompute-zones/start', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const { user_id, zones_config_hash } = req.body;
  if (!user_id || !zones_config_hash) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Необходимо указать user_id и zones_config_hash' });
    return;
  }

  if (activeJob.status === 'running' || activeJob.status === 'queued') {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Recompute job is already running' });
    return;
  }

  // Reject stale start
  const dbUser = getUser(user_id);
  const currentResolved = resolveHeartRateZones(dbUser, dbUser?.age || 35);
  if (currentResolved.configHash !== zones_config_hash) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Конфигурация зон устарела. Пожалуйста, сохраните новые зоны.' });
    return;
  }

  const db = getDb();
  const affectedSessions = db.prepare(`
    SELECT id FROM sessions 
    WHERE user_id = ? 
      AND id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM ignored_sessions)
  `).all(user_id) as { id: string }[];
  const affected_session_ids = affectedSessions.map(s => s.id);

  const newJobId = crypto.randomUUID();
  activeJob = {
    job_id: newJobId,
    status: 'queued',
    user_id,
    zones_config_hash,
    total_sessions: affected_session_ids.length,
    processed_sessions: 0,
    failed_sessions: 0,
    started_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    last_error: null,
    current_session_id: null,
    cancel_requested: false,
    affected_session_ids,
    session_results: []
  };
  persistJobState(activeJob);

  logger.info('jobs', 'Recompute zones job queued', { jobId: zones_config_hash, details: { total_sessions: affected_session_ids.length, unique_job_id: newJobId } });

  // Start background loop
  setTimeout(async () => {
    const thisJobId = newJobId;
    try {
      if (activeJob.job_id !== thisJobId) return;
      activeJob.status = 'running';
      activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
      persistJobState(activeJob);
      logger.info('jobs', 'Recompute zones job started running', { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash });

      for (const id of activeJob.affected_session_ids) {
        if (activeJob.job_id !== thisJobId) return;
        if (activeJob.cancel_requested) {
          activeJob.status = 'cancelled';
          activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
          persistJobState(activeJob);
          logger.info('jobs', 'Recompute zones job cancelled', { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash });
          break;
        }

        activeJob.current_session_id = id;
        activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
        persistJobState(activeJob);

        // Check if files exist locally on disk
        const signals = getSessionSignals(id);
        let filesExist = true;
        if (signals.length === 0) {
          filesExist = false;
        } else {
          for (const f of signals) {
            const filePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${f.id}_${f.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
            if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
              filesExist = false;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!filesExist) {
          recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'needs_source_files');
          activeJob.failed_sessions++;
          activeJob.session_results.push({
            session_id: id,
            status: 'needs_source_files',
            error: 'Исходные файлы сигналов не найдены на диске'
          });
          logger.warn('jobs', `Recompute zones: session ${id} skipped due to missing files`, { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash, sessionId: id });
          activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
          persistJobState(activeJob);
          continue;
        }

        try {
          recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'started');
          await runQcForSession(id, { forceRecomputeZones: true });
          if (activeJob.job_id !== thisJobId) return;
          recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'completed');
          activeJob.processed_sessions++;
          activeJob.session_results.push({
            session_id: id,
            status: 'completed'
          });
          logger.info('jobs', `Recompute zones: session ${id} completed`, { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash, sessionId: id, details: { processed: activeJob.processed_sessions, total: activeJob.total_sessions } });
        } catch (err: any) {
          if (activeJob.job_id !== thisJobId) return;
          recalculationStatusMap.set(id, 'failed');
          activeJob.failed_sessions++;
          activeJob.last_error = err.message;
          activeJob.session_results.push({
            session_id: id,
            status: 'failed',
            error: err.message
          });
          logger.error('jobs', `Recompute zones: session ${id} failed`, { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash, sessionId: id, details: { error: err.message } });
        }
        activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
        persistJobState(activeJob);
      }

      if (activeJob.job_id === thisJobId && activeJob.status === 'running') {
        if (activeJob.failed_sessions > 0) {
          activeJob.status = 'failed';
          activeJob.last_error = activeJob.last_error || `${activeJob.failed_sessions} из ${activeJob.total_sessions} сессий не удалось пересчитать`;
        } else {
          activeJob.status = 'completed';
        }
        activeJob.current_session_id = null;
        activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
        persistJobState(activeJob);
        logger.info('jobs', `Recompute zones job finished with status ${activeJob.status}`, { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash, details: { total: activeJob.total_sessions, processed: activeJob.processed_sessions, failed: activeJob.failed_sessions } });
      }
    } catch (jobErr: any) {
      if (activeJob.job_id === thisJobId) {
        activeJob.status = 'failed';
        activeJob.last_error = jobErr.message;
        activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
        persistJobState(activeJob);
        logger.error('jobs', 'Recompute zones job failed', { jobId: activeJob.zones_config_hash, details: { error: jobErr.message } });
      }
    }
  }, 0);

  res.json({ success: true, job: activeJob });
});

apiRouter.get('/jobs/recompute-zones/status', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  if (activeJob.status === 'idle') {
    const recovered = loadLatestJobState();
    if (recovered) {
      activeJob = recovered;
    }
  }
  res.json(activeJob);
});

apiRouter.post('/jobs/recompute-zones/cancel', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  if (activeJob.status === 'running' || activeJob.status === 'queued') {
    activeJob.cancel_requested = true;
    activeJob.status = 'cancelled';
    activeJob.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    persistJobState(activeJob);
    res.json({ success: true, job: activeJob });
  } else {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Нет запущенных задач для отмены' });
  }
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trends — aggregate HRV metrics across sessions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function calculateBaselineBand(values: number[]): { median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null } {
  if (values.length === 0) return { median: null, p25: null, p75: null };
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  
  const getPercentile = (p: number) => {
    const idx = (n - 1) * p;
    const low = Math.floor(idx);
    const high = Math.ceil(idx);
    const weight = idx - low;
    return sorted[low] * (1 - weight) + sorted[high] * weight;
  };

  return {
    median: Math.round(getPercentile(0.5) * 10) / 10,
    p25: Math.round(getPercentile(0.25) * 10) / 10,
    p75: Math.round(getPercentile(0.75) * 10) / 10
  };
}

apiRouter.get('/trends', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = (req.query.user_id as string) || 'default';
    const activityType = req.query.activity_type as string | undefined;
    const window = req.query.window as string | undefined;
    let dateFrom = req.query.date_from as string | undefined;
    let dateTo = req.query.date_to as string | undefined;
    const includeHidden = req.query.include_hidden === 'true';

    // Window presets (2w, 4w, 3m, 6m, all)
    if (window) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (window === '2w') {
        dateFrom = new Date(now - 14 * 86400000).toISOString();
        dateTo = undefined;
      } else if (window === '4w') {
        dateFrom = new Date(now - 28 * 86400000).toISOString();
        dateTo = undefined;
      } else if (window === '3m') {
        dateFrom = new Date(now - 90 * 86400000).toISOString();
        dateTo = undefined;
      } else if (window === '6m') {
        dateFrom = new Date(now - 180 * 86400000).toISOString();
        dateTo = undefined;
      } else if (window === 'all') {
        dateFrom = undefined;
        dateTo = undefined;
      }
    }

    const db = getDb();
    
    // 1. Fetch all historical data for baseline (overall history of this user/activity)
    let baselineQuery = `
      SELECT s.id, s.start_time, s.avg_hr, s.overall_quality_score, s.duration_seconds,
             m.rmssd, m.sdnn, m.pnn50, m.hrv_quality, m.hrv_source, m.recovery_1min, m.recovery_2min, m.hr_drift_ratio, m.time_in_zones,
             a.activity_type
      FROM ${includeHidden ? 'sessions' : 'visible_sessions'} s
      LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id
      LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id
      WHERE s.user_id = ?
    `;
    const baselineParams: any[] = [userId];

    // Filter by activity type if specified and not 'all'
    const isFilteredActivity = activityType && activityType !== 'all' && activityType !== 'Все активности';
    if (isFilteredActivity) {
      baselineQuery += ` AND a.activity_type = ?`;
      baselineParams.push(activityType);
    }
    const allSessionsRaw = db.prepare(baselineQuery).all(...baselineParams) as any[];

    // Canonical observation reconstruction strictly under Frozen Protocol v1.1.0
    const allSessions = await Promise.all(
      allSessionsRaw.map(async s => {
        try {
          return await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservation(s.id);
        } catch {
          return {
            id: s.id,
            session_id: s.id,
            start_time: s.start_time,
            end_time: s.end_time || null,
            duration_seconds: s.duration_seconds || null,
            evidence_mode: 'legacy_unverified' as const,
            rmssd: s.rmssd ?? null,
            sdnn: s.sdnn ?? null,
            pnn50: s.pnn50 ?? null,
            avg_hr: s.avg_hr ?? null,
            mean_rr: null,
            rmssd_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            sdnn_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            pnn50_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            mean_hr_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            baseline_included_rmssd: false,
            baseline_included_sdnn: false,
            baseline_included_pnn50: false,
            baseline_included_mean_hr: false,
            overall_quality_score: s.overall_quality_score ?? null,
            legacy_technical_quality_rollup_non_authoritative: s.overall_quality_score ?? null,
            hrv_source: s.hrv_source || 'legacy',
            hrv_quality: s.hrv_quality || 'unsupported',
            recovery_1min: s.recovery_1min ?? null,
            recovery_2min: s.recovery_2min ?? null,
            hr_drift_ratio: s.hr_drift_ratio ?? null,
            time_in_zones: s.time_in_zones ?? null,
            activity_type: s.activity_type ?? null
          };
        }
      })
    );

    // Calculate baseline and interpretation cards using the interpreter (LOO applies if target session provided)
    const targetSessionId = (req.query.current_session_id || req.query.target_session_id) as string | undefined;
    const interpreterResult = interpretTrends(allSessions, targetSessionId);

    // Map bands to the structure expected by the frontend (with sessions_used, min_sessions_required, reason)
    const baseline = {
      rmssd_ms: {
        available: interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.available,
        median: interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.median,
        p25: interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p25,
        p75: interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p75,
        min_sessions_required: 5,
        sessions_used: interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.count,
        reason: !interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.available ? 'Недостаточно личной истории для baseline. Показатель показан справочно.' : undefined
      },
      sdnn_ms: {
        available: interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.available,
        median: interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.median,
        p25: interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p25,
        p75: interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p75,
        min_sessions_required: 5,
        sessions_used: interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.count,
        reason: !interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.available ? 'Недостаточно личной истории для baseline. Показатель показан справочно.' : undefined
      },
      pnn50_percent: {
        available: interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.available,
        median: interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.median,
        p25: interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p25,
        p75: interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p75,
        min_sessions_required: 5,
        sessions_used: interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.count,
        reason: !interpreterResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.available ? 'Недостаточно личной истории для baseline. Показатель показан справочно.' : undefined
      },
      avg_hr_bpm: {
        available: interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.available,
        median: interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.median,
        p25: interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p25,
        p75: interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p75,
        min_sessions_required: 5,
        sessions_used: interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.count,
        reason: !interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.available ? 'Недостаточно личной истории для baseline. Показатель показан справочно.' : undefined
      }
    };

    // 2. Fetch specific range sessions for points
    let pointsQuery = `
      SELECT s.id, s.start_time, s.avg_hr, s.overall_quality_score, s.duration_seconds, s.active_duration_seconds,
             m.rmssd, m.sdnn, m.pnn50, m.hrv_quality, a.activity_type
      FROM ${includeHidden ? 'sessions' : 'visible_sessions'} s
      LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id
      LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id
      WHERE s.user_id = ?
    `;
    const pointsParams: any[] = [userId];

    if (isFilteredActivity) {
      pointsQuery += ` AND a.activity_type = ?`;
      pointsParams.push(activityType);
    }
    if (dateFrom) {
      pointsQuery += ` AND s.start_time >= ?`;
      pointsParams.push(dateFrom);
    }
    if (dateTo) {
      pointsQuery += ` AND s.start_time <= ?`;
      pointsParams.push(dateTo);
    }
    pointsQuery += ` ORDER BY s.start_time ASC`;

    const rangeSessions = db.prepare(pointsQuery).all(...pointsParams) as any[];

    // Map range sessions to canonical trend observations
    const observationMap = new Map(allSessions.map(o => [o.id, o]));
    const rangeObservations = await Promise.all(
      rangeSessions.map(async s => {
        if (observationMap.has(s.id)) {
          return observationMap.get(s.id)!;
        }
        try {
          return await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservation(s.id);
        } catch {
          return {
            id: s.id,
            session_id: s.id,
            start_time: s.start_time,
            end_time: s.end_time || null,
            duration_seconds: s.duration_seconds || null,
            evidence_mode: 'legacy_unverified' as const,
            rmssd: s.rmssd ?? null,
            sdnn: s.sdnn ?? null,
            pnn50: s.pnn50 ?? null,
            avg_hr: s.avg_hr ?? null,
            mean_rr: null,
            rmssd_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            sdnn_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            pnn50_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            mean_hr_eligibility: 'INCONCLUSIVE' as const,
            baseline_included_rmssd: false,
            baseline_included_sdnn: false,
            baseline_included_pnn50: false,
            baseline_included_mean_hr: false,
            overall_quality_score: s.overall_quality_score ?? null,
            legacy_technical_quality_rollup_non_authoritative: s.overall_quality_score ?? null,
            hrv_source: s.hrv_source || 'legacy',
            hrv_quality: s.hrv_quality || 'unsupported',
            recovery_1min: s.recovery_1min ?? null,
            recovery_2min: s.recovery_2min ?? null,
            hr_drift_ratio: s.hr_drift_ratio ?? null,
            time_in_zones: s.time_in_zones ?? null,
            activity_type: s.activity_type ?? null
          };
        }
      })
    );

    // Calculate quality summary (legacy technical rollup)
    const qualityScores = rangeSessions.map(s => s.overall_quality_score).filter(v => v !== null) as number[];
    const avgQuality = qualityScores.length > 0 ? Math.round((qualityScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / qualityScores.length) * 10) / 10 : null;
    const qualityLimitedCount = rangeObservations.filter(o => o.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' || o.rmssd_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS').length;
    const insufficientCount = rangeObservations.filter(o => o.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data' || o.rmssd_eligibility === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || o.evidence_mode === 'legacy_unverified').length;

    // Calculate hidden sessions excluded count
    let hiddenCount = 0;
    if (!includeHidden) {
      let hiddenQuery = `
        SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
        FROM sessions s
        JOIN ignored_sessions i ON s.id = i.session_id
        LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id
        WHERE s.user_id = ?
      `;
      const hiddenParams: any[] = [userId];
      if (isFilteredActivity) {
        hiddenQuery += ` AND a.activity_type = ?`;
        hiddenParams.push(activityType);
      }
      if (dateFrom) {
        hiddenQuery += ` AND s.start_time >= ?`;
        hiddenParams.push(dateFrom);
      }
      if (dateTo) {
        hiddenQuery += ` AND s.start_time <= ?`;
        hiddenParams.push(dateTo);
      }
      const res = db.prepare(hiddenQuery).get(...hiddenParams) as any;
      hiddenCount = res?.count ?? 0;
    }

    // Map time-series points helper using canonical observations and baseline bands
    const mapPoints = (key: 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'avg_hr', bandInfo: any) => {
      let includedCount = 0;
      let excludedCount = 0;
      const reasonsMap: Record<string, number> = {};

      const points = rangeObservations.map(obs => {
        const rawValue = obs[key];
        const elig = (obs as any)[`${key}_eligibility`] as string | undefined;
        const isIncluded = Boolean((obs as any)[`baseline_included_${key}`]);
        const exclReason = (obs as any)[`exclusion_reason_${key}`] as string | undefined;

        if (isIncluded) {
          includedCount++;
        } else {
          excludedCount++;
          const reasonKey = exclReason || (obs.evidence_mode === 'legacy_unverified' ? 'Архивный формат без исходников' : 'Ограниченное качество');
          reasonsMap[reasonKey] = (reasonsMap[reasonKey] || 0) + 1;
        }

        let status: any = 'reference_only';
        let delta_vs_baseline: number | null = null;
        let finalVal: number | null = rawValue;

        if (obs.evidence_mode === 'legacy_unverified' || !bandInfo.available) {
          status = 'reference_only';
        } else if (elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined) {
          status = 'insufficient_data';
          finalVal = null; // Do NOT plot NOT_ELIGIBLE points as valid analytical points
        } else {
          if (bandInfo.median !== null) {
            delta_vs_baseline = Math.round((rawValue - bandInfo.median) * 10) / 10;
            if (bandInfo.p75 !== null && rawValue > bandInfo.p75) {
              status = 'above_baseline';
            } else if (bandInfo.p25 !== null && rawValue < bandInfo.p25) {
              status = 'below_baseline';
            } else {
              status = 'within_baseline';
            }
          } else {
            status = 'reference_only';
          }
        }

        return {
          session_id: obs.id,
          start_time: obs.start_time,
          end_time: obs.end_time,
          value: finalVal,
          eligibility_state: elig || 'INCONCLUSIVE',
          evidence_mode: obs.evidence_mode,
          baseline_included: isIncluded,
          baseline_exclusion_reason: exclReason,
          quality_score: obs.overall_quality_score,
          legacy_technical_quality_rollup_non_authoritative: obs.legacy_technical_quality_rollup_non_authoritative,
          hrv_quality: obs.hrv_quality,
          activity_type: obs.activity_type || 'unknown',
          delta_vs_baseline,
          status
        };
      });

      return {
        points,
        included_count: includedCount,
        excluded_count: excludedCount,
        exclusion_reasons: reasonsMap
      };
    };

    const rmssdMapped = mapPoints('rmssd', baseline.rmssd_ms);
    const sdnnMapped = mapPoints('sdnn', baseline.sdnn_ms);
    const pnn50Mapped = mapPoints('pnn50', baseline.pnn50_percent);
    const avgHrMapped = mapPoints('avg_hr', baseline.avg_hr_bpm);

    const metricsSeries = [
      {
        metric_key: 'rmssd_ms',
        label: 'RMSSD',
        unit: 'ms',
        points: rmssdMapped.points,
        included_count: rmssdMapped.included_count,
        excluded_count: rmssdMapped.excluded_count,
        exclusion_reasons: rmssdMapped.exclusion_reasons
      },
      {
        metric_key: 'sdnn_ms',
        label: 'SDNN',
        unit: 'ms',
        points: sdnnMapped.points,
        included_count: sdnnMapped.included_count,
        excluded_count: sdnnMapped.excluded_count,
        exclusion_reasons: sdnnMapped.exclusion_reasons
      },
      {
        metric_key: 'pnn50_percent',
        label: 'pNN50',
        unit: '%',
        points: pnn50Mapped.points,
        included_count: pnn50Mapped.included_count,
        excluded_count: pnn50Mapped.excluded_count,
        exclusion_reasons: pnn50Mapped.exclusion_reasons
      },
      {
        metric_key: 'avg_hr_bpm',
        label: 'Средняя ЧСС',
        unit: 'уд/мин',
        points: avgHrMapped.points,
        included_count: avgHrMapped.included_count,
        excluded_count: avgHrMapped.excluded_count,
        exclusion_reasons: avgHrMapped.exclusion_reasons
      }
    ];

    const cohortKey = `${userId}::${activityType || 'unspecified'}`;
    const acceptedCount = interpreterResult.baseline_qualification_breakdown?.accepted_baseline_sessions_count || 0;
    const requiredCount = interpreterResult.sessions_required || 5;
    const isFormed = acceptedCount >= requiredCount;

    const activeCohort = {
      cohort_key: cohortKey,
      user_id: userId,
      activity_type: activityType || 'all',
      accepted_count: acceptedCount,
      required_count: requiredCount,
      excluded_count: interpreterResult.quality_limited_excluded_count || 0,
      is_formed: isFormed,
      baseline_source: interpreterResult.baseline_source,
      baseline_confidence: interpreterResult.baseline_confidence
    };

    const responsePayload = {
      period: {
        start: dateFrom || (rangeObservations.length > 0 ? rangeObservations[0].start_time : ''),
        end: dateTo || (rangeObservations.length > 0 ? rangeObservations[rangeObservations.length - 1].start_time : ''),
        window: window || 'custom'
      },
      user_id: userId,
      activity_type: activityType || null,
      active_cohort: activeCohort,
      sessions_count: rangeObservations.length,
      hidden_sessions_excluded: hiddenCount,
      quality_summary: {
        average_quality_score: avgQuality,
        quality_limited_count: qualityLimitedCount,
        insufficient_count: insufficientCount,
        is_legacy_rollup_non_authoritative: true
      },
      baseline,
      baseline_source: interpreterResult.baseline_source,
      baseline_confidence: interpreterResult.baseline_confidence,
      personal_baseline_available: interpreterResult.personal_baseline_available,
      rmssd_baseline_available: baseline.rmssd_ms.available,
      sdnn_baseline_available: baseline.sdnn_ms.available,
      pnn50_baseline_available: baseline.pnn50_percent.available,
      avg_hr_baseline_available: baseline.avg_hr_bpm.available,
      sessions_required: interpreterResult.sessions_required,
      sessions_used: interpreterResult.sessions_used,
      quality_limited_excluded_count: interpreterResult.quality_limited_excluded_count,
      baseline_qualification_breakdown: interpreterResult.baseline_qualification_breakdown,
      metrics: metricsSeries,
      interpretation_cards: interpreterResult.interpretation_cards,
      summary_metrics: interpreterResult.summary_metrics,
      text_summary: interpreterResult.text_summary,
      range_sessions: rangeObservations.map(o => ({
        id: o.id,
        start_time: o.start_time,
        end_time: o.end_time,
        duration_seconds: o.duration_seconds || 0,
        activity_type: o.activity_type || 'unknown',
        evidence_mode: o.evidence_mode,
        rmssd: o.rmssd,
        sdnn: o.sdnn,
        pnn50: o.pnn50,
        avg_hr: o.avg_hr,
        rmssd_eligibility: o.rmssd_eligibility,
        hrv_quality: o.hrv_quality
      })),
      recompute_status: HistoricalSessionRecomputeService.getStatus()
    };

    // Auto-trigger background recompute if there are legacy unverified sessions needing canonical recomputation
    const recomputeStatus = HistoricalSessionRecomputeService.getStatus();
    if ((interpreterResult.baseline_qualification_breakdown?.legacy_unverified_count ?? 0) > 0 && !recomputeStatus.is_running) {
      HistoricalSessionRecomputeService.startBackgroundRecompute();
    }

    res.json(responsePayload);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id/baseline-explanation', async (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const obs = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservation(id);
    const isRmssdIncluded = obs.baseline_included_rmssd;
    const isSdnnIncluded = obs.baseline_included_sdnn;
    const isMeanHrIncluded = obs.baseline_included_mean_hr;

    const reasons: string[] = [];
    if (!isRmssdIncluded && obs.exclusion_reason_rmssd) reasons.push(`RMSSD: ${obs.exclusion_reason_rmssd}`);
    if (!isSdnnIncluded && obs.exclusion_reason_sdnn) reasons.push(`SDNN: ${obs.exclusion_reason_sdnn}`);
    if (!isMeanHrIncluded && obs.exclusion_reason_mean_hr) reasons.push(`ЧСС: ${obs.exclusion_reason_mean_hr}`);

    if (obs.evidence_mode === 'legacy_unverified') {
      reasons.push('Сессия зарегистрирована без исходных физиологических файлов на диске (архивный режим).');
    }

    if (reasons.length === 0) {
      reasons.push('Сессия полностью пригодна для включения в личный baseline.');
    }

    res.json({
      sessionId: id,
      evidence_mode: obs.evidence_mode,
      is_eligible: isRmssdIncluded && isSdnnIncluded,
      eligible: isRmssdIncluded && isSdnnIncluded,
      rmssd_included: isRmssdIncluded,
      sdnn_included: isSdnnIncluded,
      mean_hr_included: isMeanHrIncluded,
      reasons,
      summary_ru: reasons.join(' '),
      explanation_ru: reasons.join(' '),
      explanation_en: reasons.join(' '),
      metric_status: {
        rmssd: { included: isRmssdIncluded, reason: obs.exclusion_reason_rmssd || null },
        sdnn: { included: isSdnnIncluded, reason: obs.exclusion_reason_sdnn || null },
        mean_hr: { included: isMeanHrIncluded, reason: obs.exclusion_reason_mean_hr || null }
      }
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});
