// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reports & Exports
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function getReportContext(sessionId: string) {
  const db = getDb();
  // Fetch session
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as SessionMetadata | undefined;
  if (!session) return null;

  const qcMetrics = getSessionQcMetrics(sessionId);
  const analyticsMetrics = getSessionMetrics(sessionId);
  const flags = getCandidateFlags(sessionId);
  const signalFiles = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
  const rawUser = session.user_id ? getUserProfile(session.user_id) : getUser(DEFAULT_USER_ID);
  
  const user: UserPreferences | null = rawUser ? {
    id: rawUser.id,
    age: rawUser.age ?? 35,
    resting_hr: rawUser.resting_hr ?? 60,
    max_hr: rawUser.max_hr ?? 185,
    custom_zones: rawUser.custom_zones ?? null,
    custom_zones_updated_at: rawUser.custom_zones_updated_at ?? null,
    created_at: rawUser.created_at
  } : null;

  // Query trends baseline context
  const annotation = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as { activity_type: string } | undefined;
  const activityType = annotation?.activity_type;

  const allObservations = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser(session.user_id || 'default', activityType);
  const trends = interpretTrends(allObservations, session.id);
  const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId).catch(() => null);

  return { session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, flags, signalFiles, user, trends, canonicalSession };
}

apiRouter.get('/reports/:id/pdf', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = req.params.id;
  try {
    const customHeader = (req.query['custom_header'] || req.query['customHeader']) as string | undefined;
    if (customHeader) {
      const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
      if (!entState.capabilities.report_custom_header_allowed) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: `Custom report header is not permitted on the '${entState.tier}' tier. Upgrade to Professional tier for custom branding.`,
          code: 'REPORT_CUSTOM_HEADER_NOT_PERMITTED',
          tier: entState.tier
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    logger.info('report', `Starting PDF report generation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
    const notes = req.query['notes'] as string | undefined;
    const ctx = await getReportContext(id);
    if (!ctx) {
      logger.warn('report', `Failed to generate PDF report: Session ${id} not found`, { sessionId: id });
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }
    
    const pdfBuffer = await generateSessionPdf({ ...ctx, notes });
    recordWorkstationEvent('report_action', { sessionId: id, action: 'exported', format: 'pdf', source: 'server_pipeline' });
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename=cardio_report_${id}.pdf`);
    res.send(pdfBuffer);
    logger.info('report', `Completed PDF report generation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('report', `Failed to generate PDF report for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id, details: { error: err.message } });
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/reports/:id/html', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = req.params.id;
  try {
    const customHeader = (req.query['custom_header'] || req.query['customHeader']) as string | undefined;
    if (customHeader) {
      const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
      if (!entState.capabilities.report_custom_header_allowed) {
        res.status(403).json({
          error: `Custom report header is not permitted on the '${entState.tier}' tier. Upgrade to Professional tier for custom branding.`,
          code: 'REPORT_CUSTOM_HEADER_NOT_PERMITTED',
          tier: entState.tier
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    logger.info('report', `Starting HTML report generation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
    const notes = req.query['notes'] as string | undefined;
    const ctx = await getReportContext(id);
    if (!ctx) {
      logger.warn('report', `Failed to generate HTML report: Session ${id} not found`, { sessionId: id });
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }
    
    // Read HR points for chart rendering
    const hrFile = ctx.signalFiles.find(s => s.signal_type === 'HR');
    let hrPoints: Point[] = [];
    if (hrFile) {
      const filePath = resolveSignalPath(hrFile.id, 'hr');
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        const rawPoints = await readHRGz(filePath);
        hrPoints = rawPoints.map(p => [p.timeMs, p.hrBpm]);
      }
    }
    
    const htmlString = generateSessionHtml({ ...ctx, notes }, hrPoints);
    recordWorkstationEvent('report_action', { sessionId: id, action: 'exported', format: 'html', source: 'server_pipeline' });
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename=cardio_report_${id}.html`);
    res.send(htmlString);
    logger.info('report', `Completed HTML report generation for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('report', `Failed to generate HTML report for session ${id}`, { sessionId: id, details: { error: err.message } });
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/diagnostics/events', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { event_type, metadata } = req.body || {};
    if (event_type) {
      if (!ALLOWED_CLIENT_WORKSTATION_EVENTS.has(event_type)) {
        res.status(403).json({ error: `Event type ${event_type} is restricted: authoritative milestones cannot be emitted by client` });
        return;
      }
      const metaCheck = validateClientWorkstationMetadata(metadata || {});
      if (!metaCheck.isValid) {
        res.status(403).json({ error: metaCheck.error });
        return;
      }
      const cleanMeta = { ...(metadata || {}), source: 'client_diagnostics' };
      recordWorkstationEvent(event_type, cleanMeta);
    }
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/reports/:id/provenance-comparison', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = req.params.id;
  try {
    const ctx = await getReportContext(id);
    if (!ctx) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }
    const prov = getSessionProvenance(ctx.analyticsMetrics?.hrv_version);
    const presentation = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
      session: ctx.session,
      canonicalSession: ctx.canonicalSession,
      qcMetrics: ctx.qcMetrics,
      analyticsMetrics: ctx.analyticsMetrics
    });

    const mismatches: string[] = [];
    const comparedSurfaces = [
      { surface: 'canonical_session_api', status: ctx.canonicalSession ? 'checked_match' : 'legacy_fallback' },
      { surface: 'presentation_adapter', status: presentation ? 'checked_match' : 'failed' },
      { surface: 'session_metrics_csv', status: 'not_checked' },
      { surface: 'consultation_bundle', status: 'not_checked' },
      { surface: 'llm_pack', status: 'not_checked' }
    ];

    if (ctx.canonicalSession) {
      if (ctx.canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value !== presentation.core_metrics.rmssd.value) {
        mismatches.push('rmssd_value_mismatch');
      }
      if (ctx.canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value !== presentation.core_metrics.sdnn.value) {
        mismatches.push('sdnn_value_mismatch');
      }
      if (ctx.canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value !== presentation.core_metrics.pnn50.value) {
        mismatches.push('pnn50_value_mismatch');
      }
      if (ctx.canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value !== presentation.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value) {
        mismatches.push('mean_hr_value_mismatch');
      }
      if (ctx.canonicalSession.provenance.protocol_version !== '1.1.0') {
        mismatches.push('protocol_version_mismatch');
      }
    } else {
      mismatches.push('canonical_session_absent_legacy_mode');
    }

    const hasUncheckedSurfaces = comparedSurfaces.some(s => s.status === 'not_checked');
    // allOutputsAgree = mismatches.length === 0 (null when unchecked surfaces exist)
    const allOutputsAgree = hasUncheckedSurfaces ? null : (mismatches.length === 0);

    const provenance_comparison = {
      session_id: id,
      provenance_status: prov.provenance_status,
      evidence_mode: ctx.canonicalSession ? 'canonical' : 'legacy_unverified',
      build_provenance: {
        app_version: APP_VERSION,
        build_version: BUILD_VERSION,
        electron_version: process.versions.electron || 'unknown',
        node_version: process.versions.node,
        release_channel: RELEASE_CHANNEL
      },
      stored_session_provenance: {
        methodology_version: ctx.canonicalSession ? ctx.canonicalSession.provenance.method_version : prov.methodology_version,
        algorithm_version: ctx.canonicalSession ? ctx.canonicalSession.provenance.protocol_version : prov.algorithm_version,
        qc_version: prov.qc_version,
        hrv_source: ctx.canonicalSession ? 'CanonicalBeatLedger' : prov.hrv_source,
        metric_source: ctx.canonicalSession ? 'CanonicalSessionResult' : prov.metric_source
      },
      output_schema_provenance: {
        report_schema_version: prov.report_schema_version,
        session_metrics_csv_schema_version: prov.session_metrics_csv_schema_version,
        rr_csv_schema_version: prov.rr_csv_schema_version,
        consultation_bundle_schema_version: prov.consultation_bundle_schema_version,
        llm_pack_schema_version: prov.llm_pack_schema_version,
        snapshot_schema_version: prov.snapshot_schema_version
      },
      compared_surfaces: comparedSurfaces,
      mismatches: mismatches,
      all_outputs_agree: allOutputsAgree,
      verification_status: hasUncheckedSurfaces ? 'not_fully_checked' : (mismatches.length === 0 ? 'verified_agree' : 'mismatch_detected'),
      all_surfaces_fully_checked: !hasUncheckedSurfaces
    };
    
    res.json(provenance_comparison);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/reports/:id/bundle.zip', async (req: ReqParam<{id:string}>, res: Response) => {
  const id = req.params.id;
  try {
    const notes = req.query['notes'] as string | undefined;
    const includeRaw = req.query['include_raw'] === 'true';
    const ctx = await getReportContext(id);
    if (!ctx) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Сессия не найдена' });
      return;
    }
    const zipStream = await generateConsultationBundleZip({ ...ctx, notes, includeRaw });
    recordWorkstationEvent('report_action', { sessionId: id, action: 'exported', format: 'bundle_zip', source: 'server_pipeline' });
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename=bundle_${id}.zip`);
    zipStream.pipe(res);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/users', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();

    // Check revision precondition if supplied by client
    const expRev = req.body?.expected_revision !== undefined
      ? Number(req.body.expected_revision)
      : (req.body?.expectedRevision !== undefined ? Number(req.body.expectedRevision) : undefined);
    if (expRev !== undefined && entState.active_revision !== undefined && entState.active_revision !== expRev) {
      res.status(412).json({
        error: `Precondition failed: Stale entitlement revision. Expected ${expRev}, current is ${entState.active_revision}`,
        code: 'STALE_ENTITLEMENT_REVISION',
        current_revision: entState.active_revision
      });
      return;
    }

    const existingUsers = getUserProfiles();
    if (isProfileLimitReached(entState, existingUsers.length)) {
      res.status(403).json({
        error: `Profile limit reached for tier '${entState.tier}'. Maximum allowed profiles: ${entState.capabilities.max_profiles}`,
        code: 'PROFILE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
        tier: entState.tier,
        max_profiles: entState.capabilities.max_profiles
      });
      return;
    }

    const { id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, custom_zones } = req.body;
    if (!id || !display_name || !export_alias) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'id, display_name, и export_alias обязательны' });
      return;
    }

    const parsedAge = age !== undefined && age !== null ? parseInt(age, 10) : null;
    const parsedResting = resting_hr !== undefined && resting_hr !== null ? parseInt(resting_hr, 10) : null;
    const parsedMax = max_hr !== undefined && max_hr !== null ? parseInt(max_hr, 10) : null;

    if (parsedAge !== null && (!Number.isFinite(parsedAge) || parsedAge <= 0 || parsedAge > 120)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный возраст: должен быть от 1 до 120' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedResting !== null && (!Number.isFinite(parsedResting) || parsedResting < 30 || parsedResting > 220)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный пульс покоя: должен быть от 30 до 220' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedMax !== null && (!Number.isFinite(parsedMax) || parsedMax < 60 || parsedMax > 250)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный максимальный пульс: должен быть от 60 до 250' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedResting !== null && parsedMax !== null && parsedResting >= parsedMax) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Пульс покоя должен быть строго меньше максимального пульса' });
      return;
    }
    
    let customZonesStr: string | null = null;
    let customZonesUpdatedAt: string | null = null;
    if (custom_zones) {
      const parsedObj = typeof custom_zones === 'string' ? JSON.parse(custom_zones) : custom_zones;
      const validation = validateCustomHeartRateZones(parsedObj);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error || 'Неверный формат зон ЧСС' });
        return;
      }
      customZonesUpdatedAt = parsedObj.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
      if (!parsedObj.updatedAt) {
        parsedObj.updatedAt = customZonesUpdatedAt;
      }
      customZonesStr = JSON.stringify(parsedObj);
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newUser: UserProfile = {
      id,
      display_name,
      export_alias,
      relationship_label: relationship_label || null,
      age: parsedAge,
      resting_hr: parsedResting,
      max_hr: parsedMax,
      custom_zones: customZonesStr,
      custom_zones_updated_at: customZonesUpdatedAt,
      is_active: 1,
      created_at: now,
      updated_at: now
    };
    saveUserProfile(newUser);
    
    const responseUser = {
      ...newUser,
      custom_zones: newUser.custom_zones ? JSON.parse(newUser.custom_zones) : null
    };
    res.status(201).json(responseUser);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.put('/users/:id', async (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = req.params.id;
    const user = getUserProfile(id);
    if (!user) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Пользователь не найден' });
      return;
    }
    const { display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, custom_zones } = req.body;

    const parsedAge = age !== undefined ? (age !== null ? parseInt(age, 10) : null) : user.age;
    const parsedResting = resting_hr !== undefined ? (resting_hr !== null ? parseInt(resting_hr, 10) : null) : user.resting_hr;
    const parsedMax = max_hr !== undefined ? (max_hr !== null ? parseInt(max_hr, 10) : null) : user.max_hr;

    if (parsedAge !== null && parsedAge !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(parsedAge) || parsedAge <= 0 || parsedAge > 120)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный возраст: должен быть от 1 до 120' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedResting !== null && parsedResting !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(parsedResting) || parsedResting < 30 || parsedResting > 220)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный пульс покоя: должен быть от 30 до 220' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedMax !== null && parsedMax !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(parsedMax) || parsedMax < 60 || parsedMax > 250)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Некорректный максимальный пульс: должен быть от 60 до 250' });
      return;
    }
    if (parsedResting !== null && parsedResting !== undefined && parsedMax !== null && parsedMax !== undefined && parsedResting >= parsedMax) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Пульс покоя должен быть строго меньше максимального пульса' });
      return;
    }
    
    let customZonesStr: string | null = user.custom_zones ?? null;
    let customZonesUpdatedAt: string | null = user.custom_zones_updated_at ?? null;
    if (custom_zones !== undefined) {
      if (custom_zones === null) {
        customZonesStr = null;
        customZonesUpdatedAt = null;
      } else {
        const parsedObj = typeof custom_zones === 'string' ? JSON.parse(custom_zones) : custom_zones;
        const validation = validateCustomHeartRateZones(parsedObj);
        if (!validation.isValid) {
          res.status(400).json({ error: validation.error || 'Неверный формат зон ЧСС' });
          return;
        }
        customZonesUpdatedAt = parsedObj.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
        if (!parsedObj.updatedAt) {
          parsedObj.updatedAt = customZonesUpdatedAt;
        }
        customZonesStr = JSON.stringify(parsedObj);
      }
    }

    const updatedUser: UserProfile = {
      ...user,
      display_name: display_name !== undefined ? display_name : user.display_name,
      export_alias: export_alias !== undefined ? export_alias : user.export_alias,
      relationship_label: relationship_label !== undefined ? relationship_label : user.relationship_label,
      age: parsedAge,
      resting_hr: parsedResting,
      max_hr: parsedMax,
      custom_zones: customZonesStr,
      custom_zones_updated_at: customZonesUpdatedAt,
      is_active: is_active !== undefined ? parseInt(is_active, 10) : user.is_active,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveUserProfile(updatedUser);

    // Recalculate sessions for this user to avoid stale zone metrics
    const db = getDb();
    const sessions = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?').all(id) as { id: string }[];
    for (const s of sessions) {
      await runQcForSession(s.id, { forceRecomputeZones: true });
    }
    
    const responseUser = {
      ...updatedUser,
      custom_zones: updatedUser.custom_zones ? JSON.parse(updatedUser.custom_zones) : null
    };
    res.json(responseUser);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.delete('/users/:id', async (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const id = req.params.id;
    if (id === 'default' || id === '1') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Нельзя удалить пользователя по умолчанию' });
      return;
    }
    const disposition = (req.query.disposition as any) || (req.body?.disposition) || 'detach_as_unassigned';
    const targetProfileId = (req.query.target_profile_id as string) || (req.body?.target_profile_id);
    await ProfileLifecycleService.getInstance().deleteProfile(id, disposition, targetProfileId);
    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/llm-pack/preflight', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const { sessionId, exportProfile } = req.body;
  try {
    logger.info('llm_pack', 'Starting LLM Pack size budget preflight check', { sessionId });
    const { userId, privacyLevel, includeNotes, ecgStripsMode, selectedPrompt, excludeEcgCsv, limitEcgStrips, eventExportMode } = req.body;
    if (!sessionId || !exportProfile) {
      logger.warn('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack preflight rejected: missing parameters');
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required parameters for LLM Pack preflight' });
      return;
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      logger.warn('llm_pack', `LLM Pack preflight failed: Session ${sessionId} not found`, { sessionId });
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Session ${sessionId} not found` });
      return;
    }

    const flags = getCandidateFlags(sessionId);
    const signalFiles = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
    const hasEcg = signalFiles.some(f => f.signal_type === 'ECG');

    const mappedTypes = flags.map(f => {
      let type = f.flag_type;
      if (type === 'RR outlier') type = 'candidate_rr_outlier';
      if (type === 'Actual missing data') type = 'data_gap';
      if (type === 'ECG high-frequency noise') type = 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
      if (type === 'Baseline drift') type = 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
      if (type === 'Motion artifact') type = 'motion_artifact';
      if (type === 'Timestamp/sync issue') type = 'sync_issue';
      return type;
    });
    const uniqueEventTypesCount = new Set(mappedTypes).size;

    const baselineSessions = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM visible_sessions WHERE user_id = ?').get(userId || 'default') as any;
    const numSessions = baselineSessions?.count || 0;

    const est = estimatePreflight({
      exportProfile: exportProfile as ExportProfile,
      eventExportMode: eventExportMode as any,
      durationSeconds: session.duration_seconds,
      flagsCount: flags.length,
      uniqueEventTypesCount,
      numSessions,
      ecgStripsMode: ecgStripsMode as any,
      excludeEcgCsv: !!excludeEcgCsv,
      limitEcgStrips: limitEcgStrips !== undefined ? Number(limitEcgStrips) : undefined,
      selectedPrompt,
      flags
    });

    const budget = BUDGETS[exportProfile as ExportProfile];
    if (!budget) {
      logger.warn('llm_pack', `LLM Pack preflight failed: Unknown export profile ${exportProfile}`);
      res.status(400).json({ error: `Unknown export profile: ${exportProfile}` });
      return;
    }

    const maxEntries = budget.maxEntries;
    const maxTextCharsTotal = budget.maxTextCharsTotal;
    const maxSingleFileChars = budget.maxSingleFileChars || 0;

    const hasRawEvents = exportProfile === 'antigravity_local_debug' || eventExportMode === 'debug';

    const actionableFixes: string[] = [];
    if (
      est.estimatedEntriesCount > maxEntries || 
      est.estimatedTextCharsTotal > maxTextCharsTotal || 
      (maxSingleFileChars > 0 && est.estimatedSingleFileChars && est.estimatedSingleFileChars > maxSingleFileChars)
    ) {
      actionableFixes.push('auto_fit');
      if (eventExportMode !== 'summary') {
        actionableFixes.push('events_summary_only');
      }
      if (est.breakdown!.ecgStripCsv > 0) {
        actionableFixes.push('remove_ecg_csv');
      }
      if (est.estimatedEcgStripsCount > 1) {
        actionableFixes.push('one_ecg_strip');
      }
      if (exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full') {
        actionableFixes.push('switch_gemini_compact');
      }
    }

    res.json({
      profile: exportProfile,
      maxEntries,
      estimatedEntries: est.estimatedEntriesCount,
      estimatedZipBytes: est.plan!.estimated_zip_bytes, // unified ZIP size estimate
      maxTextCharsTotal,
      estimatedTextCharsTotal: est.estimatedTextCharsTotal,
      maxSingleFileChars: maxSingleFileChars || null,
      estimatedSingleFileChars: est.estimatedSingleFileChars || null,
      hasRawEvents,
      breakdown: est.breakdown!,
      charBreakdown: est.charBreakdown!,
      plannedFiles: est.plannedFiles!,
      actionableFixes,
      plan: est.plan! // return plan
    });
    logger.info('llm_pack', 'Completed LLM Pack size budget preflight check successfully', { sessionId });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack preflight check failed', { sessionId, details: { error: err.message } });
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Error executing LLM preflight' });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/llm-pack/preview', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const {
    sessionId,
    exportProfile,
    userId,
    privacyLevel,
    includeNotes,
    ecgStripsMode,
    selectedPrompt,
    userGoal,
    rawSeriesOptIn,
    signalExcerptOptIn,
    excludeEcgCsv,
    limitEcgStrips,
    eventExportMode,
    windowId,
    window_id,
    windowRevision,
    window_revision,
    comparisonId,
    comparison_id
  } = req.body;
  try {
    if (!sessionId || !userId || !exportProfile || !privacyLevel) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required parameters for LLM Pack preview' });
      return;
    }
    const preview = await createLlmPackPreview({
      sessionId,
      userId,
      exportProfile,
      privacyLevel,
      includeNotes: !!includeNotes,
      ecgStripsMode: ecgStripsMode || 'none',
      selectedPrompt,
      userGoal,
      rawSeriesOptIn: !!rawSeriesOptIn,
      signalExcerptOptIn: !!signalExcerptOptIn,
      excludeEcgCsv: !!excludeEcgCsv,
      limitEcgStrips: limitEcgStrips !== undefined ? Number(limitEcgStrips) : undefined,
      eventExportMode,
      windowId: windowId || window_id,
      windowRevision: (windowRevision !== undefined && windowRevision !== null) ? Number(windowRevision) : (window_revision !== undefined && window_revision !== null ? Number(window_revision) : undefined),
      comparisonId: comparisonId || comparison_id
    });
    res.json(preview);
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack preview failed', { sessionId, details: { error: err.message } });
    const status = err.statusCode || 500;
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message || 'Error creating LLM pack preview', errorCode: err.errorCode });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/llm-pack/preview/:previewId/file/:fileName', (req: ReqParam<{previewId: string; fileName: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { previewId, fileName } = req.params;
    if (!fileName || fileName.includes('..') || fileName.includes('/') || fileName.includes('\\')) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Path traversal rejected', errorCode: 'PATH_TRAVERSAL_REJECTED' });
      return;
    }
    const userId = (req.query.userId || req.query.user_id) as string | undefined;
    const sessionId = (req.query.sessionId || req.query.session_id) as string | undefined;
    const content = getPreviewFileContent(previewId, fileName, { userId, sessionId });
    if (content === null) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `File "${fileName}" not found in preview "${previewId}" or preview expired` });
      return;
    }
    res.type('text/plain; charset=utf-8').send(content);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.statusCode || (err.message?.includes('Forbidden') ? 403 : 500);
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message, errorCode: err.errorCode });
  }
});

  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/llm-pack/export', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
  if (!entState.capabilities.ai_pack_export_allowed) {
    res.status(403).json({
      error: `AI Pack export is not permitted on the '${entState.tier}' tier. Upgrade to Personal or Professional tier.`,
      code: 'AI_PACK_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED',
      tier: entState.tier
    });
    return;
  }

  const {
    sessionId,
    exportProfile,
    previewId,
    rawSeriesOptIn,
    signalExcerptOptIn,
    userGoal,
    expectedFingerprint,
    expected_fingerprint,
    windowId,
    window_id,
    windowRevision,
    window_revision,
    comparisonId,
    comparison_id
  } = req.body;
  try {
    logger.info('llm_pack', 'Starting LLM Pack compilation and export', { sessionId, details: { previewId } });
    const { userId, privacyLevel, includeNotes, ecgStripsMode, selectedPrompt, excludeEcgCsv, limitEcgStrips, eventExportMode } = req.body;
    if (!sessionId || !userId || !exportProfile || !privacyLevel || includeNotes === undefined || !ecgStripsMode || !previewId) {
      logger.warn('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack export rejected: missing parameters');
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required parameters for LLM Pack export (sessionId, userId, exportProfile, privacyLevel, includeNotes, ecgStripsMode, previewId)' });
      return;
    }
    const result = await compileLlmPack({
      sessionId,
      userId,
      exportProfile,
      privacyLevel,
      includeNotes,
      ecgStripsMode,
      selectedPrompt,
      userGoal,
      rawSeriesOptIn: !!rawSeriesOptIn,
      signalExcerptOptIn: !!signalExcerptOptIn,
      excludeEcgCsv,
      limitEcgStrips,
      eventExportMode,
      previewId,
      expectedFingerprint: expectedFingerprint || expected_fingerprint,
      windowId: windowId || window_id,
      windowRevision: (windowRevision !== undefined && windowRevision !== null) ? Number(windowRevision) : (window_revision !== undefined && window_revision !== null ? Number(window_revision) : undefined),
      comparisonId: comparisonId || comparison_id
    });
    recordWorkstationEvent('ai_pack_action', { sessionId, action: 'exported', packId: result.packId, source: 'server_pipeline' });
    res.json(result);
    logger.info('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack exported successfully', { sessionId, details: { packId: result.packId } });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('llm_pack', 'LLM Pack export failed', { sessionId, details: { error: err.message } });
    const status = err.statusCode || 500;
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message || 'Error compiling LLM pack', errorCode: err.errorCode });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/methodology-pack/download/:filename', (req: ReqParam<{filename: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const filename = req.params.filename;
    if (filename.includes('/') || filename.includes('\\') || filename.includes('..')) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: Path traversal detected' });
      return;
    }
    const resolvedPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.artifacts/methodology', filename);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Methodology Pack file not found' });
      return;
    }
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
    res.sendFile(resolvedPath);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/llm-pack/:packId/download', (req: ReqParam<{packId: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const pack = getLlmPack(req.params.packId);
    if (!pack) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'LLM Pack not found' });
      return;
    }

    const exportDir = path.resolve(getAppDataDir(), 'llm_exports');
    const resolvedPath = path.resolve(pack.filepath);

    if (!resolvedPath.startsWith(exportDir)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: Path traversal detected' });
      return;
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'File not found on disk' });
      return;
    }

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${pack.filename}"`);
    res.sendFile(resolvedPath);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/llm-pack/:packId/prompt/:promptName', (req: ReqParam<{packId: string, promptName: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const pack = getLlmPack(req.params.packId);
    if (!pack) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'LLM Pack not found' });
      return;
    }
    const promptName = req.params.promptName;
    let content = '';
    if (pack.metadata_json) {
      try {
        const meta = JSON.parse(pack.metadata_json);
        if (meta.prompt_bytes || meta.frozen_prompt_bytes) {
          content = meta.prompt_bytes || meta.frozen_prompt_bytes;
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (!content) {
      content = getPromptContent(promptName);
    }
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/markdown');
    res.send(content);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/llm-responses/import', express.json({ limit: '5mb' }), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const {
      userId,
      sessionId,
      packId,
      provider,
      model,
      modelLabel,
      promptName,
      promptProfile,
      content,
      sourceType,
      sourceFilename,
      sourceExt,
      windowId,
      window_id,
      windowRevision,
      window_revision,
      comparisonId,
      comparison_id,
      promptBytesHash,
      prompt_bytes_hash,
      artifactState,
      artifact_state,
      requestFingerprint,
      request_fingerprint
    } = req.body;

    if (!userId || !provider || !content || !sourceType) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Не указаны обязательные поля: userId, provider, content, sourceType' });
      return;
    }

    // Validate user profile exists
    const user = getUserProfile(userId);
    if (!user) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Профиль пользователя не найден' });
      return;
    }

    // Provider-neutral normalization (allows any valid provider: chatgpt, gemini, claude, local, etc.)
    const normalizedProvider = typeof provider === 'string' && provider.trim() ? provider.trim().toLowerCase() : 'other';
    const effectiveModelLabel = (model || modelLabel || '').trim() || null;

    // Validate size limit (<= 2 MB after UTF-8 decoding)
    const byteSize = Buffer.byteLength(content, 'utf8');
    if (byteSize > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Размер содержимого превышает лимит 2 МБ' });
      return;
    }

    // Validate source type and extensions
    if (sourceType === 'file') {
      if (sourceExt !== '.md' && sourceExt !== '.txt') {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Разрешены только файлы с расширением .md или .txt' });
        return;
      }
    } else if (sourceType !== 'pasted_text') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Неверный тип источника. Разрешены: file, pasted_text' });
      return;
    }

    // Sanitize markdown and extract plain text
    const sanitized = sanitizeMarkdown(content);
    const plainText = extractPlainText(sanitized);
    const contentHash = computeSha256(sanitized);

    // Check for duplicate hash for the same user
    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM llm_diary WHERE user_id = ? AND content_hash_sha256 = ?').get(userId, contentHash) as { id: string } | undefined;
    if (existing) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: 'Этот файл или текст уже был импортирован для данного пользователя' });
      return;
    }

    // Validate pack linkage if packId is provided (Section 19)
    let packSnapshotJson: string | null = null;
    let effectiveSessionId = sessionId || null;
    let derivedPromptName = promptName || null;
    let derivedPromptProfile = promptProfile || null;
    let derivedProvider = normalizedProvider as LlmProvider;
    let effectivePromptBytesHash = promptBytesHash || prompt_bytes_hash || null;
    let effectiveRequestFingerprint = requestFingerprint || request_fingerprint || null;
    let effectiveArtifactState: 'current' | 'stale' | 'unknown' | 'missing' | 'corrupt' | 'unlinked' | null = (artifactState || artifact_state) || (packId ? 'current' : (sourceType === 'pasted_text' ? 'unlinked' : 'unknown'));

    if (packId) {
      const pack = getLlmPack(packId);
      if (!pack) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: `LLM Pack с ID "${packId}" не найден` });
        return;
      }
      if (pack.user_id !== userId) {
        res.status(403).json({ error: 'LLM Pack принадлежит другому пользователю' });
        return;
      }
      if (sessionId && sessionId !== pack.session_id) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'ID сессии не совпадает с сессией указанного LLM Pack' });
        return;
      }
      const archiveExists = pack.filepath ? fs.existsSync(pack.filepath) : false;
      if (!archiveExists && !artifactState && !artifact_state) {
        effectiveArtifactState = 'missing';
      }

      if (!effectiveSessionId) {
        effectiveSessionId = pack.session_id;
      }

      let meta: any = {};
      try {
        meta = JSON.parse(pack.metadata_json || '{}');
      } catch {}

      const expectedPromptName = meta.selected_prompt || meta.selected_prompt_name || meta.prompt_name || (meta.plan && meta.plan.selected_prompt) || null;
      if (promptName && expectedPromptName && promptName !== expectedPromptName) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: `Параметр promptName "${promptName}" не соответствует promptName связанного пакета "${expectedPromptName}"` });
        return;
      }

      const expectedPromptProfile = pack.export_profile || meta.export_profile || meta.user_goal || null;
      if (promptProfile && expectedPromptProfile && promptProfile !== expectedPromptProfile) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: `Параметр promptProfile "${promptProfile}" не соответствует профилю экспорта связанного пакета "${expectedPromptProfile}"` });
        return;
      }

      derivedPromptName = expectedPromptName || promptName || null;
      derivedPromptProfile = expectedPromptProfile || promptProfile || null;

      if (!effectivePromptBytesHash && meta.prompt_sha256) {
        effectivePromptBytesHash = meta.prompt_sha256;
      }
      if (!effectiveRequestFingerprint && meta.request_fingerprint) {
        effectiveRequestFingerprint = meta.request_fingerprint;
      }

      const snapshot = {
        pack_id: pack.id,
        session_id: pack.session_id,
        user_id: pack.user_id,
        export_profile: pack.export_profile,
        provider_family: meta.provider_family || null,
        filename: pack.filename,
        size_bytes: pack.size_bytes,
        created_at: pack.created_at,
        canonical_result_identity: meta.canonical_result_identity || null,
        canonical_semantic_hash: meta.canonical_semantic_hash || null,
        preview_id: meta.preview_id || null,
        user_goal: meta.user_goal || null,
        prompt_name: derivedPromptName,
        privacy_level: meta.privacy_level || null,
        archive_exists: archiveExists
      };
      packSnapshotJson = JSON.stringify(snapshot);
    }

    const effectiveWindowId = windowId || window_id || null;
    const effectiveWindowRevision = (windowRevision !== undefined && windowRevision !== null) 
      ? Number(windowRevision) 
      : (window_revision !== undefined && window_revision !== null ? Number(window_revision) : null);
    const effectiveComparisonId = comparisonId || comparison_id || null;

    // Resolve date ranges and activity type if session is provided
    let dateRangeStart = null;
    let dateRangeEnd = null;
    let activityType = null;
    if (effectiveSessionId) {
      const sess = db.prepare('SELECT start_time, end_time FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(effectiveSessionId) as any;
      if (sess) {
        dateRangeStart = sess.start_time;
        dateRangeEnd = sess.end_time;
      }
      const ann = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(effectiveSessionId) as any;
      if (ann) {
        activityType = ann.activity_type;
      }
    }

    const title = deriveTitle(sanitized);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const finalPromptName = packId ? derivedPromptName : (promptName || null);
    const finalPromptProfile = packId ? derivedPromptProfile : (promptProfile || null);

    const entry: any = {
      id: `diary_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11)}`,
      user_id: userId,
      profile_id: userId,
      session_id: effectiveSessionId,
      pack_id: packId || null,
      date_range_start: dateRangeStart,
      date_range_end: dateRangeEnd,
      activity_type: activityType,
      provider: derivedProvider,
      model_label: effectiveModelLabel,
      prompt_name: finalPromptName,
      prompt_profile: finalPromptProfile,
      title,
      source_type: sourceType,
      source_filename: sourceFilename || null,
      source_ext: sourceExt || null,
      content_hash_sha256: contentHash,
      original_response_md: content,
      response_md: sanitized,
      response_text_plain: plainText,
      created_at: now,
      imported_at: now,
      updated_at: now,
      is_favorite: false,
      tags_json: null,
      pack_snapshot_json: packSnapshotJson,
      window_id: effectiveWindowId,
      window_revision: effectiveWindowRevision,
      comparison_id: effectiveComparisonId,
      prompt_bytes_hash: effectivePromptBytesHash,
      artifact_state: effectiveArtifactState,
      request_fingerprint: effectiveRequestFingerprint,
      lineage_state: effectiveArtifactState,
      is_retired: false,
      optimistic_revision: 1
    };

    saveLlmDiary(entry);

    if (packId) {
      recordProductEvent('response_linked', {
        userId,
        sessionId: effectiveSessionId,
        diaryId: entry.id,
        packId
      });
    }

    res.status(201).json(entry);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Ошибка при импорте дневника ИИ' });
  }
});

async function resolveDiaryDynamicLineage(record: LlmDiaryRecord): Promise<DiaryLineageInfo> {
  if (!record.pack_id) {
    if (record.source_type === 'pasted_text') {
      return {
        state: 'unlinked',
        reason_code: 'unlinked_paste',
        explanation: 'Текст вставлен вручную без привязки к контекстному пакету (Unlinked pasted text)',
        needs_reinterpretation: false,
        recorded_context: null,
        current_context: null
      };
    }
    return {
      state: 'unknown',
      reason_code: 'legacy_unknown',
      explanation: 'Историческая запись без манифеста контекста (Legacy unlinked record)',
      needs_reinterpretation: true,
      recorded_context: null,
      current_context: null
    };
  }

  const pack = getLlmPack(record.pack_id);
  if (!pack) {
    return {
      state: 'artifact_missing',
      reason_code: 'pack_missing',
      explanation: `LLM Pack с ID "${record.pack_id}" не найден в базе данных`,
      needs_reinterpretation: true,
      recorded_context: null,
      current_context: null
    };
  }

  if (pack.filepath && !fs.existsSync(pack.filepath)) {
    return {
      state: 'artifact_missing',
      reason_code: 'pack_missing',
      explanation: 'Файл архива LLM Pack отсутствует на диске',
      needs_reinterpretation: true,
      recorded_context: null,
      current_context: null
    };
  }

  let meta: any = {};
  try {
    meta = JSON.parse(pack.metadata_json || '{}');
  } catch {}

  const recordedContext = meta.analysis_context_snapshot || null;
  const recordedSessionId = record.session_id || pack.session_id;

  if (recordedSessionId) {
    const session = getSession(recordedSessionId);
    if (!session) {
      return {
        state: 'source_unavailable',
        reason_code: 'session_recomputed',
        explanation: 'Связанная сессия недоступна или удалена',
        needs_reinterpretation: true,
        recorded_context: recordedContext,
        current_context: null
      };
    }

    const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(recordedSessionId).catch(() => null);
    const currentCanonicalHash = canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonical?.source_bundle_id || 'unverified';
    const recordedCanonicalHash = recordedContext?.canonical_result_identity || meta.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || meta.canonical_semantic_hash || null;

    if (recordedCanonicalHash && currentCanonicalHash !== recordedCanonicalHash) {
      return {
        state: 'source_changed',
        reason_code: 'session_recomputed',
        explanation: 'Каноническое состояние сессии изменилось после создания пакета (Session recomputed)',
        needs_reinterpretation: true,
        recorded_context: recordedContext,
        current_context: {
          session_id: recordedSessionId,
          canonical_identity: currentCanonicalHash
        }
      };
    }
  }

  if (record.window_id) {
    const activeWindow = await NamedWindowService.getWindowById(record.window_id);
    if (!activeWindow || !activeWindow.isActive) {
      return {
        state: 'historical',
        reason_code: 'window_revised',
        explanation: 'Именованное окно было отозвано или удалено',
        needs_reinterpretation: true,
        recorded_context: recordedContext,
        current_context: {
          window_revision: record.window_revision ?? undefined,
          active_window_revision: activeWindow?.revision
        }
      };
    }

    if (record.window_revision && activeWindow.revision !== record.window_revision) {
      return {
        state: 'historical',
        reason_code: 'window_revised',
        explanation: `Ревизия окна устарела (зафиксирована v${record.window_revision}, текущая v${activeWindow.revision})`,
        needs_reinterpretation: true,
        recorded_context: recordedContext,
        current_context: {
          window_revision: record.window_revision,
          active_window_revision: activeWindow.revision
        }
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    state: 'current',
    reason_code: 'active_match',
    explanation: 'Полное соответствие текущему каноническому контексту',
    needs_reinterpretation: false,
    recorded_context: recordedContext,
    current_context: {
      session_id: recordedSessionId,
      window_revision: record.window_revision ?? undefined
    }
  };
}

apiRouter.get('/llm-responses', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const isPaged = req.query.paged === 'true' || req.query.limit !== undefined || req.query.offset !== undefined || req.query.cursor !== undefined;
    if (isPaged) {
      const page = getLlmDiariesPaged({
        profile_id: (req.query.user_id || req.query.profile_id) as string | undefined,
        session_id: req.query.session_id as string | undefined,
        activity_type: req.query.activity_type as string | undefined,
        provider: req.query.provider as string | undefined,
        pack_id: req.query.pack_id as string | undefined,
        date_from: req.query.date_from as string | undefined,
        date_to: req.query.date_to as string | undefined,
        search: req.query.search as string | undefined,
        favorite_only: req.query.favorite_only === 'true',
        include_retired: req.query.include_retired === 'true',
        currentness: req.query.currentness as string | undefined,
        limit: req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined,
        offset: req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined,
        cursor: req.query.cursor as string | undefined
      });
      res.json(page);
      return;
    }

    const filters = {
      userId: req.query.user_id as string | undefined,
      sessionId: req.query.session_id as string | undefined,
      activityType: req.query.activity_type as string | undefined,
      provider: req.query.provider as string | undefined,
      packId: req.query.pack_id as string | undefined,
      dateFrom: req.query.date_from as string | undefined,
      dateTo: req.query.date_to as string | undefined,
      search: req.query.search as string | undefined,
      favoriteOnly: req.query.favorite_only === 'true'
    };
    const records = getLlmDiaries(filters);
    const enriched = await Promise.all(records.map(async (r) => {
      const lineage = await resolveDiaryDynamicLineage(r);
      return {
        ...r,
        lineage_state: lineage.state,
        lineage_info: lineage
      };
    }));
    res.json(enriched);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.put('/llm-responses/:id', (req: ReqParam<{id: string}>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { title, is_favorite, tags, tags_json, expected_revision } = req.body;
    if (expected_revision === undefined || typeof expected_revision !== 'number') {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'expected_revision is required for optimistic concurrency control' });
      return;
    }

    const tagsJsonStr = tags ? JSON.stringify(tags) : tags_json;
    const result = updateLlmDiaryMetadata(req.params.id, {
      title,
      is_favorite,
      tags_json: tagsJsonStr,
      expected_revision
    });

    if (result.conflict) {
      const current = getLlmDiaryById(req.params.id);
      res.status(409).json({
        error: 'Optimistic concurrency conflict: revision mismatch',
        expected_revision,
        current_revision: current?.optimistic_revision || 1
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!result.success) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Запись дневника не найдена' });
      return;
    }

    res.json({ success: true, record: result.record });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/ai-workspace/snapshot', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const profileId = (req.query.profile_id || req.query.userId || req.query.user_id) as string;
    const sessionId = (req.query.session_id || req.query.sessionId) as string;

    const snapshot = await AiWorkspaceService.buildWorkspaceSnapshot(profileId, sessionId, {
      promptLibraryVersion: req.query.prompt_library_version as string | undefined,
      activeWindowId: (req.query.active_window_id || req.query.window_id) as string | undefined,
      activeWindowRevision: req.query.active_window_revision ? parseInt(req.query.active_window_revision as string, 10) : undefined,
      comparisonId: req.query.comparison_id as string | undefined,
      longitudinalSnapshotId: req.query.longitudinal_snapshot_id as string | undefined
    });

    res.json(snapshot);
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof AiWorkspaceValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, name: err.name });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/ai-pack/plan', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { snapshot, prompt_id, prompt_revision, bounded_goal, bounded_notes, opt_ins, locale, timezone, idempotency_key } = req.body;
    if (!snapshot) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Workspace snapshot is required to create a plan' });
      return;
    }
    if (!prompt_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'prompt_id is required' });
      return;
    }
    const plan = await AiWorkspaceService.createPackPlan(snapshot, {
      promptId: prompt_id,
      promptRevision: prompt_revision,
      boundedGoal: bounded_goal || 'session_first_look',
      boundedNotes: bounded_notes,
      optIns: opt_ins,
      locale,
      timezone,
      idempotencyKey: idempotency_key
    });
    res.status(201).json(plan);
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof AiWorkspaceValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

function getFormattedTimestamp(): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const yyyymmdd = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
  const hhmmss = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 8).replace(/:/g, '');
  return `${yyyymmdd}_${hhmmss}`;
}

apiRouter.get(['/api/diagnostics/logs/status', '/diagnostics/log-level'], (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const logPath = getActiveLogFilePath();
    let sizeBytes = 0;
    let lastTs: string | null = null;
    if (fs.existsSync(logPath)) {
      sizeBytes = fs.statSync(logPath).size;
      const content = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').trim();
      if (content) {
        const lines = content.split('\n');
        const lastLine = lines[lines.length - 1];
        if (lastLine) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(lastLine);
            lastTs = parsed.ts || null;
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
    }
    
    const debugMode = getLogLevel() === 'debug';
    const redactedPath = redactPaths(logPath, debugMode);

    res.json({
      current_log_path_redacted: redactedPath,
      current_log_size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      last_log_timestamp: lastTs,
      level: getLogLevel(),
      retention_days: getRetentionDays(),
      max_file_size_mb: getMaxFileSizeMb()
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/api/diagnostics/bundle/export', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    logger.info('diagnostics', 'Starting diagnostic bundle export');
    const timestamp = getFormattedTimestamp();
    const zipName = `diagnostic_bundle_${timestamp}.zip`;
    const tempPath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), zipName);
    
    await createDiagnosticBundle(tempPath);
    
    res.download(tempPath, zipName, (err) => {
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
          fs.unlinkSync(tempPath);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      if (err) {
        logger.error('diagnostics', 'Diagnostic bundle export failed', { details: { error: err.message } });
      } else {
        logger.info('diagnostics', 'Diagnostic bundle export completed successfully');
      }
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('diagnostics', 'Diagnostic bundle export failed', { details: { error: err.message } });
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/database/backup', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { backupPath } = req.body;
    if (!backupPath) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'backupPath is required' });
      return;
    }
    
    const allowedBackupDir = path.resolve(getAppDataDir(), 'backups');
    if (!fs.existsSync(allowedBackupDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(allowedBackupDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const resolvedBackupPath = path.resolve(backupPath);

    // Resolve real paths if they exist on disk to prevent symlink/junction escape
    let realAllowedDir = allowedBackupDir;
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(allowedBackupDir)) {
        realAllowedDir = fs.realpathSync(allowedBackupDir);
      }
    } catch {}

    let realBackupPath = resolvedBackupPath;
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(resolvedBackupPath)) {
        realBackupPath = fs.realpathSync(resolvedBackupPath);
      } else {
        // Resolve dangling symlinks or verify their target path
        let currentPath = resolvedBackupPath;
        let isSym = false;
        try {
          isSym = fs.lstatSync(currentPath).isSymbolicLink();
        } catch {}
        
        if (isSym) {
          let target = fs.readlinkSync(currentPath);
          if (!path.isAbsolute(target)) {
            target = path.resolve(path.dirname(currentPath), target);
          }
          currentPath = target;
        }
        
        const parentDir = path.dirname(currentPath);
        const baseName = path.basename(currentPath);
        const realParent = fs.realpathSync(parentDir);
        realBackupPath = path.join(realParent, baseName);
      }
    } catch {}

    // Ensure the resolved target path is strictly located within the backups directory
    const prefix = realAllowedDir + path.sep;
    if (!realBackupPath.startsWith(prefix)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: Backup path must be inside the backups directory' });
      return;
    }

    if (fs.existsSync(resolvedBackupPath)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Backup destination already exists' });
      return;
    }

    const db = getDb();
    
    db.backup(resolvedBackupPath);

    res.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/workspace/backup/export', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { destinationPath, includeQuarantine } = req.body || {};
    let safeDestination: string | undefined = undefined;
    if (destinationPath && typeof destinationPath === 'string') {
      const resolved = path.resolve(destinationPath);
      if (resolved.includes('\0')) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid destination path' });
        return;
      }
      safeDestination = resolved;
    }

    const result = await workspaceBackupService.createBackup({
      destinationPath: safeDestination,
      includeQuarantine: Boolean(includeQuarantine)
    });

    res.json({
      success: true,
      backupPath: result.backupPath,
      sha256: result.sha256,
      size_bytes: result.size_bytes,
      manifest: result.manifest
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('backup', `Export workspace backup failed: ${err.message}`);
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/entitlements/apply', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOperatorAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({
        error: 'DIRECT_APPLY_NOT_PERMITTED: Direct license key application is disabled on customer path. Use trusted desktop file capability exchange.',
        code: 'DIRECT_APPLY_NOT_PERMITTED',
        status: 403
      });
      return;
    }

    const { licenseKey, licenseeName, expectedRevision, expected_revision, allowTestFixtures } = req.body || {};
    if (!licenseKey) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'licenseKey is required', code: 'LICENSE_KEY_REQUIRED' });
      return;
    }

    const expRev = expectedRevision !== undefined ? Number(expectedRevision) : (expected_revision !== undefined ? Number(expected_revision) : undefined);
    const result = entitlementService.applyLicense(licenseKey, licenseeName, new Date(), {
      expectedRevision: expRev,
      allowTestFixtures: allowTestFixtures === true && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'
    });

    if (result.status === 'stale_revision') {
      res.status(412).json({
        error: result.message,
        code: 'STALE_ENTITLEMENT_REVISION',
        tier: result.tier
      });
      return;
    }

    if (result.status === 'expired') {
      res.status(410).json({
        error: result.message,
        code: 'LICENSE_EXPIRED',
        tier: result.tier
      });
      return;
    }

    if (result.status === 'revoked') {
      res.status(403).json({
        error: result.message,
        code: 'LICENSE_REVOKED',
        tier: result.tier
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!result.success) {
      res.status(422).json({
        error: result.message,
        code: 'LICENSE_VERIFICATION_FAILED',
        tier: result.tier
      });
      return;
    }

    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

function mapCommercialErrorToResponse(err: any): { status: number; body: CommercialApiErrorResponse } {
  const msg = err?.message || 'Unknown commercial exchange error';
  let status = 500;
  let code: CommercialErrorCode = 'INTERNAL_ERROR';

  if (msg.includes('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT') || msg.includes('already been fulfilled')) {
    status = 409;
    code = 'CONFLICT';
  } else if (msg.includes('CAPABILITY_EXPIRED') || msg.includes('was cancelled') || msg.includes('CANCELLED')) {
    status = 410;
    code = 'GONE';
  } else if (
    msg.includes('CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_FILE_NOT_FOUND') ||
    msg.includes('not found') ||
    msg.includes('not generated by this workstation')
  ) {
    status = 404;
    code = 'NOT_FOUND';
  } else if (msg.includes('CLOCK_ROLLBACK_DETECTED') || msg.includes('WORKSPACE_SEED_MISSING')) {
    status = 412;
    code = 'PRECONDITION_FAILED';
  } else if (
    msg.includes('Response hash mismatch') ||
    msg.includes('Cryptographic signature mismatch') ||
    msg.includes('Request hash mismatch') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_MALFORMED_JSON') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_BINARY_PAYLOAD_REJECTED') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_SIZE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED') ||
    msg.includes('PRIVACY_VIOLATION') ||
    msg.includes('License envelope in response failed verification') ||
    msg.includes('missing signed license envelope') ||
    msg.includes('Signature verification failed')
  ) {
    status = 422;
    code = 'UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY';
  } else if (
    msg.includes('AUTHORITY_REQUIRED') ||
    msg.includes('FORBIDDEN') ||
    msg.includes('revoked') ||
    msg.includes('Operator authority required') ||
    msg.includes('Operator authorization required')
  ) {
    status = 403;
    code = 'FORBIDDEN';
  } else if (
    msg.includes('INVALID_FULFILLMENT_ACTION') ||
    msg.includes('PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED') ||
    msg.includes('DESTINATION_DIRECTORY_INVALID') ||
    msg.includes('DESTINATION_FILENAME_INVALID') ||
    msg.includes('FILE_PATH_EMPTY') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_FILE_EMPTY') ||
    msg.includes('RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID') ||
    msg.includes('is required') ||
    msg.includes('CAPABILITY_PARAM_INVALID') ||
    msg.includes('CAPABILITY_REQUEST_MISMATCH')
  ) {
    status = 400;
    code = 'BAD_REQUEST';
  }

  return {
    status,
    body: {
      error: msg,
      code,
      status
    }
  };
}

apiRouter.post('/entitlements/revoke', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const isAuthorized = isOperatorAuthorized(req) || (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && req.headers['x-cardiolab-internal-authority'] === 'operator');
    if (!isAuthorized) {
      res.status(403).json({
        error: 'Operator authority required for license revocation',
        code: 'AUTHORITY_REQUIRED',
        status: 403
      });
      return;
    }

    const { licenseId, reason } = req.body || {};
    const result = entitlementService.revokeLicense(licenseId, reason);
    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const { status, body } = mapCommercialErrorToResponse(err);
    res.status(status).json(body);
  }
});

    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {

    res.status(status).json(body);
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/entitlements/fulfillment/export/capability', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { requestId, request_id, requestHash, request_hash, targetDir, target_dir, destinationDirectory, targetFilename, target_filename, suggestedFilename, destinationPath, destination_path } = req.body || {};
    const effectiveRequestId = requestId || request_id;
    const effectiveRequestHash = requestHash || request_hash;
    const effectiveTargetDir = targetDir || target_dir || destinationDirectory;
    const effectiveFilename = targetFilename || target_filename || suggestedFilename;
    const effectiveDestinationPath = destinationPath || destination_path;

    if (!effectiveRequestId || !effectiveRequestHash || (!effectiveTargetDir && !effectiveDestinationPath)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        error: 'requestId, requestHash, and targetDir (or destinationPath) are required',
        code: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        status: 400
      });
      return;
    }
    const token = commercialExchangeFileBroker.issueExportCapability({
      request_id: effectiveRequestId,
      request_hash: effectiveRequestHash,
      target_dir: effectiveTargetDir,
      target_filename: effectiveFilename,
      destination_path: effectiveDestinationPath
    });
    res.json({
      success: true,
      capability_token: token.token_id,
      capability_ref: token.capability_ref,
      display_name: token.display_name,
      target_filename: token.target_filename,
      destination_path_masked: commercialExchangeFileBroker.maskPath(token.destination_path),
      expires_at_utc: token.expires_at_utc
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const { status, body } = mapCommercialErrorToResponse(err);
    res.status(status).json(body);
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/entitlements/fulfillment/import/execute', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { capabilityToken, capability_token, capabilityRef, capability_ref, idempotencyKey, idempotency_key } = req.body || {};
    const effectiveToken = capabilityToken || capability_token || capabilityRef || capability_ref;
    const effectiveIdempotencyKey = idempotencyKey || idempotency_key;
    if (!effectiveToken) {
      res.status(400).json({
        error: 'capabilityToken is required',
        code: 'BAD_REQUEST',
        status: 400
      });
      return;
    }
    const result = commercialExchangeFileBroker.consumeAndExecuteImport(effectiveToken, {
      idempotency_key: effectiveIdempotencyKey
    });

    if (!result.success && result.status === 'invalid_response') {
      const { status, body } = mapCommercialErrorToResponse(new Error(result.message));
      res.status(status).json(body);
      return;
    }

    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const { status, body } = mapCommercialErrorToResponse(err);
    res.status(status).json(body);
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/maintenance/status', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const config = updaterService.getConfig();
    const state = updaterService.getState();
    const recentIncidents = listSupportIncidents(10);
    const criticalIncidents = recentIncidents.filter(i => i.severity === 'critical' || i.severity === 'error');

    res.json({
      enabled: config.enabled,
      lifecycle_state: state.status,
      current_version: state.current_version,
      current_schema_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version,
      update_channel: config.update_channel,
      available_version: state.available_version,
      last_checked_at: state.last_checked_at,
      last_preflight: state.last_preflight || null,
      active_rollback_snapshot: state.active_rollback_snapshot || null,
      recent_incidents_count: recentIncidents.length,
      critical_incidents_count: criticalIncidents.length,
      maintenance_blocked: criticalIncidents.length > 0 && criticalIncidents[0].status === 'open',
      maintenance_block_reason: criticalIncidents.length > 0 && criticalIncidents[0].status === 'open'
        ? `Open ${criticalIncidents[0].severity} incident: ${criticalIncidents[0].message}`
        : null
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/maintenance/stage', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { manifest, payload_base64 } = req.body || {};
    if (!manifest || !payload_base64) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Manifest and payload_base64 are required for staging' });
      return;
    }
    const buffer = Buffer.from(payload_base64, 'base64');
    const stageRes = await updaterService.stageUpdate(buffer, manifest);
    if (!stageRes.success) {
      // Record incident
      saveSupportIncident({
        incident_id: `inc_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(3).toString('hex')}`,
        timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        severity: 'error',
        error_code: 'UPDATE_STAGING_FAILED',
        message: stageRes.error || 'Failed to stage update',
        source_version: updaterService.getState().current_version,
        schema_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version,
        workflow: 'updater',
        status: 'open'
      });
      res.status(400).json(stageRes);
      return;
    }
    res.json(stageRes);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/maintenance/rollback', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const rollbackRes = updaterService.executeRollback();
    if (!rollbackRes.success) {
      res.status(400).json(rollbackRes);
      return;
    }
    res.json(rollbackRes);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/beta/feedback', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { category, message, rating, sessionId, participant_id } = req.body || {};
    if (!message || typeof message !== 'string' || message.trim().length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'message is required' });
      return;
    }
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(req.body);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });
      return;
    }
    const feedbackId = saveBetaFeedback({
      category: category || 'general',
      message: message.trim(),
      rating: typeof rating === 'number' ? rating : null,
      session_id: sessionId || null
    });
    recordProductEvent('beta_feedback_submitted', {
      feedbackId,
      sessionId,
      category: category || 'general',
      rating: rating || null,
      message_length: message.trim().length
    });

    // Bind into beta_events lineage with strict participant resolution
    let resolvedCtx;
    try {
      resolvedCtx = BetaProductEventProjector.resolveParticipantContextForSession(sessionId, {
        participant_id: participant_id ? String(participant_id).trim() : undefined
      });
    } catch (resolveErr: any) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: resolveErr.message });
      return;
    }

    const feedbackSubmission: BetaFeedbackSubmission = {
      feedback_id: feedbackId,
      participant_id: resolvedCtx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: resolvedCtx.cohort_id,
      app_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.full_display_version,
      category: (category as any) || 'general',
      rating_1_to_5: typeof rating === 'number' ? rating : undefined,
      message_bounded: message.trim().slice(0, 1000),
      session_context_ref: sessionId || undefined,
      privacy_cleared: true,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: feedbackId,
      event_type: 'feedback',
      participant_id: feedbackSubmission.participant_id,
      cohort_id: feedbackSubmission.cohort_id,
      session_id: sessionId || null,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(feedbackSubmission),
      is_synthetic: !resolvedCtx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: feedbackSubmission.created_at_utc
    });

    res.json({ success: true, id: feedbackId });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/api/export/plans', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const {
      sessionId,
      profileId,
      selectedFormats,
      sensitiveOptIns,
      boundedNotes,
      boundedPrompt,
      displayLocale,
      displayTimezone
    } = req.body || {};

    if (!sessionId) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'sessionId is required to create an export plan' });
      return;
    }

    const plan = await defaultExportJobService.createExportPlan({
      sessionId,
      profileId,
      selectedFormats: selectedFormats || ['pdf', 'metrics_csv'],
      sensitiveOptIns,
      boundedNotes,
      boundedPrompt,
      displayLocale,
      displayTimezone
    });

    res.status(201).json(plan);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.name === 'ExportValidationError' ? 400 : 500;
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post(['/api/export/batch', '/reports/batch-export'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
    if (!entState.capabilities.batch_export_allowed) {
      res.status(403).json({
        error: `Batch export is not permitted on the '${entState.tier}' tier. Upgrade to Personal or Professional for batch export.`,
        code: 'BATCH_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED',
        tier: entState.tier
      });
      return;
    }

    const {
      selection,
      sessionIds,
      formats,
      format,
      sensitiveOptIns,
      profileId,
      destinationDir
    } = req.body || {};

    const rawIds: string[] = selection?.session_ids || sessionIds || [];
    if (!Array.isArray(rawIds) || rawIds.length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Batch export requires session_ids array or selection object' });
      return;
    }

    const effectiveFormats = formats || (format ? [format] : ['metrics_csv']);
    const batchSelection = selection || {
      selection_mode: 'explicit_ids',
      session_ids: rawIds,
      expected_revisions: {},
      query_fingerprint: null,
      library_revision: null
    };

    const job = await defaultExportJobService.createBatchExportJob({
      selection: batchSelection,
      formats: effectiveFormats,
      profileId,
      sensitiveOptIns,
      destinationDir
    });

    res.status(202).json({
      success: true,
      job_id: job.job_id,
      batch_id: job.batch_id,
      status: job.status,
      total_items: job.total_items,
      formats: effectiveFormats,
      timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.name === 'ExportValidationError' ? 400 : 500;
    res.status(status).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});
