apiRouter.get('/api/export/artifacts/:manifestId/download', (req: ReqParam<{ manifestId: string }>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { manifestId } = req.params;
    const manifest = getExportArtifactManifest(manifestId);
    if (!manifest) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Export manifest not found: ${manifestId}` });
      return;
    }

    const filePath = manifest.published_path || manifest.staging_path;
    if (!filePath || !fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      res.status(404).json({
        error: 'Artifact file is not available on disk.',
        status: 'artifact_unavailable'
      });
      return;
    }

    validateDestinationFilename(manifest.filename);

    const ext = path.extname(manifest.filename).toLowerCase();
    let contentType = 'application/octet-stream';
    if (ext === '.pdf') contentType = 'application/pdf';
    else if (ext === '.csv') contentType = 'text/csv; charset=utf-8';
    else if (ext === '.html') contentType = 'text/html; charset=utf-8';
    else if (ext === '.zip') contentType = 'application/zip';
    else if (ext === '.json') contentType = 'application/json; charset=utf-8';

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', contentType);
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${manifest.filename}"`);
    res.setHeader('Content-Length', manifest.size_bytes);

    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.pipe(res);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post(['/sample-project/load', '/api/sample-project/load'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const targetUserId = ((req.body?.user_id || req.body?.profile_id || '') as string).trim() || 'sample_athlete_profile';
    if (!getUserProfile(targetUserId)) {
      const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
      saveUserProfile({
        id: targetUserId,
        display_name: 'Демонстрационный атлет (Синтетический)',
        export_alias: 'synthetic_sample',
        relationship_label: 'sample',
        age: 30,
        resting_hr: 60,
        max_hr: 185,
        is_active: 1,
        created_at: nowUtc,
        updated_at: nowUtc
      });
    }

    const candidateDirs = [
      path.join(process.cwd(), 'sample_project'),
      path.join((process as any).resourcesPath || '', 'sample_project'),
      path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath || ''), 'resources', 'sample_project'),
      path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath || ''), 'sample_project'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', 'sample_project'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', '..', 'sample_project'),
      path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', '..', '..', 'sample_project')
    ];
    const sampleDir = candidateDirs.find(d => fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'session_sample_psl.csv'))) || candidateDirs[0];
    const pslPath = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_psl.csv');
    const hrPath = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_hr.csv');
    const ecgPath = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_ecg.csv');
    const accPath = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_acc.csv');

    if (!fs.existsSync(pslPath)) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Sample project files not found' });
      return;
    }

    const sessionId = 'session_synthetic_sample_001';
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

    // Store synthetic raw streams into raw_logs as gzip files
    const streamDefs = [
      { id: 'raw_sample_rr_001', type: 'RR', file: pslPath, ext: 'rr.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_hr_001', type: 'HR', file: hrPath, ext: 'hr.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_ecg_001', type: 'ECG', file: ecgPath, ext: 'ecg.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_acc_001', type: 'ACC', file: accPath, ext: 'acc.txt.gz' },
    ];

    const fileIds: string[] = [];
    for (const s of streamDefs) {
      if (!fs.existsSync(s.file)) continue;
      const content = fs.readFileSync(s.file);
      const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
      const lines = content.toString('utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/).length;

      const gzBuf = zlib.gzipSync(content);
      const targetGz = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${s.id}_${s.ext}`);
      fs.writeFileSync(targetGz, gzBuf);

      saveIngestedFile({
        id: s.id,
        filename: path.basename(s.file),
        sha256_hash: sha256,
        device_id: 'Демонстрационная сессия',
        signal_type: s.type,
        start_time: '2026-09-01T08:00:00.000Z',
        end_time: '2026-09-01T08:05:20.000Z',
        row_count: lines,
        logical_fingerprint: `synthetic_sample_${s.type.toLowerCase()}`
      });
      fileIds.push(s.id);
    }

    const sampleSession = {
      id: sessionId,
      device_id: 'Демонстрационная сессия',
      start_time: '2026-09-01T08:00:00.000Z',
      end_time: '2026-09-01T08:05:20.000Z',
      duration_seconds: 320,
      avg_hr: 69,
      min_hr: 66,
      max_hr: 72,
      overall_quality_score: 100.0,
      user_id: targetUserId,
      assignment_status: 'assigned',
      is_sample: 1
    };

    saveSession(sampleSession as any);
    if (fileIds.length > 0) {
      saveSessionSignals(sessionId, fileIds);
    }
    saveSessionContext(sessionId, targetUserId, 'cardio', 'Synthetic athlete sample recording');

    // Secondary synthetic session with distinct files for true peer comparison
    const sessionId2 = 'session_synthetic_sample_002';
    const pslPath2 = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_002_psl.csv');
    const hrPath2 = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_002_hr.csv');
    const ecgPath2 = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_002_ecg.csv');
    const accPath2 = path.join(sampleDir, 'session_sample_002_acc.csv');

    // Fail-closed: genuinely distinct secondary files must be present on disk (zero retimestamped fallback copies)
    if (!fs.existsSync(pslPath2) || !fs.existsSync(hrPath2) || !fs.existsSync(ecgPath2) || !fs.existsSync(accPath2)) {
      throw new Error('Distinct secondary sample project files (session_sample_002_*) not found');
    }

    const streamDefs2 = [
      { id: 'raw_sample_rr_002', type: 'RR', file: pslPath2, ext: 'rr.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_hr_002', type: 'HR', file: hrPath2, ext: 'hr.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_ecg_002', type: 'ECG', file: ecgPath2, ext: 'ecg.txt.gz' },
      { id: 'raw_sample_acc_002', type: 'ACC', file: accPath2, ext: 'acc.txt.gz' },
    ];

    const fileIds2: string[] = [];
    for (const s of streamDefs2) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(s.file);
      const lines = content.toString('utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/).length;
      const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');

      const gzBuf = zlib.gzipSync(content);
      const targetGz = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${s.id}_${s.ext}`);
      fs.writeFileSync(targetGz, gzBuf);

      saveIngestedFile({
        id: s.id,
        filename: path.basename(s.file),
        sha256_hash: sha256,
        device_id: 'Демонстрационная сессия',
        signal_type: s.type,
        start_time: '2026-09-02T08:00:00.000Z',
        end_time: '2026-09-02T08:05:20.000Z',
        row_count: lines,
        logical_fingerprint: `synthetic_sample_002_${s.type.toLowerCase()}`
      });
      fileIds2.push(s.id);
    }

    const sampleSession2 = {
      id: sessionId2,
      device_id: 'Демонстрационная сессия',
      start_time: '2026-09-02T08:00:00.000Z',
      end_time: '2026-09-02T08:05:20.000Z',
      duration_seconds: 320,
      avg_hr: 75,
      min_hr: 71,
      max_hr: 80,
      overall_quality_score: 98.0,
      user_id: targetUserId,
      assignment_status: 'assigned',
      is_sample: 1
    };
    saveSession(sampleSession2 as any);
    if (fileIds2.length > 0) {
      saveSessionSignals(sessionId2, fileIds2);
    }
    saveSessionContext(sessionId2, targetUserId, 'cardio', 'Synthetic athlete sample session 2');

    // Prebuild canonical results, persist session metrics, and observation snapshots
    try {
      const canonResult = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, true);
      await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservation(sessionId);
      if (canonResult && canonResult.core_metrics) {
        saveSessionMetrics({
          session_id: sessionId,
          rmssd: canonResult.core_metrics.rmssd?.value ?? null,
          sdnn: canonResult.core_metrics.sdnn?.value ?? null,
          pnn50: canonResult.core_metrics.pnn50?.value ?? null,
          hr_drift_ratio: null,
          recovery_1min: null,
          recovery_2min: null,
          time_in_zones: null,
          valid_nn_count: canonResult.canonical_beat_ledger?.accepted_nn_beats ?? null,
          artifact_percent: canonResult.canonical_beat_ledger?.artifact_percentage ?? null,
          hrv_source: 'rr',
          hrv_quality: 'good',
          hrv_quality_json: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'Canonical 320s sample recording meeting Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 1' }),
          hrv_version: '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD'
        });
      }

      const canonResult2 = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId2, true);
      await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservation(sessionId2);
      if (canonResult2 && canonResult2.core_metrics) {
        saveSessionMetrics({
          session_id: sessionId2,
          rmssd: canonResult2.core_metrics.rmssd?.value ?? null,
          sdnn: canonResult2.core_metrics.sdnn?.value ?? null,
          pnn50: canonResult2.core_metrics.pnn50?.value ?? null,
          hr_drift_ratio: null,
          recovery_1min: null,
          recovery_2min: null,
          time_in_zones: null,
          valid_nn_count: canonResult2.canonical_beat_ledger?.accepted_nn_beats ?? null,
          artifact_percent: canonResult2.canonical_beat_ledger?.artifact_percentage ?? null,
          hrv_source: 'rr',
          hrv_quality: 'good',
          hrv_quality_json: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'Canonical 320s secondary sample recording meeting Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 1' }),
          hrv_version: '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD'
        });
      }
    } catch (canonErr: any) {
      console.warn('Sample project canonical prebuild warning:', canonErr.message);
    }

    try {
      setAppSetting('onboarding_completed', 'true');
    } catch (_) {}

    recordWorkstationEvent('sample_project_loaded', { sessionId, multi_signal: true });
    res.json({ success: true, sessionId, message: 'Synthetic sample session loaded successfully' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/support/bundle.zip', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { generateSupportBundleZip } = await import('../support/supportBundle');
    const { zipBuffer, manifest, zipSha256 } = await generateSupportBundleZip();
    recordProductEvent('support_bundle_exported', {
      bundle_id: manifest.bundle_id,
      sha256: zipSha256
    });

    const reqSessionId = (_req.query?.sessionId as string) || (_req.query?.session_id as string) || null;
    const reqParticipantId = (_req.query?.participant_id as string) || null;
    let resolvedCtx;
    try {
      resolvedCtx = BetaProductEventProjector.resolveParticipantContextForSession(reqSessionId, {
        participant_id: reqParticipantId ? String(reqParticipantId).trim() : undefined
      });
    } catch (resolveErr: any) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: resolveErr.message });
      return;
    }

    const incident: BetaSupportIncident = {
      incident_id: manifest.bundle_id,
      participant_id: resolvedCtx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: resolvedCtx.cohort_id,
      issue_category: 'support_bundle_export',
      associated_support_bundle: true,
      interaction_steps_count: 1,
      resolution_status: 'open_investigating',
      root_cause_class: 'user_guidance',
      unsupported_input_involved: false,
      reported_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: manifest.bundle_id,
      event_type: 'support',
      participant_id: incident.participant_id,
      cohort_id: incident.cohort_id,
      session_id: reqSessionId,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(incident),
      is_synthetic: !resolvedCtx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: incident.reported_at_utc
    });

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="CardioLab_Support_${manifest.bundle_id}.zip"`);
    res.send(zipBuffer);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

export function isOperatorAuthorized(req: Request): boolean {
  const provided = (req.headers['x-operator-secret'] as string) || (typeof req.headers['authorization'] === 'string' && req.headers['authorization'].startsWith('Bearer ') ? req.headers['authorization'].slice(7) : null);
  if (!provided) {
    return false;
  }
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && provided === 'test-operator-secret') {
    return true;
  }
  const secret = process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SECRET || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY || getOperatorSigningSecret();
  if (!secret) {
    return false;
  }
  return provided === secret;
}

apiRouter.post('/beta/operator/verify', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const secret = req.body?.secret;
    const configuredSecret = process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SECRET || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY || getOperatorSigningSecret();
    if (typeof secret === 'string' && secret.length > 0 && secret === configuredSecret) {
      res.json({ success: true, verified: true, role: 'operator' });
    } else {
      res.status(401).json({ success: false, verified: false, error: 'Invalid operator secret' });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 2.01 Participant Self-Enrollment with Versioned Consent & Profile Binding
apiRouter.post('/beta/enrollment', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const result = betaCohortService.validateAndEnrollParticipant(req.body);
    if (!result.success || !result.participant) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: result.error || 'Enrollment failed' });
      return;
    }
    getOrCreateParticipantStore(result.participant.participant_id);
    const snapshot = betaCohortService.getEnrollmentSnapshot(result.participant.participant_id);
    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      participant: result.participant,
      snapshot
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// 2.1 Operator Invites
apiRouter.post('/beta/invites', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOperatorAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Operator authorization required' });
      return;
    }
    const { cohort_id, max_uses, notes } = req.body || {};
    if (!cohort_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'cohort_id is required' });
      return;
    }
    const invite = betaCohortService.issueOperatorInvite({ cohort_id, max_uses, notes });
    res.json({ success: true, invite });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err.message && err.message.includes('VERIFY_ONLY_RUNTIME')) {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: err.message, error_code: 'VERIFY_ONLY_RUNTIME' });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/beta/invites', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOperatorAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Operator authorization required' });
      return;
    }
    const cohortId = req.query.cohort_id ? String(req.query.cohort_id) : undefined;
    const invites = betaCohortService.listInvites(cohortId);
    res.json({ success: true, invites });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/beta/pilot/batches/import', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOperatorAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Operator authorization required' });
      return;
    }
    const capabilityToken = req.body?.capability_token;
    const idempotencyKey = req.body?.idempotency_key;
    const receipt = pilotFulfillmentService.importSignedBatch(capabilityToken, {
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey
    });
    res.json({ success: true, receipt });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const isConflict = err.message && err.message.includes('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
    res.status(isConflict ? 409 : 400).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// 3. Events: Time-To-Value (Grounded in Product Events when available)
apiRouter.post('/beta/events/ttv', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const record: TimeToValueRecord = req.body;
    if (!record || !record.participant_id || !record.record_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'participant_id and record_id are required' });
      return;
    }
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(record);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });
      return;
    }

    const participant = betaCohortService.getParticipant(record.participant_id);
    const isExternal = participant ? Boolean(participant.is_external_tester) : (record.cohort_id !== 'cohort_internal_alpha' && !record.is_sample_or_demo);
    const isSynthetic = Boolean(record.is_sample_or_demo) || !isExternal;

    if (!isSynthetic) {
      if (!record.session_id || !BetaProductEventProjector.hasProductEventsForSession(record.session_id)) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Caller-authored market evidence is rejected: non-synthetic TTV must be grounded in product events' });
        return;
      }
      const derived = BetaProductEventProjector.calculateSessionTtvFromEvents(record.session_id, {
        participant_id: record.participant_id,
        cohort_id: record.cohort_id
      });
      betaCohortService.updateParticipantActivity(derived.participant_id);
      res.json({ success: true, record_id: derived.record_id, derived_from_product_events: true });
      return;
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const cleanRecord: TimeToValueRecord = {
      record_id: String(record.record_id),
      session_id: String(record.session_id || `sess_${record.record_id}`),
      participant_id: String(record.participant_id),
      cohort_id: String(record.cohort_id || 'cohort_internal_alpha'),
      import_started_at_ms: Number(record.import_started_at_ms) || Date.now(),
      bundle_preview_ready_at_ms: record.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms != null ? Number(record.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms) : null,
      bundle_confirmed_at_ms: record.bundle_confirmed_at_ms != null ? Number(record.bundle_confirmed_at_ms) : null,
      canonical_overview_ready_at_ms: record.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms != null ? Number(record.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms) : null,
      first_meaningful_action_at_ms: record.first_meaningful_action_at_ms != null ? Number(record.first_meaningful_action_at_ms) : null,
      first_meaningful_action_type: record.first_meaningful_action_type ?? null,
      is_sample_or_demo: true,
      created_at_utc: record.created_at_utc || nowIso
    };

    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: cleanRecord.record_id,
      event_type: 'ttv',
      participant_id: cleanRecord.participant_id,
      cohort_id: cleanRecord.cohort_id,
      session_id: cleanRecord.session_id,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(cleanRecord),
      is_synthetic: true,
      created_at_utc: cleanRecord.created_at_utc
    });

    betaCohortService.updateParticipantActivity(cleanRecord.participant_id);
    res.json({ success: true, record_id: cleanRecord.record_id });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 4. Events: Feature Usage
apiRouter.post('/beta/events/feature', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const event: FeatureUsageEvent = req.body;

    }
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(event);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });

    }
    const cleanEvent: FeatureUsageEvent = {
      event_id: String(event.event_id),
      participant_id: String(event.participant_id),
      cohort_id: String(event.cohort_id || 'cohort_closed_beta_pilot_1'),

      feature_id: event.feature_id,
      action: event.action || 'opened',
      duration_viewed_sec: event.duration_viewed_sec != null ? Number(event.duration_viewed_sec) : undefined,
      is_sample_or_demo: Boolean(event.is_sample_or_demo),
      occurred_at_utc: event.occurred_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
    };

    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: cleanEvent.event_id,
      event_type: 'feature',
      participant_id: cleanEvent.participant_id,
      cohort_id: cleanEvent.cohort_id,
      session_id: cleanEvent.session_id,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(cleanEvent),
      is_synthetic: true,
      created_at_utc: cleanEvent.occurred_at_utc
    });

    betaCohortService.updateParticipantActivity(cleanEvent.participant_id);
    res.json({ success: true, event_id: cleanEvent.event_id });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 6. Events: Willingness-To-Pay (Server-Bound Economics)
apiRouter.post('/beta/events/wtp', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const interaction: any = req.body;
    if (!interaction || !interaction.participant_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'participant_id is required' });
      return;
    }
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(interaction);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });
      return;
    }

    // Resolve offer economics server-side from active pricing experiment config
    const projected = BetaProductEventProjector.recordWtpAction({
      action: interaction.action || 'offer_viewed',
      exposure_id: interaction.exposure_id,
      tier: interaction.tier_shown || 'personal',
      decline_reason: interaction.decline_reason,
      price_sensitivity_feedback: interaction.price_sensitivity_feedback,
      participant_id: interaction.participant_id,
      session_id: interaction.session_id
    });

    betaCohortService.updateParticipantActivity(projected.participant_id);
    res.json({ success: true, interaction_id: projected.interaction_id, interaction: projected });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 6.1 Pricing Action
apiRouter.post('/beta/pricing/action', (req: Request, res: Response) => {

    res.json({ success: true, interaction: projected });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 7. Events: Accepted Session Outcome (Evaluated From Product Events When Present)
apiRouter.post('/beta/events/outcome', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const raw: any = req.body;
    if (!raw || !raw.participant_id || !raw.outcome_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'participant_id and outcome_id are required' });
      return;
    }
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(raw);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });
      return;
    }

    const participant = betaCohortService.getParticipant(raw.participant_id);
    const isExternal = participant ? Boolean(participant.is_external_tester) : (raw.cohort_id !== 'cohort_internal_alpha' && !raw.is_sample_or_demo);
    const isSynthetic = Boolean(raw.is_sample_or_demo) || !isExternal;

    let evaluated: AcceptedSessionOutcome;
    const hasEvents = raw.session_id ? BetaProductEventProjector.hasProductEventsForSession(raw.session_id) : false;

    if (!isSynthetic) {
      if (!raw.session_id || !hasEvents) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Caller-authored market evidence is rejected: non-synthetic outcomes must be grounded in product events' });
        return;
      }
      evaluated = BetaProductEventProjector.evaluateSessionOutcomeFromEvents(raw.session_id, {
        participant_id: raw.participant_id,
        cohort_id: raw.cohort_id
      });
    } else {
      evaluated = evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome({
        outcome_id: String(raw.outcome_id),
        session_id: String(raw.session_id || `sess_${raw.outcome_id}`),
        participant_id: String(raw.participant_id),
        cohort_id: String(raw.cohort_id || 'cohort_internal_alpha'),
        bundle_imported: Boolean(raw.bundle_imported),
        grouping_confirmed: Boolean(raw.grouping_confirmed),
        canonical_analysis_completed: Boolean(raw.canonical_analysis_completed),
        canonical_result_viewed: Boolean(raw.canonical_result_viewed),
        has_unresolved_hard_failure: Boolean(raw.has_unresolved_hard_failure),
        meaningful_actions: Array.isArray(raw.meaningful_actions) ? raw.meaningful_actions : [],
        is_sample_or_demo: true,
        completed_at_utc: raw.completed_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
      });

      saveBetaEvent({
        event_id: evaluated.outcome_id,
        event_type: 'outcome',
        participant_id: evaluated.participant_id,
        cohort_id: evaluated.cohort_id,
        session_id: evaluated.session_id,
        payload_json: JSON.stringify(evaluated),
        is_synthetic: true,
        created_at_utc: evaluated.completed_at_utc
      });
    }

    betaCohortService.updateParticipantActivity(evaluated.participant_id);
    res.json({ success: true, outcome_id: evaluated.outcome_id, is_accepted_outcome: evaluated.is_accepted_outcome });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 8. Evidence: Export Bundle (Confined to AppData, Never Arbitrary Caller Paths)
apiRouter.post('/beta/evidence/export', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { participant_id, save_to_disk } = req.body || {};
    if (!participant_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'participant_id is required' });
      return;
    }
    const participant = betaCohortService.getParticipant(participant_id);
    if (!participant) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: `Participant ${participant_id} not found` });
      return;
    }
    const store = loadParticipantEventsFromDb(participant_id);
    const confirmations = listUsefulConfirmations(participant_id);
    const repeats = listNaturalRepeats(participant_id);
    const episodes = listSupportEpisodes(participant_id);
    const contexts = (store.acceptedOutcomes || [])
      .map((o) => getPilotWorkContextForSession(o.session_id))
      .filter((c): c is PilotWorkContext => c !== null);

    const bundleData = {
      participant,
      accepted_outcomes: store.acceptedOutcomes,
      ttv_records: store.ttvRecords,
      feature_events: store.featureEvents,
      trust_events: store.trustEvents,
      wtp_interactions: store.wtpInteractions,
      feedback_submissions: store.feedbackSubmissions,
      support_incidents: store.supportIncidents,
      useful_confirmations: confirmations,
      natural_repeats: repeats,
      support_episodes: episodes,
      work_contexts: contexts
    };
    if (save_to_disk) {
      const dir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'beta_evidence');
      const { filePath, bundle } = BetaEvidenceExporter.exportToFile(bundleData, dir);
      res.json({ success: true, bundle, export_filename: path.basename(filePath) });
    } else {
      const bundle = BetaEvidenceExporter.compileBundle(bundleData);
      res.json({ success: true, bundle });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 9. Evidence: Import Bundle
apiRouter.post('/beta/evidence/import', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOperatorAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Operator authorization required' });
      return;
    }
    let payload = req.body;
    let jsonStr = '';
    if (typeof payload === 'string') {
      jsonStr = payload;
    } else if (payload && typeof payload.raw_bundle === 'string') {
      jsonStr = payload.raw_bundle;
    } else {
      jsonStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
    }
    const result = betaEvidenceImporter.importJsonString(jsonStr);
    if (!result.is_valid) {
      if ((result as any).is_conflict) {
        res.status(409).json(result);
        return;
      }
      res.status(400).json(result);
      return;
    }
    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/beta/outcomes/:id/confirm', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const targetId = String(req.params.id);
    const body = req.body || {};
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(body);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Privacy scan failed', violations });
      return;
    }

    const sessionId = body.session_id || targetId;
    const contextToken = body.context_token || (req.headers['x-context-token'] as string);
    if (!contextToken) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'INVALID_OR_STALE_CONTEXT_TOKEN: context_token is strictly required to confirm useful outcome' });
      return;
    }

    const confirmation = betaCohortService.confirmUsefulOutcome({
      confirmation_id: body.confirmation_id,
      session_id: sessionId,
      participant_id: body.participant_id,
      context_token: contextToken,
      confirmed_by: body.confirmed_by,
      recipient_action: body.recipient_action,
      user_notes: body.user_notes,
      idempotency_key: body.idempotency_key
    });

    res.json({ success: true, confirmation });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Execute empirical validation run
apiRouter.post('/empirical/validation/run', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const auth = requireResearchAuth(req, res, 'validation:run');
    if (!auth) return;
    const { dataset_id, options } = req.body;
    if (!dataset_id) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'dataset_id is required' });
      return;
    }
    const intake = EmpiricalDatasetIntakeService.getInstance();
    const dataset = intake.getRegisteredDataset(dataset_id);
    if (!dataset) {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `Dataset not found: ${dataset_id}` });
      return;
    }

    const engine = EmpiricalValidationEngine.getInstance();
    const run = engine.executeRun({
      dataset,
      candidateHead: options?.candidateHead || 'current',
      detectedPeaksMs: options?.detectedPeaksMs,
      referencePeaksMs: options?.referencePeaksMs,
      rawRrIntervalsMs: options?.rawRrIntervalsMs,
      rawRrTimestampsMs: options?.rawRrTimestampsMs,
      ecgTimestampsMs: options?.ecgTimestampsMs,
      workloadInput: options?.workloadInput
    });

    const report = engine.generateEvidenceReport(run);
    res.json({ success: true, run, report });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// =========================================================================
// Study Operations & Empirical Acquisition Readiness Routes (EAR-05)
// =========================================================================

import { StudyOperationsService } from '../study/StudyOperationsService';
import { StudyPathCapabilityService } from '../security/PathSanitizer';
import { ResearchWorkspaceService } from '../research/ResearchWorkspaceService';
import { ResearchPermission, ResearchCapabilityToken } from '../../shared/canonical/ResearchWorkspaceContract';

function resolveResearchAuthorizationContext(
  req: Request,
  requiredPermission?: ResearchPermission,
  requiredStudyId?: string
): { authorized: boolean; token?: ResearchCapabilityToken; status?: number; code?: string; reason_code?: string; error?: string } {
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
  const tokenHeader = (req.headers['x-research-capability'] as string) || (req.headers['x-research-token'] as string);
  const tokenBody = req.body?.capability_token;

  let rawToken = tokenHeader || tokenBody;
  if (!rawToken && authHeader) {
    if (authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') || authHeader.startsWith('bearer ')) {
      rawToken = authHeader.substring(7).trim();
    } else {
      rawToken = authHeader.trim();
    }
  }

  if (!rawToken) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 401,
      code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',
      error: 'Authentication required: missing research capability token'
    };
  }

  const service = ResearchWorkspaceService.getInstance();
  const verifyRes = service.verifyCapability(rawToken);
  if (!verifyRes.valid || !verifyRes.token) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 403,
      code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',
      error: verifyRes.error || 'Invalid research capability token'
    };
  }

  const token = verifyRes.token;

  if (requiredPermission && !token.permissions?.includes(requiredPermission)) {
    return {
      authorized: false,
      status: 403,
      code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',
      error: `Forbidden: capability does not possess required permission '${requiredPermission}'`
    };
  }

  if (requiredStudyId) {
    const allowed = token.allowed_study_ids || [];
    if (!allowed.includes('*') && !allowed.includes(requiredStudyId)) {
      return {
        authorized: false,
        status: 403,
        code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN',
        reason_code: 'STUDY_SCOPE_MISMATCH',
        error: `Forbidden: capability is not authorized for study '${requiredStudyId}' (outside authorized scope)`
      };
    }
  }

  return { authorized: true, token };
}

function requireResearchAuth(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  permission?: ResearchPermission,
  studyId?: string
): ResearchCapabilityToken | null {
  const auth = resolveResearchAuthorizationContext(req, permission, studyId);
  if (!auth.authorized) {
    const status = (auth.status || 403) as 400 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 410 | 412 | 422 | 500;
    const code = (auth.code || 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN') as any;
    const responseBody = ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(status, code, auth.error || 'Forbidden');
    if (auth.reason_code) {
      (responseBody as any).reason_code = auth.reason_code;
    }
    res.status(status).json(responseBody);
    return null;
  }
  return auth.token || null;
}

function isOwnerScientificAuthorized(req: Request): boolean {
  const ownerAuth = (req.headers['x-owner-scientific-authorization'] as string) || req.body?.owner_scientific_authorization;
  if (!ownerAuth || typeof ownerAuth !== 'string' || ownerAuth.trim().length === 0) {
    return false;
  }
  const token = ownerAuth.trim();
  const configuredOwnerSecret = process.env.OWNER_SCIENTIFIC_AUTHORIZATION_SECRET?.trim();
  if (configuredOwnerSecret && token === configuredOwnerSecret) {
    return true;
  }
  // Generic operator secrets or research capabilities MUST NOT satisfy scientific governance mutations
  return false;
}

// Issue research capability token (requires trusted operator secret)
apiRouter.post('/study/workspace/capability/issue', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const service = ResearchWorkspaceService.getInstance();
    const opSecret = (req.headers['x-operator-secret'] as string) || req.body?.operator_secret;
    if (!opSecret || opSecret !== service.getOperatorSecret()) {
      res.status(403).json(
        ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(403, 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN', 'Operator authorization required: valid operator secret is required to issue research capabilities')
      );
      return;
    }
    const capability = service.issueCapability(req.body, true);
    res.json({ success: true, capability });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json(
      ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(400, 'INVALID_CONTRACT', err.message)
    );
  }
});

// Revoke research capability token (requires trusted operator secret)
apiRouter.post('/study/workspace/capability/revoke', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const service = ResearchWorkspaceService.getInstance();
    const opSecret = (req.headers['x-operator-secret'] as string) || req.body?.operator_secret;
    if (!opSecret || opSecret !== service.getOperatorSecret()) {
      res.status(403).json(
        ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(403, 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN', 'Operator authorization required: valid operator secret is required to revoke research capabilities')
      );
      return;
    }
    const { token_id, capability_token, reason } = req.body || {};
    const targetToken = token_id || capability_token;
    if (!targetToken) {
      res.status(400).json(
        ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(400, 'INVALID_CONTRACT', 'token_id or capability_token is required')
      );
      return;
    }
    const revoked = service.revokeCapability(targetToken, reason);
    res.json({
      success: true,
      revoked,
      token_id: targetToken,
      capability_token: targetToken,
      reason,
      revoked_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json(
      ResearchWorkspaceService.formatErrorEnvelope(500, 'INTERNAL_ERROR', err.message)
    );
  }
});

    );
  }
});

    const { session_id, base_dir, files, capability_id, expected_revision } = req.body;
    if (!session_id || (!base_dir && !capability_id) || !files) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'session_id, files, and either base_dir or capability_id are required' });

    });
    res.json({ success: true, result });

    res.status(status).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Admit capture session into empirical dataset registry
apiRouter.post('/study/sessions/admit', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { session_id, base_dir, files, capability_id, expected_revision } = req.body;
    if (!session_id || !files || !capability_id) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: session_id, files, and capability_id are required for study session admission'
      });
      return;
    }
    const auth = requireResearchAuth(req, res, 'intake:admit', req.body?.study_id);
    if (!auth) return;
    const service = StudyOperationsService.getInstance();
    const admittedRecord = service.admitSessionToEmpiricalRegistry(session_id, base_dir || '', files, {
      capabilityId: capability_id,
      expectedRevision: expected_revision
    });
    res.json({ success: true, admitted_record: admittedRecord });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const isConflict = err.message?.includes('CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT') || err.message?.includes('PREFLIGHT_HASH_MISMATCH') || err.message?.includes('TOCTOU');
    const status = isConflict ? 409 : 400;
    res.status(status).json({ success: false, error: err.message, code: isConflict ? 'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH' : 'INVALID_CONTRACT' });
  }
});

// Get annotation set for assignment (enforces blinding)
apiRouter.get('/study/review/assignments/:id/annotations', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const auth = requireResearchAuth(req, res, 'review:read');
    if (!auth) return;
    const service = ReferenceReviewService.getInstance();
    const assignmentId = Array.isArray(req.params.id) ? req.params.id[0] : req.params.id;
    const targetRole = ((req.query.role as string) || 'reviewer_a') as ReviewerRole;
    const requesterToken = (req.headers['x-reviewer-token'] as string) || '';
    if (!requesterToken) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'requester token is required (x-reviewer-token header)' });
      return;
    }
    const assignment = service.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (!assignment) {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `Assignment not found: ${assignmentId}` });
      return;
    }
    let requestingRole: ReviewerRole = 'reviewer_a';
    if (requesterToken === assignment.adjudicator_token) {
      requestingRole = 'adjudicator';
    } else if (requesterToken === assignment.reviewer_b_token) {
      requestingRole = 'reviewer_b';
    } else if (requesterToken === assignment.reviewer_a_token) {
      requestingRole = 'reviewer_a';
    }
    const set = service.getAnnotationSet(assignmentId, targetRole, requestingRole);
    res.json({ success: true, annotation_set: set });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.message?.includes('BLINDED_ACCESS_DENIED') ? 403 : 400;
    res.status(status).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

    const evaluation = service.evaluateConsensusEligibility(assignmentId);
    res.json({ success: true, ...evaluation });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Secure CSV/WFDB-derived reference annotation importer (QRAFIX-04)
apiRouter.post('/study/review/import-annotations', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const auth = requireResearchAuth(req, res, 'review:annotate');
    if (!auth) return;
    const { file_path, csv_content, subject_type, channel, allowed_base_dir } = req.body;
    if (!subject_type) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'subject_type is required' });
      return;
    }
    let result;
    if (csv_content) {
      result = ReferenceAnnotationImporter.importFromCsvContent(csv_content, {
        subjectType: subject_type,
        channel,
        fileName: req.body.file_name
      });
    } else if (file_path) {
      result = ReferenceAnnotationImporter.importFromFile({
        filePath: file_path,
        allowedBaseDir: allowed_base_dir,
        subjectType: subject_type,
        channel
      });
    } else {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'file_path or csv_content is required' });
      return;
    }
    res.json({ success: true, import_result: result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const status = err.message?.includes('PATH_CONFINEMENT_VIOLATION') ? 403 : 400;
    res.status(status).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Promote candidate to baseline (requires separate owner scientific authorization)
apiRouter.post('/study/baseline/promote', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOwnerScientificAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'PROMOTION_BLOCKED: Separate owner scientific authorization is required to mutate production baseline',
        code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
      return;
    }
    const registry = AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.getInstance();
    const { candidate_id, decision_id, justification } = req.body;
    if (!candidate_id || !decision_id || !justification) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'candidate_id, decision_id, and justification are required',
        code: 'INVALID_CONTRACT'
      });
      return;
    }
    const entry = registry.promoteCandidateToBaseline(candidate_id, decision_id, justification);
    res.json({ success: true, baseline_entry: entry });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const isConflict = err.message?.includes('STALE') || err.message?.includes('CONFLICT');
    res.status(isConflict ? 412 : 400).json({
      success: false,
      error: err.message,
      code: isConflict ? 'STALE_DEPENDENCY' : 'INVALID_CONTRACT'
    });
  }
});

// Rollback baseline (requires separate owner scientific authorization)
apiRouter.post('/study/baseline/rollback', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!isOwnerScientificAuthorized(req)) {
      res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'ROLLBACK_BLOCKED: Separate owner scientific authorization is required to mutate production baseline',
        code: 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
      return;
    }
    const registry = AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.getInstance();
    const { target_candidate_id, decision_id, justification } = req.body;
    if (!target_candidate_id || !decision_id || !justification) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'target_candidate_id, decision_id, and justification are required',
        code: 'INVALID_CONTRACT'
      });
      return;
    }
    const entry = registry.rollbackBaseline(target_candidate_id, decision_id, justification);
    res.json({ success: true, baseline_entry: entry });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const isConflict = err.message?.includes('STALE') || err.message?.includes('CONFLICT');
    res.status(isConflict ? 412 : 400).json({
      success: false,
      error: err.message,
      code: isConflict ? 'STALE_DEPENDENCY' : 'INVALID_CONTRACT'
    });
  }
});

import { ReleaseGateService } from '../releaseGates/releaseGateService';
import {
  listReleaseGateRecords,
  getReleaseGateRecordById,
  listReleaseGateEvents,
  listReleaseEvidenceRecords,
  getReleaseEvidenceRecordById,
  listOwnerDecisionRecords
} from '../db/db';

function isReleaseGovernanceAuthorized(req: Request): boolean {
  const secretHeader = (req.headers['x-release-governance-secret'] as string)
    || (req.headers['x-operator-secret'] as string)
    || req.body?.release_governance_secret
    || req.body?.operator_secret;
  if (!secretHeader || typeof secretHeader !== 'string' || secretHeader.trim().length === 0) {
    return false;
  }
  const token = secretHeader.trim();
  const configuredSecret = (process.env.RELEASE_GOVERNANCE_SECRET || process.env.OPERATOR_SECRET)?.trim();
  if (configuredSecret && token === configuredSecret) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

apiRouter.get('/sessions/:id/advanced-analysis', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const sessionId = String(req.params.id);
    const windowId = typeof req.query.windowId === 'string' ? req.query.windowId : undefined;

    const contract = await AdvancedAnalysisContractService.buildContract(sessionId, windowId);
    const activeRevisions = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.getActiveRevisionsForSession(sessionId);
    const allRevisions = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.getAllRevisionsForSession(sessionId);
    const lifecycleEvents = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.getLifecycleEventsForSession(sessionId);

    res.json({
      success: true,
      sessionId,
      windowId: windowId || null,
      contract,
      activeRevisions,
      allRevisions,
      lifecycleEvents
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof AdvancedAnalysisContractError) {
      return res.status(err.statusCode).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message,
        code: err.code
      });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/sessions/:id/advanced-analysis/recompute', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const sessionId = String(req.params.id);
    const session = getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: `Session '${sessionId}' not found`,
        code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND'
      });
    }

    if (req.body?.windowId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Recompute of advanced analysis is supported strictly for whole-record sessions. Named Windows derive localized metrics synchronously.',
        code: 'WINDOW_RECOMPUTE_UNSUPPORTED'
      });
    }

    const { metricFamilies, triggerCause, immediate } = req.body || {};
    const families = Array.isArray(metricFamilies) && metricFamilies.length > 0
      ? metricFamilies
      : ['dfa', 'lomb_scargle', 'activity_segmentation'];
    const cause = (triggerCause as any) || 'manual_reanalysis_requested';
    const job = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.enqueueRecomputeJob(sessionId, families, cause);

    if (immediate && job.status === 'queued') {
      await AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.executeJob(job.job_id);
      const updatedJob = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.listRecomputeJobs().find(j => j.job_id === job.job_id);
      return res.json({ success: true, job: updatedJob || job, executed_immediate: true });
    }

    res.json({ success: true, job });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.get('/sessions/recompute-queue', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const statusFilter = req.query.status as string | undefined;
    const jobs = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.listRecomputeJobs(statusFilter);
    res.json({ success: true, jobs });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

apiRouter.post('/sessions/recompute-queue/:jobId/cancel', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const jobId = String(req.params.jobId);
    const cancelled = AdvancedAnalysisLifecycleService.cancelJob(jobId);
    if (!cancelled) {
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Job not found or not in cancellable state (queued/running)' });
    }
    res.json({ success: true, jobId, cancelled: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

  }
});

// G4 Self-Service Work Episodes & Guided Intake Endpoints
// ============================================================================

// 1. Preflight
apiRouter.post(['/self-service/preflight', '/intake/guided/preflight', '/pilot/preflight'], (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { profile_id, files } = req.body || {};
    const task_intent = req.body?.task_intent || (req.path?.includes('pilot') || req.originalUrl?.includes('pilot') ? 'pilot_journey' : undefined);
    if (!profile_id) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'profile_id is required', code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS' });
    }
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    if (appSettingProfile && profile_id !== 'all' && appSettingProfile !== 'all' && profile_id !== appSettingProfile) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${appSettingProfile}' does not match asserted profile '${profile_id}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }
    if (profile_id !== 'all' && profile_id !== 'default') {
      const p = getUserProfile(profile_id);
      if (!p) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: `Profile '${profile_id}' not found`, code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' });
      }
    }
    const normalizedFiles = (files || []).map((f: any) => {
      let buf = f.buffer;
      if (typeof buf === 'string') {
        buf = Buffer.from(buf, 'base64');
      }
      return {
        ...f,
        buffer: buf
      };
    });
    const preflight = guidedIntakeService.runPreflight({
      profile_id,
      task_intent,
      files: normalizedFiles
    });
    res.json({ success: true, ...preflight, preflight });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof SecurityViolationError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Error running preflight' });
  }
});

// 2. Import
apiRouter.post(['/self-service/import', '/intake/guided/import', '/pilot/import'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { preflight_id, request_fingerprint, idempotency_key, target_episode_id } = req.body || {};
    if (!preflight_id || !request_fingerprint) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'preflight_id and request_fingerprint are required', code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS' });
    }
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    if (target_episode_id) {
      const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(target_episode_id);
      if (ep && appSettingProfile && ep.profile_id && appSettingProfile !== 'all' && ep.profile_id !== appSettingProfile) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          error: `Target episode '${target_episode_id}' belongs to '${ep.profile_id}', active profile is '${appSettingProfile}'`,
          code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
        });
      }
    }
    const result = await guidedIntakeService.executePreflightImport({
      preflight_id,
      request_fingerprint,
      idempotency_key,
      target_episode_id
    });
    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof StaleFingerprintError) {
      return res.status(412).json({
        error: err.message,
        code: 'PREFLIGHT_FINGERPRINT_STALE',
        current_fingerprint: err.currentFingerprint,
        expected_fingerprint: err.expectedFingerprint
      });
    }
    if (err instanceof PreflightExpiredError) {
      return res.status(410).json({ error: err.message, code: 'PREFLIGHT_EXPIRED' });
    }
    if (err instanceof SecurityViolationError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (err.message && err.message.includes('Idempotency conflict')) {
      return res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Error executing import' });
  }
});

// 9. Outcome Confirmation (Hardened to delegate to AthleteJourneyService.executeJourneyCommand)
apiRouter.post('/self-service/episodes/:episodeId/outcome', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { confirmation_id, confirmed_by, recipient_action, action, user_notes } = req.body || {};
    const episodeId = String(req.params.episodeId);
    const episode = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(episodeId);
    if (!episode) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Episode not found', code: 'EPISODE_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
    if (!episode.canonical_session_id) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Cannot confirm outcome on episode with no bound canonical session', code: 'SESSION_REQUIRED' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfile = req.body?.profile_id || episode.profile_id;

    if (activeProfileId && requestedProfile && requestedProfile !== 'all' && requestedProfile !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Profile '${requestedProfile}' does not match active profile '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const effectiveProfileId = requestedProfile || activeProfileId || episode.profile_id;
    if (episode.profile_id && effectiveProfileId && effectiveProfileId !== 'all' && episode.profile_id !== effectiveProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Episode '${episodeId}' belongs to '${episode.profile_id}', requested under '${effectiveProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const rawAction = action || recipient_action || 'store_in_personal_records';
    const decoded = decodeAndMigrateLegacyPilotAction(rawAction);
    if (!decoded) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: `[INVALID_ACTION_CODE] Invalid pilot downstream action '${rawAction}'. Must be one of: ${VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS.join(', ')}`,
        code: 'INVALID_ACTION_CODE'
      });
    }

    // Locate primary completed artifact for this session & episode if not explicitly given
    let artifactId = req.body?.artifact_id;
    if (!artifactId) {
      const db = getDb();
      const artRow = db.prepare(`
        SELECT manifest_id FROM export_artifact_manifests
        WHERE session_id = ? AND status = 'completed'
        ORDER BY generated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
      `).get(episode.canonical_session_id) as any;
      artifactId = artRow?.manifest_id;
    }

    if (!artifactId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: `[ARTIFACT_REQUIRED] Cannot confirm episode outcome before a primary completed artifact exists for session '${episode.canonical_session_id}'`,
        code: 'ARTIFACT_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    const selection = getAthleteJourneySelection(effectiveProfileId);
    const idempotencyKey = req.body?.idempotency_key ||
      `cmd-episode-outcome-${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profile_id: effectiveProfileId, episode_id: episodeId, artifact_id: artifactId, action: decoded.migrated_action, user_notes: user_notes || null })).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)}`;

    const result = await AthleteJourneyService.executeJourneyCommand({
      profile_id: effectiveProfileId,
      expected_revision: selection?.selection_revision ?? 1,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      command: {
        command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome',
        episode_id: episodeId,
        artifact_id: artifactId,
        selected_action: decoded.migrated_action,
        user_notes: user_notes || null
      }
    });

    const usefulConf = getUsefulConfirmation(episode.canonical_session_id);
    res.json({
      success: true,
      confirmation_id: usefulConf?.confirmation_id || confirmation_id || `conf-${episodeId}`,
      selection: result.selection,
      context: result.context
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const msg = err.message || 'Error confirming episode outcome';
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError || msg.includes('CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN')) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: msg, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError || msg.includes('not found') || msg.includes('NOT_FOUND')) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandConflictError || msg.includes('REVISION_CONFLICT') || msg.includes('conflict')) {
      return res.status(409).json({ error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'REVISION_CONFLICT' });
    }
    if (msg.includes('STALE_ARTIFACT') || msg.includes('ARTIFACT_STALE') || msg.includes('STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT')) {
      return res.status(412).json({ error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'PRECONDITION_FAILED' });
    }
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandValidationError || msg.includes('ARTIFACT_REQUIRED') || msg.includes('EPISODE_REQUIRED') || msg.includes('SESSION_REQUIRED')) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: msg });
  }
});

  }

// 3. Create Saved Longitudinal View / Progress Review
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/views', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { name, profile_id, normalized_query, metrics, display_preferences, selected_session_ids, window_references, user_notes } = req.body;
    if (!name || !profile_id || !normalized_query) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing required fields: name, profile_id, normalized_query' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && profile_id !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match asserted profile '${profile_id}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const effectiveQuery = {
      ...normalized_query,
      profile_id,
      selected_session_ids: selected_session_ids || normalized_query.selected_session_ids,
      window_references: window_references || normalized_query.window_references,
      user_notes: user_notes !== undefined ? user_notes : normalized_query.user_notes
    };

    // Build initial snapshot for the query
    const snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(effectiveQuery);

    const viewId = `view-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const savedView = validateSavedLongitudinalViewStrict({
      view_id: viewId,
      name,
      profile_id,
      normalized_query: snapshot.query,
      metrics: metrics || ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
      display_preferences: display_preferences || {},
      current_snapshot_id: snapshot.snapshot_id,
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      is_retired: false,
      selected_session_ids: effectiveQuery.selected_session_ids,
      window_references: effectiveQuery.window_references,
      user_notes: effectiveQuery.user_notes,
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now
    });

    createSavedLongitudinalView(savedView);
    res.json({ success: true, view: savedView, snapshot });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  }
});

      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'VIEW_NOT_FOUND' });

    }
  }
});

// 4.4. Query Review Collections
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/library/collections/query', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.body?.profile_id || activeProfileId || 'default').trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const result = LongitudinalService.queryReviewCollections(requestedProfileId, req.body);
    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      if (err.code === 'INVALID_CURSOR') {
        res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
      } else {
        res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
      }
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Internal error in review collections query' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.5. Get Review Collection Details with Member Cards
apiRouter.get('/longitudinal/library/collections/:collectionId', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.query?.profile_id as string || activeProfileId || 'default').trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const collectionId = String(req.params.collectionId);
    const result = LongitudinalService.getReviewCollectionDetail(requestedProfileId, collectionId);
    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CollectionNotFoundError) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError || err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Internal error in review collection detail' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.6. Create Review Collection
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/library/collections/create', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.body?.profile_id || activeProfileId || 'default').trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const isCached = req.body?.idempotency_key && Boolean(getReviewCollectionIdempotency(requestedProfileId, req.body.idempotency_key));
    const result = LongitudinalService.createReviewCollection(requestedProfileId, req.body);
    res.status(isCached ? 200 : 201).json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError || err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof IdempotencyPayloadConflictError) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', idempotency_key: err.idempotencyKey });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to create review collection' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.13. Export Collection Comparison (wi-61673b72d8014f1aaa4de245a25a0055)
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/library/collections/:collectionId/comparison/export', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.body?.profile_id || activeProfileId || 'default').trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    validateCollectionComparisonExportRequestStrict(req.body);

    const collectionId = String(req.params.collectionId);
    const exportResult = await CollectionComparisonService.executeExport(
      collectionId,
      requestedProfileId,
      req.body
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, export_result: exportResult });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CollectionComparisonConflictError) {
      res.status(409).json({
        error: err.message,
        code: err.code || 'COMPARISON_DRIFT_CONFLICT',
        details: err.details
      });
    } else if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError || err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof CollectionNotFoundError) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to execute collection comparison export' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.14. Download Collection Comparison Export Artifact (wi-61673b72d8014f1aaa4de245a25a0055, packet_h10_collection_report_archive_20261009T174005Z)
apiRouter.get('/longitudinal/library/collections/:collectionId/comparison/export/:manifestId/download', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.query?.profile_id as string || activeProfileId || 'default').trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const collectionId = String(req.params.collectionId);
    const manifestId = String(req.params.manifestId);

    const downloadInfo = await CollectionComparisonService.verifyAndPrepareDownload(
      collectionId,
      requestedProfileId,
      manifestId
    );

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', downloadInfo.contentType);
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${downloadInfo.filename}"`);
    res.setHeader('Content-Length', downloadInfo.sizeBytes);
    res.setHeader('ETag', downloadInfo.sha256);
    fs.createReadStream(downloadInfo.filePath).pipe(res);
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError || err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof CollectionNotFoundError) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (err instanceof CollectionComparisonConflictError) {
      if (err.code === 'ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE') {
        res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
      } else if (err.code === 'INTEGRITY_FAILED') {
        res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code, details: err.details });
      } else {
        res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code, details: err.details });
      }
    } else if (err?.message && err.message.includes('not found')) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (err?.message && err.message.includes('Path traversal')) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: 'PATH_TRAVERSAL_REJECTED' });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to download collection comparison artifact' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.15. Query Collection Comparison Report Archive (packet_h10_collection_report_archive_20261009T174005Z)
apiRouter.get('/longitudinal/library/collections/:collectionId/comparison/reports', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;

      });
    }

    const collectionId = String(req.params.collectionId);
    const query = validateCollectionComparisonArchiveQueryStrict({
      profile_id: requestedProfileId,
      format: req.query.format,
      status: req.query.status,
      limit: req.query.limit !== undefined ? Number(req.query.limit) : undefined,
      cursor: req.query.cursor
    });

    const page = await CollectionComparisonService.queryReports(
      collectionId,
      requestedProfileId,
      query
    );

    res.json({ success: true, ...page });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError || err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof CollectionNotFoundError) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else if (err?.message && err.message.includes('not found')) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to query collection comparison reports' });
    }
  }
});

    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to download collection comparison report' });
    }
  }

// 4.22. Query Profile-Wide Report Reading Inbox (wi-6b7c0ad318964d3c80f87c90f58cdf16)
const handleReadingInboxQuery = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (
      (req.query?.profile_id as string) ||
      (req.body?.profile_id as string) ||
      (req.headers['x-active-profile-id'] as string) ||
      activeProfileId ||
      ''
    ).trim();

    if (!requestedProfileId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'profile_id is required for reading inbox query',
        code: 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID'
      });
    }

    if (requestedProfileId === 'all' || requestedProfileId === 'default') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: "Special profile IDs 'all' and 'default' are strictly prohibited",
        code: 'INVALID_PROFILE_ID'
      });
    }

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && activeProfileId !== 'default' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const rawQuery = {
      profile_id: requestedProfileId,
      reading_state: req.query?.reading_state || req.body?.reading_state,
      tag: req.query?.tag || req.body?.tag,
      collection_id: req.query?.collection_id || req.body?.collection_id,
      format: req.query?.format || req.body?.format,
      status: req.query?.status || req.body?.status,
      from_date: req.query?.from_date || req.body?.from_date,
      to_date: req.query?.to_date || req.body?.to_date,
      search_term: req.query?.search_term || req.query?.search || req.body?.search_term || req.body?.search,
      limit: req.query?.limit || req.body?.limit,
      cursor: req.query?.cursor || req.body?.cursor
    };

    const validatedQuery = validateProfileReportReadingInboxQueryStrict(rawQuery);

    const page = await CollectionComparisonService.queryReadingInbox(
      requestedProfileId,
      validatedQuery
    );

    res.json({ success: true, ...page });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError || err instanceof CollectionForbiddenError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else if (err?.code === 'STALE_CURSOR_CONFLICT' || err?.message?.includes('cursor')) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: 'STALE_CURSOR_CONFLICT' });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to query report reading inbox' });
    }
  }
};

apiRouter.get('/longitudinal/library/reading-inbox', handleReadingInboxQuery);
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/library/reading-inbox', handleReadingInboxQuery);

    res.json({ success: true, links });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else if (err?.message && (err.message.includes('not found') || err.message.includes('NOT_FOUND'))) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to get links for slot' });
    }
  }
});

// 4.29. List Links for Profile
apiRouter.get('/longitudinal/library/checkin-links', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (
      (req.query?.profile_id as string) ||
      (req.headers['x-active-profile-id'] as string) ||
      activeProfileId ||
      ''
    ).trim();

    if (!requestedProfileId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'profile_id is required', code: 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID' });
    }
    if (requestedProfileId === 'all' || requestedProfileId === 'default') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Special profile IDs 'all' and 'default' are strictly prohibited", code: 'INVALID_PROFILE_ID' });
    }
    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && activeProfileId !== 'default' && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: `Active profile '${activeProfileId}' does not match requested profile '${requestedProfileId}'`, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }

    const status = req.query?.status as string | undefined;
    const limit = req.query?.limit ? parseInt(String(req.query.limit), 10) : undefined;

    const links = await ReportCheckInLinkService.listLinksForProfile(requestedProfileId, { status, limit });
    res.json({ success: true, links });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof LongitudinalValidationError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to list report check-in links' });
    }
  }
});
