// 6. Update Saved View (with Optimistic Concurrency Check)
apiRouter.put('/longitudinal/views/:viewId', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const viewId = String(req.params.viewId);
    const existing = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
    if (!existing) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: `Saved view '${viewId}' not found`, code: 'VIEW_NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && existing.profile_id !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Saved view '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${existing.profile_id}', active profile is '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const { expected_revision, name, normalized_query, metrics, display_preferences, is_retired, selected_session_ids, window_references, user_notes } = req.body;

    if (typeof expected_revision !== 'number') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'expected_revision is required for optimistic concurrency check' });
    }

    let nextSnapshotId: string | undefined = undefined;
    let newSnapshot: any = null;

    const effectiveQuery = normalized_query ? {
      ...normalized_query,
      profile_id: existing.profile_id,
      selected_session_ids: selected_session_ids !== undefined ? selected_session_ids : normalized_query.selected_session_ids,
      window_references: window_references !== undefined ? window_references : normalized_query.window_references,
      user_notes: user_notes !== undefined ? user_notes : normalized_query.user_notes
    } : undefined;

    if (effectiveQuery) {
      newSnapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(effectiveQuery);
      nextSnapshotId = newSnapshot.snapshot_id;
    }

    const updatedView = updateSavedLongitudinalView(
      viewId,
      expected_revision,
      {
        name,
        normalized_query: effectiveQuery,
        metrics,
        display_preferences,
        current_snapshot_id: nextSnapshotId,
        is_retired,
        selected_session_ids,
        window_references,
        user_notes
      },
      req.body
    );

    res.json({ success: true, view: updatedView, snapshot: newSnapshot });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof ViewRevisionConflictError) {
      res.status(409).json({
        error: err.message,
        code: 'VIEW_REVISION_CONFLICT',
        authoritative_view: err.authoritativeView,
        expected_revision: err.expectedRevision,
        current_revision: err.currentRevision,
        draft_history_id: err.draftHistoryId
      });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  }
});

// 11. Progress Review Report Export Endpoint
apiRouter.post('/longitudinal/views/:viewId/report-export', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const viewId = String(req.params.viewId);
    const existing = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
    if (!existing) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: `Saved view '${viewId}' not found`, code: 'VIEW_NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;
    const requestedProfileId = (req.body?.profile_id || activeProfileId || existing.profile_id).trim();

    if (activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'all' && (existing.profile_id !== activeProfileId || requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId)) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        error: `Saved view '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${existing.profile_id}', active profile is '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const { format, expected_view_revision, expected_dependency_hash, privacy_options, idempotency_key } = req.body || {};
    if (!format || !['html', 'csv', 'json'].includes(format)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: `Valid format ('html' | 'csv' | 'json') is required.`, code: 'INVALID_FORMAT' });
    }
    if (typeof expected_view_revision !== 'number') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: `expected_view_revision is required.`, code: 'REVISION_REQUIRED' });
    }

    const result = await ProgressReviewReportService.executeReportExport(viewId, requestedProfileId, {
      view_id: viewId,
      format,
      expected_view_revision,
      expected_dependency_hash,
      privacy_options,
      idempotency_key
    });

    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileAccessError) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    } else if (err instanceof ProgressReportConflictError) {
      res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    } else {
      res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
    }
  }
});

// ============================================================================
// G18 Authoritative Single Athlete Core Journey & Workspace Snapshot Endpoints
// ============================================================================

function checkJourneyQueryOverrides(req: Request, res: Response): boolean {
  for (const key of Object.keys(req.query)) {
    const norm = key.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_]/g, '');
    if (!['profileid', 'userid', '', 't', 'timestamp'].includes(norm)) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: `Query override parameter '${key}' is forbidden on authoritative journey endpoints. Use POST /journey/command to commit selection state.`,
        code: 'OVERRIDE_QUERY_FORBIDDEN'
      });
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// 1. Get Authoritative Athlete Workspace Snapshot
apiRouter.get('/journey/snapshot', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (checkJourneyQueryOverrides(req, res)) return;

    const rawProfileId = req.query.profile_id || req.query.user_id || req.query.userId;
    const profileId = typeof rawProfileId === 'string' ? rawProfileId.trim() : null;

    const snapshot = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveWorkspaceSnapshot(profileId);
    res.json({ success: true, snapshot });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: (err as any).code || 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 2. Get Authoritative Journey Context
apiRouter.get(['/journey/context', '/context/journey'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (checkJourneyQueryOverrides(req, res)) return;

    const rawProfileId = req.query.profile_id || req.query.user_id || req.query.userId;
    const profileId = typeof rawProfileId === 'string' ? rawProfileId.trim() : null;

    if (!profileId || profileId === 'unresolved') {
      const unresolved = createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
      return res.json({ success: true, context: unresolved });
    }

    const snapshot = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveWorkspaceSnapshot(profileId);
    res.json({ success: true, context: snapshot.context });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: (err as any).code || 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 3. Execute Authoritative Journey Command
apiRouter.post('/journey/command', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const result = await AthleteJourneyService.executeJourneyCommand(req.body);
    res.json({ success: true, selection: result.selection, context: result.context });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandValidationError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: (err as any).code || 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandConflictError) {
      return res.status(409).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof ReadOnlyMutationError) {
      return res.status(422).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 5. Get Authoritative One-Recording Pilot Projection (CardioLab G39, G42, G43)
apiRouter.get(['/journey/pilot', '/pilot/projection'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (checkJourneyQueryOverrides(req, res)) return;

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;

    if (!activeProfileId || activeProfileId === 'unresolved') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '[ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED] Active profile is required and could not be resolved',
        code: 'ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    const rawProfileId = req.query.profile_id || req.query.user_id || req.query.userId;
    const assertedProfileId = typeof rawProfileId === 'string' ? rawProfileId.trim() : null;

    if (assertedProfileId === 'unresolved') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '[ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED] Active profile is required and could not be resolved',
        code: 'ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    if (assertedProfileId && assertedProfileId !== 'all' && assertedProfileId !== 'unresolved') {
      const p = getUserProfile(assertedProfileId);
      if (!p) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: `Profile '${assertedProfileId}' not found`, code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' });
      }
    }

    if (assertedProfileId && assertedProfileId !== 'all' && assertedProfileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Asserted profile '${assertedProfileId}' does not match active profile '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    const profileId = activeProfileId;
    const p = getUserProfile(profileId);
    if (!p) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: `Profile '${profileId}' not found`, code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    const projection = await AthleteJourneyService.resolvePilotProjection(profileId);
    res.json({ success: true, projection });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: err.message, code: err.code });
    }
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message, code: (err as any).code || 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 6. Generate Primary Reproducible Pilot Report (CardioLab G39, G41, G42, G43)
apiRouter.post('/pilot/report', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    let { sessionId, profileId, contextType, windowRootId, windowRevision } = req.body || {};
    if (!sessionId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'sessionId is required', code: 'MISSING_PARAMETERS' });
    }

    const sess = getSession(sessionId);
    if (!sess) {
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `[SESSION_NOT_FOUND] Session '${sessionId}' not found`, code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;

    if (!activeProfileId || activeProfileId === 'unresolved') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '[ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED] Active profile is required and could not be resolved',
        code: 'ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    if (profileId && profileId !== 'all' && profileId !== 'unresolved') {
      const p = getUserProfile(profileId);
      if (!p) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `Profile '${profileId}' not found`, code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' });
      }
    }

    if (profileId && profileId !== 'all' && profileId !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Asserted profile '${profileId}' does not match active profile '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    profileId = activeProfileId;

    if (sess.user_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && sess.user_id !== profileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Session '${sessionId}' belongs to '${sess.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    let effectiveEpisodeId: string | null = req.body?.episodeId || req.body?.episode_id || null;
    if (!effectiveEpisodeId && sessionId) {
      const boundEps = getDb().prepare("SELECT episode_id FROM self_service_episodes WHERE canonical_session_id = ? AND profile_id = ?").all(sessionId, profileId) as any[];
      if (boundEps.length === 1) {
        effectiveEpisodeId = boundEps[0].episode_id;
      } else if (boundEps.length > 1) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: '[AMBIGUOUS_EPISODE_BINDING] Multiple episodes bound to session; explicit episodeId is required',
          code: 'EPISODE_REQUIRED'
        });
      }
    }
    if (!effectiveEpisodeId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '[EPISODE_REQUIRED] episodeId is required for pilot report generation',
        code: 'EPISODE_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(effectiveEpisodeId);
    if (!ep) {
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `[EPISODE_NOT_FOUND] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' not found`, code: 'EPISODE_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
    if (ep.profile_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && ep.profile_id !== profileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' belongs to '${ep.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (ep.canonical_session_id && ep.canonical_session_id !== sessionId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: `[EPISODE_SESSION_MISMATCH] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' is bound to session '${ep.canonical_session_id}', not '${sessionId}'`, code: 'EPISODE_SESSION_MISMATCH' });
    }

    // G55-EXPORT-007: Strictly queue-only route. Always queues and returns immediate queue contract.
    const queued = await PilotReportGenerator.queueReport({
      sessionId,
      profileId: profileId || 'default',
      episodeId: effectiveEpisodeId,
      contextType,
      windowRootId,
      windowRevision
    });
    return res.json({
      success: true,
      status: 'queued',
      job_id: queued.job_id,
      plan_id: queued.plan_id,
      manifest_id: queued.manifest_id,
      file_display_name: queued.file_display_name,
      authoritative_fingerprint: queued.authoritative_fingerprint,
      report: {
        manifest_id: queued.manifest_id,
        plan_id: queued.plan_id,
        job_id: queued.job_id,
        status: 'queued',
        file_display_name: queued.file_display_name
      }
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const msg = err.message || 'Error generating pilot report';
    if (msg.includes('CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN') || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError) {
      return res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (msg.includes('not found') || msg.includes('WINDOW_NOT_FOUND') || msg.includes('SESSION_NOT_FOUND') || err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError) {
      const code = msg.includes('Named window') ? 'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND' : 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND';
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: msg, code });
    }
    if (msg.includes('WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING')) {
      return res.status(422).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING' });
    }
    if (msg.includes('required')) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'PILOT_REPORT_ERROR' });
  }
});

// 7. Pilot Outcome Confirmation (CardioLab G39, G41, G50, G51, G52-API-009)
apiRouter.post(['/pilot/confirm', '/journey/pilot/confirm'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { profile_id, episode_id, artifact_id, action, user_notes } = req.body || {};
    if (!profile_id || !episode_id || !artifact_id) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'profile_id, episode_id, and artifact_id are required', code: 'MISSING_PARAMETERS' });
    }

    const appSettingProfile = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id');
    const activeProfileId = (appSettingProfile && appSettingProfile.trim() !== '') ? appSettingProfile.trim() : null;

    if (!activeProfileId || activeProfileId === 'unresolved') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: '[ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED] Active profile is required and could not be resolved',
        code: 'ACTIVE_PROFILE_REQUIRED'
      });
    }

    if (profile_id && profile_id !== 'all' && profile_id !== 'unresolved') {
      const p = getUserProfile(profile_id);
      if (!p) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: `Profile '${profile_id}' not found`, code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' });
      }
    }

    if (profile_id && profile_id !== 'all' && profile_id !== activeProfileId) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Asserted profile '${profile_id}' does not match active profile '${activeProfileId}'`,
        code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN'
      });
    }

    let effectiveAction = 'store_in_personal_records';
    if (action) {
      const decoded = decodeAndMigrateLegacyPilotAction(action);
      if (!decoded) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: `[INVALID_ACTION_CODE] Invalid pilot downstream action '${action}'. Must be one of: ${VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS.join(', ')}`,
          code: 'INVALID_ACTION_CODE'
        });
      }
      effectiveAction = decoded.migrated_action;
    }

    const idempotencyKey = req.body?.idempotency_key ||
      `cmd-pilot-confirm-${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profile_id, episode_id, artifact_id, action: effectiveAction, user_notes: user_notes || null })).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)}`;

    const selection = getAthleteJourneySelection(profile_id);
    const result = await AthleteJourneyService.executeJourneyCommand({
      profile_id,
      expected_revision: selection?.selection_revision ?? 1,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      command: {
        command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome',
        episode_id,
        artifact_id,
        selected_action: effectiveAction,
        user_notes
      }
    });
    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    const msg = err.message || 'Error confirming pilot outcome';
    if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError || err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyError || msg.includes('CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN')) {
      return res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
    }
    if (err instanceof ResourceNotFoundError || msg.includes('not found') || msg.includes('NOT_FOUND')) {
      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND' });
    }
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandConflictError || msg.includes('REVISION_CONFLICT') || msg.includes('conflict')) {
      return res.status(409).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'REVISION_CONFLICT' });
    }
    if (msg.includes('STALE_ARTIFACT') || msg.includes('ARTIFACT_STALE') || msg.includes('STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT')) {
      return res.status(412).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'PRECONDITION_FAILED' });
    }
    if (err instanceof JourneyCommandValidationError || msg.includes('ARTIFACT_REQUIRED') || msg.includes('EPISODE_REQUIRED') || msg.includes('SESSION_REQUIRED')) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: (err as any).code || 'VALIDATION_ERROR' });
    }
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: msg, code: 'PILOT_CONFIRM_ERROR' });
  }
});

    };
    const history = queryExportHistory(filter);
    res.json({
      success: true,
      total: history.total_count,
      total_count: history.total_count,
      page: history.page,
      pageSize: history.page_size,
      page_size: history.page_size,
      total_pages: history.total_pages,
      artifacts: history.rows,
      rows: history.rows
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 10. Download Export Artifact
apiRouter.get('/export/artifacts/:id/download', (req: ReqParam<{ id: string }>, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const manifest = getExportArtifactManifest(req.params.id);
    if (!manifest) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Artifact manifest not found', code: 'ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND' });
    }

    const filePath = manifest.published_path && fs.existsSync(manifest.published_path)
      ? manifest.published_path
      : manifest.staging_path;

    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      return res.status(410).json({ error: 'Artifact file is missing or expired on disk', code: 'ARTIFACT_EXPIRED' });
    }

    let contentType = 'application/octet-stream';
    if (manifest.format === 'metrics_csv' || manifest.format === 'rr_csv') {
      contentType = 'text/csv; charset=utf-8';
    } else if (manifest.format === 'pdf') {
      contentType = 'application/pdf';
    } else if (manifest.format === 'html') {
      contentType = 'text/html; charset=utf-8';
    } else if (manifest.format === 'consultation_bundle' || manifest.format === 'ai_pack') {
      contentType = 'application/zip';
    }

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', contentType);
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${manifest.filename}"`);
    res.setHeader('Content-Length', manifest.size_bytes);

    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.pipe(res);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 3. Relink Moved Source File
apiRouter.post(['/workspace/recovery/relink-source', '/api/workspace/recovery/relink-source'], (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const body = req.body || {};
    const sessionId = body.session_id || body.sessionId;
    const targetPath = body.target_file_path || body.new_verified_path || body.newVerifiedPath;
    if (!sessionId || !targetPath) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'session_id and target_file_path are required', code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS' });
    }
    const result = recoveryCenterService.relinkMovedSource(body);
    if (!result.success && result.code === 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN') {
      return res.status(403).json(result);
    }
    if (!result.success && result.code === 'HASH_MISMATCH') {
      return res.status(409).json(result);
    }
    if (!result.success && (result.code === 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND' || result.code === 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND')) {
      return res.status(404).json(result);
    }
    res.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// 21. Get Profile Check-in Agenda across all plans (wi-3512f5ed2cd64d63ad0582efaaaa83f5)
apiRouter.get(
  ['/checkin/agenda', '/api/checkin/agenda'],
  (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const requestedProfileId = (req.query?.profile_id as string) || (req.query?.profileId as string) || undefined;
      const activeProfileId = getAppSetting('active_profile_id') || getAppSetting('active_user_id') || 'default';
      const profileId = (requestedProfileId && requestedProfileId !== 'default') ? requestedProfileId : activeProfileId;

      if (requestedProfileId && requestedProfileId !== 'default' && activeProfileId && requestedProfileId !== activeProfileId && activeProfileId !== 'default') {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Запрос к повестке профиля ${requestedProfileId} запрещен (активен ${activeProfileId})`);
      }
      const fromDate = (req.query?.from_date as string) || (req.query?.fromDate as string) || undefined;
      const toDate = (req.query?.to_date as string) || (req.query?.toDate as string) || undefined;
      const statusFilter = (req.query?.status_filter as any) || (req.query?.statusFilter as any) || (req.query?.status as any) || undefined;
      const planId = (req.query?.plan_id as string) || (req.query?.planId as string) || undefined;
      const includeRetired = req.query?.include_retired === 'true' || req.query?.includeRetired === 'true';
      const limit = req.query?.limit ? Number(req.query.limit) : undefined;
      const cursor = (req.query?.cursor as string) || undefined;

      const agenda = athleteCheckInService.getProfileAgenda(profileId, {
        profile_id: profileId,
        from_date: fromDate,
        to_date: toDate,
        status_filter: statusFilter,
        plan_id: planId,
        include_retired: includeRetired,
        limit,
        cursor
      });
      res.json({ success: true, ...agenda });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err instanceof CheckInCrossProfileError) {
        return res.status(403).json({ success: false, error: err.message, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN' });
      }
      if (err instanceof CheckInValidationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: err.message, code: 'CHECKIN_VALIDATION_ERROR' });
      }
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
    }
  }
);

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getAppDataDir, getRawLogsDir, getCorruptedLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import { VERSION_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/versionContract';
import {
  WORKSPACE_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  WORKSPACE_BACKUP_PROJECT_ID,
  WorkspaceBackupManifest,
  BackupManifestMember,
  ExternalSourceReference,
  WorkspaceDataSummary,
  validateSafeZipMemberPath
} from '../../shared/workspaceBackupContract';

const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');

export interface CreateBackupOptions {
  destinationPath?: string;
  includeQuarantine?: boolean;
}

export interface CreateBackupResult {
  success?: boolean;
  backupPath: string;
  backupFilePath?: string;
  sha256: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  manifest: WorkspaceBackupManifest;
}

export class WorkspaceBackupService {
  private static instance: WorkspaceBackupService;

  public static getInstance(): WorkspaceBackupService {
    if (!WorkspaceBackupService.instance) {
      WorkspaceBackupService.instance = new WorkspaceBackupService();
    }
    return WorkspaceBackupService.instance;
  }

  public async inspectBackup(backupZipPath: string): Promise<any> {
    const { workspaceRestoreService } = await import('./WorkspaceRestoreService');
    const res = await workspaceRestoreService.inspectBackup(backupZipPath);
    const hasDb = res.manifest?.members ? res.manifest.members.some(m => m.category === 'database') : true;
    return {
      ...res,
      manifest: res.manifest ? {
        ...res.manifest,
        databaseIncluded: hasDb
      } : { databaseIncluded: hasDb }
    };
  }

  public getBackupsDir(): string {
    const dir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'backups');
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
    return dir;
  }

  public computeFileSha256(filePath: string): string {
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    const buffer = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
    hash.update(buffer);
    return hash.digest('hex');
  }

  public computeBufferSha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Computes a deterministic revision hash representing the current live workspace data state.
   * Includes row counts, schema version, content update timestamps (annotations, windows, diary),
   * and raw log file size/mtime signatures to prevent stale content identity when row counts are unchanged.
   */
  public getCurrentWorkspaceRevision(): string {
    const db = getDb();
    try {
      const counts = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions) as sessions_cnt,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) as users_cnt,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_annotations) as annotations_cnt,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_named_windows) as windows_cnt,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_diary) as diary_cnt,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advanced_analysis_revisions) as adv_revisions_cnt,
          (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM sessions) as max_session_time,
          (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM users) as max_user_time,
          (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM session_annotations) as max_annotation_time,
          (SELECT MAX(imported_at) FROM llm_diary) as max_diary_time,
          (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM session_named_windows) as max_window_time,
          (SELECT TOTAL(revision) FROM session_named_windows) as sum_window_revisions,
          (SELECT MAX(created_at_utc) FROM advanced_analysis_revisions) as max_adv_revisions_time
      `).get() as any;

      const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
      const rawLogsSignatures: string[] = [];
      if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir).sort();
        for (const file of rawFiles) {
          try {
            const filePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, file);
            const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
            if (stat.isFile()) {
              rawLogsSignatures.push(`${file}:${stat.size}:${Math.floor(stat.mtimeMs)}`);
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      const input = JSON.stringify({
        counts,
        rawLogsSignatures,
        rawLogsCount: rawLogsSignatures.length,
        dbSchema: VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version
      });

      return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(input).digest('hex');
    } catch (err) {
      return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`fallback_${Date.now()}`).digest('hex');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generates a complete, integrity-checked workspace backup archive.
   */
  public async createBackup(options: CreateBackupOptions = {}): Promise<CreateBackupResult> {
    const backupsDir = this.getBackupsDir();
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const defaultFilename = `cardiolab_workspace_backup_${timestamp}.zip`;
    const targetPath = options.destinationPath ? path.resolve(options.destinationPath) : path.join(backupsDir, defaultFilename);

    // Guard: target directory must exist
    const targetDir = path.dirname(targetPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    // Guard: reject if destination already exists
    if (fs.existsSync(targetPath)) {
      throw new Error(`BACKUP_DESTINATION_EXISTS: Destination already exists: ${targetPath}`);
    }

    const stagingId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const stagingDir = path.join(backupsDir, `.staging_backup_${stagingId}`);
    const stagingZipPath = path.join(backupsDir, `.staging_archive_${stagingId}.tmp`);
    fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });

    logger.info('backup', `Starting workspace backup creation: ${targetPath}`);

    try {
      const db = getDb();

      // 1. Quiesce database writes and checkpoint WAL
      try {
        db.exec('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);');
      } catch (e: any) {
        logger.warn('backup', `WAL truncate warning: ${e.message}`);
      }

      // 2. Create verified database snapshot in staging
      const stagedDbPath = path.join(stagingDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
      db.backup(stagedDbPath);

      // Verify staged database integrity
      const stagedDbSha256 = this.computeFileSha256(stagedDbPath);
      const stagedDbSize = fs.statSync(stagedDbPath).size;

      const members: BackupManifestMember[] = [
        {
          path: 'cardio_lab.db',
          sha256: stagedDbSha256,
          size_bytes: stagedDbSize,
          category: 'database'
        }
      ];

      // 3. Collect app-owned raw_logs files
      const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
      let rawLogsCount = 0;
      if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
        for (const file of rawFiles) {
          const filePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, file);
          const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
          if (stat.isFile()) {
            const memberRelPath = `raw_logs/${file}`;
            validateSafeZipMemberPath(memberRelPath);
            const sha256 = this.computeFileSha256(filePath);
            members.push({
              path: memberRelPath,
              sha256,
              size_bytes: stat.size,
              category: 'raw_logs'
            });
            rawLogsCount++;
          }
        }
      }

      // 4. Optional quarantine files
      let quarantineCount = 0;
      if (options.includeQuarantine) {
        const corruptDir = getCorruptedLogsDir();
        if (fs.existsSync(corruptDir)) {
          const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(corruptDir);
          for (const file of corruptFiles) {
            const filePath = path.join(corruptDir, file);
            const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
            if (stat.isFile()) {
              const memberRelPath = `corrupted/${file}`;
              validateSafeZipMemberPath(memberRelPath);
              const sha256 = this.computeFileSha256(filePath);
              members.push({
                path: memberRelPath,
                sha256,
                size_bytes: stat.size,
                category: 'quarantine'
              });
              quarantineCount++;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 5. Query external source folder references
      const externalReferences: ExternalSourceReference[] = [];
      try {
        const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM external_sync_folders').all() as any[];
        for (const r of rows) {
          externalReferences.push({
            id: String(r.id),
            folder_path: String(r.folder_path),
            label: r.label ? String(r.label) : null,
            is_active: Boolean(r.is_active),
            last_scan_utc: r.last_scan_utc ? String(r.last_scan_utc) : null,
            status: String(r.status || 'idle')
          });
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        logger.warn('backup', `Failed to read external_sync_folders: ${e.message}`);
      }

      // 6. Assemble Data Summary
      const summary: WorkspaceDataSummary = {
        sessions_count: 0,
        users_count: 0,
        annotations_count: 0,
        named_windows_count: 0,
        diary_records_count: 0,
        ingested_files_count: 0,
        external_sources_count: externalReferences.length
      };

      try {
        const counts = db.prepare(`
          SELECT 
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions) as sessions_cnt,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) as users_cnt,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_annotations) as annotations_cnt,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_named_windows) as windows_cnt,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_diary) as diary_cnt,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ingested_files) as ingested_cnt
        `).get() as any;

        if (counts) {
          summary.sessions_count = Number(counts.sessions_cnt || 0);
          summary.users_count = Number(counts.users_cnt || 0);
          summary.annotations_count = Number(counts.annotations_cnt || 0);
          summary.named_windows_count = Number(counts.windows_cnt || 0);
          summary.diary_records_count = Number(counts.diary_cnt || 0);
          summary.ingested_files_count = Number(counts.ingested_cnt || 0);
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        logger.warn('backup', `Failed to read data summary: ${e.message}`);
      }

      // 7. Assemble Manifest
      const manifest: WorkspaceBackupManifest = {
        $schema: 'https://cardiolab.app/schemas/workspace-backup-manifest-v1.json',
        schema_version: WORKSPACE_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        project_id: WORKSPACE_BACKUP_PROJECT_ID,
        created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        app_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.candidate_version,
        database_schema_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version,
        source_candidate_sha256: VERSION_CONTRACT.app_version,
        workspace_revision: this.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision(),
        privacy_notice: 'This backup contains sensitive local personal cardio and health data. It is stored exclusively on your local device and is never transmitted to cloud services.',
        member_counts: {
          database: 1,
          raw_logs: rawLogsCount,
          metadata: 1,
          quarantine: quarantineCount,
          total: members.length + 1 // +1 for manifest.json itself
        },
        members,
        external_references: externalReferences,
        data_summary: summary
      };

      // 8. Package ZIP archive
      const zip = new AdmZip();

      // Add manifest.json
      const manifestBuffer = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), 'utf8');
      zip.addFile('manifest.json', manifestBuffer);

      // Add database
      zip.addLocalFile(stagedDbPath, '');

      // Add raw_logs
      if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
        for (const file of rawFiles) {
          const filePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, file);
          if (fs.statSync(filePath).isFile()) {
            zip.addLocalFile(filePath, 'raw_logs');
          }
        }
      }

      // Add optional quarantine
      if (options.includeQuarantine) {
        const corruptDir = getCorruptedLogsDir();
        if (fs.existsSync(corruptDir)) {
          const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(corruptDir);
          for (const file of corruptFiles) {
            const filePath = path.join(corruptDir, file);
            if (fs.statSync(filePath).isFile()) {
              zip.addLocalFile(filePath, 'corrupted');
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Write staging zip
      zip.writeZip(stagingZipPath);

      // Verify staged zip file integrity
      const zipSize = fs.statSync(stagingZipPath).size;
      if (zipSize === 0) {
        throw new Error('CORRUPTED_BACKUP_ARCHIVE: Staged zip file is empty (0 bytes)');
      }
      const zipSha256 = this.computeFileSha256(stagingZipPath);

      // 9. Atomic rename to final target destination
      fs.renameSync(stagingZipPath, targetPath);

      logger.info('backup', `Workspace backup created successfully: ${targetPath} (${zipSize} bytes, SHA256: ${zipSha256})`);

      // 10. Automatic Retention Pruning (Keep max 3 most recent backups in default backupsDir)
      try {
        this.pruneOldBackups(backupsDir, 3);
      } catch (pruneErr: any) {
        logger.warn('backup', `Automatic backup retention warning: ${pruneErr?.message}`);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
        backupPath: targetPath,
        backupFilePath: targetPath,
        sha256: zipSha256,
        size_bytes: zipSize,
        manifest
      };
    } finally {
      // Clean up staging directory and temporary files
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(stagingZipPath)) {
          fs.unlinkSync(stagingZipPath);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
          fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * Prunes older workspace backup archives, keeping only the N most recent (FIFO).
   * Prevents uncontrolled disk bloat during repeated test runs or automated backups.
   */
  public pruneOldBackups(backupsDir: string = this.getBackupsDir(), keepCount: number = 3): number {
    if (!fs.existsSync(backupsDir)) return 0;
    try {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(backupsDir)
        .filter(f => f.startsWith('cardiolab_workspace_backup_') && f.endsWith('.zip'))
        .map(f => {
          const fullPath = path.join(backupsDir, f);
          const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
          return { fullPath, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs, size: stat.size };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);

      if (files.length <= keepCount) return 0;

      const toDelete = files.slice(keepCount);
      let prunedBytes = 0;
      for (const item of toDelete) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(item.fullPath);
          prunedBytes += item.size;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      logger.info('backup', `Pruned ${toDelete.length} old workspace backups (${Math.round(prunedBytes / (1024 * 1024))} MB reclaimed)`);
      return toDelete.length;
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.warn('backup', `pruneOldBackups error: ${err?.message}`);
      return 0;
    }
  }
}

export const workspaceBackupService = WorkspaceBackupService.getInstance();

FILE: src/backend/backup/WorkspaceRestoreService.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { DatabaseSync } from '../db/databaseAdapter';
import { getDb, closeDb, initDb, getAppDataDir, getRawLogsDir, getCorruptedLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import { VERSION_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/versionContract';
import {
  WORKSPACE_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  WORKSPACE_BACKUP_PROJECT_ID,
  MIN_SUPPORTED_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  MIN_SUPPORTED_DATABASE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  WorkspaceBackupManifest,
  BackupInspectionResult,
  RestoreExecutionResult,
  SafetySnapshotInfo,
  InspectedExternalSource,
  validateSafeZipMemberPath
} from '../../shared/workspaceBackupContract';
import { workspaceBackupService } from './WorkspaceBackupService';

const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');

interface StoredRestoreToken {
  token: string;
  archivePath: string;
  archiveSha256: string;
  currentRevision: string;
  expiresAt: number;
  manifest: WorkspaceBackupManifest;
}

export class WorkspaceRestoreService {
  private static instance: WorkspaceRestoreService;
  private activeTokens: Map<string, StoredRestoreToken> = new Map();
  private isRestoreInProgress = false;
  private _testFaultInjection: 'fail_during_swap' | 'fail_during_rollback' | null = null;

  public setTestFaultInjection(mode: 'fail_during_swap' | 'fail_during_rollback' | null): void {
    this._testFaultInjection = mode;
  }

  public static getInstance(): WorkspaceRestoreService {
    if (!WorkspaceRestoreService.instance) {
      WorkspaceRestoreService.instance = new WorkspaceRestoreService();
    }
    return WorkspaceRestoreService.instance;
  }

  public computeFileSha256(filePath: string): string {
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    const buffer = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
    hash.update(buffer);
    return hash.digest('hex');
  }

  public computeBufferSha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Creates an automatic, verified safety snapshot of the active application database.
   */
  public async createSafetySnapshot(): Promise<SafetySnapshotInfo> {
    const backupsDir = workspaceBackupService.getBackupsDir();
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const filename = `safety_snapshot_${timestamp}_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}.db`;
    const snapshotPath = path.join(backupsDir, filename);

    logger.info('backup', `Creating pre-restore safety snapshot: ${snapshotPath}`);

    const db = getDb();

    // Checkpoint WAL first
    try {
      db.exec('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);');
    } catch (e: any) {
      logger.warn('backup', `Safety snapshot WAL checkpoint warning: ${e.message}`);
    }

    // Perform serialized backup with verification
    db.backup(snapshotPath);

    const size = fs.statSync(snapshotPath).size;
    const sha256 = this.computeFileSha256(snapshotPath);

    // Verify snapshot integrity with independent connection
    const verifyDb = new DatabaseSync(snapshotPath);
    let integrityStatus: 'ok' | 'corrupted' = 'corrupted';
    try {
      const check = verifyDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
      if (check && check.integrity_check === 'ok') {
        integrityStatus = 'ok';
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Safety snapshot failed integrity check: ${check?.integrity_check}`);
      }
    } finally {
      verifyDb.close();
    }

    const info: SafetySnapshotInfo = {
      filename,
      filepath: snapshotPath,
      size_bytes: size,
      sha256,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      integrity_status: integrityStatus
    };

    logger.info('backup', `Safety snapshot verified successfully: ${snapshotPath} (${size} bytes, SHA256: ${sha256})`);

    // Automatic Retention Pruning (Keep max 3 most recent safety snapshots)
    try {
      this.pruneOldSafetySnapshots(backupsDir, 3);
    } catch (pruneErr: any) {
      logger.warn('backup', `Automatic safety snapshot retention warning: ${pruneErr?.message}`);
    }

    return info;
  }

  /**
   * Prunes older safety snapshot databases, keeping only the N most recent (FIFO).
   * Prevents uncontrolled disk bloat during repeated restore preflights or test runs.
   */
  public pruneOldSafetySnapshots(backupsDir: string = workspaceBackupService.getBackupsDir(), keepCount: number = 3): number {
    if (!fs.existsSync(backupsDir)) return 0;
    try {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(backupsDir)
        .filter(f => f.startsWith('safety_snapshot_') && f.endsWith('.db'))
        .map(f => {
          const fullPath = path.join(backupsDir, f);
          const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
          return { fullPath, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs, size: stat.size };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);

      if (files.length <= keepCount) return 0;

      const toDelete = files.slice(keepCount);
      let prunedBytes = 0;
      for (const item of toDelete) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(item.fullPath);
          prunedBytes += item.size;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      logger.info('backup', `Pruned ${toDelete.length} old safety snapshots (${Math.round(prunedBytes / (1024 * 1024))} MB reclaimed)`);
      return toDelete.length;
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.warn('backup', `pruneOldSafetySnapshots error: ${err?.message}`);
      return 0;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Lists all existing safety snapshots in the backups directory.
   */
  public listSafetySnapshots(): SafetySnapshotInfo[] {
    const backupsDir = workspaceBackupService.getBackupsDir();
    if (!fs.existsSync(backupsDir)) return [];

    const files = fs.readdirSync(backupsDir);
    const snapshots: SafetySnapshotInfo[] = [];

    for (const f of files) {
      if (f.startsWith('safety_snapshot_') && f.endsWith('.db')) {
        const fullPath = path.join(backupsDir, f);
        try {
          const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
          if (stat.isFile()) {
            snapshots.push({
              filename: f,
              filepath: fullPath,
              size_bytes: stat.size,
              sha256: this.computeFileSha256(fullPath),
              created_at_utc: stat.mtime.toISOString(),
              integrity_status: 'ok'
            });
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // Sort newest first
    snapshots.sort((a, b) => b.created_at_utc.localeCompare(a.created_at_utc));
    return snapshots;
  }

  /**
   * Performs read-only inspection and preflight verification of a candidate backup archive.
   * Does NOT alter any local workspace state.
   */
  public async inspectBackup(backupZipPath: string): Promise<BackupInspectionResult> {
    const resolvedPath = path.resolve(backupZipPath);

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {
      throw new Error(`BACKUP_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Backup archive not found: ${resolvedPath}`);
    }

    const stat = fs.statSync(resolvedPath);
    if (!stat.isFile()) {
      throw new Error(`NOT_A_FILE: Path is not a file: ${resolvedPath}`);
    }

    if (stat.size === 0) {
      throw new Error(`EMPTY_ARCHIVE: Backup file is empty (0 bytes): ${resolvedPath}`);
    }

    const archiveSha256 = this.computeFileSha256(resolvedPath);
    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const externalSources: InspectedExternalSource[] = [];

    let zip: any;
    try {
      zip = new AdmZip(resolvedPath);
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_ZIP_ARCHIVE: Could not read archive: ${err.message}`);
    }

    const entries = zip.getEntries();
    if (!entries || entries.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('CORRUPT_ARCHIVE: Zip archive contains no entries');
    }

    // 1. Anti-Zip-Slip and Path Traversal Inspection
    const entryMap = new Map<string, any>();
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.isDirectory) continue;
      const rawName = entry.entryName;

      try {
        const safeName = validateSafeZipMemberPath(rawName);
        if (entryMap.has(safeName)) {
          blockers.push(`DUPLICATE_MEMBER: Archive contains duplicate member "${safeName}"`);
        }
        entryMap.set(safeName, entry);
      } catch (traversalErr: any) {
        blockers.push(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: ${traversalErr.message}`);
      }
    }

    // If severe path traversal is detected, fail immediately
    if (blockers.some(b => b.startsWith('PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED'))) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        archive_path: resolvedPath,
        archive_sha256: archiveSha256,
        archive_size_bytes: stat.size,
        manifest: null,
        compatibility: 'incompatible',
        blockers,
        warnings,
        external_sources: [],
        restore_token: null,
        token_expires_at_utc: null,
        current_workspace_revision: workspaceBackupService.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision()
      };
    }

    // 2. Extract and Validate manifest.json
    const manifestEntry = entryMap.get('manifest.json');
    if (!manifestEntry) {
      blockers.push('MANIFEST_MISSING: Backup archive does not contain manifest.json');
      return {
        valid: false,
        archive_path: resolvedPath,
        archive_sha256: archiveSha256,
        archive_size_bytes: stat.size,
        manifest: null,
        compatibility: 'incompatible',
        blockers,
        warnings,
        external_sources: [],
        restore_token: null,
        token_expires_at_utc: null,
        current_workspace_revision: workspaceBackupService.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision()
      };
    }

    let manifest: WorkspaceBackupManifest;
    try {
      const manifestContent = manifestEntry.getData().toString('utf8');
      manifest = JSON.parse(manifestContent);
    } catch (jsonErr: any) {
      blockers.push(`MANIFEST_INVALID_JSON: Failed to parse manifest.json: ${jsonErr.message}`);
      return {
        valid: false,
        archive_path: resolvedPath,
        archive_sha256: archiveSha256,
        archive_size_bytes: stat.size,
        manifest: null,
        compatibility: 'incompatible',
        blockers,
        warnings,
        external_sources: [],
        restore_token: null,
        token_expires_at_utc: null,
        current_workspace_revision: workspaceBackupService.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision()
      };
    }

    // 3. Validate Project Identity
    if (manifest.project_id !== WORKSPACE_BACKUP_PROJECT_ID) {
      blockers.push(`PROJECT_ID_MISMATCH: Expected project "${WORKSPACE_BACKUP_PROJECT_ID}", found "${manifest.project_id}"`);
    }

    // 4. Validate Schema Versions
    const backupMajor = parseInt(manifest.schema_version?.split('.')[0] || '0', 10);
    const minBackupMajor = parseInt(MIN_SUPPORTED_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION.split('.')[0], 10);
    if (backupMajor < minBackupMajor) {
      blockers.push(`UNSUPPORTED_BACKUP_SCHEMA: Backup schema version ${manifest.schema_version} is older than minimum supported ${MIN_SUPPORTED_BACKUP_SCHEMA_VERSION}`);
    } else if (backupMajor > 1) {
      blockers.push(`NEWER_BACKUP_SCHEMA: Backup schema version ${manifest.schema_version} is newer than current supported version 1.x`);
    }

    let compatibility: 'compatible' | 'requires_migration' | 'incompatible' = 'compatible';
    const dbMajor = parseInt(manifest.database_schema_version?.split('.')[0] || '0', 10);
    const appDbMajor = parseInt(VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version.split('.')[0], 10);
    if (dbMajor > appDbMajor) {
      blockers.push(`NEWER_DATABASE_SCHEMA: Database schema ${manifest.database_schema_version} is newer than app version (${VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version})`);
      compatibility = 'incompatible';
    } else if (dbMajor < appDbMajor) {
      warnings.push(`База данных резервной копии (${manifest.database_schema_version}) требует автоматической миграции до текущей версии (${VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version}).`);
      compatibility = 'requires_migration';
    }

    // 5. Verify Member Hashes & Sizes
    if (!Array.isArray(manifest.members) || manifest.members.length === 0) {
      blockers.push('MEMBERS_EMPTY: Manifest contains no registered members');
    } else {
      let hasDbMember = false;
      for (const member of manifest.members) {
        if (member.path === 'cardio_lab.db') {
          hasDbMember = true;
        }

        const entry = entryMap.get(member.path);
        if (!entry) {
          blockers.push(`MISSING_MEMBER_FILE: Manifest member "${member.path}" is missing from the archive`);
          continue;
        }

        const data: Buffer = entry.getData();
        if (data.length !== member.size_bytes) {
          blockers.push(`MEMBER_SIZE_MISMATCH: Member "${member.path}" size mismatch (expected ${member.size_bytes}, got ${data.length})`);
        }

        const calculatedSha = this.computeBufferSha256(data);
        if (calculatedSha.toLowerCase() !== member.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
          blockers.push(`MEMBER_HASH_MISMATCH: Member "${member.path}" SHA-256 hash mismatch`);
        }
      }

      if (!hasDbMember) {
        blockers.push('DATABASE_MEMBER_MISSING: Mandatory member "cardio_lab.db" is not declared in manifest');
      }
    }

    // 6. Inspect Staged Database Integrity in Isolated Sandbox
    const dbEntry = entryMap.get('cardio_lab.db');
    if (dbEntry && blockers.length === 0) {
      const sandboxDir = path.join(workspaceBackupService.getBackupsDir(), `.inspect_sandbox_${crypto.randomUUID()}`);
      fs.mkdirSync(sandboxDir, { recursive: true });
      const sandboxDbPath = path.join(sandboxDir, 'inspect_test.db');

      try {
        fs.writeFileSync(sandboxDbPath, dbEntry.getData());
        const inspectDb = new DatabaseSync(sandboxDbPath);
        try {
          const check = inspectDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
          if (!check || check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
            blockers.push(`DATABASE_INTEGRITY_FAILED: SQLite integrity check failed: ${check?.integrity_check || 'unknown'}`);
          }
          // Invariant: Verify that backup contains at least one user profile (Audit Lead 2)
          let userCount = 0;
          try {
            const u = inspectDb.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM users;').get() as any;
            userCount = u?.c || 0;
          } catch (_) {}

          if (userCount === 0) {
            blockers.push('INCOMPATIBLE_ARCHIVE_NO_USERS: Backup archive contains no user profiles; cannot fabricate default user during restore');
            compatibility = 'incompatible';
          }
        } finally {
          inspectDb.close();
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        blockers.push(`DATABASE_OPEN_FAILED: Failed to open database snapshot: ${err.message}`);
      } finally {
        try {
          if (fs.existsSync(sandboxDbPath)) fs.unlinkSync(sandboxDbPath);
          if (fs.existsSync(sandboxDir)) fs.rmSync(sandboxDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 7. Inspect External Source Folder References
    if (Array.isArray(manifest.external_references)) {
      for (const ref of manifest.external_references) {
        const exists = fs.existsSync(ref.folder_path);
        const sourceInfo: InspectedExternalSource = {
          id: ref.id,
          folder_path: ref.folder_path,
          label: ref.label || null,
          exists_on_disk: exists,
          status: exists ? 'online' : 'missing'
        };
        externalSources.push(sourceInfo);

        if (!exists) {
          warnings.push(`Внешняя папка синхронизации "${ref.folder_path}" не найдена на этом компьютере. Все исторические сессии сохранены.`);
        }
      }
    }

    const currentRevision = workspaceBackupService.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision();
    const isValid = blockers.length === 0;

    // 8. Generate Compare-and-Swap (CAS) Restore Authorization Token
    let restoreToken: string | null = null;
    let tokenExpiresAt: string | null = null;

    if (isValid) {
      const tokenId = crypto.randomUUID();
      const expiresAtMs = Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes TTL
      restoreToken = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${archiveSha256}:${currentRevision}:${expiresAtMs}:${tokenId}`).digest('hex');
      tokenExpiresAt = new Date(expiresAtMs).toISOString();

      // Store in active tokens map
      this.activeTokens.set(restoreToken, {
        token: restoreToken,
        archivePath: resolvedPath,
        archiveSha256,
        currentRevision,
        expiresAt: expiresAtMs,
        manifest
      });
    }

    logger.info('backup', `Inspected backup: ${resolvedPath}. Valid: ${isValid}, Blockers: ${blockers.length}, Warnings: ${warnings.length}`);

    return {
      valid: isValid,
      archive_path: resolvedPath,
      archive_sha256: archiveSha256,
      archive_size_bytes: stat.size,
      manifest,
      compatibility: isValid ? compatibility : 'incompatible',
      blockers,
      warnings,
      external_sources: externalSources,
      data_summary: manifest.data_summary,
      restore_token: restoreToken,
      token_expires_at_utc: tokenExpiresAt,
      current_workspace_revision: currentRevision
    };
  }

  /**
   * Executes an atomic workspace restore from a preflighted backup archive.
   * Requires a valid, unexpired Compare-and-Swap token from inspectBackup().
   * Automatically creates a verified safety snapshot before replacing live data.
   * Automatically rolls back to the safety snapshot on ANY error.
   */
  public async restoreWorkspace(backupZipPath: string, restoreToken: string): Promise<RestoreExecutionResult> {
    if (this.isRestoreInProgress) {
      throw new Error('CONCURRENT_RESTORE_BLOCKED: Another restore transaction is currently in progress');
    }

    this.isRestoreInProgress = true;

    try {
      const resolvedPath = path.resolve(backupZipPath);

      // 1. Verify CAS Token
      const storedToken = this.activeTokens.get(restoreToken);
      if (!storedToken) {
        throw new Error('RESTORE_TOKEN_INVALID: Restore token is invalid or does not exist');
      }

      if (Date.now() > storedToken.expiresAt) {
        this.activeTokens.delete(restoreToken);
        throw new Error('RESTORE_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Restore authorization token has expired. Please inspect again');
      }

      const currentRevision = workspaceBackupService.getCurrentWorkspaceRevision();
      if (currentRevision !== storedToken.currentRevision) {
        this.activeTokens.delete(restoreToken);
        throw new Error('WORKSPACE_MUTATED_SINCE_INSPECTION: Current workspace has changed since preflight inspection. Re-inspection required');
      }

      const currentArchiveSha256 = this.computeFileSha256(resolvedPath);
      if (currentArchiveSha256.toLowerCase() !== storedToken.archiveSha256.toLowerCase()) {
        this.activeTokens.delete(restoreToken);
        throw new Error('BACKUP_FILE_MUTATED: Backup archive content changed after inspection');
      }

      logger.info('backup', `Initiating atomic restore transaction from: ${resolvedPath}`);

      // 2. Create Pre-Restore Safety Snapshot
      const safetySnapshot = await this.createSafetySnapshot();
      if (safetySnapshot.integrity_status !== 'ok') {
        throw new Error(`SAFETY_SNAPSHOT_FAILED: Could not create verified safety snapshot: ${safetySnapshot.filepath}`);
      }

      const stagingId = crypto.randomUUID();
      const stagingDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), `.restore_staging_${stagingId}`);
      fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });

      const liveDbPath = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'cardio_lab.db');
      const liveRawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
      const liveCorruptDir = getCorruptedLogsDir();

      // Pre-swap estate directory holds snapshot of DB and all live signal/quarantine files
      const preSwapEstateDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), `.pre_swap_estate_${stagingId}`);
      fs.mkdirSync(preSwapEstateDir, { recursive: true });
      const preSwapDbPath = path.join(preSwapEstateDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
      const preSwapRawLogsDir = path.join(preSwapEstateDir, 'raw_logs');
      const preSwapCorruptDir = path.join(preSwapEstateDir, 'corrupted');
      fs.mkdirSync(preSwapRawLogsDir, { recursive: true });
      fs.mkdirSync(preSwapCorruptDir, { recursive: true });

      let swapCommitted = false;

      try {
        // 3. Extract Archive into Staging Directory
        const zip = new AdmZip(resolvedPath);
        const entries = zip.getEntries();

        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isDirectory) continue;
          const safeName = validateSafeZipMemberPath(entry.entryName);
          const targetFile = path.join(stagingDir, safeName);
          const targetSubdir = path.dirname(targetFile);
          if (!fs.existsSync(targetSubdir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(targetSubdir, { recursive: true });
          }
          fs.writeFileSync(targetFile, entry.getData());
        }

        const stagedDbPath = path.join(stagingDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
        if (!fs.existsSync(stagedDbPath)) {
          throw new Error('STAGED_DATABASE_MISSING: Extracted archive does not contain cardio_lab.db');
        }

        // 4. Staged Database Verification & Invariant Checks
        const stagedDb = new DatabaseSync(stagedDbPath);
        try {
          const check = stagedDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
          if (!check || check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
            throw new Error(`Staged database failed integrity check: ${check?.integrity_check}`);
          }

          // Invariant: At least one user exists; NEVER fabricate default user (Audit Lead 2)
          let userCount = 0;
          try {
            const u = stagedDb.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM users').get() as any;
            userCount = u?.c || 0;
          } catch (_) {}

          if (userCount === 0) {
            throw new Error('INCOMPATIBLE_ARCHIVE_NO_USERS: Backup contains zero user profiles; cannot fabricate default user during restore');
          }

          // Invariant: Adjust unavailable external sync folders
          try {
            const syncFolders = stagedDb.prepare('SELECT id, folder_path FROM external_sync_folders').all() as any[];
            const updateStmt = stagedDb.prepare('UPDATE external_sync_folders SET status = ?, health = ?, error_message = ? WHERE id = ?');
            for (const sf of syncFolders) {
              if (!fs.existsSync(sf.folder_path)) {
                updateStmt.run('missing', 'offline', 'Папка отсутствует на данном устройстве после восстановления', sf.id);
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}

          // Invariant: Audit beta participants to prevent unverified qualification promotion upon restore (Scenario 16)
          try {
            const tableCheck = stagedDb.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='beta_participants'").get() as any;
            if (tableCheck) {
              const participants = stagedDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM beta_participants").all() as any[];
              const demoteStmt = stagedDb.prepare("UPDATE beta_participants SET participant_class = 'legacy_unqualified', is_external_tester = 0 WHERE participant_id = ?");
              for (const p of participants) {
                if (p.participant_class === 'qualified_external') {
                  const hasSignedToken = typeof p.invite_token === 'string' && p.invite_token.startsWith('BETA.');
                  const hasProof = typeof p.enrollment_proof === 'string' && p.enrollment_proof.length > 0;
                  if (!hasSignedToken && !hasProof) {
                    demoteStmt.run(p.participant_id);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          } catch (e: any) {
            logger.warn('backup', `Beta participants restore audit warning: ${e.message}`);
          }
        } finally {
          stagedDb.close();
        }

        // 5. Pre-Swap Estate Backup (DB + Raw Logs + Corrupted Quarantine)
        logger.info('backup', 'Creating comprehensive pre-swap estate snapshot...');
        if (fs.existsSync(liveDbPath)) {
          fs.copyFileSync(liveDbPath, preSwapDbPath);
        }
        if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`)) {
          try { fs.copyFileSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`, path.join(preSwapEstateDir, 'cardio_lab.db-wal')); } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`)) {
          try { fs.copyFileSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`, path.join(preSwapEstateDir, 'cardio_lab.db-shm')); } catch (_) {}
        }

        if (fs.existsSync(liveRawLogsDir)) {
          const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(liveRawLogsDir);
          for (const rf of rawFiles) {
            const src = path.join(liveRawLogsDir, rf);
            if (fs.statSync(src).isFile()) {
              fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(preSwapRawLogsDir, rf));
            }
          }
        }

        if (fs.existsSync(liveCorruptDir)) {
          const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(liveCorruptDir);
          for (const cf of corruptFiles) {
            const src = path.join(liveCorruptDir, cf);
            if (fs.statSync(src).isFile()) {
              fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(preSwapCorruptDir, cf));
            }
          }
        }

        // 6. Atomic Estate Swap
        logger.info('backup', 'Executing atomic database and signal files swap...');
        closeDb();

        // Remove active WAL/SHM to avoid stale log replay
        const liveWal = `${liveDbPath}-wal`;
        const liveShm = `${liveDbPath}-shm`;
        try { if (fs.existsSync(liveWal)) fs.unlinkSync(liveWal); } catch (_) {}
        try { if (fs.existsSync(liveShm)) fs.unlinkSync(liveShm); } catch (_) {}

        // Copy staged database into active location
        fs.copyFileSync(stagedDbPath, liveDbPath);

        // Synchronize raw_logs
        const stagedRawLogsDir = path.join(stagingDir, 'raw_logs');
        if (fs.existsSync(stagedRawLogsDir)) {
          const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagedRawLogsDir);
          for (const f of rawFiles) {
            const src = path.join(stagedRawLogsDir, f);
            const dst = path.join(liveRawLogsDir, f);
            if (fs.statSync(src).isFile()) {
              fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
            }
          }
        }

        // Synchronize optional quarantine logs
        const stagedCorruptDir = path.join(stagingDir, 'corrupted');
        if (fs.existsSync(stagedCorruptDir)) {
          const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagedCorruptDir);
          for (const f of corruptFiles) {
            const src = path.join(stagedCorruptDir, f);
            const dst = path.join(liveCorruptDir, f);
            if (fs.statSync(src).isFile()) {
              fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
            }
          }
        }

        // 7. Reopen & Verify Live Database
        const reopenedDb = initDb(liveDbPath);
        const finalCheck = reopenedDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
        if (!finalCheck || finalCheck.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
          throw new Error(`Reopened database failed post-swap integrity check: ${finalCheck?.integrity_check}`);
        }

        // Test fault injection check
        if (this._testFaultInjection === 'fail_during_swap' || this._testFaultInjection === 'fail_during_rollback') {
          throw new Error('TEST_INJECTED_SWAP_FAILURE: Simulated failure during post-swap validation');
        }

        swapCommitted = true;

        // Cleanup temporary pre-swap estate
        try {
          if (fs.existsSync(preSwapEstateDir)) {
            fs.rmSync(preSwapEstateDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        // Invalidate token
        this.activeTokens.delete(restoreToken);

        logger.info('backup', 'Atomic workspace restore committed successfully.');

        return {
          success: true,
          safety_snapshot_path: safetySnapshot.filepath,
          safety_snapshot_sha256: safetySnapshot.sha256,
          restored_manifest: storedToken.manifest,
          restored_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          restarted_db_verified: true,
          rollback_status: 'succeeded'
        };
      } catch (swapError: any) {
        logger.error('backup', `Restore failed during execution: ${swapError.message}. Initiating rollback to safety snapshot and pre-swap estate...`);

        const rollbackErrors: string[] = [];
        let rollbackVerified = false;

        // AUTOMATIC COMPREHENSIVE ROLLBACK
        try {
          closeDb();

          // Injected rollback failure check for test harness
          if (this._testFaultInjection === 'fail_during_rollback') {
            throw new Error('TEST_INJECTED_ROLLBACK_FAILURE: Simulated catastrophic failure during rollback');
          }

          // 1. Restore original live database from pre-swap snapshot (or safety snapshot)
          if (fs.existsSync(preSwapDbPath)) {
            if (fs.existsSync(liveDbPath)) fs.unlinkSync(liveDbPath);
            fs.copyFileSync(preSwapDbPath, liveDbPath);
          } else if (fs.existsSync(safetySnapshot.filepath)) {
            if (fs.existsSync(liveDbPath)) fs.unlinkSync(liveDbPath);
            fs.copyFileSync(safetySnapshot.filepath, liveDbPath);
          } else {
            rollbackErrors.push('No pre-swap database or safety snapshot found');
          }

          // Remove any stray WAL/SHM
          try { if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`)) fs.unlinkSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`); } catch (_) {}
          try { if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`)) fs.unlinkSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`); } catch (_) {}

          // 2. Restore live raw_logs from preSwapEstateDir
          if (fs.existsSync(liveRawLogsDir)) {
            const currentLiveFiles = fs.readdirSync(liveRawLogsDir);
            const preSwapFiles = fs.existsSync(preSwapRawLogsDir) ? fs.readdirSync(preSwapRawLogsDir) : [];
            // Remove files added during failed restore
            for (const file of currentLiveFiles) {
              if (!preSwapFiles.includes(file)) {
                try {
                  fs.unlinkSync(path.join(liveRawLogsDir, file));
                } catch (e: any) {
                  rollbackErrors.push(`Failed to remove stray raw log ${file}: ${e.message}`);
                }
              }
            }
            // Restore original files
            for (const file of preSwapFiles) {
              try {
                fs.copyFileSync(path.join(preSwapRawLogsDir, file), path.join(liveRawLogsDir, file));
              } catch (e: any) {
                rollbackErrors.push(`Failed to restore raw log ${file}: ${e.message}`);
              }
            }
          }

          // 3. Restore live corrupted logs from preSwapEstateDir
          if (fs.existsSync(liveCorruptDir)) {
            const currentLiveFiles = fs.readdirSync(liveCorruptDir);
            const preSwapFiles = fs.existsSync(preSwapCorruptDir) ? fs.readdirSync(preSwapCorruptDir) : [];
            // Remove files added during failed restore
            for (const file of currentLiveFiles) {
              if (!preSwapFiles.includes(file)) {
                try {
                  fs.unlinkSync(path.join(liveCorruptDir, file));
                } catch (e: any) {
                  rollbackErrors.push(`Failed to remove stray corrupted file ${file}: ${e.message}`);
                }
              }
            }
            // Restore original files
            for (const file of preSwapFiles) {
              try {
                fs.copyFileSync(path.join(preSwapCorruptDir, file), path.join(liveCorruptDir, file));
              } catch (e: any) {
                rollbackErrors.push(`Failed to restore corrupted file ${file}: ${e.message}`);
              }
            }
          }

          // 4. Re-initialize and verify restored database
          const restoredDb = initDb(liveDbPath);
          const check = restoredDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
          if (!check || check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
            rollbackErrors.push(`Post-rollback database integrity check failed: ${check?.integrity_check}`);
          }

          // 5. Verify raw logs hash integrity
          if (fs.existsSync(preSwapRawLogsDir)) {
            const expectedFiles = fs.readdirSync(preSwapRawLogsDir);
            for (const file of expectedFiles) {
              const liveFile = path.join(liveRawLogsDir, file);
              if (!fs.existsSync(liveFile)) {
                rollbackErrors.push(`Missing restored raw log: ${file}`);
              } else {
                const expectedSha = this.computeFileSha256(path.join(preSwapRawLogsDir, file));
                const liveSha = this.computeFileSha256(liveFile);
                if (expectedSha !== liveSha) {
                  rollbackErrors.push(`Hash mismatch on restored raw log ${file}`);
                }
              }
            }
          }

          if (rollbackErrors.length === 0) {
            rollbackVerified = true;
            logger.info('backup', 'Rollback to pre-restore safety estate completed and verified successfully.');
          } else {
            logger.error('backup', `CRITICAL: Rollback completed with errors: ${rollbackErrors.join('; ')}`);
          }
        } catch (rollbackErr: any) {
          logger.error('backup', `CRITICAL: Rollback failed: ${rollbackErr.message}`);
          rollbackErrors.push(`Rollback execution failed: ${rollbackErr.message}`);
        }

        const isFullyRolledBack = rollbackVerified && rollbackErrors.length === 0;

        return {
          success: false,
          safety_snapshot_path: safetySnapshot.filepath,
          safety_snapshot_sha256: safetySnapshot.sha256,
          restored_manifest: storedToken.manifest,
          restored_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          restarted_db_verified: isFullyRolledBack,
          rolled_back: isFullyRolledBack,
          rollback_status: isFullyRolledBack ? 'failed_rolled_back' : 'failed_rollback_incomplete',
          rollback_reason: swapError.message,
          rollback_incomplete_details: isFullyRolledBack ? undefined : rollbackErrors,
          error: swapError.message
        };
      } finally {
        // Clean up staging and pre-swap estate directories
        try {
          if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
            fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
          if (fs.existsSync(preSwapEstateDir)) {
            fs.rmSync(preSwapEstateDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    } finally {
      this.isRestoreInProgress = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Restores the workspace directly from a safety snapshot.
   */
  public async restoreFromSafetySnapshot(snapshotPath: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const resolved = path.resolve(snapshotPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolved)) {
      throw new Error(`SAFETY_SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND: ${resolved}`);
    }

    // Verify snapshot integrity
    const verifyDb = new DatabaseSync(resolved);
    try {
      const check = verifyDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
      if (!check || check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
        throw new Error(`Safety snapshot corrupted: ${check?.integrity_check}`);
      }
    } finally {
      verifyDb.close();
    }

    const liveDbPath = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'cardio_lab.db');
    closeDb();

    try { if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`)) fs.unlinkSync(`${liveDbPath}-wal`); } catch (_) {}
    try { if (fs.existsSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`)) fs.unlinkSync(`${liveDbPath}-shm`); } catch (_) {}

    fs.copyFileSync(resolved, liveDbPath);
    const restoredDb = initDb(liveDbPath);

    // Audit beta participants to prevent unverified qualification promotion (Scenario 16)
    try {
      const tableCheck = restoredDb.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='beta_participants'").get();
      if (tableCheck) {
        const participants = restoredDb.prepare("SELECT * FROM beta_participants").all() as any[];
        const demoteStmt = restoredDb.prepare("UPDATE beta_participants SET participant_class = 'legacy_unqualified', is_external_tester = 0 WHERE participant_id = ?");
        for (const p of participants) {
          if (p.participant_class === 'qualified_external') {
            const hasSignedToken = typeof p.invite_token === 'string' && p.invite_token.startsWith('BETA.');
            const hasProof = typeof p.enrollment_proof === 'string' && p.enrollment_proof.length > 0;
            if (!hasSignedToken && !hasProof) {
              demoteStmt.run(p.participant_id);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      logger.warn('backup', `Beta participants safety snapshot restore audit warning: ${e.message}`);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Successfully restored database from safety snapshot: ${path.basename(resolved)}`
    };
  }
}

export const workspaceRestoreService = WorkspaceRestoreService.getInstance();
