/**
 * Beta Cohort Analysis & Reproducible Evidence Reporting Service
 *
 * Produces structured, inspectable evidence reports covering:
 * - Active participant counts & acquisition sources
 * - North Star metric: Accepted Session Outcomes per Active User
 * - Activation funnel & time-to-value distributions
 * - Repeat signals & longitudinal retention with censoring
 * - Feature usage & depth analysis
 * - Trust, failure & unsupported-input rates
 * - Support burden metrics
 * - Willingness-to-pay / pricing corridor responses
 * - Strict separation between real external participants and sample/synthetic records
 */

import {
  BetaEvidenceExportBundle,
  BetaParticipant,
  AcceptedSessionOutcome,
  TimeToValueRecord,
  FeatureUsageEvent,
  TrustFailureEvent,
  WtpOfferInteraction,
  BetaSupportIncident,
  BetaFeedbackSubmission,
  BetaFeedbackSummary,
  TimeToValueSummary,
  FeatureUsageSummaryItem,
  TrustQualitySummary,
  SupportBurdenSummary,
  LongitudinalRetentionMetrics,
  ParticipantClass,
  UsefulOutcomeConfirmation,
  PilotWorkContext,
  NaturalRepeatRecord,
  SupportEpisode
} from '../../shared/betaContract';
import { computeNorthStarMetrics, NorthStarCalculationResult } from '../analytics/northStarMetrics';
import { TimeToValueTracker } from '../diagnostics/timeToValueTracker';
import { FeatureUsageTracker } from '../diagnostics/featureUsageTracker';
import { TrustFailureTracker } from '../diagnostics/trustFailureTracker';
import { verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance } from './betaCohortService';

export interface ClosedBetaEvidenceReport {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  generated_at_utc: string;
  evidence_period: {
    start_utc: string | null;
    end_utc: string | null;
  };
  participants_summary: {
    total_participants: number;
    real_external_participants: number;
    unverified_external_candidates: number;
    synthetic_or_sample_participants: number;
    by_channel: Record<string, number>;
    by_cohort: Record<string, number>;
    by_tier: Record<string, number>;
    by_class?: Record<ParticipantClass, number>;
  };
  unverified_external_candidates?: {
    participant_id: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    source_channel: string;
    rejection_reason: string;
  }[];
  north_star: NorthStarCalculationResult;
  time_to_value: TimeToValueSummary;
  repeat_and_retention: {
    total_participants_evaluated: number;
    second_accepted_session_rate_pct: number | null;
    repeat_comparison_rate_pct: number | null;
    repeat_report_rate_pct: number | null;
    repeat_llm_pack_rate_pct: number | null;
    longitudinal_retention: LongitudinalRetentionMetrics;
  };
  feature_usage: FeatureUsageSummaryItem[];
  trust_and_quality: TrustQualitySummary;
  support_burden: SupportBurdenSummary;
  feedback: BetaFeedbackSummary;
  pricing_and_wtp: {
    total_exposures: number;
    total_selections: number;
    total_purchase_requests: number;
    intent_rate_pct: number | null;
    by_tier: Record<string, { exposures: number; selections: number; requests: number }>;
  };
  external_evidence_status: 'real_external_cohort_present' | 'awaiting_external_tester_evidence';
  evidence_quality: {
    total_bundles_processed: number;
    conflicts_detected: number;
    provenance_verified_external_count: number;
    unverified_external_rejected_count: number;
    synthetic_records_isolated_count: number;
  };
  internal_or_synthetic_verification?: {
    total_participants: number;
    total_outcomes: number;
    accepted_outcomes: number;
  };
  outcomes_by_class?: Record<ParticipantClass, {
    total_sessions_attempted: number;
    total_accepted_outcomes: number;
    technical_completion_count: number;
    useful_outcome_confirmed_count: number;
    active_users: number;
    north_star_ratio: number | null;
  }>;
}

function canonicalOutcomePayload(o: AcceptedSessionOutcome): string {
  const actions = [...(o.meaningful_actions || [])].sort();
  return JSON.stringify({
    session_id: o.session_id,
    participant_id: o.participant_id,
    cohort_id: o.cohort_id,
    bundle_imported: Boolean(o.bundle_imported),
    grouping_confirmed: Boolean(o.grouping_confirmed),
    canonical_analysis_completed: Boolean(o.canonical_analysis_completed),
    canonical_result_viewed: Boolean(o.canonical_result_viewed),
    has_unresolved_hard_failure: Boolean(o.has_unresolved_hard_failure),
    is_accepted_outcome: Boolean(o.is_accepted_outcome),
    is_sample_or_demo: Boolean(o.is_sample_or_demo),
    meaningful_actions: actions
  });
}

function canonicalTtvPayload(t: TimeToValueRecord): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    session_id: t.session_id,
    participant_id: t.participant_id,
    cohort_id: t.cohort_id,
    import_started_at_ms: t.import_started_at_ms ?? null,
    bundle_preview_ready_at_ms: t.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms ?? null,
    bundle_confirmed_at_ms: t.bundle_confirmed_at_ms ?? null,
    canonical_overview_ready_at_ms: t.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms ?? null,
    first_meaningful_action_at_ms: t.first_meaningful_action_at_ms ?? null,
    first_meaningful_action_type: t.first_meaningful_action_type ?? null,
    is_sample_or_demo: Boolean(t.is_sample_or_demo)
  });
}

function canonicalFeaturePayload(f: FeatureUsageEvent): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    participant_id: f.participant_id,
    cohort_id: f.cohort_id,
    session_id: f.session_id,
    feature_id: f.feature_id,
    action: f.action,
    duration_viewed_sec: f.duration_viewed_sec ?? null,
    is_sample_or_demo: Boolean(f.is_sample_or_demo)
  });
}

function canonicalTrustPayload(tr: TrustFailureEvent): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    participant_id: tr.participant_id,
    cohort_id: tr.cohort_id,
    session_id: tr.session_id ?? null,
    error_type: tr.error_type,
    reason_code: tr.reason_code,
    file_extension: tr.file_extension ?? null,
    user_corrected_successfully: tr.user_corrected_successfully ?? null
  });
}

function canonicalWtpPayload(w: WtpOfferInteraction): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    participant_id: w.participant_id,
    cohort_id: w.cohort_id,
    experiment_variant_id: w.experiment_variant_id,
    tier_shown: w.tier_shown,
    price_amount: w.price_amount,
    currency: w.currency,
    billing_model: w.billing_model,
    action: w.action,
    decline_reason: w.decline_reason ?? null,
    price_sensitivity_feedback: w.price_sensitivity_feedback
      ? {
          too_expensive_threshold: w.price_sensitivity_feedback.too_expensive_threshold ?? null,
          fair_price_estimate: w.price_sensitivity_feedback.fair_price_estimate ?? null,
          cheap_quality_concern_threshold: w.price_sensitivity_feedback.cheap_quality_concern_threshold ?? null
        }
      : null
  });
}

function canonicalSupportPayload(s: BetaSupportIncident): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    participant_id: s.participant_id,
    cohort_id: s.cohort_id,
    issue_category: s.issue_category,
    associated_support_bundle: Boolean(s.associated_support_bundle),
    interaction_steps_count: s.interaction_steps_count,
    resolution_status: s.resolution_status,
    root_cause_class: s.root_cause_class,
    unsupported_input_involved: Boolean(s.unsupported_input_involved)
  });
}

function canonicalFeedbackPayload(fb: BetaFeedbackSubmission): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    participant_id: fb.participant_id,
    cohort_id: fb.cohort_id,
    app_version: fb.app_version,
    category: fb.category,
    rating_1_to_5: fb.rating_1_to_5 ?? null,
    message_bounded: fb.message_bounded,
    session_context_ref: fb.session_context_ref ?? null,
    privacy_cleared: Boolean(fb.privacy_cleared)
  });
}

export class BetaCohortAnalysis {
  public static generateReport(bundles: BetaEvidenceExportBundle[]): ClosedBetaEvidenceReport {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Participant Deduplication across cumulative bundles
    const participantsMap = new Map<string, BetaParticipant>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      const p = b.participant_profile;
      if (!p) continue;
      if (!participantsMap.has(p.participant_id)) {
        participantsMap.set(p.participant_id, { ...p });
      } else {
        const existing = participantsMap.get(p.participant_id)!;
        // Fail closed on conflicting cohort, external tester status, or source channel
        if (
          existing.cohort_id !== p.cohort_id ||
          Boolean(existing.is_external_tester) !== Boolean(p.is_external_tester) ||
          existing.source_channel !== p.source_channel
        ) {
          throw new Error(`Conflicting participant profile for ${p.participant_id}: cohort or external tester status mismatch`);
        }
        // Expand observation window
        const t1 = Math.min(new Date(existing.first_seen_at_utc).getTime(), new Date(p.first_seen_at_utc).getTime());
        const t2 = Math.max(new Date(existing.last_seen_at_utc).getTime(), new Date(p.last_seen_at_utc).getTime());
        existing.first_seen_at_utc = new Date(t1).toISOString();
        existing.last_seen_at_utc = new Date(t2).toISOString();
        if (p.entitlement_tier) existing.entitlement_tier = p.entitlement_tier;
        if (p.app_version) existing.app_version = p.app_version;
        if (p.build_number) existing.build_number = p.build_number;
        if (p.invite_token) existing.invite_token = p.invite_token;
        if (p.invite_code) existing.invite_code = p.invite_code;
        if (p.enrollment_proof) existing.enrollment_proof = p.enrollment_proof;
      }
    }
    const allParticipants = Array.from(participantsMap.values());

    // 2. Participant Partitioning & Provenance Verification
    const verifiedExternalParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];
    const internalParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];
    const internalRehearsalParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];
    const syntheticParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];
    const legacyUnqualifiedParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];
    const unverifiedCandidates: { participant_id: string; cohort_id: string; source_channel: string; rejection_reason: string }[] = [];
    const syntheticOrSampleParticipants: BetaParticipant[] = [];

    for (const p of allParticipants) {
      const isDeclaredExternal = Boolean(p.is_external_tester);
      const isSyntheticChannel = p.source_channel === 'synthetic_fixture';
      const isInternalCohort = p.cohort_id === 'cohort_internal_alpha';

      if (p.participant_class === 'synthetic' || isSyntheticChannel) {
        syntheticParticipants.push(p);
        syntheticOrSampleParticipants.push(p);
      } else if (p.participant_class === 'internal_rehearsal') {
        internalRehearsalParticipants.push(p);
        syntheticOrSampleParticipants.push(p);
      } else if (p.participant_class === 'internal' || (isInternalCohort && !isDeclaredExternal)) {
        internalParticipants.push(p);
        syntheticOrSampleParticipants.push(p);
      } else if (p.participant_class === 'legacy_unqualified') {
        legacyUnqualifiedParticipants.push(p);
        syntheticOrSampleParticipants.push(p);
      } else if (isDeclaredExternal) {
        const prov = verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance(p);
        if (prov.verified && (p.participant_class === 'qualified_external' || !p.participant_class)) {
          verifiedExternalParticipants.push(p);
        } else {
          unverifiedCandidates.push({
            participant_id: p.participant_id,
            cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
            source_channel: p.source_channel,
            rejection_reason: prov.reason || 'Failed enrollment provenance verification'
          });
          legacyUnqualifiedParticipants.push(p);
        }
      } else {
        internalParticipants.push(p);
        syntheticOrSampleParticipants.push(p);
      }
    }

    const verifiedExternalIds = new Set(verifiedExternalParticipants.map((p) => p.participant_id));
    const internalIds = new Set(internalParticipants.map((p) => p.participant_id));
    const internalRehearsalIds = new Set(internalRehearsalParticipants.map((p) => p.participant_id));
    const syntheticIds = new Set(syntheticParticipants.map((p) => p.participant_id));
    const legacyIds = new Set(legacyUnqualifiedParticipants.map((p) => p.participant_id));
    const hasExternalCohort = verifiedExternalParticipants.length > 0;

    const byChannel: Record<string, number> = {};
    const byCohort: Record<string, number> = {};
    const byTier: Record<string, number> = {};

    for (const p of allParticipants) {
      byChannel[p.source_channel] = (byChannel[p.source_channel] || 0) + 1;
      byCohort[p.cohort_id] = (byCohort[p.cohort_id] || 0) + 1;
      byTier[p.entitlement_tier] = (byTier[p.entitlement_tier] || 0) + 1;
    }

    // 3. Deep Canonical Event Deduplication across cumulative bundles
    const outcomesMap = new Map<string, { event: AcceptedSessionOutcome; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const o of b.accepted_outcomes || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalOutcomePayload(o);
        if (!outcomesMap.has(o.outcome_id)) {
          outcomesMap.set(o.outcome_id, { event: o, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = outcomesMap.get(o.outcome_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting outcome payload detected for outcome_id: ${o.outcome_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allOutcomes = Array.from(outcomesMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const ttvMap = new Map<string, { event: TimeToValueRecord; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const t of b.ttv_records || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalTtvPayload(t);
        if (!ttvMap.has(t.record_id)) {
          ttvMap.set(t.record_id, { event: t, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = ttvMap.get(t.record_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting TTV payload detected for record_id: ${t.record_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allTtv = Array.from(ttvMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const featureMap = new Map<string, { event: FeatureUsageEvent; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const f of b.feature_events || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalFeaturePayload(f);
        if (!featureMap.has(f.event_id)) {
          featureMap.set(f.event_id, { event: f, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = featureMap.get(f.event_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting feature event payload for event_id: ${f.event_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allFeatureEvents = Array.from(featureMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const trustMap = new Map<string, { event: TrustFailureEvent; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const tr of b.trust_events || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalTrustPayload(tr);
        if (!trustMap.has(tr.event_id)) {
          trustMap.set(tr.event_id, { event: tr, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = trustMap.get(tr.event_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting trust event payload for event_id: ${tr.event_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allTrustEvents = Array.from(trustMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const wtpMap = new Map<string, { event: WtpOfferInteraction; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const w of b.wtp_interactions || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalWtpPayload(w);
        if (!wtpMap.has(w.interaction_id)) {
          wtpMap.set(w.interaction_id, { event: w, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = wtpMap.get(w.interaction_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting WTP interaction payload for interaction_id: ${w.interaction_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allWtp = Array.from(wtpMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const supportMap = new Map<string, { event: BetaSupportIncident; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const s of b.support_incidents || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalSupportPayload(s);
        if (!supportMap.has(s.incident_id)) {
          supportMap.set(s.incident_id, { event: s, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = supportMap.get(s.incident_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting support incident payload for incident_id: ${s.incident_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allSupport = Array.from(supportMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const feedbackMap = new Map<string, { event: BetaFeedbackSubmission; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const fb of b.feedback_submissions || []) {
        const canonical = canonicalFeedbackPayload(fb);
        if (!feedbackMap.has(fb.feedback_id)) {
          feedbackMap.set(fb.feedback_id, { event: fb, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = feedbackMap.get(fb.feedback_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting feedback submission payload for feedback_id: ${fb.feedback_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allFeedback = Array.from(feedbackMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const episodeMap = new Map<string, { event: SupportEpisode; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const ep of b.support_episodes || []) {
        const canonical = JSON.stringify({
          episode_id: ep.episode_id,
          participant_id: ep.participant_id,
          cohort_id: ep.cohort_id,
          reason: ep.reason,
          interactions_count: ep.interactions_count,
          user_active_minutes: ep.user_active_minutes,
          operator_active_minutes: ep.operator_active_minutes,
          category: ep.category,
          resolution_status: ep.resolution_status
        });
        if (!episodeMap.has(ep.episode_id)) {
          episodeMap.set(ep.episode_id, { event: ep, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = episodeMap.get(ep.episode_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting support episode payload for episode_id: ${ep.episode_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allSupportEpisodes = Array.from(episodeMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const repeatMap = new Map<string, { event: NaturalRepeatRecord; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const nr of b.natural_repeats || []) {
        const canonical = JSON.stringify({
          repeat_id: nr.repeat_id,
          participant_id: nr.participant_id,
          cohort_id: nr.cohort_id,
          baseline_session_id: nr.baseline_session_id,
          repeat_session_id: nr.repeat_session_id,
          repeat_type: nr.repeat_type,
          is_distinct_session: nr.is_distinct_session,
          is_qualified_repeat: nr.is_qualified_repeat
        });
        if (!repeatMap.has(nr.repeat_id)) {
          repeatMap.set(nr.repeat_id, { event: nr, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = repeatMap.get(nr.repeat_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting natural repeat payload for repeat_id: ${nr.repeat_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allNaturalRepeats = Array.from(repeatMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    const confirmationMap = new Map<string, { event: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation; canonical: string }>();
    for (const b of bundles) {
      for (const c of b.useful_confirmations || []) {
        const canonical = JSON.stringify({
          confirmation_id: c.confirmation_id,
          session_id: c.session_id,
          participant_id: c.participant_id,
          context_id: c.context_id,
          confirmed_by: c.confirmed_by,
          recipient_action: c.recipient_action
        });
        if (!confirmationMap.has(c.confirmation_id)) {
          confirmationMap.set(c.confirmation_id, { event: c, canonical });
        } else {
          const existing = confirmationMap.get(c.confirmation_id)!;
          if (existing.canonical !== canonical) {
            throw new Error(`Conflicting confirmation payload for confirmation_id: ${c.confirmation_id}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allConfirmations = Array.from(confirmationMap.values()).map((item) => item.event);

    // 4. Evidence period boundaries across all accepted evidence
    const allDates: string[] = [];
    allParticipants.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.first_seen_at_utc) allDates.push(p.first_seen_at_utc);
      if (p.last_seen_at_utc) allDates.push(p.last_seen_at_utc);
    });
    allOutcomes.forEach((o) => {
      if (o.completed_at_utc) allDates.push(o.completed_at_utc);
    });
    allTtv.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.created_at_utc) allDates.push(t.created_at_utc);
    });
    allFeatureEvents.forEach((f) => {
      if (f.occurred_at_utc) allDates.push(f.occurred_at_utc);
    });
    allTrustEvents.forEach((tr) => {
      if (tr.occurred_at_utc) allDates.push(tr.occurred_at_utc);
    });
    allWtp.forEach((w) => {
      if (w.occurred_at_utc) allDates.push(w.occurred_at_utc);
    });
    allSupport.forEach((s) => {
      if (s.reported_at_utc) allDates.push(s.reported_at_utc);
    });
    allFeedback.forEach((fb) => {
      if (fb.created_at_utc) allDates.push(fb.created_at_utc);
    });
    allSupportEpisodes.forEach((ep) => {
      if (ep.reported_at_utc) allDates.push(ep.reported_at_utc);
    });
    allNaturalRepeats.forEach((nr) => {
      if (nr.repeat_completed_at_utc) allDates.push(nr.repeat_completed_at_utc);
    });
    allConfirmations.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.confirmed_at_utc) allDates.push(c.confirmed_at_utc);
    });

    const validDates = allDates.filter((d) => Number.isFinite(Date.parse(d))).sort();
    const startUtc = validDates.length > 0 ? validDates[0] : null;
    const endUtc = validDates.length > 0 ? validDates[validDates.length - 1] : null;

    // 5. Partitioned Market Events: ONLY verified external participants and non-sample data
    const marketOutcomes = allOutcomes.filter((o) => verifiedExternalIds.has(o.participant_id) && !o.is_sample_or_demo && o.external_market_qualified !== false);
    const marketTtv = allTtv.filter((t) => verifiedExternalIds.has(t.participant_id) && !t.is_sample_or_demo);
    const marketFeatureEvents = allFeatureEvents.filter((f) => verifiedExternalIds.has(f.participant_id) && !f.is_sample_or_demo);
    const marketTrustEvents = allTrustEvents.filter((tr) => verifiedExternalIds.has(tr.participant_id));
    const marketWtp = allWtp.filter((w) => verifiedExternalIds.has(w.participant_id));
    const marketSupport = allSupport.filter((s) => verifiedExternalIds.has(s.participant_id));
    const marketFeedback = allFeedback.filter((fb) => verifiedExternalIds.has(fb.participant_id));

    // 5b. Class-partitioned outcomes and separate North Star denominators
    const computeClassOutcomes = (pIds: Set<string>, isExternal = false) => {
      const classOutcomes = allOutcomes.filter((o) => pIds.has(o.participant_id) && (isExternal ? (!o.is_sample_or_demo && o.external_market_qualified !== false) : true));
      const activeUsers = new Set(classOutcomes.map((o) => o.participant_id)).size;
      const acceptedCount = classOutcomes.filter((o) => o.is_accepted_outcome).length;
      const techCount = classOutcomes.filter((o) => o.technical_completion ?? (o.bundle_imported && o.grouping_confirmed && o.canonical_analysis_completed && o.canonical_result_viewed && !o.has_unresolved_hard_failure)).length;
      const usefulCount = classOutcomes.filter((o) => o.useful_outcome_confirmed ?? ((o.meaningful_actions && o.meaningful_actions.length > 0) || Boolean(o.confirmation_details))).length;
      return {
        total_sessions_attempted: classOutcomes.length,
        total_accepted_outcomes: acceptedCount,
        technical_completion_count: techCount,
        useful_outcome_confirmed_count: usefulCount,
        active_users: activeUsers,
        north_star_ratio: activeUsers > 0 ? Number((acceptedCount / activeUsers).toFixed(2)) : null
      };
    };

    const outcomesByClass: Record<ParticipantClass, {
      total_sessions_attempted: number;
      total_accepted_outcomes: number;
      technical_completion_count: number;
      useful_outcome_confirmed_count: number;
      active_users: number;
      north_star_ratio: number | null;
    }> = {
      qualified_external: computeClassOutcomes(verifiedExternalIds, true),
      internal: computeClassOutcomes(internalIds, false),
      internal_rehearsal: computeClassOutcomes(internalRehearsalIds, false),
      synthetic: computeClassOutcomes(syntheticIds, false),
      legacy_unqualified: computeClassOutcomes(legacyIds, false)
    };

    // 6. North Star calculation
    const northStar: NorthStarCalculationResult = hasExternalCohort
      ? computeNorthStarMetrics(marketOutcomes, { excludeSampleData: true })
      : {
          cohort_id: undefined,
          total_users_active: 0,
          total_sessions_attempted: 0,
          total_accepted_outcomes: 0,
          north_star_ratio: null,
          sample_or_demo_outcomes_count: allOutcomes.filter((o) => o.is_sample_or_demo && o.is_accepted_outcome).length,
          action_breakdown: {
            comparison_count: 0,
            report_count: 0,
            llm_pack_count: 0,
            advanced_detail_count: 0
          },
          funnel: {
            imports_attempted: 0,
            grouping_confirmed: 0,
            analysis_completed: 0,
            overview_viewed: 0,
            meaningful_action_taken: 0
          }
        };

    // 7. Time-to-Value
    const ttvSummary = hasExternalCohort && marketTtv.length > 0
      ? TimeToValueTracker.summarizeRecords(marketTtv, false)
      : TimeToValueTracker.summarizeRecords([], false);

    // 8. Feature Usage
    const featureSummary = hasExternalCohort
      ? FeatureUsageTracker.summarizeFeatureUsage(marketFeatureEvents, verifiedExternalParticipants.length, false)
      : FeatureUsageTracker.summarizeFeatureUsage([], 0, false);

    // 9. Trust & Quality
    const externalSessionsAttempted = marketOutcomes.length;
    const trustSummary: TrustQualitySummary = hasExternalCohort && externalSessionsAttempted > 0
      ? TrustFailureTracker.summarizeEvents(marketTrustEvents, externalSessionsAttempted)
      : {
          total_sessions_attempted: externalSessionsAttempted,
          grouping_corrections_count: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'grouping_correction').length,
          grouping_correction_rate_pct: null,
          unsupported_format_count: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'unsupported_format').length,
          unsupported_format_rate_pct: null,
          hard_failure_count: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'hard_parsing_failure').length,
          hard_failure_rate_pct: null,
          output_parity_failures: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'output_parity_failure').length,
          silent_drops_count: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'silent_drop_detected').length,
          privacy_scan_failures: marketTrustEvents.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'privacy_scan_violation').length,
          warnings_acted_upon_pct: null
        };

    // 10. Repeat & Retention Modeling
    // Single-action authority: actions mirrored in outcome meaningful_actions and feature_events merge by session/action authority
    let secondAcceptedCount = 0;
    let repeatComparisonCount = 0;
    let repeatReportCount = 0;
    let repeatLlmPackCount = 0;

    for (const p of verifiedExternalParticipants) {
      const pOutcomes = marketOutcomes.filter((o) => o.participant_id === p.participant_id);
      const pFeatures = marketFeatureEvents.filter((f) => f.participant_id === p.participant_id);

      // Distinct accepted outcomes:
      const distinctAccepted = new Set<string>();
      for (const o of pOutcomes) {
        if (o.is_accepted_outcome) {
          distinctAccepted.add(o.session_id || o.outcome_id);
        }
      }
      if (distinctAccepted.size >= 2) {
        secondAcceptedCount += 1;
      }

      // Distinct comparisons:
      const distinctComparisons = new Set<string>();
      for (const o of pOutcomes) {
        if (o.meaningful_actions?.includes('comparison_opened')) {
          distinctComparisons.add(o.session_id ? `session:${o.session_id}` : `outcome:${o.outcome_id}`);
        }
      }
      for (const f of pFeatures) {
        const feat = f.feature_id as string;
        const act = f.action as string;
        if (feat === 'comparison_view' || act === 'comparison_opened') {
          distinctComparisons.add(f.session_id ? `session:${f.session_id}` : `event:${f.event_id}`);
        }
      }
      if (distinctComparisons.size >= 2) {
        repeatComparisonCount += 1;
      }

      // Distinct report exports:
      const distinctReports = new Set<string>();
      for (const o of pOutcomes) {
        if (o.meaningful_actions?.includes('report_exported')) {
          distinctReports.add(o.session_id ? `session:${o.session_id}` : `outcome:${o.outcome_id}`);
        }
      }
      for (const f of pFeatures) {
        const feat = f.feature_id as string;
        const act = f.action as string;
        if (feat.startsWith('report_export') || act === 'exported' || act === 'report_exported') {
          distinctReports.add(f.session_id ? `session:${f.session_id}` : `event:${f.event_id}`);
        }
      }
      if (distinctReports.size >= 2) {
        repeatReportCount += 1;
      }

      // Distinct LLM packs:
      const distinctLlmPacks = new Set<string>();
      for (const o of pOutcomes) {
        if (o.meaningful_actions?.includes('llm_pack_generated')) {
          distinctLlmPacks.add(o.session_id ? `session:${o.session_id}` : `outcome:${o.outcome_id}`);
        }
      }
      for (const f of pFeatures) {
        const feat = f.feature_id as string;
        const act = f.action as string;
        if (feat.startsWith('llm_pack') || feat === 'ai_pack_export' || act === 'linked' || act === 'llm_pack_generated') {
          distinctLlmPacks.add(f.session_id ? `session:${f.session_id}` : `event:${f.event_id}`);
        }
      }
      if (distinctLlmPacks.size >= 2) {
        repeatLlmPackCount += 1;
      }
    }

    const evalCount = verifiedExternalParticipants.length;

    const secondAcceptedRate = hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0
      ? Number(((secondAcceptedCount / evalCount) * 100).toFixed(1))
      : null;

    const repeatCompRate = hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0
      ? Number(((repeatComparisonCount / evalCount) * 100).toFixed(1))
      : null;

    const repeatRepRate = hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0
      ? Number(((repeatReportCount / evalCount) * 100).toFixed(1))
      : null;

    const repeatLlmRate = hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0
      ? Number(((repeatLlmPackCount / evalCount) * 100).toFixed(1))
      : null;

    // Timestamp-window longitudinal retention:
    // N-day eligibility requires horizon (last_seen - first_seen) >= N days
    // Retained requires qualifying return activity (accepted outcome) occurring at or after the N-day threshold
    const calcWindowRetention = (days: number) => {
      if (!hasExternalCohort || evalCount === 0) {
        return { eligibleCount: 0, retainedCount: 0, rate: null };
      }
      const thresholdMs = days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

      const eligible = verifiedExternalParticipants.filter((p) => {
        const startMs = Date.parse(p.first_seen_at_utc);
        const lastMs = Date.parse(p.last_seen_at_utc);
        if (!Number.isFinite(startMs) || !Number.isFinite(lastMs)) return false;
        return (lastMs - startMs) >= thresholdMs;
      });

      const retained = eligible.filter((p) => {
        const startMs = Date.parse(p.first_seen_at_utc);
        const pOutcomes = marketOutcomes.filter((o) => o.participant_id === p.participant_id && o.is_accepted_outcome);
        return pOutcomes.some((o) => {
          const compMs = Date.parse(o.completed_at_utc);
          if (!Number.isFinite(compMs)) return false;
          return (compMs - startMs) >= thresholdMs;
        });
      });

      const rate = eligible.length > 0 ? Number(((retained.length / eligible.length) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null;
      return { eligibleCount: eligible.length, retainedCount: retained.length, rate };
    };

    const ret7 = calcWindowRetention(7);
    const ret30 = calcWindowRetention(30);
    const ret60 = calcWindowRetention(60);
    const ret90 = calcWindowRetention(90);

    const censoredCount = hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0
      ? verifiedExternalParticipants.filter((p) => {
          const startMs = Date.parse(p.first_seen_at_utc);
          const lastMs = Date.parse(p.last_seen_at_utc);
          if (!Number.isFinite(startMs) || !Number.isFinite(lastMs)) return true;
          return (lastMs - startMs) < (90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        }).length
      : 0;

    const longitudinal: LongitudinalRetentionMetrics = {
      cohort_id: verifiedExternalParticipants[0]?.cohort_id || 'no_external_cohort',
      eligible_participants_7d: ret7.eligibleCount,
      retained_participants_7d: ret7.retainedCount,
      rate_7d: ret7.rate,
      eligible_participants_30d: ret30.eligibleCount,
      retained_participants_30d: ret30.retainedCount,
      rate_30d: ret30.rate,
      eligible_participants_60d: ret60.eligibleCount,
      retained_participants_60d: ret60.retainedCount,
      rate_60d: ret60.rate,
      eligible_participants_90d: ret90.eligibleCount,
      retained_participants_90d: ret90.retainedCount,
      rate_90d: ret90.rate,
      censored_participants_count: censoredCount
    };

    // 11. Support Burden
    const marketSupportEpisodes = allSupportEpisodes.filter((e) => verifiedExternalIds.has(e.participant_id));
    const totalIncidents = marketSupport.length + marketSupportEpisodes.length;
    const resolvedCount =
      marketSupport.filter((i) => i.resolution_status.startsWith('resolved')).length +
      marketSupportEpisodes.filter((e) => e.resolution_status === 'resolved' || e.resolution_status === 'unsupported_closed').length;
    const unsupportedCount =
      marketSupport.filter((i) => i.unsupported_input_involved).length +
      marketSupportEpisodes.filter((e) => e.category === 'unsupported_input' || e.resolution_status === 'unsupported_closed').length;

    const rootCauseCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const s of marketSupport) {
      rootCauseCounts[s.root_cause_class] = (rootCauseCounts[s.root_cause_class] || 0) + 1;
    }
    for (const ep of marketSupportEpisodes) {
      rootCauseCounts[ep.category] = (rootCauseCounts[ep.category] || 0) + 1;
    }

    let supportSummary: SupportBurdenSummary;
    if (marketSupportEpisodes.length === 0 && marketSupport.length === 0) {
      supportSummary = {
        total_incidents: 0,
        incidents_per_active_user: null,
        resolution_rate_pct: null,
        unsupported_input_share_pct: null,
        top_root_causes: [],
        observation_status: 'not_observed'
      };
    } else {
      const userActiveMinutes = marketSupportEpisodes.length > 0
        ? marketSupportEpisodes.reduce((acc, ep) => acc + (Number(ep.user_active_minutes) || 0), 0)
        : undefined;
      const operatorActiveMinutes = marketSupportEpisodes.length > 0
        ? marketSupportEpisodes.reduce((acc, ep) => acc + (Number(ep.operator_active_minutes) || 0), 0)
        : undefined;
      const unresolvedCount =
        marketSupportEpisodes.filter((e) => e.resolution_status === 'unresolved').length +
        marketSupport.filter((s) => s.resolution_status === 'open_investigating').length;

      const byCategory: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const ep of marketSupportEpisodes) {
        byCategory[ep.category] = (byCategory[ep.category] || 0) + 1;
      }
      for (const s of marketSupport) {
        byCategory[s.issue_category] = (byCategory[s.issue_category] || 0) + 1;
      }

      supportSummary = {
        total_incidents: totalIncidents,
        incidents_per_active_user: hasExternalCohort && evalCount > 0 ? Number((totalIncidents / evalCount).toFixed(2)) : null,
        resolution_rate_pct: totalIncidents > 0 ? Number(((resolvedCount / totalIncidents) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
        unsupported_input_share_pct: totalIncidents > 0 ? Number(((unsupportedCount / totalIncidents) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
        top_root_causes: Object.entries(rootCauseCounts).map(([root_cause, count]) => ({ root_cause, count })),
        user_active_minutes: userActiveMinutes,
        operator_active_minutes: operatorActiveMinutes,
        by_category: byCategory,
        unresolved_count: unresolvedCount,
        observation_status: 'active_episodes_recorded'
      };
    }

    // 12. Pricing & WTP
    const totalExposures = marketWtp.filter((w) => w.action === 'offer_viewed').length;
    const totalSelections = marketWtp.filter((w) => w.action === 'tier_selected').length;
    const totalRequests = marketWtp.filter((w) => w.action === 'request_to_buy_clicked').length;
    const wtpByTier: Record<string, { exposures: number; selections: number; requests: number }> = {
      personal: { exposures: 0, selections: 0, requests: 0 },
      professional: { exposures: 0, selections: 0, requests: 0 },
      academic: { exposures: 0, selections: 0, requests: 0 }
    };

    for (const w of marketWtp) {
      const entry = wtpByTier[w.tier_shown] || { exposures: 0, selections: 0, requests: 0 };
      if (w.action === 'offer_viewed') entry.exposures += 1;
      if (w.action === 'tier_selected') entry.selections += 1;
      if (w.action === 'request_to_buy_clicked') entry.requests += 1;
      wtpByTier[w.tier_shown] = entry;
    }

    const intentRatePct = totalExposures > 0 ? Number(((totalRequests / totalExposures) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null;

    // 13. Qualitative Feedback Aggregation
    const feedbackByCategory: Record<string, number> = {};
    const validRatings: number[] = [];
    let privacyClearedFeedbackCount = 0;

    for (const fb of marketFeedback) {
      feedbackByCategory[fb.category] = (feedbackByCategory[fb.category] || 0) + 1;
      if (typeof fb.rating_1_to_5 === 'number' && fb.rating_1_to_5 >= 1 && fb.rating_1_to_5 <= 5) {
        validRatings.push(fb.rating_1_to_5);
      }
      if (fb.privacy_cleared) {
        privacyClearedFeedbackCount += 1;
      }
    }

    const feedbackSummary: BetaFeedbackSummary = {
      total_submissions: marketFeedback.length,
      by_category: feedbackByCategory,
      average_rating_1_to_5: validRatings.length > 0 ? Number((validRatings.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / validRatings.length).toFixed(2)) : null,
      privacy_cleared_count: privacyClearedFeedbackCount
    };

    // 14. Evidence Quality
    const evidenceQuality = {
      total_bundles_processed: bundles.length,
      conflicts_detected: 0,
      provenance_verified_external_count: verifiedExternalParticipants.length,
      unverified_external_rejected_count: unverifiedCandidates.length,
      synthetic_records_isolated_count: syntheticOrSampleParticipants.length
    };

    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      generated_at_utc: nowIso,
      evidence_period: {
        start_utc: startUtc,
        end_utc: endUtc
      },
      participants_summary: {
        total_participants: allParticipants.length,
        real_external_participants: verifiedExternalParticipants.length,
        unverified_external_candidates: unverifiedCandidates.length,
        synthetic_or_sample_participants: syntheticOrSampleParticipants.length,
        by_channel: byChannel,
        by_cohort: byCohort,
        by_tier: byTier,
        by_class: {
          qualified_external: verifiedExternalParticipants.length,
          internal: internalParticipants.length,
          internal_rehearsal: internalRehearsalParticipants.length,
          synthetic: syntheticParticipants.length,
          legacy_unqualified: legacyUnqualifiedParticipants.length
        }
      },
      unverified_external_candidates: unverifiedCandidates.length > 0 ? unverifiedCandidates : undefined,
      north_star: northStar,
      time_to_value: ttvSummary,
      repeat_and_retention: {
        total_participants_evaluated: evalCount,
        second_accepted_session_rate_pct: secondAcceptedRate,
        repeat_comparison_rate_pct: repeatCompRate,
        repeat_report_rate_pct: repeatRepRate,
        repeat_llm_pack_rate_pct: repeatLlmRate,
        longitudinal_retention: longitudinal
      },
      feature_usage: featureSummary,
      trust_and_quality: trustSummary,
      support_burden: supportSummary,
      feedback: feedbackSummary,
      pricing_and_wtp: {
        total_exposures: totalExposures,
        total_selections: totalSelections,
        total_purchase_requests: totalRequests,
        intent_rate_pct: intentRatePct,
        by_tier: wtpByTier
      },
      external_evidence_status: hasExternalCohort ? 'real_external_cohort_present' : 'awaiting_external_tester_evidence',
      evidence_quality: evidenceQuality,
      internal_or_synthetic_verification: {
        total_participants: syntheticOrSampleParticipants.length,
        total_outcomes: allOutcomes.filter((o) => o.is_sample_or_demo || !verifiedExternalIds.has(o.participant_id)).length,
        accepted_outcomes: allOutcomes.filter((o) => (o.is_sample_or_demo || !verifiedExternalIds.has(o.participant_id)) && o.is_accepted_outcome).length
      },
      outcomes_by_class: outcomesByClass
    };
  }
}
