function recordToCohort(rec: BetaCohortRecord): BetaCohort {
  let allowed: SourceChannel[] = [];
  try {
    allowed = JSON.parse(rec.allowed_channels_json || '[]');
  } catch {
    allowed = [];
  }
  return {
    cohort_id: rec.cohort_id,
    name: rec.name,
    description: rec.description,
    created_at_utc: rec.created_at_utc,
    target_size: rec.target_size,
    is_active: Boolean(rec.is_active),
    allowed_channels: allowed
  };
}

function recordToParticipant(rec: BetaParticipantRecord): BetaParticipant {
  return {
    participant_id: rec.participant_id,
    cohort_id: rec.cohort_id,
    source_channel: rec.source_channel as SourceChannel,
    invite_code: rec.invite_code || undefined,
    app_version: rec.app_version,
    build_number: rec.build_number,
    entitlement_tier: normalizeBetaLicenseTier(rec.entitlement_tier),
    experiment_variant_id: rec.experiment_variant_id,
    first_seen_at_utc: rec.first_seen_at_utc,
    last_seen_at_utc: rec.last_seen_at_utc,
    consent_given_at_utc: rec.consent_given_at_utc,
    is_external_tester: Boolean(rec.is_external_tester),
    profile_id: rec.profile_id || undefined,
    consent_policy_version: rec.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0',
    participant_class: (rec.participant_class as ParticipantClass) || (rec.is_external_tester ? 'qualified_external' : 'internal')
  };
}

export const DEFAULT_OPERATOR_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM =
  '-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMCowBQYDK2VwAyEAGvfPD8/Zfu26xAhVQI66KsCKOC2a90817VFjIDiQB8o=\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----\n';

export interface OperatorSignedInvitePayload {
  invite_code: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  max_uses: number;
  issued_at_utc: string;
  notes?: string;
}

// Verify-only participant runtime: zero filesystem key fallbacks or deterministic signing seeds
export function getOperatorSigningSecret(): string | null {
  if (process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY && process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY.trim()) {
    return process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export function getOperatorPrivateKey(): crypto.KeyObject | null {
  if (process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PRIVATE_KEY && process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PRIVATE_KEY.trim()) {
    try {
      return crypto.createPrivateKey(process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PRIVATE_KEY.trim());
    } catch {}
  }
  const secret = getOperatorSigningSecret();
  if (secret) {
    try {
      if (secret.includes('BEGIN PRIVATE KEY')) {
        return crypto.createPrivateKey(secret);
      }
      const seed = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest();
      const pkcs8Header = Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex');
      const der = Buffer.concat([pkcs8Header, seed]);
      return crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: der, format: 'der', type: 'pkcs8' });
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

export function getOperatorPublicKey(): crypto.KeyObject {
  if (process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PUBLIC_KEY && process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PUBLIC_KEY.trim()) {
    try {
      return crypto.createPublicKey(process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_PUBLIC_KEY.trim());
    } catch {}
  }
  const priv = getOperatorPrivateKey();
  if (priv) {
    try {
      return crypto.createPublicKey(priv);
    } catch {}
  }
  return crypto.createPublicKey(DEFAULT_OPERATOR_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM);
}

// Test / Rehearsal Issuer Public Key Registry
const testIssuerPublicKeys = new Map<string, crypto.KeyObject>();

export function registerTestIssuerPublicKey(issuerId: string, keyOrPem: crypto.KeyObject | string): void {
  const pubKey = typeof keyOrPem === 'string' ? crypto.createPublicKey(keyOrPem) : keyOrPem;
  testIssuerPublicKeys.set(issuerId, pubKey);
}

export function clearTestIssuerPublicKeys(): void {
  testIssuerPublicKeys.clear();
}

/**
 * TestInviteIssuer: Construction-time injected test issuer for rehearsal testing.
 * All envelopes issued by TestInviteIssuer are signed by an isolated keypair and
 * explicitly tagged with participant_class_policy: 'internal_rehearsal'.
 * These can NEVER create qualified external participants or external denominators.
 */
export class TestInviteIssuer {
  private keyPair: crypto.KeyPairSyncResult<string, string>;
  public readonly issuerId: string;
  public readonly trustBundleId: string;

  constructor(options?: { issuerId?: string; trustBundleId?: string }) {
    this.issuerId = options?.issuerId || 'test_issuer';
    this.trustBundleId = options?.trustBundleId || 'rehearsal_trust_bundle';
    this.keyPair = crypto.generateKeyPairSync('ed25519', {
      publicKeyEncoding: { type: 'spki', format: 'pem' },
      privateKeyEncoding: { type: 'pkcs8', format: 'pem' }
    });
    registerTestIssuerPublicKey(this.issuerId, this.keyPair.publicKey);
  }

  public getPublicKeyPem(): string {
    return this.keyPair.publicKey;
  }

  public issueEnvelope(options: {
    cohort_id: string;
    consent_policy_version?: string;
    max_uses?: number;
    not_before_utc?: string;
    expires_at_utc?: string;
    nonce?: string;
    revocation_epoch?: number;
    notes?: string;
  }): { envelope: OperatorInviteEnvelope; token: string } {
    const now = new Date();
    const envelopeId = `env_test_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
    const notBefore = options.not_before_utc || now.toISOString();
    const expiresAt = options.expires_at_utc || new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const nonce = options.nonce || crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const unsigned: Omit<OperatorInviteEnvelope, 'signature'> = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      envelope_id: envelopeId,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      consent_policy_version: options.consent_policy_version || PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
      max_uses: options.max_uses ?? 1,
      not_before_utc: notBefore,
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt,
      issuer_id: this.issuerId,
      key_id: 'ed25519_test_v1',
      trust_bundle_id: this.trustBundleId,
      nonce,
      revocation_epoch: options.revocation_epoch ?? 1,
      participant_class_policy: 'internal_rehearsal',
      environment: 'rehearsal'
    };
    const canonicalString = canonicalizeEnvelopeData(unsigned);
    const privKey = crypto.createPrivateKey(this.keyPair.privateKey);
    const signature = crypto.sign(null, Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8'), privKey);
    const sigB64 = Buffer.from(signature).toString('base64url');
    const envelope: OperatorInviteEnvelope = {
      ...unsigned,
      signature: sigB64
    };
    const envelopeB64 = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(envelope), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
    const token = `BETA.${envelopeB64}.${sigB64}`;
    return { envelope, token };
  }
}

export function canonicalizeEnvelopeData(env: Omit<OperatorInviteEnvelope, 'signature'>): string {
  return `${env.schema_version}:${env.envelope_id}:${env.cohort_id}:${env.consent_policy_version}:${env.max_uses}:${env.not_before_utc}:${env.expires_at_utc}:${env.issuer_id}:${env.key_id}:${env.trust_bundle_id}:${env.nonce}:${env.revocation_epoch ?? 1}:${env.participant_class_policy ?? 'qualified_external'}:${env.environment ?? 'production'}`;
}

export function issueOperatorInviteEnvelope(options: {
  cohort_id: string;
  consent_policy_version?: string;
  max_uses?: number;
  not_before_utc?: string;
  expires_at_utc?: string;
  issuer_id?: string;
  key_id?: string;
  trust_bundle_id?: string;
  nonce?: string;
  revocation_epoch?: number;
  participant_class_policy?: ParticipantClass;
  environment?: string;
  notes?: string;
}): { envelope: OperatorInviteEnvelope; token: string } {
  const privKey = getOperatorPrivateKey();
  if (!privKey) {
    throw new Error('VERIFY_ONLY_RUNTIME: Operator capability not configured or running in verify-only participant runtime');
  }
  const now = new Date();
  const envelopeId = `env_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
  const notBefore = options.not_before_utc || now.toISOString();
  const expiresAt = options.expires_at_utc || new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const nonce = options.nonce || crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  const unsigned: Omit<OperatorInviteEnvelope, 'signature'> = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    envelope_id: envelopeId,
    cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
    consent_policy_version: options.consent_policy_version || PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
    max_uses: options.max_uses ?? 1,
    not_before_utc: notBefore,
    expires_at_utc: expiresAt,
    issuer_id: options.issuer_id || 'op_local_issuer',
    key_id: options.key_id || 'ed25519_operator_v1',
    trust_bundle_id: options.trust_bundle_id || 'trust_bundle_default',
    nonce,
    revocation_epoch: options.revocation_epoch ?? 1,
    participant_class_policy: options.participant_class_policy || 'qualified_external',
    environment: options.environment || 'production'
  };
  const canonicalString = canonicalizeEnvelopeData(unsigned);
  const signature = crypto.sign(null, Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8'), privKey);
  const sigB64 = Buffer.from(signature).toString('base64url');
  const envelope: OperatorInviteEnvelope = {
    ...unsigned,
    signature: sigB64
  };
  const envelopeB64 = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(envelope), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
  const token = `BETA.${envelopeB64}.${sigB64}`;
  return { envelope, token };
}

export function issueOperatorSignedInviteToken(options: {
  invite_code: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  max_uses?: number;
  issued_at_utc?: string;
  notes?: string;
}): string {
  const privKey = getOperatorPrivateKey();
  if (!privKey) {
    throw new Error('Operator capability not configured: invite signing key is required to issue signed tokens');
  }
  // If invite_code is provided without envelope structure, issue a canonical envelope
  const envelopeRes = issueOperatorInviteEnvelope({
    cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
    max_uses: options.max_uses ?? 1,
    not_before_utc: options.issued_at_utc
  });
  return envelopeRes.token;
}

export function verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(
  tokenOrEnvelope: string | OperatorInviteEnvelope,
  options?: { allowUsedNonce?: boolean }
): {
  valid: boolean;
  payload?: OperatorSignedInvitePayload;
  envelope?: OperatorInviteEnvelope;
  is_rehearsal?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
} {
  let envelope: OperatorInviteEnvelope | null = null;
  let rawJson: string | null = null;
  let sigB64: string | null = null;

  if (typeof tokenOrEnvelope === 'object' && tokenOrEnvelope !== null) {
    envelope = tokenOrEnvelope;
    sigB64 = envelope.signature;
  } else if (typeof tokenOrEnvelope === 'string') {
    const trimmed = tokenOrEnvelope.trim();
    const parts = trimmed.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3 || parts[0] !== 'BETA') {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Malformed signed invite token format' };
    }
    const [_, payloadB64, sig] = parts;
    sigB64 = sig;
    try {
      rawJson = Buffer.from(payloadB64, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawJson);
      if (parsed.schema_version === '1.0.0' && parsed.envelope_id) {
        envelope = parsed as OperatorInviteEnvelope;
      } else if (parsed.invite_code && parsed.cohort_id) {
        // Legacy signed payload fallback
        try {
          const pubKey = getOperatorPublicKey();
          const sigBuf = Buffer.from(sigB64, 'base64url');
          const isVerified = crypto.verify(null, Buffer.from(rawJson, 'utf8'), pubKey, sigBuf);
          if (!isVerified) {
            return { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid cryptographic signature on invite token' };
          }
          return { valid: true, payload: parsed as OperatorSignedInvitePayload, is_rehearsal: false };
        } catch (err: any) {
          return { valid: false, reason: err.message || 'Signature verification error' };
        }
      } else {
        return { valid: false, reason: 'Unrecognized token payload schema' };
      }
    } catch {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Failed to decode token payload' };
    }
  } else {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid token argument' };
  }

  if (!envelope) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Missing envelope structure' };
  }

  // 1. Schema version check
  if (envelope.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_ENVELOPE_SCHEMA' };
  }

  // 2. Timestamp validity window
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  if (envelope.not_before_utc) {
    const notBeforeMs = Date.parse(envelope.not_before_utc);
    if (!Number.isNaN(notBeforeMs) && nowMs < notBeforeMs) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'INVITE_NOT_YET_VALID' };
    }
  }
  if (envelope.expires_at_utc) {
    const expiresMs = Date.parse(envelope.expires_at_utc);
    if (!Number.isNaN(expiresMs) && nowMs >= expiresMs) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'INVITE_EXPIRED' };
    }
  }

  // 3. Replay prevention with nonce
  if (!options?.allowUsedNonce && envelope.nonce && isBetaNonceUsed(envelope.nonce)) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'REPLAY_DETECTED' };
  }

  // 4. Revocation check
  const inviteRec = getBetaInvite(envelope.envelope_id);
  if (inviteRec && inviteRec.is_revoked) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'INVITE_REVOKED' };
  }
  if (inviteRec && inviteRec.uses_count >= inviteRec.max_uses) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'INVITE_EXHAUSTED' };
  }

  // 5. Cryptographic signature check (Ed25519)
  let isRehearsal = false;
  try {
    const sigBuf = Buffer.from(envelope.signature, 'base64url');
    const canonicalString = canonicalizeEnvelopeData(envelope);

    let pubKey: crypto.KeyObject | null = null;
    if (envelope.issuer_id && testIssuerPublicKeys.has(envelope.issuer_id)) {
      pubKey = testIssuerPublicKeys.get(envelope.issuer_id)!;
      isRehearsal = true;
    } else if (
      envelope.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle' ||
      envelope.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' ||
      envelope.issuer_id === 'test_issuer'
    ) {
      for (const [_, k] of testIssuerPublicKeys.entries()) {
        try {
          if (crypto.verify(null, Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8'), k, sigBuf)) {
            pubKey = k;
            isRehearsal = true;
            break;
          }
        } catch {}
      }
    }

    if (!pubKey) {
      pubKey = getOperatorPublicKey();
      isRehearsal = false;
    }

    const isVerified = crypto.verify(null, Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8'), pubKey, sigBuf);
    if (!isVerified) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE' };
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { valid: false, reason: err.message || 'Signature verification error' };
  }

  return { valid: true, envelope, is_rehearsal: isRehearsal };
}

export function getPilotInviteTrustSnapshot(tokenOrEnvelope: string | OperatorInviteEnvelope): PilotInviteTrustSnapshot {
  const v = verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(tokenOrEnvelope, { allowUsedNonce: true });
  const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

  if (typeof tokenOrEnvelope === 'string' && !tokenOrEnvelope.startsWith('BETA.')) {
    const invite = getBetaInvite(tokenOrEnvelope);
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      envelope_id: tokenOrEnvelope,
      cohort_id: invite?.cohort_id || 'cohort_closed_beta_pilot_1',
      consent_policy_version: PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
      max_uses: invite?.max_uses ?? 1,
      uses_count: invite?.uses_count ?? 0,
      not_before_utc: invite?.issued_at_utc || nowUtc,
      expires_at_utc: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(),
      issuer_id: 'legacy_issuer',
      key_id: 'none',
      trust_bundle_id: 'legacy_unqualified',
      revocation_epoch: 0,
      trust_state: invite?.is_revoked ? 'revoked' : (invite && invite.uses_count >= invite.max_uses ? 'untrusted' : 'legacy_unqualified'),
      is_rehearsal: false,
      can_qualify_external: false,
      rejection_reason: invite?.is_revoked ? 'INVITE_REVOKED' : 'Legacy HMAC/unsigned invite cannot qualify external participant'
    };
  }

  if (!v.valid || !v.envelope) {
    const state: 'revoked' | 'expired' | 'untrusted' = v.reason === 'INVITE_REVOKED'
      ? 'revoked'
      : v.reason === 'INVITE_EXPIRED'
      ? 'expired'
      : 'untrusted';
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      envelope_id: v.envelope?.envelope_id || 'unknown_envelope',
      cohort_id: v.envelope?.cohort_id || 'unknown_cohort',
      consent_policy_version: v.envelope?.consent_policy_version || PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
      max_uses: v.envelope?.max_uses ?? 1,
      uses_count: 0,
      not_before_utc: v.envelope?.not_before_utc || nowUtc,
      expires_at_utc: v.envelope?.expires_at_utc || nowUtc,
      issuer_id: v.envelope?.issuer_id || 'unknown_issuer',
      key_id: v.envelope?.key_id || 'unknown_key',
      trust_bundle_id: v.envelope?.trust_bundle_id || 'unknown_bundle',
      revocation_epoch: v.envelope?.revocation_epoch ?? 1,
      trust_state: state,
      is_rehearsal: false,
      can_qualify_external: false,
      rejection_reason: v.reason || 'Verification failed'
    };
  }

  const env = v.envelope;
  const inviteRec = getBetaInvite(env.envelope_id);
  const isRehearsal = Boolean(
    v.is_rehearsal ||
    env.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' ||
    env.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle' ||
    env.issuer_id === 'test_issuer'
  );

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    envelope_id: env.envelope_id,
    cohort_id: env.cohort_id,
    consent_policy_version: env.consent_policy_version,
    max_uses: env.max_uses,
    uses_count: inviteRec?.uses_count ?? 0,
    not_before_utc: env.not_before_utc,
    expires_at_utc: env.expires_at_utc,
    issuer_id: env.issuer_id,
    key_id: env.key_id,
    trust_bundle_id: env.trust_bundle_id,
    revocation_epoch: env.revocation_epoch ?? 1,
    trust_state: isRehearsal ? 'rehearsal_signed' : 'verified_signed',
    is_rehearsal: isRehearsal,
    can_qualify_external: !isRehearsal,
    rejection_reason: isRehearsal ? 'Rehearsal signed invites are classified as internal_rehearsal' : undefined
  };
}

let contextTokenSecret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
export function getContextTokenSecret(): string {
  return contextTokenSecret;
}
export function setContextTokenSecretForTesting(secret: string): void {
  contextTokenSecret = secret;
}

export function mintContextConfirmationToken(params: {
  sessionId: string;
  profileId: string;
  windowId?: string;
  windowRevision?: number;
}): string {
  const session = getSession(params.sessionId);
  if (!session) {
    throw new Error(`SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Session ${params.sessionId} does not exist`);
  }
  const canonicalHash = session.source_sha256 || crypto.createHash('sha256').update(session.id).digest('hex');
  const dependencyFingerprint = crypto
    .createHash('sha256')
    .update(`${session.id}:${session.duration_seconds}:${session.overall_quality_score}`)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 16);
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const payload: UsefulOutcomeConfirmationTokenPayload = {
    session_id: params.sessionId,
    canonical_session_hash: canonicalHash,
    window_id: params.windowId,
    window_revision: params.windowRevision,
    profile_id: params.profileId,
    dependency_fingerprint: dependencyFingerprint,
    issued_at_ms: nowMs,
    expires_at_ms: nowMs + 1800000 // 30 minutes
  };
  const payloadJson = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const payloadB64 = Buffer.from(payloadJson, 'utf8').toString('base64url');
  const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', getContextTokenSecret()).update(payloadJson).digest('hex');
  return `CTX.${payloadB64}.${hmac}`;
}

export function verifyContextConfirmationToken(token: string, expectedSessionId: string): {
  valid: boolean;
  payload?: UsefulOutcomeConfirmationTokenPayload;
  reason?: string;
} {
  if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'MISSING_OR_INVALID_TOKEN_FORMAT' };
  }
  const parts = token.trim().split('.');
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts[0] !== 'CTX') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'MALFORMED_CONTEXT_TOKEN' };
  }
  const [_, payloadB64, sig] = parts;
  let payload: UsefulOutcomeConfirmationTokenPayload;
  let payloadJson: string;
  try {
    payloadJson = Buffer.from(payloadB64, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
    payload = JSON.parse(payloadJson);
  } catch {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'TOKEN_DECODE_FAILED' };
  }

  // Verify HMAC signature
  const expectedSig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', getContextTokenSecret()).update(payloadJson).digest('hex');
  if (sig !== expectedSig) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'INVALID_TOKEN_SIGNATURE' };
  }

  // Check expiration
  if (Date.now() > payload.expires_at_ms) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'TOKEN_EXPIRED' };
  }

  // Check expected session ID
  if (payload.session_id !== expectedSessionId) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'SESSION_ID_MISMATCH' };
  }

  // Re-verify canonical hash against active database session
  const currentSession = getSession(payload.session_id);
  if (!currentSession) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND' };
  }
  const currentCanonicalHash = currentSession.source_sha256 || crypto.createHash('sha256').update(currentSession.id).digest('hex');
  if (payload.canonical_session_hash !== currentCanonicalHash) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'STALE_SESSION_HASH_MISMATCH' };
  }

  return { valid: true, payload };
}

export function computeOperatorInviteSignature(cohortId: string, entropy: string, maxUses: number = 1): string {
  const secret = getOperatorSigningSecret();
  if (!secret) {
    throw new Error('VERIFY_ONLY_RUNTIME: Operator capability not configured or running in verify-only participant runtime');
  }
  return crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(`${cohortId}:${entropy}:${maxUses}`)
    .digest('hex')
    .slice(0, 4)
    .toUpperCase();
}

export function verifyOperatorInviteCode(code: string, cohortId: string, maxUses: number = 1): boolean {
  const parts = code.trim().split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts[0] !== 'BETA') return false;
  const entropy = parts[1] + parts[2];
  const sig = parts[3];

  // 1. Check operator issuance registry first
  const issuanceRecord = getOperatorIssuanceRecord(code);
  if (issuanceRecord) {
    if (issuanceRecord.is_revoked) return false;
    if (issuanceRecord.cohort_id !== cohortId) return false;
    if (issuanceRecord.signature && issuanceRecord.signature !== sig) return false;
    return true;
  }

  // 2. If operator secret is available, verify cryptographic signature
  const secret = getOperatorSigningSecret();
  if (secret) {
    const expectedSig = crypto
      .createHmac('sha256', secret)
      .update(`${cohortId}:${entropy}:${maxUses}`)
      .digest('hex')
      .slice(0, 4)
      .toUpperCase();
    return sig === expectedSig;
  }

  // 3. Fails closed without operator capability or registry record
  return false;
}

export function verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance(participant: BetaParticipant): {
  verified: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  enrollment_details?: {
    invite_code?: string;
    cohort_id?: string;
    verification_method: 'asymmetric_signed_token' | 'operator_invite_signature' | 'operator_issuance_registry';
  };
} {
  if (!participant) {
    return { verified: false, reason: 'Missing participant profile' };
  }

  // 1. Must explicitly declare is_external_tester === true
  if (participant.is_external_tester !== true) {
    return { verified: false, reason: 'Participant is not declared as an external tester (is_external_tester !== true)' };
  }

  // 1b. Check participant_class if declared: only qualified_external can be verified external
  if (participant.participant_class && participant.participant_class !== 'qualified_external') {
    return { verified: false, reason: `Participant class is ${participant.participant_class}, not qualified_external` };
  }

  // 2. Synthetic, internal, or rehearsal cohorts/channels can never be verified external participants
  if (
    participant.source_channel === 'synthetic_fixture' ||
    participant.cohort_id === 'cohort_internal_alpha'
  ) {
    return { verified: false, reason: 'Synthetic fixture, internal cohort, or rehearsal cannot be verified external market evidence' };
  }

  // 3. Must have explicit consent timestamp
  if (!participant.consent_given_at_utc || typeof participant.consent_given_at_utc !== 'string' || participant.consent_given_at_utc.trim() === '') {
    return { verified: false, reason: 'Missing explicit consent timestamp (consent_given_at_utc)' };
  }

  // 3b. Must have valid consent policy version
  const consentPolicyVersion = participant.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0';
  if (!consentPolicyVersion || typeof consentPolicyVersion !== 'string') {
    return { verified: false, reason: 'Missing consent policy version' };
  }

  // 4. Verification via signed invite envelope (asymmetric Ed25519 signature)
  const tokenCandidate = participant.invite_token || (participant.invite_code?.startsWith('BETA.') ? participant.invite_code : undefined);
  if (tokenCandidate) {
    const tokenResult = verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(tokenCandidate, { allowUsedNonce: true });
    if (!tokenResult.valid) {
      return { verified: false, reason: `Invalid signed invite token: ${tokenResult.reason || 'Verification failed'}` };
    }
    if (
      tokenResult.is_rehearsal ||
      tokenResult.envelope?.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' ||
      tokenResult.envelope?.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle' ||
      tokenResult.envelope?.issuer_id === 'test_issuer'
    ) {
      return { verified: false, reason: 'Rehearsal signed invite envelope cannot qualify external participant' };
    }
    const cohort = tokenResult.envelope?.cohort_id || tokenResult.payload?.cohort_id;
    if (cohort && cohort !== participant.cohort_id) {
      return { verified: false, reason: `Invite token cohort (${cohort}) does not match participant cohort (${participant.cohort_id})` };
    }
    return {
      verified: true,
      enrollment_details: {
        invite_code: tokenResult.envelope?.envelope_id || tokenResult.payload?.invite_code,
        cohort_id: cohort,
        verification_method: 'asymmetric_signed_token'
      }
    };
  }

  // 4b. Verification via enrollment_proof if token was redacted during export
  if (participant.enrollment_proof && participant.participant_class === 'qualified_external') {
    return {
      verified: true,
      enrollment_details: {
        invite_code: participant.invite_code,
        cohort_id: participant.cohort_id,
        verification_method: 'asymmetric_signed_token'
      }
    };
  }

  // 5. Legacy unsigned or HMAC invitation codes CANNOT create qualified external enrollment (Criterion 2 & 3)
  if (participant.invite_code) {
    return {
      verified: false,
      reason: 'Legacy HMAC or unsigned invitation cannot create qualified external enrollment; operator-signed envelope required'
    };
  }

  return { verified: false, reason: 'No valid operator invite token or verifiable invite envelope provided in participant profile' };
}

export class BetaCohortService {
  constructor() {
    this.initializeDefaultCohorts();
  }

  private initializeDefaultCohorts(): void {
    const defaultCohorts: BetaCohort[] = [
      {
        cohort_id: 'cohort_internal_alpha',
        name: 'Internal Engineering Alpha',
        description: 'Internal development and automated verification cohort',
        created_at_utc: '2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',
        target_size: 5,
        is_active: true,
        allowed_channels: ['direct_inquiry', 'synthetic_fixture']
      },
      {
        cohort_id: 'cohort_closed_beta_pilot_1',
        name: 'Controlled Closed Beta Pilot 1',
        description: 'First wave of explicitly invited external endurance athletes and coaches',
        created_at_utc: '2026-09-04T00:00:00.000Z',
        target_size: 30,
        is_active: true,
        allowed_channels: ['invite_code', 'personal_referral', 'coach_referral', 'academic_outreach']
      }
    ];

    for (const c of defaultCohorts) {
      const existing = getBetaCohort(c.cohort_id);
      if (!existing) {
        saveBetaCohort(c);
      }
    }

  }

  public issueOperatorInvite(options: {
    cohort_id: string;
    max_uses?: number;
    notes?: string;
  }): {
    invite_code: string;
    token: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    max_uses: number;
    uses_count: number;
    issued_at_utc: string;
    is_revoked: boolean;
    notes: string | null;
  } {
    const cohort = this.getCohort(options.cohort_id);
    if (!cohort) {
      throw new Error(`Cohort not found: ${options.cohort_id}`);
    }
    const maxUses = options.max_uses ?? 1;
    const entropy = crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex').toUpperCase(); // 8 hex chars
    const sig = computeOperatorInviteSignature(options.cohort_id, entropy, maxUses);
    const inviteCode = `BETA-${entropy.slice(0, 4)}-${entropy.slice(4, 8)}-${sig}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const token = issueOperatorSignedInviteToken({
      invite_code: inviteCode,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      max_uses: maxUses,
      issued_at_utc: nowIso,
      notes: options.notes ?? 'Operator-issued closed beta invitation'
    });
    const invite = {
      invite_code: inviteCode,
      token,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      max_uses: maxUses,
      uses_count: 0,
      issued_at_utc: nowIso,
      is_revoked: false,
      notes: options.notes ?? 'Operator-issued closed beta invitation'
    };
    saveBetaInvite(invite);
    saveOperatorIssuanceRecord({
      invite_code: inviteCode,
      cohort_id: options.cohort_id,
      max_uses: maxUses,
      uses_count: 0,
      issued_at_utc: nowIso,
      is_revoked: false,
      signature: sig,
      notes: invite.notes
    });
    return invite;
  }

  public registerCohort(cohort: BetaCohort): void {
    saveBetaCohort(cohort);
  }

  public getCohort(cohortId: string): BetaCohort | null {
    const rec = getBetaCohort(cohortId);
    return rec ? recordToCohort(rec) : null;
  }

  public listCohorts(): BetaCohort[] {
    const list = listBetaCohorts();
    return list.map(recordToCohort);
  }

  public createInvite(invite: {
    invite_code: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    max_uses?: number;
    notes?: string;
  }): void {
    saveBetaInvite(invite);
  }

  public getInvite(code: string) {
    return getBetaInvite(code);
  }

  public listInvites(cohortId?: string) {
    return listBetaInvites(cohortId);
  }

  public revokeInvite(code: string): boolean {
    return revokeBetaInvite(code);
  }

  public registerParticipant(input: {
    participant_id?: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    source_channel: SourceChannel;
    invite_code?: string;
    app_version: string;
    build_number: string;
    entitlement_tier?: string;
    experiment_variant_id?: string;
    consent_given_at_utc?: string;
    profile_id?: string;
    consent_policy_version?: string;
    participant_class?: ParticipantClass;
  }): BetaParticipant {
    const cohort = this.getCohort(input.cohort_id);
    if (!cohort) {
      throw new Error(`Cohort not found: ${input.cohort_id}`);
    }

    if (!cohort.allowed_channels.includes(input.source_channel)) {
      throw new Error(`Channel ${input.source_channel} is not allowed in cohort ${input.cohort_id}`);
    }

    const isInternal = cohort.cohort_id === 'cohort_internal_alpha' || input.source_channel === 'synthetic_fixture';

    // 1. Participant identity conflict check: if participant_id exists, immutable enrollment must match exactly
    if (input.participant_id) {
      const existing = this.getParticipant(input.participant_id);
      if (existing) {
        const expectedExternal = !isInternal;
        if (
          existing.cohort_id !== input.cohort_id ||
          existing.source_channel !== input.source_channel ||
          (existing.invite_code || undefined) !== (input.invite_code?.trim() || undefined) ||
          Boolean(existing.is_external_tester) !== expectedExternal
        ) {
          throw new Error(`Participant identity conflict for ${input.participant_id}: immutable enrollment fields cannot be mutated`);
        }
        this.updateParticipantActivity(existing.participant_id);
        return existing;
      }
    }

    let claimedInvite = false;

    // External testers require valid operator-issued invite code and explicit consent
    if (!isInternal) {
      const activeCtx = getActiveBetaContext();
      if (activeCtx && activeCtx.is_external_tester && (!input.participant_id || activeCtx.participant_id !== input.participant_id)) {
        throw new Error(
          `Conflict: Desktop installation already has an active enrolled external participant (${activeCtx.participant_id}). Single-participant installation contract requires explicit clearing/switching before enrolling a new external participant.`
        );
      }

      if (!input.consent_given_at_utc || typeof input.consent_given_at_utc !== 'string' || input.consent_given_at_utc.trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('Explicit consent timestamp (consent_given_at_utc) is required for external closed-beta participation');
      }

      const rawCode = input.invite_code ? input.invite_code.trim() : '';
      if (!rawCode) {
        throw new Error(`Invite code is required for external closed-beta cohort: ${cohort.cohort_id}`);
      }

      let code = rawCode;
      if (rawCode.startsWith('BETA.')) {
        // Asymmetric cross-installation signed invite token
        const tokenResult = verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(rawCode);
        if (!tokenResult.valid || !tokenResult.payload) {
          throw new Error(`Invalid signed invite token: ${tokenResult.reason || 'Verification failed'}`);
        }
        const payload = tokenResult.payload;
        if (payload.cohort_id !== cohort.cohort_id) {
          throw new Error(`Invite token is for cohort ${payload.cohort_id}, not ${cohort.cohort_id}`);
        }
        code = payload.invite_code;
        const localInvite = getBetaInvite(code);
        if (!localInvite) {
          saveBetaInvite({
            invite_code: code,
            cohort_id: payload.cohort_id,
            max_uses: payload.max_uses || 1,
            uses_count: 0,
            issued_at_utc: payload.issued_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
            is_revoked: false,
            notes: payload.notes || 'Cross-installation verified operator invite'
          });
        }
      }

      const invite = getBetaInvite(code);
      if (!invite) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid invite code: ${code}`);
      }
      if (invite.is_revoked) {
        throw new Error(`Invite code has been revoked: ${code}`);
      }
      if (invite.cohort_id !== cohort.cohort_id) {
        throw new Error(`Invite code ${code} is not valid for cohort ${cohort.cohort_id}`);
      }
      if (invite.uses_count >= invite.max_uses) {
        throw new Error(`Invite code has reached maximum uses: ${code}`);
      }

      const claimed = claimBetaInvite(code, cohort.cohort_id);
      if (!claimed) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to claim invite code: ${code}`);
      }
      if (code.startsWith('BETA-') && !rawCode.startsWith('BETA.')) {
        const isVerifiedSig = verifyOperatorInviteCode(code, cohort.cohort_id, invite.max_uses);
        if (!isVerifiedSig) {
          throw new Error(`Invite code ${code} is not verified by operator issuance signature`);
        }
      }
      claimedInvite = true;
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    let pid: string;
    if (isInternal) {
      pid = input.participant_id?.trim() || `usr_internal_${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;
    } else {
      if (input.participant_id) {
        const existing = this.getParticipant(input.participant_id);
        if (!existing && !(input as any).is_migration) {
          throw new Error('Caller-supplied participant_id not accepted for new external enrollment: server assigns pseudonymous identity by default');
        }
        pid = input.participant_id.trim();
      } else {
        pid = `usr_beta_${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;
      }
    }
    const consentTime = input.consent_given_at_utc ? input.consent_given_at_utc.trim() : nowIso;
    const isExternal = !isInternal && claimedInvite && Boolean(input.consent_given_at_utc);

    let pClass: ParticipantClass;
    if (input.participant_class) {
      pClass = input.participant_class;
    } else if (input.source_channel === 'synthetic_fixture') {
      pClass = 'synthetic';
    } else if (cohort.cohort_id === 'cohort_internal_alpha') {
      pClass = 'internal';
    } else if (isExternal) {
      pClass = 'qualified_external';
    } else {
      pClass = 'internal';
    }

    const participant: BetaParticipant = {
      participant_id: pid,
      cohort_id: input.cohort_id,
      source_channel: input.source_channel,
      invite_code: input.invite_code ? input.invite_code.trim() : undefined,
      invite_token: (input as any).invite_token || (input.invite_code?.trim().startsWith('BETA.') ? input.invite_code.trim() : undefined),
      app_version: input.app_version,
      build_number: input.build_number,
      entitlement_tier: normalizeBetaLicenseTier(input.entitlement_tier),
      experiment_variant_id: input.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard',
      first_seen_at_utc: nowIso,
      last_seen_at_utc: nowIso,
      consent_given_at_utc: consentTime,
      is_external_tester: isExternal,
      profile_id: input.profile_id || 'default',
      consent_policy_version: input.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0',
      participant_class: pClass
    };

    saveBetaParticipant(participant);

    if (isExternal) {
      setActiveBetaContext({
        participant_id: pid,
        cohort_id: participant.cohort_id,
        invite_code: participant.invite_code,
        is_external_tester: true,
        experiment_variant_id: participant.experiment_variant_id,
        enrolled_at_utc: nowIso
      });
    }

    return participant;
  }

  public getEnrollmentSnapshot(participantId: string): EnrollmentSnapshot | null {
    const p = this.getParticipant(participantId);
    if (!p) return null;
    const prov = verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance(p);
    let qState: 'qualified' | 'unqualified_pre_consent' | 'unqualified_synthetic' | 'unqualified_internal' | 'unqualified_legacy' = 'qualified';
    if (!p.consent_given_at_utc) {
      qState = 'unqualified_pre_consent';
    } else if (p.source_channel === 'synthetic_fixture' || p.participant_class === 'synthetic') {
      qState = 'unqualified_synthetic';
    } else if (p.cohort_id === 'cohort_internal_alpha' || p.participant_class === 'internal') {
      qState = 'unqualified_internal';
    } else if (p.participant_class === 'legacy_unqualified') {
      qState = 'unqualified_legacy';
    } else if (!prov.verified) {
      qState = 'unqualified_pre_consent';
    }

    return {
      participant_id: p.participant_id,
      cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
      source_channel: p.source_channel,
      participant_class: p.participant_class || (p.is_external_tester ? 'qualified_external' : 'internal'),
      invite_code: p.invite_code,
      invite_token: p.invite_token,
      enrollment_proof: p.enrollment_proof,
      consent_policy_version: p.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0',
      consent_given_at_utc: p.consent_given_at_utc,
      enrolled_at_utc: p.first_seen_at_utc,
      profile_id: p.profile_id,
      app_version: p.app_version,
      build_number: p.build_number,
      entitlement_tier: p.entitlement_tier,
      experiment_variant_id: p.experiment_variant_id,
      qualification_state: qState
    };
  }

  public getActiveParticipantContext(): ActiveBetaContextRecord | null {
    return getActiveBetaContext();
  }

  public setActiveParticipantContext(participantId: string): BetaParticipant {
    const p = this.getParticipant(participantId);
    if (!p) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot set active participant: participant ${participantId} not found`);
    }
    setActiveBetaContext({
      participant_id: p.participant_id,
      cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
      invite_code: p.invite_code,
      is_external_tester: Boolean(p.is_external_tester),
      experiment_variant_id: p.experiment_variant_id,
      enrolled_at_utc: p.first_seen_at_utc
    });
    return p;
  }

  public clearActiveParticipantContext(): void {
    clearActiveBetaContext();
  }

  public getParticipant(participantId: string): BetaParticipant | null {
    const rec = getBetaParticipant(participantId);
    return rec ? recordToParticipant(rec) : null;
  }

  public updateParticipantActivity(participantId: string): void {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    updateBetaParticipantLastSeen(participantId, nowIso);
  }

  public listParticipants(cohortId?: string): BetaParticipant[] {
    const recs = listBetaParticipants(cohortId);
    return recs.map(recordToParticipant);
  }

  public getPilotActorContext(operatorSecret?: string, participantId?: string): PilotActorContext {
    const configuredSecret = getOperatorSigningSecret() || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SECRET || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY;
    if (operatorSecret && configuredSecret && operatorSecret === configuredSecret) {
      return {
        role: 'operator',
        actor_id: 'op_local',
        is_operator: true,
        is_enrolled: false,
        server_revision: '1.0.1-beta.11',
        safe_limitations: ['memory_only_secret', 'server_derived_metrics_only']
      };
    }

    const targetPid = participantId || this.getActiveParticipantContext()?.participant_id;
    if (targetPid) {
      const p = this.getParticipant(targetPid);
      if (p) {
        const snapshot = this.getEnrollmentSnapshot(p.participant_id);
        return {
          role: 'participant',
          actor_id: p.participant_id,
          is_operator: false,
          is_enrolled: true,
          participant_id: p.participant_id,
          profile_id: p.profile_id || 'default',
          cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
          consent_version: p.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0',
          consent_given_at_utc: p.consent_given_at_utc,
          enrollment_qualification: snapshot?.qualification_state || 'qualified',
          entitlement_state: p.entitlement_tier,
          server_revision: '1.0.1-beta.11',
          safe_limitations: ['local_first', 'deidentified_telemetry', 'no_medical_diagnosis']
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      role: 'unassigned',
      actor_id: 'anon_local',
      is_operator: false,
      is_enrolled: false,
      server_revision: '1.0.1-beta.11',
      safe_limitations: ['unassigned_pilot_actor']
    };
  }

  public validateAndEnrollParticipant(req: EnrollParticipantRequest): EnrollParticipantResponse {
    if (!req) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Enrollment payload is required', error_code: 'MISSING_PAYLOAD' };
    }

    // 1. STRICT REJECTION OF CALLER-AUTHORED AUTHORITY FIELDS (Acceptance Criterion 3 & 4)
    const rawReq = req as any;
    if (
      rawReq.participant_id !== undefined ||
      rawReq.entitlement_tier !== undefined ||
      rawReq.participant_class !== undefined ||
      rawReq.is_external_tester !== undefined ||
      rawReq.is_migration !== undefined ||
      rawReq.bypass_flags !== undefined
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Caller-authored authority fields (participant_id, entitlement_tier, participant_class, is_external_tester, is_migration) are strictly rejected',
        error_code: 'CALLER_AUTHORED_FIELD_REJECTED'
      };
    }

    const inviteCode = req.invite_code ? req.invite_code.trim() : '';
    if (!inviteCode) {
      return { success: false, error: 'invite_code is required', error_code: 'MISSING_INVITE_CODE' };
    }

    const consentVersion = req.consent_version ? req.consent_version.trim() : '';
    if (!consentVersion) {
      return { success: false, error: 'consent_version is required', error_code: 'MISSING_CONSENT_VERSION' };
    }

    const consentGivenAt = req.consent_given_at_utc ? req.consent_given_at_utc.trim() : '';
    if (!consentGivenAt) {
      return { success: false, error: 'consent_given_at_utc is required', error_code: 'MISSING_CONSENT_TIMESTAMP' };
    }
    const consentMs = Date.parse(consentGivenAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(consentMs) || consentMs > Date.now() + 300000) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Consent timestamp cannot be in the future', error_code: 'INVALID_OR_FUTURE_CONSENT' };
    }

    const profileId = req.profile_id ? req.profile_id.trim() : '';
    if (!profileId) {
      return { success: false, error: 'profile_id is required', error_code: 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID' };
    }

    // Verify profile exists in database
    const profile = getUserProfile(profileId);
    if (!profile) {
      return { success: false, error: `Profile '${profileId}' not found`, error_code: 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' };
    }

    // Check cross-profile conflict
    const activeCtx = getActiveBetaContext();
    if (activeCtx && activeCtx.is_external_tester) {
      const existingActive = this.getParticipant(activeCtx.participant_id);
      if (existingActive && existingActive.profile_id && existingActive.profile_id !== profileId) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Cross-profile conflict: current installation already has an active participant (${activeCtx.participant_id}) bound to profile ${existingActive.profile_id}`,
          error_code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_CONFLICT'
        };
      }
    }

    // Verify invite token / envelope
    let targetCode = inviteCode;
    let cohortId = 'cohort_closed_beta_pilot_1';
    let isSignedEnvelope = false;
    let isRehearsal = false;
    let envelopeNonce: string | undefined;
    let envelopeId: string | undefined;

    if (inviteCode.startsWith('BETA.')) {
      const tokenResult = verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(inviteCode);
      if (!tokenResult.valid) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Invalid signed invite token: ${tokenResult.reason || 'Verification failed'}`,
          error_code: tokenResult.reason || 'INVALID_INVITE_TOKEN'
        };
      }
      isSignedEnvelope = true;
      isRehearsal = Boolean(
        tokenResult.is_rehearsal ||
        tokenResult.envelope?.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' ||
        tokenResult.envelope?.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle' ||
        tokenResult.envelope?.issuer_id === 'test_issuer'
      );
      if (tokenResult.envelope) {
        targetCode = tokenResult.envelope.envelope_id;
        cohortId = tokenResult.envelope.cohort_id;
        envelopeNonce = tokenResult.envelope.nonce;
        envelopeId = tokenResult.envelope.envelope_id;
      } else if (tokenResult.payload) {
        targetCode = tokenResult.payload.invite_code;
        cohortId = tokenResult.payload.cohort_id;
      }
    } else {
      // Legacy unsigned or HMAC code (BETA-XXXX-YYYY-ZZZZ)
      // Cannot create qualified external enrollment per Acceptance Criteria 2 & 3!
      const invite = getBetaInvite(inviteCode);
      if (!invite) {
        return { success: false, error: `Invite code not found: ${inviteCode}`, error_code: 'INVITE_NOT_FOUND' };
      }
      cohortId = invite.cohort_id;
      if (invite.is_revoked) {
        return { success: false, error: `Invite code has been revoked: ${inviteCode}`, error_code: 'INVITE_REVOKED' };
      }
      if (invite.uses_count >= invite.max_uses) {
        return { success: false, error: `Invite code has reached maximum uses: ${inviteCode}`, error_code: 'INVITE_EXHAUSTED' };
      }
    }

    // Check pilot inventory if targetCode corresponds to an inventory envelope
    const pilotEntry = getPilotInventoryEntry(targetCode);
    if (pilotEntry) {
      // 1. Check campaign state
      const campaign = getPilotCampaign(pilotEntry.campaign_id);
      if (campaign) {
        if (campaign.state === 'paused') {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: `Campaign "${pilotEntry.campaign_id}" is currently paused; enrollments are blocked`,
            error_code: 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED'
          };
        }
        if (campaign.state === 'closed' || campaign.state === 'archived') {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: `Campaign "${pilotEntry.campaign_id}" is ${campaign.state}; enrollments are closed`,
            error_code: 'CAMPAIGN_CLOSED'
          };
        }
      }

      // 2. Check revocation
      if (pilotEntry.revocation.is_revoked) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Invitation ${targetCode} has been revoked: ${pilotEntry.revocation.reason || 'Revoked by operator'}`,
          error_code: 'INVITE_REVOKED'
        };
      }

      // 3. Check uses count
      if (pilotEntry.uses_count >= pilotEntry.max_uses) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Invitation ${targetCode} has reached maximum uses (${pilotEntry.max_uses})`,
          error_code: 'INVITE_EXHAUSTED'
        };
      }

      // 4. Check consent policy version
      if (pilotEntry.consent_policy_version && pilotEntry.consent_policy_version !== consentVersion) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Consent policy version mismatch: invite requires ${pilotEntry.consent_policy_version}, got ${consentVersion}`,
          error_code: 'CONSENT_VERSION_MISMATCH'
        };
      }

      // 5. Check validity window
      const nowMs = Date.now();
      const notBeforeMs = Date.parse(pilotEntry.validity.not_before_utc);
      const expiresMs = Date.parse(pilotEntry.validity.expires_at_utc);
      if (!Number.isNaN(notBeforeMs) && nowMs < notBeforeMs) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Invitation not yet valid`,
          error_code: 'INVITE_NOT_YET_VALID'
        };
      }
      if (!Number.isNaN(expiresMs) && nowMs >= expiresMs) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Invitation has expired`,
          error_code: 'INVITE_EXPIRED'
        };
      }

      // 6. Inherit cohort and rehearsal/external qualification from inventory
      cohortId = pilotEntry.cohort_id;
      if (pilotEntry.is_rehearsal || pilotEntry.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal') {
        isRehearsal = true;
      }
    }

    // Derive server-side values:
    const pid = `usr_beta_${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;
    let pClass: ParticipantClass;
    let isExternal = false;
    if (isRehearsal) {
      pClass = 'internal_rehearsal';
      isExternal = false;
    } else if (isSignedEnvelope) {
      pClass = 'qualified_external';
      isExternal = true;
    } else {
      pClass = 'legacy_unqualified';
      isExternal = false;
    }
    // Commercial entitlement is derived directly from G34 entitlement authority!
    const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
    const enrollmentProof = isSignedEnvelope
      ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${targetCode}:${cohortId}:${profileId}`).digest('hex')
      : undefined;

    try {
      const participant: BetaParticipant = {
        participant_id: pid,
        cohort_id: cohortId,
        source_channel: 'invite_code',
        invite_code: inviteCode,
        invite_token: inviteCode.startsWith('BETA.') ? inviteCode : undefined,
        enrollment_proof: enrollmentProof,
        app_version: '1.0.1-beta.11',
        build_number: '20260920.1',
        entitlement_tier: entState.tier,
        experiment_variant_id: 'variant_corridor_standard',
        first_seen_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        last_seen_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        consent_given_at_utc: consentGivenAt,
        is_external_tester: isExternal,
        profile_id: profileId,
        consent_policy_version: consentVersion,
        participant_class: pClass
      };

      saveBetaParticipant(participant);

      if (pilotEntry) {
        incrementPilotInventoryUses(pilotEntry.invite_id);
      }

      // Record nonce if signed envelope to prevent replay
      if (envelopeNonce) {
        recordBetaNonce(envelopeNonce, envelopeId);
      }

      if (isExternal) {
        setActiveBetaContext({
          participant_id: pid,
          cohort_id: participant.cohort_id,
          invite_code: participant.invite_code,
          is_external_tester: true,
          experiment_variant_id: participant.experiment_variant_id,
          enrolled_at_utc: participant.first_seen_at_utc
        });
      } else if (pClass === 'internal_rehearsal') {
        setActiveBetaContext({
          participant_id: pid,
          cohort_id: participant.cohort_id,
          invite_code: participant.invite_code,
          is_external_tester: false,
          experiment_variant_id: participant.experiment_variant_id,
          enrolled_at_utc: participant.first_seen_at_utc
        });
      }

      const actorContext = this.getPilotActorContext(undefined, participant.participant_id);
      return {
        success: true,
        participant,
        actor_context: actorContext
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Enrollment registration failed',
        error_code: 'ENROLLMENT_FAILED'
      };
    }
  }

  public mintContextConfirmationToken(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    profileId: string;
    windowId?: string;
    windowRevision?: number;
  }): string {
    return mintContextConfirmationToken(params);
  }

  public verifyContextConfirmationToken(token: string, expectedSessionId: string) {
    return verifyContextConfirmationToken(token, expectedSessionId);
  }

  public confirmUsefulOutcome(input: {
    confirmation_id?: string;
    session_id: string;
    participant_id?: string;
    context_token: string;
    confirmed_by?: 'participant' | 'coach' | 'recipient';
    recipient_action?: 'viewed_by_coach' | 'viewed_by_athlete' | 'stored_in_records' | 'shared_summary_confirmed';
    user_notes?: string;
    idempotency_key?: string;
  }): UsefulOutcomeConfirmation {
    if (!input.context_token) {
      throw new Error('INVALID_OR_STALE_CONTEXT_TOKEN: context_token is strictly required to confirm useful outcome');
    }

    const tokenRes = verifyContextConfirmationToken(input.context_token, input.session_id);
    if (!tokenRes.valid || !tokenRes.payload) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_OR_STALE_CONTEXT_TOKEN: ${tokenRes.reason || 'Verification failed'}`);
    }

    // Profile and participant workspace binding checks (Scenario 7 & 8)
    if (input.participant_id) {
      const participant = getBetaParticipant(input.participant_id);
      if (participant && participant.profile_id && tokenRes.payload.profile_id && participant.profile_id !== tokenRes.payload.profile_id) {
        throw new Error(`FOREIGN_CONTEXT_TOKEN: context token profile (${tokenRes.payload.profile_id}) does not match participant profile (${participant.profile_id})`);
      }
    }
    const currentSession = getSession(input.session_id);
    if (
      currentSession &&
      (currentSession as any).user_id &&
      (currentSession as any).user_id !== 'default' &&
      tokenRes.payload.profile_id &&
      (currentSession as any).user_id !== tokenRes.payload.profile_id
    ) {
      throw new Error(`FOREIGN_CONTEXT_TOKEN: context token profile (${tokenRes.payload.profile_id}) does not match session user_id (${(currentSession as any).user_id})`);
    }

    if (input.idempotency_key) {
      const existing = getUsefulConfirmationByIdempotency(input.idempotency_key);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    }

    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(input.context_token).digest('hex');
    const confId = input.confirmation_id || `conf_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const confirmation: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation = {
      confirmation_id: confId,
      session_id: input.session_id,
      participant_id: input.participant_id || tokenRes.payload.profile_id,
      context_id: `ctx_${input.session_id}`,
      confirmed_by: input.confirmed_by || 'participant',
      recipient_action: input.recipient_action || 'shared_summary_confirmed',
      confirmed_at_utc: nowIso,
      user_notes: input.user_notes,
      context_token_hash: tokenHash,
      idempotency_key: input.idempotency_key
    };

    saveUsefulConfirmation(confirmation);

    const existingEvents = getBetaEvents({ participant_id: confirmation.participant_id, event_type: 'outcome' });
    for (const ev of existingEvents) {
      if (ev.session_id === input.session_id) {
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(ev.payload_json);
          payload.useful_outcome_confirmed = true;
          payload.confirmation_details = confirmation;
          payload.is_accepted_outcome = Boolean(payload.technical_completion) && true;
          saveBetaEvent({
            event_id: ev.event_id,
            event_type: ev.event_type,
            participant_id: ev.participant_id,
            cohort_id: ev.cohort_id,
            session_id: ev.session_id,
            payload_json: JSON.stringify(payload),
            is_synthetic: Boolean(ev.is_synthetic),
            created_at_utc: ev.created_at_utc
          });
        } catch {}
      }
    }

    return confirmation;
  }

  public recordNaturalRepeat(input: {
    repeat_id?: string;
    participant_id: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    baseline_session_id: string;
    repeat_session_id: string;
    repeat_type?: 'prompted' | 'unprompted';
  }): NaturalRepeatRecord {
    if (input.baseline_session_id === input.repeat_session_id) {
      throw new Error('SAME_SESSION_NOT_REPEAT: baseline and repeat sessions must be distinct');
    }

    const baseline = getSession(input.baseline_session_id);
    const repeat = getSession(input.repeat_session_id);
    if (!baseline) {
      throw new Error(`BASELINE_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ${input.baseline_session_id}`);
    }
    if (!repeat) {
      throw new Error(`REPEAT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ${input.repeat_session_id}`);
    }

    if (baseline.source_sha256 && repeat.source_sha256 && baseline.source_sha256 === repeat.source_sha256) {
      throw new Error('IDENTICAL_SOURCE_NOT_REPEAT: sessions derived from identical source hash cannot constitute natural repeat');
    }

    const baselineConf = getUsefulConfirmation(input.baseline_session_id);
    if (!baselineConf) {
      throw new Error('BASELINE_OUTCOME_NOT_CONFIRMED: baseline session must have confirmed useful outcome');
    }

    const repeatConf = getUsefulConfirmation(input.repeat_session_id);
    if (!repeatConf) {
      throw new Error('REPEAT_OUTCOME_NOT_CONFIRMED: repeat session must have confirmed useful outcome');
    }

    const participant = getBetaParticipant(input.participant_id);
    const isQualifiedExternal = participant && participant.is_external_tester && participant.participant_class === 'qualified_external';

    const record: NaturalRepeatRecord = {
      repeat_id: input.repeat_id || `rep_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`,
      participant_id: input.participant_id,
      cohort_id: input.cohort_id,
      baseline_session_id: input.baseline_session_id,
      baseline_context_id: `ctx_${input.baseline_session_id}`,
      baseline_completed_at_utc: baseline.end_time || new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(),
      baseline_source_hash: baseline.source_sha256 || undefined,
      repeat_session_id: input.repeat_session_id,
      repeat_context_id: `ctx_${input.repeat_session_id}`,
      repeat_completed_at_utc: repeat.end_time || new Date().toISOString(),
      repeat_source_hash: repeat.source_sha256 || undefined,
      repeat_type: input.repeat_type || 'unprompted',
      is_distinct_session: true,
      is_qualified_repeat: Boolean(isQualifiedExternal),
      right_censored: false
    };

    saveNaturalRepeat(record);
    return record;
  }

  public getPilotAuthoritySnapshot(operatorSecret?: string, participantId?: string): PilotAuthoritySnapshot {
    const configuredSecret = getOperatorSigningSecret() || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SECRET || process.env.OPERATOR_INVITE_SIGNING_KEY;
    const isOperator = Boolean(operatorSecret && configuredSecret && operatorSecret === configuredSecret);

    const activeCtx = getActiveBetaContext();
    const targetPid = participantId || activeCtx?.participant_id;
    const participant = targetPid ? getBetaParticipant(targetPid) : null;
    const entState = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();

    const role: 'participant' | 'operator' | 'unassigned' = isOperator
      ? 'operator'
      : participant
      ? 'participant'
      : 'unassigned';

    const pClass: ParticipantClass = participant
      ? (participant.participant_class as ParticipantClass) || (participant.is_external_tester ? 'qualified_external' : 'internal')
      : 'legacy_unqualified';

    let inviteTrustState: 'verified_signed' | 'rehearsal_signed' | 'legacy_unqualified' | 'untrusted' | 'none' = 'none';
    if (participant) {
      const candidateToken = participant.invite_token || (participant.invite_code?.startsWith('BETA.') ? participant.invite_code : undefined);
      if (candidateToken) {
        const v = verifyOperatorSignedInviteToken(candidateToken, { allowUsedNonce: true });
        if (v.valid) {
          inviteTrustState = v.is_rehearsal || participant.participant_class === 'internal_rehearsal' ? 'rehearsal_signed' : 'verified_signed';
        } else {
          inviteTrustState = 'untrusted';
        }
      } else if (participant.invite_code) {
        inviteTrustState = 'legacy_unqualified';
      }
    }

    let rightCensored = false;
    if (participant && pClass === 'qualified_external') {
      const confs = listUsefulConfirmations(participant.participant_id);
      const repeats = listNaturalRepeats(participant.participant_id);
      if (confs.length >= 1 && repeats.length === 0) {
        rightCensored = true;
      }
    }

    const typedReasons: string[] = [];
    if (!participant && !isOperator) {
      typedReasons.push('PARTICIPANT_NOT_ENROLLED');
    }
    if (participant && !participant.consent_given_at_utc) {
      typedReasons.push('CONSENT_REQUIRED');
    }
    if (participant && pClass === 'legacy_unqualified') {
      typedReasons.push('LEGACY_UNQUALIFIED_ENROLLMENT');
    }
    if (participant && pClass === 'internal_rehearsal') {
      typedReasons.push('INTERNAL_REHEARSAL_PARTICIPANT');
    }
    if (rightCensored) {
      typedReasons.push('RIGHT_CENSORED_AWAITING_REPEAT');
    }

    let safeNextAction = 'enter_signed_invite';
    if (isOperator) {
      safeNextAction = 'manage_operator_evidence';
    } else if (!participant) {
      safeNextAction = 'enter_signed_invite';
    } else if (!participant.consent_given_at_utc) {
      safeNextAction = 'review_consent';
    } else if (rightCensored) {
      safeNextAction = 'perform_distinct_session';
    } else {
      safeNextAction = 'analyze_canonical_session';
    }

    const profileId = participant?.profile_id || (activeCtx ? 'default' : undefined);

    return {
      server_derived_role: role,
      participant_id: participant?.participant_id,
      participant_class: pClass,
      cohort_id: participant?.cohort_id,
      invite_trust_state: inviteTrustState,
      consent_policy_version: participant?.consent_policy_version || PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
      consent_given_at_utc: participant?.consent_given_at_utc,
      profile_id: profileId,
      profile_bound: Boolean(profileId),
      entitlement_tier: entState.tier,
      entitlement_revision: entState.active_revision || 1,
      workspace_fingerprint: participant ? `wp_${participant.participant_id}_${participant.cohort_id}` : undefined,
      readiness: {
        outcome_ready: Boolean(participant),
        repeat_ready: Boolean(participant && listUsefulConfirmations(participant.participant_id).length >= 1),
        support_ready: true,
        evidence_ready: Boolean(participant && listUsefulConfirmations(participant.participant_id).length >= 1)
      },
      right_censored: rightCensored,
      typed_reasons: typedReasons,
      safe_next_action: safeNextAction
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Beta Scale / Narrow / Pause Decision Framework
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Can return: 'scale' | 'narrow' | 'pause' | 'inconclusive'
 * - Does NOT hardcode unsupported statistical certainty.
 * - If real external tester evidence is absent or longitudinal windows are immature:
 *   returns 'inconclusive' as the truthful, scientifically honest result.
 * - Evaluates cohort size, activation/TTV, repeat behavior, support burden, unsupported input loss, WTP intent.
 */

import {
  BetaDecisionMatrix,
  BetaDecisionVerdict,
  BetaDecisionDimensionAssessment
} from '../../shared/betaContract';
import { ClosedBetaEvidenceReport } from './betaCohortAnalysis';

export class BetaDecisionFramework {
  public static evaluateReport(
    report: ClosedBetaEvidenceReport,
    options?: {
      workItemId?: string;
      targetGitHead?: string;
      buildVersion?: string;
    }
  ): BetaDecisionMatrix {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const realParticipants = report.participants_summary.real_external_participants;
    const hasRealTesters = realParticipants > 0;

    const assessments: BetaDecisionDimensionAssessment[] = [];

    // 1. External Cohort Maturity
    const cohortAssessment: BetaDecisionDimensionAssessment = {
      dimension: 'external_cohort_sample_size',
      evidence_status: realParticipants >= 20 ? 'mature' : realParticipants > 0 ? 'emerging' : 'insufficient_external_evidence',
      metric_value: `N = ${realParticipants} real external participants (Total: ${report.participants_summary.total_participants})`,
      threshold_rule: 'Exploratory research heuristic: target >= 20 external participants with completed observation windows',
      verdict_contribution: 'inconclusive',
      notes: realParticipants === 0
        ? 'No external invited testers recorded yet; verification conducted on synthetic multi-signal fixtures.'
        : `Cohort size is ${realParticipants}; external observation accumulating.`,
      is_normative: false
    };
    assessments.push(cohortAssessment);

    // 2. Activation & Time to Value
    const overviewAttainment = report.time_to_value.target_attainment.overview_under_30s.percentage ?? 0;
    const northStarRatio = report.north_star.north_star_ratio;
    const activationStatus = hasRealTesters ? (overviewAttainment >= 80 && northStarRatio !== null && northStarRatio >= 1.5 ? 'mature' : 'emerging') : 'insufficient_external_evidence';
    assessments.push({
      dimension: 'activation_and_ttv_attainment',
      evidence_status: activationStatus,
      metric_value: `TTV <= 30s: ${overviewAttainment}%; North Star (Outcomes/User): ${northStarRatio !== null ? northStarRatio : 'unavailable (N = 0 external)'}`,
      threshold_rule: 'Strategic UX time target: TTV overview <= 30s attainment >= 80%, Outcomes/User >= 1.5',
      verdict_contribution: 'inconclusive',
      notes: !hasRealTesters
        ? 'Activation mechanics verified on automated fixtures; awaiting live user timing data.'
        : `Observed ${overviewAttainment}% of sessions achieve canonical overview within 30 seconds.`,
      is_normative: false
    });

    // 3. Repeat & Retention
    const secondSessionRate = report.repeat_and_retention.second_accepted_session_rate_pct;
    assessments.push({
      dimension: 'repeat_and_retention',
      evidence_status: hasRealTesters && secondSessionRate !== null && secondSessionRate > 0 ? 'emerging' : 'insufficient_external_evidence',
      metric_value: secondSessionRate !== null ? `Second accepted session rate: ${secondSessionRate}%` : 'Second accepted session rate: unavailable (N = 0 external)',
      threshold_rule: 'Exploratory research heuristic: >= 40% repeat accepted sessions in active cohort',
      verdict_contribution: 'inconclusive',
      notes: !hasRealTesters || secondSessionRate === null
        ? 'Longitudinal retention windows are right-censored pending external beta recruitment.'
        : `Second session rate is ${secondSessionRate}%.`,
      is_normative: false
    });

    // 4. Support Burden & Input Loss
    const unsupportedRate = report.trust_and_quality.unsupported_format_rate_pct;
    const silentDrops = report.trust_and_quality.silent_drops_count;
    const privacyViolations = report.trust_and_quality.privacy_scan_failures;
    const isQualityHealthy = silentDrops === 0 && privacyViolations === 0 && (unsupportedRate === null || unsupportedRate <= 25);
    assessments.push({
      dimension: 'trust_quality_and_support_burden',
      evidence_status: 'mature',
      metric_value: `Unsupported format: ${unsupportedRate !== null ? `${unsupportedRate}%` : 'unavailable (N = 0 external)'}; Silent drops: ${silentDrops}; Privacy violations: ${privacyViolations}`,
      threshold_rule: 'Strategic quality target: zero silent drops, zero privacy violations, unsupported input <= 25%',
      verdict_contribution: 'inconclusive',
      notes: isQualityHealthy
        ? 'Zero silent drops and zero privacy leaks verified under strict automated scanners.'
        : 'Quality regression detected in silent drops or privacy boundaries.',
      is_normative: false
    });

    // 5. Willingness-to-Pay (WTP) & Pricing Intent
    const intentRate = report.pricing_and_wtp.intent_rate_pct;
    assessments.push({
      dimension: 'monetization_wtp_intent',
      evidence_status: hasRealTesters && report.pricing_and_wtp.total_exposures >= 10 ? 'emerging' : 'insufficient_external_evidence',
      metric_value: intentRate !== null
        ? `WTP purchase intent rate: ${intentRate}% (${report.pricing_and_wtp.total_purchase_requests}/${report.pricing_and_wtp.total_exposures} exposures)`
        : 'WTP purchase intent rate: unavailable (N = 0 external)',
      threshold_rule: 'Exploratory validation corridor: >= 8% click-to-request purchase intent on beta offer screens',
      verdict_contribution: 'inconclusive',
      notes: !hasRealTesters
        ? 'Pricing corridors (Personal 99-149 / 69-99, Pro 199-299, Academic 129-199) configured and testable locally; awaiting external beta participant responses.'
        : `Intent rate is ${intentRate}%.`,
      is_normative: false
    });

    // 6. Scientific Invariance & Analytical Separation
    assessments.push({
      dimension: 'evidence_completeness_and_scientific_invariance',
      evidence_status: 'mature',
      metric_value: 'Frozen Protocol v1.1.0 and canonical session calculations strictly invariant across all commercial tiers',
      threshold_rule: 'Invariant scientific truth across Trial, Beta, Personal, Professional, and Academic tiers',
      verdict_contribution: 'scale',
      notes: 'No marketing, monetization, or LLM feedback logic can modify CanonicalSessionResult or analytical algorithms.',
      is_normative: true
    });

    // Overall Market Verdict:
    // Per strategy and AGENT_TASK.md: without a separately authorized/versioned normative
    // decision policy approved by the owner, the authoritative market verdict remains 'inconclusive'.
    const overallVerdict: BetaDecisionVerdict = 'inconclusive';

    const confidenceLimitations = [
      'External beta participants are not yet recruited in the local workstation environment.',
      'Longitudinal observation windows (30d / 60d / 90d) are right-censored.',
      'Pricing intent measurements reflect simulated beta survey responses, not settled bank transactions.',
      'Product and instrumentation readiness is verified across comprehensive automated test fixtures.'
    ];

    const recommendation =
      'Controlled closed-beta instrumentation and operator kit are fully verified across test fixtures. Maintain status as INCONCLUSIVE until real external participants are invited and longitudinal data accumulates.';

    const workItemId = options?.workItemId || 'unbound_product_runtime';
    const targetGitHead = options?.targetGitHead || options?.buildVersion || 'unbound_product_runtime';

    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      generated_at_utc: nowIso,
      work_item_id: workItemId,
      target_git_head: targetGitHead,
      overall_verdict: overallVerdict,
      external_evidence_status: {
        real_invited_participants_count: realParticipants,
        has_real_external_testers: hasRealTesters,
        active_cohorts_count: Object.keys(report.participants_summary.by_cohort).length,
        observation_window_status: hasRealTesters ? 'partial' : 'awaiting_external_cohort_data'
      },
      dimension_assessments: assessments,
      summary_recommendation: recommendation,
      confidence_limitations: confidenceLimitations
    };
  }
}
