/**
 * Beta Evidence Exporter Service
 *
 * Grounded in:
 * - Local-first, privacy-safe evidence packaging
 * - Strict prohibition of raw physiology, athlete names, device IDs, local paths, or medical claims
 * - Manifest with exact event counts and SHA-256 integrity hash
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import {
  BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  BetaEvidenceExportBundle,
  BetaParticipant,
  AcceptedSessionOutcome,
  TimeToValueRecord,
  FeatureUsageEvent,
  TrustFailureEvent,
  WtpOfferInteraction,
  BetaFeedbackSubmission,
  BetaSupportIncident,
  MktR07ObservationRecord,
  createBlankMktR07Protocol,
  scanObjectForProhibitedFields,
  UsefulOutcomeConfirmation,
  PilotWorkContext,
  NaturalRepeatRecord,
  SupportEpisode
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export interface ExporterInputData {
  participant: BetaParticipant;
  accepted_outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[];
  ttv_records: TimeToValueRecord[];
  feature_events: FeatureUsageEvent[];
  trust_events: TrustFailureEvent[];
  wtp_interactions: WtpOfferInteraction[];
  feedback_submissions: BetaFeedbackSubmission[];
  support_incidents: BetaSupportIncident[];
  mkt_r07_observations?: MktR07ObservationRecord[];
  useful_confirmations?: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation[];
  work_contexts?: PilotWorkContext[];
  natural_repeats?: NaturalRepeatRecord[];
  support_episodes?: SupportEpisode[];
}

import { getAppDataDir } from '../db/db';

export function getSafeBetaEvidenceExportDir(): string {
  const dir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'beta_evidence');
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
  return dir;
}

function isWithinDirectory(parentDir: string, candidateDir: string): boolean {
  const rel = path.relative(path.resolve(parentDir), path.resolve(candidateDir));
  return rel === '' || (!rel.startsWith('..') && !path.isAbsolute(rel));
}

export function validateSafeExportDirectory(candidateDir?: string): string {
  const defaultDir = getSafeBetaEvidenceExportDir();
  if (!candidateDir || candidateDir.trim() === '') {
    return defaultDir;
  }

  // Reject path traversal tokens
  if (candidateDir.includes('..')) {
    throw new Error('Unsafe export path: directory traversal (..) is strictly prohibited');
  }

  const resolved = path.resolve(candidateDir);
  const appData = path.resolve(getAppDataDir());
  const userProfile = process.env.USERPROFILE ? path.resolve(process.env.USERPROFILE) : null;
  const projectRoot = path.resolve(process.cwd());

  // Strictly forbid exporting into .agy
  const agyDir = path.join(projectRoot, '.agy');
  if (isWithinDirectory(agyDir, resolved)) {
    throw new Error('Unsafe export path: export into .agy is strictly prohibited');
  }

  const isUnderAppData = isWithinDirectory(appData, resolved);
  const isUnderDist = isWithinDirectory(path.join(projectRoot, 'dist'), resolved);
  const isUnderUser = userProfile ? (
    isWithinDirectory(path.join(userProfile, 'Downloads'), resolved) ||
    isWithinDirectory(path.join(userProfile, 'Documents'), resolved)
  ) : false;

  const isSystemRoot = resolved === path.parse(resolved).root || (userProfile && resolved === userProfile);
  if (isSystemRoot || (!isUnderAppData && !isUnderDist && !isUnderUser)) {
    throw new Error(`Unsafe export path: directory ${candidateDir} is not an authorized export location`);
  }

  return resolved;
}

export class BetaEvidenceExporter {
  public static compileBundle(data: ExporterInputData): BetaEvidenceExportBundle {
    const bundleId = `bundle_${data.participant.cohort_id}_${data.participant.participant_id}_${Date.now()}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const sanitizedParticipant: BetaParticipant = {
      ...data.participant,
      invite_token: undefined,
      invite_code: data.participant.invite_code ? 'REDACTED_INVITE_CODE' : undefined
    };

    const preManifestBundle: Omit<BetaEvidenceExportBundle, 'manifest' | 'privacy_verification'> = {
      schema_version: BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      participant_profile: sanitizedParticipant,
      accepted_outcomes: data.accepted_outcomes,
      ttv_records: data.ttv_records,
      feature_events: data.feature_events,
      trust_events: data.trust_events,
      wtp_interactions: data.wtp_interactions,
      feedback_submissions: data.feedback_submissions,
      support_incidents: data.support_incidents,
      ...(data.mkt_r07_observations ? { mkt_r07_observations: data.mkt_r07_observations } : {}),
      ...(data.useful_confirmations ? { useful_confirmations: data.useful_confirmations } : {}),
      ...(data.work_contexts ? { work_contexts: data.work_contexts } : {}),
      ...(data.natural_repeats ? { natural_repeats: data.natural_repeats } : {}),
      ...(data.support_episodes ? { support_episodes: data.support_episodes } : {})
    };

    // 1. Run fail-closed privacy scan
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(preManifestBundle);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Beta evidence bundle contains prohibited privacy-violating fields: ${violations.join('; ')}`);
    }

    // 2. Compute canonical hash of the event contents
    const payloadJson = JSON.stringify(preManifestBundle);
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payloadJson, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    const manifest = {
      manifest_version: '1.0.0' as const,
      bundle_id: bundleId,
      participant_id: data.participant.participant_id,
      cohort_id: data.participant.cohort_id,
      app_version: data.participant.app_version,
      build_version: data.participant.build_number,
      generated_at_utc: nowIso,
      source_channel: data.participant.source_channel,
      event_counts: {
        accepted_outcomes: data.accepted_outcomes.length,
        ttv_records: data.ttv_records.length,
        feature_events: data.feature_events.length,
        trust_events: data.trust_events.length,
        wtp_interactions: data.wtp_interactions.length,
        feedback_submissions: data.feedback_submissions.length,
        support_incidents: data.support_incidents.length,
        ...(data.mkt_r07_observations ? { mkt_r07_observations: data.mkt_r07_observations.length } : {}),
        ...(data.useful_confirmations ? { useful_confirmations: data.useful_confirmations.length } : {}),
        ...(data.work_contexts ? { work_contexts: data.work_contexts.length } : {}),
        ...(data.natural_repeats ? { natural_repeats: data.natural_repeats.length } : {}),
        ...(data.support_episodes ? { support_episodes: data.support_episodes.length } : {})
      },
      sha256: hash
    };

    return {
      ...preManifestBundle,
      manifest,
      privacy_verification: {
        scanned_at_utc: nowIso,
        prohibited_pattern_violations: [],
        is_privacy_cleared: true
      }
    };
  }

  public static exportToFile(data: ExporterInputData, targetDirectory?: string): { filePath: string; bundle: BetaEvidenceExportBundle } {
    const bundle = this.compileBundle(data);
    const safeDir = validateSafeExportDirectory(targetDirectory);
    if (!fs.existsSync(safeDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(safeDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    const fileName = `beta_evidence_${bundle.manifest.cohort_id}_${bundle.manifest.participant_id}_${Date.now()}.json`;
    const filePath = path.join(safeDir, fileName);
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(bundle, null, 2), 'utf8');
    return { filePath, bundle };
  }

  public static exportBlankMktR07Protocol(targetDirectory?: string): { filePath: string; protocol: MktR07ObservationRecord } {
    const protocol = createBlankMktR07Protocol();
    const safeDir = validateSafeExportDirectory(targetDirectory);
    if (!fs.existsSync(safeDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(safeDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    const filePath = path.join(safeDir, 'mkt_r07_blank_observation_protocol.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(protocol, null, 2), 'utf8');
    return { filePath, protocol };
  }
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/beta/betaEvidenceImporter.ts

/**
 * Beta Evidence Importer & Aggregator Service
 *
 * Grounded in:
 * - Schema validation & SHA-256 integrity verification
 * - Duplicate / replayed bundle detection (anti-double-counting) with SQLite replay protection
 * - Strict runtime schema validation (reject unknown fields, deep event checks)
 * - Strict privacy verification on import
 * - Zero modification of local user sessions or scientific databases
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import {
  BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1,
  BetaEvidenceExportBundle,
  MktR07ObservationRecord,
  UsefulOutcomeConfirmation,
  PilotWorkContext,
  NaturalRepeatRecord,
  SupportEpisode,
  evaluateMktR07Status,
  filterNaturalMarketObservations,
  scanObjectForProhibitedFields,
  validateBetaEvidenceBundleStrict,
  adaptBetaBundleV1ToV2
} from '../../shared/betaContract';
import {
  saveBetaImportedBundle,
  hasBetaImportedBundleId,
  hasBetaImportedPayloadSha,
  listBetaImportedBundles,
  saveUsefulConfirmation,
  savePilotWorkContext,
  saveNaturalRepeat,
  saveSupportEpisode,
  getBetaParticipant,
  getDb
} from '../db/db';
import { verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance } from './betaCohortService';

export interface ImportValidationResult {
  is_valid: boolean;
  bundle_id?: string;
  error_code?: string;
  rejection_reason?: string;
  violations?: string[];
  imported_bundle?: BetaEvidenceExportBundle;
  enrollment_verified?: boolean;
  unverified_external?: boolean;
  provenance_reason?: string;
  is_conflict?: boolean;
  is_legacy_adapted?: boolean;
  identical_duplicate?: boolean;
}

export class BetaEvidenceImporter {
  private importedBundleIds = new Set<string>();
  private importedPayloadHashes = new Set<string>();
  private importedBundleIdToSha = new Map<string, string>();
  private validBundles: BetaEvidenceExportBundle[] = [];
  private persistToDb: boolean;

  constructor(options?: { persistToDb?: boolean }) {
    this.persistToDb = options?.persistToDb ?? true;
    if (this.persistToDb) {
      try {
        const records = listBetaImportedBundles();
        for (const r of records) {
          this.importedBundleIds.add(r.bundle_id);
          this.importedPayloadHashes.add(r.payload_sha256);
          this.importedBundleIdToSha.set(r.bundle_id, r.payload_sha256);
          // Rehydrate and revalidate persisted bundle JSON across restarts
          if (r.raw_bundle_json) {
            try {
              let parsed = JSON.parse(r.raw_bundle_json);
              if (parsed.schema_version === BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1) {
                parsed = adaptBetaBundleV1ToV2(parsed);
              }
              const strictRes = validateBetaEvidenceBundleStrict(parsed);
              if (strictRes.is_valid) {
                const preManifest = {
                  schema_version: parsed.schema_version,
                  participant_profile: parsed.participant_profile,
                  accepted_outcomes: parsed.accepted_outcomes,
                  ttv_records: parsed.ttv_records,
                  feature_events: parsed.feature_events,
                  trust_events: parsed.trust_events,
                  wtp_interactions: parsed.wtp_interactions,
                  feedback_submissions: parsed.feedback_submissions,
                  support_incidents: parsed.support_incidents,
                  ...(parsed.mkt_r07_observations ? { mkt_r07_observations: parsed.mkt_r07_observations } : {}),
                  ...(parsed.useful_confirmations ? { useful_confirmations: parsed.useful_confirmations } : {}),
                  ...(parsed.work_contexts ? { work_contexts: parsed.work_contexts } : {}),
                  ...(parsed.natural_repeats ? { natural_repeats: parsed.natural_repeats } : {}),
                  ...(parsed.support_episodes ? { support_episodes: parsed.support_episodes } : {})
                };
                const recomputedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(preManifest), 'utf8').digest('hex');
                if (recomputedHash === parsed.manifest?.sha256) {
                  const privViolations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(preManifest);
                  if (privViolations.length === 0) {
                    this.validBundles.push(parsed as BetaEvidenceExportBundle);
                  }
                }
              }
            } catch {
              // Corrupted persisted record fails closed and is excluded from validBundles
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // If DB is uninitialized in test mocks, continue safely
      }
    }
  }

  public importJsonString(jsonContent: string): ImportValidationResult {
    let parsed: any;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(jsonContent);
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { is_valid: false, rejection_reason: `Malformed JSON: ${e.message}` };
    }

    // Adapt legacy v1 bundles if encountered
    let isLegacyAdapted = false;
    if (parsed && parsed.schema_version === BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1) {
      isLegacyAdapted = true;
      try {
        parsed = adaptBetaBundleV1ToV2(parsed);
      } catch (err: any) {
        return { is_valid: false, rejection_reason: `Legacy bundle adapter failed: ${err.message}` };
      }
    }

    // 1. Strict schema validation (reject unknown fields, invalid types, deep event checks)
    const strictValidation = validateBetaEvidenceBundleStrict(parsed);
    if (!strictValidation.is_valid) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        rejection_reason: `Strict schema validation failed: ${strictValidation.errors.join(', ')}`,
        violations: strictValidation.errors
      };
    }

    const bundle = parsed as BetaEvidenceExportBundle;

    // 2. Cryptographic integrity check (validate payload before replay / duplicate checking)
    const preManifestBundle = {
      schema_version: bundle.schema_version,
      participant_profile: bundle.participant_profile,
      accepted_outcomes: bundle.accepted_outcomes,
      ttv_records: bundle.ttv_records,
      feature_events: bundle.feature_events,
      trust_events: bundle.trust_events,
      wtp_interactions: bundle.wtp_interactions,
      feedback_submissions: bundle.feedback_submissions,
      support_incidents: bundle.support_incidents,
      ...(bundle.mkt_r07_observations ? { mkt_r07_observations: bundle.mkt_r07_observations } : {}),
      ...(bundle.useful_confirmations ? { useful_confirmations: bundle.useful_confirmations } : {}),
      ...(bundle.work_contexts ? { work_contexts: bundle.work_contexts } : {}),
      ...(bundle.natural_repeats ? { natural_repeats: bundle.natural_repeats } : {}),
      ...(bundle.support_episodes ? { support_episodes: bundle.support_episodes } : {})
    };

    const recomputedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(preManifestBundle), 'utf8').digest('hex');
    if (recomputedHash !== bundle.manifest.sha256) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
        rejection_reason: `Integrity check failed: manifest sha256 (${bundle.manifest.sha256}) does not match recomputed hash (${recomputedHash})`
      };
    }

    // 3. Privacy boundary scan
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields(preManifestBundle);
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
        rejection_reason: 'Privacy boundary scan failed: prohibited fields present',
        violations
      };
    }

    // 3b. Pre-consent event check: fail atomically if any events occurred before consent timestamp
    const consentTimeStr = bundle.participant_profile?.consent_given_at_utc;
    if (consentTimeStr) {
      const consentMs = Date.parse(consentTimeStr);
      if (Number.isFinite(consentMs)) {
        const eventsToCheck: Array<{ id: string; time?: string }> = [
          ...(bundle.accepted_outcomes || []).map((o) => ({ id: o.outcome_id, time: o.completed_at_utc })),
          ...(bundle.ttv_records || []).map((t) => ({ id: t.record_id, time: t.created_at_utc })),
          ...(bundle.feature_events || []).map((f) => ({ id: f.event_id, time: f.occurred_at_utc })),
          ...(bundle.trust_events || []).map((t) => ({ id: t.event_id, time: t.occurred_at_utc })),
          ...(bundle.useful_confirmations || []).map((c) => ({ id: c.confirmation_id, time: c.confirmed_at_utc })),
          ...(bundle.natural_repeats || []).map((r) => ({ id: r.repeat_id, time: r.repeat_completed_at_utc }))
        ];
        for (const ev of eventsToCheck) {
          if (ev.time && Date.parse(ev.time) < consentMs - 1000) {
            return {
              is_valid: false,
              bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
              error_code: 'INVALID_BUNDLE_CONSENT_VIOLATION',
              rejection_reason: `Pre-consent data rejected: event ${ev.id} occurred before consent timestamp`
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 3c. Class promotion check: fail atomically if participant class is being promoted without proof
    if (this.persistToDb && bundle.participant_profile?.participant_id) {
      try {
        const existingP = getBetaParticipant(bundle.participant_profile.participant_id);
        if (
          existingP &&
          existingP.participant_class &&
          existingP.participant_class !== 'qualified_external' &&
          bundle.participant_profile.participant_class === 'qualified_external'
        ) {
          return {
            is_valid: false,
            bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
            is_conflict: true,
            error_code: 'CLASS_PROMOTION_UNAUTHORIZED',
            rejection_reason: `Class promotion rejected: participant ${existingP.participant_id} cannot be promoted from ${existingP.participant_class} to qualified_external`
          };
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    // 4. Staging transaction & conflict detection
    // A) Check memory for existing bundle_id
    const inMemSha = this.importedBundleIdToSha.get(bundle.manifest.bundle_id);
    if (inMemSha) {
      if (inMemSha !== bundle.manifest.sha256) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          is_conflict: true,
          bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
          rejection_reason: `Conflict: Bundle ID ${bundle.manifest.bundle_id} already exists with different payload hash`
        };
      }
      return {
        is_valid: true,
        bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
        imported_bundle: bundle,
        enrollment_verified: true,
        identical_duplicate: true
      };
    }

    // B) Check DB for existing bundle_id with conflict check
    if (this.persistToDb) {
      try {
        const db = getDb();
        const existingRow = db.prepare('SELECT payload_sha256 FROM beta_imported_bundles WHERE bundle_id = ? LIMIT 1').get(bundle.manifest.bundle_id) as { payload_sha256: string } | undefined;
        if (existingRow) {
          if (existingRow.payload_sha256 !== bundle.manifest.sha256) {
            return {
              is_valid: false,
              is_conflict: true,
              bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
              rejection_reason: `Conflict: Bundle ID ${bundle.manifest.bundle_id} already exists in database with different payload hash`
            };
          }
          return {
            is_valid: true,
            bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
            imported_bundle: bundle,
            enrollment_verified: true,
            identical_duplicate: true
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fallback
      }
    }

    // C) Replay check (same SHA with different bundle ID)
    let isDuplicateSha = this.importedPayloadHashes.has(bundle.manifest.sha256);
    if (!isDuplicateSha && this.persistToDb) {
      try {
        if (hasBetaImportedPayloadSha(bundle.manifest.sha256)) {
          isDuplicateSha = true;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    if (isDuplicateSha) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
        rejection_reason: `Replayed content hash rejected: sha256 ${bundle.manifest.sha256} already imported`
      };
    }

    // 5. Persist to SQLite FIRST - fail closed if durable persistence fails
    if (this.persistToDb) {
      try {
        saveBetaImportedBundle({
          bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
          payload_sha256: bundle.manifest.sha256,
          cohort_id: bundle.participant_profile.cohort_id,
          participant_id: bundle.participant_profile.participant_id,
          imported_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          raw_bundle_json: jsonContent
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
          rejection_reason: `Durable persistence failed: ${err.message}`
        };
      }
    }

    // 6. Check enrollment provenance for external testers
    let enrollmentVerified = false;
    let unverifiedExternal = false;
    let provenanceReason: string | undefined;

    if (bundle.participant_profile?.is_external_tester) {
      const prov = verifyParticipantEnrollmentProvenance(bundle.participant_profile);
      enrollmentVerified = prov.verified;
      unverifiedExternal = !prov.verified;
      provenanceReason = prov.reason;
    }

    // 7. Success - register bundle in memory
    this.importedBundleIds.add(bundle.manifest.bundle_id);
    this.importedPayloadHashes.add(bundle.manifest.sha256);
    this.importedBundleIdToSha.set(bundle.manifest.bundle_id, bundle.manifest.sha256);
    this.validBundles.push(bundle);

    return {
      is_valid: true,
      bundle_id: bundle.manifest.bundle_id,
      imported_bundle: bundle,
      enrollment_verified: enrollmentVerified,
      unverified_external: unverifiedExternal,
      provenance_reason: provenanceReason
    };
  }

  public importFromFile(filePath: string): ImportValidationResult {
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      return { is_valid: false, rejection_reason: `File not found: ${filePath}` };
    }
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
    return this.importJsonString(content);
  }

  public getValidBundles(): BetaEvidenceExportBundle[] {
    return [...this.validBundles];
  }

  public getImportedCount(): number {
    return this.validBundles.length;
  }

  public getAllMktR07Observations(): MktR07ObservationRecord[] {
    const obs: MktR07ObservationRecord[] = [];
    for (const b of this.validBundles) {
      if (Array.isArray(b.mkt_r07_observations)) {
        obs.push(...b.mkt_r07_observations);
      }
    }
    return obs;
  }

  public getMktR07Status(): {
    status: 'NOT_EVALUATED' | 'EVALUATED';
    natural_count: number;
    synthetic_count: number;
    repeat_observed: boolean;
    payer_observed: boolean;
    summary: string;
  } {
    return evaluateMktR07Status(this.getAllMktR07Observations());
  }
}



================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/beta/betaProductEventProjector.ts

/**
 * Beta Product-Event Projector
 *
 * Requirements (from AGENT_TASK.md):
 * 1. Single authoritative event lineage: grounded in real workstation / product operations
 *    persisted in SQLite `local_product_events`.
 * 2. Real product operations:
 *    - guided import started/completed/failed
 *    - grouping confirmed/corrected
 *    - canonical analysis completed
 *    - canonical result returned/viewed
 *    - comparison action
 *    - successful report generation/export
 *    - successful AI Pack generation
 *    - Advanced detail use
 *    - unsupported input
 *    - hard failure
 *    - pricing offer exposure
 *    - pricing/WTP action
 *    - support bundle action
 *    - beta feedback submission
 * 3. Accepted Session Outcome MUST be projected from persisted real event history.
 *    No production API may accept caller-supplied milestone booleans.
 * 4. TTV MUST be calculated from persisted real event timestamps.
 * 5. Feature and trust evidence MUST derive from actual product actions/failures.
 * 6. WTP: client sends only bounded action; server resolves and binds economics.
 * 7. Idempotent projection: product event ID, beta event ID, provenance tracking.
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  AcceptedSessionOutcome,
  TimeToValueRecord,
  FeatureUsageEvent,
  TrustFailureEvent,
  WtpOfferInteraction,
  MeaningfulFollowUpAction,
  evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome,
  UsefulOutcomeConfirmation,
  PilotWorkContext,
  NaturalRepeatRecord,
  SupportEpisode
} from '../../shared/betaContract';
import {
  DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG,
  PricingPlanOption
} from '../../shared/pricingExperimentContract';
import {
  getDb,
  saveBetaEvent,
  getBetaEvents,
  listBetaParticipants,
  getBetaParticipant,
  getActiveBetaContext,
  getSessionParticipantBinding,
  bindSessionToParticipant,
  getFlowForSession,
  getGuidedFlow,
  getSessionsForFlow,
  BetaEventRecord,
  getUsefulConfirmation,
  saveUsefulConfirmation,
  getPilotWorkContext,
  savePilotWorkContext,
  getPilotWorkContextForSession,
  saveNaturalRepeat,
  listNaturalRepeats,
  saveSupportEpisode,
  listSupportEpisodes
} from '../db/db';
import {
  recordWorkstationEvent,
  WorkstationEventType,
  WorkstationEvent,
  addWorkstationEventListener
} from '../diagnostics/workstationEvents';

export type BetaLicenseTier = 'personal' | 'professional' | 'academic';
export type WtpAction = 'offer_viewed' | 'tier_selected' | 'request_to_buy_clicked' | 'declined' | 'survey_submitted';

export interface ProjectorParticipantContext {
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  is_external_tester: boolean;
  experiment_variant_id: string;
}

export class BetaProductEventProjector {
  /**
   * Authoritatively resolves participant context for a specific session.
   * Eliminates un-attributed selection of arbitrary external testers.
   */
  public static resolveParticipantContextForSession(
    sessionId?: string | null,
    override?: Partial<ProjectorParticipantContext>
  ): ProjectorParticipantContext {
    if (sessionId) {
      const binding = getSessionParticipantBinding(sessionId);
      if (binding) {
        if (override?.participant_id && override.participant_id !== binding.participant_id) {
          throw new Error(`Participant mismatch: session ${sessionId} is bound to ${binding.participant_id}, but caller supplied ${override.participant_id}`);
        }
        const participant = getBetaParticipant(binding.participant_id);
        const consentTime = participant?.consent_given_at_utc ? Date.parse(participant.consent_given_at_utc) : NaN;
        const boundTime = Date.parse(binding.bound_at_utc);
        const isExternal =
          Boolean(binding.is_external_tester) &&
          Boolean(participant?.is_external_tester) &&
          (!Number.isFinite(consentTime) || (Number.isFinite(boundTime) && boundTime >= consentTime));

        return {
          participant_id: binding.participant_id,
          cohort_id: binding.cohort_id,
          is_external_tester: isExternal,
          experiment_variant_id: participant?.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
        };
      }

      // Session exists, but no binding exists. An override cannot claim external evidence!
      if (override?.participant_id) {
        const p = getBetaParticipant(override.participant_id);
        if (!p) {
          throw new Error(`Unknown participant ID: ${override.participant_id}`);
        }
        // Unbound session cannot be claimed as external evidence
        return {
          participant_id: p.participant_id,
          cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
          is_external_tester: false,
          experiment_variant_id: p.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
        };
      }
    } else {
      // No session provided
      if (override?.participant_id) {
        const p = getBetaParticipant(override.participant_id);
        if (!p) {
          throw new Error(`Unknown participant ID: ${override.participant_id}`);
        }
        return {
          participant_id: p.participant_id,
          cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
          is_external_tester: Boolean(p.is_external_tester),
          experiment_variant_id: p.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
        };
      }
      // Check active participant context if no override
      const active = getActiveBetaContext();
      if (active && active.is_external_tester) {
        return {
          participant_id: active.participant_id,
          cohort_id: active.cohort_id,
          is_external_tester: true,
          experiment_variant_id: active.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
        };
      }
    }

    // Default internal context (never attributes to external tester without verified binding)
    return this.getDefaultInternalContext();
  }

  public static getDefaultInternalContext(): ProjectorParticipantContext {
    return {
      participant_id: 'usr_internal_workstation',
      cohort_id: 'cohort_internal_alpha',
      is_external_tester: false,
      experiment_variant_id: 'variant_corridor_standard'
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resolves active participant context. Returns active context from SQLite if external,
   * otherwise defaults to internal workstation identity.
   */
  public static getActiveParticipantContext(): ProjectorParticipantContext {
    const active = getActiveBetaContext();
    if (active && active.is_external_tester) {
      return {
        participant_id: active.participant_id,
        cohort_id: active.cohort_id,
        is_external_tester: true,
        experiment_variant_id: active.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
      };
    }
    return this.getDefaultInternalContext();
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether real product events exist in SQLite for a given session.
   */
  public static hasProductEventsForSession(sessionId: string): boolean {
    try {
      const db = getDb();
      const row = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 1 FROM local_product_events
        WHERE session_id = ? OR payload_json LIKE ? OR payload_json LIKE ?
        LIMIT 1
      `).get(sessionId, `%"session_id":"${sessionId}"%`, `%"sessionId":"${sessionId}"%`);
      return Boolean(row);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates Accepted Session Outcome purely from the persisted real product-event history.
   * Eliminates caller-authored milestone booleans.
   */
  public static evaluateSessionOutcomeFromEvents(
    sessionId: string,
    participantContext?: Partial<ProjectorParticipantContext>
  ): AcceptedSessionOutcome {
    const ctx = this.resolveParticipantContextForSession(sessionId, participantContext);

    const flowId = getFlowForSession(sessionId);
    const db = getDb();
    let query = `
      SELECT event_name, payload_json, created_at_utc
      FROM local_product_events
      WHERE session_id = ? OR payload_json LIKE ? OR payload_json LIKE ?
    `;
    const params: any[] = [sessionId, `%"session_id":"${sessionId}"%`, `%"sessionId":"${sessionId}"%`];
    if (flowId) {
      query += ` OR payload_json LIKE ? OR payload_json LIKE ?`;
      params.push(`%"flow_id":"${flowId}"%`, `%"flowId":"${flowId}"%`);
    }
    query += ` ORDER BY id ASC`;
    const rows = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as Array<{
      event_name: string;
      payload_json: string | null;
      created_at_utc: string;
    }>;

    let bundleImported = false;
    let groupingConfirmed = false;
    let canonicalAnalysisCompleted = false;
    let canonicalResultViewed = false;
    let hasUnresolvedHardFailure = false;
    const meaningfulActionsSet = new Set<MeaningfulFollowUpAction>();
    let lastSuccessTime = '';

    if (flowId) {
      const flow = getGuidedFlow(flowId);
      if (flow?.grouping_decision) {
        groupingConfirmed = true;
      }
    }

    for (const r of rows) {
      const name = r.event_name;
      let meta: any = {};
      if (r.payload_json) {
        try {
          meta = JSON.parse(r.payload_json);
        } catch {
          meta = {};
        }
      }

      if (name === 'guided_import_completed' || name === 'guided_scan_completed' || name === 'sample_project_loaded') {
        bundleImported = true;
        hasUnresolvedHardFailure = false; // Reset if subsequent import succeeded
        lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
      } else if (name === 'guided_import_failed' || name === 'hard_failure') {
        hasUnresolvedHardFailure = true;
      } else if (name === 'bundle_auto_grouped' || name === 'bundle_grouping_corrected' || name === 'bundle_grouping_confirmed') {
        groupingConfirmed = true;
        lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
      } else if (name === 'canonical_analysis_completed') {
        canonicalAnalysisCompleted = true;
        lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
      } else if (name === 'canonical_result_viewed' || name === 'canonical_overview_viewed') {
        canonicalResultViewed = true;
        lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
      } else if (name === 'report_action') {
        if (meta.action === 'exported' && meta.source === 'server_pipeline') {
          meaningfulActionsSet.add('report_exported');
          lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
        }
      } else if (name === 'ai_pack_action') {
        if ((meta.action === 'exported' || meta.action === 'compiled') && meta.source === 'server_pipeline') {
          meaningfulActionsSet.add('llm_pack_generated');
          lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
        }
      } else if (name === 'compare_action') {
        if (meta.action === 'opened' || meta.sessionId || !meta.action) {
          meaningfulActionsSet.add('comparison_opened');
          lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
        }
      } else if (name === 'advanced_tab_opened') {
        if (meta.action === 'viewed' || meta.tab || !meta.action) {
          meaningfulActionsSet.add('advanced_detail_opened');
          lastSuccessTime = r.created_at_utc;
        }
      }
    }

    const meaningfulActions = Array.from(meaningfulActionsSet);
    const completedAt = lastSuccessTime || new Date().toISOString();

    const existingRow = db.prepare(`SELECT event_id FROM beta_events WHERE session_id = ? AND event_type = 'outcome' LIMIT 1`).get(sessionId) as { event_id: string } | undefined;
    const outcomeId = existingRow?.event_id || `out_proj_${sessionId}`;

    const participant = getBetaParticipant(ctx.participant_id);
    const confirmation = getUsefulConfirmation(sessionId);
    let workContext = getPilotWorkContextForSession(sessionId);

    if (!workContext && (meaningfulActions.length > 0 || canonicalResultViewed)) {
      let taskCat: 'rr_inspection' | 'window_analysis' | 'comparison' | 'report_export' | 'ai_pack' | 'diary_review' = 'rr_inspection';
      if (meaningfulActions.includes('comparison_opened')) taskCat = 'comparison';
      else if (meaningfulActions.includes('report_exported')) taskCat = 'report_export';
      else if (meaningfulActions.includes('llm_pack_generated')) taskCat = 'ai_pack';
      else if (meaningfulActions.includes('advanced_detail_opened')) taskCat = 'window_analysis';

      workContext = this.createOrGetWorkContext({
        sessionId,
        profileId: participant?.profile_id || 'default',
        taskCategory: taskCat
      });
    }

    const isExternalQualified =
      Boolean(ctx.is_external_tester) &&
      Boolean(participant?.is_external_tester) &&
      (participant?.participant_class === 'qualified_external' || (participant?.cohort_id !== 'cohort_internal_alpha' && participant?.source_channel !== 'synthetic_fixture')) &&
      participant?.source_channel !== 'synthetic_fixture';

    const technicalCompletion =
      bundleImported &&
      groupingConfirmed &&
      canonicalAnalysisCompleted &&
      canonicalResultViewed &&
      !hasUnresolvedHardFailure;

    const usefulConfirmed = Boolean(confirmation) || meaningfulActions.length > 0;

    const evaluated = evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome({
      outcome_id: outcomeId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      bundle_imported: bundleImported,
      grouping_confirmed: groupingConfirmed,
      canonical_analysis_completed: canonicalAnalysisCompleted,
      canonical_result_viewed: canonicalResultViewed,
      has_unresolved_hard_failure: hasUnresolvedHardFailure,
      meaningful_actions: meaningfulActions,
      is_sample_or_demo: !isExternalQualified,
      completed_at_utc: completedAt,
      technical_completion: technicalCompletion,
      useful_outcome_confirmed: usefulConfirmed,
      confirmation_details: confirmation || undefined,
      external_market_qualified: isExternalQualified,
      qualification_reason: isExternalQualified ? 'verified_external_enrollment' : (participant?.participant_class || 'internal_or_synthetic'),
      is_accepted_external_outcome: isExternalQualified && technicalCompletion && usefulConfirmed,
      context_snapshot: workContext || undefined
    });

    // Idempotently persist to beta_events table
    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: evaluated.outcome_id,
      event_type: 'outcome',
      participant_id: evaluated.participant_id,
      cohort_id: evaluated.cohort_id,
      session_id: evaluated.session_id,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(evaluated),
      is_synthetic: !isExternalQualified,
      created_at_utc: evaluated.completed_at_utc
    });

    if (evaluated.is_accepted_outcome) {
      this.detectAndRecordNaturalRepeat(evaluated, workContext?.context_id || `ctx_${sessionId}`);
    }

    return evaluated;
  }

  public static createOrGetWorkContext(options: {
    sessionId: string;
    profileId?: string;
    taskCategory: 'rr_inspection' | 'window_analysis' | 'comparison' | 'report_export' | 'ai_pack' | 'diary_review';
    artifactCategory?: string;
    recipientCategory?: 'self' | 'coach' | 'athlete' | 'researcher';
    windowId?: string;
    windowRevision?: number;
    comparisonPartnerSessionId?: string;
    comparisonHash?: string;
    reportArtifactHash?: string;
    llmPackFingerprint?: string;
    diaryEntryId?: string;
  }): PilotWorkContext {
    const existing = getPilotWorkContextForSession(options.sessionId);
    if (existing && existing.task_category === options.taskCategory) {
      return existing;
    }
    const contextId = `ctx_${options.sessionId}_${Date.now()}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const ctx: PilotWorkContext = {
      context_id: contextId,
      profile_id: options.profileId || 'default',
      session_id: options.sessionId,
      canonical_session_hash: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(options.sessionId).digest('hex'),
      window_id: options.windowId,
      window_revision: options.windowRevision,
      comparison_partner_session_id: options.comparisonPartnerSessionId,
      comparison_hash: options.comparisonHash,
      report_artifact_hash: options.reportArtifactHash,
      llm_pack_fingerprint: options.llmPackFingerprint,
      diary_entry_id: options.diaryEntryId,
      task_category: options.taskCategory,
      artifact_category: options.artifactCategory,
      recipient_category: options.recipientCategory,
      privacy_decisions: {
        rawSeriesOptIn: false,
        includeNotes: false
      },
      source_event_ids: [],
      timestamps: {
        created_at_utc: nowIso,
        evaluated_at_utc: nowIso
      },
      canonical_payload_hash: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${options.sessionId}:${options.taskCategory}:${nowIso}`).digest('hex'),
      live_qualification: 'current'
    };
    savePilotWorkContext(ctx);
    return ctx;
  }

  public static detectAndRecordNaturalRepeat(
    outcome: AcceptedSessionOutcome,
    contextId: string
  ): NaturalRepeatRecord | null {
    try {
      const db = getDb();
      const priorOutcomes = db.prepare(`
        SELECT payload_json, created_at_utc FROM beta_events
        WHERE participant_id = ? AND event_type = 'outcome' AND session_id != ?
        ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC
      `).all(outcome.participant_id, outcome.session_id) as Array<{ payload_json: string; created_at_utc: string }>;

      let priorAccepted: AcceptedSessionOutcome | null = null;
      for (const row of priorOutcomes) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(row.payload_json);
          if (parsed.is_accepted_outcome && parsed.session_id !== outcome.session_id) {
            priorAccepted = parsed;
            break;
          }
        } catch {}
      }

      if (!priorAccepted) {
        return null;
      }

      const existingRepeat = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 1 FROM beta_natural_repeats
        WHERE participant_id = ? AND repeat_session_id = ?
        LIMIT 1
      `).get(outcome.participant_id, outcome.session_id);

      if (existingRepeat) {
        return null;
      }

      const promptEvent = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 1 FROM local_product_events
        WHERE session_id = ? AND event_name IN ('repeat_prompt_shown', 'notification_clicked', 'reminder_opened')
        LIMIT 1
      `).get(outcome.session_id);

      const repeatType: 'prompted' | 'unprompted' = promptEvent ? 'prompted' : 'unprompted';
      const isQualified = Boolean(outcome.is_accepted_external_outcome && priorAccepted.is_accepted_external_outcome);

      const repeatRecord: NaturalRepeatRecord = {
        repeat_id: `rpt_${priorAccepted.session_id}_${outcome.session_id}`,
        participant_id: outcome.participant_id,
        cohort_id: outcome.cohort_id,
        baseline_session_id: priorAccepted.session_id,
        baseline_context_id: priorAccepted.context_snapshot?.context_id || `ctx_${priorAccepted.session_id}`,
        baseline_completed_at_utc: priorAccepted.completed_at_utc,
        repeat_session_id: outcome.session_id,
        repeat_context_id: contextId,
        repeat_completed_at_utc: outcome.completed_at_utc,
        repeat_type: repeatType,
        is_distinct_session: true,
        is_qualified_repeat: isQualified
      };

      saveNaturalRepeat(repeatRecord);
      return repeatRecord;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Derives Time-To-Value (TTV) strictly from the real product-event timestamps in SQLite.
   * Eliminates caller-supplied milestone timestamps.
   */
  public static calculateSessionTtvFromEvents(
    sessionId: string,
    participantContext?: Partial<ProjectorParticipantContext>
  ): TimeToValueRecord {
    const ctx = this.resolveParticipantContextForSession(sessionId, participantContext);

    const flowId = getFlowForSession(sessionId);
    const db = getDb();
    let query = `
      SELECT event_name, payload_json, created_at_utc
      FROM local_product_events
      WHERE session_id = ? OR payload_json LIKE ? OR payload_json LIKE ?
    `;
    const params: any[] = [sessionId, `%"session_id":"${sessionId}"%`, `%"sessionId":"${sessionId}"%`];
    if (flowId) {
      query += ` OR payload_json LIKE ? OR payload_json LIKE ?`;
      params.push(`%"flow_id":"${flowId}"%`, `%"flowId":"${flowId}"%`);
    }
    query += ` ORDER BY id ASC`;
    const rows = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as Array<{
      event_name: string;
      payload_json: string | null;
      created_at_utc: string;
    }>;

    let importStartedMs: number | null = null;
    let previewReadyMs: number | null = null;
    let confirmedMs: number | null = null;
    let canonicalOverviewReadyMs: number | null = null;
    let firstMeaningfulActionMs: number | null = null;
    let firstMeaningfulActionType: MeaningfulFollowUpAction | null = null;

    if (flowId) {
      const flow = getGuidedFlow(flowId);
      if (flow) {
        if (flow.started_at_utc) {
          const flowStart = new Date(flow.started_at_utc).getTime();
          if (importStartedMs === null || flowStart < importStartedMs) {
            importStartedMs = flowStart;
          }
        }
        if (flow.preview_ready_at_utc) {
          const flowPreview = new Date(flow.preview_ready_at_utc).getTime();
          if (previewReadyMs === null) {
            previewReadyMs = flowPreview;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    for (const r of rows) {
      const ts = new Date(r.created_at_utc).getTime();
      const name = r.event_name;
      let meta: any = {};
      if (r.payload_json) {
        try { meta = JSON.parse(r.payload_json); } catch {}
      }

      if (name === 'guided_import_started' || name === 'guided_scan_started' || name === 'preview_started') {
        if (importStartedMs === null || ts < importStartedMs) {
          importStartedMs = ts;
        }
      } else if (name === 'bundle_auto_grouped' || name === 'guided_scan_completed' || name === 'preview_ready') {
        if (previewReadyMs === null) {
          previewReadyMs = ts;
        }
      } else if (name === 'bundle_grouping_corrected' || name === 'bundle_grouping_confirmed') {
        if (confirmedMs === null) {
          confirmedMs = ts;
        }
      } else if (name === 'canonical_overview_viewed' || name === 'canonical_result_viewed' || name === 'canonical_analysis_completed') {
        if (canonicalOverviewReadyMs === null) {
          canonicalOverviewReadyMs = ts;
        }
      } else if (name === 'report_action' || name === 'ai_pack_action' || name === 'compare_action' || name === 'advanced_tab_opened') {
        const isEligible =
          (name === 'report_action' && meta.action === 'exported' && meta.source === 'server_pipeline') ||
          (name === 'ai_pack_action' && (meta.action === 'exported' || meta.action === 'compiled') && meta.source === 'server_pipeline') ||
          (name === 'compare_action' && (meta.action === 'opened' || meta.sessionId || !meta.action)) ||
          (name === 'advanced_tab_opened' && (meta.action === 'viewed' || meta.tab || !meta.action));

        if (isEligible && (firstMeaningfulActionMs === null || ts < firstMeaningfulActionMs)) {
          firstMeaningfulActionMs = ts;
          firstMeaningfulActionType =
            name === 'report_action' ? 'report_exported' :
            name === 'ai_pack_action' ? 'llm_pack_generated' :
            name === 'compare_action' ? 'comparison_opened' :
            'advanced_detail_opened';
        }
      }
    }

    // Monotonicity enforcement (fail closed to null if non-monotonic)
    if (previewReadyMs !== null && importStartedMs !== null && previewReadyMs < importStartedMs) {
      previewReadyMs = null;
    }
    if (confirmedMs !== null && previewReadyMs !== null && confirmedMs < previewReadyMs) {
      confirmedMs = null;
    }
    if (confirmedMs !== null && importStartedMs !== null && confirmedMs < importStartedMs) {
      confirmedMs = null;
    }
    if (canonicalOverviewReadyMs !== null && confirmedMs !== null && canonicalOverviewReadyMs < confirmedMs) {
      canonicalOverviewReadyMs = null;
    }
    if (canonicalOverviewReadyMs !== null && previewReadyMs !== null && canonicalOverviewReadyMs < previewReadyMs) {
      canonicalOverviewReadyMs = null;
    }
    if (canonicalOverviewReadyMs !== null && importStartedMs !== null && canonicalOverviewReadyMs < importStartedMs) {
      canonicalOverviewReadyMs = null;
    }
    if (firstMeaningfulActionMs !== null && canonicalOverviewReadyMs !== null && firstMeaningfulActionMs < canonicalOverviewReadyMs) {
      firstMeaningfulActionMs = null;
      firstMeaningfulActionType = null;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const existingTtvRow = db.prepare(`SELECT event_id FROM beta_events WHERE session_id = ? AND event_type = 'ttv' LIMIT 1`).get(sessionId) as { event_id: string } | undefined;
    const recordId = existingTtvRow?.event_id || `ttv_proj_${sessionId}`;

    const record: TimeToValueRecord = {
      record_id: recordId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      import_started_at_ms: importStartedMs,
      bundle_preview_ready_at_ms: previewReadyMs,
      bundle_confirmed_at_ms: confirmedMs,
      canonical_overview_ready_at_ms: canonicalOverviewReadyMs,
      first_meaningful_action_at_ms: firstMeaningfulActionMs,
      first_meaningful_action_type: firstMeaningfulActionType,
      is_sample_or_demo: !ctx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: new Date(importStartedMs || now).toISOString()
    };

    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: record.record_id,
      event_type: 'ttv',
      participant_id: record.participant_id,
      cohort_id: record.cohort_id,
      session_id: record.session_id,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(record),
      is_synthetic: !ctx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: record.created_at_utc
    });

    return record;
  }

  /**
   * Recomputes both Accepted Session Outcome and TTV from real workstation events for a session.
   */
  public static recomputeSessionOutcomeAndTtv(sessionId: string): {
    outcome: AcceptedSessionOutcome;
    ttv: TimeToValueRecord;
  } {
    const outcome = this.evaluateSessionOutcomeFromEvents(sessionId);
    const ttv = this.calculateSessionTtvFromEvents(sessionId);
    return { outcome, ttv };
  }

  /**
   * Recomputes outcomes and TTV for all sessions known to the workstation.
   */
  public static recomputeAllSessionOutcomesAndTtv(): {
    recomputedCount: number;
    outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[];
    ttvRecords: TimeToValueRecord[];
  } {
    const db = getDb();
    const sessionIdsSet = new Set<string>();

    const rowsEvents = db.prepare(`SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM local_product_events WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id != ''`).all() as Array<{ session_id: string }>;
    for (const r of rowsEvents) sessionIdsSet.add(r.session_id);

    try {
      const rowsSessions = db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM sessions`).all() as Array<{ id: string }>;
      for (const r of rowsSessions) sessionIdsSet.add(r.id);
    } catch {}

    const outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[] = [];
    const ttvRecords: TimeToValueRecord[] = [];

    for (const sid of sessionIdsSet) {
      const res = this.recomputeSessionOutcomeAndTtv(sid);
      outcomes.push(res.outcome);
      ttvRecords.push(res.ttv);
    }

    return {
      recomputedCount: sessionIdsSet.size,
      outcomes,
      ttvRecords
    };
  }

  /**
   * Records a genuine pricing offer exposure in SQLite and beta_events.
   * Required before any WTP intent action can be bound.
   */
  public static recordOfferExposure(options?: {
    participant_id?: string;
    tier?: BetaLicenseTier;
    experiment_variant_id?: string;
    session_id?: string;
  }): {
    exposure_id: string;
    participant_id: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    tier_shown: BetaLicenseTier;
    price_amount: number;
    currency: string;
    billing_model: 'one_time' | 'annual';
    experiment_variant_id: string;
    occurred_at_utc: string;
  } {
    const ctx = this.resolveParticipantContextForSession(options?.session_id, {
      participant_id: options?.participant_id
    });
    const tier: BetaLicenseTier = options?.tier || 'personal';
    const config = DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG;
    const plan = config.plans.find((p) => p.tier === tier) || config.plans[0];
    const billingModel: 'one_time' | 'annual' = plan.billing_model === 'one_time' ? 'one_time' : 'annual';
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const exposureId = `exp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;

    recordWorkstationEvent('pricing_offer_exposed', {
      exposure_id: exposureId,
      tier,
      price_amount: plan.suggested_price_usd,
      currency: 'USD',
      billing_model: billingModel,
      experiment_id: config.experiment_id,
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id
    });

    const exposureInteraction: WtpOfferInteraction = {
      interaction_id: exposureId,
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      experiment_variant_id: config.experiment_id,
      tier_shown: tier,
      price_amount: plan.suggested_price_usd,
      currency: 'USD',
      billing_model: billingModel,
      action: 'offer_viewed',
      occurred_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: exposureId,
      event_type: 'wtp',
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      session_id: options?.session_id || null,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(exposureInteraction),
      is_synthetic: !ctx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: nowIso
    });

    return {
      exposure_id: exposureId,
      participant_id: ctx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      tier_shown: tier,
      price_amount: plan.suggested_price_usd,
      currency: 'USD',
      billing_model: billingModel,
      experiment_variant_id: config.experiment_id,
      occurred_at_utc: nowIso
    };
  }

  /**
   * Records a user WTP action, resolving pricing economics server-side from active config.
   * Client cannot pass price_amount, currency, or billing_model.
   * Binds strictly to a prior offer exposure.
   */
  public static recordWtpAction(input: {
    action: WtpAction;
    exposure_id?: string;
    tier?: BetaLicenseTier;
    decline_reason?: string;
    price_sensitivity_feedback?: {
      too_expensive_threshold?: number;
      fair_price_estimate?: number;
      cheap_quality_concern_threshold?: number;
    } | string;
    participant_id?: string;
    session_id?: string;
  }): WtpOfferInteraction {
    const ctx = this.resolveParticipantContextForSession(input.session_id, {
      participant_id: input.participant_id
    });
    const participantId = ctx.participant_id;

    let tier: BetaLicenseTier = input.tier || 'personal';
    let priceAmount: number;
    let currency: 'EUR' | 'USD' = 'USD';
    let billingModel: 'one_time' | 'annual' = 'one_time';
    let experimentVariantId = DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG.experiment_id;

    if (input.action === 'offer_viewed') {
      const config = DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG;
      const plan = config.plans.find((p) => p.tier === tier) || config.plans[0];
      priceAmount = plan.suggested_price_usd;
      billingModel = plan.billing_model === 'one_time' ? 'one_time' : 'annual';
      currency = 'USD';
    } else {
      // All other actions strictly require an exposure_id
      if (!input.exposure_id) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action ${input.action} rejected: exposure_id is required`);
      }
      const db = getDb();
      const expRow = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM beta_events WHERE event_type = 'wtp' AND event_id = ? LIMIT 1").get(input.exposure_id) as any;
      if (!expRow) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Exposure ${input.exposure_id} not found`);
      }
      let expPayload: WtpOfferInteraction;
      try {
        expPayload = JSON.parse(expRow.payload_json);
      } catch {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Malformed exposure payload for ${input.exposure_id}`);
      }
      if (expPayload.action !== 'offer_viewed') {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Referenced event ${input.exposure_id} is not an offer_viewed exposure`);
      }
      if (expRow.participant_id !== participantId) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Exposure participant ${expRow.participant_id} does not match caller ${participantId}`);
      }
      if (input.tier && input.tier !== expPayload.tier_shown) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Selected tier ${input.tier} does not match exposed tier ${expPayload.tier_shown}`);
      }
      // Single-use semantics: verify no prior action has been recorded for this exposure_id
      const duplicateRow = db.prepare(`
        SELECT event_id FROM beta_events
        WHERE event_type = 'wtp' AND payload_json LIKE ? LIMIT 1
      `).get(`%"exposure_id":"${input.exposure_id}"%`);
      if (duplicateRow) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Action already recorded for exposure ${input.exposure_id}`);
      }
      // Validate chronological precedence
      const exposureTime = Date.parse(expPayload.occurred_at_utc || expRow.created_at_utc);
      const nowTime = Date.now();
      if (Number.isFinite(exposureTime) && exposureTime > nowTime) {
        throw new Error(`WTP action rejected: Exposure time is in the future relative to action`);
      }

      // Derive economics directly from bound exposure
      tier = expPayload.tier_shown;
      priceAmount = expPayload.price_amount;
      currency = expPayload.currency;
      billingModel = expPayload.billing_model;
      experimentVariantId = expPayload.experiment_variant_id;
    }

    const sensitivityObj = typeof input.price_sensitivity_feedback === 'string'
      ? { fair_price_estimate: parseFloat(input.price_sensitivity_feedback) || undefined }
      : input.price_sensitivity_feedback;

    const interaction: WtpOfferInteraction = {
      interaction_id: `wtp_proj_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
      exposure_id: input.exposure_id,
      participant_id: participantId,
      cohort_id: ctx.cohort_id,
      experiment_variant_id: experimentVariantId,
      tier_shown: tier,
      price_amount: priceAmount,
      currency: currency,
      billing_model: billingModel,
      action: input.action,
      decline_reason: input.decline_reason,
      price_sensitivity_feedback: sensitivityObj,
      occurred_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    recordWorkstationEvent('plan_interest_selected', {
      action: input.action,
      tier: tier,
      price_amount: priceAmount,
      currency: currency,
      experiment_id: experimentVariantId,
      exposure_id: input.exposure_id || null
    });

    saveBetaEvent({
      event_id: interaction.interaction_id,
      event_type: 'wtp',
      participant_id: interaction.participant_id,
      cohort_id: interaction.cohort_id,
      session_id: input.session_id || null,
      payload_json: JSON.stringify(interaction),
      is_synthetic: !ctx.is_external_tester,
      created_at_utc: interaction.occurred_at_utc
    });

    return interaction;
  }

  /**
   * Projects unprojected product events into beta_events idempotently.
   * Resolves participant context strictly per session/event to avoid cross-attribution.
   */
  public static projectProductEventsToBetaEvidence(): {
    projected_count: number;
  } {
    const db = getDb();

    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, event_name, user_id, session_id, payload_json, created_at_utc
      FROM local_product_events
      ORDER BY id ASC
    `).all() as Array<{
      id: number;
      event_name: string;
      user_id: string | null;
      session_id: string | null;
      payload_json: string | null;
      created_at_utc: string;
    }>;

    let projectedCount = 0;

    for (const r of rows) {
      const eventId = `pevt_${r.id}`;
      let meta: any = {};
      if (r.payload_json) {
        try {
          meta = JSON.parse(r.payload_json);
        } catch {
          meta = {};
        }
      }

      const sessionId = r.session_id || meta.session_id || meta.sessionId || null;

      // Resolve participant context independently per event/session
      let eventCtx: ProjectorParticipantContext;
      if (sessionId) {
        const binding = getSessionParticipantBinding(sessionId);
        if (binding) {
          const participant = getBetaParticipant(binding.participant_id);
          const consentTime = participant?.consent_given_at_utc ? Date.parse(participant.consent_given_at_utc) : NaN;
          const boundTime = Date.parse(binding.bound_at_utc);
          const evTime = Date.parse(r.created_at_utc);
          const isExternal =
            Boolean(binding.is_external_tester) &&
            Boolean(participant?.is_external_tester) &&
            (!Number.isFinite(consentTime) || (Number.isFinite(boundTime) && boundTime >= consentTime && evTime >= consentTime));

          eventCtx = {
            participant_id: binding.participant_id,
            cohort_id: binding.cohort_id,
            is_external_tester: isExternal,
            experiment_variant_id: participant?.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
          };
        } else {
          // Unbound session -> project as internal/synthetic
          eventCtx = this.getDefaultInternalContext();
        }
      } else if (r.user_id) {
        const p = getBetaParticipant(r.user_id);
        if (p) {
          const consentTime = Date.parse(p.consent_given_at_utc || p.first_seen_at_utc);
          const evTime = Date.parse(r.created_at_utc);
          const isExternal = Boolean(p.is_external_tester) && (!Number.isFinite(consentTime) || evTime >= consentTime);
          eventCtx = {
            participant_id: p.participant_id,
            cohort_id: p.cohort_id,
            is_external_tester: isExternal,
            experiment_variant_id: p.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard'
          };
        } else {
          eventCtx = this.getDefaultInternalContext();
        }
      } else {
        eventCtx = this.getDefaultInternalContext();
      }

      // Project feature usage
      if (['report_action', 'ai_pack_action', 'compare_action', 'advanced_tab_opened', 'sample_project_loaded'].includes(r.event_name)) {
        const featureId =
          r.event_name === 'report_action' ? (meta.action_type || 'report_export_pdf') :
          r.event_name === 'ai_pack_action' ? 'ai_pack_export' :
          r.event_name === 'compare_action' ? 'session_comparison' :
          r.event_name === 'advanced_tab_opened' ? 'advanced_hrv_explorer' :
          'sample_project_onboarding';

        const featureEvent: FeatureUsageEvent = {
          event_id: eventId,
          participant_id: eventCtx.participant_id,
          cohort_id: eventCtx.cohort_id,
          session_id: sessionId || `sess_pevt_${r.id}`,
          feature_id: featureId,
          action: meta.action || 'opened',
          duration_viewed_sec: meta.duration_ms ? Math.round(meta.duration_ms / 1000) : undefined,
          is_sample_or_demo: !eventCtx.is_external_tester,
          occurred_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
        };

        saveBetaEvent({
          event_id: eventId,
          event_type: 'feature',
          participant_id: eventCtx.participant_id,
          cohort_id: eventCtx.cohort_id,
          session_id: featureEvent.session_id,
          payload_json: JSON.stringify(featureEvent),
          is_synthetic: !eventCtx.is_external_tester,
          created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
        });
        projectedCount++;
      }

      // Project trust failure
      else if (['unsupported_input', 'guided_import_failed', 'bundle_conflict_detected'].includes(r.event_name)) {
        const errorType =
          r.event_name === 'unsupported_input' ? 'unsupported_format' :
          r.event_name === 'guided_import_failed' ? 'import_parse_error' :
          'timestamp_discontinuity';

        const trustEvent: TrustFailureEvent = {
          event_id: eventId,
          participant_id: eventCtx.participant_id,
          cohort_id: eventCtx.cohort_id,
          session_id: sessionId || undefined,
          error_type: errorType as any,
          reason_code: String(meta.reason || meta.error || 'unsupported_operation'),
          file_extension: meta.extension ? String(meta.extension) : undefined,
          user_corrected_successfully: meta.corrected ? Boolean(meta.corrected) : undefined,
          occurred_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
        };

        saveBetaEvent({
          event_id: eventId,
          event_type: 'trust',
          participant_id: eventCtx.participant_id,
          cohort_id: eventCtx.cohort_id,
          session_id: sessionId,
          payload_json: JSON.stringify(trustEvent),
          is_synthetic: !eventCtx.is_external_tester,
          created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
        });
        projectedCount++;
      }
    }

    return { projected_count: projectedCount };
  }
}

// Auto-subscribe to workstation milestone events for real-time outcome & TTV recomputation
addWorkstationEventListener((event) => {
  const meta = event.metadata;
  const sessionId = (meta?.sessionId || meta?.session_id) as string | undefined;
  if (sessionId) {
    const milestoneEvents: WorkstationEventType[] = [
      'canonical_analysis_completed',
      'canonical_overview_viewed',
      'canonical_result_viewed',
      'report_action',
      'ai_pack_action',
      'compare_action',
      'advanced_tab_opened',
      'guided_import_failed',
      'guided_import_completed'
    ];
    if (milestoneEvents.includes(event.event_type)) {
      try {
        BetaProductEventProjector.recomputeSessionOutcomeAndTtv(sessionId);
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking
      }
    }
  }
});

/**
 * Pilot Fulfillment & Cohort Launch Operations Service
 * Schema Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * Implements the offline pilot-launch path:
 * campaign & consent policy -> canonical issuance request -> trusted Save ->
 * signing outside CardioLab -> trusted Open and signed-batch preflight ->
 * atomic redacted inventory import -> sensitive delivery artifact -> verify-only enrollment ->
 * usage/revocation history -> truthful zero-external cohort readiness.
 */
