          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // Verify session
    const session = getSession(req.session_id);
    if (!session) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(`Сессия ${req.session_id} не найдена в хранилище`);
    }

    // Cross-profile fail closed check
    const sessionUserId = session.user_id || 'default';
    if (sessionUserId !== profileId && profileId !== 'default' && sessionUserId !== 'default') {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Сессия принадлежит профилю ${sessionUserId}, а не ${profileId}`);
    }

    // Named Window verification if provided
    let verifiedWindowRevision: number | null = null;
    if (req.window_root_id) {
      const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(req.session_id);
      const targetWindow = windows.find((w: any) =>
        w.id === req.window_root_id ||
        w.root_window_id === req.window_root_id ||
        w.window_id === req.window_root_id ||
        w.root_id === req.window_root_id
      );
      if (!targetWindow) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(`Окно ${req.window_root_id} не найдено в сессии ${req.session_id}`);
      }
      if (req.window_revision !== undefined && req.window_revision !== null && targetWindow.revision !== req.window_revision) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия окна ${targetWindow.revision} не совпадает с ожидаемой ${req.window_revision}`);
      }
      verifiedWindowRevision = targetWindow.revision;
    }

    // Notes validation
    if (req.user_notes) {
      const wording = validateCheckInWording(req.user_notes);
      if (!wording.valid) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(wording.violation!);
      }
    }

    // Determine eligibility state and quality
    const qualityScore = session.overall_quality_score;
    let eligibility: CheckInSlotEligibility = 'usable_current';
    let qualityExp = 'Данные пригодны для контрольного сравнения';

    if (qualityScore < 60) {
      eligibility = 'recorded_quality_limited';
      qualityExp = `Качество записи снижено (${Math.round(qualityScore)}%), высокая зашумленность сигнала`;
    }

    entry.session_id = req.session_id;
    entry.window_root_id = req.window_root_id || null;
    entry.window_revision = verifiedWindowRevision;
    entry.saved_view_id = req.saved_view_id || null;
    entry.eligibility_state = eligibility;
    entry.quality_score = qualityScore;
    entry.quality_explanation_ru = qualityExp;
    entry.user_notes = req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : null;

    const prevRev = entry.optimistic_revision;
    entry.optimistic_revision += 1;
    entry.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, entry);
      if (!success) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError();
      }
      recordCheckInHistory(planId, entry.id, 'slot_assigned', entry.optimistic_revision, entry);
    });
    runTx();

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, entry);
    }

    return entry;
  }

  /**
   * Unassigns session from slot, returning it to not_recorded state.
   */
  public unassignSlot(planId: string, req: UnassignCheckInSlotRequest, profileId: string): AthleteCheckInEntry {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(req.entry_id);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError();
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: req.entry_id,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    entry.session_id = null;
    entry.window_root_id = null;
    entry.window_revision = null;
    entry.saved_view_id = null;
    entry.eligibility_state = 'not_recorded';
    entry.quality_score = null;
    entry.quality_explanation_ru = null;
    entry.user_notes = null;

    const prevRev = entry.optimistic_revision;
    entry.optimistic_revision += 1;
    entry.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, entry);
      if (!success) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError();
      }
      recordCheckInHistory(planId, entry.id, 'slot_unassigned', entry.optimistic_revision, entry);
    });
    runTx();

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, entry);
    }

    return entry;
  }

  /**
   * Creates a linked SavedLongitudinalView in existing Progress Review from recorded slots.
   */
  public createProgressReviewFromPlan(planId: string, profileId: string, viewName?: string, idempotencyKey?: string): SavedLongitudinalView {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      view_name: viewName || null
    };

    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(idempotencyKey);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    const entries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    const recordedEntries = entries.filter((e) => e.session_id !== null);
    if (recordedEntries.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('В плане нет привязанных записей для создания отчета прогресса');
    }

    const sessionIds = recordedEntries.map((e) => e.session_id!);
    const viewId = `view_chk_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    const allowedMetrics: ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[] = [
      'avg_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50', 'mean_rr', 'dfa_alpha1', 'recovery_1min'
    ];
    const metricSet = plan.metric_keys.filter((k): k is ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min') =>
      allowedMetrics.includes(k as any)
    );

    const normalizedQuery: LongitudinalSeriesQuery = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_session_ids: sessionIds,
      target_session_id: sessionIds[sessionIds.length - 1],
      metric_set: metricSet.length > 0 ? metricSet : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
      user_notes: `Создано из плана контрольных наблюдений: ${plan.title}`
    };

    const savedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      view_id: viewId,
      name: viewName ? viewName.trim() : `Обзор прогресса: ${plan.title}`,
      profile_id: profileId,
      normalized_query: normalizedQuery,
      metrics: metricSet.length > 0 ? metricSet : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
      display_preferences: {},
      is_retired: false,
      user_notes: plan.description || undefined,
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      created_at_utc: nowUtc,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      createSavedLongitudinalView(savedView);
      for (const ent of recordedEntries) {
        ent.saved_view_id = viewId;
        ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
        saveCheckInEntry(ent);
      }
      recordCheckInHistory(planId, null, 'progress_review_created', plan.optimistic_revision, {
        view_id: viewId,
        session_ids: sessionIds
      });
    });
    runTx();

    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(idempotencyKey, reqHash, savedView);
    }

    return savedView;
  }

  /**
   * Builds an authoritative preview of a Progress Review constructed from selected Check-in slots.
   * Enforces exact Named Window revisions, per-metric comparability checks, and deduplication of sessions.
   */
  public previewProgressReviewForSlots(
    planId: string,
    profileId: string,
    selectedSlots: CheckInSlotSelectionItem[],
    requestedMetricKeys?: string[]
  ): CheckInReviewPreviewResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(selectedSlots) || selectedSlots.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Необходимо выбрать как минимум один слот для предварительного просмотра');
    }

    const planEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    const entryMap = new Map<string, AthleteCheckInEntry>();
    for (const ent of planEntries) {
      entryMap.set(ent.id, ent);
    }

    const allowedMetrics: ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[] = [
      'avg_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50', 'mean_rr', 'dfa_alpha1', 'recovery_1min'
    ];
    const targetMetrics = (requestedMetricKeys && requestedMetricKeys.length > 0 ? requestedMetricKeys : plan.metric_keys)
      .filter((k): k is ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min') => allowedMetrics.includes(k as any));
    const activeMetricList = targetMetrics.length > 0 ? targetMetrics : (['rmssd', 'avg_hr'] as const);

    const previewItems: any[] = [];
    const orderedSessionIds: string[] = [];
    const sessionSeenSet = new Set<string>();
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const limitations: string[] = [];

    // Track per-metric comparability tallies
    const metricStats: Record<string, { comparableCount: number; unsupportedSlots: string[] }> = {};
    for (const m of activeMetricList) {
      metricStats[m] = { comparableCount: 0, unsupportedSlots: [] };
    }

    for (const sel of selectedSlots) {
      const entry = entryMap.get(sel.slot_id);
      if (!entry) {
        throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} не найден в плане`);
      }
      if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }
      if (entry.optimistic_revision !== sel.expected_revision) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия слота ${sel.slot_id} (${entry.optimistic_revision}) не соответствует ожидаемой (${sel.expected_revision})`);
      }
      if (!entry.session_id) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} (${entry.slot_date}) не имеет привязанной записи`);
      }

      // Check session
      const session = getSession(entry.session_id);
      if (!session) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} для слота ${sel.slot_id} недоступна в хранилище`);
      }
      const sessionUserId = session.user_id || 'default';
      if (sessionUserId !== profileId && profileId !== 'default' && sessionUserId !== 'default') {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }

      // Reconcile entry state
      this.reconcileEntryState(entry);

      // Window exactness check
      let activeNamedWindow: any = null;
      if (entry.window_root_id) {
        const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(entry.session_id);
        activeNamedWindow = windows.find((w: any) =>
          w.id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.root_window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.root_id === entry.window_root_id
        );
        if (!activeNamedWindow) {
          throw new CheckInValidationError(`Named Window ${entry.window_root_id} не найдено в сессии ${entry.session_id}`);
        }
        if (entry.window_revision !== null && activeNamedWindow.revision !== entry.window_revision) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия Named Window ${entry.window_root_id} изменилась (актуальная: ${activeNamedWindow.revision}, в слоте: ${entry.window_revision})`);
        }
      }

      // Compute per-metric comparability for this slot
      const comparableMetrics: any[] = [];
      for (const m of activeMetricList) {
        if (entry.window_root_id) {
          // Window comparability: Named Window has its own specific canonical metric derivation
          // Window metrics support HR and HRV (rmssd, sdnn, pnn50, avg_hr, mean_rr).
          // But DFA alpha1 or recovery_1min might not be available at window granularity.
          if (m === 'dfa_alpha1' || m === 'recovery_1min') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'unsupported_window_metric',
              reason_ru: `Метрика ${m} не поддерживается для Named Window (доступна только для целой сессии)`
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else if (entry.eligibility_state === 'stale' || entry.eligibility_state === 'source_unavailable') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'quality_withheld',
              reason_ru: `Данные слота недоступны или требуют обновления (${entry.eligibility_state})`
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: true,
              reason_code: 'supported',
              reason_ru: 'Метрика доступна для сравнения в окне'
            });
            metricStats[m].comparableCount++;
          }
        } else {
          // Whole session slot
          if (entry.eligibility_state === 'source_unavailable') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'missing_data',
              reason_ru: 'Сессия недоступна'
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: true,
              reason_code: 'supported',
              reason_ru: 'Метрика доступна'
            });
            metricStats[m].comparableCount++;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!sessionSeenSet.has(entry.session_id)) {
        sessionSeenSet.add(entry.session_id);
        orderedSessionIds.push(entry.session_id);
      }

      previewItems.push({
        slot_id: entry.id,
        slot_date: entry.slot_date,
        slot_index: entry.slot_index,
        session_id: entry.session_id,
        window_root_id: entry.window_root_id,
        window_revision: entry.window_revision,
        quality_score: entry.quality_score,
        eligibility_state: entry.eligibility_state,
        comparable_metrics: comparableMetrics,
        user_notes: entry.user_notes
      });
    }

    // Sort preview items chronologically by slot_date, then slot_index
    previewItems.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmp = a.slot_date.localeCompare(b.slot_date);
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
      return a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
    });

    const eligibleIndependentPeers = sessionSeenSet.size;
    if (selectedSlots.length > eligibleIndependentPeers) {
      warnings.push(`Несколько выбранных слотов ссылаются на одну сессию. Независимых сессий: ${eligibleIndependentPeers}.`);
    }

    const perMetricComparability: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const m of activeMetricList) {
      const stats = metricStats[m];
      const isReady = stats.comparableCount >= 2 && stats.unsupportedSlots.length === 0;
      const mLimitations: string[] = [];
      if (stats.unsupportedSlots.length > 0) {
        const text = `${stats.unsupportedSlots.length} из ${selectedSlots.length} слотов не имеют поддержки метрики ${m}`;
        mLimitations.push(text);
        limitations.push(`Неполная сопоставимость по метрике "${m}": ${text}`);
      }
      perMetricComparability[m] = {
        comparable_slots_count: stats.comparableCount,
        total_slots_count: selectedSlots.length,
        is_ready_for_review: isReady,
        unsupported_slots: stats.unsupportedSlots,
        limitations: mLimitations
      };
    }

    let overallReadiness: 'ready' | 'limited' | 'insufficient_history' = 'ready';
    if (eligibleIndependentPeers < 2) {
      overallReadiness = 'insufficient_history';
      limitations.push('Для построения достоверного динамического ряда рекомендуется не менее 2 независимых записей');
    } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
      overallReadiness = 'limited';
    }

    return {
      plan_id: plan.id,
      plan_title: plan.title,
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: previewItems,
      ordered_session_ids: orderedSessionIds,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: eligibleIndependentPeers,
      per_metric_comparability: perMetricComparability,
      overall_readiness: overallReadiness,
      warnings,
      limitations
    };
  }

  /**
   * Atomically creates a linked SavedLongitudinalView in Progress Review from strictly SELECTED slots.
   * Sets slot.saved_view_id backlinks and writes athlete_checkin_history record in one SQLite transaction.
   */
  public createProgressReviewFromSelectedSlots(
    planId: string,
    profileId: string,
    req: CreateProgressReviewFromSelectedSlotsRequest
  ): SavedLongitudinalView {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(req.selected_slots) || req.selected_slots.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Необходимо выбрать как минимум один слот для создания отчета прогресса');
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: req.selected_slots.map(s => ({ slot_id: s.slot_id, expected_revision: s.expected_revision })),
      view_name: req.view_name || null,
      user_notes: req.user_notes || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // Validate preview and slot integrity first
    const preview = this.previewProgressReviewForSlots(planId, profileId, req.selected_slots);

    const planEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    const entryMap = new Map<string, AthleteCheckInEntry>();
    for (const ent of planEntries) {
      entryMap.set(ent.id, ent);
    }

    const selectedEntries: AthleteCheckInEntry[] = [];
    const windowReferences: Array<{ session_id: string; window_root_id: string; window_revision: number; slot_date?: string; slot_index?: number }> = [];

    for (const sel of req.selected_slots) {
      const ent = entryMap.get(sel.slot_id)!;
      selectedEntries.push(ent);
      if (ent.window_root_id && ent.window_revision !== null && ent.session_id) {
        windowReferences.push({
          session_id: ent.session_id,
          window_root_id: ent.window_root_id,
          window_revision: ent.window_revision,
          slot_date: ent.slot_date,
          slot_index: ent.slot_index
        });
      }
    }

    const viewId = `view_chk_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    const allowedMetrics: ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[] = [
      'avg_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50', 'mean_rr', 'dfa_alpha1', 'recovery_1min'
    ];
    const metricSet = plan.metric_keys.filter((k): k is ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min') =>
      allowedMetrics.includes(k as any)
    );

    const targetSessionId = preview.ordered_session_ids[preview.ordered_session_ids.length - 1];

    const normalizedQuery: LongitudinalSeriesQuery = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      target_session_id: targetSessionId,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      metric_set: metricSet.length > 0 ? metricSet : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : `Создано из выбранных слотов плана: ${plan.title}`
    };

    const savedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      view_id: viewId,
      name: req.view_name ? req.view_name.trim() : `Обзор прогресса: ${plan.title} (${selectedEntries.length} слотов)`,
      profile_id: profileId,
      normalized_query: normalizedQuery,
      metrics: metricSet.length > 0 ? metricSet : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
      display_preferences: {},
      is_retired: false,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : (plan.description || undefined),
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      created_at_utc: nowUtc,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      createSavedLongitudinalView(savedView);
      for (const ent of selectedEntries) {
        ent.saved_view_id = viewId;
        const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
        ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
        ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
        const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
        if (!success) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
        }
      }
      recordCheckInHistory(planId, null, 'progress_review_created_from_selected', plan.optimistic_revision, {
        view_id: viewId,
        selected_slot_ids: selectedEntries.map(e => e.id),
        session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
        window_references: windowReferences
      });
    });
    runTx();

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, savedView);
    }

    return savedView;
  }

  /**
   * Saves or updates a pending intake intent for a slot (e.g. staged preflight, candidate session).
   */
  public saveSlotIntakeIntent(
    planId: string,
    entryId: string,
    req: SaveCheckInIntakeIntentRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): CheckInSlotIntakeIntent {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(entryId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError();
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: entryId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      staged_preflight_id: req.staged_preflight_id || null,
      request_fingerprint: req.request_fingerprint || null,
      imported_session_id: req.imported_session_id || null,
      candidate_quality_score: req.candidate_quality_score ?? null,
      status: req.status || 'preflighted'
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    const existing = getCheckInIntakeIntent(entryId);
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const intentId = existing ? existing.id : `intent_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

    const intent: CheckInSlotIntakeIntent = {
      id: intentId,
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: entryId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      staged_preflight_id: req.staged_preflight_id || null,
      request_fingerprint: req.request_fingerprint || null,
      imported_session_id: req.imported_session_id || null,
      candidate_quality_score: req.candidate_quality_score ?? null,
      status: req.status || 'preflighted',
      created_at_utc: existing ? existing.created_at_utc : nowUtc,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    saveCheckInIntakeIntent(intent);

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, intent);
    }

    return intent;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves active intake intent for a slot.
   */
  public getSlotIntakeIntent(
    planId: string,
    entryId: string,
    profileId: string
  ): CheckInSlotIntakeIntent | null {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(entryId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    return getCheckInIntakeIntent(entryId);
  }

  /**
   * Cancels active intake intent for a slot.
   */
  public cancelSlotIntakeIntent(
    planId: string,
    entryId: string,
    profileId: string
  ): { success: boolean; cancelled: boolean } {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(entryId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const cancelled = cancelCheckInIntakeIntent(entryId, profileId);
    return { success: true, cancelled };
  }

  /**
   * Confirms slot intake intent by executing the actual slot assignment.
   * If slot assignment succeeds, intent status is set to 'confirmed'.
   * If assignment fails, the imported session remains safely in SQLite (no destructive rollback).
   */
  public confirmSlotIntakeIntent(
    planId: string,
    entryId: string,
    req: ConfirmCheckInIntakeIntentRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): { entry: AthleteCheckInEntry; intent: CheckInSlotIntakeIntent } {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(entryId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: entryId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      session_id: req.session_id,
      window_root_id: req.window_root_id || null,
      window_revision: req.window_revision ?? null,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // Assign slot using assignSlot
    const assignedEntry = this.assignSlot(
      planId,
      {
        entry_id: entryId,
        expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
        session_id: req.session_id,
        window_root_id: req.window_root_id,
        window_revision: req.window_revision,
        user_notes: req.user_notes,
        idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key ? `${req.idempotency_key}_assign` : undefined
      },
      profileId
    );

    // Mark intent confirmed
    const existing = getCheckInIntakeIntent(entryId);
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const intent: CheckInSlotIntakeIntent = {
      id: existing ? existing.id : `intent_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: entryId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      staged_preflight_id: existing?.staged_preflight_id || null,
      request_fingerprint: existing?.request_fingerprint || null,
      imported_session_id: req.session_id,
      candidate_quality_score: assignedEntry.quality_score,
      status: 'confirmed',
      created_at_utc: existing ? existing.created_at_utc : nowUtc,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    saveCheckInIntakeIntent(intent);

    const result = { entry: assignedEntry, intent };
    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, result);
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a read-only preview of extending a plan with additional slots.
   * Preserves cadence identity, calendar anchors (anchor day-of-month, 7-day intervals, manual dates),
   * IANA timezone stability, and produces a tamper-evident digest.
   */
  public previewPlanExtension(
    planId: string,
    req: CheckInPlanExtensionPreviewRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): CheckInPlanExtensionPreviewResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя продлить архивированный план (retired)');
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии плана: ожидалась ${req.expected_revision}, актуальная ${plan.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const entries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('План поврежден: отсутствуют исходные календарные слоты');
    }

    // Sort existing entries chronologically by slot_index
    entries.sort((a, b) => a.slot_index - b.slot_index);
    const lastEntry = entries[entries.length - 1];
    const lastSlotIndex = lastEntry.slot_index;
    const lastSlotDate = lastEntry.slot_date;
    const anchorDate = entries[0].slot_date;

    const existingDatesSet = new Set(entries.map(e => e.slot_date));
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.schedule_decision !== 'skipped_by_user' && e.effective_date) {
        existingDatesSet.add(e.effective_date);
      }
    }
    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    let proposedDates: string[] = [];
    let proposedCount = 0;

    if (plan.cadence === 'manual') {
      // Manual cadence requires explicit manual_dates from user
      if (!Array.isArray(req.manual_dates) || req.manual_dates.length === 0) {
        blockers.push('Для ручного плана (manual) необходимо указать конкретные календарные даты (manual_dates)');
      } else {
        proposedCount = req.manual_dates.length;
        if (proposedCount > 52) {
          blockers.push('Превышено максимальное число добавляемых слотов (максимум 52 за операцию)');
        }
        for (const dateStr of req.manual_dates) {
          if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateStr)) {
            blockers.push(`Некорректный формат даты: "${dateStr}". Ожидается YYYY-MM-DD`);
            continue;
          }
          if (existingDatesSet.has(dateStr)) {
            blockers.push(`Дата ${dateStr} уже существует в плане`);
          }
          if (proposedDates.includes(dateStr)) {
            blockers.push(`В списке запроса передана дублирующаяся дата: ${dateStr}`);
          }
          // Validate calendar validity (e.g. leap day, month day range)
          const parts = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
          const d = new Date(Date.UTC(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2]));
          if (d.getUTCFullYear() !== parts[0] || d.getUTCMonth() !== parts[1] - 1 || d.getUTCDate() !== parts[2]) {
            blockers.push(`Календарная дата не существует: "${dateStr}"`);
          }
          proposedDates.push(dateStr);
        }
      }
    } else if (plan.cadence === 'weekly') {
      const requestedCount = req.slot_count || 4;
      if (requestedCount < 1 || requestedCount > 52) {
        blockers.push('Число слотов должно быть от 1 до 52');
      }
      proposedCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(requestedCount, 52));

      // Weekly: step by exactly 7 calendar days from lastSlotDate
      const lastParts = lastSlotDate.split('-').map(Number);
      const lastYear = lastParts[0];
      const lastMonth = lastParts[1] - 1;
      const lastDay = lastParts[2];

      for (let i = 1; i <= proposedCount; i++) {
        const d = new Date(Date.UTC(lastYear, lastMonth, lastDay + i * 7));
        const dateStr = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (existingDatesSet.has(dateStr)) {
          blockers.push(`Вычисленная еженедельная дата ${dateStr} пересекается с существующим слотом`);
        }
        proposedDates.push(dateStr);
      }
    } else if (plan.cadence === 'monthly') {
      const requestedCount = req.slot_count || 4;
      if (requestedCount < 1 || requestedCount > 52) {
        blockers.push('Число слотов должно быть от 1 до 52');
      }
      proposedCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(requestedCount, 52));

      // Monthly: derive anchor day-of-month from the latest active segment anchor date,
      // or fall back to last non-superseded entry / anchorDate
      const segments = listCheckInScheduleSegments(planId);
      const latestSegment = segments.length > 0 ? segments[segments.length - 1] : null;
      const segAnchorDate = (latestSegment && latestSegment.anchor_date) ? latestSegment.anchor_date : lastSlotDate;

      const segAnchorParts = segAnchorDate.split('-').map(Number);
      const anchorYear = segAnchorParts[0];
      const anchorMonth = segAnchorParts[1] - 1;
      const anchorDay = segAnchorParts[2];

      // Calculate how many months have passed since latest segment anchor date to last slot date
      const lastParts = lastSlotDate.split('-').map(Number);
      const lastYear = lastParts[0];
      const lastMonth = lastParts[1] - 1;
      const monthsFromAnchor = (lastYear - anchorYear) * 12 + (lastMonth - anchorMonth);

      for (let i = 1; i <= proposedCount; i++) {
        const targetMonth = anchorMonth + monthsFromAnchor + i;
        const d = new Date(Date.UTC(anchorYear, targetMonth, 1));
        const y = d.getUTCFullYear();
        const m = d.getUTCMonth();
        const daysInMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
        const clampedDay = Math.min(anchorDay, daysInMonth);
        const slotDate = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, clampedDay));
        const dateStr = slotDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (existingDatesSet.has(dateStr)) {
          blockers.push(`Вычисленная ежемесячная дата ${dateStr} пересекается с существующим слотом`);
        }
        if (clampedDay < anchorDay) {
          warnings.push(`Дата ${dateStr} была скорректирована под длину месяца (${daysInMonth} дн.) относительно дня привязки (${anchorDay}-е число).`);
        }
        proposedDates.push(dateStr);
      }
    }

    const proposedIndices: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < proposedDates.length; i++) {
      proposedIndices.push(lastSlotIndex + 1 + i);
    }

    const canExtend = blockers.length === 0;

    // Digest calculation to guarantee client confirmation integrity
    const digestPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      last_slot_index: lastSlotIndex,
      proposed_dates: proposedDates,
      proposed_indices: proposedIndices
    };
    const digest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      current_revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      cadence: plan.cadence,
      timezone: plan.timezone,
      last_slot_index: lastSlotIndex,
      last_slot_date: lastSlotDate,
      anchor_date: anchorDate,
      proposed_slot_count: proposedDates.length,
      proposed_dates: proposedDates,
      proposed_indices: proposedIndices,
      can_extend: canExtend,
      blockers,
      warnings,
      digest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Durably confirms extension of the check-in plan in a single atomic SQLite transaction.
   * Atomically:
   * 1. Re-verifies plan ownership, active status, and CAS expected_revision
   * 2. Re-computes extension preview and verifies expected_last_slot_index & digest
   * 3. Increments plan optimistic_revision
   * 4. Inserts new slots with status 'not_recorded', unique (plan_id, slot_index) and (plan_id, slot_date)
   * 5. Writes athlete_checkin_history record
   * 6. Saves durable payload-bound idempotency receipt
   * 7. Rolls back completely on failure
   */
  public confirmPlanExtension(
    planId: string,
    req: ConfirmCheckInPlanExtensionRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): ConfirmCheckInPlanExtensionResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      expected_last_slot_index: req.expected_last_slot_index,
      slot_count: req.slot_count || null,
      manual_dates: req.manual_dates ? [...req.manual_dates].sort() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя продлить архивированный план (retired)');
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии плана: ожидалась ${req.expected_revision}, актуальная ${plan.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    // Generate authoritative preview
    const preview = this.previewPlanExtension(
      planId,
      {
        profile_id: profileId,
        expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
        slot_count: req.slot_count,
        manual_dates: req.manual_dates
      },
      profileId
    );

    if (!preview.can_extend || preview.blockers.length > 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(`Продление плана невозможно: ${preview.blockers.join('; ')}`);
    }

    if (req.expected_last_slot_index !== preview.last_slot_index) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Курсор последнего слота изменился (ожидался индекс ${req.expected_last_slot_index}, актуальный ${preview.last_slot_index})`);
    }

    if (req.preview_digest && req.preview_digest !== preview.digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра устарел или не совпадает с актуальным расписанием');
    }

    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const createdEntries: AthleteCheckInEntry[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < preview.proposed_dates.length; i++) {
      const slotDate = preview.proposed_dates[i];
      const slotIndex = preview.proposed_indices[i];
      const entryId = `ent_chk_${Date.now()}_${slotIndex}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
      const entry: AthleteCheckInEntry = {
        id: entryId,
        plan_id: plan.id,
        profile_id: plan.profile_id,
        slot_date: slotDate,
        slot_index: slotIndex,
        effective_date: slotDate,
        schedule_decision: 'scheduled',
        schedule_notes: null,
        schedule_revision: 1,
        session_id: null,
        window_root_id: null,
        window_revision: null,
        saved_view_id: null,
        eligibility_state: 'not_recorded',
        quality_score: null,
        quality_explanation_ru: null,
        user_notes: null,
        is_retired: false,
        optimistic_revision: 1,
        created_at_utc: nowUtc,
        updated_at_utc: nowUtc
      };
      createdEntries.push(entry);
    }

    const prevPlanRev = plan.optimistic_revision;
    plan.optimistic_revision += 1;
    plan.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;

    let result: ConfirmCheckInPlanExtensionResponse;

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. CAS update of plan
      const success = updateCheckInPlanWithCas(prevPlanRev, plan);
      if (!success) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного изменения плана при продлении');
      }

      // 2. Insert new entries
      for (const ent of createdEntries) {
        saveCheckInEntry(ent);
      }

      // 3. Write history record
      recordCheckInHistory(plan.id, null, 'plan_extended', plan.optimistic_revision, {
        extended_slot_count: createdEntries.length,
        new_slot_indices: preview.proposed_indices,
        new_dates: preview.proposed_dates,
        previous_last_slot_index: preview.last_slot_index
      });

      const allEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(plan.id);
      result = {
        success: true,
        plan,
        created_entries: createdEntries,
        total_slots: allEntries.length
      };

      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, result);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return result!;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a read-only preview for rescheduling, skipping, or restoring a future unassigned check-in slot.
   * Enforces:
   * - Plan active (fail-closed on retired plans)
   * - Slot ownership and plan membership
   * - Slot unassigned (session_id === null)
   * - No active pending intake intent
   * - Calendar date validation under plan IANA timezone (no past dates for reschedule)
   * - Intra-plan effective date collision prevention
   * - Tamper-evident preview digest calculation
   */
  public previewScheduleException(
    planId: string,
    slotId: string,
    req: CheckInScheduleExceptionPreviewRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): CheckInScheduleExceptionPreviewResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId || req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя изменять расписание слотов в архивном плане (retired)');
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(slotId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_entry_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии слота: ожидалась ${req.expected_entry_revision}, актуальная ${entry.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    // Slot must be unassigned
    if (entry.session_id !== null) {
      blockers.push('Слот уже привязан к сессии наблюдения; изменение расписания недопустимо');
    }

    // Check intake intent in flight
    const pendingIntent = getCheckInIntakeIntent(slotId);
    if (pendingIntent && (pendingIntent.status === 'pending' || pendingIntent.status === 'preflighted' || pendingIntent.status === 'imported')) {
      blockers.push('Для слота зафиксирован активный процесс импорта (intent). Отмените или завершите импорт перед изменением расписания.');
    }

    // Validate notes wording if provided
    if (req.user_notes) {
      const wording = validateCheckInWording(req.user_notes);
      if (!wording.valid) {
        blockers.push(wording.violation!);
      }
    }

    let proposedEffectiveDate = entry.effective_date;
    let proposedDecision: CheckInScheduleDecision = entry.schedule_decision;

    const allEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    const todayInTz = formatCalendarDate(new Date(), plan.timezone);

    if (req.action === 'reschedule') {
      if (!req.target_date || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(req.target_date)) {
        blockers.push('Для переноса даты необходимо указать целевую дату (target_date) в формате YYYY-MM-DD');
      } else {
        const dateStr = req.target_date;
        const parts = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
        const d = new Date(Date.UTC(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2]));
        if (d.getUTCFullYear() !== parts[0] || d.getUTCMonth() !== parts[1] - 1 || d.getUTCDate() !== parts[2]) {
          blockers.push(`Календарная дата не существует: "${dateStr}"`);
        } else {
          // Cannot reschedule to past local calendar date
          if (dateStr < todayInTz) {
            blockers.push(`Нельзя перенести наблюдение на прошедшую дату (${dateStr} < ${todayInTz})`);
          }

          // Check collisions with other non-skipped slots in the same plan
          const collision = allEntries.find(
            e => e.id !== entry.id &&
                 e.schedule_decision !== 'skipped_by_user' &&
                 e.effective_date === dateStr
          );
          if (collision) {
            blockers.push(`Дата ${dateStr} уже занята слотом #${collision.slot_index + 1} в данном плане`);
          }

          proposedEffectiveDate = dateStr;
          proposedDecision = 'rescheduled';
        }
      }
    } else if (req.action === 'skip') {
      if (entry.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user') {
        warnings.push('Слот уже помечен как пропущенный');
      }
      proposedDecision = 'skipped_by_user';
      // effective_date remains for history
      proposedEffectiveDate = entry.slot_date;
    } else if (req.action === 'restore') {
      if (entry.schedule_decision === 'scheduled' && entry.effective_date === entry.slot_date) {
        warnings.push('Слот уже находится в исходном плановом графике');
      }

      // Check collision if another slot was rescheduled to entry.slot_date
      const collision = allEntries.find(
        e => e.id !== entry.id &&
             e.schedule_decision !== 'skipped_by_user' &&
             e.effective_date === entry.slot_date
      );
      if (collision) {
        blockers.push(`Исходная дата ${entry.slot_date} занята другим перенесенным слотом #${collision.slot_index + 1}`);
      }

      proposedEffectiveDate = entry.slot_date;
      proposedDecision = 'scheduled';
    } else {
      blockers.push(`Неизвестное действие над расписанием: ${(req as any).action}`);
    }

    const canApply = blockers.length === 0;

    const digestPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: slotId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      action: req.action,
      current_entry_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
      initial_slot_date: entry.slot_date,
      proposed_effective_date: proposedEffectiveDate,
      proposed_decision: proposedDecision
    };
    const digest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      plan_id: planId,
      entry_id: slotId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      action: req.action,
      current_entry_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
      initial_slot_date: entry.slot_date,
      current_effective_date: entry.effective_date,
      proposed_effective_date: proposedEffectiveDate,
      current_decision: entry.schedule_decision,
      proposed_decision: proposedDecision,
      can_apply: canApply,
      blockers,
      warnings,
      digest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Durably confirms schedule exception in a single atomic SQLite transaction.
   * Saves payload-bound idempotency receipt inside the transaction.
   */
  public confirmScheduleException(
    planId: string,
    slotId: string,
    req: ConfirmCheckInScheduleExceptionRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): ConfirmCheckInScheduleExceptionResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId || req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      slot_id: slotId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_plan_revision: req.expected_plan_revision,
      expected_entry_revision: req.expected_entry_revision,
      action: req.action,
      target_date: req.target_date || null,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя изменять расписание слотов в архивном плане (retired)');
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_plan_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии плана: ожидалась ${req.expected_plan_revision}, актуальная ${plan.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(slotId);
    if (!entry || entry.plan_id !== planId) {
      throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError();
    }
    if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_entry_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии слота: ожидалась ${req.expected_entry_revision}, актуальная ${entry.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    // Run preview check
    const preview = this.previewScheduleException(
      planId,
      slotId,
      {
        profile_id: profileId,
        entry_id: slotId,
        expected_entry_revision: req.expected_entry_revision,
        action: req.action,
        target_date: req.target_date,
        user_notes: req.user_notes
      },
      profileId
    );

    if (!preview.can_apply || preview.blockers.length > 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(`Изменение расписания невозможно: ${preview.blockers.join('; ')}`);
    }

    if (req.preview_digest && req.preview_digest !== preview.digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра устарел или не совпадает с актуальным расписанием');
    }

    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevPlanRev = plan.optimistic_revision;
    const prevEntryRev = entry.optimistic_revision;

    entry.effective_date = preview.proposed_effective_date;
    entry.schedule_decision = preview.proposed_decision;
    entry.schedule_notes = req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : entry.schedule_notes;
    entry.schedule_revision = (entry.schedule_revision || 1) + 1;
    entry.optimistic_revision += 1;
    entry.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;

    plan.optimistic_revision += 1;
    plan.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;

    let result: ConfirmCheckInScheduleExceptionResponse;

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. CAS update of entry
      const entrySuccess = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevEntryRev, entry);
      if (!entrySuccess) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного изменения слота при обновлении расписания');
      }

      // 2. CAS update of plan
      const planSuccess = updateCheckInPlanWithCas(prevPlanRev, plan);
      if (!planSuccess) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного изменения плана при обновлении расписания');
      }

      // 3. Write history record
      recordCheckInHistory(plan.id, entry.id, `schedule_exception_${req.action}`, entry.optimistic_revision, {
        action: req.action,
        initial_slot_date: entry.slot_date,
        effective_date: entry.effective_date,
        schedule_decision: entry.schedule_decision,
        schedule_notes: entry.schedule_notes,
        schedule_revision: entry.schedule_revision
      });

      result = {
        success: true,
        plan,
        entry
      };

      // 4. Save idempotency inside the single atomic transaction
      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, result);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return result!;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a read-only preview for revising a plan schedule segment (changing cadence, timezone, effective date).
   * Identifies:
   * - protected_slots: slots that cannot be superseded (has session_id, active intent, or exception rescheduled/skipped)
   * - superseded_slots: unassigned placeholder slots with schedule_decision === 'scheduled' on or after effective_from_date
   * - proposed new slots starting from effective_from_date using new cadence and timezone
   * - blockers: collides with protected slots, past date, invalid timezone, etc.
   * - tamper-evident preview digest
   */
  public previewScheduleRevision(
    planId: string,
    req: CheckInScheduleRevisionPreviewRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): CheckInScheduleRevisionPreviewResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId || req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя изменять расписание в архивном плане (retired)');
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии плана: ожидалась ${req.expected_revision}, актуальная ${plan.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    // Timezone validation
    if (!isValidIanaTimezone(req.new_timezone)) {
      blockers.push(`Некорректный IANA часовой пояс: "${req.new_timezone}"`);
    }

    // Effective from date validation
    if (!req.effective_from_date || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(req.effective_from_date)) {
      blockers.push('Дата вступления в силу (effective_from_date) должна быть в формате YYYY-MM-DD');
    }

    const todayInNewTz = isValidIanaTimezone(req.new_timezone)
      ? formatCalendarDate(new Date(), req.new_timezone)
      : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    if (req.effective_from_date && req.effective_from_date < todayInNewTz) {
      blockers.push(`Дата вступления в силу не может быть в прошлом (${req.effective_from_date} < ${todayInNewTz})`);
    }

    const allEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(planId);
    allEntries.sort((a, b) => a.slot_index - b.slot_index);

    const protectedSlots: AthleteCheckInEntry[] = [];
    const supersededSlots: AthleteCheckInEntry[] = [];

    for (const ent of allEntries) {
      const isLinked = ent.session_id !== null;
      const isException = ent.schedule_decision === 'rescheduled' || ent.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user';
      const intent = getCheckInIntakeIntent(ent.id);
      const hasIntent = intent && (intent.status === 'pending' || intent.status === 'preflighted' || intent.status === 'imported');

      const isProtected = isLinked || isException || hasIntent;
      if (isProtected) {
        protectedSlots.push(ent);
      } else {
        const entEffDate = ent.effective_date || ent.slot_date;
        if (entEffDate >= req.effective_from_date && !ent.is_superseded) {
          supersededSlots.push(ent);
        }
      }
    }

    // Generate proposed dates under new cadence and timezone
    let proposedDates: string[] = [];
    const slotCount = req.slot_count || (req.new_cadence === 'weekly' ? 8 : req.new_cadence === 'monthly' ? 6 : 4);

    if (req.new_cadence === 'manual') {
      if (!Array.isArray(req.manual_dates) || req.manual_dates.length === 0) {
        blockers.push('Для ручного режима расписания (manual) необходимо указать даты (manual_dates)');
      } else {
        for (const d of req.manual_dates) {
          if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d)) {
            blockers.push(`Некорректный формат даты: "${d}". Ожидается YYYY-MM-DD`);
          } else if (d < req.effective_from_date) {
            blockers.push(`Дата ${d} меньше даты начала действия сегмента ${req.effective_from_date}`);
          }
          if (proposedDates.includes(d)) {
            blockers.push(`Дублирующаяся дата в списке: ${d}`);
          }
          proposedDates.push(d);
        }
      }
    } else {
      proposedDates = generateSlotDates(req.new_cadence, req.new_timezone, slotCount, req.effective_from_date);
    }

    // Check collision of proposed dates with protected slots
    const protectedDateSet = new Set(protectedSlots.map(s => s.effective_date || s.slot_date));
    for (const pDate of proposedDates) {
      if (protectedDateSet.has(pDate)) {
        blockers.push(`Предлагаемая дата ${pDate} совпадает с защищенным слотом плана`);
      }
    }

    const lastSlotIndex = allEntries.length > 0 ? allEntries[allEntries.length - 1].slot_index : -1;
    const proposedIndices: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < proposedDates.length; i++) {
      proposedIndices.push(lastSlotIndex + 1 + i);
    }

    const canApply = blockers.length === 0;

    const digestPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      new_cadence: req.new_cadence,
      new_timezone: req.new_timezone,
      effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
      superseded_slot_ids: supersededSlots.map(s => s.id),
      proposed_dates: proposedDates,
      proposed_indices: proposedIndices
    };
    const digest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      current_revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      current_cadence: plan.cadence,
      current_timezone: plan.timezone,
      new_cadence: req.new_cadence,
      new_timezone: req.new_timezone,
      effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
      new_anchor_date: proposedDates[0] || req.effective_from_date,
      protected_slots: protectedSlots,
      superseded_slots: supersededSlots,
      proposed_slot_count: proposedDates.length,
      proposed_dates: proposedDates,
      proposed_indices: proposedIndices,
      can_apply: canApply,
      blockers,
      warnings,
      digest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Confirms schedule revision atomically in SQLite transaction.
   * 1. CAS on plan optimistic_revision
   * 2. Re-validates preview and digest
   * 3. Marks superseded slots with is_superseded = true
   * 4. Updates plan cadence, timezone, increments schedule_version and optimistic_revision
   * 5. Saves new CheckInScheduleSegment
   * 6. Inserts new slots linked to new segment
   * 7. Records checkin history
   * 8. Saves payload-bound idempotency receipt
   */
  public confirmScheduleRevision(
    planId: string,
    req: ConfirmCheckInScheduleRevisionRequest,
    profileId: string
  ): ConfirmCheckInScheduleRevisionResponse {
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError();
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId || req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError();
    }
    if (plan.status === 'retired') {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Нельзя изменять расписание в архивном плане (retired)');
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      plan_id: planId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
      new_cadence: req.new_cadence,
      new_timezone: req.new_timezone,
      effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
      slot_count: req.slot_count || null,
      manual_dates: req.manual_dates ? [...req.manual_dates].sort() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии плана: ожидалась ${req.expected_revision}, актуальная ${plan.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    // Run preview check
    const preview = this.previewScheduleRevision(
      planId,
      {
        profile_id: profileId,
        expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
        new_cadence: req.new_cadence,
        new_timezone: req.new_timezone,
        effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
        slot_count: req.slot_count,
        manual_dates: req.manual_dates
      },
      profileId
    );

    if (!preview.can_apply || preview.blockers.length > 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(`Смена режима календаря невозможна: ${preview.blockers.join('; ')}`);
    }

    if (req.preview_digest && req.preview_digest !== preview.digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра устарел или не совпадает с актуальным состоянием');
    }

    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevPlanRev = plan.optimistic_revision;
    const newVersionIndex = (plan.schedule_version || 1) + 1;

    const newSegmentId = `seg_chk_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const newSegment: CheckInScheduleSegment = {
      id: newSegmentId,
      plan_id: plan.id,
      version_index: newVersionIndex,
      cadence: req.new_cadence,
      timezone: req.new_timezone,
      effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
      anchor_date: preview.new_anchor_date,
      manual_dates: req.new_cadence === 'manual' ? (req.manual_dates || null) : null,
      created_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    // Prepare new entries
    const createdEntries: AthleteCheckInEntry[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < preview.proposed_dates.length; i++) {
      const slotDate = preview.proposed_dates[i];
      const slotIndex = preview.proposed_indices[i];
      const entryId = `ent_chk_${Date.now()}_${slotIndex}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
      const entry: AthleteCheckInEntry = {
        id: entryId,
        plan_id: plan.id,
        profile_id: plan.profile_id,
        slot_date: slotDate,
        slot_index: slotIndex,
        effective_date: slotDate,
        schedule_decision: 'scheduled',
        schedule_notes: null,
        schedule_revision: 1,
        schedule_segment_id: newSegmentId,
        is_superseded: false,
        session_id: null,
        window_root_id: null,
        window_revision: null,
        saved_view_id: null,
        eligibility_state: 'not_recorded',
        quality_score: null,
        quality_explanation_ru: null,
        user_notes: null,
        is_retired: false,
        optimistic_revision: 1,
        created_at_utc: nowUtc,
        updated_at_utc: nowUtc
      };
      createdEntries.push(entry);
    }

    // Update plan fields
    plan.cadence = req.new_cadence;
    plan.timezone = req.new_timezone;
    plan.schedule_version = newVersionIndex;
    plan.optimistic_revision += 1;
    plan.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;

    let result: ConfirmCheckInScheduleRevisionResponse;

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. Mark superseded slots
      for (const oldSlot of preview.superseded_slots) {
        const prevSlotRev = oldSlot.optimistic_revision;
        oldSlot.is_superseded = true;
        oldSlot.optimistic_revision += 1;
        oldSlot.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
        const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevSlotRev, oldSlot);
        if (!success) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного изменения слота ${oldSlot.id} при замещении`);
        }
      }

      // 2. CAS update plan
      const planSuccess = updateCheckInPlanWithCas(prevPlanRev, plan);
      if (!planSuccess) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного обновления плана при смене расписания');
      }

      // 3. Save new segment
      saveCheckInScheduleSegment(newSegment);

      // 4. Save new entries
      for (const ent of createdEntries) {
        saveCheckInEntry(ent);
      }

      // 5. Write history
      recordCheckInHistory(plan.id, null, 'schedule_version_transition', plan.optimistic_revision, {
        previous_schedule_version: newVersionIndex - 1,
        new_schedule_version: newVersionIndex,
        segment_id: newSegmentId,
        new_cadence: req.new_cadence,
        new_timezone: req.new_timezone,
        effective_from_date: req.effective_from_date,
        superseded_slots_count: preview.superseded_slots.length,
        created_entries_count: createdEntries.length
      });

      const allPlanEntries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(plan.id);
      result = {
        success: true,
        plan,
        segment: newSegment,
        superseded_slots_count: preview.superseded_slots.length,
        created_entries: createdEntries,
        total_slots: allPlanEntries.length
      };

      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, result);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return result!;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves unified offline Check-in Agenda across all plans of an athlete.
   * Enforces:
   * - Authorized profile isolation
   * - Filter by date range (from_date, to_date in YYYY-MM-DD)
   * - Status filters (all, scheduled, recorded, usable_current, quality_limited, rescheduled, skipped, superseded, retired)
   * - Deterministic sorting by effective civil date, then plan_id, slot_index, slot_id
   * - Strict pagination cursor support
   * - Accurate counters differentiating slots vs unique independent sessions
   * - Pure read-only operation with zero mutation
   */
  public getProfileAgenda(
    profileId: string,
    query: CheckInAgendaQuery
  ): CheckInAgendaResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (query.profile_id && query.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к повестке чужого профиля запрещен');
    }

    const allPlans = listCheckInPlans(profileId);
    const plansToScan = query.plan_id
      ? allPlans.filter(p => p.id === query.plan_id)
      : (query.include_retired ? allPlans : allPlans.filter(p => p.status === 'active'));

    const fromDate = query.from_date || '0000-01-01';
    const toDate = query.to_date || '9999-12-31';
    const statusFilter = query.status_filter || 'all';
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit || 50, 1), 200);

    const agendaItems: CheckInAgendaSlotItem[] = [];
    const allSessionIds: string[] = [];

    // Tally counters across all matching plans for this profile
    let totalSlots = 0;
    let activeScheduledSlots = 0;
    let recordedSlots = 0;
    let usableCurrentSlots = 0;
    let qualityLimitedSlots = 0;
    let rescheduledSlots = 0;
    let skippedSlots = 0;
    let supersededSlots = 0;
    let retiredSlots = 0;

    for (const plan of plansToScan) {
      const entries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(plan.id);
      const segments = listCheckInScheduleSegments(plan.id);
      const segmentMap = new Map<string, CheckInScheduleSegment>();
      for (const seg of segments) {
        segmentMap.set(seg.id, seg);
      }

      // Today in plan's current timezone
      const todayInPlanTz = isValidIanaTimezone(plan.timezone)
        ? formatCalendarDate(new Date(), plan.timezone)
        : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      for (const ent of entries) {
        this.reconcileEntryState(ent);

        const seg = ent.schedule_segment_id ? segmentMap.get(ent.schedule_segment_id) : null;
        const entryTz = seg ? seg.timezone : plan.timezone;
        const entryVersion = seg ? seg.version_index : (plan.schedule_version || 1);
        const effectiveDate = ent.effective_date || ent.slot_date;

        const isPlanRetired = plan.status === 'retired';
        const isSlotRetired = ent.is_retired || isPlanRetired;
        const isSuperseded = Boolean(ent.is_superseded);
        const isRecorded = ent.session_id !== null;
        const isUsable = ent.eligibility_state === 'usable_current';
        const isQualityLimited = ent.eligibility_state === 'recorded_quality_limited';
        const isRescheduled = ent.schedule_decision === 'rescheduled';
        const isSkipped = ent.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user';
        const isScheduled = ent.schedule_decision === 'scheduled' && !isRecorded && !isSuperseded && !isSlotRetired;

        const isPastDue = !isRecorded && !isSkipped && !isSuperseded && !isSlotRetired && effectiveDate < todayInPlanTz;

        totalSlots++;
        if (isPlanRetired || isSlotRetired) {
          retiredSlots++;
        }
        if (isSuperseded) {
          supersededSlots++;
        }
        if (isRecorded) {
          recordedSlots++;
          allSessionIds.push(ent.session_id!);
        }
        if (isUsable) {
          usableCurrentSlots++;
        }
        if (isQualityLimited) {
          qualityLimitedSlots++;
        }
        if (isRescheduled) {
          rescheduledSlots++;
        }
        if (isSkipped) {
          skippedSlots++;
        }
        if (isScheduled) {
          activeScheduledSlots++;
        }

        // Apply retired filter unless explicitly included
        if (isSlotRetired && !query.include_retired) {
          continue;
        }

        // Apply date range filter
        if (effectiveDate < fromDate || effectiveDate > toDate) {
          continue;
        }

        // Apply status filter
        if (statusFilter === 'scheduled' && !isScheduled) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'recorded' && !isRecorded) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'usable_current' && !isUsable) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'quality_limited' && !isQualityLimited) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'rescheduled' && !isRescheduled) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'skipped' && !isSkipped) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'superseded' && !isSuperseded) continue;
        if (statusFilter === 'retired' && !isSlotRetired) continue;

        agendaItems.push({
          plan_id: plan.id,
          plan_title: plan.title,
          plan_cadence: plan.cadence,
          plan_status: plan.status,
          slot_id: ent.id,
          slot_index: ent.slot_index,
          initial_slot_date: ent.slot_date,
          effective_date: effectiveDate,
          timezone: entryTz,
          schedule_segment_id: ent.schedule_segment_id || null,
          schedule_version: entryVersion,
          schedule_decision: ent.schedule_decision,
          schedule_notes: ent.schedule_notes,
          is_superseded: isSuperseded,
          is_retired: isSlotRetired,
          session_id: ent.session_id,
          window_root_id: ent.window_root_id,
          window_revision: ent.window_revision,
          saved_view_id: ent.saved_view_id,
          eligibility_state: ent.eligibility_state,
          quality_score: ent.quality_score,
          quality_explanation_ru: ent.quality_explanation_ru,
          user_notes: ent.user_notes,
          optimistic_revision: ent.optimistic_revision,
          is_past_due: isPastDue
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort items chronologically: effective_date ASC, then plan_id ASC, slot_index ASC, slot_id ASC
    agendaItems.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmpDate = a.effective_date.localeCompare(b.effective_date);
      if (cmpDate !== 0) return cmpDate;
      const cmpPlan = a.plan_id.localeCompare(b.plan_id);
      if (cmpPlan !== 0) return cmpPlan;
      const cmpIndex = a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
      if (cmpIndex !== 0) return cmpIndex;
      return a.slot_id.localeCompare(b.slot_id);
    });

    // Cursor-based deterministic pagination: cursor encodes composite (effective_date, plan_id, slot_id)
    let startIndex = 0;
    if (query.cursor) {
      try {
        const decoded = Buffer.from(query.cursor, 'base64').toString('utf8');
        const [cursorDate, cursorPlanId, cursorSlotId] = decoded.split('|');
        const found = agendaItems.findIndex(
          item =>
            item.effective_date > cursorDate ||
            (item.effective_date === cursorDate && item.plan_id > cursorPlanId) ||
            (item.effective_date === cursorDate && item.plan_id === cursorPlanId && item.slot_id > cursorSlotId)
        );
        if (found !== -1) {
          startIndex = found;
        } else {
          startIndex = agendaItems.length;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        startIndex = 0;
      }
    }

    const pagedItems = agendaItems.slice(startIndex, startIndex + limit);
    const hasMore = startIndex + limit < agendaItems.length;
    let nextCursor: string | null = null;
    if (hasMore && pagedItems.length > 0) {
      const last = pagedItems[pagedItems.length - 1];
      const cursorStr = `${last.effective_date}|${last.plan_id}|${last.slot_id}`;
      nextCursor = Buffer.from(cursorStr, 'utf8').toString('base64');
    }

    const uniqueSessions = new Set(allSessionIds).size;
    const counters: CheckInAgendaCounters = {
      total_slots: totalSlots,
      active_scheduled_slots: activeScheduledSlots,
      recorded_slots: recordedSlots,
      usable_current_slots: usableCurrentSlots,
      quality_limited_slots: qualityLimitedSlots,
      rescheduled_slots: rescheduledSlots,
      skipped_slots: skippedSlots,
      superseded_slots: supersededSlots,
      retired_slots: retiredSlots,
      unique_sessions_count: uniqueSessions
    };

    // Calculate plan revisions digest for snapshot consistency
    const planRevisionsTotal = allPlans.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.optimistic_revision, 0);

    return {
      profile_id: profileId,
      from_date: fromDate,
      to_date: toDate,
      items: pagedItems,
      counters,
      next_cursor: nextCursor,
      has_more: hasMore,
      query_snapshot_revision: planRevisionsTotal
    };
  }

  /**
   * Previews a unified Progress Review constructed from selected Check-in slots across MULTIPLE plans.
   * Enforces:
   * - Authorized profile isolation across all selected slots and plans
   * - Verification of plan and slot existence and revisions
   * - Verification of linked sessions and exact Named Window revisions
   * - Per-metric comparability check (Negative Window Proof: dfa_alpha1, recovery_1min withheld for windows)
   * - Session deduplication across plans (eligible_independent_peer_count)
   * - Chronological sorting by effective_date, slot_date, plan_id, slot_index
   * - Distinct plans counting
   * - SHA-256 tamper-evident preview_digest
   */
  public previewCrossPlanReview(
    profileId: string,
    req: CrossPlanReviewPreviewRequest
  ): CrossPlanReviewPreviewResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к предварительному просмотру чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(req.selected_slots) || req.selected_slots.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Необходимо выбрать как минимум один слот для предварительного просмотра');
    }

    const planMap = new Map<string, AthleteCheckInPlan>();
    const planEntriesMap = new Map<string, Map<string, AthleteCheckInEntry>>();

    // 1. Verify and cache all distinct plans
    const distinctPlanIds = Array.from(new Set(req.selected_slots.map(s => s.plan_id)));
    for (const pId of distinctPlanIds) {
      const plan = getCheckInPlan(pId);
      if (!plan) {
        throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`План ${pId} не найден`);
      }
      if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`План ${pId} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }
      planMap.set(pId, plan);

      const entries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(pId);
      const eMap = new Map<string, AthleteCheckInEntry>();
      for (const ent of entries) {
        eMap.set(ent.id, ent);
      }
      planEntriesMap.set(pId, eMap);
    }

    // Determine target metrics
    const allowedMetrics: ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[] = [
      'avg_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50', 'mean_rr', 'dfa_alpha1', 'recovery_1min'
    ];
    let activeMetricList: ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[];
    if (req.metric_keys && req.metric_keys.length > 0) {
      activeMetricList = req.metric_keys.filter((k): k is ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min') =>
        allowedMetrics.includes(k as any)
      );
    } else {
      const unionKeys = new Set<string>();
      for (const p of planMap.values()) {
