        for (const mk of p.metric_keys) {
          if (allowedMetrics.includes(mk as any)) {
            unionKeys.add(mk);
          }
        }
      }
      activeMetricList = Array.from(unionKeys) as any;
      if (activeMetricList.length === 0) {
        activeMetricList = ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'];
      }
    }

    const previewItems: CrossPlanSelectedSlotPreviewItem[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const limitations: string[] = [];

    const metricStats: Record<string, { comparableCount: number; unsupportedSlots: string[] }> = {};
    for (const m of activeMetricList) {
      metricStats[m] = { comparableCount: 0, unsupportedSlots: [] };
    }

    // 2. Validate each selected slot
    for (const sel of req.selected_slots) {
      const plan = planMap.get(sel.plan_id);
      if (!plan) {
        throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`План ${sel.plan_id} не найден`);
      }
      if (sel.expected_plan_revision !== undefined && plan.optimistic_revision !== sel.expected_plan_revision) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия плана ${sel.plan_id} (${plan.optimistic_revision}) не соответствует ожидаемой (${sel.expected_plan_revision})`);
      }

      const eMap = planEntriesMap.get(sel.plan_id)!;
      const entry = eMap.get(sel.slot_id);
      if (!entry) {
        throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} не найден в плане ${sel.plan_id}`);
      }
      if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }
      if (entry.optimistic_revision !== sel.expected_slot_revision) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия слота ${sel.slot_id} (${entry.optimistic_revision}) не соответствует ожидаемой (${sel.expected_slot_revision})`);
      }
      if (!entry.session_id) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} (${entry.slot_date}) не имеет привязанной записи`);
      }

      const session = getSession(entry.session_id);
      if (!session) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} для слота ${sel.slot_id} недоступна в хранилище`);
      }
      const sessionUserId = session.user_id || 'default';
      if (sessionUserId !== profileId && profileId !== 'default' && sessionUserId !== 'default') {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }

      this.reconcileEntryState(entry);

      if (entry.window_root_id) {
        const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(entry.session_id);
        const activeWindow = windows.find((w: any) =>
          w.id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.root_window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
          w.root_id === entry.window_root_id
        );
        if (!activeWindow) {
          throw new CheckInValidationError(`Named Window ${entry.window_root_id} не найдено в сессии ${entry.session_id}`);
        }
        if (entry.window_revision !== null && activeWindow.revision !== entry.window_revision) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError(`Ревизия Named Window ${entry.window_root_id} изменилась (актуальная: ${activeWindow.revision}, в слоте: ${entry.window_revision})`);
        }
      }

      const comparableMetrics: any[] = [];
      for (const m of activeMetricList) {
        if (entry.window_root_id) {
          if (m === 'dfa_alpha1' || m === 'recovery_1min') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'unsupported_window_metric',
              reason_ru: `Метрика ${m} не поддерживается для Named Window (доступна только для целой сессии)`
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else if (entry.eligibility_state === 'stale' || entry.eligibility_state === 'source_unavailable') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'quality_withheld',
              reason_ru: `Данные слота недоступны или требуют обновления (${entry.eligibility_state})`
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: true,
              reason_code: 'supported',
              reason_ru: 'Метрика доступна для сравнения в окне'
            });
            metricStats[m].comparableCount++;
          }
        } else {
          if (entry.eligibility_state === 'source_unavailable') {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: false,
              reason_code: 'missing_data',
              reason_ru: 'Сессия недоступна'
            });
            metricStats[m].unsupportedSlots.push(entry.id);
          } else {
            comparableMetrics.push({
              metric_key: m,
              comparable: true,
              reason_code: 'supported',
              reason_ru: 'Метрика доступна'
            });
            metricStats[m].comparableCount++;
          }
        }
      }

      previewItems.push({
        plan_id: plan.id,
        plan_title: plan.title,
        plan_cadence: plan.cadence,
        plan_timezone: plan.timezone,
        slot_id: entry.id,
        slot_date: entry.slot_date,
        effective_date: entry.effective_date || entry.slot_date,
        slot_index: entry.slot_index,
        session_id: entry.session_id,
        window_root_id: entry.window_root_id,
        window_revision: entry.window_revision,
        quality_score: entry.quality_score,
        eligibility_state: entry.eligibility_state,
        comparable_metrics: comparableMetrics,
        user_notes: entry.user_notes
      });
    }

    // 3. Sort preview items chronologically
    previewItems.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmpDate = a.effective_date.localeCompare(b.effective_date);
      if (cmpDate !== 0) return cmpDate;
      const cmpInitial = a.slot_date.localeCompare(b.slot_date);
      if (cmpInitial !== 0) return cmpInitial;
      const cmpPlan = a.plan_id.localeCompare(b.plan_id);
      if (cmpPlan !== 0) return cmpPlan;
      return a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
    });

    // 4. Session deduplication and independent peers
    const sessionSeenSet = new Set<string>();
    const orderedSessionIds: string[] = [];
    for (const item of previewItems) {
      if (!sessionSeenSet.has(item.session_id)) {
        sessionSeenSet.add(item.session_id);
        orderedSessionIds.push(item.session_id);
      }
    }
    const eligibleIndependentPeers = sessionSeenSet.size;
    if (previewItems.length > eligibleIndependentPeers) {
      warnings.push(`Несколько выбранных слотов ссылаются на одну сессию. Независимых сессий: ${eligibleIndependentPeers}.`);
    }

    const perMetricComparability: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const m of activeMetricList) {
      const stats = metricStats[m];
      const isReady = stats.comparableCount >= 2 && stats.unsupportedSlots.length === 0;
      const mLimitations: string[] = [];
      if (stats.unsupportedSlots.length > 0) {
        const text = `${stats.unsupportedSlots.length} из ${previewItems.length} слотов не имеют поддержки метрики ${m}`;
        mLimitations.push(text);
        limitations.push(`Неполная сопоставимость по метрике "${m}": ${text}`);
      }
      perMetricComparability[m] = {
        comparable_slots_count: stats.comparableCount,
        total_slots_count: previewItems.length,
        is_ready_for_review: isReady,
        unsupported_slots: stats.unsupportedSlots,
        limitations: mLimitations
      };
    }

    let overallReadiness: 'ready' | 'limited' | 'insufficient_history' = 'ready';
    if (eligibleIndependentPeers < 2) {
      overallReadiness = 'insufficient_history';
      limitations.push('Для построения достоверного динамического ряда рекомендуется не менее 2 независимых записей');
    } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
      overallReadiness = 'limited';
    }

    // 5. Compute SHA-256 preview digest
    const digestPayload = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      distinct_plans_count: distinctPlanIds.length,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: eligibleIndependentPeers,
      ordered_session_ids: orderedSessionIds,
      metric_keys: activeMetricList,
      selected_slots: previewItems.map(p => ({
        plan_id: p.plan_id,
        slot_id: p.slot_id,
        slot_date: p.slot_date,
        effective_date: p.effective_date,
        slot_index: p.slot_index,
        session_id: p.session_id,
        window_root_id: p.window_root_id,
        window_revision: p.window_revision,
        eligibility_state: p.eligibility_state
      }))
    };
    const previewDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: previewItems,
      ordered_session_ids: orderedSessionIds,
      distinct_plans_count: distinctPlanIds.length,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: eligibleIndependentPeers,
      per_metric_comparability: perMetricComparability,
      overall_readiness: overallReadiness,
      warnings,
      limitations,
      preview_digest: previewDigest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Atomically creates a linked SavedLongitudinalView in Progress Review from selected slots across MULTIPLE plans.
   * Embeds durable cross_plan_provenance and window_references in the view and its normalized_query.
   * Updates each slot's saved_view_id via CAS, records history for all touched plans, and caches idempotency.
   */
  public createCrossPlanProgressReview(
    profileId: string,
    req: CreateCrossPlanProgressReviewRequest
  ): SavedLongitudinalView {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к созданию обзора чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(req.selected_slots) || req.selected_slots.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Необходимо выбрать как минимум один слот для создания отчета прогресса');
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: req.selected_slots.map(s => ({
        plan_id: s.plan_id,
        slot_id: s.slot_id,
        expected_slot_revision: s.expected_slot_revision,
        expected_plan_revision: s.expected_plan_revision
      })),
      view_name: req.view_name ? req.view_name.trim() : null,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // 1. Run authoritative preview
    const preview = this.previewCrossPlanReview(profileId, {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: req.selected_slots
    });

    if (req.preview_digest && req.preview_digest !== preview.preview_digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра устарел или не совпадает с актуальным состоянием');
    }

    const viewId = `view_xplan_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    const crossPlanProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = preview.selected_slots.map(s => ({
      plan_id: s.plan_id,
      plan_title: s.plan_title,
      slot_id: s.slot_id,
      slot_date: s.slot_date,
      effective_date: s.effective_date,
      slot_index: s.slot_index,
      session_id: s.session_id,
      window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
      window_revision: s.window_revision
    }));

    const windowReferences: Array<{ session_id: string; window_root_id: string; window_revision: number; slot_date?: string; slot_index?: number }> = [];
    for (const s of preview.selected_slots) {
      if (s.window_root_id && s.window_revision !== null) {
        windowReferences.push({
          session_id: s.session_id,
          window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
          window_revision: s.window_revision,
          slot_date: s.slot_date,
          slot_index: s.slot_index
        });
      }
    }

    const targetSessionId = preview.ordered_session_ids[preview.ordered_session_ids.length - 1];
    const metricKeys = Object.keys(preview.per_metric_comparability);
    const metricSet = (metricKeys.length > 0 ? metricKeys : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr']) as ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[];

    const defaultTitle = `Обзор по планам (${crossPlanProvenance.length} слотов, ${preview.distinct_plans_count} планов)`;
    const title = req.view_name ? req.view_name.trim() : defaultTitle;

    const wordingTitle = validateCheckInWording(title);
    if (!wordingTitle.valid) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingTitle.violation!);
    }
    if (req.user_notes) {
      const wordingNotes = validateCheckInWording(req.user_notes);
      if (!wordingNotes.valid) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingNotes.violation!);
      }
    }

    const normalizedQuery: LongitudinalSeriesQuery = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      target_session_id: targetSessionId,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      metric_set: metricSet,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : `Создано из нескольких планов наблюдений (${preview.distinct_plans_count} планов)`
    };
    (normalizedQuery as any).title = title;

    const savedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      view_id: viewId,
      name: title,
      profile_id: profileId,
      normalized_query: normalizedQuery,
      metrics: metricSet,
      display_preferences: {},
      is_retired: false,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : undefined,
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      created_at_utc: nowUtc,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      createSavedLongitudinalView(savedView);

      // Update history record for revision 1 to include full draft_query_json
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE saved_longitudinal_view_history
        SET draft_query_json = ?
        WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = 1
      `).run(JSON.stringify(savedView.normalized_query), viewId);

      // CAS update for each selected slot
      for (const sel of req.selected_slots) {
        const ent = getCheckInEntry(sel.slot_id);
        if (!ent) {
          throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} не найден`);
        }
        const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
        ent.saved_view_id = viewId;
        ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
        ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
        const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
        if (!success) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
        }
      }

      // Record history on each touched plan
      const touchedPlanIds = Array.from(new Set(req.selected_slots.map(s => s.plan_id)));
      for (const pId of touchedPlanIds) {
        const plan = getCheckInPlan(pId);
        const planRev = plan ? plan.optimistic_revision : 1;
        recordCheckInHistory(pId, null, 'cross_plan_progress_review_created', planRev, {
          view_id: viewId,
          selected_slots: req.selected_slots.filter(s => s.plan_id === pId).map(s => s.slot_id),
          all_selected_slots: req.selected_slots.map(s => s.slot_id),
          distinct_plans_count: touchedPlanIds.length,
          session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids
        });
      }

      // Save idempotency receipt inside the atomic transaction
      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, savedView);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return savedView;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a read-only preview of proposed amendments to an existing Cross-Plan Progress Review.
   * Allows adding/removing slots across plans, editing title and non-diagnostic notes,
   * verifying exact revisions, computing resulting chronological order, and generating a SHA-256 preview digest.
   */
  public previewCrossPlanReviewRevision(
    profileId: string,
    req: CrossPlanReviewRevisionPreviewRequest
  ): CrossPlanReviewRevisionPreviewResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к предварительному просмотру чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!req.view_id) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор представления обзора обязателен');
    }
    if (typeof req.expected_view_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Ожидаемая ревизия представления обязательна');
    }

    const view = getSavedLongitudinalView(req.view_id);
    if (!view) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError('Представление обзора не найдено');
    }
    if (view.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Представление обзора принадлежит чужому профилю');
    }
    if (view.is_retired) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Нельзя изменить архивированное представление обзора');
    }
    if (view.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_view_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии представления обзора: ожидалась ${req.expected_view_revision}, актуальная ${view.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const existingProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = view.cross_plan_provenance || view.normalized_query?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
    if (existingProvenance.length === 0) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Представление не является Cross-plan Progress Review');
    }

    const removeSet = new Set(req.remove_slot_ids || []);
    const retainedProvenance = existingProvenance.filter(p => !removeSet.has(p.slot_id));
    const addedSlots = req.add_slots || [];

    // Resulting slots must have at least 1 slot
    const tentativeTotalCount = retainedProvenance.length + addedSlots.length;
    if (tentativeTotalCount < 1) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('После изменений выборка не может быть пустой (требуется хотя бы один слот)');
    }

    // Combine retained and added slots into CrossPlanSlotSelectionItem[]
    const combinedSlots: CrossPlanSlotSelectionItem[] = [];
    const seenSlotIds = new Set<string>();

    for (const ret of retainedProvenance) {
      if (seenSlotIds.has(ret.slot_id)) continue;
      seenSlotIds.add(ret.slot_id);
      const entry = getCheckInEntry(ret.slot_id);
      if (!entry) {
        throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError(`Слот ${ret.slot_id} не найден в плане ${ret.plan_id}`);
      }
      if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CheckInCrossProfileError(`Слот ${ret.slot_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
      }
      combinedSlots.push({
        plan_id: ret.plan_id,
        slot_id: ret.slot_id,
        expected_slot_revision: entry.optimistic_revision
      });
    }

    for (const add of addedSlots) {
      if (seenSlotIds.has(add.slot_id)) {
        continue;
      }
      seenSlotIds.add(add.slot_id);
      combinedSlots.push({
        plan_id: add.plan_id,
        slot_id: add.slot_id,
        expected_slot_revision: add.expected_slot_revision,
        expected_plan_revision: add.expected_plan_revision
      });
    }

    // Call standard previewCrossPlanReview with combined slots
    const basePreview = this.previewCrossPlanReview(profileId, {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: combinedSlots,
      metric_keys: req.metric_keys
    });

    // Build tamper-evident preview digest for the revision
    const digestPayload = {
      view_id: view.view_id,
      current_revision: view.optimistic_revision,
      proposed_revision: view.optimistic_revision + 1,
      profile_id: profileId,
      distinct_plans_count: basePreview.distinct_plans_count,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: basePreview.eligible_independent_peer_count,
      ordered_session_ids: basePreview.ordered_session_ids,
      metric_keys: Object.keys(basePreview.per_metric_comparability),
      selected_slots: basePreview.selected_slots.map(p => ({
        plan_id: p.plan_id,
        slot_id: p.slot_id,
        slot_date: p.slot_date,
        effective_date: p.effective_date,
        slot_index: p.slot_index,
        session_id: p.session_id,
        window_root_id: p.window_root_id,
        window_revision: p.window_revision,
        eligibility_state: p.eligibility_state
      }))
    };
    const previewDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      view_id: view.view_id,
      current_revision: view.optimistic_revision,
      proposed_revision: view.optimistic_revision + 1,
      original_slots_count: existingProvenance.length,
      added_slots_count: addedSlots.length,
      removed_slots_count: req.remove_slot_ids ? req.remove_slot_ids.length : 0,
      resulting_slots_count: basePreview.selected_slots.length,
      resulting_slots: basePreview.selected_slots,
      ordered_session_ids: basePreview.ordered_session_ids,
      distinct_plans_count: basePreview.distinct_plans_count,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: basePreview.eligible_independent_peer_count,
      per_metric_comparability: basePreview.per_metric_comparability,
      overall_readiness: basePreview.overall_readiness,
      warnings: basePreview.warnings,
      limitations: basePreview.limitations,
      preview_digest: previewDigest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Atomically commits a new revision to an existing Cross-Plan Progress Review.
   * Performs CAS optimistic concurrency increment on SavedLongitudinalView,
   * inserts a revision record into saved_longitudinal_view_history ('revision_committed'),
   * updates slot backlinks (assigning added slots, unlinking removed slots),
   * records history on all touched plans, and caches durable idempotency.
   */
  public commitCrossPlanReviewRevision(
    profileId: string,
    req: CommitCrossPlanReviewRevisionRequest
  ): SavedLongitudinalView {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к сохранению ревизии чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!req.view_id) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор представления обзора обязателен');
    }
    if (typeof req.expected_view_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Ожидаемая ревизия представления обязательна');
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      view_id: req.view_id,
      expected_view_revision: req.expected_view_revision,
      add_slots: (req.add_slots || []).map(s => ({
        plan_id: s.plan_id,
        slot_id: s.slot_id,
        expected_slot_revision: s.expected_slot_revision,
        expected_plan_revision: s.expected_plan_revision
      })),
      remove_slot_ids: req.remove_slot_ids ? [...req.remove_slot_ids].sort() : [],
      view_name: req.view_name ? req.view_name.trim() : null,
      user_notes: req.user_notes ? req.user_notes.trim() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest || null
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // 1. Run authoritative revision preview
    const preview = this.previewCrossPlanReviewRevision(profileId, {
      profile_id: profileId,
      view_id: req.view_id,
      expected_view_revision: req.expected_view_revision,
      add_slots: req.add_slots,
      remove_slot_ids: req.remove_slot_ids,
      new_view_name: req.view_name,
      new_user_notes: req.user_notes
    });

    if (req.preview_digest && req.preview_digest !== preview.preview_digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра устарел или не совпадает с актуальным состоянием');
    }

    const existingView = getSavedLongitudinalView(req.view_id);
    if (!existingView) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError('Представление обзора не найдено');
    }

    const existingProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = existingView.cross_plan_provenance || existingView.normalized_query?.cross_plan_provenance || [];

    const nextRevision = req.expected_view_revision + 1;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    const crossPlanProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = preview.resulting_slots.map(s => ({
      plan_id: s.plan_id,
      plan_title: s.plan_title,
      slot_id: s.slot_id,
      slot_date: s.slot_date,
      effective_date: s.effective_date,
      slot_index: s.slot_index,
      session_id: s.session_id,
      window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
      window_revision: s.window_revision
    }));

    const windowReferences: Array<{ session_id: string; window_root_id: string; window_revision: number; slot_date?: string; slot_index?: number }> = [];
    for (const s of preview.resulting_slots) {
      if (s.window_root_id && s.window_revision !== null) {
        windowReferences.push({
          session_id: s.session_id,
          window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
          window_revision: s.window_revision,
          slot_date: s.slot_date,
          slot_index: s.slot_index
        });
      }
    }

    const targetSessionId = preview.resulting_slots[preview.resulting_slots.length - 1].session_id;
    const metricKeys = Object.keys(preview.per_metric_comparability);
    const metricSet = (metricKeys.length > 0 ? metricKeys : existingView.metrics) as ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[];

    const title = req.view_name !== undefined && req.view_name.trim().length > 0 ? req.view_name.trim() : existingView.name;
    const notes = req.user_notes !== undefined ? req.user_notes.trim() : (existingView.user_notes || null);

    const wordingTitle = validateCheckInWording(title);
    if (!wordingTitle.valid) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingTitle.violation!);
    }
    if (notes) {
      const wordingNotes = validateCheckInWording(notes);
      if (!wordingNotes.valid) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingNotes.violation!);
      }
    }

    const normalizedQuery: LongitudinalSeriesQuery = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      target_session_id: targetSessionId,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      metric_set: metricSet,
      user_notes: notes || `Обновлено: ревизия ${nextRevision} (${preview.distinct_plans_count} планов)`
    };
    (normalizedQuery as any).title = title;

    const updatedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
      ...existingView,
      name: title,
      user_notes: notes || undefined,
      normalized_query: normalizedQuery,
      metrics: metricSet,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      optimistic_revision: nextRevision,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. CAS update saved_longitudinal_views
      const viewRes = db.prepare(`
        UPDATE saved_longitudinal_views
        SET name = ?, normalized_query_json = ?, metrics_json = ?,
            display_preferences_json = ?, current_snapshot_id = ?,
            optimistic_revision = ?, is_retired = ?,
            selected_session_ids_json = ?, window_references_json = ?, user_notes = ?,
            updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
      `).run(
        updatedView.name,
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.normalized_query),
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.metrics),
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.display_preferences),
        updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
        updatedView.optimistic_revision,
        updatedView.is_retired ? 1 : 0,
        updatedView.selected_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.selected_session_ids) : null,
        updatedView.window_references ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.window_references) : null,
        updatedView.user_notes ?? null,
        updatedView.updated_at_utc,
        req.view_id,
        req.expected_view_revision
      );

      if (viewRes.changes === 0) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного обновления: ревизия представления изменилась');
      }

      // 2. Insert into saved_longitudinal_view_history with change_type: 'revision_committed'
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
          history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
          change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        `hist-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
        req.view_id,
        nextRevision,
        updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
        'revision_committed',
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.normalized_query),
        nowUtc
      );

      // 3. Backlink newly added slots
      if (req.add_slots && req.add_slots.length > 0) {
        for (const sel of req.add_slots) {
          const ent = getCheckInEntry(sel.slot_id);
          if (!ent) {
            throw new CheckInEntryNotFoundError(`Слот ${sel.slot_id} не найден`);
          }
          const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
          ent.saved_view_id = req.view_id;
          ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
          ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
          const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
          if (!success) {
            throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
          }
        }
      }

      // 4. Clear backlinks on removed slots
      if (req.remove_slot_ids && req.remove_slot_ids.length > 0) {
        for (const slotId of req.remove_slot_ids) {
          const ent = getCheckInEntry(slotId);
          if (ent && ent.saved_view_id === req.view_id) {
            const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
            ent.saved_view_id = null;
            ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
            ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
            const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
            if (!success) {
              throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 5. Record history on touched plans
      const touchedPlanIds = new Set<string>();
      if (req.add_slots) {
        for (const s of req.add_slots) touchedPlanIds.add(s.plan_id);
      }
      if (req.remove_slot_ids) {
        for (const slotId of req.remove_slot_ids) {
          const oldProv = existingProvenance.find(p => p.slot_id === slotId);
          if (oldProv) touchedPlanIds.add(oldProv.plan_id);
        }
      }
      for (const pId of touchedPlanIds) {
        const plan = getCheckInPlan(pId);
        const planRev = plan ? plan.optimistic_revision : 1;
        recordCheckInHistory(pId, null, 'cross_plan_progress_review_revised', planRev, {
          view_id: req.view_id,
          revision: nextRevision,
          added_slots: req.add_slots ? req.add_slots.filter(s => s.plan_id === pId).map(s => s.slot_id) : [],
          removed_slots: req.remove_slot_ids || [],
          total_slots: preview.resulting_slots_count
        });
      }

      // 6. Save idempotency inside the single atomic transaction
      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, updatedView);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return updatedView;
  }

  /**
   * Performs read-only comparison between two historical revisions of a Cross-Plan Progress Review,
   * or between a historical revision and the current authoritative view.
   * Enforces:
   * - Authorized profile isolation
   * - Immutable history provenance inspection (does not hallucinate missing fields)
   * - Returns legacy_snapshot_incomplete / is_comparable: false for incomplete legacy snapshots
   * - Evaluates added / removed / unchanged / changed slots with exact change reasons
   * - Strict canonical Longitudinal metrics read path (Negative Window Proof: dfa_alpha1, recovery_1min unsupported for windows)
   * - Session deduplication without inflating independent peer count
   * - Zero database mutation (read-only)
   */
  public diffCrossPlanReviewRevisions(
    profileId: string,
    req: CrossPlanReviewRevisionDiffRequest
  ): CrossPlanReviewRevisionDiffResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к сравнению ревизий чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!req.view_id) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор представления обзора обязателен');
    }

    const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(req.view_id);
    if (!currentView) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError('Представление обзора не найдено');
    }
    if (currentView.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Представление обзора принадлежит чужому профилю');
    }

    const historyRecords = getSavedLongitudinalViewHistory(req.view_id);

    // 1. Resolve Base Record
    let baseRecord: any = null;
    if (req.base_history_id) {
      baseRecord = historyRecords.find(h => h.history_id === req.base_history_id);
    } else if (req.base_revision !== undefined) {
      baseRecord = historyRecords.find(h => h.optimistic_revision === req.base_revision);
    } else {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Необходимо указать базовую ревизию для сравнения (base_revision или base_history_id)');
    }

    if (!baseRecord) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`Базовая ревизия не найдена в истории обзора ${req.view_id}`);
    }

    // 2. Resolve Target Record / State
    let isTargetCurrent = false;
    let targetRecord: any = null;
    let targetProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = [];
    let targetTitle = '';
    let targetNotes: string | null = null;
    let targetMetricKeys: string[] = [];
    let targetRevision = 0;
    let targetHistoryId: string | null = null;
    let targetCreatedAtUtc = '';

    if (req.compare_with_current === true || (req.target_revision === undefined && !req.target_history_id)) {
      isTargetCurrent = true;
      targetRevision = currentView.optimistic_revision;
      targetTitle = currentView.name;
      targetNotes = currentView.user_notes || null;
      targetMetricKeys = currentView.metrics || ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'];
      targetProvenance = currentView.cross_plan_provenance || (currentView.normalized_query as any)?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
      targetCreatedAtUtc = currentView.updated_at_utc || currentView.created_at_utc;
    } else if (req.target_history_id) {
      targetRecord = historyRecords.find(h => h.history_id === req.target_history_id);
      if (!targetRecord) {
        throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`Целевая ревизия не найдена в истории обзора ${req.view_id}`);
      }
      targetRevision = targetRecord.optimistic_revision;
      targetHistoryId = targetRecord.history_id;
      targetCreatedAtUtc = targetRecord.created_at_utc;
      isTargetCurrent = targetRevision === currentView.optimistic_revision;
    } else if (req.target_revision !== undefined) {
      if (req.target_revision === currentView.optimistic_revision) {
        isTargetCurrent = true;
        targetRevision = currentView.optimistic_revision;
        targetTitle = currentView.name;
        targetNotes = currentView.user_notes || null;
        targetMetricKeys = currentView.metrics || ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'];
        targetProvenance = currentView.cross_plan_provenance || (currentView.normalized_query as any)?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
        targetCreatedAtUtc = currentView.updated_at_utc || currentView.created_at_utc;
      } else {
        targetRecord = historyRecords.find(h => h.optimistic_revision === req.target_revision);
        if (!targetRecord) {
          throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`Целевая ревизия #${req.target_revision} не найдена в истории обзора ${req.view_id}`);
        }
        targetRevision = targetRecord.optimistic_revision;
        targetHistoryId = targetRecord.history_id;
        targetCreatedAtUtc = targetRecord.created_at_utc;
        isTargetCurrent = false;
      }
    }

    // 3. Check legacy snapshot completeness
    const baseProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = baseRecord.draft_query?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
    const isBaseIncomplete =
      !baseRecord.draft_query ||
      !Array.isArray(baseRecord.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance) ||
      baseRecord.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance.length === 0 ||
      baseRecord.change_type === 'conflict_draft_preserved' ||
      baseRecord.change_type === 'retired';

    let isTargetIncomplete = false;
    if (targetRecord) {
      targetProvenance = targetRecord.draft_query?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
      targetTitle = targetRecord.draft_query?.title || (targetRecord.optimistic_revision === currentView.optimistic_revision ? currentView.name : `Обзор (ревизия ${targetRecord.optimistic_revision})`);
      targetNotes = targetRecord.draft_query?.user_notes || null;
      targetMetricKeys = targetRecord.draft_query?.metric_set || currentView.metrics || ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'];
      isTargetIncomplete =
        !targetRecord.draft_query ||
        !Array.isArray(targetRecord.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance) ||
        targetRecord.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance.length === 0 ||
        targetRecord.change_type === 'conflict_draft_preserved' ||
        targetRecord.change_type === 'retired';
    } else if (isTargetCurrent) {
      if (targetProvenance.length === 0) {
        isTargetIncomplete = true;
      }
    }

    const baseTitle = baseRecord.draft_query?.title || (baseRecord.optimistic_revision === currentView.optimistic_revision ? currentView.name : `Обзор (ревизия ${baseRecord.optimistic_revision})`);
    const baseNotes = baseRecord.draft_query?.user_notes || null;
    const baseMetricKeys = baseRecord.draft_query?.metric_set || ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'];

    if (isBaseIncomplete || isTargetIncomplete) {
      return {
        view_id: req.view_id,
        base_revision: baseRecord.optimistic_revision,
        base_history_id: baseRecord.history_id,
        base_created_at_utc: baseRecord.created_at_utc,
        target_revision: targetRevision,
        target_history_id: targetHistoryId,
        target_created_at_utc: targetCreatedAtUtc,
        is_target_current: isTargetCurrent,
        is_comparable: false,
        reason_code: 'legacy_snapshot_incomplete',
        reason_ru: isBaseIncomplete
          ? `Базовая ревизия #${baseRecord.optimistic_revision} является архивной или неполной (legacy_snapshot_incomplete); детальное сравнение недоступно.`
          : `Целевая ревизия #${targetRevision} является архивной или неполной (legacy_snapshot_incomplete); детальное сравнение недоступно.`,
        title_changed: false,
        base_title: isBaseIncomplete ? 'unknown' : baseTitle,
        target_title: isTargetIncomplete ? 'unknown' : targetTitle,
        notes_changed: false,
        base_notes: isBaseIncomplete ? null : baseNotes,
        target_notes: isTargetIncomplete ? null : targetNotes,
        metric_keys_changed: false,
        base_metric_keys: isBaseIncomplete ? [] : baseMetricKeys,
        target_metric_keys: isTargetIncomplete ? [] : targetMetricKeys,
        slots_diff: [],
        added_slots_count: 0,
        removed_slots_count: 0,
        unchanged_slots_count: 0,
        changed_slots_count: 0,
        distinct_plans_count: 0,
        eligible_independent_peer_count: 0,
        warnings: ['Исторический снимок не содержит полной структуры выборки (legacy_snapshot_incomplete)'],
        limitations: ['Сравнение недоступно для неполных исторических записей']
      };
    }

    // 4. Compare slots between Base and Target
    const baseSlotsMap = new Map<string, CrossPlanObservationProvenance>();
    for (const s of baseProvenance) {
      baseSlotsMap.set(s.slot_id, s);
    }
    const targetSlotsMap = new Map<string, CrossPlanObservationProvenance>();
    for (const s of targetProvenance) {
      targetSlotsMap.set(s.slot_id, s);
    }

    const allSlotIds = Array.from(new Set([...Array.from(baseSlotsMap.keys()), ...Array.from(targetSlotsMap.keys())]));
    const diffSlots: CrossPlanRevisionDiffSlotItem[] = [];

    let addedCount = 0;
    let removedCount = 0;
    let unchangedCount = 0;
    let changedCount = 0;

    const allPlansSet = new Set<string>();
    const sessionSeenSet = new Set<string>();

    for (const slotId of allSlotIds) {
      const inBase = baseSlotsMap.get(slotId);
      const inTarget = targetSlotsMap.get(slotId);

      if (!inBase && inTarget) {
        // Added in target
        addedCount++;
        allPlansSet.add(inTarget.plan_id);
        sessionSeenSet.add(inTarget.session_id);
        diffSlots.push({
          slot_id: inTarget.slot_id,
          plan_id: inTarget.plan_id,
          plan_title: inTarget.plan_title || inTarget.plan_id,
          slot_date: inTarget.slot_date,
          effective_date: inTarget.effective_date || inTarget.slot_date,
          slot_index: inTarget.slot_index,
          session_id: inTarget.session_id,
          window_root_id: inTarget.window_root_id,
          window_revision: inTarget.window_revision,
          status: 'added'
        });
      } else if (inBase && !inTarget) {
        // Removed in target
        removedCount++;
        allPlansSet.add(inBase.plan_id);
        sessionSeenSet.add(inBase.session_id);
        diffSlots.push({
          slot_id: inBase.slot_id,
          plan_id: inBase.plan_id,
          plan_title: inBase.plan_title || inBase.plan_id,
          slot_date: inBase.slot_date,
          effective_date: inBase.effective_date || inBase.slot_date,
          slot_index: inBase.slot_index,
          session_id: inBase.session_id,
          window_root_id: inBase.window_root_id,
          window_revision: inBase.window_revision,
          status: 'removed'
        });
      } else if (inBase && inTarget) {
        allPlansSet.add(inTarget.plan_id);
        sessionSeenSet.add(inTarget.session_id);

        const reasons: string[] = [];
        if (inBase.session_id !== inTarget.session_id) {
          reasons.push('session_reassigned');
        }
        if (inBase.window_root_id !== inTarget.window_root_id) {
          reasons.push('window_root_changed');
        }
        if (inBase.window_revision !== inTarget.window_revision) {
          reasons.push('window_revision_changed');
        }
        if ((inBase.effective_date || inBase.slot_date) !== (inTarget.effective_date || inTarget.slot_date)) {
          reasons.push('date_rescheduled');
        }

        if (reasons.length > 0) {
          changedCount++;
          diffSlots.push({
            slot_id: inTarget.slot_id,
            plan_id: inTarget.plan_id,
            plan_title: inTarget.plan_title || inTarget.plan_id,
            slot_date: inTarget.slot_date,
            effective_date: inTarget.effective_date || inTarget.slot_date,
            slot_index: inTarget.slot_index,
            session_id: inTarget.session_id,
            window_root_id: inTarget.window_root_id,
            window_revision: inTarget.window_revision,
            status: 'changed',
            change_reasons: reasons
          });
        } else {
          unchangedCount++;
          diffSlots.push({
            slot_id: inTarget.slot_id,
            plan_id: inTarget.plan_id,
            plan_title: inTarget.plan_title || inTarget.plan_id,
            slot_date: inTarget.slot_date,
            effective_date: inTarget.effective_date || inTarget.slot_date,
            slot_index: inTarget.slot_index,
            session_id: inTarget.session_id,
            window_root_id: inTarget.window_root_id,
            window_revision: inTarget.window_revision,
            status: 'unchanged'
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Sort deterministically: effective_date ASC, then slot_date ASC, plan_id ASC, slot_index ASC
    diffSlots.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmpDate = a.effective_date.localeCompare(b.effective_date);
      if (cmpDate !== 0) return cmpDate;
      const cmpInitial = a.slot_date.localeCompare(b.slot_date);
      if (cmpInitial !== 0) return cmpInitial;
      const cmpPlan = a.plan_id.localeCompare(b.plan_id);
      if (cmpPlan !== 0) return cmpPlan;
      return a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
    });

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    if (sessionSeenSet.size < diffSlots.length) {
      warnings.push(`Несколько наблюдений ссылаются на одну сессию. Независимых сессий: ${sessionSeenSet.size}.`);
    }

    const titleChanged = baseTitle !== targetTitle;
    const notesChanged = (baseNotes || '') !== (targetNotes || '');
    const metricKeysChanged =
      baseMetricKeys.length !== targetMetricKeys.length ||
      baseMetricKeys.some((k: string, i: number) => k !== targetMetricKeys[i]);

    return {
      view_id: req.view_id,
      base_revision: baseRecord.optimistic_revision,
      base_history_id: baseRecord.history_id,
      base_created_at_utc: baseRecord.created_at_utc,
      target_revision: targetRevision,
      target_history_id: targetHistoryId,
      target_created_at_utc: targetCreatedAtUtc,
      is_target_current: isTargetCurrent,
      is_comparable: true,
      reason_code: 'comparable',
      reason_ru: 'Ревизии успешно сопоставлены по неизменяемой истории',
      title_changed: titleChanged,
      base_title: baseTitle,
      target_title: targetTitle,
      notes_changed: notesChanged,
      base_notes: baseNotes,
      target_notes: targetNotes,
      metric_keys_changed: metricKeysChanged,
      base_metric_keys: baseMetricKeys,
      target_metric_keys: targetMetricKeys,
      slots_diff: diffSlots,
      added_slots_count: addedCount,
      removed_slots_count: removedCount,
      unchanged_slots_count: unchangedCount,
      changed_slots_count: changedCount,
      distinct_plans_count: allPlansSet.size,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: sessionSeenSet.size,
      warnings,
      limitations: []
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generates a read-only preview of restoring a historical revision of a Cross-Plan Review as a new revision.
   * Enforces:
   * - Authorized profile isolation
   * - Validates historical record exists and has full immutable snapshot
   * - Validates current existence and ownership of all constituent plans, slots, sessions, and Named Windows
   * - Fails closed if any slot is missing, reassigned, or Named Window revision is mismatched
   * - Pure read-only operation (does not mutate database)
   * - SHA-256 tamper-evident preview digest
   */
  public previewCrossPlanReviewRestore(
    profileId: string,
    req: CrossPlanReviewRestorePreviewRequest
  ): CrossPlanReviewRestorePreviewResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к восстановлению чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!req.view_id) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор представления обзора обязателен');
    }
    if (typeof req.target_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Целевая восстанавливаемая ревизия обязательна');
    }
    if (typeof req.expected_current_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Ожидаемая текущая ревизия обязательна');
    }

    const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(req.view_id);
    if (!currentView) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError('Представление обзора не найдено');
    }
    if (currentView.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Представление обзора принадлежит чужому профилю');
    }
    if (currentView.is_retired) {
      throw new CheckInUnprocessableEntityError('Нельзя восстановить архивированное представление обзора (retired)', 'stale_view');
    }
    if (currentView.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_current_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии представления обзора: ожидалась ${req.expected_current_revision}, актуальная ${currentView.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const historyRecords = getSavedLongitudinalViewHistory(req.view_id);
    let targetHistory = req.target_history_id
      ? historyRecords.find(h => h.history_id === req.target_history_id)
      : historyRecords.find(h => h.optimistic_revision === req.target_revision);

    if (!targetHistory) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError(`Историческая ревизия #${req.target_revision} не найдена в истории обзора ${req.view_id}`);
    }

    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const limitations: string[] = [];

    // Check completeness of historical snapshot
    const histProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = targetHistory.draft_query?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
    const isHistoryIncomplete =
      !targetHistory.draft_query ||
      !Array.isArray(targetHistory.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance) ||
      targetHistory.draft_query.cross_plan_provenance.length === 0 ||
      targetHistory.change_type === 'conflict_draft_preserved' ||
      targetHistory.change_type === 'retired';

    if (isHistoryIncomplete) {
      blockers.push(`Историческая запись ревизии #${targetHistory.optimistic_revision} не содержит полного снимка данных (legacy_snapshot_incomplete). Восстановление невозможно, пересоберите обзор вручную через редактор.`);
      return {
        view_id: req.view_id,
        current_view_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision,
        proposed_new_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision + 1,
        restored_from_revision: targetHistory.optimistic_revision,
        restored_from_history_id: targetHistory.history_id,
        can_restore: false,
        reason_code: 'legacy_snapshot_incomplete',
        reason_ru: 'Исторический снимок не содержит полной структуры выборки; автоматическое восстановление заблокировано.',
        proposed_title: currentView.name,
        proposed_notes: currentView.user_notes || null,
        slots_to_restore: [],
        slots_retained_from_current: [],
        slots_removed_from_current: [],
        ordered_session_ids: [],
        distinct_plans_count: 0,
        eligible_independent_peer_count: 0,
        per_metric_comparability: {},
        overall_readiness: 'insufficient_history',
        blockers,
        warnings,
        limitations: ['Неполный исторический снимок'],
        preview_digest: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ blocked: true, reason: 'legacy_snapshot_incomplete' })).digest('hex')
      };
    }

    // Server-side verification of all historical constituent slots against current machine state
    const verifiedSlotSelections: CrossPlanSlotSelectionItem[] = [];

    for (const hSlot of histProvenance) {
      // 1. Plan check
      const plan = getCheckInPlan(hSlot.plan_id);
      if (!plan) {
        blockers.push(`План ${hSlot.plan_id} удален`);
        continue;
      }
      if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
        blockers.push(`План ${hSlot.plan_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
        continue;
      }
      if (plan.status === 'retired') {
        blockers.push(`План "${plan.title}" (${hSlot.plan_id}) архивирован`);
        continue;
      }

      // 2. Entry check
      const entry = getCheckInEntry(hSlot.slot_id);
      if (!entry) {
        blockers.push(`Слот ${hSlot.slot_id} не найден в плане ${hSlot.plan_id}`);
        continue;
      }
      if (entry.profile_id !== profileId) {
        blockers.push(`Слот ${hSlot.slot_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
        continue;
      }
      if (entry.is_retired) {
        blockers.push(`Слот ${hSlot.slot_id} (${hSlot.slot_date}) архивирован`);
        continue;
      }
      if (!entry.session_id) {
        blockers.push(`Слот ${hSlot.slot_id} (${hSlot.slot_date}) больше не имеет привязанной сессии`);
        continue;
      }
      if (entry.session_id !== hSlot.session_id) {
        blockers.push(`Слот ${hSlot.slot_id} был переназначен на другую сессию (исходная: ${hSlot.session_id}, актуальная: ${entry.session_id})`);
        continue;
      }

      // 3. Session check
      const session = getSession(entry.session_id);
      if (!session) {
        blockers.push(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} для слота ${hSlot.slot_id} недоступна в хранилище`);
        continue;
      }
      const sessionUserId = session.user_id || 'default';
      if (sessionUserId !== profileId && profileId !== 'default' && sessionUserId !== 'default') {
        blockers.push(`Сессия ${entry.session_id} принадлежит чужому профилю`);
        continue;
      }

      // 4. Named window check
      if (hSlot.window_root_id) {
        const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(entry.session_id);
        const activeWindow = windows.find((w: any) =>
          w.id === hSlot.window_root_id ||
          w.root_window_id === hSlot.window_root_id ||
          w.window_id === hSlot.window_root_id ||
          w.root_id === hSlot.window_root_id
        );
        if (!activeWindow) {
          blockers.push(`Named Window ${hSlot.window_root_id} удалено из сессии ${entry.session_id}`);
          continue;
        }
        if (hSlot.window_revision !== null && activeWindow.revision !== hSlot.window_revision) {
          blockers.push(`Ревизия Named Window ${hSlot.window_root_id} изменилась (исходная: ${hSlot.window_revision}, актуальная: ${activeWindow.revision})`);
          continue;
        }
      }

      verifiedSlotSelections.push({
        plan_id: hSlot.plan_id,
        slot_id: hSlot.slot_id,
        expected_slot_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
        expected_plan_revision: plan.optimistic_revision
      });
    }

    if (blockers.length > 0) {
      return {
        view_id: req.view_id,
        current_view_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision,
        proposed_new_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision + 1,
        restored_from_revision: targetHistory.optimistic_revision,
        restored_from_history_id: targetHistory.history_id,
        can_restore: false,
        reason_code: 'sources_unavailable',
        reason_ru: 'Один или несколько источников недоступны, переназначены или изменили ревизию окон. Пересоберите обзор вручную.',
        proposed_title: currentView.name,
        proposed_notes: currentView.user_notes || null,
        slots_to_restore: [],
        slots_retained_from_current: [],
        slots_removed_from_current: [],
        ordered_session_ids: [],
        distinct_plans_count: 0,
        eligible_independent_peer_count: 0,
        per_metric_comparability: {},
        overall_readiness: 'insufficient_history',
        blockers,
        warnings,
        limitations: ['Ошибки проверки источников'],
        preview_digest: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ blockers })).digest('hex')
      };
    }

    // Call canonical previewCrossPlanReview with verified slots
    const preview = this.previewCrossPlanReview(profileId, {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_slots: verifiedSlotSelections,
      metric_keys: req.metric_keys || targetHistory.draft_query?.metric_set || currentView.metrics
    });

    // Determine proposed title and notes
    let proposedTitle = currentView.name;
    if (req.title_policy === 'custom' && req.custom_title && req.custom_title.trim().length > 0) {
      proposedTitle = req.custom_title.trim();
    } else if (req.title_policy === 'restore_historical') {
      proposedTitle = `Восстановленный обзор: ${currentView.name} (из рев. #${targetHistory.optimistic_revision})`;
    }

    let proposedNotes = currentView.user_notes || null;
    if (req.notes_policy === 'custom' && req.custom_notes !== undefined) {
      proposedNotes = req.custom_notes ? req.custom_notes.trim() : null;
    } else if (req.notes_policy === 'restore_historical') {
      proposedNotes = targetHistory.draft_query?.user_notes || null;
    }

    // Calculate slots differences relative to current view
    const currentProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] =
      currentView.cross_plan_provenance || (currentView.normalized_query as any)?.cross_plan_provenance || [];
    const currentSlotIds = new Set(currentProvenance.map(s => s.slot_id));
    const restoredSlotIds = new Set(preview.selected_slots.map(s => s.slot_id));

    const slotsRetained = Array.from(currentSlotIds).filter(id => restoredSlotIds.has(id));
    const slotsRemoved = Array.from(currentSlotIds).filter(id => !restoredSlotIds.has(id));

    // Digest calculation
    const digestPayload = {
      view_id: req.view_id,
      current_view_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision,
      proposed_new_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision + 1,
      restored_from_revision: targetHistory.optimistic_revision,
      restored_from_history_id: targetHistory.history_id,
      proposed_title: proposedTitle,
      proposed_notes: proposedNotes,
      selected_slot_ids: preview.selected_slots.map(s => s.slot_id),
      ordered_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids
    };
    const previewDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload)).digest('hex');

    return {
      view_id: req.view_id,
      current_view_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision,
      proposed_new_revision: currentView.optimistic_revision + 1,
      restored_from_revision: targetHistory.optimistic_revision,
      restored_from_history_id: targetHistory.history_id,
      can_restore: true,
      reason_code: 'ready',
      reason_ru: 'Историческая выборка полностью верифицирована и готова к восстановлению как новой редакции',
      proposed_title: proposedTitle,
      proposed_notes: proposedNotes,
      slots_to_restore: preview.selected_slots,
      slots_retained_from_current: slotsRetained,
      slots_removed_from_current: slotsRemoved,
      ordered_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      distinct_plans_count: preview.distinct_plans_count,
      eligible_independent_peer_count: preview.eligible_independent_peer_count,
      per_metric_comparability: preview.per_metric_comparability,
      overall_readiness: preview.overall_readiness,
      blockers: [],
      warnings: preview.warnings,
      limitations: preview.limitations,
      preview_digest: previewDigest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Atomically commits restoration of a historical revision as a new monotonically increasing revision.
   * Single SQLite transaction encompasses:
   * 1. CAS update of saved_longitudinal_views (checks expected_current_revision)
   * 2. Inserting history record with change_type: 'revision_restored'
   * 3. Updating slot backlinks (attaching restored slots, detaching unlinked slots)
   * 4. Recording audit history on all touched plans
   * 5. Durable payload-bound idempotency receipt caching INSIDE the single transaction
   */
  public commitCrossPlanReviewRestore(
    profileId: string,
    req: CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreRequest
  ): CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreResponse {
    if (!profileId) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор профиля обязателен');
    }
    if (req.profile_id && req.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CheckInCrossProfileError('Запрос к фиксации восстановления чужого профиля запрещен');
    }
    if (!req.view_id) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Идентификатор представления обзора обязателен');
    }
    if (typeof req.target_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Целевая восстанавливаемая ревизия обязательна');
    }
    if (typeof req.expected_current_revision !== 'number') {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Ожидаемая текущая ревизия обязательна');
    }
    if (!req.preview_digest) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра обязателен');
    }

    const normalizedPayload = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      view_id: req.view_id,
      target_revision: req.target_revision,
      target_history_id: req.target_history_id || null,
      expected_current_revision: req.expected_current_revision,
      title_policy: req.title_policy || 'keep_current',
      custom_title: req.custom_title ? req.custom_title.trim() : null,
      notes_policy: req.notes_policy || 'keep_current',
      custom_notes: req.custom_notes ? req.custom_notes.trim() : null,
      preview_digest: req.preview_digest
    };

    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      const cached = getCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key);
      const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
      if (cached) {
        if (cached.requestHash !== reqHash) {
          throw new CheckInConflictError('Ключ идемпотентности уже использован с другими параметрами запроса');
        }
        return cached.response;
      }
    }

    // Run authoritative restore preview
    const preview = this.previewCrossPlanReviewRestore(profileId, {
      profile_id: profileId,
      view_id: req.view_id,
      target_revision: req.target_revision,
      target_history_id: req.target_history_id,
      expected_current_revision: req.expected_current_revision,
      title_policy: req.title_policy,
      custom_title: req.custom_title,
      notes_policy: req.notes_policy,
      custom_notes: req.custom_notes
    });

    if (!preview.can_restore) {
      throw new CheckInUnprocessableEntityError(
        `Восстановление невозможно: ${preview.blockers.join('; ')}`,
        preview.reason_code
      );
    }

    if (req.preview_digest !== preview.preview_digest) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError('Контрольный дайджест предпросмотра восстановления устарел или не совпадает с актуальным состоянием');
    }

    const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(req.view_id);
    if (!currentView) {
      throw new CheckInPlanNotFoundError('Представление обзора не найдено');
    }
    if (currentView.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_current_revision) {
      throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт ревизии представления обзора: ожидалась ${req.expected_current_revision}, актуальная ${currentView.optimistic_revision}`);
    }

    const nextRevision = currentView.optimistic_revision + 1;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    const crossPlanProvenance: CrossPlanObservationProvenance[] = preview.slots_to_restore.map(s => ({
      plan_id: s.plan_id,
      plan_title: s.plan_title,
      slot_id: s.slot_id,
      slot_date: s.slot_date,
      effective_date: s.effective_date,
      slot_index: s.slot_index,
      session_id: s.session_id,
      window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
      window_revision: s.window_revision
    }));

    const windowReferences: Array<{ session_id: string; window_root_id: string; window_revision: number; slot_date?: string; slot_index?: number }> = [];
    for (const s of preview.slots_to_restore) {
      if (s.window_root_id && s.window_revision !== null) {
        windowReferences.push({
          session_id: s.session_id,
          window_root_id: s.window_root_id,
          window_revision: s.window_revision,
          slot_date: s.slot_date,
          slot_index: s.slot_index
        });
      }
    }

    const targetSessionId = preview.slots_to_restore[preview.slots_to_restore.length - 1].session_id;
    const metricKeys = Object.keys(preview.per_metric_comparability);
    const metricSet = (metricKeys.length > 0 ? metricKeys : currentView.metrics) as ('avg_hr' | 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'mean_rr' | 'dfa_alpha1' | 'recovery_1min')[];

    const wordingTitle = validateCheckInWording(preview.proposed_title);
    if (!wordingTitle.valid) {
      throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingTitle.violation!);
    }
    if (preview.proposed_notes) {
      const wordingNotes = validateCheckInWording(preview.proposed_notes);
      if (!wordingNotes.valid) {
        throw new CheckInValidationError(wordingNotes.violation!);
      }
    }

    const normalizedQuery: LongitudinalSeriesQuery = {
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      target_session_id: targetSessionId,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      metric_set: metricSet,
      user_notes: preview.proposed_notes || `Восстановлено: ревизия ${nextRevision} (из ревизии #${preview.restored_from_revision})`
    };
    (normalizedQuery as any).title = preview.proposed_title;

    const updatedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
      ...currentView,
      name: preview.proposed_title,
      user_notes: preview.proposed_notes || undefined,
      normalized_query: normalizedQuery,
      metrics: metricSet,
      selected_session_ids: preview.ordered_session_ids,
      window_references: windowReferences.length > 0 ? windowReferences : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: crossPlanProvenance,
      optimistic_revision: nextRevision,
      updated_at_utc: nowUtc
    };

    let result: CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreResponse;

    const db = getDb();
    const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. CAS update saved_longitudinal_views
      const viewRes = db.prepare(`
        UPDATE saved_longitudinal_views
        SET name = ?, normalized_query_json = ?, metrics_json = ?,
            display_preferences_json = ?, current_snapshot_id = ?,
            optimistic_revision = ?, is_retired = ?,
            selected_session_ids_json = ?, window_references_json = ?, user_notes = ?,
            updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
      `).run(
        updatedView.name,
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.normalized_query),
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.metrics),
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.display_preferences),
        updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
        updatedView.optimistic_revision,
        updatedView.is_retired ? 1 : 0,
        updatedView.selected_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.selected_session_ids) : null,
        updatedView.window_references ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.window_references) : null,
        updatedView.user_notes ?? null,
        updatedView.updated_at_utc,
        req.view_id,
        req.expected_current_revision
      );

      if (viewRes.changes === 0) {
        throw new CheckInConflictError('Конфликт параллельного обновления: ревизия представления изменилась');
      }

      // 2. Insert into saved_longitudinal_view_history with change_type: 'revision_restored'
      const newHistoryId = `hist-restore-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
          history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
          change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        newHistoryId,
        req.view_id,
        nextRevision,
        updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
        'revision_restored',
        JSON.stringify(updatedView.normalized_query),
        nowUtc
      );

      // 3. Backlink newly attached slots
      for (const sel of preview.slots_to_restore) {
        const ent = getCheckInEntry(sel.slot_id);
        if (ent) {
          const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
          ent.saved_view_id = req.view_id;
          ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
          ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
          const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
          if (!success) {
            throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
          }
        }
      }

      // 4. Clear backlinks on slots removed from current view
      for (const slotId of preview.slots_removed_from_current) {
        const ent = getCheckInEntry(slotId);
        if (ent && ent.saved_view_id === req.view_id) {
          const prevRev = ent.optimistic_revision;
          ent.saved_view_id = null;
          ent.optimistic_revision += 1;
          ent.updated_at_utc = nowUtc;
          const success = updateCheckInEntryWithCas(prevRev, ent);
          if (!success) {
            throw new CheckInConflictError(`Конфликт параллельного обновления слота ${ent.id}`);
          }
        }
      }

      // 5. Record history on touched plans
      const touchedPlanIds = Array.from(new Set(preview.slots_to_restore.map(s => s.plan_id)));
      for (const pId of touchedPlanIds) {
        const plan = getCheckInPlan(pId);
        const planRev = plan ? plan.optimistic_revision : 1;
        recordCheckInHistory(pId, null, 'cross_plan_progress_review_restored', planRev, {
          view_id: req.view_id,
          new_revision: nextRevision,
          restored_from_revision: preview.restored_from_revision,
          restored_from_history_id: preview.restored_from_history_id,
          total_slots: preview.slots_to_restore.length
        });
      }

      result = {
        success: true,
        view: updatedView,
        restored_from_revision: preview.restored_from_revision,
        restored_from_history_id: preview.restored_from_history_id,
        new_revision: nextRevision
      };

      // 6. Save payload-bound idempotency receipt INSIDE the single atomic SQLite transaction
      if (req.idempotency_key) {
        const reqHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalizedPayload)).digest('hex');
        saveCheckInIdempotency(req.idempotency_key, reqHash, result);
      }
    });
    runTx();

    return result!;
  }


  private reconcileEntryState(entry: AthleteCheckInEntry): void {
    if (!entry.session_id) {
      entry.eligibility_state = 'not_recorded';
      return;
    }

    const session = getSession(entry.session_id);
    if (!session) {
      entry.eligibility_state = 'source_unavailable';
      entry.quality_explanation_ru = 'Исходная запись была удалена или недоступна';
      return;
    }

    // Check window revision if window was linked
    if (entry.window_root_id) {
      const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(entry.session_id);
      const w = windows.find((item: any) =>
        item.id === entry.window_root_id ||
        item.root_window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
        item.window_id === entry.window_root_id ||
        item.root_id === entry.window_root_id
      );
      if (!w || (entry.window_revision !== null && w.revision !== entry.window_revision)) {
        entry.eligibility_state = 'stale';
        entry.quality_explanation_ru = 'Ревизия Named Window изменилась; слот требует повторного подтверждения';
        return;
      }
    }

    if (session.overall_quality_score < 60) {
      entry.eligibility_state = 'recorded_quality_limited';
      entry.quality_explanation_ru = `Качество записи снижено (${Math.round(session.overall_quality_score)}%)`;
    } else {
      entry.eligibility_state = 'usable_current';
      entry.quality_explanation_ru = 'Данные пригодны для контрольного сравнения';
    }
  }

  private buildProjection(plan: AthleteCheckInPlan, entries: AthleteCheckInEntry[]): CheckInPlanProjection {
    const totalSlots = entries.length;
    const recordedSlots = entries.filter((e) => e.session_id !== null).length;
    const usableSlots = entries.filter((e) => e.eligibility_state === 'usable_current').length;
    const skippedSlots = entries.filter((e) => e.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user').length;
    const rescheduledSlots = entries.filter((e) => e.schedule_decision === 'rescheduled').length;
    const nextPending = entries.find((e) => e.session_id === null && !e.is_superseded && e.schedule_decision !== 'skipped_by_user') || null;

    const segments = listCheckInScheduleSegments(plan.id);

    return {
      plan,
      entries,
      next_pending_slot: nextPending,
      schedule_segments: segments,
      current_schedule_version: plan.schedule_version || 1,
      total_slots: totalSlots,
      recorded_slots: recordedSlots,
      usable_slots: usableSlots,
      skipped_slots: skippedSlots,
      rescheduled_slots: rescheduledSlots
    };
  }
}

export const athleteCheckInService = new AthleteCheckInService();

import { DatabaseSync as NodeDatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import * as fs from 'fs';

export class DatabaseSync extends NodeDatabaseSync {
  transaction<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: T): T {
    return ((...args: any[]) => {
      this.exec('BEGIN');
      try {
        const result = fn(...args);
        this.exec('COMMIT');
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        this.exec('ROLLBACK');
        throw err;
      }
    }) as T;
  }

  backup(destination: string, options?: any): void {
    if (fs.existsSync(destination)) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(destination); } catch (_) {}
    }
    try {
      // 1. Perform consistent snapshot backup using VACUUM INTO (or serialize if available)
      if (typeof (this as any).serialize === 'function') {
        const data = (this as any).serialize();
        fs.writeFileSync(destination, data);
      } else {
        const escaped = destination.replace(/'/g, "''");
        this.exec(`VACUUM INTO '${escaped}';`);
      }
      
      // 2. Open temporary connection to verify backup integrity
      const tempDb = new NodeDatabaseSync(destination);
      try {
        const check = tempDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as { integrity_check: string };
        if (!check || check.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
          throw new Error(`Backup database integrity check failed: ${check ? check.integrity_check : 'unknown'}`);
        }
      } finally {
        tempDb.close();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (fs.existsSync(destination)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(destination); } catch (_) {}
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export function getLiveElectronUserDataDir(): string {
  try {
    const { app } = require('electron');
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      return app.getPath('userData');
    }
  } catch {}

  const roaming = process.env.APPDATA || (process.env.USERPROFILE ? path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE, 'AppData', 'Roaming') : '');
  const candidateRoaming = path.join(roaming, 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab');
  if (fs.existsSync(candidateRoaming)) {
    return candidateRoaming;
  }

  const localAppData = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || (process.env.USERPROFILE ? path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE, 'AppData', 'Local') : '');
  return path.join(localAppData, 'H10AthleteCardioLab');
}

export function getAppDataDir(): string {
  if (process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR && process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR.trim().length > 0) {
    const custom = path.resolve(process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR.trim());
    if (!fs.existsSync(custom)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(custom, { recursive: true });
    }
    return custom;
  }

  try {
    const { app } = require('electron');
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      return app.getPath('userData');
    }
  } catch {}

  // If LOCALAPPDATA is explicitly configured (e.g. by test sandboxes), prefer it
  if (process.env.LOCALAPPDATA) {
    const appDir = path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA, 'H10AthleteCardioLab');
    if (!fs.existsSync(appDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(appDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    return appDir;
  }

  const roaming = process.env.APPDATA || (process.env.USERPROFILE ? path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE, 'AppData', 'Roaming') : '');
  const candidateRoaming = path.join(roaming, 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab');
  if (fs.existsSync(candidateRoaming)) {
    return candidateRoaming;
  }

  const localAppData = path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE || '', 'AppData', 'Local');
  const appDir = path.join(localAppData, 'H10AthleteCardioLab');
  if (!fs.existsSync(appDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(appDir, { recursive: true });
  }
  return appDir;
}

export function getLegacyAppDataDir(): string {
  if (process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR && process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR.trim().length > 0) {
    return path.join(path.dirname(process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR.trim()), 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab');
  }
  const localAppData = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE || '', 'AppData', 'Local');
  return path.join(localAppData, 'H10AthleteCardioLab');
}
