export function initDb(dbPath?: string): DatabaseSync {
  let actualPath = dbPath;
  let isElectron = false;
  try {
    const { app } = require('electron');
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      isElectron = true;
    }
  } catch {}

  if (!actualPath) {
    actualPath = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'cardio_lab.db');
  }

  if (dbInstance) {
    if (activeDbPath === actualPath) {
      return dbInstance;
    }
    closeDb();
  }

  activeDbPath = actualPath;

  // Legacy data migration block (skipped in isolated test sandboxes)
  if (isElectron && actualPath !== ':memory:' && !fs.existsSync(actualPath) && !process.env.CARDIOLAB_USER_DATA_DIR) {
    const legacyDir = getLegacyAppDataDir();
    const legacyDbPath = path.join(legacyDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
    if (fs.existsSync(legacyDbPath)) {
      const targetDir = path.dirname(actualPath);
      if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
      }

      logger.info('sync', '[Migration] Legacy database detected. Migrating...');
      const legacyBackupPath = legacyDbPath + `.migration_bak_${Date.now()}`;
      try {
        fs.copyFileSync(legacyDbPath, legacyBackupPath);
        fs.copyFileSync(legacyDbPath, actualPath);

        const verifyDb = new DatabaseSync(actualPath);
        const integrity = verifyDb.prepare("PRAGMA integrity_check;").get() as { integrity_check: string } | undefined;
        verifyDb.close();

        if (integrity && integrity.integrity_check === 'ok') {
          logger.info('sync', '[Migration] Database integrity verified. Migration successful.');

          // Move raw logs too
          const legacyLogsDir = path.join(legacyDir, 'raw_logs');
          const newLogsDir = path.join(targetDir, 'raw_logs');
          if (fs.existsSync(legacyLogsDir)) {
            if (!fs.existsSync(newLogsDir)) {
              fs.mkdirSync(newLogsDir, { recursive: true });
            }
            const logFiles = fs.readdirSync(legacyLogsDir);
            for (const file of logFiles) {
              const srcFile = path.join(legacyLogsDir, file);
              const destFile = path.join(newLogsDir, file);
              if (!fs.existsSync(destFile)) {
                fs.copyFileSync(srcFile, destFile);
              }
            }
            logger.info('sync', '[Migration] Raw logs migrated.');
          }
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Integrity check failed: ${integrity?.integrity_check}`);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.error('sync', '[Migration] Failed legacy data migration', { details: { error: err.message } });
        if (fs.existsSync(actualPath)) {
          fs.unlinkSync(actualPath);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Ensure app directory exists if not in-memory
  if (actualPath !== ':memory:') {
    const dir = path.dirname(actualPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }

  const db = new DatabaseSync(actualPath);
  dbInstance = db;

  // Enable WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode for concurrent access performance
  db.exec("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;");

  // Initialize schemas
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingested_files (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      filename TEXT NOT NULL,
      sha256_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      signal_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      end_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      row_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
      logical_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'utc'))
    );
  `);

  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      end_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      duration_seconds REAL NOT NULL,
      avg_hr REAL,
      min_hr INTEGER,
      max_hr INTEGER,
      overall_quality_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'utc'))
    );
  `);

  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS session_signals (
      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (session_id, file_id),
      FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES ingested_files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
  `);

  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS session_bundle_provenance (
      session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      grouping_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
      grouping_confidence TEXT NOT NULL,
      grouping_evidence TEXT,
      user_grouping_corrections TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
  `);

  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS session_qc_metrics (
      session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      monotonicity_status TEXT NOT NULL,
      missing_samples_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      duplicate_timestamps_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      ecg_clipping_seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
      ecg_noise_ratio REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
      ecg_baseline_drift_ratio REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
      acc_motion_severity TEXT NOT NULL,
      ecg_rr_consistency REAL,
      ecg_rr_match_metrics_json TEXT,
      FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
  `);

  // Migration: Add ecg_rr_consistency if it is not present in an existing database
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE session_qc_metrics ADD COLUMN ecg_rr_consistency REAL;');
  } catch (err) {
    // Column already exists, ignore error
  }
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE session_qc_metrics ADD COLUMN ecg_rr_match_metrics_json TEXT;');
  } catch (err) {
    // Column already exists, ignore error
  }

  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS candidate_flags (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      timestamp_offset_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      flag_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      description_ru TEXT NOT NULL,
      severity TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
  `);

  // Check if we need to migrate the users table
  let needUsersMigration = false;
  try {
    db.prepare('SELECT display_name FROM users LIMIT 1').get();
  } catch (err) {
    needUsersMigration = true;
  }

  if (needUsersMigration) {
    try {
      db.exec('ALTER TABLE users RENAME TO users_old;');
      db.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE users (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
          export_alias TEXT NOT NULL,

          age INTEGER,
          resting_hr INTEGER,
          max_hr INTEGER,
          is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);
      const oldUser = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users_old WHERE id = ?').get('default') as any;
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      if (oldUser) {
        const insert = db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
        `);
        insert.run('default', 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)', 'Athlete', 'self', oldUser.age || 35, oldUser.resting_hr || 60, oldUser.max_hr || 185, oldUser.created_at || now, now);
      } else {
        const insert = db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
        `);
        insert.run('default', 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)', 'Athlete', 'self', 35, 60, 185, now, now);
      }
      db.exec('DROP TABLE users_old;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
          export_alias TEXT NOT NULL,
          relationship_label TEXT,
          age INTEGER,
          resting_hr INTEGER,
          max_hr INTEGER,
          custom_zones TEXT,
          custom_zones_updated_at TEXT,
          is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
      `);
      const exists = db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = 'default' LIMIT 1").get();
      if (!exists) {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const insert = db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
        `);
        insert.run('default', 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)', 'Athlete', 'self', 35, 60, 185, now, now);
      }
    }
  } else {
    db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        export_alias TEXT NOT NULL,
        relationship_label TEXT,
        age INTEGER,
        resting_hr INTEGER,
        max_hr INTEGER,
        custom_zones TEXT,
        custom_zones_updated_at TEXT,
        is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
    `);
    const exists = db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = 'default' LIMIT 1").get();
    if (!exists) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      const insert = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
      `);
      insert.run('default', 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)', 'Athlete', 'self', 35, 60, 185, now, now);
    }

    const missingMetrics = db.prepare(`

             m.recovery_1min, m.recovery_2min, m.hr_drift_ratio, m.time_in_zones,

      FROM session_metrics m
      INNER JOIN sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id
      LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON m.session_id = a.session_id
      WHERE m.canonical_observation_json IS NULL
    `).all() as any[];

    if (missingMetrics && missingMetrics.length > 0) {
      const updateStmt = db.prepare('UPDATE session_metrics SET canonical_observation_json = ? WHERE session_id = ?');

  try { db.exec('ALTER TABLE owner_decision_records ADD COLUMN envelope_json TEXT;'); } catch (_) {}
  try { db.exec('ALTER TABLE owner_decision_records ADD COLUMN key_id TEXT;'); } catch (_) {}
  try { db.exec('ALTER TABLE owner_decision_records ADD COLUMN trust_revision INTEGER DEFAULT 1;'); } catch (_) {}

  try {
    const existingOnboarding = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'onboarding_completed'").get() as { value: string } | undefined;
    if (!existingOnboarding) {
      const sessionCount = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM sessions").get() as { count: number } | undefined;
      if (sessionCount && sessionCount.count > 0) {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        db.prepare("INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('onboarding_completed', 'true', ?)").run(now);
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // =========================================================================
  // CardioLab G21 — Durable Intake, Import Queue & Source Relink Tables
  // =========================================================================
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS durable_import_jobs (
      job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
      idempotency_key TEXT,
      stage TEXT NOT NULL,
      stage_label_ru TEXT NOT NULL,
      progress_percent REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      total_bundles INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      completed_bundles INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      current_bundle_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      current_bundle_name TEXT,
      steps_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      results_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cancel_acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      is_retryable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      recovery_descriptor_json TEXT,
      error TEXT,
      revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      correlation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      command_json TEXT,
      started_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      completed_at_utc TEXT
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_durable_jobs_profile ON durable_import_jobs(profile_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_durable_jobs_fingerprint ON durable_import_jobs(request_fingerprint);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_durable_jobs_stage ON durable_import_jobs(stage);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS durable_import_idempotency (
      idempotency_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_durable_idemp_fingerprint ON durable_import_idempotency(request_fingerprint);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS durable_import_claims (
      claim_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_import_claims_job ON durable_import_claims(job_id);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_relink_records (
      decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      relink_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
      original_path TEXT,
      current_path TEXT,
      affected_session_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      lineage_action TEXT NOT NULL,
      notes_ru TEXT NOT NULL,
      notes_en TEXT NOT NULL,
      idempotency_key TEXT,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_relink_sha ON source_relink_records(source_sha256);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bundle_grouping_revisions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      bundle_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      grouping_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      immutable_source_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
      user_corrections_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grouping_rev_bundle ON bundle_grouping_revisions(bundle_id, grouping_revision);

    -- =========================================================================
    -- CardioLab — Athlete Check-in Ledger Tables (A02-A06)
    -- =========================================================================
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_plans (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT,
      cadence TEXT NOT NULL,
      timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
      activity_type TEXT,
      metric_keys_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      optimistic_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_plans_profile ON athlete_checkin_plans(profile_id, status);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_entries (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      slot_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      slot_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
      effective_date TEXT,
      schedule_decision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
      schedule_notes TEXT,
      schedule_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      session_id TEXT,
      window_root_id TEXT,
      window_revision INTEGER,
      saved_view_id TEXT,
      eligibility_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_recorded',
      quality_score REAL,
      quality_explanation_ru TEXT,
      user_notes TEXT,
      is_retired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      optimistic_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES athlete_checkin_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_entries_plan ON athlete_checkin_entries(plan_id, slot_index);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_entries_session ON athlete_checkin_entries(session_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_entries_profile ON athlete_checkin_entries(profile_id);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_history (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      entry_id TEXT,
      change_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      optimistic_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_history_plan ON athlete_checkin_history(plan_id);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_idempotency (
      idempotency_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_intake_intents (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
      staged_preflight_id TEXT,
      request_fingerprint TEXT,
      imported_session_id TEXT,
      candidate_quality_score REAL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES athlete_checkin_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES athlete_checkin_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_intent_entry ON athlete_checkin_intake_intents(entry_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_intent_plan ON athlete_checkin_intake_intents(plan_id);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS athlete_checkin_schedule_segments (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      version_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
      cadence TEXT NOT NULL,
      timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
      effective_from_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      anchor_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      manual_dates_json TEXT,
      created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES athlete_checkin_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_segments_plan ON athlete_checkin_schedule_segments(plan_id, version_index);
  `);

  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_plans ADD COLUMN schedule_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN schedule_segment_id TEXT;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN is_superseded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_entries_superseded ON athlete_checkin_entries(plan_id, is_superseded);');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN effective_date TEXT;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec("ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN schedule_decision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled';");
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN schedule_notes TEXT;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE athlete_checkin_entries ADD COLUMN schedule_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('UPDATE athlete_checkin_entries SET effective_date = slot_date WHERE effective_date IS NULL;');
  } catch (_) {}
  try {
    db.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chk_entries_effective ON athlete_checkin_entries(plan_id, effective_date);');
  } catch (_) {}

  try {
    db.exec('ALTER TABLE durable_import_jobs ADD COLUMN command_json TEXT;');
  } catch (_) {}

  try {
    const { reconcileDurableImportJobsOnStartup } = require('../ingestion/guidedImportJob');
    reconcileDurableImportJobsOnStartup();
  } catch (_) {}

  return db;
}

export function closeDb(): void {
  if (dbInstance) {
    try {
      dbInstance.close();
    } catch {}
    dbInstance = null;
    activeDbPath = null;
  }
}

export function getDb(): DatabaseSync {
  if (!dbInstance) {
    return initDb();
  }
  return dbInstance;
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// G21: Durable Import Jobs & Queue CRUD
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function saveDurableImportJob(job: DurableImportJobSnapshot & { command?: any; command_json?: string }): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const commandJson = job.command ? JSON.stringify(job.command) : (job.command_json || null);
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO durable_import_jobs (
      job_id, profile_id, plan_id, request_fingerprint, idempotency_key,
      stage, stage_label_ru, progress_percent, total_bundles, completed_bundles,
      current_bundle_index, current_bundle_name, steps_json, results_json,
      cancel_requested, cancel_acknowledged, is_retryable, recovery_descriptor_json,
      error, revision, correlation_id, command_json, started_at_utc, updated_at_utc, completed_at_utc
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
    )
    ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET
      stage = excluded.stage,
      stage_label_ru = excluded.stage_label_ru,
      progress_percent = excluded.progress_percent,
      completed_bundles = excluded.completed_bundles,
      current_bundle_index = excluded.current_bundle_index,
      current_bundle_name = excluded.current_bundle_name,
      steps_json = excluded.steps_json,
      results_json = excluded.results_json,
      cancel_requested = excluded.cancel_requested,
      cancel_acknowledged = excluded.cancel_acknowledged,
      is_retryable = excluded.is_retryable,
      recovery_descriptor_json = excluded.recovery_descriptor_json,
      error = excluded.error,
      revision = excluded.revision,
      command_json = coalesce(excluded.command_json, durable_import_jobs.command_json),
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc,
      completed_at_utc = excluded.completed_at_utc
  `);

  stmt.run(
    job.job_id,
    job.profile_id,
    job.plan_id,
    job.request_fingerprint,
    job.idempotency_key ?? null,
    job.stage,
    job.stage_label_ru,
    job.progress_percent,
    job.total_bundles,
    job.completed_bundles,
    job.current_bundle_index,
    job.current_bundle_name ?? null,
    JSON.stringify(job.steps || []),
    JSON.stringify(job.results || []),
    job.cancel_requested ? 1 : 0,
    job.cancel_acknowledged ? 1 : 0,
    job.is_retryable ? 1 : 0,
    job.recovery_descriptor ? JSON.stringify(job.recovery_descriptor) : null,
    job.error ?? null,
    job.revision || 1,
    job.correlation_id,
    commandJson,
    job.started_at_utc,
    job.updated_at_utc,
    job.completed_at_utc ?? null
  );
}

export function getDurableImportJob(jobId: string): (DurableImportJobSnapshot & { command?: any; command_json?: string }) | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs WHERE job_id = ?').get(jobId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;

  let commandObj: any = undefined;
  if (row.command_json) {
    try { commandObj = JSON.parse(row.command_json); } catch (_) {}
  }

  return {
    schema_version: SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    job_id: row.job_id,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    request_fingerprint: row.request_fingerprint,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key ?? undefined,
    stage: row.stage as any,
    stage_label_ru: row.stage_label_ru,
    progress_percent: row.progress_percent,
    total_bundles: row.total_bundles,
    completed_bundles: row.completed_bundles,
    current_bundle_index: row.current_bundle_index,
    current_bundle_name: row.current_bundle_name ?? undefined,
    steps: row.steps_json ? JSON.parse(row.steps_json) : [],
    results: row.results_json ? JSON.parse(row.results_json) : [],
    cancel_requested: Boolean(row.cancel_requested),
    cancel_acknowledged: Boolean(row.cancel_acknowledged),
    is_retryable: Boolean(row.is_retryable),
    recovery_descriptor: row.recovery_descriptor_json ? JSON.parse(row.recovery_descriptor_json) : null,
    recovery_descriptor_json: row.recovery_descriptor_json ?? undefined,
    error: row.error ?? undefined,
    revision: row.revision,
    correlation_id: row.correlation_id,
    command_json: row.command_json ?? undefined,
    command: commandObj,
    target_episode_id: commandObj?.target_episode_id || (row.recovery_descriptor_json ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(row.recovery_descriptor_json).target_episode_id; } catch (_) { return null; } })() : null) || null,
    started_at_utc: row.started_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc,
    completed_at_utc: row.completed_at_utc ?? undefined
  };
}

export function listDurableImportJobs(limit = 50): DurableImportJobSnapshot[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC LIMIT ?').all(limit) as any[];
  return rows.map(row => ({
    schema_version: SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    job_id: row.job_id,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    request_fingerprint: row.request_fingerprint,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key ?? undefined,
    stage: row.stage as any,
    stage_label_ru: row.stage_label_ru,
    progress_percent: row.progress_percent,
    total_bundles: row.total_bundles,
    completed_bundles: row.completed_bundles,
    current_bundle_index: row.current_bundle_index,
    current_bundle_name: row.current_bundle_name ?? undefined,
    steps: row.steps_json ? JSON.parse(row.steps_json) : [],
    results: row.results_json ? JSON.parse(row.results_json) : [],
    cancel_requested: Boolean(row.cancel_requested),
    cancel_acknowledged: Boolean(row.cancel_acknowledged),
    is_retryable: Boolean(row.is_retryable),
    recovery_descriptor: row.recovery_descriptor_json ? JSON.parse(row.recovery_descriptor_json) : null,
    error: row.error ?? undefined,
    revision: row.revision,
    correlation_id: row.correlation_id,
    started_at_utc: row.started_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc,
    completed_at_utc: row.completed_at_utc ?? undefined
  }));
}

export function updateDurableImportJobStage(
  jobId: string,
  stage: string,
  stageLabelRu: string,
  progressPercent: number
): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE durable_import_jobs
    SET stage = ?, stage_label_ru = ?, progress_percent = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ?
  `).run(stage, stageLabelRu, progressPercent, now, jobId);
}

export function requestDurableImportJobCancellation(jobId: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const job = getDurableImportJob(jobId);
  if (!job) return false;
  if (['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(job.stage)) {
    return false;
  }
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE durable_import_jobs
    SET cancel_requested = 1, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ?
  `).run(now, jobId);
  return true;
}

export function acknowledgeDurableImportJobCancellation(jobId: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE durable_import_jobs
    SET cancel_acknowledged = 1, stage = 'cancelled', stage_label_ru = 'Импорт отменен пользователем',
        updated_at_utc = ?, completed_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ?
  `).run(now, now, jobId);
}

export function claimDurableImportJob(jobId: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE durable_import_jobs
    SET stage = 'revalidating_sources', updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ? AND stage = 'queued'
  `).run(now, jobId);
  return (res as any)?.changes > 0;
}

export function recoverDurableImportJobsOnStartup(): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const inProgressStages = [
    'revalidating_sources',
    'hashing',
    'storing_sources',
    'creating_session',
    'running_qc',
    'building_canonical_result'
  ];
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Any job interrupted mid-stage during unexpected backend stop is marked for recovery
  for (const st of inProgressStages) {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE durable_import_jobs
      SET stage = 'partial_failure',
          stage_label_ru = 'Задача прервана перезапуском бэкенда (доступно возобновление)',
          updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE stage = ?
    `).run(now, st);
  }
}

export function saveDurableImportIdempotency(params: {
  idempotency_key: string;
  request_fingerprint: string;
  payload_hash: string;
  job_id: string;
  result: any;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO durable_import_idempotency (
      idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, payload_hash, job_id, result_json, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    params.idempotency_key,
    params.request_fingerprint,
    params.payload_hash,
    params.job_id,
    JSON.stringify(params.result),
    now,
    now
  );
}

export function getDurableImportIdempotency(key: string): {
  idempotency_key: string;
  request_fingerprint: string;
  payload_hash: string;
  job_id: string;
  result: any;
} | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(key) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint: row.request_fingerprint,
    payload_hash: row.payload_hash,
    job_id: row.job_id,
    result: JSON.parse(row.result_json)
  };
}

export function saveSourceRelinkRecord(decision: SourceRelinkDecision): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO source_relink_records (
      decision_id, relink_type, source_sha256, original_path, current_path,
      affected_session_ids_json, lineage_action, notes_ru, notes_en, idempotency_key, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    decision.decision_id,
    decision.relink_type,
    decision.source_sha256,
    decision.original_path ?? null,
    decision.current_path ?? null,
    JSON.stringify(decision.affected_session_ids || []),
    decision.lineage_action,
    decision.notes_ru,
    decision.notes_en,
    decision.idempotency_key ?? null,
    decision.timestamp_utc
  );
}

    relink_type: row.relink_type,
    source_sha256: row.source_sha256,
    original_path: row.original_path ?? undefined,
    current_path: row.current_path ?? undefined,
    affected_session_ids: JSON.parse(row.affected_session_ids_json || '[]'),
    lineage_action: row.lineage_action,
    notes_ru: row.notes_ru,
    notes_en: row.notes_en,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key ?? undefined,
    timestamp_utc: row.created_at_utc
  };
}

    original_path: row.original_path ?? undefined,
    current_path: row.current_path ?? undefined,
    affected_session_ids: JSON.parse(row.affected_session_ids_json || '[]'),
    lineage_action: row.lineage_action,
    notes_ru: row.notes_ru,
    notes_en: row.notes_en,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key ?? undefined,
    timestamp_utc: row.created_at_utc
  };
}

    original_path: row.original_path ?? undefined,
    current_path: row.current_path ?? undefined,
    affected_session_ids: JSON.parse(row.affected_session_ids_json || '[]'),
    lineage_action: row.lineage_action,
    notes_ru: row.notes_ru,
    notes_en: row.notes_en,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key ?? undefined,
    timestamp_utc: row.created_at_utc
  }));

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function saveGroupingRevision(params: {
  bundle_id: string;
  grouping_revision: number;
  immutable_source_identity: string;
  user_corrections: any[];
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const id = `rev-${params.bundle_id}-${params.grouping_revision}`;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO bundle_grouping_revisions (
      id, bundle_id, grouping_revision, immutable_source_identity, user_corrections_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    id,
    params.bundle_id,
    params.grouping_revision,
    params.immutable_source_identity,
    JSON.stringify(params.user_corrections || []),
    now
  );
}

export function getGroupingRevision(bundleId: string, revision?: number): {
  bundle_id: string;
  grouping_revision: number;
  immutable_source_identity: string;
  user_corrections: any[];
} | null {
  const db = getDb();
  let row: any;
  if (revision !== undefined) {
    row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM bundle_grouping_revisions WHERE bundle_id = ? AND grouping_revision = ?').get(bundleId, revision) as any;
  } else {
    row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM bundle_grouping_revisions WHERE bundle_id = ? ORDER BY grouping_revision DESC LIMIT 1').get(bundleId) as any;
  }
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    bundle_id: row.bundle_id,
    grouping_revision: row.grouping_revision,
    immutable_source_identity: row.immutable_source_identity,
    user_corrections: JSON.parse(row.user_corrections_json || '[]')
  };
}

}

    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM session_signals)
      AND logical_fingerprint NOT IN (SELECT logical_fingerprint FROM ignored_source_fingerprints WHERE logical_fingerprint IS NOT NULL)

  `);

export function saveSession(session: SessionMetadata): void {
  const db = getDb();
  
  // Check if session exists to avoid INSERT OR REPLACE cascade deletions
  const exists = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1').get(session.id);
  if (exists) {
    const current = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
    
    const active = (session.active_duration_seconds !== undefined ? session.active_duration_seconds : (current ? current.active_duration_seconds : null)) ?? null;
    const inactive = (session.inactive_duration_seconds !== undefined ? session.inactive_duration_seconds : (current ? current.inactive_duration_seconds : null)) ?? null;
    const uncertain = (session.uncertain_duration_seconds !== undefined ? session.uncertain_duration_seconds : (current ? current.uncertain_duration_seconds : null)) ?? null;
    const segJson = (session.activity_segmentation_json !== undefined ? session.activity_segmentation_json : (current ? current.activity_segmentation_json : null)) ?? null;
    const segVersion = (session.activity_segmentation_version !== undefined ? session.activity_segmentation_version : (current ? current.activity_segmentation_version : 'needs_reanalysis')) ?? 'needs_reanalysis';
    const segStatus = (session.activity_segmentation_status !== undefined ? session.activity_segmentation_status : (current ? current.activity_segmentation_status : 'needs_reanalysis')) ?? 'needs_reanalysis';

    const admissionJson = (session.admission_json !== undefined ? session.admission_json : (current ? current.admission_json : null)) ?? null;
    const sourceSha = (session.source_sha256 !== undefined ? session.source_sha256 : (current ? current.source_sha256 : null)) ?? null;

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE sessions SET
        device_id = ?,
        start_time = ?,
        end_time = ?,
        duration_seconds = ?,
        avg_hr = ?,
        min_hr = ?,
        max_hr = ?,
        overall_quality_score = ?,
        user_id = ?,
        assignment_status = ?,
        active_duration_seconds = ?,
        inactive_duration_seconds = ?,
        uncertain_duration_seconds = ?,
        activity_segmentation_json = ?,
        activity_segmentation_version = ?,
        activity_segmentation_status = ?,
        source_sha256 = ?,
        admission_json = ?
      WHERE id = ?
    `);
    stmt.run(
      session.device_id,
      session.start_time,
      session.end_time ?? session.start_time ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      session.duration_seconds ?? 0,
      session.avg_hr ?? null,
      session.min_hr ?? null,
      session.max_hr ?? null,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? 0.0,
      (session.user_id !== undefined ? session.user_id : (current ? current.user_id : 'default')) ?? 'default',
      (session.assignment_status !== undefined ? session.assignment_status : (current ? current.assignment_status : 'unassigned')) ?? 'unassigned',
      active,
      inactive,
      uncertain,
      segJson,
      segVersion,
      segStatus,
      sourceSha,
      admissionJson,
      session.id
    );
  } else {
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO sessions (
        id, device_id, start_time, end_time, duration_seconds, avg_hr, min_hr, max_hr, overall_quality_score, user_id, assignment_status,
        active_duration_seconds, inactive_duration_seconds, uncertain_duration_seconds, activity_segmentation_json, activity_segmentation_version, activity_segmentation_status,
        source_sha256, admission_json
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?
      )
    `);
    stmt.run(
      session.id,
      session.device_id,
      session.start_time,
      session.end_time ?? session.start_time ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      session.duration_seconds,
      session.avg_hr ?? null,
      session.min_hr ?? null,
      session.max_hr ?? null,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? 0.0,
      session.user_id !== undefined ? session.user_id : 'default',
      session.assignment_status !== undefined ? session.assignment_status : 'unassigned',
      session.active_duration_seconds ?? null,
      session.inactive_duration_seconds ?? null,
      session.uncertain_duration_seconds ?? null,
      session.activity_segmentation_json ?? null,
      session.activity_segmentation_version ?? 'needs_reanalysis',
      session.activity_segmentation_status ?? 'needs_reanalysis',
      session.source_sha256 ?? null,
      session.admission_json ?? null
    );
  }

  try {
    const { entitlementService } = require('../entitlements/entitlementService');
    entitlementService.recordAcceptedSession(session.id, Boolean((session as any).is_sample));
  } catch (_) {}
}

export function saveCandidateFlags(flags: CandidateFlag[]): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO candidate_flags (
      id, session_id, timestamp_offset_ms, flag_type, description_ru, severity
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
    )
  `);
  for (const flag of flags) {
    const type = flag.flag_type;
    const desc = flag.description_ru.toLowerCase();
    if ((type === 'candidate_rr_outlier' || type === 'RR outlier') && (desc.includes('пропуск') || desc.includes('gap') || desc.includes('missing'))) {
      throw new Error("Forbid RR outliers labeled as data_gap");
    }
    if ((type === 'data_gap' || type === 'Actual missing data') && (desc.includes('outlier') || desc.includes('нетипичный') || desc.includes('выбивающийся'))) {
      throw new Error("Forbid RR outliers labeled as data_gap");
    }

    stmt.run(
      flag.id,
      flag.session_id,
      flag.timestamp_offset_ms,
      flag.flag_type,
      flag.description_ru,
      flag.severity
    );
  }
}

export function saveUser(user: UserPreferences): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO users (
      id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, custom_zones, custom_zones_updated_at, is_active, created_at, updated_at
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?
    )
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      age = excluded.age,
      resting_hr = excluded.resting_hr,
      max_hr = excluded.max_hr,
      custom_zones = excluded.custom_zones,
      custom_zones_updated_at = excluded.custom_zones_updated_at,

  `);
  stmt.run(
    user.id,
    user.id === 'default' ? 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)' : user.id,
    user.id === 'default' ? 'Athlete' : user.id,
    user.id === 'default' ? 'self' : 'other',
    user.age,
    user.resting_hr,
    user.max_hr,
    user.custom_zones ?? null,
    user.custom_zones_updated_at ?? null,
    user.created_at || now,
    now
  );
}

export function deleteUserProfile(id: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  if (id === 'default') return;
  
  const updateStmt = db.prepare("UPDATE sessions SET user_id = 'default', assignment_status = 'unassigned' WHERE user_id = ?");
  updateStmt.run(id);

  const stmt = db.prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?');
  stmt.run(id);
}

export function bulkAssignSessionsToUser(sessionIds: string[], userId: string | null, status: string = 'assigned'): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET user_id = ?, assignment_status = ? WHERE id = ?');
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    for (const id of sessionIds) {
      stmt.run(userId, status, id);
    }
    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
}

export function getSessionContext(sessionId: string): {
  session_id: string;
  user_id: string | null;
  activity_type: string;
  user_notes: string | null;
} | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
  if (!session) return null;

  const ann = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type, user_notes FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;

  return {
    session_id: sessionId,
    user_id: session.user_id || null,
    activity_type: ann?.activity_type ?? 'unknown',
    user_notes: ann?.user_notes ?? null
  };
}

export function saveSessionContext(
  sessionId: string,
  userId: string | null,
  activityType: string,
  userNotes: string | null | undefined,
  includeIgnored: boolean = false
): void {
  const db = getDb();

  // 1. Validate session existence
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
  if (!session) {
    throw new Error(`Session ${sessionId} not found`);
  }

  // 2. Validate ignored status if not includeIgnored
  if (!includeIgnored) {
    const isIgnored = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM ignored_sessions WHERE session_id = ? LIMIT 1').get(sessionId);
    if (isIgnored) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot modify ignored session ${sessionId}`);
    }
  }

  // 3. Validate user
  let normalizedUserId: string | null = null;
  if (userId && userId !== 'unassigned' && userId !== '') {
    const user = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(userId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new Error(`User ${userId} not found`);
    }
    normalizedUserId = userId;
  }

  // 4. Validate activity type
  const allowedActivities = ['unknown', 'cardio', 'sleep', 'mixed', 'resting_hrv', 'recovery', 'strength', 'other'];
  if (!allowedActivities.includes(activityType)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid activity type: ${activityType}`);
  }

  // 5. Validate user notes
  if (userNotes && userNotes.length > 2000) {
    throw new Error('User notes length must not exceed 2000 characters');
  }

  // 6. Execute inside transaction
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    // Update sessions table
    const assignmentStatus = normalizedUserId ? 'assigned' : 'unassigned';
    db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET user_id = ?, assignment_status = ? WHERE id = ?')
      .run(normalizedUserId, assignmentStatus, sessionId);

    // Upsert session_annotations
    const existingAnn = db.prepare('SELECT id, created_at FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    const annotationId = existingAnn ? existingAnn.id : `ann_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`;
    const createdAt = existingAnn ? existingAnn.created_at : new Date().toISOString();

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO session_annotations (id, session_id, user_id, activity_type, user_notes, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now', 'utc'))
      ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
        user_id = excluded.user_id,
        activity_type = excluded.activity_type,
        user_notes = COALESCE(excluded.user_notes, session_annotations.user_notes),
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
    `);
    stmt.run(annotationId, sessionId, normalizedUserId, activityType, userNotes !== undefined ? userNotes : null, createdAt);

    // Invalidate stale canonical observation and baseline cache upon metadata update
    db.prepare('UPDATE session_metrics SET canonical_observation_json = NULL WHERE session_id = ?')
      .run(sessionId);

    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
}

export function saveLlmPack(pack: LlmPackRecord): void {
  const db = getDb();
  let userId = pack.user_id;
  if (!userId && pack.session_id) {
    const s = getSession(pack.session_id);
    if (s?.user_id) userId = s.user_id;
  }
  if (!userId) userId = 'athlete_default';

  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO llm_packs (
      id, session_id, user_id, export_profile, filename, filepath, size_bytes, created_at, metadata_json
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
    )
  `);
  stmt.run(
    pack.id,
    pack.session_id,
    userId,
    pack.export_profile ?? 'standard',
    pack.filename ?? `${pack.id}.zip`,
    pack.filepath ?? '',
    pack.size_bytes ?? 0,
    pack.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    pack.metadata_json ?? null
  );
}

      window_id, lineage_state, window_revision, comparison_id, prompt_bytes_hash, artifact_state, request_fingerprint,

    ) VALUES (

      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
    )
  `);
  stmt.run(

    entry.prompt_name ?? null,
    entry.prompt_profile ?? null,
    entry.title ?? 'Analysis Diary Entry',
    entry.source_type ?? 'p4_ai_pack_v2',
    entry.source_filename ?? null,
    entry.source_ext ?? null,
    entry.content_hash_sha256 ?? 'unverified',
    entry.response_md ?? '',
    entry.response_text_plain ?? entry.response_md ?? '',
    entry.created_at ?? now,
    entry.imported_at ?? now,
    entry.updated_at ?? now,
    entry.is_favorite ? 1 : 0,
    entry.tags_json ?? null,
    entry.pack_snapshot_json ?? null,
    entry.window_id ?? null,
    entry.lineage_state ?? 'current',
    entry.window_revision ?? 1,
    entry.comparison_id ?? null,
    entry.prompt_bytes_hash ?? null,
    entry.artifact_state ?? 'current',
    entry.request_fingerprint ?? null,
    entry.original_response_md ?? entry.response_md ?? '',
    entry.is_retired ? 1 : 0,
    entry.retired_at_utc ?? null,
    entry.retire_reason ?? null,
    entry.optimistic_revision ?? 1
  );
}

export function recordProductEvent(eventName: string, data?: { userId?: string; sessionId?: string; [key: string]: any }): void {
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    const userId = data?.userId ?? null;
    const sessionId = data?.sessionId ?? null;
    const payloadJson = data ? JSON.stringify(data) : null;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO local_product_events (event_name, user_id, session_id, payload_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(eventName, userId, sessionId, payloadJson, now);
  } catch (e) {
    // Non-blocking local telemetry failure
  }
}

export function getProductEvents(limit: number = 100): LocalProductEvent[] {
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM local_product_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').all(limit) as any[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}


export function getLlmDiaries(filters: {
  userId?: string;
  sessionId?: string;
  activityType?: string;
  provider?: string;
  packId?: string;
  dateFrom?: string;
  dateTo?: string;
  search?: string;
  favoriteOnly?: boolean;
}): LlmDiaryRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  let query = `
    SELECT d.*, s.start_time, u.display_name, u.export_alias
    FROM llm_diary d
    JOIN users u ON d.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN sessions s ON d.session_id = s.id
    WHERE 1=1
  `;
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (filters.userId) {
    query += ` AND d.user_id = ?`;
    params.push(filters.userId);
  }
  if (filters.sessionId) {
    query += ` AND d.session_id = ?`;
    params.push(filters.sessionId);
  }
  if (filters.activityType) {
    query += ` AND d.activity_type = ?`;
    params.push(filters.activityType);
  }
  if (filters.provider) {
    query += ` AND d.provider = ?`;
    params.push(filters.provider);
  }
  if (filters.packId) {
    query += ` AND d.pack_id = ?`;
    params.push(filters.packId);
  }
  if (filters.dateFrom) {
    query += ` AND d.imported_at >= ?`;
    params.push(filters.dateFrom);
  }
  if (filters.dateTo) {
    query += ` AND d.imported_at <= ?`;
    params.push(filters.dateTo);
  }
  if (filters.favoriteOnly) {
    query += ` AND d.is_favorite = 1`;
  }
  if (filters.search) {
    query += ` AND (d.title LIKE ? OR d.response_text_plain LIKE ? OR d.tags_json LIKE ?)`;
    const term = `%${filters.search}%`;
    params.push(term, term, term);
  }

  query += ` ORDER BY d.imported_at DESC`;

  const rows = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
  return rows.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    is_favorite: r.is_favorite === 1
  }));
}

export function getLlmDiaryById(id: string): LlmDiaryRecord | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    SELECT d.*, s.start_time, u.display_name, u.export_alias
    FROM llm_diary d
    JOIN users u ON d.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN sessions s ON d.session_id = s.id
    WHERE d.id = ?
  `);
  const result = stmt.get(id) as any;
  if (!result) return null;
  return {
    ...result,
    is_favorite: result.is_favorite === 1
  };
}

export function deleteLlmDiary(id: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').run(id);
}

export function toggleLlmDiaryFavorite(id: string, favorite: boolean): void {
  const db = getDb();
  db.prepare('UPDATE llm_diary SET is_favorite = ? WHERE id = ?').run(favorite ? 1 : 0, id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// V1.1 Phase 2: Session Named Windows DAO (REC-007)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface SessionNamedWindowRecord {
  id: string;
  session_id: string;
  user_id: string | null;
  name: string;
  start_offset_seconds: number;
  end_offset_seconds: number;
  revision: number;
  root_window_id?: string;
  is_active?: number;
  retired_at?: string | null;
  result_identity?: string | null;
  metrics_json: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

export function saveNamedWindowRecord(window: SessionNamedWindowRecord): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const rootId = window.root_window_id || window.id;
  const isActive = window.is_active !== undefined ? window.is_active : 1;
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO session_named_windows (
      id, session_id, user_id, name, start_offset_seconds, end_offset_seconds, revision,
      root_window_id, is_active, retired_at, result_identity, metrics_json, created_at, updated_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    window.id,
    window.session_id,
    window.user_id || null,
    window.name,
    window.start_offset_seconds,
    window.end_offset_seconds,
    window.revision || 1,
    rootId,
    isActive,
    window.retired_at || null,
    window.result_identity || null,
    window.metrics_json || null,
    window.created_at,
    window.updated_at
  );
}

export function getNamedWindowsForSession(sessionId: string, includeRetired: boolean = false): SessionNamedWindowRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  if (includeRetired) {
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY start_offset_seconds ASC, revision ASC').all(sessionId) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord[];
  }
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE session_id = ? AND (is_active = 1 OR is_active IS NULL) ORDER BY start_offset_seconds ASC').all(sessionId) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord[];
}

export function getNamedWindowById(id: string, includeRetired: boolean = false): SessionNamedWindowRecord | null {
  const db = getDb();
  if (includeRetired) {
    let row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE id = ?').get(id) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord | undefined;
    if (row) return row;
    row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE root_window_id = ? ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1').get(id) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord | undefined;
    return row || null;
  }
  let row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE id = ? AND (is_active = 1 OR is_active IS NULL)').get(id) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord | undefined;
  if (row) return row;
  row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE root_window_id = ? AND (is_active = 1 OR is_active IS NULL) ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1').get(id) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord | undefined;
  return row || null;
}

export function getNamedWindowRevisionHistory(rootWindowId: string): SessionNamedWindowRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE id = ? OR root_window_id = ? ORDER BY revision ASC').all(rootWindowId, rootWindowId) as unknown as SessionNamedWindowRecord[];
}

export interface UpdateNamedWindowResult {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
  currentRevision?: number;
  newRecord?: SessionNamedWindowRecord;
}

export function updateNamedWindowRecord(
  id: string,
  updates: {
    name?: string;
    start_offset_seconds?: number;
    end_offset_seconds?: number;
    metrics_json?: string | null;
    result_identity?: string | null;
    updated_at?: string;
  },
  expectedRevision?: number
): UpdateNamedWindowResult {
  const db = getDb();
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    const current = getNamedWindowById(id);
    if (!current || (current.is_active !== undefined && current.is_active === 0)) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND' };
    }

    if (expectedRevision !== undefined && current.revision !== expectedRevision) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: 'CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT', 
        currentRevision: current.revision 
      };
    }

    const now = updates.updated_at || new Date().toISOString();
    const rootId = current.root_window_id || current.id;
    const newRevision = current.revision + 1;
    const newId = (updates as any).new_id || `win_${crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8) : Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    const newName = updates.name !== undefined ? updates.name : current.name;
    const newStart = updates.start_offset_seconds !== undefined ? updates.start_offset_seconds : current.start_offset_seconds;
    const newEnd = updates.end_offset_seconds !== undefined ? updates.end_offset_seconds : current.end_offset_seconds;
    let newMetrics = updates.metrics_json !== undefined ? updates.metrics_json : current.metrics_json;
    if (newMetrics) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(newMetrics);
        parsed.windowId = newId;
        newMetrics = JSON.stringify(parsed);
      } catch {}
    }
    const newResultIdentity = updates.result_identity !== undefined ? updates.result_identity : current.result_identity;

    // Logically retire the prior revision
    db.prepare('UPDATE session_named_windows SET is_active = 0, retired_at = ? WHERE id = ?').run(now, current.id);

    // Insert the new immutable revision
    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO session_named_windows (
        id, session_id, user_id, name, start_offset_seconds, end_offset_seconds, revision,
        root_window_id, is_active, retired_at, result_identity, metrics_json, created_at, updated_at
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    insertStmt.run(
      newId,
      current.session_id,
      current.user_id || null,
      newName,
      newStart,
      newEnd,
      newRevision,
      rootId,
      1,
      null,
      newResultIdentity || null,
      newMetrics,
      current.created_at,
      now
    );

    const newRecord: SessionNamedWindowRecord = {
      id: newId,
      session_id: current.session_id,
      user_id: current.user_id,
      name: newName,
      start_offset_seconds: newStart,
      end_offset_seconds: newEnd,
      revision: newRevision,
      root_window_id: rootId,
      is_active: 1,
      retired_at: null,
      result_identity: newResultIdentity || null,
      metrics_json: newMetrics,
      created_at: current.created_at,
      updated_at: now
    };

    db.exec('COMMIT;');
    return { success: true, newRecord };
  } catch (err) {
    try { db.exec('ROLLBACK;'); } catch {}
    throw err;
  }
}

export function deleteNamedWindowRecord(id: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  // Logical retirement: preserve history, mark active revision retired
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE session_named_windows
    SET is_active = 0, retired_at = ?
    WHERE (id = ? OR root_window_id = ?) AND (is_active = 1 OR is_active IS NULL)
  `).run(now, id, id);
  return res.changes > 0;
}


export interface IgnoredSessionRecord {
  id: string;
  session_id: string;
  reason?: string | null;
  ignored_at: string;
  ignored_by_user_id?: string | null;
  restore_possible: number;
}

export interface IgnoredFingerprintRecord {
  id: string;
  session_id?: string | null;
  raw_file_id?: string | null;
  file_hash_sha256?: string | null;
  logical_fingerprint?: string | null;
  device_id_redacted?: string | null;
  signal_type?: string | null;
  start_time?: string | null;
  end_time?: string | null;
  ignored_at: string;
  reason?: string | null;
}

export function ignoreSession(params: {
  sessionId: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  reason?: string;
  excludeFromFutureSync: boolean;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    // 1. Insert into ignored_sessions
    const ignoredSessionId = randomUUID();
    const insertSession = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO ignored_sessions (id, session_id, reason, ignored_at, ignored_by_user_id, restore_possible)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
    `);
    insertSession.run(ignoredSessionId, params.sessionId, params.reason ?? null, now, params.userId ?? null);

    // 2. Exclude source files if requested
    if (params.excludeFromFutureSync) {
      // Find all raw files linked to this session
      const stmt = db.prepare(`
        SELECT f.id as raw_file_id, f.sha256_hash, f.logical_fingerprint, f.device_id, f.signal_type, f.start_time, f.end_time
        FROM ingested_files f
        JOIN session_signals s ON f.id = s.file_id
        WHERE s.session_id = ?
      `);
      const files = stmt.all(params.sessionId) as any[];
      
      const insertFingerprint = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO ignored_source_fingerprints (
          id, session_id, raw_file_id, file_hash_sha256, logical_fingerprint, device_id_redacted, signal_type, start_time, end_time, ignored_at, reason
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);
      
      for (const file of files) {
        const redactedDevice = file.device_id ? (file.device_id.slice(0, 4) + '...') : 'REDACTED';
        insertFingerprint.run(
          randomUUID(),
          params.sessionId,
          file.raw_file_id,
          file.sha256_hash,
          file.logical_fingerprint,
          redactedDevice,
          file.signal_type,
          file.start_time,
          file.end_time,
          now,
          params.reason ?? null
        );
      }
    }

    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
}

export function restoreSession(sessionId: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ignored_sessions WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ignored_source_fingerprints WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
}

export function getIgnoredSessions(): any[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    SELECT i.*, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.duration_seconds, s.avg_hr, s.user_id 
    FROM ignored_sessions i
    JOIN sessions s ON i.session_id = s.id
    ORDER BY i.ignored_at DESC
  `);
  return stmt.all();
}

export function getIgnoredFingerprints(): IgnoredFingerprintRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM ignored_source_fingerprints ORDER BY ignored_at DESC');
  return stmt.all() as any as IgnoredFingerprintRecord[];
}

export function deleteIgnoredFingerprint(id: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM ignored_source_fingerprints WHERE id = ?').run(id);
}

export function isFingerprintIgnored(params: { logicalFingerprint?: string; sha256?: string }): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  if (params.sha256) {
    const stmt = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM ignored_source_fingerprints WHERE file_hash_sha256 = ? LIMIT 1');
    if (stmt.get(params.sha256)) return true;
  }
  if (params.logicalFingerprint) {
    const stmt = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM ignored_source_fingerprints WHERE logical_fingerprint = ? LIMIT 1');
    if (stmt.get(params.logicalFingerprint)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

  created_at_utc?: string;
  target_size?: number;
  is_active?: boolean;

    INSERT INTO beta_cohorts (cohort_id, name, description, created_at_utc, target_size, is_active, allowed_channels_json)

      is_active=excluded.is_active,

    cohort.description,
    cohort.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    cohort.target_size ?? 30,

  );
}

}

export function claimBetaInvite(code: string, cohortId: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const invite = getBetaInvite(code);
  if (!invite) return false;
  if (invite.cohort_id !== cohortId) return false;
  if (invite.is_revoked) return false;
  if (invite.uses_count >= invite.max_uses) return false;

  const res = db.prepare('UPDATE beta_invites SET uses_count = uses_count + 1 WHERE invite_code = ? AND uses_count < max_uses AND is_revoked = 0').run(code);
  return res.changes > 0;
}

export function listBetaInvites(cohortId?: string): BetaInviteRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  if (cohortId) {
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM beta_invites WHERE cohort_id = ?').all(cohortId) as unknown as BetaInviteRecord[];
  }
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM beta_invites').all() as unknown as BetaInviteRecord[];
}

export function revokeBetaInvite(code: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare('UPDATE beta_invites SET is_revoked = 1 WHERE invite_code = ?').run(code);
  db.prepare('UPDATE operator_issuance_registry SET is_revoked = 1 WHERE invite_code = ?').run(code);
  return res.changes > 0;
}

export function saveBetaParticipant(p: {
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  source_channel: string;
  invite_code?: string | null;
  app_version: string;
  build_number: string;
  entitlement_tier?: string;
  experiment_variant_id?: string;
  first_seen_at_utc?: string;
  last_seen_at_utc?: string;
  consent_given_at_utc?: string;
  is_external_tester?: boolean;
  profile_id?: string | null;
  consent_policy_version?: string | null;
  participant_class?: string | null;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getBetaParticipant(p.participant_id);
  if (existing) {
    if (
      existing.cohort_id !== p.cohort_id ||
      existing.source_channel !== p.source_channel ||
      (existing.invite_code || null) !== (p.invite_code || null) ||
      existing.consent_given_at_utc !== p.consent_given_at_utc ||
      Boolean(existing.is_external_tester) !== Boolean(p.is_external_tester)
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Participant identity conflict for ${p.participant_id}: immutable enrollment fields (cohort, channel, invite, consent, external status) cannot be mutated.`);
    }
  }
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO beta_participants (
      participant_id, cohort_id, source_channel, invite_code, app_version,
      build_number, entitlement_tier, experiment_variant_id, first_seen_at_utc,
      last_seen_at_utc, consent_given_at_utc, is_external_tester, created_at_utc,
      profile_id, consent_policy_version, participant_class
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(participant_id) DO UPDATE SET
      last_seen_at_utc=excluded.last_seen_at_utc,
      app_version=excluded.app_version,
      build_number=excluded.build_number,
      profile_id=COALESCE(excluded.profile_id, beta_participants.profile_id),
      consent_policy_version=COALESCE(excluded.consent_policy_version, beta_participants.consent_policy_version),
      participant_class=COALESCE(excluded.participant_class, beta_participants.participant_class)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    p.participant_id,
    p.cohort_id,
    p.source_channel,
    p.invite_code ?? null,
    p.app_version,
    p.build_number,
    p.entitlement_tier || 'trial',
    p.experiment_variant_id || 'variant_corridor_standard',
    p.first_seen_at_utc || now,
    p.last_seen_at_utc || now,
    p.consent_given_at_utc || now,
    p.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0,
    now,
    p.profile_id ?? null,
    p.consent_policy_version ?? '1.0.0',
    p.participant_class ?? (p.is_external_tester ? 'qualified_external' : 'internal')
  );
}

export function saveBetaEvent(event: {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  session_id?: string | null;
  payload_json: string;
  is_synthetic?: boolean;
  created_at_utc: string;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO beta_events (
      event_id, event_type, participant_id, cohort_id, session_id, payload_json, is_synthetic, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET
      payload_json = excluded.payload_json,
      is_synthetic = excluded.is_synthetic,
      created_at_utc = excluded.created_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    event.event_id,
    event.event_type,
    event.participant_id,
    event.cohort_id,
    event.session_id ?? null,
    event.payload_json,
    event.is_synthetic ? 1 : 0,
    event.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getBetaEvents(options?: {
  participant_id?: string;
  cohort_id?: string;
  event_type?: string;
}): BetaEventRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const clauses: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];
  if (options?.participant_id) {
    clauses.push('participant_id = ?');
    params.push(options.participant_id);
  }
  if (options?.cohort_id) {
    clauses.push('cohort_id = ?');
    params.push(options.cohort_id);
  }
  if (options?.event_type) {
    clauses.push('event_type = ?');
    params.push(options.event_type);
  }
  const where = clauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${clauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  const stmt = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM beta_events ${where} ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC, id ASC`);
  return stmt.all(...params) as unknown as BetaEventRecord[];
}

export function deleteBetaEventsForParticipant(participantId: string): void {

}

export function confirmUsefulOutcome(c: {
  confirmation_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  participant_id?: string;
  user_id?: string;
  context_id?: string;
  confirmed_by?: string;
  feedback_rating?: number;
  recipient_action?: string;
  confirmed_at?: string;
  confirmed_at_utc?: string;
  user_notes?: string;
  context_token_hash?: string;
  idempotency_key?: string;
}): void {
  saveUsefulConfirmation({
    confirmation_id: c.confirmation_id,
    session_id: c.session_id,
    participant_id: c.participant_id ?? c.user_id ?? 'athlete_default',
    context_id: c.context_id ?? `ctx_${c.session_id}`,
    confirmed_by: (c.confirmed_by as any) ?? 'participant',
    recipient_action: (c.recipient_action as any) ?? (c.feedback_rating ? `viewed_by_athlete` : 'stored_in_records'),
    confirmed_at_utc: c.confirmed_at_utc ?? c.confirmed_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    user_notes: c.user_notes,
    context_token_hash: c.context_token_hash,
    idempotency_key: c.idempotency_key
  });
}

export function triageSupportEpisode(req: TriageSupportEpisodeRequest): SupportEpisode {
  const ep = getSupportEpisode(req.episode_id);
  if (!ep) {
    throw new Error(`Support episode ${req.episode_id} not found`);
  }
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const history = ep.history ? [...ep.history] : [];
  const userDelta = Math.max(0, req.user_active_minutes - ep.user_active_minutes);
  const opDelta = Math.max(0, req.operator_active_minutes - ep.operator_active_minutes);

  history.push({
    triaged_at_utc: nowIso,
    category: req.category,
    root_cause_class: req.root_cause_class,
    user_active_minutes_delta: userDelta,
    operator_active_minutes_delta: opDelta,
    resolution_status: req.resolution_status,
    triage_notes: req.triage_notes
  });

  const updated: SupportEpisode = {
    ...ep,
    category: req.category,
    root_cause_class: req.root_cause_class,
    user_active_minutes: req.user_active_minutes,
    operator_active_minutes: req.operator_active_minutes,
    resolution_status: req.resolution_status,
    resolved_at_utc: (req.resolution_status === 'resolved' || req.resolution_status === 'unsupported_closed')
      ? (ep.resolved_at_utc || nowIso)
      : undefined,
    interactions_count: ep.interactions_count + 1,
    history
  };

  saveSupportEpisode(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function insertLocalProductEvent(
  eventNameOrObj: string | {
    event_id?: string;
    event_type: string;
    timestamp_utc?: string;
    duration_ms?: number;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  },
  userId?: string | null,
  sessionId?: string | null,
  payloadJson?: string | null
): number {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  if (typeof eventNameOrObj === 'object') {
    const eventName = eventNameOrObj.event_type;
    const meta = {
      event_id: eventNameOrObj.event_id,
      duration_ms: eventNameOrObj.duration_ms,
      ...eventNameOrObj.metadata
    };
    const payload = JSON.stringify(meta);
    const sid = (eventNameOrObj.metadata?.sessionId || eventNameOrObj.metadata?.session_id || null) as string | null;
    let uid = (eventNameOrObj.metadata?.userId || eventNameOrObj.metadata?.user_id || null) as string | null;
    if (sid && !uid) {
      const binding = getSessionParticipantBinding(sid);
      if (binding) uid = binding.participant_id;
    }
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO local_product_events (event_name, user_id, session_id, payload_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const info = stmt.run(eventName, uid, sid, payload, eventNameOrObj.timestamp_utc || now);
    return Number(info.lastInsertRowid);
  } else {
    let effectiveUid = userId ?? null;
    if (sessionId && !effectiveUid) {
      const binding = getSessionParticipantBinding(sessionId);
      if (binding) effectiveUid = binding.participant_id;
    }
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO local_product_events (event_name, user_id, session_id, payload_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const info = stmt.run(eventNameOrObj, effectiveUid, sessionId ?? null, payloadJson ?? null, now);
    return Number(info.lastInsertRowid);
  }
}

export function getLocalProductEvents(limit = 100): Array<{
  id: number;
  event_name: string;
  user_id: string | null;
  session_id: string | null;
  payload_json: string | null;
  created_at_utc: string;
}> {
  const db = getDb();
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM local_product_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').all(limit) as any;
}

export interface SessionParticipantBindingRecord {
  session_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  invite_code: string | null;
  is_external_tester: number;
  bound_at_utc: string;
}

export function bindSessionToParticipant(binding: {
  session_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  invite_code?: string | null;
  is_external_tester?: boolean;
  bound_at_utc?: string;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getSessionParticipantBinding(binding.session_id);
  if (existing) {
    const isExt = binding.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0;
    const existingIsExt = existing.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0;
    const inv = binding.invite_code ?? null;
    const existInv = existing.invite_code ?? null;
    if (
      existing.participant_id !== binding.participant_id ||
      existing.cohort_id !== binding.cohort_id ||
      existInv !== inv ||
      existingIsExt !== isExt
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Immutable session binding conflict for session ${binding.session_id}: already bound to participant ${existing.participant_id}, cannot rebind to ${binding.participant_id}`);
    }
    // Exact repeat is idempotent
    return;
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO session_participant_bindings (
      session_id, participant_id, cohort_id, invite_code, is_external_tester, bound_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    binding.session_id,
    binding.participant_id,
    binding.cohort_id,
    binding.invite_code ?? null,
    binding.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0,
    binding.bound_at_utc || now
  );
}

/**
 * Audited session rebinding for explicit migration or administrative recovery.
 * Requires explicit reason and operator ID.
 */
export function rebindSessionForAuditedMigration(
  binding: {
    session_id: string;
    participant_id: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    invite_code?: string | null;
    is_external_tester?: boolean;
    bound_at_utc?: string;
  },
  audit: {
    migration_reason: string;
    operator_id: string;
  }
): void {
  if (!audit.migration_reason || !audit.operator_id) {
    throw new Error('Audited session rebinding requires migration_reason and operator_id');
  }
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO session_participant_bindings (
      session_id, participant_id, cohort_id, invite_code, is_external_tester, bound_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
      participant_id=excluded.participant_id,
      cohort_id=excluded.cohort_id,
      invite_code=excluded.invite_code,
      is_external_tester=excluded.is_external_tester,
      bound_at_utc=excluded.bound_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    binding.session_id,
    binding.participant_id,
    binding.cohort_id,
    binding.invite_code ?? null,
    binding.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0,
    binding.bound_at_utc || now
  );
}

export function getSessionParticipantBinding(sessionId: string): SessionParticipantBindingRecord | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_participant_bindings WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId);
  return row ? (row as unknown as SessionParticipantBindingRecord) : null;
}

export interface GuidedFlowRecord {
  flow_id: string;
  started_at_utc: string;
  preview_ready_at_utc?: string | null;
  grouping_decision?: string | null;
  correction_count?: number;
  selected_bundle_count?: number;
  imported_session_ids_json?: string;
  completed_at_utc?: string | null;
  metadata_json?: string | null;
}

export function createGuidedFlow(flow: {
  flow_id: string;
  started_at_utc?: string;
  preview_ready_at_utc?: string | null;
  grouping_decision?: string | null;
  correction_count?: number;
  selected_bundle_count?: number;
  imported_session_ids?: string[];
  completed_at_utc?: string | null;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const startedAt = flow.started_at_utc || new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO guided_analysis_flows (
      flow_id, started_at_utc, preview_ready_at_utc, grouping_decision, correction_count, selected_bundle_count, imported_session_ids_json, completed_at_utc, metadata_json
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(flow_id) DO NOTHING
  `).run(
    flow.flow_id,
    startedAt,
    flow.preview_ready_at_utc ?? null,
    flow.grouping_decision ?? null,
    flow.correction_count ?? 0,
    flow.selected_bundle_count ?? 0,
    flow.imported_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(flow.imported_session_ids) : null,
    flow.completed_at_utc ?? null,
    flow.metadata ? JSON.stringify(flow.metadata) : null
  );
}

export function updateGuidedFlow(
  flow_id: string,
  updates: {
    preview_ready_at_utc?: string | null;
    grouping_decision?: string | null;
    correction_count?: number;
    selected_bundle_count?: number;
    imported_session_ids?: string[];
    completed_at_utc?: string | null;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  }
): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getGuidedFlow(flow_id);
  if (!existing) {
    createGuidedFlow({ flow_id });
  }
  const sets: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (updates.preview_ready_at_utc !== undefined) {
    sets.push('preview_ready_at_utc = ?');
    params.push(updates.preview_ready_at_utc);
  }
  if (updates.grouping_decision !== undefined) {
    sets.push('grouping_decision = ?');
    params.push(updates.grouping_decision);
  }
  if (updates.correction_count !== undefined) {
    sets.push('correction_count = ?');
    params.push(updates.correction_count);
  }
  if (updates.selected_bundle_count !== undefined) {
    sets.push('selected_bundle_count = ?');
    params.push(updates.selected_bundle_count);
  }
  if (updates.imported_session_ids !== undefined) {
    sets.push('imported_session_ids_json = ?');
    params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.imported_session_ids));
  }
  if (updates.completed_at_utc !== undefined) {
    sets.push('completed_at_utc = ?');
    params.push(updates.completed_at_utc);
  }
  if (updates.metadata !== undefined) {
    sets.push('metadata_json = ?');
    params.push(JSON.stringify(updates.metadata));
  }

  if (sets.length > 0) {
    params.push(flow_id);
    db.prepare(`UPDATE guided_analysis_flows SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE flow_id = ?`).run(...params);
  }
}

export function getGuidedFlow(flow_id: string): GuidedFlowRecord | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM guided_analysis_flows WHERE flow_id = ?').get(flow_id);
  return (row as unknown as GuidedFlowRecord) || null;
}
