export interface SessionDuplicateMeta {
  is_duplicate: boolean;
  has_duplicates: boolean;
  duplicate_count: number;
  canonical_representative_id: string;
  duplicate_group_id: string;
}

/**
 * Groups sessions by identical source file SHA-256 hashes or device/time window fingerprints,
 * selecting the canonical primary representative and tagging secondary duplicates.
 */
export function getDuplicateSessionMap(db?: any): Map<string, SessionDuplicateMeta> {
  const database = db || getDb();
  const map = new Map<string, SessionDuplicateMeta>();
  if (!database || typeof database.prepare !== 'function') {
    return map;
  }

  try {
    const sessions = database.prepare('SELECT id, device_id, start_time, duration_seconds, overall_quality_score, created_at FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at ASC').all() as Array<{
      id: string;
      device_id: string;
      start_time: string;
      duration_seconds: number;
      overall_quality_score: number;
      created_at: string;
    }>;

    if (sessions.length === 0) return map;

    const signalRows = database.prepare(`
      SELECT ss.session_id, ss.file_id, f.sha256_hash, f.signal_type
      FROM session_signals ss
      JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
      ORDER BY ss.session_id, f.sha256_hash
    `).all() as Array<{
      session_id: string;
      file_id: string;
      sha256_hash: string;
      signal_type: string;
    }>;

    const sessionFilesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const r of signalRows) {
      const list = sessionFilesMap.get(r.session_id) || [];
      list.push(r.sha256_hash);
      sessionFilesMap.set(r.session_id, list);
    }

    const groups = new Map<string, typeof sessions>();

    for (const s of sessions) {
      const fileHashes = sessionFilesMap.get(s.id);
      let groupKey: string;
      if (fileHashes && fileHashes.length > 0) {
        groupKey = `files:${[...fileHashes].sort().join('|')}`;
      } else {
        const startTimeMs = new Date(s.start_time).getTime();
        const roundedTimeSec = !isNaN(startTimeMs) ? Math.round(startTimeMs / 5000) * 5 : s.start_time;
        const roundedDur = Math.round(s.duration_seconds / 2) * 2;
        groupKey = `time:${s.device_id}_${roundedTimeSec}_${roundedDur}`;
      }

      const group = groups.get(groupKey) || [];
      group.push(s);
      groups.set(groupKey, group);
    }

    for (const [groupKey, groupSessions] of groups.entries()) {
      if (groupSessions.length === 1) {
        const s = groupSessions[0];
        map.set(s.id, {
          is_duplicate: false,
          has_duplicates: false,
          duplicate_count: 1,
          canonical_representative_id: s.id,
          duplicate_group_id: groupKey
        });
      } else {
        const sorted = [...groupSessions].sort((a, b) => {
          if (b.overall_quality_score !== a.overall_quality_score) {
            return b.overall_quality_score - a.overall_quality_score;
          }
          return new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime();
        });

        const primary = sorted[0];

        for (const s of groupSessions) {
          const isDup = s.id !== primary.id;
          map.set(s.id, {
            is_duplicate: isDup,
            has_duplicates: !isDup,
            duplicate_count: groupSessions.length,
            canonical_representative_id: primary.id,
            duplicate_group_id: groupKey
          });
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to compute duplicate session groups:', e);
  }

  return map;
}

    INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, updated_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Session Tags & Bulk Operations
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function getSessionTags(sessionId: string): string[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT tags_json FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as { tags_json?: string | null } | undefined;
  if (!row || !row.tags_json) return [];
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(row.tags_json);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter(t => typeof t === 'string' && t.trim().length > 0) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function setSessionTags(sessionId: string, tags: string[]): string[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const sanitized = Array.from(new Set(tags.map(t => typeof t === 'string' ? t.trim() : '').filter(t => t.length > 0 && t.length <= 50))).slice(0, 30);
  const tagsJson = JSON.stringify(sanitized);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const existingAnn = db.prepare('SELECT id, created_at FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
  const annotationId = existingAnn ? existingAnn.id : `ann_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`;
  const createdAt = existingAnn ? existingAnn.created_at : now;

  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO session_annotations (id, session_id, user_id, activity_type, tags_json, created_at, updated_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, NULL, 'unknown', ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
      tags_json = excluded.tags_json,
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
  `).run(annotationId, sessionId, tagsJson, createdAt, now);

  return sanitized;
}

export function addSessionTag(sessionId: string, tag: string): string[] {
  const current = getSessionTags(sessionId);
  const trimmed = tag.trim();
  if (trimmed && !current.includes(trimmed)) {
    return setSessionTags(sessionId, [...current, trimmed]);
  }
  return current;
}

export function removeSessionTag(sessionId: string, tag: string): string[] {
  const current = getSessionTags(sessionId);
  const filtered = current.filter(t => t !== tag.trim());
  return setSessionTags(sessionId, filtered);
}

export function bulkUpdateSessionTags(
  sessionIds: string[],
  addTags: string[] = [],
  removeTags: string[] = []
): { updatedCount: number } {
  const db = getDb();
  if (!sessionIds || sessionIds.length === 0) return { updatedCount: 0 };

  const sanitizedAdd = addTags.map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0);
  const sanitizedRemove = new Set(removeTags.map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0));

  let updatedCount = 0;
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    for (const sid of sessionIds) {
      const current = getSessionTags(sid);
      let newTags = [...current];
      for (const a of sanitizedAdd) {
        if (!newTags.includes(a)) newTags.push(a);
      }
      newTags = newTags.filter(t => !sanitizedRemove.has(t));
      setSessionTags(sid, newTags);
      updatedCount++;
    }
    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
  return { updatedCount };
}

export function bulkUpdateSessionMetadata(
  sessionIds: string[],
  metadata: { userId?: string | null; activityType?: string }
): { updatedCount: number } {
  const db = getDb();
  if (!sessionIds || sessionIds.length === 0) return { updatedCount: 0 };

  let updatedCount = 0;
  db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
  try {
    for (const sid of sessionIds) {
      const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sid) as any;
      if (!session) continue;

      if (metadata.userId !== undefined) {
        const normUser = (metadata.userId && metadata.userId !== 'unassigned') ? metadata.userId : null;
        const assignmentStatus = normUser ? 'assigned' : 'unassigned';
        db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET user_id = ?, assignment_status = ? WHERE id = ?').run(normUser, assignmentStatus, sid);
      }

      if (metadata.activityType !== undefined) {
        const existingAnn = db.prepare('SELECT id, created_at, user_id FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sid) as any;
        const annotationId = existingAnn ? existingAnn.id : `ann_${sid}_${Date.now()}`;
        const createdAt = existingAnn ? existingAnn.created_at : new Date().toISOString();
        const effectiveUser = metadata.userId !== undefined ? (metadata.userId === 'unassigned' ? null : metadata.userId) : (existingAnn?.user_id ?? session.user_id);

        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO session_annotations (id, session_id, user_id, activity_type, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now', 'utc'))
          ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
            user_id = COALESCE(excluded.user_id, session_annotations.user_id),
            activity_type = excluded.activity_type,
            updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
        `).run(annotationId, sid, effectiveUser, metadata.activityType, createdAt);
      }

      updatedCount++;
    }
    db.exec('COMMIT;');
  } catch (err) {
    db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
    throw err;
  }
  return { updatedCount };
}

export function getAllDistinctTags(): string[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare("SELECT tags_json FROM session_annotations WHERE tags_json IS NOT NULL AND tags_json != '' AND tags_json != '[]'").all() as { tags_json: string }[];
  const set = new Set<string>();
  for (const r of rows) {
    try {
      const arr = JSON.parse(r.tags_json);
      if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
        for (const item of arr) {
          if (typeof item === 'string' && item.trim()) {
            set.add(item.trim());
          }
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }
  return Array.from(set).sort();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// External Sync Folders & Sync Ledger
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface ExternalSyncFolder {
  id: string;
  folder_path: string;
  label: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  last_scan_utc: string | null;
  status: 'idle' | 'scanning' | 'offline' | 'error';
  health: 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'folder_missing' | 'error';
  error_message: string | null;
  discovered_count: number;
  imported_count: number;
  skipped_count: number;
  failed_count: number;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export interface SyncLedgerEntry {
  id: string;
  folder_id: string;
  bundle_fingerprint: string;
  bundle_name: string;
  file_paths_json: string;
  state: 'discovered' | 'settling' | 'imported' | 'skipped_duplicate' | 'failed';
  imported_session_id: string | null;
  error_message: string | null;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export function getExternalSyncFolders(): ExternalSyncFolder[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM external_sync_folders ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC').all() as any[];
  return rows.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    is_active: Boolean(r.is_active)
  }));
}

export function getExternalSyncFolder(id: string): ExternalSyncFolder | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM external_sync_folders WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return { ...row, is_active: Boolean(row.is_active) };
}

export function addExternalSyncFolder(folderPath: string, label?: string): ExternalSyncFolder {
  const db = getDb();
  const normPath = path.resolve(folderPath);
  const id = `folder_${crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12) : Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO external_sync_folders (
      id, folder_path, label, is_active, status, health, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, 'idle', 'healthy', ?, ?)
  `).run(id, normPath, label || path.basename(normPath) || normPath, now, now);
  return getExternalSyncFolder(id)!;
}

export function removeExternalSyncFolder(id: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const info = db.prepare('DELETE FROM external_sync_folders WHERE id = ?').run(id);
  return info.changes > 0;
}

export function toggleExternalSyncFolder(id: string, isActive?: boolean): ExternalSyncFolder | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const current = getExternalSyncFolder(id);
  if (!current) return null;
  const newActive = isActive !== undefined ? (isActive ? 1 : 0) : (current.is_active ? 0 : 1);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare('UPDATE external_sync_folders SET is_active = ?, updated_at_utc = ? WHERE id = ?').run(newActive, now, id);
  return getExternalSyncFolder(id);
}

export function updateExternalSyncFolderStatus(id: string, update: Partial<ExternalSyncFolder>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const sets: string[] = ['updated_at_utc = ?'];
  const values: any[] = [new Date().toISOString()];

  if (update.status !== undefined) { sets.push('status = ?'); values.push(update.status); }
  if (update.health !== undefined) { sets.push('health = ?'); values.push(update.health); }
  if (update.error_message !== undefined) { sets.push('error_message = ?'); values.push(update.error_message); }
  if (update.last_scan_utc !== undefined) { sets.push('last_scan_utc = ?'); values.push(update.last_scan_utc); }
  if (update.discovered_count !== undefined) { sets.push('discovered_count = ?'); values.push(update.discovered_count); }
  if (update.imported_count !== undefined) { sets.push('imported_count = ?'); values.push(update.imported_count); }
  if (update.skipped_count !== undefined) { sets.push('skipped_count = ?'); values.push(update.skipped_count); }
  if (update.failed_count !== undefined) { sets.push('failed_count = ?'); values.push(update.failed_count); }

  values.push(id);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE external_sync_folders SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...values);
}

export function getSyncLedgerEntries(folderId?: string): SyncLedgerEntry[] {
  const db = getDb();
  if (folderId) {
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sync_ledger WHERE folder_id = ? ORDER BY updated_at_utc DESC').all(folderId) as any[];
  }
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sync_ledger ORDER BY updated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 200').all() as any[];
}

export function recordSyncLedgerEntry(entry: {
  folder_id: string;
  bundle_fingerprint: string;
  bundle_name: string;
  file_paths_json: string;
  state: SyncLedgerEntry['state'];
  imported_session_id?: string | null;
  error_message?: string | null;
}): SyncLedgerEntry {
  const db = getDb();
  const id = `ledger_${crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12) : Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO sync_ledger (
      id, folder_id, bundle_fingerprint, bundle_name, file_paths_json, state,
      imported_session_id, error_message, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    id, entry.folder_id, entry.bundle_fingerprint, entry.bundle_name, entry.file_paths_json,
    entry.state, entry.imported_session_id || null, entry.error_message || null, now, now
  );
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sync_ledger WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
}

export function updateSyncLedgerEntry(id: string, update: Partial<SyncLedgerEntry>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const sets: string[] = ['updated_at_utc = ?'];
  const values: any[] = [new Date().toISOString()];

  if (update.state !== undefined) { sets.push('state = ?'); values.push(update.state); }
  if (update.imported_session_id !== undefined) { sets.push('imported_session_id = ?'); values.push(update.imported_session_id); }
  if (update.error_message !== undefined) { sets.push('error_message = ?'); values.push(update.error_message); }

  values.push(id);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE sync_ledger SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...values);
}

export function findSyncLedgerByFingerprint(bundleFingerprint: string): SyncLedgerEntry | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sync_ledger WHERE bundle_fingerprint = ? LIMIT 1').get(bundleFingerprint);
  return row ? (row as any) : null;
}

export function saveSupportIncident(incident: {
  incident_id: string;
  timestamp_utc: string;
  severity: string;
  error_code: string;
  message: string;
  stack_trace_redacted?: string | null;
  source_version: string;
  schema_version: string;
  workflow: string;
  status?: string;
  resolution_notes?: string | null;
  resolved_at_utc?: string | null;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO support_incidents (
      incident_id, timestamp_utc, severity, error_code, message,
      stack_trace_redacted, source_version, schema_version, workflow,
      status, resolution_notes, resolved_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    incident.incident_id,
    incident.timestamp_utc,
    incident.severity,
    incident.error_code,
    incident.message,
    incident.stack_trace_redacted ?? null,
    incident.source_version,
    incident.schema_version,
    incident.workflow,
    incident.status || 'open',
    incident.resolution_notes ?? null,
    incident.resolved_at_utc ?? null
  );
}

export function listSupportIncidents(limit = 50, workflow?: string): any[] {
  const db = getDb();
  if (workflow) {
    return db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM support_incidents
      WHERE workflow = ?
      ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC
      LIMIT ?
    `).all(workflow, limit) as any[];
  }
  return db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM support_incidents
    ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT ?
  `).all(limit) as any[];
}

export function resolveSupportIncident(incidentId: string, notes: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE support_incidents
    SET status = 'resolved', resolution_notes = ?, resolved_at_utc = ?
    WHERE incident_id = ?
  `).run(notes, new Date().toISOString(), incidentId);
  return (res as any).changes > 0;
}

  dependencies_json: string;
  is_blocking: number;
  external_action_required: number;
  specification_doc?: string | null;
  evidence_types_allowed_json: string;
  status: string;
  active_evidence_id?: string | null;
  active_decision_id?: string | null;
  last_evaluated_at_utc?: string | null;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export function upsertReleaseGateRecord(record: DbReleaseGateRecord): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO external_release_gates (
      id, name, description, category, required_authority_class,
      dependencies_json, is_blocking, external_action_required,
      specification_doc, evidence_types_allowed_json, status,
      active_evidence_id, active_decision_id, last_evaluated_at_utc,
      created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      name = excluded.name,
      description = excluded.description,
      category = excluded.category,
      required_authority_class = excluded.required_authority_class,
      dependencies_json = excluded.dependencies_json,
      is_blocking = excluded.is_blocking,
      external_action_required = excluded.external_action_required,
      specification_doc = excluded.specification_doc,
      evidence_types_allowed_json = excluded.evidence_types_allowed_json,
      status = excluded.status,
      active_evidence_id = excluded.active_evidence_id,
      active_decision_id = excluded.active_decision_id,
      last_evaluated_at_utc = excluded.last_evaluated_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    record.id,
    record.name,
    record.description,
    record.category,
    record.required_authority_class,
    record.dependencies_json,
    record.is_blocking,
    record.external_action_required,
    record.specification_doc ?? null,
    record.evidence_types_allowed_json,
    record.status,
    record.active_evidence_id ?? null,
    record.active_decision_id ?? null,
    record.last_evaluated_at_utc ?? null,
    record.created_at_utc,
    record.updated_at_utc
  );
}

export function listReleaseEvidenceRecords(filter?: { gateId?: string; candidateFreezeId?: string; status?: string }): DbReleaseEvidenceRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  let query = 'SELECT * FROM external_release_evidence WHERE 1=1';
  const params: any[] = [];
  if (filter?.gateId) {
    query += ' AND gate_id = ?';
    params.push(filter.gateId);
  }
  if (filter?.candidateFreezeId) {
    query += ' AND candidate_freeze_id = ?';
    params.push(filter.candidateFreezeId);
  }
  if (filter?.status) {
    query += ' AND status = ?';
    params.push(filter.status);
  }
  query += ' ORDER BY received_at_utc DESC';
  return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as unknown as DbReleaseEvidenceRecord[];
}

    query += ' AND candidate_freeze_id = ?';
    params.push(filter.candidateFreezeId);

  if (filter?.activeOnly) {
    query += ' AND is_active = 1';
  }
  if (filter?.decisionType) {
    query += ' AND decision_type = ?';
    params.push(filter.decisionType);
  }
  query += ' ORDER BY recorded_at_utc DESC';
  return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as unknown as DbOwnerDecisionRecord[];
}

export function createSelfServiceEpisode(episode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO self_service_episodes (
      episode_id, profile_id, actor_class, task_intent,
      canonical_session_id, canonical_session_hash, canonical_result_hash,
      window_id, window_revision, comparison_partner_session_id, comparison_hash,
      llm_pack_fingerprint, diary_entry_id, lifecycle_state,
      completion_gates_json, blockers_json, recovery_history_json,
      repeat_classification, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc,
      completed_at_utc, provenance_version
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    episode.episode_id,
    episode.profile_id,
    episode.actor_class,
    episode.task_intent,
    episode.canonical_session_id ?? null,
    episode.canonical_session_hash ?? null,
    episode.canonical_result_hash ?? null,
    episode.window_id ?? null,
    episode.window_revision ?? null,
    episode.comparison_partner_session_id ?? null,
    episode.comparison_hash ?? null,
    episode.llm_pack_fingerprint ?? null,
    episode.diary_entry_id ?? null,
    episode.lifecycle_state,
    JSON.stringify(episode.completion_gates || {}),
    JSON.stringify(episode.blockers || []),
    JSON.stringify(episode.recovery_history || []),
    episode.repeat_classification,
    episode.created_at_utc,
    episode.updated_at_utc,
    episode.completed_at_utc ?? null,
    episode.provenance_version
  );
}

export function parseEpisodeRow(row: any): SelfServiceWorkEpisode | null {
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    episode_id: row.episode_id,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    actor_class: row.actor_class,
    task_intent: row.task_intent,
    canonical_session_id: row.canonical_session_id,
    canonical_session_hash: row.canonical_session_hash,
    canonical_result_hash: row.canonical_result_hash,
    window_id: row.window_id,
    window_revision: row.window_revision,
    comparison_partner_session_id: row.comparison_partner_session_id,
    comparison_hash: row.comparison_hash,
    llm_pack_fingerprint: row.llm_pack_fingerprint,
    diary_entry_id: row.diary_entry_id,
    lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as EpisodeLifecycleState,
    completion_gates: row.completion_gates_json ? JSON.parse(row.completion_gates_json) : {},
    blockers: row.blockers_json ? JSON.parse(row.blockers_json) : [],
    recovery_history: row.recovery_history_json ? JSON.parse(row.recovery_history_json) : [],
    repeat_classification: row.repeat_classification,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc,
    completed_at_utc: row.completed_at_utc,
    provenance_version: row.provenance_version
  };
}

export function updateSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId: string, updates: Partial<SelfServiceWorkEpisode>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
  if (!existing) {
    throw new Error(`SelfServiceWorkEpisode '${episodeId}' not found for update`);
  }

  const merged: SelfServiceWorkEpisode = {
    ...existing,
    ...updates,
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE self_service_episodes SET
      canonical_session_id = ?,
      canonical_session_hash = ?,
      canonical_result_hash = ?,
      window_id = ?,
      window_revision = ?,
      comparison_partner_session_id = ?,
      comparison_hash = ?,
      llm_pack_fingerprint = ?,
      diary_entry_id = ?,
      lifecycle_state = ?,
      completion_gates_json = ?,
      blockers_json = ?,
      recovery_history_json = ?,
      repeat_classification = ?,
      updated_at_utc = ?,
      completed_at_utc = ?
    WHERE episode_id = ?
  `);
  stmt.run(
    merged.canonical_session_id ?? null,
    merged.canonical_session_hash ?? null,
    merged.canonical_result_hash ?? null,
    merged.window_id ?? null,
    merged.window_revision ?? null,
    merged.comparison_partner_session_id ?? null,
    merged.comparison_hash ?? null,
    merged.llm_pack_fingerprint ?? null,
    merged.diary_entry_id ?? null,
    merged.lifecycle_state,
    JSON.stringify(merged.completion_gates || {}),
    JSON.stringify(merged.blockers || []),
    JSON.stringify(merged.recovery_history || []),
    merged.repeat_classification,
    merged.updated_at_utc,
    merged.completed_at_utc ?? null,
    episodeId
  );
}

export function saveGuidedPreflight(preflight: GuidedIntakePreflight & { admission?: any; admission_json?: string }, stagingDir?: string): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const admissionJson = preflight.admission_json || (preflight.admission ? JSON.stringify(preflight.admission) : null);
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT OR REPLACE INTO guided_preflights (
      preflight_id, request_fingerprint, profile_id, task_intent,
      discovered_members_json, format_support, duplicate_state_json,
      privacy_class, status, issues_json, predicted_capabilities_json,
      staging_dir, expires_at_utc, created_at_utc, admission_json
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);
  stmt.run(
    preflight.preflight_id,
    preflight.request_fingerprint,
    preflight.profile_id,
    preflight.task_intent,
    JSON.stringify(preflight.discovered_members || []),
    preflight.format_support,
    JSON.stringify(preflight.duplicate_state || {}),
    preflight.privacy_class,
    preflight.status,
    JSON.stringify(preflight.issues || []),
    JSON.stringify(preflight.predicted_capabilities || []),
    stagingDir ?? null,
    preflight.expires_at_utc,
    preflight.created_at_utc,
    admissionJson
  );
}

export function parsePreflightRow(row: any): { preflight: GuidedIntakePreflight & { admission?: any }; stagingDir?: string } | null {
  if (!row) return null;
  const preflight: GuidedIntakePreflight & { admission?: any } = {
    schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    preflight_id: row.preflight_id,
    request_fingerprint: row.request_fingerprint,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    task_intent: row.task_intent,
    discovered_members: row.discovered_members_json ? JSON.parse(row.discovered_members_json) : [],
    format_support: row.format_support,
    required_companions: [],
    optional_companions: [],
    duplicate_state: row.duplicate_state_json ? JSON.parse(row.duplicate_state_json) : { is_duplicate: false, duplicate_type: 'none' },
    privacy_class: row.privacy_class,
    status: row.status,
    issues: row.issues_json ? JSON.parse(row.issues_json) : [],
    predicted_capabilities: row.predicted_capabilities_json ? JSON.parse(row.predicted_capabilities_json) : [],
    expires_at_utc: row.expires_at_utc,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    admission: row.admission_json ? JSON.parse(row.admission_json) : null
  };
  return { preflight, stagingDir: row.staging_dir ?? undefined };
}

export function getGuidedPreflightByFingerprint(fingerprint: string): { preflight: GuidedIntakePreflight; stagingDir?: string } | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM guided_preflights WHERE request_fingerprint = ?').get(fingerprint);
  return parsePreflightRow(row);
}

  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM guided_preflights WHERE preflight_id = ?').get(preflightId);
  return parsePreflightRow(row);
}

    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM self_service_support_records WHERE episode_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all(episodeId);

export function attachLegacySessionToEpisode(sessionId: string, profileId: string, taskIntent = 'single_session_analysis'): SelfServiceWorkEpisode {
  const db = getDb();
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
  if (!session) {
    throw new Error(`Cannot attach legacy session: session '${sessionId}' not found in database.`);
  }

  // Check if already attached
  const existing = getSelfServiceEpisodeBySession(sessionId);
  if (existing) {
    return existing;
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const episodeId = `ep-legacy-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
  const episode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode = {
    schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    episode_id: episodeId,
    profile_id: profileId,
    actor_class: 'legacy_unqualified',
    task_intent: taskIntent,
    canonical_session_id: sessionId,
    canonical_session_hash: session.file_hash ?? null,
    canonical_result_hash: null,
    lifecycle_state: 'analysis_ready',
    completion_gates: {
      preflight_passed: true,
      import_completed: true,
      qc_evaluated: true
    },
    blockers: [],
    recovery_history: [],
    repeat_classification: 'first_use',
    created_at_utc: now,
    updated_at_utc: now,
    completed_at_utc: null,
    provenance_version: '1.0.0'
  };

  createSelfServiceEpisode(episode);
  return episode;
}

// ============================================================================
// G5 Longitudinal & Saved View DAOs
// ============================================================================

export class ViewRevisionConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly viewId: string,
    public readonly expectedRevision: number,
    public readonly currentRevision: number,
    public readonly authoritativeView: SavedLongitudinalView,
    public readonly draftHistoryId?: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ViewRevisionConflictError';
  }
}

export function saveLongitudinalSnapshot(snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot): void {
  const db = getDb();
  // Mark prior snapshots for this exact query fingerprint as non-current
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE longitudinal_snapshots
    SET is_current = 0, currentness_reason = 'superseded_by_new_calculation'
    WHERE query_fingerprint = ? AND is_current = 1
  `).run(snapshot.query_fingerprint);

  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO longitudinal_snapshots (
      snapshot_id, profile_id, query_fingerprint, query_json,
      snapshot_json, aggregate_dependency_hash, is_current,
      currentness_reason, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);

  stmt.run(
    snapshot.snapshot_id,
    snapshot.profile_id,
    snapshot.query_fingerprint,
    JSON.stringify(snapshot.query),
    JSON.stringify(snapshot),
    snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
    snapshot.is_current ? 1 : 0,
    snapshot.currentness_reason,
    snapshot.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getLongitudinalSnapshot(snapshotId: string): LongitudinalSnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM longitudinal_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = ?').get(snapshotId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    const snap = JSON.parse(row.snapshot_json) as LongitudinalSnapshot;
    snap.is_current = Boolean(row.is_current);
    snap.currentness_reason = row.currentness_reason;
    return snap;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getLatestSnapshotByFingerprint(fingerprint: string): LongitudinalSnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM longitudinal_snapshots
    WHERE query_fingerprint = ? AND is_current = 1
    ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
  `).get(fingerprint) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    const snap = JSON.parse(row.snapshot_json) as LongitudinalSnapshot;
    snap.is_current = Boolean(row.is_current);
    snap.currentness_reason = row.currentness_reason;
    return snap;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function invalidateSnapshotsForProfile(profileId: string, reason = 'source_or_result_mutated'): number {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE longitudinal_snapshots
    SET is_current = 0, currentness_reason = ?
    WHERE profile_id = ? AND is_current = 1
  `).run(reason, profileId);
  return Number(res.changes);
}

export function createSavedLongitudinalView(view: SavedLongitudinalView): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_views (
      view_id, name, profile_id, normalized_query_json,
      metrics_json, display_preferences_json, current_snapshot_id,
      optimistic_revision, is_retired,
      selected_session_ids_json, window_references_json, user_notes,
      created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `);

  stmt.run(
    view.view_id,
    view.name,
    view.profile_id,
    JSON.stringify({
      ...view.normalized_query,
      cross_plan_provenance: view.cross_plan_provenance || view.normalized_query?.cross_plan_provenance
    }),
    view.metrics ? JSON.stringify(view.metrics) : JSON.stringify(['rmssd', 'avg_hr']),
    view.display_preferences ? JSON.stringify(view.display_preferences) : '{}',
    view.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
    view.optimistic_revision,
    view.is_retired ? 1 : 0,
    view.selected_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(view.selected_session_ids) : (view.normalized_query?.selected_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(view.normalized_query.selected_session_ids) : null),
    view.window_references ? JSON.stringify(view.window_references) : (view.normalized_query?.window_references ? JSON.stringify(view.normalized_query.window_references) : null),
    view.user_notes ?? view.normalized_query?.user_notes ?? null,
    view.created_at_utc,
    view.updated_at_utc
  );

  // Record initial history record
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
      history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
      change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    `hist-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
    view.view_id,
    view.optimistic_revision,
    view.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
    'created',
    null,
    view.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId: string): SavedLongitudinalView | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_views WHERE view_id = ?').get(viewId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  const normQuery = JSON.parse(row.normalized_query_json);
  return {
    view_id: row.view_id,
    name: row.name,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    normalized_query: normQuery,
    metrics: JSON.parse(row.metrics_json),
    display_preferences: JSON.parse(row.display_preferences_json),
    current_snapshot_id: row.current_snapshot_id,
    optimistic_revision: row.optimistic_revision,
    is_retired: Boolean(row.is_retired),
    selected_session_ids: row.selected_session_ids_json ? JSON.parse(row.selected_session_ids_json) : undefined,
    window_references: row.window_references_json ? JSON.parse(row.window_references_json) : undefined,
    user_notes: row.user_notes !== undefined ? row.user_notes : undefined,
    cross_plan_provenance: normQuery?.cross_plan_provenance || undefined,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  };
}

export function updateSavedLongitudinalView(
  viewId: string,
  expectedRevision: number,
  update: Partial<SavedLongitudinalView>,
  draftQuery?: any
): SavedLongitudinalView {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
  if (!existing) {
    throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' not found.`);
  }

  // Optimistic concurrency check
  if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
    const conflictHistoryId = `hist-conflict-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    // Preserve draft query/update in history so work is not lost
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
        history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
        change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      conflictHistoryId,
      viewId,
      existing.optimistic_revision,
      existing.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
      'conflict_draft_preserved',
      draftQuery ? JSON.stringify(draftQuery) : JSON.stringify(update),
      nowUtc
    );

    throw new ViewRevisionConflictError(
      `Optimistic concurrency conflict on saved view '${viewId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, but database is at revision ${existing.optimistic_revision}. Draft has been preserved in view history.`,
      viewId,
      expectedRevision,
      existing.optimistic_revision,
      existing,
      conflictHistoryId
    );
  }

  const nextRevision = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const updatedSelectedSessionIds = update.selected_session_ids !== undefined ? update.selected_session_ids : (update.normalized_query?.selected_session_ids !== undefined ? update.normalized_query.selected_session_ids : existing.selected_session_ids);
  const updatedWindowReferences = update.window_references !== undefined ? update.window_references : (update.normalized_query?.window_references !== undefined ? update.normalized_query.window_references : existing.window_references);
  const updatedUserNotes = update.user_notes !== undefined ? update.user_notes : (update.normalized_query?.user_notes !== undefined ? update.normalized_query.user_notes : existing.user_notes);

  const updatedView: SavedLongitudinalView = {
    ...existing,
    name: update.name ?? existing.name,
    normalized_query: update.normalized_query ?? existing.normalized_query,
    metrics: update.metrics ?? existing.metrics,
    display_preferences: update.display_preferences ?? existing.display_preferences,
    current_snapshot_id: update.current_snapshot_id !== undefined ? update.current_snapshot_id : existing.current_snapshot_id,
    optimistic_revision: nextRevision,
    is_retired: update.is_retired !== undefined ? update.is_retired : existing.is_retired,
    selected_session_ids: updatedSelectedSessionIds,
    window_references: updatedWindowReferences,
    user_notes: updatedUserNotes,
    cross_plan_provenance: update.cross_plan_provenance !== undefined ? update.cross_plan_provenance : (update.normalized_query?.cross_plan_provenance !== undefined ? update.normalized_query.cross_plan_provenance : existing.cross_plan_provenance),
    updated_at_utc: now
  };

  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE saved_longitudinal_views
    SET name = ?, normalized_query_json = ?, metrics_json = ?,
        display_preferences_json = ?, current_snapshot_id = ?,
        optimistic_revision = ?, is_retired = ?,
        selected_session_ids_json = ?, window_references_json = ?, user_notes = ?,
        updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
  `).run(
    updatedView.name,
    JSON.stringify(updatedView.normalized_query),
    JSON.stringify(updatedView.metrics),
    JSON.stringify(updatedView.display_preferences),
    updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
    updatedView.optimistic_revision,
    updatedView.is_retired ? 1 : 0,
    updatedView.selected_session_ids ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.selected_session_ids) : null,
    updatedView.window_references ? JSON.stringify(updatedView.window_references) : null,
    updatedView.user_notes ?? null,
    updatedView.updated_at_utc,
    viewId,
    expectedRevision
  );

  // Record history record
  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
      history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
      change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    `hist-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
    viewId,
    nextRevision,
    updatedView.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
    'updated',
    null,
    now
  );

  return updatedView;
}

export function retireSavedLongitudinalView(viewId: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
  if (!existing) return false;

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE saved_longitudinal_views
    SET is_retired = 1, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE view_id = ?
  `).run(now, viewId);

  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
      history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
      change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    `hist-retire-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
    viewId,
    existing.optimistic_revision,
    existing.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
    'retired',
    null,
    now
  );

  return true;
}

export function listSavedLongitudinalViews(profileId: string, includeRetired = false): SavedLongitudinalView[] {
  const db = getDb();
  let query = 'SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_views WHERE profile_id = ?';
  if (!includeRetired) {
    query += ' AND is_retired = 0';
  }
  query += ' ORDER BY updated_at_utc DESC';

  const rows = db.prepare(query).all(profileId) as any[];
  return rows.map(row => {
    const normQuery = JSON.parse(row.normalized_query_json);
    return {
      view_id: row.view_id,
      name: row.name,
      profile_id: row.profile_id,
      normalized_query: normQuery,
      metrics: JSON.parse(row.metrics_json),
      display_preferences: JSON.parse(row.display_preferences_json),
      current_snapshot_id: row.current_snapshot_id,
      optimistic_revision: row.optimistic_revision,
      is_retired: Boolean(row.is_retired),
      selected_session_ids: row.selected_session_ids_json ? JSON.parse(row.selected_session_ids_json) : undefined,
      window_references: row.window_references_json ? JSON.parse(row.window_references_json) : undefined,
      user_notes: row.user_notes !== undefined ? row.user_notes : undefined,
      cross_plan_provenance: normQuery?.cross_plan_provenance || undefined,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
    };
  });
}

export function getSavedLongitudinalViewHistory(viewId: string): SavedLongitudinalViewHistoryRecord[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_view_history
    WHERE view_id = ?
    ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC
  `).all(viewId) as any[];

  return rows.map(r => ({

    snapshot_id: r.snapshot_id,
    change_type: r.change_type,
    draft_query: r.draft_query_json ? JSON.parse(r.draft_query_json) : null,
    created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
  }));
}

export function appendSavedLongitudinalViewHistory(record: {
  history_id: string;
  view_id: string;
  revision_number?: number;
  optimistic_revision?: number;
  snapshot_id?: string | null;
  change_type?: string;
  view_name?: string;
  query_json?: string;
  metrics_json?: string;
  display_preferences_json?: string;
  user_notes?: string;
  created_at_utc?: string;
}): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const rev = record.revision_number !== undefined
    ? record.revision_number
    : (record.optimistic_revision !== undefined ? record.optimistic_revision : 1);

  db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
      history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id, change_type,
      view_name, query_json, metrics_json, display_preferences_json, user_notes, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).run(
    record.history_id,
    record.view_id,
    rev,
    record.snapshot_id ?? null,
    record.change_type ?? 'updated',
    record.view_name ?? null,
    record.query_json ?? null,
    record.metrics_json ?? null,
    record.display_preferences_json ?? null,
    record.user_notes ?? null,
    record.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  );
}

export class CurationRevisionConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly viewId: string,
    public readonly expectedRevision: number,
    public readonly currentRevision: number
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'CurationRevisionConflictError';
  }
}

export class IdempotencyPayloadConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly idempotencyKey: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'IdempotencyPayloadConflictError';
  }
}

export function getSavedViewCuration(viewId: string): { is_favorite: boolean; curation_revision: number; updated_at_utc: string } | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT is_favorite, curation_revision, updated_at_utc FROM saved_view_curation WHERE view_id = ?').get(viewId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    is_favorite: Boolean(row.is_favorite),
    curation_revision: Number(row.curation_revision),
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  };
}

export function setSavedViewFavoriteWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  viewId: string,
  isFavorite: boolean,
  idempotencyKey: string,
  expectedRevision?: number
): { is_favorite: boolean; curation_revision: number; updated_at_utc: string } {
  const db = getDb();

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // 1. Check idempotency record
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM saved_view_curation_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, idempotencyKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.view_id === viewId && Boolean(idempRow.is_favorite) === isFavorite) {
        return {
          is_favorite: Boolean(idempRow.is_favorite),
          curation_revision: Number(idempRow.curation_revision),
          updated_at_utc: idempRow.created_at_utc
        };
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with a different favorite payload`,
          idempotencyKey
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. Verify view exists and belongs to profile
    const viewRow = db.prepare('SELECT view_id, profile_id FROM saved_longitudinal_views WHERE view_id = ?').get(viewId) as any;
    if (!viewRow) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' not found`);
    }
    if (viewRow.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${viewRow.profile_id}', not '${profileId}'`);
    }

    // 3. Check existing curation & CAS revision
    const curRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM saved_view_curation WHERE view_id = ?').get(viewId) as any;
    const currentRev = curRow ? Number(curRow.curation_revision) : 1;

    if (expectedRevision !== undefined && curRow && currentRev !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new CurationRevisionConflictError(
        `Curation revision conflict on view '${viewId}': expected ${expectedRevision}, current is ${currentRev}`,
        viewId,
        expectedRevision,
        currentRev
      );
    }

    const nextRev = curRow ? currentRev + 1 : 1;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO saved_view_curation (view_id, profile_id, is_favorite, curation_revision, updated_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(view_id) DO UPDATE SET
        is_favorite = excluded.is_favorite,
        curation_revision = excluded.curation_revision,
        updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
    `).run(viewId, profileId, isFavorite ? 1 : 0, nextRev, now);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO saved_view_curation_idempotency (profile_id, idempotency_key, view_id, is_favorite, curation_revision, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, idempotencyKey, viewId, isFavorite ? 1 : 0, nextRev, now);

    return {
      is_favorite: isFavorite,
      curation_revision: nextRev,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };
  })();
}

export function archiveSavedReviewWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  viewId: string,
  expectedRevision: number,
  reason?: string
): { view_id: string; is_retired: boolean; optimistic_revision: number; retired_at_utc: string } {
  const db = getDb();
  return db.transaction(() => {
    const existing = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (existing.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${existing.profile_id}', not '${profileId}'`);
    }

    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new ViewRevisionConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on view '${viewId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, but database is at revision ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        viewId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision,
        existing,
        `hist-archive-conflict-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE saved_longitudinal_views
      SET is_retired = 1, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(nextRev, now, viewId, expectedRevision);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO saved_longitudinal_view_history (
        history_id, view_id, optimistic_revision, snapshot_id,
        change_type, draft_query_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      `hist-archive-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      viewId,
      nextRev,
      existing.current_snapshot_id ?? null,
      'retired',
      reason ? JSON.stringify({ reason }) : null,
      now
    );

    return {
      view_id: viewId,
      is_retired: true,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      retired_at_utc: now
    };
  })();
}

  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly viewId: string,

  }

export function getReviewCollection(collectionId: string): ReviewCollection | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM review_collections WHERE collection_id = ?').get(collectionId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  const memberCountRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM review_collection_members WHERE collection_id = ?').get(collectionId) as any;
  return {
    collection_id: row.collection_id,
    owning_profile: row.owning_profile,
    title: row.title,
    description: row.description || null,
    optimistic_revision: Number(row.optimistic_revision),
    is_archived: Boolean(row.is_archived),
    member_count: Number(memberCountRow?.cnt) || 0,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  };
}

export function listReviewCollections(
  profileId: string,
  includeArchived = false,
  search?: string
): ReviewCollectionSummaryCard[] {
  const db = getDb();
  let sql = `
    SELECT c.*,
           COUNT(m.view_id) AS member_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN v.is_retired = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_member_count
    FROM review_collections c
    LEFT JOIN review_collection_members m ON c.collection_id = m.collection_id
    LEFT JOIN saved_longitudinal_views v ON m.view_id = v.view_id
    WHERE c.owning_profile = ?
  `;
  const params: any[] = [profileId];

  if (!includeArchived) {
    sql += ' AND c.is_archived = 0';
  }

  sql += ' GROUP BY c.collection_id ORDER BY c.updated_at_utc DESC';

  const rows = db.prepare(sql).all(...params) as any[];
  const searchLower = search ? search.trim().toLowerCase() : null;

  const results: ReviewCollectionSummaryCard[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (searchLower && (!r.title || !r.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower))) {
      continue;
    }
    results.push({
      collection_id: r.collection_id,
      owning_profile: r.owning_profile,
      title: r.title,
      description: r.description || null,
      optimistic_revision: Number(r.optimistic_revision),
      is_archived: Boolean(r.is_archived),
      member_count: Number(r.member_count) || 0,
      active_member_count: Number(r.active_member_count) || 0,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: r.updated_at_utc
    });
  }

  return results;
}

  const db = getDb();

  `).all(collectionId) as any[];

    pinned_revision_number: r.pinned_revision_number !== null && r.pinned_revision_number !== undefined ? Number(r.pinned_revision_number) : null,
    position: Number(r.position),
    added_at_utc: r.added_at_utc
  }));
}

function verifyPinnedRevisionExists(
  db: any,
  viewId: string,
  pinnedRevisionId: string | null,
  pinnedRevisionNumber: number | null
): { resolvedId: string; resolvedNumber: number } {
  // Check in saved_longitudinal_view_history or current view
  let histRow: any = null;
  if (pinnedRevisionId) {
    histRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_view_history
      WHERE view_id = ? AND history_id = ?
    `).get(viewId, pinnedRevisionId) as any;
  }
  if (!histRow && pinnedRevisionNumber !== null) {
    histRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_view_history
      WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
      ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(viewId, pinnedRevisionNumber) as any;
  }

  if (histRow) {
    if (!histRow.snapshot_id && !histRow.draft_query_json && !histRow.query_json) {
      throw new CollectionIncompleteRevisionError(
        `Historical revision '${pinnedRevisionId || pinnedRevisionNumber}' for view '${viewId}' is incomplete (missing snapshot/query)`,
        viewId,
        pinnedRevisionId || pinnedRevisionNumber || 0
      );
    }
    return {
      resolvedId: histRow.history_id,
      resolvedNumber: Number(histRow.revision || histRow.optimistic_revision || pinnedRevisionNumber || 1)
    };
  }

  // Also check if current view matches pinned revision
  const currentView = db.prepare('SELECT optimistic_revision, current_snapshot_id FROM saved_longitudinal_views WHERE view_id = ?').get(viewId) as any;
  if (currentView && pinnedRevisionNumber !== null && Number(currentView.optimistic_revision) === pinnedRevisionNumber) {
    return {
      resolvedId: pinnedRevisionId || `rev-${pinnedRevisionNumber}`,
      resolvedNumber: pinnedRevisionNumber
    };
  }

  throw new CollectionIncompleteRevisionError(
    `Pinned revision '${pinnedRevisionId || pinnedRevisionNumber}' not found in revision history for view '${viewId}'`,
    viewId,
    pinnedRevisionId || pinnedRevisionNumber || 0
  );
}

export function createReviewCollectionWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  req: CreateReviewCollectionRequest
): ReviewCollection {
  const db = getDb();
  const title = req.title.trim();
  const description = req.description ? req.description.trim() : null;
  const idempotencyKey = (req.idempotency_key && req.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? req.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, title, description })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM review_collection_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, idempotencyKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json) as ReviewCollection;
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with a different collection payload`,
          idempotencyKey
        );
      }
    }

    const collectionId = `col-${randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newCollection: ReviewCollection = {
      collection_id: collectionId,
      owning_profile: profileId,
      title,
      description,
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      is_archived: false,
      member_count: 0,
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO review_collections (collection_id, owning_profile, title, description, optimistic_revision, is_archived, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 0, ?, ?)
    `).run(collectionId, profileId, newCollection.title, newCollection.description, now, now);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO review_collection_idempotency (profile_id, idempotency_key, collection_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'create', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, idempotencyKey, collectionId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(newCollection), now);

    return newCollection;
  })();
}

export function updateReviewCollectionWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  req: UpdateReviewCollectionRequest
): ReviewCollection {
  const db = getDb();
  const { collection_id: collectionId, expected_revision: expectedRevision } = req;
  const idempotencyKey = (req.idempotency_key && req.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? req.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, collectionId, expectedRevision, title: req.title, description: req.description })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM review_collection_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, idempotencyKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json) as ReviewCollection;
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with a different collection payload`,
          idempotencyKey
        );
      }
    }

    const existing = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new CollectionNotFoundError(`Collection '${collectionId}' not found`, collectionId);
    }
    if (existing.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CollectionForbiddenError(`Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${existing.owning_profile}', not '${profileId}'`, collectionId);
    }
    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new CollectionRevisionConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on collection '${collectionId}': expected ${expectedRevision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        collectionId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const updatedTitle = req.title !== undefined ? req.title.trim() : existing.title;
    const updatedDesc = req.description !== undefined ? (req.description ? req.description.trim() : null) : existing.description;
    const updatedCollection: ReviewCollection = {
      ...existing,
      title: updatedTitle,
      description: updatedDesc,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE review_collections
      SET title = ?, description = ?, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE collection_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(updatedCollection.title, updatedCollection.description, nextRev, now, collectionId, expectedRevision);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO review_collection_idempotency (profile_id, idempotency_key, collection_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'update', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, idempotencyKey, collectionId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(updatedCollection), now);

    return updatedCollection;
  })();
}

export function setReviewCollectionMembersWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  req: SetReviewCollectionMembersRequest
): { collection: ReviewCollection; members: ReviewCollectionMember[] } {
  const db = getDb();
  const { collection_id: collectionId, expected_revision: expectedRevision, members: memberItems } = req;
  const idempotencyKey = (req.idempotency_key && req.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? req.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, collectionId, expectedRevision, memberItems })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM review_collection_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, idempotencyKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json);
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with a different collection payload`,
          idempotencyKey
        );
      }
    }

    const existing = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new CollectionNotFoundError(`Collection '${collectionId}' not found`, collectionId);
    }
    if (existing.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CollectionForbiddenError(`Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${existing.owning_profile}', not '${profileId}'`, collectionId);
    }
    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new CollectionRevisionConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on collection '${collectionId}': expected ${expectedRevision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        collectionId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    // Verify all member views exist and belong to profile
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const verifiedMembers: ReviewCollectionMember[] = [];

    for (let pos = 0; pos < memberItems.length; pos++) {
      const item = memberItems[pos];
      const viewRow = db.prepare('SELECT view_id, profile_id FROM saved_longitudinal_views WHERE view_id = ?').get(item.view_id) as any;
      if (!viewRow) {
        throw new Error(`Saved view '${item.view_id}' not found in database`);
      }
      if (viewRow.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CollectionForbiddenError(`Saved view '${item.view_id}' belongs to profile '${viewRow.profile_id}', not '${profileId}'`, collectionId);
      }

      let pinnedId = item.pinned_revision_id || null;
      let pinnedNum = item.pinned_revision_number !== undefined && item.pinned_revision_number !== null ? item.pinned_revision_number : null;

      if (item.reference_mode === 'pin_revision') {
        const verifiedRev = verifyPinnedRevisionExists(db, item.view_id, pinnedId, pinnedNum);
        pinnedId = verifiedRev.resolvedId;
        pinnedNum = verifiedRev.resolvedNumber;
      }

      verifiedMembers.push({
        collection_id: collectionId,
        view_id: item.view_id,
        reference_mode: item.reference_mode,
        pinned_revision_id: pinnedId,
        pinned_revision_number: pinnedNum,
        position: pos + 1,
        added_at_utc: now
      });
    }

    // Delete existing members
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM review_collection_members WHERE collection_id = ?').run(collectionId);

    // Insert new members in exact order
    const insertMember = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO review_collection_members (collection_id, view_id, reference_mode, pinned_revision_id, pinned_revision_number, position, added_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);

    for (const vm of verifiedMembers) {
      insertMember.run(
        vm.collection_id,
        vm.view_id,
        vm.reference_mode,
        vm.pinned_revision_id || '',
        vm.pinned_revision_number,
        vm.position,
        vm.added_at_utc
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE review_collections
      SET optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE collection_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(nextRev, now, collectionId, expectedRevision);

    const updatedCollection: ReviewCollection = {
      ...existing,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      member_count: verifiedMembers.length,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    const result = {
      collection: updatedCollection,
      members: verifiedMembers
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO review_collection_idempotency (profile_id, idempotency_key, collection_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'set_members', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, idempotencyKey, collectionId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(result), now);

    return result;
  })();
}

export function addReviewCollectionMemberWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  req: AddReviewCollectionMemberRequest
): { collection: ReviewCollection; members: ReviewCollectionMember[] } {
  const currentMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(req.collection_id);
  const mode = req.reference_mode === 'pin_revision' ? 'pin_revision' : 'follow_latest';
  const newMemberItem: SetReviewCollectionMemberItem = {
    view_id: req.view_id,
    reference_mode: mode,
    pinned_revision_id: req.pinned_revision_id,
    pinned_revision_number: req.pinned_revision_number
  };

  const existingItems: SetReviewCollectionMemberItem[] = currentMembers.map(m => ({
    view_id: m.view_id,
    reference_mode: m.reference_mode,
    pinned_revision_id: m.pinned_revision_id,
    pinned_revision_number: m.pinned_revision_number
  }));

  // Append at end
  const combined = [...existingItems, newMemberItem];
  const setReq: SetReviewCollectionMembersRequest = {
    profile_id: profileId,
    collection_id: req.collection_id,
    expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
    members: combined,
    idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key
  };
  return setReviewCollectionMembersWithCas(profileId, setReq);
}

export function removeReviewCollectionMemberWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  req: RemoveReviewCollectionMemberRequest
): { collection: ReviewCollection; members: ReviewCollectionMember[] } {
  const currentMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(req.collection_id);
  const filtered = currentMembers.filter(m => {
    if (m.view_id !== req.view_id) return true;
    if (req.reference_mode && m.reference_mode !== req.reference_mode) return true;
    if (req.pinned_revision_id !== undefined && (m.pinned_revision_id || '') !== (req.pinned_revision_id || '')) return true;
    return false;
  });

  const memberItems: SetReviewCollectionMemberItem[] = filtered.map(m => ({
    view_id: m.view_id,
    reference_mode: m.reference_mode,
    pinned_revision_id: m.pinned_revision_id,
    pinned_revision_number: m.pinned_revision_number
  }));

  const setReq: SetReviewCollectionMembersRequest = {
    profile_id: profileId,
    collection_id: req.collection_id,
    expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
    members: memberItems,
    idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key
  };
  return setReviewCollectionMembersWithCas(profileId, setReq);
}

export function saveCollectionComparisonReport(report: CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO collection_comparison_reports (
      report_id,
      manifest_id,
      collection_id,
      collection_revision,
      profile_id,
      format,
      filename,
      staging_path,
      published_path,
      size_bytes,
      sha256,
      status,
      status_reason,
      dependency_digest,
      selected_member_count,
      selected_members_json,
      resolved_member_revisions_json,
      privacy_options_json,
      request_payload_hash,
      idempotency_key,
      is_available,
      created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(report_id) DO UPDATE SET
      manifest_id = excluded.manifest_id,
      published_path = excluded.published_path,
      size_bytes = excluded.size_bytes,
      sha256 = excluded.sha256,
      status = excluded.status,
      status_reason = excluded.status_reason,
      is_available = excluded.is_available,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  stmt.run(
    report.report_id,
    report.manifest_id,
    report.collection_id,
    report.collection_revision,
    report.profile_id,
    report.format,
    report.filename,
    report.staging_path,
    report.published_path || null,
    report.size_bytes,
    report.sha256,
    report.status,
    report.status_reason || null,
    report.dependency_digest,
    report.selected_member_count,
    JSON.stringify(report.selected_members),
    JSON.stringify(report.resolved_member_revisions),
    JSON.stringify(report.privacy_options),
    report.request_payload_hash,
    report.idempotency_key || null,
    report.is_available ? 1 : 0,
    report.created_at_utc || now,
    now
  );
}

function mapRowToReportDetail(row: any): CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail {
  return {
    report_id: row.report_id,
    manifest_id: row.manifest_id,
    collection_id: row.collection_id,
    collection_revision: Number(row.collection_revision),
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    format: row.format as ProgressReviewReportFormat,
    filename: row.filename,
    staging_path: row.staging_path,
    published_path: row.published_path || null,
    size_bytes: Number(row.size_bytes),
    sha256: row.sha256,
    status: row.status as CollectionComparisonReportStatus,
    status_reason: row.status_reason || undefined,
    dependency_digest: row.dependency_digest,
    selected_member_count: Number(row.selected_member_count),
    selected_members: row.selected_members_json ? JSON.parse(row.selected_members_json) : [],
    resolved_member_revisions: row.resolved_member_revisions_json ? JSON.parse(row.resolved_member_revisions_json) : {},
    privacy_options: row.privacy_options_json ? JSON.parse(row.privacy_options_json) : {
      exclude_raw_signals: true,
      exclude_notes: true,
      exclude_paths: true,
      exclude_direct_identifiers: true
    },
    request_payload_hash: row.request_payload_hash,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key || null,
    is_available: Boolean(row.is_available),
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
  };
}
