export function updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(
  reportId: string,
  status: CollectionComparisonReportStatus,
  statusReason?: string,
  isAvailable?: boolean
): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let sql = 'UPDATE collection_comparison_reports SET status = ?, updated_at_utc = ?';
  const params: any[] = [status, now];
  if (statusReason !== undefined) {
    sql += ', status_reason = ?';
    params.push(statusReason);
  }
  if (isAvailable !== undefined) {
    sql += ', is_available = ?';
    params.push(isAvailable ? 1 : 0);
  }
  sql += ' WHERE report_id = ?';
  params.push(reportId);
  db.prepare(sql).run(...params);
}

export function queryCollectionComparisonReports(options: {
  profileId?: string;
  collectionId?: string;
  format?: string;
  status?: string;
  limit?: number;
  cursor?: string;
}): { reports: CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail[]; total_count: number; has_more: boolean; next_cursor: string | null } {
  const db = getDb();
  const whereClauses: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (options.collectionId) {
    whereClauses.push('collection_id = ?');
    params.push(options.collectionId);
  }
  if (options.profileId) {
    whereClauses.push('profile_id = ?');
    params.push(options.profileId);
  }
  if (options.format && options.format !== 'all') {
    whereClauses.push('format = ?');
    params.push(options.format);
  }
  if (options.status && options.status !== 'all') {
    whereClauses.push('status = ?');
    params.push(options.status);
  }

  const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';

  const countRow = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM collection_comparison_reports ${whereSql}`).get(...params) as { total: number };
  const totalCount = countRow ? countRow.total : 0;

  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, options.limit || 20));
  let cursorSql = '';
  const queryParams = [...params];

  if (options.cursor) {
    const cursorClause = whereClauses.length > 0 ? 'AND created_at_utc < ?' : 'WHERE created_at_utc < ?';
    cursorSql = cursorClause;
    queryParams.push(options.cursor);
  }

  queryParams.push(limit + 1);

  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM collection_comparison_reports
    ${whereSql} ${cursorSql}
    ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC
    LIMIT ?
  `).all(...queryParams) as any[];

  const hasMore = rows.length > limit;
  const sliced = rows.slice(0, limit);
  const nextCursor = hasMore && sliced.length > 0 ? sliced[sliced.length - 1].created_at_utc : null;

  return {
    reports: sliced.map(mapRowToReportDetail),
    total_count: totalCount,
    has_more: hasMore,
    next_cursor: nextCursor
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// Profile-Wide Report Reading Inbox Database Access (wi-6b7c0ad318964d3c80f87c90f58cdf16)
// ============================================================================

export function queryProfileReadingInbox(
  profileId: string,
  options: ProfileReportReadingInboxQuery
): ProfileReportReadingInboxPage {
  const db = getDb();

  // Base scope: enforce profile ownership on both reports and their containing collections
  const whereClauses: string[] = ['ccr.profile_id = ?', 'rc.owning_profile = ?'];
  const params: any[] = [profileId, profileId];

  if (options.collection_id) {
    whereClauses.push('ccr.collection_id = ?');
    params.push(options.collection_id);
  }

  if (options.format && options.format !== 'all') {
    whereClauses.push('ccr.format = ?');
    params.push(options.format);
  }

  if (options.from_date) {
    whereClauses.push('ccr.created_at_utc >= ?');
    params.push(options.from_date);
  }

  if (options.to_date) {
    whereClauses.push('ccr.created_at_utc <= ?');
    params.push(options.to_date);
  }

  if (options.reading_state && options.reading_state !== 'all') {
    if (options.reading_state === 'read_by_user') {
      whereClauses.push("ccrn.reading_state = 'read_by_user'");
    } else if (options.reading_state === 'not_marked') {
      whereClauses.push("(ccrn.reading_state IS NULL OR ccrn.reading_state = 'not_marked')");
    }
  }

  if (options.tag) {
    whereClauses.push("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(ccrn.tags_json) WHERE LOWER(value) = LOWER(?))");
    params.push(options.tag);
  }

  if (options.search_term) {
    // Privacy Retention Invariant: Search ONLY by safe collection title or report filename, NEVER in private notes
    const rawPattern = `%${options.search_term}%`;
    const lowerPattern = `%${options.search_term.toLowerCase()}%`;
    whereClauses.push("(rc.title LIKE ? OR LOWER(rc.title) LIKE ? OR rc.title LIKE ? OR ccr.filename LIKE ? OR LOWER(ccr.filename) LIKE ?)");
    params.push(rawPattern, lowerPattern, lowerPattern, rawPattern, lowerPattern);
  }

  if (options.status && options.status !== 'all') {
    if (options.status === 'historical') {
      whereClauses.push("(ccr.status = 'historical' OR rc.optimistic_revision > ccr.collection_revision)");
    } else if (options.status === 'unavailable') {
      whereClauses.push("(ccr.status = 'unavailable' OR ccr.is_available = 0)");
    } else if (options.status === 'current') {
      whereClauses.push("(ccr.status = 'current' AND rc.optimistic_revision <= ccr.collection_revision AND ccr.is_available = 1)");
    } else if (options.status === 'integrity_failed') {
      whereClauses.push("ccr.status = 'integrity_failed'");
    } else {
      whereClauses.push("ccr.status = ?");
      params.push(options.status);
    }
  }

  const whereSql = `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}`;

  // 1. Calculate filtered total count
  const countRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ccr.report_id) as total
    FROM collection_comparison_reports ccr
    INNER JOIN review_collections rc ON rc.collection_id = ccr.collection_id AND rc.owning_profile = ccr.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN collection_comparison_report_notes ccrn ON ccrn.report_id = ccr.report_id AND ccrn.profile_id = ccr.profile_id
    ${whereSql}
  `).get(...params) as { total: number };
  const totalCount = countRow ? countRow.total : 0;

  // 2. Deterministic cursor pagination with tie-breaker
  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, options.limit || 20));
  let cursorSql = '';
  const queryParams = [...params];

  if (options.cursor) {
    let cursorCreatedAt: string | null = null;
    let cursorReportId: string | null = null;

    try {
      const decoded = Buffer.from(options.cursor, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
      const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.created_at_utc === 'string' && typeof parsed.report_id === 'string') {
        cursorCreatedAt = parsed.created_at_utc;
        cursorReportId = parsed.report_id;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      cursorCreatedAt = options.cursor;
    }

    if (cursorCreatedAt) {
      if (cursorReportId) {
        cursorSql = 'AND (ccr.created_at_utc < ? OR (ccr.created_at_utc = ? AND ccr.report_id < ?))';
        queryParams.push(cursorCreatedAt, cursorCreatedAt, cursorReportId);
      } else {
        cursorSql = 'AND ccr.created_at_utc < ?';
        queryParams.push(cursorCreatedAt);
      }
    }
  }

  queryParams.push(limit + 1);

  // 3. Single SQL query: LEFT JOIN notes, strictly redact note text column
  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT
      ccr.report_id,
      ccr.manifest_id,
      ccr.collection_id,
      rc.title as collection_title,
      rc.optimistic_revision as rc_revision,
      ccr.collection_revision,
      ccr.profile_id,
      ccr.format,
      ccr.filename,
      ccr.staging_path,
      ccr.published_path,
      ccr.size_bytes,
      ccr.sha256,
      ccr.status as report_status,
      ccr.status_reason,
      ccr.is_available,
      ccr.dependency_digest,
      ccr.selected_member_count,
      ccr.created_at_utc,
      ccrn.reading_state,
      ccrn.read_at_utc,
      ccrn.tags_json,
      ccrn.optimistic_revision as note_revision
    FROM collection_comparison_reports ccr
    INNER JOIN review_collections rc ON rc.collection_id = ccr.collection_id AND rc.owning_profile = ccr.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN collection_comparison_report_notes ccrn ON ccrn.report_id = ccr.report_id AND ccrn.profile_id = ccr.profile_id
    ${whereSql} ${cursorSql}
    ORDER BY ccr.created_at_utc DESC, ccr.report_id DESC
    LIMIT ?
  `).all(...queryParams) as any[];

  const hasMore = rows.length > limit;
  const sliced = rows.slice(0, limit);

  const items: ProfileReportReadingInboxItem[] = sliced.map(row => {
    const filePath = row.published_path || row.staging_path;
    let fileExists = false;
    if (filePath) {
      try {
        fileExists = fs.existsSync(filePath);
      } catch (_) {
        fileExists = false;
      }
    }

    let dynamicStatus: CollectionComparisonReportStatus = row.report_status;
    let dynamicReason = row.status_reason;
    let isAvailable = fileExists;

    if (!fileExists) {
      dynamicStatus = 'unavailable';
      dynamicReason = 'Artifact file missing on disk';
      isAvailable = false;
    } else if (Number(row.rc_revision) > Number(row.collection_revision)) {
      dynamicStatus = 'historical';
      dynamicReason = 'Collection revision has evolved';
    }

    let parsedTags: string[] = [];
    if (row.tags_json) {
      try {
        parsedTags = JSON.parse(row.tags_json);
      } catch (_) {
        parsedTags = [];
      }
    }

    return {
      report_id: row.report_id,
      manifest_id: row.manifest_id,
      collection_id: row.collection_id,
      collection_title: row.collection_title || '',
      collection_revision: Number(row.collection_revision),
      profile_id: row.profile_id,
      format: row.format as ProgressReviewReportFormat,
      filename: row.filename,
      size_bytes: Number(row.size_bytes),
      sha256: row.sha256,
      status: dynamicStatus,
      status_reason: dynamicReason || null,
      is_available: isAvailable,
      dependency_digest: row.dependency_digest,
      selected_member_count: Number(row.selected_member_count),
      reading_state: (row.reading_state as ReportReadingState) || 'not_marked',
      read_at_utc: row.read_at_utc || null,
      tags: parsedTags,
      note_revision: row.note_revision ? Number(row.note_revision) : 1,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
    };
  });

  const nextCursor = hasMore && sliced.length > 0
    ? Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
        created_at_utc: sliced[sliced.length - 1].created_at_utc,
        report_id: sliced[sliced.length - 1].report_id
      })).toString('base64')
    : null;

  // 4. Compute profile aggregate summary statistics across all unique reports owned by athlete
  const summaryRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT ccr.report_id) as total_reports,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccrn.reading_state = 'read_by_user' THEN ccr.report_id END) as read_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccrn.reading_state IS NULL OR ccrn.reading_state = 'not_marked' THEN ccr.report_id END) as unread_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.status = 'historical' OR rc.optimistic_revision > ccr.collection_revision THEN ccr.report_id END) as historical_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.is_available = 0 OR ccr.status = 'unavailable' THEN ccr.report_id END) as unavailable_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.status = 'integrity_failed' THEN ccr.report_id END) as integrity_failed_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.format = 'html' THEN ccr.report_id END) as html_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.format = 'csv' THEN ccr.report_id END) as csv_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccr.format = 'json' THEN ccr.report_id END) as json_count
    FROM collection_comparison_reports ccr
    INNER JOIN review_collections rc ON rc.collection_id = ccr.collection_id AND rc.owning_profile = ccr.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN collection_comparison_report_notes ccrn ON ccrn.report_id = ccr.report_id AND ccrn.profile_id = ccr.profile_id
    WHERE ccr.profile_id = ?
  `).get(profileId) as any;

  const summary: ProfileReportReadingInboxSummary = {
    total_reports: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.total_reports || 0) : 0,
    read_by_user_count: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.read_count || 0) : 0,
    not_marked_count: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.unread_count || 0) : 0,
    historical_count: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.historical_count || 0) : 0,
    unavailable_count: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.unavailable_count || 0) : 0,
    integrity_failed_count: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.integrity_failed_count || 0) : 0,
    format_counts: {
      html: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.html_count || 0) : 0,
      csv: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.csv_count || 0) : 0,
      json: summaryRow ? Number(summaryRow.json_count || 0) : 0
    }
  };

  return {
    profile_id: profileId,
    summary,
    total_count: totalCount,
    has_more: hasMore,
    next_cursor: nextCursor,
    reports: items
  };
}

  };
}

export function saveReportReadingNoteWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  reportId: string,
  collectionId: string,
  manifestId: string,
  expectedRevision: number,
  note: string | null,
  tags: string[],
  idempotencyKey?: string
): { noteRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord; isIdempotentReplay: boolean } {
  const db = getDb();
  const actualIdempKey = (idempotencyKey && idempotencyKey.trim() !== '')
    ? idempotencyKey.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, reportId, expectedRevision, note, tags })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, actualIdempKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return { noteRecord: JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json), isIdempotentReplay: true };
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${actualIdempKey}' was already used with a different notebook payload`,
          actualIdempKey
        );
      }
    }

    const existing = getReportReadingNote(reportId, profileId);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (!existing) {
      if (expectedRevision !== 1) {
        throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
          `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading note for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, but note record does not exist (current is 1)`,
          reportId,
          expectedRevision,
          1
        );
      }

      const nextRev = 2;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_notes (
          report_id, profile_id, collection_id, manifest_id, reading_state,
          note, tags_json, optimistic_revision, read_at_utc, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'not_marked', ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        reportId, profileId, collectionId, manifestId,
        note, JSON.stringify(tags), nextRev, now, now
      );

      // Record history (note text omitted for privacy retention)
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_history (
          history_id, report_id, profile_id, revision, change_type, reading_state, tags_count, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'created', 'not_marked', ?, ?)
      `).run(`hist_note_${randomUUID()}`, reportId, profileId, nextRev, tags.length, now);

      const createdRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord = {
        report_id: reportId,
        profile_id: profileId,
        collection_id: collectionId,
        manifest_id: manifestId,
        reading_state: 'not_marked',
        note,
        tags,
        optimistic_revision: nextRev,
        read_at_utc: null,
        created_at_utc: now,
        updated_at_utc: now
      };

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency (
          profile_id, idempotency_key, report_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'update_note', ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(profileId, actualIdempKey, reportId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(createdRecord), now);

      return { noteRecord: createdRecord, isIdempotentReplay: false };
    }

    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading note for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        reportId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE collection_comparison_report_notes
      SET note = ?, tags_json = ?, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE report_id = ? AND profile_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(note, JSON.stringify(tags), nextRev, now, reportId, profileId, expectedRevision);

    // Record history (note text omitted for privacy retention)
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_history (
        history_id, report_id, profile_id, revision, change_type, reading_state, tags_count, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'updated', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(`hist_note_${randomUUID()}`, reportId, profileId, nextRev, existing.reading_state, tags.length, now);

    const updatedRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord = {
      ...existing,
      note,
      tags,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency (
        profile_id, idempotency_key, report_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'update_note', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, actualIdempKey, reportId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(updatedRecord), now);

    return { noteRecord: updatedRecord, isIdempotentReplay: false };
  })();
}

export function clearReportReadingNoteWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  reportId: string,
  expectedRevision: number,
  idempotencyKey?: string
): { noteRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord; isIdempotentReplay: boolean } {
  const db = getDb();
  const actualIdempKey = (idempotencyKey && idempotencyKey.trim() !== '')
    ? idempotencyKey.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, reportId, expectedRevision, action: 'clear' })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, actualIdempKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return { noteRecord: JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json), isIdempotentReplay: true };
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${actualIdempKey}' was already used with a different notebook payload`,
          actualIdempKey
        );
      }
    }

    const existing = getReportReadingNote(reportId, profileId);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading note for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, but note record does not exist`,
        reportId,
        expectedRevision,
        1
      );
    }

    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading note for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        reportId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE collection_comparison_report_notes
      SET note = NULL, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE report_id = ? AND profile_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(nextRev, now, reportId, profileId, expectedRevision);

    // Record history: change_type 'cleared', note text is strictly null/omitted
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_history (
        history_id, report_id, profile_id, revision, change_type, reading_state, tags_count, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'cleared', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(`hist_note_${randomUUID()}`, reportId, profileId, nextRev, existing.reading_state, existing.tags.length, now);

    const clearedRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord = {
      ...existing,
      note: null,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency (
        profile_id, idempotency_key, report_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'clear_note', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, actualIdempKey, reportId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(clearedRecord), now);

    return { noteRecord: clearedRecord, isIdempotentReplay: false };
  })();
}

export function setReportReadingStateWithCas(
  profileId: string,
  reportId: string,
  collectionId: string,
  manifestId: string,
  readingState: ReportReadingState,
  expectedRevision: number,
  idempotencyKey?: string
): { noteRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord; isIdempotentReplay: boolean } {
  const db = getDb();
  const actualIdempKey = (idempotencyKey && idempotencyKey.trim() !== '')
    ? idempotencyKey.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;
  const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ profileId, reportId, readingState, expectedRevision })).digest('hex');

  return db.transaction(() => {
    // Check idempotency
    const idempRow = db.prepare(
      'SELECT * FROM collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
    ).get(profileId, actualIdempKey) as any;

    if (idempRow) {
      if (idempRow.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        return { noteRecord: JSON.parse(idempRow.response_json), isIdempotentReplay: true };
      } else {
        throw new IdempotencyPayloadConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${actualIdempKey}' was already used with a different notebook payload`,
          actualIdempKey
        );
      }
    }

    const existing = getReportReadingNote(reportId, profileId);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const readAtUtc = readingState === 'read_by_user' ? now : null;

    if (!existing) {
      if (expectedRevision !== 1) {
        throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
          `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading state for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, but note record does not exist (current is 1)`,
          reportId,
          expectedRevision,
          1
        );
      }

      const nextRev = 2;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_notes (
          report_id, profile_id, collection_id, manifest_id, reading_state,
          note, tags_json, optimistic_revision, read_at_utc, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, '[]', ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        reportId, profileId, collectionId, manifestId, readingState,
        nextRev, readAtUtc, now, now
      );

      const changeType = readingState === 'read_by_user' ? 'marked_read' : 'unmarked_read';
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_history (
          history_id, report_id, profile_id, revision, change_type, reading_state, tags_count, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)
      `).run(`hist_note_${randomUUID()}`, reportId, profileId, nextRev, changeType, readingState, now);

      const createdRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord = {
        report_id: reportId,
        profile_id: profileId,
        collection_id: collectionId,
        manifest_id: manifestId,
        reading_state: readingState,
        note: null,
        tags: [],
        optimistic_revision: nextRev,
        read_at_utc: readAtUtc,
        created_at_utc: now,
        updated_at_utc: now
      };

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency (
          profile_id, idempotency_key, report_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'set_reading_state', ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(profileId, actualIdempKey, reportId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(createdRecord), now);

      return { noteRecord: createdRecord, isIdempotentReplay: false };
    }

    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new ReportNoteConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Optimistic concurrency conflict on reading state for report '${reportId}': expected revision ${expectedRevision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}`,
        reportId,
        expectedRevision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    const nextRev = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE collection_comparison_report_notes
      SET reading_state = ?, read_at_utc = ?, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE report_id = ? AND profile_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
    `).run(readingState, readAtUtc, nextRev, now, reportId, profileId, expectedRevision);

    const changeType = readingState === 'read_by_user' ? 'marked_read' : 'unmarked_read';
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_history (
        history_id, report_id, profile_id, revision, change_type, reading_state, tags_count, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(`hist_note_${randomUUID()}`, reportId, profileId, nextRev, changeType, readingState, existing.tags.length, now);

    const updatedRecord: ReportReadingNoteRecord = {
      ...existing,
      reading_state: readingState,
      read_at_utc: readAtUtc,
      optimistic_revision: nextRev,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO collection_comparison_report_note_idempotency (
        profile_id, idempotency_key, report_id, action, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'set_reading_state', ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(profileId, actualIdempKey, reportId, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(updatedRecord), now);

    return { noteRecord: updatedRecord, isIdempotentReplay: false };
  })();
}

export class ReportCheckInLinkConcurrencyConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly linkId: string,
    public readonly expectedRevision: number,
    public readonly currentRevision: number
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ReportCheckInLinkConcurrencyConflictError';
  }
}

      timezone, segment_id, status, unlinked_at_utc, unlink_reason,
      optimistic_revision, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
      ?, ?, ?
    )
  `).run(
    link.link_id, link.profile_id, link.report_id, link.manifest_id, link.report_sha256,
    link.collection_id, link.collection_revision, link.plan_id, link.slot_id,
    link.plan_revision, link.slot_revision, link.initial_slot_date, link.effective_date,

export function updateReportCheckInLinkWithCas(expectedRevision: number, link: ReportCheckInLink): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE report_checkin_links
    SET status = ?, unlinked_at_utc = ?, unlink_reason = ?,
        optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE link_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
  `).run(
    link.status, link.unlinked_at_utc ?? null, link.unlink_reason ?? null,
    link.optimistic_revision, link.updated_at_utc,
    link.link_id, expectedRevision
  );
  return res.changes > 0;
}

export function listReportCheckInLinksForProfile(
  profileId: string,
  options?: { status?: string; limit?: number }
): ReportCheckInLink[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const status = options?.status;
  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(500, options?.limit || 100));

  let sql = 'SELECT * FROM report_checkin_links WHERE profile_id = ?';
  const params: any[] = [profileId];

  if (status && status !== 'all') {
    sql += ' AND status = ?';
    params.push(status);
  }

  sql += ' ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT ?';
  params.push(limit);

  const rows = db.prepare(sql).all(...params) as any[];
  return rows.map(row => ({
    link_id: row.link_id,
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    report_id: row.report_id,
    manifest_id: row.manifest_id,
    report_sha256: row.report_sha256,
    collection_id: row.collection_id,
    collection_revision: Number(row.collection_revision),
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    slot_id: row.slot_id,
    plan_revision: Number(row.plan_revision),
    slot_revision: Number(row.slot_revision),
    initial_slot_date: row.initial_slot_date,
    effective_date: row.effective_date,
    timezone: row.timezone,
    segment_id: row.segment_id ?? null,
    status: row.status as ReportCheckInLinkStatus,
    unlinked_at_utc: row.unlinked_at_utc ?? null,
    unlink_reason: row.unlink_reason ?? null,
    optimistic_revision: Number(row.optimistic_revision),
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  }));
}

export function getAthleteJourneySelection(profileId: string): AthleteJourneySelectionState | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM athlete_journey_selections WHERE profile_id = ?').get(profileId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    is_aggregate_read_only: Boolean(row.is_aggregate_read_only),
    selection_revision: Number(row.selection_revision),
    context_generation: Number(row.context_generation),
    selected_session_id: row.selected_session_id || null,
    comparison_mode: row.comparison_mode || 'none',
    compare_target_session_id: row.compare_target_session_id || null,
    compare_peer_session_id: row.compare_peer_session_id || null,
    selected_window_root_id: row.selected_window_root_id || null,
    selected_window_revision: row.selected_window_revision !== null && row.selected_window_revision !== undefined ? Number(row.selected_window_revision) : null,
    selected_saved_view_id: row.selected_saved_view_id || null,
    selected_snapshot_id: row.selected_snapshot_id || null,
    export_projection: row.export_projection || null,
    sensitive_opt_in: row.sensitive_opt_in_json ? JSON.parse(row.sensitive_opt_in_json) : { ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN },
    selected_preview_fingerprint: row.selected_preview_fingerprint || null,
    selected_pack_id: row.selected_pack_id || null,
    selected_diary_id: row.selected_diary_id || null,
    last_route_view: row.last_route_view || null,
    last_route_id: row.last_route_id || null,
    exact_next_safe_action: row.exact_next_safe_action || 'nav:sessions',
    selection_fingerprint: row.selection_fingerprint,
    last_idempotency_key: row.last_idempotency_key || null,
    last_command_type: row.last_command_type || null,
    last_command_hash: row.last_command_hash || null,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  };
}

export function saveAthleteJourneySelection(selection: AthleteJourneySelectionState): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const fingerprint = selection.selection_fingerprint || computeSelectionFingerprint(selection);
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO athlete_journey_selections (
      profile_id, selection_revision, context_generation, is_aggregate_read_only,
      selected_session_id, comparison_mode, compare_target_session_id, compare_peer_session_id,
      selected_window_root_id, selected_window_revision, selected_saved_view_id, selected_snapshot_id,
      export_projection, sensitive_opt_in_json, selected_preview_fingerprint, selected_pack_id,
      selected_diary_id, last_route_view, last_route_id, exact_next_safe_action,
      selection_fingerprint, last_idempotency_key, last_command_type, last_command_hash, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(profile_id) DO UPDATE SET
      selection_revision = excluded.selection_revision,
      context_generation = excluded.context_generation,
      is_aggregate_read_only = excluded.is_aggregate_read_only,
      selected_session_id = excluded.selected_session_id,
      comparison_mode = excluded.comparison_mode,
      compare_target_session_id = excluded.compare_target_session_id,
      compare_peer_session_id = excluded.compare_peer_session_id,
      selected_window_root_id = excluded.selected_window_root_id,
      selected_window_revision = excluded.selected_window_revision,
      selected_saved_view_id = excluded.selected_saved_view_id,
      selected_snapshot_id = excluded.selected_snapshot_id,
      export_projection = excluded.export_projection,
      sensitive_opt_in_json = excluded.sensitive_opt_in_json,
      selected_preview_fingerprint = excluded.selected_preview_fingerprint,
      selected_pack_id = excluded.selected_pack_id,
      selected_diary_id = excluded.selected_diary_id,
      last_route_view = excluded.last_route_view,
      last_route_id = excluded.last_route_id,
      exact_next_safe_action = excluded.exact_next_safe_action,
      selection_fingerprint = excluded.selection_fingerprint,
      last_idempotency_key = excluded.last_idempotency_key,
      last_command_type = excluded.last_command_type,
      last_command_hash = excluded.last_command_hash,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);

  stmt.run(
    selection.profile_id,
    selection.selection_revision,
    selection.context_generation,
    selection.is_aggregate_read_only ? 1 : 0,
    selection.selected_session_id ?? null,
    selection.comparison_mode || 'none',
    selection.compare_target_session_id ?? null,
    selection.compare_peer_session_id ?? null,
    selection.selected_window_root_id ?? null,
    selection.selected_window_revision ?? null,
    selection.selected_saved_view_id ?? null,
    selection.selected_snapshot_id ?? null,
    selection.export_projection ?? null,
    JSON.stringify(selection.sensitive_opt_in || DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN),
    selection.selected_preview_fingerprint ?? null,
    selection.selected_pack_id ?? null,
    selection.selected_diary_id ?? null,
    selection.last_route_view ?? null,
    selection.last_route_id ?? null,
    selection.exact_next_safe_action || 'nav:sessions',
    fingerprint,
    selection.last_idempotency_key ?? null,
    selection.last_command_type ?? null,
    selection.last_command_hash || null,
    selection.created_at_utc || selection.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    selection.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  );
}

export function saveAthleteJourneySelectionWithCas(
  expectedRevision: number | null,
  nextSelection: AthleteJourneySelectionState
): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  if (expectedRevision === null) {
    saveAthleteJourneySelection(nextSelection);
    return true;
  }

  const fingerprint = nextSelection.selection_fingerprint || computeSelectionFingerprint(nextSelection);
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE athlete_journey_selections SET
      selection_revision = ?,
      context_generation = ?,
      is_aggregate_read_only = ?,
      selected_session_id = ?,
      comparison_mode = ?,
      compare_target_session_id = ?,
      compare_peer_session_id = ?,
      selected_window_root_id = ?,
      selected_window_revision = ?,
      selected_saved_view_id = ?,
      selected_snapshot_id = ?,
      export_projection = ?,
      sensitive_opt_in_json = ?,
      selected_preview_fingerprint = ?,
      selected_pack_id = ?,
      selected_diary_id = ?,
      last_route_view = ?,
      last_route_id = ?,
      exact_next_safe_action = ?,
      selection_fingerprint = ?,
      last_idempotency_key = ?,
      last_command_type = ?,
      last_command_hash = ?,
      updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE profile_id = ? AND selection_revision = ?
  `);

  const res = stmt.run(
    nextSelection.selection_revision,
    nextSelection.context_generation,
    nextSelection.is_aggregate_read_only ? 1 : 0,
    nextSelection.selected_session_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.comparison_mode || 'none',
    nextSelection.compare_target_session_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.compare_peer_session_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_window_root_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_window_revision ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_saved_view_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_snapshot_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.export_projection ?? null,
    JSON.stringify(nextSelection.sensitive_opt_in || DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN),
    nextSelection.selected_preview_fingerprint ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_pack_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.selected_diary_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.last_route_view ?? null,
    nextSelection.last_route_id ?? null,
    nextSelection.exact_next_safe_action || 'nav:sessions',
    fingerprint,
    nextSelection.last_idempotency_key ?? null,
    nextSelection.last_command_type ?? null,
    nextSelection.last_command_hash || null,
    nextSelection.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    nextSelection.profile_id,
    expectedRevision
  );

  return res.changes > 0;
}

export function clearDependentSelectionsForProfile(profileId: string): void {
  const current = getAthleteJourneySelection(profileId);
  if (!current) return;
  const cleared: AthleteJourneySelectionState = {
    ...current,
    selected_session_id: null,
    comparison_mode: 'none',
    compare_target_session_id: null,
    compare_peer_session_id: null,
    selected_window_root_id: null,
    selected_window_revision: null,
    selected_saved_view_id: null,
    selected_snapshot_id: null,
    selected_preview_fingerprint: null,
    selected_pack_id: null,
    selected_diary_id: null,
    selection_revision: current.selection_revision + 1,
    context_generation: current.context_generation + 1,
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  cleared.selection_fingerprint = computeSelectionFingerprint(cleared);
  saveAthleteJourneySelection(cleared);
}

// CardioLab G18 — Durable Athlete Journey Idempotency Ledger
// ============================================================================

export interface JourneyIdempotencyRecord {
  profile_id: string;
  idempotency_key: string;
  command_hash: string;
  committed_revision: number;
  command_type: string;
  result_selection_json: string;
  result_context_json: string;
  created_at_utc: string;
}

export function getJourneyIdempotencyRecord(
  profileId: string,
  idempotencyKey: string
): JourneyIdempotencyRecord | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare(
    'SELECT * FROM athlete_journey_idempotency WHERE profile_id = ? AND idempotency_key = ?'
  ).get(profileId, idempotencyKey) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    profile_id: row.profile_id,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key,
    command_hash: row.command_hash,
    committed_revision: Number(row.committed_revision),
    command_type: row.command_type,
    result_selection_json: row.result_selection_json,
    result_context_json: row.result_context_json,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
  };
}

export function saveJourneyIdempotencyRecord(record: JourneyIdempotencyRecord): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO athlete_journey_idempotency (
      profile_id, idempotency_key, command_hash, committed_revision,
      command_type, result_selection_json, result_context_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(profile_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET
      command_hash = excluded.command_hash,
      committed_revision = excluded.committed_revision,
      command_type = excluded.command_type,
      result_selection_json = excluded.result_selection_json,
      result_context_json = excluded.result_context_json,
      created_at_utc = excluded.created_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    record.profile_id,
    record.idempotency_key,
    record.command_hash,
    record.committed_revision,
    record.command_type,
    record.result_selection_json,
    record.result_context_json,
    record.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function pruneJourneyIdempotencyRecords(olderThanUtc: string): number {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare('DELETE FROM athlete_journey_idempotency WHERE created_at_utc < ?').run(olderThanUtc);
  return Number(res.changes);
}

/**
 * CardioLab G20 — Single Atomic Database Transaction for Selection CAS + Idempotency Write.
 * Ensures that selection state changes and idempotency ledger records are committed atomically.
 * If CAS fails or any error occurs, the entire transaction is rolled back.
 */
export function commitAthleteJourneySelectionAndIdempotencyAtomic(
  expectedRevision: number | null,
  nextSelection: AthleteJourneySelectionState,
  idempotencyRecord: JourneyIdempotencyRecord,
  extraTxAction?: () => void
): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
    if (expectedRevision === null) {
      saveAthleteJourneySelection(nextSelection);
      saveJourneyIdempotencyRecord(idempotencyRecord);
      if (extraTxAction) extraTxAction();
      return true;
    }

    const casSuccess = saveAthleteJourneySelectionWithCas(expectedRevision, nextSelection);
    if (!casSuccess) {
      throw new Error('CAS_CONFLICT_INTERNAL');
    }
    saveJourneyIdempotencyRecord(idempotencyRecord);
    if (extraTxAction) extraTxAction();
    return true;
  });

  try {
    return runTx();
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err.message === 'CAS_CONFLICT_INTERNAL') {
      return false;
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export interface StoredPilotCampaign extends PilotCampaignPolicy {
  revision: number;
  state: CampaignState;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export function savePilotCampaign(campaign: PilotCampaignPolicy & { state?: CampaignState; revision?: number; created_at_utc?: string; updated_at_utc?: string }): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO pilot_campaigns (
      campaign_id, revision, name, state, cohort_id, participant_class_policy,
      channel_policy_json, consent_policy_version, max_invites, max_uses_per_invite,
      validity_days, not_before_utc, expires_at_utc, revocation_epoch,
      trust_bundle_id, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET
      revision = excluded.revision,
      name = excluded.name,
      state = excluded.state,
      cohort_id = excluded.cohort_id,
      participant_class_policy = excluded.participant_class_policy,
      channel_policy_json = excluded.channel_policy_json,
      consent_policy_version = excluded.consent_policy_version,
      max_invites = excluded.max_invites,
      max_uses_per_invite = excluded.max_uses_per_invite,
      validity_days = excluded.validity_days,
      not_before_utc = excluded.not_before_utc,
      expires_at_utc = excluded.expires_at_utc,
      revocation_epoch = excluded.revocation_epoch,
      trust_bundle_id = excluded.trust_bundle_id,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);

  stmt.run(
    campaign.campaign_id,
    campaign.revision ?? 1,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.state ?? 'draft',
    campaign.cohort_id,
    campaign.participant_class_policy ?? 'qualified_external',
    JSON.stringify(campaign.allowed_channels || []),
    campaign.consent_policy_version,
    campaign.max_invites ?? 10,
    campaign.max_uses_per_invite ?? 1,
    campaign.validity_days ?? 30,
    campaign.not_before_utc || null,
    campaign.expires_at_utc || null,
    campaign.revocation_epoch ?? 1,
    campaign.trust_bundle_id || 'trust_bundle_default',
    campaign.created_at_utc || now,
    campaign.updated_at_utc || now
  );
}

    cohort_id: row.cohort_id,

    max_uses_per_invite: Number(row.max_uses_per_invite),

    expires_at_utc: row.expires_at_utc || undefined,

    trust_bundle_id: row.trust_bundle_id,

  };
}

    revocation_epoch: Number(row.revocation_epoch),

    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  }));
}

export function updatePilotCampaignState(
  campaignId: string,
  nextState: CampaignState,
  expectedRevision?: number
): { success: boolean; newRevision?: number } {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  if (expectedRevision !== undefined) {
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE pilot_campaigns
      SET state = ?, revision = revision + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE campaign_id = ? AND revision = ?
    `);
    const res = stmt.run(nextState, now, campaignId, expectedRevision);
    if (res.changes === 0) return { success: false };
    return { success: true, newRevision: expectedRevision + 1 };
  }

  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE pilot_campaigns
    SET state = ?, revision = revision + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE campaign_id = ?
  `);
  const res = stmt.run(nextState, now, campaignId);
  if (res.changes === 0) return { success: false };
  const updated = getPilotCampaign(campaignId);
  return { success: true, newRevision: updated?.revision };
}

export function listPilotIssuanceRequests(campaignId?: string): PilotInviteIssuanceRequest[] {

  let rows: any[];
  if (campaignId) {
    rows = db.prepare('SELECT status, request_json FROM pilot_issuance_requests WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all(campaignId) as any[];
  } else {
    rows = db.prepare('SELECT status, request_json FROM pilot_issuance_requests ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all() as any[];
  }
  return rows.map((r) => {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(r.request_json);
    parsed.status = r.status || parsed.status;
    return parsed;
  });
}

export function updatePilotIssuanceRequestStatus(requestId: string, status: IssuanceRequestStatus): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = db.prepare('SELECT request_json FROM pilot_issuance_requests WHERE request_id = ?').get(requestId) as any;
  let updatedJson: string | null = null;
  if (existing) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(existing.request_json);
      parsed.status = status;
      updatedJson = JSON.stringify(parsed);
    } catch {}
  }
  if (updatedJson) {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE pilot_issuance_requests
      SET status = ?, request_json = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE request_id = ?
    `).run(status, updatedJson, now, requestId);
  } else {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE pilot_issuance_requests
      SET status = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE request_id = ?
    `).run(status, now, requestId);
  }
}

export function savePilotInventoryEntry(entry: PilotInviteInventoryEntry): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO pilot_invite_inventory (
      invite_id, invite_digest, campaign_id, request_id, batch_id,
      cohort_id, participant_class_policy, consent_policy_version,
      max_uses, uses_count, is_revoked, revoked_at_utc, revocation_reason,
      not_before_utc, expires_at_utc, revocation_epoch, nonce_digest,
      trust_bundle_id, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(invite_id) DO UPDATE SET
      uses_count = excluded.uses_count,
      is_revoked = excluded.is_revoked,
      revoked_at_utc = excluded.revoked_at_utc,
      revocation_reason = excluded.revocation_reason,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);

  stmt.run(
    entry.invite_id,
    entry.invite_digest,
    entry.campaign_id,
    entry.request_id,
    entry.batch_id,
    entry.cohort_id,
    entry.participant_class_policy,
    entry.consent_policy_version,
    entry.max_uses,
    entry.uses_count,
    entry.revocation.is_revoked ? 1 : 0,
    entry.revocation.revoked_at_utc || null,
    entry.revocation.reason || null,
    entry.validity.not_before_utc,
    entry.validity.expires_at_utc,
    entry.revocation.revocation_epoch,
    entry.nonce_digest,
    entry.trust_bundle_id,
    entry.created_at_utc || now,
    entry.updated_at_utc || now
  );
}

function rowToInventoryEntry(row: any): PilotInviteInventoryEntry {
  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const notBeforeMs = Date.parse(row.not_before_utc);
  const expiresMs = Date.parse(row.expires_at_utc);
  const isValidNow = !row.is_revoked && row.uses_count < row.max_uses && nowMs >= notBeforeMs && nowMs < expiresMs;
  const isRehearsal = row.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' || row.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle';

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    invite_id: row.invite_id,
    invite_digest: row.invite_digest,
    campaign_id: row.campaign_id,
    request_id: row.request_id,
    batch_id: row.batch_id,
    cohort_id: row.cohort_id,
    participant_class_policy: row.participant_class_policy,
    consent_policy_version: row.consent_policy_version,
    validity: {
      not_before_utc: row.not_before_utc,
      expires_at_utc: row.expires_at_utc,
      is_valid_now: isValidNow
    },
    max_uses: Number(row.max_uses),
    uses_count: Number(row.uses_count),
    revocation: {
      is_revoked: Boolean(row.is_revoked),
      revoked_at_utc: row.revoked_at_utc || null,
      reason: row.revocation_reason || null,
      revocation_epoch: Number(row.revocation_epoch)
    },
    nonce_digest: row.nonce_digest,
    trust_bundle_id: row.trust_bundle_id,
    is_rehearsal: isRehearsal,
    can_qualify_external: !isRehearsal && row.participant_class_policy === 'qualified_external',
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
  };
}

export function getPilotInventoryEntry(inviteId: string): PilotInviteInventoryEntry | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM pilot_invite_inventory WHERE invite_id = ?').get(inviteId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return rowToInventoryEntry(row);
}

  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM pilot_invite_inventory WHERE invite_digest = ?').get(inviteDigest) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return rowToInventoryEntry(row);
}

export function listPilotInventory(campaignId?: string): PilotInviteInventoryEntry[] {
  const db = getDb();
  let rows: any[];
  if (campaignId) {
    rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM pilot_invite_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all(campaignId) as any[];
  } else {
    rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM pilot_invite_inventory ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all() as any[];
  }
  return rows.map(rowToInventoryEntry);
}

export function updatePilotInventoryRevocation(inviteId: string, isRevoked: boolean, reason?: string | null): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE pilot_invite_inventory
    SET is_revoked = ?, revoked_at_utc = ?, revocation_reason = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE invite_id = ?
  `).run(isRevoked ? 1 : 0, isRevoked ? now : null, reason || null, now, inviteId);
  return res.changes > 0;
}

export function incrementPilotInventoryUses(inviteId: string): { success: boolean; uses_count: number; max_uses: number } {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const entry = getPilotInventoryEntry(inviteId);
  if (!entry) {
    return { success: false, uses_count: 0, max_uses: 0 };
  }
  if (entry.uses_count >= entry.max_uses) {
    return { success: false, uses_count: entry.uses_count, max_uses: entry.max_uses };
  }

  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE pilot_invite_inventory
    SET uses_count = uses_count + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE invite_id = ? AND uses_count < max_uses
  `).run(now, inviteId);

  if (res.changes === 0) {
    return { success: false, uses_count: entry.uses_count, max_uses: entry.max_uses };
  }

  return { success: true, uses_count: entry.uses_count + 1, max_uses: entry.max_uses };
}

export function saveCheckInPlan(plan: AthleteCheckInPlan): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const scheduleVersion = plan.schedule_version !== undefined && plan.schedule_version !== null ? plan.schedule_version : 1;
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO athlete_checkin_plans (
      id, profile_id, title, description, cadence, timezone,
      activity_type, metric_keys_json, status, schedule_version, optimistic_revision,
      created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      title = excluded.title,
      description = excluded.description,
      cadence = excluded.cadence,
      timezone = excluded.timezone,
      activity_type = excluded.activity_type,
      metric_keys_json = excluded.metric_keys_json,
      status = excluded.status,
      schedule_version = excluded.schedule_version,
      optimistic_revision = excluded.optimistic_revision,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    plan.id,
    plan.profile_id,
    plan.title,
    plan.description || null,
    plan.cadence,
    plan.timezone,
    plan.activity_type || null,
    JSON.stringify(plan.metric_keys || []),
    plan.status,
    scheduleVersion,
    plan.optimistic_revision,
    plan.created_at_utc,
    plan.updated_at_utc
  );
}

    INSERT INTO athlete_checkin_entries (
      id, plan_id, profile_id, slot_date, slot_index,
      effective_date, schedule_decision, schedule_notes, schedule_revision,
      schedule_segment_id, is_superseded,

      eligibility_state, quality_score, quality_explanation_ru,
      user_notes, is_retired, optimistic_revision, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      slot_date = excluded.slot_date,
      slot_index = excluded.slot_index,
      effective_date = excluded.effective_date,
      schedule_decision = excluded.schedule_decision,
      schedule_notes = excluded.schedule_notes,
      schedule_revision = excluded.schedule_revision,
      schedule_segment_id = excluded.schedule_segment_id,
      is_superseded = excluded.is_superseded,
      session_id = excluded.session_id,
      window_root_id = excluded.window_root_id,
      window_revision = excluded.window_revision,
      saved_view_id = excluded.saved_view_id,

      quality_score = excluded.quality_score,
      quality_explanation_ru = excluded.quality_explanation_ru,
      user_notes = excluded.user_notes,
      is_retired = excluded.is_retired,
      optimistic_revision = excluded.optimistic_revision,
      updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    entry.id,
    entry.plan_id,
    entry.profile_id,
    entry.slot_date,
    entry.slot_index,
    effectiveDate,
    scheduleDecision,
    entry.schedule_notes || null,

  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO athlete_checkin_schedule_segments (
      id, plan_id, version_index, cadence, timezone,
      effective_from_date, anchor_date, manual_dates_json, created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      version_index = excluded.version_index,
      cadence = excluded.cadence,
      timezone = excluded.timezone,
      effective_from_date = excluded.effective_from_date,
      anchor_date = excluded.anchor_date,
      manual_dates_json = excluded.manual_dates_json
  `);
  stmt.run(
    segment.id,
    segment.plan_id,
    segment.version_index,
    segment.cadence,
    segment.timezone,
    segment.effective_from_date,
    segment.anchor_date,
    segment.manual_dates ? JSON.stringify(segment.manual_dates) : null,
    segment.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getCheckInScheduleSegment(id: string): import('../../shared/checkinContract').CheckInScheduleSegment | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM athlete_checkin_schedule_segments WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    version_index: Number(row.version_index),
    cadence: row.cadence as any,
    timezone: row.timezone,
    effective_from_date: row.effective_from_date,
    anchor_date: row.anchor_date,
    manual_dates: row.manual_dates_json ? JSON.parse(row.manual_dates_json) : null,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
  };
}

export function listCheckInScheduleSegments(planId: string): import('../../shared/checkinContract').CheckInScheduleSegment[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM athlete_checkin_schedule_segments WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY version_index ASC').all(planId) as any[];
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    version_index: Number(row.version_index),
    cadence: row.cadence as any,
    timezone: row.timezone,
    effective_from_date: row.effective_from_date,
    anchor_date: row.anchor_date,
    manual_dates: row.manual_dates_json ? JSON.parse(row.manual_dates_json) : null,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc
  }));
}

FILE: src/backend/db/runtimeDataSourceDiscovery.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { DatabaseSync } from './databaseAdapter';

export type PathProvenanceType = 'electron_runtime_resolved' | 'environment_fallback_inferred' | 'custom_test_override';

export interface DataSourceCandidateInfo {
  role: 'live_electron' | 'legacy_localappdata' | 'repository_local';
  dir_path: string;
  path_provenance: PathProvenanceType;
  dir_exists: boolean;
  db_path: string;
  db_exists: boolean;
  db_size_bytes: number;
  db_integrity_status: string;
  raw_logs_path: string;
  raw_logs_exists: boolean;
  raw_logs_count: number;
  session_count: number;
  ingested_file_count: number;
  data_sources_count: number;
  is_authoritative: boolean;
}

export interface RuntimeDataSourceDiscoveryOptions {
  projectRoot?: string;
  customRoamingDir?: string;
  customLocalDir?: string;
}

export interface RuntimeDataSourceDiscoveryResult {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  discovered_at_utc: string;
  authoritative_db_path: string;
  authoritative_role: 'live_electron' | 'legacy_localappdata' | 'repository_local' | 'none';
  authoritative_provenance: PathProvenanceType;
  candidates: DataSourceCandidateInfo[];
  configured_data_sources: Array<{
    id: string;
    label: string;
    path: string;
    is_active: number;
    last_status?: string | null;
  }>;
}

export function discoverRuntimeDataSources(options: RuntimeDataSourceDiscoveryOptions = {}): RuntimeDataSourceDiscoveryResult {
  const projectRoot = options.projectRoot || process.cwd();
  
  let roamingProvenance: PathProvenanceType = 'environment_fallback_inferred';
  let roamingDir = path.join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab');
  
  if (options.customRoamingDir) {
    roamingDir = options.customRoamingDir;
    roamingProvenance = 'custom_test_override';
  } else {
    // Check if valid actual Electron runtime paths artifact is present
    const electronPathsArtifact = path.join(projectRoot, '.agy', 'evidence', 'ELECTRON_RUNTIME_PATHS.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(electronPathsArtifact)) {
      try {
        const eData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(electronPathsArtifact, 'utf8'));
        const isValidActualApp = (eData.launch_mode === 'actual_dev_app_identity' || eData.launch_mode === 'actual_packaged_app_identity') &&
                                 (eData.app_name === 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab' || eData.app_name === 'H10 Athlete Cardio Lab' || eData.app_name === 'CardioLab Workstation') &&
                                 eData.resolution_status === 'electron_runtime_resolved';

        if (isValidActualApp && eData.user_data_dir) {
          roamingDir = eData.user_data_dir;
          roamingProvenance = 'electron_runtime_resolved';
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  const localProvenance: PathProvenanceType = options.customLocalDir ? 'custom_test_override' : 'environment_fallback_inferred';
  const localDir = options.customLocalDir || path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || '', 'H10AthleteCardioLab');
  const repoDataDir = path.join(projectRoot, 'data');

  const candidatesConfig: Array<{ role: 'live_electron' | 'legacy_localappdata' | 'repository_local'; dir: string; dbPath: string; logsDir: string; provenance: PathProvenanceType }> = [
    { role: 'live_electron', dir: roamingDir, dbPath: path.join(roamingDir, 'cardio_lab.db'), logsDir: path.join(roamingDir, 'raw_logs'), provenance: roamingProvenance },
    { role: 'legacy_localappdata', dir: localDir, dbPath: path.join(localDir, 'cardio_lab.db'), logsDir: path.join(localDir, 'raw_logs'), provenance: localProvenance },
    { role: 'repository_local', dir: repoDataDir, dbPath: path.join(repoDataDir, 'h10_cardio_lab.db'), logsDir: path.join(repoDataDir, 'raw_logs'), provenance: 'environment_fallback_inferred' }
  ];

  const candidateInfos: DataSourceCandidateInfo[] = [];
  let authCandidate: DataSourceCandidateInfo | null = null;
  let configuredSources: any[] = [];

  for (const c of candidatesConfig) {
    const dirExists = fs.existsSync(c.dir);
    const dbExists = fs.existsSync(c.dbPath);
    const dbSize = dbExists ? fs.statSync(c.dbPath).size : 0;
    const logsExists = fs.existsSync(c.logsDir);
    const logsCount = logsExists ? fs.readdirSync(c.logsDir).length : 0;

    let sessionCount = 0;
    let ingestedCount = 0;
    let dsCount = 0;
    let integrityStatus = 'not_checked';

    if (dbExists && dbSize > 0) {
      try {
        const db = new DatabaseSync(c.dbPath, { readOnly: true });
        try {
          const integRow = db.prepare("PRAGMA integrity_check").get() as Record<string, string> | undefined;
          integrityStatus = integRow ? (Object.values(integRow)[0] as string) : 'ok';
        } catch {
          integrityStatus = 'check_failed';
        }
        try {
          const sRow = db.prepare("SELECT count(*) as c FROM sessions").get() as { c: number };
          sessionCount = sRow?.c || 0;
        } catch {}
        try {
          const fRow = db.prepare("SELECT count(*) as c FROM ingested_files").get() as { c: number };
          ingestedCount = fRow?.c || 0;
        } catch {}
        try {
          const dRow = db.prepare("SELECT count(*) as c FROM data_sources").get() as { c: number };
          dsCount = dRow?.c || 0;
        } catch {}

        if (c.role === 'live_electron' || (!authCandidate && sessionCount > 0)) {
          try {
            configuredSources = db.prepare("SELECT id, label, path, is_active, last_status FROM data_sources").all() as any[];
          } catch {}
        }
        db.close();
      } catch {}
    }

    const info: DataSourceCandidateInfo = {
      role: c.role,
      dir_path: c.dir,
      path_provenance: c.provenance,
      dir_exists: dirExists,
      db_path: c.dbPath,
      db_exists: dbExists,
      db_size_bytes: dbSize,
      db_integrity_status: integrityStatus,
      raw_logs_path: c.logsDir,
      raw_logs_exists: logsExists,
      raw_logs_count: logsCount,
      session_count: sessionCount,
      ingested_file_count: ingestedCount,
      data_sources_count: dsCount,
      is_authoritative: false
    };

    candidateInfos.push(info);
  }

  const live = candidateInfos.find(ci => ci.role === 'live_electron');
  const legacy = candidateInfos.find(ci => ci.role === 'legacy_localappdata');
  const repo = candidateInfos.find(ci => ci.role === 'repository_local');

  if (live && live.db_exists && live.db_size_bytes > 0 && live.session_count > 0) {
    live.is_authoritative = true;
    authCandidate = live;
  } else if (legacy && legacy.db_exists && legacy.db_size_bytes > 0 && legacy.session_count > 0) {
    legacy.is_authoritative = true;
    authCandidate = legacy;
  } else if (repo && repo.db_exists) {
    repo.is_authoritative = true;
    authCandidate = repo;
  }

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    discovered_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
    authoritative_db_path: authCandidate ? authCandidate.db_path : '',
    authoritative_role: authCandidate ? authCandidate.role : 'none',
    authoritative_provenance: authCandidate ? authCandidate.path_provenance : 'environment_fallback_inferred',
    candidates: candidateInfos,
    configured_data_sources: configuredSources
  };
}

/**
 * Feature Value & Depth Usage Tracker
 *
 * Tracks individual feature interactions:
 * - ECG view, ACC view, frequency-domain, Poincaré, methodology, artifact ledger
 * - Comparison view, report export (CSV, PDF, HTML, bundle), LLM pack generation, AI response link
 *
 * Invariants:
 * - Observational only: does NOT modify CanonicalSessionResult, FeatureMaturity, TaskEligibility, or scientific algorithms.
 * - Separates real vs sample/demo usage.
 */

import {
  BetaFeatureId,
  FeatureUsageEvent,
  FeatureUsageSummaryItem
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export class FeatureUsageTracker {
  private events: FeatureUsageEvent[] = [];

  public track(event: Omit<FeatureUsageEvent, 'event_id' | 'occurred_at_utc'>): FeatureUsageEvent {
    const fullEvent: FeatureUsageEvent = {
      ...event,
      event_id: `feat_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,
      occurred_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    this.events.push(fullEvent);
    return fullEvent;
  }

  public getEvents(filter?: { participantId?: string; sessionId?: string; excludeSample?: boolean }): FeatureUsageEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter((e) => {
      if (filter?.participantId && e.participant_id !== filter.participantId) return false;
      if (filter?.sessionId && e.session_id !== filter.sessionId) return false;
      if (filter?.excludeSample && e.is_sample_or_demo) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }

  public static summarizeFeatureUsage(
    events: FeatureUsageEvent[],
    totalActiveUsers: number,
    excludeSample = true
  ): FeatureUsageSummaryItem[] {
    const filtered = events.filter((e) => (excludeSample ? !e.is_sample_or_demo : true));
    const featureMap = new Map<BetaFeatureId, { totalEvents: number; userCounts: Map<string, number> }>();

    const allFeatures: BetaFeatureId[] = [
      'ecg_view',
      'acc_view',
      'frequency_view',
      'poincare_view',
      'methodology_view',
      'artifact_ledger_view',
      'hr_zone_view',
      'comparison_view',
      'report_export_csv',
      'report_export_pdf',
      'report_export_html',
      'report_export_bundle',
      'llm_pack_gemini',
      'llm_pack_zip',
      'ai_response_linked'
    ];

    for (const fid of allFeatures) {
      featureMap.set(fid, { totalEvents: 0, userCounts: new Map<string, number>() });
    }

    for (const ev of filtered) {
      const entry = featureMap.get(ev.feature_id);
      if (entry) {
        entry.totalEvents += 1;
        const currentCount = entry.userCounts.get(ev.participant_id) || 0;
        entry.userCounts.set(ev.participant_id, currentCount + 1);
      }
    }

    const summary: FeatureUsageSummaryItem[] = [];

    for (const [fid, stats] of featureMap.entries()) {
      const uniqueUsers = stats.userCounts.size;
      const repeatUsers = Array.from(stats.userCounts.values()).filter((cnt) => cnt > 1).length;
      const penetration = totalActiveUsers > 0 ? Number(((uniqueUsers / totalActiveUsers) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0;

      let recommendation: 'retain_primary' | 'maintain_advanced' | 'consider_postponing_or_folding' = 'maintain_advanced';
      if (penetration >= 40 || ['report_export_pdf', 'report_export_csv', 'llm_pack_gemini', 'comparison_view'].includes(fid)) {
        recommendation = 'retain_primary';
      } else if (penetration < 5 && totalActiveUsers >= 10 && stats.totalEvents < 3) {
        recommendation = 'consider_postponing_or_folding';
      }

      summary.push({
        feature_id: fid,
        total_events: stats.totalEvents,
        unique_participants_used: uniqueUsers,
        penetration_rate_pct: penetration,
        repeat_use_participants: repeatUsers,
        recommended_action: recommendation
      });
    }

    return summary;
  }
}

FILE: src/backend/diagnostics/timeToValueTracker.ts

/**
 * Time-to-Value (TTV) Measurement Service
 *
 * Monotonic timestamp tracking for:
 * 1. Import start -> bundle preview (Target: <= 15 sec)
 * 2. Bundle confirmation -> canonical overview (Target: <= 30 sec)
 * 3. Canonical overview -> first meaningful action (Target: <= 2 min)
 *
 * Enforces:
 * - Descriptive statistics (n, missing, min, p25, median, p75, max, mean)
 * - Never substitutes 0 for missing/aborted events
 * - Clear sample vs real cohort separation
 */

import {
  TimeToValueRecord,
  TimeToValueSummary,
  DescriptiveDistribution,
  MeaningfulFollowUpAction
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export function calculateDescriptiveDistribution(values: (number | null)[]): DescriptiveDistribution {
  const validValues = values.filter((v): v is number => v !== null && !isNaN(v) && v >= 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = validValues.length;
  const missingCount = values.length - n;

  if (n === 0) {
    return {
      n: 0,
      missing_count: missingCount,
      min_ms: null,
      p25_ms: null,
      median_ms: null,
      p75_ms: null,
      max_ms: null,
      mean_ms: null
    };
  }

  const min = validValues[0];
  const max = validValues[n - 1];
  const sum = validValues.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);
  const mean = Math.round(sum / n);

  const getPercentile = (p: number) => {
    const idx = (p / 100) * (n - 1);
    const lower = Math.floor(idx);
    const upper = Math.ceil(idx);
    const weight = idx - lower;
    if (lower === upper) return validValues[lower];
    return Math.round(validValues[lower] * (1 - weight) + validValues[upper] * weight);
  };

  return {
    n,
    missing_count: missingCount,
    min_ms: min,
    p25_ms: getPercentile(25),
    median_ms: getPercentile(50),
    p75_ms: getPercentile(75),
    max_ms: max,
    mean_ms: mean
  };
}

export class TimeToValueTracker {
  private activeRecords = new Map<string, Partial<TimeToValueRecord>>();

  public startImport(sessionId: string, participantId: string, cohortId: string, isSampleOrDemo = false): TimeToValueRecord {
    const record: Partial<TimeToValueRecord> = {
      record_id: `ttv_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`,
      session_id: sessionId,
      participant_id: participantId,
      cohort_id: cohortId,
      import_started_at_ms: Date.now(),
      bundle_preview_ready_at_ms: null,
      bundle_confirmed_at_ms: null,
      canonical_overview_ready_at_ms: null,
      first_meaningful_action_at_ms: null,
      first_meaningful_action_type: null,
      is_sample_or_demo: isSampleOrDemo,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    this.activeRecords.set(sessionId, record);
    return record as TimeToValueRecord;
  }

  public recordPreviewReady(sessionId: string): void {
    const rec = this.activeRecords.get(sessionId);
    if (rec && rec.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms === null) {
      rec.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms = Date.now();
    }
  }

  public recordBundleConfirmed(sessionId: string): void {
    const rec = this.activeRecords.get(sessionId);
    if (rec && rec.bundle_confirmed_at_ms === null) {
      rec.bundle_confirmed_at_ms = Date.now();
    }
  }

  public recordOverviewReady(sessionId: string): void {
    const rec = this.activeRecords.get(sessionId);
    if (rec && rec.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms === null) {
      rec.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms = Date.now();
    }
  }

  public recordFirstAction(sessionId: string, action: MeaningfulFollowUpAction): void {
    const rec = this.activeRecords.get(sessionId);
    if (rec && rec.first_meaningful_action_at_ms === null) {
      rec.first_meaningful_action_at_ms = Date.now();
      rec.first_meaningful_action_type = action;
    }
  }

  public getRecord(sessionId: string): TimeToValueRecord | null {
    const rec = this.activeRecords.get(sessionId);
    return rec ? (rec as TimeToValueRecord) : null;
  }

  public static summarizeRecords(records: TimeToValueRecord[], excludeSample = true): TimeToValueSummary {
    const filtered = records.filter((r) => (excludeSample ? !r.is_sample_or_demo : true));

    const importToPreviewDeltas = filtered.map((r) =>
      r.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms !== null && r.import_started_at_ms !== null && r.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms >= r.import_started_at_ms
        ? r.bundle_preview_ready_at_ms - r.import_started_at_ms
        : null
    );

    const previewToOverviewDeltas = filtered.map((r) =>
      r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms !== null && r.bundle_confirmed_at_ms !== null && r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms >= r.bundle_confirmed_at_ms
        ? r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms - r.bundle_confirmed_at_ms
        : null
    );

    const overviewToActionDeltas = filtered.map((r) =>
      r.first_meaningful_action_at_ms !== null && r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms !== null && r.first_meaningful_action_at_ms >= r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms
        ? r.first_meaningful_action_at_ms - r.canonical_overview_ready_at_ms
        : null
    );

    const previewDist = calculateDescriptiveDistribution(importToPreviewDeltas);
    const overviewDist = calculateDescriptiveDistribution(previewToOverviewDeltas);
    const actionDist = calculateDescriptiveDistribution(overviewToActionDeltas);

    const previewAttainment = {
      numerator: importToPreviewDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 15000).length,
      denominator: previewDist.n,
      percentage: previewDist.n > 0 ? Number(((importToPreviewDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 15000).length / previewDist.n) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null
    };

    const overviewAttainment = {
      numerator: previewToOverviewDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 30000).length,
      denominator: overviewDist.n,
      percentage: overviewDist.n > 0 ? Number(((previewToOverviewDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 30000).length / overviewDist.n) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null
    };

    const actionAttainment = {
      numerator: overviewToActionDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 120000).length,
      denominator: actionDist.n,
      percentage: actionDist.n > 0 ? Number(((overviewToActionDeltas.filter((d): d is number => d !== null && d <= 120000).length / actionDist.n) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null
    };

    return {
      ttv_import_to_preview: previewDist,
      ttv_preview_to_overview: overviewDist,
      ttv_overview_to_first_action: actionDist,
      target_attainment: {
        preview_under_15s: previewAttainment,
        overview_under_30s: overviewAttainment,
        first_action_under_2m: actionAttainment
      }
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Trust, Failure & Unsupported-Input Tracker
 *
 * Measures:
 * - Grouping correction rate
 * - Unsupported format rate
 * - Hard failure rate
 * - Output parity failures
 * - Silent drop count (Target: 0)
 * - Privacy scan failures (Target: 0)
 * - Warning interaction and user correction success
 */

import {
  TrustFailureEvent,
  TrustQualitySummary
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export class TrustFailureTracker {
  private events: TrustFailureEvent[] = [];
  private totalAttemptedSessions = 0;

  public incrementAttemptedSessions(): void {
    this.totalAttemptedSessions += 1;
  }

  public track(event: Omit<TrustFailureEvent, 'event_id' | 'occurred_at_utc'>): TrustFailureEvent {
    const fullEvent: TrustFailureEvent = {
      ...event,
      event_id: `trust_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,
      occurred_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    this.events.push(fullEvent);
    return fullEvent;
  }

  public getEvents(): TrustFailureEvent[] {
    return [...this.events];
  }

  public getSummary(): TrustQualitySummary {
    const hasSessions = this.totalAttemptedSessions > 0;
    const total = this.totalAttemptedSessions;

    const groupingCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'grouping_correction').length;
    const unsupportedCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'unsupported_format').length;
    const hardFailuresCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'hard_parsing_failure').length;
    const outputParityCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'output_parity_failure').length;
    const silentDropCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'silent_drop_detected').length;
    const privacyViolationsCount = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'privacy_scan_violation').length;

    const warningsExpanded = this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'warning_expanded').length;
    const warningsTotal = warningsExpanded + this.events.filter((e) => e.error_type === 'warning_dismissed').length;

    return {
      total_sessions_attempted: this.totalAttemptedSessions,
      grouping_corrections_count: groupingCount,
      grouping_correction_rate_pct: hasSessions ? Number(((groupingCount / total) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
      unsupported_format_count: unsupportedCount,
      unsupported_format_rate_pct: hasSessions ? Number(((unsupportedCount / total) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
      hard_failure_count: hardFailuresCount,
      hard_failure_rate_pct: hasSessions ? Number(((hardFailuresCount / total) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
      output_parity_failures: outputParityCount,
      silent_drops_count: silentDropCount,
      privacy_scan_failures: privacyViolationsCount,
      warnings_acted_upon_pct: warningsTotal > 0 ? Number(((warningsExpanded / warningsTotal) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null
    };
  }

  public static summarizeEvents(events: TrustFailureEvent[], totalAttemptedSessions: number): TrustQualitySummary {
    const tracker = new TrustFailureTracker();
    tracker.totalAttemptedSessions = totalAttemptedSessions;
    for (const ev of events) {
      tracker.track(ev);
    }
    return tracker.getSummary();
  }
}

export interface WorkstationEvent {

const inMemoryEvents: WorkstationEvent[] = [];
const MAX_IN_MEMORY_EVENTS = 200;

export type WorkstationEventListener = (event: WorkstationEvent) => void;
const workstationEventListeners = new Set<WorkstationEventListener>();

export function addWorkstationEventListener(listener: WorkstationEventListener): () => void {
