export function recordWorkstationEvent(
  eventType: WorkstationEventType,
  metadata?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>,
  durationMs?: number
): WorkstationEvent {
  const event: WorkstationEvent = {
    event_id: `evt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
    event_type: eventType,
    timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
    duration_ms: durationMs,
    metadata: sanitizeMetadata(metadata)
  };

  inMemoryEvents.push(event);
  if (inMemoryEvents.length > MAX_IN_MEMORY_EVENTS) {
    inMemoryEvents.shift();
  }

  // Persist into SQLite local product events store
  try {
    insertLocalProductEvent({
      event_id: event.event_id,
      event_type: event.event_type,
      timestamp_utc: event.timestamp_utc,
      duration_ms: event.duration_ms,
      metadata: event.metadata
    });
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking
  }

  // Persist asynchronously in bounded local log file
  try {
    const logDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'events');
    if (!fs.existsSync(logDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(logDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    const logFile = path.join(logDir, 'workstation_ttv_events.jsonl');
    fs.appendFileSync(logFile, JSON.stringify(event) + '\n', 'utf-8');
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking for UI/business operations
  }

  // Synchronously notify registered listeners
  for (const listener of workstationEventListeners) {
    try {
      listener(event);
    } catch {
      // Non-blocking
    }
  }

  // Automatic outcome & TTV reconstruction on milestone events
  const sessionId = (event.metadata?.sessionId || event.metadata?.session_id) as string | undefined;
  if (sessionId) {
    const milestoneEvents: WorkstationEventType[] = [
      'canonical_analysis_completed',
      'canonical_overview_viewed',
      'canonical_result_viewed',
      'report_action',
      'ai_pack_action',
      'compare_action',
      'advanced_tab_opened',
      'guided_import_failed',
      'guided_import_completed'
    ];
    if (milestoneEvents.includes(eventType)) {
      try {
        import('../beta/betaProductEventProjector')
          .then((mod) => {
            mod.BetaProductEventProjector.recomputeSessionOutcomeAndTtv(sessionId);
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      } catch {
        // Non-blocking
      }
    }
  }

  return event;
}

export function getRecentWorkstationEvents(limit = 50): WorkstationEvent[] {
  try {
    const rows = getLocalProductEvents(limit);
    if (rows && rows.length > 0) {
      const mapped = rows.map((r: any) => {
        let meta: Record<string, any> | undefined;
        if (r.payload_json) {
          try {
            meta = JSON.parse(r.payload_json);
          } catch {
            meta = undefined;
          }
        }
        return {
          event_id: meta?.event_id || `evt-${r.id}`,
          event_type: r.event_name as WorkstationEventType,
          timestamp_utc: r.created_at_utc,
          duration_ms: meta?.duration_ms,
          metadata: meta
        };
      });
      return mapped.reverse();
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback to in-memory
  }
  return inMemoryEvents.slice(-limit);
}

export function clearWorkstationEvents(): void {
  inMemoryEvents.length = 0;
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM local_product_events').run();
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking
  }
}

/**
 * Sanitizes metadata to guarantee no raw physiological signals or private file paths are leaked.
 */
function sanitizeMetadata(raw?: Record<string, any>): Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> {
  if (!raw) return {};
  const clean: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null> = {};

  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (v === null || typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean') {
      clean[k] = v;
    } else if (typeof v === 'string') {
      // Redact local absolute directories
      clean[k] = v.replace(/([A-Za-z]:\\[^ \n\r\t]+|\/Users\/[^ \n\r\t]+|\/home\/[^ \n\r\t]+)/g, '<local_path>');
    }
  }

  return clean;
}

  /**
   * Reloads and cryptographically reverifies active trust bundle from SQLite storage.
   * If corrupted or missing or unauthenticated, fails closed to unprovisioned trust root.
   */
  public reloadAndReverifyTrust(): { success: boolean; message: string; digest?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const ptr = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM active_trust_bundle_pointer WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    if (!ptr) {
      return { success: false, message: 'No active trust bundle pointer registered in database' };
    }

    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_trust_bundles WHERE bundle_id = ?').get(ptr.active_bundle_id) as any;
    if (!row) {
      return { success: false, message: `Active trust bundle "${ptr.active_bundle_id}" not found in trust bundle store` };
    }

    try {
      const publicKeys = JSON.parse(row.public_keys_json);
      const bundle: LicenseTrustBundle = {
        schema_version: '1.0.0',
        project_id: row.project_id || 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
        bundle_id: row.bundle_id,
        bundle_revision: row.bundle_revision,
        environment: row.environment,
        issuer_id: row.issuer_id,
        public_keys: publicKeys,
        revocation_epoch: row.revocation_epoch || 0,
        predecessor_bundle_hash: row.predecessor_bundle_hash || null,
        bootstrap_authority_id: row.bootstrap_authority_id,
        signer_key_id: row.signer_key_id,
        signed_at_utc: row.signed_at_utc,
        installed_at_utc: row.installed_at_utc,
        signature: row.signature
      };

      const computedDigest = computeTrustBundleDigest(bundle);
      if (computedDigest !== ptr.active_digest) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `Active trust bundle digest tampering detected: stored "${ptr.active_digest}", computed "${computedDigest}"`
        };
      }

      // Cryptographic signature and bootstrap verification
      const verifyRes = this.verifier.verifyTrustBundle(bundle);
      if (!verifyRes.valid) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `Active trust bundle verification failed on reload: ${verifyRes.message}`
        };
      }

      // Activate in memory
      this.verifier.setTrustStore({
        environment: bundle.environment,
        bundleRevision: bundle.bundle_revision,
        publicKeys: { ...bundle.public_keys },
        revocationEpoch: bundle.revocation_epoch ?? 0,
        bundleId: bundle.bundle_id,
        bundleDigest: verifyRes.digest || computedDigest,
        bootstrapAuthorityId: bundle.bootstrap_authority_id,
        signerKeyId: bundle.signer_key_id,
        signedAtUtc: bundle.signed_at_utc,
        signature: bundle.signature,
        predecessorBundleHash: bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash || null
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        message: `Successfully reloaded and reverified active trust bundle "${bundle.bundle_id}"`,
        digest: computedDigest
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Failed to parse or reload active trust bundle: ${err.message}`
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Updates trusted clock state and checks for backward clock jumps.
   * Call ONLY on state-mutating commands (activation, session acceptance, merchant event).
   */
  public updateClockAnchor(currentDate: Date = new Date()): { healthy: boolean; driftSeconds: number; lastSeenUtc: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const clockRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM trusted_clock_state WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    const nowIso = currentDate.toISOString();
    const lastSeen = clockRow?.last_seen_utc ? new Date(clockRow.last_seen_utc) : currentDate;
    const diffSeconds = (currentDate.getTime() - lastSeen.getTime()) / 1000;

    // Tolerance of 3600 seconds (1 hour) backward
    const healthy = diffSeconds >= -3600;

    if (healthy && currentDate.getTime() > lastSeen.getTime()) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE trusted_clock_state
        SET last_seen_utc = ?, monotonic_counter = monotonic_counter + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE id = 1
      `).run(nowIso, nowIso);
    }

    return {
      healthy,
      driftSeconds: diffSeconds,
      lastSeenUtc: clockRow?.last_seen_utc || nowIso
    };
  }

  /**
   * Read-only inspection of clock health. Pure and side-effect free (does not mutate trusted_clock_state).
   */
  public checkClockHealth(currentDate: Date = new Date()): { healthy: boolean; driftSeconds: number; lastSeenUtc: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const clockRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM trusted_clock_state WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    const nowIso = currentDate.toISOString();
    const lastSeen = clockRow?.last_seen_utc ? new Date(clockRow.last_seen_utc) : currentDate;
    const diffSeconds = (currentDate.getTime() - lastSeen.getTime()) / 1000;
    const healthy = diffSeconds >= -3600;

    return {
      healthy,
      driftSeconds: diffSeconds,
      lastSeenUtc: clockRow?.last_seen_utc || nowIso
    };
  }

  /**
   * Returns current trusted last seen UTC timestamp.
   */
  public getTrustedClockAnchor(): string {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const clockRow = db.prepare('SELECT last_seen_utc FROM trusted_clock_state WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    return clockRow?.last_seen_utc || new Date().toISOString();
  }

  /**
   * Gets set of revoked license IDs from database.
   */
  public getRevokedLicenseIds(): Set<string> {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT license_id FROM revoked_license_registry').all() as any[];
    return new Set(rows.map(r => r.license_id));

  public getState(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): EntitlementState {
    return this.getEntitlementState(referenceDate);
  }

  /**
   * Pure, side-effect free evaluation of active entitlement state.
   */
  public getEntitlementState(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): EntitlementState {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const clockInfo = this.checkClockHealth(referenceDate);

    // 1. Check if we have an active signed license in license_registry
    const regRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    if (regRow && regRow.envelope_json) {
      try {
        const envelope: SignedLicenseEnvelope = JSON.parse(regRow.envelope_json);
        const verification = this.verifier.verify(envelope, {
          currentUtc: referenceDate,
          trustedLastSeenUtc: clockInfo.lastSeenUtc,
          revokedLicenseIds: this.getRevokedLicenseIds(),
          revocationEpoch: regRow.revocation_epoch
        });

        const tier = verification.tier;
        const baseCaps = TIER_CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY[tier] || TIER_CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY.trial;
        const capabilities = {
          ...baseCaps,
          max_athlete_profiles: regRow.max_profiles ?? baseCaps.max_athlete_profiles,
          max_profiles: regRow.max_profiles ?? baseCaps.max_profiles
        };
        const isExpired = verification.status === 'expired';
        const inGrace = verification.status === 'grace_period';
        const isRevoked = verification.status === 'revoked';

        return {
          tier: isRevoked ? 'trial' : tier,
          status: isRevoked ? 'revoked' : (isExpired ? 'expired' : (inGrace ? 'grace_period' : 'active')),
          licensee_name: regRow.customer_name_masked || 'Licensed Customer',
          license_key_masked: maskLicenseId(regRow.license_id),
          active_license_id: isRevoked ? null : regRow.license_id,
          key_id: isRevoked ? null : regRow.key_id,
          issuer_id: isRevoked ? null : regRow.issuer_id,
          expires_at_utc: regRow.expires_at_utc,
          grace_period_days: regRow.grace_period_days,
          in_grace_period: inGrace,
          active_revision: regRow.active_revision || 1,
          days_remaining: verification.days_remaining,
          is_expired: isExpired || isRevoked,
          clock_healthy: clockInfo.healthy,
          capabilities,
          data_access_guarantee: {
            prior_sessions_readable: true,
            prior_exports_accessible: true,
            database_unlocked: true
          }
        };
      } catch {}
    }

    // 2. Fall back to local trial/beta tracking in license_entitlements
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_entitlements WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    const tier = (row?.tier as LicenseTier) || 'trial';
    const trialStartedAt = row?.trial_started_at_utc ? new Date(row.trial_started_at_utc) : referenceDate;
    const diffDays = (referenceDate.getTime() - trialStartedAt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);

    let isExpired = false;
    let fallbackStatus: 'active' | 'expired' | 'revoked' = 'active';
    if (row?.status === 'revoked') {
      fallbackStatus = 'revoked';
      isExpired = true;
    } else if (tier === 'trial') {
      if (diffDays > (row?.trial_duration_days ?? 14) || (row?.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0) >= (row?.trial_session_limit ?? 3)) {
        isExpired = true;
        fallbackStatus = 'expired';
      }
    }

    const sessionsRemaining = Math.max(0, (row?.trial_session_limit ?? 3) - (row?.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0));
    const daysRemaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((row?.trial_duration_days ?? 14) - diffDays));

    return {
      tier,
      status: fallbackStatus,
      trial_status: tier === 'trial' ? (fallbackStatus === 'active' ? 'active' : 'expired') : 'none',
      licensee_name: row?.licensee_name || 'Evaluation User',
      license_key_masked: row?.license_key_masked || 'TRIAL-EVAL-V1',
      active_license_id: null,
      key_id: null,
      issuer_id: null,
      expires_at_utc: null,
      trial_started_at_utc: row?.trial_started_at_utc || referenceDate.toISOString(),
      trial_duration_days: row?.trial_duration_days ?? 14,
      trial_sessions_analyzed: row?.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0,
      trial_session_limit: row?.trial_session_limit ?? 3,
      sessions_remaining: sessionsRemaining,
      days_remaining: daysRemaining,
      is_expired: isExpired,
      clock_healthy: clockInfo.healthy,
      active_revision: 1,
      capabilities: TIER_CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY[tier] || TIER_CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY.trial,
      data_access_guarantee: {
        prior_sessions_readable: true,
        prior_exports_accessible: true,
        database_unlocked: true
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Returns authoritative, runtime-validated, revisioned EntitlementSnapshot.
   * Completely side-effect free on read. Exposes no raw tokens, private keys, or unmasked signatures.
   */
  public getEntitlementSnapshot(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): EntitlementSnapshot {
    const state = this.getEntitlementState(referenceDate);
    const clockInfo = this.checkClockHealth(referenceDate);
    const trustStore = this.verifier.getTrustStore();
    const nowIso = referenceDate.toISOString();

    let source: 'trial' | 'beta' | 'signed_license' = 'trial';
    if (state.active_license_id) {
      source = 'signed_license';
    } else if (state.tier === 'beta') {
      source = 'beta';
    }

    let safeNextAction = 'none';
    if (!clockInfo.healthy) {
      safeNextAction = 'restore_system_clock';
    } else if (state.status === 'revoked') {
      safeNextAction = 'activate_new_license';
    } else if (state.status === 'expired' || state.is_expired) {
      safeNextAction = state.tier === 'trial' ? 'activate_license' : 'renew_license';
    } else if (state.in_grace_period) {
      safeNextAction = 'renew_license_grace';
    }

    const denialRows = getDb().prepare(`
      SELECT denial_reason, COUNT(*) as cnt 
      FROM feature_denial_log 
      GROUP BY denial_reason
    `).all() as any[];
    const denialCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const r of denialRows) {
      denialCounts[r.denial_reason] = r.cnt;
    }

    return {
      ...state,
      active_tier: state.tier,
      source,
      environment: (trustStore.environment as any) || 'production',
      active_revision: state.active_revision || 1,
      trusted_clock: {
        system_time_utc: nowIso,
        last_seen_utc: clockInfo.lastSeenUtc,
        clock_drift_seconds: Math.round(clockInfo.driftSeconds),
        clock_healthy: clockInfo.healthy
      },
      trust_bundle: {
        bundle_id: trustStore.bundleId || null,
        bundle_revision: trustStore.bundleRevision || null,
        trust_bundle_digest: trustStore.bundleDigest || null,
        bootstrap_authority_id: trustStore.bootstrapAuthorityId || null,
        signer_key_id: trustStore.signerKeyId || null
      },
      safe_next_action: safeNextAction,
      denial_reasons: denialCounts
    };
  }

  public setTier(tier: LicenseTier): void {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    if (tier === 'trial') {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').run();
    }
    db.prepare('UPDATE license_entitlements SET tier = ?, updated_at_utc = ? WHERE id = 1').run(tier, now);
  }

  /**
   * Applies and validates a signed license envelope or test fixture key.
   * In production mode, fixture keys are strictly rejected; valid signed envelope under active trust bundle is required.
   */
  public applyLicense(
    licenseInput: string,
    licenseeName?: string,
    referenceDate: Date = new Date(),
    options?: { allowTestFixtures?: boolean; expectedRevision?: number }
  ): {
    success: boolean;
    tier: LicenseTier;
    message: string;
    license_id?: string;
    status?: string;
    active_revision?: number;
  } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const trimmed = licenseInput ? licenseInput.trim() : '';
    const now = referenceDate.toISOString();

    // Check revision precondition if provided
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT active_revision FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    const currentRev = existing?.active_revision || 1;
    if (options?.expectedRevision !== undefined && options.expectedRevision !== currentRev) {
      return {
        success: false,
        tier: 'trial',
        status: 'stale_revision',
        message: `Precondition failed: Expected revision ${options.expectedRevision}, but current revision is ${currentRev}`
      };
    }

    const clockInfo = this.updateClockAnchor(referenceDate);

    // 1. Try parsing as asymmetric SignedLicenseEnvelope (JSON, base64 or compact token)
    const envelope = parseLicenseEnvelope(trimmed);
    if (envelope) {
      const verification = this.verifier.verify(envelope, {
        currentUtc: referenceDate,
        trustedLastSeenUtc: clockInfo.lastSeenUtc,
        revokedLicenseIds: this.getRevokedLicenseIds(),
        revocationEpoch: envelope.payload.revocation_epoch
      });

      if (!verification.is_valid) {
        return {
          success: false,
          tier: 'trial',
          message: verification.reason,
          status: verification.status
        };
      }

      const p = envelope.payload;
      const masked = maskLicenseId(p.license_id);
      const customerName = licenseeName || p.customer_name_masked || 'Licensed User';
      const nextRev = currentRev + 1;

      // Read current active trust bundle metadata
      const trustStore = this.verifier.getTrustStore();
      const currentBundleId = trustStore.bundleId || null;
      const currentBundleRev = trustStore.bundleRevision || null;
      const currentBundleDigest = trustStore.bundleDigest || null;

      // Upsert into license_registry — raw_token is NULL (never store raw tokens)
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_registry (
          id, license_id, customer_id, customer_name_masked, tier,
          max_profiles, features_json, envelope_json, raw_token,
          key_id, issuer_id, issued_at_utc, not_before_utc, expires_at_utc,
          grace_period_days, revocation_epoch, order_id, status, active_revision,
          trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_revision, trust_bundle_digest,
          activated_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
          license_id = excluded.license_id,
          customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
          customer_name_masked = excluded.customer_name_masked,
          tier = excluded.tier,
          max_profiles = excluded.max_profiles,
          features_json = excluded.features_json,
          envelope_json = excluded.envelope_json,
          raw_token = NULL,
          key_id = excluded.key_id,
          issuer_id = excluded.issuer_id,
          issued_at_utc = excluded.issued_at_utc,
          not_before_utc = excluded.not_before_utc,
          expires_at_utc = excluded.expires_at_utc,
          grace_period_days = excluded.grace_period_days,
          revocation_epoch = excluded.revocation_epoch,
          order_id = excluded.order_id,
          status = excluded.status,
          active_revision = excluded.active_revision,
          trust_bundle_id = excluded.trust_bundle_id,
          trust_bundle_revision = excluded.trust_bundle_revision,
          trust_bundle_digest = excluded.trust_bundle_digest,
          activated_at_utc = excluded.activated_at_utc,
          updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
      `).run(
        p.license_id,
        p.customer_id,
        customerName,
        p.tier,
        p.max_profiles,
        JSON.stringify(p.features || []),
        JSON.stringify(envelope),
        p.key_id,
        p.issuer_id,
        p.issued_at_utc,
        p.not_before_utc,
        p.expires_at_utc,
        p.grace_period_days ?? 7,
        p.revocation_epoch ?? 0,
        p.order_id || null,
        verification.status,
        nextRev,
        currentBundleId,
        currentBundleRev,
        currentBundleDigest,
        now,
        now
      );

      // Audit log in license_history — redacted envelope_json (no secrets or signatures)
      const sanitizedHistoryMetadata = JSON.stringify({
        license_id_masked: masked,
        tier: p.tier,
        key_id: p.key_id,
        issuer_id: p.issuer_id
      });
      const historyId = `hist_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_history (
          history_id, license_id, action, tier, key_id, envelope_json, reason,
          trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_revision, trust_bundle_digest, recorded_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, 'activated', ?, ?, ?, 'Asymmetric offline activation succeeded', ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(historyId, p.license_id, p.tier, p.key_id, sanitizedHistoryMetadata, currentBundleId, currentBundleRev, currentBundleDigest, now);

      // Keep legacy table synchronized
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE license_entitlements
        SET tier = ?, licensee_name = ?, license_key_masked = ?,
            trial_started_at_utc = ?, trial_sessions_analyzed = 0, trial_session_limit = 3, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE id = 1
      `).run(p.tier, customerName, masked, now, now);

      return {
        success: true,
        tier: p.tier,
        license_id: p.license_id,
        status: verification.status,
        active_revision: nextRev,
        message: `Successfully activated ${p.tier} offline license`
      };
    }

    // 2. Reject fixture strings in production mode unless explicitly authorized via test options
    const isAllowedTest = options?.allowTestFixtures === true || (options?.allowTestFixtures !== false && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test');
    if (!isAllowedTest) {
      return {
        success: false,
        tier: 'trial',
        status: 'rejected',
        message: 'Invalid license format. Production activation accepts only a verified signed envelope under the active trust bundle. Hardcoded test keys are rejected.'
      };
    }

    // 3. Test-only mock key strings for test harness dependency injection
    const upperKey = trimmed.toUpperCase();
    let targetTier: LicenseTier | null = null;

    if (upperKey === 'TEST-PRO-BETA' || upperKey.startsWith('DEV-TEST-KEY-PRO') || upperKey.startsWith('CLBETA-PRO')) {
      targetTier = 'professional';
    } else if (upperKey === 'TEST-PERS-BETA' || upperKey.startsWith('DEV-TEST-KEY-PERS') || upperKey.startsWith('CLBETA-PERS')) {
      targetTier = 'personal';
    } else if (upperKey === 'TEST-ACAD-BETA' || upperKey.startsWith('DEV-TEST-KEY-ACAD') || upperKey.startsWith('CLBETA-ACAD')) {
      targetTier = 'academic';
    } else if (upperKey === 'TEST-BETA-V1' || upperKey.startsWith('DEV-TEST-KEY-BETA') || upperKey.startsWith('CLBETA-BETA')) {
      targetTier = 'beta';
    } else if (upperKey === 'TEST-TRIAL-BETA' || upperKey === 'TRIAL-RESET' || upperKey === 'RESET-TRIAL' || upperKey.startsWith('DEV-TEST-KEY-TRIAL')) {
      targetTier = 'trial';
    } else {
      return {
        success: false,
        tier: 'trial',
        status: 'rejected',
        message: 'Invalid test license fixture format.'
      };
    }

    const masked = upperKey.length > 8
      ? `${upperKey.substring(0, 4)}...${upperKey.substring(upperKey.length - 4)}`
      : upperKey;

    // Clear any active asymmetric license when resetting to test mock
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').run();

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE license_entitlements 
      SET tier = ?, licensee_name = ?, license_key_masked = ?, 
          trial_started_at_utc = ?, trial_sessions_analyzed = 0, trial_session_limit = 3, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE id = 1
    `).run(targetTier, licenseeName || 'Licensed User', masked, now, now);

    return {
      success: true,
      tier: targetTier,
      status: 'active',
      active_revision: currentRev + 1,
      message: `Successfully applied test fixture ${targetTier} entitlement`
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resets evaluation state cleanly to initial unassigned trial without using fixture keys.
   */
  public resetEvaluationState(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): void {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = referenceDate.toISOString();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM trial_session_log').run();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE license_entitlements 
      SET tier = 'trial', status = 'active', licensee_name = 'Evaluation User',
          license_key_masked = 'TRIAL-EVAL-V1', trial_started_at_utc = ?,
          trial_sessions_analyzed = 0, trial_session_limit = 3, trial_duration_days = 14,
          updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE id = 1
    `).run(now, now);
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE trusted_clock_state
      SET last_seen_utc = ?, max_session_time_utc = ?, monotonic_counter = 0, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE id = 1
    `).run(now, now, now);
  }

  /**
   * Explicitly revokes active license and records in revocation registry.
   */
  public revokeLicense(licenseId?: string, reason: string = 'Operator or merchant revocation'): { success: boolean; message: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const reg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    const targetId = licenseId || reg?.license_id;

    if (targetId) {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO revoked_license_registry (license_id, revoked_at_utc, reason, revocation_epoch)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(targetId, now, reason, (reg?.revocation_epoch || 0) + 1);

      const historyId = `hist_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_history (
          history_id, license_id, action, tier, key_id, envelope_json, reason, recorded_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, 'revoked', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(historyId, targetId, reg?.tier || 'trial', reg?.key_id || 'unknown', reg?.envelope_json || null, reason, now);
    }

    // Delete active license and revert to trial
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').run();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE license_entitlements
      SET tier = 'trial', status = 'revoked', licensee_name = 'Evaluation User',
          license_key_masked = 'REVOKED', updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE id = 1
    `).run(now);

    return { success: true, message: `License ${targetId || ''} revoked successfully` };
  }

  /**
   * Installs and persists a new versioned trust bundle with anti-rollback validation.
   */
  public installTrustBundle(bundle: LicenseTrustBundle): { success: boolean; message: string; revision: number; digest?: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Authenticate bundle against verifier rules (project, bootstrap, signature, anti-rollback)
    const authRes = this.verifier.verifyTrustBundle(bundle);
    if (!authRes.valid) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: authRes.message,
        revision: this.verifier.getTrustStore().bundleRevision
      };
    }

    const digest = authRes.digest || computeTrustBundleDigest(bundle);

    // 2. Transactionally update SQLite: insert bundle, update pointer, deactivate previous bundles
    db.transaction(() => {
      // Mark all bundles as inactive
      db.prepare('UPDATE license_trust_bundles SET is_active = 0').run();

      // Upsert new bundle
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_trust_bundles (
          bundle_id, bundle_revision, project_id, environment, issuer_id,
          public_keys_json, revocation_epoch, predecessor_bundle_hash,
          bootstrap_authority_id, signer_key_id, signed_at_utc, signature,
          digest, is_active, installed_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(bundle_id) DO UPDATE SET
          bundle_revision = excluded.bundle_revision,
          project_id = excluded.project_id,
          environment = excluded.environment,
          issuer_id = excluded.issuer_id,
          public_keys_json = excluded.public_keys_json,
          revocation_epoch = excluded.revocation_epoch,
          predecessor_bundle_hash = excluded.predecessor_bundle_hash,
          bootstrap_authority_id = excluded.bootstrap_authority_id,
          signer_key_id = excluded.signer_key_id,
          signed_at_utc = excluded.signed_at_utc,
          signature = excluded.signature,
          digest = excluded.digest,
          is_active = 1,
          installed_at_utc = excluded.installed_at_utc
      `).run(
        bundle.bundle_id,
        bundle.bundle_revision,
        bundle.project_id || 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
        bundle.environment,
        bundle.issuer_id,
        JSON.stringify(bundle.public_keys),
        bundle.revocation_epoch ?? 0,
        bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash || null,
        bundle.bootstrap_authority_id,
        bundle.signer_key_id,
        bundle.signed_at_utc,
        bundle.signature,
        digest,
        bundle.installed_at_utc || now
      );

      // Update active pointer
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO active_trust_bundle_pointer (id, active_bundle_id, active_revision, active_digest, updated_at_utc)
        VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
          active_bundle_id = excluded.active_bundle_id,
          active_revision = excluded.active_revision,
          active_digest = excluded.active_digest,
          updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
      `).run(
        bundle.bundle_id,
        bundle.bundle_revision,
        digest,
        now
      );
    })();

    // 3. Update verifier in-memory state
    const installRes = this.verifier.installTrustBundle(bundle);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Successfully installed authenticated trust bundle "${bundle.bundle_id}" revision ${bundle.bundle_revision}`,
      revision: bundle.bundle_revision,
      digest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Removes active license, cleanly resetting to unassigned trial.
   */
  public removeLicense(reason: string = 'User removed license'): { success: boolean; message: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const reg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    if (reg) {
      const historyId = `hist_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_history (
          history_id, license_id, action, tier, key_id, envelope_json, reason, recorded_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, 'removed', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(historyId, reg.license_id, reg.tier, reg.key_id, reg.envelope_json, reason, now);
    }

    db.prepare('DELETE FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').run();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE license_entitlements
      SET tier = 'trial', status = 'active', licensee_name = 'Evaluation User',
          license_key_masked = 'TRIAL-EVAL-V1', updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE id = 1
    `).run(now);

    return { success: true, message: 'License removed. System returned to trial tier.' };
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles a provider-neutral merchant fulfillment event with durable idempotency.
   */
  public reconcileMerchantEvent(event: MerchantEventEnvelope): {
    applied: boolean;
    status: 'applied' | 'duplicate_idempotent' | 'missing_predecessor' | 'rejected';
    message: string;
    event_id: string;
  } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Idempotency Check
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM merchant_event_log WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(event.idempotency_key) as any;
    if (existing) {
      return {
        applied: false,
        status: 'duplicate_idempotent',
        message: `Event with idempotency key "${event.idempotency_key}" was already processed`,
        event_id: existing.event_id
      };
    }

    // 2. Predecessor Lineage Check (if applicable)
    if (event.previous_event_id) {
      const prev = db.prepare('SELECT event_id FROM merchant_event_log WHERE event_id = ?').get(event.previous_event_id);
      if (!prev) {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO merchant_event_log (
            event_id, event_type, idempotency_key, customer_id, license_id,
            tier, currency, amount_cents, previous_event_id, timestamp_utc,
            payload_json, status, error_reason, applied_at_utc
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'rejected', 'Missing predecessor event in lineage', ?)
        `).run(
          event.event_id, event.event_type, event.idempotency_key, event.customer_id,
          event.license_id, event.tier, event.currency, event.amount_cents,
          event.previous_event_id, event.timestamp_utc, JSON.stringify(event.payload || {}), now
        );

        return {
          applied: false,
          status: 'missing_predecessor',
          message: `Predecessor event "${event.previous_event_id}" not found in event history`,
          event_id: event.event_id
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Process Event Logic
    let applyStatus: 'applied' | 'rejected' = 'applied';
    let errorMessage: string | null = null;

    switch (event.event_type) {
      case 'checkout.completed':
      case 'manual.grant': {
        // If event payload has a signed license token, apply it
        if (event.payload?.license_token) {
          const appRes = this.applyLicense(event.payload.license_token);
          if (!appRes.success) {
            applyStatus = 'rejected';
            errorMessage = appRes.message;
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'order.refunded':
      case 'license.revoked':
      case 'dispute.opened': {
        this.revokeLicense(event.license_id, `Merchant event ${event.event_type}`);
        break;
      }
      case 'subscription.cancelled': {
        // Non-destructive cancellation: active license is not deleted; expires at normal expires_at_utc
        break;
      }
      case 'subscription.renewed': {
        // Extend active license expiry if provided in payload
        if (event.payload?.new_expires_at_utc) {
          db.prepare(`
            UPDATE license_registry
            SET expires_at_utc = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
            WHERE id = 1 AND license_id = ?
          `).run(event.payload.new_expires_at_utc, now, event.license_id);

          const histId = `hist_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
          db.prepare(`
            INSERT INTO license_history (
              history_id, license_id, action, tier, key_id, reason, recorded_at_utc
            ) VALUES (?, ?, 'renew', ?, 'merchant_sync', 'Subscription renewed via merchant event', ?)
          `).run(histId, event.license_id, event.tier, now);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'dispute.closed': {
        if (event.payload?.dispute_status === 'lost') {
          this.revokeLicense(event.license_id, 'Merchant dispute closed as lost');
        }
        break;
      }
      default:
        break;
    }

    // 4. Record in merchant_event_log with trust bundle lineage
    const trustStore = this.verifier.getTrustStore();
    const currentBundleId = trustStore.bundleId || null;
    const currentBundleRev = trustStore.bundleRevision || null;
    const currentBundleDigest = trustStore.bundleDigest || null;

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO merchant_event_log (
        event_id, event_type, idempotency_key, customer_id, license_id,
        tier, currency, amount_cents, previous_event_id, timestamp_utc,
        payload_json, status, error_reason, trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_revision, trust_bundle_digest, applied_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      event.event_id, event.event_type, event.idempotency_key, event.customer_id,
      event.license_id, event.tier, event.currency, event.amount_cents,
      event.previous_event_id || null, event.timestamp_utc,
      JSON.stringify(event.payload || {}), applyStatus, errorMessage,
      currentBundleId, currentBundleRev, currentBundleDigest, now
    );

    return {
      applied: applyStatus === 'applied',
      status: applyStatus,
      message: errorMessage || `Event ${event.event_type} processed successfully`,
      event_id: event.event_id
    };
  }

  /**
   * Records a feature access denial for diagnostics.
   */
  public recordDenial(capability: string, reason: string): void {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const current = this.getEntitlementState();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO feature_denial_log (denial_reason, capability, tier, denied_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(reason, capability, current.tier, now);
  }

  /**
   * Builds sanitized, privacy-safe diagnostics excluding tokens, signatures, and personal secrets.
   */
  public getDiagnostics(referenceDate: Date = new Date()): SanitizedEntitlementDiagnostics {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = referenceDate.toISOString();
    const state = this.getEntitlementState(referenceDate);
    const clockInfo = this.updateClockAnchor(referenceDate);

    // Event reconciliation count
    const countRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM merchant_event_log').get() as any;
    const lastEventRow = db.prepare('SELECT event_type, applied_at_utc FROM merchant_event_log ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get() as any;

    // Denial counts
    const denialRows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT denial_reason, COUNT(*) as cnt 
      FROM feature_denial_log 
      GROUP BY denial_reason
    `).all() as any[];

    const denialCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const r of denialRows) {
      denialCounts[r.denial_reason] = r.cnt;
    }

    const capabilitiesSummary: Record<string, boolean> = {
      batch_export: state.capabilities.batch_export_allowed,
      ai_pack_export: state.capabilities.ai_pack_export_allowed,
      report_custom_header: state.capabilities.report_custom_header_allowed,
      commercial_use: state.capabilities.commercial_use_allowed,
      scientific_truth_unrestricted: true
    };

    const trustStore = this.verifier.getTrustStore();
    const hasKeys = trustStore && Object.keys(trustStore.publicKeys).length > 0;
    const hasAuthenticatedDigest = Boolean(trustStore?.bundleDigest && trustStore.bundleDigest !== 'initial_built_in_authority');
    const trustRootStatus = (hasKeys && hasAuthenticatedDigest) ? 'authenticated' : (hasKeys ? 'active' : 'unprovisioned_trust_root');

    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      generated_at_utc: now,
      active_tier: state.tier,
      entitlement_status: state.status,
      trust_root_status: trustRootStatus,
      bundle_revision: trustStore?.bundleRevision ?? 1,
      trust_bundle_digest: trustStore?.bundleDigest || null,
      bootstrap_authority_id: trustStore?.bootstrapAuthorityId || null,
      signer_key_id: trustStore?.signerKeyId || null,
      license_id_masked: maskLicenseId(state.active_license_id),
      key_id: state.key_id || 'none',
      issuer_id: state.issuer_id || 'none',
      issued_at_utc: null, // Redacted for privacy
      expires_at_utc: state.expires_at_utc || null,
      grace_period_days: state.grace_period_days || 7,
      is_in_grace_period: Boolean(state.in_grace_period),
      clock_state: {
        system_time_utc: now,
        trusted_last_seen_utc: clockInfo.lastSeenUtc,
        clock_drift_seconds: Math.round(clockInfo.driftSeconds),
        clock_healthy: clockInfo.healthy
      },
      capabilities_summary: capabilitiesSummary,
      reconciliation_stats: {
        total_events_processed: countRow?.cnt || 0,
        last_event_type: lastEventRow?.event_type || null,
        last_reconciled_at_utc: lastEventRow?.applied_at_utc || null
      },
      denial_counts: denialCounts,
      data_access_guarantee_verified: true
    };
  }

  /**
   * Returns license audit history.
   */
  public getHistory(): any[] {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM license_history ORDER BY recorded_at_utc DESC').all() as any[];
    return rows.map(r => ({
      history_id: r.history_id,
      license_id_masked: maskLicenseId(r.license_id),
      action: r.action,
      tier: r.tier,
      key_id: r.key_id,
      reason: r.reason,
      recorded_at_utc: r.recorded_at_utc
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Records newly accepted session in trial log. Idempotent: same session is never counted twice.
   * Sample sessions (isSample = true) and synthetic sessions (isSynthetic = true) never consume trial quota.
   */
  public recordAcceptedSession(sessionId: string, isSample: boolean = false, isSynthetic: boolean = false): { counted: boolean; newTotal: number } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (!sessionId || isSample || isSynthetic) {
      const current = this.getEntitlementState();
      return { counted: false, newTotal: current.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0 };
    }

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT session_id FROM trial_session_log WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId);
    if (existing) {
      const current = this.getEntitlementState();
      return { counted: false, newTotal: current.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0 };
    }

    db.transaction(() => {
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO trial_session_log (session_id, recorded_at_utc, is_sample) VALUES (?, ?, 0)').run(sessionId, now);

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE license_entitlements 
        SET trial_sessions_analyzed = trial_sessions_analyzed + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE id = 1
      `).run(now);

      const reg = db.prepare('SELECT active_revision FROM license_registry WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
      if (reg) {
        db.prepare('UPDATE license_registry SET active_revision = active_revision + 1, updated_at_utc = ? WHERE id = 1').run(now);
      }
    })();

    this.updateClockAnchor(new Date());

    const updated = this.getEntitlementState();
    return { counted: true, newTotal: updated.trial_sessions_analyzed ?? 0 };
  }

  public recordSessionAnalyzed(): void {
    const fakeId = `compat_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
    this.recordAcceptedSession(fakeId, false, false);
  }
}

  public ensureSchema(): void {

    // Ensure installation seed exists (app-owned random bytes, ZERO hardware identifiers)
    const seedRow = db.prepare('SELECT seed_hex FROM workspace_installation_seed WHERE id = 1').get();
    if (!seedRow) {

      const randomSeed = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

  /**
   * Retrieves persistent pseudonymous workspace digest.
   * Derived exclusively from local SQLite installation seed without accessing hardware/network info.
   * Fails closed if seed row is missing.
   */
  public getPseudonymousWorkspaceDigest(): string {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT seed_hex FROM workspace_installation_seed WHERE id = 1').get() as any;
    if (!row || !row.seed_hex) {
      throw new Error('WORKSPACE_SEED_MISSING: Installation seed is missing in workspace database');
    }
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(row.seed_hex).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Generates a canonical, privacy-sanitized fulfillment request.
   */
  public createRequest(options: FulfillmentRequestCommand = {}): LicenseFulfillmentRequest {
    validateFulfillmentRequestCommandStrict(options);
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const entitlementState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();
    if (entitlementState.clock_healthy === false) {
      throw new Error('CLOCK_ROLLBACK_DETECTED: Request generation blocked during clock skew anomaly');
    }

    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();

    // Determine default action
    let defaultAction: FulfillmentAction = 'new';
    if (entitlementState.active_license_id) {
      defaultAction = entitlementState.is_expired ? 'renew' : 'upgrade';
    }
    const action = options.action || defaultAction;

    const allowedActions: FulfillmentAction[] = [
      'new',
      'renew',
      'upgrade',
      'downgrade',
      'replace',
      'reactivate',
      'transfer_request'
    ];
    if (!allowedActions.includes(action)) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_FULFILLMENT_ACTION: Action "${action}" is not supported`);
    }

    const requestedTier = options.requestedTier || (entitlementState.tier !== 'trial' ? entitlementState.tier : 'professional');

    const defaultMaxProfiles = requestedTier === 'professional' ? 9999 : (requestedTier === 'academic' ? 10 : 2);
    const requestedScope = {
      max_profiles: options.requestedScope?.max_profiles ?? defaultMaxProfiles,
      features: options.requestedScope?.features || (
        requestedTier === 'professional'
          ? ['batch_export', 'ai_pack_export', 'report_custom_header', 'priority_support', 'consultation_bundles']
          : (requestedTier === 'academic'
            ? ['batch_export', 'ai_pack_export', 'research_exchange']
            : ['batch_export', 'ai_pack_export'])
      )
    };

    // Sanitize user note (truncate <= 256 chars, strip control chars)
    let sanitizedNote: string | null = null;
    if (options.userNote && typeof options.userNote === 'string') {
      sanitizedNote = options.userNote.trim().slice(0, 256).replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ');
    }

    // Check idempotency if key provided
    const idempotencyKey = options.idempotency_key || (options as any).idempotencyKey;
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const canonicalPayloadForIdempotency = JSON.stringify({
        action,
        requestedTier,
        requestedScope,
        sanitizedNote,
        expectedRevision: options.expected_revision
      });
      const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayloadForIdempotency).digest('hex');

      const existing = db.prepare('SELECT payload_hash, response_json FROM fulfillment_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(idempotencyKey) as any;
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.payload_hash !== payloadHash) {
          throw new Error(`IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Idempotency key "${idempotencyKey}" was previously used with different parameters`);
        }
        return JSON.parse(existing.response_json);
      }
    }

    const nonce = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const requestId = `req_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const workspaceDigest = this.getPseudonymousWorkspaceDigest();

    const requestPayload: Omit<LicenseFulfillmentRequest, 'request_hash' | 'status'> = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      request_id: requestId,
      nonce,
      created_at_utc: now,
      environment: trustStore.environment,
      app_version: APP_VERSION,
      action,
      requested_tier: requestedTier,
      requested_scope: requestedScope,
      current_license_id_masked: entitlementState.active_license_id ? maskLicenseId(entitlementState.active_license_id) : null,
      current_entitlement_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
      trust_bundle_id: trustStore.bundleId || 'bundle-initial',
      trust_bundle_digest: trustStore.bundleDigest || 'initial_built_in_authority',
      supported_schemas: ['cardiolab_fulfillment_v1', 'cardiolab_offline_license_v1'],
      pseudonymous_workspace_digest: workspaceDigest,
      user_note: sanitizedNote
    };

    const requestHash = computeRequestHash(requestPayload);

    const fullRequest: LicenseFulfillmentRequest = {
      ...requestPayload,
      request_hash: requestHash,
      status: 'pending'
    };

    // Verify privacy sanitization
    const privacyCheck = validatePrivacySanitization(fullRequest);
    if (!privacyCheck.is_clean) {
      throw new Error(`Privacy violation during request generation: ${privacyCheck.violations.join(', ')}`);
    }

    // Mark previous pending requests as superseded
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE fulfillment_requests
      SET status = 'superseded', updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE status = 'pending'
    `).run(now);

    // Insert into database
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO fulfillment_requests (
        request_id, nonce, created_at_utc, environment, app_version,
        action, requested_tier, requested_scope_json, current_license_id_masked,
        current_entitlement_revision, trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_digest,
        supported_schemas_json, pseudonymous_workspace_digest, user_note,
        request_hash, status, updated_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?)
    `).run(
      fullRequest.request_id,
      fullRequest.nonce,
      fullRequest.created_at_utc,
      fullRequest.environment,
      fullRequest.app_version,
      fullRequest.action,
      fullRequest.requested_tier,
      JSON.stringify(fullRequest.requested_scope),
      fullRequest.current_license_id_masked,
      fullRequest.current_entitlement_revision,
      fullRequest.trust_bundle_id,
      fullRequest.trust_bundle_digest,
      JSON.stringify(fullRequest.supported_schemas),
      fullRequest.pseudonymous_workspace_digest,
      fullRequest.user_note,
      fullRequest.request_hash,
      now
    );

    // Save idempotency record if requested
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const canonicalPayloadForIdempotency = JSON.stringify({
        action,
        requestedTier,
        requestedScope,
        sanitizedNote,
        expectedRevision: options.expected_revision
      });
      const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayloadForIdempotency).digest('hex');
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fulfillment_idempotency (idempotency_key, operation, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, 'create_request', ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(idempotencyKey, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(fullRequest), now);
    }

    return fullRequest;
  }
