  /**
   * Cancels active request.
   */
  public cancelRequest(requestId: string, reason: string = 'User cancelled'): { success: boolean; message: string } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const info = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE fulfillment_requests
      SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE request_id = ? AND status = 'pending'
    `).run(now, requestId);

    if (info.changes === 0) {
      return { success: false, message: `Request "${requestId}" not found or not in pending status` };
    }

    return { success: true, message: `Request "${requestId}" cancelled successfully: ${reason}` };
  }

  /**
   * Cryptographically verifies an incoming LicenseFulfillmentResponse.
   */
  public verifyResponse(response: LicenseFulfillmentResponse): {
    valid: boolean;
    status: 'valid' | 'malformed' | 'hash_mismatch' | 'unknown_key' | 'key_revoked' | 'invalid_signature' | 'environment_mismatch';
    message: string;
  } {
    if (!response || response.schema_version !== '1.0.0' || !response.response_id || !response.request_id) {
      return { valid: false, status: 'malformed', message: 'Malformed fulfillment response format' };
    }

    // 1. Verify computed response hash matches response_hash
    const computedHash = computeResponseHash(response);
    if (computedHash !== response.response_hash) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'hash_mismatch',
        message: `Response hash mismatch: stored "${response.response_hash}", computed "${computedHash}"`
      };
    }

    // 2. Lookup public verification key in verifier trust store
    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
    const keyRecord = trustStore.publicKeys[response.key_id];

    if (!keyRecord) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'unknown_key',
        message: `Signing key ID "${response.key_id}" not found in active trust store`
      };
    }

    if (keyRecord.status === 'revoked') {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'key_revoked',
        message: `Signing key ID "${response.key_id}" has been revoked`
      };
    }

    // 3. Verify asymmetric Ed25519 signature
    if (!response.signature) {
      return { valid: false, status: 'invalid_signature', message: 'Missing response signature' };
    }

    try {
      const canonicalString = canonicalSerializeFulfillmentResponse(response);
      const dataBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8');
      const signatureBytes = Buffer.from(response.signature, 'base64');
      const isSigValid = crypto.verify(null, dataBytes, keyRecord.public_key_pem, signatureBytes);

      if (!isSigValid) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          status: 'invalid_signature',
          message: 'Cryptographic signature mismatch: response content has been forged or modified'
        };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'invalid_signature',
        message: `Signature verification failed: ${err.message}`
      };
    }

    return { valid: true, status: 'valid', message: 'Response verified successfully' };
  }

  /**
   * Helper for tests to simulate a missing workspace installation seed.
   */
  public deleteInstallationSeedForTest(): void {
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM workspace_installation_seed').run();
  }

  /**
   * Imports, cryptographically authenticates, binds to request, and applies a signed response.
   */
  public importAndApplyResponse(
    responsePayload: LicenseFulfillmentResponse,
    options: { allowUnboundResponse?: boolean; idempotency_key?: string; expected_revision?: number; expectedRevision?: number } = {}
  ): {
    success: boolean;
    status: 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'needs_information' | 'invalid_response';
    message: string;
    operator_message?: string | null;
    receipt?: ActivationReceipt;
  } {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const expRev = options.expected_revision !== undefined ? options.expected_revision : options.expectedRevision;
    if (expRev !== undefined) {
      const currentRev = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState().active_revision || 1;
      if (expRev !== currentRev) {
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 'invalid_response',
          message: `REVISION_CONFLICT: Expected entitlement revision ${expRev}, but current revision is ${currentRev}`
        };
      }
    }

    // Check idempotency if key provided
    if (options.idempotency_key) {
      const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify({
        response_id: responsePayload?.response_id,
        response_hash: responsePayload?.response_hash,
        request_id: responsePayload?.request_id
      });
      const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');

      const existing = db.prepare('SELECT payload_hash, response_json FROM fulfillment_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(options.idempotency_key) as any;
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.payload_hash !== payloadHash) {
          throw new Error(`IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Idempotency key "${options.idempotency_key}" was previously used with a different response`);
        }
        return JSON.parse(existing.response_json);
      }
    }

    // 1. Authenticate response signature and hash integrity
    const verification = this.verifyResponse(responsePayload);
    if (!verification.valid) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `Response validation failed: ${verification.message}`
      };
    }

    // 2. Request binding check (Customer paths strictly require matching local request)
    const matchingReq = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM fulfillment_requests WHERE request_id = ?').get(responsePayload.request_id) as any;

    if (!matchingReq) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `UNBOUND_RESPONSE_REJECTED: Request ID "${responsePayload.request_id}" was not generated by this workstation`
      };
    }

    if (matchingReq.request_hash !== responsePayload.request_hash) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `UNBOUND_RESPONSE_REJECTED: Request hash mismatch: request had "${matchingReq.request_hash}", response specifies "${responsePayload.request_hash}"`
      };
    }

    if (matchingReq.status === 'fulfilled') {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `Request "${responsePayload.request_id}" has already been fulfilled and cannot be replayed`
      };
    }

    if (matchingReq.status === 'cancelled') {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `Request "${responsePayload.request_id}" was cancelled prior to response import`
      };
    }

    // 3. Handle Refusal or Needs-Information Responses
    if (responsePayload.status === 'rejected') {
      const rejectResult = {
        success: false,
        status: 'rejected' as const,
        message: 'Fulfillment request was declined by the operator.',
        operator_message: responsePayload.operator_message
      };

      db.transaction(() => {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE fulfillment_requests
          SET status = 'rejected', response_id = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
          WHERE request_id = ?
        `).run(responsePayload.response_id, now, responsePayload.request_id);

        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO fulfillment_responses (
            response_id, request_id, request_hash, action, status,
            predecessor_license_id, superseded_license_ids_json, license_envelope_json,
            operator_message, issuer_id, key_id, trust_bundle_id,
            issued_at_utc, response_hash, signature, applied_at_utc
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'rejected', ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'REDACTED_BY_LINEAGE_POLICY', ?)
        `).run(
          responsePayload.response_id,
          responsePayload.request_id,
          responsePayload.request_hash,
          responsePayload.action,
          responsePayload.predecessor_license_id || null,
          JSON.stringify(responsePayload.superseded_license_ids || []),
          responsePayload.operator_message || 'Request rejected by operator',
          responsePayload.issuer_id,
          responsePayload.key_id,
          responsePayload.trust_bundle_id,
          responsePayload.issued_at_utc,
          responsePayload.response_hash,
          now
        );

        if (this.faultInjectionPoint === 'inside_write_transaction') {
          throw new Error('TEST_FAULT_INSIDE_WRITE_TRANSACTION: Injected failure inside SQLite transaction');
        }

        if (options.idempotency_key) {
          const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify({
            response_id: responsePayload.response_id,
            response_hash: responsePayload.response_hash,
            request_id: responsePayload.request_id
          });
          const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');
          db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fulfillment_idempotency (idempotency_key, operation, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
            VALUES (?, 'apply_response', ?, ?, ?)
          `).run(options.idempotency_key, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(rejectResult), now);
        }
      })();

      return rejectResult;
    }

    if (responsePayload.status === 'needs_information') {
      const needsInfoResult = {
        success: false,
        status: 'needs_information' as const,
        message: 'The operator requested additional information to fulfill this license request.',
        operator_message: responsePayload.operator_message
      };

      db.transaction(() => {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE fulfillment_requests
          SET status = 'needs_information', response_id = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
          WHERE request_id = ?
        `).run(responsePayload.response_id, now, responsePayload.request_id);

        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO fulfillment_responses (
            response_id, request_id, request_hash, action, status,
            predecessor_license_id, superseded_license_ids_json, license_envelope_json,
            operator_message, issuer_id, key_id, trust_bundle_id,
            issued_at_utc, response_hash, signature, applied_at_utc
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'needs_information', ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'REDACTED_BY_LINEAGE_POLICY', ?)
        `).run(
          responsePayload.response_id,
          responsePayload.request_id,
          responsePayload.request_hash,
          responsePayload.action,
          responsePayload.predecessor_license_id || null,
          JSON.stringify(responsePayload.superseded_license_ids || []),
          responsePayload.operator_message || 'Additional information required',
          responsePayload.issuer_id,
          responsePayload.key_id,
          responsePayload.trust_bundle_id,
          responsePayload.issued_at_utc,
          responsePayload.response_hash,
          now
        );

        if (this.faultInjectionPoint === 'inside_write_transaction') {
          throw new Error('TEST_FAULT_INSIDE_WRITE_TRANSACTION: Injected failure inside SQLite transaction');
        }

        if (options.idempotency_key) {
          const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify({
            response_id: responsePayload.response_id,
            response_hash: responsePayload.response_hash,
            request_id: responsePayload.request_id
          });
          const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');
          db.prepare(`
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fulfillment_idempotency (idempotency_key, operation, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
            VALUES (?, 'apply_response', ?, ?, ?)
          `).run(options.idempotency_key, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(needsInfoResult), now);
        }
      })();

      return needsInfoResult;
    }

    // 4. Approved Response Handling
    if (!responsePayload.license_envelope) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: 'Approved fulfillment response is missing signed license envelope'
      };
    }

    const envelope = responsePayload.license_envelope;

    // Verify envelope against verifier
    const envelopeVerification = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().verify(envelope);
    if (!envelopeVerification.is_valid) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'invalid_response',
        message: `License envelope in response failed verification: ${envelopeVerification.reason}`
      };
    }

    // Capture state before apply
    const beforeState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();
    const revisionBefore = beforeState.active_revision || 1;
    const previousLicenseId = beforeState.active_license_id;
    const nextRev = revisionBefore + 1;

    const p = envelope.payload;
    const masked = maskLicenseId(p.license_id);
    const customerName = p.customer_name_masked || 'Licensed User';

    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
    const currentBundleId = trustStore.bundleId || null;
    const currentBundleRev = trustStore.bundleRevision || null;
    const currentBundleDigest = trustStore.bundleDigest || null;

    // Build lineage chain: previous license ID, superseded IDs, predecessor ID
    const lineageChain: string[] = [];
    if (previousLicenseId) lineageChain.push(previousLicenseId);
    if (responsePayload.predecessor_license_id && !lineageChain.includes(responsePayload.predecessor_license_id)) {
      lineageChain.push(responsePayload.predecessor_license_id);
    }
    for (const supId of responsePayload.superseded_license_ids || []) {
      if (!lineageChain.includes(supId)) lineageChain.push(supId);
    }

    const receiptId = `rec_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const rawReceipt: Omit<ActivationReceipt, 'receipt_hash'> = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      receipt_id: receiptId,
      applied_at_utc: now,
      action: responsePayload.action,
      request_id: responsePayload.request_id,
      request_hash: responsePayload.request_hash,
      response_id: responsePayload.response_id,
      response_hash: responsePayload.response_hash,
      previous_license_id_masked: previousLicenseId ? maskLicenseId(previousLicenseId) : null,
      previous_tier: beforeState.tier,
      new_license_id_masked: maskLicenseId(envelope.payload.license_id),
      new_tier: envelope.payload.tier,
      entitlement_revision_before: revisionBefore,
      entitlement_revision_after: nextRev,
      trust_bundle_id: responsePayload.trust_bundle_id,
      lineage_chain: lineageChain
    };

    const receiptHash = computeReceiptHash(rawReceipt);
    const receipt: ActivationReceipt = {
      ...rawReceipt,
      receipt_hash: receiptHash
    };

    const sanitizedHistoryMetadata = JSON.stringify({
      license_id_masked: masked,
      tier: p.tier,
      key_id: p.key_id,
      issuer_id: p.issuer_id
    });
    const historyId = `hist_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;

    const approvedResult = {
      success: true,
      status: 'approved' as const,
      message: `Successfully fulfilled ${responsePayload.action} request. Tier upgraded to ${receipt.new_tier}.`,
      operator_message: responsePayload.operator_message,
      receipt
    };

    // Test fault injection point: after in-memory state derivation
    if (this.faultInjectionPoint === 'after_derivation') {
      throw new Error('TEST_FAULT_AFTER_DERIVATION: Injected failure after in-memory state derivation');
    }

    // Single Atomic SQLite Transaction for the entire fulfillment mutation
    db.transaction(() => {
      // 1. Advance trusted clock state
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE trusted_clock_state
        SET last_seen_utc = ?, monotonic_counter = monotonic_counter + 1, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE id = 1
      `).run(now, now);

      // 2. Upsert license_registry (raw_token is NULL, envelope_json has verified envelope)
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_registry (
          id, license_id, customer_id, customer_name_masked, tier,
          max_profiles, features_json, envelope_json, raw_token,
          key_id, issuer_id, issued_at_utc, not_before_utc, expires_at_utc,
          grace_period_days, revocation_epoch, order_id, status, active_revision,
          trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_revision, trust_bundle_digest,
          activated_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
          license_id = excluded.license_id,
          customer_id = excluded.customer_id,
          customer_name_masked = excluded.customer_name_masked,
          tier = excluded.tier,
          max_profiles = excluded.max_profiles,
          features_json = excluded.features_json,
          envelope_json = excluded.envelope_json,
          raw_token = NULL,
          key_id = excluded.key_id,
          issuer_id = excluded.issuer_id,
          issued_at_utc = excluded.issued_at_utc,
          not_before_utc = excluded.not_before_utc,
          expires_at_utc = excluded.expires_at_utc,
          grace_period_days = excluded.grace_period_days,
          revocation_epoch = excluded.revocation_epoch,
          order_id = excluded.order_id,
          status = excluded.status,
          active_revision = excluded.active_revision,
          trust_bundle_id = excluded.trust_bundle_id,
          trust_bundle_revision = excluded.trust_bundle_revision,
          trust_bundle_digest = excluded.trust_bundle_digest,
          activated_at_utc = excluded.activated_at_utc,
          updated_at_utc = excluded.updated_at_utc
      `).run(
        p.license_id,
        p.customer_id,
        customerName,
        p.tier,
        p.max_profiles,
        JSON.stringify(p.features || []),
        JSON.stringify(envelope),
        p.key_id,
        p.issuer_id,
        p.issued_at_utc,
        p.not_before_utc,
        p.expires_at_utc,
        p.grace_period_days ?? 7,
        p.revocation_epoch ?? 0,
        p.order_id || null,
        envelopeVerification.status,
        nextRev,
        currentBundleId,
        currentBundleRev,
        currentBundleDigest,
        now,
        now
      );

      // 3. Record in license_history (sanitized metadata, zero secrets)
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO license_history (
          history_id, license_id, action, tier, key_id, envelope_json, reason,
          trust_bundle_id, trust_bundle_revision, trust_bundle_digest, recorded_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, 'activated', ?, ?, ?, 'Asymmetric offline activation via fulfillment response', ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(historyId, p.license_id, p.tier, p.key_id, sanitizedHistoryMetadata, currentBundleId, currentBundleRev, currentBundleDigest, now);

      // 4. Keep license_entitlements table synchronized
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE license_entitlements
        SET tier = ?, licensee_name = ?, license_key_masked = ?,
            trial_started_at_utc = ?, trial_sessions_analyzed = 0, trial_session_limit = 3, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE id = 1
      `).run(p.tier, customerName, masked, now, now);

      // 5. Record activation receipt
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO activation_receipts (
          receipt_id, applied_at_utc, action, request_id, request_hash,
          response_id, response_hash, previous_license_id_masked, previous_tier,
          new_license_id_masked, new_tier, entitlement_revision_before,
          entitlement_revision_after, trust_bundle_id, lineage_chain_json, receipt_hash
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        receipt.receipt_id,
        receipt.applied_at_utc,
        receipt.action,
        receipt.request_id,
        receipt.request_hash,
        receipt.response_id,
        receipt.response_hash,
        receipt.previous_license_id_masked,
        receipt.previous_tier,
        receipt.new_license_id_masked,
        receipt.new_tier,
        receipt.entitlement_revision_before,
        receipt.entitlement_revision_after,
        receipt.trust_bundle_id,
        JSON.stringify(receipt.lineage_chain),
        receipt.receipt_hash
      );

      // 6. Record fulfillment response (envelope_json NULL, signature REDACTED_BY_LINEAGE_POLICY)
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO fulfillment_responses (
          response_id, request_id, request_hash, action, status,
          predecessor_license_id, superseded_license_ids_json, license_envelope_json,
          operator_message, issuer_id, key_id, trust_bundle_id,
          issued_at_utc, response_hash, signature, applied_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'approved', ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'REDACTED_BY_LINEAGE_POLICY', ?)
      `).run(
        responsePayload.response_id,
        responsePayload.request_id,
        responsePayload.request_hash,
        responsePayload.action,
        responsePayload.predecessor_license_id || null,
        JSON.stringify(responsePayload.superseded_license_ids || []),
        responsePayload.operator_message || null,
        responsePayload.issuer_id,
        responsePayload.key_id,
        responsePayload.trust_bundle_id,
        responsePayload.issued_at_utc,
        responsePayload.response_hash,
        now
      );

      // 7. Update fulfillment request to fulfilled
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE fulfillment_requests
        SET status = 'fulfilled', fulfilled_at_utc = ?, response_id = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE request_id = ?
      `).run(now, responsePayload.response_id, now, responsePayload.request_id);

      // Test fault injection point: inside write transaction
      if (this.faultInjectionPoint === 'inside_write_transaction') {
        throw new Error('TEST_FAULT_INSIDE_WRITE_TRANSACTION: Injected failure inside SQLite transaction');
      }

      // 8. Record idempotency inside transaction
      if (options.idempotency_key) {
        const canonicalPayload = JSON.stringify({
          response_id: responsePayload.response_id,
          response_hash: responsePayload.response_hash,
          request_id: responsePayload.request_id
        });
        const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fulfillment_idempotency (idempotency_key, operation, payload_hash, response_json, created_at_utc)
          VALUES (?, 'apply_response', ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(options.idempotency_key, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(approvedResult), now);
      }
    })();

    return approvedResult;
  }

  /**
   * Returns list of activation receipts for audit and customer support recovery.
   */
  public getReceipts(limit: number = 20): ActivationReceipt[] {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM activation_receipts
      ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT ?
    `).all(limit) as any[];

    return rows.map(r => ({
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      receipt_id: r.receipt_id,
      applied_at_utc: r.applied_at_utc,
      action: r.action,
      request_id: r.request_id,
      request_hash: r.request_hash,
      response_id: r.response_id,
      response_hash: r.response_hash,
      previous_license_id_masked: r.previous_license_id_masked,
      previous_tier: r.previous_tier,
      new_license_id_masked: r.new_license_id_masked,
      new_tier: r.new_tier,
      entitlement_revision_before: r.entitlement_revision_before,
      entitlement_revision_after: r.entitlement_revision_after,
      trust_bundle_id: r.trust_bundle_id,
      lineage_chain: JSON.parse(r.lineage_chain_json || '[]'),
      receipt_hash: r.receipt_hash
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Emits a pure, side-effect-free commercial exchange workspace snapshot.
   */
  public getCommercialExchangeSnapshot(): CommercialExchangeWorkspaceSnapshot {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const entitlementState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();
    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
    const activeRequest = this.getActiveRequest();
    const receipts = this.getReceipts(10);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const allowedActions: FulfillmentAction[] = [
      'new',
      'renew',
      'upgrade',
      'downgrade',
      'replace',
      'reactivate',
      'transfer_request'
    ];

    const isClockSkew = entitlementState.clock_healthy === false;
    const isRevoked = entitlementState.status === 'revoked';
    const status = isClockSkew
      ? 'clock_rollback'
      : (entitlementState.status as any || 'active');

    // Query last response if any
    const lastResponse = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM fulfillment_responses
      ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    let nextActionCode = 'EXPORT_REQUEST';
    let nextLabel = 'Export Fulfillment Request';
    let nextLabelRu = 'Экспортировать запрос на лицензию';
    let nextDesc = 'Create and export a signed fulfillment request file to obtain or upgrade your license.';
    let nextDescRu = 'Создайте и экспортируйте файл запроса для получения или продления лицензии.';

    if (isClockSkew) {
      nextActionCode = 'restore_clock';
      nextLabel = 'Restore System Clock';
      nextLabelRu = 'Восстановить системные часы';
      nextDesc = 'System clock anomaly detected. Please restore the real time on your machine.';
      nextDescRu = 'Обнаружен сдвиг системных часов. Пожалуйста, синхронизируйте системное время.';
    } else if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'needs_information') {
      nextActionCode = 'PROVIDE_FULFILLMENT_INFORMATION';
      nextLabel = 'Provide Fulfillment Information';
      nextLabelRu = 'Предоставить уточняющие данные';
      nextDesc = `The operator requested additional information: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Please contact support'}". Please generate an updated request with the required notes.`;
      nextDescRu = `Оператор запросил уточняющие данные: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Пожалуйста, свяжитесь с поддержкой'}". Создайте обновленный запрос с примечанием.`;
    } else if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'rejected') {
      nextActionCode = 'REQUEST_RECONSIDERATION';
      nextLabel = 'Create Updated Request';
      nextLabelRu = 'Создать новый запрос';
      nextDesc = `Previous request declined: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Declined'}". You may submit an updated request.`;
      nextDescRu = `Предыдущий запрос отклонен: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Отклонен'}". Вы можете отправить обновленный запрос.`;
    } else if (activeRequest && activeRequest.status === 'pending') {
      nextActionCode = 'EXPORT_REQUEST';
      nextLabel = 'Exchange Fulfillment File';
      nextLabelRu = 'Передать файл запроса';
      nextDesc = 'Request generated. Export and transfer the file to CardioLab operator.';
      nextDescRu = 'Запрос сформирован. Экспортируйте файл и передайте его оператору CardioLab.';
    } else if (entitlementState.in_grace_period) {
      nextActionCode = 'request_renewal';
      nextLabel = 'Request Renewal';
      nextLabelRu = 'Запросить продление';
      nextDesc = 'License is in grace period. Generate a renewal request before grace ends.';
      nextDescRu = 'Лицензия находится в льготном периоде. Сформируйте запрос на продление.';
    } else if (entitlementState.is_expired) {
      nextActionCode = 'reactivate_license';
      nextLabel = 'Reactivate License';
      nextLabelRu = 'Активировать продление';
      nextDesc = 'License expired. All past data remains accessible. Request renewal to unlock pro exports.';
      nextDescRu = 'Срок лицензии истек. Все прошлые данные доступны. Запросите продление для разблокировки pro-функций.';
    } else if (entitlementState.active_license_id && entitlementState.tier !== 'trial') {
      nextActionCode = 'idle';
      nextLabel = 'Workstation Ready';
      nextLabelRu = 'Рабочая станция готова';
      nextDesc = 'Offline workstation is running in healthy local entitlement mode.';
      nextDescRu = 'Рабочая станция функционирует в штатном локальном режиме.';
    }

    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      entitlement_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
      workspace_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
      source: entitlementState.active_license_id ? 'signed_license' : 'trial',
      tier: entitlementState.tier,
      status,
      expires_at_utc: entitlementState.expires_at_utc || null,
      grace_period_days: entitlementState.grace_period_days || 7,
      in_grace_period: Boolean(entitlementState.in_grace_period),
      is_revoked: isRevoked,
      trusted_clock_state: {
        healthy: !isClockSkew,
        last_seen_utc: (entitlementState as any).last_clock_update_utc || (entitlementState as any).trusted_clock?.last_seen_utc || now,
        skew_detected: isClockSkew
      },
      active_license_id_masked: entitlementState.active_license_id ? maskLicenseId(entitlementState.active_license_id) : null,
      trust_bundle: {
        bundle_id: trustStore.bundleId || 'bundle-initial',
        bundle_digest: trustStore.bundleDigest || 'initial_built_in_authority',
        bundle_revision: trustStore.bundleRevision || 1
      },
      current_request_status: activeRequest ? activeRequest.status : 'none',
      active_request: activeRequest,
      current_import_status: 'idle',
      recent_receipts: receipts,
      allowed_actions: allowedActions,
      profile_limits: {
        current_profiles: 1,
        max_profiles: entitlementState.capabilities?.max_profiles || (entitlementState.tier === 'professional' ? 9999 : 2),
        limit_reached: false
      },
      data_access_guarantee: {
        prior_sessions_readable: true,
        prior_exports_accessible: true,
        database_unlocked: true
      },
      typed_reasons: isClockSkew ? ['CLOCK_SKEW_DETECTED'] : (isRevoked ? ['LICENSE_REVOKED'] : []),
      safe_next_action: {
        action_code: nextActionCode,
        label: nextLabel,
        label_ru: nextLabelRu,
        description: nextDesc,
        description_ru: nextDescRu
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves complete customer lifecycle snapshot for UI and support diagnosis.
   */
  public getLifecycleSnapshot(): CustomerLifecycleSnapshot {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();

    const activeRequest = this.getActiveRequest();
    const receipts = this.getReceipts(10);
    const entitlementState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();

    const totalReceiptsRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM activation_receipts').get() as any;
    const totalReceipts = totalReceiptsRow?.cnt || 0;

    // Check last response status
    const lastResponse = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM fulfillment_responses
      ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    let guidanceState: 'idle' | 'request_pending' | 'response_approved' | 'response_rejected' | 'needs_information' = 'idle';
    let instructions = 'Offline workstation is operating normally under local entitlement rules.';
    let instructions_ru = 'Автономная рабочая станция работает в штатном режиме согласно локальным правилам лицензирования.';

    if (activeRequest && activeRequest.status === 'pending') {
      guidanceState = 'request_pending';
      instructions = 'A fulfillment request is pending. Export or copy the request JSON and send it to CardioLab support/operator to receive your signed response.';
      instructions_ru = 'Запрос на лицензирование ожидает ответа. Скопируйте или сохраните JSON запроса и отправьте его оператору/в поддержку CardioLab для получения подписанного ответа.';
    } else if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'rejected') {
      guidanceState = 'response_rejected';
      instructions = `Your previous license request was declined by the operator. Reason: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'No reason provided'}". Your existing entitlements remain active.`;
      instructions_ru = `Ваш предыдущий запрос был отклонен оператором. Причина: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Причина не указана'}". Текущие права доступа сохранены без изменений.`;
    } else if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'needs_information') {
      guidanceState = 'needs_information';
      instructions = `The operator requested additional information: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Please contact support'}". Please generate an updated request with the required notes.`;
      instructions_ru = `Оператор запросил уточняющие данные: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Пожалуйста, свяжитесь с поддержкой'}". Создайте обновленный запрос с необходимыми примечаниями.`;
    } else if (receipts.length > 0) {
      guidanceState = 'response_approved';
      instructions = `Latest license activation (${receipts[0].action} to ${receipts[0].new_tier}) was successfully verified and recorded in your local lineage ledger.`;
      instructions_ru = `Последняя активация (${receipts[0].action} -> ${receipts[0].new_tier}) успешно проверена и зафиксирована в локальном реестре истории.`;
    }

    return {
      active_request: activeRequest,
      recent_receipts: receipts,
      lineage_status: {
        current_tier: entitlementState.tier,
        active_license_id_masked: entitlementState.active_license_id ? maskLicenseId(entitlementState.active_license_id) : null,
        active_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
        total_receipts: totalReceipts,
        last_receipt_at_utc: receipts.length > 0 ? receipts[0].applied_at_utc : null
      },
      support_safe_guidance: {
        state: guidanceState,
        instructions,
        instructions_ru
      }
    };
  }

  public getVerifier(): LicenseVerifier {
    return this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier();
  }

  /**
   * Returns list of activation receipts conforming strictly to CustomerLifecycleCommandReceipt.
   */
  public getCustomerLifecycleReceipts(limit: number = 20): CustomerLifecycleCommandReceipt[] {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT r.*, resp.issuer_id, resp.key_id, resp.operator_message
      FROM activation_receipts r
      LEFT JOIN fulfillment_responses resp ON r.response_id = resp.response_id
      ORDER BY r.applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT ?
    `).all(limit) as any[];

    return rows.map(r => {
      const receipt: CustomerLifecycleCommandReceipt = {
        schema_version: '1.0.0',
        receipt_id: r.receipt_id,
        applied_at_utc: r.applied_at_utc,
        action: r.action as FulfillmentAction,
        result: 'approved',
        request_id: r.request_id,
        request_hash: r.request_hash,
        response_id: r.response_id,
        response_hash: r.response_hash,
        previous_license_id_masked: r.previous_license_id_masked || null,
        previous_tier: r.previous_tier as LicenseTier,
        new_license_id_masked: r.new_license_id_masked,
        new_tier: r.new_tier as LicenseTier,
        entitlement_revision_before: r.entitlement_revision_before,
        entitlement_revision_after: r.entitlement_revision_after,
        trust_bundle_id: r.trust_bundle_id,
        issuer_id: r.issuer_id || 'cardiolab-production-issuer',
        key_id: r.key_id || 'ed25519-2026-v1',
        idempotency_key: null,
        receipt_hash: r.receipt_hash,
        reason_digest: null,
        lineage_chain: JSON.parse(r.lineage_chain_json || '[]')
      };
      validateCustomerLifecycleCommandReceipt(receipt);
      return receipt;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Emits a runtime-validated CustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot for G32 Settings and onboarding.
   */
  public getCustomerActivationSnapshot(): CustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const entitlementState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();
    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
    const activeRequest = this.getActiveRequest();
    const receipts = this.getCustomerLifecycleReceipts(10);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const isClockSkew = entitlementState.clock_healthy === false;
    const isRevoked = entitlementState.status === 'revoked';
    const isExpired = Boolean(entitlementState.is_expired);
    const inGrace = Boolean(entitlementState.in_grace_period);

    let status: 'active' | 'expired' | 'grace_period' | 'revoked' | 'clock_rollback' = 'active';
    if (isClockSkew) {
      status = 'clock_rollback';
    } else if (isRevoked) {
      status = 'revoked';
    } else if (inGrace) {
      status = 'grace_period';
    } else if (isExpired) {
      status = 'expired';
    } else {
      status = (entitlementState.status as any) || 'active';
    }

    // Determine recovery class & safe next action
    let recoveryClass: LicenseSupportRecoveryClass = 'none';
    const typedReasons: string[] = [];

    let nextActionCode = 'EXPORT_REQUEST';
    let nextLabel = 'Export Fulfillment Request';
    let nextLabelRu = 'Экспортировать запрос на лицензию';
    let nextDesc = 'Generate and export a signed fulfillment request file to obtain or upgrade your license.';
    let nextDescRu = 'Создайте и экспортируйте файл запроса для получения или продления лицензии.';

    if (isClockSkew) {
      recoveryClass = 'clock_rollback';
      typedReasons.push('SYSTEM_CLOCK_SKEW_DETECTED');
      nextActionCode = 'restore_clock';
      nextLabel = 'Restore System Clock';
      nextLabelRu = 'Синхронизировать системные часы';
      nextDesc = 'System clock anomaly detected. Please restore the real time on your machine.';
      nextDescRu = 'Обнаружен сдвиг системных часов. Пожалуйста, синхронизируйте системное время.';
    } else if (isRevoked) {
      recoveryClass = 'key_revoked';
      typedReasons.push('LICENSE_KEY_REVOKED');
      nextActionCode = 'reactivate_license';
      nextLabel = 'Reactivate License';
      nextLabelRu = 'Запросить повторную активацию';
      nextDesc = 'The active license key was revoked. Generate a replacement request.';
      nextDescRu = 'Активная лицензия отозвана. Сформируйте запрос на замену ключа.';
    } else if (isExpired) {
      recoveryClass = 'reactivation_required';
      typedReasons.push('LICENSE_EXPIRED');
      nextActionCode = 'reactivate_license';
      nextLabel = 'Reactivate License';
      nextLabelRu = 'Запросить продление';
      nextDesc = 'License expired. All past data remains accessible. Request renewal to unlock pro exports.';
      nextDescRu = 'Срок действия лицензии истек. Все данные сохранены. Запросите продление.';
    } else if (inGrace) {
      typedReasons.push('LICENSE_IN_GRACE_PERIOD');
      nextActionCode = 'request_renewal';
      nextLabel = 'Request Renewal';
      nextLabelRu = 'Запросить продление';
      nextDesc = 'License is in grace period. Generate a renewal request before grace ends.';
      nextDescRu = 'Лицензия в льготном периоде. Сформируйте запрос на продление.';
    } else if (activeRequest && activeRequest.status === 'pending') {
      nextActionCode = 'EXPORT_REQUEST';
      nextLabel = 'Exchange Fulfillment File';
      nextLabelRu = 'Передать файл запроса';
      nextDesc = 'Request generated. Export and transfer the file to CardioLab operator.';
      nextDescRu = 'Запрос сформирован. Экспортируйте файл и передайте его оператору.';
    } else if (entitlementState.active_license_id && entitlementState.tier !== 'trial') {
      nextActionCode = 'idle';
      nextLabel = 'Workstation Ready';
      nextLabelRu = 'Рабочая станция готова';
      nextDesc = 'Offline workstation is running in healthy local entitlement mode.';
      nextDescRu = 'Рабочая станция функционирует в штатном локальном режиме.';
    }

    // Check last response for refusal / needs info
    const lastResponse = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM fulfillment_responses
      ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'needs_information') {
      typedReasons.push('OPERATOR_REQUESTED_INFORMATION');
      nextActionCode = 'PROVIDE_FULFILLMENT_INFORMATION';
      nextLabel = 'Provide Fulfillment Information';
      nextLabelRu = 'Предоставить уточняющие данные';
      nextDesc = `The operator requested additional information: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Please contact support'}".`;
      nextDescRu = `Оператор запросил уточняющие данные: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Свяжитесь с поддержкой'}".`;
    } else if (lastResponse && lastResponse.status === 'rejected') {
      recoveryClass = 'response_mismatch';
      typedReasons.push('OPERATOR_REJECTED_REQUEST');
      nextActionCode = 'REQUEST_RECONSIDERATION';
      nextLabel = 'Create Updated Request';
      nextLabelRu = 'Создать новый запрос';
      nextDesc = `Previous request was declined: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Declined'}". You may submit an updated request.`;
      nextDescRu = `Предыдущий запрос отклонен: "${lastResponse.operator_message || 'Отклонен'}". Создайте обновленный запрос.`;
    }

    let pendingPreflight: any = null;
    try {
      pendingPreflight = commercialExchangeFileBroker.getPendingPreflight();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }

    const permittedActions: FulfillmentAction[] = [
      'new',
      'renew',
      'upgrade',
      'downgrade',
      'replace',
      'reactivate',
      'transfer_request'
    ];

    const snapshot: CustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      entitlement_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
      workspace_revision: entitlementState.active_revision || 1,
      source: entitlementState.active_license_id ? 'signed_license' : (entitlementState.tier === 'beta' ? 'beta' : 'trial'),
      tier: entitlementState.tier,
      status,
      expires_at_utc: entitlementState.expires_at_utc || null,
      grace_period_days: entitlementState.grace_period_days || 7,
      in_grace_period: inGrace,
      is_revoked: isRevoked,
      trusted_clock_state: {
        healthy: !isClockSkew,
        last_seen_utc: (entitlementState as any).last_clock_update_utc || (entitlementState as any).trusted_clock?.last_seen_utc || now,
        skew_detected: isClockSkew
      },
      trial_ledger: {
        trial_started_at_utc: (entitlementState as any).trial_started_at_utc || null,
        trial_duration_days: (entitlementState as any).trial_duration_days || 30,
        trial_sessions_analyzed: (entitlementState as any).trial_sessions_analyzed || 0,
        trial_session_limit: (entitlementState as any).trial_session_limit || 10,
        sessions_remaining: typeof (entitlementState as any).sessions_remaining === 'number' ? (entitlementState as any).sessions_remaining : 10,
        days_remaining: typeof entitlementState.days_remaining === 'number' ? entitlementState.days_remaining : 30
      },
      current_license_masked: {
        license_id_masked: entitlementState.active_license_id ? maskLicenseId(entitlementState.active_license_id) : null,
        predecessor_id_masked: receipts.length > 0 && receipts[0].previous_license_id_masked ? receipts[0].previous_license_id_masked : null,
        licensee_name_masked: entitlementState.licensee_name ? `${entitlementState.licensee_name.slice(0, 3)}***` : null
      },
      trust_bundle: {
        bundle_id: trustStore.bundleId || 'bundle-initial',
        bundle_digest: trustStore.bundleDigest || 'initial_built_in_authority',
        bundle_revision: trustStore.bundleRevision || 1,
        key_status: 'active'
      },
      active_request: activeRequest ? {
        request_id: activeRequest.request_id,
        request_hash: activeRequest.request_hash,
        action: activeRequest.action,
        status: activeRequest.status,
        expires_at_utc: null
      } : null,
      pending_preflight: pendingPreflight,
      recent_receipts: receipts,
      support_recovery: {
        recovery_class: recoveryClass,
        typed_reasons: typedReasons,
        safe_next_action: {
          action_code: nextActionCode,
          label: nextLabel,
          label_ru: nextLabelRu,
          description: nextDesc,
          description_ru: nextDescRu
        }
      },
      existing_data_guarantees: {
        prior_sessions_readable: true,
        prior_exports_accessible: true,
        database_unlocked: true
      },
      permitted_lifecycle_actions: permittedActions
    };

    validateCustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot(snapshot);
    return snapshot;
  }

  /**
   * Emits a strictly validated ProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot for G33 single activation authority.
   */
  public getProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot(): ProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot {
    const snapshot = this.getCustomerActivationSnapshot();
    validateProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot(snapshot);
    return snapshot;
  }

  /**
   * Emits a privacy-safe LicenseSupportCaseSnapshot for self-service recovery and triage.
   */
  public getSupportCaseSnapshot(): LicenseSupportCaseSnapshot {
    this.ensureSchema();
    const db = getDb();
    const activeReq = this.getActiveRequest();
    const receipts = this.getReceipts(1);
    const entitlementState = this.entitlementSvc.getEntitlementState();
    const trustStore = this.entitlementSvc.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
    const snap = this.getCustomerActivationSnapshot();

    const lastResponse = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM fulfillment_responses
      ORDER BY applied_at_utc DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    const caseSnap: LicenseSupportCaseSnapshot = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      case_id: `case_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      support_class: snap.support_recovery.recovery_class,
      masked_identities: {
        request_id: activeReq?.request_id || null,
        response_id: lastResponse?.response_id || null,
        current_license_id_masked: entitlementState.active_license_id ? maskLicenseId(entitlementState.active_license_id) : null,
        predecessor_license_id_masked: receipts.length > 0 ? receipts[0].previous_license_id_masked : null
      },
      hashes: {
        request_hash: activeReq?.request_hash || null,
        response_hash: lastResponse?.response_hash || null,
        trust_digest: trustStore.bundleDigest || null
      },
      reason_codes: snap.support_recovery.typed_reasons,
      data_preserved: true,
      retry_safe: true,
      primary_action: snap.support_recovery.safe_next_action,
      support_bundle_eligible: true
    };

    validateLicenseSupportCaseSnapshot(caseSnap);
    return caseSnap;
  }
}

export const licenseFulfillmentService = LicenseFulfillmentService.getInstance();

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  SignedLicenseEnvelope,
  SignedLicensePayload,
  PublicKeyRecord,
  LicenseTrustBundle,
  OFFLINE_LICENSE_KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  TEST_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  LicenseVerificationResult,
  LicenseVerificationStatus,
  canonicalSerializeLicense,
  canonicalSerializeTrustBundle,
  computeTrustBundleDigest
} from '../../shared/canonical/OfflineLicenseContract';

export interface LicenseTrustStore {
  environment: 'production' | 'test';
  bundleRevision: number;
  publicKeys: Record<string, PublicKeyRecord>;
  revocationEpoch: number;
  bundleId?: string;
  bundleDigest?: string;
  bootstrapAuthorityId?: string;
  signerKeyId?: string;
  signedAtUtc?: string;
  signature?: string;
  predecessorBundleHash?: string | null;
}

export interface VerificationContext {
  trustStore?: LicenseTrustStore;
  keyRegistry?: Record<string, PublicKeyRecord>;
  currentUtc?: string | Date;
  trustedLastSeenUtc?: string | Date | null;
  revocationEpoch?: number;
  revokedLicenseIds?: Set<string> | string[];
  clockToleranceSeconds?: number;
  environment?: 'production' | 'test';
}

export class LicenseVerifier {
  private static instance: LicenseVerifier;
  private defaultTrustStore: LicenseTrustStore;
  private bootstrapRegistry: Record<string, PublicKeyRecord>;

  constructor(customTrustStore?: LicenseTrustStore, customBootstrapRegistry?: Record<string, PublicKeyRecord>) {
    const env = customTrustStore?.environment || 'production';
    this.bootstrapRegistry = customBootstrapRegistry || (env === 'production' ? { ...PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS } : { ...TEST_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS });
    this.defaultTrustStore = customTrustStore || {
      environment: 'production',
      bundleRevision: 1,
      publicKeys: { ...OFFLINE_LICENSE_KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS },
      revocationEpoch: 0,
      bundleId: 'bundle-prod-2026-v1-initial',
      bundleDigest: 'initial_built_in_authority',
      bootstrapAuthorityId: 'prod-bootstrap-2026-v1',
      signerKeyId: 'prod-bootstrap-2026-v1'
    };
  }

  public getTrustStore(): LicenseTrustStore {
    return this.defaultTrustStore;
  }

  public setTrustStore(trustStore: LicenseTrustStore): void {
    this.defaultTrustStore = trustStore;
  }

  public getBootstrapRegistry(): Record<string, PublicKeyRecord> {
    return this.bootstrapRegistry;
  }

  public setBootstrapRegistry(registry: Record<string, PublicKeyRecord>): void {
    this.bootstrapRegistry = registry;
  }

  /**
   * Cryptographically authenticates a LicenseTrustBundle against pinned bootstrap root.
   * Does NOT mutate in-memory state.
   */
  public verifyTrustBundle(bundle: LicenseTrustBundle): {
    valid: boolean;
    status: 'valid' | 'malformed' | 'invalid_project' | 'environment_mismatch' | 'unprovisioned_bootstrap' | 'unknown_bootstrap_key' | 'bootstrap_revoked' | 'invalid_signature' | 'anti_rollback' | 'epoch_rollback' | 'predecessor_mismatch';
    message: string;
    digest?: string;
  } {
    if (!bundle || bundle.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
      return { valid: false, status: 'malformed', message: 'Malformed trust bundle format or schema version' };
    }

    if (bundle.project_id !== 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab') {
      return { valid: false, status: 'invalid_project', message: `Invalid bundle project_id: "${bundle.project_id}", expected "H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab"` };
    }

    if (bundle.environment !== this.defaultTrustStore.environment) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'environment_mismatch',
        message: `Trust bundle environment mismatch: bundle is "${bundle.environment}" but verifier is configured for "${this.defaultTrustStore.environment}"`
      };
    }

    // Check bootstrap authority registry
    if (!this.bootstrapRegistry || Object.keys(this.bootstrapRegistry).length === 0) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'unprovisioned_bootstrap',
        message: 'No approved bootstrap trust root is provisioned'
      };
    }

    const bootstrapKey = this.bootstrapRegistry[bundle.signer_key_id];
    if (!bootstrapKey) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'unknown_bootstrap_key',
        message: `Signer key ID "${bundle.signer_key_id}" is not in pinned bootstrap registry`
      };
    }

    if (bootstrapKey.status === 'revoked') {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'bootstrap_revoked',
        message: `Bootstrap authority key "${bundle.signer_key_id}" has been revoked`
      };
    }

    // Verify cryptographic signature of bundle
    if (!bundle.signature) {
      return { valid: false, status: 'invalid_signature', message: 'Trust bundle is missing cryptographic signature' };
    }

    try {
      const canonicalString = canonicalSerializeTrustBundle(bundle);
      const dataBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8');
      const signatureBytes = Buffer.from(bundle.signature, 'base64');
      const isSignatureValid = crypto.verify(null, dataBytes, bootstrapKey.public_key_pem, signatureBytes);

      if (!isSignatureValid) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          status: 'invalid_signature',
          message: 'Cryptographic signature mismatch: trust bundle content has been forged or modified'
        };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'invalid_signature',
        message: `Bootstrap signature verification error: ${err.message}`
      };
    }

    // Monotonic revision check
    if (typeof bundle.bundle_revision !== 'number' || bundle.bundle_revision <= this.defaultTrustStore.bundleRevision) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'anti_rollback',
        message: `Anti-rollback violation: incoming bundle revision (${bundle.bundle_revision}) must strictly exceed current revision (${this.defaultTrustStore.bundleRevision})`
      };
    }

    // Revocation epoch monotonicity check
    if (typeof bundle.revocation_epoch !== 'number' || bundle.revocation_epoch < this.defaultTrustStore.revocationEpoch) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        status: 'epoch_rollback',
        message: `Revocation epoch rollback: incoming epoch (${bundle.revocation_epoch}) is less than current epoch (${this.defaultTrustStore.revocationEpoch})`
      };
    }

    // Predecessor hash check if current store has a digest
    if (this.defaultTrustStore.bundleDigest && this.defaultTrustStore.bundleDigest !== 'initial_built_in_authority') {
      if (bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash && bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash !== this.defaultTrustStore.bundleDigest) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          status: 'predecessor_mismatch',
          message: `Predecessor digest mismatch: bundle specifies "${bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash}", expected current active "${this.defaultTrustStore.bundleDigest}"`
        };
      }
    }

    const digest = computeTrustBundleDigest(bundle);
    return {
      valid: true,
      status: 'valid',
      message: `Trust bundle "${bundle.bundle_id}" authenticated successfully`,
      digest
    };
  }

  /**
   * Installs and activates a verified trust bundle in in-memory verifier state.
   */
  public installTrustBundle(bundle: LicenseTrustBundle): { success: boolean; message: string; revision: number; digest?: string } {
    const auth = this.verifyTrustBundle(bundle);
    if (!auth.valid) {
      return { success: false, message: auth.message, revision: this.defaultTrustStore.bundleRevision };
    }

    this.defaultTrustStore = {
      environment: bundle.environment,
      bundleRevision: bundle.bundle_revision,
      publicKeys: { ...bundle.public_keys },
      revocationEpoch: bundle.revocation_epoch ?? 0,
      bundleId: bundle.bundle_id,
      bundleDigest: auth.digest,
      bootstrapAuthorityId: bundle.bootstrap_authority_id,
      signerKeyId: bundle.signer_key_id,
      signedAtUtc: bundle.signed_at_utc,
      signature: bundle.signature,
      predecessorBundleHash: bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash || null
    };

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Successfully installed authenticated trust bundle "${bundle.bundle_id}" revision ${bundle.bundle_revision}`,
      revision: bundle.bundle_revision,
      digest: auth.digest
    };
  }

  public static getInstance(): LicenseVerifier {
    if (!LicenseVerifier.instance) {
      LicenseVerifier.instance = new LicenseVerifier();
    }
    return LicenseVerifier.instance;
  }

  /**
   * Verifies an asymmetric signed license envelope against the trusted public key registry.
   */
  public verify(
    envelope: SignedLicenseEnvelope,
    context: VerificationContext = {}
  ): LicenseVerificationResult {
    if (!envelope || envelope.format !== 'cardiolab_offline_license_v1' || !envelope.payload || !envelope.signature) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'malformed',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: 'Malformed license envelope format'
      };
    }

    const payload = envelope.payload;
    const effectiveTrustStore = context.trustStore || this.defaultTrustStore;
    const keyRegistry = context.keyRegistry || effectiveTrustStore.publicKeys;
    const effectiveEnv = context.environment || effectiveTrustStore.environment;

    // 0. Trust Root Provisioning Check
    if (!keyRegistry || Object.keys(keyRegistry).length === 0) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'unprovisioned_trust_root',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: 'No approved public trust root is provisioned in the trust store',
        payload
      };
    }

    // 0b. Environment Mismatch Check
    // If verifier is in production environment, reject test issuers and test key namespaces
    if (effectiveEnv === 'production') {
      if (
        payload.issuer_id === 'cardiolab-sandbox-issuer' ||
        payload.key_id.startsWith('test-') ||
        (payload.metadata && payload.metadata.environment === 'sandbox_test')
      ) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          status: 'environment_mismatch',
          tier: 'trial',
          reason: `Test/sandbox license token (issuer: "${payload.issuer_id}", key: "${payload.key_id}") is rejected by production trust store`,
          payload
        };
      }
    }

    const keyRecord = keyRegistry[payload.key_id];

    // 1. Key Lookup
    if (!keyRecord) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'unknown_key',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: `Unknown signing key ID: "${payload.key_id}" is not in trusted public registry`,
        payload
      };
    }

    // 2. Key Status Checks
    if (keyRecord.status === 'revoked') {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'revoked',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: `Signing key "${payload.key_id}" has been revoked`,
        payload,
        key_status: 'revoked'
      };
    }

    if (keyRecord.status === 'retired') {
      if (keyRecord.retired_at_utc) {
        const retiredDate = new Date(keyRecord.retired_at_utc).getTime();
        const issuedDate = new Date(payload.issued_at_utc).getTime();
        if (issuedDate >= retiredDate) {
          return {
            is_valid: false,
            status: 'retired_key_unauthorized',
            tier: 'trial',
            reason: `Signing key "${payload.key_id}" was retired before this license was issued`,
            payload,
            key_status: 'retired'
          };
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Cryptographic Signature Verification
    try {
      const canonicalString = canonicalSerializeLicense(payload);
      const dataBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8');
      const signatureBytes = Buffer.from(envelope.signature, 'base64');
      const isSignatureValid = crypto.verify(null, dataBytes, keyRecord.public_key_pem, signatureBytes);

      if (!isSignatureValid) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          status: 'invalid_signature',
          tier: 'trial',
          reason: 'Cryptographic signature mismatch: license content has been forged or modified',
          payload,
          key_status: keyRecord.status
        };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'invalid_signature',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: `Signature verification error: ${err.message}`,
        payload,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    // 4. Revocation Checks
    const revokedSet = context.revokedLicenseIds instanceof Set
      ? context.revokedLicenseIds
      : new Set(context.revokedLicenseIds || []);

    if (revokedSet.has(payload.license_id)) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'revoked',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: `License ID "${payload.license_id}" is on the revoked license registry`,
        payload,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    const currentEpoch = context.revocationEpoch ?? 0;
    if (typeof payload.revocation_epoch === 'number' && payload.revocation_epoch < currentEpoch) {
      return {
        is_valid: false,
        status: 'revoked',
        tier: 'trial',
        reason: `License revocation epoch (${payload.revocation_epoch}) is superseded by current epoch (${currentEpoch})`,
        payload,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    // 5. Time & Clock Verification
    const now = context.currentUtc ? new Date(context.currentUtc) : new Date();
    const toleranceSec = context.clockToleranceSeconds ?? 3600; // 1 hour tolerance for timezone/NTP skew

    // Clock Rollback Detection against trusted anchor
    if (context.trustedLastSeenUtc) {
      const trustedTime = new Date(context.trustedLastSeenUtc).getTime();
      if (now.getTime() < trustedTime - (toleranceSec * 1000)) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          status: 'clock_rollback',
          tier: 'trial',
          reason: `System clock rollback detected: current time (${now.toISOString()}) is earlier than trusted anchor (${new Date(trustedTime).toISOString()})`,
          payload,
          clock_skew_detected: true,
          key_status: keyRecord.status
        };
      }
    }

    // Not Before Check
    if (payload.not_before_utc) {
      const notBefore = new Date(payload.not_before_utc);
      if (now.getTime() < notBefore.getTime() - (toleranceSec * 1000)) {
        return {
          is_valid: false,
          status: 'not_yet_valid',
          tier: 'trial',
          reason: `License is not valid until ${payload.not_before_utc}`,
          payload,
          key_status: keyRecord.status
        };
      }
    }

    // Expiry and Grace Period Checks
    if (!payload.expires_at_utc) {
      // Perpetual License
      return {
        is_valid: true,
        status: 'active',
        tier: payload.tier,
        reason: 'Valid perpetual license',
        payload,
        days_remaining: undefined,
        in_grace_period: false,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    const expiresAt = new Date(payload.expires_at_utc);
    const msRemaining = expiresAt.getTime() - now.getTime();
    const daysRemaining = Math.ceil(msRemaining / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (now.getTime() <= expiresAt.getTime()) {
      return {
        is_valid: true,
        status: 'active',
        tier: payload.tier,
        reason: `Valid active license (${daysRemaining} days remaining)`,
        payload,
        days_remaining: Math.max(0, daysRemaining),
        in_grace_period: false,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    // Check Grace Period
    const graceDays = payload.grace_period_days ?? 7;
    const graceExpiry = new Date(expiresAt.getTime() + (graceDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));

    if (now.getTime() <= graceExpiry.getTime()) {
      const graceDaysLeft = Math.ceil((graceExpiry.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      return {
        is_valid: true,
        status: 'grace_period',
        tier: payload.tier,
        reason: `License expired on ${payload.expires_at_utc}. In grace period (${graceDaysLeft} days left to renew)`,
        payload,
        days_remaining: 0,
        in_grace_period: true,
        key_status: keyRecord.status
      };
    }

    // Expired
    return {
      is_valid: false,
      status: 'expired',
      tier: 'trial',
      reason: `License expired on ${payload.expires_at_utc} and grace period has ended`,
      payload,
      days_remaining: 0,
      in_grace_period: false,
      key_status: keyRecord.status
    };
  }
}

export const licenseVerifier = LicenseVerifier.getInstance();

import { ECGAmplitudeFeatures } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

export function calculateAmplitudeFeatures(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  candidateAbsoluteThresholdUv: number = 19500.0
): ECGAmplitudeFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  if (N === 0) {
    return {
      minimum_uv: 0,
      maximum_uv: 0,
      mean_uv: 0,
      median_uv: 0,
      standard_deviation_uv: 0,
      p01_uv: 0,
      p05_uv: 0,
      p10_uv: 0,
      p90_uv: 0,
      p95_uv: 0,
      p99_uv: 0,
      peak_to_peak_uv: 0,
      p90_minus_p10_uv: 0,
      longest_identical_sample_run: 0,
      flatline_fraction: 0,
      fraction_above_candidate_absolute_amplitude: 0
    };
  }

  const values = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal);
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);

  let sum = 0;
  for (const v of values) sum += v;
  const mean = sum / N;

  let sqSum = 0;
  for (const v of values) sqSum += (v - mean) ** 2;
  const stdDev = Math.sqrt(sqSum / N);

  const min = sorted[0];
  const max = sorted[N - 1];
  const median = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.5)];
  const p01 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.01)];
  const p05 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.05)];
  const p10 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.10)];
  const p90 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.90)];
  const p95 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.95)];
  const p99 = sorted[Math.floor(N * 0.99)];

  const peakToPeak = max - min;
  const p90MinusP10 = p90 - p10;

  // Calculate longest run of identical samples
  let maxRun = 1;
  let currentRun = 1;
  let flatlineCount = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    if (values[i] === values[i - 1]) {
      currentRun++;
      if (currentRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentRun;
      // We consider consecutive repeats as part of flatline
      flatlineCount++;
    } else {
      currentRun = 1;
    }
  }

  const flatlineFrac = N > 1 ? flatlineCount / (N - 1) : 0.0;

  // Fraction above candidate absolute amplitude
  let aboveCount = 0;
  for (const v of values) {
    if (Math.abs(v) >= candidateAbsoluteThresholdUv) {
      aboveCount++;
    }
  }
  const aboveFrac = aboveCount / N;

  return {
    minimum_uv: min,
    maximum_uv: max,
    mean_uv: mean,
    median_uv: median,
    standard_deviation_uv: stdDev,
    p01_uv: p01,
    p05_uv: p05,
    p10_uv: p10,
    p90_uv: p90,
    p95_uv: p95,
    p99_uv: p99,
    peak_to_peak_uv: peakToPeak,
    p90_minus_p10_uv: p90MinusP10,
    longest_identical_sample_run: maxRun,
    flatline_fraction: flatlineFrac,
    fraction_above_candidate_absolute_amplitude: aboveFrac
  };
}

import { ECGBaselineFeatures } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

export function calculateBaselineFeatures(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  nominalSampleRateHz: number = 130.0
): ECGBaselineFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  const rollingWindowSec = 1.0;
  const W = Math.round(nominalSampleRateHz * rollingWindowSec);
  const minSamplesRequired = Math.round(W * 0.5);

  if (N < minSamplesRequired) {
    return {
      rolling_median_baseline_range: null,
      rolling_median_baseline_slope: null,
      detrended_variance: null,
      raw_to_detrended_variance_ratio: null,
      low_frequency_bandpower: null,
      rolling_window_duration_seconds: rollingWindowSec,
      edge_handling: 'truncate_at_boundaries',
      minimum_samples_required: minSamplesRequired,
      reason_unavailable: `insufficient_samples_for_baseline_estimation_N_${N}`
    };
  }

  const values = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal);
  const baseline: number[] = new Array(N);

  // Compute centered rolling median with truncated edge handling
  const halfW = Math.floor(W / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const start = Math.max(0, i - halfW);
    const end = Math.min(N - 1, i + halfW);
    const windowSlice = values.slice(start, end + 1);
    windowSlice.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    baseline[i] = windowSlice[Math.floor(windowSlice.length / 2)];
  }

  // Calculate baseline range
  let maxB = baseline[0];
  let minB = baseline[0];
  for (const b of baseline) {
    if (b > maxB) maxB = b;
    if (b < minB) minB = b;
  }
  const rangeB = maxB - minB;

  // Calculate baseline slope (linear regression)
  let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXY = 0, sumXX = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    sumX += i;
    sumY += baseline[i];
    sumXY += i * baseline[i];
    sumXX += i * i;
  }
  const slope = N > 1 ? (N * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / (N * sumXX - sumX * sumX) : 0;

  // Detrended values
  const detrended = values.map((v, i) => v - baseline[i]);

  // Variance of raw values
  let sumRaw = 0;
  for (const v of values) sumRaw += v;
  const meanRaw = sumRaw / N;
  let sqSumRaw = 0;
  for (const v of values) sqSumRaw += (v - meanRaw) ** 2;
  const rawVar = sqSumRaw / N;

  // Variance of detrended values
  let sumDet = 0;
  for (const d of detrended) sumDet += d;
  const meanDet = sumDet / N;
  let sqSumDet = 0;
  for (const d of detrended) sqSumDet += (d - meanDet) ** 2;
  const detrendedVar = sqSumDet / N;

  const ratio = detrendedVar > 0 ? rawVar / detrendedVar : 1.0;

  // Low frequency bandpower candidate: variance of baseline array
  let sumB = 0;
  for (const b of baseline) sumB += b;
  const meanB = sumB / N;
  let sqSumB = 0;
  for (const b of baseline) sqSumB += (b - meanB) ** 2;
  const baselineVar = sqSumB / N;

  return {
    rolling_median_baseline_range: rangeB,
    rolling_median_baseline_slope: slope,
    detrended_variance: detrendedVar,
    raw_to_detrended_variance_ratio: ratio,
    low_frequency_bandpower: baselineVar,
    rolling_window_duration_seconds: rollingWindowSec,
    edge_handling: 'truncate_at_boundaries',
    minimum_samples_required: minSamplesRequired,
    reason_unavailable: null
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/experimental/ecgSqiPrototype/ecgDetectorAgreement.ts
================================================================================
import { ECGDetectorAgreement } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

export function runPanTompkinsDerivativeDetector(
  values: number[],
  fs: number,
  refractoryMs: number = 250
): number[] {
  const N = values.length;
  if (N < 2) return [];

  // 1. Calculate absolute first difference as pre-processing
  const dy = new Array(N).fill(0);
  let sumDy = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    dy[i] = Math.abs(values[i] - values[i - 1]);
    sumDy += dy[i];
  }
  const meanDy = sumDy / N;

  let sqSumDy = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    sqSumDy += (dy[i] - meanDy) ** 2;
  }
  const stdDy = Math.sqrt(sqSumDy / N);

  // Threshold: mean + 1.5 * std
  const threshold = meanDy + 1.5 * stdDy;
  const refractorySamples = Math.round((refractoryMs / 1000) * fs);

  const peaks: number[] = [];
  let lastPeakIdx = -refractorySamples - 1;

  for (let i = 2; i < N - 2; i++) {
    if (dy[i] > threshold) {
      // Local peak check
      if (dy[i] >= dy[i - 1] && dy[i] >= dy[i - 2] && dy[i] >= dy[i + 1] && dy[i] >= dy[i + 2]) {
        if (i - lastPeakIdx >= refractorySamples) {
          peaks.push(i);
          lastPeakIdx = i;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return peaks;
}

export function runAdaptiveAmplitudeDetector(
  values: number[],
  fs: number,
  refractoryMs: number = 300
): number[] {
  const N = values.length;
  if (N < 10) return [];

  // Detrend locally by subtracting mean
  let sum = 0;
  for (const v of values) sum += v;
  const mean = sum / N;
  const detrended = values.map(v => v - mean);

  // Find absolute maximum deviation
  let maxAbs = 0;
  for (const v of detrended) {
    if (Math.abs(v) > maxAbs) maxAbs = Math.abs(v);
  }

  // Threshold: 0.45 of max absolute value
  const threshold = maxAbs * 0.45;
  const refractorySamples = Math.round((refractoryMs / 1000) * fs);

  const peaks: number[] = [];
  let lastPeakIdx = -refractorySamples - 1;

  for (let i = 1; i < N - 1; i++) {
    const val = Math.abs(detrended[i]);
    if (val > threshold) {
      if (val >= Math.abs(detrended[i - 1]) && val >= Math.abs(detrended[i + 1])) {
        if (i - lastPeakIdx >= refractorySamples) {
          peaks.push(i);
          lastPeakIdx = i;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return peaks;
}

export function calculateDetectorAgreement(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  observedRate: number
): ECGDetectorAgreement {
  const tolerancesMs = [25, 50, 75, 100];
  const values = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal);

  const d1Peaks = runPanTompkinsDerivativeDetector(values, observedRate, 250);
  const d2Peaks = runAdaptiveAmplitudeDetector(values, observedRate, 300);

  const agreementByTolerance: { [tolerance: number]: number | null } = {};
  const unmatchedD1: { [tolerance: number]: number } = {};
  const unmatchedD2: { [tolerance: number]: number } = {};

  const d1Times = d1Peaks.map(idx => Number(samples[idx].sensorTimeNs) / 1e9);
  const d2Times = d2Peaks.map(idx => Number(samples[idx].sensorTimeNs) / 1e9);

  const hasFailure = d1Peaks.length === 0 || d2Peaks.length === 0;

  for (const tolMs of tolerancesMs) {
    const tolSec = tolMs / 1000;
    if (hasFailure) {
      agreementByTolerance[tolMs] = null;
      unmatchedD1[tolMs] = d1Peaks.length;
      unmatchedD2[tolMs] = d2Peaks.length;
      continue;
    }

    // Greedy matching
    const pairs: { i1: number; i2: number; diff: number }[] = [];
    for (let i1 = 0; i1 < d1Times.length; i1++) {
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < d2Times.length; i2++) {
        const diff = Math.abs(d1Times[i1] - d2Times[i2]);
        if (diff <= tolSec) {
          pairs.push({ i1, i2, diff });
        }
      }
    }

    pairs.sort((a, b) => a.diff - b.diff);

    const matched1 = new Set<number>();
    const matched2 = new Set<number>();
    let tp = 0;

    for (const p of pairs) {
      if (!matched1.has(p.i1) && !matched2.has(p.i2)) {
        matched1.add(p.i1);
        matched2.add(p.i2);
        tp++;
      }
    }

    const fp = d1Peaks.length - tp;
    const fn = d2Peaks.length - tp;

    agreementByTolerance[tolMs] = (2 * tp) / (d1Peaks.length + d2Peaks.length);
    unmatchedD1[tolMs] = fp;
    unmatchedD2[tolMs] = fn;
  }

  return {
    detector_1_name: 'PanTompkinsDerivative',
    detector_2_name: 'AdaptiveAmplitudeMovingMax',
    pre_processing_applied: 'd1=first_difference, d2=mean_subtraction',
    detector_1_refractory_ms: 250,
    detector_2_refractory_ms: 300,
    peak_matching_algorithm: 'greedy_one_to_one_closest_time',
    match_tolerance_ms_grid: tolerancesMs,
    agreement_by_tolerance: agreementByTolerance,
    detector_1_peak_count: d1Peaks.length,
    detector_2_peak_count: d2Peaks.length,
    unmatched_detector_1_count: unmatchedD1,
    unmatched_detector_2_count: unmatchedD2,
    detector_failure_status: hasFailure,
    reason: hasFailure ? 'one_or_both_detectors_returned_zero_peaks' : null
  };
}

FILE: src/backend/experimental/ecgSqiPrototype/ecgDifferenceFeatures.ts
