import { ECGDifferenceFeatures } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

export function calculateDifferenceFeatures(samples: RawECGSample[]): ECGDifferenceFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  if (N < 2) {
    return {
      first_difference_variance: 0,
      first_difference_MAD: 0,
      first_difference_p95_absolute: 0,
      second_difference_mean_absolute: 0,
      second_difference_MAD: 0
    };
  }

  const values = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal);
  const firstDiffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    firstDiffs.push(values[i] - values[i - 1]);
  }

  // Population variance of first differences (denominator = firstDiffs.length)
  let sumDiff = 0;
  for (const d of firstDiffs) sumDiff += d;
  const meanDiff = sumDiff / firstDiffs.length;

  let sqSumDiff = 0;
  for (const d of firstDiffs) sqSumDiff += (d - meanDiff) ** 2;
  const firstDiffVar = sqSumDiff / firstDiffs.length;

  // MAD of first differences
  const sortedDiffs = [...firstDiffs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const medianDiff = sortedDiffs[Math.floor(sortedDiffs.length / 2)];
  const absDevs = firstDiffs.map(d => Math.abs(d - medianDiff));
  const sortedDevs = absDevs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const firstDiffMAD = sortedDevs[Math.floor(sortedDevs.length / 2)];

  // p95 of absolute first differences
  const absFirstDiffs = firstDiffs.map(d => Math.abs(d));
  const sortedAbsDiffs = absFirstDiffs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const firstDiffP95Abs = sortedAbsDiffs[Math.floor(sortedAbsDiffs.length * 0.95)];

  // Second differences (length N - 2)
  const secondDiffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < firstDiffs.length; i++) {
    secondDiffs.push(firstDiffs[i] - firstDiffs[i - 1]);
  }

  let secondDiffMeanAbs = 0;
  let secondDiffMAD = 0;

  if (secondDiffs.length > 0) {
    let sumAbsSec = 0;
    for (const d of secondDiffs) sumAbsSec += Math.abs(d);
    secondDiffMeanAbs = sumAbsSec / secondDiffs.length;

    const sortedSec = [...secondDiffs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const medianSec = sortedSec[Math.floor(sortedSec.length / 2)];
    const absDevsSec = secondDiffs.map(d => Math.abs(d - medianSec));
    const sortedDevsSec = absDevsSec.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    secondDiffMAD = sortedDevsSec[Math.floor(sortedDevsSec.length / 2)];
  }

  return {
    first_difference_variance: firstDiffVar,
    first_difference_MAD: firstDiffMAD,
    first_difference_p95_absolute: firstDiffP95Abs,
    second_difference_mean_absolute: secondDiffMeanAbs,
    second_difference_MAD: secondDiffMAD
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/experimental/ecgSqiPrototype/ecgRrReconciliation.ts
================================================================================
import { ECGRrReconciliation } from './ecgSqiTypes';

export function reconcileEcgWithRr(
  ecgPeakTimesSec: number[],
  nativeRrTimesSec: number[]
): ECGRrReconciliation {
  const tolerancesMs = [25, 50, 75, 100];
  const matchedIntervalCount: { [tol: number]: number } = {};
  const unmatchedEcgCount: { [tol: number]: number } = {};
  const unmatchedRrCount: { [tol: number]: number } = {};

  const limitations: string[] = [];
  if (ecgPeakTimesSec.length === 0) limitations.push('no_ecg_peaks_detected');
  if (nativeRrTimesSec.length === 0) limitations.push('no_native_rr_intervals_available');

  if (ecgPeakTimesSec.length === 0 || nativeRrTimesSec.length === 0) {
    return {
      status: 'unavailable',
      alignment_confidence: null,
      lag_estimate_ms: null,
      matched_interval_count: null,
      unmatched_ecg_count: null,
      unmatched_rr_count: null,
      residual_median_ms: null,
      residual_MAD_ms: null,
      residual_p95_ms: null,
      residuals: null,
      reason_codes: limitations,
      alignment_limitations: limitations
    };
  }

  // 1. Candidate lag estimation: search shift in [-500ms, +500ms] to find the shift that maximizes matching peaks
  let bestLagSec = 0.0;
  let maxMatches = -1;

  for (let shiftMs = -500; shiftMs <= 500; shiftMs += 10) {
    const shiftSec = shiftMs / 1000;
    let matches = 0;
    const tempMatched = new Set<number>();
    for (const tE of ecgPeakTimesSec) {
      const shifted = tE - shiftSec;
      // find nearest in nativeRrTimesSec
      let nearestDist = Infinity;
      let nearestIdx = -1;
      for (let j = 0; j < nativeRrTimesSec.length; j++) {
        const d = Math.abs(shifted - nativeRrTimesSec[j]);
        if (d < nearestDist) {
          nearestDist = d;
          nearestIdx = j;
        }
      }
      if (nearestIdx !== -1 && nearestDist <= 0.050 && !tempMatched.has(nearestIdx)) {
        matches++;
        tempMatched.add(nearestIdx);
      }
    }
    if (matches > maxMatches) {
      maxMatches = matches;
      bestLagSec = shiftSec;
    }
  }

  // 2. Perform matching for each tolerance using the estimated bestLagSec
  let finalResidualsMs: number[] = [];

  for (const tolMs of tolerancesMs) {
    const tolSec = tolMs / 1000;
    const matchedRrIndices = new Set<number>();
    let matches = 0;
    const residuals: number[] = [];

    for (const tE of ecgPeakTimesSec) {
      const shifted = tE - bestLagSec;
      let nearestDist = Infinity;
      let nearestIdx = -1;
      for (let j = 0; j < nativeRrTimesSec.length; j++) {
        const d = Math.abs(shifted - nativeRrTimesSec[j]);
        if (d < nearestDist) {
          nearestDist = d;
          nearestIdx = j;
        }
      }

      if (nearestIdx !== -1 && nearestDist <= tolSec && !matchedRrIndices.has(nearestIdx)) {
        matches++;
        matchedRrIndices.add(nearestIdx);
        residuals.push((shifted - nativeRrTimesSec[nearestIdx]) * 1000);
      }
    }

    matchedIntervalCount[tolMs] = matches;
    unmatchedEcgCount[tolMs] = ecgPeakTimesSec.length - matches;
    unmatchedRrCount[tolMs] = nativeRrTimesSec.length - matches;

    // Use 50ms residuals for overall statistics
    if (tolMs === 50) {
      finalResidualsMs = residuals;
    }
  }

  // 3. Residual analysis
  let resMedian: number | null = null;
  let resMAD: number | null = null;
  let resP95: number | null = null;

  if (finalResidualsMs.length > 0) {
    const sorted = [...finalResidualsMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    resMedian = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];

    const absDevs = finalResidualsMs.map(r => Math.abs(r - (resMedian || 0.0)));
    const sortedDevs = absDevs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    resMAD = sortedDevs[Math.floor(sortedDevs.length / 2)];

    const absVals = finalResidualsMs.map(r => Math.abs(r));
    const sortedAbs = absVals.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    resP95 = sortedAbs[Math.floor(sortedAbs.length * 0.95)];
  }

  // Alignment confidence: fraction of matched peaks under 50ms tolerance
  const matched50 = matchedIntervalCount[50];
  const maxEvents = Math.max(ecgPeakTimesSec.length, nativeRrTimesSec.length);
  const confidence = maxEvents > 0 ? matched50 / maxEvents : 0.0;

  return {
    status: 'available',
    alignment_confidence: confidence,
    lag_estimate_ms: Math.round(bestLagSec * 1000),
    matched_interval_count: matchedIntervalCount,
    unmatched_ecg_count: unmatchedEcgCount,
    unmatched_rr_count: unmatchedRrCount,
    residual_median_ms: resMedian,
    residual_MAD_ms: resMAD,
    residual_p95_ms: resP95,
    residuals: finalResidualsMs,
    reason_codes: limitations,
    alignment_limitations: limitations
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/experimental/ecgSqiPrototype/ecgSpectralFeatures.ts
================================================================================
import { ECGSpectralFeatures, ECGPowerBand } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

function fft(re: number[], im: number[]) {
  const n = re.length;
  if (n <= 1) return;
  const reEven = new Array(n / 2);
  const imEven = new Array(n / 2);
  const reOdd = new Array(n / 2);
  const imOdd = new Array(n / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
    reEven[i] = re[2 * i];
    imEven[i] = im[2 * i];
    reOdd[i] = re[2 * i + 1];
    imOdd[i] = im[2 * i + 1];
  }
  fft(reEven, imEven);
  fft(reOdd, imOdd);
  for (let k = 0; k < n / 2; k++) {
    const angle = -2 * Math.PI * k / n;
    const c = Math.cos(angle);
    const s = Math.sin(angle);
    const tRe = reOdd[k] * c - imOdd[k] * s;
    const tIm = reOdd[k] * s + imOdd[k] * c;
    re[k] = reEven[k] + tRe;
    im[k] = imEven[k] + tIm;
    re[k + n / 2] = reEven[k] - tRe;
    im[k + n / 2] = imEven[k] - tIm;
  }
}

export function calculateSpectralFeatures(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  nominalSampleRateHz: number = 130.0
): ECGSpectralFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  
  // Calculate observed sample rate using sensor timestamps
  let observedRate = nominalSampleRateHz;
  if (N > 1) {
    const firstSensor = Number(samples[0].sensorTimeNs);
    const lastSensor = Number(samples[N - 1].sensorTimeNs);
    const duration = (lastSensor - firstSensor) / 1e9;
    if (duration > 0) {
      observedRate = (N - 1) / duration;
    }
  }

  // Define default unavailable band structure
  const makeUnavailableBand = (reason: string): ECGPowerBand => ({
    absolute_bandpower: null,
    fractional_bandpower: null,
    availability: 'unavailable',
    reason
  });

  const defaultBands = {
    band_0_5_5_hz: makeUnavailableBand('insufficient_samples'),
    band_5_15_hz: makeUnavailableBand('insufficient_samples'),
    band_15_30_hz: makeUnavailableBand('insufficient_samples'),
    band_30_45_hz: makeUnavailableBand('insufficient_samples'),
    band_45_to_nyquist: makeUnavailableBand('insufficient_samples')
  };

  if (N < 16) {
    return {
      observed_sample_rate_hz: observedRate,
      detrending_method: 'mean_subtraction',
      window_function: 'Hann',
      nperseg: N,
      overlap: 0,
      fft_length: 0,
      scaling: 'density',
      frequency_resolution: 0,
      usable_frequency_range: 'none',
      spectral_entropy: null,
      bands: defaultBands
    };
  }

  // 1. Detrend by subtracting the mean
  let sum = 0;
  for (const s of samples) sum += s.ecgVal;
  const mean = sum / N;
  const detrended = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal - mean);

  // 2. Apply Hann Window
  // w[n] = 0.5 * (1 - cos(2*pi*n / (N-1)))
  const win = new Array(N);
  let winSumSq = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
    win[n] = 0.5 * (1 - Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * n) / (N - 1)));
    winSumSq += win[n] * win[n];
  }

  const windowed = detrended.map((v, i) => v * win[i]);

  // 3. Zero-pad to next power of 2
  const fftLength = Math.pow(2, Math.ceil(Math.log2(N)));
  const re = new Array(fftLength).fill(0);
  const im = new Array(fftLength).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    re[i] = windowed[i];
  }

  // 4. Compute FFT
  fft(re, im);

  // 5. Compute One-Sided Power Spectral Density (PSD)
  // PSD[k] = |X[k]|^2 / (fs * sum(w[n]^2))
  const numBins = fftLength / 2 + 1;
  const psd = new Array(numBins).fill(0);
  const df = observedRate / fftLength;
  const denom = observedRate * winSumSq;

  for (let k = 0; k < numBins; k++) {
    const magSq = re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k];
    let val = magSq / denom;
    // One-sided PSD adjustments
    if (k > 0 && k < numBins - 1) {
      val *= 2;
    }
    psd[k] = val;
  }

  // Nyquist limit
  const nyquist = observedRate / 2;

  // Integrate helper
  const integratePSD = (lowF: number, highF: number): { power: number | null, reason: string | null } => {
    if (lowF >= nyquist) {
      return { power: null, reason: 'insufficient_window_duration_or_nyquist' };
    }
    // We need at least one bin falling in the range
    // Frequency of bin k is k * df
    const actualHigh = Math.min(highF, nyquist);
    let sumPower = 0;
    let countedBins = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < numBins; k++) {
      const f = k * df;
      if (f >= lowF && f <= actualHigh) {
        sumPower += psd[k] * df;
        countedBins++;
      }
    }
    if (countedBins === 0) {
      return { power: null, reason: 'insufficient_window_duration_or_nyquist' };
    }
    return { power: sumPower, reason: null };
  };

  // Define bands
  const bandSpecs = [
    { name: 'band_0_5_5_hz', low: 0.5, high: 5.0 },
    { name: 'band_5_15_hz', low: 5.0, high: 15.0 },
    { name: 'band_15_30_hz', low: 15.0, high: 30.0 },
    { name: 'band_30_45_hz', low: 30.0, high: 45.0 },
    { name: 'band_45_to_nyquist', low: 45.0, high: nyquist }
  ];

  const bands: any = {};
  let totalUsablePower = 0;

  for (const spec of bandSpecs) {
    const res = integratePSD(spec.low, spec.high);
    if (res.power === null) {
      bands[spec.name] = makeUnavailableBand(res.reason || 'insufficient_resolution');
    } else {
      bands[spec.name] = {
        absolute_bandpower: res.power,
        fractional_bandpower: null, // to be updated below
        availability: 'available',
        reason: null
      };
      totalUsablePower += res.power;
    }
  }

  // Update fractional bandpowers relative to total usable power
  for (const spec of bandSpecs) {
    const b = bands[spec.name];
    if (b.availability === 'available' && totalUsablePower > 0) {
      b.fractional_bandpower = b.absolute_bandpower / totalUsablePower;
    }
  }

  // 6. Calculate Spectral Entropy over usable range
  // Normalize PSD bins to sum to 1 over the bins in [0.5 Hz, Nyquist]
  const usablePsd: number[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < numBins; k++) {
    const f = k * df;
    if (f >= 0.5 && f <= nyquist) {
      usablePsd.push(psd[k]);
    }
  }

  let spectralEntropy: number | null = null;
  if (usablePsd.length > 1) {
    const sumP = usablePsd.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (sumP > 0) {
      let ent = 0;
      for (const p of usablePsd) {
        const normP = p / sumP;
        if (normP > 0) {
          ent -= normP * Math.log(normP);
        }
      }
      spectralEntropy = ent / Math.log(usablePsd.length);
    }
  }

  return {
    observed_sample_rate_hz: observedRate,
    detrending_method: 'mean_subtraction',
    window_function: 'Hann',
    nperseg: N,
    overlap: 0,
    fft_length: fftLength,
    scaling: 'density',
    frequency_resolution: df,
    usable_frequency_range: `0.5 Hz to ${nyquist.toFixed(2)} Hz`,
    spectral_entropy: spectralEntropy,
    bands: bands as any
  };
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import {
  ECGWindowRecord,
  ECGWindowFeatures,
  ECGProvisionalLabelRecord,
  ECGProvisionalLabel
} from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample, parseECGFile, extractContiguousSegments, extractWindowsFromSegment } from './ecgWindowExtractor';
import { calculateTimestampFeatures } from './ecgTimestampFeatures';
import { calculateAmplitudeFeatures } from './ecgAmplitudeFeatures';
import { calculateDifferenceFeatures } from './ecgDifferenceFeatures';
import { calculateBaselineFeatures } from './ecgBaselineFeatures';
import { calculateSpectralFeatures } from './ecgSpectralFeatures';
import { calculateDetectorAgreement } from './ecgDetectorAgreement';
import { reconcileEcgWithRr } from './ecgRrReconciliation';

export interface ACCSample {
  sensorTimeNs: bigint;
  timeMs: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}

export interface RREvent {
  timeSec: number;
  intervalMs: number;
}

export function parseACCFile(content: string): ACCSample[] {
  const lines = content.split('\n');
  const samples: ACCSample[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length < 6) continue;
    const phoneMs = new Date(parts[0]).getTime();
    const sensorTimeNs = BigInt(parts[1]);
    const x = parseFloat(parts[3]);
    const y = parseFloat(parts[4]);
    const z = parseFloat(parts[5]);
    if (!isNaN(phoneMs) && !isNaN(x) && !isNaN(y) && !isNaN(z)) {
      samples.push({ sensorTimeNs, timeMs: phoneMs, x, y, z });
    }
  }
  return samples;
}

export function parseRRFile(content: string, firstPhoneTimeMs: number): RREvent[] {
  const lines = content.split('\n');
  const events: RREvent[] = [];
  let cumulativeMs = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length < 2) continue;
    const intervalMs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
    if (!isNaN(intervalMs)) {
      cumulativeMs += intervalMs;
      events.push({
        timeSec: cumulativeMs / 1000.0,
        intervalMs
      });
    }
  }
  return events;
}

export function computeFeaturesForWindow(
  win: ECGWindowRecord,
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  accSamples: ACCSample[],
  rrEvents: RREvent[],
  nominalSampleRateHz: number = 130.0
): ECGWindowFeatures {
  const winSamples = samples.slice(win.start_row - 2, win.end_row - 1); // 1-indexed conversion adjustment
  
  // 1. Calculate observed sample rate using sensor timestamps
  const firstSensor = Number(win.start_sensor_timestamp_ns);
  const lastSensor = Number(win.end_sensor_timestamp_ns);
  const duration = (lastSensor - firstSensor) / 1e9;
  const observedRate = duration > 0 && winSamples.length > 1 ? (winSamples.length - 1) / duration : nominalSampleRateHz;

  // 2. Compute feature sub-structures
  const timestampFeat = calculateTimestampFeatures(winSamples, nominalSampleRateHz);
  const amplitudeFeat = calculateAmplitudeFeatures(winSamples);
  const differenceFeat = calculateDifferenceFeatures(winSamples);
  const baselineFeat = calculateBaselineFeatures(winSamples, observedRate);
  const spectralFeat = calculateSpectralFeatures(winSamples, observedRate);
  const detectorFeat = calculateDetectorAgreement(winSamples, observedRate);

  // 3. Align RR Events and Reconcile
  const winStartSec = Number(BigInt(win.start_sensor_timestamp_ns) - BigInt(samples[0].sensorTimeNs)) / 1e9;
  const winEndSec = Number(BigInt(win.end_sensor_timestamp_ns) - BigInt(samples[0].sensorTimeNs)) / 1e9;

  // Map ECG Peak times in seconds relative to window start
  const ptPeaks = detectorFeat.detector_1_peak_count > 0 
    ? runPanTompkinsPeakTimes(winSamples, observedRate)
    : [];

  // Filter RR events falling in this window
  const winRrTimes = rrEvents
    .filter(e => e.timeSec >= winStartSec && e.timeSec <= winEndSec)
    .map(e => e.timeSec - winStartSec);

  const rrReconciliation = reconcileEcgWithRr(ptPeaks, winRrTimes);

  // 4. Align ACC Samples
  const startNs = BigInt(win.start_sensor_timestamp_ns);
  const endNs = BigInt(win.end_sensor_timestamp_ns);
  const winAcc = accSamples.filter(s => s.sensorTimeNs >= startNs && s.sensorTimeNs <= endNs);

  let alignedAccAvailable = false;
  let accMean: number | null = null;
  let accStd: number | null = null;
  let accCoverage: number | null = null;
  let alignmentConfidence: number | null = null;
  let reason: string | null = null;

  if (winAcc.length > 0 && winSamples.length > 0) {
    alignedAccAvailable = true;
    const magnitudes = winAcc.map(s => Math.sqrt(s.x * s.x + s.y * s.y + s.z * s.z));
    let sumMag = 0;
    for (const m of magnitudes) sumMag += m;
    accMean = sumMag / magnitudes.length;

    let sqSumMag = 0;
    for (const m of magnitudes) sqSumMag += (m - accMean) ** 2;
    accStd = Math.sqrt(sqSumMag / magnitudes.length);

    const expectedAcc = Math.round(win.duration_seconds * 25.0);
    accCoverage = expectedAcc > 0 ? Math.min(1.0, winAcc.length / expectedAcc) : 0.0;

    const accStartNs = winAcc[0].sensorTimeNs;
    const accEndNs = winAcc[winAcc.length - 1].sensorTimeNs;
    const targetDurationNs = BigInt(Math.round(win.window_length_target_seconds * 1e9));
    const epochMatch = 1.0 - Math.min(1.0, Number((accStartNs > startNs ? accStartNs - startNs : 0n) + (endNs > accEndNs ? endNs - accEndNs : 0n)) / Number(targetDurationNs || 1n));

    const overlap = Number(accEndNs > accStartNs ? accEndNs - accStartNs : 0n) / Number(endNs > startNs ? endNs - startNs : 1n);

    const residuals: number[] = [];
    let ecgIdx = 0;
    winAcc.forEach(ac => {
      while (ecgIdx < winSamples.length - 1 &&
             Math.abs(Number(winSamples[ecgIdx + 1].sensorTimeNs - ac.sensorTimeNs)) <
             Math.abs(Number(winSamples[ecgIdx].sensorTimeNs - ac.sensorTimeNs))) {
        ecgIdx++;
      }
      const nearestEcg = winSamples[ecgIdx];
      if (nearestEcg) {
        const offsetAcc = ac.timeMs - Number(ac.sensorTimeNs) / 1e6;
        const offsetEcg = nearestEcg.timeMs - Number(nearestEcg.sensorTimeNs) / 1e6;
        residuals.push(Math.abs(offsetAcc - offsetEcg));
      }
    });

    let residualP95 = 0;
    if (residuals.length > 0) {
      const sorted = residuals.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      residualP95 = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)];
    }

    const residualFactor = Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - residualP95 / 100.0);
    alignmentConfidence = epochMatch * overlap * accCoverage * residualFactor;

    if (alignmentConfidence < 0.1) {
      alignedAccAvailable = false;
      alignmentConfidence = null;
      accMean = null;
      accStd = null;
      accCoverage = null;
      reason = 'insufficient_alignment_evidence';
    }
  } else {
    alignedAccAvailable = false;
    alignmentConfidence = null;
    accMean = null;
    accStd = null;
    accCoverage = null;
    reason = 'insufficient_alignment_evidence';
  }

  return {
    window_id: win.window_id,
    timestamp: timestampFeat,
    amplitude: amplitudeFeat,
    difference: differenceFeat,
    baseline: baselineFeat,
    spectral: spectralFeat,
    detector_agreement: detectorFeat,
    rr_reconciliation: rrReconciliation,
    cross_signal_context: {
      aligned_ACC_available: alignedAccAvailable,
      alignment_confidence: alignmentConfidence,
      acc_dynamic_magnitude_mean: accMean,
      acc_dynamic_magnitude_std: accStd,
      acc_coverage_fraction: accCoverage,
      reason: reason
    }
  };
}

function runPanTompkinsPeakTimes(samples: RawECGSample[], fs: number): number[] {
  // Simple derivative peak detector to estimate peak times relative to window start
  const values = samples.map(s => s.ecgVal);
  const N = values.length;
  if (N < 2) return [];

  const dy = new Array(N).fill(0);
  let sumDy = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    dy[i] = Math.abs(values[i] - values[i - 1]);
    sumDy += dy[i];
  }
  const meanDy = sumDy / N;

  let sqSumDy = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    sqSumDy += (dy[i] - meanDy) ** 2;
  }
  const stdDy = Math.sqrt(sqSumDy / N);
  const threshold = meanDy + 1.5 * stdDy;

  const refractorySamples = Math.round(0.250 * fs);
  const peakTimes: number[] = [];
  let lastPeakIdx = -refractorySamples - 1;

  for (let i = 2; i < N - 2; i++) {
    if (dy[i] > threshold) {
      if (dy[i] >= dy[i - 1] && dy[i] >= dy[i - 2] && dy[i] >= dy[i + 1] && dy[i] >= dy[i + 2]) {
        if (i - lastPeakIdx >= refractorySamples) {
          // relative time from window start
          const timeSec = Number(samples[i].sensorTimeNs - samples[0].sensorTimeNs) / 1e9;
          peakTimes.push(timeSec);
          lastPeakIdx = i;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return peakTimes;
}

export function assignProvisionalLabel(
  win: ECGWindowRecord,
  feat: ECGWindowFeatures
): ECGProvisionalLabelRecord {
  let label: ECGProvisionalLabel = 'visually_usable_candidate';
  let rationale = 'Contiguous steady-state window with clear amplitude profiles and consistent peaks.';
  const confounders: string[] = [];

  // Rules for provisional labeling (without deploying unvalidated claims)
  if (win.structural_stratum === 'startup') {
    label = 'startup_window_candidate';
    rationale = 'Window falls within initial startup transient period.';
    confounders.push('startup_noise');
  } else if (feat.amplitude.flatline_fraction > 0.4 || feat.amplitude.longest_identical_sample_run > 25) {
    label = 'low_amplitude_or_plateau_candidate';
    rationale = 'Significant repeated values or flatline saturation observed.';
    confounders.push('lead_off');
  } else if (feat.amplitude.fraction_above_candidate_absolute_amplitude > 0.1) {
    label = 'low_amplitude_or_plateau_candidate'; // Saturation clipping
    rationale = 'Amplitude exceeds high clipping boundary candidate thresholds.';
    confounders.push('clipping_saturation');
  } else if (feat.difference.first_difference_variance > 100000) {
    label = 'high_frequency_contamination_candidate';
    rationale = 'High difference domain variance indicates significant high-frequency muscle noise or powerline interference.';
    confounders.push('muscle_motion');
  } else if (feat.baseline.rolling_median_baseline_range && feat.baseline.rolling_median_baseline_range > 15000) {
    label = 'baseline_shift_candidate';
    rationale = 'High baseline roll amplitude indicates thoracic breathing wander.';
    confounders.push('breathing_drift');
  } else if (win.reconnect_or_gap_before || win.reconnect_or_gap_after) {
    label = 'amplitude_instability_candidate';
    rationale = 'Window borders detected reconnection gap boundary.';
    confounders.push('packet_loss');
  }

  return {
    window_id: win.window_id,
    source_session_group_id: win.source_session_group_id,
    source_file: win.source_file,
    source_file_sha256: win.source_file_sha256,
    proposed_label: label,
    rationale,
    known_confounders: confounders.join(',') || 'none',
    features_not_used_for_label: ['spectral_entropy', 'inter_detector_agreement'],
    adjacent_context_reference: { prev_id: null, next_id: null }, // updated later
    cross_signal_context_available: feat.cross_signal_context.aligned_ACC_available,
    review_status: 'unreviewed',
    label_origin: 'agent_provisional',
    reviewer_identity: null,
    reviewer_confidence: null,
    inter_reviewer_agreement_available: false
  };
}

import { ECGTimestampFeatures } from './ecgSqiTypes';
import { RawECGSample } from './ecgWindowExtractor';

export function calculateTimestampFeatures(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  nominalSampleRateHz: number = 130.0
): ECGTimestampFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  if (N === 0) {
    return {
      observed_sample_rate_hz: 0,
      median_sensor_delta_ms: 0,
      MAD_sensor_delta_ms: 0,
      p05_sensor_delta_ms: 0,
      p95_sensor_delta_ms: 0,
      duplicate_timestamp_count: 0,
      non_monotonic_timestamp_count: 0,
      robust_gap_count: 0,
      expected_sample_count: 0,
      estimated_missing_sample_count: 0,
      valid_coverage_fraction: 0,
      gap_detection_basis: 'no_samples'
    };
  }

  const firstSensorTime = Number(samples[0].sensorTimeNs);
  const lastSensorTime = Number(samples[N - 1].sensorTimeNs);
  const durationSec = (lastSensorTime - firstSensorTime) / 1e9;

  // Correct rate formula: (N - 1) / (duration_seconds)
  const observedRate = durationSec > 0 && N > 1 ? (N - 1) / durationSec : 130.0;

  // Calculate sensor deltas in milliseconds
  const deltasMs: number[] = [];
  let duplicates = 0;
  let nonMonotonic = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    const prev = samples[i - 1];
    const curr = samples[i];
    const diffNs = curr.sensorTimeNs - prev.sensorTimeNs;
    const diffMs = Number(diffNs) / 1e6;

    if (diffNs === 0n) duplicates++;
    if (diffNs < 0n) nonMonotonic++;
    
    deltasMs.push(diffMs);
  }

  // Robust statistics on deltas
  let medianDelta = 0;
  let madDelta = 0;
  let p05Delta = 0;
  let p95Delta = 0;

  if (deltasMs.length > 0) {
    const sorted = [...deltasMs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    medianDelta = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
    
    const absDevs = deltasMs.map(d => Math.abs(d - medianDelta));
    const sortedDevs = absDevs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    madDelta = sortedDevs[Math.floor(sortedDevs.length / 2)];

    p05Delta = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.05)];
    p95Delta = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)];
  }

  // Robust gap count: delta > 2 * robust median (but at least 15 ms to avoid noise)
  const gapThresholdMs = Math.max(medianDelta * 2, 15.0);
  let gaps = 0;
  for (const d of deltasMs) {
    if (d > gapThresholdMs) {
      gaps++;
    }
  }

  const expectedSamples = Math.round(durationSec * nominalSampleRateHz) + 1;
  const missingSamples = Math.max(0, expectedSamples - N);
  const validCoverage = expectedSamples > 0 ? N / expectedSamples : 0.0;

  return {
    observed_sample_rate_hz: observedRate,
    median_sensor_delta_ms: medianDelta,
    MAD_sensor_delta_ms: madDelta,
    p05_sensor_delta_ms: p05Delta,
    p95_sensor_delta_ms: p95Delta,
    duplicate_timestamp_count: duplicates,
    non_monotonic_timestamp_count: nonMonotonic,
    robust_gap_count: gaps,
    expected_sample_count: expectedSamples,
    estimated_missing_sample_count: missingSamples,
    valid_coverage_fraction: Math.min(1.0, validCoverage),
    gap_detection_basis: `delta_gt_twice_robust_median_or_15ms`
  };
}

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { ECGWindowRecord } from './ecgSqiTypes';

export interface RawECGSample {
  phoneTime: string;
  sensorTimeNs: bigint;
  timeMs: number;
  ecgVal: number;
  rowIdx: number; // 1-indexed in the source file
}

export function parseECGFile(content: string): RawECGSample[] {
  const lines = content.split('\n');
  const samples: RawECGSample[] = [];
  // Skip header line
  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    const parts = line.split(';');
    if (parts.length < 4) continue;
    const phoneTime = parts[0];
    const sensorTimeNs = BigInt(parts[1]);
    const timeMs = parseFloat(parts[2]);
    const ecgVal = parseFloat(parts[3]);
    if (!isNaN(timeMs) && !isNaN(ecgVal)) {
      samples.push({
        phoneTime,
        sensorTimeNs,
        timeMs,
        ecgVal,
        rowIdx: i + 1 // 1-indexed (header is row 1)
      });
    }
  }
  return samples;
}

export function extractContiguousSegments(
  samples: RawECGSample[],
  gapThresholdMs: number = 1000
): RawECGSample[][] {
  if (samples.length === 0) return [];
  const segments: RawECGSample[][] = [];
  let currentSegment: RawECGSample[] = [samples[0]];

  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const prev = samples[i - 1];
    const curr = samples[i];
    const timeDiffNs = curr.sensorTimeNs - prev.sensorTimeNs;
    const timeDiffMs = Number(timeDiffNs) / 1e6;

    // Check non-monotonic or gap
    if (timeDiffNs < 0n || timeDiffMs > gapThresholdMs) {
      segments.push(currentSegment);
      currentSegment = [curr];
    } else {
      currentSegment.push(curr);
    }
  }
  segments.push(currentSegment);
  return segments;
}

export function extractWindowsFromSegment(
  segment: RawECGSample[],
  segmentIdx: number,
  totalSegments: number,
  targetDurationSeconds: number,
  overlapFraction: number,
  sourceFile: string,
  sourceFileSha256: string,
  sourceGroupId: string,
  fullLines: string[],
  firstFileTimestampMs: number
): ECGWindowRecord[] {
  const records: ECGWindowRecord[] = [];
  if (segment.length === 0) return [];

  // Calculate average sampling interval using sensor times
  const firstSensorTime = Number(segment[0].sensorTimeNs);
  const lastSensorTime = Number(segment[segment.length - 1].sensorTimeNs);
  const segmentDurationSec = (lastSensorTime - firstSensorTime) / 1e9;
  
  // Nominal sample rate calculation (N-1) / duration
  const observedSampleRate = segment.length > 1 && segmentDurationSec > 0
    ? (segment.length - 1) / segmentDurationSec
    : 130.0;

  const targetDurationNs = BigInt(Math.round(targetDurationSeconds * 1e9));
  const stepNs = BigInt(Math.round(targetDurationSeconds * (1 - overlapFraction) * 1e9));

  let windowStartNs = segment[0].sensorTimeNs;
  let idx = 0;

  while (true) {
    const windowEndNs = windowStartNs + targetDurationNs;
    // Find all samples within [windowStartNs, windowEndNs]
    const windowSamples: RawECGSample[] = [];
    while (idx < segment.length && segment[idx].sensorTimeNs < windowStartNs) {
      idx++;
    }
    let tempIdx = idx;
    while (tempIdx < segment.length && segment[tempIdx].sensorTimeNs <= windowEndNs) {
      windowSamples.push(segment[tempIdx]);
      tempIdx++;
    }

    if (windowSamples.length === 0) {
      break;
    }

    // Check if the window is too far beyond the segment end
    if (windowEndNs > segment[segment.length - 1].sensorTimeNs + BigInt(Math.round(0.1 * 1e9))) {
      break;
    }

    const startSample = windowSamples[0];
    const endSample = windowSamples[windowSamples.length - 1];

    const actualDurationSec = Number(endSample.sensorTimeNs - startSample.sensorTimeNs) / 1e9;
    const coverageFraction = targetDurationSeconds > 0 ? actualDurationSec / targetDurationSeconds : 0;

    // Grab raw lines from file to generate raw_window_sha256
    const winLines = fullLines.slice(startSample.rowIdx - 1, endSample.rowIdx);
    const rawWinStr = winLines.join('\n');
    const winSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawWinStr).digest('hex').toUpperCase();

    // Strata logic:
    // startup: if start time is within first 2 seconds of the overall file
    const overallStartTimeDiffSec = (startSample.timeMs - firstFileTimestampMs) / 1000;
    const isStartup = overallStartTimeDiffSec <= 2.0;

    // reconnect: if segment index > 0 and start time is within first 5 seconds of this segment
    const isPostReconnect = segmentIdx > 0 && (Number(startSample.sensorTimeNs - segment[0].sensorTimeNs) / 1e9 <= 5.0);

    let stratum: 'startup' | 'steady_state' | 'post_reconnect' | 'ordinary_contiguous' = 'steady_state';
    if (isStartup) {
      stratum = 'startup';
    } else if (isPostReconnect) {
      stratum = 'post_reconnect';
    } else if (segment.length > 500) {
      stratum = 'steady_state';
    } else {
      stratum = 'ordinary_contiguous';
    }

    const winRecord: ECGWindowRecord = {
      window_id: `${sourceGroupId}_W${targetDurationSeconds}_O${overlapFraction.toFixed(2)}_${records.length.toString().padStart(4, '0')}`,
      source_session_group_id: sourceGroupId,
      source_file: sourceFile,
      source_file_sha256: sourceFileSha256,
      start_row: startSample.rowIdx,
      end_row: endSample.rowIdx,
      sample_count: windowSamples.length,
      start_sensor_timestamp_ns: startSample.sensorTimeNs.toString(),
      end_sensor_timestamp_ns: endSample.sensorTimeNs.toString(),
      start_phone_timestamp: startSample.phoneTime,
      end_phone_timestamp: endSample.phoneTime,
      raw_window_sha256: winSha,
      duration_seconds: actualDurationSec,
      window_length_target_seconds: targetDurationSeconds,
      overlap_fraction: overlapFraction,
      coverage_fraction: coverageFraction,
      structural_stratum: stratum,
      reconnect_or_gap_before: segmentIdx > 0 && (startSample.rowIdx === segment[0].rowIdx),
      reconnect_or_gap_after: segmentIdx < totalSegments - 1 && (endSample.rowIdx === segment[segment.length - 1].rowIdx)
    };

    records.push(winRecord);

    // If step is 0 (or target duration is 0), avoid infinite loop
    if (stepNs <= 0n) {
      break;
    }
    windowStartNs += stepNs;
    if (windowStartNs >= segment[segment.length - 1].sensorTimeNs) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return records;
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/experimental/rrArtifactPrototype/rrArtifactClassifier.ts

import {
  RRArtifactClass,
  RRRecommendedAction,
  RRArtifactDecision,
  RRTimelineContext
} from './rrArtifactTypes';
import {
  extractRRFeatureSet
} from './rrArtifactFeatures';

export interface RRClassifierParams {
  config_id: string;
  context_window_size: 5 | 11 | 21;
  minimum_reference_count: number;
  missed_ratio_low: number;
  missed_ratio_high: number;
  extra_ratio_threshold: number;
  pair_sum_tolerance: number;
  protected_short_ratio_threshold: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_PARAMS: RRClassifierParams = {
  config_id: 'default_config',
  context_window_size: 11,
  minimum_reference_count: 5,
  missed_ratio_low: 1.8,
  missed_ratio_high: 2.2,
  extra_ratio_threshold: 0.65,
  pair_sum_tolerance: 0.12,
  protected_short_ratio_threshold: 0.8
};

export function classifyRRInterval(
  raw_rr: number[],
  idx: number,
  timeline: RRTimelineContext,
  params: RRClassifierParams = DEFAULT_PARAMS
): RRArtifactDecision {
  const N = raw_rr.length;
  const reason_codes: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [];
  const unavailable_features: string[] = [];

  const val = raw_rr[idx];
  let isUnusable = false;
  let isGap = false;

  // 1. Structural Validation / Segmentation checks
  if (!Number.isFinite(val) || val <= 0) {
    isUnusable = true;
    reason_codes.push('structural_invalid_value');
  }

  // Boundary context checks
  const half = Math.floor(params.context_window_size / 2);
  if (idx < half || idx >= N - half) {
    limitations.push('insufficient_boundary_context');
  }

  // Handle external reconnect boundaries/gaps explicitly
  const isExternalReconnect = timeline.external_reconnect_boundaries.includes(idx) ||
    (timeline.timestamps_ms !== null && idx > 0 && timeline.external_reconnect_boundaries.includes(timeline.timestamps_ms[idx]));

  const isExternalGap = timeline.external_coverage_gap_boundaries.includes(idx);

  if (isExternalReconnect || isExternalGap) {
    isGap = true;
    reason_codes.push('timeline_external_reconnect_evidence');
  }

  // Check timestamp semantics non-monotonicity
  if (timeline.timestamps_ms !== null && idx > 0) {
    const tsDelta = timeline.timestamps_ms[idx] - timeline.timestamps_ms[idx - 1];
    if (tsDelta <= 0) {
      isUnusable = true;
      reason_codes.push('structural_non_monotonic_timestamp');
    }
  }

  if (timeline.timestamps_ms === null) {
    unavailable_features.push('timestamps_ms');
  }

  const feature_values: Record<string, number | boolean | null> = {};

  if (isUnusable) {
    return createDecision(
      idx, idx, [val], null,
      'unusable_segment', 1.0, 'high',
      'no_automatic_action', false,
      true, 'ineligible',
      null, 'none', [],
      val, null, null, false,
      feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
    );
  }

  if (isGap) {
    return createDecision(
      idx, idx, [val], null,
      'reconnect_or_packet_gap', 1.0, 'high',
      'no_automatic_action', false,
      true, 'ineligible',
      null, 'none', [],
      val, null, null, false,
      feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
    );
  }

  // 2. Extract leave-one-out context features
  const features = extractRRFeatureSet(raw_rr, idx, params.context_window_size, params.minimum_reference_count);
  const single = features.single;
  const pair = features.pair;
  const triplet = features.triplet;

  // If a positive local reference cannot be computed
  if (!single || single.local_median === null || single.local_median <= 0) {
    reason_codes.push('missing_or_invalid_local_reference');
    return createDecision(
      idx, idx, [val], null,
      'unusable_segment', 0.8, 'medium',
      'no_automatic_action', false,
      true, 'ineligible',
      null, 'none', [],
      val, null, null, false,
      feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
    );
  }

  const median = single.local_median;

  // Populate features record
  feature_values['median_ratio'] = single.median_ratio;
  feature_values['local_median'] = single.local_median;
  feature_values['local_MAD'] = single.local_MAD;
  feature_values['robust_CV'] = single.robust_CV;
  feature_values['missed_single_residual'] = features.missed_single_residual;
  feature_values['extra_pair_sum_residual'] = features.extra_pair_sum_residual;
  feature_values['misalignment_pair_sum_residual'] = features.misalignment_pair_sum_residual;
  feature_values['triplet_sum_residual'] = features.triplet_sum_residual;

  // Stage 3: Protected pattern guard (short-long sequences)
  if (idx < N - 1) {
    const isShort = val / median <= params.protected_short_ratio_threshold;
    const isLong = raw_rr[idx + 1] / median >= 1.15;
    const isLongShort = val / median >= 1.15 && raw_rr[idx + 1] / median <= params.protected_short_ratio_threshold;

    if ((isShort && isLong) || isLongShort) {
      reason_codes.push('protected_short_long_pattern_origin_unresolved');
      return createDecision(
        idx, idx + 1, [val, raw_rr[idx + 1]], null,
        'protected_short_long_pattern', 0.9, 'high',
        'no_automatic_action', false,
        false, 'ineligible',
        null, 'none', [],
        val + raw_rr[idx + 1], null, null, false,
        feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
      );
    }
  }

  // 1. Missed Beat Candidate Check
  const isMissedRatio = single.median_ratio !== null &&
    single.median_ratio >= params.missed_ratio_low && 
    single.median_ratio <= params.missed_ratio_high;
  
  const isMissedResidual = features.missed_single_residual !== null && 
    Math.abs(features.missed_single_residual) <= params.pair_sum_tolerance;

  if (isMissedRatio && isMissedResidual) {
    reason_codes.push('heuristic_missed_beat_ratio_match');
    const halfSplit = Math.round(val / 2);
    const duration_after = halfSplit + (val - halfSplit);
    const duration_error = Math.abs(val - duration_after);
    return createDecision(
      idx, idx, [val], null,
      'technical_missed_detection_candidate', 0.9, 'high',
      'candidate_split', true,
      false, 'eligible',
      median, 'single_loo_context', single.local_reference_excluded_indices,
      val, duration_after, duration_error, duration_error <= 0.1,
      feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
    );
  }

  // 2. Extra Beat / False Trigger Candidate Check
  if (idx < N - 1 && pair && pair.local_median !== null && pair.local_median > 0) {
    const isPairExtraRatio = val / pair.local_median < params.extra_ratio_threshold && 
      raw_rr[idx + 1] / pair.local_median < params.extra_ratio_threshold;
    
    const isPairExtraSum = features.extra_pair_sum_residual !== null && 
      Math.abs(features.extra_pair_sum_residual) <= params.pair_sum_tolerance;

    if (isPairExtraRatio && isPairExtraSum) {
      reason_codes.push('heuristic_extra_beat_pair_match');
      const sumVal = val + raw_rr[idx + 1];
      return createDecision(
        idx, idx + 1, [val, raw_rr[idx + 1]], null,
        'technical_extra_detection_candidate', 0.95, 'high',
        'candidate_merge', true,
        false, 'eligible',
        pair.local_median, 'pair_loo_context', pair.local_reference_excluded_indices,
        sumVal, sumVal, 0, true,
        feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
      );
    }
  }

  // 3. Misalignment Check
  if (idx < N - 1 && pair && pair.local_median !== null && pair.local_median > 0) {
    const isMisalignedSum = features.misalignment_pair_sum_residual !== null &&
      Math.abs(features.misalignment_pair_sum_residual) <= params.pair_sum_tolerance;
    
    const isOneShortOneLong = (val < pair.local_median && raw_rr[idx + 1] > pair.local_median) || 
      (val > pair.local_median && raw_rr[idx + 1] < pair.local_median);

    if (isMisalignedSum && isOneShortOneLong && Math.abs(val - raw_rr[idx + 1]) > 100) {
      reason_codes.push('heuristic_misaligned_pair_match');
      const sumVal = val + raw_rr[idx + 1];
      return createDecision(
        idx, idx + 1, [val, raw_rr[idx + 1]], null,
        'technical_misaligned_detection_candidate', 0.85, 'medium',
        'candidate_boundary_adjustment', true,
        false, 'eligible',
        pair.local_median, 'pair_loo_context', pair.local_reference_excluded_indices,
        sumVal, sumVal, 0, true,
        feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
      );
    }
  }

  // 4. Ambiguous / Isolated Outliers
  const isOutlier = single.median_ratio !== null &&
    (single.median_ratio < 0.7 || single.median_ratio > 1.3);

  if (isOutlier) {
    reason_codes.push('ambiguous_isolated_outlier');
    return createDecision(
      idx, idx, [val], null,
      'ambiguous', 0.6, 'low',
      'no_automatic_action', false,
      false, 'ineligible',
      null, 'none', [],
      val, null, null, false,
      feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
    );
  }

  // 5. Clean
  return createDecision(
    idx, idx, [val], null,
    'clean', 1.0, 'high',
    'none', false,
    false, 'eligible',
    median, 'single_loo_context', single.local_reference_excluded_indices,
    val, val, 0, true,
    feature_values, unavailable_features, reason_codes, limitations, params.config_id
  );
}

function createDecision(
  raw_index_start: number,
  raw_index_end: number,
  raw_rr_ms: number[],
  raw_timestamp_offsets_ms: number[] | null,
  predicted_class: RRArtifactClass,
  heuristic_score: number,
  score_level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high',
  recommended_action: RRRecommendedAction,
  eligible: boolean,
  segment_boundary_recommended: boolean,
  nn_eligibility: 'eligible' | 'ineligible' | 'unknown',
  local_ref_rr: number | null,
  local_ref_method: string,
  excluded_indices: number[],
  duration_before: number,
  duration_after: number | null,
  duration_error: number | null,
  duration_conserved: boolean | null,
  feature_values: Record<string, number | boolean | null>,
  unavailable_features: string[],
  reason_codes: string[],
  limitations: string[],
  config_id: string
): RRArtifactDecision {
  return {
    raw_index_start,
    raw_index_end,
    raw_rr_ms,
    raw_timestamp_offsets_ms,
    predicted_class,
    heuristic_score,
    score_level,
    score_is_calibrated_probability: false,
    recommended_action,
    automatic_action_allowed: false, // strictly false for safety
    eligible_for_future_automatic_action: eligible,
    segment_boundary_recommended,
    nn_eligibility,
    local_reference_rr_ms: local_ref_rr,
    local_reference_method: local_ref_method,
    local_reference_excluded_indices: excluded_indices,
    duration_before_ms: duration_before,
    duration_after_candidate_action_ms: duration_after,
    duration_error_ms: duration_error,
    duration_conserved,
    feature_values,
    unavailable_features,
    reason_codes,
    limitations,
    parameter_config_id: config_id,
    algorithm_version: '1.0.0'
  };
}

import { RRArtifactDecision } from './rrArtifactTypes';

export function resolveConflicts(decisions: RRArtifactDecision[]): {
  resolved: RRArtifactDecision[];
  suppressed: { decision: RRArtifactDecision; reason: string }[];
} {
  const resolved: RRArtifactDecision[] = [];
  const suppressed: { decision: RRArtifactDecision; reason: string }[] = [];

  // Sort decisions by priority and start index
  // Priority rank (lower number = higher priority):
  // 1. reconnect_or_packet_gap, unusable_segment
  // 2. protected_short_long_pattern, ambiguous
  // 3. technical_*
  // 4. clean
  const getPriority = (d: RRArtifactDecision): number => {
    const cls = d.predicted_class;
    if (cls === 'reconnect_or_packet_gap' || cls === 'unusable_segment') return 1;
    if (cls === 'protected_short_long_pattern' || cls === 'ambiguous') return 2;
    if (cls.startsWith('technical_')) return 3;
    return 4;
  };

  const sorted = [...decisions].sort((a, b) => {
    const prioA = getPriority(a);
    const prioB = getPriority(b);
    if (prioA !== prioB) return prioA - prioB;
    if (a.raw_index_start !== b.raw_index_start) return a.raw_index_start - b.raw_index_start;
    return b.heuristic_score - a.heuristic_score; // higher score first
  });

  const coveredIndices = new Set<number>();

  for (const d of sorted) {
    let overlap = false;
    for (let idx = d.raw_index_start; idx <= d.raw_index_end; idx++) {
      if (coveredIndices.has(idx)) {
        overlap = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (overlap) {
      suppressed.push({
        decision: d,
        reason: 'Overlapped by a higher-priority resolved decision.'
      });
    } else {
      resolved.push(d);
      for (let idx = d.raw_index_start; idx <= d.raw_index_end; idx++) {
        coveredIndices.add(idx);
      }
    }
  }

  // Sort resolved back by index order
  resolved.sort((a, b) => a.raw_index_start - b.raw_index_start);

  return { resolved, suppressed };
}

export interface LocalRRFeatures {
  local_median: number | null;
  local_trimmed_mean: number | null;
  local_MAD: number | null;
  local_IQR: number | null;
  robust_CV: number | null;
  median_ratio: number | null;
  normalized_residual: number | null;
  preceding_ratio: number | null;
  following_ratio: number | null;
  local_trend: number | null;
  local_reference_excluded_indices: number[];
  normalized_residual_error_reason?: string;
}

export interface RRFeatureSet {
  single: LocalRRFeatures | null;
  pair: LocalRRFeatures | null;
  triplet: LocalRRFeatures | null;

  // Difference features
  previous_dRR: number | null;
  next_dRR: number | null;
  normalized_previous_dRR: number | null;
  normalized_next_dRR: number | null;
  sign_reversal: boolean | null;
  short_long_compensation_residual: number | null;

  // Hypothesis-specific residuals computed using the correct context references
  missed_single_residual: number | null;
  extra_pair_sum_residual: number | null;
  misalignment_pair_sum_residual: number | null;
  triplet_sum_residual: number | null;

  quantile_method: string;
  trimmed_mean_rounding: string;
}

export function getMedian(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

export function getMAD(arr: number[], median: number): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const diffs = arr.map(v => Math.abs(v - median));
  return getMedian(diffs);
}

export function getIQR(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const q75Idx = Math.floor(0.75 * (sorted.length - 1));
  const q25Idx = Math.floor(0.25 * (sorted.length - 1));
  return sorted[q75Idx] - sorted[q25Idx];
}

export function getTrimmedMean(arr: number[]): number {
  const N = arr.length;
  if (N === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const K = Math.round(0.1 * N);
  const trimmed = sorted.slice(K, N - K);
  if (trimmed.length === 0) {
    return sorted[Math.floor(N / 2)];
  }
  return trimmed.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / trimmed.length;
}

export function getTrend(arr: number[]): number {
  const N = arr.length;
  if (N < 2) return 0;
  let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXX = 0, sumXY = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    sumX += i;
    sumY += arr[i];
    sumXX += i * i;
    sumXY += i * arr[i];
  }
  const denominator = N * sumXX - sumX * sumX;
  return denominator !== 0 ? (N * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denominator : 0;
}

function getLOOContext(
  raw_rr: number[],
  centerIdx: number,
  windowSize: number,
  excludeIndices: number[]
): number[] {
  const half = Math.floor(windowSize / 2);
  const context: number[] = [];
  for (let i = centerIdx - half; i <= centerIdx + half; i++) {
    if (i >= 0 && i < raw_rr.length) {
      if (!excludeIndices.includes(i)) {
        context.push(raw_rr[i]);
      }
    }
  }
  return context;
}

export function computeLocalRRFeatures(
  context: number[],
  targetValue: number,
  raw_rr: number[],
  idx: number,
  minimum_reference_count: number,
  excludeIndices: number[]
): LocalRRFeatures | null {
  if (context.length < minimum_reference_count) {
    return null;
  }
  const local_median = getMedian(context);
  if (local_median <= 0) {
    return null; // Avoid division by zero or invalid negative medians
  }
  
  const local_trimmed_mean = getTrimmedMean(context);
  const local_MAD = getMAD(context, local_median);
  const local_IQR = getIQR(context);
  const robust_CV = (1.4826 * local_MAD) / local_median;
  const median_ratio = targetValue / local_median;
  
  let normalized_residual: number | null = null;
  let normalized_residual_error_reason: string | undefined;
  
  if (local_MAD === 0) {
    normalized_residual = null;
    normalized_residual_error_reason = "zero_or_insufficient_robust_scale";
  } else {
    normalized_residual = (targetValue - local_median) / local_MAD;
  }

  const preceding_ratio = idx > 0 ? targetValue / raw_rr[idx - 1] : null;
  const following_ratio = idx < raw_rr.length - 1 ? targetValue / raw_rr[idx + 1] : null;
  const local_trend = getTrend(context);

  return {
    local_median,
    local_trimmed_mean,
    local_MAD,
    local_IQR,
    robust_CV,
    median_ratio,
    normalized_residual,
    preceding_ratio,
    following_ratio,
    local_trend,
    local_reference_excluded_indices: excludeIndices,
    normalized_residual_error_reason
  };
}

export function extractRRFeatureSet(
  raw_rr: number[],
  idx: number,
  context_window_size: 5 | 11 | 21,
  minimum_reference_count: number
): RRFeatureSet {
  const targetValue = raw_rr[idx];

  // 1. Single Context Features (excluding index i)
  const singleExcludes = [idx];
  const singleContext = getLOOContext(raw_rr, idx, context_window_size, singleExcludes);
  const singleFeatures = computeLocalRRFeatures(
    singleContext, targetValue, raw_rr, idx, minimum_reference_count, singleExcludes
  );

  // 2. Pair Context Features (excluding indices i, i+1)
  const pairExcludes = [idx, idx + 1];
  const pairContext = getLOOContext(raw_rr, idx, context_window_size, pairExcludes);
  const pairFeatures = idx < raw_rr.length - 1 ? computeLocalRRFeatures(
    pairContext, targetValue, raw_rr, idx, minimum_reference_count, pairExcludes
  ) : null;

  // 3. Triplet Context Features (excluding indices i-1, i, i+1)
  const tripletExcludes = [idx - 1, idx, idx + 1];
  const tripletContext = getLOOContext(raw_rr, idx, context_window_size, tripletExcludes);
  const tripletFeatures = (idx > 0 && idx < raw_rr.length - 1) ? computeLocalRRFeatures(
    tripletContext, targetValue, raw_rr, idx, minimum_reference_count, tripletExcludes
  ) : null;

  // 4. Difference features using the configured single context reference if available
  let previous_dRR: number | null = null;
  let next_dRR: number | null = null;
  let normalized_previous_dRR: number | null = null;
  let normalized_next_dRR: number | null = null;
  let sign_reversal: boolean | null = null;
  let short_long_compensation_residual: number | null = null;

  const median = singleFeatures?.local_median || null;

  if (idx > 0) {
    previous_dRR = raw_rr[idx] - raw_rr[idx - 1];
    if (median && median > 0) {
      normalized_previous_dRR = previous_dRR / median;
    }
  }
  if (idx < raw_rr.length - 1) {
    next_dRR = raw_rr[idx + 1] - raw_rr[idx];
    if (median && median > 0) {
      normalized_next_dRR = next_dRR / median;
    }
  }
  if (previous_dRR !== null && next_dRR !== null) {
    sign_reversal = (previous_dRR * next_dRR) < 0;
    short_long_compensation_residual = previous_dRR + next_dRR;
  }

  // 5. Hypothesis-specific residuals computed using the CORRECT context references
  const missed_single_residual = (singleFeatures && singleFeatures.local_median && singleFeatures.local_median > 0)
    ? raw_rr[idx] / (2 * singleFeatures.local_median) - 1
    : null;

  const extra_pair_sum_residual = (pairFeatures && pairFeatures.local_median && pairFeatures.local_median > 0 && idx < raw_rr.length - 1)
    ? (raw_rr[idx] + raw_rr[idx + 1]) / pairFeatures.local_median - 1
    : null;

  const misalignment_pair_sum_residual = (pairFeatures && pairFeatures.local_median && pairFeatures.local_median > 0 && idx < raw_rr.length - 1)
    ? (raw_rr[idx] + raw_rr[idx + 1]) / (2 * pairFeatures.local_median) - 1
    : null;

  const triplet_sum_residual = (tripletFeatures && tripletFeatures.local_median && tripletFeatures.local_median > 0 && idx > 0 && idx < raw_rr.length - 1)
    ? (raw_rr[idx - 1] + raw_rr[idx] + raw_rr[idx + 1]) / (3 * tripletFeatures.local_median) - 1
    : null;

  return {
    single: singleFeatures,
    pair: pairFeatures,
    triplet: tripletFeatures,
    previous_dRR,
    next_dRR,
    normalized_previous_dRR,
    normalized_next_dRR,
    sign_reversal,
    short_long_compensation_residual,
    missed_single_residual,
    extra_pair_sum_residual,
    misalignment_pair_sum_residual,
    triplet_sum_residual,
    quantile_method: "floor-index empirical quantile without interpolation",
    trimmed_mean_rounding: "K = Math.round(0.1 * N)"
  };
}

import {
  RRArtifactDecision,
  RRSimulationMapping,
  RRSimulationOutput
} from './rrArtifactTypes';

export function simulateCorrections(
  raw_rr: number[],
  resolvedDecisions: RRArtifactDecision[]
): RRSimulationOutput {
  // Note: Alternative split strategies like neighbor-based or trend-aware splitting remain unresolved future research decisions.
  // This frozen implementation supports only equal splitting.
  const raw_passthrough_rr_ms = [...raw_rr];
  const candidate_simulated_rr_ms = [...raw_rr];
  const mappings: RRSimulationMapping[] = [];
  const ineligible_raw_indices: number[] = [];

  // Create a map from index to decision
  const decisionMap = new Map<number, RRArtifactDecision>();
  for (const d of resolvedDecisions) {
    decisionMap.set(d.raw_index_start, d);
  }

  // First pass: identify ineligible indices and apply simulator replacements
  let i = 0;
  while (i < raw_rr.length) {
    const dec = decisionMap.get(i);
    if (dec) {
      const cls = dec.predicted_class;
      const isProtectedOrStructural = 
        cls === 'protected_short_long_pattern' ||
        cls === 'reconnect_or_packet_gap' ||
        cls === 'unusable_segment' ||
        cls === 'ambiguous';

      if (isProtectedOrStructural) {
        for (let k = dec.raw_index_start; k <= dec.raw_index_end; k++) {
          ineligible_raw_indices.push(k);
        }
        // Passthrough untouched
        i += (dec.raw_index_end - dec.raw_index_start + 1);
        continue;
      }

      if (dec.eligible_for_future_automatic_action) {
        // Validation Checks
        const hasValidRef = dec.local_reference_rr_ms !== null && dec.local_reference_rr_ms > 0;
        const val = raw_rr[i];
        const isValValid = Number.isFinite(val) && val > 0;

        if (dec.recommended_action === 'candidate_split' && hasValidRef && isValValid) {
          const half = Math.floor(val / 2);
          const parts = [half, val - half];
          
          // Verify duration conservation
          const sum = parts[0] + parts[1];
          if (Math.abs(val - sum) <= 0.1 && parts[0] > 0 && parts[1] > 0) {
            // Refuse to write directly into flat array of different size, 
            // but log the mapping and output simulation values
            mappings.push({
              output_index_start: i,
              output_index_end: i + 1,
              source_raw_indices: [i],
              candidate_values_ms: parts,
              action: 'candidate_split',
              duration_before_ms: val,
              duration_after_ms: sum,
              duration_error_ms: Math.abs(val - sum)
            });
          }
          i++;
        } else if (dec.recommended_action === 'candidate_merge' && hasValidRef && isValValid) {
          const val2 = raw_rr[i + 1];
          if (Number.isFinite(val2) && val2 > 0) {
            const mergedVal = val + val2;
            mappings.push({
              output_index_start: i,
              output_index_end: i,
              source_raw_indices: [i, i + 1],
              candidate_values_ms: [mergedVal],
              action: 'candidate_merge',
              duration_before_ms: val + val2,
              duration_after_ms: mergedVal,
              duration_error_ms: 0
            });
          }
          i += 2;
        } else if (dec.recommended_action === 'candidate_boundary_adjustment' && hasValidRef && isValValid) {
          const val2 = raw_rr[i + 1];
          if (Number.isFinite(val2) && val2 > 0) {
            const totalVal = val + val2;
            const ref = dec.local_reference_rr_ms!;
            const adjustedParts = [ref, totalVal - ref];
            if (adjustedParts[0] > 0 && adjustedParts[1] > 0) {
              mappings.push({
                output_index_start: i,
                output_index_end: i + 1,
                source_raw_indices: [i, i + 1],
                candidate_values_ms: adjustedParts,
                action: 'candidate_boundary_adjustment',
                duration_before_ms: totalVal,
                duration_after_ms: adjustedParts[0] + adjustedParts[1],
                duration_error_ms: 0
              });
            }
          }
          i += 2;
        } else {
          i++;
        }
      } else {
        i++;
      }
    } else {
      i++;
    }
  }

  // Second pass: construct candidate_simulated_rr_ms based on mappings
  // and form eligible_nn_segments
  // (Since split/merge mapping replaces raw indices, we reconstruct the simulated series)
  const simulatedSeries: number[] = [];
  const indexMapping = new Map<number, number[]>(); // raw index to simulated values

  // Fill index mappings
  mappings.forEach(m => {
    m.source_raw_indices.forEach((rawIdx, listIdx) => {
      if (listIdx === 0) {
        indexMapping.set(rawIdx, m.candidate_values_ms);
      } else {
        indexMapping.set(rawIdx, []); // marked as consumed
      }
    });
  });

  const simulatedIndices: { rawIdx: number; val: number }[] = [];

  for (let k = 0; k < raw_rr.length; k++) {
    if (indexMapping.has(k)) {
      const vals = indexMapping.get(k)!;
      vals.forEach(v => {
        simulatedIndices.push({ rawIdx: k, val: v });
      });
    } else {
      simulatedIndices.push({ rawIdx: k, val: raw_rr[k] });
    }
  }

  const candidate_simulated_rr_ms_output = simulatedIndices.map(x => x.val);

  // Group contiguous eligible indices
  const eligible_nn_segments: Array<{
    raw_index_start: number;
    raw_index_end: number;
    nn_ms: number[];
    eligibility_reason: string;
  }> = [];

  let currentSegment: { raw_index_start: number; raw_index_end: number; nn_ms: number[] } | null = null;

  for (let idx = 0; idx < simulatedIndices.length; idx++) {
    const item = simulatedIndices[idx];
    const isIdxIneligible = ineligible_raw_indices.includes(item.rawIdx);

    if (!isIdxIneligible) {
      if (currentSegment === null) {
        currentSegment = {
          raw_index_start: item.rawIdx,
          raw_index_end: item.rawIdx,
          nn_ms: [item.val]
        };
      } else {
        currentSegment.raw_index_end = item.rawIdx;
        currentSegment.nn_ms.push(item.val);
      }
    } else {
      if (currentSegment !== null) {
        eligible_nn_segments.push({
          ...currentSegment,
          eligibility_reason: 'Contiguous segment of clean or corrected intervals free of protected patterns or gaps'
        });
        currentSegment = null;
      }
    }
  }

  if (currentSegment !== null) {
    eligible_nn_segments.push({
      ...currentSegment,
      eligibility_reason: 'Contiguous segment of clean or corrected intervals free of protected patterns or gaps'
    });
  }

  return {
    raw_passthrough_rr_ms,
    candidate_simulated_rr_ms: candidate_simulated_rr_ms_output,
    eligible_nn_segments,
    ineligible_raw_indices,
    mappings
  };
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { RRArtifactDecision, RRArtifactClass, RRRecommendedAction } from './rrArtifactTypes';

export class LCG {
  private seed: number;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seed = seed;
  }
  next(): number {
    this.seed = (this.seed * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
    return this.seed / 233280;
  }
}

export interface SyntheticFixture {
  fixture_id: string;
  family: string;
  raw_rr_ms: number[];
  raw_event_timestamps_ms: number[] | null;
  event_timestamp_semantics: 'independent_event_time' | 'cumulative_rr_reconstruction' | 'phone_arrival_time' | 'unknown';
  external_reconnect_boundaries: number[];
  external_coverage_gap_boundaries: number[];
  anomaly_raw_indices: number[];
  expected_classes: RRArtifactClass[];
  acceptable_alternative_classes: RRArtifactClass[];
  forbidden_actions: RRRecommendedAction[];
  expected_automatic_action_allowed: false;
  expected_duration_before_ms: number;
  expected_duration_behavior: 'must_be_conserved' | 'no_candidate_action' | 'not_applicable';
  expected_score_level: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'not_constrained';
  expected_nn_eligibility: 'eligible' | 'ineligible';
  rationale: string;
  generator_version: string;
  generator_seed: number;
  generator_config: string;
}

export function generateBaseSeries(lcg: LCG, length: number, baseRR: number, jitter: number): number[] {
  const series: number[] = [];
  let current = baseRR;
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    const drift = Math.sin(i / 10.0) * 15;
    const noise = (lcg.next() - 0.5) * jitter;
    series.push(Math.round(current + drift + noise));
  }
  return series;
}

export interface HRVMetrics {
  mean_rr: number;
  mean_hr: number;
  sdnn: number;
  rmssd: number;
  pnn50: number;
  valid_count: number;
}

export function calculateHRV(nn: number[]): HRVMetrics {
  const N = nn.length;
  if (N === 0) return { mean_rr: 0, mean_hr: 0, sdnn: 0, rmssd: 0, pnn50: 0, valid_count: 0 };
  
  const mean_rr = nn.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / N;
  const mean_hr = mean_rr > 0 ? 60000 / mean_rr : 0;
  
  const varSum = nn.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.pow(b - mean_rr, 2), 0);
  const sdnn = Math.sqrt(varSum / (N - 1 || 1));
  
  const diffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    diffs.push(nn[i] - nn[i - 1]);
  }
  
  const sqDiffSum = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0);
  const rmssd = diffs.length > 0 ? Math.sqrt(sqDiffSum / diffs.length) : 0;
  
  const nn50Count = diffs.filter(d => Math.abs(d) > 50).length;
  const pnn50 = diffs.length > 0 ? nn50Count / diffs.length : 0;
  
  return { mean_rr, mean_hr, sdnn, rmssd, pnn50, valid_count: N };
}

export interface SegmentHRVResult {
  raw_index_start: number;
  raw_index_end: number;
  interval_count: number;
  duration_seconds: number;
  status: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible';
  reason_codes: string[];
  metrics: {
    mean_rr_ms: number;
    mean_hr_bpm: number;
    sdnn_ms: number;
    rmssd_ms: number;
    pnn50_percent: number;
  } | null;
}

export function calculateSegmentHRV(
  nn: number[],
  raw_index_start: number,
  raw_index_end: number,
  ineligible_raw_indices: number[]
): SegmentHRVResult {
  const reason_codes: string[] = [];
  const N = nn.length;

  if (N < 10) {
    reason_codes.push('insufficient_interval_count');
  }

  const duration_ms = nn.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0 ? v : 0), 0);
  const duration_seconds = duration_ms / 1000;
  if (duration_seconds < 10.0) {
    reason_codes.push('insufficient_continuous_duration');
  }

  const allFinitePositive = nn.every(v => Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0);
  if (!allFinitePositive) {
    reason_codes.push('invalid_non_positive_or_non_finite_value');
  }

  let hasIneligible = false;
  for (let idx = raw_index_start; idx <= raw_index_end; idx++) {
    if (ineligible_raw_indices.includes(idx)) {
      hasIneligible = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (hasIneligible) {
    reason_codes.push('contains_ineligible_raw_index');
  }

  const isEligible = reason_codes.length === 0;

  if (!isEligible) {
    return {
      raw_index_start,
      raw_index_end,
      interval_count: N,
      duration_seconds,
      status: 'not_eligible',
      reason_codes,
      metrics: null
    };
  }

  const mean_rr_ms = duration_ms / N;
  const mean_hr_bpm = 60000 / mean_rr_ms;

  const varSum = nn.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - mean_rr_ms, 2), 0);
  const sdnn_ms = Math.sqrt(varSum / (N - 1));

  const diffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < N; i++) {
    diffs.push(nn[i] - nn[i - 1]);
  }
  const sqDiffSum = diffs.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v * v, 0);
  const rmssd_ms = Math.sqrt(sqDiffSum / diffs.length);

  const nn50Count = diffs.filter(d => Math.abs(d) > 50).length;
  const pnn50_percent = (nn50Count / diffs.length) * 100;

  return {
    raw_index_start,
    raw_index_end,
    interval_count: N,
    duration_seconds,
    status: 'eligible',
    reason_codes: [],
    metrics: {
      mean_rr_ms,
      mean_hr_bpm,
      sdnn_ms,
      rmssd_ms,
      pnn50_percent
    }
  };
}

export function buildFixtureSets(targetDir: string) {
  const calibDir = path.join(targetDir, 'rr_prototype_calibration');
  const lockedDir = path.join(targetDir, 'rr_prototype_locked_evaluation');

  if (fs.existsSync(calibDir)) {
    fs.readdirSync(calibDir).forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(path.join(calibDir, f)));
  } else {
    fs.mkdirSync(calibDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  if (fs.existsSync(lockedDir)) {
    fs.readdirSync(lockedDir).forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(path.join(lockedDir, f)));
  } else {
    fs.mkdirSync(lockedDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const generateSet = (destDir: string, setType: string) => {
    const seedOffset = setType === 'calibration' ? 0 : 50000;
    const manifest: any[] = [];

    // Helper to write fixture and register it
    const writeFixture = (fixture: SyntheticFixture) => {
      const filePath = path.join(destDir, `${fixture.fixture_id}.json`);
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(fixture, null, 2));
      manifest.push({
        fixture_id: fixture.fixture_id,
        file: `${fixture.fixture_id}.json`,
        family: fixture.family
      });
    };

    const lcg = new LCG(12345 + seedOffset);

    // 1. Clean Family
    const cleanTypes = [
      { id: 'stable_clean', length: 50, baseRR: 800, jitter: 5 },
      { id: 'smooth_oscillation_clean', length: 60, baseRR: 750, jitter: 12 },
      { id: 'gradual_acceleration_clean', length: 55, baseRR: 900, jitter: 6, trend: -3 },
      { id: 'gradual_deceleration_clean', length: 55, baseRR: 650, jitter: 8, trend: 4 },
      { id: 'high_smooth_variability_clean', length: 50, baseRR: 850, jitter: 20 },
      { id: 'low_rate_clean', length: 50, baseRR: 1200, jitter: 10 },
      { id: 'high_rate_clean', length: 50, baseRR: 500, jitter: 4 }
    ];

    cleanTypes.forEach(t => {
      const base = generateBaseSeries(lcg, t.length, t.baseRR, t.jitter);
      if (t.trend) {
        for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i++) base[i] += i * t.trend;
      }
      const fixId = `${t.id}_${setType}`;
      writeFixture({
        fixture_id: fixId,
        family: 'clean',
        raw_rr_ms: base,
        raw_event_timestamps_ms: base.reduce((acc: number[], v) => {
          acc.push((acc[acc.length - 1] || 0) + v);
          return acc;
        }, []),
        event_timestamp_semantics: 'cumulative_rr_reconstruction',
        external_reconnect_boundaries: [],
        external_coverage_gap_boundaries: [],
        anomaly_raw_indices: [],
        expected_classes: ['clean'],
        acceptable_alternative_classes: [],
        forbidden_actions: ['candidate_split', 'candidate_merge', 'candidate_boundary_adjustment'],
        expected_automatic_action_allowed: false,
        expected_duration_before_ms: base.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
        expected_duration_behavior: 'must_be_conserved',
        expected_score_level: 'high',
        expected_nn_eligibility: 'eligible',
        rationale: 'Clean technical baseline sequence without injected detector anomalies.',
        generator_version: '1.1.0',
        generator_seed: 12345 + seedOffset,
        generator_config: `Clean baseline series ${t.id}`
      });
    });

    // 2. Missed Detection Candidates Family
    const missedTypes = [
      { id: 'exact_double_centered', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = b[25] * 2; } },
      { id: 'unequal_two_interval_candidate', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = Math.round(b[25] * 2.15); } },
      { id: 'candidate_during_trend', trend: -4, mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = b[25] * 2; } },
      { id: 'two_adjacent_candidates', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = b[25] * 2; b[27] = b[27] * 2; } },
      { id: 'candidate_near_start_boundary', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[5] = b[5] * 2; } },
      { id: 'candidate_near_end_boundary', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[44] = b[44] * 2; } }
    ];

    missedTypes.forEach(t => {
      const base = generateBaseSeries(lcg, 50, 800, 10);
      if (t.trend) {
        for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i++) base[i] += i * t.trend;
      }
      t.mod(base);
      const fixId = `${t.id}_${setType}`;
      writeFixture({
        fixture_id: fixId,
        family: 'missed_detection',
        raw_rr_ms: base,
        raw_event_timestamps_ms: base.reduce((acc: number[], v) => {
          acc.push((acc[acc.length - 1] || 0) + v);
          return acc;
        }, []),
        event_timestamp_semantics: 'cumulative_rr_reconstruction',
        external_reconnect_boundaries: [],
        external_coverage_gap_boundaries: [],
        anomaly_raw_indices: t.id.includes('adjacent') ? [25, 27] : (t.id.includes('start') ? [5] : (t.id.includes('end') ? [44] : [25])),
        expected_classes: ['technical_missed_detection_candidate'],
        acceptable_alternative_classes: ['ambiguous'],
        forbidden_actions: ['candidate_merge'],
        expected_automatic_action_allowed: false,
        expected_duration_before_ms: base.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
        expected_duration_behavior: 'must_be_conserved',
        expected_score_level: 'not_constrained',
        expected_nn_eligibility: 'eligible',
        rationale: 'Missed detection candidate sequence.',

    // 3. Extra Detection Candidates Family
    const extraTypes = [

      { id: 'short_long_technical_candidate', mod: (b: number[]) => { const v = b[25]; b[25] = Math.round(v * 0.3); b.splice(26, 0, v - b[25]); } },
      { id: 'candidate_during_trend', trend: 5, mod: (b: number[]) => { const v = b[25]; b[25] = Math.round(v * 0.5); b.splice(26, 0, v - b[25]); } },
      { id: 'multiple_extra_candidates', mod: (b: number[]) => { const v = b[25]; b[25] = Math.round(v * 0.35); b.splice(26, 0, v - b[25]); const v2 = b[35]; b[35] = Math.round(v2 * 0.4); b.splice(36, 0, v2 - b[35]); } }
    ];

    extraTypes.forEach(t => {
      const base = generateBaseSeries(lcg, 50, 800, 8);
      if (t.trend) {
        for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i++) base[i] += i * t.trend;
      }
      t.mod(base);
      const fixId = `${t.id}_${setType}`;
      writeFixture({
        fixture_id: fixId,
        family: 'extra_detection',
        raw_rr_ms: base,
        raw_event_timestamps_ms: base.reduce((acc: number[], v) => {
          acc.push((acc[acc.length - 1] || 0) + v);
          return acc;
        }, []),
        event_timestamp_semantics: 'cumulative_rr_reconstruction',
        external_reconnect_boundaries: [],
        external_coverage_gap_boundaries: [],
        anomaly_raw_indices: t.id.includes('multiple') ? [25, 26, 36, 37] : [25, 26],
        expected_classes: ['technical_extra_detection_candidate'],
        acceptable_alternative_classes: ['ambiguous'],
        forbidden_actions: ['candidate_split'],
        expected_automatic_action_allowed: false,
        expected_duration_before_ms: base.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
        expected_duration_behavior: 'must_be_conserved',
        expected_score_level: 'not_constrained',
        expected_nn_eligibility: 'eligible',
        rationale: 'Extra detection candidate sequence.',
        generator_version: '1.1.0',
        generator_seed: 12345 + seedOffset,
        generator_config: `Extra detection ${t.id}`
      });
    });

    // 4. Misalignment Candidates Family
    const misalignTypes = [
      { id: 'displaced_pair', mod: (b: number[]) => { const sum = b[25] + b[26]; b[25] = Math.round(sum * 0.3); b[26] = sum - b[25]; } },
      { id: 'displaced_pair_during_trend', trend: -3, mod: (b: number[]) => { const sum = b[25] + b[26]; b[25] = Math.round(sum * 0.35); b[26] = sum - b[25]; } },
      { id: 'low_confidence_displacement', mod: (b: number[]) => { const sum = b[25] + b[26]; b[25] = Math.round(sum * 0.45); b[26] = sum - b[25]; } }
    ];

    misalignTypes.forEach(t => {
      const base = generateBaseSeries(lcg, 50, 800, 10);
      if (t.trend) {
        for (let i = 0; i < base.length; i++) base[i] += i * t.trend;
      }
      t.mod(base);
      const fixId = `${t.id}_${setType}`;
      writeFixture({
        fixture_id: fixId,
        family: 'misalignment',
        raw_rr_ms: base,
        raw_event_timestamps_ms: base.reduce((acc: number[], v) => {
          acc.push((acc[acc.length - 1] || 0) + v);
          return acc;
        }, []),
        event_timestamp_semantics: 'cumulative_rr_reconstruction',
        external_reconnect_boundaries: [],
        external_coverage_gap_boundaries: [],
        anomaly_raw_indices: [25, 26],
        expected_classes: ['technical_misaligned_detection_candidate'],
        acceptable_alternative_classes: ['ambiguous', 'clean'],
        forbidden_actions: ['candidate_split', 'candidate_merge'],
        expected_automatic_action_allowed: false,
        expected_duration_before_ms: base.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
        expected_duration_behavior: 'must_be_conserved',
        expected_score_level: 'not_constrained',
        expected_nn_eligibility: 'eligible',
        rationale: 'Misaligned boundary displacement.',
        generator_version: '1.1.0',
        generator_seed: 12345 + seedOffset,
        generator_config: `Misalignment ${t.id}`
      });
    });

    // 5. Protected/Ambiguous Family
    const protTypes = [
      { id: 'protected_short_long_pattern', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = 400; b[26] = 1200; }, cls: 'protected_short_long_pattern' as RRArtifactClass },
      { id: 'isolated_long_unresolved', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = 1500; }, cls: 'ambiguous' as RRArtifactClass },
      { id: 'isolated_short_unresolved', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = 400; }, cls: 'ambiguous' as RRArtifactClass },
      { id: 'mixed_unstable_cluster', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[24] = 450; b[25] = 1350; b[26] = 300; }, cls: 'ambiguous' as RRArtifactClass },
      { id: 'high_variability_ambiguous', mod: (b: number[]) => { for (let i = 20; i < 30; i++) b[i] = Math.round(b[i] * (i % 2 === 0 ? 0.6 : 1.4)); }, cls: 'ambiguous' as RRArtifactClass }

    protTypes.forEach(t => {

        family: 'protected_ambiguous',

        generator_config: `Protected/Ambiguous ${t.id}`
      });
    });

    // 6. Structural Family (reconnect/invalid/non-monotonic)
    const structTypes = [
      { id: 'explicit_reconnect_boundary', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = 8000; }, extRec: [25], cls: 'reconnect_or_packet_gap' as RRArtifactClass },
      { id: 'explicit_coverage_gap', mod: (b: number[]) => { b[25] = 9000; }, extGap: [25], cls: 'reconnect_or_packet_gap' as RRArtifactClass },

    ];

    structTypes.forEach(t => {
