export function resolveCapabilityPath(capabilityId: string, admissionIdOrStagingDir?: string): string | null {
  if (!capabilityId || typeof capabilityId !== 'string' || !capabilityId.startsWith('cap-')) {
    return null;
  }

  const appData = getAppDataDir();
  const stagingBase = path.resolve(appData, 'staging');
  const capBase = path.resolve(appData, 'capabilities');

  if (admissionIdOrStagingDir) {
    if (admissionIdOrStagingDir.includes('..')) {
      return null;
    }

    if (admissionIdOrStagingDir.includes('/') || admissionIdOrStagingDir.includes('\\') || path.isAbsolute(admissionIdOrStagingDir)) {
      const resolved = path.resolve(admissionIdOrStagingDir);
      const isUnderStaging = resolved.startsWith(stagingBase + path.sep) || resolved === stagingBase;
      const isUnderCap = resolved.startsWith(capBase + path.sep) || resolved === capBase;
      if (!isUnderStaging && !isUnderCap) {
        // Arbitrary external directory rejected (G56-CAP-002)
        return null;
      }
      const candidate = path.join(resolved, `${capabilityId}.bin`);
      if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) return candidate;
      return null;
    }

    const stagingCandidate = path.join(stagingBase, admissionIdOrStagingDir, `${capabilityId}.bin`);
    if (fs.existsSync(stagingCandidate)) return stagingCandidate;

    const capCandidate = path.join(capBase, admissionIdOrStagingDir, `${capabilityId}.bin`);
    if (fs.existsSync(capCandidate)) return capCandidate;

    // Do NOT fall back to global capabilities when admissionId was specified (G56-CAP-002)
    return null;
  }

  const directPath = path.join(capBase, `${capabilityId}.bin`);
  if (fs.existsSync(directPath)) return directPath;

  return null;
}

export function persistCapabilityBuffer(capabilityId: string, buffer: Buffer, admissionId?: string): string {
  const capDir = admissionId
    ? path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'staging', admissionId)
    : path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'capabilities');
  try { fs.mkdirSync(capDir, { recursive: true }); } catch (_) {}
  const target = path.join(capDir, `${capabilityId}.bin`);
  fs.writeFileSync(target, buffer);
  return target;
}

export function reconstructBundlesFromCommand(command: any, admissionIdOrStagingDir?: string): DiscoveredBundle[] {
  if (!command) {
    throw new Error('Cannot reconstruct bundles from command: command is null or undefined.');
  }

  const members = command.members || [];
  if (!Array.isArray(members) || members.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Cannot reconstruct bundles from command: command.members is missing or empty.');
  }

  const admissionScope = command.admission_id || admissionIdOrStagingDir;

  // Group members by bundleId
  const bundleMap = new Map<string, {
    bundleId: string;
    bundleName: string;
    members: any[];
  }>();

  for (const m of members) {
    const bId = m.bundle_id || (command.bundles && command.bundles[0]?.bundle_id) || `bundle-${command.command_id || command.profile_id || 'import'}`;
    const bName = m.bundle_name || (command.bundles && command.bundles.find((b: any) => b.bundle_id === bId)?.bundle_name) || command.bundles?.[0]?.bundle_name || m.name || m.file_name || 'Import_Bundle';

    if (!bundleMap.has(bId)) {
      bundleMap.set(bId, {
        bundleId: bId,
        bundleName: bName,
        members: []
      });
    }
    bundleMap.get(bId)!.members.push(m);
  }

  const reconstructedBundles: DiscoveredBundle[] = [];

  for (const [bId, bData] of bundleMap.entries()) {
    const files: DiscoveredFileItem[] = [];

    for (const m of bData.members) {
      const memberName = m.name || m.file_name || 'unknown_member';
      const capPath = resolveCapabilityPath(m.capability_id, admissionScope);
      if (!capPath || !fs.existsSync(capPath)) {
        throw new Error(`Capability file missing on disk for capability '${m.capability_id}' (${memberName}) in admission scope '${admissionScope}'`);
      }
      const stat = fs.statSync(capPath);
      if (m.size_bytes && stat.size !== m.size_bytes) {
        throw new Error(`Capability size mismatch for '${m.capability_id}': expected ${m.size_bytes}, found ${stat.size}`);
      }
      const buf = fs.readFileSync(capPath);
      const actualSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
      if (m.sha256 && actualSha256 !== m.sha256) {
        throw new Error(`Capability hash mismatch for '${m.capability_id}': expected ${m.sha256}, found ${actualSha256}`);
      }
      files.push({
        fileName: memberName,
        fullPath: capPath,
        sizeBytes: stat.size,
        sha256: actualSha256,
        signalType: m.signal_type as DetectedSignalType,
        capability_id: m.capability_id,
        schemaType: (m.signal_type === 'RR'
          ? 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col'
          : (m.signal_type === 'ECG'
              ? 'polar_sensor_logger_ecg'
              : (m.signal_type === 'ACC'
                  ? 'polar_sensor_logger_acc'
                  : 'unknown'))) as any,
        rowCount: 0,
        isRowCountEstimated: false
      } as any);
    }

    reconstructedBundles.push({
      bundleId: bId,
      bundleName: bData.bundleName,
      deviceId: 'Polar_H10',
      profileId: command.profile_id,
      groupingBasis: 'filename_pattern',
      groupingConfidence: 'high',
      status: 'VALID',
      startTime: null,
      endTime: null,
      durationSeconds: null,
      isDurationEstimated: false,
      channels: bData.members.map((m: any) => m.signal_type as DetectedSignalType),
      files,
      warnings: [],
      userCorrections: [],
      selected: true
    });
  }

  return reconstructedBundles;
}

export function reconstructBundleFromCommand(command: any, admissionIdOrStagingDir?: string): DiscoveredBundle {
  const bundles = reconstructBundlesFromCommand(command, admissionIdOrStagingDir);
  return bundles[0];
}

export interface GuidedImportJobResultItem {
  sessionId: string;
  bundleName: string;
  startTime: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  channels: string[];
  alreadyImported?: boolean;
  canonicalMetrics: {
    rmssd: number | null;
    sdnn: number | null;
    pnn50: number | null;
    mean_hr: number | null;
    rmssd_eligibility?: string;
    sdnn_eligibility?: string;
    pnn50_eligibility?: string;
    mean_hr_eligibility?: string;
    rmssd_reasons?: string[];
    sdnn_reasons?: string[];
    pnn50_reasons?: string[];
    mean_hr_reasons?: string[];
  } | null;
  error?: string;
}

export interface GuidedImportJob {
  jobId: string;
  stage: GuidedImportJobStage;
  stageLabelRu: string;
  progressPercent: number;
  totalBundles: number;
  completedBundles: number;
  currentBundleIndex: number;
  currentBundleName?: string;
  results: GuidedImportJobResultItem[];
  cancelRequested?: boolean;
  cancelAcknowledged?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  startedAtUtc: string;
  completedAtUtc?: string;
}

export function toLegacyJobView(snapshot: DurableImportJobSnapshot): GuidedImportJob {
  return {
    jobId: snapshot.job_id,
    stage: snapshot.stage,
    stageLabelRu: snapshot.stage_label_ru,
    progressPercent: snapshot.progress_percent,
    totalBundles: snapshot.total_bundles,
    completedBundles: snapshot.completed_bundles,
    currentBundleIndex: snapshot.current_bundle_index,
    currentBundleName: snapshot.current_bundle_name,
    results: (snapshot.results || []).map(r => ({
      sessionId: r.session_id,
      bundleName: r.bundle_name,
      startTime: r.start_time_utc,
      durationSeconds: r.duration_seconds,
      channels: r.channels as string[],
      alreadyImported: r.already_imported,
      canonicalMetrics: r.canonical_metrics ? {
        rmssd: r.canonical_metrics.rmssd,
        sdnn: r.canonical_metrics.sdnn,
        pnn50: r.canonical_metrics.pnn50,
        mean_hr: r.canonical_metrics.mean_hr_bpm,
        rmssd_eligibility: r.canonical_metrics.rmssd_eligibility,
        sdnn_eligibility: r.canonical_metrics.sdnn_eligibility,
        pnn50_eligibility: r.canonical_metrics.pnn50_eligibility,
        mean_hr_eligibility: r.canonical_metrics.mean_hr_eligibility,
        rmssd_reasons: r.canonical_metrics.rmssd_reasons,
        sdnn_reasons: r.canonical_metrics.sdnn_reasons,
        pnn50_reasons: r.canonical_metrics.pnn50_reasons,
        mean_hr_reasons: r.canonical_metrics.mean_hr_reasons
      } : null,
      error: r.error
    })),
    cancelRequested: snapshot.cancel_requested,
    cancelAcknowledged: snapshot.cancel_acknowledged,
    error: snapshot.error,
    startedAtUtc: snapshot.started_at_utc,
    completedAtUtc: snapshot.completed_at_utc
  };
}

export function getGuidedImportJob(jobId: string): GuidedImportJob | undefined {
  const snapshot = getDbDurableJob(jobId);
  if (!snapshot) return undefined;
  return toLegacyJobView(snapshot);
}

export function getDurableJobSnapshot(jobId: string): DurableImportJobSnapshot | null {
  return getDbDurableJob(jobId);
}

export function cancelGuidedImportJob(jobId: string): boolean {
  return cancelDbDurableJob(jobId);
}

const activeJobPromises = new Map<string, Promise<DurableImportJobSnapshot>>();

export async function awaitDurableImportJob(jobId: string, timeoutMs = 60000): Promise<DurableImportJobSnapshot> {
  const inFlight = activeJobPromises.get(jobId);
  if (inFlight) {
    return await inFlight;
  }
  const start = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
    const s = getDbDurableJob(jobId);
    if (s && (
      s.stage === 'completed' ||
      s.stage === 'failed' ||
      s.stage === 'partial_failure' ||
      s.stage === 'failed_recoverable' ||
      s.stage === 'rolled_back' ||
      s.stage === 'cancelled'
    )) {
      return s;
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 25));
  }
  throw new Error(`Durable import job '${jobId}' timed out waiting for completion.`);
}

export interface GuidedImportJobOptions {
  profileId?: string;
  participantId?: string;
  flowId?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  admission?: any;
  targetEpisodeId?: string | null;
  task_intent?: string;
  stagingDir?: string;
  payloadHash?: string;
}

export function resolveGuidedImportParticipantContext(callerSuppliedParticipantId?: string | null): {
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  is_external_tester: boolean;
  invite_code?: string | null;
} | null {
  const activeCtx = getActiveBetaContext();

  if (callerSuppliedParticipantId) {
    if (activeCtx && activeCtx.is_external_tester) {
      if (callerSuppliedParticipantId !== activeCtx.participant_id) {
        throw new Error(
          `Participant reassignment rejected: caller-supplied participant '${callerSuppliedParticipantId}' does not match active enrolled external participant '${activeCtx.participant_id}'.`
        );
      }
      return {
        participant_id: activeCtx.participant_id,
        cohort_id: activeCtx.cohort_id,
        invite_code: activeCtx.invite_code,
        is_external_tester: true
      };
    } else {
      const p = getBetaParticipant(callerSuppliedParticipantId);
      if (p && p.is_external_tester) {
        throw new Error(
          `Participant reassignment rejected: '${callerSuppliedParticipantId}' is an external participant but is not the active enrolled context on this installation.`
        );
      }
      return null;
    }
  }

  if (activeCtx && activeCtx.is_external_tester) {
    return {
      participant_id: activeCtx.participant_id,
      cohort_id: activeCtx.cohort_id,
      invite_code: activeCtx.invite_code,
      is_external_tester: true
    };
  }

  return null;
}

export function executeImportJob(
  jobId: string,
  initialSnapshot: DurableImportJobSnapshot,
  selected: DiscoveredBundle[],
  options?: GuidedImportJobOptions & { targetEpisodeId?: string | null }
): Promise<DurableImportJobSnapshot> {
  const flowId = options?.flowId || selected.find(b => b.flow_id)?.flow_id;
  const targetParticipant = resolveGuidedImportParticipantContext(options?.participantId);

  const jobExecutionPromise = (async (): Promise<DurableImportJobSnapshot> => {
    try {
      if (selected.length === 0) {
        initialSnapshot.stage = 'completed';
        initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = 'Нет выбранных пакетов';
        initialSnapshot.progress_percent = 100;
        initialSnapshot.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
        initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
        return initialSnapshot;
      }

      const claimed = claimDurableImportJob(jobId);
      if (!claimed) {
        // Already claimed by another worker
        return initialSnapshot;
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
        // Cooperative cancellation check
        const currentJob = getDbDurableJob(jobId);
        if (currentJob?.cancel_requested) {
          acknowledgeDurableImportJobCancellation(jobId);
          recordWorkstationEvent('guided_import_cancelled', { job_id: jobId, completed_bundles: i });
          return initialSnapshot;
        }

        const bundle = selected[i];
        const step = initialSnapshot.steps[i];
        if (step) {
          step.status = 'in_progress';
          step.started_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
        }

        initialSnapshot.current_bundle_index = i + 1;
        initialSnapshot.current_bundle_name = bundle.bundleName;

        const onBundleProgress = (stage: string, percent: number) => {
          initialSnapshot.stage = stage as GuidedImportJobStage;
          if (stage === 'revalidating_sources') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Проверка целостности источников (${bundle.bundleName})...`;
          } else if (stage === 'hashing') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Хэширование сигналов (${bundle.bundleName})...`;
          } else if (stage === 'storing_sources') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Сохранение сигналов (${bundle.bundleName})...`;
          } else if (stage === 'creating_session') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Регистрация канонической сессии в БД...`;
          } else if (stage === 'running_qc') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Расчет контроля качества (QC Coordinator)...`;
          } else if (stage === 'building_canonical_result') {
            initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = `Построение CanonicalSessionResult и проверка Task Eligibility...`;
          }
          initialSnapshot.progress_percent = Math.min(99, Math.round(((i + (percent / 100)) / selected.length) * 100));
          initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
          saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
        };

        try {
          const effFlowId = flowId || bundle.flow_id;
          if (effFlowId && !bundle.flow_id) {
            bundle.flow_id = effFlowId;
          }
          const decision = bundle.userCorrections && bundle.userCorrections.length > 0 ? 'manually_corrected' : 'auto_accepted';
          recordWorkstationEvent('bundle_grouping_confirmed', {
            flow_id: effFlowId ?? null,
            bundle_id: bundle.bundleId,
            bundle_name: bundle.bundleName,
            decision,
            corrections_count: bundle.userCorrections?.length || 0
          });

          const importRes = await importDiscoveredBundle(bundle, onBundleProgress);

          const stepResult: DurableBundleStepResult = {
            session_id: importRes.sessionId,
            bundle_id: bundle.bundleId,
            bundle_name: bundle.bundleName,
            start_time_utc: importRes.startTime,
            duration_seconds: importRes.durationSeconds,
            channels: importRes.channels as DetectedSignalType[],
            already_imported: Boolean(importRes.alreadyImported),
            canonical_metrics: importRes.canonicalMetrics ? {
              rmssd: importRes.canonicalMetrics.rmssd ?? null,
              sdnn: importRes.canonicalMetrics.sdnn ?? null,
              pnn50: importRes.canonicalMetrics.pnn50 ?? null,
              mean_hr_bpm: importRes.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? importRes.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr ?? null,
              mean_rr_ms: importRes.canonicalMetrics.mean_rr_ms?.value ?? null,
              rmssd_eligibility: importRes.canonicalMetrics.rmssd_eligibility,
              sdnn_eligibility: importRes.canonicalMetrics.sdnn_eligibility,
              pnn50_eligibility: importRes.canonicalMetrics.pnn50_eligibility,
              mean_hr_eligibility: importRes.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_eligibility,
              rmssd_reasons: importRes.canonicalMetrics.rmssd_reasons,
              sdnn_reasons: importRes.canonicalMetrics.sdnn_reasons,
              pnn50_reasons: importRes.canonicalMetrics.pnn50_reasons,
              mean_hr_reasons: importRes.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_reasons
            } : null
          };

          initialSnapshot.results.push(stepResult);
          if (step) {
            step.status = 'succeeded';
            step.session_id = importRes.sessionId;
            step.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
          }

          if (importRes.sessionId) {
            if (effFlowId) {
              try {
                bindSessionToFlow(effFlowId, importRes.sessionId);
              } catch {}
            }
            if (targetParticipant && targetParticipant.is_external_tester) {
              try {
                bindSessionToParticipant({
                  session_id: importRes.sessionId,
                  participant_id: targetParticipant.participant_id,
                  cohort_id: targetParticipant.cohort_id,
                  invite_code: targetParticipant.invite_code,
                  is_external_tester: true,
                  bound_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
                });
              } catch {}
            }
            recordWorkstationEvent('canonical_analysis_completed', {
              sessionId: importRes.sessionId,
              flow_id: effFlowId ?? null,
              bundleName: bundle.bundleName
            });
            recordWorkstationEvent('guided_import_completed', {
              sessionId: importRes.sessionId,
              job_id: jobId,
              flow_id: effFlowId ?? null,
              bundleName: bundle.bundleName
            });
          }
        } catch (bundleErr: any) {
          if (step) {
            step.status = 'failed';
            step.error = bundleErr.message || 'Ошибка импорта пакета';
            step.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
          }
          initialSnapshot.results.push({
            session_id: '',
            bundle_id: bundle.bundleId,
            bundle_name: bundle.bundleName,
            start_time_utc: bundle.startTime || '',
            duration_seconds: bundle.durationSeconds || 0,
            channels: bundle.channels,
            already_imported: false,
            canonical_metrics: null,
            error: bundleErr.message || 'Ошибка импорта пакета'
          });
        }

        initialSnapshot.completed_bundles = i + 1;
        initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
      }

      // Check final state
      const hasFailures = initialSnapshot.results.some(r => !!r.error);
      const allFailed = initialSnapshot.results.length > 0 && initialSnapshot.results.every(r => !!r.error);

      if (allFailed) {
        initialSnapshot.stage = 'failed';
        initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = 'Все пакеты завершились ошибкой импорта';
        initialSnapshot.progress_percent = 100;
        initialSnapshot.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      } else if (hasFailures) {
        initialSnapshot.stage = 'partial_failure';
        initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = 'Импорт завершен частично с ошибками';
        initialSnapshot.progress_percent = 100;
        initialSnapshot.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      } else {
        // G55-BIND-004: Single-session cardinality check before mutating episode or journey selection
        const validSessionResults = initialSnapshot.results.filter(r => r.session_id);
        if (validSessionResults.length > 1) {
          throw new Error(`[AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_SESSION_CANDIDATES] One-recording import command produced ${validSessionResults.length} session candidates; single-session cardinality required.`);
        }

        // G52-BIND-003, G54-BIND-004: Explicit product_binding stage before completion
        initialSnapshot.stage = 'product_binding';
        initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = 'Привязка канонической сессии к эпизоду и маршруту...';
        initialSnapshot.progress_percent = 99;
        initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
        saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);

        const db = getDb();
        let command = (initialSnapshot as any).command;
        if (!command && (initialSnapshot as any).command_json) {
          try { command = JSON.parse((initialSnapshot as any).command_json); } catch (_) {}
        }
        const admissionData = options?.admission || command?.admission;
        const admissionJson = admissionData ? JSON.stringify(admissionData) : null;
        const targetEpisodeId = options?.targetEpisodeId || command?.target_episode_id || null;
        const expectedTaskIntent = command?.task_intent || options?.task_intent || (options as any)?.admission?.task_intent || 'pilot_journey';

        db.transaction(() => {
          let primaryBound = false;
          for (const res of initialSnapshot.results) {
            if (res.session_id) {
              if (admissionJson) {
                db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET admission_json = ? WHERE id = ?').run(
                  admissionJson,
                  res.session_id
                );
              }

              let currentEpisodeId = targetEpisodeId;
              if (currentEpisodeId) {
                const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(currentEpisodeId);
                if (!ep) {
                  throw new Error(`[EPISODE_NOT_FOUND] Target episode '${currentEpisodeId}' not found.`);
                }
                if (ep.profile_id && ep.profile_id !== initialSnapshot.profile_id) {
                  throw new Error(`[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Target episode belongs to '${ep.profile_id}', requested under '${initialSnapshot.profile_id}'.`);
                }
                if (ep.lifecycle_state === 'completed' || ep.lifecycle_state === 'cancelled') {
                  throw new Error(`[EPISODE_STATE_INVALID] Target episode '${currentEpisodeId}' is in terminal state '${ep.lifecycle_state}'.`);
                }
                if (ep.canonical_session_id && ep.canonical_session_id !== res.session_id) {
                  throw new Error(`[EPISODE_ALREADY_BOUND] Target episode '${currentEpisodeId}' is already bound to session '${ep.canonical_session_id}'.`);
                }
                if (ep.task_intent && expectedTaskIntent && ep.task_intent !== expectedTaskIntent) {
                  throw new Error(`[EPISODE_TASK_MISMATCH] Target episode task intent '${ep.task_intent}' does not match command task intent '${expectedTaskIntent}'.`);
                }
                selfServiceEpisodeService.transitionEpisode(currentEpisodeId, 'analysis_ready', {
                  canonical_session_id: res.session_id,
                  completion_gates: {
                    preflight_passed: true,
                    import_completed: true,
                    qc_evaluated: true
                  }
                });
              } else {
                const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.createEpisode({
                  profile_id: initialSnapshot.profile_id,
                  task_intent: expectedTaskIntent,
                  canonical_session_id: res.session_id,
                  lifecycle_state: 'analysis_ready',
                  completion_gates: {
                    preflight_passed: true,
                    import_completed: true,
                    qc_evaluated: true
                  }
                });
                currentEpisodeId = ep.episode_id;
              }

              (res as any).episode_id = currentEpisodeId;

              // Only bind primary result to journey selection and idempotency to avoid multi-result overwrites (G54-BIND-004)
              if (!primaryBound) {
                primaryBound = true;
                const existingSel = getAthleteJourneySelection(initialSnapshot.profile_id);
                saveAthleteJourneySelection({
                  ...(existingSel || {}),
                  profile_id: initialSnapshot.profile_id,
                  selected_session_id: res.session_id,
                  selected_window_root_id: null,
                  selected_window_revision: null,
                  comparison_mode: 'none',
                  compare_target_session_id: null,
                  compare_peer_session_id: null,
                  selected_snapshot_id: null,
                  selected_saved_view_id: null,
                  export_projection: null,
                  sensitive_opt_in: {
                    identifiers: false,
                    raw_rr: false,
                    raw_ecg: false,
                    raw_acc: false,
                    notes: false,
                    paths: false
                  },
                  selected_preview_fingerprint: null,
                  selected_pack_id: null,
                  selected_diary_id: null,
                  is_aggregate_read_only: false,
                  exact_next_safe_action: 'quality_review',
                  selection_revision: (existingSel?.selection_revision ?? 0) + 1,
                  context_generation: (existingSel?.context_generation ?? 0) + 1
                } as any);

                if (initialSnapshot.idempotency_key) {
                  saveDurableImportIdempotency({
                    idempotency_key: initialSnapshot.idempotency_key,
                    request_fingerprint: initialSnapshot.request_fingerprint,
                    payload_hash: initialSnapshot.correlation_id?.startsWith('payload:')
                      ? initialSnapshot.correlation_id.slice(8)
                      : initialSnapshot.request_fingerprint,
                    job_id: jobId,
                    result: {
                      sessionId: res.session_id,
                      episodeId: currentEpisodeId,
                      alreadyImported: false
                    }
                  });
                }
              }
            }
          }
        })();

        initialSnapshot.stage = 'completed';
        initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = 'Импорт успешно завершен';
        initialSnapshot.progress_percent = 100;
        initialSnapshot.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      }
      initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
      recordWorkstationEvent('guided_import_completed', { job_id: jobId, imported_count: initialSnapshot.results.length, has_failures: hasFailures });
      return initialSnapshot;
    } catch (err: any) {
      const isBindingFailure = initialSnapshot.stage === 'product_binding' || Boolean(err.message && err.message.includes('AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_SESSION_CANDIDATES'));
      initialSnapshot.stage = isBindingFailure ? 'failed_recoverable' : 'failed';
      initialSnapshot.stage_label_ru = isBindingFailure
        ? `Ошибка привязки сессии к эпизоду (доступно возобновление): ${err.message}`
        : `Ошибка импорта: ${err.message}`;
      initialSnapshot.error = err.message;
      if (isBindingFailure) {
        initialSnapshot.recovery_descriptor = {
          error_code: 'PRODUCT_BINDING_FAILED',
          can_resume: true,
          command_available: true
        } as any;
      } else {
        initialSnapshot.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      }
      initialSnapshot.updated_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
      recordWorkstationEvent('guided_import_failed', { job_id: jobId, error: err.message, recoverable: isBindingFailure });
      return initialSnapshot;
    }
  })();

  activeJobPromises.set(jobId, jobExecutionPromise);
  jobExecutionPromise.finally(() => {
    activeJobPromises.delete(jobId);
  });

  return jobExecutionPromise;
}

export function startGuidedImportJob(bundles: DiscoveredBundle[], options?: GuidedImportJobOptions): { jobId: string } {
  const profileId = options?.profileId || 'default';
  const selected = bundles.filter(b => b.selected);
  for (const b of selected) {
    if (!b.profileId && profileId) {
      b.profileId = profileId;
    }
  }
  const flowId = options?.flowId || bundles.find(b => b.flow_id)?.flow_id;
  const targetParticipant = resolveGuidedImportParticipantContext(options?.participantId);

  const targetEpisodeId = (options as any)?.targetEpisodeId || (options as any)?.target_episode_id || null;
  const admissionId = (options?.admission as any)?.admission_id || (options?.admission as any)?.staging_id || (options?.admission as any)?.preflight_id || (options?.stagingDir ? path.basename(options.stagingDir) : null);
  const effectiveTaskIntent = (options as any)?.task_intent || (options?.admission as any)?.task_intent || (flowId ? 'guided_bundle_import' : 'pilot_journey');
  const duplicateDecision = (options as any)?.duplicate_decision || null;

  const versions = {
    parser_version: (options?.admission as any)?.parser_version || '1.3.0',
    envelope_version: (options?.admission as any)?.envelope_version || '1.0.0',
    grouping_version: (options as any)?.grouping_version || '1.0.0',
    import_version: '1.0.0'
  };

  // G55-COMMAND-001 / G56-IMPORT-001: Global monotonic member ordinals and bundle associations across the command
  let globalMemberOrdinal = 0;
  const executableCommandMembers = selected.flatMap(b => (b.files || []).map((f) => {
    const capId = (f as any).capability_id || (f as any).capabilityId;
    if (!capId || typeof capId !== 'string' || !capId.startsWith('cap-')) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid or missing capability ID for member '${f.fileName}'. Pre-issued opaque capability is required; synthesis from hash or path is rejected.`);
    }
    return {
      bundle_id: b.bundleId,
      bundle_name: b.bundleName,
      capability_id: capId,
      ordinal: globalMemberOrdinal++,
      role: f.signalType || 'data',
      name: f.fileName,
      size_bytes: f.sizeBytes,
      sha256: f.sha256 || '',
      signal_type: f.signalType
    };
  }));

  // G55-COMMAND-001: Deterministic canonical payload binding all semantic dimensions
  const canonicalPayload = {
    profile_id: profileId,
    task_intent: effectiveTaskIntent,
    target_episode_id: targetEpisodeId,
    duplicate_decision: duplicateDecision,
    admission_id: admissionId || null,
    bundles: selected.map(b => ({ bundle_id: b.bundleId, bundle_name: b.bundleName })),
    versions,
    members: executableCommandMembers.map(m => ({
      ordinal: m.ordinal,
      role: m.role,
      name: m.name,
      size_bytes: m.size_bytes,
      sha256: m.sha256,
      signal_type: m.signal_type
    })),
    flow_id: flowId || null,
    participant_id: targetParticipant?.participant_id || options?.participantId || null
  };
  const payloadHash = options?.payloadHash || crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(canonicalPayload)).digest('hex');

  const db = getDb();
  const claimKey = `${profileId}:${payloadHash}`;

  const jobId = `job-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  const planId = `plan-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
  const correlationId = `payload:${payloadHash}`;

  // Complete canonical command structure with authoritative versions and NO staging_path (G50-CMD-002, G54-COMMAND-003, G55-COMMAND-001)
  const executableCommand = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    command_id: `cmd-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    command_type: 'import_and_bind',
    profile_id: profileId,
    admission_id: admissionId || null,
    admission: options?.admission || null,
    task_intent: effectiveTaskIntent,
    target_episode_id: targetEpisodeId,
    idempotency_key: options?.idempotencyKey || null,
    payload_hash: payloadHash,
    source_set_identity: payloadHash,
    duplicate_decision: duplicateDecision,
    bundles: selected.map(b => ({ bundle_id: b.bundleId, bundle_name: b.bundleName })),
    members: executableCommandMembers,
    versions,
    created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const requestFingerprint = computeDurablePlanFingerprint({
    profile_id: profileId,
    task_intent: 'guided_bundle_import',
    bundles: selected.map((b, idx) => ({
      bundle_id: b.bundleId || `bundle_${idx}`,
      immutable_source_identity: b.bundleId || `bundle_${idx}`,
      revision: (b.userCorrections && b.userCorrections.length > 0) ? 2 : 1,
      selected: true
    })),
    parser_version: '1.3.0',
    import_options: { flowId, participantId: options?.participantId }
  });

  const steps: DurableBundleStep[] = selected.map((b, idx) => ({
    step_index: idx + 1,
    bundle_id: b.bundleId,
    bundle_name: b.bundleName,
    status: 'pending'
  }));

  const initialSnapshot: DurableImportJobSnapshot & { command_json?: string; command?: any } = {
    schema_version: SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    job_id: jobId,
    profile_id: profileId,
    plan_id: planId,
    request_fingerprint: requestFingerprint,
    idempotency_key: options?.idempotencyKey,
    target_episode_id: targetEpisodeId,
    stage: 'queued',
    stage_label_ru: 'Очередь обработки...',
    progress_percent: 0,
    total_bundles: selected.length,
    completed_bundles: 0,
    current_bundle_index: 0,
    steps,
    results: [],
    cancel_requested: false,
    cancel_acknowledged: false,
    is_retryable: true,
    revision: 1,
    correlation_id: correlationId,
    command_json: JSON.stringify(executableCommand),
    command: executableCommand,
    started_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // Atomic claim and idempotency check in one transaction without race conditions (G50-CLAIM-001)
  let existingJobId: string | null = null;
  db.transaction(() => {
    if (options?.idempotencyKey) {
      const existingJob = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs WHERE idempotency_key = ? LIMIT 1').get(options.idempotencyKey) as any;
      if (existingJob) {
        const existingHash = existingJob.correlation_id?.startsWith('payload:')
          ? existingJob.correlation_id.slice(8)
          : existingJob.request_fingerprint;
        if (existingHash === payloadHash) {
          existingJobId = existingJob.job_id;
          return;
        } else {
          throw new IdempotencyConflictError('Idempotency conflict: same key with different payload.');
        }
      }
    }

    const existingClaim = db.prepare('SELECT job_id FROM durable_import_claims WHERE claim_key = ?').get(claimKey) as any;
    if (existingClaim) {
      const existingJob = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs WHERE job_id = ?').get(existingClaim.job_id) as any;
      if (existingJob && !['failed', 'cancelled', 'rolled_back'].includes(existingJob.stage)) {
        const existingHash = existingJob.correlation_id?.startsWith('payload:')
          ? existingJob.correlation_id.slice(8)
          : existingJob.request_fingerprint;
        if (existingHash === payloadHash) {
          existingJobId = existingClaim.job_id;
          return;
        } else {
          throw new IdempotencyConflictError('Claim conflict: active import claim exists with different payload.');
        }
      }
    }

    // Coalesce same-payload jobs (active or completed)
    const existingSamePayload = db.prepare(`
      SELECT job_id FROM durable_import_jobs
      WHERE profile_id = ? AND correlation_id = ? AND stage NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled', 'rolled_back')
      ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(profileId, `payload:${payloadHash}`) as any;

    if (existingSamePayload) {
      existingJobId = existingSamePayload.job_id;
      return;
    }

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO durable_import_claims (claim_key, job_id, created_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?)
    `).run(claimKey, jobId, new Date().toISOString());
    saveDurableImportJob(initialSnapshot);
  })();

  if (existingJobId) {
    return { jobId: existingJobId };
  }

  recordWorkstationEvent('guided_import_started', { job_id: jobId, flow_id: flowId ?? null, bundles_count: selected.length });

  // G56-IMPORT-001: All executions (single and multi-bundle) reconstruct strictly from executableCommand
  const bundlesToExecute = reconstructBundlesFromCommand(executableCommand, admissionId || options?.stagingDir);
  executeImportJob(jobId, initialSnapshot, bundlesToExecute, { ...options, targetEpisodeId });

  return { jobId };
}

export interface ReconcileStartupResult {
  recoveredCount: number;
  rolledBackCount: number;
}

export function reconcileDurableImportJobsOnStartup(): ReconcileStartupResult {
  const db = getDb();
  let recoveredCount = 0;
  let rolledBackCount = 0;

  try {
    const inFlightJobs = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs
      WHERE stage NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'partial_failure', 'cancelled', 'rolled_back')
    `).all() as any[];

    for (const row of inFlightJobs) {
      try {
        const jobId = row.job_id;
        let steps: any[] = [];
        let results: any[] = [];
        let command: any = null;
        try { steps = JSON.parse(row.steps_json || '[]'); } catch (_) {}
        try { results = JSON.parse(row.results_json || '[]'); } catch (_) {}
        if (row.command_json) {
          try { command = JSON.parse(row.command_json); } catch (_) {}
        }

        let allValid = (row.completed_bundles >= row.total_bundles) &&
                       results.length > 0 &&
                       results.length >= row.total_bundles &&
                       results.every(r => r.session_id && !r.error);
        if (allValid) {
          for (const res of results) {
            const sess = db.prepare('SELECT id, user_id, admission_json FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(res.session_id) as any;
            const metrics = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, canonical_observation_json FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(res.session_id) as any;
            if (!sess || !metrics || (row.profile_id && sess.user_id !== row.profile_id)) {
              allValid = false;
              break;
            }

            const isModernSealJob = Boolean(command || row.command_json || jobId.startsWith('job-g54') || jobId.startsWith('job-g55') || (row.plan_id && (row.plan_id.includes('g54') || row.plan_id.includes('g55'))));

            if (isModernSealJob) {
              if (!sess.admission_json) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              // Verify canonical metrics JSON is non-empty and valid (G54-SEAL-001, G55-SEAL-002)
              let obsValid = false;
              let canonicalResultHash: string | null = null;
              let beatLedgerHash: string | null = null;
              try {
                const obs = JSON.parse(metrics.canonical_observation_json || '{}');
                canonicalResultHash = obs.canonical_result_hash || obs.resultIdentity || null;
                beatLedgerHash = obs.beat_ledger_hash || obs.ledger_hash || null;
                obsValid = Boolean(canonicalResultHash && beatLedgerHash && (obs.mean_hr || obs.rmssd || obs.sdnn || obs.pnn50));
              } catch (_) {
                obsValid = false;
              }
              if (!obsValid || !canonicalResultHash || !beatLedgerHash) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              // QC coordinator metrics must exist and not be invalid
              const qc = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, monotonicity_status FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(res.session_id) as any;
              if (!qc || qc.monotonicity_status === 'invalid') {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              const ep = db.prepare('SELECT episode_id, profile_id, lifecycle_state FROM self_service_episodes WHERE canonical_session_id = ?').get(res.session_id) as any;
              if (!ep || ep.lifecycle_state === 'draft' || (row.profile_id && ep.profile_id !== row.profile_id)) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }
              if (command.target_episode_id && ep.episode_id !== command.target_episode_id) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              // Check signals and files on disk: signals MUST exist, match command members count, and have exact unique files (G54-SEAL-001, G55-SEAL-002)
              const signals = db.prepare('SELECT f.id, f.sha256_hash, f.signal_type FROM session_signals ss JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id WHERE ss.session_id = ?').all(res.session_id) as any[];
              if (signals.length === 0) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }
              if (command.members && Array.isArray(command.members) && command.members.length > 0 && signals.length !== command.members.length) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
              let filesOk = true;
              for (const sig of signals) {
                try {
                  const sigTypeLower = (sig.signal_type || '').toLowerCase();
                  const candidateNames = [
                    `${sig.id}_${sigTypeLower}.txt.gz`,
                    `${sig.id}.txt.gz`,
                    `${sig.id}_${sigTypeLower}`,
                    `${sig.id}`
                  ];

                  let matchedPath: string | null = null;
                  for (const cName of candidateNames) {
                    const cPath = path.join(rawLogsDir, cName);
                    if (fs.existsSync(cPath)) {
                      matchedPath = cPath;
                      break;
                    }
                  }

                  if (!matchedPath) {
                    filesOk = false;
                    break;
                  }

                  const stat = fs.statSync(matchedPath);
                  if (stat.size === 0 || (sig.filesize && stat.size !== sig.filesize)) {
                    filesOk = false;
                    break;
                  }
                  const buf = fs.readFileSync(matchedPath);
                  const sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
                  if (sig.sha256_hash && sha !== sig.sha256_hash) {
                    filesOk = false;
                    break;
                  }
                } catch (_) {
                  filesOk = false;
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (!filesOk) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              // Check journey selection if exists
              const journeySel = db.prepare('SELECT selected_session_id FROM athlete_journey_selections WHERE profile_id = ?').get(row.profile_id) as any;
              if (!journeySel || journeySel.selected_session_id !== res.session_id) {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }

              // Check idempotency if key was present
              if (row.idempotency_key) {
                const idemp = db.prepare('SELECT job_id FROM durable_import_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(row.idempotency_key) as any;
                if (!idemp || idemp.job_id !== jobId) {
                  allValid = false;
                  break;
                }
              }
            } else {
              // Legacy non-command jobs: verify basic session metrics and QC if present
              const qc = db.prepare('SELECT session_id, monotonicity_status FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(res.session_id) as any;
              if (qc && qc.monotonicity_status === 'invalid') {
                allValid = false;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }

        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (allValid) {
          db.prepare(`
            UPDATE durable_import_jobs
            SET stage = 'completed', stage_label_ru = 'Восстановлено при запуске', progress_percent = 100, updated_at_utc = ?, completed_at_utc = ?
            WHERE job_id = ?
          `).run(now, now, jobId);
          recoveredCount++;
        } else {
          // Roll back partial unsealed session state without deleting pre-existing deduplicated sessions (G54-SEAL-001, G55-RECOVERY-003)
          for (const res of results) {
            if (res.session_id) {
              try {
                const isAlreadyImported = Boolean(res.already_imported || res.alreadyImported);
                if (!isAlreadyImported) {
                  db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(res.session_id);
                  db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(res.session_id);
                  db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_signals WHERE session_id = ?').run(res.session_id);
                  db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').run(res.session_id);
                }
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          }

          const canResume = Boolean(command && command.members && command.members.length > 0);
          const recoveryDescriptor = {
            error_code: 'INTERRUPTED_BEFORE_CANONICAL_SEAL',
            can_resume: canResume,
            command_available: Boolean(command),
            command_id: command?.command_id || null,
            target_episode_id: command?.target_episode_id || null
          };

          db.prepare(`
            UPDATE durable_import_jobs
            SET stage = 'failed_recoverable',
                stage_label_ru = 'Прервано до завершения (доступно возобновление)',
                updated_at_utc = ?,
                error = 'Job interrupted before canonical readiness seal',
                recovery_descriptor_json = ?
            WHERE job_id = ?
          `).run(now, JSON.stringify(recoveryDescriptor), jobId);
          rolledBackCount++;

          if (canResume) {
            // Automatically resume the same job in-place across repeated crashes (G52-RECOVERY-002, G54-RESUME-002)
            resumeDurableImportJob(jobId).catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  return { recoveredCount, rolledBackCount };
}

/**
 * Resumes an interrupted or recoverable import job using its persisted command_json (G50-RECOVERY-003, G54-COMMAND-003).
 * Resumes the exact same job ID in-place from persisted capabilities, revalidating bytes,
 * size, and hash, preserving target_episode_id and complete admission lineage without creating replacement jobs.
 */
export async function resumeDurableImportJob(jobId: string): Promise<DurableImportJobSnapshot> {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM durable_import_jobs WHERE job_id = ?').get(jobId) as any;
  if (!row) {
    throw new Error(`Durable import job '${jobId}' not found for resumption.`);
  }

  if (row.stage === 'completed') {
    return getDurableJobSnapshot(jobId)!;
  }

  if (!row.command_json) {
    throw new Error(`Cannot resume job '${jobId}': missing executable command_json.`);
  }

  let command: any;
  try {
    command = JSON.parse(row.command_json);
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new Error(`Corrupted command_json on job '${jobId}': ${err.message}`);
  }

  let bundles: DiscoveredBundle[];
  try {
    bundles = reconstructBundlesFromCommand(command, command.admission_id || row.admission_id);
  } catch (err: any) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE durable_import_jobs
      SET stage = 'failed_recoverable',
          stage_label_ru = 'Прервано до завершения (доступно возобновление)',
          error = ?,
          updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE job_id = ?
    `).run(`Corrupted capability or disk error: ${err.message}`, now, jobId);
    return getDurableJobSnapshot(jobId)!;
  }

  // Reset stage to queued on the EXACT SAME jobId
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE durable_import_jobs
    SET stage = 'queued', stage_label_ru = 'Возобновление обработки...', error = NULL, updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ?
  `).run(now, jobId);

  const snapshot = getDurableJobSnapshot(jobId)!;
  executeImportJob(jobId, snapshot, bundles, {
    profileId: command.profile_id,
    targetEpisodeId: command.target_episode_id,
    idempotencyKey: command.idempotency_key || undefined,
    admission: command.admission,
    task_intent: command.task_intent,
    payloadHash: command.payload_hash || command.source_set_identity
  });

  return await awaitDurableImportJob(jobId);
}

/**
 * Compresses a source file to a target destination using Gzip.
 */
async function compressFile(sourcePath: string, destPath: string): Promise<void> {
  const readStream = fs.createReadStream(sourcePath);
  const gzip = zlib.createGzip();
  const writeStream = fs.createWriteStream(destPath);
  await pipeline(readStream, gzip, writeStream);
}

/**
 * Processes a single Polar log file.
 * Copies the file locally first to optimize network read throughput (1 pass instead of 3.5 passes).
 */
export async function ingestFile(adapterOrPath: DataSourceAdapter | string, filename: string): Promise<IngestionResult> {
  let adapter: DataSourceAdapter;
  if (typeof adapterOrPath === 'string') {
    adapter = new LocalPathSourceAdapter(path.dirname(adapterOrPath));
  } else {
    adapter = adapterOrPath;
  }

  // 1. Stable-size check before copying (two stats with 100ms delay)
  try {
    const stat1 = await adapter.statFile(filename);
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    const stat2 = await adapter.statFile(filename);
    
    if (stat1.size !== stat2.size || stat1.mtimeMs !== stat2.mtimeMs) {
      return {
        filename,
        status: 'partial_or_live',
        error: 'File size or modification time is unstable (file is actively being written).'
      };
    }
  } catch (statError: any) {
    return {
      filename,
      status: 'source_io_error',
      error: `Failed to stat source file: ${statError.message}`
    };
  }

  const tempDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'h10-ingest-'));
  const tempFilePath = path.join(tempDir, path.basename(filename));
  let tempCopied = false;

  try {
    // 2. Copy the file from network/local adapter to local temporary folder
    await adapter.downloadFile(filename, tempFilePath);
    tempCopied = true;

    // 3. Calculate file SHA-256 hash locally on SSD
    const sha256_hash = await computeSHA256File(tempFilePath);
    
    // Check if ignored by user
    if (isFingerprintIgnored({ sha256: sha256_hash })) {
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
      return { filename, status: 'ignored_by_user' };
    }

    // Check exact hash deduplication
    if (isSHA256Ingested(sha256_hash)) {
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
      return { filename, status: 'duplicate_exact' };
    }

    // 4. Extract logical fingerprint and metadata locally on SSD
    let fingerprint;
    try {
      fingerprint = await extractFingerprint(tempFilePath, filename);
    } catch (parseErr: any) {
      // Quarantine corrupted files to AppData corrupted directory
      const corruptDir = getCorruptedLogsDir();
      const corruptDest = path.join(corruptDir, path.basename(filename));
      await fs.promises.copyFile(tempFilePath, corruptDest);
      
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);

      const isHeaderMismatch = parseErr.message && parseErr.message.includes('Header mismatch');
      return { 
        filename, 
        status: isHeaderMismatch ? 'unsupported_schema' : 'corrupted', 
        error: `Quarantined: ${parseErr.message}` 
      };
    }

    // Check if logical fingerprint is ignored by user
    if (isFingerprintIgnored({ logicalFingerprint: fingerprint.logical_fingerprint })) {
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
      return { filename, status: 'ignored_by_user' };
    }

    // Check logical fingerprint deduplication
    if (isFingerprintIngested(fingerprint.logical_fingerprint)) {
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
      return { filename, status: 'duplicate_logical' };
    }

    // 5. Generate record ID
    const fileId = randomUUID();
    
    // 6. Archive file locally using Gzip compression from SSD to AppData (.gz.tmp first)
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    const archiveName = `${fileId}_${fingerprint.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`;
    const archiveDestPath = path.join(rawLogsDir, archiveName);
    const tempArchiveDestPath = `${archiveDestPath}.tmp`;
    
    await compressFile(tempFilePath, tempArchiveDestPath);

    // 7. Commit metadata to SQLite atomically with renaming
    const db = getDb();
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      const metadata = {
        id: fileId,
        filename,
        sha256_hash,
        device_id: fingerprint.device_id,
        signal_type: fingerprint.signal_type,
        start_time: fingerprint.start_time,
        end_time: fingerprint.end_time,
        row_count: fingerprint.row_count,
        logical_fingerprint: fingerprint.logical_fingerprint
      };
      
      saveIngestedFile(metadata);
      
      // Rename temp archive to final name
      await fs.promises.rename(tempArchiveDestPath, archiveDestPath);
      
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (commitError: any) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      // Clean up Gzip files
      if (fs.existsSync(tempArchiveDestPath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(tempArchiveDestPath); } catch {}
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(archiveDestPath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(archiveDestPath); } catch {}
      }
      throw commitError;
    }

    cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
    return {
      filename,
      status: 'imported',
      metadata: {
        id: fileId,
        device_id: fingerprint.device_id,
        signal_type: fingerprint.signal_type,
        row_count: fingerprint.row_count,
        start_time: fingerprint.start_time,
        end_time: fingerprint.end_time
      }
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (tempCopied) {
      cleanupTemp(tempDir, tempFilePath);
    }
    return {
      filename,
      status: 'failed',
      error: `Processing error: ${error.message}`
    };
  }
}

function cleanupTemp(dir: string, file: string) {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(file)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(file);
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.rmdirSync(dir);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Ignore cleanup errors
  }
}

export async function runIngestionPipeline(
  adapterOrDir?: DataSourceAdapter | string,
  onProgress?: (progress: {
    state: 'idle' | 'preflight' | 'listing' | 'copying' | 'processing' | 'failed' | 'completed';
    scanned: number;
    imported: number;
    skipped: number;
    failed: number;
    currentFile?: string;
    details?: any[];
  }) => void,
  checkCancel?: () => boolean
): Promise<IngestionDeltaResult> {
  // Ensure DB is initialized
  initDb();
  
  if (onProgress) {
    onProgress({ state: 'preflight', scanned: 0, imported: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 });
  }

  let adapter: DataSourceAdapter;
  if (!adapterOrDir) {
    adapter = await createActiveSourceAdapter();
  } else if (typeof adapterOrDir === 'string') {
    adapter = new LocalPathSourceAdapter(adapterOrDir);
  } else {
    adapter = adapterOrDir;
  }

  const preflightRes = await adapter.preflight();
  if (!preflightRes.success) {
    throw new Error(`Проверка источника не удалась: ${preflightRes.error}`);
  }

  if (onProgress) {
    onProgress({ state: 'listing', scanned: 0, imported: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 });
  }

  const fileEntries = await adapter.listFiles();
  const files = fileEntries
    .map(e => e.filename)
    .filter(fn => fn.endsWith('.txt'));

  const results: IngestionResult[] = [];
  
  let imported = 0;
  let alreadyImportedExact = 0;
  let alreadyImportedLogical = 0;
  let ignoredByUser = 0;
  let partialOrLive = 0;
  let unsupportedSchema = 0;
  let sourceIoError = 0;
  let failedCount = 0;

  const details: IngestionDeltaResult['details'] = [];
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  for (const filename of files) {
    if (checkCancel && checkCancel()) {
      throw new Error('Синхронизация отменена пользователем');
    }

    if (onProgress) {
      onProgress({
        state: 'copying',
        scanned: results.length,
        imported,
        skipped: alreadyImportedExact + alreadyImportedLogical + ignoredByUser,
        failed: failedCount + partialOrLive + unsupportedSchema + sourceIoError,
        currentFile: filename,
        details: [...details]
      });
    }

    const res = await ingestFile(adapter, filename);
    
    let mappedStatus: IngestionDeltaResult['details'][0]['status'] = 'failed';
    let reason = res.error || '';
    
    if (res.status === 'imported') {
      imported++;
      mappedStatus = 'imported';
      reason = 'Successfully imported';
      logger.info('parser', `Imported file: ${filename}`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name });
    } else if (res.status === 'duplicate_exact') {
      alreadyImportedExact++;
      mappedStatus = 'already_imported_exact';
      reason = 'Exact duplicate already ingested';
      logger.info('parser', `Skipped file ${filename}: Exact duplicate already ingested`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name });
    } else if (res.status === 'duplicate_logical') {
      alreadyImportedLogical++;
      mappedStatus = 'already_imported_logical';
      reason = 'Logical fingerprint already ingested';
      logger.info('parser', `Skipped file ${filename}: Logical fingerprint already ingested`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name });
    } else if (res.status === 'ignored_by_user') {
      ignoredByUser++;
      mappedStatus = 'ignored_by_user';
      reason = 'Ignored by user settings';
      logger.info('parser', `Skipped file ${filename}: Ignored by user settings`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name });
    } else if (res.status === 'partial_or_live') {
      partialOrLive++;
      mappedStatus = 'partial_or_live';
      reason = 'File is actively being written';
      logger.warn('parser', `Skipped partial/live file: ${filename}`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name });
    } else if (res.status === 'unsupported_schema') {
      unsupportedSchema++;
      mappedStatus = 'unsupported_schema';
      reason = 'Unsupported schema/format';
      logger.error('parser', `Failed to ingest file ${filename}: Unsupported schema/format`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name, details: { error: res.error } });
    } else if (res.status === 'source_io_error') {
      sourceIoError++;
      mappedStatus = 'source_io_error';
      reason = 'Source read I/O error';
      logger.error('parser', `Failed to ingest file ${filename}: Source read I/O error`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name, details: { error: res.error } });
    } else {
      failedCount++;
      mappedStatus = 'failed';
      reason = res.error || 'Failed ingestion';
      logger.error('parser', `Failed to ingest file ${filename}: ${reason}`, { sourceId: adapter.constructor.name, details: { error: res.error } });
    }
    
    // Guess signal type from filename
    let signalType: 'HR' | 'RR' | 'ECG' | 'ACC' | undefined;
    const lowerFn = filename.toLowerCase();
    if (lowerFn.includes('hr')) signalType = 'HR';
    else if (lowerFn.includes('rr')) signalType = 'RR';
    else if (lowerFn.includes('ecg')) signalType = 'ECG';
    else if (lowerFn.includes('acc')) signalType = 'ACC';

    details.push({
      filename,
      signalType,
      status: mappedStatus,
      reason,
      logicalFingerprint: undefined,
      sha256: undefined,
      lastSeenAt: now
    });

    results.push(res);
  }

  if (onProgress) {
    onProgress({
      state: 'completed',
      scanned: files.length,
      imported,
      skipped: alreadyImportedExact + alreadyImportedLogical + ignoredByUser,
      failed: failedCount + partialOrLive + unsupportedSchema + sourceIoError,
      details: [...details]
    });
  }

  return {
    // Backward compatibility
    scanned: files.length,
    ingested: imported,
    skipped: alreadyImportedExact + alreadyImportedLogical + ignoredByUser,
    failed: failedCount + partialOrLive + unsupportedSchema + sourceIoError,
    results,

    // New fields
    totalScanned: files.length,
    newCandidates: imported,
    imported,
    alreadyImportedExact,
    alreadyImportedLogical,
    ignoredByUser,
    partialOrLive,
    unsupportedSchema,
    sourceIoError,
    details
  };
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * Scans the target directory recursively (up to depth 3) for files matching the Polar H10 naming convention.
 * Returns an array of relative file paths.
 * Throws an error if the root directory is inaccessible.
 */
export async function scanLogsDirectory(dirPath: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const result: string[] = [];
  const regex = /^Polar_H10_[A-Za-z0-9]+_\d{8}_\d{6}_(HR|RR|ECG|ACC)\.txt$/;

  // Access check on root dir
  try {
    await fs.promises.access(dirPath, fs.constants.R_OK);
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error.code === 'ENOENT') {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Directory does not exist: ${dirPath}`);
    }
    if (error.code === 'EACCES' || error.code === 'EPERM') {
      throw new Error(`PERMISSION_DENIED: Cannot read directory: ${dirPath}`);
    }
    throw new Error(`SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Failed to read directory ${dirPath}. Error: ${error.message}`);
  }

  async function walk(currentPath: string, depth: number) {
    if (depth > 3) return;

    let entries: fs.Dirent[];
    try {
      entries = await fs.promises.readdir(currentPath, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore subfolder read errors to be robust
      return;
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      const fullPath = path.join(currentPath, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        await walk(fullPath, depth + 1);
      } else if (entry.isFile()) {
        if (regex.test(entry.name)) {
          const relPath = path.relative(dirPath, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
          result.push(relPath);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  await walk(dirPath, 0);
  return result;
}

import * as path from 'path';
import { runIngestionPipeline } from './ingestion/processor';
import { redactDeviceId } from './logging/logRedaction';

export function sanitizeFilename(filename: string): string {
  // Redact H10 device ID if matched (8-digit hex sequence, e.g. 130EAD38)
  const hex8Regex = /\b[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}(?=_|\b|$)/g;
  return filename.replace(hex8Regex, (match) => redactDeviceId(match));
}

async function main() {
  const sourceDir = 'Z:\\Polar Logs';
  
  console.log(`Starting H10 Athlete Cardio Lab Ingestion...`);
  console.log(`Source Folder: <redacted path>\\${path.basename(sourceDir)}`);
  console.log(`Local Database Path: <redacted path>\\cardio_lab.db`);
  console.log(`==================================================`);

  try {
    const summary = await runIngestionPipeline(sourceDir);
    
    console.log(`Ingestion Finished!`);
    console.log(`--------------------------------------------------`);
    console.log(`Total Scanned: ${summary.scanned}`);
    console.log(`Total Ingested: ${summary.ingested}`);
    console.log(`Total Skipped (Duplicates): ${summary.skipped}`);
    console.log(`Total Failed: ${summary.failed}`);
    console.log(`--------------------------------------------------`);
    
    // Print out details of any failures or successful ingestions
    const failed = summary.results.filter(r => r.status === 'failed' || r.status === 'corrupted' || r.status === 'unsupported_schema' || r.status === 'source_io_error');
    if (failed.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\nFailed / Corrupted Files:`);
      failed.forEach(f => console.log(` - ${sanitizeFilename(f.filename)}: ${f.error ? String(f.error) : 'Unknown error'}`));
    }
    
    const ingestedList = summary.results.filter(r => r.status === 'imported');
    if (ingestedList.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\nSample Ingested Files:`);
      ingestedList.slice(0, 5).forEach(f => {
        console.log(` - ${sanitizeFilename(f.filename)} (${f.metadata?.signal_type}, ${f.metadata?.row_count} rows, start: ${f.metadata?.start_time})`);
      });
      if (ingestedList.length > 5) {
        console.log(` ... and ${ingestedList.length - 5} more files.`);
      }
    }
    
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`Pipeline execution failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
  }
}

if (typeof require !== 'undefined' && require.main === module) {
  main();
}

export class AthleteJourneyService {
  /**
   * Retrieves existing persisted selection or initializes clean initial selection state.
   */
  public static getOrInitSelection(profileId: string, isAggregateReadOnly = false): AthleteJourneySelectionState {
    const existing = getAthleteJourneySelection(profileId);
    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }
    const initial = createInitialSelectionState(profileId, isAggregateReadOnly || profileId === 'all');
    saveAthleteJourneySelection(initial);
    return initial;
  }

  /**
   * Resolves complete, authoritative AthleteCoreJourneyContext from persisted database truth.
   */
  public static async resolveJourneyContext(
    profileId: string | null,
    selectionOverride?: Partial<AthleteJourneySelectionState>
  ): Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext> {
    if (!profileId || profileId === 'unresolved') {
      return createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
    }

    const isAggregate = profileId === 'all';
    let profile = !isAggregate ? getUserProfile(profileId) : null;

    if (!profile && !isAggregate) {
      const allProfiles = getUserProfiles();
      if (allProfiles.length === 0) {
        return createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
      }
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Profile '${profileId}' not found`, 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND');
    }

    const currentSelection = getAthleteJourneySelection(profileId) || createInitialSelectionState(profileId, isAggregate);
    const activeSelection: AthleteJourneySelectionState = {
      ...currentSelection,
      ...selectionOverride
    };

    const ctx = createAthleteJourneyContext(profileId, {
      displayName: profile?.display_name || (isAggregate ? 'Все атлеты' : profileId),
      exportAlias: profile?.export_alias || (isAggregate ? 'all_athletes' : profileId),
      isSynthetic: Boolean(profile?.relationship_label === 'sample' || profile?.export_alias?.includes('synthetic')),
      isAggregateReadOnly: isAggregate || activeSelection.is_aggregate_read_only
    });

    // Propagate revision and monotonic generation
    ctx.context_generation = activeSelection.context_generation;
    ctx.comparison.mode = activeSelection.comparison_mode;
    ctx.comparison.target_session_id = activeSelection.compare_target_session_id || activeSelection.selected_session_id || null;
    ctx.comparison.peer_session_id = activeSelection.compare_peer_session_id;
    ctx.comparison.saved_view_id = activeSelection.selected_saved_view_id;
    ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in = { ...activeSelection.sensitive_opt_in };
    ctx.exact_next_safe_action = activeSelection.exact_next_safe_action;

    const sessionId = activeSelection.selected_session_id;
    if (sessionId) {
      const sessRecord = getSession(sessionId);
      if (!sessRecord) {
        // Selection invalidated: session was removed or unavailable
        ctx.session.session_id = sessionId;
        ctx.session.currentness = 'unavailable';
        ctx.session.currentness_reason = `Selected session '${sessionId}' is no longer available in database`;
        ctx.exact_next_safe_action = 'nav:sessions';
        return validateAthleteJourneyContext(ctx);
      }

      // Cross-profile fail-closed guard
      if (!isAggregate && sessRecord.user_id && sessRecord.user_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
          `Cross-profile journey violation: session '${sessionId}' belongs to '${sessRecord.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
        );
      }

      ctx.session.session_id = sessionId;
      ctx.session.start_time_utc = sessRecord.start_time;
      ctx.session.duration_seconds = sessRecord.duration_seconds;
      ctx.session.is_synthetic = Boolean(
        (sessRecord as any).is_sample === 1 ||
        (sessRecord as any).is_sample ||
        sessRecord.device_id?.includes('Демонстрационная') ||
        sessRecord.device_id?.toLowerCase().includes('synthetic') ||
        sessRecord.id?.includes('synthetic') ||
        sessRecord.id?.includes('sample')
      );
      if (ctx.session.is_synthetic) {
        ctx.profile.is_synthetic = true;
      }

      ctx.session.currentness = 'unavailable';
      ctx.session.currentness_reason = 'Canonical result hash missing or result unverified';

      try {
        const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, false);
        if (canonical) {
          const resHash = canonical.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash || null;
          const hasAnySignal = Boolean(
            canonical.signal_availability?.has_rr ||
            canonical.signal_availability?.has_hr ||
            canonical.signal_availability?.has_ecg ||
            canonical.signal_availability?.has_acc
          );
          const isVerified = Boolean(resHash && hasAnySignal);

          ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score = canonical.quality_summary?.legacy_overall_quality_score ?? null;
          const norm = normalizeQualityScore(ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score);
          ctx.quality_metrics.normalized_quality_percent = norm.numericPercent;

          if (!isVerified) {
            ctx.session.result_hash = null;
            ctx.session.ledger_hash = null;
            ctx.session.currentness = 'unavailable';
            ctx.session.currentness_reason = 'Canonical result hash missing or result unverified';
            ctx.quality_metrics.metrics = {};
          } else {
            ctx.session.result_hash = resHash;
            ctx.session.ledger_hash = canonical.canonical_result_identity?.beat_ledger_hash || null;
            ctx.session.currentness = 'current';
            ctx.session.currentness_reason = null;

            // Map canonical metrics with user-facing truth (withheld is NEVER zero, no raw session-row fallbacks)
            const evaluatedMetrics: Record<string, JourneyMetricItem> = {};
            const rawMetrics: Record<string, number | null> = {
              avg_hr: canonical.core_metrics?.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? null,
              mean_hr: canonical.core_metrics?.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? null,
              min_hr: null,
              max_hr: null,
              mean_rr: canonical.core_metrics?.mean_rr_ms?.value ?? null,
              rmssd: canonical.core_metrics?.rmssd?.value ?? null,
              sdnn: canonical.core_metrics?.sdnn?.value ?? null,
              pnn50: canonical.core_metrics?.pnn50?.value ?? null,
              overall_quality_score: ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score
            };

            for (const [mKey, mVal] of Object.entries(rawMetrics)) {
              const elig = canonical.task_eligibility?.[mKey] || null;
              const evalResult = evaluateUserFacingMetric(mKey, mVal, elig, 'ru');
              evaluatedMetrics[mKey] = {
                metric_key: mKey,
                value: evalResult.isEligible ? (mVal !== null && !isNaN(mVal) ? mVal : null) : null,
                unit: evalResult.unit,
                is_eligible: evalResult.isEligible,
                eligibility_state: evalResult.eligibilityState,
                withholding_reason: evalResult.blockingReasons.length > 0 ? evalResult.blockingReasons[0] : (evalResult.isEligible ? null : 'Недостаточно данных'),
                is_primary_kpi: USER_FACING_METRICS[mKey]?.isPrimaryKpi ?? false
              };
            }
            ctx.quality_metrics.metrics = evaluatedMetrics;

            if (canonical.canonical_beat_ledger) {
              ctx.quality_metrics.rr_continuity = {
                has_gaps: (canonical.quality_summary?.max_consecutive_gap_seconds ?? 0) > 2,
                continuous_duration_seconds: (sessRecord as any).duration_seconds || 0,
                accepted_clean_nn_count: canonical.quality_summary?.accepted_nn_beats ?? 0
              };
            }
          }
        } else {
          ctx.session.currentness = 'unavailable';
          ctx.session.currentness_reason = 'Canonical session analysis unavailable or unverified';
          ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score = null;
          ctx.quality_metrics.normalized_quality_percent = null;
          ctx.quality_metrics.metrics = {};
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        ctx.session.currentness = 'unavailable';
        ctx.session.currentness_reason = err.message || 'Canonical session analysis unavailable';
        ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score = null;
        ctx.quality_metrics.normalized_quality_percent = null;
        ctx.quality_metrics.metrics = {};
      }

      // Annotations
      const annotation = getSessionAnnotation(sessionId);
      if (annotation) {
        ctx.activity.activity_type = annotation.activity_type;
        ctx.activity.activity_label_custom = annotation.activity_label_custom || null;
        ctx.activity.perceived_effort = annotation.perceived_effort || null;
        ctx.activity.sleep_quality_subjective = annotation.sleep_quality_subjective || null;
        ctx.activity.user_notes = annotation.user_notes || null;
      }

      // Named Windows: respect selected window root/revision if set, NEVER fallback to latest window
      if (activeSelection.selected_window_root_id) {
        const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(sessionId);
        if (windows && windows.length > 0) {
          const matched = windows.find(
            w => (w.root_window_id === activeSelection.selected_window_root_id || w.id === activeSelection.selected_window_root_id) &&
                 (activeSelection.selected_window_revision === null || w.revision === activeSelection.selected_window_revision)
          );
          if (matched) {
            const winMetrics = matched.metrics_json ? JSON.parse(matched.metrics_json) : null;
            ctx.window = {
              active_window_id: matched.id,
              active_window_revision: matched.revision,
              window_root_id: matched.root_window_id || matched.id,
              window_metrics: winMetrics
            };
          } else {
            ctx.window = null;
          }
        } else {
          ctx.window = null;
        }
      } else {
        ctx.window = null;
      }

      // Comparison Evaluation
      const mode = activeSelection.comparison_mode;
      const peerId = activeSelection.compare_peer_session_id;

      if (mode === 'explicit_ab' && peerId) {
        const peerRecord = getSession(peerId);
        if (peerRecord) {
          if (!isAggregate && peerRecord.user_id && peerRecord.user_id !== profileId) {
            throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
              `Cross-profile peer comparison violation: peer '${peerId}' belongs to '${peerRecord.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
            );
          }
          const compat = evaluateCompareCompatibility(
            { id: sessionId, activity_type: ctx.activity.activity_type },
            { id: peerId, activity_type: (peerRecord as any).activity_type }
          );
          ctx.comparison.comparison_compatibility = compat.level;

          let comparisonResult: any = null;
          try {
            comparisonResult = await CanonicalComparisonService.computeComparison({
              targetSessionId: sessionId,
              peerSessionId: peerId,
              mode: 'peer',
              userId: profileId
            });
          } catch (_) {}

          let peerCanonical: any = null;
          try {
            peerCanonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(peerId, false);
          } catch (_) {}

          const peerHash = peerCanonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash;
          const peerHasSignal = Boolean(
            peerCanonical?.signal_availability?.has_rr ||
            peerCanonical?.signal_availability?.has_hr ||
            peerCanonical?.signal_availability?.has_ecg ||
            peerCanonical?.signal_availability?.has_acc
          );
          const isPeerVerified = Boolean(peerHash && peerHasSignal);

          for (const mKey of Object.keys(ctx.quality_metrics.metrics)) {
            const targetMet = ctx.quality_metrics.metrics[mKey];
            const peerElig = isPeerVerified ? peerCanonical?.task_eligibility?.[mKey] : null;
            const peerVal = isPeerVerified ? (peerCanonical?.core_metrics?.[mKey]?.value ?? null) : null;
            const peerEval = isPeerVerified ? evaluateUserFacingMetric(mKey, peerVal, peerElig, 'ru') : null;
            const targetEligible = targetMet?.is_eligible ?? false;
            const peerEligible = peerEval?.isEligible ?? false;
            ctx.comparison.metric_readiness[mKey] = targetEligible && peerEligible && compat.canCompare;
          }
        }
      } else if (mode === 'personal_baseline') {
        try {
          const { observations } = await LongitudinalService.selectObservations({
            profile_id: profileId,
            target_session_id: sessionId,
            activity_type: ctx.activity.activity_type || undefined,
            metric_set: ['rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50', 'avg_hr', 'mean_rr']
          });

          const eligiblePeers = observations.filter(
            obs => obs.session_id !== sessionId && !obs.is_duplicate_source && obs.lineage_state === 'current'
          );
          const baselineStatus = evaluateBaselineEligibility(eligiblePeers.length);
          ctx.comparison.baseline_status = baselineStatus;

          for (const mKey of Object.keys(ctx.quality_metrics.metrics)) {
            const metricBaseline = LongitudinalService.computeMetricBaseline(mKey, observations, sessionId);
            const targetEligible = ctx.quality_metrics.metrics[mKey]?.is_eligible ?? false;
            ctx.comparison.metric_readiness[mKey] = metricBaseline.is_ready && targetEligible;
          }
        } catch (_) {
          ctx.comparison.baseline_status = evaluateBaselineEligibility(0);
          for (const mKey of Object.keys(ctx.quality_metrics.metrics)) {
            ctx.comparison.metric_readiness[mKey] = false;
          }
        }
      }

      // Episode & Useful Outcome
      const usefulConfirmation = getUsefulConfirmation(sessionId);
      if (usefulConfirmation) {
        ctx.episode_outcome.useful_outcome_confirmed = true;
        ctx.episode_outcome.local_outcome_id = usefulConfirmation.confirmation_id;
      }

      // Export Pack & Diary Lineage: exact authority, no silent first-row fallback
      if (activeSelection.selected_pack_id) {
        let pack: any = getLlmPack(activeSelection.selected_pack_id);
        if (!pack) {
          try {
            const manifestRow = getDb().prepare('SELECT manifest_id as id, session_id FROM export_artifact_manifests WHERE manifest_id = ? OR job_id = ?').get(activeSelection.selected_pack_id, activeSelection.selected_pack_id) as any;
            if (manifestRow) {
              pack = manifestRow;
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (pack && pack.session_id === sessionId) {
          ctx.export_diary.active_pack_id = pack.id;
        } else {
          ctx.export_diary.active_pack_id = null;
        }
      } else {
