        ctx.export_diary.active_pack_id = null;
      }

      if (activeSelection.selected_diary_id) {
        const diaries = getLlmDiaries({ sessionId: sessionId });
        const matched = diaries.find(d => d.id === activeSelection.selected_diary_id);
        if (matched) {
          ctx.export_diary.active_diary_id = matched.id;
          ctx.export_diary.diary_text = matched.response_md || matched.response_text_plain;
          const currentPackId = ctx.export_diary.active_pack_id;
          ctx.export_diary.diary_lineage_currentness = (currentPackId && matched.pack_id === currentPackId) ? 'current' : 'historical';
        } else {
          ctx.export_diary.active_diary_id = null;
          ctx.export_diary.diary_text = null;
          ctx.export_diary.diary_lineage_currentness = 'unavailable';
        }
      } else {
        ctx.export_diary.active_diary_id = null;
        ctx.export_diary.diary_text = null;
        ctx.export_diary.diary_lineage_currentness = 'unavailable';
      }

      ctx.exact_next_safe_action = 'nav:session';
    }

    return validateAthleteJourneyContext(ctx);
  }

  /**
   * Executes a safe, runtime-validated journey command atomically, persisting the updated selection state
   * and returning the freshly resolved authoritative AthleteCoreJourneyContext.
   */
  public static async executeJourneyCommand(
    envelopeRaw: unknown
  ): Promise<{ selection: AthleteJourneySelectionState; context: AthleteCoreJourneyContext }> {
    // 1. Runtime validation & forbidden derived fields rejection
    const envelope = validateAthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope(envelopeRaw);
    const { profile_id, expected_revision, idempotency_key, command } = envelope;

    const isAggregate = profile_id === 'all';
    if (!isAggregate && profile_id !== 'unresolved') {
      const profile = getUserProfile(profile_id);
      if (!profile) {
        throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Profile '${profile_id}' not found`, 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND');
      }
    }

    const currentCommandHash = computeCommandPayloadHash(profile_id, expected_revision, command);

    // 2. Durable Idempotency Check across intervening commands
    const existingIdemp = getJourneyIdempotencyRecord(profile_id, idempotency_key);
    if (existingIdemp) {
      if (existingIdemp.command_hash === currentCommandHash) {
        return {
          selection: JSON.parse(existingIdemp.result_selection_json),
          context: JSON.parse(existingIdemp.result_context_json)
        };
      }
      throw new JourneyCommandConflictError(
        `Idempotency key '${idempotency_key}' reused with a different command payload`,
        'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    // 3. Fetch current persisted selection state
    const current = getAthleteJourneySelection(profile_id);

    // 4. Initial selection bootstrap vs subsequent mutation check
    if (!current) {
      if (command.command_type !== 'select_profile') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
          'Initial workspace requires an explicit select_profile bootstrap command',
          'BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED'
        );
      }
      if (expected_revision !== null && expected_revision !== 1) {
        throw new JourneyCommandConflictError(
          `Initial selection bootstrap requires expected_revision null or 1, found ${expected_revision}`,
          'REVISION_CONFLICT'
        );
      }

      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      const initial = createInitialSelectionState(profile_id, Boolean(command.is_aggregate_read_only || profile_id === 'all'));
      initial.selection_revision = 2;
      initial.context_generation = 2;
      initial.last_idempotency_key = idempotency_key;
      initial.last_command_type = command.command_type;
      initial.last_command_hash = currentCommandHash;
      initial.selection_fingerprint = computeSelectionFingerprint(initial);
      initial.updated_at_utc = now;

      // Preflight context
      const resolvedContext = await this.resolveJourneyContext(profile_id, initial);

      // Commit initial selection & idempotency record atomically
      const atomicSuccess = commitAthleteJourneySelectionAndIdempotencyAtomic(
        null,
        initial,
        {
          profile_id,
          idempotency_key,
          command_hash: currentCommandHash,
          committed_revision: initial.selection_revision,
          command_type: command.command_type,
          result_selection_json: JSON.stringify(initial),
          result_context_json: JSON.stringify(resolvedContext),
          created_at_utc: now
        }
      );
      if (!atomicSuccess) {
        throw new JourneyCommandConflictError(
          `Bootstrap conflict during atomic persistence for profile '${profile_id}'`,
          'BOOTSTRAP_CONFLICT'
        );
      }

      return {
        selection: initial,
        context: resolvedContext
      };
    }

    // Selection already exists: mutations require non-null expected_revision
    if (expected_revision === null) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
        'Mutations to existing workspace selection require a non-null expected_revision',
        'REVISION_REQUIRED'
      );
    }

    // Optimistic concurrency check
    if (expected_revision !== current.selection_revision) {
      throw new JourneyCommandConflictError(
        `Selection revision mismatch: expected ${expected_revision}, current is ${current.selection_revision}`,
        'REVISION_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    // Aggregate read-only protection: cannot mutate sessions or exports in aggregate mode
    if (current.is_aggregate_read_only && command.command_type !== 'select_profile' && command.command_type !== 'resume_last_valid_selection') {
      throw new ReadOnlyMutationError('Cannot mutate selection in aggregate read-only mode');
    }

    // Apply command to derive next selection state
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    let deferredTxAction: (() => void) | undefined = undefined;
    const next: AthleteJourneySelectionState = {
      ...current,
      selection_revision: current.selection_revision + 1,
      context_generation: current.context_generation + 1,
      last_idempotency_key: idempotency_key,
      last_command_type: command.command_type,
      last_command_hash: currentCommandHash,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    switch (command.command_type) {

      case 'select_profile': {
        next.profile_id = command.profile_id;
        next.is_aggregate_read_only = Boolean(command.is_aggregate_read_only || command.profile_id === 'all');
        // If changing profile, atomically clear incompatible session and dependent pointers
        if (command.profile_id !== current.profile_id) {
          next.selected_session_id = null;
          next.comparison_mode = 'none';
          next.compare_target_session_id = null;
          next.compare_peer_session_id = null;
          next.selected_window_root_id = null;
          next.selected_window_revision = null;
          next.selected_saved_view_id = null;
          next.selected_snapshot_id = null;
          next.selected_preview_fingerprint = null;
          next.selected_pack_id = null;
          next.selected_diary_id = null;
          next.last_route_view = 'sessions';
          next.exact_next_safe_action = 'nav:sessions';
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'open_session': {
        const sid = command.session_id;
        if (sid === null) {
          next.selected_session_id = null;
          next.compare_target_session_id = null;
          next.compare_peer_session_id = null;
          next.selected_window_root_id = null;
          next.selected_window_revision = null;
          next.selected_pack_id = null;
          next.selected_diary_id = null;
          next.last_route_view = 'sessions';
          next.exact_next_safe_action = 'nav:sessions';
        } else {
          const sess = getSession(sid);
          if (!sess) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Session '${sid}' not found`, 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND');
          }
          if (!isAggregate && sess.user_id && sess.user_id !== profile_id) {
            throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
              `Cross-profile session selection forbidden: session '${sid}' belongs to '${sess.user_id}', requested under '${profile_id}'`
            );
          }
          next.selected_session_id = sid;
          next.compare_target_session_id = sid;
          next.last_route_view = 'session';
          next.last_route_id = sid;
          next.exact_next_safe_action = 'nav:session';
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'set_comparison': {
        next.comparison_mode = command.mode;
        if (command.target_session_id !== undefined) {
          next.compare_target_session_id = command.target_session_id;
        } else if (!next.compare_target_session_id && next.selected_session_id) {
          next.compare_target_session_id = next.selected_session_id;
        }
        if (command.peer_session_id !== undefined) {
          if (command.peer_session_id) {
            const peer = getSession(command.peer_session_id);
            if (!peer) {
              throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Peer session '${command.peer_session_id}' not found`, 'PEER_NOT_FOUND');
            }
            if (!isAggregate && peer.user_id && peer.user_id !== profile_id) {
              throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
                `Cross-profile peer comparison forbidden: peer '${command.peer_session_id}' belongs to '${peer.user_id}', requested under '${profile_id}'`
              );
            }
          }
          next.compare_peer_session_id = command.peer_session_id;
        }
        next.last_route_view = 'compare';
        break;
      }

      case 'select_window_revision': {
        next.selected_window_root_id = command.window_root_id;
        next.selected_window_revision = command.window_revision;
        break;
      }

      case 'select_longitudinal_view': {
        if (command.saved_view_id !== undefined) {
          next.selected_saved_view_id = command.saved_view_id;
        }
        if (command.snapshot_id !== undefined) {
          next.selected_snapshot_id = command.snapshot_id;
        }
        next.last_route_view = 'trends';
        break;
      }

      case 'set_export_projection': {
        if (command.export_projection !== undefined) {
          next.export_projection = command.export_projection;
        }
        if (command.sensitive_opt_in) {
          next.sensitive_opt_in = {
            ...next.sensitive_opt_in,
            ...command.sensitive_opt_in
          };
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'bind_pack_or_diary': {
        if (command.pack_id !== undefined) {
          next.selected_pack_id = command.pack_id;
        }
        if (command.diary_id !== undefined) {
          next.selected_diary_id = command.diary_id;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'clear_dependent_selection': {
        const fields = command.fields || ['session', 'comparison', 'window', 'longitudinal', 'export_diary'];
        if (fields.includes('session')) {
          next.selected_session_id = null;
        }
        if (fields.includes('comparison')) {
          next.comparison_mode = 'none';
          next.compare_target_session_id = null;
          next.compare_peer_session_id = null;
        }
        if (fields.includes('window')) {
          next.selected_window_root_id = null;
          next.selected_window_revision = null;
        }
        if (fields.includes('longitudinal')) {
          next.selected_saved_view_id = null;
          next.selected_snapshot_id = null;
        }
        if (fields.includes('export_diary')) {
          next.selected_preview_fingerprint = null;
          next.selected_pack_id = null;
          next.selected_diary_id = null;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'resume_last_valid_selection': {
        // If the selected session is no longer valid, gracefully clear it
        if (next.selected_session_id) {
          const sess = getSession(next.selected_session_id);
          if (!sess) {
            next.selected_session_id = null;
            next.compare_target_session_id = null;
            next.compare_peer_session_id = null;
          }
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'set_pilot_context': {
        if (command.context_type === 'whole_recording') {
          next.selected_window_root_id = null;
          next.selected_window_revision = null;
        } else if (command.context_type === 'named_window') {
          if (!next.selected_session_id) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              '[SESSION_REQUIRED] Named window context selection requires an active selected session',
              'SESSION_REQUIRED'
            );
          }
          if (!command.window_root_id) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              'window_root_id is required when context_type is named_window',
              'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND'
            );
          }
          if (command.window_revision === null || command.window_revision === undefined || typeof command.window_revision !== 'number') {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              '[WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED] window_revision is required and must be an explicit number when context_type is named_window',
              'WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED'
            );
          }

          // Centralized authoritative context check (G53-WINDOW-005)
          const authContext = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext({
            sessionId: next.selected_session_id,
            profileId: profile_id,
            contextType: 'named_window',
            windowRootId: command.window_root_id,
            windowRevision: command.window_revision
          });

          next.selected_window_revision = authContext.window_revision;
          next.selected_window_root_id = command.window_root_id;
        }
        next.selected_preview_fingerprint = null;
        next.last_route_view = 'session';
        break;
      }

      case 'confirm_pilot_outcome': {
        if (!next.selected_session_id && command.episode_id) {
          const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(command.episode_id);
          if (ep && ep.canonical_session_id) {
            next.selected_session_id = ep.canonical_session_id;
          }
        }
        if (!next.selected_session_id) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('[SESSION_REQUIRED] Cannot confirm pilot outcome without a selected session', 'SESSION_REQUIRED');
        }
        const sess = getSession(next.selected_session_id);
        if (!sess) {
          throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Session '${next.selected_session_id}' not found`, 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND');
        }
        if (sess.user_id && profile_id && profile_id !== 'all' && sess.user_id !== profile_id) {
          throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
            `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Session '${next.selected_session_id}' belongs to profile '${sess.user_id}', requested under '${profile_id}'`
          );
        }
        if (!command.episode_id) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            '[EPISODE_REQUIRED] Cannot confirm pilot outcome without an active episode_id',
            'EPISODE_REQUIRED'
          );
        }
        const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(command.episode_id);
        if (!ep) {
          throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Episode '${command.episode_id}' not found`, 'EPISODE_NOT_FOUND');
        }
        if (ep.profile_id && profile_id && profile_id !== 'all' && ep.profile_id !== profile_id) {
          throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
            `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Episode '${command.episode_id}' belongs to profile '${ep.profile_id}', requested under '${profile_id}'`
          );
        }

        const db = getDb();
        const row = db.prepare(`
          SELECT manifest_id, published_path, staging_path, size_bytes, sha256, status, canonical_result_hash, sensitive_opt_ins_json,
                 profile_id, episode_id, context_type, window_root_id, window_revision, window_result_identity, beat_ledger_hash, dependency_fingerprint, export_preset_version
          FROM export_artifact_manifests
          WHERE manifest_id = ? AND session_id = ?
        `).get(command.artifact_id, next.selected_session_id) as any;

        if (!row) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[ARTIFACT_REQUIRED] Cannot confirm pilot outcome before a primary artifact exists (artifact '${command.artifact_id}' not found for session '${next.selected_session_id}')`,
            'ARTIFACT_REQUIRED'
          );
        }

        if (row.status !== 'completed') {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[ARTIFACT_NOT_COMPLETED] Manifest '${command.artifact_id}' status is '${row.status}', expected 'completed'`,
            'ARTIFACT_NOT_COMPLETED'
          );
        }

        // Verify artifact context exactly matches current journey context (G44-AUTH-010, G44-AUTH-011, G45-CUTOVER-008, G50-COMP-009, G52-LINEAGE-008)
        let opts: any = {};
        try { opts = JSON.parse(row.sensitive_opt_ins_json || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
        const manifestContextType = (opts.context_type !== undefined ? opts.context_type : row.context_type) || 'whole_recording';
        const isNamedWindow = Boolean(next.selected_window_root_id);

        const manifestProfile = (opts.profile_id !== undefined ? opts.profile_id : row.profile_id);

        if (!manifestProfile || (profile_id !== 'all' && manifestProfile !== profile_id)) {
          throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
            `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Artifact profile '${manifestProfile}' does not match active profile '${profile_id}'`
          );
        }

        const currentContextType: PilotContextType = isNamedWindow ? 'named_window' : 'whole_recording';
        const currentProjection = await AthleteJourneyService.resolvePilotProjection(profile_id);
        const currentDependencyFingerprint = currentProjection.dependency_fingerprint;

        const manifestEpId = (opts.episode_id !== undefined ? opts.episode_id : row.episode_id);
        if (!manifestEpId || manifestEpId !== command.episode_id) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[STALE_ARTIFACT] Cannot confirm outcome: artifact episode '${manifestEpId || 'missing'}' does not match active episode '${command.episode_id}'`,
            'ARTIFACT_STALE'
          );
        }

        const manifestDepFp = (opts.dependency_fingerprint !== undefined ? opts.dependency_fingerprint : row.dependency_fingerprint);
        if (!manifestDepFp || manifestDepFp !== currentDependencyFingerprint) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[STALE_ARTIFACT] Cannot confirm outcome: artifact dependency fingerprint '${manifestDepFp || 'missing'}' does not match current dependency fingerprint '${currentDependencyFingerprint}'`,
            'ARTIFACT_STALE'
          );
        }

        if (isNamedWindow) {
          if (next.selected_window_revision === null || next.selected_window_revision === undefined || typeof next.selected_window_revision !== 'number') {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              `[WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED] Cannot confirm outcome: named window context requires an explicit non-null window revision`,
              'WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED'
            );
          }
          if (
            manifestContextType !== 'named_window' ||
            opts.window_id !== next.selected_window_root_id ||
            opts.window_revision === null ||
            opts.window_revision === undefined ||
            opts.window_revision !== next.selected_window_revision
          ) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              `[STALE_ARTIFACT] Cannot confirm outcome: artifact context does not match current selection (current: named_window ${next.selected_window_root_id} rev ${next.selected_window_revision}, artifact: ${manifestContextType} rev ${opts.window_revision})`,
              'ARTIFACT_STALE'
            );
          }
        } else {
          if (manifestContextType !== 'whole_recording') {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              `[STALE_ARTIFACT] Cannot confirm outcome: artifact context does not match current selection (current: whole_recording, artifact: ${manifestContextType})`,
              'ARTIFACT_STALE'
            );
          }
        }

        let currentResultHash: string | null = null;
        if (isNamedWindow) {
          const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(next.selected_session_id);
          const matched = windows.find(
            w => (w.root_window_id === next.selected_window_root_id || w.id === next.selected_window_root_id) &&
                 w.revision === next.selected_window_revision
          );
          if (!matched) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
              `[WINDOW_NOT_FOUND] Named window '${next.selected_window_root_id}' rev ${next.selected_window_revision} not found during outcome confirmation`,
              'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND'
            );
          }
          let winMetrics: any = null;
          try { winMetrics = matched?.metrics_json ? JSON.parse(matched.metrics_json) : null; } catch (_) {}
          currentResultHash = winMetrics?.resultIdentity || matched?.result_identity || null;
        } else {
          const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(next.selected_session_id, false);
          currentResultHash = canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash || null;
        }

        if (!currentResultHash) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING] Current session/window context lacks an authoritative result identity`,
            'RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING'
          );
        }

        if (!row.canonical_result_hash || row.canonical_result_hash !== currentResultHash) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[STALE_ARTIFACT] Cannot confirm outcome: artifact result hash '${row.canonical_result_hash || 'missing'}' does not match current result hash '${currentResultHash}'`,
            'ARTIFACT_STALE'
          );
        }

        const fs = require('fs');
        const artifactPath = row.published_path || row.staging_path;
        if (!artifactPath || !fs.existsSync(artifactPath)) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[ARTIFACT_FILE_MISSING] Primary artifact file is missing on disk at '${artifactPath}'`,
            'ARTIFACT_FILE_MISSING'
          );
        }

        const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(artifactPath);
        if (row.size_bytes !== undefined && row.size_bytes !== null && fileBuf.length !== row.size_bytes) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[ARTIFACT_SIZE_MISMATCH] Physical artifact size ${fileBuf.length} does not match manifest ${row.size_bytes}`,
            'ARTIFACT_SIZE_MISMATCH'
          );
        }
        const actualSha256 = require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
        if (actualSha256 !== row.sha256) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH] Physical artifact bytes hash '${actualSha256}' does not match manifest '${row.sha256}'`,
            'ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH'
          );
        }

        const contextTokenHash = AthleteJourneyService.computeContextTokenHash({
          profileId: profile_id,
          episodeId: command.episode_id || null,
          sessionId: next.selected_session_id!,
          contextType: currentContextType,
          windowId: next.selected_window_root_id,
          windowRevision: next.selected_window_revision,
          resultIdentity: currentResultHash,
          dependencyFingerprint: currentDependencyFingerprint,
          artifactId: command.artifact_id,
          manifestSha256: row.sha256
        });

        const confId = `conf-${Date.now()}`;
        const rawAction = command.selected_action || 'store_in_personal_records';
        const decoded = decodeAndMigrateLegacyPilotAction(rawAction);
        if (!decoded) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[INVALID_ACTION_CODE] Invalid pilot downstream action '${rawAction}'. Must be one of: ${VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS.join(', ')}`,
            'INVALID_ACTION_CODE'
          );
        }
        const finalAction = decoded.migrated_action;
        let userNotesWithProvenance: string | undefined = undefined;
        if (decoded.was_legacy) {
          userNotesWithProvenance = command.user_notes
            ? `${command.user_notes} ${decoded.provenance_note || ''}`.trim()
            : (decoded.provenance_note || undefined);
        } else if (command.user_notes) {
          userNotesWithProvenance = command.user_notes;
        }

        deferredTxAction = () => {
          confirmUsefulOutcome({
            confirmation_id: confId,
            session_id: next.selected_session_id!,
            participant_id: profile_id,
            user_notes: userNotesWithProvenance,
            recipient_action: finalAction as any,
            context_token_hash: contextTokenHash
          });

          if (command.episode_id) {
            const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(command.episode_id);
            if (ep && (ep.lifecycle_state === 'draft' || ep.lifecycle_state === 'preflight_ready')) {
              selfServiceEpisodeService.transitionEpisode(command.episode_id, 'analysis_ready', {
                canonical_session_id: next.selected_session_id!,
                completion_gates: {
                  preflight_passed: true,
                  import_completed: true,
                  qc_evaluated: true
                }
              });
            }
            selfServiceEpisodeService.transitionEpisode(command.episode_id, 'completed', {
              completion_gates: {
                preflight_passed: true,
                import_completed: true,
                qc_evaluated: true,
                artifact_exported: true,
                outcome_confirmed: true
              }
            });
          }
        };

        next.exact_next_safe_action = 'completed';
        break;
      }
    }

    // 7. Update fingerprint and save to database via atomic CAS
    next.selection_fingerprint = computeSelectionFingerprint(next);
    const resolvedContext = await this.resolveJourneyContext(profile_id, next);

    const idempotencyRecord: JourneyIdempotencyRecord = {
      profile_id,
      idempotency_key,
      command_hash: currentCommandHash,
      committed_revision: next.selection_revision,
      command_type: command.command_type,
      result_selection_json: JSON.stringify(next),
      result_context_json: JSON.stringify(resolvedContext),
      created_at_utc: now
    };

    const atomicSuccess = commitAthleteJourneySelectionAndIdempotencyAtomic(
      current.selection_revision,
      next,
      idempotencyRecord,
      deferredTxAction
    );
    if (!atomicSuccess) {
      throw new JourneyCommandConflictError(
        `Selection revision conflict during persistence: revision ${current.selection_revision} was concurrently modified`,
        'REVISION_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    return {
      selection: next,
      context: resolvedContext
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resolves the authoritative AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot.
   * Pure read: does NOT create or mutate any database selection state.
   */
  public static async resolveWorkspaceSnapshot(
    profileId: string | null
  ): Promise<AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot> {
    if (!profileId || profileId === 'unresolved') {
      const unresolvedContext = createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
      const fp = computeCompleteDependencyFingerprint({
        profile_id: null,
        profile_mode: 'unresolved',
        selection_revision: null,
        selection_generation: 1,
        session_id: null,
        source_id: null,
        result_hash: null,
        ledger_hash: null,
        currentness: 'unavailable',
        annotation_revision: 0,
        task_revision: 0,
        selected_window_root_id: null,
        selected_window_revision: null,
        comparison_mode: 'none',
        compare_target_session_id: null,
        compare_peer_session_id: null,
        longitudinal_snapshot_id: null,
        saved_view_id: null,
        saved_view_revision: null,
        export_projection: null,
        sensitive_opt_in: { ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN },
        selected_preview_fingerprint: null,
        selected_pack_id: null,
        selected_diary_id: null,
        privacy_mode: 'standard',
        entitlement_status: 'valid',
        policy_versions: {
          compiler: '1.0.0',
          entitlement: '1.0.0',
          privacy: '1.0.0',
          schema: ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION
        },
        active_episode_id: null,
        local_outcome_id: null
      });

      return {
        schema_version: ATHLETE_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        profile_state: unresolvedContext.profile,
        is_aggregate_read_only: false,
        selection: null,
        selection_revision: null,
        selection_generation: 1,
        context: unresolvedContext,
        dependency_fingerprint: fp,
        policy_versions: {
          entitlement: '1.0.0',
          privacy: '1.0.0',
          compiler: '1.0.0',
          schema: ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION
        },
        currentness_codes: ['profile_unresolved'],
        server_timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        next_safe_action: {
          route: unresolvedContext.exact_next_safe_action,
          action_type: 'create_profile_or_load_sample',
          description: 'Create or select athlete profile'
        }
      };
    }

    const isAggregate = profileId === 'all';
    let profile = !isAggregate ? getUserProfile(profileId) : null;

    if (!profile && !isAggregate) {
      const allProfiles = getUserProfiles();
      if (allProfiles.length === 0) {
        return this.resolveWorkspaceSnapshot('unresolved');
      }
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Profile '${profileId}' not found`, 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND');
    }

    const persistedSelection = getAthleteJourneySelection(profileId);
    const resolvedContext = await this.resolveJourneyContext(profileId, persistedSelection || undefined);

    const fp = computeCompleteDependencyFingerprint({
      profile_id: resolvedContext.profile.profile_id,
      profile_mode: resolvedContext.profile.mode,
      selection_revision: persistedSelection?.selection_revision ?? null,
      selection_generation: persistedSelection?.context_generation ?? resolvedContext.context_generation,
      session_id: resolvedContext.session.session_id,
      source_id: resolvedContext.session.source_id,
      result_hash: resolvedContext.session.result_hash,
      ledger_hash: resolvedContext.session.ledger_hash,
      currentness: resolvedContext.session.currentness,
      annotation_revision: resolvedContext.activity.annotation_revision,
      task_revision: resolvedContext.activity.task_revision,
      selected_window_root_id: resolvedContext.window?.window_root_id || null,
      selected_window_revision: resolvedContext.window?.active_window_revision || null,
      comparison_mode: resolvedContext.comparison.mode,
      compare_target_session_id: resolvedContext.comparison.target_session_id,
      compare_peer_session_id: resolvedContext.comparison.peer_session_id,
      longitudinal_snapshot_id: resolvedContext.comparison.longitudinal_snapshot_id,
      saved_view_id: resolvedContext.comparison.saved_view_id,
      saved_view_revision: resolvedContext.comparison.saved_view_revision,
      export_projection: persistedSelection?.export_projection || null,
      sensitive_opt_in: resolvedContext.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in,
      selected_preview_fingerprint: resolvedContext.export_diary.export_preview_fingerprint,
      selected_pack_id: resolvedContext.export_diary.active_pack_id,
      selected_diary_id: resolvedContext.export_diary.active_diary_id,
      privacy_mode: resolvedContext.privacy_entitlement.privacy_mode,
      entitlement_status: resolvedContext.privacy_entitlement.entitlement_status,
      policy_versions: {
        compiler: '1.0.0',
        entitlement: '1.0.0',
        privacy: '1.0.0',
        schema: ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION
      },
      active_episode_id: resolvedContext.episode_outcome.active_episode_id,
      local_outcome_id: resolvedContext.episode_outcome.local_outcome_id
    });

    const currentnessCodes: string[] = [];
    if (resolvedContext.session.currentness !== 'current') {
      currentnessCodes.push(resolvedContext.session.currentness_reason || `session_${resolvedContext.session.currentness}`);
    } else {
      currentnessCodes.push('session_current');
    }
    if (persistedSelection) {
      currentnessCodes.push('selection_persisted');
    } else {
      currentnessCodes.push('selection_uninitialized');
    }

    return {
      schema_version: ATHLETE_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      profile_state: resolvedContext.profile,
      is_aggregate_read_only: isAggregate || Boolean(persistedSelection?.is_aggregate_read_only),
      selection: persistedSelection,
      selection_revision: persistedSelection?.selection_revision ?? null,
      selection_generation: persistedSelection?.context_generation ?? resolvedContext.context_generation,
      context: resolvedContext,
      dependency_fingerprint: fp,
      policy_versions: {
        entitlement: '1.0.0',
        privacy: '1.0.0',
        compiler: '1.0.0',
        schema: ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION
      },
      currentness_codes: currentnessCodes,
      server_timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      next_safe_action: {
        route: resolvedContext.exact_next_safe_action,
        action_type: 'navigate',
        description: `Navigate to ${resolvedContext.exact_next_safe_action}`
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Computes a deterministic token hash for a specific pilot journey context.
   */
  public static computeContextTokenHash(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    contextType: PilotContextType;
    windowId?: string | null;
    windowRevision?: number | null;
    resultIdentity?: string | null;
    profileId?: string | null;
    episodeId?: string | null;
    dependencyFingerprint?: string | null;
    artifactId?: string | null;
    manifestSha256?: string | null;
  }): string {
    const raw = `${params.profileId || ''}:${params.episodeId || ''}:${params.sessionId}:${params.contextType}:${params.windowId || ''}:${params.windowRevision ?? ''}:${params.resultIdentity || ''}:${params.dependencyFingerprint || ''}:${params.artifactId || ''}:${params.manifestSha256 || ''}`;
    return require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * CardioLab G53-WINDOW-005: Authoritative centralized analysis context resolver.
   * Single source of truth for both projection and export worker.
   * Evaluates parent session result and ledger, validates named window ownership,
   * active state, revision, and provenance, and evaluates descriptive metrics and
   * continuity without local fallbacks.
   */
  public static async resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    profileId?: string | null;
    contextType?: PilotContextType;
    windowRootId?: string | null;
    windowRevision?: number | null;
  }): Promise<AuthoritativeAnalysisContext> {
    const { sessionId, profileId, contextType = 'whole_recording', windowRootId, windowRevision } = params;

    const session = getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError(`Session '${sessionId}' not found for analysis context resolution`, 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND');
    }

    if (session.user_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && session.user_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
        `Cross-profile journey violation: session '${sessionId}' belongs to '${session.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, false);
    if (!canonical && contextType !== 'named_window') {
      throw new Error(`Canonical analysis not available for session '${sessionId}'`);
    }

    const parentResultHash = canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash || null;
    const parentLedgerHash = canonical?.canonical_result_identity?.beat_ledger_hash || null;

    if (contextType !== 'named_window' && (!parentResultHash || !parentLedgerHash)) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
        `Parent session '${sessionId}' canonical result or ledger is not ready or unverified`,
        'STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT'
      );
    }

    // 1. Whole recording baseline quality
    const acceptedNn = canonical?.quality_summary?.accepted_nn_beats ?? 0;
    const excluded = canonical?.quality_summary?.excluded_beats ?? 0;
    const totalRr = acceptedNn + excluded;
    const sessionDurationSec = (canonical?.quality_summary as any)?.duration_seconds ?? session.duration_seconds ?? 0;
    const sessionAcceptedDurationSec = (canonical?.quality_summary as any)?.accepted_duration_seconds ?? null;
    const sessionCoverageRatio = sessionDurationSec > 0 && sessionAcceptedDurationSec !== null
      ? Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, sessionAcceptedDurationSec / sessionDurationSec))
      : (totalRr > 0 ? (acceptedNn / totalRr) : 0);
    const sessionMaxGapSec = canonical?.quality_summary?.max_consecutive_gap_seconds ?? 0;

    // G54-CONTEXT-005 & G55-CONTEXT-005: Canonical-only continuity: derived strictly from canonical task eligibility and quality summary without local gap thresholds, beat-count ratios, or continuous-by-default overrides
    let sessionContinuity: 'standard_continuous' | 'segmented_quality_limited' | 'insufficient' = 'segmented_quality_limited';
    if ((canonical?.quality_summary as any)?.continuity_status) {
      sessionContinuity = (canonical.quality_summary as any).continuity_status;
    } else if (canonical?.timing?.timebase_monotonic === false || canonical?.task_eligibility?.mean_hr_rr?.state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
      sessionContinuity = 'insufficient';
    } else if (canonical?.task_eligibility?.core_time_domain_hrv?.state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
      sessionContinuity = 'standard_continuous';
    } else {
      sessionContinuity = 'segmented_quality_limited';
    }

    let wholeQualityDecision: PilotQualityDecision = 'usable';
    let wholeDecisionReasonRu = 'Запись пригодна для описательного анализа ЧСС и ВСР';
    let wholeDecisionReasonEn = 'Recording is usable for descriptive HR and HRV analysis';

    const meanHrElig = canonical?.task_eligibility?.mean_hr || canonical?.task_eligibility?.mean_hr_rr || canonical?.task_eligibility?.mean_hr_rr_metric_eligibility;
    const coreHrvElig = canonical?.task_eligibility?.core_time_domain_hrv || canonical?.task_eligibility?.rmssd;

    if (meanHrElig?.state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || sessionContinuity === 'insufficient' || (canonical?.quality_summary as any)?.data_validity === 'invalid') {
      wholeQualityDecision = 'insufficient';
      wholeDecisionReasonRu = meanHrElig?.blocking_reasons?.[0] || 'Недостаточно валидных данных или непрерывности для описательного анализа';
      wholeDecisionReasonEn = 'Insufficient valid data or continuity for descriptive analysis';
    } else if (
      sessionContinuity === 'segmented_quality_limited' ||
      coreHrvElig?.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ||
      coreHrvElig?.state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
    ) {
      wholeQualityDecision = 'quality_limited';
      wholeDecisionReasonRu = coreHrvElig?.blocking_reasons?.[0] || coreHrvElig?.warning_reasons?.[0] || 'Запись имеет ограничения по качеству или непрерывности; часть метрик удержана';
      wholeDecisionReasonEn = 'Recording has quality or continuity limitations; some metrics are withheld';
    }

    if (contextType === 'named_window') {
      if (!windowRootId) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('windowRootId is required when contextType is named_window', 'WINDOW_REQUIRED');
      }
      if (windowRevision === null || windowRevision === undefined || typeof windowRevision !== 'number') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
          '[WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED] windowRevision is required and must be an explicit number when contextType is named_window',
          'WINDOW_REVISION_REQUIRED'
        );
      }

      const windows = getNamedWindowsForSession(sessionId);
      const matched = windows.find(
        w => (w.root_window_id === windowRootId || w.id === windowRootId) &&
             w.revision === windowRevision
      );
      if (!matched) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
          `Named window '${windowRootId}' (revision ${windowRevision}) does not exist (not found) for session '${sessionId}'`,
          'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND'
        );
      }
      if (matched.user_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && matched.user_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CrossProfileJourneyAccessError(
          `[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Window '${windowRootId}' belongs to '${matched.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
        );
      }
      if (!matched.is_active) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
          `Named window '${windowRootId}' is inactive or deleted`,
          'WINDOW_INACTIVE'
        );
      }

      let winMetrics: any = null;
      try { winMetrics = matched.metrics_json ? JSON.parse(matched.metrics_json) : null; } catch (_) {}
      if (!winMetrics) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
          `[WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING] Named window '${windowRootId}' lacks valid semantic result identity (metrics_json is missing)`,
          'WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING'
        );
      }

      const windowResultIdentity = winMetrics?.resultIdentity || matched.result_identity;
      if (!windowResultIdentity || typeof windowResultIdentity !== 'string' || windowResultIdentity.trim() === '') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`[WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING] Named window '${windowRootId}' lacks valid semantic result identity`, 'WINDOW_RESULT_IDENTITY_MISSING');
      }

      // Exact parent provenance check when parent session canonical identity is present
      if (parentResultHash) {
        if (!winMetrics.parent_result_hash || winMetrics.parent_result_hash !== parentResultHash) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT] Named window '${windowRootId}' stored parent result hash '${winMetrics.parent_result_hash}' does not match current parent session '${parentResultHash}'`,
            'STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT'
          );
        }
      }
      if (parentLedgerHash) {
        if (!winMetrics.parent_ledger_hash || winMetrics.parent_ledger_hash !== parentLedgerHash) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
            `[STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT] Named window '${windowRootId}' stored parent ledger hash '${winMetrics.parent_ledger_hash}' does not match current parent session '${parentLedgerHash}'`,
            'STALE_PARENT_CONTEXT'
          );
        }
      }

      const winCleanBeats = winMetrics.cleanBeatCount ?? winMetrics.valid_nn_count ?? 0;
      const winExcludedBeats = winMetrics.excludedBeatCount ?? 0;
      const winTotalBeats = winCleanBeats + winExcludedBeats;
      const winDurationSec = (matched.end_offset_seconds ?? 0) - (matched.start_offset_seconds ?? 0);

      // Continuity: NEVER default missing continuity to standard_continuous! (G53-WINDOW-005, G54-CONTEXT-005)
      let winContinuityStatus: 'standard_continuous' | 'segmented_quality_limited' | 'insufficient';
      let winMaxGapSec = 0;
      if (winMetrics.continuity) {
        winContinuityStatus = winMetrics.continuity.continuity_classification || winMetrics.continuity.continuity_status || 'segmented_quality_limited';
        winMaxGapSec = winMetrics.continuity.largest_gap_seconds ?? 0;
      } else if (winMetrics.continuity_status || winMetrics.continuity_classification) {
        winContinuityStatus = winMetrics.continuity_status || winMetrics.continuity_classification;
        winMaxGapSec = winMetrics.largest_gap_seconds ?? 0;
      } else {
        winContinuityStatus = 'segmented_quality_limited';
        winMaxGapSec = 0;
      }

      const winAcceptedDurationSec = winMetrics.accepted_duration_seconds ?? null;
      const winCoverage = winDurationSec > 0 && winAcceptedDurationSec !== null
        ? Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, winAcceptedDurationSec / winDurationSec))
        : (winTotalBeats > 0 ? (winCleanBeats / winTotalBeats) : 0);

      const winQuality: PilotQualitySummary = {
        decision: winContinuityStatus === 'insufficient' ? 'insufficient' : (winContinuityStatus === 'segmented_quality_limited' ? 'quality_limited' : 'usable'),
        decision_reason_ru: winContinuityStatus === 'insufficient' ? 'Окно имеет критические пропуски или недостаточно непрерывно' : 'Метрики окна вычислены по подтвержденному отрезку',
        decision_reason_en: winContinuityStatus === 'insufficient' ? 'Window has critical gaps or insufficient continuity' : 'Window metrics evaluated on confirmed segment',
        total_rr_count: winTotalBeats,
        accepted_nn_count: winCleanBeats,
        excluded_count: winExcludedBeats,
        exclusion_reasons: winMetrics.exclusionReasons || {},
        duration_seconds: winDurationSec,
        accepted_duration_seconds: winAcceptedDurationSec ?? 0,
        coverage_ratio: Math.round(winCoverage * 1000) / 1000,
        continuity_status: winContinuityStatus,
        largest_gap_seconds: winMaxGapSec,
        valid_pair_count: winMetrics.valid_pair_count ?? null
      };

      // Metrics projection for window
      const metrics: Record<string, PilotMetricItem> = {};
      const metricKeys = ['mean_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50'];

      for (const k of metricKeys) {
        let rawVal: number | null = null;
        let eligState: any = null;
        let blockingReason: string | null = null;

        if (k === 'mean_hr') {
          rawVal = winMetrics.meanHr ?? winMetrics.mean_hr ?? null;
          eligState = winMetrics.meanHrEligibility ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.mean_hr?.state ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.mean_hr;
          blockingReason = winMetrics.exclusionReasons?.meanHr;
        } else if (k === 'rmssd') {
          rawVal = winMetrics.rmssd ?? null;
          eligState = winMetrics.rmssdEligibility ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.rmssd?.state ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.rmssd;
          blockingReason = winMetrics.exclusionReasons?.rmssd;
        } else if (k === 'sdnn') {
          rawVal = winMetrics.sdnn ?? null;
          eligState = winMetrics.sdnnEligibility ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.sdnn?.state ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.sdnn;
          blockingReason = winMetrics.exclusionReasons?.sdnn;
        } else if (k === 'pnn50') {
          rawVal = winMetrics.pnn50 ?? null;
          eligState = winMetrics.pnn50Eligibility ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.pnn50?.state ?? winMetrics.task_eligibility?.pnn50;
          blockingReason = winMetrics.exclusionReasons?.pnn50;
        }

        const stateStr = typeof eligState === 'object' ? eligState?.state : eligState;
        const isElig = (stateStr === 'ELIGIBLE' || stateStr === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') && rawVal !== null && !isNaN(rawVal);

        metrics[k] = {
          metric_key: k,
          label: USER_FACING_METRICS[k]?.nameRu || k,
          value: isElig ? rawVal : null,
          unit: USER_FACING_METRICS[k]?.unitRu || '',
          is_eligible: isElig,
          eligibility_state: isElig ? stateStr : ((stateStr === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || stateStr === 'INCONCLUSIVE') ? stateStr : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'),
          withholding_reason: isElig ? null : (blockingReason || (typeof eligState === 'object' ? eligState?.blocking_reasons?.[0] : null) || 'Отсутствует подтвержденная пригодность метрики для окна'),
          limitation_note: isElig && winQuality.decision === 'quality_limited' ? 'Метрика окна с ограничениями непрерывности' : null
        };
      }

      return {
        context_type: 'named_window',
        window_id: windowRootId,
        window_revision: windowRevision,
        window_result_identity: windowResultIdentity,
        context_title: `Named Episode: ${matched.name || 'Window'} (rev ${matched.revision})`,
        duration_seconds: winDurationSec,
        quality: winQuality,
        metrics,
        parent_result_hash: parentResultHash,
        parent_ledger_hash: parentLedgerHash,
        policy_versions: {
          method_name: winMetrics.method_name || 'named_window_descriptive_v1',
          method_version: winMetrics.method_version || '1.0.0',
          protocol_authority: winMetrics.protocol_authority || 'Frozen Protocol v1.1'
        },
        pair_count: winMetrics.valid_pair_count ?? null,
        continuity_status: winContinuityStatus,
        largest_gap_seconds: winMaxGapSec
      };
    }

    // Whole recording context
    const wholeQuality: PilotQualitySummary = {
      decision: wholeQualityDecision,
      decision_reason_ru: wholeDecisionReasonRu,
      decision_reason_en: wholeDecisionReasonEn,
      total_rr_count: totalRr,
      accepted_nn_count: acceptedNn,
      excluded_count: excluded,
      exclusion_reasons: (canonical.quality_summary as any)?.exclusion_breakdown || { 'artifact_or_ectopic': excluded },
      duration_seconds: sessionDurationSec,
      accepted_duration_seconds: sessionAcceptedDurationSec,
      coverage_ratio: Math.round(sessionCoverageRatio * 1000) / 1000,
      continuity_status: sessionContinuity,
      largest_gap_seconds: sessionMaxGapSec,
      valid_pair_count: (canonical.quality_summary as any)?.valid_pairs_count ?? null
    };

    const wholeMetrics: Record<string, PilotMetricItem> = {};
    const metricKeys = ['mean_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50'];
    const rawMetrics: Record<string, number | null> = {
      mean_hr: canonical.core_metrics?.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? null,
      rmssd: canonical.core_metrics?.rmssd?.value ?? null,
      sdnn: canonical.core_metrics?.sdnn?.value ?? null,
      pnn50: canonical.core_metrics?.pnn50?.value ?? null
    };

    for (const k of metricKeys) {
      const elig = canonical.task_eligibility?.[k] || null;
      const mVal = rawMetrics[k];
      const evaluated = evaluateUserFacingMetric(k, mVal, elig, 'ru');
      const isInsufficient = wholeQualityDecision === 'insufficient';

      wholeMetrics[k] = {
        metric_key: k,
        label: USER_FACING_METRICS[k]?.nameRu || k,
        value: (!isInsufficient && evaluated.isEligible && mVal !== null && !isNaN(mVal)) ? mVal : null,
        unit: evaluated.unit,
        is_eligible: !isInsufficient && evaluated.isEligible,
        eligibility_state: isInsufficient ? 'withheld_insufficient_quality' : evaluated.eligibilityState,
        withholding_reason: isInsufficient
          ? 'Качество записи недостаточно для описательного расчета'
          : (evaluated.blockingReasons.length > 0 ? evaluated.blockingReasons[0] : (evaluated.isEligible ? null : 'Недостаточно данных')),
        limitation_note: wholeQualityDecision === 'quality_limited' ? 'Запись имеет ограничения по качеству или непрерывности' : null
      };
    }

    return {
      context_type: 'whole_recording',
      window_id: null,
      window_revision: null,
      window_result_identity: parentResultHash,
      context_title: 'Whole Recording',
      duration_seconds: sessionDurationSec,
      quality: wholeQuality,
      metrics: wholeMetrics,
      parent_result_hash: parentResultHash,
      parent_ledger_hash: parentLedgerHash,
      policy_versions: {
        method_name: 'whole_recording_descriptive_v1',
        method_version: '1.0.0',
        protocol_authority: 'Frozen Protocol v1.1'
      },
      pair_count: (canonical.quality_summary as any)?.valid_pairs_count ?? null,
      continuity_status: sessionContinuity,
      largest_gap_seconds: sessionMaxGapSec
    };
  }

  /**
   * CardioLab G39: Resolves authoritative OneRecordingPilotProjection.
   * Single server-derived projection covering source admission -> import & session ->
   * quality review -> whole recording or named window -> descriptive metrics ->
   * primary report artifact -> declared downstream outcome & completion.
   * Pure read: does NOT mutate database selection or create duplicate records.
   */
  public static async resolvePilotProjection(
    profileId: string | null
  ): Promise<OneRecordingPilotProjection> {
    const snapshot = await this.resolveWorkspaceSnapshot(profileId);
    const resolvedContext = snapshot.context;
    const selection = snapshot.selection;
    const sessionId = resolvedContext.session.session_id;

    const db = getDb();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Resolve episode binding
    let episodeId = resolvedContext.episode_outcome.active_episode_id || null;
    if (sessionId && !episodeId && profileId && profileId !== 'unresolved') {
      try {
        const epRow = db.prepare('SELECT episode_id FROM self_service_episodes WHERE canonical_session_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get(sessionId) as any;
        if (epRow) episodeId = epRow.episode_id;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Durable admission & Source summary without path leakage
    const sanitizeBasename = (p: string) => (p ? p.replace(/^.*[\\/]/, '') : '');

    let sourceSummary: { member_count: number; members: string[]; source_sha256?: string | null } | null = null;
    let admission: any = null;

    if (sessionId) {
      try {
        const fileRows = db.prepare(`
          SELECT f.id, f.filename, f.sha256_hash, f.signal_type FROM ingested_files f
          JOIN session_signals ss ON ss.file_id = f.id
          WHERE ss.session_id = ?
          ORDER BY f.filename ASC
        `).all(sessionId) as Array<{ id: string; filename: string; sha256_hash: string; signal_type?: string }>;
        if (fileRows.length > 0) {
          const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
          sourceSummary = {
            member_count: fileRows.length,
            members: fileRows.map(r => sanitizeBasename(r.filename)),
            member_items: fileRows.map(r => {
              let sz = 0;
              try {
                const fsMod = require('fs');
                const pathMod = require('path');
                const matches = fsMod.readdirSync(rawLogsDir).filter((fn: string) => fn.startsWith(`${r.id}_`) || fn === `${r.id}.txt.gz` || fn === `${r.id}`);
                if (matches.length > 0) {
                  sz = fsMod.statSync(pathMod.join(rawLogsDir, matches[0])).size;
                }
              } catch (_) {}
              return {
                name: sanitizeBasename(r.filename),
                size_bytes: sz,
                sha256: r.sha256_hash || '',
                role: r.signal_type || 'data'
              };
            }),
            source_sha256: fileRows[0]?.sha256_hash || null
          } as any;
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      try {
        const sessRow = db.prepare('SELECT admission_json FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
        if (sessRow?.admission_json) {
          admission = JSON.parse(sessRow.admission_json);
        } else if (episodeId) {
          const pfRow = db.prepare('SELECT admission_json FROM guided_preflights WHERE canonical_session_id = ? OR episode_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get(sessionId, episodeId) as any;
          if (pfRow?.admission_json) {
            admission = JSON.parse(pfRow.admission_json);
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      if (admission) {
        if (admission.decision?.members && Array.isArray(admission.decision.members)) {
          admission.decision.members = admission.decision.members.map((m: any) => ({
            ...m,
            file_name: sanitizeBasename(m.file_name)
          }));
        }
        if (admission.envelope?.members && Array.isArray(admission.envelope.members)) {
          admission.envelope.members = admission.envelope.members.map((m: any) => ({
            ...m,
            file_name: sanitizeBasename(m.file_name)
          }));
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Centralized authoritative analysis context resolution (G53-WINDOW-005)
    const isNamedWindow = Boolean(selection?.selected_window_root_id);
    const contextType: PilotContextType = isNamedWindow ? 'named_window' : 'whole_recording';
    const windowId = isNamedWindow ? selection!.selected_window_root_id : null;
    const windowRev = isNamedWindow ? selection!.selected_window_revision : null;

    let authContext: AuthoritativeAnalysisContext | null = null;
    let windowResultIdentity: string | null = null;
    let contextLabel = isNamedWindow ? `Named Episode (rev ${windowRev ?? '?'})` : 'Whole Recording';
    let quality: PilotQualitySummary | null = null;
    const pilotMetrics: Record<string, PilotMetricItem> = {};

    if (sessionId) {
      try {
        authContext = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext({
          sessionId,
          profileId,
          contextType,
          windowRootId: windowId,
          windowRevision: windowRev
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err instanceof CrossProfileJourneyAccessError) throw err;
        authContext = null;
      }
    }

    if (authContext) {
      quality = authContext.quality;
      windowResultIdentity = authContext.window_result_identity;
      contextLabel = authContext.context_title;
      Object.assign(pilotMetrics, authContext.metrics);
    } else {
      const metricKeys = ['mean_hr', 'rmssd', 'sdnn', 'pnn50'];
      for (const k of metricKeys) {
        pilotMetrics[k] = {
          metric_key: k,
          label: USER_FACING_METRICS[k]?.nameRu || k,
          value: null,
          unit: USER_FACING_METRICS[k]?.unitRu || '',
          is_eligible: false,
          eligibility_state: isNamedWindow ? 'withheld_insufficient_quality' : 'unavailable',
          withholding_reason: isNamedWindow ? 'Указанное именованное окно не найдено или недоступно' : 'Данные сессии недоступны',
          limitation_note: isNamedWindow ? 'Метрика удержана из-за отсутствия или недоступности окна' : null
        };
      }
    }

    // Pre-artifact projection & dependency fingerprint calculation (G49-ART-001, G49-COMP-001)
    const sessionCurrentness: 'current' | 'historical' | 'unavailable' | 'stale' =
      resolvedContext.session.currentness === 'superseded'
        ? 'historical'
        : (resolvedContext.session.currentness as 'current' | 'historical' | 'unavailable');

    const preArtifactProjection = {
      schema_version: ONE_RECORDING_PILOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      mode: 'one_recording_pilot' as const,
      episode_id: episodeId,
      profile_id: resolvedContext.profile.profile_id,
      profile_display_name: resolvedContext.profile.display_name || 'Athlete',
      selection_revision: snapshot.selection_revision ?? 1,
      dependency_fingerprint: '',
      stage: 'result_review' as PilotJourneyStage,
      admission: admission || null,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_summary: sourceSummary,
      canonical_result_hash: resolvedContext.session.result_hash,
      beat_ledger_hash: resolvedContext.session.ledger_hash,
      currentness: sessionCurrentness,
      currentness_reason: resolvedContext.session.currentness_reason,
      quality,
      context: {
        type: contextType,
        window_id: windowId,
        window_revision: windowRev,
        window_result_identity: windowResultIdentity,
        context_label: contextLabel
      },
      metrics: pilotMetrics,
      artifact: null,
      downstream_action: {
        action_code: null,
        user_notes: null,
        confirmed_at_utc: null,
        is_confirmed: false,
        confirmation_id: null
      },
      exact_next_safe_action: '',
      recovery: null,
      baseline_required: false as const,
      ai_required: false as const,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    const currentDependencyFingerprint = computePilotDependencyFingerprint(preArtifactProjection);

    // 6. Primary Report Artifact State (G42-AUTH-006, G43-SOURCE-007, G44-AUTH-009, G49-ART-001: exact context, episode, fingerprint match)
    let artifact: PilotArtifactState | null = null;
    if (sessionId) {
      try {
        const manifestRows = db.prepare(`
          SELECT manifest_id, format, filename, published_path, staging_path, size_bytes, sha256, status, canonical_result_hash, sensitive_opt_ins_json, generated_at_utc,
                 profile_id, episode_id, context_type, window_root_id, window_revision, window_result_identity, beat_ledger_hash, dependency_fingerprint, export_preset_version
          FROM export_artifact_manifests
          WHERE session_id = ? AND status = 'completed'
          ORDER BY generated_at_utc DESC
        `).all(sessionId) as any[];

        let matchedManifestRow: any = null;
        for (const row of manifestRows) {
          let opts: any = {};
          try { opts = JSON.parse(row.sensitive_opt_ins_json || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
          const manifestProfileId = opts.profile_id !== undefined ? opts.profile_id : row.profile_id;
          const manifestEpisodeId = opts.episode_id === null ? null : (row.episode_id || opts.episode_id || null);
          const manifestContextType = row.context_type || opts.context_type || 'whole_recording';
          const manifestDependencyFingerprint = row.dependency_fingerprint || opts.dependency_fingerprint;
          const manifestWindowId = (row.window_root_id !== undefined && row.window_root_id !== null) ? row.window_root_id : (opts.window_id !== undefined ? opts.window_id : null);
          const manifestWindowRevision = (row.window_revision !== undefined && row.window_revision !== null) ? Number(row.window_revision) : (opts.window_revision !== undefined && opts.window_revision !== null ? Number(opts.window_revision) : null);

          // G51-LINEAGE-007, G52-LINEAGE-008, G55-LINEAGE-008: Mandatory lineage fields - missing is NEVER wildcard! Every field must match exactly.
          if (!manifestProfileId || manifestProfileId !== resolvedContext.profile.profile_id) {
            continue;
          }
          if (!manifestEpisodeId || manifestEpisodeId !== (episodeId || null)) {
            continue;
          }
          if (!manifestDependencyFingerprint || manifestDependencyFingerprint !== currentDependencyFingerprint) {
            continue;
          }

          if (isNamedWindow) {
            if (
              manifestContextType === 'named_window' &&
              manifestWindowId === windowId &&
              manifestWindowRevision !== null &&
              manifestWindowRevision === windowRev &&
              windowResultIdentity &&
              row.canonical_result_hash === windowResultIdentity
            ) {
              matchedManifestRow = row;
              break;
            }
          } else {
            if (
              manifestContextType === 'whole_recording' &&
              resolvedContext.session.result_hash &&
              row.canonical_result_hash === resolvedContext.session.result_hash
            ) {
              matchedManifestRow = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (matchedManifestRow) {
          const fs = require('fs');
          const artifactPath = matchedManifestRow.published_path || matchedManifestRow.staging_path;
          const fileExistsOnDisk = Boolean(artifactPath && fs.existsSync(artifactPath));
          let fileMatches = false;
          if (fileExistsOnDisk && matchedManifestRow.size_bytes !== null && matchedManifestRow.size_bytes !== undefined && matchedManifestRow.sha256) {
            try {
              const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(artifactPath);
              if (fileBuf.length === matchedManifestRow.size_bytes) {
                const actualSha256 = require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
                if (actualSha256 === matchedManifestRow.sha256) {
                  fileMatches = true;
                }
              }
            } catch (_) {
              fileMatches = false;
            }
          }
          const isCurrent = resolvedContext.session.currentness === 'current' && fileMatches;

          artifact = {
            artifact_id: matchedManifestRow.manifest_id,
            artifact_type: matchedManifestRow.format,
            manifest_sha256: matchedManifestRow.sha256,
            is_current: isCurrent,
            generated_at_utc: matchedManifestRow.generated_at_utc,
            human_readable_summary: `Primary report manifest ${matchedManifestRow.manifest_id} for ${contextLabel}`,
            file_display_name: matchedManifestRow.filename
          };
        } else {
          artifact = null;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 7. Declared Downstream Action & Confirmation
    let downstreamAction: PilotDownstreamAction = {
      action_code: null,
      user_notes: null,
      confirmed_at_utc: null,
      is_confirmed: false,
      confirmation_id: null
    };

    const currentContextTokenHash = AthleteJourneyService.computeContextTokenHash({
      profileId: profileId,
      episodeId: episodeId,
      sessionId: sessionId || '',
      contextType,
      windowId,
      windowRevision: windowRev,
      resultIdentity: isNamedWindow ? windowResultIdentity : resolvedContext.session.result_hash,
      dependencyFingerprint: currentDependencyFingerprint,
      artifactId: artifact?.artifact_id || null,
      manifestSha256: artifact?.manifest_sha256 || null
    });

    if (sessionId && artifact && artifact.is_current) {
      try {
        const confs = db.prepare(`
          SELECT * FROM beta_useful_confirmations
          WHERE session_id = ?
          ORDER BY confirmed_at_utc DESC
        `).all(sessionId) as any[];

        const matchedConf = confs.find(conf =>
          conf.context_token_hash === currentContextTokenHash &&
          (!profileId || profileId === 'all' || conf.participant_id === profileId)
        );

        if (matchedConf) {
          let actionCode: PilotDownstreamActionCode = 'store_in_personal_records';
          const decoded = decodeAndMigrateLegacyPilotAction(matchedConf.recipient_action);
          if (decoded) {
            actionCode = decoded.migrated_action;
            if (decoded.was_legacy) {
              try {
                const updatedNotes = matchedConf.user_notes
                  ? `${matchedConf.user_notes} ${decoded.provenance_note}`
                  : decoded.provenance_note;
                db.prepare(`
                  UPDATE beta_useful_confirmations
                  SET recipient_action = ?, user_notes = ?
                  WHERE confirmation_id = ?
                `).run(actionCode, updatedNotes, matchedConf.confirmation_id);
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          }
          downstreamAction = {
            action_code: actionCode,
            user_notes: matchedConf.user_notes !== undefined ? matchedConf.user_notes : null,
            confirmed_at_utc: matchedConf.confirmed_at_utc,
            is_confirmed: true,
            confirmation_id: matchedConf.confirmation_id
          };
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 8. Deterministic Stage Progression & Next Safe Action
    let stage: PilotJourneyStage = 'source_admission';
    let nextSafeAction = 'select_source';

    if (isNamedWindow && !windowResultIdentity) {
      stage = 'recovery_required';
      nextSafeAction = 'reselect_named_window';
    } else if (downstreamAction.is_confirmed && artifact && artifact.is_current) {
      stage = 'completed';
      nextSafeAction = 'view_completed_summary';
    } else if (!sessionId) {
      stage = 'source_admission';
      nextSafeAction = 'run_preflight';
    } else if (resolvedContext.session.currentness === 'unavailable') {
      stage = 'recovery_required';
      nextSafeAction = 'recompute_or_relink';
    } else if (!quality) {
      stage = 'quality_review';
      nextSafeAction = 'review_recording_quality';
    } else if (quality.decision === 'insufficient') {
      stage = 'quality_review';
      nextSafeAction = 'review_insufficient_recording';
    } else if (!artifact || !artifact.is_current) {
      stage = isNamedWindow ? 'context_selection' : 'result_review';
      nextSafeAction = 'generate_pilot_report';
    } else if (artifact && artifact.is_current) {
      stage = 'artifact_ready';
      nextSafeAction = 'confirm_downstream_outcome';
    }

    const recovery = stage === 'recovery_required' ? {
      recovery_required: true,
      recovery_reason: resolvedContext.session.currentness_reason || 'Session data unavailable',
      suggested_remediation: 'Relink source folder or re-import supported H10 log files'
    } : null;

    const projection: OneRecordingPilotProjection = {
      schema_version: ONE_RECORDING_PILOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      mode: 'one_recording_pilot',
      episode_id: episodeId,
      profile_id: resolvedContext.profile.profile_id,
      profile_display_name: resolvedContext.profile.display_name || 'Athlete',
      selection_revision: snapshot.selection_revision ?? 1,
      dependency_fingerprint: '',
      stage,
      admission: admission || null,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_summary: sourceSummary,
      canonical_result_hash: resolvedContext.session.result_hash,
      beat_ledger_hash: resolvedContext.session.ledger_hash,
      currentness: sessionCurrentness,
      currentness_reason: resolvedContext.session.currentness_reason,
      quality,
      context: {
        type: contextType,
        window_id: windowId,
        window_revision: windowRev,
        window_result_identity: windowResultIdentity,
        context_label: contextLabel
      },
      metrics: pilotMetrics,
      artifact,
      downstream_action: downstreamAction,
      exact_next_safe_action: nextSafeAction,
      recovery,
      baseline_required: false,
      ai_required: false,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    projection.dependency_fingerprint = computePilotDependencyFingerprint(projection);
    return validateOneRecordingPilotProjection(projection);
  }
}

FILE: src/backend/library/SessionLibraryRepository.ts
