import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import {
  SessionLibraryQuery,
  SessionLibraryRow,
  SessionLibraryPage,
  ReviewPresetFilter,
  SourceLifecycleState,
  computeQueryFingerprint,
  computeRowFingerprint,
  validateSessionLibraryQueryStrict,
  validateSessionLibraryPageStrict,
  SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  SESSION_LIBRARY_QUERY_POLICY_VERSION
} from '../../shared/canonical/SessionLibraryContracts';

export class SessionLibraryRepository {
  /**
   * Authoritative server-paged session library query with pushed SQL filtering,
   * deterministic tie-breakers, page-scoped joins, and review queue counts.
   */
  public static queryPage(rawQuery: Partial<SessionLibraryQuery>): SessionLibraryPage {
    const query = validateSessionLibraryQueryStrict(rawQuery);
    const db = getDb();
    const queryFingerprint = computeQueryFingerprint(query);

    // Build WHERE clause and parameter bindings
    const whereClauses: string[] = [];
    const params: any[] = [];

    // Profile scoping
    if (query.profile_id && query.profile_id !== 'all') {
      if (query.profile_id === 'unassigned') {
        whereClauses.push("(s.user_id IS NULL OR s.user_id = '' OR s.user_id = 'unassigned')");
      } else {
        whereClauses.push("s.user_id = ?");
        params.push(query.profile_id);
      }
    }

    // Text search
    if (query.search && query.search.trim().length > 0) {
      const term = `%${query.search.trim().toLowerCase()}%`;
      whereClauses.push(`(
        LOWER(s.id) LIKE ? OR
        LOWER(s.device_id) LIKE ? OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(a.activity_label_custom, '')) LIKE ? OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(a.user_notes, '')) LIKE ? OR
        LOWER(COALESCE(a.tags_json, '')) LIKE ?
      )`);
      params.push(term, term, term, term, term);
    }

    // Activity filter
    if (query.activity_type && query.activity_type !== 'all') {
      whereClauses.push("LOWER(COALESCE(a.activity_type, 'unknown')) = ?");
      params.push(query.activity_type.toLowerCase());
    }

    // Date range
    if (query.date_from) {
      whereClauses.push("s.start_time >= ?");
      params.push(query.date_from);
    }
    if (query.date_to) {
      whereClauses.push("s.start_time <= ?");
      params.push(query.date_to);
    }

    // Ignored sessions filter
    if (!query.include_ignored) {
      whereClauses.push("(s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)");
    }

    // Duplicates filter
    if (!query.include_duplicates) {
      whereClauses.push("(s.duplicate_representative_id IS NULL OR s.duplicate_representative_id = '' OR s.duplicate_representative_id = s.id)");
    }

    // Source availability filter
    if (query.source_available && query.source_available !== 'all') {
      if (query.source_available === 'true') {
        whereClauses.push("(s.source_lifecycle_state = 'persisted_available' OR s.source_lifecycle_state IS NULL)");
      } else {
        whereClauses.push("s.source_lifecycle_state = 'source_unavailable'");
      }
    }

    // Tags filter
    if (query.tags && query.tags.length > 0) {
      for (const tag of query.tags) {
        if (tag && tag.trim()) {
          whereClauses.push("a.tags_json LIKE ?");
          params.push(`%"${tag.trim()}"%`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Signal type filter
    if (query.signal_type && query.signal_type !== 'all') {
      whereClauses.push(`EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM session_signals ss
        JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
        WHERE ss.session_id = s.id AND UPPER(f.signal_type) = ?
      )`);
      params.push(query.signal_type.toUpperCase());
    }

    // Readiness filter
    if (query.readiness && query.readiness !== 'all') {
      if (query.readiness === 'ready') {
        whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_rmssd\":true%' AND m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_sdnn\":true%')");
      } else if (query.readiness === 'limited') {
        whereClauses.push("(m.rmssd IS NOT NULL OR m.sdnn IS NOT NULL OR s.avg_hr IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_rmssd\":true%' AND m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_sdnn\":true%')");
      } else if (query.readiness === 'unavailable') {
        whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json IS NULL OR m.canonical_observation_json = '') AND m.rmssd IS NULL AND m.sdnn IS NULL AND s.avg_hr IS NULL");
      }
    }

    // Baseline eligible filter
    if (query.baseline_eligible && query.baseline_eligible !== 'all') {
      if (query.baseline_eligible === 'true') {
        whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_rmssd\":true%' AND m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_sdnn\":true%' AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL))");
      } else {
        whereClauses.push("NOT (m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_rmssd\":true%' AND m.canonical_observation_json LIKE '%\"baseline_included_sdnn\":true%' AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL))");
      }
    }

    // Review preset filters
    if (query.review_preset && query.review_preset !== 'all') {
      switch (query.review_preset) {
        case 'unassigned_profile':
          whereClauses.push("(s.user_id IS NULL OR s.user_id = '' OR s.user_id = 'unassigned')");
          break;
        case 'missing_activity':
          whereClauses.push("(a.activity_type IS NULL OR a.activity_type = 'unknown' OR a.activity_type = '')");
          break;
        case 'not_evaluated':
          whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json IS NULL OR m.canonical_observation_json = '')");
          break;
        case 'quality_limited':
          whereClauses.push("(s.overall_quality_score < 70 OR m.hrv_quality = 'limited' OR m.hrv_quality = 'invalid')");
          break;
        case 'source_unavailable':
          whereClauses.push("s.source_lifecycle_state = 'source_unavailable'");
          break;
        case 'relink_available':
          whereClauses.push("s.source_lifecycle_state = 'relink_available'");
          break;
        case 'duplicate_decision_needed':
          whereClauses.push("(s.duplicate_representative_id IS NOT NULL AND s.duplicate_representative_id != '' AND s.duplicate_representative_id != s.id)");
          break;
        case 'compare_ready':
          whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json IS NOT NULL AND s.overall_quality_score >= 70 AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL))");
          break;
        case 'baseline_ready':
          whereClauses.push("(m.canonical_observation_json IS NOT NULL AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL))");
          break;
      }
    }

    const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';

    // 1. Total count query
    const countSql = `
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as total
      FROM sessions s
      LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id
      LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id
      ${whereSql}
    `;
    const countRow = db.prepare(countSql).get(...params) as { total: number };
    const totalCount = countRow ? Number(countRow.total) : 0;

    // 2. Deterministic sort column mapping
    let orderCol = 's.start_time';
    switch (query.sort_by) {
      case 'duration_seconds':
        orderCol = 's.duration_seconds';
        break;
      case 'avg_hr':
        orderCol = 's.avg_hr';
        break;
      case 'rmssd':
        orderCol = 'm.rmssd';
        break;
      case 'sdnn':
        orderCol = 'm.sdnn';
        break;
      case 'overall_quality_score':
        orderCol = 's.overall_quality_score';
        break;
      case 'readiness':
        orderCol = 's.overall_quality_score';
        break;
      case 'start_time':
      default:
        orderCol = 's.start_time';
        break;
    }
    const orderDir = query.sort_dir === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';

    // 3. Page query with deterministic secondary sort tie-breaker (s.id ASC)
    const pageSql = `
      SELECT
        s.id,
        s.device_id,
        s.start_time,
        s.end_time,
        s.duration_seconds,
        s.avg_hr,
        s.overall_quality_score,
        s.user_id,
        s.curation_revision,
        s.is_ignored,
        s.ignored_at_utc,
        s.ignore_reason,
        s.excluded_from_future_sync,
        s.duplicate_representative_id,
        s.source_sha256,
        s.source_lifecycle_state,
        s.relinked_source_path,
        a.activity_type,
        a.activity_label_custom,
        a.user_notes,
        a.tags_json,
        m.rmssd,
        m.sdnn,
        m.pnn50,
        m.hrv_quality,
        m.canonical_observation_json
      FROM sessions s
      LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id
      LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id
      ${whereSql}
      ORDER BY ${orderCol} ${orderDir}, s.id ASC
      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    `;

    const pageRows = db.prepare(pageSql).all(...params, query.limit, query.offset) as any[];

    // 4. Page-scoped batch enrichment (only for the page rows!)
    const pageSessionIds = pageRows.map(r => r.id);
    let signalsMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    let usersMap = new Map<string, string>();
    let duplicateCountsMap = new Map<string, number>();

    if (pageSessionIds.length > 0) {
      const placeholders = pageSessionIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
      
      // Page signals only
      const sigRows = db.prepare(`
        SELECT ss.session_id, f.signal_type, f.filename, f.sha256_hash
        FROM session_signals ss
        JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
        WHERE ss.session_id IN (${placeholders})
      `).all(...pageSessionIds) as any[];

      for (const sig of sigRows) {
        const list = signalsMap.get(sig.session_id) || [];
        list.push(sig);
        signalsMap.set(sig.session_id, list);
      }

      // Page users only
      const userIds = Array.from(new Set(pageRows.map(r => r.user_id).filter(Boolean)));
      if (userIds.length > 0) {
        const uPlaceholders = userIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
        const uRows = db.prepare(`SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id IN (${uPlaceholders})`).all(...userIds) as any[];
        for (const u of uRows) {
          usersMap.set(u.id, u.display_name);
        }
      }

      // Duplicate count
      for (const r of pageRows) {
        const repId = r.duplicate_representative_id || r.id;
        const dupCount = db.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sessions
          WHERE duplicate_representative_id = ? OR id = ?
        `).get(repId, repId) as { cnt: number };
        duplicateCountsMap.set(r.id, dupCount ? Number(dupCount.cnt) : 1);
      }
    }

    // 5. Construct SessionLibraryRow items with canonical row truth
    const rows: SessionLibraryRow[] = pageRows.map(r => {
      const sigList = signalsMap.get(r.id) || [];
      const signalClasses = Array.from(new Set(sigList.map(s => s.signal_type)));

      // Parse tags
      let tags: string[] = [];
      if (r.tags_json) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(r.tags_json);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            tags = parsed.filter(t => typeof t === 'string' && t.trim().length > 0);
          }
        } catch {}
      }

      // Parse canonical observation
      let obs: any = null;
      if (r.canonical_observation_json) {
        try {
          obs = JSON.parse(r.canonical_observation_json);
        } catch {}
      }

      let canonicalEvaluationStatus: 'evaluated' | 'not_evaluated' | 'unavailable' | 'legacy_unverified' = 'not_evaluated';
      let readiness: 'ready' | 'limited' | 'unavailable' = 'unavailable';
      let readinessReasons: string[] = [];
      let baselineEligible = false;
      let baselineReasons: string[] = [];
      let compareReady = false;
      let compareBlockers: string[] = [];

      const isIgnored = Boolean(r.is_ignored);

      if (obs) {
        canonicalEvaluationStatus = 'evaluated';
        const isReady = Boolean(obs.baseline_included_rmssd && obs.baseline_included_sdnn);
        const isLimited = (obs.rmssd !== null || obs.sdnn !== null || r.avg_hr !== null) && !isReady;
        readiness = isReady ? 'ready' : (isLimited ? 'limited' : 'unavailable');
        
        if (isReady) {
          readinessReasons.push('Канонические метрики валидны и стабильны');
          baselineEligible = !isIgnored;
          if (baselineEligible) {
            baselineReasons.push('Соответствует критериям персонального базового уровня');
          } else {
            baselineReasons.push('Исключено из-за статуса скрытой/игнорируемой сессии');
          }
        } else {
          readinessReasons.push('Каноническая оценка показала неполные или ограниченные данные');
          baselineReasons.push('Не удовлетворяет критериям стабильности базового уровня');
        }

        // Compare readiness
        if (isIgnored) {
          compareBlockers.push('Сессия скрыта (игнорируется)');
        } else if (r.overall_quality_score < 70) {
          compareBlockers.push(`Недостаточное качество данных (${Math.round(r.overall_quality_score)}% < 70%)`);
        } else if (!isReady && !isLimited) {
          compareBlockers.push('Недостаточно валидных интервалов для сравнительного анализа');
        } else {
          compareReady = true;
        }
      } else {
        // Missing canonical result is never shown as ready from legacy metrics
        canonicalEvaluationStatus = 'not_evaluated';
        readiness = (r.rmssd !== null || r.sdnn !== null || r.avg_hr !== null) ? 'limited' : 'unavailable';
        readinessReasons.push('Каноническая оценка сессии еще не выполнена');
        baselineEligible = false;
        baselineReasons.push('Требуется каноническая оценка сессии');
        compareReady = false;
        compareBlockers.push('Каноническая оценка сессии еще не выполнена');
      }

      const isDuplicate = Boolean(r.duplicate_representative_id && r.duplicate_representative_id !== r.id);
      const duplicateRepId = r.duplicate_representative_id || r.id;
      const dupCount = duplicateCountsMap.get(r.id) || 1;
      const sourceState: SourceLifecycleState = r.source_lifecycle_state || 'persisted_available';
      const rowRevision = Number(r.curation_revision || 1);

      const rowData = {
        session_id: r.id,
        device_id: r.device_id,
        start_time_utc: r.start_time,
        end_time_utc: r.end_time || r.start_time,
        duration_seconds: Number(r.duration_seconds || 0),
        profile_id: r.user_id || null,
        profile_name: usersMap.get(r.user_id) || (r.user_id ? r.user_id : 'Без профиля'),
        activity_type: r.activity_type || 'unknown',
        user_notes: r.user_notes || null,
        tags,
        signal_classes: signalClasses,
        canonical_result_id: obs ? `obs_${r.id}` : null,
        canonical_evaluation_status: canonicalEvaluationStatus,
        canonical_currentness: (obs ? 'current' : 'not_applicable') as 'current' | 'not_applicable',
        avg_hr: r.avg_hr !== null ? Number(r.avg_hr) : null,

        rmssd: r.rmssd !== null ? Number(r.rmssd) : null,
        sdnn: r.sdnn !== null ? Number(r.sdnn) : null,
        pnn50: r.pnn50 !== null ? Number(r.pnn50) : null,
        metrics_quality: (r.overall_quality_score >= 80 ? 'high' : r.overall_quality_score >= 60 ? 'medium' : 'low') as any,
        quality_score: Number(r.overall_quality_score || 0),
        readiness,
        readiness_reasons: readinessReasons,
        baseline_eligible: baselineEligible,
        baseline_reasons: baselineReasons,
        compare_ready: compareReady,
        compare_blockers: compareBlockers,
        per_metric_longitudinal_readiness: {
          rmssd: { ready: baselineEligible, reason_ru: baselineReasons[0] },
          sdnn: { ready: baselineEligible, reason_ru: baselineReasons[0] }
        },
        source_lifecycle_state: sourceState,
        source_sha256: r.source_sha256 || undefined,
        is_duplicate: isDuplicate,
        duplicate_representative_id: duplicateRepId,
        duplicate_count: dupCount,
        is_ignored: isIgnored,
        ignored_at_utc: r.ignored_at_utc || undefined,
        ignore_reason: r.ignore_reason || undefined,
        excluded_from_future_sync: Boolean(r.excluded_from_future_sync),
        row_revision: rowRevision,
        row_fingerprint: '',
        allowed_actions: [
          'edit_profile',
          'edit_activity',
          'edit_tags',
          isIgnored ? 'restore' : 'ignore',
          'recalculate',
          'compare'
        ] as any[]
      };

      rowData.row_fingerprint = computeRowFingerprint({
        session_id: rowData.session_id,
        row_revision: rowData.row_revision,
        profile_id: rowData.profile_id,
        activity_type: rowData.activity_type,
        tags: rowData.tags,
        is_ignored: rowData.is_ignored,
        is_duplicate: rowData.is_duplicate,
        canonical_result_id: rowData.canonical_result_id
      });

      return rowData;
    });

    // 6. Review queue counts
    const reviewCounts: Record<ReviewPresetFilter, number> = {
      all: totalCount,
      unassigned_profile: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions WHERE (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = '' OR user_id = 'unassigned') AND (is_ignored = 0 OR is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0),
      missing_activity: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_annotations a ON s.id = a.session_id WHERE (a.activity_type IS NULL OR a.activity_type = 'unknown' OR a.activity_type = '') AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0),
      not_evaluated: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE (m.canonical_observation_json IS NULL OR m.canonical_observation_json = '') AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0),
      quality_limited: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE (s.overall_quality_score < 70 OR m.hrv_quality = 'limited' OR m.hrv_quality = 'invalid') AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0),
      source_unavailable: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions WHERE source_lifecycle_state = 'source_unavailable'").get()?.c || 0),
      relink_available: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions WHERE source_lifecycle_state = 'relink_available'").get()?.c || 0),
      duplicate_decision_needed: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions WHERE duplicate_representative_id IS NOT NULL AND duplicate_representative_id != '' AND duplicate_representative_id != id").get()?.c || 0),
      compare_ready: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.canonical_observation_json IS NOT NULL AND s.overall_quality_score >= 70 AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0),
      baseline_ready: Number(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.canonical_observation_json IS NOT NULL AND (s.is_ignored = 0 OR s.is_ignored IS NULL)").get()?.c || 0)
    };

    // 7. Library revision
    const revRow = db.prepare("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(curation_revision), 1) as max_rev FROM sessions").get() as { max_rev: number };
    const libraryRevision = revRow ? Number(revRow.max_rev) : 1;

    const pageIndex = Math.floor(query.offset / query.limit) + 1;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / query.limit));

    const page: SessionLibraryPage = {
      schema_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      query_fingerprint: queryFingerprint,
      normalized_query: query,
      rows,
      total_count: totalCount,
      page_index: pageIndex,
      page_size: query.limit,
      total_pages: totalPages,
      has_next_page: pageIndex < totalPages,
      has_prev_page: pageIndex > 1,
      library_revision: libraryRevision,
      timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      review_queue_counts: reviewCounts
    };

    return validateSessionLibraryPageStrict(page);
  }

  /**
   * Explicitly probes source files on disk for a single session and updates its persisted
   * lifecycle state in SQLite. Ordinary list queries never synchronously probe the filesystem.
   */
  public static refreshSourceState(sessionId: string): SourceLifecycleState {
    const db = getDb();
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

    const sigs = db.prepare(`
      SELECT ss.session_id, f.id, f.signal_type, f.filename, f.sha256_hash
      FROM session_signals ss
      JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
      WHERE ss.session_id = ?
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    let newState: SourceLifecycleState = 'source_unavailable';

    if (sigs.length > 0 && fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
      const allFound = sigs.every(sig => {
        const expectedP = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sig.id}_${sig.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
        const directP = sig.filename ? path.join(rawLogsDir, sig.filename) : '';
        return fs.existsSync(expectedP) || (directP && fs.existsSync(directP));
      });
      if (allFound) {
        newState = 'persisted_available';
      } else {
        // Check if there is a relink record in G21 table
        const relink = db.prepare(`
          SELECT * FROM source_relink_records
          WHERE source_sha256 = ?
          ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
        `).get(sigs[0].sha256_hash);
        newState = relink ? 'relink_available' : 'source_unavailable';
      }
    }

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE sessions
      SET source_lifecycle_state = ?, curation_revision = curation_revision + 1
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(newState, sessionId);

    return newState;
  }
}

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  SessionLibraryCommand,
  BulkMutationReceipt,
  TargetFailure,
  TargetConflict,
  TargetSkipped,
  validateSessionLibraryCommandStrict,
  validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict,
  SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/canonical/SessionLibraryContracts';
import { CanonicalComparisonService } from '../analytics/CanonicalComparisonService';
import { CanonicalTrendObservationService } from '../analytics/CanonicalTrendObservationService';
import { saveSourceRelinkRecord } from '../db/db';

export class CurationConflictError extends Error {
  public readonly code = 'CURATION_CONFLICT';
  public readonly conflictedTargets: TargetConflict[];
  constructor(message: string, conflictedTargets: TargetConflict[]) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'CurationConflictError';
    this.conflictedTargets = conflictedTargets;
  }
}

export class CurationIdempotencyConflictError extends Error {
  public readonly code = 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'CurationIdempotencyConflictError';
  }
}

export class SessionLibraryService {
  /**
   * Executes a transactional curation command with strict idempotency,
   * CAS revision checking, atomic SQLite commits, and dependent cache invalidations.
   */
  public static executeCommand(rawCommand: any): BulkMutationReceipt {
    const cmd = validateSessionLibraryCommandStrict(rawCommand);
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Idempotency Check
    const cmdPayloadForHash = { ...cmd };
    delete (cmdPayloadForHash as any).idempotency_key;
    const payloadHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(cmdPayloadForHash)).digest('hex');

    const existingIdem = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM bulk_mutation_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = ?
    `).get(cmd.idempotency_key) as any;

    if (existingIdem) {
      if (existingIdem.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
        // Idempotent replay: return identical cached receipt
        return validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict(JSON.parse(existingIdem.receipt_json));
      } else {
        // Idempotency key reused with different payload -> 409 Conflict
        throw new CurationIdempotencyConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${cmd.idempotency_key}' was previously used for a different command payload.`
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. Resolve Target IDs and Expected Revisions
    let targetSessionIds: string[] = [];
    let expectedRevisions: Record<string, number> = {};

    switch (cmd.command_type) {
      case 'assign_profile':
      case 'assign_activity':
      case 'update_tags':
      case 'ignore_sessions':
      case 'restore_sessions':
      case 'recompute_sessions':
        targetSessionIds = [...cmd.target_session_ids];
        expectedRevisions = { ...(cmd.expected_revisions || {}) };
        break;
      case 'set_duplicate_representative':
        targetSessionIds = [cmd.duplicate_session_id];
        expectedRevisions = { [cmd.duplicate_session_id]: cmd.expected_revision };
        break;
      case 'relink_source':
        targetSessionIds = [cmd.session_id];
        expectedRevisions = { [cmd.session_id]: cmd.expected_revision };
        break;
    }

    // 3. Check Target Existence and CAS Revision Integrity
    const beforeRevisions: Record<string, number> = {};
    const afterRevisions: Record<string, number> = {};
    const failedTargets: TargetFailure[] = [];
    const conflictedTargets: TargetConflict[] = [];

    for (const sid of targetSessionIds) {
      const sessionRow = db.prepare('SELECT id, curation_revision, is_ignored, user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sid) as any;
      if (!sessionRow) {
        failedTargets.push({
          session_id: sid,
          error_code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND',
          message_ru: `Сессия '${sid}' не найдена в базе данных`,
          message_en: `Session '${sid}' not found in database`
        });
        continue;
      }

      const curRev = Number(sessionRow.curation_revision || 1);
      beforeRevisions[sid] = curRev;

      if (expectedRevisions[sid] !== undefined && expectedRevisions[sid] !== curRev) {
        conflictedTargets.push({
          session_id: sid,
          current_revision: curRev,
          expected_revision: expectedRevisions[sid]
        });
      }
    }

    // If any CAS revision conflicts detected, abort and return conflict receipt
    if (conflictedTargets.length > 0) {
      const conflictReceipt: BulkMutationReceipt = {
        schema_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        receipt_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        command_type: cmd.command_type,
        idempotency_key: cmd.idempotency_key,
        status: 'conflict',
        total_targets: targetSessionIds.length,
        succeeded_targets: [],
        failed_targets: failedTargets,
        conflicted_targets: conflictedTargets,
        skipped_targets: [],
        before_revisions: beforeRevisions,
        after_revisions: beforeRevisions,
        dependency_invalidations: [],
        timestamp_utc: now
      };
      return validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict(conflictReceipt);
    }

    // If any target was not found, return partial_failure / rejected
    if (failedTargets.length > 0) {
      const failureReceipt: BulkMutationReceipt = {
        schema_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        receipt_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        command_type: cmd.command_type,
        idempotency_key: cmd.idempotency_key,
        status: 'rejected',
        total_targets: targetSessionIds.length,
        succeeded_targets: [],
        failed_targets: failedTargets,
        conflicted_targets: [],
        skipped_targets: [],
        before_revisions: beforeRevisions,
        after_revisions: beforeRevisions,
        dependency_invalidations: [],
        timestamp_utc: now
      };
      return validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict(failureReceipt);
    }

    // 4. Execute atomic transaction
    const dependencyInvalidations: string[] = [];

    const tx = db.transaction(() => {
      for (const sid of targetSessionIds) {
        const nextRev = beforeRevisions[sid] + 1;
        afterRevisions[sid] = nextRev;

        switch (cmd.command_type) {
          case 'assign_profile': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET user_id = ?, curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(cmd.profile_id ?? null, nextRev, sid);

            // Also ensure annotations row matches profile
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE session_annotations
              SET user_id = ?, updated_at = ?
              WHERE session_id = ?
            `).run(cmd.profile_id ?? null, now, sid);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('journey_selection')) dependencyInvalidations.push('journey_selection');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('comparison_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('comparison_cache');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('longitudinal_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('longitudinal_cache');
            break;
          }

          case 'assign_activity': {
            // Ensure session_annotations row exists
            const annExists = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sid);
            if (annExists) {
              db.prepare(`
                UPDATE session_annotations
                SET activity_type = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE session_id = ?
              `).run(cmd.activity_type, now, sid);
            } else {
              db.prepare(`
                INSERT INTO session_annotations (id, session_id, activity_type, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
              `).run(crypto.randomUUID(), sid, cmd.activity_type, now, now);
            }

            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(nextRev, sid);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('comparison_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('comparison_cache');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('longitudinal_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('longitudinal_cache');
            break;
          }

          case 'update_tags': {
            const ann = db.prepare('SELECT tags_json FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sid) as any;
            let currentTags: string[] = [];
            if (ann && ann.tags_json) {
              try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(ann.tags_json);
                if (Array.isArray(parsed)) currentTags = parsed;
              } catch {}
            }

            const tagSet = new Set(currentTags);
            for (const t of (cmd.add_tags || [])) {
              if (t && t.trim()) tagSet.add(t.trim());
            }
            for (const t of (cmd.remove_tags || [])) {
              tagSet.delete(t.trim());
            }

            const finalTagsJson = JSON.stringify(Array.from(tagSet));

            if (ann) {
              db.prepare(`
                UPDATE session_annotations
                SET tags_json = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE session_id = ?
              `).run(finalTagsJson, now, sid);
            } else {
              db.prepare(`
                INSERT INTO session_annotations (id, session_id, tags_json, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
              `).run(crypto.randomUUID(), sid, finalTagsJson, now, now);
            }

            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(nextRev, sid);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('tag_filters')) dependencyInvalidations.push('tag_filters');
            break;
          }

          case 'ignore_sessions': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET is_ignored = 1,
                  ignored_at_utc = ?,
                  ignore_reason = ?,
                  excluded_from_future_sync = ?,
                  curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(now, cmd.reason, cmd.exclude_from_future_sync ? 1 : 0, nextRev, sid);

            db.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO session_ignore_history (id, session_id, action, reason, excluded_from_future_sync, idempotency_key, timestamp_utc)
              VALUES (?, ?, 'ignore', ?, ?, ?, ?)
            `).run(crypto.randomUUID(), sid, cmd.reason, cmd.exclude_from_future_sync ? 1 : 0, cmd.idempotency_key, now);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('baseline_denominator')) dependencyInvalidations.push('baseline_denominator');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('repeat_series')) dependencyInvalidations.push('repeat_series');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('comparison_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('comparison_cache');
            break;
          }

          case 'restore_sessions': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET is_ignored = 0,
                  ignored_at_utc = NULL,
                  ignore_reason = NULL,
                  excluded_from_future_sync = 0,
                  curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(nextRev, sid);

            db.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO session_ignore_history (id, session_id, action, reason, excluded_from_future_sync, idempotency_key, timestamp_utc)
              VALUES (?, ?, 'restore', NULL, 0, ?, ?)
            `).run(crypto.randomUUID(), sid, cmd.idempotency_key, now);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('baseline_denominator')) dependencyInvalidations.push('baseline_denominator');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('repeat_series')) dependencyInvalidations.push('repeat_series');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('comparison_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('comparison_cache');
            break;
          }

          case 'set_duplicate_representative': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET duplicate_representative_id = ?,
                  curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(cmd.representative_session_id, nextRev, sid);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('duplicate_clusters')) dependencyInvalidations.push('duplicate_clusters');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('baseline_denominator')) dependencyInvalidations.push('baseline_denominator');
            break;
          }

          case 'relink_source': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET source_lifecycle_state = 'persisted_available',
                  relinked_source_path = ?,
                  curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(cmd.new_source_path, nextRev, sid);

            saveSourceRelinkRecord({
              schema_version: '1.0.0',
              decision_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
              relink_type: 'same_bytes_new_path',
              source_sha256: cmd.expected_sha256,

              current_path: cmd.new_source_path,
              affected_session_ids: [sid],
              lineage_action: 'relink',
              notes_ru: `Перепривязка источника сессии ${sid}`,
              notes_en: `Relink source for session ${sid}`,
              idempotency_key: cmd.idempotency_key,
              timestamp_utc: now
            });

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('source_lineage')) dependencyInvalidations.push('source_lineage');
            break;
          }

          case 'recompute_sessions': {
            db.prepare(`
              UPDATE sessions
              SET curation_revision = ?
              WHERE id = ?
            `).run(nextRev, sid);

            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('canonical_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('canonical_cache');
            if (!dependencyInvalidations.includes('comparison_cache')) dependencyInvalidations.push('comparison_cache');
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      // 5. Invalidate caches
      CanonicalComparisonService.clearCache();
      CanonicalTrendObservationService.clearCache();

      // 6. Build final successful receipt
      const receipt: BulkMutationReceipt = {
        schema_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        receipt_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        command_type: cmd.command_type,
        idempotency_key: cmd.idempotency_key,
        status: 'completed',
        total_targets: targetSessionIds.length,
        succeeded_targets: targetSessionIds,
        failed_targets: [],
        conflicted_targets: [],
        skipped_targets: [],
        before_revisions: beforeRevisions,
        after_revisions: afterRevisions,
        dependency_invalidations: dependencyInvalidations,
        timestamp_utc: now
      };

      const validatedReceipt = validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict(receipt);

      // 7. Save to idempotency ledger within the same transaction
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO bulk_mutation_idempotency (idempotency_key, command_type, payload_hash, receipt_json, created_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(cmd.idempotency_key, cmd.command_type, payloadHash, JSON.stringify(validatedReceipt), now);

      return validatedReceipt;
    });

    return tx();
  }
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/lifecycle/DataLifecyclePlannerService.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getAppDataDir, getRawLogsDir, getCorruptedLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  DATA_LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  DataLifecycleImpactPlan,
  DataLifecycleImpactSummary,
  LifecycleOperationType,
  ProfileDeletionDisposition,
  CasTokenPayload
} from '../../shared/dataLifecycleContract';
import { WorkspaceBackupService } from '../backup/WorkspaceBackupService';

const CAS_SECRET = 'cardiolab-lifecycle-cas-guard-v1';
const TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 900; // 15 minutes

export class DataLifecyclePlannerService {
  private static instance: DataLifecyclePlannerService;
  private consumedTokens: Set<string> = new Set();

  public static getInstance(): DataLifecyclePlannerService {
    if (!DataLifecyclePlannerService.instance) {
      DataLifecyclePlannerService.instance = new DataLifecyclePlannerService();
    }
    return DataLifecyclePlannerService.instance;
  }

  public getWorkspaceRevision(): string {
    return WorkspaceBackupService.getInstance().getCurrentWorkspaceRevision();
  }

  public consumeCasToken(token: string): boolean {
    if (this.consumedTokens.has(token)) {
      return false;
    }
    this.consumedTokens.add(token);
    return true;
  }

  public clearConsumedTokensForTest(): void {
    this.consumedTokens.clear();
  }

  public generateCasToken(
    operation: LifecycleOperationType,
    target_id: string | null,
    planHash: string,
    optionsHash: string
  ): { token: string; expires_at_utc: string } {
    const revision = this.getWorkspaceRevision();
    const now = new Date();
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS * 1000);

    const payload: CasTokenPayload = {
      operation,
      target_id,
      workspace_revision: revision,
      plan_hash: planHash,
      options_hash: optionsHash,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt.toISOString()
    };

    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
    const signature = crypto
      .createHmac('sha256', CAS_SECRET)
      .update(payloadStr)
      .digest('hex');

    const token = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ payload, signature })).toString('base64url');
    return { token, expires_at_utc: expiresAt.toISOString() };
  }

  public validateCasToken(
    token: string,
    expectedOperation: LifecycleOperationType,
    expectedTargetId: string | null,
    options?: any,
    consume: boolean = false
  ): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'CAS_TOKEN_MISSING: Токен авторизации не предоставлен' };
    }

    if (this.consumedTokens.has(token)) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: 'CAS_TOKEN_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Токен авторизации уже был использован (защита от повторного выполнения)'
      };
    }

    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64url').toString('utf8'));
      if (!decoded || !decoded.payload || !decoded.signature) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'CAS_TOKEN_MALFORMED: Некорректный формат токена' };
      }

      const { payload, signature } = decoded as { payload: CasTokenPayload; signature: string };

      // 1. Signature check
      const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
      const expectedSig = crypto
        .createHmac('sha256', CAS_SECRET)
        .update(payloadStr)
        .digest('hex');

      if (signature !== expectedSig) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'CAS_TOKEN_INVALID_SIGNATURE: Подпись токена недействительна' };
      }

      // 2. Expiration check
      const now = Date.now();
      const expiresAt = Date.parse(payload.expires_at_utc);
      if (isNaN(expiresAt) || now > expiresAt) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'CAS_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Срок действия токена предварительного плана истёк' };
      }

      // 3. Operation check
      if (payload.operation !== expectedOperation) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          error: `CAS_TOKEN_OPERATION_MISMATCH: Токен выдан для операции ${payload.operation}, а запрошена ${expectedOperation}`
        };
      }

      // 4. Target ID check
      if (String(payload.target_id || '') !== String(expectedTargetId || '')) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          error: `CAS_TOKEN_TARGET_MISMATCH: Токен выдан для объекта ${payload.target_id}, а запрошен ${expectedTargetId}`
        };
      }

      // 5. Options check if provided
      if (options !== undefined) {
        const currentOptsHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(options)).digest('hex');
        if (payload.options_hash && payload.options_hash !== currentOptsHash) {
          return { valid: false, error: 'CAS_TOKEN_OPTIONS_MISMATCH: Параметры операции изменились с момента расчёта плана' };
        }
      }

      // 6. Workspace revision check
      const currentRevision = this.getWorkspaceRevision();
      if (payload.workspace_revision !== currentRevision) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          error: 'WORKSPACE_REVISION_DRIFT: Рабочая область изменилась во время ожидания. Требуется повторный предварительный просмотр'
        };
      }

      if (consume) {
        this.consumedTokens.add(token);
      }

      return { valid: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { valid: false, error: `CAS_TOKEN_ERROR: Ошибка проверки токена (${err.message})` };
    }
  }

  public async generatePlan(
    operation: LifecycleOperationType,
    target_id: string | null,
    options: any = {}
  ): Promise<DataLifecycleImpactPlan> {
    const db = getDb();
    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const filesToDelete: string[] = [];
    const retainedSummary: string[] = [];
    const externalReferencesUntouched: string[] = [];

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: 0,
      annotations_count: 0,
      named_windows_count: 0,
      diary_entries_count: 0,
      metrics_records_count: 0,
      candidate_flags_count: 0,
      app_files_count: 0,
      profiles_count: 0
    };

    let bytesReclaimedEstimate = 0;
    let targetLabel = target_id || 'Общая рабочая область';

    switch (operation) {
      case 'archive_session':
      case 'restore_session': {
        if (!target_id) {
          blockers.push('Не указан идентификатор сессии.');
          break;
        }
        const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, start_time, duration_seconds, assignment_status FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        if (!session) {
          blockers.push(`Сессия с ID "${target_id}" не найдена.`);
          break;
        }
        targetLabel = `Сессия ${session.start_time ? new Date(session.start_time).toLocaleString('ru-RU') : target_id}`;
        summary.sessions_count = 1;
        retainedSummary.push('Все исходные файлы сигналов (.txt.gz) сохраняются без изменений.');
        retainedSummary.push('Все аннотации, окна, дневниковые записи и метрики сохраняются.');
        if (operation === 'archive_session') {
          warnings.push('Сессия будет скрыта из стандартных списков и исключена из трендов.');
        } else {
          retainedSummary.push('Сессия восстанавливается в активный статус.');
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'purge_derived': {
        if (!target_id) {
          blockers.push('Не указан идентификатор сессии.');
          break;
        }
        const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, start_time FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        if (!session) {
          blockers.push(`Сессия с ID "${target_id}" не найдена.`);
          break;
        }
        targetLabel = `Сессия ${session.start_time ? new Date(session.start_time).toLocaleString('ru-RU') : target_id}`;
        summary.sessions_count = 1;

        const metricsRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.metrics_records_count = (metricsRow?.cnt || 0);

        const qcRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.metrics_records_count += (qcRow?.cnt || 0);

        const flagsRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.candidate_flags_count = (flagsRow?.cnt || 0);

        retainedSummary.push('Исходные файлы ЭКГ/RR/ЧСС/АКК остаются в хранилище без изменений.');
        retainedSummary.push('Пользовательские аннотации, размеченные окна и записи LLM-дневника сохраняются.');
        retainedSummary.push('Метрики могут быть пересчитаны повторно в любой момент.');
        bytesReclaimedEstimate = (summary.metrics_records_count + summary.candidate_flags_count) * 2048;
        break;
      }

      case 'purge_source': {
        if (!target_id) {
          blockers.push('Не указан идентификатор сессии.');
          break;
        }
        const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, start_time FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        if (!session) {
          blockers.push(`Сессия с ID "${target_id}" не найдена.`);
          break;
        }
        targetLabel = `Сессия ${session.start_time ? new Date(session.start_time).toLocaleString('ru-RU') : target_id}`;
        summary.sessions_count = 1;

        const annRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.annotations_count = (annRow?.cnt || 0);

        const winRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_named_windows WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.named_windows_count = (winRow?.cnt || 0);

        const diaryRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM llm_diary WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.diary_entries_count = (diaryRow?.cnt || 0);

        const metricsRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.metrics_records_count = (metricsRow?.cnt || 0);

        const flagsRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        summary.candidate_flags_count = (flagsRow?.cnt || 0);

        // Check raw log references
        const signals = db.prepare(`
          SELECT f.id, f.filename, f.sha256_hash 
          FROM session_signals ss
          JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
          WHERE ss.session_id = ?
        `).all(target_id) as any[];

        const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
        for (const sig of signals) {
          // Check if file is shared with any other session
          const refCountRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as ref_count 
            FROM session_signals 
            WHERE file_id = ? AND session_id != ?
          `).get(sig.id, target_id) as any;

          const otherRefs = refCountRow?.ref_count || 0;
          const candidatePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, sig.filename);

          if (otherRefs === 0) {
            if (fs.existsSync(candidatePath)) {
              filesToDelete.push(candidatePath);
              summary.app_files_count++;
              try {
                bytesReclaimedEstimate += fs.statSync(candidatePath).size;
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          } else {
            retainedSummary.push(`Файл ${sig.filename} используется другой сессией (${otherRefs} ссылок) и сохраняется.`);
          }
        }

        // Check external sync folder references
        try {
          const syncEntries = db.prepare('SELECT source_file_path FROM sync_ledger WHERE session_id = ?').all(target_id) as any[];
          for (const se of syncEntries) {
            if (se.source_file_path) {
              externalReferencesUntouched.push(se.source_file_path);
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        warnings.push('Удаление сессии необратимо. Будут удалены аннотации и размеченные окна.');
        break;
      }

      case 'delete_profile': {
        if (!target_id) {
          blockers.push('Не указан идентификатор профиля.');
          break;
        }

        const profile = db.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
        if (!profile) {
          blockers.push(`Профиль с ID "${target_id}" не найден.`);
          break;
        }

        targetLabel = `Профиль "${profile.display_name}" (ID: ${profile.id})`;

        // Default profile protection
        if (String(profile.id) === '1' || profile.display_name === 'Основной профиль') {
          blockers.push('Защита основного профиля: удаление основного профиля приложения запрещено.');
          break;
        }

        summary.profiles_count = 1;
        const disp: ProfileDeletionDisposition = options.disposition;

        if (!disp || !['reassign_to_selected_profile', 'detach_as_unassigned', 'cancel'].includes(disp)) {
          blockers.push('Требуется явный выбор стратегии обращения с данными: переназначение, открепление или отмена.');
        } else if (disp === 'cancel') {
          retainedSummary.push('Операция отменена. Никакие данные не изменяются.');
        } else if (disp === 'reassign_to_selected_profile') {
          const targetProfileId = options.target_profile_id;
          if (!targetProfileId) {
            blockers.push('Не указан целевой профиль для переназначения сессий.');
          } else if (String(targetProfileId) === String(target_id)) {
            blockers.push('Целевой профиль не может совпадать с удаляемым профилем.');
          } else {
            const targetProf = db.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(targetProfileId) as any;
            if (!targetProf) {
              blockers.push(`Целевой профиль с ID "${targetProfileId}" не существует.`);
            } else {
              const sessionsCountRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
              summary.sessions_count = (sessionsCountRow?.cnt || 0);
              retainedSummary.push(`Все ${summary.sessions_count} сессий будут безопасно переназначены профилю "${targetProf.display_name}".`);
              retainedSummary.push('Все аннотации, размеченные окна и дневниковые записи сохраняются.');
            }
          }
        } else if (disp === 'detach_as_unassigned') {
          const sessionsCountRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?').get(target_id) as any;
          summary.sessions_count = (sessionsCountRow?.cnt || 0);
          retainedSummary.push(`Все ${summary.sessions_count} сессий остаются в базе данных без привязки к удалённому профилю (непривязанные сессии).`);
          retainedSummary.push('Ни одна сессия или файл не удаляются.');
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'cleanup_storage': {
        targetLabel = 'Хранилище приложения (кэш, старые копии, журналы)';
        const backupsDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'backups');
        const logsDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'logs');
        const stagingDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'staging');
        const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

        const keepBackups = options.keep_latest_backups_count ?? 5;
        const maxBackupAgeDays = options.max_backup_age_days ?? 30;
        const maxLogAgeDays = options.max_log_age_days ?? 14;
        const now = Date.now();

        // 1. Backups check
        if (fs.existsSync(backupsDir)) {
          const files = fs.readdirSync(backupsDir)
            .filter(f => f.endsWith('.cardiolab-backup') || f.endsWith('.zip'))
            .map(f => {
              const full = path.join(backupsDir, f);
              const stat = fs.statSync(full);
              return { name: f, path: full, size: stat.size, mtime: stat.mtimeMs };
            })
            .sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime);

          // Retain latest N backups regardless of age
          const candidates = files.slice(keepBackups);
          for (const b of candidates) {
            const ageDays = (now - b.mtime) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
            if (ageDays > maxBackupAgeDays) {
              filesToDelete.push(b.path);
              summary.app_files_count++;
              bytesReclaimedEstimate += b.size;
            }
          }
          retainedSummary.push(`Сохраняются последние ${Math.min(files.length, keepBackups)} резервных копий.`);
        }

        // 2. Logs check
        if (fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
          const logFiles = fs.readdirSync(logsDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.log'));
          for (const lf of logFiles) {
            const full = path.join(logsDir, lf);
            try {
              const stat = fs.statSync(full);
              const ageDays = (now - stat.mtimeMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
              if (ageDays > maxLogAgeDays) {
                filesToDelete.push(full);
                summary.app_files_count++;
                bytesReclaimedEstimate += stat.size;
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }

        // 3. Staging temp check
        if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
          const stagingFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagingDir);
          for (const sf of stagingFiles) {
            const full = path.join(stagingDir, sf);
            try {
              const stat = fs.statSync(full);
              filesToDelete.push(full);
              summary.app_files_count++;
              bytesReclaimedEstimate += stat.size;
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }

        // 4. Orphan raw logs check
        if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
          const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
          const knownFiles = new Set(
            (db.prepare('SELECT filename FROM ingested_files').all() as any[]).map(r => r.filename)
          );
          for (const rf of rawFiles) {
            if (!knownFiles.has(rf)) {
              const full = path.join(rawLogsDir, rf);
              try {
                const stat = fs.statSync(full);
                filesToDelete.push(full);
                summary.app_files_count++;
                bytesReclaimedEstimate += stat.size;
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          }
        }

        retainedSummary.push('Все активные сессии, сырые сигналы и пользовательские аннотации сохраняются.');
        retainedSummary.push('Внешние каталоги синхронизации и экспорты пользователя не затрагиваются.');
        break;
      }

      case 'reset_workspace': {
        targetLabel = 'Вся рабочая область CardioLab';
        const sessionsCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sessions').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;
        const usersCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM users').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;
        const annCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_annotations').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;
        const winCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_named_windows').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;
        const diaryCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM llm_diary').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;
        const metricsCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_metrics').get() as any)?.cnt || 0;

        summary.sessions_count = sessionsCnt;
        summary.profiles_count = usersCnt;
        summary.annotations_count = annCnt;
        summary.named_windows_count = winCnt;
        summary.diary_entries_count = diaryCnt;
        summary.metrics_records_count = metricsCnt;

        const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
        if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
          const files = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
          summary.app_files_count = files.length;
          for (const f of files) {
            try {
              bytesReclaimedEstimate += fs.statSync(path.join(rawLogsDir, f)).size;
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }

        try {
          const dbPath = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'cardio_lab.db');
          if (fs.existsSync(dbPath)) {
            bytesReclaimedEstimate += fs.statSync(dbPath).size;
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        if (options.create_safety_snapshot !== false) {
          retainedSummary.push('Перед сбросом будет создана проверенная контрольная резервная копия рабочей области.');
        } else {
          warnings.push('Внимание: запрошен сброс БЕЗ создания резервной копии. Данные будут удалены безвозвратно.');
        }

        retainedSummary.push('Файлы в исходных внешних каталогах синхронизации и ранее экспортированные отчёты остаются нетронутыми.');
        warnings.push('Операция требует точного текстового подтверждения "СБРОСИТЬ ДАННЫЕ".');
        break;
      }

      default:
        blockers.push(`Неизвестный тип операции жизненного цикла: ${operation}`);
    }

    const planHashInput = JSON.stringify({
      operation,
      target_id,
      summary,
      filesToDelete: filesToDelete.map(f => path.basename(f)),
      blockers
    });
    const planHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(planHashInput).digest('hex');
    const optionsHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(options || {})).digest('hex');

    const { token, expires_at_utc } = this.generateCasToken(operation, target_id, planHash, optionsHash);
    const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();

    return {
      schema_version: DATA_LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      operation,
      target_id,
      target_label: targetLabel,
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed_estimate: bytesReclaimedEstimate,
      files_to_delete: filesToDelete,
      retained_records_summary: retainedSummary,
      external_references_untouched: externalReferencesUntouched,
      blockers,
      warnings,
      workspace_revision: this.getWorkspaceRevision(),
      cas_token: token,
      generated_at_utc: nowUtc,
      expires_at_utc
    };
  }
}

import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  ProfileDeletionDisposition,
  DataLifecycleReceipt,
  DataLifecycleImpactSummary
} from '../../shared/dataLifecycleContract';
import { DataLifecyclePlannerService } from './DataLifecyclePlannerService';

export class ProfileLifecycleService {
  private static instance: ProfileLifecycleService;

  public static getInstance(): ProfileLifecycleService {
    if (!ProfileLifecycleService.instance) {
      ProfileLifecycleService.instance = new ProfileLifecycleService();
    }
    return ProfileLifecycleService.instance;
  }

  public async deleteProfile(
    profileId: string,
    disposition: ProfileDeletionDisposition,
    targetProfileId?: string | null,
    casToken?: string
  ): Promise<DataLifecycleReceipt> {
    if (!profileId || typeof profileId !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Идентификатор профиля не указан');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const profile = db.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(profileId) as any;
    if (!profile) {
      throw new Error(`Профиль с ID "${profileId}" не найден`);
    }

    // Default profile protection invariant
    if (String(profile.id) === '1' || profile.display_name === 'Основной профиль') {
      throw new Error('Защита основного профиля: удаление основного профиля приложения строго запрещено');
    }

    // Validate disposition mode
    if (!disposition || !['reassign_to_selected_profile', 'detach_as_unassigned', 'cancel'].includes(disposition)) {
      throw new Error('Требуется явный выбор стратегии: переназначение, открепление или отмена');
    }

    // Validate CAS Token
    if (casToken) {
      const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
      const expectedOptions: any = { disposition };
      if (disposition === 'reassign_to_selected_profile' && targetProfileId) {
        expectedOptions.target_profile_id = targetProfileId;
      }
      const val = planner.validateCasToken(casToken, 'delete_profile', profileId, expectedOptions, true);
      if (!val.valid) {
        throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для удаления профиля');
      }
    }

    if (disposition === 'cancel') {
      logger.info('lifecycle', `[ProfileLifecycle] Deletion of profile ${profileId} was cancelled by user.`);
      return {
        receipt_id: `rcpt_prof_cancel_${profileId}_${Date.now()}`,
        operation: 'delete_profile',
        target_id: profileId,
        target_label: `Профиль ${profile.display_name}`,
        executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        cas_token: casToken || '',
        items_affected: {
          sessions_count: 0,
          annotations_count: 0,
          named_windows_count: 0,
          diary_entries_count: 0,
          metrics_records_count: 0,
          candidate_flags_count: 0,
          app_files_count: 0,
          profiles_count: 0
        },
        bytes_reclaimed: 0,
        deleted_files: [],
        external_files_untouched_count: 0,
        safety_snapshot_created: false
      };
    }

    let targetProfile: any = null;
    if (disposition === 'reassign_to_selected_profile') {
      if (!targetProfileId) {
        throw new Error('Не указан целевой профиль для переназначения сессий');
      }
      if (String(targetProfileId) === String(profileId)) {
        throw new Error('Целевой профиль не может совпадать с удаляемым профилем');
      }
      targetProfile = db.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(targetProfileId) as any;
      if (!targetProfile) {
        throw new Error(`Целевой профиль с ID "${targetProfileId}" не найден`);
      }
    }

    // Measure affected counts
    const sessionsCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?').get(profileId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const annCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_annotations WHERE user_id = ?').get(profileId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const winCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_named_windows WHERE user_id = ?').get(profileId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const diaryCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM llm_diary WHERE user_id = ?').get(profileId) as any)?.cnt || 0;

    // Execute atomic disposition and deletion
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      if (disposition === 'reassign_to_selected_profile') {
        const targetId = targetProfileId!;
        db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET user_id = ?, assignment_status = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(
          targetId,
          'assigned',
          profileId
        );
        try {
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_annotations SET user_id = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(targetId, profileId);
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_named_windows SET user_id = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(targetId, profileId);
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
          db.prepare('UPDATE llm_diary SET user_id = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(targetId, profileId);
        } catch (_) {}
      } else if (disposition === 'detach_as_unassigned') {
        db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET user_id = NULL, assignment_status = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(
          'unassigned',
          profileId
        );
        try {
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_annotations SET user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = ?').run(profileId);
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_named_windows SET user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = ?').run(profileId);
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Delete the profile
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?').run(profileId);

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    logger.info(
      'lifecycle',
      `[ProfileLifecycle] Deleted profile ${profileId} ("${profile.display_name}") with disposition ${disposition}`
    );

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: sessionsCnt,
      annotations_count: annCnt,
      named_windows_count: winCnt,
      diary_entries_count: diaryCnt,
      metrics_records_count: 0,
      candidate_flags_count: 0,
      app_files_count: 0,
      profiles_count: 1
    };

    return {
      receipt_id: `rcpt_prof_del_${profileId}_${Date.now()}`,
      operation: 'delete_profile',
      target_id: profileId,
      target_label: `Профиль ${profile.display_name}`,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      cas_token: casToken || '',
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed: 0,
      deleted_files: [],
      external_files_untouched_count: 0,
      safety_snapshot_created: false
    };
  }
}
