import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  DataLifecycleReceipt,
  DataLifecycleImpactSummary
} from '../../shared/dataLifecycleContract';
import { DataLifecyclePlannerService } from './DataLifecyclePlannerService';

export class SessionLifecycleService {
  private static instance: SessionLifecycleService;

  public static getInstance(): SessionLifecycleService {
    if (!SessionLifecycleService.instance) {
      SessionLifecycleService.instance = new SessionLifecycleService();
    }
    return SessionLifecycleService.instance;
  }

  public async archiveSession(sessionId: string, casToken: string): Promise<DataLifecycleReceipt> {
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(casToken, 'archive_session', sessionId, undefined, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для архивации сессии');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, assignment_status FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`Сессия "${sessionId}" не найдена`);
    }

    db.prepare("UPDATE sessions SET assignment_status = 'ignored' WHERE id = ?").run(sessionId);
    logger.info('lifecycle', `[SessionLifecycle] Session ${sessionId} archived (ignored)`);

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: 1,
      annotations_count: 0,
      named_windows_count: 0,
      diary_entries_count: 0,
      metrics_records_count: 0,
      candidate_flags_count: 0,
      app_files_count: 0,
      profiles_count: 0
    };

    return {
      receipt_id: `rcpt_archive_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`,
      operation: 'archive_session',
      target_id: sessionId,
      target_label: `Сессия ${sessionId}`,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      cas_token: casToken,
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed: 0,
      deleted_files: [],
      external_files_untouched_count: 0,
      safety_snapshot_created: false
    };
  }

  public async restoreSession(sessionId: string, casToken: string): Promise<DataLifecycleReceipt> {
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(casToken, 'restore_session', sessionId, undefined, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для восстановления сессии');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`Сессия "${sessionId}" не найдена`);
    }

    const newStatus = (session.user_id && String(session.user_id).trim().length > 0) ? 'assigned' : 'unassigned';
    db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET assignment_status = ? WHERE id = ?').run(newStatus, sessionId);
    logger.info('lifecycle', `[SessionLifecycle] Session ${sessionId} restored with status ${newStatus}`);

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: 1,
      annotations_count: 0,
      named_windows_count: 0,
      diary_entries_count: 0,
      metrics_records_count: 0,
      candidate_flags_count: 0,
      app_files_count: 0,
      profiles_count: 0
    };

    return {
      receipt_id: `rcpt_restore_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`,
      operation: 'restore_session',
      target_id: sessionId,
      target_label: `Сессия ${sessionId}`,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      cas_token: casToken,
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed: 0,
      deleted_files: [],
      external_files_untouched_count: 0,
      safety_snapshot_created: false
    };
  }

  public async purgeDerivedMetrics(sessionId: string, casToken: string): Promise<DataLifecycleReceipt> {
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(casToken, 'purge_derived', sessionId, undefined, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для очистки производных метрик');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`Сессия "${sessionId}" не найдена`);
    }

    const mCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const qCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const fCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;

    // Execute atomic cleanup of derived records
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    logger.info('lifecycle', `[SessionLifecycle] Purged derived metrics for session ${sessionId}`);

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: 1,
      annotations_count: 0,
      named_windows_count: 0,
      diary_entries_count: 0,
      metrics_records_count: mCnt + qCnt,
      candidate_flags_count: fCnt,
      app_files_count: 0,
      profiles_count: 0
    };

    return {
      receipt_id: `rcpt_purge_derived_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`,
      operation: 'purge_derived',
      target_id: sessionId,
      target_label: `Сессия ${sessionId}`,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      cas_token: casToken,
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed: (mCnt + qCnt + fCnt) * 2048,
      deleted_files: [],
      external_files_untouched_count: 0,
      safety_snapshot_created: false
    };
  }

  public async purgeSourceSession(sessionId: string, casToken: string): Promise<DataLifecycleReceipt> {
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(casToken, 'purge_source', sessionId, undefined, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для удаления сессии');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`Сессия "${sessionId}" не найдена`);
    }

    const annCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const winCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_named_windows WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const diaryCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM llm_diary WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const mCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const qCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;
    const fCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any)?.cnt || 0;

    // Check raw log references
    const signals = db.prepare(`
      SELECT f.id, f.filename 
      FROM session_signals ss
      JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
      WHERE ss.session_id = ?
    `).all(sessionId) as any[];

    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    const filesToDelete: string[] = [];
    const fileIdsToDelete: string[] = [];
    let bytesReclaimed = 0;

    for (const sig of signals) {
      const refCountRow = db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as ref_count 
        FROM session_signals 
        WHERE file_id = ? AND session_id != ?
      `).get(sig.id, sessionId) as any;

      if ((refCountRow?.ref_count || 0) === 0) {
        fileIdsToDelete.push(sig.id);
        const candidatePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, sig.filename);
        if (fs.existsSync(candidatePath)) {
          filesToDelete.push(candidatePath);
          try {
            bytesReclaimed += fs.statSync(candidatePath).size;
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    }

    // Check external sync count
    let externalUntouchedCount = 0;
    try {
      const syncEntries = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sync_ledger WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
      externalUntouchedCount = syncEntries?.cnt || 0;
    } catch (_) {}

    // Atomic database cleanup
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_signals WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_named_windows WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM llm_diary WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      try {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM sync_ledger WHERE session_id = ?').run(sessionId);
      } catch (_) {}

      for (const fid of fileIdsToDelete) {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM ingested_files WHERE id = ?').run(fid);
      }

      db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').run(sessionId);
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    // Delete unlinked app-owned raw files
    const successfullyDeletedFiles: string[] = [];
    for (const fp of filesToDelete) {
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
          fs.unlinkSync(fp);
          successfullyDeletedFiles.push(fp);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.warn('lifecycle', `[SessionLifecycle] Failed to unlink raw log file ${fp}: ${err.message}`);
      }
    }

    logger.info('lifecycle', `[SessionLifecycle] Session ${sessionId} source purged (${successfullyDeletedFiles.length} raw files unlinked)`);

    const summary: DataLifecycleImpactSummary = {
      sessions_count: 1,
      annotations_count: annCnt,
      named_windows_count: winCnt,
      diary_entries_count: diaryCnt,
      metrics_records_count: mCnt + qCnt,
      candidate_flags_count: fCnt,
      app_files_count: successfullyDeletedFiles.length,
      profiles_count: 0
    };

    return {
      receipt_id: `rcpt_purge_source_${sessionId}_${Date.now()}`,
      operation: 'purge_source',
      target_id: sessionId,
      target_label: `Сессия ${sessionId}`,
      executed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      cas_token: casToken,
      items_affected: summary,
      bytes_reclaimed: bytesReclaimed,
      deleted_files: successfullyDeletedFiles,
      external_files_untouched_count: externalUntouchedCount,
      safety_snapshot_created: false
    };
  }
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/lifecycle/StorageMaintenanceService.ts
================================================================================
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { getDb, getAppDataDir, getRawLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  StorageCleanupCandidate,
  StorageMaintenanceScanResult,
  StorageCleanupOptions,
  StorageCleanupResult
} from '../../shared/dataLifecycleContract';
import { DataLifecyclePlannerService } from './DataLifecyclePlannerService';

export class StorageMaintenanceService {
  private static instance: StorageMaintenanceService;

  public static getInstance(): StorageMaintenanceService {
    if (!StorageMaintenanceService.instance) {
      StorageMaintenanceService.instance = new StorageMaintenanceService();
    }
    return StorageMaintenanceService.instance;
  }

  public async scanStorage(): Promise<StorageMaintenanceScanResult> {
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const backupsDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'backups');
    const logsDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'logs');
    const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'staging');
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    const db = getDb();

    const candidates: StorageCleanupCandidate[] = [];
    let totalAppDataBytes = 0;
    let reclaimableBytes = 0;
    let pinnedBackupsCount = 0;

    // Check pinned backups from DB
    const pinnedBackupPaths = new Set<string>();
    try {
      const records = db.prepare(`
        SELECT archive_path FROM backup_records 
        WHERE (notes LIKE '%pin%' OR notes LIKE '%lock%' OR notes LIKE '%protect%')
      `).all() as any[];
      for (const r of records) {
        if (r.archive_path) pinnedBackupPaths.add(path.resolve(r.archive_path).toLowerCase());
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 1. Scan backups
    if (fs.existsSync(backupsDir)) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(backupsDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.cardiolab-backup') || f.endsWith('.zip'));
      const sortedBackups = files.map(f => {
        const fp = path.join(backupsDir, f);
        const stat = fs.statSync(fp);
        return { name: f, path: fp, size: stat.size, mtime: stat.mtimeMs, mtimeIso: stat.mtime.toISOString() };
      }).sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime);

      // Keep latest 5 by default; older are candidates
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedBackups.length; i++) {
        const b = sortedBackups[i];
        totalAppDataBytes += b.size;
        const isPinned = pinnedBackupPaths.has(path.resolve(b.path).toLowerCase());
        if (isPinned) {
          pinnedBackupsCount++;
          continue;
        }

        if (i >= 5) {
          candidates.push({
            category: 'backup_snapshot',
            file_path: b.path,
            file_name: b.name,
            size_bytes: b.size,
            last_modified_utc: b.mtimeIso,
            reason: `Резервная копия за пределами последних 5 снимков (позиция #${i + 1})`,
            is_safe_to_delete: true
          });
          reclaimableBytes += b.size;
        }
      }
    }

    // 2. Scan logs
    if (fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
      const logFiles = fs.readdirSync(logsDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.log'));
      const now = Date.now();
      for (const lf of logFiles) {
        const fp = path.join(logsDir, lf);
        try {
          const stat = fs.statSync(fp);
          totalAppDataBytes += stat.size;
          const ageDays = (now - stat.mtimeMs) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
          if (ageDays > 14) {
            candidates.push({
              category: 'runtime_log',
              file_path: fp,
              file_name: lf,
              size_bytes: stat.size,
              last_modified_utc: stat.mtime.toISOString(),
              reason: `Журнал приложения старше 14 дней (${Math.round(ageDays)} дн.)`,
              is_safe_to_delete: true
            });
            reclaimableBytes += stat.size;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 3. Scan staging temp
    if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
      const sFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagingDir);
      for (const sf of sFiles) {
        const fp = path.join(stagingDir, sf);
        try {
          const stat = fs.statSync(fp);
          totalAppDataBytes += stat.size;
          candidates.push({
            category: 'staging_temp',
            file_path: fp,
            file_name: sf,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            last_modified_utc: stat.mtime.toISOString(),
            reason: 'Временный файл незавершённого импорта/распаковки',
            is_safe_to_delete: true
          });
          reclaimableBytes += stat.size;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 4. Scan orphan raw logs
    if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
      const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
      const knownFiles = new Set(
        (db.prepare('SELECT filename FROM ingested_files').all() as any[]).map(r => r.filename)
      );
      for (const rf of rawFiles) {
        const fp = path.join(rawLogsDir, rf);
        try {
          const stat = fs.statSync(fp);
          totalAppDataBytes += stat.size;
          if (!knownFiles.has(rf)) {
            candidates.push({
              category: 'orphan_raw_log',
              file_path: fp,
              file_name: rf,
              size_bytes: stat.size,
              last_modified_utc: stat.mtime.toISOString(),
              reason: 'Сырой лог без записи в каталоге ingested_files',
              is_safe_to_delete: true
            });
            reclaimableBytes += stat.size;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // Measure DB size
    try {
      const dbPath = path.join(appDataDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
      if (fs.existsSync(dbPath)) {
        totalAppDataBytes += fs.statSync(dbPath).size;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Measure external references
    let externalCount = 0;
    try {
      const sfRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM external_sync_folders').get() as any;
      externalCount = sfRow?.cnt || 0;
    } catch (_) {}

    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const plan = await planner.generatePlan('cleanup_storage', null);

    return {
      scan_time_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      total_app_data_bytes: totalAppDataBytes,
      candidates,
      total_reclaimable_bytes: reclaimableBytes,
      pinned_backups_count: pinnedBackupsCount,
      external_references_count: externalCount,
      cas_token: plan.cas_token,
      workspace_revision: plan.workspace_revision
    };
  }

  public async cleanupStorage(options: StorageCleanupOptions): Promise<StorageCleanupResult> {
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(options.cas_token, 'cleanup_storage', null, undefined, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для очистки хранилища');
    }

    const scan = await this.scanStorage();
    const selectedCats = new Set(
      options.selected_categories || ['backup_snapshot', 'runtime_log', 'staging_temp', 'orphan_raw_log']
    );

    const deletedFiles: string[] = [];
    const skippedFiles: string[] = [];
    let bytesReclaimed = 0;

    for (const c of scan.candidates) {
      if (!selectedCats.has(c.category) || !c.is_safe_to_delete) {
        skippedFiles.push(c.file_path);
        continue;
      }

      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(c.file_path)) {
          const stat = fs.statSync(c.file_path);
          if (stat.isDirectory()) {
            fs.rmSync(c.file_path, { recursive: true, force: true });
          } else {
            fs.unlinkSync(c.file_path);
          }
          deletedFiles.push(c.file_path);
          bytesReclaimed += c.size_bytes;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.warn('lifecycle', `[StorageMaintenance] Failed to delete candidate ${c.file_path}: ${err.message}`);
        skippedFiles.push(c.file_path);
      }
    }

    logger.info(
      'lifecycle',
      `[StorageMaintenance] Storage cleanup completed: ${deletedFiles.length} files removed, ${bytesReclaimed} bytes reclaimed`
    );

    return {
      cleaned_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      deleted_files_count: deletedFiles.length,
      bytes_reclaimed: bytesReclaimed,
      deleted_files: deletedFiles,
      skipped_files: skippedFiles
    };
  }
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/lifecycle/WorkspaceResetService.ts
================================================================================
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { getDb, closeDb, initDb, getAppDataDir, getRawLogsDir, getCorruptedLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  WorkspaceResetOptions,
  WorkspaceResetResult,
  WORKSPACE_RESET_CONFIRMATION_PHRASES
} from '../../shared/dataLifecycleContract';
import { DataLifecyclePlannerService } from './DataLifecyclePlannerService';
import { WorkspaceBackupService } from '../backup/WorkspaceBackupService';

export class WorkspaceResetService {
  private static instance: WorkspaceResetService;

  public static getInstance(): WorkspaceResetService {
    if (!WorkspaceResetService.instance) {
      WorkspaceResetService.instance = new WorkspaceResetService();
    }
    return WorkspaceResetService.instance;
  }

  public async resetWorkspace(options: WorkspaceResetOptions): Promise<WorkspaceResetResult> {
    if (!options) {
      throw new Error('Параметры сброса рабочей области не предоставлены');
    }

    // 1. Validate confirmation phrase
    const normalizedConfirmation = (options.confirmation_text || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const isValidPhrase = (WORKSPACE_RESET_CONFIRMATION_PHRASES as readonly string[]).includes(normalizedConfirmation);
    if (!isValidPhrase) {
      throw new Error(
        `Неверный текст подтверждения: введено "${options.confirmation_text}". Требуется ввести "СБРОСИТЬ ДАННЫЕ" для подтверждения необратимого действия.`
      );
    }

    // 2. Validate CAS Token
    const planner = DataLifecyclePlannerService.getInstance();
    const val = planner.validateCasToken(options.cas_token, 'reset_workspace', null, {
      create_safety_snapshot: options.create_safety_snapshot,
      confirmation_text: options.confirmation_text
    }, true);
    if (!val.valid) {
      throw new Error(val.error || 'Недействительный CAS-токен для сброса рабочей области');
    }

    let safetySnapshotPath: string | null = null;
    let safetySnapshotSha256: string | null = null;

    // 3. Optional Safety Snapshot
    if (options.create_safety_snapshot !== false) {
      logger.info('lifecycle', '[WorkspaceReset] Creating verified pre-reset safety snapshot...');
      try {
        const backupResult = await WorkspaceBackupService.getInstance().createBackup({
          includeQuarantine: true
        });
        safetySnapshotPath = backupResult.backupPath;
        safetySnapshotSha256 = backupResult.sha256;
        logger.info(
          'lifecycle',
          `[WorkspaceReset] Safety snapshot created at ${safetySnapshotPath} (SHA-256: ${safetySnapshotSha256})`
        );
      } catch (err: any) {
        throw new Error(`Не удалось создать резервную копию безопасности перед сбросом: ${err.message}. Сброс отменён.`);
      }
    } else {
      logger.warn('lifecycle', '[WorkspaceReset] Explicit no-backup reset requested. Proceeding without safety backup.');
    }

    // 4. Quiesce & Close Database
    logger.info('lifecycle', '[WorkspaceReset] Quiescing writers and closing database connection...');
    closeDb();

    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const liveDbPath = path.join(appDataDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
    const liveWal = `${liveDbPath}-wal`;
    const liveShm = `${liveDbPath}-shm`;

    const preResetBackupDir = path.join(appDataDir, `.pre_reset_bak_${Date.now()}`);
    fs.mkdirSync(preResetBackupDir, { recursive: true });
    const rawLogsBackupDir = path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'raw_logs');
    const corruptLogsBackupDir = path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'corrupted');
    fs.mkdirSync(rawLogsBackupDir, { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(corruptLogsBackupDir, { recursive: true });

    let preResetFilesMoved = false;

    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    const corruptDir = getCorruptedLogsDir();

    try {
      // 5. Atomic Preserving Move of DB
      if (fs.existsSync(liveDbPath)) {
        fs.copyFileSync(liveDbPath, path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db'));
        fs.unlinkSync(liveDbPath);
        preResetFilesMoved = true;
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(liveWal)) {
        fs.copyFileSync(liveWal, path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db-wal'));
        try { fs.unlinkSync(liveWal); } catch (_) {}
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(liveShm)) {
        fs.copyFileSync(liveShm, path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db-shm'));
        try { fs.unlinkSync(liveShm); } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Back up raw logs before clearing
      if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
        for (const rf of rawFiles) {
          try {
            fs.copyFileSync(path.join(rawLogsDir, rf), path.join(rawLogsBackupDir, rf));
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      // Back up corrupted logs before clearing
      if (fs.existsSync(corruptDir)) {
        const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(corruptDir);
        for (const cf of corruptFiles) {
          try {
            fs.copyFileSync(path.join(corruptDir, cf), path.join(corruptLogsBackupDir, cf));
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      // 6. Clear app-owned raw logs, corrupted quarantine, staging, and temp
      if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsDir);
        for (const rf of rawFiles) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(path.join(rawLogsDir, rf)); } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      if (fs.existsSync(corruptDir)) {
        const corruptFiles = fs.readdirSync(corruptDir);
        for (const cf of corruptFiles) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(path.join(corruptDir, cf)); } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'staging');
      if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
        const sFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagingDir);
        for (const sf of sFiles) {
          try { fs.rmSync(path.join(stagingDir, sf), { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      // 7. Initialize fresh database & verify integrity
      logger.info('lifecycle', '[WorkspaceReset] Initializing clean database...');
      const freshDb = initDb(liveDbPath);
      const integrity = freshDb.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as any;
      if (!integrity || integrity.integrity_check !== 'ok') {
        throw new Error(`Проверка целостности новой базы данных не прошла: ${integrity?.integrity_check}`);
      }

      // Ensure default user profile exists
      const defaultUser = freshDb.prepare('SELECT id, display_name FROM users WHERE id = ?').get('1') as any;
      if (!defaultUser) {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        freshDb.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)
        `).run('1', 'Основной профиль', 'Атлет', now, now);
      }

      // Clean up fallback dir on success
      try {
        fs.rmSync(preResetBackupDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch (_) {}

      logger.info('lifecycle', '[WorkspaceReset] Workspace reset completed successfully.');

      return {
        success: true,
        reset_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        safety_snapshot_path: safetySnapshotPath,
        safety_snapshot_sha256: safetySnapshotSha256,
        database_reinitialized: true,
        message_ru: 'Рабочая область CardioLab успешно сброшена в исходное состояние.'
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.error('lifecycle', `[WorkspaceReset] Reset failed: ${err.message}. Rolling back pre-reset workspace...`);
      // Rollback
      closeDb();
      const rollbackErrors: string[] = [];

      if (preResetFilesMoved) {
        try {
          const bakDb = path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
          if (fs.existsSync(bakDb)) {
            fs.copyFileSync(bakDb, liveDbPath);
          }
          const bakWal = path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db-wal');
          if (fs.existsSync(bakWal)) {
            fs.copyFileSync(bakWal, liveWal);
          }
          const bakShm = path.join(preResetBackupDir, 'cardio_lab.db-shm');
          if (fs.existsSync(bakShm)) {
            fs.copyFileSync(bakShm, liveShm);
          }
        } catch (rbErr: any) {
          logger.error('lifecycle', `[WorkspaceReset] Critical db rollback failure: ${rbErr.message}`);
          rollbackErrors.push(`БД: ${rbErr.message}`);
        }
      }

      // Restore raw logs
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(rawLogsBackupDir)) {
          const rawBakFiles = fs.readdirSync(rawLogsBackupDir);
          for (const rbf of rawBakFiles) {
            fs.copyFileSync(path.join(rawLogsBackupDir, rbf), path.join(rawLogsDir, rbf));
          }
        }
      } catch (rawRbErr: any) {
        logger.error('lifecycle', `[WorkspaceReset] Raw logs rollback failure: ${rawRbErr.message}`);
        rollbackErrors.push(`raw_logs: ${rawRbErr.message}`);
      }

      // Restore corrupted logs
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(corruptLogsBackupDir)) {
          const corruptBakFiles = fs.readdirSync(corruptLogsBackupDir);
          for (const cbf of corruptBakFiles) {
            fs.copyFileSync(path.join(corruptLogsBackupDir, cbf), path.join(corruptDir, cbf));
          }
        }
      } catch (cRbErr: any) {
        logger.error('lifecycle', `[WorkspaceReset] Corrupted logs rollback failure: ${cRbErr.message}`);
        rollbackErrors.push(`corrupted: ${cRbErr.message}`);
      }

      initDb(liveDbPath);
      if (rollbackErrors.length > 0) {
        throw new Error(`Ошибка сброса рабочей области: ${err.message}. Неполный откат: ${rollbackErrors.join(', ')}.`);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Ошибка сброса рабочей области: ${err.message}. Состояние полностью восстановлено.`);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**

 * manifests, and lineage-safe diary with optimistic concurrency control.

import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  AiPackPlan,
  AiPackPreview,
  AiPackJobSnapshot,
  AiPackManifest,
  DiaryEntrySnapshot,
  DiaryQuery,
  DiaryPage,
  AI_PACK_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_PACK_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_PACK_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_PACK_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_DIARY_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/canonical/AiDiaryContracts';

export function saveAiPackPlan(plan: AiPackPlan): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO ai_pack_plans (
      id,
      plan_hash,
      workspace_fingerprint,
      session_id,
      profile_id,
      plan_json,
      idempotency_key,
      created_at,
      expires_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      plan_hash = excluded.plan_hash,
      workspace_fingerprint = excluded.workspace_fingerprint,
      plan_json = excluded.plan_json,
      expires_at = excluded.expires_at
  `);
  stmt.run(
    plan.plan_id,
    plan.plan_hash,
    plan.workspace_fingerprint,
    plan.session_id,
    plan.profile_id,
    JSON.stringify(plan),
    plan.idempotency_key || null,
    plan.created_at_utc,
    plan.expires_at_utc
  );
}

export function getAiPackPlan(planId: string): AiPackPlan | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT plan_hash, plan_json FROM ai_pack_plans WHERE id = ?').get(planId) as { plan_hash: string; plan_json: string } | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    const plan = JSON.parse(row.plan_json) as AiPackPlan;
    if (row.plan_hash) {
      plan.plan_hash = row.plan_hash;
    }
    return plan;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getAiPackPlanByIdempotencyKey(key: string): AiPackPlan | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM ai_pack_plans WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(key) as { id: string } | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  return getAiPackPlan(row.id);
}

export function updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId: string, updates: Partial<AiPackJobSnapshot>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const current = getAiPackJob(jobId);
  if (!current) return;

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const nextStatus = updates.status || current.status;
  const nextProgress = updates.progress_percent !== undefined ? updates.progress_percent : current.progress_percent;
  const nextPackId = updates.pack_id !== undefined ? updates.pack_id : current.pack_id;
  const nextFilename = updates.zip_filename !== undefined ? updates.zip_filename : current.zip_filename;
  const nextPath = updates.zip_path !== undefined ? updates.zip_path : current.zip_path;
  const nextBytes = updates.size_bytes !== undefined ? updates.size_bytes : current.size_bytes;
  const nextSha256 = updates.sha256 !== undefined ? updates.sha256 : current.sha256;
  const nextError = updates.error_message !== undefined ? updates.error_message : current.error_message;
  const completedAt = ['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(nextStatus) ? (updates.completed_at_utc || now) : current.completed_at_utc;

  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE ai_pack_jobs SET
      status = ?,
      progress_percent = ?,
      pack_id = ?,
      zip_filename = ?,
      zip_path = ?,
      size_bytes = ?,
      sha256 = ?,
      error_message = ?,
      updated_at = ?,
      completed_at = ?
    WHERE id = ?
  `).run(
    nextStatus,
    nextProgress,
    nextPackId,
    nextFilename,
    nextPath,
    nextBytes,
    nextSha256,
    nextError,
    now,
    completedAt,
    jobId
  );
}

export function saveAiPackManifest(manifest: AiPackManifest): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO ai_pack_manifests (
      id,
      job_id,
      pack_id,
      session_id,
      profile_id,
      filename,
      size_bytes,
      sha256,
      canonical_semantic_hash,
      manifest_json,
      created_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
      filename = excluded.filename,
      size_bytes = excluded.size_bytes,
      sha256 = excluded.sha256,
      canonical_semantic_hash = excluded.canonical_semantic_hash,
      manifest_json = excluded.manifest_json
  `);
  stmt.run(
    manifest.manifest_id,
    manifest.job_id,
    manifest.pack_id,
    manifest.session_id,
    manifest.profile_id,
    manifest.filename,
    manifest.size_bytes,
    manifest.sha256,
    manifest.canonical_semantic_hash,
    JSON.stringify(manifest),
    manifest.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getAiPackManifest(manifestId: string): AiPackManifest | null {

  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(row.manifest_json) as AiPackManifest;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

  }
}

export function softRetireLlmDiary(id: string, reason?: string): DiaryEntrySnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE llm_diary
    SET is_retired = 1, retired_at_utc = ?, retire_reason = ?, optimistic_revision = COALESCE(optimistic_revision, 1) + 1, updated_at = ?
    WHERE id = ? AND (is_retired = 0 OR is_retired IS NULL)
  `).run(now, reason || null, now, id);
  if (Number(res.changes) === 0) return null;
  const updated = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  return mapRowToDiarySnapshot(updated);
}

export function restoreLlmDiary(id: string): DiaryEntrySnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE llm_diary
    SET is_retired = 0, retired_at_utc = NULL, retire_reason = NULL, optimistic_revision = COALESCE(optimistic_revision, 1) + 1, updated_at = ?
    WHERE id = ? AND is_retired = 1
  `).run(now, id);
  if (Number(res.changes) === 0) return null;
  const updated = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  return mapRowToDiarySnapshot(updated);
}

export function updateLlmDiaryMetadata(
  id: string,
  updates: {
    title?: string;
    is_favorite?: boolean;
    tags_json?: string;
    expected_revision: number;
  }
): { success: boolean; record?: DiaryEntrySnapshot; conflict?: boolean } {
  const db = getDb();
  const current = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  if (!current) {
    return { success: false };
  }

  const currentRevision = current.optimistic_revision || 1;
  if (updates.expected_revision !== currentRevision) {
    return { success: false, conflict: true };
  }

  const nextRevision = currentRevision + 1;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const newTitle = updates.title !== undefined ? updates.title : current.title;
  const newFavorite = updates.is_favorite !== undefined ? (updates.is_favorite ? 1 : 0) : current.is_favorite;
  const newTags = updates.tags_json !== undefined ? updates.tags_json : current.tags_json;

  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE llm_diary
    SET title = ?, is_favorite = ?, tags_json = ?, optimistic_revision = ?, updated_at = ?
    WHERE id = ? AND (optimistic_revision = ? OR optimistic_revision IS NULL)
  `).run(newTitle, newFavorite, newTags, nextRevision, now, id, currentRevision);

  if (Number(res.changes) === 0) {
    return { success: false, conflict: true };
  }

  const updated = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
  return {
    success: true,
    record: mapRowToDiarySnapshot(updated)
  };
}

export function getLlmDiariesPaged(query: DiaryQuery): DiaryPage {
  const db = getDb();
  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, query.limit || 20));
  const offset = Math.max(0, query.offset || 0);

  const whereClauses: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (query.profile_id) {
    whereClauses.push('d.user_id = ?');
    params.push(query.profile_id);
  }
  if (query.session_id) {
    whereClauses.push('d.session_id = ?');
    params.push(query.session_id);
  }
  if (query.activity_type) {
    whereClauses.push('d.activity_type = ?');
    params.push(query.activity_type);
  }
  if (query.provider) {
    whereClauses.push('d.provider = ?');
    params.push(query.provider);
  }
  if (query.pack_id) {
    whereClauses.push('d.pack_id = ?');
    params.push(query.pack_id);
  }
  if (query.date_from) {
    whereClauses.push('d.imported_at >= ?');
    params.push(query.date_from);
  }
  if (query.date_to) {
    whereClauses.push('d.imported_at <= ?');
    params.push(query.date_to);
  }
  if (query.favorite_only) {
    whereClauses.push('d.is_favorite = 1');
  }
  if (!query.include_retired) {
    whereClauses.push('(d.is_retired = 0 OR d.is_retired IS NULL)');
  }
  if (query.search) {
    whereClauses.push('(d.title LIKE ? OR d.response_text_plain LIKE ? OR d.tags_json LIKE ?)');
    const term = `%${query.search}%`;
    params.push(term, term, term);
  }
  if (query.currentness) {
    whereClauses.push('d.lineage_state = ?');
    params.push(query.currentness);
  }

  const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';

  const countRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total
    FROM llm_diary d
    ${whereSql}
  `).get(...params) as { total: number };

  const totalCount = countRow ? countRow.total : 0;

  const queryParams = [...params, limit, offset];
  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT d.*
    FROM llm_diary d
    ${whereSql}
    ORDER BY d.imported_at DESC, d.id DESC
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
  `).all(...queryParams) as any[];

  const items = rows.map(mapRowToDiarySnapshot);
  const hasMore = offset + items.length < totalCount;
  const nextCursor = hasMore ? String(offset + limit) : undefined;

  return {
    items,
    total_count: totalCount,
    limit,
    offset,
    has_more: hasMore,
    next_cursor: nextCursor
  };
}

export function mapRowToDiarySnapshot(row: any): DiaryEntrySnapshot {
  let tags: string[] = [];
  try {
    if (row.tags_json) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(row.tags_json);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) tags = parsed;
    }
  } catch {}

  return {
    schema_version: AI_DIARY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    id: row.id,
    profile_id: row.user_id,
    session_id: row.session_id || null,
    pack_id: row.pack_id || null,
    provider: row.provider,
    model_label: row.model_label || null,
    prompt_name: row.prompt_name || null,
    prompt_profile: row.prompt_profile || null,
    title: row.title,
    source_type: row.source_type,
    source_filename: row.source_filename || null,
    source_ext: row.source_ext || null,
    content_hash_sha256: row.content_hash_sha256,
    original_response_md: row.original_response_md || row.response_md || '',
    response_md: row.response_md,
    response_text_plain: row.response_text_plain,
    is_favorite: row.is_favorite === 1,
    is_retired: row.is_retired === 1,
    retired_at_utc: row.retired_at_utc || null,
    retire_reason: row.retire_reason || null,
    optimistic_revision: row.optimistic_revision || 1,
    tags,
    lineage_state: row.lineage_state || 'current',
    artifact_state: row.artifact_state || 'available',
    source_state: row.source_id ? 'available' : (row.session_id ? 'available' : 'unlinked'),
    created_at_utc: row.created_at,
    imported_at_utc: row.imported_at,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at
  };
}

/**
 * src/backend/llmPack/aiWorkspaceService.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G24 — Authoritative AI Interpretation Workspace & Lineage-Safe Diary Service.
 * Implements strict workspace validation, deterministic plan/preview caching,
 * staged background job compilation with member parity verification, atomic publication,
 * cancel/failure staging cleanup, and bounded response import with immutable originals.
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getUserProfile, getSessionMetrics, getAppDataDir, saveLlmPack, LlmPackRecord } from '../db/db';
import { getCanonicalSessionResult } from '../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder';
import { projectCanonicalSessionToAiPack } from '../../shared/canonical/AIInterpretationPack';

  AI_PACK_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_PACK_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  AI_PACK_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,

export class AiWorkspaceService {

  /**
   * Builds an authoritative snapshot of the AI Interpretation Workspace.
   * INVARIANT: Explicitly rejects first-session or default-profile fallback!
   */
  static async buildWorkspaceSnapshot(
    profileId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    options?: {
      promptLibraryVersion?: string;
      activeWindowId?: string;
      activeWindowRevision?: number;
      comparisonId?: string;
      longitudinalSnapshotId?: string;
    }
  ): Promise<AiInterpretationWorkspaceSnapshot> {
    if (!profileId || typeof profileId !== 'string' || profileId.trim() === '') {
      throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError('Valid profile_id is required; default-profile fallback is strictly prohibited');
    }

    const user = getUserProfile(profileId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Profile "${profileId}" does not exist; default fallback is prohibited`);
    }

    if (!sessionId || typeof sessionId !== 'string' || sessionId.trim() === '') {
      throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError('Valid session_id is required; first-session fallback is strictly prohibited');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Session "${sessionId}" does not exist; fallback is prohibited`);
    }

    if (session.user_id && session.user_id !== profileId && profileId !== 'default') {
      throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Session "${sessionId}" belongs to user "${session.user_id}", not profile "${profileId}"`);
    }

    // Validate Named Window if provided
    let validatedWindowId: string | null = null;
    let validatedWindowRevision: number | null = null;

    if (options?.activeWindowId) {
      const windowRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE id = ?').get(options.activeWindowId) as any;
      if (!windowRow || windowRow.is_active === 0) {
        throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Named window "${options.activeWindowId}" not found or retired`);
      }
      if (windowRow.session_id !== sessionId) {
        throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Named window "${options.activeWindowId}" belongs to session "${windowRow.session_id}", not "${sessionId}"`);
      }
      if (options.activeWindowRevision !== undefined && options.activeWindowRevision !== null) {
        if (windowRow.revision !== options.activeWindowRevision) {
          throw new AiWorkspaceValidationError(`Named window revision mismatch: requested v${options.activeWindowRevision}, current is v${windowRow.revision}`);
        }
      }
      validatedWindowId = windowRow.id;
      validatedWindowRevision = windowRow.revision;
    }

    // Load canonical session result
    const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId).catch(() => null);
    const dbMetrics = (getSessionMetrics(sessionId) || {}) as Record<string, any>;

    const resultHash = canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash ||
      crypto.createHash('sha256').update(sessionId + '_' + (session.start_time || '')).digest('hex');
    const ledgerHash = canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.beat_ledger_hash ||
      crypto.createHash('sha256').update('ledger_' + sessionId).digest('hex');

    // Query active plans/jobs
    const latestPlanRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM ai_pack_plans WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(sessionId) as { id: string } | undefined;

    const latestJobRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT j.id, j.status, j.pack_id FROM ai_pack_jobs j
      JOIN ai_pack_plans p ON j.plan_id = p.id
      WHERE p.session_id = ?
      ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(sessionId) as { id: string; status: string; pack_id: string } | undefined;

    const latestDiaryRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM llm_diary WHERE session_id = ? AND (is_retired = 0 OR is_retired IS NULL)
      ORDER BY imported_at DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(sessionId) as { id: string } | undefined;

    let nextSafeAction: 'CREATE_PACK_PLAN' | 'CREATE_PACK_PREVIEW' | 'CREATE_PACK_JOB' | 'IMPORT_RESPONSE' | 'READY_FOR_INTERPRETATION' = 'CREATE_PACK_PLAN';
    if (latestJobRow && latestJobRow.status === 'completed' && latestJobRow.pack_id) {
      nextSafeAction = latestDiaryRow ? 'READY_FOR_INTERPRETATION' : 'IMPORT_RESPONSE';
    } else if (latestJobRow && (latestJobRow.status === 'pending' || latestJobRow.status === 'compiling')) {
      nextSafeAction = 'CREATE_PACK_JOB';
    } else if (latestPlanRow) {
      nextSafeAction = 'CREATE_PACK_PREVIEW';
    }

    const partialSnapshot = {
      schema_version: AI_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION as typeof AI_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      profile_id: profileId,
      profile_selection_revision: 1,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_id: session.device_id || null,
      result_hash: resultHash,
      ledger_hash: ledgerHash,
      active_window_id: validatedWindowId,
      active_window_revision: validatedWindowRevision,
      comparison_id: options?.comparisonId || null,
      longitudinal_snapshot_id: options?.longitudinalSnapshotId || null,
      canonical_values: {
        avg_hr: canonicalSession?.core_metrics?.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? dbMetrics.avg_hr ?? session.avg_hr ?? null,
        max_hr: dbMetrics.max_hr ?? session.max_hr ?? null,
        duration_seconds: canonicalSession?.timing?.duration_seconds ?? session.duration_seconds ?? null,
        sdnn: canonicalSession?.core_metrics?.sdnn?.value ?? dbMetrics.sdnn ?? null,
        rmssd: canonicalSession?.core_metrics?.rmssd?.value ?? dbMetrics.rmssd ?? null,
        artifact_percent: canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.artifact_percentage ?? dbMetrics.artifact_percent ?? null
      },
      eligibility: {
        eligible_for_ai_interpretation: true,
        reasons: []
      },
      limitations: [
        'Non-diagnostic athletic conditioning analytics only',
        'Not evaluated by medical regulatory authorities'
      ],
      prompt_library_version: options?.promptLibraryVersion || '2026.1',
      privacy_defaults: { ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_AI_OPT_IN },
      entitlement: {
        allowed: true,
        status: 'valid' as const,
        limitations: []
      },
      active_plan_id: latestPlanRow?.id || null,
      active_preview_id: null,
      active_job_id: latestJobRow?.id || null,
      active_pack_id: latestJobRow?.pack_id || null,
      active_diary_id: latestDiaryRow?.id || null,
      exact_next_safe_action: nextSafeAction
    };

    const fingerprint = computeAiWorkspaceFingerprint(partialSnapshot);

    return {
      ...partialSnapshot,
      snapshot_id: `ws_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`,
      dependency_fingerprint: fingerprint,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * Creates a deterministic compilation plan for an AI Interpretation Pack.
   */
  static async createPackPlan(
    snapshot: AiInterpretationWorkspaceSnapshot,
    params: {
      promptId: string;
      promptRevision?: string;
      boundedGoal: string;
      boundedNotes?: string | null;
      optIns?: Partial<SensitiveAiOptIn>;
      locale?: string;
      timezone?: string;
      idempotencyKey?: string;
    }
  ): Promise<AiPackPlan> {
    if (params.idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = getAiPackPlanByIdempotencyKey(params.idempotencyKey);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    }

    const mergedOptIns: SensitiveAiOptIn = {
      ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_AI_OPT_IN,
      ...(params.optIns || {})
    };

    const projectedMembers: ProjectedAiPackMember[] = [
      { name: '00_manifest.json', member_class: 'manifest', estimated_bytes: 2048, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '01_athlete_profile.json', member_class: 'canonical_semantic', estimated_bytes: 1024, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '02_canonical_session_summary.json', member_class: 'canonical_semantic', estimated_bytes: 4096, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '03_hrv_recovery_analytics.json', member_class: 'canonical_projection', estimated_bytes: 4096, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '04_cardiac_drift_aerobic_coupling.json', member_class: 'canonical_projection', estimated_bytes: 4096, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '05_claims_and_evidence_ledger.json', member_class: 'canonical_projection', estimated_bytes: 8192, required_opt_ins: [] },
      { name: '06_prompt_instructions.md', member_class: 'prompt', estimated_bytes: 4096, required_opt_ins: [] }
    ];

    if (mergedOptIns.raw_series_opt_in) {
      projectedMembers.push({
        name: '07_raw_rr_series.csv',
        member_class: 'raw_physiological_series',
        estimated_bytes: 65536,
        required_opt_ins: ['raw_series_opt_in']
      });
    }

    if (mergedOptIns.ecg_opt_in) {
      projectedMembers.push({
        name: '08_ecg_sample_excerpt.csv',
        member_class: 'physiological_excerpt',
        estimated_bytes: 131072,
        required_opt_ins: ['ecg_opt_in']
      });
    }

    if (mergedOptIns.acc_opt_in) {
      projectedMembers.push({
        name: '09_acc_sample_excerpt.csv',
        member_class: 'physiological_excerpt',
        estimated_bytes: 65536,
        required_opt_ins: ['acc_opt_in']
      });
    }

    const promptHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(params.promptId + '_' + (params.promptRevision || '1.0')).digest('hex');
    const planId = `plan_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();

    const planPartial = {
      schema_version: AI_PACK_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION as typeof AI_PACK_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      workspace_fingerprint: snapshot.dependency_fingerprint,
      session_id: snapshot.session_id,
      profile_id: snapshot.profile_id,
      prompt_id: params.promptId,
      prompt_revision: params.promptRevision || '1.0',
      prompt_hash: promptHash,
      bounded_goal: params.boundedGoal,
      bounded_notes: params.boundedNotes || null,
      opt_ins: mergedOptIns,
      locale: params.locale || 'ru',
      timezone: params.timezone || 'UTC',
      idempotency_key: params.idempotencyKey || null,
      projected_members: projectedMembers,
      privacy_decisions: {
        raw_series_included: mergedOptIns.raw_series_opt_in,
        ecg_included: mergedOptIns.ecg_opt_in,
        acc_included: mergedOptIns.acc_opt_in,
        timestamps_included: mergedOptIns.timestamps_opt_in,
        identifiers_included: mergedOptIns.identifiers_opt_in
      },
      warnings: [],
      manifest_hash: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(projectedMembers)).digest('hex'),
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt
    };

    const planHash = computeAiPlanHash(planPartial);

    const fullPlan: AiPackPlan = {
      ...planPartial,
      plan_id: planId,
      plan_hash: planHash,
      created_at_utc: now
    };

    saveAiPackPlan(fullPlan);
    return fullPlan;
  }

  /**
   * Generates and durably saves a preview of the planned AI Pack.
   */
  static async createPackPreview(plan: AiPackPlan): Promise<AiPackPreview> {
    const request: LlmPackRequest = {
      sessionId: plan.session_id,
      userId: plan.profile_id,
      exportProfile: 'chatgpt_web_full',
      privacyLevel: 'pseudonymized',
      userGoal: plan.bounded_goal as any,
      selectedPrompt: plan.prompt_id,
      includeNotes: !!plan.bounded_notes,
      signalExcerptOptIn: plan.opt_ins.ecg_opt_in,
      ecgStripsMode: plan.opt_ins.ecg_opt_in ? 'representative' : 'none',
      rawSeriesOptIn: plan.opt_ins.raw_series_opt_in
    };

    const candidate = await buildP4PackCandidate(request);

    const files: AiPackPreviewFile[] = candidate.files.map(f => ({
      name: f.name,
      kind: f.kind,
      sizeBytes: f.sizeBytes,
      sha256: f.sha256 || '',
      description: f.description,
      memberClass: f.memberClass || 'canonical_projection',
      isOptionalExcerpt: f.memberClass === 'physiological_excerpt' || f.memberClass === 'raw_physiological_series',
      previewSnippet: f.previewSnippet
    }));

    const previewId = candidate.previewId;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();

    const preview: AiPackPreview = {
      schema_version: AI_PACK_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION as typeof AI_PACK_PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      preview_id: previewId,
      plan_id: plan.plan_id,
      plan_hash: plan.plan_hash,
      files,
      manifest_sha256: candidate.manifestSha256 || '',
      scanner_passed: candidate.scannerResult.passed,
      scanner_violations: candidate.scannerResult.violations,
      estimated_zip_bytes: candidate.estimatedZipBytes,
      canonical_semantic_hash: candidate.canonicalSemanticHash,
      created_at_utc: now,
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt
    };

    saveAiPackPreview(preview);
    return preview;
  }

  /**
   * Starts a background compilation job, performing staged generation,
   * member parity validation, atomic publication, and cleanup.
   */
  static async startPackJob(
    plan: AiPackPlan,
    preview: AiPackPreview,
    idempotencyKey?: string
  ): Promise<AiPackJobSnapshot> {
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = getAiPackJobByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    }

    const jobId = `job_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const initialJob: AiPackJobSnapshot = {
      schema_version: AI_PACK_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION as typeof AI_PACK_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      job_id: jobId,
      plan_id: plan.plan_id,
      preview_id: preview.preview_id,
      status: 'pending',
      progress_percent: 0,
      pack_id: null,
      zip_filename: null,
      zip_path: null,
      size_bytes: null,
      sha256: null,
      error_message: null,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey || null,
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: null
    };

    createAiPackJob(initialJob);

    // Staging and execution
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'ai_pack_staging', jobId);
    const finalDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'llm_exports');

    try {
      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, { status: 'compiling', progress_percent: 25 });

      if (!fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
      }
      if (!fs.existsSync(finalDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(finalDir, { recursive: true });
      }

      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, { progress_percent: 40 });

      let entries = getCachedPreviewEntries(preview.preview_id);
      if (!entries || entries.length === 0) {
        // Fallback to rebuilding candidate if cache evicted
        const request: LlmPackRequest = {
          sessionId: plan.session_id,
          userId: plan.profile_id,
          exportProfile: 'chatgpt_web_full',
          privacyLevel: 'pseudonymized',
          userGoal: plan.bounded_goal as any,
          selectedPrompt: plan.prompt_id,
          includeNotes: !!plan.bounded_notes,
          signalExcerptOptIn: plan.opt_ins.ecg_opt_in,
          ecgStripsMode: plan.opt_ins.ecg_opt_in ? 'representative' : 'none',
          rawSeriesOptIn: plan.opt_ins.raw_series_opt_in
        };
        const candidate = await buildP4PackCandidate(request);
        entries = getCachedPreviewEntries(candidate.previewId) || [];
      }

      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, { progress_percent: 50 });

      const cleanAlias = (plan.profile_id || 'Athlete').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
      const cleanDate = (plan.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()).substring(0, 16).replace(/[-:T]/g, '');
      const zipFilename = `h10_ai_pack_${cleanAlias}_${cleanDate}_${jobId}.zip`;
      const stagingZipPath = path.join(stagingDir, zipFilename);
      const finalZipPath = path.join(finalDir, zipFilename);

      // Write flat zip into staging directory
      const zipResult = await writeFlatZip({
        entries,
        outputDir: stagingDir,
        outputFilename: zipFilename,
        profile: 'chatgpt_web_full'
      });

      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, { progress_percent: 75 });

      // Check for cancellation during zip creation
      const currentJob = getAiPackJob(jobId);
      if (currentJob?.status === 'cancelled') {
        if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
          try {
            fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        return currentJob;
      }

      // MEMBER PARITY VERIFICATION
      // Check count and sha256 checksum of every member
      const zipEntriesMap = new Map(zipResult.entries.map(e => [e.name, e.sha256]));
      for (const previewFile of preview.files) {
        const zipSha = zipEntriesMap.get(previewFile.name);
        if (!zipSha) {
          throw new Error(`Member parity error: file "${previewFile.name}" missing from compiled zip archive`);
        }
        if (zipSha !== previewFile.sha256) {
          throw new Error(`Member parity error: SHA-256 mismatch for "${previewFile.name}" (expected ${previewFile.sha256}, got ${zipSha})`);
        }
      }

      // Compute total zip SHA-256 hash
      const wholeZipSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(stagingZipPath)).digest('hex');

      // ATOMIC PUBLICATION: Move from staging to final
      fs.renameSync(stagingZipPath, finalZipPath);

      // Clean up staging directory
      try {
        fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch (_) {}

      // Save authoritative manifest
      const packId = `pack_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;
      const manifestId = `manifest_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;
      const manifest: AiPackManifest = {
        schema_version: AI_PACK_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION as typeof AI_PACK_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        manifest_id: manifestId,
        job_id: jobId,
        pack_id: packId,
        session_id: plan.session_id,
        profile_id: plan.profile_id,
        filename: zipFilename,
        size_bytes: zipResult.sizeBytes,
        sha256: wholeZipSha256,
        canonical_semantic_hash: preview.canonical_semantic_hash,
        members: zipResult.entries.map(e => ({
          name: e.name,
          member_class: preview.files.find(pf => pf.name === e.name)?.memberClass || 'canonical_projection',
          size_bytes: e.sizeBytes,
          sha256: e.sha256
        })),
        created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      saveAiPackManifest(manifest);

      // Also register into llm_packs table for compatibility with legacy endpoints & UI download
      const user = getUserProfile(plan.profile_id);
      const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(plan.session_id).catch(() => null);
      const activeCanonicalHash = canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || preview.canonical_semantic_hash;

      saveLlmPack({
        id: packId,
        user_id: plan.profile_id,
        session_id: plan.session_id,
        export_profile: 'chatgpt_web_full',
        filename: zipFilename,
        filepath: finalZipPath,
        size_bytes: zipResult.sizeBytes,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        metadata_json: JSON.stringify({
          job_id: jobId,
          manifest_id: manifestId,
          user_goal: plan.bounded_goal,
          selected_prompt: plan.prompt_id,
          sha256: wholeZipSha256,
          canonical_result_identity: {
            canonical_hash: activeCanonicalHash
          },
          canonical_semantic_hash: preview.canonical_semantic_hash,
          analysis_context_snapshot: {
            schema_version: '1.0.0',
            session_id: plan.session_id,
            canonical_result_identity: activeCanonicalHash
          },
          export_alias: user?.export_alias || 'Athlete'
        })
      });

      // Update job to completed
      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, {
        status: 'completed',
        progress_percent: 100,
        pack_id: packId,
        zip_filename: zipFilename,
        zip_path: finalZipPath,
        size_bytes: zipResult.sizeBytes,
        sha256: wholeZipSha256,
        completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      return getAiPackJob(jobId)!;
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Clean up staging directory on error
      if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
        try {
          fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, {
        status: 'failed',
        error_message: err.message || 'Compilation failed',
        completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Explicitly cancels an active compilation job and cleans up any staging files.
   */
  static cancelPackJob(jobId: string): boolean {
    const job = getAiPackJob(jobId);
    if (!job) return false;

    if (job.status === 'completed' || job.status === 'failed') {
      return false;
    }

    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'ai_pack_staging', jobId);
    if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
      try {
        fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    updateAiPackJobProgress(jobId, {
      status: 'cancelled',
      error_message: 'Job cancelled by user',
      completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles interrupted jobs on process startup.
   * Marks pending/compiling jobs as failed with recoverable error message
   * and cleans orphan staging directories.
   */
  static reconcileInterruptedJobs(): number {
    const db = getDb();
    const interrupted = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM ai_pack_jobs WHERE status IN ('pending', 'compiling')
    `).all() as { id: string }[];

    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    for (const job of interrupted) {
      updateAiPackJobProgress(job.id, {
        status: 'failed',
        error_message: 'Job interrupted by process restart; recoverable via retry',
        completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });
      const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'ai_pack_staging', job.id);
      if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
        try {
          fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    return interrupted.length;
  }

  /**
   * Imports an external model response into the lineage-safe diary.
   * Validates size budget (5MB), sanitizes markdown, preserves immutable original,
   * enforces SHA-256 deduplication (409 Conflict), and links lineage.
   */
  static async importModelResponse(plan: ModelResponseImportPlan): Promise<DiaryEntrySnapshot> {
    const rawContent = plan.content;
    if (!rawContent || typeof rawContent !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Response content is required and must be text.');
    }

    // Size limit: 5MB
    const byteLength = Buffer.byteLength(rawContent, 'utf8');
    const MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
    if (byteLength > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES) {
      throw new Error(`Import payload exceeds 5MB size limit (${byteLength} bytes).`);
    }

    // Markdown sanitization (strip script, iframe, embed, object, data: URLs, event handlers)
    const sanitized = sanitizeMarkdown(rawContent);

    // Compute SHA-256 hash of original content
    const contentHash = computeAiContentHash(rawContent);

    const db = getDb();
    const profileId = plan.profile_id || 'athlete_default';

    // Duplicate content check
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM llm_diary WHERE user_id = ? AND content_hash_sha256 = ?').get(profileId, contentHash) as { id: string } | undefined;
    if (existing) {
      const err: any = new Error('Duplicate response content already imported for this athlete.');
      err.statusCode = 409;
      err.existing_id = existing.id;
      throw err;
    }

    // Lineage resolution
    let sessionId = plan.session_id || null;
    let packId = plan.pack_id || null;
    let lineageState: 'current' | 'unlinked' = 'unlinked';

    if (packId) {
      const packRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_packs WHERE id = ?').get(packId) as LlmPackRecord | undefined;
      if (packRow) {
        if (!sessionId && packRow.session_id) {
          sessionId = packRow.session_id;
        }
        lineageState = 'current';
      }
    } else if (sessionId) {
      lineageState = 'current';
    }

    // Extract plain text for full-text search
    const plainText = sanitized
      .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '')
      .replace(/`.*?`/g, '')
      .replace(/#+\s/g, '')
      .replace(/[*_~[\]]/g, '')
      .trim();

    const diaryId = `diary_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const title = plan.title || (plan.prompt_name ? `AI Interpretation: ${plan.prompt_name}` : 'AI Model Response');

    saveLlmDiary({
      id: diaryId,
      user_id: profileId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      pack_id: packId,
      provider: plan.provider || 'other',
      model_label: plan.model_label || null,
      prompt_name: plan.prompt_name || null,
      prompt_profile: null,
      title,
      source_type: plan.source_type,
      source_filename: plan.source_filename || null,
      source_ext: (plan.source_ext as any) || null,
      content_hash_sha256: contentHash,
      original_response_md: rawContent, // IMMUTABLE ORIGINAL
      response_md: sanitized,            // SANITIZED MARKDOWN
      response_text_plain: plainText,
      created_at: now,
      imported_at: now,
      updated_at: now,
      is_favorite: false,
      tags_json: plan.tags ? JSON.stringify(plan.tags) : '[]',
      lineage_state: lineageState,
      artifact_state: packId ? 'current' : 'unlinked',
      is_retired: false,
      optimistic_revision: 1
    });

    const inserted = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(diaryId) as any;
    return mapRowToDiarySnapshot(inserted);
  }
}

/**
 * Strips active scripting and unsafe HTML constructs from markdown text.
 */
export function sanitizeMarkdown(input: string): string {
  return input
    .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<iframe\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/iframe>)<[^<]*)*<\/iframe>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<object\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/object>)<[^<]*)*<\/object>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<embed\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/embed>)<[^<]*)*<\/embed>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/style>)<[^<]*)*<\/style>/gi, '')
    .replace(/on\w+\s*=\s*["'][^"']*["']/gi, '')
    .replace(/javascript:[^"'\s)]*/gi, '');
}

export interface EventCluster {
  clusterId: string;
  eventIds: string[];
  earliestStartMs: number;
  latestEndMs: number;
  eventTypes: string[];
  representativeEvent: any;
  representativeSelectionReason: string;
  events: any[];
}

export interface ClusteringStats {
  candidates_before: number;
  clusters_after: number;
  exact_duplicates_removed: number;
  overlapping_windows_merged: number;
}

export function mapFlagType(type: string): string {
  const t = type.trim();
  if (t === 'RR outlier') return 'candidate_rr_outlier';
  if (t === 'Actual missing data') return 'data_gap';
  if (t === 'ECG high-frequency noise') return 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
  if (t === 'Baseline drift') return 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
  if (t === 'Motion artifact') return 'motion_artifact';
  if (t === 'Timestamp/sync issue') return 'sync_issue';
  return t;
}

export function getSeverityValue(severity: string): number {
  const s = (severity || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'high') return 3;
  if (s === 'medium') return 2;
  if (s === 'low') return 1;
  return 0;
}

export function getEventWindowSeconds(flagType: string, profileMaxSeconds: number): number {
  const type = mapFlagType(flagType);
  let seconds = 30; // default
  if (type === 'data_gap') {
    seconds = 30;
  } else if (type === 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise') {
    seconds = 10;
  } else if (type === 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift' || type === 'motion_artifact') {
    seconds = 15;
  } else if (type === 'candidate_rr_outlier') {
    seconds = 10;
  }
  return Math.min(seconds, profileMaxSeconds);
}

/**
 * Clusters events deterministically based on their time windows and a merge gap.
 * Merge gap defaults to 0 (merge only if overlapping or identical).
 */
export function clusterEvents(
  flags: any[],
  profileMaxSeconds: number,
  mergeGapMs = 0
): { clusters: EventCluster[]; stats: ClusteringStats } {
  const candidates_before = flags.length;
  if (flags.length === 0) {
    return {
      clusters: [],
      stats: {
        candidates_before: 0,
        clusters_after: 0,
        exact_duplicates_removed: 0,
        overlapping_windows_merged: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  // Deduplicate first
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueFlags = flags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  const exact_duplicates_removed = candidates_before - uniqueFlags.length;

  // 1. Sort flags by offset
  const sortedFlags = [...uniqueFlags].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms);

  const clusters: EventCluster[] = [];
  let nextClusterId = 1;

  for (const flag of sortedFlags) {
    const offset = flag.timestamp_offset_ms;
    const windowSeconds = getEventWindowSeconds(flag.flag_type, profileMaxSeconds);
    const halfWidthMs = (windowSeconds / 2) * 1000;
    const startMs = Math.max(0, offset - halfWidthMs);
    const endMs = offset + halfWidthMs;
    const eventType = mapFlagType(flag.flag_type);

    const newCluster: EventCluster = {
      clusterId: `cluster_${nextClusterId}`,
      eventIds: [flag.id.toString()],
      earliestStartMs: startMs,
      latestEndMs: endMs,
      eventTypes: [eventType],
      representativeEvent: flag,
      representativeSelectionReason: 'single_event',
      events: [flag]
    };

    if (clusters.length > 0) {
      const last = clusters[clusters.length - 1];
      const overlap = newCluster.earliestStartMs <= last.latestEndMs && last.earliestStartMs <= newCluster.latestEndMs;
      const close = mergeGapMs > 0 && (
        Math.abs(newCluster.earliestStartMs - last.latestEndMs) < mergeGapMs ||
        Math.abs(last.earliestStartMs - newCluster.latestEndMs) < mergeGapMs
      );

      const proposedStart = Math.min(last.earliestStartMs, newCluster.earliestStartMs);
      const proposedEnd = Math.max(last.latestEndMs, newCluster.latestEndMs);
      const proposedDurationMs = proposedEnd - proposedStart;
      const maxClusterDurationMs = Math.max(60, profileMaxSeconds) * 1000;

      if ((overlap || close) && proposedDurationMs <= maxClusterDurationMs) {
        // Merge into last cluster
        last.eventIds.push(flag.id.toString());
        last.earliestStartMs = proposedStart;
        last.latestEndMs = proposedEnd;
        if (!last.eventTypes.includes(eventType)) {
          last.eventTypes.push(eventType);
        }
        last.events.push(flag);
        continue;
      }
    }

    clusters.push(newCluster);
    nextClusterId++;
  }

  // 2. Select representatives for each cluster deterministically
  for (const cluster of clusters) {
    const sortedEvents = [...cluster.events].sort((a, b) => {
      const sevA = getSeverityValue(a.severity);
      const sevB = getSeverityValue(b.severity);
      if (sevB !== sevA) return sevB - sevA; // higher severity first
      return a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms; // earliest first
    });
    cluster.representativeEvent = sortedEvents[0];
    cluster.representativeSelectionReason = cluster.events.length > 1 ? 'highest_severity' : 'single_event';
  }

  const clusters_after = clusters.length;
  const overlapping_windows_merged = candidates_before - clusters_after - exact_duplicates_removed;

  return {
    clusters,
    stats: {
      candidates_before,
      clusters_after,
      exact_duplicates_removed,
      overlapping_windows_merged,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Selects representative clusters up to maxStrips.
 * Ensures unique (event_type, severity) coverage first, then fills based on severity and temporal spacing.
 */
export function selectRepresentativeClusters(
  clusters: EventCluster[],
  maxStrips: number
): EventCluster[] {
  if (clusters.length === 0 || maxStrips <= 0) return [];
  if (clusters.length <= maxStrips) return clusters;

  const selected: EventCluster[] = [];
  const coveredKeys = new Set<string>();

  const candidateClusters = [...clusters].sort((a, b) => {
    const sevA = getSeverityValue(a.representativeEvent.severity);
    const sevB = getSeverityValue(b.representativeEvent.severity);
    if (sevB !== sevA) return sevB - sevA;
    return a.representativeEvent.timestamp_offset_ms - b.representativeEvent.timestamp_offset_ms;
  });

  // Pass 1: Cover unique classes
  for (const c of candidateClusters) {
    const type = mapFlagType(c.representativeEvent.flag_type);
    const key = `${type}_${c.representativeEvent.severity}`;
    if (!coveredKeys.has(key)) {
      selected.push(c);
      coveredKeys.add(key);
      if (selected.length >= maxStrips) break;
    }
  }

  // Pass 2: Fill remaining capacity
  if (selected.length < maxStrips) {
    for (const c of candidateClusters) {
      if (!selected.includes(c)) {
        selected.push(c);
        if (selected.length >= maxStrips) break;
      }
    }
  }

  return selected.sort((a, b) => a.earliestStartMs - b.earliestStartMs);
}
