import { CandidateFlag, SessionQcMetrics } from '../db/db';

export interface AggregatedEvent {
  event_class: string;
  event_type: string;
  label_ru: string;
  label_en: string;
  count: number;
  first_offset_ms: number;
  last_offset_ms: number;
  severity_max: string;
  representative_offsets_ms: string;
  quality_context: string;
}

export function getEventClass(type: string): string {
  switch (type) {
    case 'candidate_rr_outlier':
      return 'candidate_rr_outlier';
    case 'data_gap':
      return 'gap';
    case 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise':
    case 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift':
    case 'motion_artifact':
      return 'quality_artifact';
    case 'sync_issue':
      return 'sync';
    default:
      return 'unknown';
  }
}

export function getEventLabels(type: string): { ru: string; en: string } {
  switch (type) {
    case 'candidate_rr_outlier':
      return { ru: 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал', en: 'Candidate RR Outlier' };
    case 'data_gap':
      return { ru: 'Пропуск данных', en: 'Data Gap' };
    case 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise':
      return { ru: 'Шум ЭКГ', en: 'ECG Noise' };
    case 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift':
      return { ru: 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ', en: 'ECG Baseline Drift' };
    case 'motion_artifact':
      return { ru: 'Артефакт движения', en: 'Motion Artifact' };
    case 'sync_issue':
      return { ru: 'Рассинхронизация времени', en: 'Time Sync Issue' };
    default:
      return { ru: 'Неизвестное событие', en: 'Unknown Event' };
  }
}

export function aggregateCandidateEvents(flags: CandidateFlag[], qcMetrics: SessionQcMetrics | null): AggregatedEvent[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueFlags = flags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  const groups: Record<string, CandidateFlag[]> = {};
  for (const f of uniqueFlags) {
    let type = f.flag_type;
    if (type === 'RR outlier') type = 'candidate_rr_outlier';
    if (type === 'Actual missing data') type = 'data_gap';
    if (type === 'ECG high-frequency noise') type = 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
    if (type === 'Baseline drift') type = 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
    if (type === 'Motion artifact') type = 'motion_artifact';
    if (type === 'Timestamp/sync issue') type = 'sync_issue';

    // Strict validation check to forbid RR outliers labeled as data_gap
    if (type === 'candidate_rr_outlier' && (f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('пропуск') || f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('gap') || f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('missing'))) {
      throw new Error("Forbid RR outliers labeled as data_gap");
    }
    if (type === 'data_gap' && (f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('outlier') || f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('нетипичный') || f.description_ru.toLowerCase().includes('выбивающийся'))) {
      throw new Error("Forbid RR outliers labeled as data_gap");
    }

    if (!groups[type]) {
      groups[type] = [];
    }
    groups[type].push(f);
  }

  const severityOrder: Record<string, number> = { low: 1, medium: 2, high: 3 };

  return Object.entries(groups).map(([type, groupFlags]) => {
    const sortedOffsets = groupFlags.map(f => f.timestamp_offset_ms).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const count = groupFlags.length;
    const first_offset_ms = sortedOffsets[0] ?? 0;
    const last_offset_ms = sortedOffsets[sortedOffsets.length - 1] ?? 0;

    let severity_max = 'low';
    for (const f of groupFlags) {
      const orderVal = severityOrder[f.severity.toLowerCase()] ?? 0;
      const maxVal = severityOrder[severity_max] ?? 0;
      if (orderVal > maxVal) {
        severity_max = f.severity.toLowerCase();
      }
    }

    const repOffsets = sortedOffsets.slice(0, 5);
    const representative_offsets_ms = JSON.stringify(repOffsets);

    let quality_context = '{}';
    if (qcMetrics) {
      const ctxObj: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (type === 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise') {
        ctxObj.ecg_noise_ratio = qcMetrics.ecg_noise_ratio;
        ctxObj.ecg_clipping_seconds = qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds;
      } else if (type === 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift') {
        ctxObj.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio = qcMetrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio;
      } else if (type === 'motion_artifact') {
        ctxObj.acc_motion_severity = qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity;
      } else if (type === 'data_gap') {
        ctxObj.missing_samples_count = qcMetrics.missing_samples_count;
      } else if (type === 'sync_issue') {
        ctxObj.duplicate_timestamps_count = qcMetrics.duplicate_timestamps_count;
      }
      quality_context = JSON.stringify(ctxObj);
    }

    const { ru, en } = getEventLabels(type);

    return {
      event_class: getEventClass(type),
      event_type: type,
      label_ru: ru,
      label_en: en,
      count,
      first_offset_ms,
      last_offset_ms,
      severity_max,
      representative_offsets_ms,
      quality_context
    };
  });
}

export function compileEventSummaryCsv(aggregated: AggregatedEvent[]): string {
  const rows = [
    'event_class,event_type,label_ru,label_en,count,first_offset_ms,last_offset_ms,severity_max,representative_offsets_ms,quality_context'
  ];
  for (const a of aggregated) {
    rows.push(
      `${a.event_class},${a.event_type},"${a.label_ru.replace(/"/g, '""')}",` +
      `"${a.label_en.replace(/"/g, '""')}",${a.count},${a.first_offset_ms},${a.last_offset_ms},` +
      `${a.severity_max},"${a.representative_offsets_ms.replace(/"/g, '""')}",` +
      `"${a.quality_context.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
    );
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

export function compileEventDensityCsv(flags: CandidateFlag[]): string {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueFlags = flags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  const density: Record<number, Record<string, number>> = {};
  for (const f of uniqueFlags) {
    const minute = Math.floor(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 60000);
    let type = f.flag_type;
    if (type === 'RR outlier') type = 'candidate_rr_outlier';
    if (type === 'Actual missing data') type = 'data_gap';
    if (type === 'ECG high-frequency noise') type = 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
    if (type === 'Baseline drift') type = 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
    if (type === 'Motion artifact') type = 'motion_artifact';
    if (type === 'Timestamp/sync issue') type = 'sync_issue';

    if (!density[minute]) {
      density[minute] = {};
    }
    density[minute][type] = (density[minute][type] || 0) + 1;
  }

  const rows = ['minute,event_type,count'];
  const sortedMinutes = Object.keys(density).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (const min of sortedMinutes) {
    const types = Object.keys(density[min]).sort();
    for (const t of types) {
      rows.push(`${min},${t},${density[min][t]}`);
    }
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

export function compileRepresentativeEventsCsv(flags: CandidateFlag[]): string {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueFlags = flags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  const groups: Record<string, CandidateFlag[]> = {};
  for (const f of uniqueFlags) {
    let type = f.flag_type;
    if (type === 'RR outlier') type = 'candidate_rr_outlier';
    if (type === 'Actual missing data') type = 'data_gap';
    if (type === 'ECG high-frequency noise') type = 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
    if (type === 'Baseline drift') type = 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
    if (type === 'Motion artifact') type = 'motion_artifact';
    if (type === 'Timestamp/sync issue') type = 'sync_issue';

    if (!groups[type]) {
      groups[type] = [];
    }
    groups[type].push(f);
  }

  const rows = ['flag_id,offset_ms,event_type,severity,description_ru'];
  for (const [type, groupFlags] of Object.entries(groups)) {
    const sorted = [...groupFlags].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms);
    const representative = sorted.slice(0, 5);
    for (const f of representative) {
      rows.push(`${f.id},${f.timestamp_offset_ms},${type},${f.severity},"${f.description_ru.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`);
    }
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

import { ExportProfile, BUDGETS } from './sizeBudget';

export interface ManifestData {
  pack_id: string;
  pack_version: string;
  generated_at_local: string;
  generated_at_utc: string;
  timezone: string;
  app_version: string;
  source_commit: string;

  };

    full_raw_acc: boolean;
    local_source_paths: boolean;
    full_device_id: boolean;
    automatic_cloud_upload: boolean;
  };
}

/**
 * Compiles manifest data into a JSON structure.
 */
export function compileManifest(params: {
  packId: string;
  exportProfile: ExportProfile;
  userExportAlias: string;
  displayNameIncluded: boolean;
  activityType: string;
  sessionIds: string[];
  dateRange: { start: string; end: string };
  signalsAvailable: string[];
  signalsAnalyzed: string[];
  signalsIncludedInPack: string[];
  signalsExcludedByProfile: string[];
  zonesConfigHash?: string;
  privacyLevel: string;
  ecgStripsIncluded: boolean;
  files: ManifestFileEntry[];
  sourceCommit?: string;
  canonicalResultIdentity?: {
    session_id: string;
    source_bundle_id: string | null;
    canonical_hash: string;
  };
  canonicalSemanticHash?: string;
  previewId?: string;
  userGoal?: string;
  selectedPrompt?: string;
  selectedPromptId?: string;
  selectedPromptName?: string;
  providerFamily?: string;
  notesIncluded?: boolean;
  rawPhysiologicalSeriesIncluded?: boolean;
  prohibitedScanVerdict?: {
    passed: boolean;
    scanned_files_count: number;
  };
  timezone?: string;
}): ManifestData {
  const now = new Date();
  
  // Derive timezone strictly from session/user parameter or source evidence, never host machine offset
  let timezoneStr = params.timezone;
  if (!timezoneStr) {
    const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(params.dateRange?.start || '');
    if (temporal.source_offset_minutes !== null) {
      const sign = temporal.source_offset_minutes >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
      const abs = Math.abs(temporal.source_offset_minutes);
      const h = Math.floor(abs / 60);
      const m = abs % 60;
      timezoneStr = `UTC${sign}${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } else if (temporal.source_iana_zone) {
      timezoneStr = temporal.source_iana_zone;
    } else {
      timezoneStr = 'UTC';
    }
  }

  const budget = BUDGETS[params.exportProfile];

  const hasRawEcg = params.files.some(f => f.name.includes('ecg_full.csv'));

  const isV2 = !!params.canonicalSemanticHash;

  return {
    pack_id: params.packId,
    pack_version: isV2 ? '2.0' : '1.0',
    generated_at_local: SharedFormatter.formatDateTime(now.toISOString(), timezoneStr.startsWith('UTC') ? 'UTC' : timezoneStr, 'ru-RU'),
    generated_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
    timezone: timezoneStr,
    app_version: APP_VERSION,
    source_commit: params.sourceCommit || RELEASE_COMMIT || 'unknown',

    algorithm_version: isV2 ? '2.0.0' : '1.2.0',
    export_profile: params.exportProfile,
    provider_family: params.providerFamily,
    flat_zip: true,
    nested_paths_allowed: false,
    max_entries_for_profile: budget.maxEntries,
    user_export_alias: params.userExportAlias,
    display_name_included: params.displayNameIncluded,
    activity_type: params.activityType,
    session_ids: params.sessionIds,
    date_range_local: params.dateRange,
    relative_time_origin: 'session_start',
    signals_available: params.signalsAvailable,
    signals_analyzed: params.signalsAnalyzed,
    signals_included_in_pack: params.signalsIncludedInPack,
    signals_excluded_by_profile: params.signalsExcludedByProfile,
    zones_config_hash: params.zonesConfigHash,
    privacy_level: params.privacyLevel,
    ecg_strips_included: params.ecgStripsIncluded,
    canonical_result_identity: params.canonicalResultIdentity,
    canonical_semantic_hash: params.canonicalSemanticHash,
    preview_id: params.previewId,
    user_goal: params.userGoal,
    selected_prompt: params.selectedPrompt,
    selected_prompt_id: params.selectedPromptId,
    selected_prompt_name: params.selectedPromptName,
    notes_included: params.notesIncluded,
    raw_physiological_series_included: params.rawPhysiologicalSeriesIncluded,
    prohibited_scan_verdict: params.prohibitedScanVerdict,
    files: params.files,
    excluded: {
      full_raw_ecg: !hasRawEcg,
      full_raw_acc: true,
      local_source_paths: true,
      full_device_id: true,
      automatic_cloud_upload: true,
    },
  };
}


/**
 * Generates the checksum mapping matching the name-to-sha256 schema.
 */
export function compileChecksums(files: ManifestFileEntry[]): Record<string, string> {
  const result: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const f of files) {
    if (f.sha256 !== null) {
      result[f.name] = f.sha256;
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export function determinePackMemberClass(fileName: string): PackMemberClass {
  const name = fileName.toLowerCase();
  if (name === 'manifest.json' || name === '00_manifest.json' || name === '99_checksums.json' || name === 'checksums.sha256') {
    return 'manifest';
  }
  if (name.includes('prompt') || name.startsWith('00_')) {
    return 'prompt';
  }
  if (
    name === '01_ai_interpretation.md' ||
    name === '01_ai_interpretation_context.json' ||
    name === '02_session_snapshot.json' ||
    name === 'canonical_result.json' ||
    name === 'session_summary.md' ||
    name === 'comparison_summary.md' ||
    name === '16_comparison_summary.md' ||
    name === '15_user_notes.md'
  ) {
    return 'canonical_semantic';
  }
  if (
    name === '03_metrics_and_zones.json' ||
    name === '04_hrv_analysis.json' ||
    name === '07_recovery_metrics.json' ||
    name === '08_load_estimates.json' ||
    name === 'metric_table.csv' ||
    name === 'quality_and_eligibility.md' ||
    name === 'methodology_and_limits.md' ||
    name === 'suggested_questions.md' ||
    name.startsWith('40_') ||
    name.startsWith('41_') ||
    name.startsWith('42_') ||
    name.startsWith('43_')
  ) {
    return 'canonical_projection';
  }
  if (
    name === '09_candidate_event_summary.csv' ||
    name === '09_candidate_flags.json' ||
    name === '10_event_minute_density.csv' ||
    name === '11_representative_events.csv' ||
    name === '12_event_cluster_index.json'
  ) {
    return 'aggregate_event_summary';
  }
  if (name.includes('chart') || name.startsWith('20_') || name.startsWith('45_') || (name.endsWith('.png') && !name.includes('ecg_strip'))) {
    return 'chart';
  }
  if (name.includes('ecg_strip') || name.startsWith('30_') || name.startsWith('31_')) {
    return 'physiological_excerpt';
  }
  if (
    name.includes('ecg_full') ||
    name.includes('05_hr_downsampled.csv') ||
    name.includes('06_rr_cleaned.csv') ||
    name.includes('raw_physiological')
  ) {
    return 'raw_physiological_series';
  }
  if (name.includes('debug')) {
    return 'debug_internal';
  }
  return 'canonical_projection';
}

  compileRepresentativeEventsCsv 
} from './eventAggregation';

function calculateBaselineBand(values: number[]): { median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null } {
  if (values.length === 0) return { median: null, p25: null, p75: null };
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  
  const getPercentile = (p: number) => {
    const idx = (n - 1) * p;
    const low = Math.floor(idx);
    const high = Math.ceil(idx);
    if (low === high) return sorted[low];
    const weight = idx - low;
    return sorted[low] * (1 - weight) + sorted[high] * weight;
  };

  return {
    median: Math.round(getPercentile(0.5) * 10) / 10,
    p25: Math.round(getPercentile(0.25) * 10) / 10,
    p75: Math.round(getPercentile(0.75) * 10) / 10
  };
}

interface CachedPreviewItem {
  previewId?: string;
  preview: LlmPackPreviewResult;
  finalEntries: any[];
  rawZipBuffer?: Buffer;
  canonicalSessionHash: string;
  requestFingerprint?: string;
  request: LlmPackRequest;
  finalManifest: any;
  cachedAt: number;
}

const previewCache = new Map<string, CachedPreviewItem>();

export function getPreviewFileContent(
  previewId: string, 
  fileName: string, 
  callerContext?: { userId?: string; sessionId?: string }
): string | null {
  cleanExpiredPreviews();
  if (!fileName || fileName.includes('..') || fileName.includes('/') || fileName.includes('\\')) {
    const err = new Error('Path traversal rejected');
    (err as any).statusCode = 400;
    throw err;
  }
  const cached = previewCache.get(previewId);
  if (!cached) return null;
  if (callerContext) {
    if (callerContext.userId && cached.request.userId && callerContext.userId !== cached.request.userId) {
      const err = new Error('Forbidden: preview does not belong to caller user');
      (err as any).statusCode = 403;
      throw err;
    }
    if (callerContext.sessionId && cached.request.sessionId && callerContext.sessionId !== cached.request.sessionId) {
      const err = new Error('Forbidden: preview does not belong to requested session');
      (err as any).statusCode = 403;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const entry = cached.finalEntries.find(e => e.name === fileName);
  if (!entry) return null;
  if (entry.content) {
    return entry.content.toString('utf8');
  }
  if (entry.contentString) {
    return entry.contentString;
  }
  if (entry.contentBuffer) {
    return entry.contentBuffer.toString('utf8');
  }
  if (entry.filePath && fs.existsSync(entry.filePath)) {
    return fs.readFileSync(entry.filePath, 'utf8');
  }
  return null;
}

export function computePreviewRequestFingerprint(
  req: LlmPackRequest,
  canonicalHash: string,
  userNotes: string | null
): string {
  const notesHash = userNotes ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(userNotes).digest('hex') : 'none';
  const payload = {
    userId: req.userId,
    sessionId: req.sessionId,
    exportProfile: req.exportProfile,
    privacyLevel: req.privacyLevel,
    includeNotes: Boolean(req.includeNotes),
    notesHash,
    rawSeriesOptIn: Boolean(req.rawSeriesOptIn),
    signalExcerptOptIn: Boolean(req.signalExcerptOptIn),
    userGoal: req.userGoal || 'session_first_look',
    selectedPrompt: req.selectedPrompt || 'default',
    canonicalHash
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(payload)).digest('hex');
}

export function cleanExpiredPreviews(): void {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [id, item] of previewCache.entries()) {
    if (now - item.cachedAt > 15 * 60 * 1000) {
      if (item.finalEntries) {
        for (const entry of item.finalEntries) {
          if ((entry as any).filePath && fs.existsSync((entry as any).filePath)) {
            try {
              fs.unlinkSync((entry as any).filePath);
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }
      previewCache.delete(id);
    }
  }
}

function renderV2SessionSummaryMarkdown(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2, userNotes?: string | null, namedWindows?: any[]): string {
  const s = pack.session_context;
  const q = pack.quality_evidence;
  const c = pack.core_metrics;
  const a = pack.advanced_metrics;

  let windowsSection = '';
  if (namedWindows && namedWindows.length > 0) {
    const rows = namedWindows.map(w => {
      let metrics: any = null;
      if (w.metrics_json) {
        try { metrics = JSON.parse(w.metrics_json); } catch {}
      }
      const hr = metrics?.meanHr !== null && metrics?.meanHr !== undefined ? `${metrics.meanHr} bpm` : '—';
      const rmssd = metrics?.rmssd !== null && metrics?.rmssd !== undefined ? `${metrics.rmssd} ms` : '—';
      const sdnn = metrics?.sdnn !== null && metrics?.sdnn !== undefined ? `${metrics.sdnn} ms` : 'Withheld (<300s)';
      const dur = Math.round(w.end_offset_seconds - w.start_offset_seconds);
      return `| **${w.name}** | ${w.start_offset_seconds}s – ${w.end_offset_seconds}s (${dur}s) | ${metrics?.beatCount ?? '—'} | ${hr} | ${rmssd} | ${sdnn} |`;
    }).join('\n');

    windowsSection = `\n---\n\n## Named Analysis Windows (Local Slices)\n| Window | Range (Duration) | Beats | Mean HR | RMSSD | SDNN |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n${rows}\n\n*Notice: User-defined windows are descriptive local slices and do not alter whole-session baseline metrics.*\n`;
  }

  return `# Session Summary — ${s.session_alias}

* **Session ID**: \`${s.session_id}\`
* **Recorded At (UTC)**: ${s.start_time_utc}
* **Duration**: ${s.duration_formatted} (${s.duration_seconds} seconds)
* **Recording Context**: ${s.recording_context}
* **Signals Present**: ${s.signals_present.join(', ')}

---

## Autonomic & Time-Domain HRV Markers
| Metric | Value | Unit | Eligibility | Method | Feature Maturity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RMSSD** | ${c.rmssd.value !== null ? c.rmssd.value : '—'} | ${c.rmssd.unit} | ${c.rmssd.eligibility} | ${c.rmssd.method} | ${c.rmssd.maturity} |
| **SDNN** | ${c.sdnn.value !== null ? c.sdnn.value : '—'} | ${c.sdnn.unit} | ${c.sdnn.eligibility} | ${c.sdnn.method} | ${c.sdnn.maturity} |
| **pNN50** | ${c.pnn50.value !== null ? c.pnn50.value : '—'} | ${c.pnn50.unit} | ${c.pnn50.eligibility} | ${c.pnn50.method} | ${c.pnn50.maturity} |
| **Mean HR** | ${c.mean_hr_bpm.value !== null ? Math.round(c.mean_hr_bpm.value) : '—'} | ${c.mean_hr_bpm.unit} | ${c.mean_hr_bpm.eligibility} | ${c.mean_hr_bpm.method} | ${c.mean_hr_bpm.maturity} |
| **Mean RR** | ${c.mean_rr_ms.value !== null ? Math.round(c.mean_rr_ms.value) : '—'} | ${c.mean_rr_ms.unit} | ${c.mean_rr_ms.eligibility} | ${c.mean_rr_ms.method} | ${c.mean_rr_ms.maturity} |

---

## Advanced Analytical Indicators
* **Spectral Frequency Domain (LF/HF)**: ${a.frequency_domain.values.lf_hf_ratio !== null ? a.frequency_domain.values.lf_hf_ratio : '—'} (LF: ${a.frequency_domain.values.lf ?? '—'}, HF: ${a.frequency_domain.values.hf ?? '—'} ms²) [${a.frequency_domain.maturity}]
* **Poincaré Plot (SD1/SD2)**: SD1: ${a.poincare.values.sd1 ?? '—'} ms, SD2: ${a.poincare.values.sd2 ?? '—'} ms [${a.poincare.maturity}]
* **ECG Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)**: ${a.signal_noise_ratio.values.snr_db !== null ? a.signal_noise_ratio.values.snr_db + ' dB' : '—'} [${a.signal_noise_ratio.maturity}]
* **Heart Rate Recovery (1 min drop)**: ${a.heart_rate_recovery.values.recovery_1min_drop_bpm !== null ? a.heart_rate_recovery.values.recovery_1min_drop_bpm + ' bpm drop' : '—'} [${a.heart_rate_recovery.maturity}]
* **ECG-RR Paired Agreement**: ${a.ecg_rr_agreement.status === 'unavailable' ? 'Unavailable (Dataset Debt: requires validated paired dataset)' : 'Available'}
* **Cardiac Decoupling / Drift**: ${a.cardiac_drift.status === 'unavailable' ? 'Unavailable (Implementation Debt: requires external power meter)' : 'Available'}

---

## Signal Quality & Beat Lineage Overview
* **Total Heart Beats**: ${q.total_beats}
* **Accepted NN Beats**: ${q.accepted_nn_beats}
* **Artifact Percentage**: ${q.artifact_percentage.toFixed(2)}%
* **Signal Quality Status**: ${q.snr_quality_status ? q.snr_quality_status.toUpperCase() : 'NOT_ASSESSED'}
* **SNR**: ${q.snr_db !== null ? q.snr_db.toFixed(1) + ' dB' : '—'}
* **Motion Severity**: ${q.motion_severity ? q.motion_severity.toUpperCase() : 'NONE'}
${q.task_warnings.length > 0 ? `* **Warnings**: ${q.task_warnings.join('; ')}` : ''}
${userNotes ? `\n---\n\n## Athlete Notes (Redacted)\n${userNotes}\n` : ''}
${windowsSection}
---

> **Notice**: Non-medical research and athletic tracking workstation. Not a medical device.`;
}

function renderV2MetricTableCsv(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const rows = ['metric_id,category,name,value,unit,eligibility,maturity,method,limitations'];
  for (const [id, m] of Object.entries(pack.core_metrics)) {
    const lim = (m.limitations || []).join('; ').replace(/"/g, '""');
    rows.push(`${id},core,"${m.name}",${m.value !== null ? m.value : ''},"${m.unit}","${m.eligibility}","${m.maturity}","${m.method}","${lim}"`);
  }
  for (const [id, m] of Object.entries(pack.advanced_metrics)) {
    const lim = (m.limitations || []).join('; ').replace(/"/g, '""');
    for (const [valKey, val] of Object.entries(m.values)) {
      if (typeof val === 'number' || val === null) {
        rows.push(`${id}_${valKey},advanced,"${m.name} (${valKey})",${val !== null ? val : ''},"","${m.status}","${m.maturity}","","${lim}"`);
      }
    }
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

function renderV2QualityAndEligibilityMarkdown(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const q = pack.quality_evidence;
  const lines = [
    '# Signal Quality & Task Eligibility Evidence',
    '',
    `* **Total Detected Beats**: ${q.total_beats}`,
    `* **Accepted NN Intervals**: ${q.accepted_nn_beats}`,
    `* **Artifact Ratio**: ${q.artifact_percentage.toFixed(2)}%`,
    `* **SNR (dB)**: ${q.snr_db !== null ? q.snr_db.toFixed(1) + ' dB' : 'N/A'}`,
    `* **SNR Quality Status**: ${q.snr_quality_status || 'NOT_ASSESSED'}`,
    `* **Motion Severity**: ${q.motion_severity || 'NONE'}`,
    `* **ECG Clipping Fraction**: ${q.ecg_clipping_fraction !== null ? (q.ecg_clipping_fraction * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : 'N/A'}`,
    `* **ECG Noisy Window Fraction**: ${q.ecg_noisy_window_fraction !== null ? (q.ecg_noisy_window_fraction * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : 'N/A'}`,
    '',
    '## Task Eligibility Breakdown',
    '| Task ID | State | Warnings | Limitations |',
    '| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |'
  ];
  for (const [taskId, t] of Object.entries(pack.task_eligibility)) {
    const w = (t.warnings || []).join('; ');
    const l = (t.limitations || []).join('; ');
    lines.push(`| \`${taskId}\` | **${t.state}** | ${w || '—'} | ${l || '—'} |`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

function renderV2ComparisonSummaryMarkdown(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const c = pack.comparison_context;
  const lines = [
    '# Longitudinal Trends and Baseline Evidence',
    '',
    `* **Target Session ID**: \`${c.target_session_id}\``,
    `* **Compatible Peer Sessions**: ${c.compatible_peer_count}`,
    `* **Excluded Historical Sessions**: ${c.excluded_peer_count}`,
    `* **Comparison Status**: **${c.status.toUpperCase()}**`,
    ''
  ];
  if (c.excluded_reasons.length > 0) {
    lines.push('### Reasons for Peer Session Exclusion:');
    for (const r of c.excluded_reasons) {
      lines.push(`* ${r}`);
    }
    lines.push('');
  }
  if (c.comparisons) {
    lines.push('### Metric Variations vs Compatible Baseline (Median):');
    lines.push('| Metric | Current Value | Baseline Median | Difference | Diff (%) | Unit |');
    lines.push('| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |');
    for (const [mKey, diff] of Object.entries(c.comparisons)) {
      if (diff) {
        const label = mKey.toLowerCase() === 'rmssd' ? 'RMSSD (мс)' : (mKey.toLowerCase() === 'sdnn' ? 'SDNN (мс)' : mKey.toUpperCase());
        lines.push(`| **${label}** | ${diff.current ?? '—'} | ${diff.baseline_median ?? '—'} | ${diff.diff ?? '—'} | ${diff.diff_percent !== null ? (diff.diff_percent > 0 ? '+' : '') + diff.diff_percent + '%' : '—'} | ${diff.unit} |`);
      }
    }
  } else {
    lines.push('> **Baseline Unavailable**: Insufficient compatible canonical sessions were found for this user under Frozen Protocol v1.1.0. General reference values are not substituted to prevent false physiological conclusions.');
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('* Отслеживаемые метрики персонального тренда: **RMSSD (мс)**, **SDNN (мс)**, **pNN50 (%)**, **Ср. ЧСС (уд/мин)**.');
  }
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('### Limitations:');
  for (const l of c.limitations) {
    lines.push(`* ${l}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

function renderV2MethodologyAndLimitsMarkdown(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const m = pack.methodology_and_limits;
  return `# Scientific Methodology & Non-Medical Boundaries

**Protocol Authority**: \`${m.frozen_protocol_authority}\`  
**Engine & Build Version**: \`CardioLab v${m.build_version}\`  
**Evaluation Timestamp (UTC)**: \`${m.timestamp_utc}\`

---

## 1. Deterministic Time-Domain Formulas
* **RMSSD**: Root Mean Square of Successive Differences across validated NN intervals:
  $$\\text{RMSSD} = \\sqrt{\\frac{1}{N-1} \\sum_{i=1}^{N-1} (NN_{i+1} - NN_i)^2}$$
* **SDNN**: Unbiased Sample Standard Deviation using Bessel's correction ($N-1$):
  $$\\text{SDNN} = \\sqrt{\\frac{1}{N-1} \\sum_{i=1}^N (NN_i - \\overline{NN})^2}$$
* **pNN50**: Percentage of successive NN differences exceeding 50 ms over total successive interval pairs.

---

## 2. Cryptographic Source Integrity & Immutability
All analytical metrics are derived deterministically from canonical source bundle records identified cryptographically via SHA-256 hashes. No downstream presentation or AI commentary layer has authority to modify or recompute core metric values.

---

## 3. Strict Non-Medical & Non-Diagnostic Limits
* **NON-DIAGNOSTIC NOTICE**: ${m.non_medical_disclaimer}
* **INSTRUCTION TO AI MODELS**: ${m.non_diagnostic_notice}
`;
}

function renderV2SuggestedQuestionsMarkdown(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const lines = [
    '# Suggested Non-Medical Questions for Further Exploration',
    '',
    'The following inquiries are framed strictly within non-diagnostic athletic tracking and physiology research boundaries:',
    ''
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < pack.suggested_questions.length; i++) {
    lines.push(`${i + 1}. ${pack.suggested_questions[i]}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function validateV2SemanticSourceGraph(): { passed: boolean; violations: string[] } {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const entry of V2_SEMANTIC_SOURCE_RENDER_GRAPH) {
    if (!entry.exactSemanticSource.includes('AIInterpretationPackContextV2')) {
      violations.push(`Member "${entry.fileName}" has non-V2 semantic source: "${entry.exactSemanticSource}"`);
    }
    if (!entry.renderer || entry.renderer.length === 0) {
      violations.push(`Member "${entry.fileName}" has empty renderer`);
    }
  }
  return { passed: violations.length === 0, violations };
}

function renderV2LegacyContextProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): any {
  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    session_id: pack.session_context.session_id,
    session_date: pack.session_context.start_time_utc ? pack.session_context.start_time_utc.split('T')[0] : 'UNKNOWN_DATE',
    duration_seconds: pack.session_context.duration_seconds,
    duration_formatted: pack.session_context.duration_formatted,
    recording_context: pack.session_context.recording_context,
    signals_present: pack.session_context.signals_present,
    quality: {
      total_beats: pack.quality_evidence.total_beats,
      accepted_nn_beats: pack.quality_evidence.accepted_nn_beats,
      artifact_percentage: pack.quality_evidence.artifact_percentage
    },
    core_metrics: {
      rmssd: pack.core_metrics.rmssd.value,
      sdnn: pack.core_metrics.sdnn.value,
      pnn50: pack.core_metrics.pnn50.value,
      mean_hr_bpm: pack.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value,
      mean_rr_ms: pack.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.value
    },
    task_eligibility: pack.task_eligibility,
    provenance: pack.provenance,
    compatibility_mode: 'v2_canonical_projection'
  };
}

function renderV2LegacyTrendsSummaryProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  return renderV2ComparisonSummaryMarkdown(pack);
}

function renderV2LegacyTrendsInterpretationProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): any {
  return {
    schema_version: '2.0.0',
    target_session_id: pack.session_context.session_id,
    comparison_context: pack.comparison_context,
    compatibility_mode: 'v2_canonical_projection'
  };
}

function renderV2LegacyTrendsTimeseriesProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const c = pack.comparison_context;
  const rows = ['session_id,status,rmssd_ms,sdnn_ms,mean_hr_bpm,recovery_1min'];
  if (c.comparisons) {
    for (const [key, diff] of Object.entries(c.comparisons)) {
      if (diff) {
        rows.push(`${c.target_session_id},current,${diff.current ?? ''},,,`);
      }
    }
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

function renderV2LegacyTrendsQualityProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): any {
  return {
    target_session_id: pack.session_context.session_id,
    compatible_peer_count: pack.comparison_context.compatible_peer_count,
    excluded_peer_count: pack.comparison_context.excluded_peer_count,
    status: pack.comparison_context.status,
    limitations: pack.comparison_context.limitations,
    compatibility_mode: 'v2_canonical_projection'
  };
}

function renderV2LegacyTimelineProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const s = pack.session_context;
  const durMs = (s.duration_seconds || 0) * 1000;
  return [
    'event,timestamp_utc,offset_ms',
    `session_start,${s.start_time_utc || ''},0`,
    `session_end,${s.end_time_utc || ''},${durMs}`
  ].join('\n');
}

function renderV2LegacyAnalysisPackProjection(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2, userNotes?: string | null): string {
  return renderV2SessionSummaryMarkdown(pack, userNotes);
}

/**
 * Commits an approved preview into persistent storage and records the pack_exported product event.
 */
export async function commitApprovedP4Preview(previewId: string, options?: { isLegacyV1?: boolean; expectedFingerprint?: string }): Promise<LlmPackResult> {
  cleanExpiredPreviews();
  const cached = previewCache.get(previewId);
  if (!cached) {
    const err = new Error(`Preview with ID "${previewId}" not found or expired. Please generate a new preview.`);
    (err as any).statusCode = 412;
    throw err;
  }

  if (options?.expectedFingerprint && cached.requestFingerprint && options.expectedFingerprint !== cached.requestFingerprint) {
    const err = new Error(`Request fingerprint mismatch for preview "${previewId}". Expected "${options.expectedFingerprint}", cached is "${cached.requestFingerprint}".`);
    (err as any).statusCode = 409;
    throw err;
  }

  const currentCanonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(cached.request.sessionId).catch(() => null);
  const currentHash = currentCanonical?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || currentCanonical?.source_bundle_id || 'unverified';
  if (currentHash !== cached.canonicalSessionHash) {
    previewCache.delete(previewId);
    const err = new Error(`Session canonical state changed since preview "${previewId}" was created. TOCTOU check failed.`);
    (err as any).statusCode = 409;
    throw err;
  }

  // Pre-commit member-by-member byte & SHA-256 verification
  for (const entry of cached.finalEntries) {
    const buf = entry.content || (entry.contentBuffer) || (entry.filePath && fs.existsSync(entry.filePath) ? fs.readFileSync(entry.filePath) : (entry.contentString ? Buffer.from(entry.contentString, 'utf8') : null));
    if (!buf) {
      const err = new Error(`Member payload missing for "${entry.name}" during pre-commit verification`);
      (err as any).statusCode = 412;
      throw err;
    }
    const memberClass = entry.memberClass || determinePackMemberClass(entry.name);
    if (memberClass === 'raw_physiological_series' && !cached.request.rawSeriesOptIn) {
      const err = new Error(`Raw physiological series "${entry.name}" present without explicit opt-in.`);
      (err as any).statusCode = 403;
      throw err;
    }
    if (memberClass === 'physiological_excerpt' && !cached.request.signalExcerptOptIn && cached.request.ecgStripsMode === 'none') {
      const err = new Error(`Physiological excerpt "${entry.name}" present without explicit opt-in.`);
      (err as any).statusCode = 403;
      throw err;
    }
  }

  // Export ZIP using cached exact finalEntries
  const db = getDb();
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(cached.request.sessionId) as any;
  const existingUser = db.prepare('SELECT id, export_alias FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(cached.request.userId) as any;
  const sessionUser = session?.user_id ? db.prepare('SELECT id, export_alias FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(session.user_id) as any : null;
  const defaultUser = db.prepare('SELECT id, export_alias FROM users WHERE id = ?').get('default') as any;

  let validUserId = existingUser?.id || sessionUser?.id || defaultUser?.id;
  if (!validUserId) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    validUserId = cached.request.userId || 'default';
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, 'Athlete', 'Athlete', 'self', 35, 60, 185, 1, ?, ?)
      `).run(validUserId, now, now);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  const user = getUserProfile(validUserId) || {
    id: validUserId,
    display_name: 'Athlete',
    export_alias: 'Athlete',
    is_active: 1,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const rawFlags = getCandidateFlags(cached.request.sessionId);
  const seenFlags = new Set<string>();
  const flags = rawFlags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seenFlags.has(key)) return false;
    seenFlags.add(key);
    return true;
  });

  const exportDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'llm_exports');
  if (!fs.existsSync(exportDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(exportDir, { recursive: true });
  }
  const cleanAlias = (user.export_alias || 'Athlete').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
  const cleanDate = (session?.start_time || new Date().toISOString()).substring(0, 16).replace(/[-:T]/g, '');
  const cleanActivity = cached.request.exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact' ? 'gemini' : cached.request.exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full' ? 'chatgpt' : 'antigravity';
  const zipFilename = `h10_llm_pack_${cleanAlias}_${cleanDate}_${cleanActivity}_${cached.preview.packId}.zip`;
  const zipPath = path.join(exportDir, zipFilename);

  try {
    const zipResult = await writeFlatZip({
      entries: cached.finalEntries,
      outputDir: exportDir,
      outputFilename: zipFilename,
      profile: cached.request.exportProfile
    });

    const est = estimatePreflight({
      exportProfile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      eventExportMode: cached.request.eventExportMode,
      durationSeconds: session?.duration_seconds || 0,
      flagsCount: flags.length,
      uniqueEventTypesCount: new Set(flags.map(f => f.flag_type)).size,
      numSessions: 1,
      ecgStripsMode: cached.request.ecgStripsMode || 'none',
      excludeEcgCsv: cached.request.excludeEcgCsv,
      limitEcgStrips: cached.request.limitEcgStrips,
      selectedPrompt: cached.request.selectedPrompt,
      flags
    });

    let totalUncompressed = 0;
    let totalText = 0;
    let totalTextChars = 0;
    let totalBinary = 0;
    for (const e of cached.finalEntries) {
      let b = 0;
      if (e.content) {
        b = e.content.length;
      } else if (e.sizeBytes) {
        b = e.sizeBytes;
      } else if (e.filePath && fs.existsSync(e.filePath)) {
        b = fs.statSync(e.filePath).size;
      }
      totalUncompressed += b;
      if (e.kind === 'png' || (e.name && e.name.endsWith('.png'))) {
        totalBinary += b;
      } else {
        totalText += b;
        if (typeof e.content === 'string') {
          totalTextChars += e.content.length;
        } else if (Buffer.isBuffer(e.content)) {
          totalTextChars += e.content.toString('utf8').length;
        } else if (e.filePath && fs.existsSync(e.filePath)) {
          totalTextChars += fs.readFileSync(e.filePath, 'utf8').length;
        }
      }
    }

    const plan = est.plan!;
    plan.actual_zip_bytes = zipResult.sizeBytes;
    plan.actual_uncompressed_bytes = totalUncompressed;
    plan.actual_text_bytes = totalText;
    plan.actual_text_characters = totalTextChars > 0 ? totalTextChars : totalText;
    (plan as any).actual_text_chars_total = plan.actual_text_characters;
    plan.actual_binary_bytes = totalBinary;

    const providerFamily = cached.request.exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full'
      ? 'chatgpt'
      : cached.request.exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact'
        ? 'gemini'
        : 'antigravity';

    const selectedPromptId = cached.request.selectedPrompt || 'none';
    const selectedPromptName = cached.request.selectedPrompt || 'none';

    let frozenPromptBytes = '';
    if (selectedPromptName !== 'none' && selectedPromptName !== 'data_only') {
      for (const e of cached.finalEntries) {
        if (determinePackMemberClass(e.name) === 'prompt' || e.name.toLowerCase().includes('prompt')) {
          if ((e as any).data) {
            frozenPromptBytes = typeof (e as any).data === 'string' ? (e as any).data : (e as any).data.toString('utf8');
            break;
          } else if ((e as any).content) {
            frozenPromptBytes = typeof (e as any).content === 'string' ? (e as any).content : (e as any).content.toString('utf8');
            break;
          } else if ((e as any).filePath && fs.existsSync((e as any).filePath)) {
            frozenPromptBytes = fs.readFileSync((e as any).filePath, 'utf8');
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (!frozenPromptBytes && selectedPromptName) {
        try {
          frozenPromptBytes = getPromptContent(selectedPromptName);
        } catch {}
      }
    }

    const promptSha256 = frozenPromptBytes ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(frozenPromptBytes).digest('hex') : null;
    const requestFingerprint = cached.requestFingerprint || crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({
      sessionId: session.id,
      exportProfile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      privacyLevel: cached.request.privacyLevel,
      userGoal: cached.request.userGoal || 'session_first_look',
      selectedPrompt: selectedPromptName,
      promptSha256,
      canonicalSemanticHash: cached.preview.canonicalSemanticHash
    })).digest('hex');

    // Record preview approval event
    recordProductEvent('preview_approved', {
      userId: user.id,
      sessionId: session.id,
      previewId: cached.preview.previewId,
      exportProfile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      privacyLevel: cached.request.privacyLevel,
      userGoal: cached.request.userGoal
    });

    // Check for repeat pack generation
    const db = getDb();
    const existingPacks = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM llm_packs WHERE session_id = ? OR user_id = ?').get(session.id, user.id) as { count: number } | undefined;
    if (existingPacks && existingPacks.count > 0) {
      recordProductEvent('repeat_pack_generation', {
        userId: user.id,
        sessionId: session.id,
        previousPacksCount: existingPacks.count,
        exportProfile: cached.request.exportProfile
      });
    }

    const metadataObj = {
      ...(cached.finalManifest || {}),
      export_profile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      provider_family: providerFamily,
      privacy_level: cached.request.privacyLevel,
      user_goal: cached.request.userGoal || 'session_first_look',
      selected_prompt: selectedPromptName,
      selected_prompt_id: selectedPromptId,
      selected_prompt_name: selectedPromptName,
      frozen_prompt_bytes: frozenPromptBytes,
      prompt_bytes: frozenPromptBytes,
      prompt_sha256: promptSha256,
      request_fingerprint: requestFingerprint,
      preview_id: cached.preview.previewId,
      canonical_result_identity: cached.preview.canonicalResultIdentity || cached.finalManifest?.canonical_result_identity || null,
      canonical_semantic_hash: cached.preview.canonicalSemanticHash,
      canonical_schema_version: options?.isLegacyV1 ? '1.0.0' : '2.0.0',
      pack_mode: options?.isLegacyV1 ? 'legacy_v1_direct' : 'v2_canonical',
      is_legacy: !!options?.isLegacyV1,
      manifest_id: cached.preview.packId,
      raw_series_opt_in: !!cached.request.rawSeriesOptIn,
      signal_excerpt_opt_in: !!cached.request.signalExcerptOptIn,
      files: cached.preview.files,
      analysis_context_snapshot: cached.preview.analysisContextSnapshot || null,
      plan
    };

    const record: LlmPackRecord = {
      id: cached.preview.packId,
      session_id: session.id,
      user_id: user.id,
      export_profile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      filename: zipFilename,
      filepath: zipResult.zipPath,
      size_bytes: zipResult.sizeBytes,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      metadata_json: JSON.stringify(metadataObj),
    };
    saveLlmPack(record);

    recordProductEvent('pack_exported', {
      userId: user.id,
      sessionId: session.id,
      packId: cached.preview.packId,
      previewId: cached.preview.previewId,
      exportProfile: cached.request.exportProfile,
      canonicalSemanticHash: cached.preview.canonicalSemanticHash
    });

    previewCache.delete(previewId);

    return {
      packId: cached.preview.packId,
      filename: zipFilename,
      filepath: zipResult.zipPath,
      sizeBytes: zipResult.sizeBytes,
      entryCount: cached.finalEntries.length,
      plan
    };
  } finally {
    for (const entry of cached.finalEntries) {
      if ((entry as any).filePath && fs.existsSync((entry as any).filePath)) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync((entry as any).filePath);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Main coordinator to compile a flat ZIP evidence pack for LLM analysis.
 * V2 requires prior approved previewId.
 */
export async function compileLlmPack(request: LlmPackRequest): Promise<LlmPackResult> {
  if (request.previewId) {
    return await commitApprovedP4Preview(request.previewId, {
      expectedFingerprint: request.expectedFingerprint || (request as any).expected_fingerprint
    });
  }
  if (request.userGoal || (request as any).version === 'v2') {
    throw new Error('V2 export requires prior approved previewId; self-approval of unreviewed packs is prohibited.');
  }
  return await compileLegacyV1PackDirect(request);
}

/**
 * Legacy V1 direct compilation for historical usage/tests without prior approved previewId.
 */
export async function compileLegacyV1PackDirect(request: LlmPackRequest): Promise<LlmPackResult> {
  const legacyRequest: LlmPackRequest = {
    ...request,
    userGoal: undefined
  };
  const preview = await buildP4PackCandidate(legacyRequest, true /* isLegacyV1Direct */);
  return await commitApprovedP4Preview(preview.previewId, { isLegacyV1: true });
}

/**
 * Builds candidate pack in-memory for preview and scanner validation without writing to disk or DB.
 */
export async function buildP4PackCandidate(request: LlmPackRequest, isLegacyV1Direct?: boolean): Promise<LlmPackPreviewResult> {
  if (request.privacyLevel === 'internal_debug' && request.exportProfile !== 'antigravity_local_debug') {
    throw new Error('Privacy level "internal_debug" is prohibited for web export profiles (ChatGPT, Gemini).');
  }

  if (request.ecgStripsMode && request.ecgStripsMode !== 'none' && !request.signalExcerptOptIn) {
    throw new Error('Physiological signal excerpts (ECG strips) require explicit signalExcerptOptIn consent.');
  }

  const db = getDb();
  
  // 1. Fetch Session
  const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM visible_sessions WHERE id = ?').get(request.sessionId) as any;
  if (!session) {
    throw new Error(`Session with ID "${request.sessionId}" not found.`);
  }

  // 2. Fetch User Profile & Canonical Session
  const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(request.sessionId).catch(() => null);
  const canonicalAiPack = canonicalSession ? projectCanonicalSessionToAiPack(canonicalSession) : null;
  const isLegacyUnverified = !canonicalSession;

  const user = getUserProfile(request.userId) || getUserProfile('default') || {
    id: 'default',
    display_name: 'Спортсмен (по умолчанию)',
    export_alias: 'Athlete',
    is_active: 1,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;
  const zoneConfig = canonicalSession?.heart_rate_zones?.configuration;
  const hasValidCanonicalZones = !!(zoneConfig && Array.isArray(zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm) && zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[5] > 0);

  const resolvedZones = hasValidCanonicalZones ? {
    mode: zoneConfig!.mode,
    source: zoneConfig!.source,
    boundariesBpm: zoneConfig!.boundaries_bpm,
    configHash: zoneConfig!.config_hash,
    updatedAt: undefined
  } : (!isCanonical ? resolveHeartRateZones({
    max_hr: user.max_hr ?? 185,
    resting_hr: user.resting_hr ?? 60,
    custom_zones: user.custom_zones
  }, user.age ?? 35) : null);

  const privacyContext: import('./privacy').PrivacyContext = {
    realName: user.display_name,
    exportAlias: user.export_alias,
    deviceId: session.device_id,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
  };

  const budget = BUDGETS[request.exportProfile];
  const packId = `pack_${request.sessionId}_${Date.now()}`;
  
  // Clean filenames: replace spaces/colons
  const cleanAlias = user.export_alias.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
  const cleanDate = session.start_time.substring(0, 16).replace(/[-:T]/g, '');
  const cleanActivity = request.exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact' ? 'gemini' : request.exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full' ? 'chatgpt' : 'antigravity';
  
  const zipFilename = `h10_llm_pack_${cleanAlias}_${cleanDate}_${cleanActivity}_${packId}.zip`;
  const exportDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'llm_exports');

  // Load ancillary DB records
  const qcMetrics = getSessionQcMetrics(request.sessionId);
  const analyticsMetrics = getSessionMetrics(request.sessionId);
  const rawFlags = getCandidateFlags(request.sessionId);
  const seenFlags = new Set<string>();
  const flags = rawFlags.filter(f => {
    const key = `${f.timestamp_offset_ms}_${f.flag_type}_${f.severity}`;
    if (seenFlags.has(key)) return false;
    seenFlags.add(key);
    return true;
  });
  const signalFiles = getSessionSignals(request.sessionId);
  const sessionStartMs = new Date(session.start_time).getTime();

  const annotation = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type, user_notes FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as { activity_type: string; user_notes?: string } | undefined;
  const sessionActivityType = annotation?.activity_type || 'unknown';

  // Read notes if enabled
  let userNotes: string | null = null;
  if (request.includeNotes && annotation?.user_notes) {
    userNotes = redactText(annotation.user_notes.trim(), privacyContext);
  }

  // Canonical Trend Observation service for compatible peers
  const allObservations = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser(request.userId || session.user_id || 'default', sessionActivityType);
  const comparisonPeers = allObservations
    .filter(obs => obs.session_id !== session.id)
    .map(obs => {
      const isCompatible = obs.evidence_mode === 'canonical' && obs.rmssd_eligibility !== 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
      return {
        id: obs.session_id,
        isCompatible,
        exclusionReason: !isCompatible ? (obs.evidence_mode !== 'canonical' ? 'legacy_unverified_protocol' : 'ineligible_quality_gate') : undefined,
        metrics: {
          rmssd: obs.rmssd,
          sdnn: obs.sdnn,
          mean_hr: obs.avg_hr
        }
      };
    });

  const userGoal = request.userGoal || 'session_first_look';
  const canonicalAiPackV2 = canonicalSession ? projectCanonicalSessionToAiPackV2(canonicalSession, {
    sessionAlias: `${user.export_alias}_${session.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
    recordingContext: sessionActivityType !== 'unknown' ? sessionActivityType : 'general_workout',
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    includeNotes: request.includeNotes,
    rawSeriesOptIn: request.rawSeriesOptIn ?? false,
    userGoal,
    comparisonPeers
  }) : null;
  const canonicalSemanticHash = canonicalAiPackV2 ? computeCanonicalSemanticHash(canonicalAiPackV2) : '';

  let v2SessionSummaryMd = '';
  let v2MetricTableCsv = '';
  let v2QualityAndEligibilityMd = '';
  let v2ComparisonSummaryMd = '';
  let v2MethodologyAndLimitsMd = '';
  let v2SuggestedQuestionsMd = '';

  if (canonicalAiPackV2) {
    const rawNamedWindows = getNamedWindowsForSession(session.id);
    const namedWindows = (rawNamedWindows || []).map(w => ({
      ...w,
      name: redactText(w.name, privacyContext)
    }));
    v2SessionSummaryMd = renderV2SessionSummaryMarkdown(canonicalAiPackV2, userNotes, namedWindows);
    v2MetricTableCsv = renderV2MetricTableCsv(canonicalAiPackV2);
    v2QualityAndEligibilityMd = renderV2QualityAndEligibilityMarkdown(canonicalAiPackV2);
    v2ComparisonSummaryMd = renderV2ComparisonSummaryMarkdown(canonicalAiPackV2);
    v2MethodologyAndLimitsMd = renderV2MethodologyAndLimitsMarkdown(canonicalAiPackV2);
    v2SuggestedQuestionsMd = renderV2SuggestedQuestionsMarkdown(canonicalAiPackV2);
  }

  const driftAnalysis = {
    value_percent: null,
    status: 'unavailable' as const,
    reasons: ['requires_external_workload_power_meter_and_20min_duration']
  };

  // For V2 packs, v2ComparisonSummaryMd based on canonical trend observations is the sole comparison authority.

  const presentationSummary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession,
    qcMetrics,
    analyticsMetrics
  });

  // Create temporary list of entries to build before writing zip
  const rawEntries: (Omit<FlatZipEntry, 'content'> & { contentString?: string; contentBuffer?: Buffer })[] = [];

  let metricsSummary: any = null;
  let qualityReport: any = null;
  let timelineCsvRows: string[] = [];
  let hrCsvStr = '';
  let rrCsvStr = '';
  let eventsCsvStr = '';

  // 1. P4 V2 Canonical Core Files & Projections (Single Semantic Authority)
  if (canonicalAiPackV2) {
    metricsSummary = renderV2LegacyMetricsProjection(canonicalAiPackV2);
    qualityReport = renderV2LegacyQualityProjection(canonicalAiPackV2);
    timelineCsvRows = renderV2LegacyTimelineProjection(canonicalAiPackV2).split('\n');

    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'canonical_result.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(canonicalAiPackV2, null, 2),
        description: 'Canonical AI interpretation context derived strictly from CanonicalSessionResult.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_semantic'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'session_summary.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: v2SessionSummaryMd,
        description: 'Human-readable session overview and metadata index.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_semantic'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'metric_table.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: v2MetricTableCsv,
        description: 'Tabular overview of core and advanced analytical metrics.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'quality_and_eligibility.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: v2QualityAndEligibilityMd,
        description: 'Signal quality indicators, beat lineage, and task eligibility gates.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'comparison_summary.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: v2ComparisonSummaryMd,
        description: 'Longitudinal comparison against compatible peer sessions.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_semantic'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'methodology_and_limits.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: v2MethodologyAndLimitsMd,
        description: 'Scientific methodology, formulas, and non-medical research boundaries.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: 'suggested_questions.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: v2SuggestedQuestionsMd,
        description: 'Structured non-diagnostic inquiries for exploratory analysis.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });

      // Deterministic V2 Compatibility Projections
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '01_AI_INTERPRETATION_CONTEXT.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(renderV2LegacyContextProjection(canonicalAiPackV2), null, 2),
        description: 'Canonical AI interpretation context derived strictly from CanonicalSessionResult.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_semantic'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '02_METRICS_SUMMARY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(metricsSummary, null, 2),
        description: 'HR and HRV aggregate summary metrics.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '03_QUALITY_REPORT.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(qualityReport, null, 2),
        description: 'Data quality control (QC) assessment details.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '04_SESSION_TIMELINE.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: renderV2LegacyTimelineProjection(canonicalAiPackV2),
        description: 'Timeline milestones for the recording.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '08_TRAINING_LOAD_SUMMARY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(renderV2LegacyTrainingLoadProjection(canonicalAiPackV2), null, 2),
        description: 'Distribution of heart rate zones and decoupling factor.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }
  } else {
    // Legacy Non-V2 compilation
    // 01_AI_INTERPRETATION_CONTEXT.json (Pure Canonical Core Projection)
    if (canonicalAiPack && request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '01_AI_INTERPRETATION_CONTEXT.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(canonicalAiPack, null, 2),
        description: 'Canonical AI interpretation context derived strictly from CanonicalSessionResult.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_semantic'
      });
    }

    // 02_METRICS_SUMMARY.json
    metricsSummary = {
      pack_mode: isLegacyUnverified ? 'legacy_unverified' : 'canonical',
      session_id: session.id,
      start_time: session.start_time,
      end_time: session.end_time,
      duration_seconds: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.timing.duration_seconds : session.duration_seconds,
      avg_hr: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value : session.avg_hr,
      min_hr: session.min_hr,
      max_hr: session.max_hr,
      legacy_overall_quality_score_non_authoritative: session.overall_quality_score ?? null,
      rmssd: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value : (isLegacyUnverified ? (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null) : null),
      sdnn: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value : (isLegacyUnverified ? (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null) : null),
      pnn50: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value : (isLegacyUnverified ? (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null) : null),
      mean_hr_bpm: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value : null,
      mean_rr_ms: canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.value : null,
      canonical_source_bundle_id: canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id ?? null,
      canonical_core_metrics: canonicalAiPack?.core_metrics ?? canonicalSession?.core_metrics ?? null,
      canonical_task_eligibility: canonicalAiPack?.task_eligibility ?? canonicalSession?.task_eligibility ?? null,
      canonical_provenance: canonicalAiPack?.provenance ?? canonicalSession?.provenance ?? null,
      recovery_1min: canonicalSession
        ? (canonicalSession.recovery_metrics?.recovery_1min?.value_bpm_drop ?? null)
        : (analyticsMetrics?.recovery_1min ?? null),
      recovery_2min: canonicalSession
        ? (canonicalSession.recovery_metrics?.recovery_2min?.value_bpm_drop ?? null)
        : (analyticsMetrics?.recovery_2min ?? null),
      hr_drift_ratio: isCanonical ? null : (driftAnalysis.value_percent !== null ? driftAnalysis.value_percent / 100 : null),
      cardiac_drift: isCanonical ? {
        value_percent: null,
        status: 'unavailable',
        reasons: ['Требуются согласованный внешний датчик мощности и непрерывная запись >= 20 мин'],
        feature_maturity: 'Bounded'
      } : {
        value_percent: driftAnalysis.value_percent,
        status: driftAnalysis.status,
        reasons: driftAnalysis.reasons,
        feature_maturity: 'ImplementationDebt'
      },
      heart_rate_zones: hasValidCanonicalZones ? {
        zones_source: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.source,
        zones_mode: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.mode,
        zones_boundaries_bpm: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.boundaries_bpm,
        zones_updated_at: null,
        zones_config_hash: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.config_hash,
        hr_zone_distribution_maturity: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones?.distribution?.maturity ?? null,
        hr_zone_configuration_maturity: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.maturity ?? 'Bounded',
        aggregate_maturity: 'Bounded',
        eligibility: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones?.distribution?.eligibility ?? 'ineligible',
        limitations: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.configuration.limitations ?? []
      } : (isCanonical ? {
        zones_source: null,
        zones_mode: null,
        zones_boundaries_bpm: null,
        zones_updated_at: null,
        zones_config_hash: null,
        hr_zone_distribution_maturity: null,
        hr_zone_configuration_maturity: 'Bounded',
        aggregate_maturity: 'Bounded',
        eligibility: 'ineligible',
        limitations: ['Canonical zone configuration snapshot missing or invalid; profile fallback prohibited.']
      } : {
        zones_source: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.source : null,
        zones_mode: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.mode : null,
        zones_boundaries_bpm: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.boundariesBpm : null,
        zones_updated_at: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.updatedAt : null,
        zones_config_hash: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.configHash : null,
        hr_zone_distribution_maturity: null,
        hr_zone_configuration_maturity: 'Bounded',
        aggregate_maturity: 'Bounded',
        eligibility: 'legacy_unverified',
        limitations: ['Legacy session with unverified zones.']
      }),
      ecg_rr_agreement: presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement,
      provenance: presentationSummary.provenance,
      safety_claim: presentationSummary.safety_claim
    };
    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '02_METRICS_SUMMARY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(metricsSummary, null, 2),
        description: 'HR and HRV aggregate summary metrics.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }

    const agreementInput = makeEcgRrAgreementInput(qcMetrics);
    const agreementPres = getEcgRrAgreementPresentation(agreementInput);
    const canonicalAgreementPres = isCanonical ? {
      eligible: false,
      status_category: 'unavailable',
      value_percent: null,
      display_value: '—',
      reasons: ['Требуются валидированные парные записи Polar (H10 simultaneous/paired) для подтверждения согласованности каналов']
    } : agreementPres;

    const isTimebaseMonotonic = canonicalSession 
      ? (canonicalSession.timing?.timebase_monotonic !== false && !canonicalSession.task_eligibility?.rmssd?.blocking_reasons?.some(r => r.toLowerCase().includes('monotonic') || r.toLowerCase().includes('timestamp')))
      : (qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status === 'valid');
    const authoritativeMonotonicity = isTimebaseMonotonic ? 'valid' : 'invalid';

    // 03_QUALITY_REPORT.json
    qualityReport = qcMetrics ? {
      session_id: qcMetrics.session_id,
      monotonicity_status: authoritativeMonotonicity,
      missing_samples_count: qcMetrics.missing_samples_count,
      duplicate_timestamps_count: qcMetrics.duplicate_timestamps_count,
      ecg_clipping_seconds: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.clipping.value ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? null),
      ecg_noise_ratio: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.noisy_window_fraction.value ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics.ecg_noise_ratio ?? null),
      ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.baseline_drift.value ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio ?? null),
      acc_motion_severity: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession?.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity ?? null),
      ecg_rr_consistency: isCanonical ? null : qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency,
      ecg_rr_agreement: presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement,
      legacy_overall_quality_score_non_authoritative: session.overall_quality_score ?? null,
      ecg_rr_agreement_presentation: canonicalAgreementPres,
      safety_claim: presentationSummary.safety_claim
    } : {};
    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '03_QUALITY_REPORT.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(qualityReport, null, 2),
        description: 'Data quality control (QC) assessment details.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }

    // 04_SESSION_TIMELINE.csv
    timelineCsvRows = [
      'event,timestamp_utc,offset_ms',
      `session_start,${session.start_time},0`,
      `session_end,${session.end_time},${session.duration_seconds * 1000}`,
    ];
    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '04_SESSION_TIMELINE.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: timelineCsvRows.join('\n'),
        description: 'Timeline milestones for the recording.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }

    // 08_TRAINING_LOAD_SUMMARY.json
    const trainingLoad = {
      session_id: session.id,
      hr_drift_ratio: isCanonical ? null : (driftAnalysis.value_percent !== null ? driftAnalysis.value_percent / 100 : null),
      cardiac_drift: isCanonical ? {
        value_percent: null,
        status: 'unavailable',
        reasons: ['Требуются согласованный внешний датчик мощности и непрерывная запись >= 20 мин']
      } : {
        value_percent: driftAnalysis.value_percent,
        status: driftAnalysis.status,
        reasons: driftAnalysis.reasons
      },
      time_in_zones: canonicalSession?.heart_rate_zones?.distribution?.eligibility === 'eligible' && canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z1_seconds !== null ? {
        1: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z1_seconds,
        2: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z2_seconds,
        3: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z3_seconds,
        4: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z4_seconds,
        5: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z5_seconds
      } : (isLegacyUnverified && analyticsMetrics?.time_in_zones ? JSON.parse(analyticsMetrics.time_in_zones) : null),
      time_in_zones_provenance: canonicalSession?.heart_rate_zones?.distribution?.eligibility === 'eligible' && canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones.distribution.z1_seconds !== null
        ? 'canonical_v1_1'
        : (isLegacyUnverified && analyticsMetrics?.time_in_zones ? 'legacy_unverified' : 'ineligible_or_unavailable'),
    };
    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '08_TRAINING_LOAD_SUMMARY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(trainingLoad, null, 2),
        description: 'Distribution of heart rate zones and decoupling factor.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }
  }

  // 09_CANDIDATE_EVENTS.csv replaced by taxonomy aggregation
  const aggregatedEvents = aggregateCandidateEvents(flags, qcMetrics);
  const summaryCsvStr = compileEventSummaryCsv(aggregatedEvents);
  const densityCsvStr = compileEventDensityCsv(flags);
  const representativeCsvStr = compileRepresentativeEventsCsv(flags);

  // Raw/Debug candidate events dump
  const isDebugMode = request.exportProfile === 'antigravity_local_debug' || request.eventExportMode === 'debug';
  
  const rawEventsRows = ['flag_id,offset_ms,type,severity,description_ru'];
  for (const f of flags) {
    let type = f.flag_type;
    if (type === 'RR outlier') type = 'candidate_rr_outlier';
    if (type === 'Actual missing data') type = 'data_gap';
    if (type === 'ECG high-frequency noise') type = 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise';
    if (type === 'Baseline drift') type = 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift';
    if (type === 'Motion artifact') type = 'motion_artifact';
    if (type === 'Timestamp/sync issue') type = 'sync_issue';
    rawEventsRows.push(`${f.id},${f.timestamp_offset_ms},${type},${f.severity},"${f.description_ru.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`);
  }
  const rawEventsCsvStr = rawEventsRows.join('\n');
  eventsCsvStr = summaryCsvStr; // Set eventsCsvStr for gemini Single File markdown to be compact summary

  if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
    if (request.eventExportMode === 'summary') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '09_CANDIDATE_EVENT_SUMMARY.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: summaryCsvStr,
        description: 'Aggregated summary of candidate events by type.',
        memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
      });
    } else {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '09_CANDIDATE_EVENT_SUMMARY.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: summaryCsvStr,
        description: 'Aggregated summary of candidate events by type.',
        memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '10_EVENT_DENSITY_BY_MINUTE.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: densityCsvStr,
        description: 'Minute-by-minute count of candidate events.',
        memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '11_REPRESENTATIVE_EVENTS.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: representativeCsvStr,
        description: 'Representative examples of candidate events (up to 5 per type).',
        memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
      });

      if (isDebugMode && request.rawSeriesOptIn) {
        rawEntries.push({
          name: '09_DEBUG_RAW_CANDIDATE_EVENTS.csv',
          kind: 'csv',
          contentString: rawEventsCsvStr,
          description: 'Full unaggregated dump of candidate events (debug only).',
          memberClass: 'debug_internal'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Process Signals (HR & RR)
  const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
  let hrPointsCount = 0;
  let rrPointsCount = 0;
  let ecgStripsCount = 0;
  let hrPointsForChart: { timeMs: number; value: number }[] = [];

  for (const file of signalFiles) {
    const filePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${file.id}_${file.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) continue;

    if (file.signal_type === 'HR') {
      const allHr = await readHRGz(filePath);
      hrPointsForChart = allHr.map((p) => ({ timeMs: p.timeMs, value: p.hrBpm }));

      // Downsample HR based on profile limits
      const skip = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(allHr.length / budget.maxCsvRowsPerFile));
      const hrRows = ['offset_ms,hr_bpm'];
      for (let i = 0; i < allHr.length; i += skip) {
        const offset = allHr[i].timeMs - sessionStartMs;
        hrRows.push(`${offset},${allHr[i].hrBpm}`);
      }
      hrPointsCount = hrRows.length - 1;
      hrCsvStr = hrRows.join('\n');
      if (request.rawSeriesOptIn && request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
        rawEntries.push({
          name: '05_HR_DOWNSAMPLED.csv',
          kind: 'csv',
          contentString: hrCsvStr,
          description: `Downsampled 1Hz pulse timeseries data (${hrPointsCount} samples).`,
          memberClass: 'raw_physiological_series'
        });
      }
    }

    if (file.signal_type === 'RR' && request.rawSeriesOptIn) {
      const allRr = await readRRGz(filePath);
      
      // Clean RR outliers
      const cleanRr = allRr.filter(p => p.rrMs >= 270 && p.rrMs <= 2000);
      const skip = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(cleanRr.length / budget.maxCsvRowsPerFile));
      
      const rrRows = ['offset_ms,rr_ms'];
      for (let i = 0; i < cleanRr.length; i += skip) {
        const offset = cleanRr[i].timeMs - sessionStartMs;
        rrRows.push(`${offset},${cleanRr[i].rrMs}`);
      }
      rrPointsCount = rrRows.length - 1;
      rrCsvStr = rrRows.join('\n');
      if (request.rawSeriesOptIn && request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
        rawEntries.push({
          name: '06_RR_CLEANED.csv',
          kind: 'csv',
          contentString: rrCsvStr,
          description: `Filtered R-R interval timeseries data (${rrPointsCount} samples).`,
          memberClass: 'raw_physiological_series'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Generate HR Timeline Chart PNG
  if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact' && hrPointsForChart.length > 0) {
    try {
      const chartBuf = generateEcgPlot(800, 250, hrPointsForChart);
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '20_CHART_HR_TIMELINE.png',
        kind: 'png',
        contentBuffer: chartBuf,
        description: 'Visual timeline graph showing the session heart rate trend.',
        memberClass: 'chart'
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  // ECG strips PNG + CSV extraction
  const ecgFile = signalFiles.find(f => f.signal_type === 'ECG');
  if (ecgFile && request.ecgStripsMode !== 'none' && request.signalExcerptOptIn) {
    const ecgFilePath = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${ecgFile.id}_ecg.txt.gz`);
    if (fs.existsSync(ecgFilePath)) {
      // 1. Cluster flags using mergeGap = 0
      const { clusters } = clusterEvents(flags, budget.maxEcgStripSeconds, 0);

      const stripsLimit = request.limitEcgStrips !== undefined ? Math.min(request.limitEcgStrips, budget.maxEcgStrips) : budget.maxEcgStrips;
      
      // 2. Select representative clusters
      const repClusters = selectRepresentativeClusters(clusters, stripsLimit);
      ecgStripsCount = repClusters.length;

      // 3. Generate visual PNG strips for selected representative clusters
      for (let idx = 0; idx < repClusters.length; idx++) {
        const cluster = repClusters[idx];
        const flag = cluster.representativeEvent;
        const flagOffset = flag.timestamp_offset_ms;
        const flagAbsoluteTime = sessionStartMs + flagOffset;
        
        // Window selection based on event window
        const windowSeconds = getEventWindowSeconds(flag.flag_type, budget.maxEcgStripSeconds);
        const windowHalfWidth = (windowSeconds / 2) * 1000;
        const startMs = flagAbsoluteTime - windowHalfWidth;
        const endMs = flagAbsoluteTime + windowHalfWidth;

        // Read specific segment using gzip stream with options
        const ecgPoints = await readECGGz(ecgFilePath, { startMs, endMs });
        
        const suffix = String(idx + 1).padStart(3, '0');
        const csvName = `31_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.csv`;
        const pngName = `30_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.png`;

        // Create CSV lines
        const csvRows = ['offset_ms,ecg_uv'];
        const plotPoints: { timeMs: number; value: number }[] = [];
        
        for (const pt of ecgPoints) {
          const relativeOffset = pt.timeMs - sessionStartMs;
          csvRows.push(`${relativeOffset},${pt.ecgUv}`);
          plotPoints.push({ timeMs: relativeOffset, value: pt.ecgUv });
        }

        // Draw waveform PNG
        const skipPlot = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(plotPoints.length / 5000));
        const downsampledPlotPoints = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < plotPoints.length; i += skipPlot) {
          downsampledPlotPoints.push(plotPoints[i]);
        }
        const pngBuf = generateEcgPlot(800, 250, downsampledPlotPoints, flagOffset);

        // Individual event CSV is NOT generated for Antigravity Local Debug
        if (request.exportProfile !== 'antigravity_local_debug' && !request.excludeEcgCsv) {
          rawEntries.push({
            name: csvName,
            kind: 'csv',
            contentString: csvRows.join('\n'),
            description: `ECG voltage values segment surrounding candidate flag event ID ${flag.id}.`,
            memberClass: 'raw_physiological_series'
          });
        }

        rawEntries.push({
          name: pngName,
          kind: 'png',
          contentBuffer: pngBuf,
          description: `Visual waveform grid image surrounding candidate flag event ID ${flag.id}.`,
          memberClass: 'physiological_excerpt'
        });
      }

      // 4. If Antigravity Local Debug and raw ECG is explicitly opted-in and NOT excluded, write full-session ECG once, events table, and event cluster index
      if (request.exportProfile === 'antigravity_local_debug' && request.rawSeriesOptIn) {
        if (!request.excludeEcgCsv) {
          const allPoints = await readECGGz(ecgFilePath);
          const os = require('os');
          const tempEcgPath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `ecg_full_${session.id}_${Date.now()}.csv`);
          const ecgWriteStream = fs.createWriteStream(tempEcgPath);
          const ecgHash = crypto.createHash('sha256');

          let totalBytes = 0;
          const writeLine = (line: string) => {
            const buf = Buffer.from(line, 'utf8');
            ecgWriteStream.write(buf);
            ecgHash.update(buf);
            totalBytes += buf.length;
          };

          writeLine('offset_ms,ecg_uv\n');
          for (const pt of allPoints) {
            writeLine(`${pt.timeMs - sessionStartMs},${pt.ecgUv}\n`);
          }

          await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
            ecgWriteStream.end(() => resolve());
            ecgWriteStream.on('error', reject);
          });

          const sha256 = ecgHash.digest('hex');

          rawEntries.push({
            name: 'ecg_full.csv',
            kind: 'csv',
            filePath: tempEcgPath,
            sizeBytes: totalBytes,
            sha256: sha256,
            description: 'Complete raw ECG signal timeseries for the entire session.',
            rowCount: allPoints.length,
            memberClass: 'raw_physiological_series'
          } as any);
        }


        const eventRows = ['event_id,event_type,event_time,severity,window_start,window_end,cluster_id,source,algorithm_version,quality_status'];
        for (const cluster of clusters) {
          for (const f of cluster.events) {
            const type = mapFlagType(f.flag_type);
            const eventTime = sessionStartMs + f.timestamp_offset_ms;
            const windowSeconds = getEventWindowSeconds(f.flag_type, 30);
            const halfWidthMs = (windowSeconds / 2) * 1000;
            const windowStart = Math.max(0, f.timestamp_offset_ms - halfWidthMs);
            const windowEnd = f.timestamp_offset_ms + halfWidthMs;
            
            const severity = f.severity || 'low';
            const qualityStatus = getSeverityValue(severity) <= 1 ? 'clear' : 'suspect';
            
            eventRows.push(`${f.id},${type},${eventTime},${severity},${windowStart},${windowEnd},${cluster.clusterId},"Polar H10","1.0.0","${qualityStatus}"`);
          }
        }
        rawEntries.push({
          name: 'candidate_events.csv',
          kind: 'csv',
          contentString: eventRows.join('\n'),
          description: 'Complete table of all candidate events with timestamps and quality context.',
          memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
        });
