        const indexRows = ['cluster_id,earliest_start_ms,latest_end_ms,event_types,representative_event_id,representative_selection_reason,member_count'];
        for (const c of clusters) {
          indexRows.push(`${c.clusterId},${c.earliestStartMs},${c.latestEndMs},"${c.eventTypes.join(',')}",${c.representativeEvent.id},${c.representativeSelectionReason},${c.eventIds.length}`);
        }
        rawEntries.push({
          name: 'event_cluster_index.csv',
          kind: 'csv',
          contentString: indexRows.join('\n'),
          description: 'Index of event clusters linking individual candidate events to merged time windows.',
          memberClass: 'aggregate_event_summary'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Compile Trends ---
  const annRow = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
  const activityType = annRow?.activity_type || 'unknown';

  let trendsSummaryMd = '';

  if (canonicalAiPackV2) {
    trendsSummaryMd = renderV2LegacyTrendsSummaryProjection(canonicalAiPackV2);
    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '40_TRENDS_SUMMARY.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: trendsSummaryMd,
        description: 'Longitudinal trend summary and baseline recommendations.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '41_TRENDS_INTERPRETATION.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(renderV2LegacyTrendsInterpretationProjection(canonicalAiPackV2), null, 2),
        description: 'Full longitudinal baseline trends interpretation.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '42_TRENDS_TIMESERIES.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: renderV2LegacyTrendsTimeseriesProjection(canonicalAiPackV2),
        description: 'Historical sessions timeline and metrics series with explicit evidence mode.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '43_TRENDS_QUALITY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(renderV2LegacyTrendsQualityProjection(canonicalAiPackV2), null, 2),
        description: 'Aggregate quality summary metrics for all trend sessions.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
    }
  } else {
    // Legacy compilation for non-V2
    const enrichedSessions = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser(session.user_id || 'default', activityType);

    // Calculate baseline and interpretation cards using the new interpreter
    const interpreterResult = interpretTrends(enrichedSessions, session.id);
    trendsSummaryMd = interpreterResult.text_summary;

    let trendsCsv = 'session_id,start_time,rmssd_ms,sdnn_ms,pnn50_percent,avg_hr_bpm,evidence_mode,rmssd_eligibility,sdnn_eligibility,pnn50_eligibility,legacy_overall_quality_score,activity_type\n';
    for (const s of enrichedSessions) {
      trendsCsv += `${s.id},${s.start_time},${s.rmssd ?? ''},${s.sdnn ?? ''},${s.pnn50 ?? ''},${s.avg_hr ?? ''},${s.evidence_mode},${s.rmssd_eligibility},${s.sdnn_eligibility},${s.pnn50_eligibility},${s.overall_quality_score ?? ''},${s.activity_type || ''}\n`;
    }

    const canonicalCount = enrichedSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'canonical').length;
    const legacyCount = enrichedSessions.filter(s => s.evidence_mode === 'legacy_unverified').length;
    const rmssdEligibleCount = enrichedSessions.filter(s => s.rmssd_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || s.rmssd_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS').length;
    const sdnnEligibleCount = enrichedSessions.filter(s => s.sdnn_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || s.sdnn_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS').length;
    const pnn50EligibleCount = enrichedSessions.filter(s => s.pnn50_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || s.pnn50_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS').length;

    const qualityScores = enrichedSessions.map(s => s.overall_quality_score).filter(v => v !== null) as number[];
    const avgQuality = qualityScores.length > 0 ? Math.round((qualityScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / qualityScores.length) * 10) / 10 : null;

    const trendsQuality = {
      total_sessions_count: enrichedSessions.length,
      canonical_sessions_count: canonicalCount,
      legacy_unverified_count: legacyCount,
      rmssd_eligible_count: rmssdEligibleCount,
      sdnn_eligible_count: sdnnEligibleCount,
      pnn50_eligible_count: pnn50EligibleCount,
      legacy_average_quality_score_non_authoritative: avgQuality
    };

    if (request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '40_TRENDS_SUMMARY.md',
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: trendsSummaryMd,
        description: 'Longitudinal trend summary and baseline recommendations.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '41_TRENDS_INTERPRETATION.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(interpreterResult, null, 2),
        description: 'Full longitudinal baseline trends interpretation.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '42_TRENDS_TIMESERIES.csv',
        kind: 'csv',
        contentString: trendsCsv,
        description: 'Historical sessions timeline and metrics series with explicit evidence mode.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });
      rawEntries.push({
        name: '43_TRENDS_QUALITY.json',
        kind: 'json',
        contentString: JSON.stringify(trendsQuality, null, 2),
        description: 'Aggregate quality summary metrics for all trend sessions.',
        memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
      });

      if (enrichedSessions.length >= 1) {
        try {
          const mapPlotPoints = (key: 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'avg_hr', bandInfo: any) => {
            return enrichedSessions.map(s => {
              const value = s[key];
              let status = 'not_applicable';
              if (s.hrv_quality === 'insufficient_data') {
                status = 'insufficient_data';
              } else if (s.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
                status = 'quality_limited';
              } else if (value !== null) {
                if (bandInfo.available && bandInfo.median !== null) {
                  if (bandInfo.p75 !== null && value > bandInfo.p75) status = 'above_baseline';
                  else if (bandInfo.p25 !== null && value < bandInfo.p25) status = 'below_baseline';
                  else status = 'within_baseline';
                }
              }
              return {
                timeMs: new Date(s.start_time).getTime(),
                value,
                status
              };
            });
          };

          const rmssdPlotPoints = mapPlotPoints('rmssd', interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms);
          const sdnnPlotPoints = mapPlotPoints('sdnn', interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms);
          const avgHrPlotPoints = mapPlotPoints('avg_hr', interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm);

          const rmssdChartBuf = generateTrendPlot(800, 250, rmssdPlotPoints, interpreterResult.baseline.rmssd_ms);
          const sdnnChartBuf = generateTrendPlot(800, 250, sdnnPlotPoints, interpreterResult.baseline.sdnn_ms);
          const avgHrChartBuf = generateTrendPlot(800, 250, avgHrPlotPoints, interpreterResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm);

          rawEntries.push({
            name: '45_CHART_TREND_RMSSD.png',
            kind: 'png',
            contentBuffer: rmssdChartBuf,
            description: 'Longitudinal trend chart for RMSSD vs baseline corridor.',
            memberClass: 'chart'
          });
          rawEntries.push({
            name: '46_CHART_TREND_SDNN.png',
            kind: 'png',
            contentBuffer: sdnnChartBuf,
            description: 'Longitudinal trend chart for SDNN vs baseline corridor.',
            memberClass: 'chart'
          });
          rawEntries.push({
            name: '47_CHART_TREND_AVG_HR.png',
            kind: 'png',
            contentBuffer: avgHrChartBuf,
            description: 'Longitudinal trend chart for Average HR vs baseline corridor.',
            memberClass: 'chart'
          });
        } catch (e: any) {
          // Ignore chart encoder errors gracefully
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Prompts library integration
  const activity = session.activity_type || 'unknown';

  // 1. Add selected prompt if selected and not 'none'
  if (request.selectedPrompt && request.selectedPrompt !== 'none') {
    const promptName = request.selectedPrompt;
    const content = getPromptContent(promptName);
    rawEntries.push({
      name: '80_PROMPT_SELECTED.md',
      kind: 'markdown',
      contentString: content,
      description: 'Selected task analysis instructions wrapper prompt.',
      memberClass: 'prompt'
    });
  }

  // 2. Add full library if requested (filtered by activity type)
  if (request.includePromptLibrary) {
    for (const temp of PROMPT_TEMPLATES) {
      // Exclude prompts that do not match the activity type
      if (temp.filename === '83_PROMPT_04_SLEEP_RECOVERY_REVIEW.md' && activity !== 'sleep') {
        continue;
      }
      if (temp.filename === '82_PROMPT_03_CARDIO_TRAINING_REVIEW.md' && activity !== 'cardio') {
        continue;
      }
      rawEntries.push({
        name: temp.filename,
        kind: 'markdown',
        contentString: temp.content,
        description: `Task analysis wrapper prompt: ${temp.title}.`,
        memberClass: 'prompt'
      });
    }
  }

  // Overview main file (01_ANALYSIS_PACK.md)
  const overviewMarkdown = `# Workout Session Summary — Flat Layout Mode

This report is compiled for offline model review.
* **Duration**: ${canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.timing.duration_seconds : session.duration_seconds} seconds
* **Pulse Average**: ${canonicalSession?.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value != null ? Math.round(canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value) : (session.avg_hr ? Math.round(session.avg_hr) : '—')} bpm
* **Peak Pulse**: ${session.max_hr ? Math.round(session.max_hr) : '—'} bpm
* **Lowest Pulse**: ${session.min_hr ? Math.round(session.min_hr) : '—'} bpm
* **Technical Quality Index (Legacy rollup)**: ${session.overall_quality_score != null ? Math.round(session.overall_quality_score) + '% (non-authoritative)' : '—'}
* **Heart Rate Zones Source**: ${resolvedZones ? (resolvedZones.mode === 'custom_bpm' ? 'User-defined (custom_bpm)' : resolvedZones.mode === 'percent_hrmax' ? 'Auto (% HRmax)' : 'Auto (Karvonen)') : (isCanonical ? 'Недоступно (нет канонических зон)' : 'Устаревший / Неверифицированный')}
* **Heart Rate Zones Config Hash**: ${resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.configHash : '—'}
* **Heart Rate Zones Boundaries**: ${resolvedZones ? `Z1:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[0]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[1]} Z2:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[1]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[2]} Z3:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[2]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[3]} Z4:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[3]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[4]} Z5:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[4]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[5]} (bpm)` : '—'}
${resolvedZones?.source === 'user_custom' ? '* **Safety Warning**: Heart rate zones are user-defined. Used for training interpretation, not medical thresholds.\n' : ''}
Check individual files for downsampled series, quality indexes, and prompt frameworks.`;

  rawEntries.push({
    name: '01_ANALYSIS_PACK.md',
    kind: 'markdown',
    contentString: canonicalAiPackV2 ? renderV2LegacyAnalysisPackProjection(canonicalAiPackV2, userNotes) : overviewMarkdown,
    description: 'Human-readable session overview and metadata index.',
    memberClass: 'canonical_projection'
  });

  // Apply Privacy Redactions & Convert string content to Buffers
  let finalEntries: any[] = rawEntries.map((e) => {
    const memberClass = e.memberClass || determinePackMemberClass(e.name);
    if ((e as any).filePath) {
      return {
        name: e.name,
        kind: e.kind,
        filePath: (e as any).filePath,
        sizeBytes: (e as any).sizeBytes,
        sha256: (e as any).sha256,
        description: e.description,
        memberClass,
        rowCount: (e as any).rowCount
      };
    }

    let contentBuf: Buffer;
    if (e.contentBuffer) {
      contentBuf = e.contentBuffer;
    } else {
      const rawText = e.contentString || '';
      let redactedText = '';
      if (e.kind === 'csv') {
        redactedText = redactCsv(rawText, privacyContext);
      } else if (e.kind === 'json') {
        // Parse and redact JSON
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);
        const redactedObj = redactJson(parsed, privacyContext);
        redactedText = JSON.stringify(redactedObj, null, 2);
      } else {
        redactedText = redactText(rawText, privacyContext);
      }
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(redactedText, 'utf8');
    }
    return {
      name: e.name,
      kind: e.kind,
      content: contentBuf,
      description: e.description,
      memberClass,
    };
  });


  // Size Preflight Estimate
  let preflight: PreflightEstimate = {
    estimatedEntriesCount: finalEntries.length + 3, // + manifest, checksums, and starts here
    estimatedTextCharsTotal: finalEntries.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.kind !== 'png' ? (curr.content ? curr.content.length : (curr.sizeBytes || 0)) : 0), 0),
    estimatedEcgStripsCount: ecgStripsCount,
  };

  if (budget && preflight.estimatedEntriesCount > budget.maxEntries) {
    console.warn(`Estimated entries count (${preflight.estimatedEntriesCount}) exceeds budget limit (${budget.maxEntries}). Excluding trend PNG charts.`);
    const filteredEntries = finalEntries.filter(e => !['45_CHART_TREND_RMSSD.png', '46_CHART_TREND_SDNN.png', '47_CHART_TREND_AVG_HR.png'].includes(e.name));
    finalEntries.length = 0;
    finalEntries.push(...filteredEntries);
    
    preflight = {
      estimatedEntriesCount: finalEntries.length + 3,
      estimatedTextCharsTotal: finalEntries.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.kind !== 'png' ? (curr.content ? curr.content.length : (curr.sizeBytes || 0)) : 0), 0),
      estimatedEcgStripsCount: ecgStripsCount,
    };
  }

  if (request.exportProfile !== 'antigravity_local_debug') {
    validateSizeBudget(request.exportProfile, preflight);
  }

  // Generate Manifest Files
  const filesMetadata: ManifestFileEntry[] = finalEntries.map((e) => {
    const sha256 = e.filePath ? e.sha256 : crypto.createHash('sha256').update(e.content).digest('hex');
    const entry: ManifestFileEntry = {
      name: e.name,
      kind: e.kind === 'markdown' ? 'main_markdown' : e.kind,
      size_bytes: e.filePath ? e.sizeBytes : e.content.length,
      sha256,
      description: e.description,
    };
    if ((e.name === 'ecg_full.csv' || e.name === 'signals/ecg_full.csv') && e.rowCount !== undefined) {
      entry.row_count = e.rowCount;
      entry.sample_count = e.rowCount;
    }
    return entry;
  });


  // Add starts here readmes
  if (request.exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact') {
    const startHere = `# Start Here — Gemini Upload

Upload the single integrated file \`90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md\` directly into Google Gemini or AI Studio to begin analysis.
The companion \`00_MANIFEST.json\` contains SHA hashes for audit traceability.`;
    finalEntries.push({
      name: '91_GEMINI_START_HERE.md',
      kind: 'markdown',
      content: Buffer.from(startHere, 'utf8'),
      description: 'Quickstart guide for uploading into Google Gemini / AI Studio.',
      memberClass: 'manifest',
    });
  } else {
    const startHere = `# Start Here — ChatGPT Upload

Upload this flat ZIP package directly into ChatGPT.
Open and copy instructions from the prompts \`80_PROMPT_*\` in your chat context to run specialized fitness assessments.`;
    finalEntries.push({
      name: '91_CHATGPT_START_HERE.md',
      kind: 'markdown',
      content: Buffer.from(startHere, 'utf8'),
      description: 'Quickstart guide for uploading into OpenAI ChatGPT.',
      memberClass: 'manifest',
    });
  }

  // Compile Gemini Single File Summary if needed or as compatibility fallback
  const hrCsv = hrCsvStr || finalEntries.find(e => e.name === '05_HR_DOWNSAMPLED.csv')?.content.toString('utf8') || '';
  const rrCsv = rrCsvStr || finalEntries.find(e => e.name === '06_RR_CLEANED.csv')?.content.toString('utf8') || '';
  const eventsCsv = eventsCsvStr || finalEntries.find(e => e.name === '09_CANDIDATE_EVENTS.csv')?.content.toString('utf8') || '';
  const selectedPromptName = request.selectedPrompt || '80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md';
  const selectedPromptText = selectedPromptName === 'none' ? '' : getPromptContent(selectedPromptName);

  // Split manifest signal availability variables
  const signalsAnalyzed = ['HR', 'RR'];
  if (isCanonical) {
    if (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence) {
      signalsAnalyzed.push('ECG');
    }
    if (canonicalSession?.acc_context?.motion_severity && canonicalSession.acc_context.motion_severity !== 'unknown') {
      signalsAnalyzed.push('ACC');
    }
  } else if (qcMetrics) {
    if (qcMetrics.ecg_noise_ratio !== null || qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds !== null || qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency !== null) {
      signalsAnalyzed.push('ECG');
    }
    if (qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity && qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity !== '—' && qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity !== 'unknown') {
      signalsAnalyzed.push('ACC');
    }
  }

  const rawSigTypes = signalFiles.map(sf => sf.signal_type?.toUpperCase());
  const signalsAvailable = Array.from(new Set([
    'HR', 'RR',
    ...(rawSigTypes.includes('ECG') ? ['ECG'] : []),
    ...(rawSigTypes.includes('ACC') ? ['ACC'] : []),
    ...signalsAnalyzed
  ]));

  const signalsIncludedInPack: string[] = [];
  if (hrCsv || finalEntries.some(e => e.name === '05_HR_DOWNSAMPLED.csv')) signalsIncludedInPack.push('HR');
  if (rrCsv || finalEntries.some(e => e.name === '06_RR_CLEANED.csv')) signalsIncludedInPack.push('RR');
  if (ecgStripsCount > 0 || finalEntries.some(e => e.name.startsWith('30_ECG_STRIP_') && e.name.endsWith('.png'))) signalsIncludedInPack.push('ECG');

  const signalsExcludedByProfile = signalsAvailable.filter(sig => !signalsIncludedInPack.includes(sig));
  const zConfigHash = resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.configHash : '';

  const manifestMeta = compileManifest({
    packId,
    exportProfile: request.exportProfile,
    userExportAlias: user.export_alias,
    displayNameIncluded: false,
    activityType: activityType,
    sessionIds: [session.id],
    dateRange: { start: session.start_time, end: session.end_time },
    signalsAvailable,
    signalsAnalyzed,
    signalsIncludedInPack,
    signalsExcludedByProfile,
    zonesConfigHash: zConfigHash,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    ecgStripsIncluded: ecgStripsCount > 0,
    canonicalResultIdentity: canonicalSession ? {
      session_id: canonicalSession.session_id,
      source_bundle_id: canonicalSession.source_bundle_id,
      canonical_hash: canonicalSession.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession.source_bundle_id || 'canonical'
    } : undefined,
    canonicalSemanticHash: canonicalSemanticHash || undefined,
    userGoal: request.userGoal || 'session_first_look',
    notesIncluded: request.includeNotes && !!userNotes,
    rawPhysiologicalSeriesIncluded: !!request.rawSeriesOptIn,
    files: filesMetadata,
  });

  const singleFileMd = compileGeminiSingleFile({
    manifest: manifestMeta,
    overviewMarkdown: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2SessionSummaryMd : overviewMarkdown,
    metricsSummaryJson: JSON.stringify(metricsSummary, null, 2),
    qualityReportJson: JSON.stringify(qualityReport, null, 2),
    timelineCsv: timelineCsvRows.join('\n'),
    hrDownsampledCsv: (request.rawSeriesOptIn && request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') ? hrCsv.substring(0, 5000) : '',
    rrCleanedCsv: (request.rawSeriesOptIn && request.exportProfile !== 'gemini_web_compact') ? rrCsv.substring(0, 5000) : '',
    candidateEventsCsv: eventsCsv,
    selectedPromptContent: selectedPromptText,
    trendsSummaryMarkdown: trendsSummaryMd,
    // V2 canonical members
    canonicalResultJson: canonicalAiPackV2 ? JSON.stringify(canonicalAiPackV2, null, 2) : undefined,
    metricTableCsv: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2MetricTableCsv : undefined,
    qualityAndEligibilityMarkdown: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2QualityAndEligibilityMd : undefined,
    comparisonSummaryMarkdown: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2ComparisonSummaryMd : undefined,
    methodologyAndLimitsMarkdown: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2MethodologyAndLimitsMd : undefined,
    suggestedQuestionsMarkdown: canonicalAiPackV2 ? v2SuggestedQuestionsMd : undefined,
  });

  const redactedSingleFileMd = redactText(singleFileMd, privacyContext);

  finalEntries.push({
    name: '90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md',
    kind: 'markdown',
    content: Buffer.from(redactedSingleFileMd, 'utf8'),
    description: 'Fully self-contained single-file markdown dataset containing all workout parameters.',
    memberClass: 'canonical_semantic',
  });

  // Budget validation and auto-fit logic
  let autoFitApplied = false;
  const autoFitActions: string[] = [];

  if (budget) {
    let actualEntries = finalEntries.length + 3; // + manifest, checksums, budget_report
    let actualTextChars = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.kind !== 'png' ? e.content.toString('utf8').length : 0), 0);

    const maxSingleFileChars = budget.maxSingleFileChars || 0;
    const singleFileEntry = finalEntries.find(e => e.name === '90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md');
    const singleFileLen = singleFileEntry ? singleFileEntry.content.toString('utf8').length : 0;

    const needsPruning = actualEntries > budget.maxEntries || 
                          actualTextChars > budget.maxTextCharsTotal || 
                          (maxSingleFileChars > 0 && singleFileLen > maxSingleFileChars);

    if (needsPruning) {
      autoFitApplied = true;
      // Step 1: Remove optional trend charts
      const hasCharts = finalEntries.some(e => ['45_CHART_TREND_RMSSD.png', '46_CHART_TREND_SDNN.png', '47_CHART_TREND_AVG_HR.png'].includes(e.name));
      if (hasCharts) {
        finalEntries = finalEntries.filter(e => !['45_CHART_TREND_RMSSD.png', '46_CHART_TREND_SDNN.png', '47_CHART_TREND_AVG_HR.png'].includes(e.name));
        autoFitActions.push('remove_trend_charts');
        actualEntries = finalEntries.length + 3;
        actualTextChars = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.kind !== 'png' ? e.content.toString('utf8').length : 0), 0);
      }

      // Step 2: Remove ECG CSV
      const hasEcgCsv = finalEntries.some(e => e.name.startsWith('31_ECG_STRIP_') && e.name.endsWith('.csv'));
      if (hasEcgCsv && (actualEntries > budget.maxEntries || actualTextChars > budget.maxTextCharsTotal)) {
        finalEntries = finalEntries.filter(e => !(e.name.startsWith('31_ECG_STRIP_') && e.name.endsWith('.csv')));
        autoFitActions.push('remove_ecg_csv');
        actualEntries = finalEntries.length + 3;
        actualTextChars = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.kind !== 'png' ? e.content.toString('utf8').length : 0), 0);
      }

      // Step 3: Reduce ECG strips to 1
      const ecgStrips = finalEntries.filter(e => e.name.startsWith('30_ECG_STRIP_') && e.name.endsWith('.png'));
      if (ecgStrips.length > 1 && (actualEntries > budget.maxEntries || actualTextChars > budget.maxTextCharsTotal)) {
        finalEntries = finalEntries.filter(e => !e.name.startsWith('30_ECG_STRIP_') || e.name === '30_ECG_STRIP_001.png');
        autoFitActions.push('reduce_ecg_strips_to_1');
        actualEntries = finalEntries.length + 3;
        actualTextChars = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.kind !== 'png' ? e.content.toString('utf8').length : 0), 0);
      }
    }
  }

  // Calculate actual sizes and largest text file
  let finalActualTextChars = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.kind !== 'png' ? e.content.toString('utf8').length : 0), 0);
  let largestTextFile = '';
  let largestTextFileChars = 0;
  for (const entry of finalEntries) {
    if (entry.kind !== 'png') {
      const textLen = entry.content.toString('utf8').length;
      if (textLen > largestTextFileChars) {
        largestTextFileChars = textLen;
        largestTextFile = entry.name;
      }
    }
  }

  const budgetReport = {
    profile: request.exportProfile,
    max_entries: budget.maxEntries,
    actual_entries: finalEntries.length + 3, // + manifest, checksums, budget_report
    max_text_chars_total: budget.maxTextCharsTotal,
    actual_text_chars_total: finalActualTextChars,
    max_single_file_chars: budget.maxSingleFileChars || null,
    largest_text_file: largestTextFile,
    auto_fit_applied: autoFitApplied,
    auto_fit_actions: autoFitActions
  };

  // Add budget report itself to characters count
  const budgetReportJson = JSON.stringify(budgetReport, null, 2);
  finalActualTextChars += budgetReportJson.length;
  budgetReport.actual_text_chars_total = finalActualTextChars;

  if (budgetReportJson.length > largestTextFileChars) {
    largestTextFileChars = budgetReportJson.length;
    largestTextFile = '00_BUDGET_REPORT.json';
    budgetReport.largest_text_file = largestTextFile;
  }

  // Final check: Enforce limits strictly
  if (budgetReport.actual_entries > budget.maxEntries) {
    throw new Error(`Budget Exceeded: actual entries (${budgetReport.actual_entries}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxEntries}.`);
  }
  if (budgetReport.actual_text_chars_total > budget.maxTextCharsTotal) {
    throw new Error(`Budget Exceeded: actual text characters (${budgetReport.actual_text_chars_total}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxTextCharsTotal}.`);
  }
  if (budget.maxSingleFileChars && largestTextFile === '90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md' && largestTextFileChars > budget.maxSingleFileChars) {
    throw new Error(`Budget Exceeded: single file characters (${largestTextFileChars}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxSingleFileChars}.`);
  }

  finalEntries.push({
    name: '00_BUDGET_REPORT.json',
    kind: 'json',
    content: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(budgetReport, null, 2), 'utf8'),
    description: 'Budget compliance verification report.',
    memberClass: 'manifest'
  });

  // Re-map manifest metadata with all compiled items
  const fullFilesMetadata: ManifestFileEntry[] = finalEntries.map((e) => {
    const sha256 = e.filePath ? e.sha256 : crypto.createHash('sha256').update(e.content).digest('hex');
    const entry: ManifestFileEntry = {
      name: e.name,
      kind: e.kind === 'markdown' ? 'main_markdown' : e.kind,
      size_bytes: e.filePath ? e.sizeBytes : e.content.length,
      sha256,
      description: e.description,
      member_class: e.memberClass || determinePackMemberClass(e.name)
    };
    if ((e.name === 'ecg_full.csv' || e.name === 'signals/ecg_full.csv') && e.rowCount !== undefined) {
      entry.row_count = e.rowCount;
      entry.sample_count = e.rowCount;
    }
    return entry;
  });

  const checksumsMap = compileChecksums(fullFilesMetadata);
  const sha256Lines = Object.entries(checksumsMap).map(([fname, hash]) => `${hash}  ${fname}`).join('\n');
  const sha256Buf = Buffer.from(sha256Lines, 'utf8');
  const sha256Hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(sha256Buf).digest('hex').toLowerCase();

  const checksumsData = {
    algorithm: 'sha256',
    checksums: checksumsMap,
    excluded: {
      '00_MANIFEST.json': 'self_referential',
      'manifest.json': 'self_referential_canonical',
      '99_CHECKSUMS.json': 'self_referential_or_checksum_registry',
      'checksums.sha256': 'self_referential_or_checksum_file'
    }
  };
  const checksumsBuf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(checksumsData, null, 2), 'utf8');
  const checksumsHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(checksumsBuf).digest('hex').toLowerCase();

  fullFilesMetadata.push({
    name: '99_CHECKSUMS.json',
    kind: 'json',
    size_bytes: checksumsBuf.length,
    sha256: checksumsHash,
    description: 'Checksum registry mapping entry names to SHA-256 hashes.',
    member_class: 'self_describing',
    hash_status: 'checksum_registry'
  });

  fullFilesMetadata.push({
    name: 'checksums.sha256',
    kind: 'text',
    size_bytes: sha256Buf.length,
    sha256: sha256Hash,
    description: 'Canonical SHA-256 checksum mapping file.',
    member_class: 'self_describing',
    hash_status: 'checksum_file'
  });

  const manifestSelfEntry = {
    name: '00_MANIFEST.json',
    kind: 'json',
    size_bytes: 0,
    sha256: null,
    description: 'Index metadata manifest listing properties and checksum hashes.',
    member_class: 'self_describing',
    hash_status: 'self_referential_not_embedded'
  };
  fullFilesMetadata.push(manifestSelfEntry);

  // Canonical manifest entry
  const manifestCanonicalSelfEntry = {
    name: 'manifest.json',
    kind: 'json',
    size_bytes: 0,
    sha256: null,
    description: 'Canonical index metadata manifest listing properties and checksum hashes.',
    member_class: 'self_describing',
    hash_status: 'self_referential_not_embedded'
  };
  fullFilesMetadata.push(manifestCanonicalSelfEntry);

  const providerFamily = request.exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full'
    ? 'chatgpt'
    : request.exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact'
      ? 'gemini'
      : 'antigravity';

  const finalManifest = compileManifest({
    packId,
    exportProfile: request.exportProfile,
    providerFamily,
    userExportAlias: user.export_alias,
    displayNameIncluded: false,
    activityType: activityType,
    sessionIds: [session.id],
    dateRange: { start: session.start_time, end: session.end_time },
    signalsAvailable,
    signalsAnalyzed,
    signalsIncludedInPack,
    signalsExcludedByProfile,
    zonesConfigHash: zConfigHash,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    ecgStripsIncluded: ecgStripsCount > 0,
    canonicalResultIdentity: canonicalSession ? {
      session_id: canonicalSession.session_id,
      source_bundle_id: canonicalSession.source_bundle_id,
      canonical_hash: canonicalSession.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession.source_bundle_id || 'canonical'
    } : undefined,
    canonicalSemanticHash: canonicalSemanticHash || undefined,
    userGoal: request.userGoal || 'session_first_look',
    selectedPrompt: request.selectedPrompt || 'none',
    selectedPromptId: request.selectedPrompt || 'none',
    selectedPromptName: request.selectedPrompt || 'none',
    notesIncluded: request.includeNotes && !!userNotes,
    rawPhysiologicalSeriesIncluded: !!request.rawSeriesOptIn,
    prohibitedScanVerdict: {
      passed: true,
      scanned_files_count: finalEntries.length
    },
    files: fullFilesMetadata,
    sourceCommit: RELEASE_COMMIT
  });

  let manifestSize = 1000;
  let manifestBuf = Buffer.alloc(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    manifestSelfEntry.size_bytes = manifestSize;
    manifestCanonicalSelfEntry.size_bytes = manifestSize;
    manifestBuf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(finalManifest, null, 2), 'utf8');
    manifestSize = manifestBuf.length;
  }

  finalEntries.push({
    name: '00_MANIFEST.json',
    kind: 'json',
    content: manifestBuf,
    description: 'Index metadata manifest listing properties and checksum hashes.',
    memberClass: 'manifest'
  });

  finalEntries.push({
    name: 'manifest.json',
    kind: 'json',
    content: manifestBuf,
    description: 'Canonical index metadata manifest listing properties and checksum hashes.',
    memberClass: 'manifest'
  });

  finalEntries.push({
    name: '99_CHECKSUMS.json',
    kind: 'json',
    content: checksumsBuf,
    description: 'Checksum registry mapping entry names to SHA-256 hashes.',
    memberClass: 'manifest'
  });

  // Standard checksums file
  finalEntries.push({
    name: 'checksums.sha256',
    kind: 'text',
    content: sha256Buf,
    description: 'Canonical SHA-256 checksum mapping file.',
    memberClass: 'manifest'
  });

  // Execute Prohibited Content & Claim Scanner
  const scanResult = scanPackForProhibitedContent(finalEntries, {
    realName: user.display_name,
    deviceId: session.device_id,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    rawSeriesOptIn: request.rawSeriesOptIn ?? false,
    signalExcerptOptIn: request.signalExcerptOptIn ?? false,
    providerProfile: request.exportProfile
  });

  if (!scanResult.passed) {
    recordProductEvent('scanner_blocked', {
      userId: user.id,
      sessionId: session.id,
      violations: scanResult.violations,
      exportProfile: request.exportProfile
    });
    throw new Error(`Export blocked by Prohibited Content Scanner: ${scanResult.violations.join('; ')}`);
  }

  // Populate Preview Cache so UI or two-stage flow can access it
  const previewId = `preview_${session.id}_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
  const previewFiles: LlmPackPreviewFile[] = finalEntries.map(e => {
    let snippet: string | undefined;
    if (e.content && e.kind !== 'png') {
      const text = e.content.toString('utf8');
      snippet = text.length > 500 ? text.substring(0, 500) + '...' : text;
    }
    const isOptionalExcerpt = 
      e.name.startsWith('30_ECG_STRIP_') || 
      e.name.startsWith('31_ECG_STRIP_') || 
      e.name.includes('ecg_full.csv') || 
      e.name === '05_HR_DOWNSAMPLED.csv' || 
      e.name === '06_RR_CLEANED.csv' || 
      e.name === '09_CANDIDATE_EVENT_SUMMARY.csv';

    const buf = e.content || (e.contentBuffer) || (e.filePath && fs.existsSync(e.filePath) ? fs.readFileSync(e.filePath) : Buffer.from(e.contentString || ''));
    const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
    const sizeBytes = buf.length;

    return {
      name: e.name,
      kind: e.kind,
      sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      description: e.description,
      isOptionalExcerpt,
      previewSnippet: snippet,
      memberClass: e.memberClass || determinePackMemberClass(e.name)
    };
  });

  const memberClasses = Array.from(new Set(finalEntries.map(e => (e.memberClass || determinePackMemberClass(e.name)) as string)));
  const notesHash = userNotes ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(userNotes).digest('hex') : null;
  const canonicalIdentity = canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || 'unverified';

  const contextFingerprint = computeAnalysisContextFingerprint({
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    user_id: user.id,
    session_id: session.id,
    canonical_result_identity: canonicalIdentity,
    compare_mode: request.comparisonId ? 'peer' : request.windowId ? 'window' : 'none',
    peer_session_id: (request as any).peerSessionId || null,
    window_id: request.windowId || null,
    window_revision: request.windowRevision || null,
    window_result_identity: request.windowResultIdentity || null,
    comparison_id: request.comparisonId || null,
    comparison_kind: request.comparisonKind || null,
    comparison_inputs: request.comparisonInputs || null,
    export_profile: request.exportProfile,
    prompt_name: selectedPromptName,
    user_goal: userGoal,
    privacy_level: request.privacyLevel,
    privacy_options: {
      rawSeriesOptIn: Boolean(request.rawSeriesOptIn),
      signalExcerptOptIn: Boolean(request.signalExcerptOptIn),
      includeNotes: Boolean(request.includeNotes)
    },
    notes_hash: notesHash,
    compiler_version: '1.2.27',
    member_classes: memberClasses
  });

  const analysisContextSnapshot: AnalysisContextSnapshot = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    user_id: user.id,
    session_id: session.id,
    canonical_result_identity: canonicalIdentity,
    compare_mode: request.comparisonId ? 'peer' : request.windowId ? 'window' : 'none',
    peer_session_id: (request as any).peerSessionId || null,
    window_id: request.windowId || null,
    window_revision: request.windowRevision || null,
    window_result_identity: request.windowResultIdentity || null,
    comparison_id: request.comparisonId || null,
    comparison_kind: request.comparisonKind || null,
    comparison_inputs: request.comparisonInputs || null,
    export_profile: request.exportProfile,
    prompt_name: selectedPromptName,
    user_goal: userGoal,
    privacy_level: request.privacyLevel,
    privacy_options: {
      rawSeriesOptIn: Boolean(request.rawSeriesOptIn),
      signalExcerptOptIn: Boolean(request.signalExcerptOptIn),
      includeNotes: Boolean(request.includeNotes)
    },
    notes_hash: notesHash,
    compiler_version: '1.2.27',
    member_classes: memberClasses,
    context_fingerprint: contextFingerprint,
    timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const estimatedZipBytes = finalEntries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.content ? e.content.length : (e.sizeBytes || 0)), 0) * 0.45;

  const previewObj: LlmPackPreviewResult = {
    previewId,
    packId,
    sessionId: session.id,
    canonicalSemanticHash,
    canonicalResultIdentity: {
      session_id: session.id,
      source_bundle_id: canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id ?? null,
      canonical_hash: canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || 'canonical'
    },
    exportProfile: request.exportProfile,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    userGoal,
    files: previewFiles,
    scannerResult: scanResult,
    notesIncluded: request.includeNotes && !!userNotes,
    rawPhysiologicalSeriesIncluded: !!request.rawSeriesOptIn,
    signalExcerptsIncluded: ecgStripsCount > 0,
    estimatedZipBytes: Math.round(estimatedZipBytes),
    createdAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
    analysisContextSnapshot,
    requestFingerprint: contextFingerprint
  };

  previewCache.set(previewId, {
    previewId,
    preview: previewObj,
    finalEntries: [...finalEntries],
    canonicalSessionHash: canonicalSession?.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_hash || canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || 'unverified',
    requestFingerprint: contextFingerprint,
    request: { ...request },
    finalManifest,
    cachedAt: Date.now()
  });

  return previewObj;
}

/**
 * Creates an in-memory preview of the LLM pack for user inspection before download.
 */
export async function createLlmPackPreview(request: LlmPackRequest): Promise<LlmPackPreviewResult> {
  const preview = await buildP4PackCandidate(request);

  // Distinct lifecycle event: preview_created
  recordProductEvent('preview_created', {
    userId: request.userId,
    sessionId: request.sessionId,
    previewId: preview.previewId,
    exportProfile: request.exportProfile,
    privacyLevel: request.privacyLevel,
    userGoal: request.userGoal,
    selectedPrompt: request.selectedPrompt,
    rawSeriesOptIn: !!request.rawSeriesOptIn,
    signalExcerptOptIn: !!request.signalExcerptOptIn
  });

  // Retain preview_opened for inspecting/opening preview
  recordProductEvent('preview_opened', {
    userId: request.userId,
    sessionId: request.sessionId,
    previewId: preview.previewId,
    exportProfile: request.exportProfile
  });

  // Explicit opt-in workflow events
  if (request.rawSeriesOptIn) {
    recordProductEvent('raw_series_opt_in', {
      userId: request.userId,
      sessionId: request.sessionId,
      previewId: preview.previewId
    });
  }

  if (request.signalExcerptOptIn) {
    recordProductEvent('signal_excerpt_opt_in', {
      userId: request.userId,
      sessionId: request.sessionId,
      previewId: preview.previewId
    });
  }

  return preview;
}

/**
 * Explicitly cancels an active in-memory preview, cleaning up cached entries and recording local event.
 */
export function cancelLlmPackPreview(previewId: string, context?: { sessionId?: string; userId?: string }): boolean {
  const cached = previewCache.get(previewId);
  const sessionId = context?.sessionId || cached?.request?.sessionId;
  const userId = context?.userId || cached?.request?.userId;
  const exportProfile = cached?.request?.exportProfile;

  recordProductEvent('preview_canceled', {
    previewId,
    sessionId: sessionId || undefined,
    userId: userId || undefined,
    exportProfile: exportProfile || undefined
  });

  if (cached) {
    for (const entry of cached.finalEntries) {
      if ((entry as any).filePath && fs.existsSync((entry as any).filePath)) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync((entry as any).filePath);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    previewCache.delete(previewId);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function getCachedPreviewEntries(previewId: string): any[] | null {
  const cached = previewCache.get(previewId);
  return cached ? cached.finalEntries : null;
}

import * as zlib from 'zlib';

// CRC32 Table initialization
const crcTable = new Int32Array(256);
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  let c = i;
  for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
    c = (c & 1) ? (0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
  }
  crcTable[i] = c;
}

function crc32(buf: Buffer): number {
  let crc = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
    crc = crcTable[(crc ^ buf[i]) & 0xff] ^ (crc >>> 8);
  }
  return crc ^ -1;
}

function writeChunk(type: string, data: Buffer): Buffer {
  const typeBuf = Buffer.from(type, 'ascii');
  const lengthBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
  lengthBuf.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);

  const content = Buffer.concat([typeBuf, data]);
  const crc = crc32(content);
  const crcBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
  crcBuf.writeInt32BE(crc, 0);

  return Buffer.concat([lengthBuf, content, crcBuf]);
}

/**
 * Draws a line in the RGB pixel buffer using Bresenham's line algorithm.
 */
function drawLine(
  pixels: Buffer,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  x0: number,
  y0: number,
  x1: number,
  y1: number,
  color: [number, number, number]
) {
  x0 = Math.round(x0);
  y0 = Math.round(y0);
  x1 = Math.round(x1);
  y1 = Math.round(y1);

  const dx = Math.abs(x1 - x0);
  const dy = Math.abs(y1 - y0);
  const sx = (x0 < x1) ? 1 : -1;
  const sy = (y0 < y1) ? 1 : -1;
  let err = dx - dy;

  while (true) {
    if (x0 >= 0 && x0 < width && y0 >= 0 && y0 < height) {
      const idx = (y0 * width + x0) * 3;
      pixels[idx] = color[0];
      pixels[idx + 1] = color[1];
      pixels[idx + 2] = color[2];
    }

    if (x0 === x1 && y0 === y1) break;
    const e2 = 2 * err;
    if (e2 > -dy) {
      err -= dy;
      x0 += sx;
    }
    if (e2 < dx) {
      err += dx;
      y0 += sy;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Encodes a raw 8-bit RGB buffer into a standard PNG format.
 */
export function encodePng(width: number, height: number, pixels: Buffer): Buffer {
  const signature = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);

  // IHDR chunk
  const ihdrData = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdrData.writeUInt32BE(width, 0);
  ihdrData.writeUInt32BE(height, 4);
  ihdrData[8] = 8;  // bit depth
  ihdrData[9] = 2;  // color type: 2 (RGB)
  ihdrData[10] = 0; // compression method
  ihdrData[11] = 0; // filter method
  ihdrData[12] = 0; // interlace method
  const ihdrChunk = writeChunk('IHDR', ihdrData);

  // IDAT chunk (with no-filtering byte prefix per row)
  const rowSize = width * 3;
  const uncompressedSize = (rowSize + 1) * height;
  const uncompressedData = Buffer.alloc(uncompressedSize);

  let offset = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    uncompressedData[offset++] = 0; // filter type 0 (none)
    pixels.copy(uncompressedData, offset, y * rowSize, (y + 1) * rowSize);
    offset += rowSize;
  }

  const compressedData = zlib.deflateSync(uncompressedData, { level: 9 });
  const idatChunk = writeChunk('IDAT', compressedData);

  // IEND chunk
  const iendChunk = writeChunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0));

  return Buffer.concat([signature, ihdrChunk, idatChunk, iendChunk]);
}

interface PlotPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  value: number;
}

/**
 * Generates an ECG waveform PNG with an standard ECG grid background and marker line.
 */
export function generateEcgPlot(
  width: number,
  height: number,
  points: PlotPoint[],
  markerTimeMs?: number
): Buffer {
  const pixels = Buffer.alloc(width * height * 3);
  
  // 1. Fill background with white
  pixels.fill(255);

  // 2. Draw ECG grid lines
  const gridColorFine: [number, number, number] = [255, 230, 230];  // Light pink
  const gridColorMajor: [number, number, number] = [255, 195, 195]; // Darker pink

  // Vertical grid lines
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x += 5) {
    const isMajor = (x % 25 === 0);
    const color = isMajor ? gridColorMajor : gridColorFine;
    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
      const idx = (y * width + x) * 3;
      pixels[idx] = color[0];
      pixels[idx + 1] = color[1];
      pixels[idx + 2] = color[2];
    }
  }

  // Horizontal grid lines
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 5) {
    const isMajor = (y % 25 === 0);
    const color = isMajor ? gridColorMajor : gridColorFine;
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const idx = (y * width + x) * 3;
      pixels[idx] = color[0];
      pixels[idx + 1] = color[1];
      pixels[idx + 2] = color[2];
    }
  }

  if (points.length === 0) {
    return encodePng(width, height, pixels);
  }

  // Find min/max values to scale
  let minValue = points[0].value;
  let maxValue = points[0].value;
  let minTime = points[0].timeMs;
  let maxTime = points[0].timeMs;

  for (const p of points) {
    if (p.value < minValue) minValue = p.value;
    if (p.value > maxValue) maxValue = p.value;
    if (p.timeMs < minTime) minTime = p.timeMs;
    if (p.timeMs > maxTime) maxTime = p.timeMs;
  }

  const timeRange = (maxTime - minTime) || 1;
  const valueRange = (maxValue - minValue) || 1;

  // Add 10% padding top/bottom
  const paddingCoeff = 0.1;
  const adjustedMinVal = minValue - valueRange * paddingCoeff;
  const adjustedMaxVal = maxValue + valueRange * paddingCoeff;
  const adjustedValRange = adjustedMaxVal - adjustedMinVal;

  // Scale and map points to pixels
  const mappedPoints = points.map((p) => {
    const x = ((p.timeMs - minTime) / timeRange) * (width - 1);
    // Y pixel 0 is at the top, so we invert
    const y = (height - 1) - ((p.value - adjustedMinVal) / adjustedValRange) * (height - 1);
    return { x, y };
  });

  // 3. Draw ECG waveform (polyline)
  const lineColor: [number, number, number] = [0, 40, 90]; // Deep blue
  for (let i = 0; i < mappedPoints.length - 1; i++) {
    drawLine(
      pixels,
      width,
      height,
      mappedPoints[i].x,
      mappedPoints[i].y,
      mappedPoints[i + 1].x,
      mappedPoints[i + 1].y,
      lineColor
    );
  }

  // 4. Draw optional marker (vertical dashed red line)
  if (markerTimeMs !== undefined && markerTimeMs >= minTime && markerTimeMs <= maxTime) {
    const markerX = Math.round(((markerTimeMs - minTime) / timeRange) * (width - 1));
    const markerColor: [number, number, number] = [230, 20, 20]; // Red
    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
      // Dashed line (5 pixels red, 5 pixels skip)
      if (Math.floor(y / 5) % 2 === 0) {
        const idx = (y * width + markerX) * 3;
        if (markerX >= 0 && markerX < width) {
          pixels[idx] = markerColor[0];
          pixels[idx + 1] = markerColor[1];
          pixels[idx + 2] = markerColor[2];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return encodePng(width, height, pixels);
}

export interface TrendPlotPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  value: number | null;
  status: string;
}

export interface TrendPlotBaseline {
  available: boolean;
  median: number | null;
  p25: number | null;
  p75: number | null;
}

export function generateTrendPlot(
  width: number,
  height: number,
  points: TrendPlotPoint[],
  baseline: TrendPlotBaseline
): Buffer {
  const pixels = Buffer.alloc(width * height * 3);
  
  // 1. Fill background with premium dark slate
  // Slate-900: #0f172a [15, 23, 42]
  for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 3) {
    pixels[i] = 15;
    pixels[i + 1] = 23;
    pixels[i + 2] = 42;
  }

  // 2. Draw subtle grid lines
  const gridColor: [number, number, number] = [30, 41, 59]; // Slate-800
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x += 40) {
    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
      const idx = (y * width + x) * 3;
      pixels[idx] = gridColor[0];
      pixels[idx + 1] = gridColor[1];
      pixels[idx + 2] = gridColor[2];
    }
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 30) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const idx = (y * width + x) * 3;
      pixels[idx] = gridColor[0];
      pixels[idx + 1] = gridColor[1];
      pixels[idx + 2] = gridColor[2];
    }
  }

  const validPoints = points.filter(p => p.value !== null);
  if (validPoints.length === 0) {
    return encodePng(width, height, pixels);
  }

  // Find min/max values to scale
  let minValue = validPoints[0].value!;
  let maxValue = validPoints[0].value!;
  let minTime = points[0].timeMs;
  let maxTime = points[points.length - 1].timeMs;

  for (const p of validPoints) {
    if (p.value! < minValue) minValue = p.value!;
    if (p.value! > maxValue) maxValue = p.value!;
  }

  // Include baseline in min/max bounds if available
  if (baseline.available) {
    if (baseline.p25 !== null && baseline.p25 < minValue) minValue = baseline.p25;
    if (baseline.p75 !== null && baseline.p75 > maxValue) maxValue = baseline.p75;
  }

  const timeRange = (maxTime - minTime) || 1;
  const valueRange = (maxValue - minValue) || 1;

  // Add 15% padding top/bottom
  const paddingCoeff = 0.15;
  const adjustedMinVal = minValue - valueRange * paddingCoeff;
  const adjustedMaxVal = maxValue + valueRange * paddingCoeff;
  const adjustedValRange = (adjustedMaxVal - adjustedMinVal) || 1;

  // 3. Draw baseline band shaded region (p25 to p75)
  if (baseline.available && baseline.p25 !== null && baseline.p75 !== null) {
    // Map values to Y coordinates (remember Y is inverted in PNG)
    const y_p25 = Math.round((height - 1) - ((baseline.p25 - adjustedMinVal) / adjustedValRange) * (height - 1));
    const y_p75 = Math.round((height - 1) - ((baseline.p75 - adjustedMinVal) / adjustedValRange) * (height - 1));
    
    const yMin = Math.max(0, Math.min(y_p25, y_p75));
    const yMax = Math.min(height - 1, Math.max(y_p25, y_p75));

    // Blue/teal shaded band: #1e3a8a [30, 58, 138]
    const bandColor: [number, number, number] = [20, 35, 65]; 
    for (let y = yMin; y <= yMax; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
        const idx = (y * width + x) * 3;
        pixels[idx] = bandColor[0];
        pixels[idx + 1] = bandColor[1];
        pixels[idx + 2] = bandColor[2];
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Draw baseline median dashed line
  if (baseline.available && baseline.median !== null) {
    const y_med = Math.round((height - 1) - ((baseline.median - adjustedMinVal) / adjustedValRange) * (height - 1));
    const medianColor: [number, number, number] = [100, 116, 139]; // Slate-500
    if (y_med >= 0 && y_med < height) {
      for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
        if (Math.floor(x / 4) % 2 === 0) {
          const idx = (y_med * width + x) * 3;
          pixels[idx] = medianColor[0];
          pixels[idx + 1] = medianColor[1];
          pixels[idx + 2] = medianColor[2];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Draw trend polyline connecting points
  const mappedPoints = points.map(p => {
    const x = ((p.timeMs - minTime) / timeRange) * (width - 40) + 20; // 20px padding left/right
    const y = p.value !== null 
      ? (height - 1) - ((p.value - adjustedMinVal) / adjustedValRange) * (height - 1)
      : null;
    return { x, y, value: p.value, status: p.status };
  });

  const lineColor: [number, number, number] = [45, 212, 191]; // Teal-400
  for (let i = 0; i < mappedPoints.length - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = mappedPoints[i];
    const p1 = mappedPoints[i + 1];
    if (p0.y !== null && p1.y !== null) {
      drawLine(pixels, width, height, p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y, lineColor);
    }
  }

  // 6. Draw point markers colored by quality/baseline status
  // within: teal [20, 184, 166], above: green [34, 197, 94], below: red [239, 68, 68]
  // quality_limited: yellow [234, 179, 8], insufficient: grey [148, 163, 184]
  for (const p of mappedPoints) {
    if (p.y !== null) {
      let color: [number, number, number] = [20, 184, 166]; // default teal
      if (p.status === 'above_baseline') {
        color = [34, 197, 94]; // green
      } else if (p.status === 'below_baseline') {
        color = [239, 68, 68]; // red
      } else if (p.status === 'quality_limited') {
        color = [234, 179, 8]; // yellow
      } else if (p.status === 'insufficient_data') {
        color = [148, 163, 184]; // grey
      }
      
      // Draw a 5x5 point marker block
      drawPointMarker(pixels, width, height, p.x, p.y, 5, color);
    }
  }

  return encodePng(width, height, pixels);
}

function drawPointMarker(
  pixels: Buffer,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  size: number,
  color: [number, number, number]
) {
  const r = Math.floor(size / 2);
  for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy++) {
    for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
      const px = Math.round(cx + dx);
      const py = Math.round(cy + dy);
      if (px >= 0 && px < width && py >= 0 && py < height) {
        const idx = (py * width + px) * 3;
        pixels[idx] = color[0];
        pixels[idx + 1] = color[1];
        pixels[idx + 2] = color[2];
      }
    }
  }
}

export interface PrivacyContext {
  realName?: string;
  exportAlias: string;
  deviceId?: string;
  privacyLevel?: 'pseudonymized' | 'minimal' | 'internal_debug';
}

/**
 * Redacts sensitive paths, names, and sensor serial IDs from any string content.
 */
export function redactText(input: string, context: PrivacyContext): string {
  if (!input) return '';

  let result = input;

  // 1. Redact file paths (Windows and Unix paths)
  // Matches Windows paths like Z:\Polar Logs or C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\...
  const windowsPathRegex = /[a-zA-Z]:\\(?:[^\\\s>"\n]+(?:\\|$))+/g;
  result = result.replace(windowsPathRegex, '/local/path/redacted');

  // Matches file:/// paths
  result = result.replace(/file:\/\/\/[^\s>"\n]+/gi, '/local/path/redacted');

  // Matches Unix user paths like /Users/... or /home/...
  result = result.replace(/\/(?:Users|home)\/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\/[^\s>"\n]*/g, '/local/path/redacted');

  // Also replace any specific polar logs drive reference
  result = result.replace(/Z:\\Polar\s+Logs/gi, '/local/path/redacted');

  // 2. Secret and token scrubbing (bearer tokens, API keys, passwords)
  result = result.replace(/bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/gi, 'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]');
  result = result.replace(/(api[-_]?key|secret|token|password)\s*[:=]\s*["']?[A-Za-z0-9._-]+["']?/gi, '$1: "[REDACTED_SECRET]"');

  // 3. Redact real display name if provided
  const targetAlias = context.privacyLevel === 'minimal' ? 'Athlete' : context.exportAlias;
  if (context.realName && context.realName.trim()) {
    const escapedName = context.realName.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
    const nameRegex = new RegExp(`(?<![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])${escapedName}(?![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])`, 'gi');
    result = result.replace(nameRegex, targetAlias);
  }

  // In minimal mode, also suppress custom athlete alias down to generic 'Athlete'
  if (context.privacyLevel === 'minimal' && context.exportAlias && context.exportAlias !== 'Athlete') {
    const escapedAlias = context.exportAlias.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
    const aliasRegex = new RegExp(`(?<![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])${escapedAlias}(?![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])`, 'gi');
    result = result.replace(aliasRegex, 'Athlete');
  }

  // 4. Redact device ID serial number
  // Standard Polar H10 device ID is typically "Polar H10 XXXXXXXX" or "Polar_H10_XXXXXXXX" or "Polar H10 [serial]"
  if (context.deviceId && context.deviceId.trim()) {
    const serialMatch = context.deviceId.match(/[A-F0-9]{8}/i);
    if (serialMatch) {
      const serial = serialMatch[0];
      const serialRegex = new RegExp(serial, 'gi');
      result = result.replace(serialRegex, 'REDACTED');
    }
    const escapedDeviceId = context.deviceId.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
    const deviceRegex = new RegExp(escapedDeviceId, 'gi');
    result = result.replace(deviceRegex, 'Polar_H10_REDACTED');
  }

  // General Polar serial number scrub (scrub 8-character hex or decimal serials after H10)
  result = result.replace(/Polar\s+H10\s+[A-F0-9]{8}/gi, 'Polar H10 [REDACTED]');
  result = result.replace(/Polar_H10_[A-F0-9]{8}/gi, 'Polar_H10_REDACTED');

  return result;
}

/**
 * Recursively redacts sensitive values inside a JSON-serializable object.
 */
export function redactJson<T>(input: T, context: PrivacyContext): T {
  if (input === null || input === undefined) {
    return input;
  }

  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    return redactText(input, context) as unknown as T;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(input)) {
    return input.map(item => redactJson(item, context)) as unknown as T;
  }

  if (typeof input === 'object') {
    const result: any = {};
    const isMinimal = context.privacyLevel === 'minimal';
    const minimalStripKeys = [
      'import_warnings',
      'internal_id',
      'source_file_id',
      'raw_debug_info',
      'local_notes',
      'internal_debug_metadata',
      'debug_flags'
    ];

    for (const key of Object.keys(input)) {
      // In minimal privacy mode, strip non-essential troubleshooting/internal keys
      if (isMinimal && minimalStripKeys.includes(key)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Redact the key name if it contains sensitive info
      const redactedKey = redactText(key, context);
      
      // Specially redact key values based on key names
      if (key === 'device_id') {
        result[redactedKey] = 'Polar_H10_REDACTED';
      } else if (key === 'filename' || key === 'filepath' || key === 'path') {
        const val = (input as any)[key];
        if (typeof val === 'string') {
          // Keep only the basename, redact the path directory
          const parts = val.split(/[/\\]/);
          const basename = parts[parts.length - 1];
          result[redactedKey] = redactText(basename, context);
        } else {
          result[redactedKey] = redactJson(val, context);
        }
      } else {
        result[redactedKey] = redactJson((input as any)[key], context);
      }
    }
    return result as T;
  }

  return input;
}

/**
 * Redacts CSV data row by row.
 */
export function redactCsv(input: string, context: PrivacyContext): string {
  if (!input) return '';
  return redactText(input, context);
}

// Prohibited-Field and Prohibited-Claim Scanner (P4 Section 11 & 12)

export type PackMemberClass =
  | 'canonical_semantic'
  | 'canonical_projection'
  | 'aggregate_event_summary'
  | 'chart'
  | 'physiological_excerpt'
  | 'raw_physiological_series'
  | 'prompt'
  | 'manifest'
  | 'debug_internal';

export interface ProhibitedScanOptions {
  realName?: string;
  deviceId?: string;
  privacyLevel: 'pseudonymized' | 'minimal' | 'internal_debug';
  rawSeriesOptIn?: boolean;
  signalExcerptOptIn?: boolean;
  providerProfile?: string;
}

export interface ProhibitedScanResult {
  passed: boolean;
  violations: string[];
  scanned_files_count: number;
}

/**
 * Scans final rendered pack files for prohibited privacy leaks, unapproved raw data,
 * and forbidden medical/diagnostic claims before export.
 */
export function scanPackForProhibitedContent(
  files: Array<{ name: string; memberClass?: PackMemberClass; contentString?: string; contentBuffer?: Buffer; content?: string | Buffer }>,
  options: ProhibitedScanOptions
): ProhibitedScanResult {
  const violations: string[] = [];

  // Policy check: internal_debug cannot be exported to web-based profiles or non-local profiles
  if (options.privacyLevel === 'internal_debug' && options.providerProfile !== 'antigravity_local_debug') {
    violations.push(`Privacy profile "internal_debug" is strictly prohibited for non-local export profiles (${options.providerProfile || 'unknown'}).`);
  }

  const prohibitedPhrases: Array<{ pattern: RegExp; description: string }> = [
    { pattern: /\barrhythmia\s+detected\b/i, description: 'Medical claim: arrhythmia detected' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\barrhythmia\s+absent\b/i, description: 'Medical claim: arrhythmia absent' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\b(аритмия\s+обнаружена|диагностирована\s+аритмия)\b/i, description: 'Медицинское утверждение: обнаружение аритмии' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\bmedical\s+diagnosis\b/i, description: 'Prohibited claim: medical diagnosis' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\bclinical\s+diagnosis\b/i, description: 'Prohibited claim: clinical diagnosis' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\b(медицинский\s+диагноз|клинический\s+диагноз)\b/i, description: 'Запрещенное утверждение: медицинский диагноз' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\bdisease\s+screening\b/i, description: 'Prohibited claim: disease screening' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\bsafe[- ]to[- ]train\b/i, description: 'Prohibited safety clearance: safe-to-train' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\b(допуск\s+к\s+тренировкам|безопасно\s+для\s+тренировок)\b/i, description: 'Запрещенное утверждение: допуск к тренировкам' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\btreatment\s+prescription\b/i, description: 'Prohibited medical action: treatment prescription' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\b(назначение\s+лечения|рецепт\s+на\s+лечение)\b/i, description: 'Запрещенное медицинское действие: назначение лечения' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\buniversal\s+quality\s+score\b/i, description: 'Prohibited unscientific claim: universal quality score' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\b(универсальный\s+индекс\s+качества|универсальная\s+оценка\s+качества)\b/i, description: 'Невалидированная универсальная шкала качества' }, // запрещенные формулировки: never use
    { pattern: /\bmedical[- ]grade\s+accuracy\b/i, description: 'Prohibited device claim: medical-grade accuracy' } // запрещенные формулировки: never use
  ];

  for (const file of files) {
    const lowerName = file.name.toLowerCase();

    // Structural classification check
    if (!file.memberClass) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": missing explicit structural PackMemberClass.`);
    }

    // 1. Raw physiological file check (by structural class or explicit filename)
    const isRawSeriesFile = (
      file.memberClass === 'raw_physiological_series' ||
      lowerName.includes('ecg_full.csv') ||
      lowerName.includes('rr_cleaned') ||
      lowerName.includes('rr_raw') ||
      lowerName.includes('hr_timeseries') ||
      lowerName.includes('hr_downsampled') ||
      lowerName.includes('acc_raw')
    );

    if (isRawSeriesFile && !options.rawSeriesOptIn) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": raw physiological series included without explicit user opt-in.`);
    }

    // 1b. Physiological excerpt check (e.g. ECG strip CSV or waveform excerpts)
    const isPhysiologicalExcerptFile = (
      file.memberClass === 'physiological_excerpt' ||
      lowerName.includes('ecg_strip')
    );

    if (isPhysiologicalExcerptFile && !options.signalExcerptOptIn) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": physiological signal excerpt included without explicit user opt-in.`);
    }

    let content = file.contentString;
    if (!content) {
      if (file.contentBuffer) {
        content = file.contentBuffer.toString('utf8');
      } else if (Buffer.isBuffer(file.content)) {
        content = file.content.toString('utf8');
      } else if (typeof file.content === 'string') {
        content = file.content;
      }
    }

    if (!content) {
      continue;
    }

    // Structural content inspection: detect raw timeseries signatures even if file name was disguised
    const isStructuralRawTimeseries = (
      content.startsWith('offset_ms,ecg_uv') ||
      content.startsWith('offset_ms,rr_ms') ||
      content.startsWith('offset_ms,hr_bpm') ||
      content.includes('\noffset_ms,ecg_uv') ||
      content.includes('\noffset_ms,rr_ms')
    );
    if (isStructuralRawTimeseries && !options.rawSeriesOptIn) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": structural raw physiological series detected in content without explicit user opt-in.`);
    }

    // Secret token check (bearer tokens or API keys)
    if (/bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{10,}/i.test(content) || /(api[-_]?key|secret|password)\s*[:=]\s*["']?[A-Za-z0-9._-]{10,}["']?/i.test(content)) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains unredacted credential or secret token.`);
    }

    // 2. Real name leak check (if provided and longer than 2 chars)
    if (options.realName && options.realName.trim().length > 2) {
      const escaped = options.realName.replace(/[-\/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&');
      const nameRegex = new RegExp(`(?<![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])${escaped}(?![a-zA-Z0-9_а-яА-ЯёЁ\\-])`, 'i');
      if (nameRegex.test(content)) {
        violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains unredacted user real name.`);
      }
    }

    // 3. Device ID serial leak check
    if (options.deviceId && options.deviceId.trim().length > 4) {
      const serialMatch = options.deviceId.match(/[A-F0-9]{8}/i);
      if (serialMatch && content.includes(serialMatch[0])) {
        violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains unredacted sensor serial number (${serialMatch[0]}).`);
      }
    }

    // 4. Local filesystem path leak check
    // Match arbitrary Windows path with drive letter and folders
    const winPathMatch = content.match(/[a-zA-Z]:\\(?:[^\\\/\s>"\n]+\\)+[^\\\/\s>"\n]*/i);
    if (winPathMatch) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains local absolute filesystem path (${winPathMatch[0].substring(0, 30)}...).`);
    }

    // Match Unix user / system paths
    const unixPathMatch = content.match(/\/(?:Users|home|var|etc|opt)\/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\/[^\s>"\n]*/i);
    if (unixPathMatch) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains local Unix filesystem path (${unixPathMatch[0].substring(0, 30)}...).`);
    }

    const fileUriMatch = content.match(/file:\/\/\/[^\s>"\n]+/i);
    if (fileUriMatch) {
      violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains local file URI (${fileUriMatch[0].substring(0, 30)}...).`);
    }

    // 5. Prohibited medical / diagnostic claim check
    for (const p of prohibitedPhrases) {
      if (p.pattern.test(content)) {
        const lines = content.split('\n');
        for (const line of lines) {
          if (p.pattern.test(line)) {
            const lowerLine = line.toLowerCase();
            const isNegativeDisclaimer = (
              lowerLine.includes('not for') ||
              lowerLine.includes('does not') ||
              lowerLine.includes('do not') ||
              lowerLine.includes('must not') ||
              lowerLine.includes('shall not') ||
              lowerLine.includes('cannot') ||
              lowerLine.includes('not a medical') ||
              lowerLine.includes('no arrhythmia') || // non-diagnostic disclaimer rule: never use
              lowerLine.includes('не является') ||
              lowerLine.includes('не предназначен') ||
              lowerLine.includes('не проводит') ||
              lowerLine.includes('не заменяет') ||
              lowerLine.includes('non-diagnostic') ||
              lowerLine.includes('non-medical') ||
              lowerLine.includes('disclaimer') ||
              lowerLine.includes('notice') ||
              lowerLine.includes('warning')
            );
            if (!isNegativeDisclaimer) {
              violations.push(`File "${file.name}": contains prohibited phrase "${p.description}" on line: "${line.trim().substring(0, 60)}..."`);
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    passed: violations.length === 0,
    violations,
    scanned_files_count: files.length
  };
}

export interface PromptTemplate {
  filename: string;
  title: string;
  userGoal: string;
  content: string;
}

export const PROMPT_TEMPLATES: PromptTemplate[] = [
  {
    filename: '80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md',
    title: 'Session First Look / Обзор сессии',
    userGoal: 'session_first_look',
    content: `[Instruction: Overview of session parameters]
Analyze the provided heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in this package.

Strict Requirements & Constraints:
- The attached \`canonical_result.json\` is the single authoritative source of truth.
- Do NOT recalculate or invent any metrics; accept computed values and null states as authoritative.
- Do NOT convert null values to zero. If a metric is null or state is INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_ELIGIBLE, report it as unavailable.
- Do NOT promote Bounded or Experimental features to Validated status.
- Keep all language strictly non-diagnostic (nondiagnostic phrasing; never use for medical diagnoses):
  * Do NOT diagnose cardiac arrhythmia, ischemia, or any medical condition (prohibited phrasing; never use for medical diagnoses).
  * Do NOT provide treatment prescriptions or evaluate cardiovascular safety clearance ("safe-to-train").
- Categorize all observations strictly into: 'measured', 'inferred', 'uncertain', or 'insufficient data'.
- When personal baseline is unavailable or reference values are displayed, do not infer physical improvement, worsening, or adaptation trends based on these fallback reference values.
- Account for the beat lineage, artifact percentage, and task-specific limitations declared in \`canonical_result.json\` and \`quality_and_eligibility.md\`.

Provide a concise, objective overview of session duration, mean heart rate, time-domain HRV markers, and analytical limitations.`,
  },
  {
    filename: '81_PROMPT_02_COMPARE_WITH_CONTEXT.md',
    title: 'Compare with Compatible Sessions / Сравнение с совместимыми сессиями',
    userGoal: 'compare_with_compatible',
    content: `[Instruction: Compare session against compatible historical baseline]
Review the current session metrics in comparison with the compatible baseline evidence provided in \`comparison_summary.md\` and \`canonical_result.json\`.

Strict Requirements & Constraints:
- Do NOT assume a clinical or medical persona.

/**
 * Retrieves a prompt template by filename or defaults to the first look.
 */
export function getPromptContent(filename: string): string {
  const match = PROMPT_TEMPLATES.find((p) => p.filename === filename);
  return match ? match.content : PROMPT_TEMPLATES[0].content;
}

/**
 * Retrieves a prompt template by user goal.
 */
export function getPromptByUserGoal(goal: string): PromptTemplate {
  const match = PROMPT_TEMPLATES.find((p) => p.userGoal === goal);
  return match || PROMPT_TEMPLATES[0];
}
