import { PROMPT_TEMPLATES } from './promptTemplates';
import { PackPlan } from '../../shared/packPlan';

export type ExportProfile =
  | 'chatgpt_web_full'
  | 'gemini_web_compact'
  | 'antigravity_local_debug';

export interface ProfileBudget {
  maxZipMb: number;
  maxEntries: number;
  maxTextCharsTotal: number;
  maxCsvRowsPerFile: number;
  maxEcgStrips: number;
  maxEcgStripSeconds: number;
  requiredSingleFile?: boolean;
  maxSingleFileChars?: number;
}

export const BUDGETS: Record<ExportProfile, ProfileBudget> = {
  chatgpt_web_full: {
    maxZipMb: 100,
    maxEntries: 40,
    maxTextCharsTotal: 300_000,
    maxCsvRowsPerFile: 10_000,
    maxEcgStrips: 10,
    maxEcgStripSeconds: 30,
  },
  gemini_web_compact: {
    maxZipMb: 50,
    maxEntries: 10,
    maxTextCharsTotal: 200_000,
    maxCsvRowsPerFile: 5_000,
    maxEcgStrips: 1, // Only 1 allowed in compact
    maxEcgStripSeconds: 20,
    requiredSingleFile: true,
    maxSingleFileChars: 180_000,
  },
  antigravity_local_debug: {
    maxZipMb: 2000,
    maxEntries: 100_000,
    maxTextCharsTotal: 500_000_000,
    maxCsvRowsPerFile: 1_000_000,
    maxEcgStrips: 5,
    maxEcgStripSeconds: 30,
  },
};

export interface PreflightEstimate {
  estimatedEntriesCount: number;
  estimatedTextCharsTotal: number;
  estimatedEcgStripsCount: number;
  estimatedSingleFileChars?: number;
  breakdown?: {
    core: number;
    prompts: number;
    charts: number;
    ecgStripPng: number;
    ecgStripCsv: number;
    debugExtra: number;
  };
  charBreakdown?: {
    core: number;
    prompts: number;
    metrics: number;
    quality: number;
    events: number;
    trends: number;
    ecgStrips: number;
  };
  plannedFiles?: string[];
  plan?: PackPlan;
}

/**
 * Validates a preflight estimate against the export profile budgets.
 * Throws a descriptive error if any budget limit is exceeded.
 */
export function validateSizeBudget(
  profile: ExportProfile,
  estimate: PreflightEstimate
): void {
  const budget = BUDGETS[profile];
  if (!budget) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown export profile: ${profile}`);
  }

  // 1. Check entry count
  if (estimate.estimatedEntriesCount > budget.maxEntries) {
    const suffix = profile !== 'antigravity_local_debug' ? ' or choose a larger export profile.' : '.';
    throw new Error(
      `Budget Exceeded for profile "${profile}": Estimated entries count (${estimate.estimatedEntriesCount}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxEntries}.` +
      ` Please reduce selected items${suffix}`
    );
  }

  // 2. Check text character total
  if (estimate.estimatedTextCharsTotal > budget.maxTextCharsTotal) {
    const suffix = profile !== 'antigravity_local_debug' ? ', or choose a larger export profile.' : '.';
    throw new Error(
      `Budget Exceeded for profile "${profile}": Estimated total characters (${estimate.estimatedTextCharsTotal}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxTextCharsTotal}.` +
      ` Please shorten the time range, reduce details${suffix}`
    );
  }

  // 3. Check single file chars limit (e.g. for Gemini single file)
  if (budget.maxSingleFileChars && estimate.estimatedSingleFileChars && estimate.estimatedSingleFileChars > budget.maxSingleFileChars) {
    throw new Error(
      `Budget Exceeded for profile "${profile}": Estimated single file characters (${estimate.estimatedSingleFileChars}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxSingleFileChars}.` +
      ` Please shorten the time range or select summary-only mode.`
    );
  }

  // 4. Check ECG strip count
  if (estimate.estimatedEcgStripsCount > budget.maxEcgStrips) {
    throw new Error(
      `Budget Exceeded for profile "${profile}": Estimated ECG strips (${estimate.estimatedEcgStripsCount}) exceeds limit of ${budget.maxEcgStrips}.` +
      ` Please deselect some ECG events.`
    );
  }
}

import { clusterEvents, selectRepresentativeClusters } from './clustering';

export function estimatePreflight(params: {
  exportProfile: ExportProfile;
  eventExportMode?: 'summary' | 'default' | 'debug';
  durationSeconds: number;
  flagsCount: number;
  uniqueEventTypesCount: number;
  numSessions: number;
  ecgStripsMode: 'none' | 'candidate-only' | 'representative';
  excludeEcgCsv?: boolean;
  limitEcgStrips?: number;
  selectedPrompt?: string;
  flags?: any[];
}): PreflightEstimate {
  const profile = params.exportProfile;
  const budget = BUDGETS[profile];

  // 1. Run Event Clustering and Deduplication
  const flagsList = params.flags || Array.from({ length: params.flagsCount || 0 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `flag_${i}`,
    timestamp_offset_ms: i * 1000,
    flag_type: 'RR outlier',
    severity: 'low',
    description_ru: 'Test'
  }));

  // Merge gap defaults to 0 (merge only if overlapping or identical)
  const { clusters, stats } = clusterEvents(flagsList, profile === 'antigravity_local_debug' ? 30 : budget.maxEcgStripSeconds, 0);

  const hasEcg = params.ecgStripsMode !== 'none';
  const maxEcgStrips = budget.maxEcgStrips;
  const stripsLimit = params.limitEcgStrips !== undefined ? Math.min(params.limitEcgStrips, maxEcgStrips) : maxEcgStrips;

  // Under the representative visual policy, select representative clusters
  const repClusters = selectRepresentativeClusters(clusters, stripsLimit);
  const ecgStripsCount = hasEcg ? repClusters.length : 0;

  const plannedFiles: string[] = [
    '00_MANIFEST.json',
    '99_CHECKSUMS.json',
    '00_BUDGET_REPORT.json'
  ];

  let coreCount = 0;
  let promptsCount = 0;
  let chartsCount = 0;
  let ecgStripPng = ecgStripsCount;
  let ecgStripCsv = (profile === 'antigravity_local_debug' || params.excludeEcgCsv) ? 0 : ecgStripsCount;

  // Character section counts (must be non-negative integers)
  let charCore = 1500 + 1000 + 500; // manifest, checksums, budget report
  let charPrompts = 0;
  let charMetrics = 0;
  let charQuality = 0;
  let charEvents = 0;
  let charTrends = 0;
  let charEcgStrips = 0;

  if (profile === 'gemini_web_compact') {
    coreCount = 5;
    promptsCount = 1;
    chartsCount = 0;

    plannedFiles.push(
      '00_INDEX.md',
      '90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md',
      '91_GEMINI_START_HERE.md',
      '80_PROMPT_SELECTED.md'
    );
    charCore += 500 + 300; // 00_INDEX, 91_GEMINI_START_HERE

    // Prompts
    charPrompts = 4000; // selected prompt estimate

    // ECG strips
    for (let i = 1; i <= ecgStripsCount; i++) {
      const suffix = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
      plannedFiles.push(`30_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.png`);
      if (!params.excludeEcgCsv) {
        plannedFiles.push(`31_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.csv`);
        charEcgStrips += budget.maxEcgStripSeconds * 130 * 15;
      }
    }
  } else {
    coreCount = profile === 'chatgpt_web_full' ? 14 : 13;
    promptsCount = PROMPT_TEMPLATES.length;
    chartsCount = profile === 'chatgpt_web_full' ? 1 : 0;

    plannedFiles.push(
      '01_ANALYSIS_PACK.md',
      '02_METRICS_SUMMARY.json',
      '03_QUALITY_REPORT.json',
      '04_SESSION_TIMELINE.csv',
      '08_TRAINING_LOAD_SUMMARY.json',
      '90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md',
      '99_CHECKSUMS.json'
    );
    if (profile === 'chatgpt_web_full') {
      plannedFiles.push('91_CHATGPT_START_HERE.md', '20_CHART_HR_TIMELINE.png');
    }

    charCore += 1000 + 300; // 01_ANALYSIS_PACK, 91_CHATGPT_START_HERE

    // Prompts
    charPrompts = PROMPT_TEMPLATES.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.content.length, 0);

    // Metrics
    charMetrics = 600 + 300; // 02_METRICS, 08_TRAINING_LOAD
    plannedFiles.push('05_HR_DOWNSAMPLED.csv', '06_RR_CLEANED.csv');
    const hrRows = Math.min(params.durationSeconds, budget.maxCsvRowsPerFile);
    const rrRows = Math.min(params.durationSeconds * 1.2, budget.maxCsvRowsPerFile);
    charMetrics += Math.round(hrRows * 15 + rrRows * 15);

    // Quality
    charQuality = 400; // 03_QUALITY_REPORT

    // Events
    if (params.eventExportMode === 'summary') {
      plannedFiles.push('09_CANDIDATE_EVENT_SUMMARY.csv');
      charEvents = params.uniqueEventTypesCount * 150;
    } else {
      plannedFiles.push(
        '09_CANDIDATE_EVENT_SUMMARY.csv',
        '10_EVENT_DENSITY_BY_MINUTE.csv',
        '11_REPRESENTATIVE_EVENTS.csv'
      );
      charEvents = params.uniqueEventTypesCount * 150;
      charEvents += Math.ceil(params.durationSeconds / 60) * 30;
      charEvents += Math.min(params.flagsCount, 5 * params.uniqueEventTypesCount) * 100;

      if (profile === 'antigravity_local_debug' || params.eventExportMode === 'debug') {
        plannedFiles.push('09_DEBUG_RAW_CANDIDATE_EVENTS.csv');
        charEvents += params.flagsCount * 80;
      }
    }

    // Trends
    plannedFiles.push(
      '40_TRENDS_SUMMARY.md',
      '41_TRENDS_INTERPRETATION.json',
      '42_TRENDS_TIMESERIES.csv',
      '43_TRENDS_QUALITY.json'
    );
    charTrends = 1000 + 1000 + params.numSessions * 80 + 300;

    if (profile === 'chatgpt_web_full') {
      plannedFiles.push(
        '45_CHART_TREND_RMSSD.png',
        '46_CHART_TREND_SDNN.png',
        '47_CHART_TREND_AVG_HR.png'
      );
    }

    // Local Debug layout
    if (profile === 'antigravity_local_debug') {
      if (!params.excludeEcgCsv) {
        plannedFiles.push('ecg_full.csv');
        // full lossless signal estimated once
        charEcgStrips += Math.round(params.durationSeconds * 130 * 15);
      }
      plannedFiles.push(
        'candidate_events.csv',
        'event_cluster_index.csv'
      );
      charEvents += flagsList.length * 100;
      charEvents += clusters.length * 120;
    } else {
      // Individual event ECG strips (if not debug and not excluded)
      for (let i = 1; i <= ecgStripsCount; i++) {
        const suffix = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
        plannedFiles.push(`30_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.png`);
        if (!params.excludeEcgCsv) {
          plannedFiles.push(`31_ECG_STRIP_${suffix}.csv`);
          charEcgStrips += budget.maxEcgStripSeconds * 130 * 15;
        }
      }
    }

    // Prompt templates
    for (const p of PROMPT_TEMPLATES) {
      plannedFiles.push(p.filename);
    }
  }

  // Calculate Single File markdown size
  let singleFileChars = 1500; // overview, header, disclaimers
  singleFileChars += charQuality;
  singleFileChars += 600; // metrics
  singleFileChars += 300; // timeline
  singleFileChars += charPrompts; // prompt content
  singleFileChars += charTrends; // trends summary
  if (profile !== 'gemini_web_compact') {
    singleFileChars += 10000; // subsets of HR/RR (capped)
  }
  singleFileChars += params.uniqueEventTypesCount * 150;

  const estimatedSingleFileChars = Math.round(singleFileChars);

  // Estimates calculations
  const estimated_text_characters = Math.round(
    charCore + charPrompts + charMetrics + charQuality + charEvents + charTrends + charEcgStrips + estimatedSingleFileChars
  );
  const estimated_text_bytes = estimated_text_characters;

  // Binary bytes (timeline + trends + representative strips)
  const pngCount = (profile === 'chatgpt_web_full' ? 4 : 0) + ecgStripsCount;
  const estimated_binary_bytes = pngCount * 15 * 1024;

  const estimated_uncompressed_bytes = estimated_text_bytes + estimated_binary_bytes;

  // ZIP size estimation
  const estimated_zip_bytes = Math.round(estimated_text_bytes * 0.3) + estimated_binary_bytes;

  const uniquePlannedFiles = Array.from(new Set(plannedFiles));

  const plan: PackPlan = {
    estimated_text_characters,
    estimated_text_bytes,
    estimated_binary_bytes,
    estimated_uncompressed_bytes,
    estimated_zip_bytes,
    candidate_event_count: stats.candidates_before,
    exact_duplicate_count: stats.exact_duplicates_removed,
    cluster_count: stats.clusters_after,
    full_signal_member_count: (profile === 'antigravity_local_debug' && !params.excludeEcgCsv) ? 1 : 0,
    representative_png_count: ecgStripsCount,
    event_table_count: profile === 'antigravity_local_debug' ? 1 : 0,
    duplicate_derived_files_avoided: stats.exact_duplicates_removed + stats.overlapping_windows_merged,
    plannedFiles: uniquePlannedFiles
  };

  return {
    estimatedEntriesCount: uniquePlannedFiles.length,
    estimatedTextCharsTotal: estimated_text_bytes,
    estimatedEcgStripsCount: ecgStripsCount,
    estimatedSingleFileChars: estimatedSingleFileChars,
    breakdown: {
      core: coreCount,
      prompts: promptsCount,
      charts: chartsCount,
      ecgStripPng,
      ecgStripCsv,
      debugExtra: 0
    },
    charBreakdown: {
      core: charCore,
      prompts: charPrompts,
      metrics: charMetrics,
      quality: charQuality,
      events: charEvents,
      trends: charTrends,
      ecgStrips: charEcgStrips
    },
    plannedFiles: uniquePlannedFiles,
    plan
  };
}

FILE: src/backend/llmPack/zipFlatWriter.ts

import { ZipArchive } from 'archiver';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getAppDataDir } from '../db/db';
import { ExportProfile } from './sizeBudget';

export interface FlatZipEntry {
  name: string;
  kind: 'markdown' | 'json' | 'csv' | 'png' | 'text';
  content?: Buffer | string;
  filePath?: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  sha256?: string;
  description: string;
  memberClass?: import('./privacy').PackMemberClass;
}


export interface WriteZipResult {
  zipPath: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  entries: Array<{ name: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string }>;
}

/**
 * Validates that the entry name strictly conforms to flat root-only layout rules.
 */
export function validateEntryName(name: string): boolean {
  if (!name || name.length === 0) return false;
  if (name.includes('..') || name.includes(':') || name.includes('\\')) return false;
  if (name.startsWith('.')) return false;

  let checkName = name;
  if (name.startsWith('signals/') || name.startsWith('events/')) {
    const parts = name.split('/');
    if (parts.length !== 2) return false;
    checkName = parts[1];
  } else if (name.includes('/')) {
    // Arbitrary subdirectories are forbidden
    return false;
  }

  const isEcg = /^3[0-9]_ECG_STRIP_[0-9]{3}\.(png|csv)$/.test(checkName);
  const isGeneral = /^[0-9]{2}_[A-Z0-9_]+(\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+)?$/.test(checkName);
  const isCanonicalV2 = /^[a-z0-9_]+\.(json|md|csv|sha256|txt|png)$/.test(checkName);
  const isDebugRaw = checkName === 'ecg_full.csv' || checkName === 'candidate_events.csv' || checkName === 'event_cluster_index.csv';

  return isEcg || isGeneral || isCanonicalV2 || isDebugRaw;
}

/**
 * Computes size and SHA-256 hash using streaming to avoid loading full files in memory.
 */
export function hashFileStreaming(filePath: string): Promise<{ sizeBytes: number; sha256: string }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
    let sizeBytes = 0;
    let finished = false;

    stream.on('data', (chunk) => {
      sizeBytes += chunk.length;
      hash.update(chunk);
    });

    stream.on('end', () => {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      resolve({
        sizeBytes,
        sha256: hash.digest('hex')
      });
    });

    stream.on('error', (err) => {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      stream.destroy();
      reject(err);
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Writes a flat ZIP archive to the application's local export directory.
 */
export function writeFlatZip(params: {
  entries: FlatZipEntry[];
  outputDir: string;
  outputFilename: string;
  profile: ExportProfile;
}): Promise<WriteZipResult> {
  return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
    let tempPath = '';
    try {
      const { entries, outputDir, outputFilename } = params;

      // Ensure directory exists
      if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
      }

      const finalPath = path.join(outputDir, outputFilename);
      tempPath = path.join(outputDir, `${outputFilename}.tmp`);

      const outputStream = fs.createWriteStream(tempPath);
      const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

      let wasDestroyed = false;
      const entryDetails: Array<{ name: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string }> = [];
      const seenNames = new Set<string>();

      outputStream.on('close', () => {
        if (wasDestroyed) return;
        try {
          const stats = fs.statSync(tempPath);
          fs.renameSync(tempPath, finalPath);
          resolve({
            zipPath: finalPath,
            sizeBytes: stats.size,
            entries: entryDetails,
          });
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      });

      archive.on('error', (err: any) => {
        wasDestroyed = true;
        outputStream.destroy();
        if (tempPath && fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(tempPath); } catch (_) {}
        }
        reject(err);
      });

      archive.pipe(outputStream);

      for (const entry of entries) {
        // 1. Validate naming rules
        if (!validateEntryName(entry.name)) {
          wasDestroyed = true;
          archive.destroy();
          outputStream.destroy();
          if (tempPath && fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
            try { fs.unlinkSync(tempPath); } catch (_) {}
          }
          return reject(new Error(`Invalid entry name: "${entry.name}". Nested paths or invalid patterns are forbidden.`));
        }

        // 2. Reject duplicate names
        if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) {
          wasDestroyed = true;
          archive.destroy();
          outputStream.destroy();
          if (tempPath && fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
            try { fs.unlinkSync(tempPath); } catch (_) {}
          }
          return reject(new Error(`Duplicate entry name: "${entry.name}"`));
        }
        seenNames.add(entry.name);

        // Calculate size and SHA-256 hash
        let sizeBytes = 0;
        let sha256 = '';

        if (entry.filePath) {
          if (entry.sha256 && entry.sizeBytes !== undefined) {
            sizeBytes = entry.sizeBytes;
            sha256 = entry.sha256;
          } else {
            const hashResult = await hashFileStreaming(entry.filePath);
            sizeBytes = hashResult.sizeBytes;
            sha256 = hashResult.sha256;
          }
        } else {
          const buf = typeof entry.content === 'string' ? Buffer.from(entry.content, 'utf8') : entry.content!;
          sizeBytes = buf.length;
          sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
        }

        entryDetails.push({
          name: entry.name,
          sizeBytes,
          sha256,
        });

        // 3. Append to archive
        if (entry.filePath) {
          archive.append(fs.createReadStream(entry.filePath), { name: entry.name });
        } else {
          const buf = typeof entry.content === 'string' ? Buffer.from(entry.content, 'utf8') : entry.content!;
          archive.append(buf, { name: entry.name });
        }
      }

      archive.finalize();
    } catch (err) {
      if (tempPath && fs.existsSync(tempPath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(tempPath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

FILE: src/backend/logging/appLogger.ts
================================================================================
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { redactObject } from './logRedaction';
import { VERSION_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/versionContract';

export type LogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';
export type LogCategory =
  | 'source'
  | 'sync'
  | 'parser'
  | 'sessionizer'
  | 'qc'
  | 'analytics'
  | 'report'
  | 'llm_pack'
  | 'ui'
  | 'chart'
  | 'jobs'
  | 'diagnostics'
  | 'backup'
  | 'lifecycle';

export interface LogRecord {
  schema_version: string;
  app_version?: string;
  ts: string;
  level: LogLevel;
  category: LogCategory;
  runId?: string;
  sessionId?: string;
  sourceId?: string;
  jobId?: string;
  traceId?: string;
  message: string;
  code?: string;
  details?: Record<string, any>;
  redaction_applied: boolean;
}

let activeLogLevel: LogLevel = 'info';
let customLogsDir: string | null = null;
let maxFileSizeMb = 5;
let retentionDays = 14;

const LEVEL_SEVERITY: Record<LogLevel, number> = {
  debug: 0,
  info: 1,
  warn: 2,
  error: 3
};

/**
 * Configure the logger settings
 */
export function configureLogger(options: {
  level?: LogLevel;
  logsDir?: string;
  maxFileSizeMb?: number;
  retentionDays?: number;
}) {
  if (options.level) activeLogLevel = options.level;
  if (options.logsDir) customLogsDir = options.logsDir;
  if (options.maxFileSizeMb !== undefined) maxFileSizeMb = options.maxFileSizeMb;
  if (options.retentionDays !== undefined) retentionDays = options.retentionDays;
}

/**
 * Get active logs directory
 */
export function getLogsDir(): string {
  if (customLogsDir) return customLogsDir;

  try {
    const { app } = require('electron');
    if (app && typeof app.getPath === 'function') {
      return path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'logs');
    }
  } catch {}
  
  const localAppData = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA;
  if (localAppData) {
    return path.join(localAppData, 'H10AthleteCardioLab', 'logs');
  }
  
  // Fallback to app-managed data directory
  return path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'logs');
}

export function getLogLevel(): LogLevel {
  return activeLogLevel;
}

export function getRetentionDays(): number {
  return retentionDays;
}

export function getMaxFileSizeMb(): number {
  return maxFileSizeMb;
}

/**
 * Returns the current date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD
 */
function getTodayString(date = new Date()): string {
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/**
 * Resolves the path of the active log file, handling size-based rotation.
 */
export function getActiveLogFilePath(): string {
  const dir = getLogsDir();
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const today = getTodayString();
  let baseName = `app-${today}`;
  let attempt = 0;
  
  while (attempt < 1000) {
    const fileName = attempt === 0 ? `${baseName}.jsonl` : `${baseName}.${attempt}.jsonl`;
    const filePath = path.join(dir, fileName);
    
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      return filePath;
    }
    
    const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
    const sizeMb = stats.size / (1024 * 1024);
    if (sizeMb < maxFileSizeMb) {
      return filePath;
    }
    
    attempt++;
  }
  
  return path.join(dir, `${baseName}.jsonl`);
}

/**
 * Performs cleanup of log files older than retention_days.
 * Never fails the main application.
 */
export function cleanupOldLogs() {
  try {
    const dir = getLogsDir();
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;

    const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
    const now = new Date();
    const cutoffMs = now.getTime() - retentionDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    for (const file of files) {
      // Expect files starting with app-YYYY-MM-DD
      const match = file.match(/^app-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})(?:\.\d+)?\.jsonl$/);
      if (match) {
        const fileDateStr = match[1];
        const fileDate = new Date(fileDateStr);
        if (!isNaN(fileDate.getTime()) && fileDate.getTime() < cutoffMs) {
          try {
            fs.unlinkSync(path.join(dir, file));
          } catch (e) {
            // best-effort
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // never fail main application
  }
}

const RING_BUFFER_MAX_RECORDS = 500;
const memoryRingBuffer: LogRecord[] = [];

/**
 * Returns a shallow copy of the most recent log records in the in-memory ring buffer.
 */
export function getRecentLogRecords(): LogRecord[] {
  return [...memoryRingBuffer];
}

/**
 * Log a structured record
 */
export function logEvent(
  level: LogLevel,
  category: LogCategory,
  message: string,
  params: {
    runId?: string;
    sessionId?: string;
    sourceId?: string;
    jobId?: string;
    traceId?: string;
    code?: string;
    details?: Record<string, any>;
  } = {}
) {
  // Check severity level
  if (LEVEL_SEVERITY[level] < LEVEL_SEVERITY[activeLogLevel]) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Redact details and message
    const debugMode = activeLogLevel === 'debug';
    const redactedDetails = params.details ? redactObject(params.details, debugMode) : undefined;
    const redactedMessage = redactObject(message, debugMode);

    const record: LogRecord = {
      schema_version: '1.0',
      app_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.full_display_version,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      category,
      runId: params.runId,
      sessionId: params.sessionId,
      sourceId: params.sourceId,
      jobId: params.jobId,
      traceId: params.traceId,
      message: redactedMessage,
      code: params.code,
      details: redactedDetails,
      redaction_applied: true
    };

    memoryRingBuffer.push(record);
    if (memoryRingBuffer.length > RING_BUFFER_MAX_RECORDS) {
      memoryRingBuffer.shift();
    }

    const logLine = JSON.stringify(record) + '\n';
    const filePath = getActiveLogFilePath();
    
    fs.appendFileSync(filePath, logLine, 'utf8');

    // Run cleanups on a best-effort basis
    if (level !== 'debug') {
      cleanupOldLogs();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Never fail application due to logging issues
    console.error('Failed to write log event', e);
  }
}

// Helper methods for easy invocation
export const logger = {
  debug: (category: LogCategory, message: string, params?: Parameters<typeof logEvent>[3]) =>
    logEvent('debug', category, message, params),
  info: (category: LogCategory, message: string, params?: Parameters<typeof logEvent>[3]) =>
    logEvent('info', category, message, params),
  warn: (category: LogCategory, message: string, params?: Parameters<typeof logEvent>[3]) =>
    logEvent('warn', category, message, params),
  error: (category: LogCategory, message: string, params?: Parameters<typeof logEvent>[3]) =>
    logEvent('error', category, message, params)
};

export function setLogLevel(level: LogLevel) {
  configureLogger({ level });
}

export function clearAllLogs() {
  const dir = getLogsDir();
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.startsWith('app-') && f.endsWith('.jsonl'));
  for (const file of files) {
    try {
      fs.unlinkSync(path.join(dir, file));
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

export function getLastError(): string | null {
  const dir = getLogsDir();
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return null;
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.startsWith('app-') && f.endsWith('.jsonl')).sort();
  if (files.length === 0) return null;
  
  const latestFile = path.join(dir, files[files.length - 1]);
  const content = fs.readFileSync(latestFile, 'utf8');
  const lines = content.trim().split('\n').reverse();
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (!line) continue;
    try {
      const record = JSON.parse(line);
      if (record.level === 'error') {
        return `${record.ts.substring(11, 19)} [${record.category}] ${record.message}`;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  return null;
}

export function writeLog(level: LogLevel, category: LogCategory, message: string, details?: Record<string, any>) {
  logEvent(level, category, message, { details });
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import * as os from 'os';
import { exec } from 'child_process';
import { ZipArchive } from 'archiver';
import { getLogsDir, getLogLevel, getRetentionDays, getMaxFileSizeMb } from './appLogger';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import { redactFtpUrl, redactObject } from './logRedaction';
import { VERSION_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/versionContract';

// We will fetch the active job state dynamically. We will set this resolver from routes.ts to avoid circular imports.
let activeJobResolver: () => any = () => ({ status: 'idle' });

export function registerActiveJobResolver(resolver: () => any) {
  activeJobResolver = resolver;
}

/**
 * Creates a zip diagnostic_bundle containing redacted app state files.
 */
export function createDiagnosticBundle(outputPath: string): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const output = fs.createWriteStream(outputPath);
      const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

      output.on('close', () => resolve());
      archive.on('error', (err: any) => reject(err));
      archive.pipe(output);

      const db = getDb();

      // 1. 00_README.log
      const readmeText = `H10 Athlete Cardio Lab Diagnostic Bundle\nExported: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\nThis bundle contains application configuration summaries, redacted log events, data source configuration, and database schemas. Absolutely no raw biometric data (ECG/ACC), Polar log contents, personal notes, or password credentials are included.`;
      archive.append(readmeText, { name: '00_README.log' });

      // 2. 01_LOGS_REDACTED.jsonl
      const logsDir = getLogsDir();
      let logsContent = '';
      if (fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
        const files = fs.readdirSync(logsDir).filter(f => f.startsWith('app-') && f.endsWith('.jsonl'));
        for (const file of files) {
          const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(logsDir, file), 'utf8');
          const lines = content.split('\n');
          for (const line of lines) {
            if (!line.trim()) continue;
            try {
              const record = JSON.parse(line);
              // Run a second pass redaction to be absolutely secure
              const redactedRecord = redactObject(record, getLogLevel() === 'debug');
              logsContent += JSON.stringify(redactedRecord) + '\n';
            } catch (e) {
              // If line is corrupted, skip it
            }
          }
        }
      }
      archive.append(logsContent, { name: '01_LOGS_REDACTED.jsonl' });

      // 3. 02_APP_CONFIG_SUMMARY.json
      const configSummary = {
        app_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.full_display_version,
        canonical_protocol_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.canonical_protocol_version,
        candidate_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.candidate_version,
        release_channel: VERSION_CONTRACT.release_channel,
        log_level: getLogLevel(),
        max_file_size_mb: getMaxFileSizeMb(),
        retention_days: getRetentionDays(),
        platform: process.platform,
        arch: process.arch,
        node_version: process.version,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(configSummary, null, 2), { name: '02_APP_CONFIG_SUMMARY.json' });

      // 4. 03_DB_SCHEMA_SUMMARY.json
      let dbSchemaSummary = {};
      try {
        const tables = db.prepare("SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").all() as { name: string, sql: string }[];
        const userVersion = db.prepare("PRAGMA user_version").get() as any;
        dbSchemaSummary = {
          user_version: userVersion ? Object.values(userVersion)[0] : 0,
          tables: tables.map(t => ({ name: t.name, sql: t.sql }))
        };
      } catch (err) {
        dbSchemaSummary = { error: 'Failed to read DB schema summary' };
      }
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(dbSchemaSummary, null, 2), { name: '03_DB_SCHEMA_SUMMARY.json' });

      // 5. 04_ACTIVE_SOURCE_SUMMARY.json
      let activeSourceSummary: any[] = [];
      try {
        const sources = db.prepare("SELECT id, label, type, path, url, is_active FROM data_sources").all() as any[];
        activeSourceSummary = sources.map(s => ({
          id: s.id,
          label: s.label,
          type: s.type,
          path: s.path ? '<redacted path>' : null,
          url: s.url ? redactFtpUrl(s.url) : null,
          is_active: s.is_active
        }));
      } catch (err) {
        activeSourceSummary = [];
      }
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(activeSourceSummary, null, 2), { name: '04_ACTIVE_SOURCE_SUMMARY.json' });

      // 6. 05_RECENT_JOBS.json
      let recentJobs = [];
      try {
        const job = activeJobResolver();
        if (job) {
          recentJobs.push({
            type: 'zone_recompute',
            status: job.status,
            total_sessions: job.total_sessions,
            processed_sessions: job.processed_sessions,
            failed_sessions: job.failed_sessions,
            started_at: job.started_at,
            updated_at: job.updated_at,
            last_error: job.last_error ? 'redacted_error' : null
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {}
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(recentJobs, null, 2), { name: '05_RECENT_JOBS.json' });

      // 7. 06_RECENT_EXPORTS.json
      let recentExports: any[] = [];
      try {
        const exports = db.prepare("SELECT session_id, export_type, created_at FROM llm_packs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20").all() as any[];
        recentExports = exports.map(e => ({
          session_id: e.session_id,
          export_type: e.export_type,
          created_at: e.created_at
        }));
      } catch (err) {}
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(recentExports, null, 2), { name: '06_RECENT_EXPORTS.json' });

      // 8. 07_HARDWARE_SYSTEM_TELEMETRY.json
      const hardwareTelemetry = {
        platform: process.platform,
        arch: process.arch,
        cpu_count: os.cpus().length,
        cpu_model: os.cpus()[0]?.model || 'unknown',
        total_memory_bytes: os.totalmem(),
        free_memory_bytes: os.freemem(),
        process_uptime_seconds: process.uptime(),
        node_version: process.version,
        process_memory: process.memoryUsage(),
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(hardwareTelemetry, null, 2), { name: '07_HARDWARE_SYSTEM_TELEMETRY.json' });

      // 9. 08_HANG_INCIDENTS.json
      const hangIncidents: any[] = [];
      if (fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
        try {
          const incidentFiles = fs.readdirSync(logsDir).filter(f => f.startsWith('hang-incident-') && f.endsWith('.json'));
          for (const file of incidentFiles) {
            try {
              const content = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(logsDir, file), 'utf8'));
              hangIncidents.push(content);
            } catch {}
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(hangIncidents, null, 2), { name: '08_HANG_INCIDENTS.json' });

      // 10. 09_REQUEST_SPAN_TIMINGS.json
      let requestSpans: any[] = [];
      try {
        const { getRequestSpanTimings } = require('../server');
        if (getRequestSpanTimings) {
          requestSpans = getRequestSpanTimings();
        }
      } catch {}
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(requestSpans, null, 2), { name: '09_REQUEST_SPAN_TIMINGS.json' });

      // 11. 10_DIAGNOSTIC_MANIFEST.json
      const manifest = {
        files: [
          '00_README.log',
          '01_LOGS_REDACTED.jsonl',
          '02_APP_CONFIG_SUMMARY.json',
          '03_DB_SCHEMA_SUMMARY.json',
          '04_ACTIVE_SOURCE_SUMMARY.json',
          '05_RECENT_JOBS.json',
          '06_RECENT_EXPORTS.json',
          '07_HARDWARE_SYSTEM_TELEMETRY.json',
          '08_HANG_INCIDENTS.json',
          '09_REQUEST_SPAN_TIMINGS.json'
        ],
        logs_record_count: logsContent.split('\n').filter(Boolean).length,
        hang_incidents_count: hangIncidents.length,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      archive.append(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), { name: '10_DIAGNOSTIC_MANIFEST.json' });

      archive.finalize();
    } catch (err) {
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

export function openLogsDir() {
  const dir = getLogsDir();
  if (process.platform === 'win32') {
    exec(`explorer "${dir}"`);
  } else if (process.platform === 'darwin') {
    exec(`open "${dir}"`);
  } else {
    exec(`xdg-open "${dir}"`);
  }
}

import path from 'path';

/**
 * Normalizes carriage returns and line feeds to spaces to prevent log injection.
 */
export function normalizeLineBreaks(str: string): string {
  return str.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
}

/**
 * Redacts FTP URLs, masking credentials.
 * Input: ftp://user:pass@host:port/path -> ftp://<redacted>@host:port/path
 */
export function redactFtpUrl(url: string): string {
  return url.replace(/(ftp:\/\/)([^:@/]+)(:[^@/]+)?@/g, '$1<redacted>@');
}

/**
 * Redacts a device ID (e.g. 130E4A2F -> 130E****).
 */
export function redactDeviceId(deviceId: string): string {
  if (deviceId.length >= 4) {
    return deviceId.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(4, deviceId.length - 4));
  }
  return '****';
}

/**
 * Redacts absolute paths by replacing them with <redacted path>/<basename>.
 */
export function redactPaths(str: string, debugMode = false): string {
  if (debugMode) return str;
  // Match absolute windows paths (e.g. C:\foo\bar) or absolute posix paths (e.g. /usr/foo)
  const winPathRegex = /[a-zA-Z]:\\[\\\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+(\.[\w\u0400-\u04FF]+)?/g;
  const posixPathRegex = /\/[\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+\/[\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+(\.[\w\u0400-\u04FF]+)?/g;

  let redacted = str.replace(winPathRegex, (match) => {
    const base = path.basename(match);
    return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
  });

  redacted = redacted.replace(posixPathRegex, (match) => {
    const base = path.basename(match);
    return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
  });

  return redacted;
}

/**
 * Recursively redacts an object or array to remove sensitive values before writing to log files.
 */
export function redactObject(obj: any, debugMode = false): any {
  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj;

  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    // If it's a large array, truncate it
    if (obj.length > 10) {
      return { count: obj.length, sample_redacted: true, omitted: true };
    }
    return obj.map(item => redactObject(item, debugMode));
  }

  if (typeof obj === 'object') {
    const redacted: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const key of Object.keys(obj)) {
      const val = obj[key];
      const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();

      // Redact sensitive keys
      if (
        lowerKey.includes('password') ||
        lowerKey.includes('secret') ||
        lowerKey.includes('token') ||
        lowerKey === 'ftp' ||
        lowerKey.includes('authorization') ||
        lowerKey.includes('auth')
      ) {
        redacted[key] = '<redacted>';
      } else if (lowerKey.includes('deviceid') || lowerKey.includes('device_id')) {
        redacted[key] = typeof val === 'string' ? redactDeviceId(val) : '<redacted device id>';
      } else if (lowerKey.includes('path')) {
        redacted[key] = typeof val === 'string' ? redactPaths(val, debugMode) : '<redacted path>';
      } else if (lowerKey.includes('note') || lowerKey.includes('comment') || lowerKey.includes('personal')) {
        redacted[key] = '<redacted note>';
      } else if (lowerKey.includes('name') || lowerKey.includes('displayname')) {
        if (process.env.LOG_DISPLAY_NAMES === 'true') {
          redacted[key] = val;
        } else {
          redacted[key] = '<redacted name>';
        }
      } else if (
        lowerKey === 'ecg' ||
        lowerKey === 'acc' ||
        lowerKey === 'samples' ||
        lowerKey === 'rawpoints' ||
        lowerKey === 'intervals' ||
        lowerKey === 'points' ||
        lowerKey === 'xs' ||
        lowerKey === 'ys'
      ) {
        if (Array.isArray(val)) {
          redacted[key] = { count: val.length, sample_redacted: true, omitted: true };
        } else {
          redacted[key] = '<redacted biometrics>';
        }
      } else {
        // Recurse
        if (typeof val === 'string') {
          redacted[key] = redactString(val, debugMode);
        } else {
          redacted[key] = redactObject(val, debugMode);
        }
      }
    }
    return redacted;
  }

  if (typeof obj === 'string') {
    return redactString(obj, debugMode);
  }

  return obj;
}

export function redactString(s: string, debugMode = false): string {
  let res = redactFtpUrl(s);
  res = redactPaths(res, debugMode);
  res = normalizeLineBreaks(res);
  
  // Redact tokens/canaries/authorization patterns
  res = res.replace(/(bearer\s+)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(auth(orization)?\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(access_token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(password\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(secret\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(launch_token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/(device_id\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
  
  // Generic canary scrubbing
  res = res.replace(/POLARH10_CANARY_DEVICE_ID/gi, '<redacted device id>');
  res = res.replace(/canary-auth-header-value/gi, '<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/canary-secret-value/gi, '<redacted>');
  res = res.replace(/canary-token-value/gi, '<redacted>');

  return res;
}

export { PrivacyRedactor, CANARY_IDENTIFIERS } from '../security/PrivacyRedactor';

/**
 * CardioLab Workstation G5 — Longitudinal Analysis & Personal Baseline Engine
 * 
 * Provides:
 * - Authoritative observation point selection with profile/date/activity scope
 * - Leave-One-Out (LOO) target session exclusion
 * - Duplicate source alias and reanalysis deduplication (does not inflate N)
 * - Independent per-metric baseline evaluation (e.g. HR ready @ 5, RMSSD not ready @ 3)
 * - Strict non-diagnostic change classification (above/within/below/insufficient/withheld)
 * - Immutable snapshot generation with aggregate dependency tracking
 * - Privacy-safe export packaging
 */
