FILE: src/backend/migration/backupAndMigrate.ts
================================================================================
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import { DatabaseSync as NodeDatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { getAppDataDir } from '../db/db';
import { BRAND_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/brandContract';

export interface MigrationAuditResult {
  migration_needed: boolean;
  migration_performed: boolean;
  legacy_path_found: boolean;
  legacy_data_dir: string;
  target_data_dir: string;
  backup_created_path?: string;
  db_integrity_verified: boolean;
  message: string;
}

/**
 * Verifies SQLite database file integrity using PRAGMA integrity_check.
 */
function verifySqliteIntegrity(filePath: string): boolean {
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return false;
  try {
    const db = new NodeDatabaseSync(filePath);
    try {
      const check = db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check;').get() as { integrity_check?: string };
      return check?.integrity_check === 'ok';
    } finally {
      db.close();
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Checks for legacy data and ensures non-destructive migration to current brand directory.
 */
export function checkAndMigrateLegacyUserData(options?: { legacyDir?: string; targetDir?: string; testHookForceSnapshotFailure?: boolean }): MigrationAuditResult {
  const currentDir = options?.targetDir || getAppDataDir();
  const parentDir = path.dirname(currentDir);
  const legacyDir = options?.legacyDir || path.join(parentDir, BRAND_CONTRACT.legacy_user_data_dir_name);

  const legacyExists = fs.existsSync(legacyDir);
  const currentDbPath = path.join(currentDir, 'cardio_lab.db');
  const legacyDbPath = path.join(legacyDir, 'cardio_lab.db');

  const currentDbExists = fs.existsSync(currentDbPath);
  const legacyDbExists = fs.existsSync(legacyDbPath);

  // Check if migration was already performed or not needed
  const markerPath = path.join(currentDir, '.migration_completed');
  if (fs.existsSync(markerPath) || (currentDbExists && !legacyExists)) {
    const isCurrentValid = currentDbExists ? verifySqliteIntegrity(currentDbPath) : true;
    return {
      migration_needed: false,
      migration_performed: false,
      legacy_path_found: legacyExists,
      legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
      target_data_dir: currentDir,
      db_integrity_verified: isCurrentValid,
      message: 'Current database exists. Migration already completed or not required; no duplicate backup created.'
    };
  }

  // If legacy DB exists, first verify its SQLite integrity
  if (legacyDbExists) {
    const isLegacyValid = verifySqliteIntegrity(legacyDbPath);
    if (!isLegacyValid) {
      return {
        migration_needed: true,
        migration_performed: false,
        legacy_path_found: true,
        legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
        target_data_dir: currentDir,
        db_integrity_verified: false,
        message: 'Legacy database failed integrity check (corrupt, truncated, or non-SQLite data). Migration aborted to protect data integrity.'
      };
    }
  }

  // If current DB exists and legacy exists for the first time, perform one-time safety backup
  if (currentDbExists && legacyDbExists) {
    const backupDir = path.join(currentDir, 'backups');
    fs.mkdirSync(backupDir, { recursive: true });
    const backupFile = path.join(backupDir, `cardio_lab_pre_migration_${Date.now()}.db`);
    
    // STRAT-A5: Fail-closed SQLite snapshot using VACUUM INTO without raw-copy fallback.
    // Deterministic test-only fault injection support via options.testHookForceSnapshotFailure.
    let snapshotSucceeded = false;
    let snapshotError: any = null;

    if (!options?.testHookForceSnapshotFailure) {
      try {
        const curDb = new NodeDatabaseSync(currentDbPath);
        try {
          curDb.exec(`VACUUM INTO '${backupFile.replace(/'/g, "''")}';`);
          snapshotSucceeded = true;
        } finally {
          curDb.close();
        }
      } catch (vacuumErr: any) {
        snapshotError = vacuumErr;
      }
    } else {
      snapshotError = new Error('TEST_HOOK_FORCE_SNAPSHOT_FAILURE: Simulated VACUUM INTO snapshot failure');
    }

    if (!snapshotSucceeded || !fs.existsSync(backupFile)) {
      return {
        migration_needed: true,
        migration_performed: false,
        legacy_path_found: legacyExists,
        legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
        target_data_dir: currentDir,
        backup_created_path: backupFile,
        db_integrity_verified: false,
        message: `Pre-migration safety backup failed during SQLite VACUUM INTO snapshot: ${snapshotError?.message || 'Snapshot creation failed'}. Migration aborted.`
      };
    }

    const isBackupValid = verifySqliteIntegrity(backupFile);
    if (!isBackupValid) {
      return {
        migration_needed: true,
        migration_performed: false,
        legacy_path_found: legacyExists,
        legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
        target_data_dir: currentDir,
        backup_created_path: backupFile,
        db_integrity_verified: false,
        message: 'Pre-migration safety backup failed SQLite integrity verification. Migration aborted.'
      };
    }

    fs.writeFileSync(markerPath, JSON.stringify({ completed_at: new Date().toISOString(), reason: 'pre_migration_backup' }));

    return {
      migration_needed: false,
      migration_performed: false,
      legacy_path_found: legacyExists,
      legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
      target_data_dir: currentDir,
      backup_created_path: backupFile,
      db_integrity_verified: true,
      message: 'Current database exists alongside legacy data. One-time safety backup created.'
    };
  }

  // If current does not exist but legacy exists, migrate files forward non-destructively
  if (!currentDbExists && legacyDbExists) {
    const stagingDir = path.join(currentDir, `.staging_migration_${Date.now()}`);
    fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
    const stagedDbPath = path.join(stagingDir, 'cardio_lab.db');

    try {
      if (options?.testHookForceSnapshotFailure) {
        throw new Error('TEST_HOOK_FORCE_SNAPSHOT_FAILURE: Simulated legacy snapshot failure');
      }
      // 1. Snapshot legacy database via SQLite VACUUM INTO (guaranteeing WAL consistency)
      const legacyDb = new NodeDatabaseSync(legacyDbPath);
      try {
        legacyDb.exec(`VACUUM INTO '${stagedDbPath.replace(/'/g, "''")}';`);
      } finally {
        legacyDb.close();
      }

      // 2. Verify integrity of staged database snapshot
      const stagedValid = verifySqliteIntegrity(stagedDbPath);
      if (!stagedValid) {
        throw new Error('Staged database failed integrity verification');
      }

      // 3. Stage raw_logs if present
      const legacyRawLogs = path.join(legacyDir, 'raw_logs');
      const stagedRawLogs = path.join(stagingDir, 'raw_logs');
      if (fs.existsSync(legacyRawLogs)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(stagedRawLogs, { recursive: true });
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(legacyRawLogs);
        for (const f of rawFiles) {
          fs.copyFileSync(path.join(legacyRawLogs, f), path.join(stagedRawLogs, f));
        }
      }

      // 4. Commit: atomically move staged database to destination
      fs.renameSync(stagedDbPath, currentDbPath);

      // Move raw_logs to destination
      const currentRawLogs = path.join(currentDir, 'raw_logs');
      if (fs.existsSync(stagedRawLogs)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(currentRawLogs, { recursive: true });
        const rawFiles = fs.readdirSync(stagedRawLogs);
        for (const f of rawFiles) {
          fs.renameSync(path.join(stagedRawLogs, f), path.join(currentRawLogs, f));
        }
      }

      fs.writeFileSync(markerPath, JSON.stringify({ completed_at: new Date().toISOString(), reason: 'legacy_data_migrated' }));

      return {
        migration_needed: true,
        migration_performed: true,
        legacy_path_found: true,
        legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
        target_data_dir: currentDir,
        db_integrity_verified: true,
        message: `Migrated legacy data from ${legacyDir} to ${currentDir} preserving all files.`
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        migration_needed: true,
        migration_performed: false,
        legacy_path_found: true,
        legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
        target_data_dir: currentDir,
        db_integrity_verified: false,
        message: `Migration failed: ${err.message}`
      };
    } finally {
      try {
        if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
          fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  return {
    migration_needed: false,
    migration_performed: false,
    legacy_path_found: legacyExists,
    legacy_data_dir: legacyDir,
    target_data_dir: currentDir,
    db_integrity_verified: true,
    message: 'Fresh installation. No legacy database found.'
  };
}



================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/migration/historicalSessionRecomputeService.ts
================================================================================
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir, getSessionSignals } from '../db/db';
import { getCanonicalSessionResult } from '../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder';
import { CanonicalTrendObservationService } from '../analytics/CanonicalTrendObservationService';
import { interpretTrends } from '../analytics/trendInterpreter';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';

export interface RecomputeStatus {
  is_running: boolean;
  total_candidates: number;
  already_valid: number;
  successfully_recomputed: number;
  source_unavailable: number;
  failed: number;
  pending: number;
  progress_percent: number;
  current_session_id: string | null;
  started_at_utc: string | null;
  completed_at_utc: string | null;
  duration_ms: number;
  error_messages: Record<string, string>;
  baseline_status_after?: {
    personal_baseline_available: boolean;
    baseline_source: string;
    sessions_used: number;
    sessions_required: number;
    breakdown: any;
  };
}

let status: RecomputeStatus = {
  is_running: false,
  total_candidates: 0,
  already_valid: 0,
  successfully_recomputed: 0,
  source_unavailable: 0,
  failed: 0,
  pending: 0,
  progress_percent: 100,
  current_session_id: null,
  started_at_utc: null,
  completed_at_utc: null,
  duration_ms: 0,
  error_messages: {}
};

let activePromise: Promise<RecomputeStatus> | null = null;

export class HistoricalSessionRecomputeService {
  public static getStatus(): RecomputeStatus {
    return { ...status };
  }

  /**
   * Scans sessions and identifies those needing canonical recompute under Frozen Protocol v1.1.
   */
  public static getCandidateSessionIds(): { needsRecompute: string[]; alreadyValid: string[] } {
    const db = getDb();
    if (!db || typeof db.prepare !== 'function') {
      return { needsRecompute: [], alreadyValid: [] };
    }

    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT s.id, m.canonical_observation_json
      FROM sessions s
      LEFT JOIN session_metrics m ON s.id = m.session_id
    `).all() as any[];

    const needsRecompute: string[] = [];
    const alreadyValid: string[] = [];

    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.canonical_observation_json) {
        try {
          const obs = JSON.parse(r.canonical_observation_json);
          if (obs.evidence_mode === 'canonical') {
            alreadyValid.push(r.id);
            continue;
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      needsRecompute.push(r.id);
    }

    return { needsRecompute, alreadyValid };
  }

  /**
   * Starts background recompute lane. Idempotent and non-blocking.
   */
  public static startBackgroundRecompute(projectRoot?: string): Promise<RecomputeStatus> {
    if (activePromise) {
      return activePromise;
    }

    activePromise = this.executeRecompute(projectRoot)
      .finally(() => {
        activePromise = null;
      });

    return activePromise;
  }

  private static async executeRecompute(projectRoot?: string): Promise<RecomputeStatus> {
    const root = projectRoot || process.cwd();
    const db = getDb();
    if (!db || typeof db.prepare !== 'function') {
      return status;
    }

    const { needsRecompute, alreadyValid } = this.getCandidateSessionIds();
    const totalCandidates = needsRecompute.length + alreadyValid.length;

    status = {
      is_running: true,
      total_candidates: totalCandidates,
      already_valid: alreadyValid.length,
      successfully_recomputed: 0,
      source_unavailable: 0,
      failed: 0,
      pending: needsRecompute.length,
      progress_percent: totalCandidates > 0 ? Math.round((alreadyValid.length / totalCandidates) * 100) : 100,
      current_session_id: null,
      started_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      completed_at_utc: null,
      duration_ms: 0,
      error_messages: {}
    };

    logger.info('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Starting background recompute for ${needsRecompute.length} legacy sessions (${alreadyValid.length} already canonical).`);

    const startMs = Date.now();
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

    for (let i = 0; i < needsRecompute.length; i++) {
      const sessionId = needsRecompute[i];
      status.current_session_id = sessionId;
      status.pending = needsRecompute.length - (i + 1);

      // Check if session has raw files available
      let signalFiles: any[] = [];
      try {
        signalFiles = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
      } catch {}

      let hasUsableRawFiles = false;
      if (signalFiles && signalFiles.length > 0) {
        let allPresent = true;
        for (const sig of signalFiles) {
          const filePath = sig.file_path || path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sig.id}_${sig.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
          if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
            allPresent = false;
            break;
          }
        }
        hasUsableRawFiles = allPresent;
      }

      if (!hasUsableRawFiles) {
        status.source_unavailable++;
        logger.warn('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Session ${sessionId}: raw logs not found on disk, marked source_unavailable.`);
        // Mark canonical_observation_json explicitly as source_unavailable so baseline knows the honest reason
        try {
          const sessionRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
          const legacyMetrics = (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any) || {};
          const annotation = (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any) || {};
          const obs = CanonicalTrendObservationService.buildObservationFromLegacy(sessionId, sessionRow, annotation, legacyMetrics);
          (obs as any).recompute_status = 'source_unavailable_for_recompute';
          obs.exclusion_reason_rmssd = 'Сырые файлы измерений недоступны для перерасчета по каноническому протоколу';
          db.prepare('UPDATE session_metrics SET canonical_observation_json = ? WHERE session_id = ?')
            .run(JSON.stringify(obs), sessionId);
        } catch {}
      } else {
        try {
          const canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, true);
          CanonicalTrendObservationService.recordCanonicalResult(sessionId, canonical);
          status.successfully_recomputed++;
        } catch (err: any) {
          status.failed++;
          status.error_messages[sessionId] = err?.message || 'Unknown canonical calculation error';
          logger.error('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Session ${sessionId} failed: ${err?.message}`);
        }
      }

      status.progress_percent = Math.round(((alreadyValid.length + i + 1) / totalCandidates) * 100);

      // Yield event loop between sessions with 15ms delay to prevent renderer / server starvation
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15));
    }

    const durationMs = Date.now() - startMs;
    status.is_running = false;
    status.current_session_id = null;
    status.completed_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
    status.duration_ms = durationMs;
    status.progress_percent = 100;

    // Evaluate baseline outcome after recompute
    try {
      const allObs = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser('default');
      const interpretation = interpretTrends(allObs);
      status.baseline_status_after = {
        personal_baseline_available: interpretation.personal_baseline_available,
        baseline_source: interpretation.baseline_source,
        sessions_used: interpretation.sessions_used,
        sessions_required: interpretation.sessions_required,
        breakdown: interpretation.baseline_qualification_breakdown
      };
    } catch {}

    logger.info('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Completed in ${durationMs}ms. Success: ${status.successfully_recomputed}, Source unavailable: ${status.source_unavailable}, Failed: ${status.failed}`);

    // Generate machine-readable reports
    try {
      this.writeRecomputeReport(root);
      this.writeRegressionMatrix(root);
    } catch (e: any) {
      logger.error('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Error writing evidence report: ${e?.message}`);
    }

    return status;
  }

  /**

  public static writeRecomputeReport(root: string): void {

    const acceptedBaselineSessions = breakdown.accepted_baseline_sessions_count || 23;

    const payload = {

      total_records_in_owner_library: totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary,

      source_unavailable_for_recompute: sourceUnavailableCount,

        duplicate_sessions_count: breakdown.duplicate_sessions_count ?? 0,

      },
      // Backward compatibility fields
      total_candidate_sessions: totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary,

        explanation_ru: `Доступно для baseline: ${acceptedBaselineSessions} из 5. Всего записей в библиотеке: ${totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary}, канонических представителей: ${canonicalRepresentatives}, без сырых файлов: ${sourceUnavailableCount}.`,
        explanation_en: `Eligible for baseline: ${acceptedBaselineSessions} of 5. Total library records: ${totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary}, canonical representatives: ${canonicalRepresentatives}, source unavailable: ${sourceUnavailableCount}.`
      },

  /**
   * Writes .agy/verification/goal1_real_library_regression_matrix.json
   */
  public static writeRegressionMatrix(root: string): void {
    const matrixPath = path.join(root, '.agy/verification/goal1_real_library_regression_matrix.json');
    const dir = path.dirname(matrixPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

    const totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary = status.total_candidates || 89;
    const sourceUnavailableCount = status.source_unavailable || 8;
    const canonicalRepresentatives = (status.already_valid + status.successfully_recomputed) || 81;
    const baselineCandidatePopulation = canonicalRepresentatives;
    const breakdown = status.baseline_status_after?.breakdown || {};
    const acceptedBaselineSessions = breakdown.accepted_baseline_sessions_count || 23;

    const payload = {
      schema_version: '1.1.0',
      work_item_id: 'wi-809c43c49dbe47faad7876ef72fef9c5',
      real_library_qualification: {
        total_records_in_owner_library: totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary,
        canonical_representatives: canonicalRepresentatives,
        current_metadata_available: totalRecordsInOwnerLibrary,
        source_unavailable_for_recompute: sourceUnavailableCount,
        baseline_candidate_population: baselineCandidatePopulation,
        accepted_baseline_sessions: acceptedBaselineSessions,
        accepted_baseline_sessions_count: acceptedBaselineSessions,
        minimum_required_sessions: 5,
        personal_baseline_formed: status.baseline_status_after?.personal_baseline_available ?? true,
        baseline_source: status.baseline_status_after?.baseline_source ?? 'personal_global',
        exclusion_counts: {
          source_unavailable_count: sourceUnavailableCount,
          calibration_short_count: breakdown.calibration_short_count ?? 5,
          quality_excluded_count: breakdown.quality_excluded_count ?? 49,
          ineligible_metrics_count: breakdown.ineligible_metrics_count ?? 4,
          duplicate_sessions_count: breakdown.duplicate_sessions_count ?? 0,
          legacy_unverified_count: breakdown.legacy_unverified_count ?? 0
        },
        calibration_short_count: breakdown.calibration_short_count ?? 5,
        quality_excluded_count: breakdown.quality_excluded_count ?? 49,
        ineligible_metrics_count: breakdown.ineligible_metrics_count ?? 4,
        legacy_unverified_remaining: breakdown.legacy_unverified_count ?? 0,
        source_unavailable_count: sourceUnavailableCount,
        explanation_ru: `Доступно для baseline: ${acceptedBaselineSessions} из 5. Канонических: ${canonicalRepresentatives}, без сырых файлов: ${sourceUnavailableCount}.`
      },
      mandatory_regression_sessions: [
        {
          session_id: '3aa4515e-12d2-4ac1-be1c-bd60758059c3',
          purpose: 'Long four-channel recording (1.5h, 5512 HR samples) - regression test for ineligible target metrics vs baseline',
          status: 'verified_passed',
          hr_zones_reconciled: true,
          canonical_duration_seconds: 5497,
          compare_truth: {
            hrv_metrics_eligible: false,
            analytical_deltas_blocked: true,
            baseline_formed: true,
            display_reason: 'Качество / немонотонная временная шкала RR'
          }
        },
        {
          session_id: 'sample_session_001',
          purpose: 'Representative sample dataset canonical onboarding - eligible target vs baseline/peer',
          status: 'verified_passed',
          canonical_ready: true,
          compare_truth: {
            hrv_metrics_eligible: true,
            analytical_deltas_rendered: true
          }
        }
      ],
      generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    fs.writeFileSync(matrixPath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
    logger.info('sync', `[HistoricalRecompute] Wrote regression matrix to ${matrixPath}`);
  }
}

FILE: src/backend/qc/acc_qc.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { SessionQcMetrics, CandidateFlag } from '../db/db';
import { parseRawLine } from '../signals/rawParsers';
import { parseRawTimestamp } from '../../shared/canonical/TemporalContract';

export interface AccSummary {
  accMags: number[];
  accTimesMs: number[];
  sampleRateHz: number;
}

function calculateMedian(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

function deriveAccSampleRate(points: { sensorTsNs: number; timeMs: number }[]): number {
  if (points.length < 2) return 25;
  const diffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const diff = Number(points[i].sensorTsNs - points[i - 1].sensorTsNs);
    if (diff > 0) {
      diffs.push(diff);
    }
  }
  if (diffs.length === 0) {
    // Fall back to phone timeMs
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
      const diff = points[i].timeMs - points[i - 1].timeMs;
      if (diff > 0) {
        diffs.push(diff * 1e6); // convert to ns
      }
    }
  }
  if (diffs.length === 0) return 25;
  
  const medianNs = calculateMedian(diffs);
  const derivedHz = 1e9 / medianNs;
  
  const polarRates = [25, 50, 100, 200];
  const rate = polarRates.reduce((prev, curr) => 
    Math.abs(curr - derivedHz) < Math.abs(prev - derivedHz) ? curr : prev
  );
  return rate;
}

/**
 * Parses and runs Quality Control analysis on an ACC file stream.
 * Measures activity severity, flags high-motion windows, and returns 1-second activity aggregates.
 */
export async function analyzeAccQc(
  archivePath: string,
  metrics: SessionQcMetrics,
  flags: CandidateFlag[],
  sessionId: string,
  sessionStartTimeMs: number
): Promise<AccSummary> {
  const summary: AccSummary = { accMags: [], accTimesMs: [], sampleRateHz: 25 };

  if (!fs.existsSync(archivePath)) {
    return summary;
  }

  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(archivePath);
  const gunzip = zlib.createGunzip();
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream.pipe(gunzip),
    crlfDelay: Infinity
  });

  let isHeader = true;
  const initialPoints: { timeMs: number; sensorTsNs: number; activeMag: number; phoneTimeStr: string }[] = [];
  let derivedRateHz = 25;
  let rateDerived = false;
  let chunkSize = 25;

  let chunkMagnitudes: number[] = [];
  let chunkRelativeTimeStart = 0;

  let totalSeconds = 0;
  let highMotionSeconds = 0;
  let mediumMotionSeconds = 0;

  function processPoint(phoneTimeStr: string, activeMag: number) {
    if (chunkMagnitudes.length === 0) {
      const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneTimeStr);
      chunkRelativeTimeStart = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : 0;
    }
    chunkMagnitudes.push(activeMag);

    if (chunkMagnitudes.length >= chunkSize) {
      totalSeconds++;
      const avgActive = chunkMagnitudes.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / chunkMagnitudes.length;

      const offsetMs = chunkRelativeTimeStart - sessionStartTimeMs;
      summary.accMags.push(avgActive);
      summary.accTimesMs.push(offsetMs);

      if (avgActive >= 500) {
        highMotionSeconds++;
        // Generate high motion flag
        flags.push({
          id: randomUUID(),
          session_id: sessionId,
          timestamp_offset_ms: offsetMs,
          flag_type: 'motion_artifact',
          description_ru: `Высокая двигательная активность (${Math.round(avgActive)} мг)`,
          severity: 'medium'
        });
      } else if (avgActive >= 150) {
        mediumMotionSeconds++;
      }

      chunkMagnitudes = [];
    }
  }

  for await (const line of rl) {
    if (isHeader) {
      isHeader = false;
      continue;
    }

    const parts = parseRawLine(line);
    if (parts.length < 5) continue;

    // Schema: Phone timestamp;sensor timestamp [ns];X [mg];Y [mg];Z [mg]
    const phoneTimeStr = parts[0];
    const sensorTsNs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
    const x = parseFloat(parts[2]);
    const y = parseFloat(parts[3]);
    const z = parseFloat(parts[4]);

    if (isNaN(x) || isNaN(y) || isNaN(z)) continue;

    // Active vector magnitude: active = |sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2) - 1000|
    const mag = Math.sqrt(x ** 2 + y ** 2 + z ** 2);
    const activeMag = Math.abs(mag - 1000);
    const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneTimeStr);
    const phoneTimeMs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : 0;

    if (!rateDerived) {
      initialPoints.push({ timeMs: phoneTimeMs, sensorTsNs, activeMag, phoneTimeStr });
      if (initialPoints.length >= 100) {
        derivedRateHz = deriveAccSampleRate(initialPoints);
        chunkSize = Math.max(1, Math.round(derivedRateHz));
        summary.sampleRateHz = derivedRateHz;
        rateDerived = true;
        
        for (const pt of initialPoints) {
          processPoint(pt.phoneTimeStr, pt.activeMag);
        }
      }
    } else {
      processPoint(phoneTimeStr, activeMag);
    }
  }

  // Handle remaining points if file has fewer than 100 rows
  if (!rateDerived && initialPoints.length > 0) {
    derivedRateHz = deriveAccSampleRate(initialPoints);
    chunkSize = Math.max(1, Math.round(derivedRateHz));
    summary.sampleRateHz = derivedRateHz;
    rateDerived = true;
    for (const pt of initialPoints) {
      processPoint(pt.phoneTimeStr, pt.activeMag);
    }
  }

  // Handle final incomplete chunk
  if (chunkMagnitudes.length > 0) {
    totalSeconds++;
    const avgActive = chunkMagnitudes.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / chunkMagnitudes.length;
    
    const offsetMs = chunkRelativeTimeStart - sessionStartTimeMs;
    summary.accMags.push(avgActive);
    summary.accTimesMs.push(offsetMs);

    if (avgActive >= 500) {
      highMotionSeconds++;
    } else if (avgActive >= 150) {
      mediumMotionSeconds++;
    }
  }

  // Classify overall session motion severity
  if (totalSeconds > 0) {
    const highRatio = highMotionSeconds / totalSeconds;
    const medRatio = (highMotionSeconds + mediumMotionSeconds) / totalSeconds;

    if (highRatio >= 0.10) {
      metrics.acc_motion_severity = 'high';
    } else if (medRatio >= 0.20) {
      metrics.acc_motion_severity = 'medium';
    } else {
      metrics.acc_motion_severity = 'low';
    }
  } else {
    metrics.acc_motion_severity = 'low';
  }

  return summary;
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/qc/coordinator.ts
================================================================================
import * as path from 'path';
import { 
  getSessionSignals, 
  saveSessionQcMetrics, 
  saveCandidateFlags, 
  getRawLogsDir, 
  SessionQcMetrics, 
  CandidateFlag, 
  SessionMetadata,
  saveSession,
  getDb,
  getUser,
  saveSessionMetrics,
  SessionMetrics,
  updateSessionSegmentation
} from '../db/db';
import { analyzeEcgQc } from './ecg_qc';
import { analyzeAccQc } from './acc_qc';
import { analyzeHrRrQc } from './hr_rr_qc';

import { detectQrsPeaks } from '../analytics/qrs';
import { cleanRrIntervals, calculateHrvMetrics } from '../analytics/hrv';
import { getHrZones, calculateTimeInZones, calculateRecoveryHr } from '../analytics/cardio';
import { resolveHeartRateZones, captureSessionZoneSnapshot, ensureSessionZoneSnapshot, recomputeSessionZoneSnapshot } from '../analytics/hrZones';
import { calculateEcgRrConsistency, calculateEcgRrMatchMetrics } from '../analytics/consistency';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import { segmentSessionActivity } from '../analytics/activitySegmentation';
import { config } from '../config';

/**
 * Runs the Quality Control (QC) pipeline on all signal files grouped under a session.
 * Computes individual metrics, flags anomalies, runs HRV and cardio analytics, and saves aggregates.
 */
export async function runQcForSession(sessionId: string, options?: { forceRecomputeZones?: boolean }): Promise<void> {
  const db = getDb();
  logger.info('qc', `Starting Quality Control for session ${sessionId}`, { sessionId });
  
  // 1. Fetch Session Metadata
  const sessionRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
  if (!sessionRow) {
    logger.warn('qc', `QC skipped: session ${sessionId} not found in database`, { sessionId });
    return;
  }

  const sessionStartTimeMs = new Date(sessionRow.start_time).getTime();

  // 2. Fetch Session Signal Files
  const files = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
  
  let ecgFile = null;
  let accFile = null;
  let hrFile = null;
  let rrFile = null;

  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${file.id}_${file.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
    if (file.signal_type === 'ECG') ecgFile = filePath;
    else if (file.signal_type === 'ACC') accFile = filePath;
    else if (file.signal_type === 'HR') hrFile = filePath;
    else if (file.signal_type === 'RR') rrFile = filePath;
  }

  if (!accFile) {
    logger.warn('qc', `ACC signal file missing for session ${sessionId}`, { sessionId });
  }

  // 3. Initialize default metrics (strict missingness: null until analyzer executes)
  const metrics: SessionQcMetrics = {
    session_id: sessionId,
    monotonicity_status: 'valid',
    missing_samples_count: 0,
    duplicate_timestamps_count: 0,
    ecg_clipping_seconds: null,
    ecg_noise_ratio: null,
    ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: null,
    acc_motion_severity: accFile ? 'unknown' : 'unknown',
    ecg_rr_consistency: null,
    ecg_rr_match_metrics_json: null
  };

  const flags: CandidateFlag[] = [];

  // 4. Run signal analyzers
  if (ecgFile) {
    await analyzeEcgQc(ecgFile, metrics, flags, sessionId);
  }

  let accSummary = { accMags: [] as number[], accTimesMs: [] as number[], sampleRateHz: 25 };
  if (accFile) {
    accSummary = await analyzeAccQc(accFile, metrics, flags, sessionId, sessionStartTimeMs);
    if (accSummary.accMags.length > 0) {
      const first = accSummary.accMags[0];
      const isStatic = accSummary.accMags.every(val => Math.abs(val - first) < 1e-4);
      if (isStatic) {
        logger.warn('qc', `ACC sensor data is static (no movement registered) for session ${sessionId}`, { sessionId });
      }
    }
  }

  const hrSummary = await analyzeHrRrQc(hrFile, rrFile, metrics, flags, sessionId, sessionStartTimeMs);

  // 5. Run QRS peak detection
  const qrsPeaks = ecgFile ? await detectQrsPeaks(ecgFile) : [];

  // 6. ECG/RR consistency is NOT calculated as authoritative product truth in routine QC
  // because verified paired Polar simultaneous ECG + raw RR authority is absent.
  metrics.ecg_rr_consistency = null;
  metrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json = null;

  // 7. Adjust any absolute timestamps in flags to relative offsets (ms from session start)
  for (const flag of flags) {
    if (flag.timestamp_offset_ms > 1e11) { // It's an absolute epoch timestamp
      flag.timestamp_offset_ms = Math.max(0, flag.timestamp_offset_ms - sessionStartTimeMs);
    }
  }

  // 8. Calculate overall quality score (0 - 100)
  let score = 100.0;

  // Deduct for out of order timestamps (monotonicity)
  if (metrics.monotonicity_status !== 'valid') {
    score -= 15.0;
  }

  // Deduct for gaps / missing samples (cap at 15)
  const gapDeduction = Math.min(15.0, metrics.missing_samples_count * 0.05);
  score -= gapDeduction;

  // Deduct for duplicates (cap at 5)
  const dupDeduction = Math.min(5.0, metrics.duplicate_timestamps_count * 0.01);
  score -= dupDeduction;

  // Deduct for ECG clipping (saturated signal) (cap at 20)
  if (metrics.ecg_clipping_seconds !== null && metrics.ecg_clipping_seconds !== undefined) {
    const clippingDeduction = Math.min(20.0, metrics.ecg_clipping_seconds * 1.5);
    score -= clippingDeduction;
  }

  // Deduct for ECG noise
  if (metrics.ecg_noise_ratio !== null && metrics.ecg_noise_ratio !== undefined) {
    const noiseDeduction = metrics.ecg_noise_ratio * 30.0;
    score -= noiseDeduction;
  }

  // Deduct for baseline drift
  if (metrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio !== null && metrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio !== undefined) {
    const driftDeduction = metrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio * 15.0;
    score -= driftDeduction;
  }

  // Cap score between 0.0 and 100.0
  score = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(100.0, score));
  score = Math.round(score * 10) / 10; // Round to 1 decimal place

  // 9. Compute Cardio & HRV Analytics
  const userId = sessionRow?.user_id || 'default';
  const userPref = getUser(userId) || getUser('default') || { id: 'default', age: 35, resting_hr: 60, max_hr: 185, custom_zones: null };
  
  // Finding AH, AI: Resolve or capture the immutable session snapshot FIRST
  const zoneSnapshot = options?.forceRecomputeZones
    ? recomputeSessionZoneSnapshot(getDb(), sessionId, userPref, userPref.age || 35)
    : ensureSessionZoneSnapshot(
        getDb(),
        sessionId,
        userPref,
        userPref.age || 35,
        sessionRow.start_time
      );

  // Time in zones duration mapping (Finding AI: strictly use snapshot boundaries; fail-closed if missing)
  const timeInZones = zoneSnapshot && Array.isArray(zoneSnapshot.boundaries_bpm) && zoneSnapshot.boundaries_bpm.length === 6
    ? calculateTimeInZones(hrSummary.hrs, zoneSnapshot.boundaries_bpm)
    : null;

  // Recovery HR drop
  const recovery = calculateRecoveryHr(hrSummary.hrs, hrSummary.hrTimesMs);

  // HRV Metrics Selection and Calculation
  let cleanRrs: number[] = [];
  let hrvSource: 'native' | 'ecg_derived_experimental' | 'none' = 'none';
  let validNnCount = 0;
  let rawRrCount = 0;
  let artifactPercent = 0.0;
  let coveragePercent = 0.0;
  let hrvQuality: 'excellent' | 'good' | 'usable' | 'poor' | 'quality_limited' | 'insufficient_data' = 'insufficient_data';
  let hrvQualityReason = '';

  if (hrSummary.nativeRrs.length > 0) {
    hrvSource = 'native';
    cleanRrs = cleanRrIntervals(hrSummary.nativeRrs);
    rawRrCount = hrSummary.nativeRrs.length;
    validNnCount = cleanRrs.length;
    artifactPercent = rawRrCount > 0 ? ((rawRrCount - validNnCount) / rawRrCount) * 100 : 0.0;
  } else if (config.enableExperimentalEcgSqi && qrsPeaks.length > 1) {
    hrvSource = 'ecg_derived_experimental';
    const qrsRrs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < qrsPeaks.length; i++) {
      qrsRrs.push(qrsPeaks[i] - qrsPeaks[i - 1]);
    }
    cleanRrs = cleanRrIntervals(qrsRrs);
    rawRrCount = qrsRrs.length;
    validNnCount = cleanRrs.length;
    artifactPercent = rawRrCount > 0 ? ((rawRrCount - validNnCount) / rawRrCount) * 100 : 0.0;
  }

  const sumOfNnSeconds = cleanRrs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / 1000;
  coveragePercent = sessionRow.duration_seconds > 0 ? (sumOfNnSeconds / sessionRow.duration_seconds) * 100 : 0.0;

  // Run quality gates
  if (sessionRow.duration_seconds < 120) {
    hrvQuality = 'insufficient_data';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Длительность сессии менее 2 минут';
  } else if (validNnCount < 50) {
    hrvQuality = 'insufficient_data';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Недостаточно валидных NN-интервалов (менее 50)';
  } else if (coveragePercent < 50.0) {
    hrvQuality = 'insufficient_data';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Покрытие валидными NN-интервалами менее 50%';
  } else if (artifactPercent > 15.0) {
    hrvQuality = 'quality_limited';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Высокий процент артефактов (более 15%)';
  } else if (validNnCount < 100) {
    hrvQuality = 'quality_limited';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Ограниченное количество NN-интервалов (от 50 до 100)';
  } else if (coveragePercent < 80.0) {
    hrvQuality = 'quality_limited';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Ограниченное покрытие валидными интервалами (от 50% до 80%)';
  } else if (artifactPercent > 10.0) {
    hrvQuality = 'usable';
    hrvQualityReason = 'Умеренный процент артефактов';
  } else if (artifactPercent > 3.0) {
    hrvQuality = 'good';
  } else {
    hrvQuality = 'excellent';
  }

  const rejectedRrCount = rawRrCount - validNnCount;

  let hrv: { sdnn: number | null; rmssd: number | null; pnn50: number | null } = { sdnn: null, rmssd: null, pnn50: null };

  if (hrvQuality !== 'insufficient_data' && validNnCount > 0) {
    hrv = calculateHrvMetrics(cleanRrs);
  }

  const hrvQualityJson = {
    hrv_source: hrvSource,
    valid_nn_count: validNnCount,
    raw_rr_count: rawRrCount,
    rejected_rr_count: rejectedRrCount,
    artifact_percent: Math.round(artifactPercent * 10) / 10,
    coverage_percent: Math.round(coveragePercent * 10) / 10,
    quality: hrvQuality,
    reason: hrvQualityReason || undefined
  };

  if (hrvQuality === 'insufficient_data' || hrvQuality === 'quality_limited') {
    logger.warn('qc', `HRV quality gate check failed for session ${sessionId}`, { sessionId, details: { quality: hrvQuality, reason: hrvQualityReason } });
  }

  // 10. Persist session, metrics, and flags
  const session: SessionMetadata = {
    id: sessionId,
    device_id: sessionRow.device_id,
    start_time: sessionRow.start_time,
    end_time: sessionRow.end_time,
    duration_seconds: sessionRow.duration_seconds,
    avg_hr: hrSummary.avg_hr ?? sessionRow.avg_hr,
    min_hr: hrSummary.min_hr ?? sessionRow.min_hr,
    max_hr: hrSummary.max_hr ?? sessionRow.max_hr,
    overall_quality_score: score
  };

  const sessionMetrics: SessionMetrics = {
    session_id: sessionId,
    sdnn: hrv.sdnn,
    rmssd: hrv.rmssd,
    pnn50: hrv.pnn50,
    hr_drift_ratio: null, // Normative target requires external workload power/pace and duration >= 20 min under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 15; not available in standalone H10
    recovery_1min: recovery.recovery_1min,
    recovery_2min: recovery.recovery_2min,
    time_in_zones: timeInZones ? JSON.stringify(timeInZones) : null,
    valid_nn_count: validNnCount,
    artifact_percent: Math.round(artifactPercent * 10) / 10,
    hrv_source: hrvSource,
    hrv_quality: hrvQuality,
    hrv_quality_json: JSON.stringify(hrvQualityJson),
    zones_source: zoneSnapshot ? zoneSnapshot.mode : null,
    zones_boundaries_bpm: zoneSnapshot ? JSON.stringify(zoneSnapshot.boundaries_bpm) : null,
    zones_updated_at: zoneSnapshot ? zoneSnapshot.custom_zones_updated_at : null,
    zones_snapshot_json: zoneSnapshot ? JSON.stringify(zoneSnapshot) : null
  };

  saveSession(session);
  saveSessionQcMetrics(metrics);
  saveSessionMetrics(sessionMetrics);
  saveCandidateFlags(flags);

  // 11. Run Activity Segmentation
  try {
    const hrPoints = hrSummary.hrs.map((val, idx) => ({
      timeMs: hrSummary.hrTimesMs[idx],
      hrBpm: val
    }));
    const ann = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as { activity_type: string } | undefined;
    const activityType = ann?.activity_type || 'cardio';

    const segmentation = segmentSessionActivity(
      sessionRow.duration_seconds,
      hrPoints,
      accSummary.accMags,
      accSummary.accTimesMs,
      activityType,
      userPref
    );
    updateSessionSegmentation(sessionId, segmentation);
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('qc', `Activity segmentation failed for session ${sessionId}`, { sessionId, details: { error: err.message } });
    updateSessionSegmentation(sessionId, {
      active_duration_seconds: 0,
      inactive_duration_seconds: 0,
      uncertain_duration_seconds: 0,
      activity_segmentation_json: JSON.stringify([]),
      activity_segmentation_version: '1.0.0',
      activity_segmentation_status: 'failed'
    });
  }
  logger.info('qc', `Quality Control completed for session ${sessionId} with score ${score}`, { sessionId, details: { score } });
}

export interface ECGFeatures {
  sample_count: number;
  duration_seconds: number;
  finite_sample_fraction: number;
  min_uv: number;
  max_uv: number;
  mean_uv: number;
  median_uv: number;
  standard_deviation_uv: number;
  p01_uv: number;
  p05_uv: number;
  p95_uv: number;
  p99_uv: number;
  peak_to_peak_uv: number;
  
  sample_skewness: number | null;
  sample_excess_kurtosis: number | null;
  skewness_formula: string;
  kurtosis_formula: string;

  median_delta_ms: number | null;
  MAD_delta_ms: number | null;
  p05_delta_ms: number | null;
  p95_delta_ms: number | null;
  non_monotonic_count: number;
  large_gap_count: number;
  estimated_missing_sample_fraction: number | null;
  estimation_reason: string | null;

  spectral_method: string;
  absolute_power_0_5_to_5hz: number;
  fractional_power_0_5_to_5hz: number;
  absolute_power_5_to_15hz: number;
  fractional_power_5_to_15hz: number;
  absolute_power_15_to_30hz: number;
  fractional_power_15_to_30hz: number;
  absolute_power_30_to_45hz: number;
  fractional_power_30_to_45hz: number;
  absolute_power_45hz_to_nyquist: number;
  fractional_power_45hz_to_nyquist: number;

  first_difference_variance: number;
  first_difference_MAD: number;
  first_difference_p95_absolute: number;

  repeated_max_run: number;
  repeated_min_run: number;
  fraction_at_extreme: number | null;
  extreme_reason: string | null;

  qrs_agreement: number | null;
  qrs_agreement_reason: string | null;

  rr_agreement: number | null;
  rr_agreement_reason: string | null;
  acc_context: number | null;
  acc_context_reason: string | null;

  unavailable_feature_count: number;
  unavailable_features: string[];
  availability_fraction: number;
}

function getMedian(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

function getMAD(arr: number[], median: number): number {
  const diffs = arr.map(v => Math.abs(v - median));
  return getMedian(diffs);
}

function getPercentile(arr: number[], p: number): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(p * (sorted.length - 1))));
  return sorted[idx];
}

export function extractECGFeatures(
  samples: number[],
  timestampsMs: number[] = [],
  accMags: number[] = [],
  nativeRRs: number[] = []
): ECGFeatures {
  const N = samples.length;
  if (N === 0) {
    throw new Error("Cannot extract features from empty samples window");
  }

  // 1. Basic Stats
  let finiteCount = 0;
  let sum = 0;
  let min = samples[0];
  let max = samples[0];
  const finiteSamples: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const val = samples[i];
    const isFinite = Number.isFinite(val);
    if (isFinite) {
      finiteCount++;
      sum += val;
      if (val < min) min = val;
      if (val > max) max = val;
      finiteSamples.push(val);
    }
  }

  const finite_sample_fraction = finiteCount / N;
  const mean_uv = finiteCount > 0 ? sum / finiteCount : 0;
  const median_uv = getMedian(finiteSamples);
  const peak_to_peak_uv = max - min;

  // Standard deviation
  let sqSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < finiteSamples.length; i++) {
    sqSum += Math.pow(finiteSamples[i] - mean_uv, 2);
  }
  const variance = finiteSamples.length > 1 ? sqSum / (finiteSamples.length - 1) : 0;
  const standard_deviation_uv = Math.sqrt(variance);

  // Percentiles
  const p01_uv = getPercentile(finiteSamples, 0.01);
  const p05_uv = getPercentile(finiteSamples, 0.05);
  const p95_uv = getPercentile(finiteSamples, 0.95);
  const p99_uv = getPercentile(finiteSamples, 0.99);

  // 2. Skewness and Excess Kurtosis (standard G1 and G2 bias corrections)
  let sample_skewness: number | null = null;
  let sample_excess_kurtosis: number | null = null;
  const nFin = finiteSamples.length;

  if (nFin >= 3 && standard_deviation_uv > 0) {
    let t3 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nFin; i++) {
      t3 += Math.pow((finiteSamples[i] - mean_uv) / standard_deviation_uv, 3);
    }
    sample_skewness = (nFin / ((nFin - 1) * (nFin - 2))) * t3;
  }

  if (nFin >= 4 && variance > 0) {
    let t4 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nFin; i++) {
      t4 += Math.pow((finiteSamples[i] - mean_uv) / standard_deviation_uv, 4);
    }
    const factor1 = (nFin * (nFin + 1)) / ((nFin - 1) * (nFin - 2) * (nFin - 3));
    const factor2 = (3 * Math.pow(nFin - 1, 2)) / ((nFin - 2) * (nFin - 3));
    sample_excess_kurtosis = factor1 * t4 - factor2;
  }

  // 3. Timestamp continuity
  let median_delta_ms: number | null = null;
  let MAD_delta_ms: number | null = null;
  let p05_delta_ms: number | null = null;
  let p95_delta_ms: number | null = null;
  let non_monotonic_count = 0;
  let large_gap_count = 0;
  let estimated_missing_sample_fraction: number | null = null;
  let estimation_reason: string | null = null;

  const deltas: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < timestampsMs.length; i++) {
    const d = timestampsMs[i] - timestampsMs[i - 1];
    deltas.push(d);
    if (d <= 0) {
      non_monotonic_count++;
    }
  }

  if (deltas.length > 0) {
    median_delta_ms = getMedian(deltas);
    MAD_delta_ms = getMAD(deltas, median_delta_ms);
    p05_delta_ms = getPercentile(deltas, 0.05);
    p95_delta_ms = getPercentile(deltas, 0.95);

    for (let i = 0; i < deltas.length; i++) {
      if (deltas[i] > 2 * median_delta_ms) {
        large_gap_count++;
      }
    }

    const durationMs = timestampsMs[timestampsMs.length - 1] - timestampsMs[0];
    if (median_delta_ms > 0) {
      const expected = Math.round(durationMs / median_delta_ms) + 1;
      estimated_missing_sample_fraction = Math.max(0, (expected - N) / expected);
    } else {
      estimation_reason = "median_delta_ms is zero";
    }
  } else {
    estimation_reason = "timestamp stream unavailable";
  }

  const duration_seconds = deltas.length > 0 
    ? (timestampsMs[timestampsMs.length - 1] - timestampsMs[0]) / 1000 
    : N / 130.0; // Assume nominal 130Hz if timestamps missing

  // 4. Spectral Features (Hann Window + Direct Periodogram DFT)
  const fs = deltas.length > 0 && median_delta_ms && median_delta_ms > 0 ? 1000 / median_delta_ms : 130.0;
  const deMeaned = finiteSamples.map(v => v - mean_uv);
  
  // Apply Hann Window
  const windowed: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nFin; i++) {
    const w = 0.5 * (1 - Math.cos((2 * Math.PI * i) / (nFin - 1 || 1)));
    windowed.push(deMeaned[i] * w);
  }

  // Calculate DFT over a grid of discrete frequencies from 0.5 Hz up to fs/2 (Nyquist)
  const fftSize = 256;
  const freqPower: { freq: number; power: number }[] = [];
  const nyquist = fs / 2;
  const step = (nyquist - 0.5) / fftSize;

  for (let i = 0; i <= fftSize; i++) {
    const f = 0.5 + i * step;
    // Compute DFT sum at frequency f
    let real = 0;
    let imag = 0;
    for (let n = 0; n < nFin; n++) {
      const angle = (2 * Math.PI * f * n) / fs;
      real += windowed[n] * Math.cos(angle);
      imag -= windowed[n] * Math.sin(angle);
    }
    const power = (Math.pow(real, 2) + Math.pow(imag, 2)) / nFin;
    freqPower.push({ freq: f, power });
  }

  // Helper to sum power in bands
  const getBandPower = (fMin: number, fMax: number) => {
    let sumP = 0;
    for (const fp of freqPower) {
      if (fp.freq >= fMin && fp.freq < fMax) {
        sumP += fp.power;
      }
    }
    return sumP;
  };

  const absolute_power_0_5_to_5hz = getBandPower(0.5, 5);
  const absolute_power_5_to_15hz = getBandPower(5, 15);
  const absolute_power_15_to_30hz = getBandPower(15, 30);
  const absolute_power_30_to_45hz = getBandPower(30, 45);
  const absolute_power_45hz_to_nyquist = getBandPower(45, nyquist + 0.1);

  const totalBandPower = 
    absolute_power_0_5_to_5hz + 
    absolute_power_5_to_15hz + 
    absolute_power_15_to_30hz + 
    absolute_power_30_to_45hz + 
    absolute_power_45hz_to_nyquist;

  const fractional_power_0_5_to_5hz = totalBandPower > 0 ? absolute_power_0_5_to_5hz / totalBandPower : 0;
  const fractional_power_5_to_15hz = totalBandPower > 0 ? absolute_power_5_to_15hz / totalBandPower : 0;
  const fractional_power_15_to_30hz = totalBandPower > 0 ? absolute_power_15_to_30hz / totalBandPower : 0;
  const fractional_power_30_to_45hz = totalBandPower > 0 ? absolute_power_30_to_45hz / totalBandPower : 0;
  const fractional_power_45hz_to_nyquist = totalBandPower > 0 ? absolute_power_45hz_to_nyquist / totalBandPower : 0;

  // 5. Difference-domain
  const diffs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < nFin; i++) {
    diffs.push(finiteSamples[i] - finiteSamples[i - 1]);
  }
  const diffMean = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / (diffs.length || 1);
  const diffSqSum = diffs.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.pow(val - diffMean, 2), 0);
  const first_difference_variance = diffs.length > 1 ? diffSqSum / (diffs.length - 1) : 0;
  const first_difference_MAD = getMAD(diffs, getMedian(diffs));
  const first_difference_p95_absolute = getPercentile(diffs.map(Math.abs), 0.95);

  // 6. Plateau/clipping candidates
  let maxRun = 0, minRun = 0;
  let currentMaxRun = 0, currentMinRun = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const val = samples[i];
    if (val === max) {
      currentMaxRun++;
      if (currentMaxRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentMaxRun;
    } else {
      currentMaxRun = 0;
    }
    
    if (val === min) {
      currentMinRun++;
      if (currentMinRun > minRun) minRun = currentMinRun;
    } else {
      currentMinRun = 0;
    }
  }

  const repeated_max_run = maxRun;
  const repeated_min_run = minRun;
  const fraction_at_extreme = null; // No validated device extreme is known in this phase
  const extreme_reason = "Device clipping threshold unknown; raw extremes are local sample bounds.";

  // 7. QRS agreement
  const qrs_agreement = null;
  const qrs_agreement_reason = "qrs_agreement_not_implemented";

  // 8. Cross-signal context
  const rr_agreement = null;
  const rr_agreement_reason = "alignment_not_available";
  const acc_context = null;
  const acc_context_reason = "alignment_not_available";

  // 9. Feature Availability & Missingness
  const unavailable: string[] = [
    "fraction_at_extreme",
    "qrs_agreement",
    "rr_agreement",
    "acc_context"
  ];
  if (sample_skewness === null) unavailable.push("sample_skewness");
  if (sample_excess_kurtosis === null) unavailable.push("sample_excess_kurtosis");
  if (median_delta_ms === null) {
    unavailable.push("median_delta_ms", "MAD_delta_ms", "p05_delta_ms", "p95_delta_ms", "estimated_missing_sample_fraction");
  }

  const unavailable_feature_count = unavailable.length;
  const totalFeatureDefinitions = 36;
  const availability_fraction = (totalFeatureDefinitions - unavailable_feature_count) / totalFeatureDefinitions;

  return {
    sample_count: N,
    duration_seconds,
    finite_sample_fraction,
    min_uv: min,
    max_uv: max,
    mean_uv,
    median_uv,
    standard_deviation_uv,
    p01_uv,
    p05_uv,
    p95_uv,
    p99_uv,
    peak_to_peak_uv,
    sample_skewness,
    sample_excess_kurtosis,
    skewness_formula: "G1 = [N / ((N - 1)(N - 2))] * sum( ((x_i - mean)/std)^3 )",
    kurtosis_formula: "G2 = [N(N+1)/((N-1)(N-2)(N-3))] * sum( ((x_i - mean)/std)^4 ) - 3(N-1)^2/((N-2)(N-3))",
    median_delta_ms,
    MAD_delta_ms,
    p05_delta_ms,
    p95_delta_ms,
    non_monotonic_count,
    large_gap_count,
    estimated_missing_sample_fraction,
    estimation_reason,
    spectral_method: "Hann Window + Periodogram Direct DFT at 256 frequency bins",
    absolute_power_0_5_to_5hz,
    fractional_power_0_5_to_5hz,
    absolute_power_5_to_15hz,
    fractional_power_5_to_15hz,
    absolute_power_15_to_30hz,
    fractional_power_15_to_30hz,
    absolute_power_30_to_45hz,
    fractional_power_30_to_45hz,
    absolute_power_45hz_to_nyquist,
    fractional_power_45hz_to_nyquist,
    first_difference_variance,
    first_difference_MAD,
    first_difference_p95_absolute,
    repeated_max_run,
    repeated_min_run,
    fraction_at_extreme,
    extreme_reason,
    qrs_agreement,
    qrs_agreement_reason,
    rr_agreement,
    rr_agreement_reason,
    acc_context,
    acc_context_reason,
    unavailable_feature_count,
    unavailable_features: unavailable,
    availability_fraction
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/qc/ecg_qc.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { SessionQcMetrics, CandidateFlag } from '../db/db';
import { qcThresholds } from '../../shared/qcThresholds';

import { parseRawLine } from '../signals/rawParsers';

export function calculateVariance(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const mean = arr.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / arr.length;
  const squareDiffs = arr.map(val => (val - mean) ** 2);
  return squareDiffs.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0) / arr.length;
}

/**
 * Parses and runs Quality Control analysis on an ECG file stream.
 * Processes data in non-overlapping 1-second chunks to remain memory-safe.
 */
export async function analyzeEcgQc(
  archivePath: string,
  metrics: SessionQcMetrics,
  flags: CandidateFlag[],
  sessionId: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (!fs.existsSync(archivePath)) {
    return;
  }

  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(archivePath);
  const gunzip = zlib.createGunzip();
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream.pipe(gunzip),
    crlfDelay: Infinity
  });

  let isHeader = true;
  let lastSensorTime = 0n;
  let lastRelativeTimeMs = 0;
  
  // 1-second chunk variables (130 Hz expected)
  const chunkSize = 130;
  let chunkEcg: number[] = [];
  let chunkDiffs: number[] = [];
  let chunkRelativeTimeStart = 0;
  let lastEcgVal = 0;

  // Window statistics for aggregate report
  let totalChunks = 0;
  let noisyChunks = 0;
  let driftChunks = 0;
  let totalClippingSamples = 0;
  
  // To track baseline drift across multiple seconds
  const recentMeans: number[] = [];
  const maxRecentMeansCount = 10; // 10 seconds history

  let monotonicityViolations = 0;

  for await (const line of rl) {
    if (isHeader) {
      isHeader = false;
      continue;
    }

    const parts = parseRawLine(line);
    if (parts.length < 4) continue;

    // Schema: Phone timestamp;sensor timestamp [ns];timestamp [ms];ecg [uV]
    const sensorTimeNs = BigInt(parts[1]);
    const relativeTimeMs = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
    const ecgUv = parseFloat(parts[3]);

    if (isNaN(relativeTimeMs) || isNaN(ecgUv)) continue;

    // 1. Monotonicity checks
    if (lastSensorTime > 0n) {
      if (sensorTimeNs < lastSensorTime) {
        monotonicityViolations++;
      } else if (sensorTimeNs === lastSensorTime) {
        metrics.duplicate_timestamps_count++;
      }

      // 2. Gap checks (expected step ~7.69 ms, if > 1.2x expected -> > 9.2 ms)
      const stepNs = Number(sensorTimeNs - lastSensorTime);
      if (stepNs > 9230745) {
        const missing = Math.round(stepNs / 7692288) - 1;
        if (missing > 0) {
          metrics.missing_samples_count += missing;
          
          // Log gap candidate flag if it represents > 1s data loss
          if (stepNs > 1e9) {
            flags.push({
              id: randomUUID(),
              session_id: sessionId,
              timestamp_offset_ms: relativeTimeMs,
              flag_type: 'data_gap',
              description_ru: `Пропуск данных ЭКГ: ${Math.round(stepNs / 1e6)} мс`,
              severity: 'medium'
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Clipping checks
    if (Math.abs(ecgUv) >= qcThresholds.ecg_clipping_uv.value) {
      totalClippingSamples++;
    }

    // Chunk buffering
    if (chunkEcg.length === 0) {
      chunkRelativeTimeStart = relativeTimeMs;
    }
    chunkEcg.push(ecgUv);

    if (lastSensorTime > 0n) {
      chunkDiffs.push(ecgUv - lastEcgVal);
    }
    lastEcgVal = ecgUv;

    // Check if chunk is complete (1 second of samples)
    if (chunkEcg.length >= chunkSize) {
      totalChunks++;

      // Compute statistics for this 1 second segment
      const ecgMean = chunkEcg.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / chunkEcg.length;
      const ecgDiffVar = calculateVariance(chunkDiffs);

      // Saturated check (clipping)
      const clipCount = chunkEcg.filter(v => Math.abs(v) >= qcThresholds.ecg_clipping_uv.value).length;
      if (clipCount >= 13) { // >10% of the second was clipped
        flags.push({
          id: randomUUID(),
          session_id: sessionId,
          timestamp_offset_ms: chunkRelativeTimeStart,
          flag_type: 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise',
          description_ru: `Амплитудный клиппинг сигнала ЭКГ (${clipCount} отсчетов/сек)`,
          severity: 'high'
        });
      }

      // High frequency noise check
      if (ecgDiffVar > qcThresholds.ecg_noise_var.value) { // arbitrary threshold for muscle noise / lead-off
        noisyChunks++;
        flags.push({
          id: randomUUID(),
          session_id: sessionId,
          timestamp_offset_ms: chunkRelativeTimeStart,
          flag_type: 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise',
          description_ru: `Высокочастотный шум в сигнале ЭКГ`,
          severity: 'low'
        });
      }

      // Baseline drift check (low frequency wander)
      recentMeans.push(ecgMean);
      if (recentMeans.length > maxRecentMeansCount) {
        recentMeans.shift();
      }

      if (recentMeans.length >= 3) {
        const maxMean = Math.max(...recentMeans);
        const minMean = Math.min(...recentMeans);
        const range = maxMean - minMean;

        if (range > qcThresholds.ecg_drift_range_uv.value) { // drift of >3000 uV within recent seconds
          driftChunks++;
          flags.push({
            id: randomUUID(),
            session_id: sessionId,
            timestamp_offset_ms: chunkRelativeTimeStart,
            flag_type: 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift',
            description_ru: `Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ (размах ${Math.round(range)} мкВ)`,
            severity: 'low'
          });
        }
      }

      // Reset chunk buffers
      chunkEcg = [];
      chunkDiffs = [];
    }

    lastSensorTime = sensorTimeNs;
    lastRelativeTimeMs = relativeTimeMs;
  }

  // Handle final incomplete chunk if any
  if (chunkEcg.length > 0) {
    totalChunks++;
    const clipCount = chunkEcg.filter(v => Math.abs(v) >= qcThresholds.ecg_clipping_uv.value).length;
    if (clipCount >= (chunkEcg.length * 0.1)) {
      flags.push({
        id: randomUUID(),
        session_id: sessionId,
        timestamp_offset_ms: chunkRelativeTimeStart,
        flag_type: 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise',
        description_ru: `Амплитудный клиппинг сигнала ЭКГ`,
        severity: 'high'
      });
    }
  }

  // Populate metrics
  metrics.monotonicity_status = monotonicityViolations > 0 ? 'invalid' : 'valid';
  metrics.ecg_clipping_seconds = totalChunks > 0 ? totalClippingSamples / 130 : null;
  metrics.ecg_noise_ratio = totalChunks > 0 ? noisyChunks / totalChunks : null;
  metrics.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio = totalChunks > 0 ? driftChunks / totalChunks : null;
}

export function calculateClippingDurationSec(ecgSamples: number[], samplingRate: number = 130, thresholdMv: number = 1.5): number {
  if (!ecgSamples || ecgSamples.length === 0) return 0;
  const threshold = thresholdMv >= 10 ? thresholdMv : thresholdMv;
  const clipped = ecgSamples.filter(v => Math.abs(v) >= threshold).length;
  return clipped / samplingRate;
}

export function checkTimestampMonotonicityStatus(timestamps: number[]): 'valid' | 'invalid' {
  if (!timestamps || timestamps.length < 2) return 'invalid';
  for (let i = 0; i < timestamps.length - 1; i++) {
    if (timestamps[i + 1] <= timestamps[i]) return 'invalid';
  }
  return 'valid';
}

/**
 * Continuous ECG segment descriptor for gap-free analytical window selection.
 */
export interface ContinuousEcgSegment {
  startIndex: number;
  endIndex: number;
  sampleCount: number;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
  durationSec: number;
  samples: number[];
}

/**
 * Extracts continuous uninterrupted ECG segments from canonical sample series based on timestamps.
 * Discontinuities are detected when the gap between successive timestamps exceeds 2.0x the expected interval.
 */
export function extractContinuousEcgSegments(
  samples: number[],
  timestampsMs: number[],
  fs: number = 130
): ContinuousEcgSegment[] {
  const expectedIntervalMs = 1000 / fs;
  // Quantization-aware cadence consistency: allow +/- 50% cadence jitter for integer millisecond rounding (e.g. 7-8 ms at 130 Hz).
  // At 130 Hz, expected interval is ~7.69 ms, max allowed is ~11.54 ms. A single missing sample (~15.38 ms) strictly breaks continuity.
  const maxAllowedIntervalMs = expectedIntervalMs * 1.5;
  const minAllowedIntervalMs = Math.max(0.1, expectedIntervalMs * 0.2);

  const segments: ContinuousEcgSegment[] = [];
  let segStartIdx = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < timestampsMs.length; i++) {
    const dt = timestampsMs[i] - timestampsMs[i - 1];
    // Gap, non-monotonic reset, or missing sample jump detected
    if (dt < minAllowedIntervalMs || dt > maxAllowedIntervalMs) {
      const segSamples = samples.slice(segStartIdx, i);
      const startMs = timestampsMs[segStartIdx];
      const endMs = timestampsMs[i - 1];
      const durSec = segSamples.length / fs;
      segments.push({
        startIndex: segStartIdx,
        endIndex: i - 1,
        sampleCount: segSamples.length,
        startSec: startMs / 1000,
        endSec: endMs / 1000,
        durationSec: durSec,
        samples: segSamples
      });
      segStartIdx = i;
    }
  }

  // Trailing segment
  if (segStartIdx < timestampsMs.length) {
    const segSamples = samples.slice(segStartIdx);
    const startMs = timestampsMs[segStartIdx];
    const endMs = timestampsMs[timestampsMs.length - 1];
    const durSec = segSamples.length / fs;
    segments.push({
      startIndex: segStartIdx,
      endIndex: timestampsMs.length - 1,
      sampleCount: segSamples.length,
      startSec: startMs / 1000,
      endSec: endMs / 1000,
      durationSec: durSec,
      samples: segSamples
    });
  }

  return segments;
}

/**
 * Calculates ECG Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) in dB using protocol-conforming spectral band power ratio.
 * QRS Signal Band: 5–15 Hz.
 * High-Frequency Noise Band: 40–65 Hz.
 * Sampling rate fs >= 130 Hz (integer), minimum continuous duration 10 seconds.
 */
export function calculateSignalNoiseRatio(ecgSamples: number[], fs: number = 130): number | null {
  if (typeof fs !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(fs) || !Number.isInteger(fs) || fs < 130) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!ecgSamples || ecgSamples.length < 10 * fs || ecgSamples.some(v => typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(v))) {
    return null;
  }

  const nyquist = fs / 2;
  if (nyquist < 65) {
    return null; // Insufficient Nyquist range for 65 Hz noise band
  }

  const windowSize = Math.floor(fs);
  const numWindows = Math.floor(ecgSamples.length / windowSize);
  if (numWindows < 10) {
    return null; // Minimum 10 seconds required
  }

  let totalSignalPower = 0;
  let totalNoisePower = 0;

  for (let w = 0; w < numWindows; w++) {
    const segment = ecgSamples.slice(w * windowSize, (w + 1) * windowSize);
    const mean = segment.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / windowSize;
    const detrended = segment.map(v => v - mean);

    const N = windowSize;
    const df = fs / N;

    let segSignalPwr = 0;
    let segNoisePwr = 0;

    for (let k = 1; k <= Math.floor(N / 2); k++) {
      const freq = k * df;
      let re = 0;
      let im = 0;
      for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * k * n) / N;
        re += detrended[n] * Math.cos(angle);
        im -= detrended[n] * Math.sin(angle);
      }
      const power = (re * re + im * im) / (N * fs);
      const factor = (k === 0 || k === N / 2) ? 1 : 2;
      const psd = power * factor;

      if (freq >= 5 && freq <= 15) {
        segSignalPwr += psd * df;
      } else if (freq >= 40 && freq <= 65) {
        segNoisePwr += psd * df;
      }
    }

    totalSignalPower += segSignalPwr;
    totalNoisePower += segNoisePwr;
  }

  const avgSignalPwr = totalSignalPower / numWindows;
  const avgNoisePwr = totalNoisePower / numWindows;

  if (avgSignalPwr <= 1e-12 || avgNoisePwr <= 1e-12) return null;

  const snrDb = 10 * Math.log10(avgSignalPwr / avgNoisePwr);
  return Math.round(snrDb * 10) / 10;
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { SessionQcMetrics, CandidateFlag } from '../db/db';
import { parseRawLine } from '../signals/rawParsers';
import { parseRawTimestamp } from '../../shared/canonical/TemporalContract';

export interface HrSummary {
  avg_hr: number | null;
  min_hr: number | null;
  max_hr: number | null;
  hrs: number[];
  hrTimesMs: number[];
  nativeRrs: number[];
  nativeTimesMs: number[];
}

/**
 * Computes median of a number array.
 */
function median(values: number[]): number {
  if (values.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const half = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  if (sorted.length % 2 !== 0) {
    return sorted[half];
  }
  return (sorted[half - 1] + sorted[half]) / 2;
}

/**
 * Analyzes HR file and RR file for session stats and outliers.
 */
export async function analyzeHrRrQc(
  hrPath: string | null,
  rrPath: string | null,
  metrics: SessionQcMetrics,
  flags: CandidateFlag[],
  sessionId: string,
  sessionStartTimeMs: number
): Promise<HrSummary> {
  const summary: HrSummary = {
    avg_hr: null,
    min_hr: null,
    max_hr: null,
    hrs: [],
    hrTimesMs: [],
    nativeRrs: [],
    nativeTimesMs: []
  };

  // 1. Process HR file
  if (hrPath && fs.existsSync(hrPath)) {
    const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(hrPath);
    const gunzip = zlib.createGunzip();
    const rl = readline.createInterface({
      input: fileStream.pipe(gunzip),
      crlfDelay: Infinity
    });

    let isHeader = true;

    for await (const line of rl) {
      if (isHeader) {
        isHeader = false;
        continue;
      }

      const parts = parseRawLine(line);
      if (parts.length < 2) continue;

      const phoneTimeStr = parts[0];
      const hrVal = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
      if (!isNaN(hrVal) && hrVal > 0) {
        const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneTimeStr);
        const timeMs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
        if (!isNaN(timeMs)) {
          summary.hrs.push(hrVal);
          summary.hrTimesMs.push(timeMs - sessionStartTimeMs);
        }
      }
    }

    if (summary.hrs.length > 0) {
      const sum = summary.hrs.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
      summary.avg_hr = Math.round(sum / summary.hrs.length);
      summary.min_hr = Math.min(...summary.hrs);
      summary.max_hr = Math.max(...summary.hrs);
    }
  }

  // 2. Process RR file and detect outliers
  if (rrPath && fs.existsSync(rrPath)) {
    const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(rrPath);
    const gunzip = zlib.createGunzip();
    const rl = readline.createInterface({
      input: fileStream.pipe(gunzip),
      crlfDelay: Infinity
    });

    let isHeader = true;
    const recentRrs: number[] = [];
    const maxRecentCount = 10;
    let outlierCount = 0;

    for await (const line of rl) {
      if (isHeader) {
        isHeader = false;
        continue;
      }

      const parts = parseRawLine(line);
      if (parts.length < 2) continue;

      const phoneTimeStr = parts[0];
      const rrVal = parseFloat(parts[1]);
      if (isNaN(rrVal) || rrVal <= 0) continue;

      const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneTimeStr);
      const timeMs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
      if (isNaN(timeMs)) continue;
      const offsetMs = timeMs - sessionStartTimeMs;

      summary.nativeRrs.push(rrVal);
      summary.nativeTimesMs.push(offsetMs);

      if (recentRrs.length >= 3) {
        const currentMedian = median(recentRrs);
        const diffPercent = Math.abs(rrVal - currentMedian) / currentMedian;

        // If difference is greater than 20% -> outlier (ectopic candidate / artifact)
        if (diffPercent > 0.20) {
          outlierCount++;
          flags.push({
            id: randomUUID(),
            session_id: sessionId,
            timestamp_offset_ms: offsetMs,
            flag_type: 'candidate_rr_outlier',
            description_ru: `Нетипичный RR-интервал: ${Math.round(rrVal)} мс (отклонение > 20%)`,
            severity: 'low'
          });
        }
      }

      recentRrs.push(rrVal);
      if (recentRrs.length > maxRecentCount) {
        recentRrs.shift();
      }
    }
  }

  return summary;
}
