/**
 * src/backend/recovery/RecoveryCenterService.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G25 — Recovery and Data-Integrity Center Service.
 *
 * Distinguishes the 12 core failure / recovery states with strict data preservation
 * guarantees (data_preserved: true), non-destructive actions, single primary action
 * routing, and privacy-safe diagnostic support bundle integration.
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import {
  RecoveryDescriptor,
  RecoveryClass
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';
import { selfServiceRecoveryService } from '../selfservice/selfServiceRecoveryService';
import { compileSupportBundle } from '../support/supportBundle';
import { entitlementService } from '../entitlements/entitlementService';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';
import {
  RecoveryCommand,
  RelinkMovedSourceRequest,
  RelinkMovedSourceResult,
  RecoveryCenterStateProjection,
  RecoveryCenterPrimaryAction
} from '../../shared/canonical/WholeProductWorkspaceContract';

export class RecoveryCenterService {
  /**
   * Checks database integrity using PRAGMA integrity_check
   */
  public checkDatabaseIntegrity(): { status: 'ok' | 'warning' | 'corrupt'; details: string } {
    try {
      const db = getDb();
      const row = db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get() as any;
      const result = String(row?.integrity_check || '');
      if (result === 'ok') {
        return { status: 'ok', details: 'Database integrity verified ok' };
      }
      return { status: 'warning', details: result };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { status: 'corrupt', details: err?.message || 'Database access failed' };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Compiles the authoritative Recovery Center Projection for the active workspace
   */
  public getProjection(profileId?: string): RecoveryCenterStateProjection {
    const dbIntegrity = this.checkDatabaseIntegrity();
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    const rawLogsExists = fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir);

    const descriptors: RecoveryDescriptor[] = [];

    // 1. Check for DB integrity warning
    if (dbIntegrity.status !== 'ok') {
      descriptors.push(
        selfServiceRecoveryService.buildDescriptor({
          recovery_class: 'db_integrity_warning',
          affected_identity: { type: 'database', id: 'cardio_lab.db' },
          customMessageRu: `Целостность базы данных: ${dbIntegrity.details}. Данные сохранены.`,
          customMessageEn: `Database integrity status: ${dbIntegrity.details}. Data preserved.`
        })
      );
    }

    // 2. Query sessions for source availability / moved status
    try {
      const db = getDb();
      let query = 'SELECT id, user_id, relinked_source_path FROM sessions WHERE assignment_status != ?';
      const params: any[] = ['archived'];
      if (profileId && profileId !== 'all' && profileId !== 'unresolved') {
        query += ' AND user_id = ?';
        params.push(profileId);
      }
      query += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';
      const sessions = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];

      for (const sess of sessions) {
        let exists = false;
        if (sess.relinked_source_path && fs.existsSync(sess.relinked_source_path)) {
          exists = true;
        } else if (rawLogsExists) {
          const rawLogCandidates = [
            path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sess.id}_ecg.txt.gz`),
            path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sess.id}_ecg.txt`),
            path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sess.id}_rr.txt.gz`),
            path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sess.id}_rr.txt`),
            path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sess.id}_raw.txt`)
          ];
          exists = rawLogCandidates.some(p => fs.existsSync(p));
        }

        if (!exists) {
          if (!descriptors.some(d => d.recovery_class === 'source_unavailable')) {
            descriptors.push(
              selfServiceRecoveryService.buildDescriptor({
                recovery_class: 'source_unavailable',
                affected_identity: { type: 'session', id: sess.id }
              })
            );
          }
        }
      }

      // Check unlinked diary entries
      const diaryQuery = profileId && profileId !== 'all' && profileId !== 'unresolved'
        ? "SELECT id, session_id FROM llm_diary WHERE user_id = ? AND (session_id IS NULL OR session_id = '') LIMIT 5"
        : "SELECT id, session_id FROM llm_diary WHERE session_id IS NULL OR session_id = '' LIMIT 5";
      const unlinkedDiaries = profileId && profileId !== 'all' && profileId !== 'unresolved'
        ? (db.prepare(diaryQuery).all(profileId) as any[])
        : (db.prepare(diaryQuery).all() as any[]);

      if (unlinkedDiaries.length > 0 && !descriptors.some(d => d.recovery_class === 'diary_unlinked')) {
        descriptors.push(
          selfServiceRecoveryService.buildDescriptor({
            recovery_class: 'diary_unlinked',
            affected_identity: { type: 'diary', id: unlinkedDiaries[0].id }
          })
        );
      }

      // Check missing exported AI packs
      try {
        const manifests = db.prepare('SELECT manifest_id, session_id, staging_path, published_path FROM export_artifact_manifests ORDER BY generated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 10').all() as any[];
        for (const m of manifests) {
          const candidatePath = m.published_path || m.staging_path;
          if (candidatePath && !fs.existsSync(candidatePath)) {
            if (!descriptors.some(d => d.recovery_class === 'pack_missing')) {
              descriptors.push(
                selfServiceRecoveryService.buildDescriptor({
                  recovery_class: 'pack_missing',
                  affected_identity: { type: 'pack', id: m.manifest_id }
                })
              );
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.warn('diagnostics', `Export artifact inspection warning: ${err.message}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.warn('diagnostics', `Session source scan error: ${err.message}`);
    }

    // 3. Check Entitlement boundary
    try {
      const ent = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
      if (ent.status === 'expired' || ent.in_grace_period || ent.status === 'revoked') {
        if (!descriptors.some(d => d.recovery_class === 'entitlement_boundary')) {
          descriptors.push(
            selfServiceRecoveryService.buildDescriptor({
              recovery_class: 'entitlement_boundary',
              affected_identity: { type: 'entitlement', id: ent.tier },
              customMessageRu: `Срок действия подписки/триала: ${ent.status}. Доступ к существующим данным и экспорту полностью сохранен.`,
              customMessageEn: `Entitlement state: ${ent.status}. Access to existing data and export remains fully preserved.`
            })
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.warn('diagnostics', `Entitlement check warning: ${err.message}`);
    }

    // Evaluate support burden
    const supportBurden = selfServiceRecoveryService.evaluateSupportBurden();

    // Determine active state and single bounded primary action
    const activeState = descriptors.length > 0 ? (descriptors[0].recovery_class as any) : null;

    let primaryAction: RecoveryCenterPrimaryAction = {
      route: '#/sessions',
      action_type: 'navigate',
      label_ru: 'Открыть журнал тренировок',
      label_en: 'Open Session Library',
      description_ru: 'Все системы работают штатно. Данные сохранены и проверены.',
      description_en: 'All systems operational. Data preserved and verified.',
      executable_command: {
        command_type: 'navigate',
        route: '#/sessions'
      }
    };

    if (activeState === 'db_integrity_warning') {
      primaryAction = {
        route: '#/settings?tab=backup',
        action_type: 'create_safety_snapshot',
        label_ru: 'Создать снимок безопасности',
        label_en: 'Create Safety Snapshot',
        description_ru: 'Создайте снимок безопасности и резервную копию перед продолжением.',
        description_en: 'Create safety snapshot and backup before proceeding.',
        executable_command: {
          command_type: 'create_safety_snapshot',
          target_id: 'cardio_lab.db'
        }
      };
    } else if (activeState === 'source_unavailable') {
      const affectedId = descriptors.find(d => d.recovery_class === 'source_unavailable')?.affected_identity.id;
      primaryAction = {
        route: '#/import',
        action_type: 'relink_or_reimport',
        label_ru: 'Проверить источник данных',
        label_en: 'Check Data Source',
        description_ru: 'Исходный файл сессии временно недоступен. Анализ и отчеты сохранены.',
        description_en: 'Session source file temporarily unavailable. Existing analysis preserved.',
        executable_command: {
          command_type: 'navigate',
          target_id: affectedId,
          route: '#/import'
        }
      };
    } else if (activeState === 'source_moved') {
      const affectedId = descriptors.find(d => d.recovery_class === 'source_moved')?.affected_identity.id;
      primaryAction = {
        route: '#/sessions',
        action_type: 'relink_path',
        label_ru: 'Обновить путь к файлу',
        label_en: 'Update File Path',
        description_ru: 'Файл перемещен с сохранением идентичности. Обновите путь без потери разметки.',
        description_en: 'File moved with identical content. Update path without losing annotations.',
        executable_command: {
          command_type: 'relink_source',
          target_id: affectedId
        }
      };
    } else if (activeState === 'result_stale') {
      const affectedId = descriptors.find(d => d.recovery_class === 'result_stale')?.affected_identity.id;
      primaryAction = {
        route: '#/session',
        action_type: 'recompute',
        label_ru: 'Пересчитать сессию',
        label_en: 'Recompute Session',
        description_ru: 'Правила расчета обновлены. Выполните пересчет с сохранением исходных данных.',
        description_en: 'Calculation rules updated. Run recomputation with preserved raw data.',
        executable_command: {
          command_type: 'recompute_session',
          target_id: affectedId
        }
      };
    } else if (activeState === 'pack_corrupt' || activeState === 'pack_missing') {
      const affectedId = descriptors.find(d => d.recovery_class === 'pack_missing' || d.recovery_class === 'pack_corrupt')?.affected_identity.id;
      primaryAction = {
        route: '#/export',
        action_type: 'recompile_pack',
        label_ru: 'Сформировать AI-пакет заново',

        }
      };
    } else if (activeState === 'diary_unlinked') {

    };

  /**
   * Creates an HMAC-signed capability token for binding a relink operation
   * to a specific session ID, target file path, expected SHA-256 and revision.
   */
  public createRelinkCapabilityToken(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    targetFilePath: string;
    expectedSourceSha256?: string;
    sessionRevision?: number;
  }): string {
    const payload = {
      session_id: params.sessionId,
      target_file_path: path.resolve(params.targetFilePath),
      expected_source_sha256: params.expectedSourceSha256 ? params.expectedSourceSha256.toLowerCase() : null,
      session_revision: params.sessionRevision ?? 1,
      issued_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
    const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', 'cardiolab_relink_capability_secret').update(jsonStr).digest('hex');
    return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ payload, sig })).toString('base64url');
  }

  /**
   * Verifies an HMAC-signed capability token against requested relink parameters.
   */
  public verifyRelinkCapabilityToken(
    token: string,
    params: {
      sessionId: string;
      targetFilePath: string;
      expectedSourceSha256?: string;
      sessionRevision?: number;
    }
  ): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64url').toString('utf8'));
      if (!decoded?.payload || !decoded?.sig) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Malformed capability token structure' };
      }
      const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(decoded.payload);
      const expectedSig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', 'cardiolab_relink_capability_secret').update(jsonStr).digest('hex');
      if (expectedSig !== decoded.sig) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid capability token signature' };
      }
      const p = decoded.payload;
      if (p.session_id !== params.sessionId) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Capability token bound to session '${p.session_id}', not '${params.sessionId}'` };
      }
      if (path.resolve(p.target_file_path) !== path.resolve(params.targetFilePath)) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Capability token bound to target '${p.target_file_path}', not '${params.targetFilePath}'` };
      }
      if (p.expected_source_sha256 && params.expectedSourceSha256 && p.expected_source_sha256 !== params.expectedSourceSha256.toLowerCase()) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Capability token bound to sha '${p.expected_source_sha256}', not '${params.expectedSourceSha256}'` };
      }
      if (p.session_revision != null && params.sessionRevision != null && p.session_revision !== params.sessionRevision) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Capability token bound to revision '${p.session_revision}', not '${params.sessionRevision}'` };
      }
      return { valid: true };
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Capability token decode failed: ${e.message}` };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Relinks a moved source file to a new verified path if file exists,
   * performs SHA-256 checksum verification when provided, prevents cross-profile
   * relinking, and preserves existing sessions, windows, annotations, and diary links.
   */
  public relinkMovedSource(
    paramsOrSessionId: RelinkMovedSourceRequest | { session_id?: string; sessionId?: string; target_file_path?: string; new_verified_path?: string; newVerifiedPath?: string; expected_source_sha256?: string; expected_revision?: number; capability_token?: string; profile_id?: string } | string,
    legacyTargetPath?: string
  ): RelinkMovedSourceResult {
    let rawSessionId: string;
    let rawTargetPath: string;
    let expectedSha: string | undefined;
    let profileId: string | undefined;
    let capabilityToken: string | undefined;
    let expectedRevision: number | undefined;

    if (typeof paramsOrSessionId === 'string') {
      rawSessionId = paramsOrSessionId;
      rawTargetPath = legacyTargetPath || '';
    } else {
      rawSessionId = (paramsOrSessionId as any).session_id || (paramsOrSessionId as any).sessionId || '';
      rawTargetPath = (paramsOrSessionId as any).target_file_path || (paramsOrSessionId as any).new_verified_path || (paramsOrSessionId as any).newVerifiedPath || '';
      expectedSha = (paramsOrSessionId as any).expected_source_sha256;
      profileId = (paramsOrSessionId as any).profile_id;
      capabilityToken = (paramsOrSessionId as any).capability_token;
      expectedRevision = (paramsOrSessionId as any).expected_revision;
    }

    if (!rawSessionId || typeof rawSessionId !== 'string') {
      return { success: false, session_id: '', data_preserved: true, code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS', error: 'session_id is required' };
    }
    if (!rawTargetPath || typeof rawTargetPath !== 'string') {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'INVALID_PARAMETERS', error: 'target_file_path is required' };
    }

    const db = getDb();
    let session: any = null;
    let sessionRevision = 1;
    try {
      session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(rawSessionId) as any;
      if (session?.revision != null) {
        sessionRevision = Number(session.revision);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      session = db.prepare('SELECT id, user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(rawSessionId) as any;
    }

    if (!session) {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND', error: 'Session not found' };
    }

    // Path traversal and null-byte check
    if (rawTargetPath.includes('\0') || /[\r\n]/.test(rawTargetPath)) {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'INVALID_PATH', error: 'Target path contains illegal control characters' };
    }

    const resolvedTarget = path.resolve(rawTargetPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedTarget)) {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND', error: `Target file not found: ${resolvedTarget}` };
    }

    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(resolvedTarget);
      if (!stat.isFile()) {
        return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'NOT_A_FILE', error: 'Target path is a directory or special file' };
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'FILE_ACCESS_ERROR', error: e.message };
    }

    // Profile boundary check
    if (profileId && session.user_id && session.user_id !== profileId && profileId !== 'all') {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN', error: 'Session does not belong to active athlete profile' };
    }

    // Capability token verification if provided (Audit Lead 7)
    if (capabilityToken) {
      const tokenVerification = this.verifyRelinkCapabilityToken(capabilityToken, {
        sessionId: rawSessionId,
        targetFilePath: resolvedTarget,
        expectedSourceSha256: expectedSha,
        sessionRevision: expectedRevision
      });
      if (!tokenVerification.valid) {
        return {
          success: false,
          session_id: rawSessionId,
          data_preserved: true,
          code: 'INVALID_CAPABILITY_TOKEN',
          error: `Relink capability rejected: ${tokenVerification.error}`
        };
      }
    }

    // Session revision check if expected_revision is provided (Audit Lead 7)
    if (expectedRevision != null && expectedRevision !== sessionRevision) {
      return {
        success: false,
        session_id: rawSessionId,
        data_preserved: true,
        code: 'REVISION_MISMATCH',
        error: `Session revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, found ${sessionRevision}`
      };
    }

    // Full SHA-256 computation
    let targetSha256 = '';
    try {
      const fileBytes = fs.readFileSync(resolvedTarget);
      targetSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBytes).digest('hex');
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { success: false, session_id: rawSessionId, data_preserved: true, code: 'READ_FAILED', error: e.message };
    }

    // Check against expected_source_sha256 if provided
    if (expectedSha && typeof expectedSha === 'string' && expectedSha.trim()) {
      if (targetSha256.toLowerCase() !== expectedSha.trim().toLowerCase()) {
        return {
          success: false,
          session_id: rawSessionId,
          data_preserved: true,
          same_bytes: false,
          code: 'HASH_MISMATCH',
          error: `Target file SHA-256 (${targetSha256}) does not match expected source checksum (${expectedSha}). Relink rejected; active state preserved.`
        };
      }
    }

    // Update relinked_source_path column in sessions table
    db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET relinked_source_path = ? WHERE id = ?').run(resolvedTarget, rawSessionId);

    // Copy into raw_logs safely to guarantee local file-first availability
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();
    if (!fs.existsSync(rawLogsDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(rawLogsDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    const destName = `${rawSessionId}_raw.txt`;
    const destPath = path.join(rawLogsDir, destName);
    try {
      fs.copyFileSync(resolvedTarget, destPath);
    } catch (e: any) {
      logger.warn('diagnostics', `Warning during raw_logs mirror copy: ${e.message}`);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      session_id: rawSessionId,
      data_preserved: true,
      same_bytes: true,
      relinked_path: resolvedTarget
    };
  }

  /**
   * Executes an authoritative recovery command in a typed, non-destructive manner.
   */
  public async executeRecoveryCommand(
    command: RecoveryCommand,
    profileId?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; command_type: string; projection: RecoveryCenterStateProjection; result?: any }> {
    if (!command || !command.command_type) {
      throw new Error('COMMAND_TYPE_REQUIRED: Command must declare command_type');
    }

    let commandResult: any = null;

    switch (command.command_type) {
      case 'relink_source': {
        const sessionId = command.target_id;
        const targetPath = command.payload?.target_file_path || command.payload?.new_verified_path;
        const expectedSha = command.payload?.expected_source_sha256;
        commandResult = this.relinkMovedSource({
          session_id: sessionId!,
          target_file_path: targetPath,
          expected_source_sha256: expectedSha,
          profile_id: profileId
        });
        break;
      }

      case 'create_safety_snapshot': {
        const { workspaceRestoreService } = await import('../backup/WorkspaceRestoreService');
        commandResult = await workspaceRestoreService.createSafetySnapshot();
        break;
      }

      case 'inspect_backup': {
        const backupPath = command.payload?.backup_path || command.target_id;
        if (backupPath) {
          const { workspaceRestoreService } = await import('../backup/WorkspaceRestoreService');
          commandResult = await workspaceRestoreService.inspectBackup(backupPath);
        }
        break;
      }

      case 'navigate':
      default: {
        commandResult = { navigated: true, route: command.route || '#/sessions' };
        break;
      }
    }

    const projection = this.getProjection(profileId);
    return {
      success: true,
      command_type: command.command_type,
      projection,
      result: commandResult
    };
  }
}

export const recoveryCenterService = new RecoveryCenterService();

/**
 * releaseGateService.ts
 *
 * External Release Gate Evidence Intake, Dependency Evaluator,
 * and Owner Decision Orchestration Service.
 *
 * Implements Tasks ERG-02, ERG-03, ERG-04, ERG-05 for work item wi-4328c4e8c69f44569f38fed9652010cd.
 *
 * Invariance Guarantees:
 * 1. DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true: strictly no executable binaries (.exe, .msi, NSIS, electron-builder).
 * 2. Non-overlapping authority classes: operator evidence, external authority, and owner decisions.
 * 3. Fail-closed: missing, stale, conflicting, or quarantined evidence blocks release.
 * 4. Zero secret or raw physiological signal leakage into evidence records.
 */

export interface CandidateIdentityInfo {
  candidate_freeze_id: string;
  candidate_commit_sha: string;
  candidate_version: string;
  work_item_id: string;
  manifest_sha256?: string;
  manifest_status: 'current' | 'invalidated' | 'reconciliation_required' | 'missing';
}

export class ReleaseGateService {
  private static instance: ReleaseGateService;
  private projectRoot: string;
  private customTrustStore?: ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore;

  private constructor(projectRoot?: string) {
    this.projectRoot = projectRoot || path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
  }

  public static getInstance(projectRoot?: string): ReleaseGateService {
    if (!ReleaseGateService.instance) {
      ReleaseGateService.instance = new ReleaseGateService(projectRoot);
    }
    return ReleaseGateService.instance;
  }

  /**
   * Allows injecting a verified test trust store for adversarial tests.
   * Production trust remains unprovisioned unless explicitly provided.
   */
  public setCustomTrustStore(trustStore?: ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore): void {
    this.customTrustStore = trustStore;
  }

  public getTrustStore(): ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore {
    if (this.customTrustStore) {
      return this.customTrustStore;
    }
    // Production default: strictly unprovisioned
    return {
      environment: 'production',
      revision: 1,
      owner_keys: {},
      external_keys: {},
      revocation_epoch: 0,
      updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resolves current candidate identity strictly from .agy/CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_STATUS.json,
   * .agy/CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json, and .agy/WORK_ITEM.json.
   * Never falls back to hardcoded strings when status is missing or invalidated.
   */
  public getCandidateIdentity(): CandidateIdentityInfo {
    const workItemPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy/WORK_ITEM.json');
    let workItemId = 'wi-4328c4e8c69f44569f38fed9652010cd';
    if (fs.existsSync(workItemPath)) {
      try {
        const wi = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(workItemPath, 'utf8'));
        if (wi.work_item_id) workItemId = wi.work_item_id;
      } catch {}
    }

    const statusPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy/CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_STATUS.json');
    let manifestStatus: 'current' | 'invalidated' | 'reconciliation_required' | 'missing' = 'missing';
    let manifestSha256: string | undefined = undefined;

    if (fs.existsSync(statusPath)) {
      try {
        const ms = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(statusPath, 'utf8'));
        if (ms.status === 'current') {
          manifestStatus = 'current';
          manifestSha256 = ms.manifest_sha256;
        } else if (ms.status === 'invalidated') {
          manifestStatus = 'invalidated';
        } else if (ms.status === 'reconciliation_required') {
          manifestStatus = 'reconciliation_required';
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const manifestPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy/CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json');
    let freezeId = '';
    let commitSha = '';
    let version = '';

    if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
      try {
        const mf = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
        freezeId = mf.candidate_freeze_id || `candidate-manifest-${workItemId}`;
        commitSha = mf.head || mf.git_head || '';
        version = mf.version || '1.0.1-beta.11';
        if (!manifestSha256) {
          const rawBytes = fs.readFileSync(manifestPath);
          manifestSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawBytes).digest('hex');
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    return {
      candidate_freeze_id: freezeId || 'unbound_candidate',
      candidate_commit_sha: commitSha || 'unbound_commit',
      candidate_version: version || '1.0.1-beta.11',
      work_item_id: workItemId,
      manifest_sha256: manifestSha256,
      manifest_status: manifestStatus
    };
  }

  /**
   * Initializes and seeds standard release gates into SQLite if not already present.
   */
  public initializeStandardGates(): void {
    const existing = listReleaseGateRecords();
    const existingMap = new Map(existing.map(g => [g.id, g]));
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    for (const def of STANDARD_RELEASE_GATES) {
      const current = existingMap.get(def.gate_id);
      if (!current) {
        upsertReleaseGateRecord({
          id: def.gate_id,
          name: def.name,
          description: def.description,
          category: def.category,
          required_authority_class: def.required_authority_class,
          dependencies_json: JSON.stringify(def.dependencies),
          is_blocking: def.is_blocking ? 1 : 0,
          external_action_required: def.external_action_required ? 1 : 0,
          specification_doc: def.specification_doc || null,
          evidence_types_allowed_json: JSON.stringify(def.evidence_types_allowed),
          status: def.gate_id === 'GATE-05-LICENSE-TRUST' || def.gate_id === 'GATE-08-UPDATE-FEED'
            ? 'prepared_not_executed'
            : (def.external_action_required ? 'external_hard_stop' : 'not_started'),
          active_evidence_id: null,
          active_decision_id: null,
          last_evaluated_at_utc: now,
          created_at_utc: now,
          updated_at_utc: now
        });

        recordReleaseGateEvent({
          id: `evt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
          gate_id: def.gate_id,
          previous_status: null,
          new_status: def.external_action_required ? 'external_hard_stop' : 'not_started',
          trigger_source: 'system_initialization',
          actor_authority: 'system_evaluator',
          details: 'Initialized standard gate record.',
          recorded_at_utc: now,
          candidate_freeze_id: this.getCandidateIdentity().candidate_freeze_id
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Scans content or metadata for private keys, merchant secrets, PII, and raw signals.
   */
  public scanForSecretsAndPrivacy(content: string | Record<string, any>): {
    isClean: boolean;
    status: PrivacyScanStatus;
    quarantineReason?: string;
  } {
    const text = typeof content === 'string' ? content : JSON.stringify(content);

    // 1. Private Keys
    if (
      text.includes('BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY') ||
      text.includes('BEGIN PRIVATE KEY') ||
      text.includes('BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY') ||
      text.includes('BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY') ||
      text.includes('xprv')
    ) {
      return {
        isClean: false,
        status: 'quarantined_secret',
        quarantineReason: 'DETECTED_ASYMMETRIC_PRIVATE_KEY: Asymmetric private key material detected in payload.'
      };
    }

    // 2. Merchant Secrets & API Keys
    if (
      /sk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{20,}/.test(text) ||
      /rk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{20,}/.test(text) ||
      /live_secret_[0-9a-zA-Z]{20,}/.test(text) ||
      text.includes('access_token$production$')
    ) {
      return {
        isClean: false,
        status: 'quarantined_secret',
        quarantineReason: 'DETECTED_MERCHANT_SECRET: Production merchant or gateway secret key detected.'
      };
    }

    // 3. Canary identifiers
    if (PrivacyRedactor.containsCanary(text)) {
      return {
        isClean: false,
        status: 'quarantined_secret',
        quarantineReason: 'DETECTED_CANARY_SECRET: Privacy canary token detected.'
      };
    }

    // 4. Raw physiological arrays
    if (
      text.includes('"ecg_microvolts"') ||
      text.includes('"acc_samples"') ||
      text.includes('"raw_samples"') ||
      text.includes('"rr_intervals"')
    ) {
      // Check if it's an array with numbers
      if (/"ecg_microvolts"\s*:\s*\[[\s\d,-]+\]/.test(text) || /"raw_samples"\s*:\s*\[[\s\d,-]+\]/.test(text)) {
        return {
          isClean: false,
          status: 'quarantined_raw_signal',
          quarantineReason: 'DETECTED_RAW_PHYSIOLOGICAL_SIGNAL: Unredacted biometric raw stream array detected.'
        };
      }
    }

    // 5. Local OS User paths
    if (
      /([a-zA-Z]:[/\\\\]+Users[/\\\\]+[^"'\s\r\n/\\\\]+[/\\\\]+AppData)/i.test(text) ||
      /\/(?:home|Users)\/[^"'\s\r\n/]+\/\.config/i.test(text)
    ) {
      return {
        isClean: false,
        status: 'quarantined_forbidden_path',
        quarantineReason: 'DETECTED_LOCAL_OS_USER_PATH: Local filesystem user profile directory path detected.'
      };
    }

    return {
      isClean: true,
      status: 'clean'
    };
  }

  /**
   * Secure local evidence intake preflight and registration.
   */
  public intakeEvidence(payload: EvidenceIntakePayload): ExternalReleaseEvidenceRecord {
    this.initializeStandardGates();
    const candidate = this.getCandidateIdentity();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // Verify gate existence
    const gateDef = STANDARD_RELEASE_GATES.find(g => g.gate_id === payload.gate_id);
    if (!gateDef) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_GATE_ID: Unknown release gate ID "${payload.gate_id}"`);
    }

    // Verify allowed evidence type
    if (!gateDef.evidence_types_allowed.includes(payload.evidence_type)) {
      throw new Error(
        `INVALID_EVIDENCE_TYPE: Evidence type "${payload.evidence_type}" is not permitted for gate ${payload.gate_id}. Allowed: ${gateDef.evidence_types_allowed.join(', ')}`
      );
    }

    // Authority class segregation: operator evidence cannot claim owner decision
    if (payload.authority_class === 'owner_decision') {
      throw new Error(
        'AUTHORITY_SEGREGATION_VIOLATION: Owner decisions cannot be submitted as operator evidence. Use importOwnerDecisionEnvelope().'
      );
    }

    let fileSha256 = '';
    let sizeBytes = 0;
    let fileContentForScan = '';

    // If a physical file is referenced, validate containment and integrity
    if (payload.file_path) {
      const resolved = path.resolve(this.projectRoot, payload.file_path);
      if (!PathSanitizer.isPathContained(resolved, this.projectRoot)) {
        throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Evidence file path escapes project root: ${payload.file_path}`);
      }

      if (!fs.existsSync(resolved)) {
        throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: Evidence file does not exist: ${payload.file_path}`);
      }

      const stat = fs.statSync(resolved);
      sizeBytes = stat.size;
      const buffer = fs.readFileSync(resolved);
      fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

      if (sizeBytes < 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        fileContentForScan = buffer.toString('utf8');
      }
    } else {
      // Metadata-only evidence: compute canonical metadata digest (non-zero hash)
      const metadataCanonical = canonicalJsonStringifyGate(payload.metadata || {});
      const metaBuffer = Buffer.from(metadataCanonical, 'utf8');
      sizeBytes = metaBuffer.length;
      fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(metaBuffer).digest('hex');
    }

    // Privacy and secret scanning
    const metadata = payload.metadata || {};
    const metadataScan = this.scanForSecretsAndPrivacy(metadata);
    const fileScan = fileContentForScan ? this.scanForSecretsAndPrivacy(fileContentForScan) : { isClean: true, status: 'clean' as PrivacyScanStatus };

    const scanResult = !metadataScan.isClean ? metadataScan : fileScan;
    const isQuarantined = !scanResult.isClean;

    const evidenceId = `ev-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const evidenceStatus = isQuarantined ? 'quarantined' : 'verification_pending';

    const evidenceRecord: ExternalReleaseEvidenceRecord = {
      evidence_id: evidenceId,
      gate_id: payload.gate_id,
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: candidate.candidate_commit_sha,
      issuer: payload.issuer,
      evidence_type: payload.evidence_type,
      file_path: payload.file_path,
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      metadata: metadata,
      received_at_utc: now,
      expires_at_utc: payload.expires_at_utc,
      authority_class: payload.authority_class,
      status: evidenceStatus,
      privacy_scan_status: scanResult.status,
      quarantine_reason: scanResult.quarantineReason,
      limitations: payload.limitations,
      dependencies: payload.dependencies,
      supersedes_evidence_id: payload.supersedes_evidence_id
    };

    // Save to SQLite
    saveReleaseEvidenceRecord({
      id: evidenceRecord.evidence_id,
      gate_id: evidenceRecord.gate_id,
      project_id: evidenceRecord.project_id,
      candidate_freeze_id: evidenceRecord.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: evidenceRecord.candidate_commit_sha,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: candidate.manifest_sha256 ?? null,
      issuer: evidenceRecord.issuer,
      evidence_type: evidenceRecord.evidence_type,
      file_path: evidenceRecord.file_path,
      file_sha256: evidenceRecord.file_sha256,
      size_bytes: evidenceRecord.size_bytes,
      metadata_json: JSON.stringify(evidenceRecord.metadata),
      received_at_utc: evidenceRecord.received_at_utc,
      verified_at_utc: evidenceRecord.verified_at_utc,
      expires_at_utc: evidenceRecord.expires_at_utc,
      authority_class: evidenceRecord.authority_class,
      status: evidenceRecord.status,
      privacy_scan_status: evidenceRecord.privacy_scan_status,
      quarantine_reason: evidenceRecord.quarantine_reason,
      limitations_json: evidenceRecord.limitations ? JSON.stringify(evidenceRecord.limitations) : null,
      dependencies_json: evidenceRecord.dependencies ? JSON.stringify(evidenceRecord.dependencies) : null,
      supersedes_evidence_id: evidenceRecord.supersedes_evidence_id
    });

    // Record audit event
    recordReleaseGateEvent({
      id: `evt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      gate_id: payload.gate_id,
      previous_status: null,
      new_status: isQuarantined ? 'quarantined' : 'evidence_submitted',
      trigger_source: 'evidence_intake',
      actor_authority: payload.authority_class,
      evidence_id: evidenceId,
      details: isQuarantined
        ? `Evidence quarantined: ${scanResult.quarantineReason}`
        : `Evidence submitted by ${payload.issuer} (${payload.evidence_type})`,
      recorded_at_utc: now,
      candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id
    });

    if (isQuarantined) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_QUARANTINED: ${scanResult.quarantineReason}`);
    }

    return evidenceRecord;
  }

  /**
   * Verifies evidence against an authenticated external attestation or deterministic machine evaluator.
   * Direct caller-supplied authority without an attestation is prohibited.
   */
  public verifyEvidence(
    evidenceId: string,
    attestation: EvidenceVerificationAttestation,
    customTrustStore?: ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore
  ): ExternalReleaseEvidenceRecord {
    const rec = getReleaseEvidenceRecordById(evidenceId);
    if (!rec) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND: Evidence ID ${evidenceId} does not exist.`);
    }

    if (rec.status === 'quarantined') {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_QUARANTINED: Cannot verify quarantined evidence (${rec.quarantine_reason}).`);
    }

    const gateDef = STANDARD_RELEASE_GATES.find(g => g.gate_id === rec.gate_id);
    if (!gateDef) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_GATE: Unknown gate ${rec.gate_id}`);
    }

    // Validate attestation payload
    if (!attestation || !attestation.payload) {
      throw new Error('ATTESTATION_REQUIRED: Evidence verification requires a valid EvidenceVerificationAttestation.');
    }

    const payload = attestation.payload;
    const candidate = this.getCandidateIdentity();

    if (payload.evidence_id !== evidenceId) {
      throw new Error(`ATTESTATION_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Attestation evidence_id (${payload.evidence_id}) does not match target (${evidenceId}).`);
    }

    if (payload.evidence_sha256 !== rec.file_sha256) {
      throw new Error(`ATTESTATION_HASH_MISMATCH: Attestation evidence_sha256 does not match recorded evidence hash.`);
    }

    if (payload.gate_id !== rec.gate_id) {
      throw new Error(`ATTESTATION_GATE_MISMATCH: Attestation gate (${payload.gate_id}) does not match evidence gate (${rec.gate_id}).`);
    }

    // Enforce required authority class mechanically
    if (payload.authority_class !== gateDef.required_authority_class) {
      throw new Error(
        `AUTHORITY_CLASS_MISMATCH: Gate ${gateDef.gate_id} requires authority class "${gateDef.required_authority_class}", but attestation presented "${payload.authority_class}".`
      );
    }

    // Candidate manifest binding check
    if (candidate.manifest_sha256 && payload.candidate_manifest_sha256 !== candidate.manifest_sha256) {
      throw new Error(
        `CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_DRIFT: Attestation was issued for candidate manifest ${payload.candidate_manifest_sha256}, but active candidate manifest is ${candidate.manifest_sha256}.`
      );
    }

    // Authenticate signature via trust store
    const trustStore = customTrustStore || this.getTrustStore();
    const keyRecord = trustStore.external_keys[attestation.key_id];

    if (!keyRecord) {
      throw new Error(`UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY: Attestation key "${attestation.key_id}" is not in the authority trust store.`);
    }

    if (keyRecord.status === 'revoked') {
      throw new Error(`KEY_REVOKED: Attestation key "${attestation.key_id}" has been revoked.`);
    }

    if (keyRecord.allowed_gate_ids && !keyRecord.allowed_gate_ids.includes(gateDef.gate_id)) {
      throw new Error(`KEY_GATE_UNAUTHORIZED: Key "${attestation.key_id}" is not authorized for gate ${gateDef.gate_id}.`);
    }

    try {
      const canonicalString = canonicalSerializeAttestation(payload);
      const dataBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8');
      const signatureBytes = Buffer.from(attestation.signature, 'base64');
      const isValid = crypto.verify(null, dataBytes, keyRecord.public_key_pem, signatureBytes);

      if (!isValid) {
        throw new Error('INVALID_SIGNATURE: Cryptographic signature mismatch on evidence verification attestation.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED: ${err.message}`);
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    rec.status = payload.verification_verdict === 'verified' ? 'verified' : 'rejected';
    rec.verified_at_utc = now;
    rec.attestation_json = JSON.stringify(attestation);
    rec.candidate_manifest_sha256 = candidate.manifest_sha256 ?? null;

    saveReleaseEvidenceRecord(rec);

    // Update Gate state
    const gate = getReleaseGateRecordById(rec.gate_id);
    if (gate) {
      const prevStatus = gate.status;
      gate.status = rec.status;
      gate.active_evidence_id = evidenceId;
      gate.last_evaluated_at_utc = now;
      gate.updated_at_utc = now;
      upsertReleaseGateRecord(gate);

      recordReleaseGateEvent({
        id: `evt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
        gate_id: gate.id,
        previous_status: prevStatus,
        new_status: gate.status,
        trigger_source: 'evidence_verification',
        actor_authority: payload.authority_class,
        evidence_id: evidenceId,
        details: `Evidence verified by ${payload.verifier_identity} (${keyRecord.key_id}) under authority class ${payload.authority_class}.`,
        recorded_at_utc: now,
        candidate_freeze_id: rec.candidate_freeze_id
      });
    }

    return {
      evidence_id: rec.id,
      gate_id: rec.gate_id as ReleaseGateId,
      project_id: rec.project_id,
      candidate_freeze_id: rec.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: rec.candidate_commit_sha,
      issuer: rec.issuer,
      evidence_type: rec.evidence_type,
      file_path: rec.file_path || undefined,
      file_sha256: rec.file_sha256,
      size_bytes: rec.size_bytes,
      metadata: JSON.parse(rec.metadata_json || '{}'),
      received_at_utc: rec.received_at_utc,
      verified_at_utc: rec.verified_at_utc || undefined,
      expires_at_utc: rec.expires_at_utc || undefined,
      authority_class: rec.authority_class as AuthorityClass,
      status: rec.status as any,
      privacy_scan_status: rec.privacy_scan_status as PrivacyScanStatus,
      quarantine_reason: rec.quarantine_reason || undefined
    };
  }

  /**
   * Imports and cryptographically authenticates an OwnerDecisionEnvelope.
   * Free-form operator submission of owner decisions is strictly rejected.
   */
  public importOwnerDecisionEnvelope(
    envelope: OwnerDecisionEnvelope,
    customTrustStore?: ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore
  ): OwnerDecisionRecord {
    this.initializeStandardGates();
    const candidate = this.getCandidateIdentity();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (!envelope || !envelope.payload) {
      throw new Error('INVALID_ENVELOPE: OwnerDecisionEnvelope and payload are required.');
    }

    const payload = envelope.payload;

    if (payload.work_item_id !== candidate.work_item_id) {
      throw new Error(`WORK_ITEM_MISMATCH: Decision issued for ${payload.work_item_id}, expected ${candidate.work_item_id}.`);
    }

    if (candidate.manifest_sha256 && payload.candidate_manifest_sha256 !== candidate.manifest_sha256) {
      throw new Error(
        `CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_DRIFT: Owner decision issued for candidate manifest ${payload.candidate_manifest_sha256}, but active candidate manifest is ${candidate.manifest_sha256}.`
      );
    }

    // Verify owner signature against trust store
    const trustStore = customTrustStore || this.getTrustStore();
    const ownerKey = trustStore.owner_keys[envelope.key_id];

    if (!ownerKey) {
      throw new Error(`UNPROVISIONED_OWNER_TRUST: Owner key "${envelope.key_id}" is not provisioned in owner governance trust boundary.`);
    }

    if (ownerKey.status === 'revoked') {
      throw new Error(`OWNER_KEY_REVOKED: Owner key "${envelope.key_id}" has been revoked.`);
    }

    // Verify Ed25519 signature
    try {
      const canonicalString = canonicalSerializeOwnerDecision(payload);
      const dataBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalString, 'utf8');
      const signatureBytes = Buffer.from(envelope.signature, 'base64');
      const isValid = crypto.verify(null, dataBytes, ownerKey.public_key_pem, signatureBytes);

      if (!isValid) {
        throw new Error('INVALID_SIGNATURE: Cryptographic signature mismatch on OwnerDecisionEnvelope.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED: ${err.message}`);
    }

    // Check expiration
    if (payload.expires_at_utc) {
      const expiry = new Date(payload.expires_at_utc).getTime();
      if (Date.now() > expiry) {
        throw new Error(`DECISION_EXPIRED: Owner decision expired at ${payload.expires_at_utc}.`);
      }
    }

    const decisionId = `dec-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const rec: DbOwnerDecisionRecord = {
      id: decisionId,
      decision_type: payload.decision_type,
      gate_id: payload.gate_id || null,
      candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: candidate.candidate_commit_sha,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: candidate.manifest_sha256 ?? null,
      owner_identity: payload.owner_identity,
      decision: payload.decision,
      rationale: payload.rationale,
      envelope_json: JSON.stringify(envelope),
      key_id: envelope.key_id,
      trust_revision: trustStore.revision,
      recorded_at_utc: now,
      revoked_at_utc: null,
      is_revocable: 1,
      is_active: 1,
      metadata_json: JSON.stringify({
        nonce: payload.nonce,
        revocation_sequence: payload.revocation_sequence,
        rationale_digest_sha256: payload.rationale_digest_sha256
      })
    };

    saveOwnerDecisionRecord(rec);

    // If attached to a gate, record event and update gate
    if (payload.gate_id) {
      const gate = getReleaseGateRecordById(payload.gate_id);
      if (gate) {
        const prevStatus = gate.status;
        gate.status = payload.decision === 'approved' ? 'verified' : 'rejected';
        gate.active_decision_id = decisionId;
        gate.last_evaluated_at_utc = now;
        gate.updated_at_utc = now;
        upsertReleaseGateRecord(gate);

        recordReleaseGateEvent({
          id: `evt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
          gate_id: payload.gate_id,
          previous_status: prevStatus,
          new_status: gate.status,
          trigger_source: 'owner_decision_import',
          actor_authority: 'owner_decision',
          decision_id: decisionId,
          details: `Authenticated owner decision imported [${payload.decision.toUpperCase()}]: ${payload.rationale}`,
          recorded_at_utc: now,
          candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id
        });
      }
    }

    return {
      decision_id: rec.id,
      decision_type: rec.decision_type as any,
      gate_id: rec.gate_id ? (rec.gate_id as ReleaseGateId) : undefined,
      candidate_freeze_id: rec.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: rec.candidate_commit_sha,
      owner_identity: rec.owner_identity,
      decision: rec.decision as any,
      rationale: rec.rationale,
      recorded_at_utc: rec.recorded_at_utc,
      is_revocable: true,
      is_active: true,
      metadata: { key_id: envelope.key_id }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Revokes an existing active owner decision.
   */
  public revokeOwnerDecision(decisionId: string): boolean {
    this.initializeStandardGates();
    const success = revokeOwnerDecisionRecord(decisionId);
    if (success) {
      const candidate = this.getCandidateIdentity();
      recordReleaseGateEvent({
        id: `evt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
        gate_id: 'GATE-10-OWNER-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE',
        new_status: 'external_hard_stop',
        trigger_source: 'owner_decision_revocation',
        actor_authority: 'owner_decision',
        decision_id: decisionId,
        details: `Owner decision ${decisionId} was formally revoked.`,
        recorded_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id
      });
    }
    return success;
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates all gates and performs the fail-closed Final Acceptance Preflight.
   * Status is dynamically derived from valid, authenticated, unexpired, and non-drifted evidence.
   */
  public evaluateFinalAcceptancePreflight(customTrustStore?: ReleaseAuthorityTrustStore): FinalAcceptancePreflightResult {
    this.initializeStandardGates();
    const candidate = this.getCandidateIdentity();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const trustStore = customTrustStore || this.getTrustStore();

    const ownerKeysCount = Object.keys(trustStore.owner_keys || {}).length;
    const ownerTrustStatus: 'unprovisioned' | 'configured' | 'test_injected' =
      ownerKeysCount === 0
        ? 'unprovisioned'
        : trustStore.environment === 'test'
        ? 'test_injected'
        : 'configured';

    const blockingReasons: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const evaluations: Record<ReleaseGateId, GateEvaluationDetail> = {} as any;

    let externalHardStopsCount = 0;
    let unmetDependenciesCount = 0;
    let ownerDecisionsPendingCount = 0;

    // Check candidate manifest status first
    if (candidate.manifest_status === 'invalidated') {
      blockingReasons.push('CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_INVALIDATED: Active candidate manifest is marked invalidated by source drift.');
    } else if (candidate.manifest_status === 'reconciliation_required' || candidate.manifest_status === 'missing') {
      blockingReasons.push(`CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_STATUS_${candidate.manifest_status.toUpperCase()}: Candidate manifest requires reconciliation.`);
    }

    const allEvidence = listReleaseEvidenceRecords();
    const allDecisions = listOwnerDecisionRecords({ activeOnly: true });

    // Evaluate each standard gate in dependency order
    for (const def of STANDARD_RELEASE_GATES) {
      let status: ReleaseGateStatus = 'not_started';
      let blocking = def.is_blocking;
      let details = def.description;
      let satisfied = false;
      let activeEvidenceId: string | undefined = undefined;
      let activeDecisionId: string | undefined = undefined;

      // Find active verified evidence for this gate
      const gateEvidences = allEvidence.filter(e => e.gate_id === def.gate_id && e.status === 'verified');
      const validEvidence = gateEvidences.find(e => {
        // Must match current candidate manifest
        if (candidate.manifest_sha256 && e.candidate_manifest_sha256 && e.candidate_manifest_sha256 !== candidate.manifest_sha256) {
          return false;
        }
        // Must not be expired
        if (e.expires_at_utc && new Date(e.expires_at_utc).getTime() <= Date.now()) {
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      if (validEvidence) {
        status = 'verified';
        satisfied = true;
        activeEvidenceId = validEvidence.id;
      }

      // Check specific gates
      if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-10-OWNER-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE') {
        const approvedDecision = allDecisions.find(d => {
          if (d.decision_type !== 'final_acceptance_declaration' || d.decision !== 'approved') return false;
          if (candidate.manifest_sha256 && d.candidate_manifest_sha256 && d.candidate_manifest_sha256 !== candidate.manifest_sha256) return false;
          return true;
        });

        if (!approvedDecision) {
          status = 'owner_decision_required';
          satisfied = false;
          ownerDecisionsPendingCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('OWNER_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_DECLARATION_PENDING: Authenticated owner declaration envelope required.');
          details = ownerTrustStatus === 'unprovisioned'
            ? 'Owner governance trust root is unprovisioned. Owner final-acceptance declaration cannot be authenticated.'
            : 'Authenticated owner final-acceptance declaration not recorded.';
        } else {
          status = 'verified';
          satisfied = true;
          activeDecisionId = approvedDecision.id;
          details = `Authenticated owner final-acceptance declaration active (${approvedDecision.owner_identity}).`;
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-07-CODE-SIGNING') {
        const hasSigningEnv = Boolean(
          process.env.WIN_CSC_LINK || process.env.CSC_LINK || process.env.SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE
        );
        if (!hasSigningEnv && !satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('CODE_SIGNING_ABSENT: Windows EV Authenticode certificate/token not present in environment.');
          details = 'Authenticode EV token / signing certificate absent. Genuine owner/commercial signing action required.';
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-06-MERCHANT-PROVIDER') {
        const hasMerchantEnv = Boolean(
          process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY || process.env.PADDLE_API_KEY || process.env.LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY
        );
        if (!hasMerchantEnv && !satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('MERCHANT_GATEWAY_UNCONFIGURED: Commercial merchant credentials unconfigured.');
          details = 'Merchant API credentials absent. Local offline entitlement verified without monetary transactions.';
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-03-LEGAL-PRIVACY') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('LEGAL_APPROVAL_PENDING: Independent legal counsel attestation required prior to release.');
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-04-TRADEMARK-BRAND') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('TRADEMARK_CLEARANCE_PENDING: Trademark search and registration certification attestation required.');
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-01-PROTECTED-REVIEW') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('PROTECTED_REVIEW_PENDING: Independent protected code review attestation required.');
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-09-CLEAN-VM-ACCEPTANCE') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'external_hard_stop';
          externalHardStopsCount++;
          blockingReasons.push('CLEAN_VM_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING: Clean reference VM execution report attestation required.');
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-02-EMPIRICAL-EVIDENCE') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'prepared_not_executed';
          warnings.push('EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE: External natural-market athlete cohorts pending (MKT-R07). Technical readiness independent.');
        }
      } else if (def.gate_id === 'GATE-05-LICENSE-TRUST' || def.gate_id === 'GATE-08-UPDATE-FEED') {
        if (!satisfied) {
          status = 'prepared_not_executed';
        }
      }

      // Check dependencies
      if (def.dependencies && def.dependencies.length > 0) {
        for (const depId of def.dependencies) {
          const depEval = evaluations[depId];
          if (!depEval || !depEval.satisfied) {
            unmetDependenciesCount++;
            if (blocking) {
              blockingReasons.push(`UNMET_DEPENDENCY: Gate ${def.gate_id} requires satisfied ${depId}.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      evaluations[def.gate_id] = {
        gate_id: def.gate_id,
        name: def.name,
        status: status,
        blocking: blocking,
        details: details,
        authority_class: def.required_authority_class,
        satisfied: satisfied,
        active_evidence_id: activeEvidenceId,
        active_decision_id: activeDecisionId
      };
    }

    const preflightStatus = blockingReasons.length === 0
      ? 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE'
      : 'BLOCKED';

    const result: FinalAcceptancePreflightResult = {
      schema_version: '1.2.0',
      preflight_id: `preflight-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
      status: preflightStatus,
      evaluated_at_utc: now,
      candidate_freeze_id: candidate.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: candidate.candidate_commit_sha,
      candidate_manifest_sha256: candidate.manifest_sha256,
      candidate_manifest_status: candidate.manifest_status,
      blocking_reasons: blockingReasons,
      warnings: warnings,
      gate_evaluations: evaluations,
      can_proceed_to_final_build: preflightStatus === 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE',
      distribution_deferred: true,
      external_hard_stops_count: externalHardStopsCount,
      unmet_dependencies_count: unmetDependenciesCount,
      owner_decisions_pending_count: ownerDecisionsPendingCount,
      owner_trust_status: ownerTrustStatus
    };

    saveFinalAcceptanceEvaluation({
      id: result.preflight_id,
      candidate_freeze_id: result.candidate_freeze_id,
      candidate_commit_sha: result.candidate_commit_sha,
      status: result.status,
      blocking_reasons_json: JSON.stringify(result.blocking_reasons),
      warnings_json: JSON.stringify(result.warnings),
      gate_evaluations_json: JSON.stringify(result.gate_evaluations),
      external_hard_stops_count: result.external_hard_stops_count,
      unmet_dependencies_count: result.unmet_dependencies_count,
      owner_decisions_pending_count: result.owner_decisions_pending_count,
      evaluated_at_utc: result.evaluated_at_utc
    });

    return result;
  }
}

function calculateBaselineBand(values: number[]): { median: number | null; p25: number | null; p75: number | null } {
  if (values.length === 0) return { median: null, p25: null, p75: null };
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = sorted.length;
  
  const getPercentile = (p: number) => {
    const idx = (n - 1) * p;
    const low = Math.floor(idx);
    const high = Math.ceil(idx);
    const weight = idx - low;
    return sorted[low] * (1 - weight) + sorted[high] * weight;
  };

  return {
    median: Math.round(getPercentile(0.5) * 10) / 10,
    p25: Math.round(getPercentile(0.25) * 10) / 10,
    p75: Math.round(getPercentile(0.75) * 10) / 10
  };
}

export async function generateConsultationBundleZip(options: GenerateBundleOptions): Promise<NodeJS.ReadableStream> {
  const { session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, flags, signalFiles, user, notes, includeRaw } = options;

  let canonicalSession = options.canonicalSession;
  if (canonicalSession === undefined) {
    try {
      const { getCanonicalSessionResult } = require('../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder');
      canonicalSession = getCanonicalSessionResult(session.id);

      canonicalSession = null;
    }
  }

  const startTemporal = parseRawTimestamp(session.start_time);

  const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

  interface ZipMember {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    content: string | Buffer;
    row_count?: number;
  }

  const members: ZipMember[] = [];

  // Helper to compute SHA-256
  function getSha256(content: string | Buffer): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
  }

  // 1. Generate the PDF report
  const pdfBuffer = await generateSessionPdf({ ...options, canonicalSession });
  members.push({
    name: 'session_report.pdf',
    description: 'Полный PDF-отчет для печати.',

    SELECT f.filename

    JOIN session_signals sf ON f.id = sf.file_id

  `).all(session.id) as { filename: string }[];

    : (qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status === 'valid');
  const authoritativeMonotonicity = isTimebaseMonotonic ? 'valid' : 'invalid';

    bundle_mode: isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'legacy_unverified',

        : null,

        : null,
      ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality
        ? canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.technical_quality.baseline_drift.value
        : null,
      acc_motion_severity: canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? 'unknown',
      ecg_rr_consistency: null,
      legacy_overall_quality_score: session.overall_quality_score ?? null
    } : null,
    hr_zones: hasValidCanonicalZones ? {
      zones_source: canonicalZonesConfig!.source,

        z2_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.z2_seconds,
        z3_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.z3_seconds,
        z4_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.z4_seconds,
        z5_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.z5_seconds,
        unclassified_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.unclassified_seconds,
        canonical_coverage_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.canonical_coverage_seconds,
        bin_coverage_seconds: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.bin_coverage_seconds,
        eligibility: canonicalSession!.heart_rate_zones!.distribution.eligibility
      } : null
    } : (isCanonical ? {
      is_canonical_missing_zones: true,
      zones_source: null,
      zones_mode: null,
      zones_boundaries_bpm: null,
      zones_config_hash: null,
      max_hr: null,
      resting_hr: null,
      distribution: null
    } : {
      is_legacy: true,
      zones_source: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.source : null,
      zones_mode: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.mode : null,
      zones_boundaries_bpm: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.boundariesBpm : null,
      zones_updated_at: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.updatedAt : null,
      zones_config_hash: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.configHash : null,
      max_hr: user?.max_hr ?? 185,
      resting_hr: user?.resting_hr ?? 60
    }),
    ecg_rr_agreement: presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement,
    provenance: presentationSummary.provenance,
    safety_claim: presentationSummary.safety_claim
  };

  if (debugMode) {
    metricsSummary.cardiac_drift = {
      value_percent: driftAnalysis.value_percent,
      status: driftAnalysis.status,
      reasons: driftAnalysis.reasons
    };
  }

  members.push({
    name: 'metrics_summary.json',
    description: 'Структурированные метрики пульса и ВСР.',
    content: JSON.stringify(metricsSummary, null, 2)
  });

  // 3. Generate quality_report.json
  const qualityReport = {
    session_id: session.id,
    bundle_mode: isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'legacy_unverified',
    legacy_overall_quality_score_non_authoritative: session.overall_quality_score ?? null,
    canonical_task_eligibility: canonicalSession?.task_eligibility ?? null,
    monotonicity_status: authoritativeMonotonicity,
    missing_samples_count: qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count ?? 0,
    duplicate_timestamps_count: qcMetrics?.duplicate_timestamps_count ?? 0,
    ecg_clipping_seconds: isCanonical
      ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.clipping.value ?? null)
      : (qcMetrics?.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? null),
    ecg_noise_ratio: isCanonical
      ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.noisy_window_fraction.value ?? null)
      : (qcMetrics?.ecg_noise_ratio ?? null),
    ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: isCanonical
      ? (canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.baseline_drift.value ?? null)
      : (qcMetrics?.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio ?? null),
    acc_motion_severity: isCanonical
      ? (canonicalSession?.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? 'unknown')
      : (qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity ?? 'low'),
    ecg_rr_consistency: isCanonical ? null : (qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_consistency ?? null),
    ecg_rr_match_metrics: isCanonical ? null : (qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json ? JSON.parse(qcMetrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json) : null),
    hrv_quality_details: analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality_json ? JSON.parse(analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality_json) : null,
    ecg_rr_agreement: presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement,
    safety_claim: presentationSummary.safety_claim
  };
  members.push({
    name: 'quality_report.json',
    description: 'Детальные метрики качества и стабильности сигнала.',
    content: JSON.stringify(qualityReport, null, 2)
  });

  // 4. Generate rr_cleaned.csv
  const rrFile = signalFiles.find(s => s.signal_type === 'RR');
  const rrPoints = rrFile ? await readRRGz(path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${rrFile.id}_rr.txt.gz`)) : [];

  const cleanRrs: number[] = [];
  const cleanTimesMs: number[] = [];

  if (canonicalSession?.canonical_beat_ledger) {
    for (const beat of canonicalSession.canonical_beat_ledger.beats) {
      if (beat.accepted_for_nn && beat.raw_rr_ms !== null) {
        cleanRrs.push(beat.raw_rr_ms);
        cleanTimesMs.push(beat.relative_timestamp_ms ?? 0);
      }
    }
  } else {
    const rawRrs = rrPoints.map(p => p.rrMs);
    const classifications = classifyRrSequence(rawRrs);
    for (let i = 0; i < rrPoints.length; i++) {
      const rr = rrPoints[i];
      const offsetMs = rr.timeMs - startMs;
      const c = classifications[i];
      if (c.used_in_nn) {
        cleanRrs.push(rr.rrMs);
        cleanTimesMs.push(offsetMs);
      }
    }
  }

  const rrCsv = generateRrCsvFile(session, analyticsMetrics || ({} as any), rrPoints, canonicalSession);
  members.push({
    name: 'rr_cleaned.csv',
    description: 'Очищенный ряд R-R интервалов (NN-интервалы) с канонической разметкой качества ВСР.',
    content: rrCsv,
    row_count: rrPoints.length
  });

  // 5. Generate hrv_windows.csv
  let hrvWindowsCsv = 'time_offset_ms,rmssd,sdnn,pnn50\n';
  let hrvWindowsCount = 0;
  if (cleanRrs.length > 0) {
    const windowDurationMs = 300000;
    const stepDurationMs = 60000;
    const maxTime = cleanTimesMs[cleanTimesMs.length - 1];

    for (let wStart = 0; wStart <= maxTime - windowDurationMs; wStart += stepDurationMs) {
      const wEnd = wStart + windowDurationMs;
      const wRrs: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < cleanTimesMs.length; i++) {
        if (cleanTimesMs[i] >= wStart && cleanTimesMs[i] < wEnd) {
          wRrs.push(cleanRrs[i]);
        }
      }

      if (wRrs.length >= 50) {
        const { calculateHrvMetrics } = require('../analytics/hrv');
        const metrics = calculateHrvMetrics(wRrs);
        if (metrics.rmssd !== null && metrics.sdnn !== null && metrics.pnn50 !== null) {
          hrvWindowsCsv += `${wStart + windowDurationMs / 2},${metrics.rmssd.toFixed(1)},${metrics.sdnn.toFixed(1)},${metrics.pnn50.toFixed(1)}\n`;
          hrvWindowsCount++;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  members.push({
    name: 'hrv_windows.csv',
    description: 'Скользящие 5-минутные HRV-метрики.',
    content: hrvWindowsCsv,
    row_count: hrvWindowsCount
  });

  // 6. Generate selected_ecg_strip_001.csv and .png
  const ecgFile = signalFiles.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ECG');
  const ecgPoints = ecgFile ? await readECGGz(path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${ecgFile.id}_ecg.txt.gz`)) : [];
  const hasEcg = ecgFile && ecgPoints.length > 0;
  if (hasEcg) {
    let ecgStripCsv = 'timestamp_offset_ms,ecg_microvolts\n';
    const bestStrip = getBestEcgStrip(ecgPoints);
    for (const pt of bestStrip) {
      const offsetMs = pt.timeMs - startMs;
      ecgStripCsv += `${offsetMs},${Math.round(pt.ecgUv)}\n`;
    }
    const plotPoints = bestStrip.map(p => ({ timeMs: p.timeMs, value: p.ecgUv }));
    const pngBuf = generateEcgPlot(800, 250, plotPoints);
    
    members.push({
      name: 'selected_ecg_strip_001.png',
      description: 'Визуальный график 10-секундного фрагмента ЭКГ с наилучшим качеством.',
      content: pngBuf
    });
    members.push({
      name: 'selected_ecg_strip_001.csv',
      description: '10-секундный фрагмент ЭКГ с наилучшим качеством.',
      content: ecgStripCsv,
      row_count: bestStrip.length
    });
  }

  // 7. Trends and baseline
  const allObservations = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser(session.user_id || 'default', activityType);
  const trendsResult = interpretTrends(allObservations, session.id);

  let trendsSummaryMd = `# Longitudinal Trends and Baseline Report
**Пользователь**: ${session.user_id || 'default'}
**Активность**: ${activityType}
**Количество сессий в выборке**: ${allObservations.length}

## Параметры Baseline (Личный диапазон)
${trendsResult.personal_baseline_available ? `
- **RMSSD (мс)**: Медиана = ${trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.median ?? '—'}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p25 ?? '—'}–${trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p75 ?? '—'} (сессий: ${trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.count})
- **SDNN (мс)**: Медиана = ${trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.median ?? '—'}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p25 ?? '—'}–${trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p75 ?? '—'} (сессий: ${trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.count})
- **pNN50 (%)**: Медиана = ${trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.median ?? '—'}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p25 ?? '—'}–${trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p75 ?? '—'} (сессий: ${trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.count})
- **Ср. ЧСС (уд/мин)**: Медиана = ${trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.median ?? '—'}, Диапазон (p25-p75) = ${trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p25 ?? '—'}–${trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p75 ?? '—'}
` : `*Недостаточно валидных сессий для формирования персонального baseline.*`}

## Сравнение текущей сессии с Baseline
- **Текущий RMSSD**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.rmssd.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_label_ru})
- **Текущий SDNN**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.sdnn.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_label_ru})
- **Текущий pNN50**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.pnn50.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_label_ru})
- **Текущая ср. ЧСС**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.display_value}

### Физиологическая интерпретация тренда
*Данный отчет представляет собой техническую оценку ВСР спортсмена. HRV/ВСР тренды показаны справочно; интерпретация ограничена качеством текущей записи и сопоставимостью условий.*
`;
  members.push({
    name: 'trends_summary.md',
    description: 'Лонгитюдный анализ относительно личного диапазона (baseline).',
    content: trendsSummaryMd
  });

  // 8. Generate consultation_summary.md
  const bundleDisplayLocale = options.display_locale || (options.display_language === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU');
  const bundleDisplayTz = options.display_timezone || (canonicalSession?.timing?.display_timezone || 'UTC');
  const formattedStartDate = SharedFormatter.formatDateTime(session.start_time, bundleDisplayTz, bundleDisplayLocale);
  const formattedDuration = SharedFormatter.formatDuration(session.duration_seconds, bundleDisplayLocale as any);

  let consultationSummaryMd = `# Consultation Summary Report
**Сессия**: ${session.id}
**Режим отчёта**: ${isCanonical ? 'Канонический (Frozen Protocol v1.1)' : 'LEGACY UNVERIFIED (Историческая запись)'}
**Дата записи**: ${formattedStartDate}
**Длительность**: ${formattedDuration}

${!isCanonical ? '> **ВНИМАНИЕ**: Сессия отображается в режиме исторической записи (LEGACY UNVERIFIED). Пересчёт по каноническому протоколу v1.1 не проводился.\n' : ''}
## Основные показатели
- **Режим источника**: ${formatVisibleEnum(sourceMode)}
- **Средняя ЧСС**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.display_value}
- **RMSSD**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.rmssd.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_label_ru})
- **SDNN**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.sdnn.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_label_ru})
- **pNN50**: ${presentationSummary.core_metrics.pnn50.display_value} (${presentationSummary.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_label_ru})
- **Технический индекс качества (legacy rollup, справочно)**: ${session.overall_quality_score != null ? session.overall_quality_score.toFixed(0) + '%' : '—'}

## Достоверность данных и ограничения
${presentationSummary.limitations.warning_text ? `### Предупреждения\n${presentationSummary.limitations.warning_text}\n` : ''}
### Что можно уверенно использовать
${presentationSummary.limitations.reliable_text}

### Ограничения
${presentationSummary.limitations.limited_text}

## Технический контроль качества (QC)
- **Монотонность временных меток**: ${isTimebaseMonotonic ? 'Валидно' : 'Невалидно (обнаружена немонотонность)'}
- **ЭКГ-клиппинг (сек)**: ${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds != null ? `${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds.toFixed(1)} сек` : '—'}
- **Зашумленные фрагменты ЭКГ**: ${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_noise_ratio != null ? `${(presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_noise_ratio * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : '—'}
- **Спектральный SNR ЭКГ**: ${canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.snr?.value_db !== undefined && canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.snr.value_db !== null ? `${canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.snr.value_db} dB` : (canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.ecg_snr_db !== undefined && canonicalSession.quality_summary.ecg_snr_db !== null ? `${canonicalSession.quality_summary.ecg_snr_db} dB` : 'н/д')}
- **Согласованность ЭКГ/RR**: ${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.display_value}

## Примечания пользователя
${notes && notes.trim().length > 0 ? notes.trim() : '*Примечания отсутствуют.*'}

---
**Важное примечание (Non-Diagnostic Notice)**:
Данный отчет не является медицинским диагнозом. Все данные предназначены исключительно для спортивного мониторинга и тренировочного контроля.
`;
  members.push({
    name: 'consultation_summary.md',
    description: 'Краткое текстовое описание сессии с примечаниями.',
    content: consultationSummaryMd
  });

  // 9. Append raw logs and candidate events if includeRaw
  if (includeRaw) {
    for (const f of signalFiles) {
      const filePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${f.id}_${f.signal_type.toLowerCase()}.txt.gz`);
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        const decompressed = zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(filePath));
        const entryName = `raw_logs/${devId}_${f.signal_type}.txt`;
        const lines = decompressed.toString('utf8').trim().split('\n');
        members.push({
          name: entryName,
          description: `Необработанные распакованные данные канала ${f.signal_type}.`,
          content: decompressed,
          row_count: lines.length > 0 ? lines.length - 1 : 0
        });
      }
    }

    if (ecgFile && ecgPoints.length > 0) {
      let ecgCsv = 'timestamp_offset_ms,ecg_microvolts,is_candidate_event_flag,candidate_event_description\n';
      const sortedFlags = [...flags].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms);

      let flagIndex = 0;
      for (const pt of ecgPoints) {
        const offsetMs = pt.timeMs - startMs;
        
        let isFlagged = 0;
        let flagDesc = '';

        while (flagIndex < sortedFlags.length && sortedFlags[flagIndex].timestamp_offset_ms < offsetMs - 4) {
          flagIndex++;
        }

        if (flagIndex < sortedFlags.length && Math.abs(sortedFlags[flagIndex].timestamp_offset_ms - offsetMs) <= 4) {
          isFlagged = 1;
          flagDesc = sortedFlags[flagIndex].description_ru;
        }

        ecgCsv += `${offsetMs},${Math.round(pt.ecgUv)},${isFlagged},"${flagDesc.replace(/"/g, '""')}"\n`;
      }

      members.push({
        name: 'raw_candidate_events.csv',
        description: 'Стандартизированный ряд ЭКГ с отметками кандидатных событий.',
        content: ecgCsv,
        row_count: ecgPoints.length
      });
    }
  }

  // 10. Generate README.txt first from actual payload members
  let readmeFileList = '';
  members.forEach((m, idx) => {
    readmeFileList += `${idx + 1}. ${m.name} - ${m.description}\n`;
  });
  readmeFileList += `${members.length + 1}. README.txt - Описание набора данных.\n`;
  readmeFileList += `${members.length + 2}. MANIFEST.json - Индекс файлов архива с контрольными суммами.\n`;
  readmeFileList += `${members.length + 3}. checksums.txt - Контрольные суммы SHA-256 файлов архива.\n`;

  const readmeContent = `========================================================================
H10 Athlete Cardio Lab - Consultation Export Bundle
========================================================================

Данный архив содержит полный комплект аналитических данных по сессии для локального
изучения или передачи тренеру/консультанту.

В состав архива входят следующие файлы:
${readmeFileList}
Немедицинское предупреждение:
Cardio Lab предоставляет техническую оценку физиологического статуса и качества
сигнала с Polar H10. Ни один из показателей не является диагнозом заболевания.
`;

  // Append README.txt to members list
  members.push({
    name: 'README.txt',
    description: 'Описание набора данных.',
    content: readmeContent
  });

  // 11. Generate MANIFEST.json containing all payload members plus README.txt
  const manifestFilesList: any[] = [];
  members.forEach(m => {
    manifestFilesList.push({
      name: m.name,
      description: m.description,
      row_count: m.row_count !== undefined ? m.row_count : null,
      sha256: getSha256(m.content)
    });
  });

  const manifestContent = {
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    session_id: session.id,
    files: manifestFilesList
  };

  const finalManifestStr = JSON.stringify(manifestContent, null, 2);

  // Append MANIFEST.json to members list
  members.push({
    name: 'MANIFEST.json',
    description: 'Индекс файлов архива с контрольными суммами.',
    content: finalManifestStr
  });

  // 12. Generate checksums.txt containing all members except checksums.txt itself
  let checksumsContent = '# SHA-256 Checksums for Consultation Bundle files\n';
  members.forEach(m => {
    checksumsContent += `${getSha256(m.content)}  ${m.name}\n`;
  });

  // Append checksums.txt to members list
  members.push({
    name: 'checksums.txt',
    description: 'Контрольные суммы SHA-256 файлов архива.',
    content: checksumsContent
  });

  // 13. Write all members to the zip archive
  for (const m of members) {
    archive.append(m.content, { name: m.name });
  }

  archive.finalize();
  return archive;
}

export class CollectionComparisonConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'COLLECTION_COMPARISON_CONFLICT', public readonly details?: any) {
