function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function escapeCsvField(val: any): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  let str = String(val);
  // CSV Formula Injection mitigation: prepend single quote if starting with =, +, -, @, or tab/CR
  if (/^[=\+\-@\t\r]/.test(str)) {
    str = `'${str}`;
  }
  if (str.includes(',') || str.includes('"') || str.includes('\n') || str.includes('\r')) {
    return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return str;
}

const CANONICAL_METRIC_SPECS = [
  { key: 'rmssd', label_ru: 'RMSSD', label_en: 'RMSSD', unit: 'ms' },
  { key: 'avg_hr', label_ru: 'Средний пульс (ЧСС)', label_en: 'Average Heart Rate', unit: 'bpm' },
  { key: 'sdnn', label_ru: 'SDNN', label_en: 'SDNN', unit: 'ms' },
  { key: 'pnn50', label_ru: 'pNN50', label_en: 'pNN50', unit: '%' },
  { key: 'mean_rr', label_ru: 'Средний интервал RR', label_en: 'Mean RR', unit: 'ms' },
  { key: 'dfa_alpha1', label_ru: 'DFA α1', label_en: 'DFA alpha-1', unit: 'unitless' },
  { key: 'recovery_1min', label_ru: 'Восстановление за 1 мин', label_en: '1-min Recovery', unit: 'bpm' }
];

export class CollectionComparisonService {
  /**
   * Generates a read-only comparison board preview across 2 to 6 selected collection members.
   */
  public static async generatePreview(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    req: CollectionComparisonRequest
  ): Promise<CollectionComparisonBoardPreview> {
    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Fetch collection
    const collection = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Review collection '${collectionId}' not found.`);
    }

    // Profile check
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    // Expected collection revision check
    if (collection.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_collection_revision) {
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
        `Collection revision mismatch: expected ${req.expected_collection_revision}, current is ${collection.optimistic_revision}`,
        'COLLECTION_REVISION_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    // 2. Fetch all collection members to verify membership
    const collectionMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collectionId);
    const memberMap = new Map<string, typeof collectionMembers[0]>();
    for (const cm of collectionMembers) {
      const key = `${cm.view_id}:${cm.reference_mode}:${cm.pinned_revision_id || (cm.pinned_revision_number !== null ? `rev#${cm.pinned_revision_number}` : 'latest')}`;
      memberMap.set(key, cm);
      memberMap.set(`${cm.view_id}:${cm.reference_mode}`, cm);
      memberMap.set(cm.view_id, cm);
    }

    // 3. Resolve each requested member reference
    const resolvedMembers: CollectionComparisonResolvedMember[] = [];
    const memberSnapshots = new Map<string, LongitudinalSnapshot | null>();
    const sessionToViewMap = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
    const limitations: string[] = [];

    for (const ref of req.member_references) {
      const view = getSavedLongitudinalView(ref.view_id);
      if (!view) {
        throw new Error(`Saved review '${ref.view_id}' not found in database.`);
      }
      if (view.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
          `Review '${ref.view_id}' belongs to profile '${view.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
        );
      }

      let snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot | null = null;
      let resolvedRevision = view.optimistic_revision;
      let isHistorical = false;
      let provenanceState: CollectionComparisonResolvedMember['provenance_state'] = 'verified_current';
      let pinnedId: string | null = ref.pinned_revision_id || null;
      let pinnedNum: number | null = ref.pinned_revision_number !== undefined && ref.pinned_revision_number !== null ? ref.pinned_revision_number : null;

      if (ref.reference_mode === 'pin_revision') {
        isHistorical = true;
        // Query history
        let histRow: any = null;
        if (pinnedId) {
          histRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_view_history
            WHERE view_id = ? AND history_id = ?
          `).get(ref.view_id, pinnedId) as any;
        }
        if (!histRow && pinnedNum !== null) {
          histRow = db.prepare(`
            SELECT * FROM saved_longitudinal_view_history
            WHERE view_id = ? AND optimistic_revision = ?
            ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
          `).get(ref.view_id, pinnedNum) as any;
        }

        if (histRow) {
          resolvedRevision = Number(histRow.optimistic_revision || histRow.revision || pinnedNum || 1);
          pinnedId = histRow.history_id;
          pinnedNum = resolvedRevision;

          if (histRow.snapshot_id) {
            snapshot = getLongitudinalSnapshot(histRow.snapshot_id);
          }
          if (!snapshot && (histRow.query_json || histRow.draft_query_json)) {
            try {
              const query = JSON.parse(histRow.query_json || histRow.draft_query_json);
              snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(query);
            } catch (_) {
              snapshot = null;
            }
          }

          if (snapshot) {
            provenanceState = 'verified_historical_pin';
          } else {
            // Provenance is incomplete! Strictly DO NOT substitute current snapshot!
            provenanceState = 'legacy_provenance_incomplete';
            limitations.push(
              `Обзор '${view.name}' (rev #${resolvedRevision}) имеет неполное историческое происхождение: численный снимок недоступен.`
            );
          }
        } else {
          // Check if current view matches pinned revision number
          if (pinnedNum !== null && view.optimistic_revision === pinnedNum) {
            resolvedRevision = pinnedNum;
            if (view.current_snapshot_id) {
              snapshot = getLongitudinalSnapshot(view.current_snapshot_id);
            }
            if (!snapshot) {
              snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(view.normalized_query);
            }
            provenanceState = 'verified_historical_pin';
          } else {
            // Missing revision in history
            provenanceState = 'legacy_provenance_incomplete';
            resolvedRevision = pinnedNum || 1;
            limitations.push(
              `Закреплённая редакция #${pinnedNum || pinnedId} для '${view.name}' не найдена в истории: помечена как неполная.`
            );
          }
        }
      } else {
        // follow_latest
        isHistorical = false;
        resolvedRevision = view.optimistic_revision;
        provenanceState = 'verified_current';

        if (view.current_snapshot_id) {
          snapshot = getLongitudinalSnapshot(view.current_snapshot_id);
        }
        if (!snapshot || !snapshot.is_current) {
          snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(view.normalized_query);
        }
      }

      memberSnapshots.set(ref.view_id, snapshot);

      const uniqueSessions = snapshot ? snapshot.ordered_session_ids : (view.selected_session_ids || []);
      for (const sId of uniqueSessions) {
        if (!sessionToViewMap.has(sId)) {
          sessionToViewMap.set(sId, new Set());
        }
        sessionToViewMap.get(sId)!.add(ref.view_id);
      }

      const namedWindowCount = snapshot
        ? snapshot.ordered_observation_points.filter(p => p.is_named_window).length
        : (view.window_references?.length || 0);

      resolvedMembers.push({
        view_id: view.view_id,
        view_name: view.name,
        reference_mode: ref.reference_mode,
        resolved_revision: resolvedRevision,
        pinned_revision_id: pinnedId,
        pinned_revision_number: pinnedNum,
        is_historical_snapshot: isHistorical,
        currentness_status: view.is_retired
          ? 'retired'
          : snapshot
          ? (snapshot.is_current ? 'current' : 'stale')
          : 'unknown',
        provenance_state: provenanceState,
        snapshot_id: snapshot?.snapshot_id || null,
        dependency_hash: snapshot?.aggregate_dependency_hash || null,
        total_observations: snapshot?.ordered_observation_points.length || 0,
        unique_session_ids: uniqueSessions,
        source_availability: uniqueSessions.length > 0 ? 'available' : 'missing',
        named_window_count: namedWindowCount,
        view_is_retired: view.is_retired
      });
    }

    // 4. Detect shared sessions across views
    const sharedSessionIds: string[] = [];
    for (const [sId, vSet] of sessionToViewMap.entries()) {
      if (vSet.size > 1) {
        sharedSessionIds.push(sId);
      }
    }

    const duplicateWarnings: string[] = [];
    if (sharedSessionIds.length > 0) {
      duplicateWarnings.push(
        `Обнаружено ${sharedSessionIds.length} общих сессий между выбранными обзорами. Сессии, включённые в несколько обзоров, отражают одни и те же измерения и не считаются независимыми наблюдениями.`
      );
    }

    // 5. Build metric rows
    const metricRows: CollectionComparisonMetricRow[] = [];
    const metricsAnalyzed: string[] = [];

    for (const spec of CANONICAL_METRIC_SPECS) {
      metricsAnalyzed.push(spec.key);
      const cells: Record<string, CollectionComparisonMetricCell> = {};
      let isComparableAcrossAll = true;
      let nonComparableReason: string | undefined = undefined;

      for (const m of resolvedMembers) {
        const snap = memberSnapshots.get(m.view_id);

        if (m.provenance_state === 'legacy_provenance_incomplete' || !snap) {
          cells[m.view_id] = {
            view_id: m.view_id,
            value: null,
            unit: spec.unit,
            is_withheld: true,
            withholding_reason: 'legacy_provenance_incomplete',
            is_comparable: false,
            non_comparable_reason: 'legacy_provenance_incomplete'
          };
          isComparableAcrossAll = false;
          nonComparableReason = 'legacy_provenance_incomplete';
          continue;
        }

        const baseline = snap.per_metric_baselines[spec.key];
        const changeCard = snap.change_cards[spec.key];

        if (baseline && baseline.is_ready && baseline.median !== null) {
          cells[m.view_id] = {
            view_id: m.view_id,
            value: baseline.median,
            unit: baseline.unit || spec.unit,
            is_withheld: false,
            is_comparable: true,
            change_class: changeCard?.change_class || 'within_reference',
            reference_range: (baseline.p25 !== null && baseline.p75 !== null)
              ? { p25: baseline.p25, median: baseline.median, p75: baseline.p75 }
              : null
          };
        } else if (changeCard && changeCard.target_value !== null) {
          cells[m.view_id] = {
            view_id: m.view_id,
            value: changeCard.target_value,
            unit: spec.unit,
            is_withheld: false,
            is_comparable: true,
            change_class: changeCard.change_class
          };
        } else {
          // Withheld or insufficient data
          cells[m.view_id] = {
            view_id: m.view_id,
            value: null,
            unit: spec.unit,
            is_withheld: true,
            withholding_reason: baseline?.limitations?.[0] || 'insufficient_history',
            is_comparable: false,
            non_comparable_reason: 'insufficient_data'
          };
          isComparableAcrossAll = false;
          if (!nonComparableReason) {
            nonComparableReason = 'insufficient_data';
          }
        }
      }

      metricRows.push({
        metric_key: spec.key,
        metric_label_ru: spec.label_ru,
        metric_label_en: spec.label_en,
        unit: spec.unit,
        is_comparable_across_all: isComparableAcrossAll,
        non_comparable_reason: nonComparableReason,
        cells
      });
    }

    // 6. Compute aggregate dependency digest
    const digestPayload = {
      collection_id: collection.collection_id,
      collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
      members: resolvedMembers.map(m => ({
        view_id: m.view_id,
        resolved_revision: m.resolved_revision,
        reference_mode: m.reference_mode,
        snapshot_id: m.snapshot_id,
        dependency_hash: m.dependency_hash,
        provenance_state: m.provenance_state
      }))
    };
    const dependencyDigest = crypto
      .createHash('sha256')
      .update(JSON.stringify(digestPayload))
      .digest('hex');

    const privacyOptions: LongitudinalPrivacyOptions = {
      ...DEFAULT_LONGITUDINAL_PRIVACY_OPTIONS,
      ...(req.privacy_options || {})
    };

    return {
      collection_id: collection.collection_id,
      collection_title: collection.title,
      collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
      profile_id: collection.owning_profile,
      resolved_members: resolvedMembers,
      selected_member_count: resolvedMembers.length,
      total_unique_sessions_count: sessionToViewMap.size,
      metrics_analyzed: metricsAnalyzed,
      metric_rows: metricRows,
      shared_sessions_count: sharedSessionIds.length,
      shared_session_ids: sharedSessionIds,
      duplicate_session_warnings: duplicateWarnings,
      limitations: Array.from(new Set(limitations)),
      privacy_options: privacyOptions,
      dependency_digest: dependencyDigest,
      disclaimer_ru:
        'CardioLab Workstation не является медицинским изделием и не предназначена для постановки диагнозов или назначения тренировочных нагрузок. Сопоставление показателей носит описательный исследовательский характер.',
      disclaimer_en:
        'CardioLab Workstation is not a medical device and is not intended for clinical diagnosis or prescription of training regimens. Comparative metrics are strictly exploratory and descriptive.',
      generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generates sanitized standalone HTML report for collection comparison.
   */
  public static generateHtmlReport(preview: CollectionComparisonBoardPreview): string {
    const profileText = preview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers
      ? `Athlete #${preview.profile_id.slice(0, 8)}`
      : preview.profile_id;

    // Header column cells for member reviews
    const memberHeadersHtml = preview.resolved_members
      .map(m => {
        const modeBadge = m.reference_mode === 'follow_latest'
          ? `<span class="badge badge-latest">Текущая (rev ${m.resolved_revision})</span>`
          : `<span class="badge badge-pinned">Закреплена (rev ${m.resolved_revision})</span>`;
        const provBadge = m.provenance_state === 'legacy_provenance_incomplete'
          ? `<span class="badge badge-warn">Неполный архив</span>`
          : `<span class="badge badge-curr">Проверен</span>`;
        return `
          <th>
            <div class="col-title">${escapeHtml(m.view_name)}</div>
            <div class="col-meta">${modeBadge} ${provBadge}</div>
            <div class="col-sub">${m.total_observations} сессий • ${m.named_window_count} окон</div>
          </th>
        `;
      })
      .join('');

    // Metric rows
    let metricRowsHtml = '';
    for (const r of preview.metric_rows) {
      let cellsHtml = '';
      for (const m of preview.resolved_members) {
        const cell = r.cells[m.view_id];
        if (!cell || cell.value === null || cell.is_withheld) {
          const reason = cell?.withholding_reason || cell?.non_comparable_reason || 'Withheld';
          cellsHtml += `<td class="cell-withheld"><span class="tag">null (${escapeHtml(reason)})</span></td>`;
        } else {
          const refStr = cell.reference_range
            ? `<div class="sub-range">[${cell.reference_range.p25} – ${cell.reference_range.p75}]</div>`
            : '';
          cellsHtml += `<td><strong>${cell.value}</strong> <span class="unit">${escapeHtml(cell.unit)}</span>${refStr}</td>`;
        }
      }

      metricRowsHtml += `
        <tr>
          <td class="metric-col">
            <div class="metric-name">${escapeHtml(r.metric_label_ru)}</div>
            <div class="metric-sub">${escapeHtml(r.metric_key.toUpperCase())} (${escapeHtml(r.unit)})</div>
          </td>
          ${cellsHtml}
        </tr>
      `;
    }

    // Warnings HTML
    const warningsHtml = preview.duplicate_session_warnings.length > 0
      ? `<div class="warning-box">
           <strong>⚠️ Предупреждение о перекрытии сессий:</strong>
           ${preview.duplicate_session_warnings.map(w => `<p>${escapeHtml(w)}</p>`).join('')}
         </div>`
      : '';

    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CardioLab — Сопоставление обзоров: ${escapeHtml(preview.collection_title)}</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0f172a;
      --card-bg: #1e293b;
      --text: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --border: #334155;
      --primary: #38bdf8;
      --warning: #f59e0b;
      --danger: #ef4444;
      --success: #10b981;
    }
    body {
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .header {
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .title {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary);
      margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    }
    .meta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .section {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    h2, h3 {
      margin-top: 0;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 13px;
      text-align: left;
    }
    th, td {
      padding: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      vertical-align: top;
    }
    th {
      background: #162032;
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

  </style>

  <div class="container">
    <div class="header">

      <div class="meta-grid">
        <div><strong>Подборка:</strong> ${escapeHtml(preview.collection_title)} (rev ${preview.collection_revision})</div>
        <div><strong>Профиль:</strong> ${escapeHtml(profileText)}</div>

              ${memberHeadersHtml}

    <div class="disclaimer-box">

    </div>

</body>

    return html;
  }

  /**
   * Generates tabular CSV report for collection comparison.
   */
  public static generateCsvReport(preview: CollectionComparisonBoardPreview): string {
    const lines: string[] = [];

    // Header metadata lines
    lines.push(`# CardioLab Collection Comparison Export`);
    lines.push(`# Collection Title: ${escapeCsvField(preview.collection_title)}`);
    lines.push(`# Collection Revision: ${preview.collection_revision}`);
    lines.push(`# Profile: ${preview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers ? 'ANONYMIZED' : escapeCsvField(preview.profile_id)}`);
    lines.push(`# Selected Members Count: ${preview.selected_member_count}`);
    lines.push(`# Total Unique Sessions: ${preview.total_unique_sessions_count}`);
    lines.push(`# Shared Sessions Count: ${preview.shared_sessions_count}`);
    lines.push(`# Dependency Digest: ${preview.dependency_digest}`);
    lines.push(`# Generated UTC: ${preview.generated_at_utc}`);
    lines.push(`# Disclaimer: CardioLab is exploratory non-diagnostic software.`);

    // Column headers
    const cols = ['metric_key', 'metric_label_ru', 'metric_label_en', 'canonical_unit', 'is_comparable_across_all', 'non_comparable_reason'];
    for (const m of preview.resolved_members) {
      const sanitized = m.view_name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').slice(0, 24);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_value`);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_unit`);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_is_withheld`);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_reason`);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_reference_mode`);
      cols.push(`${sanitized}_resolved_revision`);
    }

    lines.push(cols.join(','));

    for (const r of preview.metric_rows) {
      const row: string[] = [
        escapeCsvField(r.metric_key),
        escapeCsvField(r.metric_label_ru),
        escapeCsvField(r.metric_label_en),
        escapeCsvField(r.unit),
        r.is_comparable_across_all ? 'true' : 'false',
        escapeCsvField(r.non_comparable_reason || '')
      ];

      for (const m of preview.resolved_members) {
        const cell = r.cells[m.view_id];
        if (!cell || cell.value === null || cell.is_withheld) {
          row.push(''); // STRICTLY empty/null, NEVER 0!
          row.push(escapeCsvField(cell?.unit || r.unit));
          row.push('true');
          row.push(escapeCsvField(cell?.withholding_reason || cell?.non_comparable_reason || 'Withheld'));
        } else {
          row.push(String(cell.value));
          row.push(escapeCsvField(cell.unit));
          row.push('false');
          row.push('');
        }
        row.push(escapeCsvField(m.reference_mode));
        row.push(String(m.resolved_revision));
      }

      lines.push(row.join(','));
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Generates structured JSON export payload.
   */
  public static generateJsonReport(preview: CollectionComparisonBoardPreview): any {
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      export_type: 'collection_comparison_board',
      collection_id: preview.collection_id,
      collection_title: preview.collection_title,
      collection_revision: preview.collection_revision,
      profile_id: preview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers ? 'deidentified' : preview.profile_id,
      selected_members: preview.resolved_members.map(m => ({
        view_id: m.view_id,
        view_name: m.view_name,
        reference_mode: m.reference_mode,
        resolved_revision: m.resolved_revision,
        pinned_revision_id: m.pinned_revision_id,
        pinned_revision_number: m.pinned_revision_number,
        provenance_state: m.provenance_state,
        currentness_status: m.currentness_status,
        snapshot_id: m.snapshot_id,
        dependency_hash: m.dependency_hash,
        total_observations: m.total_observations,
        unique_sessions: m.unique_session_ids
      })),
      metrics: preview.metric_rows,
      shared_sessions_count: preview.shared_sessions_count,
      shared_session_ids: preview.privacy_options.exclude_paths ? [] : preview.shared_session_ids,
      duplicate_warnings: preview.duplicate_session_warnings,
      dependency_digest: preview.dependency_digest,
      privacy_options: preview.privacy_options,
      disclaimer_ru: preview.disclaimer_ru,
      disclaimer_en: preview.disclaimer_en,
      generated_at_utc: preview.generated_at_utc
    };
  }

  /**
   * Executes atomic, idempotent export of comparison board artifacts.
   */
  public static async executeExport(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    req: CollectionComparisonExportRequest
  ): Promise<CollectionComparisonExportResult> {
    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Fetch collection & check ownership
    const collection = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Review collection '${collectionId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    // 2. Expected collection revision check
    if (collection.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_collection_revision) {
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
        `Collection revision mismatch: expected ${req.expected_collection_revision}, current is ${collection.optimistic_revision}`,
        'COLLECTION_REVISION_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    // 3. Resolve member references
    let memberRefs = req.member_references;
    if (!memberRefs || memberRefs.length === 0) {
      // Reconstruct member references from resolved_member_revisions & collection members
      const allMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collectionId);
      memberRefs = Object.keys(req.resolved_member_revisions).map(viewId => {
        const found = allMembers.find(m => m.view_id === viewId);
        return {
          view_id: viewId,
          reference_mode: found?.reference_mode || 'follow_latest',
          pinned_revision_id: found?.pinned_revision_id || null,
          pinned_revision_number: found?.pinned_revision_number || null
        };
      });
    }

    // 4. Generate fresh preview to verify drift
    const freshPreview = await this.generatePreview(collectionId, profileId, {
      collection_id: collectionId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      expected_collection_revision: req.expected_collection_revision,
      member_references: memberRefs,
      privacy_options: req.privacy_options
    });

    // 5. Verify dependency digest
    if (freshPreview.dependency_digest !== req.expected_dependency_digest) {
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
        `Dependency digest mismatch: preview state has changed. Expected ${req.expected_dependency_digest}, current is ${freshPreview.dependency_digest}`,
        'DEPENDENCY_DIGEST_MISMATCH'
      );
    }

    // 6. Verify each member view revision against expected
    for (const m of freshPreview.resolved_members) {
      const expectedRev = req.resolved_member_revisions[m.view_id];
      if (expectedRev !== undefined && m.resolved_revision !== expectedRev) {
        throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
          `Member view revision drift on view '${m.view_id}': expected revision ${expectedRev}, current resolved revision is ${m.resolved_revision}. Please refresh preview.`,
          'MEMBER_VIEW_REVISION_DRIFT'
        );
      }
    }

    // 7. Canonical payload hash & idempotency check
    const canonicalPayload = {
      collection_id: collection.collection_id,
      expected_collection_revision: req.expected_collection_revision,
      expected_dependency_digest: req.expected_dependency_digest,
      format: req.format,
      privacy_options: {
        exclude_direct_identifiers: Boolean(freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers),
        exclude_notes: Boolean(freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_notes),
        exclude_paths: Boolean(freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_paths),
        exclude_raw_signals: Boolean(freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_raw_signals)
      },
      profile_id: profileId,
      resolved_member_revisions: Object.keys(req.resolved_member_revisions).sort().reduce((acc, k) => {
        acc[k] = req.resolved_member_revisions[k];
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<string, number>)
    };
    const requestPayloadHash = crypto
      .createHash('sha256')
      .update(JSON.stringify(canonicalPayload))
      .digest('hex');

    const idempotencyKey = req.idempotency_key || null;
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      // Check collection_comparison_reports first
      const existingReport = getCollectionComparisonReportByIdempotency(profileId, idempotencyKey);
      if (existingReport) {
        if (existingReport.format !== req.format) {
          throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
            `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with format '${existingReport.format}', cannot reuse with '${req.format}'`,
            'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',
            { idempotency_key: idempotencyKey }
          );
        }
        if (existingReport.request_payload_hash !== requestPayloadHash) {
          throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
            `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with a different comparison payload`,
            'IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH',
            { idempotency_key: idempotencyKey }
          );
        }
        const filePath = existingReport.published_path || existingReport.staging_path;
        if (filePath && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
          if (stats.size === existingReport.size_bytes) {
            const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
            const actualSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
            if (actualSha === existingReport.sha256) {
              return {
                manifest_id: existingReport.manifest_id,
                collection_id: collection.collection_id,
                collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
                format: req.format,
                filename: existingReport.filename,
                artifact_path: filePath,
                size_bytes: existingReport.size_bytes,
                sha256: existingReport.sha256,
                dependency_digest: existingReport.dependency_digest,
                is_historical: existingReport.status === 'historical',
                generated_at_utc: existingReport.created_at_utc
              };
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Check legacy manifest if not in collection_comparison_reports
      const existing = db
        .prepare('SELECT * FROM export_artifact_manifests WHERE manifest_id = ? OR plan_id = ?')
        .get(idempotencyKey, idempotencyKey) as any;
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.format === req.format) {
          const filePath = existing.published_path || existing.staging_path;
          if (filePath && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
            const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
            if (stats.size === existing.size_bytes) {
              return {
                manifest_id: existing.manifest_id,
                collection_id: collection.collection_id,
                collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
                format: req.format,
                filename: existing.filename,
                artifact_path: filePath,
                size_bytes: existing.size_bytes,
                sha256: existing.sha256,
                dependency_digest: existing.dependency_fingerprint || freshPreview.dependency_digest,
                is_historical: false,
                generated_at_utc: existing.generated_at_utc
              };
            }
          }
        } else {
          throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
            `Idempotency key '${idempotencyKey}' was already used with format '${existing.format}', cannot reuse with '${req.format}'`,
            'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // 8. Generate artifact content
    let contentBuf: Buffer;
    let ext: string;

    if (req.format === 'html') {
      const htmlStr = this.generateHtmlReport(freshPreview);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(htmlStr, 'utf-8');
      ext = 'html';
    } else if (req.format === 'csv') {
      const csvStr = this.generateCsvReport(freshPreview);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(csvStr, 'utf-8');
      ext = 'csv';
    } else if (req.format === 'json') {
      const jsonPayload = this.generateJsonReport(freshPreview);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(jsonPayload, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      ext = 'json';
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported export format '${req.format}'`);
    }

    const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(contentBuf).digest('hex');
    const sizeBytes = contentBuf.length;

    // 9. Atomic write to staging directory
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'exports', 'staging', 'collection_comparisons');
    if (!fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:T]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
    const sanitizedTitle = collection.title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').slice(0, 32);
    const filename = `collection_comparison_${sanitizedTitle}_rev${collection.optimistic_revision}_${dateStamp}.${ext}`;
    const targetPath = path.join(stagingDir, filename);

    const tmpPath = `${targetPath}.${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}.tmp`;
    fs.writeFileSync(tmpPath, contentBuf);
    fs.renameSync(tmpPath, targetPath);

    // 10. Save ExportArtifactManifest & CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail
    const manifestId = idempotencyKey || `man_cmp_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const manifest: ExportArtifactManifest = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      job_id: `job_cmp_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      plan_id: idempotencyKey || `plan_cmp_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      session_id: freshPreview.resolved_members[0]?.view_id || 'collection_comparison',
      format: req.format as any,
      filename,
      staging_path: targetPath,
      published_path: targetPath,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      status: 'completed',
      canonical_result_hash: freshPreview.dependency_digest,
      privacy_level: freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers ? 'deidentified' : 'identified',
      sensitive_opt_ins: {
        raw_rr: false,
        raw_ecg: false,
        raw_acc: false,
        notes: !freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_notes,
        paths: !freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_paths,
        identifiers: !freshPreview.privacy_options.exclude_direct_identifiers
      },
      generated_at_utc: nowIso,
      validated_at_utc: nowIso,
      profile_id: profileId,
      episode_id: null,
      context_type: null,
      window_root_id: null,
      window_revision: null,
      window_result_identity: null,
      beat_ledger_hash: null,
      dependency_fingerprint: freshPreview.dependency_digest,
      export_preset_version: '1.0.0'
    };

    saveExportArtifactManifest(manifest);

    const reportDetail: CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail = {
      report_id: manifestId,
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      collection_id: collection.collection_id,
      collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
      profile_id: profileId,
      format: req.format,
      filename,
      staging_path: targetPath,
      published_path: targetPath,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      status: 'current',
      status_reason: 'Current export artifact',
      dependency_digest: freshPreview.dependency_digest,
      selected_member_count: freshPreview.selected_member_count,
      selected_members: freshPreview.resolved_members.map(m => ({
        view_id: m.view_id,
        reference_mode: m.reference_mode,
        pinned_revision_id: m.pinned_revision_id,
        pinned_revision_number: m.pinned_revision_number
      })),
      resolved_member_revisions: req.resolved_member_revisions,
      privacy_options: freshPreview.privacy_options,
      request_payload_hash: requestPayloadHash,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      is_available: true,
      created_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    saveCollectionComparisonReport(reportDetail);

    return {
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      collection_id: collection.collection_id,
      collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
      format: req.format,
      filename,
      artifact_path: targetPath,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      dependency_digest: freshPreview.dependency_digest,
      is_historical: false,
      generated_at_utc: manifest.generated_at_utc
    };
  }

  /**
   * Queries local history of exported reports for a collection with dynamic currentness evaluation.
   */
  public static async queryReports(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    query: CollectionComparisonArchiveQuery
  ): Promise<CollectionComparisonArchivePage> {
    const collection = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Review collection '${collectionId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    const pageResult = queryCollectionComparisonReports({
      collectionId,
      profileId,
      format: query.format,
      status: query.status,
      limit: query.limit,
      cursor: query.cursor
    });

    const allCollectionMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collectionId);
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const normalizedAppDir = path.resolve(appDataDir);

    const evaluatedReports: CollectionComparisonReportArchiveItem[] = [];

    for (const r of pageResult.reports) {
      const filePath = r.published_path || r.staging_path;
      let fileExists = false;

      if (filePath) {
        try {
          const resolvedP = path.resolve(filePath);
          if (resolvedP.startsWith(normalizedAppDir) && fs.existsSync(resolvedP)) {
            fileExists = true;
          }
        } catch (_) {
          fileExists = false;
        }
      }

      let dynamicStatus: CollectionComparisonReportStatus = r.status;
      let statusReason = r.status_reason;
      let isAvailable = fileExists;

      if (!fileExists) {
        dynamicStatus = 'unavailable';
        statusReason = 'Artifact file missing on disk';
        isAvailable = false;
        updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(r.report_id, 'unavailable', statusReason, false);
      } else {
        // File exists on disk. Evaluate whether collection or constituent reviews evolved
        let isHistorical = false;
        if (collection.optimistic_revision > r.collection_revision) {
          isHistorical = true;
        } else {
          // Check if any constituent view revision evolved
          for (const cm of allCollectionMembers) {
            const expectedRev = r.resolved_member_revisions[cm.view_id];
            const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(cm.view_id);
            if (currentView && expectedRev !== undefined && currentView.optimistic_revision > expectedRev) {
              isHistorical = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (isHistorical) {
          dynamicStatus = 'historical';
          statusReason = 'Collection or constituent review revision has evolved';
        } else {
          dynamicStatus = 'current';
          statusReason = 'Current up-to-date report';
        }
        isAvailable = true;
        updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(r.report_id, dynamicStatus, statusReason, true);
      }

      evaluatedReports.push({
        report_id: r.report_id,
        manifest_id: r.manifest_id,
        collection_id: r.collection_id,
        collection_revision: r.collection_revision,
        profile_id: r.profile_id,
        format: r.format,
        filename: r.filename,
        size_bytes: r.size_bytes,
        sha256: r.sha256,
        status: dynamicStatus,
        status_reason: statusReason,
        dependency_digest: r.dependency_digest,
        selected_member_count: r.selected_member_count,
        resolved_member_revisions: r.resolved_member_revisions,
        is_available: isAvailable,
        created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
      });
    }

    return {
      collection_id: collectionId,
      total_count: pageResult.total_count,
      has_more: pageResult.has_more,
      next_cursor: pageResult.next_cursor,
      reports: evaluatedReports
    };
  }

  /**
   * Gets detailed metadata for an exported report.
   */
  public static async getReportDetail(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string
  ): Promise<CollectionComparisonReportArchiveDetail> {
    const collection = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Review collection '${collectionId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(reportId);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(reportId);
    }
    if (!report) {
      throw new Error(`Report '${reportId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (report.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Report belongs to profile '${report.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }
    if (report.collection_id !== collectionId) {
      throw new Error(`Report '${reportId}' does not belong to collection '${collectionId}'`);
    }

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Verifies file integrity, size, and directory safety before streaming download.
   */
  public static async verifyAndPrepareDownload(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    identifier: string
  ): Promise<{
    filePath: string;
    filename: string;
    contentType: string;
    sizeBytes: number;
    sha256: string;
  }> {
    const collection = getReviewCollection(collectionId);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Review collection '${collectionId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection '${collectionId}' belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(identifier);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(identifier);
    }

    let targetFile = report?.published_path || report?.staging_path;
    let expectedSha = report?.sha256;
    let filename = report?.filename || 'collection_comparison_export';
    let format = report?.format;

    if (!report) {
      // Fallback check in export_artifact_manifests
      const manifest = getExportArtifactManifest(identifier);
      if (!manifest) {
        throw new Error(`Report or manifest '${identifier}' not found.`);
      }
      if (manifest.profile_id && manifest.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
          `Manifest belongs to profile '${manifest.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
        );
      }
      targetFile = manifest.published_path || manifest.staging_path;
      expectedSha = manifest.sha256;
      filename = manifest.filename;
      format = manifest.format as ProgressReviewReportFormat;
    }

    if (!targetFile) {
      if (report) {
        updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(report.report_id, 'unavailable', 'Missing file path', false);
      }
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError('Export file path missing', 'ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE');
    }

    // Path traversal safety check
    const normalizedAppDir = path.resolve(getAppDataDir());
    const resolvedFilePath = path.resolve(targetFile);
    if (!resolvedFilePath.startsWith(normalizedAppDir)) {
      throw new Error(`Path traversal rejected: path '${targetFile}' is outside application data directory.`);
    }

    // File existence check
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedFilePath)) {
      if (report) {
        updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(report.report_id, 'unavailable', 'File not found on disk', false);
      }
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
        `Export file not found at path: ${resolvedFilePath}`,
        'ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE'
      );
    }

    // SHA-256 integrity verification
    const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(resolvedFilePath);
    const actualSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');

    if (expectedSha && actualSha !== expectedSha) {
      if (report) {
        updateCollectionComparisonReportStatus(
          report.report_id,
          'integrity_failed',
          `SHA-256 hash mismatch: expected ${expectedSha}, got ${actualSha}`,
          false
        );
      }
      throw new CollectionComparisonConflictError(
        `Artifact file integrity check failed: expected SHA-256 '${expectedSha}', got '${actualSha}'`,
        'INTEGRITY_FAILED',
        { expected_sha256: expectedSha, actual_sha256: actualSha }
      );
    }

    let contentType = 'application/octet-stream';
    const ext = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase();
    if (ext === '.html' || format === 'html') contentType = 'text/html; charset=utf-8';
    else if (ext === '.csv' || format === 'csv') contentType = 'text/csv; charset=utf-8';
    else if (ext === '.json' || format === 'json') contentType = 'application/json; charset=utf-8';

    return {
      filePath: resolvedFilePath,
      filename,
      contentType,
      sizeBytes: fileBuf.length,
      sha256: actualSha
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves personal reading notebook and reading state for an exported comparison report.
   */
  public static async getReadingNote(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string
  ): Promise<ReportReadingNoteDetail> {
    const reportDetail = await this.getReportDetail(collectionId, profileId, reportId);
    const existingNote = getReportReadingNote(reportDetail.report_id, profileId);

    if (existingNote) {
      return {
        ...existingNote,
        report_filename: reportDetail.filename,
        report_format: reportDetail.format,
        report_sha256: reportDetail.sha256,
        collection_revision: reportDetail.collection_revision,
        dependency_digest: reportDetail.dependency_digest,
        report_status: reportDetail.status,
        is_available: reportDetail.is_available
      };
    }

    return {
      report_id: reportDetail.report_id,
      profile_id: profileId,
      collection_id: collectionId,
      manifest_id: reportDetail.manifest_id,
      reading_state: 'not_marked',
      note: null,
      tags: [],
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      read_at_utc: null,
      created_at_utc: reportDetail.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: reportDetail.created_at_utc,
      report_filename: reportDetail.filename,
      report_format: reportDetail.format,
      report_sha256: reportDetail.sha256,
      collection_revision: reportDetail.collection_revision,
      dependency_digest: reportDetail.dependency_digest,
      report_status: reportDetail.status,
      is_available: reportDetail.is_available
    };
  }

  /**
   * Updates note text and/or tags with optimistic revision guard (CAS).
   */
  public static async updateReadingNote(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string,
    req: UpdateReportReadingNoteRequest
  ): Promise<ReportReadingNoteDetail> {
    const reportDetail = await this.getReportDetail(collectionId, profileId, reportId);

    const existing = getReportReadingNote(reportDetail.report_id, profileId);
    const noteText = req.note !== undefined ? req.note : (existing?.note ?? null);
    const tags = req.tags !== undefined ? req.tags : (existing?.tags ?? []);

    const { noteRecord } = saveReportReadingNoteWithCas(
      profileId,
      reportDetail.report_id,
      collectionId,
      reportDetail.manifest_id,
      req.expected_revision,
      noteText,
      tags,
      req.idempotency_key
    );

    return {
      ...noteRecord,
      report_filename: reportDetail.filename,
      report_format: reportDetail.format,
      report_sha256: reportDetail.sha256,
      collection_revision: reportDetail.collection_revision,
      dependency_digest: reportDetail.dependency_digest,
      report_status: reportDetail.status,
      is_available: reportDetail.is_available
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clears personal note text with privacy retention (text deleted immediately, not kept in history).
   */
  public static async clearReadingNote(
    collectionId: string,
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string,
    req: ClearReportReadingNoteRequest
  ): Promise<ReportReadingNoteDetail> {
    const reportDetail = await this.getReportDetail(collectionId, profileId, reportId);

    const { noteRecord } = clearReportReadingNoteWithCas(
      profileId,
      reportDetail.report_id,
      req.expected_revision,
      req.idempotency_key
    );

    return {
      ...noteRecord,
      report_filename: reportDetail.filename,
      report_format: reportDetail.format,
      report_sha256: reportDetail.sha256,
      collection_revision: reportDetail.collection_revision,
      dependency_digest: reportDetail.dependency_digest,
      report_status: reportDetail.status,
      is_available: reportDetail.is_available
    };
  }

  public static async setReadingState(

  }

  /**
   * Queries profile-wide reading inbox across all review collections owned by an athlete.
   */
  public static async queryReadingInbox(
    profileId: string,
    query: ProfileReportReadingInboxQuery
  ): Promise<ProfileReportReadingInboxPage> {
    if (!profileId || profileId.trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('Profile ID is required for reading inbox query');
    }
    const cleanProfile = profileId.trim();
    if (cleanProfile === 'all' || cleanProfile === 'default') {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError("Special profile IDs 'all' and 'default' are strictly forbidden for reading inbox");
    }

    return queryProfileReadingInbox(cleanProfile, query);
  }
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import { ZipArchive } from 'archiver';
import {
  getRawLogsDir,
  SessionMetadata,
  SessionQcMetrics,
  SessionMetrics,
  getUser,
  getDb
} from '../db/db';
import { getSessionProvenance } from '../../shared/methodologyRegistry';
import { getCanonicalPresentationSummary } from '../../shared/canonical/CanonicalPresentationAdapter';
import { readHRGz, readACCGz, readRRGz } from '../signals/rawParsers';
import { resolveHeartRateZones } from '../analytics/hrZones';
import { interpretTrends } from '../analytics/trendInterpreter';
import { CanonicalTrendObservationService } from '../analytics/CanonicalTrendObservationService';
import { getCanonicalSessionResult } from '../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder';
import { CanonicalSessionResult } from '../../shared/canonical';
import { calculateHrvMetrics } from '../analytics/hrv';
import { parseRawTimestamp } from '../../shared/canonical/TemporalContract';

/**
 * Generates the standardized CSV and JSON metrics export ZIP stream.
 * Projects directly from CanonicalSessionResult and CanonicalBeatLedger as the single source of truth.
 */
export async function generateCsvMetricsZip(
  session: SessionMetadata,
  signalFiles: { id: string; signal_type: string }[]
): Promise<NodeJS.ReadableStream> {
  const hrFile = signalFiles.find(s => s.signal_type === 'HR');
  const accFile = signalFiles.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ACC');

  const startTemporal = parseRawTimestamp(session.start_time);
  const startMs = startTemporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(startTemporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : 0;

  // Retrieve canonical session result as single source of truth
  const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(session.id, true, session, signalFiles);
  const beatLedger = canonicalSession.canonical_beat_ledger;

  // 1. Build 1Hz metrics CSV
  let csv1hz = 'timestamp_offset_ms,hr_bpm,acc_mag\n';
  const hrPoints = hrFile ? await readHRGz(path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${hrFile.id}_hr.txt.gz`)) : [];
  const accPoints = accFile ? await readACCGz(path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${accFile.id}_acc.txt.gz`)) : [];

  // Index ACC points by second to speed up matching
  const accBySec = new Map<number, number[]>();
  for (const acc of accPoints) {
    const sec = Math.floor(acc.timeMs / 1000);
    if (!accBySec.has(sec)) {
      accBySec.set(sec, []);
    }
    accBySec.get(sec)!.push(acc.magnitude);
  }

  for (const hr of hrPoints) {
    const offsetMs = hr.timeMs - startMs;
    const sec = Math.floor(hr.timeMs / 1000);
    const accs = accBySec.get(sec);
    let avgAcc = '';
    if (accs && accs.length > 0) {
      const sum = accs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      avgAcc = (sum / accs.length).toFixed(3);
    }
    csv1hz += `${offsetMs},${hr.hrBpm},${avgAcc}\n`;
  }

  // 2. Build Beat-by-Beat RR CSV directly from CanonicalBeatLedger
  let csvBeat = 'beat_index,source_row_index,phone_timestamp_str,phone_timestamp_ms,sensor_timestamp_ns,relative_timestamp_ms,raw_rr_ms,raw_is_valid,parse_status,classification_status,exclusion_reasons,instantaneous_hr_bpm\n';
  for (const b of beatLedger.beats) {
    const rawRrStr = b.raw_rr_ms != null ? b.raw_rr_ms.toFixed(1) : '';
    const sensorNsStr = b.sensor_timestamp_ns != null ? b.sensor_timestamp_ns.toString() : '';
    const phoneMsStr = b.phone_timestamp_ms != null ? b.phone_timestamp_ms.toString() : '';
    const instHrStr = b.instantaneous_hr_bpm != null ? b.instantaneous_hr_bpm.toFixed(1) : '';
    const exclStr = b.exclusion_reasons && b.exclusion_reasons.length > 0 ? `"${b.exclusion_reasons.join(';')}"` : '';

    csvBeat += `${b.beat_index},${b.source_row_index},${b.phone_timestamp_str || ''},${phoneMsStr},${sensorNsStr},${b.relative_timestamp_ms ?? ''},${rawRrStr},${b.raw_is_valid ?? ''},${b.parser_status},${b.classification_status},${exclStr},${instHrStr}\n`;
  }

  // 3. Build Summary Metrics CSV directly from CanonicalSessionResult
  const core = canonicalSession.core_metrics;
  let csvSummary = 'session_id,metric_id,value,unit,eligibility_state,included_beat_count,excluded_beat_count,analysis_window_seconds,method_name,method_version,protocol_authority\n';
  
  const summaryRows = [
    core.rmssd,
    core.sdnn,
    core.pnn50,
    core.mean_hr_bpm,
    core.mean_rr_ms
  ];

  for (const m of summaryRows) {
    const valStr = m.value !== null ? m.value.toFixed(m.precision_decimals) : '';
    csvSummary += `${session.id},${m.metric_id},${valStr},${m.unit},${m.eligibility_state},${m.included_beat_count},${m.excluded_beat_count},${m.analysis_window_seconds},"${m.method_name}",${m.method_version},${m.protocol_authority}\n`;
  }

  // 4. Build 5-minute rolling HRV metrics using authoritative analytical primitives
  let csvHrvWindows = 'timestamp_offset_ms,rmssd_ms,sdnn_ms,pnn50_percent\n';
  const cleanNns = beatLedger.clean_nn_intervals;
  if (cleanNns.length >= 50) {
    // Generate 5-min rolling windows (300s window at 60s step)
    const windowDurationMs = 300 * 1000;
    const stepMs = 60 * 1000;
    
    // Construct cumulative beat timing
    let curOffsetMs = 0;
    const timedBeats: { offsetMs: number; rr: number }[] = [];
    for (const rr of cleanNns) {
      timedBeats.push({ offsetMs: curOffsetMs, rr });
      curOffsetMs += rr;
    }

    const totalDurationMs = curOffsetMs;
    for (let wStart = 0; wStart + windowDurationMs <= totalDurationMs; wStart += stepMs) {
      const wEnd = wStart + windowDurationMs;
      const wRrs = timedBeats
        .filter(b => b.offsetMs >= wStart && b.offsetMs < wEnd)
        .map(b => b.rr);

      if (wRrs.length >= 50) {
        const metrics = calculateHrvMetrics(wRrs);
        if (metrics && metrics.rmssd !== null && metrics.sdnn !== null && metrics.pnn50 !== null) {
          csvHrvWindows += `${wStart + windowDurationMs / 2},${metrics.rmssd.toFixed(1)},${metrics.sdnn.toFixed(1)},${metrics.pnn50.toFixed(1)}\n`;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Fetch Quality and Trends summaries
  const db = getDb();
  const qcRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
  const metricsRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;

  const annRow = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
  const activityType = annRow?.activity_type || 'unknown';

  const allSessions = await CanonicalTrendObservationService.getTrendObservationsForUser(session.user_id || 'default', activityType);
  const trendsResult = interpretTrends(allSessions, session.id);

  const presentationSummary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession,
    qcMetrics: qcRow,
    analyticsMetrics: metricsRow
  });

  const qualitySummary = {
    session_id: session.id,
    canonical_source_bundle_id: canonicalSession.source_bundle_id,
    canonical_source_identity: canonicalSession.source_bundle_manifest?.immutable_source_identity,
    total_beats: canonicalSession.quality_summary.total_beats,
    accepted_nn_beats: canonicalSession.quality_summary.accepted_nn_beats,
    excluded_beats: canonicalSession.quality_summary.excluded_beats,
    artifact_percentage: canonicalSession.quality_summary.artifact_percentage,
    task_eligibility: canonicalSession.task_eligibility,
    monotonicity_status: qcRow?.monotonicity_status ?? null,
    missing_samples_count: qcRow?.missing_samples_count ?? null,
    duplicate_timestamps_count: qcRow?.duplicate_timestamps_count ?? null,
    ecg_clipping_seconds: canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality
      ? canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.technical_quality.clipping.value
      : null,
    ecg_noise_ratio: canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality
      ? canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.technical_quality.noisy_window_fraction.value
      : null,
    ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality
      ? canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.technical_quality.baseline_drift.value
      : null,
    acc_motion_severity: canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null,
    ecg_rr_consistency: null,
    ecg_rr_agreement: presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement,
    legacy_overall_quality_score: canonicalSession.quality_summary.legacy_overall_quality_score,
    is_legacy_score_authoritative: false
  };

  const userId = session.user_id || 'default';
  const user = getUser(userId);
  const zoneConfig = canonicalSession?.heart_rate_zones?.configuration;
  const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;
  const hasValidCanonicalZones = !!(zoneConfig && Array.isArray(zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm) && zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[5] > 0);

  const resolvedZones = hasValidCanonicalZones ? {
    mode: zoneConfig!.mode,
    source: zoneConfig!.source,
    boundariesBpm: zoneConfig!.boundaries_bpm,
    configHash: zoneConfig!.config_hash,
    updatedAt: undefined
  } : (!isCanonical ? resolveHeartRateZones({
    max_hr: user?.max_hr ?? 185,
    resting_hr: user?.resting_hr ?? 60,
    custom_zones: user?.custom_zones
  }, user?.age ?? 35) : null);

  const metadata = {
    session_id: session.id,
    user_id: userId,
    age: user?.age ?? 35,
    resting_hr: user?.resting_hr ?? 60,
    max_hr: user?.max_hr ?? 185,
    zones_source: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.source : null,
    zones_mode: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.mode : null,
    zones_boundaries_bpm: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.boundariesBpm : null,
    zones_updated_at: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.updatedAt : null,
    zones_config_hash: resolvedZones ? resolvedZones.configHash : null,
    canonical_provenance: canonicalSession.provenance,
    canonical_timing: canonicalSession.timing,
    safety_claim: presentationSummary.safety_claim
  };

  const trendsSummary = {
    baseline_source: trendsResult.baseline_source,
    baseline_confidence: trendsResult.baseline_confidence,
    personal_baseline_available: trendsResult.personal_baseline_available,
    sessions_used: trendsResult.sessions_used,
    baseline_corridors: {
      rmssd_ms: {
        median: trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.median,
        p25: trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p25,
        p75: trendsResult.baseline.rmssd_ms.p75
      },
      sdnn_ms: {
        median: trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.median,
        p25: trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p25,
        p75: trendsResult.baseline.sdnn_ms.p75
      },
      pnn50_percent: {
        median: trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.median,
        p25: trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p25,
        p75: trendsResult.baseline.pnn50_percent.p75
      },
      avg_hr_bpm: {
        median: trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.median,
        p25: trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p25,
        p75: trendsResult.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p75
      }
    }
  };

  const readmeContent = `# H10 Athlete Cardio Lab — Exported Session Metrics Data

This archive contains standardized 1Hz, beat-by-beat, summary metrics, and rolling HRV for local analysis.

## Files included:
1. \`session_summary_metrics.csv\`: Canonical session-level core metrics (RMSSD, SDNN, pNN50, mean HR/RR) with metric-specific task eligibility.
2. \`session_beat_by_beat.csv\`: Forensic beat-by-beat RR interval ledger, sensor timestamps, parse status, and NN classification.
3. \`session_1hz_metrics.csv\`: Downsampled heart rate (bpm) and motion magnitude (G).
4. \`hrv_windows.csv\`: 5-minute rolling HRV metrics (RMSSD, SDNN, pNN50) computed at 1-minute steps.
5. \`quality_summary.json\`: Canonical data quality metrics, task eligibility, and channel agreement.
6. \`metadata.json\`: Workout details, canonical timing, and provenance authorities.
7. \`trends_summary.json\`: Baseline corridors and longitudinal trends summary data.

## Non-Diagnostic Notice
This data is for athletic wellness and research exploration only. Not for medical diagnosis or medical treatment.
`;

  const manifestContent = {
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    session_id: session.id,
    canonical_source_bundle_id: canonicalSession.source_bundle_id,
    files: [
      { name: 'session_summary_metrics.csv', description: 'Canonical session-level core metrics and eligibility.' },
      { name: 'session_beat_by_beat.csv', description: 'Canonical beat-by-beat RR ledger and classification.' },
      { name: 'session_1hz_metrics.csv', description: '1Hz downsampled heart rate and ACC magnitude series.' },
      { name: 'hrv_windows.csv', description: '5-minute rolling HRV metrics.' },
      { name: 'quality_summary.json', description: 'Data quality metrics and task eligibility summary.' },
      { name: 'metadata.json', description: 'Session metadata, canonical timing, and zones configuration.' },
      { name: 'trends_summary.json', description: 'Baseline corridors and longitudinal trends summary.' },
      { name: 'README_METRICS.md', description: 'Data descriptions, units, and non-diagnostic notices.' }
    ]
  };

  // Pack into ZIP
  const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

  archive.append(csv1hz, { name: 'session_1hz_metrics.csv' });
  archive.append(csvBeat, { name: 'session_beat_by_beat.csv' });
  archive.append(csvSummary, { name: 'session_summary_metrics.csv' });
  archive.append(csvHrvWindows, { name: 'hrv_windows.csv' });
  archive.append(JSON.stringify(qualitySummary, null, 2), { name: 'quality_summary.json' });
  archive.append(JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2), { name: 'metadata.json' });
  archive.append(JSON.stringify(trendsSummary, null, 2), { name: 'trends_summary.json' });
  archive.append(readmeContent, { name: 'README_METRICS.md' });
  archive.append(JSON.stringify(manifestContent, null, 2), { name: 'MANIFEST.json' });
  
  archive.finalize();

  return archive;
}

/**
 * Generates the aggregate metrics CSV content projecting from CanonicalSessionResult.
 * Returns text/csv format with UTF-8 BOM.
 */
export function generateMetricsCsvFile(
  session: SessionMetadata, 
  metrics?: SessionMetrics | null,
  qcMetricsOrCanonical?: any,
  canonicalSessionArg?: CanonicalSessionResult | null
): string {
  let qcRow: any = null;
  let canonicalSession: CanonicalSessionResult | null = null;

  if (qcMetricsOrCanonical && (qcMetricsOrCanonical.schema_version === '1.0.0' || qcMetricsOrCanonical.core_metrics)) {
    canonicalSession = qcMetricsOrCanonical;
  } else if (qcMetricsOrCanonical) {
    qcRow = qcMetricsOrCanonical;
    canonicalSession = canonicalSessionArg || null;
  } else {
    canonicalSession = canonicalSessionArg || null;
  }

  const prov = getSessionProvenance(metrics?.hrv_version);
  const db = getDb();
  if (!qcRow && db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
    try {
      qcRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
    } catch {}
  }

  const summary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession,
    qcMetrics: qcRow,
    analyticsMetrics: metrics || undefined
  });

  const agreementPres = summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.presentation;

  const headers = [
    'session_id',
    'metric_name',
    'value',
    'unit',
    'eligibility_state',
    'availability_status',
    'availability_reason',
    'blocking_reasons',
    'warnings',
    'limitations',
    'included_beat_count',
    'excluded_beat_count',
    'analysis_window_seconds',
    'method_name',
    'method_version',
    'protocol_authority',
    'app_build_version',
    'canonical_schema_version',
    'source_bundle_id',
    'evidence_mode',
    'technical_signal_alignment_quality',
    'technical_signal_alignment_label',
    'legacy_overall_quality_score_non_authoritative'
  ];

  const escape = (val: any): string => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
    const str = String(val);
    if (str.includes(',') || str.includes('"') || str.includes('\n')) {
      return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    }
    return str;
  };

  const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;
  const bundleId = canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || 'unknown_bundle';
  const buildVer = canonicalSession?.provenance.build_version || prov.algorithm_version;
  const schemaVer = canonicalSession?.provenance.canonical_schema_version || '1.0.0';
  const protoAuth = canonicalSession?.provenance.protocol_version ? `Frozen Protocol v${canonicalSession.provenance.protocol_version}` : 'Frozen Protocol v1.1';
  const methodVer = canonicalSession?.provenance.method_version || '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD';

  const rows: any[][] = [];

  if (canonicalSession) {
    const cm = canonicalSession.core_metrics;
    const timing = canonicalSession.timing;
    const te = canonicalSession.task_eligibility;

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'rmssd',
      cm.rmssd.value != null ? cm.rmssd.value.toFixed(1) : '',
      'ms',
      cm.rmssd.eligibility_state,
      cm.rmssd.value != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      cm.rmssd.warnings.join(';') || '',
      (te.rmssd?.blocking_reasons || []).join(';'),
      cm.rmssd.warnings.join(';'),
      cm.rmssd.limitations.join(';'),
      cm.rmssd.included_beat_count,
      cm.rmssd.excluded_beat_count,
      timing.duration_seconds,
      cm.rmssd.method_name,
      cm.rmssd.method_version || methodVer,
      cm.rmssd.protocol_authority || protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'CANONICAL',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'sdnn',
      cm.sdnn.value != null ? cm.sdnn.value.toFixed(1) : '',
      'ms',
      cm.sdnn.eligibility_state,
      cm.sdnn.value != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      cm.sdnn.warnings.join(';') || '',
      (te.sdnn?.blocking_reasons || []).join(';'),
      cm.sdnn.warnings.join(';'),
      cm.sdnn.limitations.join(';'),
      cm.sdnn.included_beat_count,
      cm.sdnn.excluded_beat_count,
      timing.duration_seconds,
      cm.sdnn.method_name,
      cm.sdnn.method_version || methodVer,
      cm.sdnn.protocol_authority || protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'CANONICAL',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'pnn50',
      cm.pnn50.value != null ? cm.pnn50.value.toFixed(1) : '',
      '%',
      cm.pnn50.eligibility_state,
      cm.pnn50.value != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      cm.pnn50.warnings.join(';') || '',
      (te.pnn50?.blocking_reasons || []).join(';'),
      cm.pnn50.warnings.join(';'),
      cm.pnn50.limitations.join(';'),
      cm.pnn50.included_beat_count,
      cm.pnn50.excluded_beat_count,
      timing.duration_seconds,
      cm.pnn50.method_name,
      cm.pnn50.method_version || methodVer,
      cm.pnn50.protocol_authority || protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'CANONICAL',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'mean_hr_bpm',
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.value != null ? cm.mean_hr_bpm.value.toFixed(1) : '',
      'bpm',
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.eligibility_state,
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.value != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.warnings.join(';') || '',
      (te.mean_hr_rr?.blocking_reasons || []).join(';'),
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.warnings.join(';'),
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.limitations.join(';'),
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.included_beat_count,
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.excluded_beat_count,
      timing.duration_seconds,
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.method_name,
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.method_version || methodVer,
      cm.mean_hr_bpm.protocol_authority || protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'CANONICAL',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);
  } else {
    // Legacy unverified fallback row projections
    const rmssdVal = metrics?.rmssd ?? null;
    const sdnnVal = metrics?.sdnn ?? null;
    const pnn50Val = metrics?.pnn50 ?? null;
    const elig = metrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (metrics?.hrv_quality ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE');

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'rmssd',
      rmssdVal != null ? rmssdVal.toFixed(1) : '',
      'ms',
      elig,
      rmssdVal != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      rmssdVal != null ? 'legacy_unverified_source' : 'insufficient_valid_rr',
      'Legacy unverified analysis: source files not recomputed under Frozen Protocol v1.1',
      metrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'Legacy quality limited' : '',
      'Legacy observation; not verified by CanonicalBeatLedger',
      0,
      0,
      session.duration_seconds,
      'Root Mean Square of Successive Differences',
      prov.algorithm_version,
      protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'sdnn',
      sdnnVal != null ? sdnnVal.toFixed(1) : '',
      'ms',
      elig,
      sdnnVal != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      sdnnVal != null ? 'legacy_unverified_source' : 'insufficient_valid_rr',
      'Legacy unverified analysis: source files not recomputed under Frozen Protocol v1.1',
      metrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'Legacy quality limited' : '',
      'Legacy observation; not verified by CanonicalBeatLedger',
      0,
      0,
      session.duration_seconds,
      'Sample Standard Deviation of NN intervals',
      prov.algorithm_version,
      protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'pnn50',
      pnn50Val != null ? pnn50Val.toFixed(1) : '',
      '%',
      elig,
      pnn50Val != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      pnn50Val != null ? 'legacy_unverified_source' : 'insufficient_valid_rr',
      'Legacy unverified analysis: source files not recomputed under Frozen Protocol v1.1',
      metrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'Legacy quality limited' : '',
      'Legacy observation; not verified by CanonicalBeatLedger',
      0,
      0,
      session.duration_seconds,
      'Percentage of successive NN differences > 50 ms',
      prov.algorithm_version,
      protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);

    rows.push([
      session.id,
      'mean_hr_bpm',
      session.avg_hr != null ? session.avg_hr.toFixed(1) : '',
      'bpm',
      session.avg_hr != null ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
      session.avg_hr != null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
      session.avg_hr != null ? 'legacy_unverified_source' : 'no_hr_data',
      'Legacy unverified analysis: source files not recomputed under Frozen Protocol v1.1',
      '',
      'Legacy observation; not verified by CanonicalBeatLedger',
      0,
      0,
      session.duration_seconds,
      'Mean Heart Rate',
      prov.algorithm_version,
      protoAuth,
      buildVer,
      schemaVer,
      bundleId,
      'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
      agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
      agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
      session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
    ]);
  }

  // Add ECG/RR agreement technical row
  rows.push([
    session.id,
    'ecg_rr_agreement',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent !== null ? summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent.toString() : 'null',
    '%',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.eligibility_status === 'eligible' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent !== null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_rr_agreement.status_category || '',
    '',
    '',
    '',
    0,
    0,
    session.duration_seconds,
    'ECG vs RR Interval Agreement',
    prov.algorithm_version,
    protoAuth,
    buildVer,
    schemaVer,
    bundleId,
    isCanonical ? 'CANONICAL' : 'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
    agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
    agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
    session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
  ]);

  // Technical Quality QC rows (strictly canonical if canonicalSession exists)
  rows.push([
    session.id,
    'ecg_clipping_seconds',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds !== null ? summary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds.toFixed(1) : '',
    's',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds !== null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
    '',
    '',
    '',
    '',
    0,
    0,
    session.duration_seconds,
    'ECG Amplitude Bounds Clipping Assessment',
    prov.algorithm_version,
    protoAuth,
    buildVer,
    schemaVer,
    bundleId,
    isCanonical ? 'CANONICAL' : 'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
    agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
    agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
    session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
  ]);

  rows.push([
    session.id,
    'ecg_noise_ratio',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_noise_ratio !== null ? summary.technical_qc.ecg_noise_ratio.toFixed(2) : '',

    summary.technical_qc.ecg_noise_ratio !== null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
    '',

    0,
    0,
    session.duration_seconds,
    'ECG Window Noise Ratio Assessment',
    prov.algorithm_version,
    protoAuth,
    buildVer,
    schemaVer,
    bundleId,
    isCanonical ? 'CANONICAL' : 'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
    agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
    agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
    session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
  ]);

  rows.push([
    session.id,
    'ecg_baseline_drift_ratio',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio !== null ? summary.technical_qc.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio.toFixed(2) : '',
    'ratio',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
    summary.technical_qc.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio !== null ? 'available' : 'unavailable',
    '',
    '',
    '',
    '',
    0,
    0,
    session.duration_seconds,
    'ECG Baseline Drift Assessment',
    prov.algorithm_version,
    protoAuth,
    buildVer,
    schemaVer,
    bundleId,
    isCanonical ? 'CANONICAL' : 'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
    agreementPres.availabilityStatus,
    agreementPres.technicalInterpretationKey,
    session.overall_quality_score ?? ''
  ]);

  const csvContent = [
    headers.map(escape).join(','),
    ...rows.map(row => row.map(escape).join(','))
  ].join('\r\n');

  return '\uFEFF' + csvContent;
}

/**
 * Generates standalone RR CSV file from CanonicalSessionResult / CanonicalBeatLedger.
 */
export function generateRrCsvFile(
  session: SessionMetadata,
  metrics?: SessionMetrics | null,
  rrPoints?: { timeMs: number; rrMs: number }[],
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null
): string {
  if (canonicalSession && canonicalSession.canonical_beat_ledger) {
    const headers = [
      'beat_index',
      'source_row_index',
      'phone_timestamp_str',
      'phone_timestamp_ms',
      'sensor_timestamp_ns',
      'relative_timestamp_ms',
      'raw_rr_ms',
      'raw_is_valid',
      'parse_status',
      'classification_status',
      'exclusion_reasons',
      'instantaneous_hr_bpm'
    ];
    const rows = canonicalSession.canonical_beat_ledger.beats.map(b => {
      const rawRr = b.raw_rr_ms != null ? b.raw_rr_ms.toFixed(1) : '';
      const sensorNs = b.sensor_timestamp_ns != null ? b.sensor_timestamp_ns.toString() : '';
      const phoneMs = b.phone_timestamp_ms != null ? b.phone_timestamp_ms.toString() : '';
      const instHr = b.instantaneous_hr_bpm != null ? b.instantaneous_hr_bpm.toFixed(1) : '';
      const excl = b.exclusion_reasons && b.exclusion_reasons.length > 0 ? `"${b.exclusion_reasons.join(';')}"` : '';
      return `${b.beat_index},${b.source_row_index},${b.phone_timestamp_str || ''},${phoneMs},${sensorNs},${b.relative_timestamp_ms ?? ''},${rawRr},${b.raw_is_valid ?? ''},${b.parser_status},${b.classification_status},${excl},${instHr}`;
    });
    return '\uFEFF' + [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\r\n');
  }

  // Legacy fallback if no canonical session provided
  const startMs = new Date(session.start_time).getTime();
  const headers = ['offset_ms', 'rr_ms', 'inst_hr'];
  const rows = (rrPoints || []).map(pt => {
    const offset = pt.timeMs - startMs;
    const hr = pt.rrMs > 0 ? (60000 / pt.rrMs).toFixed(1) : '';
    return `${offset},${pt.rrMs},${hr}`;
  });
  return '\uFEFF' + [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\r\n');
}

/**
 * src/backend/reports/exportDb.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G23 — Authoritative Database Repository for Export Workspace.
 * Encapsulates transactional CRUD for export plans, durable jobs, job items,
 * and artifact manifests in SQLite.
