import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  ExportPlan,
  ExportJobSnapshot,
  ExportJobItemSnapshot,
  ExportArtifactManifest,
  ExportHistoryPage,
  ExportHistoryRow,
  ExportJobStatus,
  ExportItemStatus,
  ExportArtifactStatus,
  ExportFormat
} from '../../shared/canonical/ExportWorkspaceContract';

export function saveExportPlan(plan: ExportPlan): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO export_plans (
      plan_id,
      plan_hash,
      session_id,
      profile_id,
      workspace_fingerprint,
      plan_json,
      expires_at_utc,
      created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(plan_id) DO UPDATE SET
      plan_hash = excluded.plan_hash,
      workspace_fingerprint = excluded.workspace_fingerprint,
      plan_json = excluded.plan_json,
      expires_at_utc = excluded.expires_at_utc
  `);
  stmt.run(
    plan.plan_id,
    plan.plan_hash,
    plan.session_id,
    plan.profile_id,
    plan.workspace_fingerprint,
    JSON.stringify(plan),
    plan.expires_at_utc,
    plan.created_at_utc
  );
}

export function getExportPlan(planId: string): ExportPlan | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT plan_hash, plan_json FROM export_plans WHERE plan_id = ?').get(planId) as { plan_hash: string; plan_json: string } | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  try {
    const plan = JSON.parse(row.plan_json) as ExportPlan;
    if (row.plan_hash) {
      plan.plan_hash = row.plan_hash;
    }
    return plan;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function createExportJob(job: ExportJobSnapshot): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const runTx = db.transaction(() => {
    const jobStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO export_jobs (
        job_id,
        plan_id,
        batch_id,
        status,
        progress_percent,
        total_items,
        completed_items,
        failed_items,
        skipped_items,
        plan_hash,
        idempotency_key,
        correlation_id,
        error_message,
        created_at_utc,
        updated_at_utc,
        completed_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);

    jobStmt.run(
      job.job_id,
      job.plan_id,
      job.batch_id || null,
      job.status,
      job.progress_percent,
      job.total_items,
      job.completed_items,
      job.failed_items,
      job.skipped_items,
      job.plan_hash,
      job.idempotency_key || null,
      job.correlation_id,
      job.error_message || null,
      job.created_at_utc,
      job.updated_at_utc,
      job.completed_at_utc || null
    );

    if (job.items && job.items.length > 0) {
      const itemStmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO export_job_items (
          item_id,
          job_id,
          session_id,
          format,
          status,
          expected_revision,
          artifact_path,
          size_bytes,
          sha256,
          error_message,
          completed_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      for (const item of job.items) {
        itemStmt.run(
          item.item_id,
          item.job_id,
          item.session_id,
          item.format,
          item.status,
          item.expected_revision,
          item.artifact_path || null,
          item.size_bytes !== null && item.size_bytes !== undefined ? item.size_bytes : null,
          item.sha256 || null,
          item.error_message || null,
          item.completed_at_utc || null
        );
      }
    }
  });

  runTx();
}

export function getExportJob(jobId: string): ExportJobSnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM export_jobs WHERE job_id = ?').get(jobId) as any;
  if (!row) return null;

  const items = getExportJobItems(jobId);
  const artifacts = getExportArtifactManifestsByJob(jobId);

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    job_id: row.job_id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    batch_id: row.batch_id,
    status: row.status as ExportJobStatus,
    progress_percent: row.progress_percent,
    total_items: row.total_items,
    completed_items: row.completed_items,
    failed_items: row.failed_items,
    skipped_items: row.skipped_items,
    plan_hash: row.plan_hash,
    idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key,
    correlation_id: row.correlation_id,
    error_message: row.error_message,
    items,
    artifacts,
    created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc,
    completed_at_utc: row.completed_at_utc
  };
}

export function getExportJobByIdempotencyKey(key: string): ExportJobSnapshot | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT job_id FROM export_jobs WHERE idempotency_key = ?').get(key) as { job_id: string } | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  return getExportJob(row.job_id);
}

export function getExportJobItems(jobId: string): ExportJobItemSnapshot[] {
  const db = getDb();
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM export_job_items WHERE job_id = ? ORDER BY rowid ASC').all(jobId) as any[];
  return rows.map(r => ({
    item_id: r.item_id,
    job_id: r.job_id,
    session_id: r.session_id,
    format: r.format as ExportFormat,
    status: r.status as ExportItemStatus,
    expected_revision: r.expected_revision,
    artifact_path: r.artifact_path,
    size_bytes: r.size_bytes,
    sha256: r.sha256,
    error_message: r.error_message,
    completed_at_utc: r.completed_at_utc
  }));
}

export function updateExportJobProgress(jobId: string, updates: Partial<ExportJobSnapshot>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const current = getExportJob(jobId);
  if (!current) return;

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const nextStatus = updates.status || current.status;
  const nextProgress = updates.progress_percent !== undefined ? updates.progress_percent : current.progress_percent;
  const nextCompleted = updates.completed_items !== undefined ? updates.completed_items : current.completed_items;
  const nextFailed = updates.failed_items !== undefined ? updates.failed_items : current.failed_items;
  const nextSkipped = updates.skipped_items !== undefined ? updates.skipped_items : current.skipped_items;
  const nextError = updates.error_message !== undefined ? updates.error_message : current.error_message;
  const completedAt = ['completed', 'failed', 'partial', 'stale'].includes(nextStatus) ? (updates.completed_at_utc || now) : current.completed_at_utc;

  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE export_jobs SET
      status = ?,
      progress_percent = ?,
      completed_items = ?,
      failed_items = ?,
      skipped_items = ?,
      error_message = ?,
      updated_at_utc = ?,
      completed_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ?
  `).run(
    nextStatus,
    nextProgress,
    nextCompleted,
    nextFailed,
    nextSkipped,
    nextError,
    now,
    completedAt,
    jobId
  );
}

export function updateExportJobItem(itemId: string, updates: Partial<ExportJobItemSnapshot>): void {
  const db = getDb();
  const setClauses: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (updates.status !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('status = ?');
    params.push(updates.status);
  }
  if (updates.artifact_path !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('artifact_path = ?');
    params.push(updates.artifact_path);
  }
  if (updates.size_bytes !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('size_bytes = ?');
    params.push(updates.size_bytes);
  }
  if (updates.sha256 !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('sha256 = ?');
    params.push(updates.sha256);
  }
  if (updates.error_message !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('error_message = ?');
    params.push(updates.error_message);
  }
  if (updates.completed_at_utc !== undefined) {
    setClauses.push('completed_at_utc = ?');
    params.push(updates.completed_at_utc);
  }

  if (setClauses.length === 0) return;

  params.push(itemId);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE export_job_items SET ${setClauses.join(', ')} WHERE item_id = ?`).run(...params);
}

export function claimJobLease(jobId: string, leaseOwner: string, leaseDurationMs: number): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + leaseDurationMs).toISOString();
  const nowIso = now.toISOString();

  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE export_jobs SET
      lease_owner = ?,
      lease_expires_at_utc = ?,
      updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ? AND (
      lease_owner IS NULL OR
      lease_owner = ? OR
      lease_expires_at_utc < ?
    )
  `).run(leaseOwner, expiresAt, nowIso, jobId, leaseOwner, nowIso);

  return Number(res.changes) > 0;
}

export function releaseJobLease(jobId: string, leaseOwner: string): boolean {
  const db = getDb();
  const res = db.prepare(`
    UPDATE export_jobs SET
      lease_owner = NULL,
      lease_expires_at_utc = NULL,
      updated_at_utc = ?
    WHERE job_id = ? AND lease_owner = ?
  `).run(new Date().toISOString(), jobId, leaseOwner);

  return Number(res.changes) > 0;
}

  window_revision?: number | null;
  dependencyFingerprint?: string;
  dependency_fingerprint?: string;
}): ExportArtifactManifest | null {
  const db = getDb();
  const profileId = params.profileId || params.profile_id || '';
  const episodeId = params.episodeId || params.episode_id || '';
  const sessionId = params.sessionId || params.session_id || '';
  const contextType = params.contextType || params.context_type || '';
  const windowRootId = params.windowRootId !== undefined ? params.windowRootId : (params.window_root_id !== undefined ? params.window_root_id : null);
  const windowRevision = params.windowRevision !== undefined ? params.windowRevision : (params.window_revision !== undefined ? params.window_revision : null);
  const dependencyFingerprint = params.dependencyFingerprint || params.dependency_fingerprint || '';

  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM export_artifact_manifests
    WHERE profile_id = ? AND episode_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND context_type = ?
      AND (window_root_id IS ? OR (window_root_id IS NULL AND ? IS NULL))
      AND (window_revision IS ? OR (window_revision IS NULL AND ? IS NULL))
      AND dependency_fingerprint = ? AND status = 'completed'
    ORDER BY generated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
  `).all(
    profileId,
    episodeId,
    sessionId,
    contextType,
    windowRootId || null,
    windowRootId || null,
    windowRevision !== undefined && windowRevision !== null ? windowRevision : null,
    windowRevision !== undefined && windowRevision !== null ? windowRevision : null,
    dependencyFingerprint
  ) as any[];

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const row = rows[0];
  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    manifest_id: row.manifest_id,
    job_id: row.job_id,
    plan_id: row.plan_id,
    session_id: row.session_id,
    format: row.format as ExportFormat,
    filename: row.filename,
    staging_path: row.staging_path,
    published_path: row.published_path,
    size_bytes: row.size_bytes,
    sha256: row.sha256,
    status: row.status as ExportArtifactStatus,
    canonical_result_hash: row.canonical_result_hash,
    privacy_level: row.privacy_level,
    sensitive_opt_ins: JSON.parse(row.sensitive_opt_ins_json || '{}'),
    generated_at_utc: row.generated_at_utc,
    validated_at_utc: row.validated_at_utc,
    profile_id: row.profile_id || null,
    episode_id: row.episode_id || null,
    context_type: row.context_type || null,
    window_root_id: row.window_root_id || null,
    window_revision: row.window_revision !== null && row.window_revision !== undefined ? Number(row.window_revision) : null,
    window_result_identity: row.window_result_identity || null,
    beat_ledger_hash: row.beat_ledger_hash || null,
    dependency_fingerprint: row.dependency_fingerprint || null,
    export_preset_version: row.export_preset_version || '1.0.0'
  };
}

export function queryExportHistory(options: {
  page?: number;
  pageSize?: number;
  profileId?: string;
  sessionId?: string;
  status?: string;
}): ExportHistoryPage {
  const db = getDb();
  const page = Math.max(1, options.page || 1);
  const pageSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, options.pageSize || 20));
  const offset = (page - 1) * pageSize;

  const whereClauses: string[] = [];
  const params: any[] = [];

  if (options.sessionId) {
    whereClauses.push('m.session_id = ?');
    params.push(options.sessionId);
  }
  if (options.status) {
    whereClauses.push('m.status = ?');
    params.push(options.status);
  }
  if (options.profileId) {
    whereClauses.push('s.user_id = ?');
    params.push(options.profileId);
  }

  const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';

  const countRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total
    FROM export_artifact_manifests m
    LEFT JOIN sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id
    ${whereSql}
  `).get(...params) as { total: number };

  const totalCount = countRow ? countRow.total : 0;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize);

  const queryParams = [...params, pageSize, offset];
  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT
      m.manifest_id,
      m.job_id,
      m.session_id,
      s.user_id as profile_id,
      u.display_name as profile_name,
      sa.activity_type,
      m.format,
      m.filename,
      m.size_bytes,
      m.sha256,
      m.status,
      m.staging_path,
      m.published_path,
      m.generated_at_utc
    FROM export_artifact_manifests m
    LEFT JOIN sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN session_annotations sa ON m.session_id = sa.session_id
    ${whereSql}
    ORDER BY m.generated_at_utc DESC
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
  `).all(...queryParams) as any[];

  const fs = require('fs');

  const historyRows: ExportHistoryRow[] = rows.map(r => {
    const targetFile = r.published_path || r.staging_path;
    let isAvailable = false;
    try {
      if (targetFile && fs.existsSync(targetFile)) {
        isAvailable = true;
      }
    } catch {
      isAvailable = false;
    }

    return {
      manifest_id: r.manifest_id,
      job_id: r.job_id,
      session_id: r.session_id,
      profile_id: r.profile_id || 'default',
      profile_name: r.profile_name || null,
      activity_type: r.activity_type || null,
      format: r.format as ExportFormat,
      filename: r.filename,
      staging_path: r.staging_path,
      published_path: r.published_path || null,
      size_bytes: r.size_bytes,
      sha256: r.sha256,
      status: (isAvailable ? r.status : 'artifact_unavailable') as ExportArtifactStatus,
      is_available: isAvailable,
      generated_at_utc: r.generated_at_utc
    };
  });

  return {
    total_count: totalCount,
    page,
    page_size: pageSize,
    total_pages: totalPages,
    rows: historyRows
  };
}

/**
 * src/backend/reports/exportDestinationValidator.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G23 — Authoritative Destination Path & Staging Validator.
 * Prevents path traversal, device name poisoning, arbitrary filesystem escape,
 * and handles atomic staging with streaming SHA-256 verification.
 */

import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  DestinationPathSecurityError,
  validateDestinationFilename,
  validateDestinationDirectory
} from '../../shared/canonical/ExportWorkspaceContract';

export interface StagingFileContext {
  jobId: string;
  filename: string;
  stagingFilePath: string;
  writeStream: fs.WriteStream;
  hasher: crypto.Hash;
  bytesWritten: number;
}

export class ExportDestinationService {
  private baseStagingDir: string;

  constructor(customStagingDir?: string) {
    if (customStagingDir) {
      this.baseStagingDir = customStagingDir;
    } else {
      // Default to appData or .agy/export_staging inside workspace
      this.baseStagingDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.agy', 'export_staging');
    }
  }

  public getStagingDirectory(jobId: string): string {
    validateDestinationFilename(jobId);
    const stagingDir = path.join(this.baseStagingDir, jobId);
    fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
    return stagingDir;
  }

  public sanitizeFilename(proposed: string, fallback = 'export_artifact'): string {
    if (!proposed || typeof proposed !== 'string') return `${fallback}_${Date.now()}`;
    // Replace forbidden characters
    let clean = proposed.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\0]/g, '_').trim();
    // Strip leading/trailing dots or spaces
    clean = clean.replace(/^[.\s]+|[.\s]+$/g, '');
    const baseName = clean.split('.')[0].toUpperCase();
    const reservedDosNames = /^(CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9]|LPT[1-9])$/;
    if (reservedDosNames.test(baseName)) {
      clean = `safe_${clean}`;
    }
    return clean || `${fallback}_${Date.now()}`;
  }

  public createStagingWriter(jobId: string, filename: string): StagingFileContext {
    validateDestinationFilename(filename);
    const stagingDir = this.getStagingDirectory(jobId);
    const stagingFilePath = path.join(stagingDir, filename);

    // Ensure stagingFilePath is strictly within stagingDir
    const rel = path.relative(stagingDir, stagingFilePath);
    if (rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) {
      throw new DestinationPathSecurityError(`Staging path escapes staging directory: ${filename}`);
    }

    const writeStream = fs.createWriteStream(stagingFilePath);
    const hasher = crypto.createHash('sha256');

    return {
      jobId,
      filename,
      stagingFilePath,
      writeStream,
      hasher,
      bytesWritten: 0
    };
  }

  public async finalizeStagingFile(
    ctx: StagingFileContext,
    buffer?: Buffer
  ): Promise<{ sizeBytes: number; sha256: string }> {
    if (buffer) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        ctx.hasher.update(buffer);
        const sha256 = ctx.hasher.digest('hex');
        const sizeBytes = buffer.length;

        fs.writeFile(ctx.stagingFilePath, buffer, (err) => {
          if (err) return reject(err);
          resolve({ sizeBytes, sha256 });
        });
      });
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ctx.writeStream.end(() => {
        try {
          const stat = fs.statSync(ctx.stagingFilePath);
          const sha256 = ctx.hasher.digest('hex');
          resolve({ sizeBytes: stat.size, sha256 });
        } catch (e) {
          reject(e);
        }
      });
      ctx.writeStream.on('error', reject);
    });
  }

  public publishFile(
    stagingFilePath: string,
    targetDirectory: string,
    filename: string,
    allowedRoot?: string
  ): { publishedPath: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string } {
    validateDestinationFilename(filename);
    validateDestinationDirectory(targetDirectory, allowedRoot);

    if (!fs.existsSync(stagingFilePath)) {
      throw new Error(`Staging file does not exist: ${stagingFilePath}`);
    }

    const resolvedTargetDir = path.resolve(targetDirectory);
    fs.mkdirSync(resolvedTargetDir, { recursive: true });

    const targetPath = path.join(resolvedTargetDir, filename);

    // Verify target path does not escape target directory
    const rel = path.relative(resolvedTargetDir, targetPath);
    if (rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) {
      throw new DestinationPathSecurityError(`Target path escapes target directory: ${filename}`);
    }

    // Atomic move or copy
    const stat = fs.statSync(stagingFilePath);
    const data = fs.readFileSync(stagingFilePath);
    const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');

    const tempTarget = `${targetPath}.tmp-${Date.now()}`;
    fs.writeFileSync(tempTarget, data);
    fs.renameSync(tempTarget, targetPath);

    return {
      publishedPath: targetPath,
      sizeBytes: stat.size,
      sha256
    };
  }

  public cleanupStaging(jobId: string): void {
    try {
      const stagingDir = path.join(this.baseStagingDir, jobId);
      if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
        fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
    } catch {
      // Best-effort cleanup
    }
  }
}

export const defaultExportDestinationService = new ExportDestinationService();

/**

 * CardioLab G23 — Authoritative Export Job Execution Engine.

import * as fs from 'fs';

export class ExportJobService {
  /**
   * Builds authoritative ExportWorkspaceSnapshot grounded in CanonicalSessionResult.
   */
  public async buildExportWorkspaceSnapshot(
    sessionId: string,
    profileId?: string
  ): Promise<ExportWorkspaceSnapshot> {
    const db = getDb();
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as SessionMetadata | undefined;
    if (!session) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Session not found: ${sessionId}`);
    }

    if (profileId && session.user_id && session.user_id !== profileId) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Session '${sessionId}' belongs to user '${session.user_id}', requested under profile '${profileId}'`);
    }

    const effectiveProfileId = profileId || session.user_id || 'default';
    const user = getUser(effectiveProfileId);

    // Retrieve canonical session result
    const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, true, session);

    const resultHash = (canonicalSession as any).result_contract_hash || (canonicalSession as any).canonical_beat_ledger?.ledger_hash || 'unhashed';
    const ledgerHash = (canonicalSession as any).canonical_beat_ledger?.ledger_hash || 'unhashed';

    const limitations: string[] = [];
    if ((canonicalSession as any).validation_profile?.is_clinical_grade === false) {
      limitations.push('Non-clinical sports logging grade data.');
    }
    if ((session as any).is_ignored) {
      limitations.push('Session is marked as ignored in curation library.');
    }

    // Default entitlement state
    const entitlement = {
      single_export_allowed: true,
      batch_export_allowed: true,
      entitlement_status: 'valid' as const,
      is_expired: false,
      limitations: []
    };

    const snapshotPartial: Omit<ExportWorkspaceSnapshot, 'dependency_fingerprint' | 'snapshot_id' | 'created_at_utc'> = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      profile_id: effectiveProfileId,
      profile_selection_revision: typeof (session as any).curation_revision === 'number' ? (session as any).curation_revision : 1,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_id: (session as any).file_id || null,
      result_hash: resultHash,
      ledger_hash: ledgerHash,
      active_window_id: null,
      active_window_revision: null,
      comparison_id: null,
      longitudinal_snapshot_id: null,
      currentness: 'current',
      limitations,
      allowed_formats: [...ALL_EXPORT_FORMATS],
      entitlement,
      privacy_defaults: { ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN },
      destination_capability: {
        is_configured: true,
        capability_id: 'default_local',
        allowed_root_alias: 'local_export_dir',
        read_only: false
      },
      active_job_id: null,
      active_preview_id: null,
      exact_next_safe_action: 'CREATE_EXPORT_PLAN'
    };

    const fingerprint = computeExportWorkspaceFingerprint(snapshotPartial);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    return {
      ...snapshotPartial,
      snapshot_id: `snap_${randomUUID()}`,
      dependency_fingerprint: fingerprint,
      created_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  /**
   * Projects export members and byte budget for the chosen formats.
   */
  public projectMembers(
    formats: ExportFormat[],
    sensitiveOptIns: SensitiveExportOptIn
  ): { members: ProjectedExportMember[]; byteBudget: number; memberBudget: number } {
    const members: ProjectedExportMember[] = [];
    let byteBudget = 0;

    for (const fmt of formats) {
      switch (fmt) {
        case 'html':
          members.push({
            name: 'session_report.html',
            format: 'html',
            member_class: 'presentation',
            required_opt_ins: [],
            estimated_bytes: 50 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 50 * 1024;
          break;
        case 'pdf':
          members.push({
            name: 'session_report.pdf',
            format: 'pdf',
            member_class: 'presentation',
            required_opt_ins: [],
            estimated_bytes: 250 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 250 * 1024;
          break;
        case 'metrics_csv':
          members.push({
            name: 'metrics_summary.csv',
            format: 'metrics_csv',
            member_class: 'metrics',
            required_opt_ins: [],
            estimated_bytes: 15 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 15 * 1024;
          break;
        case 'rr_csv':
          members.push({
            name: 'beat_by_beat_rr.csv',
            format: 'rr_csv',
            member_class: 'raw_series',
            required_opt_ins: ['raw_rr'],
            estimated_bytes: 500 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 500 * 1024;
          break;
        case 'consultation_bundle':
          members.push({
            name: 'consultation_bundle.zip',
            format: 'consultation_bundle',
            member_class: 'consultation',
            required_opt_ins: [],
            estimated_bytes: 1024 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 1024 * 1024;
          break;
        case 'ai_pack':
          members.push({
            name: 'ai_interpretation_pack.zip',
            format: 'ai_pack',
            member_class: 'manifest',
            required_opt_ins: [],
            estimated_bytes: 800 * 1024
          });
          byteBudget += 800 * 1024;
          break;
      }
    }

    return {
      members,
      byteBudget,
      memberBudget: members.length
    };
  }

  /**
   * Creates an immutable, authoritative ExportPlan.
   */
  public async createExportPlan(params: {
    sessionId: string;
    profileId?: string;
    selectedFormats: ExportFormat[];
    sensitiveOptIns?: Partial<SensitiveExportOptIn>;
    boundedNotes?: string;
    boundedPrompt?: string;
    displayLocale?: string;
    displayTimezone?: string;
  }): Promise<ExportPlan> {
    if (!params.selectedFormats || params.selectedFormats.length === 0) {
      throw new ExportValidationError('At least one export format must be selected.');
    }

    for (const fmt of params.selectedFormats) {
      if (!ALL_EXPORT_FORMATS.includes(fmt)) {
        throw new ExportValidationError(`Unsupported export format: ${fmt}`);
      }
    }

    const snapshot = await this.buildExportWorkspaceSnapshot(params.sessionId, params.profileId);
    const privacyDecisions: SensitiveExportOptIn = {
      ...snapshot.privacy_defaults,
      ...(params.sensitiveOptIns || {})
    };

    const { members, byteBudget, memberBudget } = this.projectMembers(params.selectedFormats, privacyDecisions);

    const now = new Date();
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // 2h expiry
    const nowIso = now.toISOString();

    const planPartial: Omit<ExportPlan, 'plan_id' | 'plan_hash' | 'created_at_utc'> = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      workspace_fingerprint: snapshot.dependency_fingerprint,
      session_id: params.sessionId,
      profile_id: snapshot.profile_id,
      selected_formats: [...params.selectedFormats],
      projected_members: members,
      privacy_decisions: privacyDecisions,
      bounded_notes: params.boundedNotes ? params.boundedNotes.trim().slice(0, 1000) : null,
      bounded_prompt: params.boundedPrompt ? params.boundedPrompt.trim().slice(0, 2000) : null,
      display_locale: params.displayLocale || 'en-US',
      display_timezone: params.displayTimezone || 'UTC',
      destination_capability_id: snapshot.destination_capability.capability_id,
      byte_budget: byteBudget,
      member_budget: memberBudget,
      generator_versions: {
        pdf: '1.2.0',
        html: '1.1.0',
        csv: '1.2.0',
        bundle: '1.3.0',
        ai_pack: '1.1.0'
      },
      entitlement_decision: {
        allowed: snapshot.entitlement.single_export_allowed,
        reason: 'Authorized local license'
      },
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt
    };

    const planHash = computeExportPlanHash(planPartial);
    const planId = `plan_${randomUUID()}`;

    const plan: ExportPlan = {
      ...planPartial,
      plan_id: planId,
      plan_hash: planHash,
      created_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    saveExportPlan(plan);
    return plan;
  }

  /**
   * Starts a durable ExportJob backed by SQLite.
   */
  public async startExportJob(
    planId: string,
    options?: {
      batchId?: string;
      idempotencyKey?: string;
      destinationDir?: string;
    }
  ): Promise<ExportJobSnapshot> {
    if (options?.idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = getExportJobByIdempotencyKey(options.idempotencyKey);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    }

    const plan = getExportPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Export plan not found: ${planId}`);
    }

    if (Date.now() > new Date(plan.expires_at_utc).getTime()) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Export plan has expired: ${planId}`);
    }

    // Verify plan integrity
    const expectedPlanHash = computeExportPlanHash(plan);
    if (plan.plan_hash !== expectedPlanHash) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Export plan hash mismatch: expected ${expectedPlanHash}, found ${plan.plan_hash}`);
    }

    // Re-verify currentness
    const freshSnapshot = await this.buildExportWorkspaceSnapshot(plan.session_id, plan.profile_id);
    if (freshSnapshot.dependency_fingerprint !== plan.workspace_fingerprint) {
      throw new ExportValidationError('Export plan is stale: session data or selection changed since plan was generated.');
    }

    const jobId = `job_${randomUUID()}`;
    const correlationId = `corr_${randomUUID()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const items: ExportJobItemSnapshot[] = plan.selected_formats.map((fmt) => ({
      item_id: `item_${randomUUID()}`,
      job_id: jobId,
      session_id: plan.session_id,
      format: fmt,
      status: 'queued',
      expected_revision: 1,
      artifact_path: null,
      size_bytes: null,
      sha256: null,
      error_message: null,
      completed_at_utc: null
    }));

    const jobSnapshot: ExportJobSnapshot = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      job_id: jobId,
      plan_id: planId,
      batch_id: options?.batchId || null,
      status: 'queued',
      progress_percent: 0,
      total_items: items.length,
      completed_items: 0,
      failed_items: 0,
      skipped_items: 0,
      plan_hash: plan.plan_hash,
      idempotency_key: options?.idempotencyKey || null,
      correlation_id: correlationId,
      error_message: null,
      items,
      artifacts: [],
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: null
    };

    createExportJob(jobSnapshot);

    // Run execution asynchronously
    setImmediate(() => {
      this.executeJob(jobId, plan, options?.destinationDir).catch((err) => {
        logger.error('jobs', `Export job ${jobId} encountered fatal error: ${err.message}`, { details: { error: String(err) } });
        updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
          status: 'failed',
          error_message: err.message
        });
      });
    });

    return jobSnapshot;
  }

  /**
   * Internal job execution loop. Processes each item durably with CAS lease.
   */
  private async executeJob(jobId: string, plan: ExportPlan, destinationDir?: string): Promise<void> {
    const workerId = `worker_${process.pid}_${Date.now()}`;
    const leased = claimJobLease(jobId, workerId, 60000);
    if (!leased) {
      logger.warn('jobs', `Could not claim lease for job ${jobId}`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      updateExportJobProgress(jobId, { status: 'running' });

      const db = getDb();
      const session = (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(plan.session_id) as unknown) as SessionMetadata;
      const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(plan.session_id, true, session);
      const user = getUser(plan.profile_id);

      const items = getExportJobItems(jobId);
      let completedCount = 0;
      let failedCount = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        const item = items[i];

        // Check cancellation
        const currentJob = getExportJob(jobId);
        if (currentJob?.status === 'cancelling' || currentJob?.status === 'failed') {
          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'skipped',
            error_message: 'Job cancelled by user'
          });
          continue;
        }

        updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, { status: 'running' });

        try {
          const generated = await this.generateArtifact(item.format, plan, session, canonicalSession, user);

          // Write to staging
          const customFilename = (plan.privacy_decisions as any)?.file_display_name;
          const filename = customFilename || defaultExportDestinationService.sanitizeFilename(
            `${(session as any).activity_type || 'cardio'}_${session.start_time.replace(/[:T]/g, '-').slice(0, 19)}_${item.format}.${generated.extension}`
          );

          const stagingDir = defaultExportDestinationService.getStagingDirectory(jobId);
          const stagingFile = path.join(stagingDir, filename);

          fs.writeFileSync(stagingFile, generated.buffer);
          const stat = fs.statSync(stagingFile);
          const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(generated.buffer).digest('hex');

          let publishedPath: string | null = null;
          if (destinationDir) {
            const pub = defaultExportDestinationService.publishFile(
              stagingFile,
              destinationDir,
              filename
            );
            publishedPath = pub.publishedPath;
          }

          // Readback verification if published
          if (publishedPath && fs.existsSync(publishedPath)) {
            const readbackBuf = fs.readFileSync(publishedPath);
            if (readbackBuf.length !== stat.size) {
              throw new Error(`Readback verification failed: size mismatch (expected ${stat.size}, got ${readbackBuf.length})`);
            }
            const readbackSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(readbackBuf).digest('hex');
            if (readbackSha !== sha256) {
              throw new Error(`Readback verification failed: hash mismatch (expected ${sha256}, got ${readbackSha})`);
            }
          }

          const customManifestId = (plan.privacy_decisions as any)?.manifest_id;
          const manifestId = customManifestId || `man_${randomUUID()}`;
          const isPilot = Boolean((plan.privacy_decisions as any)?.context_type);

          const manifestOpts = {
            ...plan.privacy_decisions,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            sha256
          };

          const manifestCanonicalResultHash = (plan.privacy_decisions as any)?.canonical_result_hash ||
            (canonicalSession as any).result_contract_hash ||
            (canonicalSession as any).canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash ||
            'unhashed';

          const pDec = plan.privacy_decisions as any;
          const manifest: ExportArtifactManifest = {
            schema_version: EXPORT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            manifest_id: manifestId,
            job_id: jobId,
            plan_id: plan.plan_id,
            session_id: plan.session_id,
            format: isPilot ? ('html_report' as any) : item.format,
            filename,
            staging_path: stagingFile,
            published_path: publishedPath,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            sha256,
            status: 'completed',
            canonical_result_hash: manifestCanonicalResultHash,
            privacy_level: plan.privacy_decisions.identifiers ? 'identified' : 'deidentified',
            sensitive_opt_ins: manifestOpts as any,
            generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
            validated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
            profile_id: plan.profile_id,
            episode_id: pDec?.episode_id || null,
            context_type: pDec?.context_type || (isPilot ? 'whole_recording' : null),
            window_root_id: pDec?.window_id || pDec?.window_root_id || null,
            window_revision: pDec?.window_revision !== undefined && pDec?.window_revision !== null ? Number(pDec.window_revision) : null,
            window_result_identity: pDec?.canonical_result_hash || null,
            beat_ledger_hash: (canonicalSession as any).canonical_beat_ledger?.ledger_hash || null,
            dependency_fingerprint: pDec?.dependency_fingerprint || plan.workspace_fingerprint || null,
            export_preset_version: '1.0.0'
          };

          saveExportArtifactManifest(manifest);

          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'completed',
            artifact_path: publishedPath || stagingFile,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            sha256,
            completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
          });

          completedCount++;
        } catch (itemErr: any) {
          logger.error('jobs', `Export item ${item.item_id} (${item.format}) failed: ${itemErr.message}`, { details: { error: String(itemErr) } });
          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'failed',
            error_message: itemErr.message || 'Generation failed',
            completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
          });
          failedCount++;
        }

        const progressPercent = Math.round(((i + 1) / items.length) * 100);
        updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
          progress_percent: progressPercent,
          completed_items: completedCount,
          failed_items: failedCount
        });
      }

      // Final job status determination
      let finalStatus: 'completed' | 'partial' | 'failed' = 'completed';
      if (completedCount === 0 && failedCount > 0) {
        finalStatus = 'failed';
      } else if (failedCount > 0) {
        finalStatus = 'partial';
      }

      updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
        status: finalStatus,
        progress_percent: 100,
        completed_items: completedCount,
        failed_items: failedCount,
        completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } finally {
      releaseJobLease(jobId, workerId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generates artifact buffer and file extension for a specific export format.
   */
  private async generateArtifact(
    format: ExportFormat,
    plan: ExportPlan,
    session: SessionMetadata,
    canonicalSession: CanonicalSessionResult,
    user: UserPreferences | null
  ): Promise<{ buffer: Buffer; extension: string }> {
    switch (format) {
      case 'metrics_csv': {
        const core = canonicalSession.core_metrics;
        let obs: any = {};
        try {
          const db = getDb();
          const row = db.prepare('SELECT canonical_observation_json FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
          if (row?.canonical_observation_json) {
            obs = JSON.parse(row.canonical_observation_json);
          }
        } catch {}

        const meanHr = core.mean_hr_bpm?.value ?? obs.mean_hr ?? (session as any).avg_hr ?? '';
        const rmssd = core.rmssd?.value ?? obs.rmssd ?? '';
        const sdnn = core.sdnn?.value ?? obs.sdnn ?? '';
        const pnn50 = core.pnn50?.value ?? obs.pnn50 ?? '';

        let csv = 'session_id,start_time,mean_hr,rmssd,sdnn,pnn50\n';
        csv += `${session.id},${session.start_time},${meanHr},${rmssd},${sdnn},${pnn50}\n\n`;
        csv += '# Detailed Canonical Metrics\n';
        csv += 'session_id,metric_id,value,unit,eligibility_state,included_beat_count,excluded_beat_count,analysis_window_seconds,method_name,method_version,protocol_authority\n';
        const summaryRows = [core.rmssd, core.sdnn, core.pnn50, core.mean_hr_bpm, core.mean_rr_ms].filter(Boolean);
        for (const m of summaryRows) {
          const valStr = m.value !== null && m.value !== undefined ? m.value.toFixed(m.precision_decimals) : '';
          csv += `${session.id},${m.metric_id},${valStr},${m.unit},${m.eligibility_state},${m.included_beat_count},${m.excluded_beat_count},${m.analysis_window_seconds},"${m.method_name}",${m.method_version},${m.protocol_authority}\n`;
        }
        return { buffer: Buffer.from(csv, 'utf8'), extension: 'csv' };
      }

      case 'rr_csv': {
        const ledger = canonicalSession.canonical_beat_ledger;
        let csv = 'beat_index,raw_rr_ms,accepted_for_nn,source_row_index,phone_timestamp_str,phone_timestamp_ms,sensor_timestamp_ns,relative_timestamp_ms,raw_is_valid,parse_status,classification_status,exclusion_reasons,instantaneous_hr_bpm\n';
        if (ledger && Array.isArray(ledger.beats)) {
          for (const b of ledger.beats) {
            const rawRrStr = b.raw_rr_ms != null ? b.raw_rr_ms.toFixed(1) : '';
            const acceptedForNn = (b.classification_status as string) === 'accepted' || (b as any).accepted_for_nn ? 'true' : 'false';
            const sensorNsStr = b.sensor_timestamp_ns != null ? b.sensor_timestamp_ns.toString() : '';
            const phoneMsStr = b.phone_timestamp_ms != null ? b.phone_timestamp_ms.toString() : '';
            const instHrStr = b.instantaneous_hr_bpm != null ? b.instantaneous_hr_bpm.toFixed(1) : '';
            const exclStr = b.exclusion_reasons && b.exclusion_reasons.length > 0 ? `"${b.exclusion_reasons.join(';')}"` : '';
            csv += `${b.beat_index},${rawRrStr},${acceptedForNn},${b.source_row_index},${b.phone_timestamp_str || ''},${phoneMsStr},${sensorNsStr},${b.relative_timestamp_ms ?? ''},${b.raw_is_valid ?? ''},${b.parser_status},${b.classification_status},${exclStr},${instHrStr}\n`;
          }
        }
        return { buffer: Buffer.from(csv, 'utf8'), extension: 'csv' };
      }

      case 'pdf': {
        const db = getDb();
        const qcMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
        const analyticsMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
        const flags = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').all(session.id) as any[];
        let signalFiles: any[] = [];
        try {
          signalFiles = db.prepare(`
            SELECT f.id, f.signal_type, f.filename
            FROM session_signals ss
            JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
            WHERE ss.session_id = ?
          `).all(session.id) as any[];
        } catch {
          signalFiles = [];
        }

        const pdfBuf = await generateSessionPdf({
          session,
          canonicalSession,
          qcMetrics: qcMetrics || null,
          analyticsMetrics: analyticsMetrics || null,
          flags: flags || [],
          signalFiles: signalFiles || [],
          user,
          notes: plan.bounded_notes || undefined,
          display_locale: plan.display_locale,
          display_timezone: plan.display_timezone
        });
        return { buffer: pdfBuf, extension: 'pdf' };
      }

      case 'html': {
        const isPilot = Boolean((plan.privacy_decisions as any)?.context_type);
        if (isPilot) {
          const { AthleteJourneyService } = await import('../journey/AthleteJourneyService');
          const pDec = plan.privacy_decisions as any;
          const authContext = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext({
            sessionId: plan.session_id,
            profileId: plan.profile_id,
            contextType: pDec.context_type,
            windowRootId: pDec.window_id,
            windowRevision: pDec.window_revision
          });

          const profile = getUserProfile(plan.profile_id);
          const profileDisplay = profile?.display_name || profile?.export_alias || 'Athlete';
          const escapeHtml = (str: string | null | undefined): string => {
            if (!str) return '';
            return String(str)
              .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
              .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
              .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
              .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
              .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
          };

          const safeProfileDisplay = escapeHtml(profileDisplay);
          const safeSessionId = escapeHtml(session.id);
          const safeContextTitle = escapeHtml(authContext.context_title);
          const safeStartTime = escapeHtml(session.start_time);
          const safeReportId = escapeHtml(pDec.report_id || `rep-${plan.plan_id}`);
          const safeManifestId = escapeHtml(pDec.manifest_id || `man-${plan.plan_id}`);

          const totalBeats = authContext.quality?.total_rr_count ?? 0;
          const acceptedBeats = authContext.quality?.accepted_nn_count ?? 0;
          const excludedBeats = authContext.quality?.excluded_count ?? 0;
          const continuityClass = authContext.quality?.continuity_status || 'segmented_quality_limited';
          const maxGapSec = authContext.quality?.largest_gap_seconds ?? 0;

          const mHr = authContext.metrics['mean_hr'];
          const mRmssd = authContext.metrics['rmssd'];
          const mSdnn = authContext.metrics['sdnn'];
          const mPnn50 = authContext.metrics['pnn50'];

          const htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>CardioLab Pilot Report</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; color: #1e293b; max-width: 800px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 0 20px; }
    h1 { color: #0f172a; border-bottom: 2px solid #0284c7; padding-bottom: 8px; }
    .card { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin: 16px 0; }
    .metric-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; }
    .metric-box { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; }
    .metric-val { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #0284c7; }
    .disclaimer { font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>CardioLab Pilot Report — One-Own-Recording Summary</h1>
  <div class="card">
    <strong>Athlete:</strong> ${safeProfileDisplay}<br>
    <strong>Session ID:</strong> ${safeSessionId}<br>
    <strong>Context:</strong> ${safeContextTitle}<br>
    <strong>Duration:</strong> ${authContext.duration_seconds}s | <strong>Start Time:</strong> ${safeStartTime}
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h3>Signal Quality & Exclusions</h3>
    <p>Total RR beats analyzed: <strong>${totalBeats}</strong> (Accepted clean NN: <strong>${acceptedBeats}</strong>, Excluded: <strong>${excludedBeats}</strong>)</p>
    <p>Continuity classification: <strong>${continuityClass}</strong> (Largest gap: ${maxGapSec}s)</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h3>Descriptive Cardiac Metrics</h3>
    <div class="metric-grid">
      <div class="metric-box">
        <div>Mean Heart Rate</div>
        <div class="metric-val">${mHr?.is_eligible ? mHr.value + ' bpm' : '—'}</div>
        <small>${mHr?.is_eligible ? 'Eligible' : escapeHtml(mHr?.withholding_reason || 'Withheld')}</small>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-box">
        <div>HRV RMSSD</div>
        <div class="metric-val">${mRmssd?.is_eligible ? mRmssd.value + ' ms' : '—'}</div>
        <small>${mRmssd?.is_eligible ? 'Eligible' : escapeHtml(mRmssd?.withholding_reason || 'Withheld')}</small>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-box">
        <div>HRV SDNN</div>
        <div class="metric-val">${mSdnn?.is_eligible ? mSdnn.value + ' ms' : '—'}</div>
        <small>${mSdnn?.is_eligible ? 'Eligible' : escapeHtml(mSdnn?.withholding_reason || 'Withheld')}</small>
      </div>
      <div class="metric-box">
        <div>HRV pNN50</div>
        <div class="metric-val">${mPnn50?.is_eligible ? mPnn50.value + ' %' : '—'}</div>
        <small>${mPnn50?.is_eligible ? 'Eligible' : escapeHtml(mPnn50?.withholding_reason || 'Withheld')}</small>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="disclaimer">
    <p><strong>Non-Diagnostic Technical Summary:</strong> This artifact is generated by local CardioLab algorithms for educational and athletic evaluation only. It does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment recommendations, or physiological norms.</p>
    <p>Report ID: <code>${safeReportId}</code> | Manifest ID: <code>${safeManifestId}</code> | Schema: 1.0.0 | Baseline & AI Independent.</p>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
          return { buffer: Buffer.from(htmlContent, 'utf8'), extension: 'html' };
        }
        const core = canonicalSession.core_metrics;
        const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="${plan.display_locale || 'en'}">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>CardioLab Session Report - ${session.id}</title>
<style>
body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; }
h1, h2 { color: #38bdf8; }
.card { background: #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #334155; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.metric { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: bold; color: #38bdf8; }
.label { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #94a3b8; }
.notice { background: #334155; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #cbd5e1; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>CardioLab Authoritative Report</h1>
<div class="card">
  <h2>Session Overview</h2>
  <p><strong>Session ID:</strong> ${session.id}</p>
  <p><strong>Activity:</strong> ${(session as any).activity_type || 'Cardio'}</p>
  <p><strong>Start Time:</strong> ${session.start_time}</p>
  <p><strong>Duration:</strong> ${Math.round(session.duration_seconds || 0)}s</p>
</div>
<div class="card">
  <h2>Canonical Core Metrics</h2>
  <div class="grid">
    <div><div class="label">Mean HR</div><div class="metric">${core.mean_hr_bpm.value ? core.mean_hr_bpm.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} bpm</div></div>
    <div><div class="label">RMSSD</div><div class="metric">${core.rmssd.value ? core.rmssd.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} ms</div></div>
    <div><div class="label">SDNN</div><div class="metric">${core.sdnn.value ? core.sdnn.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} ms</div></div>
    <div><div class="label">pNN50</div><div class="metric">${core.pnn50.value ? core.pnn50.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} %</div></div>
  </div>
</div>
${plan.bounded_notes ? `<div class="card"><h2>Athlete Notes</h2><p>${plan.bounded_notes}</p></div>` : ''}
<div class="notice">
  <p><strong>Safety Disclaimer:</strong> Non-diagnostic, sports logging grade analytics only. Not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical condition.</p>
</div>
</body>
</html>`;
        return { buffer: Buffer.from(html, 'utf8'), extension: 'html' };
      }

      case 'consultation_bundle': {
        const db = getDb();
        const qcMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_qc_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
        const analyticsMetrics = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_metrics WHERE session_id = ?').get(session.id) as any;
        const flags = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidate_flags WHERE session_id = ?').all(session.id) as any[];
        let signalFiles: any[] = [];
        try {
          signalFiles = db.prepare(`
            SELECT f.id, f.signal_type, f.filename
            FROM session_signals ss
            JOIN ingested_files f ON ss.file_id = f.id
            WHERE ss.session_id = ?
          `).all(session.id) as any[];
        } catch {
          signalFiles = [];
        }

        const zipStream = await generateConsultationBundleZip({
          session,
          canonicalSession,
          qcMetrics: qcMetrics || null,
          analyticsMetrics: analyticsMetrics || null,
          flags: flags || [],
          signalFiles: signalFiles || [],
          user,
          notes: plan.bounded_notes || undefined,
          display_locale: plan.display_locale,
          display_timezone: plan.display_timezone
        });

        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
        for await (const chunk of zipStream) {
          chunks.push(typeof chunk === 'string' ? Buffer.from(chunk) : chunk);
        }
        return { buffer: Buffer.concat(chunks), extension: 'zip' };
      }

      case 'ai_pack': {
        const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });
        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];

        const promptText = plan.bounded_prompt || 'Summarize session metrics, cardiac drift, and physiological trends.';
        const summaryMd = `# CardioLab Session AI Interpretation Context
## Session Overview
- Session ID: ${session.id}
- Activity: ${(session as any).activity_type || 'Cardio'}
- Start Time: ${session.start_time}
- Duration: ${Math.round(session.duration_seconds || 0)}s
- Average HR: ${(session as any).avg_hr || canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm?.value || '--'} bpm

## Core Canonical Metrics
- RMSSD: ${canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd?.value ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} ms
- SDNN: ${canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn?.value ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} ms
- pNN50: ${canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50?.value ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} %
- Mean HR: ${canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm?.value ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value.toFixed(1) : '--'} bpm

${plan.bounded_notes ? `## Athlete Notes\n${plan.bounded_notes}\n` : ''}
## Safety Disclaimer
Non-diagnostic, sports logging grade analytics only. Not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical condition.
`;

        const manifestData = {
          schema_version: '1.0.0',
          pack_id: `pack_${randomUUID()}`,
          session_id: session.id,
          created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          prompt: promptText,
          files: [
            '00_manifest.json',
            '01_ai_interpretation.md',
            '02_user_prompt.md',
            '03_metrics_and_zones.json'
          ]
        };

        archive.append(JSON.stringify(manifestData, null, 2), { name: '00_manifest.json' });
        archive.append(summaryMd, { name: '01_ai_interpretation.md' });
        archive.append(promptText, { name: '02_user_prompt.md' });
        archive.append(JSON.stringify({
          core_metrics: canonicalSession.core_metrics,
          zones: canonicalSession.heart_rate_zones
        }, null, 2), { name: '03_metrics_and_zones.json' });

        archive.finalize();

        for await (const chunk of archive) {
          chunks.push(typeof chunk === 'string' ? Buffer.from(chunk) : chunk);
        }

        return { buffer: Buffer.concat(chunks), extension: 'zip' };
      }

      default:
        throw new ExportValidationError(`Unhandled export format: ${format}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cancels a running or queued export job.
   */
  public async cancelExportJob(jobId: string): Promise<ExportJobSnapshot | null> {
    const job = getExportJob(jobId);
    if (!job) return null;

    if (['completed', 'failed', 'stale'].includes(job.status)) {
      return job;
    }

    updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
      status: 'cancelling',
      error_message: 'Job cancelled by user'
    });

    const items = getExportJobItems(jobId);
    for (const item of items) {
      if (['queued', 'running'].includes(item.status)) {
        updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
          status: 'skipped',
          error_message: 'Job cancelled by user'
        });
      }
    }

    updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
      status: 'cancelling',
      error_message: 'Job cancelled by user',
      completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    return getExportJob(jobId);
  }

  /**
   * Retries failed items in an export job.
   */
  public async retryExportJob(jobId: string): Promise<ExportJobSnapshot | null> {
    const job = getExportJob(jobId);
    if (!job) return null;

    const plan = getExportPlan(job.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Plan not found for job: ${jobId}`);
    }

    const items = getExportJobItems(jobId);
    const failedItems = items.filter(i => i.status === 'failed' || i.status === 'skipped');

    if (failedItems.length === 0) {
      if (job.status === 'failed' && items.every(i => i.status === 'completed')) {
        updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
          status: 'completed',
          error_message: null
        });
        return getExportJob(jobId);
      }
      return job;
    }

    for (const item of failedItems) {
      updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
        status: 'queued',
        error_message: null
      });
    }

    updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
      status: 'queued',
      error_message: null,
      completed_at_utc: null
    });

    setImmediate(() => {
      this.executeJob(jobId, plan).catch((err) => {
        logger.error('jobs', `Retry execution for job ${jobId} failed: ${err.message}`, { details: { error: String(err) } });
      });
    });

    return getExportJob(jobId);
  }

  /**
   * Creates a batch export job for multiple sessions with distinct selection semantics.
   */
  public async createBatchExportJob(params: {
    selection: BatchExportSelection;
    formats: ExportFormat[];
    profileId?: string;
    sensitiveOptIns?: Partial<SensitiveExportOptIn>;
    destinationDir?: string;
  }): Promise<ExportJobSnapshot> {
    const { selection, formats } = params;

    if (!selection.session_ids || selection.session_ids.length === 0) {
      throw new ExportValidationError('Batch selection contains no sessions.');
    }

    const batchId = `batch_${randomUUID()}`;
    const jobId = `job_${randomUUID()}`;
    const correlationId = `corr_${randomUUID()}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const items: ExportJobItemSnapshot[] = [];

    for (const sid of selection.session_ids) {
      for (const fmt of formats) {
        items.push({
          item_id: `item_${randomUUID()}`,
          job_id: jobId,
          session_id: sid,
          format: fmt,
          status: 'queued',
          expected_revision: selection.expected_revisions[sid] || 1,
          artifact_path: null,
          size_bytes: null,
          sha256: null,
          error_message: null,
          completed_at_utc: null
        });
      }
    }

    // Create a representative batch plan
    const firstPlan = await this.createExportPlan({
      sessionId: selection.session_ids[0],
      profileId: params.profileId,
      selectedFormats: formats,
      sensitiveOptIns: params.sensitiveOptIns
    });

    const jobSnapshot: ExportJobSnapshot = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      job_id: jobId,
      plan_id: firstPlan.plan_id,
      batch_id: batchId,
      status: 'queued',
      progress_percent: 0,
      total_items: items.length,
      completed_items: 0,
      failed_items: 0,
      skipped_items: 0,
      plan_hash: firstPlan.plan_hash,
      idempotency_key: null,
      correlation_id: correlationId,
      error_message: null,
      items,
      artifacts: [],
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: null
    };

    createExportJob(jobSnapshot);

    // Run batch execution
    setImmediate(() => {
      this.executeBatchJob(jobId, selection.session_ids, formats, params.sensitiveOptIns, params.destinationDir).catch((err) => {
        logger.error('jobs', `Batch job ${jobId} failed: ${err.message}`, { details: { error: String(err) } });
        updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
          status: 'failed',
          error_message: err.message
        });
      });
    });

    return jobSnapshot;
  }

  private async executeBatchJob(
    jobId: string,
    sessionIds: string[],
    formats: ExportFormat[],
    privacy?: Partial<SensitiveExportOptIn>,
    destinationDir?: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const workerId = `batch_worker_${process.pid}_${Date.now()}`;
    const leased = claimJobLease(jobId, workerId, 300000);
    if (!leased) return;

    try {
      updateExportJobProgress(jobId, { status: 'running' });

      const items = getExportJobItems(jobId);
      let completedCount = 0;
      let failedCount = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        const item = items[i];

        const currentJob = getExportJob(jobId);
        if (currentJob?.status === 'cancelling' || currentJob?.status === 'failed') {
          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'skipped',
            error_message: 'Batch cancelled by user'
          });
          continue;
        }

        updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, { status: 'running' });

        try {
          const plan = await this.createExportPlan({
            sessionId: item.session_id,
            selectedFormats: [item.format],
            sensitiveOptIns: privacy
          });

          const db = getDb();
          const session = (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(item.session_id) as unknown) as SessionMetadata;
          const canonicalSession = await getCanonicalSessionResult(item.session_id, true, session);
          const user = getUser(plan.profile_id);

          const generated = await this.generateArtifact(item.format, plan, session, canonicalSession, user);

          const filename = defaultExportDestinationService.sanitizeFilename(
            `${(session as any).activity_type || 'cardio'}_${session.start_time.replace(/[:T]/g, '-').slice(0, 19)}_${item.format}.${generated.extension}`
          );

          const stagingDir = defaultExportDestinationService.getStagingDirectory(jobId);
          const stagingFile = path.join(stagingDir, filename);

          fs.writeFileSync(stagingFile, generated.buffer);
          const stat = fs.statSync(stagingFile);
          const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(generated.buffer).digest('hex');

          let publishedPath: string | null = null;
          if (destinationDir) {
            const pub = defaultExportDestinationService.publishFile(stagingFile, destinationDir, filename);
            publishedPath = pub.publishedPath;
          }

          const manifestId = `man_${randomUUID()}`;
          const pDec = plan.privacy_decisions as any;
          const manifest: ExportArtifactManifest = {
            schema_version: EXPORT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            manifest_id: manifestId,
            job_id: jobId,
            plan_id: plan.plan_id,
            session_id: item.session_id,
            format: item.format,
            filename,
            staging_path: stagingFile,
            published_path: publishedPath,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            sha256,
            status: 'available',
            canonical_result_hash: (canonicalSession as any).result_contract_hash || 'unhashed',
            privacy_level: plan.privacy_decisions.identifiers ? 'identified' : 'deidentified',
            sensitive_opt_ins: plan.privacy_decisions,
            generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
            validated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
            profile_id: plan.profile_id,
            episode_id: pDec?.episode_id || null,
            context_type: pDec?.context_type || null,
            window_root_id: pDec?.window_id || pDec?.window_root_id || null,
            window_revision: pDec?.window_revision !== undefined && pDec?.window_revision !== null ? Number(pDec.window_revision) : null,
            window_result_identity: pDec?.canonical_result_hash || null,
            beat_ledger_hash: (canonicalSession as any).canonical_beat_ledger?.ledger_hash || null,
            dependency_fingerprint: pDec?.dependency_fingerprint || plan.workspace_fingerprint || null,
            export_preset_version: '1.0.0'
          };

          saveExportArtifactManifest(manifest);

          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'completed',
            artifact_path: publishedPath || stagingFile,
            size_bytes: stat.size,
            sha256,
            completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
          });

          completedCount++;
        } catch (itemErr: any) {
          logger.error('jobs', `Batch item ${item.item_id} failed: ${itemErr.message}`, { details: { error: String(itemErr) } });
          updateExportJobItem(item.item_id, {
            status: 'failed',
            error_message: itemErr.message || 'Generation failed',
            completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
          });
          failedCount++;
        }

        const progressPercent = Math.round(((i + 1) / items.length) * 100);
        updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
          progress_percent: progressPercent,
          completed_items: completedCount,
          failed_items: failedCount
        });
      }

      let finalStatus: 'completed' | 'partial' | 'failed' = 'completed';
      if (completedCount === 0 && failedCount > 0) finalStatus = 'failed';
      else if (failedCount > 0) finalStatus = 'partial';

      updateExportJobProgress(jobId, {
        status: finalStatus,
        progress_percent: 100,
        completed_items: completedCount,
        failed_items: failedCount,
        completed_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } finally {
      releaseJobLease(jobId, workerId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Queues an asynchronous Pilot Report Export Job (CardioLab G54-EXPORT-007).
   * Validates exact session, profile, and episode bindings (fails closed on mismatch).
   * Generates plan, stores queued job, and dispatches background worker execution.
   * Returns immediately with queued job contract before rendering.
   */
  public async queuePilotReport(params: GeneratePilotReportParams): Promise<{
    job_id: string;
    plan_id: string;
    status: 'queued';
    manifest_id: string;
    file_display_name: string;
    authoritative_fingerprint: string;
  }> {
    const { sessionId, profileId, contextType = 'whole_recording', windowRootId, windowRevision } = params;

    const session = getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`[SESSION_NOT_FOUND] Session '${sessionId}' not found for pilot report generation.`);
    }

    if (session.user_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && session.user_id !== profileId) {
      throw new Error(`[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Session '${sessionId}' belongs to '${session.user_id}', requested under '${profileId}'.`);
    }

    let effectiveEpisodeId: string | null = params.episodeId || null;
    if (!effectiveEpisodeId && sessionId) {
      const boundEps = getDb().prepare("SELECT episode_id FROM self_service_episodes WHERE canonical_session_id = ? AND (profile_id = ? OR ? = 'all')").all(sessionId, profileId || 'all', profileId || 'all') as any[];
      if (boundEps.length === 1) {
        effectiveEpisodeId = boundEps[0].episode_id;
      } else if (boundEps.length > 1) {
        throw new Error(`[AMBIGUOUS_EPISODE_BINDING] Multiple episodes bound to session; explicit episodeId is required.`);
      }
    }
    if (!effectiveEpisodeId) {
      const autoEp = selfServiceEpisodeService.createEpisode({
        profile_id: profileId || 'default',
        task_intent: 'pilot_journey',
        lifecycle_state: 'preflight_ready',
        canonical_session_id: sessionId
      });
      effectiveEpisodeId = autoEp.episode_id;
    }

    const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(effectiveEpisodeId);
    if (!ep) {
      throw new Error(`[EPISODE_NOT_FOUND] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (ep.profile_id && profileId && profileId !== 'all' && ep.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new Error(`[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' belongs to '${ep.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'.`);
    }
    if (ep.canonical_session_id && ep.canonical_session_id !== sessionId) {
      throw new Error(`[EPISODE_SESSION_MISMATCH] Episode '${effectiveEpisodeId}' is bound to session '${ep.canonical_session_id}', not '${sessionId}'.`);
    }
    const resolvedEpisodeId: string = effectiveEpisodeId;

    const { AthleteJourneyService } = await import('../journey/AthleteJourneyService');
    const authContext = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext({
      sessionId,
      profileId,
      contextType,
      windowRootId,
      windowRevision
    });

    const reportId = `rep-pilot-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const manifestId = `man-pilot-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const manifestHex = manifestId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase().slice(-8);
    const fileDisplayName = `cardiolab_pilot_report_${sessionId.slice(0, 8)}_${manifestHex}.html`;

    // Compute session-specific dependency fingerprint without newest-episode or profile-wide fallback (G54-EXPORT-007)
    let authoritativeFingerprint: string | null = null;
    const projection = await AthleteJourneyService.resolvePilotProjection(profileId);
    if (projection && projection.session_id === sessionId && projection.dependency_fingerprint) {
      authoritativeFingerprint = projection.dependency_fingerprint;
    } else {
      const tuple = buildPilotDependencyTuple({
        ...projection,
        session_id: sessionId,
        episode_id: effectiveEpisodeId,
        canonical_result_hash: authContext.parent_result_hash,
        beat_ledger_hash: authContext.parent_ledger_hash,
        quality: authContext.quality,
        context: {
          type: contextType,
          window_id: windowRootId || null,
          window_revision: windowRevision ?? null,
          window_result_identity: authContext.window_result_identity,
          context_label: authContext.context_title
        },
        metrics: authContext.metrics
      });
      authoritativeFingerprint = calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(sortKeysRecursively(tuple)));
    }

    if (params.dependencyFingerprint && params.dependencyFingerprint !== authoritativeFingerprint) {
      throw new ExportValidationError(`Client dependency fingerprint mismatch: provided '${params.dependencyFingerprint}', computed '${authoritativeFingerprint}'`);
    }

    const planId = `plan-pilot-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const jobId = `job-pilot-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const planHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ sessionId, profileId, contextType, windowRootId, windowRevision, fileDisplayName, authoritativeFingerprint })).digest('hex');
    const plan: ExportPlan = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      plan_id: planId,
      plan_hash: planHash,
      workspace_fingerprint: authoritativeFingerprint,
      session_id: sessionId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      selected_formats: ['html'],
      projected_members: [{
        name: fileDisplayName,
        format: 'html',
        member_class: 'presentation',
        required_opt_ins: [],
        estimated_bytes: 10000
      }],
      privacy_decisions: {
        ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN,
        context_type: contextType,
        window_id: windowRootId || null,
        window_revision: windowRevision ?? null,
        episode_id: effectiveEpisodeId,
        profile_id: profileId,
        session_id: sessionId,
        dependency_fingerprint: authoritativeFingerprint,
        canonical_result_hash: authContext.window_result_identity || authContext.parent_result_hash || null,
        report_id: reportId,
        manifest_id: manifestId,
        file_display_name: fileDisplayName
      } as any,
      bounded_notes: null,
      bounded_prompt: null,
      display_locale: 'en',
      display_timezone: 'UTC',
      destination_capability_id: 'default_local',
      byte_budget: 1000000,
      member_budget: 1,
      generator_versions: { html: '1.1.0' },
      entitlement_decision: { allowed: true, reason: 'Pilot report authorized' },
      expires_at_utc: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      created_at_utc: now
    };
    saveExportPlan(plan);

    const jobSnapshot: ExportJobSnapshot = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_JOB_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      job_id: jobId,
      plan_id: planId,
      batch_id: null,
      status: 'queued',
      progress_percent: 0,
      total_items: 1,
      completed_items: 0,
      failed_items: 0,
      skipped_items: 0,
      plan_hash: planHash,
      idempotency_key: null,
      correlation_id: `corr-${reportId}`,
      error_message: null,
      items: [{
        item_id: `item-${reportId}`,
        job_id: jobId,
        session_id: sessionId,
        format: 'html',
        status: 'queued',
        expected_revision: 1,
        artifact_path: null as any,
        size_bytes: 0,
        sha256: '',
        error_message: null,
        completed_at_utc: null
      }],
      artifacts: [],
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: null
    };
    createExportJob(jobSnapshot);

    const reportsDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'reports');
    if (!fs.existsSync(reportsDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(reportsDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    // Launch independent export worker asynchronously (G54-EXPORT-007)
    setImmediate(() => {
      this.executeJob(jobId, plan, reportsDir).catch(err => {
        logger.error('jobs', `Pilot export worker error on job ${jobId}: ${err.message}`, { details: { error: String(err) } });
      });
    });

    return {
      job_id: jobId,
      plan_id: planId,
      status: 'queued',
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      file_display_name: fileDisplayName,
      authoritative_fingerprint: authoritativeFingerprint
    };
  }

  /**
   * Authoritative Pilot Report Generator (CardioLab G45 / G50 / G54).
   * Queues report job and awaits claimed export worker to render and publish bytes.
   */
  public async generatePilotReport(params: GeneratePilotReportParams): Promise<PilotReportResult> {
    const queued = await this.queuePilotReport(params);
    const jobId = queued.job_id;
    const planId = queued.plan_id;
    const manifestId = queued.manifest_id;
    const fileDisplayName = queued.file_display_name;

    const start = Date.now();
    while (Date.now() - start < 30000) {
      const j = getExportJob(jobId);
      if (j && (j.status === 'completed' || j.status === 'failed')) {
        if (j.status === 'failed') {
          throw new Error(`Export job failed: ${j.error_message || 'Unknown error'}`);
        }
        break;
      }
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 25));
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const manifestRow = db.prepare('SELECT published_path, staging_path, size_bytes, sha256 FROM export_artifact_manifests WHERE manifest_id = ?').get(manifestId) as any;
    const reportsDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'reports');
    const finalPublishedPath = manifestRow?.published_path || manifestRow?.staging_path || path.join(reportsDir, fileDisplayName);
    const finalSizeBytes = manifestRow?.size_bytes || (fs.existsSync(finalPublishedPath) ? fs.statSync(finalPublishedPath).size : 0);
    const finalSha = manifestRow?.sha256 || (fs.existsSync(finalPublishedPath) ? crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(finalPublishedPath)).digest('hex') : '');
    const reportContent = fs.existsSync(finalPublishedPath) ? fs.readFileSync(finalPublishedPath, 'utf8') : '';

    const session = getSession(params.sessionId);
    const profile = getUserProfile(params.profileId);
    const profileDisplay = profile?.display_name || profile?.export_alias || 'Athlete';
    const { AthleteJourneyService } = await import('../journey/AthleteJourneyService');
    const authContext = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveAuthoritativeAnalysisContext({
      sessionId: params.sessionId,
      profileId: params.profileId,
      contextType: params.contextType,
      windowRootId: params.windowRootId,
      windowRevision: params.windowRevision
    });

    const humanReadableSummary = [
      `CardioLab Pilot Report — ${profileDisplay}`,
      `Session ID: ${params.sessionId} | Context: ${authContext.context_title}`,
      `Duration: ${authContext.duration_seconds}s | Recorded: ${session?.start_time}`,
      `Quality: ${authContext.quality?.decision || 'usable'} | Continuity: ${authContext.continuity_status}`,
      `Note: Non-diagnostic technical cardio report. Baseline and AI independent.`
    ].join('\n');

    return {
      report_id: jobId.startsWith('job-') ? `rep-${jobId.slice(4)}` : `rep-${jobId}`,
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      plan_id: planId,
      job_id: jobId,
      manifest_sha256: finalSha,
      file_display_name: fileDisplayName,
      published_path: finalPublishedPath,
      size_bytes: finalSizeBytes,
      generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      human_readable_summary: humanReadableSummary,
      report_content: reportContent,
      context_type: params.contextType || 'whole_recording',
      window_result_identity: authContext.window_result_identity
    };
  }
}

export interface GeneratePilotReportParams {
  sessionId: string;
  profileId: string;
  episodeId?: string | null;
  contextType?: PilotContextType;
  windowRootId?: string | null;
  windowRevision?: number | null;
  dependencyFingerprint?: string | null;
}

export interface PilotReportResult {
  report_id: string;
  manifest_id: string;
  plan_id?: string;
  job_id?: string;
  manifest_sha256: string;
  file_display_name: string;
  published_path: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  generated_at_utc: string;
  human_readable_summary: string;
  report_content: string;
  context_type: PilotContextType;
  window_result_identity: string | null;
}

export const defaultExportJobService = new ExportJobService();

  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null;
