export function escapeHtml(unsafe: string): string {
  return unsafe
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
}

export function maskDeviceId(deviceId: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!deviceId) return '—';
  if (deviceId.length <= 4) return deviceId;
  return deviceId.substring(0, 4) + '****';
}

interface GroupedFlag {
  timestamp_offset_ms: number;
  flag_type: string;
  description_ru: string;
  severity: string;
  count: number;
}

export function groupFlags(flags: CandidateFlag[]): GroupedFlag[] {
  const qualityTypes = [
    'baseline_drift', 'clipping', 'hf_noise',
    'quality_artifact_ecg_noise', 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift', 'motion_artifact'
  ];
  const anomalyFlags = flags.filter(f => !qualityTypes.includes(f.flag_type));

  const sorted = [...anomalyFlags].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms);
  const grouped: GroupedFlag[] = [];
  const windowSizeMs = 60000; // 60 seconds

  for (const f of sorted) {
    let description = f.description_ru;
    description = description.replace(/Аномальный RR-интервал/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал');
    description = description.replace(/Нетипичный RR-интервал/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал');

    const matchingGroup = grouped.find(g => 
      g.flag_type === f.flag_type && 
      g.severity === f.severity && 
      Math.abs(g.timestamp_offset_ms - f.timestamp_offset_ms) <= windowSizeMs
    );

    if (matchingGroup) {
      matchingGroup.count++;
    } else {
      grouped.push({
        timestamp_offset_ms: f.timestamp_offset_ms,
        flag_type: f.flag_type,
        description_ru: description,
        severity: f.severity,
        count: 1
      });
    }
  }
  return grouped.slice(0, 10);
}

export function getInterpretationData(
  session: SessionMetadata,
  qc: SessionQcMetrics | null,
  analytics: SessionMetrics | null,
  trends?: any,
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null
) {
  const summary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession,
    qcMetrics: qc,
    analyticsMetrics: analytics
  });

  return {
    reliableText: summary.limitations.reliable_text,
    limitedText: summary.limitations.limited_text,
    warningText: summary.limitations.warning_text,
    presentationSummary: summary
  };
}

/** Utility to build SVG sparkline/chart from dataset */
function generateSvgPath(points: [number, number][], width: number, height: number): { path: string; minX: number; maxX: number; minY: number; maxY: number } {
  if (points.length < 2) {
    return { path: '', minX: 0, maxX: 0, minY: 0, maxY: 0 };
  }

  const xs = points.map(p => p[0]);
  const ys = points.map(p => p[1]);

  const minX = Math.min(...xs);
  const maxX = Math.max(...xs);
  const minY = Math.min(...ys);
  const maxY = Math.max(...ys);

  const spanX = maxX - minX || 1;
  const spanY = maxY - minY || 1;

  const scaled = points.map(([x, y]) => {
    const sx = ((x - minX) / spanX) * width;
    const sy = height - ((y - minY) / spanY) * height;
    return `${sx.toFixed(1)},${sy.toFixed(1)}`;
  });

  return {
    path: `M ${scaled.join(' L ')}`,
    minX, maxX, minY, maxY
  };
}

export function generateSessionHtml(options: GenerateHtmlOptions, hrPoints: [number, number][] = []): string {
  const { session, canonicalSession, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, flags, signalFiles, user, notes, trends } = options;
  const prov = getSessionProvenance(analyticsMetrics?.hrv_version || '2.0');

  const rmssdVal = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value : (!canonicalSession ? (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null) : null);
  const sdnnVal = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value : (!canonicalSession ? (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null) : null);
  const pnn50Val = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value : (!canonicalSession ? (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null) : null);
  const avgHrVal = canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value ?? null) : session.avg_hr;

  const rmssdElig = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'unsupported' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'quality_unknown' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));
  const sdnnElig = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'unsupported' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'quality_unknown' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));
  const pnn50Elig = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'unsupported' && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'quality_unknown' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));

  const rmssdInvalid = rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  const sdnnInvalid = sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  const pnn50Invalid = pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';

  const hrvInvalidReason = canonicalSession?.core_metrics.rmssd.warnings[0] || 'insufficient_data';

  const startTimeStr = SharedFormatter.formatDateTime(session.start_time, displayTimezone, displayLocale);

  const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;
  const hasValidCanonicalZones = !!(zoneConfig && Array.isArray(zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm) && zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[5] > 0);

          activityType = annotation.activity_type;

      console.warn('Failed to query activity_type in html.ts', e);

  const driftAnalysis = {

  let hrSvg = '';

  // Format grouped candidate flags

        const m = Math.floor(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 60000);
        const s = Math.floor((f.timestamp_offset_ms % 60000) / 1000);
        const timeStr = `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')} мин`;
        const severityClass = `sev-${f.severity}`;

  const { reliableText, limitedText, warningText, presentationSummary } = getInterpretationData(session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, trends, canonicalSession);

  const rmssdStr = rmssdInvalid
    ? (rmssdVal != null ? `— <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: normal; display: block;">(справочно: ${rmssdVal.toFixed(1)} мс)</span>` : '—')
    : (rmssdVal != null ? `${rmssdVal.toFixed(1)} <span style="font-size: 0.8rem">мс</span>${rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? ' <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #a1a1aa; font-weight: normal; display: block; margin-top: 2px;">(справочно)</span>' : ''}` : '—');

  const sdnnStr = sdnnInvalid
    ? (sdnnVal != null ? `— <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: normal; display: block;">(справочно: ${sdnnVal.toFixed(1)} мс)</span>` : '—')
    : (sdnnVal != null ? `${sdnnVal.toFixed(1)} <span style="font-size: 0.8rem">мс</span>${sdnnElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? ' <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #a1a1aa; font-weight: normal; display: block; margin-top: 2px;">(справочно)</span>' : ''}` : '—');

  const pnn50Str = pnn50Invalid
    ? (pnn50Val != null ? `— <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: normal; display: block;">(справочно: ${pnn50Val.toFixed(1)}%)</span>` : '—')

          <span>${canonicalSession?.advanced_metrics?.lomb_scargle?.lf?.power_ms2 != null ? `${canonicalSession.advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle.lf.power_ms2} / ${canonicalSession.advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle.hf?.power_ms2} ms²` : '—'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Сегментация: Активность</span>
          <span>${canonicalSession?.activity_segmentation?.active_duration_seconds != null ? `${canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.active_duration_seconds} сек (${((canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.active_duration_seconds / Math.max(1, canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.total_duration_seconds)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)` : '—'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Сегментация: Покой</span>
          <span>${canonicalSession?.activity_segmentation?.inactive_duration_seconds != null ? `${canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.inactive_duration_seconds} сек (${((canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.inactive_duration_seconds / Math.max(1, canonicalSession.activity_segmentation.total_duration_seconds)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)` : '—'}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary);">
        * Показатели DFA и периодограмма Ломба-Скаргла являются экспериментальными математическими метриками. Акселерометрия отражает контекст движений, а не мощность нагрузки (ватты).
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Динамика Heart Rate (ЧСС)</div>
      ${hrSvg}
    </div>

    ${trends ? `
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Тренды и Baseline (Личный физиологический коридор)</div>
      <div class="info-grid" style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Источник baseline</span>
          <span>${trends.baseline_source === 'personal_activity_specific' ? 'Личный (по активности)' : (trends.baseline_source === 'personal_global' ? 'Личный (общий)' : (trends.baseline_source === 'reference_fallback' ? 'Справочный ориентир' : 'Недоступен'))}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Сессий использовано</span>
          <span>${trends.sessions_used} из ${trends.sessions_required} требуемых</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Метрика</th>
            <th>Значение сессии</th>
            <th>${trends.personal_baseline_available ? 'Личный baseline' : 'Справочный ориентир'} коридор</th>
            <th>Сравнение / Статус</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${(() => {
            const isAvailable = trends.personal_baseline_available;
            const metricsToCompare = [
              { name: 'RMSSD', val: canonicalSession ? (rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null), band: trends.baseline.rmssd_ms, unit: 'мс', eligibility: rmssdElig },
              { name: 'SDNN', val: canonicalSession ? (sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null), band: trends.baseline.sdnn_ms, unit: 'мс', eligibility: sdnnElig },
              { name: 'pNN50', val: canonicalSession ? (pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null), band: trends.baseline.pnn50_percent, unit: '%', eligibility: pnn50Elig },
              { name: 'Средняя ЧСС', val: canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value ?? null) : (session.avg_hr ?? null), band: trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm, unit: 'уд/мин', eligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' }
            ];
            return metricsToCompare.map(m => {
              const valStr = m.val != null ? `${m.val.toFixed(1)} ${m.unit}` : '—';
              const bandStr = m.band.median != null ? `${m.band.p25} – ${m.band.p75} ${m.unit}` : '—';
              let statusStr = '—';
              let statusClass = '';
              if (m.val != null && m.band.median != null) {
                if (isAvailable) {
                  const isLimited = canonicalSession
                    ? m.eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS'
                    : analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited';
                  if (m.val > m.band.p75) {
                    statusStr = isLimited 
                      ? 'Выше личного диапазона, но значение ограничено качеством записи'
                      : 'Выше личного диапазона';
                    statusClass = 'badge sev-high';
                  } else if (m.val < m.band.p25) {
                    statusStr = isLimited 
                      ? 'Ниже личного диапазона, но значение ограничено качеством записи'
                      : 'Ниже личного диапазона';
                    statusClass = 'badge sev-medium';
                  } else {
                    statusStr = isLimited 
                      ? 'В личном диапазоне, но значение ограничено качеством записи'
                      : 'В личном диапазоне';
                    statusClass = 'badge badge-ok';
                  }
                } else {
                  statusStr = 'Справочно';
                  statusClass = 'badge';
                }
              }
              return `
                <tr>
                  <td><strong>${m.name}</strong></td>
                  <td>${valStr}</td>
                  <td>${bandStr}</td>
                  <td><span class="${statusClass}">${statusStr}</span></td>
                </tr>
              `;
            }).join('');
          })()}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      ${!trends.personal_baseline_available ? `
        <div style="margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--accent-yellow); background: rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.05); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px dashed var(--accent-yellow);">
          <strong>Внимание:</strong> Справочный ориентир является популяционным ориентиром и не должен использоваться как личный baseline.
        </div>
      ` : ''}
    </div>
    ` : ''}

    <!-- Data Reliability Panel -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Достоверность данных и интерпретация</div>
      ${warningText ? `
        <div style="background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border: 1px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; color: #f87171; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.85rem;">
          ${escapeHtml(warningText)}
        </div>
      ` : ''}
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 24px;">
        <div>
          <h4 style="color: #22c55e; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 0.95rem;">Что можно уверенно использовать</h4>
          <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; white-space: pre-line; line-height: 1.6; color: #e2e8f0;">${escapeHtml(reliableText)}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4 style="color: #ef4444; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 0.95rem;">Что ограничено качеством данных</h4>
          <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; white-space: pre-line; line-height: 1.6; color: #e2e8f0;">${escapeHtml(limitedText)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Оценка качества данных</div>
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Монотонность временных меток</span>
          <span>${formatVisibleEnum(qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status) || '—'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Пропущенные отсчёты ЭКГ</span>
          <span>${qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count ?? 0}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Клиппинг ЭКГ (секунд)</span>
          <span>${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds != null ? `${presentationSummary.technical_qc.ecg_clipping_seconds.toFixed(1)} сек` : '—'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Согласованность сигналов ЭКГ/RR</span>
          <span>${agreementPres.valueString}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Движение (интенсивность)</span>
          <span>${formatVisibleEnum(presentationSummary.technical_qc.acc_motion_severity)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-item">
          <span class="info-lbl">Аэробное рассогласование (коэф.)</span>
          <span>${(driftAnalysis.status as string) === 'valid_experimental' && driftAnalysis.value_percent !== null ? (driftAnalysis.value_percent / 100).toFixed(3) + ' (экспер.)' : 'показатель недоступен (требуется внешний датчик мощности и >= 20 мин)'}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Выявленные автоматические кандидатные события</div>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th style="width: 100px;">Смещение</th>
            <th>Описание кандидатного события</th>
            <th style="width: 180px;">Тип события</th>
            <th style="width: 100px;">Степень</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${flagsRows}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <!-- Glossary Panel -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Глоссарий терминов</div>
      <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-secondary);">
        <div><strong>ЧСС:</strong> Частота сердечных сокращений (удары в минуту).</div>
        <div><strong>ВСР (HRV):</strong> Вариабельность сердечного ритма. Колебания интервалов между последовательными ударами сердца.</div>
        <div><strong>RMSSD:</strong> Временная метрика ВСР (HRV time-domain); интерпретация зависит от качества записи, типа активности и личного baseline.</div>
        <div><strong>SDNN:</strong> Временная метрика ВСР (HRV time-domain); отражает общую вариабельность; интерпретация зависит от качества, активности и baseline.</div>
        <div><strong>pNN50:</strong> Временная метрика ВСР; процент соседних интервалов, различающихся более чем на 50 мс; интерпретация зависит от контекста и baseline.</div>
        <div><strong>Согласованность сигналов ЭКГ/RR:</strong> Качество совпадения RR-интервалов из прибора и пиков ЭКГ.</div>
        <div><strong>Кандидатные события:</strong> Результаты автоматического математического анализа, которые могут быть полезны для обсуждения со специалистом при наличии симптомов или сомнений.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    ${notes && notes.trim().length > 0 ? `
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Примечания спортсмена / врача</div>
      <div class="notes-box">${escapeHtml(notes.trim())}</div>
    </div>
    ` : ''}

    <footer>
      H10 Athlete Cardio Lab © 2026. Данный отчет сформирован локально на ПК пользователя.
    </footer>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
`;
}

  getRawLogsDir,

  SessionQcMetrics,
  SessionMetrics,
  CandidateFlag,
  UserPreferences,
  getDb
} from '../db/db';

const fontsDir = process.env.WINDIR ? path.join(process.env.WINDIR, 'Fonts') : 'C:\\Windows\\Fonts';
const arialPath = path.join(fontsDir, 'arial.ttf');
const arialbdPath = path.join(fontsDir, 'arialbd.ttf');

export interface GeneratePdfOptions {
  session: SessionMetadata;
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null;
  qcMetrics: SessionQcMetrics | null;
  analyticsMetrics: SessionMetrics | null;
  flags: CandidateFlag[];
  signalFiles: { id: string; signal_type: string }[];
  user: UserPreferences | null;
  notes?: string;
  trends?: any;
  display_language?: 'ru' | 'en';
  display_locale?: string;
  display_timezone?: string;
}

export function maskDeviceId(deviceId: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!deviceId) return '—';
  if (deviceId.length <= 4) return deviceId;
  return deviceId.substring(0, 4) + '****';
}

interface GroupedFlag {
  timestamp_offset_ms: number;
  flag_type: string;
  description_ru: string;
  severity: string;
  count: number;
}

export function groupFlags(flags: CandidateFlag[]): GroupedFlag[] {
  const qualityTypes = [
    'baseline_drift', 'clipping', 'hf_noise',
    'quality_artifact_ecg_noise', 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift', 'motion_artifact'
  ];
  const anomalyFlags = flags.filter(f => !qualityTypes.includes(f.flag_type));

  const sorted = [...anomalyFlags].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp_offset_ms - b.timestamp_offset_ms);
  const grouped: GroupedFlag[] = [];
  const windowSizeMs = 60000; // 60 seconds

  for (const f of sorted) {
    let description = f.description_ru;
    description = description.replace(/Аномальный RR-интервал/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал');
    description = description.replace(/Нетипичный RR-интервал/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал');

    const matchingGroup = grouped.find(g => 
      g.flag_type === f.flag_type && 
      g.severity === f.severity && 
      Math.abs(g.timestamp_offset_ms - f.timestamp_offset_ms) <= windowSizeMs
    );

    if (matchingGroup) {
      matchingGroup.count++;
    } else {
      grouped.push({
        timestamp_offset_ms: f.timestamp_offset_ms,
        flag_type: f.flag_type,
        description_ru: description,
        severity: f.severity,
        count: 1
      });
    }
  }
  return grouped.slice(0, 10);
}

export function getInterpretationData(
  session: SessionMetadata,
  qc: SessionQcMetrics | null,
  analytics: SessionMetrics | null,
  trends?: any,
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null
) {
  const summary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession,
    qcMetrics: qc,
    analyticsMetrics: analytics
  });

  return {
    reliableText: summary.limitations.reliable_text,
    limitedText: summary.limitations.limited_text,
    warningText: summary.limitations.warning_text,
    presentationSummary: summary
  };
}

function translateFlagTypeRu(type: string): string {
  const t = type.trim();
  if (t === 'candidate_rr_outlier' || t === 'RR outlier') return 'Выбивающийся RR-интервал';
  if (t === 'data_gap' || t === 'Actual missing data') return 'Пропуск данных';
  if (t === 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise' || t === 'ECG high-frequency noise') return 'Шум ЭКГ';
  if (t === 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift' || t === 'Baseline drift') return 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ';
  if (t === 'motion_artifact' || t === 'Motion artifact') return 'Артефакт движения';
  if (t === 'sync_issue' || t === 'Timestamp/sync issue') return 'Сбой синхронизации';
  return t;
}

export function generateSessionPdf(options: GeneratePdfOptions): Promise<Buffer> {
  const { session, canonicalSession, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, flags, signalFiles, user, notes, trends } = options;
  const prov = getSessionProvenance(analyticsMetrics?.hrv_version || '2.0');

  return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const doc = new PDFDocument({ size: 'A4', margin: 40, bufferPages: true });
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];

      doc.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
      doc.on('end', () => {
        // Post-process to draw footers on all pages dynamically!
        const range = doc.bufferedPageRange();
        for (let i = 0; i < range.count; i++) {
          doc.switchToPage(i);
          doc.save();
          doc.fontSize(7.5).fillColor('#8b949e');
          doc.text(
            `Отчет сгенерирован автоматически в H10 Athlete Cardio Lab. Данные конфиденциальны. Страница ${i + 1} из ${range.count}`,
            40,
            801.89 - 15,
            { align: 'center', width: 515.28 }
          );
          doc.restore();
        }
        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      });
      doc.on('error', reject);

      if (fs.existsSync(arialPath) && fs.existsSync(arialbdPath)) {
        doc.registerFont('Arial', arialPath);
        doc.registerFont('Arial-Bold', arialbdPath);
      } else {
        doc.registerFont('Arial', 'Helvetica');
        doc.registerFont('Arial-Bold', 'Helvetica-Bold');
      }

      // Coordinates/dimensions
      const margin = 40;
      const pageWidth = 595.28;
      const contentWidth = pageWidth - margin * 2; // 515.28
      const pageHeight = 841.89;
      const pageBottom = pageHeight - margin; // 801.89
      let currentY = 0;

      // Reusable Layout Helpers
      function measureTextHeight(text: string, fontSize: number, isBold: boolean, width: number, lineGap = 0): number {
        doc.font(isBold ? 'Arial-Bold' : 'Arial').fontSize(fontSize);
        return doc.heightOfString(text, { width, lineGap });
      }

      function ensureSpace(neededHeight: number) {
        if (currentY + neededHeight > pageBottom - 20) {
          doc.addPage();
          drawHeaderBannerShort();
          currentY = 80;
        }
      }

      function drawHeaderBannerFull() {
        doc.save();
        doc.fillColor('#0d1117');
        doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 80).fill();
        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(18).fillColor('#ffffff');
        doc.text('Cardio Lab — Аналитический отчет', margin, 22);
        doc.font('Arial').fontSize(9).fillColor('#8b949e');
        doc.text(`Polar H10 RAW LOG ANALYSIS · СЕССИЯ: ${session.id}`, margin, 45);
        doc.restore();
        currentY = 95;
      }

      function drawHeaderBannerShort() {
        doc.save();
        doc.fillColor('#0d1117');
        doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 60).fill();
        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(14).fillColor('#ffffff');
        doc.text('Cardio Lab — Аналитический отчет', margin, 15);
        doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8).fillColor('#8b949e');
        doc.text(`Polar H10 RAW LOG ANALYSIS · СЕССИЯ: ${session.id}`, margin, 35);
        doc.restore();
      }

      function drawSectionTitle(title: string) {
        ensureSpace(35);
        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(11).fillColor('#212529').text(title, margin, currentY);
        doc.moveTo(margin, currentY + 15).lineTo(pageWidth - margin, currentY + 15).strokeColor('#e1e4e8').lineWidth(1).stroke();
        currentY += 25;
      }

      function drawParagraph(text: string, fontSize = 8.5, isBold = false, color = '#24292e', lineGap = 1) {
        const height = measureTextHeight(text, fontSize, isBold, contentWidth, lineGap);
        ensureSpace(height);
        doc.font(isBold ? 'Arial-Bold' : 'Arial').fontSize(fontSize).fillColor(color);
        doc.text(text, margin, currentY, { width: contentWidth, lineGap });
        currentY += height + 5;
      }

      function drawKeyValueRows(rows: { key: string; value: string }[], cols = 2) {
        doc.font('Arial').fontSize(9.5).fillColor('#586069');
        const colWidth = contentWidth / cols;
        
        let i = 0;
        while (i < rows.length) {
          const rowItems = rows.slice(i, i + cols);
          i += cols;
          
          let maxRowHeight = 16;
          const itemHeights: number[] = [];
          for (let j = 0; j < rowItems.length; j++) {
            const item = rowItems[j];
            const textStr = `${item.key}: ${item.value}`;
            const h = doc.heightOfString(textStr, { width: colWidth - 10 });
            itemHeights.push(h);
            if (h > maxRowHeight) {
              maxRowHeight = h;
            }
          }
          
          ensureSpace(maxRowHeight + 4);
          
          for (let j = 0; j < rowItems.length; j++) {
            const item = rowItems[j];
            const textStr = `${item.key}: ${item.value}`;
            const x = margin + j * colWidth;
            doc.text(textStr, x + 5, currentY, { width: colWidth - 10 });
          }
          
          currentY += maxRowHeight + 4;
        }
        currentY += 6;
      }

      function drawTableHeader(headers: string[], xOffsets: number[], widths: number[]) {
        ensureSpace(24);
        doc.lineWidth(0.5).strokeColor('#eaecef');
        doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, 24).stroke();
        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#586069');
        
        // Vertical grid lines
        for (let i = 1; i < xOffsets.length; i++) {
          doc.moveTo(margin + xOffsets[i], currentY).lineTo(margin + xOffsets[i], currentY + 24).stroke();
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
          doc.text(headers[i], margin + xOffsets[i] + 5, currentY + 7, { width: widths[i] - 10, align: 'center' });
        }
        currentY += 24;
      }

      function drawTableRow(
        cols: string[],
        xOffsets: number[],
        widths: number[],
        minHeight = 24,
        alignments?: string[],
        isBold = false,
        headersToRepeat?: { headers: string[]; xOffsets: number[]; widths: number[] }
      ) {
        doc.font(isBold ? 'Arial-Bold' : 'Arial').fontSize(8.5);

        let maxCellHeight = minHeight;
        for (let i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
          const cellWidth = widths[i] - 10;
          const cellHeight = doc.heightOfString(cols[i] || '', { width: cellWidth, lineGap: 1 }) + 8;
          if (cellHeight > maxCellHeight) {
            maxCellHeight = cellHeight;
          }
        }

        const maxPageContentHeight = pageBottom - 80 - 20;
        if (maxCellHeight > maxPageContentHeight) {
          maxCellHeight = maxPageContentHeight;
        }

        const pageBreakTriggered = currentY + maxCellHeight > pageBottom - 20;
        if (pageBreakTriggered) {
          doc.addPage();
          drawHeaderBannerShort();
          currentY = 80;

          if (headersToRepeat) {
            drawTableHeader(headersToRepeat.headers, headersToRepeat.xOffsets, headersToRepeat.widths);
          }
        }

        doc.lineWidth(0.5).strokeColor('#eaecef');
        doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, maxCellHeight).stroke();

        for (let i = 1; i < xOffsets.length; i++) {
          doc.moveTo(margin + xOffsets[i], currentY).lineTo(margin + xOffsets[i], currentY + maxCellHeight).stroke();
        }

        doc.fillColor('#24292e');
        for (let i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
          const align = (alignments && alignments[i]) || 'center';
          const cellWidth = widths[i] - 10;

          const textHeight = doc.heightOfString(cols[i] || '', { width: cellWidth, lineGap: 1 });
          const textY = currentY + (maxCellHeight - textHeight) / 2;

          doc.text(cols[i] || '', margin + xOffsets[i] + 5, textY, { width: cellWidth, align: align as any, lineGap: 1 });
        }

        currentY += maxCellHeight;
      }

      function drawGlossaryEntry(term: string, desc: string, termWidth = 100) {
        const descWidth = contentWidth - termWidth;
        const height = measureTextHeight(desc, 8.5, false, descWidth, 1);
        ensureSpace(height + 4);

        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#24292e').text(`${term}:`, margin + 5, currentY + 2, { width: termWidth });
        doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#24292e').text(desc, margin + termWidth, currentY + 2, { width: descWidth, lineGap: 1 });
        currentY += height + 6;
      }

      // Draw first page elements
      drawHeaderBannerFull();

      // Disclaimer Box
      const disclaimerText = 'Данный отчет носит исключительно информационный характер и не является медицинским диагнозом. При любых симптомах или сомнениях обратитесь к врачу. Анализ основан на потребительской записи и не заменяет диагностическую ЭКГ или Холтер.';
      const disclaimerHeight = measureTextHeight(disclaimerText, 8.5, false, contentWidth - 20, 1) + 24;
      ensureSpace(disclaimerHeight);
      doc.fillColor('#fffdef');
      doc.strokeColor('#e3b341');
      doc.lineWidth(1);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, disclaimerHeight).fillAndStroke();
      
      doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(9).fillColor('#735c0f').text('ВНИМАНИЕ:', margin + 10, currentY + 8);
      doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#735c0f').text(disclaimerText, margin + 10, currentY + 20, { width: contentWidth - 20, lineGap: 1 });
      currentY += disclaimerHeight + 15;

      // Session information
      drawSectionTitle('Информация о сессии');
      const displayLocale = options.display_locale || (options.display_language === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU');
      const displayTimezone = options.display_timezone || (canonicalSession?.timing?.display_timezone || 'UTC');
      const startTime = SharedFormatter.formatDateTime(session.start_time, displayTimezone, displayLocale);
      const durationStr = SharedFormatter.formatDuration(session.duration_seconds, displayLocale as any);
      const zoneConfig = canonicalSession?.heart_rate_zones?.configuration;
      const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;
      const hasValidCanonicalZones = !!(zoneConfig && Array.isArray(zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm) && zoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[5] > 0);

      const resolvedZones = hasValidCanonicalZones ? {
        mode: zoneConfig!.mode,
        source: zoneConfig!.source,
        boundariesBpm: zoneConfig!.boundaries_bpm,
        configHash: zoneConfig!.config_hash,
        updatedAt: undefined
      } : (!isCanonical ? resolveHeartRateZones({
        max_hr: user?.max_hr ?? 185,
        resting_hr: user?.resting_hr ?? 60,
        custom_zones: user?.custom_zones
      }, user?.age ?? 35) : null);

      const zoneModeRu = resolvedZones
        ? (resolvedZones.mode === 'custom_bpm' 
            ? 'Пользовательский (bpm)' 
            : resolvedZones.mode === 'percent_hrmax' 
              ? 'Авто (% HRmax)' 
              : 'Авто (Karvonen)')
        : (isCanonical ? 'Недоступно (нет канонических зон)' : 'Устаревший / Неверифицированный');

      const boundsStr = resolvedZones
        ? `Z1:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[0]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[1]} Z2:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[1]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[2]} Z3:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[2]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[3]} Z4:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[3]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[4]} Z5:${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[4]}-${resolvedZones.boundariesBpm[5]}`
        : '—';

      drawKeyValueRows([
        { key: 'Дата старта', value: startTime },
        { key: 'ID Устройства', value: maskDeviceId(session.device_id) },
        { key: 'Длительность', value: durationStr },
        { key: 'Возраст', value: `${user?.age ?? 35} лет` },
        { key: 'Индекс качества (legacy, справочно)', value: session.overall_quality_score != null ? `${session.overall_quality_score.toFixed(0)}%` : '—' },
        { key: 'ЧСС покой / макс', value: `${user?.resting_hr ?? 60} / ${user?.max_hr ?? 185} уд/мин` },
        { key: 'Источник зон ЧСС', value: zoneModeRu },
        { key: 'Границы зон ЧСС', value: boundsStr }
      ], 2);

      if (resolvedZones?.mode === 'custom_bpm') {
        drawParagraph('Предупреждение: Зоны ЧСС заданы пользователем. Используются для тренировочной интерпретации и не являются медицинскими порогами.', 8, false, '#735c0f');
      }

      // HRV metrics Table
      drawSectionTitle('Показатели пульса и ВСР (HRV)');
      
      const canonical = options.canonicalSession;
      const rmssdVal = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.rmssd.value : (!canonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null) : null);
      const sdnnVal = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.sdnn.value : (!canonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null) : null);
      const pnn50Val = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.pnn50.value : (!canonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null) : null);
      const avgHrVal = canonical ? (canonical.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value ?? null) : (session.avg_hr ?? null);

      const rmssdElig = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'valid' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));
      const sdnnElig = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'valid' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));
      const pnn50Elig = canonical ? canonical.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_state : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'valid' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));

      const rmssdStr = rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
        ? (rmssdVal != null ? `— (${rmssdVal.toFixed(1)} мс)` : '—')
        : (rmssdVal != null ? `${rmssdVal.toFixed(1)} мс${rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? ' (справ.)' : ''}` : '—');

      const sdnnStr = sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
        ? (sdnnVal != null ? `— (${sdnnVal.toFixed(1)} мс)` : '—')
        : (sdnnVal != null ? `${sdnnVal.toFixed(1)} мс${sdnnElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? ' (справ.)' : ''}` : '—');

      const pnn50Str = pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
        ? (pnn50Val != null ? `— (${pnn50Val.toFixed(1)}%)` : '—')
        : (pnn50Val != null ? `${pnn50Val.toFixed(1)}%${pnn50Elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? ' (справ.)' : ''}` : '—');

      const agreementInput = makeEcgRrAgreementInput(qcMetrics);
      const agreementPres = getEcgRrAgreementPresentation(agreementInput);
      const consistencyStr = agreementPres.valueString;

      const xOffsets = [0, 85, 170, 255, 340, 425];
      const widths = [85, 85, 85, 85, 85, 90.28];
      
      drawTableHeader(['Ср. ЧСС', 'Мин/Макс ЧСС', 'RMSSD (ВСР)', 'SDNN (ВСР)', 'pNN50', 'Согласованность'], xOffsets, widths);
      drawTableRow([
        `${avgHrVal ? Math.round(avgHrVal) : '—'} уд/мин`,
        `${session.min_hr ?? '—'} / ${session.max_hr ?? '—'}`,
        rmssdStr,
        sdnnStr,
        pnn50Str,
        consistencyStr
      ], xOffsets, widths, 24, undefined, false, {
        headers: ['Ср. ЧСС', 'Мин/Макс ЧСС', 'RMSSD (ВСР)', 'SDNN (ВСР)', 'pNN50', 'Согласованность'],
        xOffsets,
        widths
      });
      currentY += 10;

      // HR Trend Chart
      const hrFile = signalFiles.find((s) => s.signal_type === 'HR');
      if (hrFile) {
        const hrFilePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${hrFile.id}_hr.txt.gz`);
        if (fs.existsSync(hrFilePath)) {
          const hrPointsRaw = await readHRGz(hrFilePath);
          const hrPoints: [number, number][] = hrPointsRaw.map(p => [p.timeMs, p.hrBpm]);
          if (hrPoints.length > 5) {
            ensureSpace(130);
            doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(11).fillColor('#212529').text('График ЧСС на протяжении сессии', margin, currentY);
            doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#8b949e').text('(ось X: минуты, ось Y: уд/мин)', margin + 200, currentY + 2);
            
            const chartH = 80;
            const chartW = contentWidth;
            const startX = margin;
            const startY = currentY + 18;

            doc.save();
            doc.lineWidth(0.5).strokeColor('#e1e4e8');
            doc.rect(startX, startY, chartW, chartH).stroke();

            const minT = hrPoints[0][0];
            const maxT = hrPoints[hrPoints.length - 1][0];
            const spanT = maxT - minT || 1;
            const hrs = hrPoints.map((p) => p[1]);
            const minH = Math.max(0, Math.min(...hrs) - 10);
            const maxH = Math.min(240, Math.max(...hrs) + 10);
            const spanH = maxH - minH || 1;

            doc.lineWidth(1.2).strokeColor('#f66a0a');
            
            const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(hrPoints.length / 300));
            for (let i = 0; i < hrPoints.length; i += step) {
              const [t, hr] = hrPoints[i];
              const px = startX + ((t - minT) / spanT) * chartW;
              const py = startY + chartH - ((hr - minH) / spanH) * chartH;
              if (i === 0) {
                doc.moveTo(px, py);
              } else {
                doc.lineTo(px, py);
              }
            }
            doc.stroke();

            doc.font('Arial').fontSize(7.5).fillColor('#586069');
            doc.text(String(Math.round(maxH)), startX + 5, startY + 5);
            doc.text(String(Math.round(minH + spanH / 2)), startX + 5, startY + chartH / 2 - 4);
            doc.text(String(Math.round(minH)), startX + 5, startY + chartH - 10);
            doc.restore();

            currentY += 115;
          }
        }
      }

      // ECG Snippet
      const ecgFile = signalFiles.find((s) => s.signal_type === 'ECG');
      if (ecgFile) {
        const ecgFilePath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${ecgFile.id}_ecg.txt.gz`);
        if (fs.existsSync(ecgFilePath)) {
          let startOffsetMs = 60000;
          if (flags.length > 0) {
            startOffsetMs = Math.max(0, flags[0].timestamp_offset_ms - 2500);
          }

          const startMs = new Date(session.start_time).getTime() + startOffsetMs;
          const endMs = startMs + 5000;
          const snippetPoints = await readECGGz(ecgFilePath, { startMs, endMs });
          const snippet: [number, number][] = snippetPoints.map(p => [p.timeMs, p.ecgUv]);
          const targetStartTs = startMs;

          if (snippet.length > 10) {
            ensureSpace(160);
            doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(11).fillColor('#212529').text('Фрагмент ЭКГ (сетка 25 мм/с, 10 мм/мВ)', margin, currentY);
            doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#586069').text(`Время смещения: ${(startOffsetMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} сек`, margin + 250, currentY + 2);
            
            const startX = margin;
            const startY = currentY + 18;
            const chartW = contentWidth;
            const chartH = 100;

            const ptPerMm = chartW / 125;
            
            doc.save();
            doc.rect(startX, startY, chartW, chartH).clip();

            doc.lineWidth(0.25).strokeColor('#ffdede');
            for (let x = 0; x < 125; x++) {
              const dx = startX + x * ptPerMm;
              doc.moveTo(dx, startY).lineTo(dx, startY + chartH).stroke();
            }
            const yLines = Math.floor(chartH / ptPerMm);
            for (let y = 0; y < yLines; y++) {
              const dy = startY + y * ptPerMm;
              doc.moveTo(startX, dy).lineTo(startX + chartW, dy).stroke();
            }

            doc.lineWidth(0.6).strokeColor('#ffadad');
            for (let x = 0; x <= 125; x += 5) {
              const dx = startX + x * ptPerMm;
              doc.moveTo(dx, startY).lineTo(dx, startY + chartH).stroke();
            }
            for (let y = 0; y <= yLines; y += 5) {
              const dy = startY + y * ptPerMm;
              doc.moveTo(startX, dy).lineTo(startX + chartW, dy).stroke();
            }

            const centerY = startY + chartH / 2;
            const scaleY = (10 * ptPerMm) / 1000;
            const minT = targetStartTs;

            doc.lineWidth(1).strokeColor('#1b1f23');
            for (let i = 0; i < snippet.length; i++) {
              const [t, uv] = snippet[i];
              const px = startX + ((t - minT) / 5000) * chartW;
              const py = centerY - uv * scaleY;
              if (i === 0) {
                doc.moveTo(px, py);
              } else {
                doc.lineTo(px, py);
              }
            }
            doc.stroke();
            doc.restore();

            currentY += 135;
          }
        }
      }

      // Reliability & Interpretation
      drawSectionTitle('Достоверность данных и интерпретация');
      const { reliableText, limitedText, warningText } = getInterpretationData(session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, trends, canonicalSession);

      if (warningText) {
        const warningBoxHeight = measureTextHeight(warningText, 8.5, true, contentWidth - 20) + 16;
        ensureSpace(warningBoxHeight);
        doc.fillColor('#fff0f0');
        doc.strokeColor('#f87171');
        doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, warningBoxHeight).fillAndStroke();
        doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#b91c1c').text(warningText, margin + 10, currentY + 8, { width: contentWidth - 20 });
        currentY += warningBoxHeight + 10;
      }

      ensureSpace(120);
      const halfWidth = contentWidth / 2 - 10;
      let interpretationStartY = currentY;
      doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(9.5).fillColor('#22c55e').text('Что можно уверенно использовать', margin, interpretationStartY);
      doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#24292e').text(reliableText, margin, interpretationStartY + 15, { width: halfWidth, lineGap: 3 });

      doc.font('Arial-Bold').fontSize(9.5).fillColor('#ef4444').text('Что ограничено качеством данных', margin + halfWidth + 20, interpretationStartY);
      doc.font('Arial').fontSize(8.5).fillColor('#24292e').text(limitedText, margin + halfWidth + 20, interpretationStartY + 15, { width: halfWidth, lineGap: 3 });

      // Determine heights of interpretation text to advance currentY
      const relHeight = measureTextHeight(reliableText, 8.5, false, halfWidth, 3);
      const limHeight = measureTextHeight(limitedText, 8.5, false, halfWidth, 3);
      currentY += Math.max(relHeight, limHeight) + 30;

      // Technical Passport
      drawSectionTitle('Технический паспорт анализа (Методология)');

      const hrvQualityJson = analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality_json ? JSON.parse(analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality_json) : null;
      const matchMetricsJson = qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json ? JSON.parse(qcMetrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json) : null;
      let rrCleaningSummary = 'Нет данных';
      if (hrvQualityJson) {
        const artPercent = hrvQualityJson.artifact_percent != null ? hrvQualityJson.artifact_percent.toFixed(1) : '—';
        rrCleaningSummary = `Удалено ${artPercent}% артефактов (${hrvQualityJson.rejected_rr_count} из ${hrvQualityJson.raw_rr_count})`;
      }

      let matchMetricsSummary = agreementPres.valueString;
      if (canonicalSession) {
        matchMetricsSummary = '— (требуются валидированные парные записи)';
      } else if (agreementPres.value !== null && matchMetricsJson) {
        matchMetricsSummary = `20мс/50мс: ${matchMetricsJson.match_rate_20ms.toFixed(1)}%/${matchMetricsJson.match_rate_50ms.toFixed(1)}%, Ср.ош: ${matchMetricsJson.median_abs_error_ms.toFixed(1)} мс`;
      }

      let activityType = 'unknown';
      const db = getDb();
      if (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function') {
        try {
          const stmt = db.prepare('SELECT activity_type FROM session_annotations WHERE session_id = ?');
          if (stmt && typeof stmt.get === 'function') {
            const annotation = stmt.get(session.id) as { activity_type: string } | undefined;
            if (annotation?.activity_type) {
              activityType = annotation.activity_type;
            }
          }
        } catch (e: any) {
          const { logger } = require('../logging/appLogger');
          logger.warn('report', 'Failed to query activity_type in pdf.ts', { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
        }
      }

      const isTimebaseMonotonic = canonical 
        ? (canonical.timing?.timebase_monotonic !== false && !canonical.task_eligibility?.rmssd?.blocking_reasons?.some(r => r.toLowerCase().includes('monotonic') || r.toLowerCase().includes('timestamp')))
        : (qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status === 'valid');
      const timestampConfidence = isTimebaseMonotonic ? 'Валидно' : 'Невалидно (немонотонность)';
      const hrvSrc = hrvQualityJson?.hrv_source || hrvQualityJson?.source || hrvQualityJson?.quality || analyticsMetrics?.hrv_source;
      let hrvSource = formatVisibleEnum(hrvSrc);
      if ((!hrvSrc || hrvSrc === 'none') && (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd != null || analyticsMetrics?.sdnn != null)) {
        hrvSource = 'Нативные RR Polar';
      }
      const hrvQuality = formatVisibleEnum(hrvQualityJson?.quality || analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality);
      const dbFiles = (db && typeof db.prepare === 'function')
        ? (db.prepare(`
        SELECT f.filename 
        FROM ingested_files f
        JOIN session_signals sf ON f.id = sf.file_id
        WHERE sf.session_id = ?
      `).all(session.id) as { filename: string }[])
        : [];
      const sourceMode = getSourceMode(dbFiles);
      const sourceModeRu = formatVisibleEnum(sourceMode);

      drawKeyValueRows([
        { key: 'Версия методологии', value: (canonical ? canonical.provenance.method_version : prov.methodology_version) || '' },
        { key: 'Источник ВСР', value: canonical ? 'CanonicalBeatLedger' : hrvSource },
        { key: 'Версия алгоритмов', value: (canonical ? canonical.provenance.protocol_version : prov.algorithm_version) || '' },
        { key: 'Качество ВСР', value: canonical ? (rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'Валидно' : (rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'Ограничено качеством' : 'Не применимо')) : hrvQuality },
        { key: 'Режим источника', value: sourceModeRu },
        { key: 'Очистка артефактов RR', value: rrCleaningSummary },
        { key: 'Исходное время', value: session.start_time },
        { key: 'Согласованность ЭКГ/RR', value: matchMetricsSummary },
        { key: 'Достоверность меток', value: timestampConfidence }
      ], 2);

      // Trends and Baseline
      if (trends) {
        drawSectionTitle('Тренды и Baseline (Личный физиологический коридор)');
        const isAvailable = trends.personal_baseline_available;
        const sourceLabel = isAvailable ? 'Личный baseline' : 'Справочный ориентир (не личный)';

        drawKeyValueRows([
          { key: 'Источник baseline', value: trends.baseline_source === 'personal_activity_specific' ? 'Личный (по активности)' : (trends.baseline_source === 'personal_global' ? 'Личный (общий)' : (trends.baseline_source === 'reference_fallback' ? 'Справочный ориентир' : 'Недоступен')) },
          { key: 'Сессий использовано', value: `${trends.sessions_used} из ${trends.sessions_required} требуемых` }
        ], 2);

        const compareOffsets = [0, 85, 170, 310];
        const compareWidths = [85, 85, 140, 205.28];
        
        drawTableHeader(['Метрика', 'Значение сессии', `${sourceLabel} коридор`, 'Сравнение / Статус'], compareOffsets, compareWidths);

        const metricsToCompare = [
          { name: 'RMSSD', val: canonical ? (rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonical.core_metrics.rmssd.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null), band: trends.baseline.rmssd_ms, unit: 'мс', eligibility: rmssdElig },
          { name: 'SDNN', val: canonical ? (sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonical.core_metrics.sdnn.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null), band: trends.baseline.sdnn_ms, unit: 'мс', eligibility: sdnnElig },
          { name: 'pNN50', val: canonical ? (pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? null : canonical.core_metrics.pnn50.value) : (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null), band: trends.baseline.pnn50_percent, unit: '%', eligibility: pnn50Elig },
          { name: 'Средняя ЧСС', val: canonical ? (canonical.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value ?? null) : (session.avg_hr ?? null), band: trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm, unit: 'уд/мин', eligibility: 'ELIGIBLE' }
        ];

        for (const m of metricsToCompare) {
          let valStr = '—';
          if (m.val != null) {
            valStr = `${m.val.toFixed(1)} ${m.unit}`;
          }

          let bandStr = '—';
          if (m.band.median != null) {
            bandStr = `${m.band.p25} – ${m.band.p75} ${m.unit}`;
          }

          let statusStr = '—';
          if (m.val != null && m.band.median != null) {
            if (isAvailable) {
              const isLimited = canonical
                ? m.eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS'
                : analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited';
              if (m.val > m.band.p75) {
                statusStr = isLimited 
                  ? 'Выше личного диапазона (качество ограничено)'
                  : 'Выше личного диапазона';
              } else if (m.val < m.band.p25) {
                statusStr = isLimited 
                  ? 'Ниже личного диапазона (качество ограничено)'
                  : 'Ниже личного диапазона';
              } else {
                statusStr = isLimited 
                  ? 'В личном диапазоне (качество ограничено)'
                  : 'В личном диапазоне';
              }
            } else {
              statusStr = 'Справочно (Личный профиль не сформирован)';
            }
          }

          drawTableRow([m.name, valStr, bandStr, statusStr], compareOffsets, compareWidths, 20, undefined, false, {
            headers: ['Метрика', 'Значение сессии', `${sourceLabel} коридор`, 'Сравнение / Статус'],
            xOffsets: compareOffsets,
            widths: compareWidths
          });
        }
        currentY += 10;

        if (!isAvailable) {
          drawParagraph('Внимание: Справочный ориентир является популяционным ориентиром и не должен использоваться как личный baseline.', 7.5, false, '#735c0f');
        }
      }

      // Grouped Events
      drawSectionTitle('Выявленные автоматические кандидатные события');
      drawParagraph('* Данные события представляют собой результаты автоматического математического анализа. Они не проверены кардиологом и не могут являться основанием для диагнозов.', 8, false, '#586069');

      const displayFlags = groupFlags(flags);
      if (displayFlags.length === 0) {
        drawParagraph('Автоматические кандидатные события не обнаружены при данном качестве записи.', 9.5, false, '#586069');
      } else {
        const eventOffsets = [0, 85, 305, 430];
        const eventWidths = [85, 220, 125, 85.28];
        
        drawTableHeader(['Смещение', 'Описание события (недиагностическое)', 'Тип сигнала', 'Степень'], eventOffsets, eventWidths);

        for (const f of displayFlags) {
          const m = Math.floor(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 60000);
          const s = Math.floor((f.timestamp_offset_ms % 60000) / 1000);
          
          let descText = f.description_ru;
          if (f.count > 1) {
            descText += ` (повторилось ${f.count} раз(а))`;
          }
          const sevRu = formatVisibleEnum(f.severity);

          drawTableRow([
            `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')} мин`,
            descText,
            translateFlagTypeRu(f.flag_type),
            sevRu
          ], eventOffsets, eventWidths, 24, ['center', 'left', 'center', 'center'], false, {
            headers: ['Смещение', 'Описание события (недиагностическое)', 'Тип сигнала', 'Степень'],
            xOffsets: eventOffsets,
            widths: eventWidths
          });
        }
      }
      currentY += 10;

      // User Notes
      if (notes && notes.trim().length > 0) {
        drawSectionTitle('Заметки и примечания к сессии');
        drawParagraph(notes.trim(), 9, false, '#24292e', 2);
      }

      // Glossary
      drawSectionTitle('Глоссарий терминов');
      const glossaryItems = [
        { term: 'ЧСС', desc: 'Частота сердечных сокращений (удары в минуту).' },
        { term: 'ВСР (HRV)', desc: 'Вариабельность сердечного ритма. Колебания интервалов между ударами.' },
        { term: 'RMSSD', desc: 'Временная метрика ВСР (HRV time-domain); интерпретация зависит от качества записи, типа активности и личного baseline.' },
        { term: 'SDNN', desc: 'Временная метрика ВСР (HRV time-domain); отражает общую вариабельность; интерпретация зависит от качества, активности и baseline.' },
        { term: 'pNN50', desc: 'Временная метрика ВСР; процент соседних интервалов, различающихся более чем на 50 мс; интерпретация зависит от контекста и baseline.' },
        { term: 'Согласованность', desc: 'Качество совпадения RR-интервалов из файла с пиками ЭКГ.' },
        { term: 'Кандидатные события', desc: 'Результаты автоматического мат. анализа, которые могут быть полезны для обсуждения со специалистом при наличии симптомов или сомнений.' }
      ];

      for (const item of glossaryItems) {
        drawGlossaryEntry(item.term, item.desc, 100);
      }

      doc.end();
    } catch (e) {
      reject(e);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * src/backend/reports/progressReviewReportService.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G18 / G23 — Authoritative Offline Progress Review Report Service.
 * Implements:
 * - Preview generation with exact currentness verification against view revision & underlying sessions
 * - Sanitized standalone HTML report with non-diagnostic disclaimers and XSS mitigation
 * - Tabular CSV generation with unit columns, withholding reasons and CSV formula injection neutralization
 * - JSON payload generation with privacy options
 * - Stale dependency / revision conflict rejection (409 / 412)
 * - Atomic write to staging directory with SHA-256 and byte verification
 * - Idempotency by idempotency_key
 * - Strict profile isolation (CrossProfileAccessError)
 */

export class ProgressReportConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'PROGRESS_REPORT_STALE') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ProgressReportConflictError';
  }
}

function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function escapeCsvField(val: any): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  let str = String(val);
  // CSV Formula Injection mitigation: prepend single quote if starting with =, +, -, @, or tab/CR
  if (/^[=\+\-@\t\r]/.test(str)) {
    str = `'${str}`;
  }
  if (str.includes(',') || str.includes('"') || str.includes('\n') || str.includes('\r')) {
    return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return str;
}

export class ProgressReviewReportService {
  /**
   * Generates a comprehensive live preview of the progress review report.
   */
  public static async generatePreview(
    viewId: string,
    profileId: string
  ): Promise<ProgressReviewReportPreview> {
    const view = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
    if (!view) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' not found.`);
    }

    if (view.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `View '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${view.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    let snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot | null = null;
    if (view.current_snapshot_id) {
      snapshot = getLongitudinalSnapshot(view.current_snapshot_id);
    }

    // If snapshot is missing or stale, calculate fresh snapshot
    if (!snapshot || !snapshot.is_current) {
      snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(view.normalized_query);
    }

    const eligiblePeers = new Set<string>();
    for (const b of Object.values(snapshot.per_metric_baselines)) {
      for (const pId of b.included_peer_session_ids) {
        eligiblePeers.add(pId);
      }
    }

    const limitations: string[] = [];
    if (!snapshot.is_current) {
      limitations.push(`Снимок помечен как неактуальный: ${snapshot.currentness_reason}`);
    }
    for (const b of Object.values(snapshot.per_metric_baselines)) {
      if (b.limitations && b.limitations.length > 0) {
        limitations.push(...b.limitations);
      }
    }

    const preview: ProgressReviewReportPreview = {
      view_id: view.view_id,
      view_name: view.name,
      view_revision: view.optimistic_revision,
      profile_id: view.profile_id,
      snapshot_id: snapshot.snapshot_id,
      dependency_hash: snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
      is_current: snapshot.is_current,
      currentness_status: snapshot.is_current ? 'current' : 'historical_superseded',
      total_observations: snapshot.ordered_observation_points.length,
      eligible_peers_count: eligiblePeers.size,
      metrics_analyzed: Object.keys(snapshot.per_metric_baselines),
      baselines: snapshot.per_metric_baselines,
      change_cards: snapshot.change_cards,
      limitations: Array.from(new Set(limitations)),
      disclaimer_ru:
        'CardioLab Workstation не является медицинским изделием и не предназначена для постановки диагнозов или назначения лечения. Персональные референсные диапазоны носят исключительно описательный исследовательский характер.',
      disclaimer_en:
        'CardioLab Workstation is not a medical device and is not intended for clinical diagnosis or medical treatment. Personal reference ranges are strictly descriptive and exploratory.',
      generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    return preview;
  }

  /**
   * Generates tabular CSV report.
   */
  public static generateCsvReport(
    view: SavedLongitudinalView,
    snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot,
    privacyOptions: LongitudinalPrivacyOptions
  ): string {
    const requestedMetrics = Object.keys(snapshot.per_metric_baselines);
    const lines: string[] = [];

    // Header metadata lines
    lines.push(`# CardioLab Athlete Progress Review Export`);
    lines.push(`# View Name: ${escapeCsvField(view.name)}`);
    lines.push(`# View Revision: ${view.optimistic_revision}`);
    lines.push(`# Profile: ${privacyOptions.exclude_direct_identifiers ? 'ANONYMIZED' : escapeCsvField(view.profile_id)}`);
    lines.push(`# Snapshot ID: ${snapshot.snapshot_id}`);
    lines.push(`# Aggregate Dependency Hash: ${snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash}`);
    lines.push(`# Generated UTC: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
    lines.push(`# Disclaimer: CardioLab is non-diagnostic exploratory software.`);
    if (!privacyOptions.exclude_notes && view.user_notes) {
      lines.push(`# User Notes: ${escapeCsvField(view.user_notes)}`);
    }

    // Column headers
    const cols = [
      'ordinal_index',
      'slot_date',
      'session_id',
      'is_named_window',
      'window_root_id',
      'window_revision',
      'timestamp_utc',
      'activity_type',
      'quality_score',
      'lineage_state'
    ];

    for (const mKey of requestedMetrics) {
      cols.push(`${mKey}_value`);
      cols.push(`${mKey}_unit`);
      cols.push(`${mKey}_is_withheld`);
      cols.push(`${mKey}_withholding_reason`);
    }

    lines.push(cols.join(','));

    for (const obs of snapshot.ordered_observation_points) {
      const row: string[] = [
        String(obs.ordinal_index),
        escapeCsvField(obs.slot_date || ''),
        escapeCsvField(obs.session_id),
        obs.is_named_window ? 'true' : 'false',
        escapeCsvField(obs.window_root_id || ''),
        obs.window_revision !== null && obs.window_revision !== undefined ? String(obs.window_revision) : '',
        escapeCsvField(obs.timestamp_utc),
        escapeCsvField(obs.activity_type || ''),
        obs.quality_score !== null ? String(obs.quality_score) : '',
        escapeCsvField(obs.lineage_state)
      ];

      for (const mKey of requestedMetrics) {
        const m = obs.metrics[mKey];
        if (!m || m.value === null || m.is_withheld) {
          row.push(''); // STRICTLY empty/null, NEVER 0!
          row.push(escapeCsvField(m?.unit || ''));
          row.push('true');
          row.push(escapeCsvField(m?.withholding_reason || m?.baseline_exclusion_reason || 'Withheld'));
        } else {
          row.push(String(m.value));
          row.push(escapeCsvField(m.unit));
          row.push('false');
          row.push('');
        }
      }

      lines.push(row.join(','));
    }

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Executes atomic, idempotent export of the progress review report.
   */
  public static async executeReportExport(
    viewId: string,
    profileId: string,
    req: ProgressReviewReportExportRequest
  ): Promise<ProgressReviewReportExportResult> {
    const view = getSavedLongitudinalView(viewId);
    if (!view) {
      throw new Error(`Saved view '${viewId}' not found.`);
    }

    if (view.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `View '${viewId}' belongs to profile '${view.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    // Revision check
    if (view.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_view_revision) {
      throw new ProgressReportConflictError(
        `View revision mismatch: expected ${req.expected_view_revision}, current is ${view.optimistic_revision}`,
        'VIEW_REVISION_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    let snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot | null = null;
    if (view.current_snapshot_id) {
      snapshot = getLongitudinalSnapshot(view.current_snapshot_id);
    }

    if (!snapshot || !snapshot.is_current) {
      snapshot = await LongitudinalService.buildSnapshot(view.normalized_query);
    }

    // Dependency hash check if requested
    if (req.expected_dependency_hash && req.expected_dependency_hash !== snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash) {
      throw new ProgressReportConflictError(
        `Dependency hash mismatch: expected ${req.expected_dependency_hash}, current is ${snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash}`,
        'DEPENDENCY_HASH_MISMATCH'
      );
    }

    // Window revision drift check: verify all linked Named Windows match current active DB revision
    const db = getDb();
    const windowRefs = view.window_references || view.normalized_query?.window_references;
    if (windowRefs && windowRefs.length > 0) {
      for (const wRef of windowRefs) {
        const winRow = db.prepare(`
          SELECT revision FROM session_named_windows
          WHERE session_id = ? AND (root_window_id = ? OR id = ?) AND is_active = 1
          ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
        `).get(wRef.session_id, wRef.window_root_id, wRef.window_root_id) as any;
        if (!winRow) {
          throw new ProgressReportConflictError(
            `Named Window '${wRef.window_root_id}' on session '${wRef.session_id}' was deleted or retired`,
            'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND'
          );
        }
        if (wRef.window_revision !== undefined && winRow.revision !== wRef.window_revision) {
          throw new ProgressReportConflictError(
            `Named Window '${wRef.window_root_id}' revision drift: expected ${wRef.window_revision}, current DB revision is ${winRow.revision}`,
            'WINDOW_REVISION_DRIFT'
          );
        }
      }
    }

    const privacyOptions: LongitudinalPrivacyOptions = {
      ...DEFAULT_LONGITUDINAL_PRIVACY_OPTIONS,
      ...(req.privacy_options || {})
    };

    let contentBuf: Buffer;
    let ext: string;

    if (req.format === 'html') {
      const htmlStr = this.generateHtmlReport(view, snapshot, privacyOptions);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(htmlStr, 'utf-8');
      ext = 'html';
    } else if (req.format === 'csv') {
      const csvStr = this.generateCsvReport(view, snapshot, privacyOptions);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(csvStr, 'utf-8');
      ext = 'csv';
    } else if (req.format === 'json') {
      const jsonPayload = LongitudinalService.exportLongitudinalPayload(snapshot.snapshot_id, privacyOptions);
      contentBuf = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(jsonPayload, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      ext = 'json';
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported report format '${req.format}'`);
    }

    const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(contentBuf).digest('hex');
    const sizeBytes = contentBuf.length;

    // Check idempotency if key provided
    const idempotencyKey = req.idempotency_key || null;
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = db
        .prepare('SELECT * FROM export_artifact_manifests WHERE manifest_id = ? OR plan_id = ?')
        .get(idempotencyKey, idempotencyKey) as any;
      if (existing && existing.format === req.format) {
        const filePath = existing.published_path || existing.staging_path;
        if (filePath && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
          if (stats.size === existing.size_bytes) {
            return {
              manifest_id: existing.manifest_id,
              view_id: view.view_id,
              view_revision: view.optimistic_revision,
              format: req.format,
              filename: existing.filename,
              artifact_path: filePath,
              size_bytes: existing.size_bytes,
              sha256: existing.sha256,
              dependency_hash: existing.dependency_fingerprint || snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
              is_historical: false,
              generated_at_utc: existing.generated_at_utc
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Write to staging directory
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const stagingDir = path.join(appDataDir, 'exports', 'staging', 'progress_reports');
    if (!fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:T]/g, '-').slice(0, 19);
    const sanitizedViewName = view.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').slice(0, 32);
    const filename = `progress_report_${sanitizedViewName}_rev${view.optimistic_revision}_${dateStamp}.${ext}`;
    const targetPath = path.join(stagingDir, filename);

    // Atomic write
    const tmpPath = `${targetPath}.${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}.tmp`;
    fs.writeFileSync(tmpPath, contentBuf);
    fs.renameSync(tmpPath, targetPath);

    const manifestId = idempotencyKey || `man_prog_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
    const manifest: ExportArtifactManifest = {
      schema_version: EXPORT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      job_id: `job_prog_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      plan_id: idempotencyKey || `plan_prog_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      session_id: snapshot.ordered_session_ids[0] || 'longitudinal_view',
      format: req.format as any,
      filename,
      staging_path: targetPath,
      published_path: targetPath,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      status: 'completed',
      canonical_result_hash: snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
      privacy_level: privacyOptions.exclude_direct_identifiers ? 'deidentified' : 'identified',
      sensitive_opt_ins: {
        raw_rr: !privacyOptions.exclude_raw_signals,
        raw_ecg: false,
        raw_acc: false,
        notes: !privacyOptions.exclude_notes,
        paths: !privacyOptions.exclude_paths,
        identifiers: !privacyOptions.exclude_direct_identifiers
      },
      generated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      validated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      profile_id: profileId,
      episode_id: null,
      context_type: null,
      window_root_id: null,
      window_revision: null,
      window_result_identity: null,
      beat_ledger_hash: null,
      dependency_fingerprint: snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
      export_preset_version: '1.0.0'
    };

    saveExportArtifactManifest(manifest);

    return {
      manifest_id: manifestId,
      view_id: view.view_id,
      view_revision: view.optimistic_revision,
      format: req.format,
      filename,
      artifact_path: targetPath,
      size_bytes: sizeBytes,
      sha256,
      dependency_hash: snapshot.aggregate_dependency_hash,
      is_historical: !snapshot.is_current,
      generated_at_utc: manifest.generated_at_utc
    };
  }
}

/**
 * src/backend/reports/reportCheckInLinkService.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G26 / wi-601173e63d7c4b8bb52883c79fba6fbe
 * Service layer for explicit offline linkages between specific archival
 * Collection Comparison Reports and future Check-in slots for an athlete.
 *
 * Implements:
 * - Discovery of eligible future Check-in slots in active plans
 * - Safe read-only preview with preview dependency digest computation
 * - Durable SQLite confirm transaction with CAS, idempotency, and partial unique active pair invariant
 * - Safe soft-unlink preserving report bytes, notes, slot observations, and plans without data loss
 * - Bidirectional navigation: report -> slot status and slot -> report status
 * - Strict cross-profile isolation and fail-closed security invariants
 * - Non-clinical editorial disclaimer enforcement
 */
