export class ReportCheckInLinkConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string = 'LINK_CONFLICT',
    public readonly details?: any
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ReportCheckInLinkConflictError';
  }
}

export function getCivilDateInTimezone(tz: string, date: Date = new Date()): string {
  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: tz || 'UTC',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit'
    });
    return formatter.format(date);
  } catch (_) {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export const REPORT_CHECKIN_LINK_DISCLAIMER_RU =
  'Связь отчёта со слотом носит исключительно организационный характер и не является клиническим подтверждением, медицинским диагнозом или оценкой качества сессии.';

export class ReportCheckInLinkService {
  /**
   * Discovers eligible future target slots in active check-in plans for an athlete.
   */
  public static async getEligibleTargetSlots(
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string,
    planId?: string
  ): Promise<EligibleCheckInSlotTarget[]> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);

    // 1. Verify report exists and belongs to profile
    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(reportId);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(reportId);
    }
    if (!report) {
      throw new Error(`Report '${reportId}' not found.`);
    }
    if (report.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Report belongs to profile '${report.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    // 2. Fetch plans for profile
    let plans = listCheckInPlans(profileId).filter(p => p.status === 'active');
    if (planId) {
      plans = plans.filter(p => p.id === planId);
      if (plans.length === 0) {
        const targetPlan = getCheckInPlan(planId);
        if (!targetPlan) {
          throw new Error(`Check-in plan '${planId}' not found.`);
        }
        if (targetPlan.profile_id !== profileId) {
          throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
            `Plan '${planId}' belongs to profile '${targetPlan.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
          );
        }
        if (targetPlan.status !== 'active') {
          return [];
        }
        plans = [targetPlan];
      }
    }

    const eligibleSlots: EligibleCheckInSlotTarget[] = [];

    for (const plan of plans) {
      const todayInPlanTz = getCivilDateInTimezone(plan.timezone);
      const entries = listCheckInEntriesForPlan(plan.id);

      for (const entry of entries) {
        // Eligibility criteria:
        // - unretired
        // - unsuperseded
        // - not skipped by user
        // - unassigned (no session_id)
        // - effective date >= today in plan timezone
        if (entry.is_retired) continue;
        if (entry.is_superseded) continue;
        if (entry.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user') continue;
        if (entry.session_id) continue;

        const effectiveDate = entry.effective_date || entry.slot_date;
        if (effectiveDate < todayInPlanTz) continue;

        const existingActiveLink = getActiveReportCheckInLinkForPair(report.report_id, entry.id);

        eligibleSlots.push({
          plan_id: plan.id,
          plan_title: plan.title,
          plan_cadence: plan.cadence,
          plan_revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
          plan_timezone: plan.timezone,
          slot_id: entry.id,
          slot_index: entry.slot_index,
          slot_date: entry.slot_date,
          effective_date: effectiveDate,
          slot_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
          segment_id: entry.schedule_segment_id ?? null,
          already_linked: Boolean(existingActiveLink)
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort by effective date ascending, then slot_index ascending
    eligibleSlots.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmp = a.effective_date.localeCompare(b.effective_date);
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
      return a.slot_index - b.slot_index;
    });

    return eligibleSlots;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a safe read-only preview of linking a comparison report to a check-in slot.
   */
  public static async previewLink(
    profileId: string,
    rawReq: unknown
  ): Promise<ReportCheckInLinkPreviewResponse> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);
    const req = validateReportCheckInLinkPreviewRequestStrict(rawReq);

    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    // 1. Report verification
    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(req.report_id);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(req.report_id);
    }
    if (!report) {
      throw new Error(`Report '${req.report_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (report.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Report belongs to profile '${report.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    const collection = getReviewCollection(report.collection_id);
    if (!collection) {
      blockers.push(`Коллекция обзоров '${report.collection_id}' не найдена.`);
    } else if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    } else if (collection.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_collection_revision) {
      blockers.push(
        `Ревизия коллекции изменилась: ожидалась ${req.expected_collection_revision}, текущая ${collection.optimistic_revision}.`
      );
    }

    // Report file integrity & existence check
    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const normalizedAppDir = path.resolve(appDataDir);
    const targetFile = report.published_path || report.staging_path;
    let fileExists = false;
    let shaMatch = false;

    if (targetFile) {
      try {
        const resolvedPath = path.resolve(targetFile);
        if (resolvedPath.startsWith(normalizedAppDir) && fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {
          fileExists = true;
          const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(resolvedPath);
          const actualSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
          if (actualSha.toLowerCase() === report.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
            shaMatch = true;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {
        fileExists = false;
      }
    }

    if (!fileExists) {
      blockers.push('Файл отчёта отсутствует на диске (отчёт недоступен).');
    } else if (!shaMatch) {
      blockers.push('Нарушена контрольная сумма (SHA-256) файла отчёта на диске.');
    }

    // Historical status evaluation
    let isHistorical = false;
    if (collection && collection.optimistic_revision > report.collection_revision) {
      isHistorical = true;
    } else if (collection) {
      const allMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collection.collection_id);
      for (const cm of allMembers) {
        const expectedRev = report.resolved_member_revisions[cm.view_id];
        const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(cm.view_id);
        if (currentView && expectedRev !== undefined && currentView.optimistic_revision > expectedRev) {
          isHistorical = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (isHistorical) {
      warnings.push('Отчёт является архивным: коллекция или её обзоры изменились после генерации.');
      if (!req.acknowledge_historical_report) {
        blockers.push(
          'Отчёт является архивным. Требуется явное подтверждение (acknowledge_historical_report) для связывания.'
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. Plan & Slot verification
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(req.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`Check-in plan '${req.plan_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Plan belongs to profile '${plan.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }
    if (plan.status !== 'active') {
      blockers.push(`План наблюдения не активен (текущий статус: '${plan.status}').`);
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_plan_revision) {
      blockers.push(
        `Ревизия плана изменилась: ожидалась ${req.expected_plan_revision}, текущая ${plan.optimistic_revision}.`
      );
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(req.slot_id);
    if (!entry) {
      throw new Error(`Check-in slot '${req.slot_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (entry.plan_id !== plan.id) {
      blockers.push(`Слот '${req.slot_id}' не принадлежит плану '${plan.id}'.`);
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_slot_revision) {
      blockers.push(
        `Ревизия слота изменилась: ожидалась ${req.expected_slot_revision}, текущая ${entry.optimistic_revision}.`
      );
    }

    if (entry.is_retired) {
      blockers.push('Слот наблюдения отозван (retired).');
    }
    if (entry.is_superseded) {
      blockers.push('Слот наблюдения заменён новой редакцией расписания (superseded).');
    }
    if (entry.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user') {
      blockers.push('Слот наблюдения пропущен спортсменом (skipped).');
    }
    if (entry.session_id) {
      blockers.push('К данному слоту уже привязана сессия измерения (session_assigned).');
    }

    const todayInPlanTz = getCivilDateInTimezone(plan.timezone);
    const effectiveDate = entry.effective_date || entry.slot_date;
    if (effectiveDate < todayInPlanTz) {
      blockers.push(`Дата слота (${effectiveDate}) уже прошла в часовом поясе плана (${plan.timezone}).`);
    }

    // 3. Existing active link check
    const existingActiveLink = getActiveReportCheckInLinkForPair(report.report_id, entry.id);
    if (existingActiveLink) {
      blockers.push('Активная связь между этим отчётом и данным слотом уже создана.');
    }

    // 4. Preview dependency digest
    const canonicalPayload = [
      report.report_id,
      report.manifest_id,
      report.sha256.toLowerCase(),
      report.collection_id,
      collection ? collection.optimistic_revision : report.collection_revision,
      plan.id,
      plan.optimistic_revision,
      entry.id,
      entry.optimistic_revision,
      effectiveDate,
      plan.timezone
    ].join(':');

    const previewDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');

    return {
      report_id: report.report_id,
      manifest_id: report.manifest_id,
      report_filename: report.filename,
      report_format: report.format,
      report_sha256: report.sha256,
      report_status: isHistorical ? 'historical' : 'current',
      collection_id: report.collection_id,
      collection_title: collection ? collection.title : 'Коллекция',
      collection_revision: collection ? collection.optimistic_revision : report.collection_revision,
      plan_id: plan.id,
      plan_title: plan.title,
      plan_revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      slot_id: entry.id,
      slot_index: entry.slot_index,
      slot_date: entry.slot_date,
      effective_date: effectiveDate,
      slot_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
      timezone: plan.timezone,
      can_link: blockers.length === 0,
      blockers,
      warnings,
      preview_digest: previewDigest,
      disclaimer_ru: REPORT_CHECKIN_LINK_DISCLAIMER_RU
    };
  }

  /**
   * Confirms creation of an active link with CAS, preview digest verification, and payload-bound idempotency.
   */
  public static async confirmLink(
    profileId: string,
    rawReq: unknown
  ): Promise<ConfirmReportCheckInLinkResponse> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);
    const req = validateConfirmReportCheckInLinkRequestStrict(rawReq);

    // 1. Check idempotency
    const payloadHash = crypto
      .createHash('sha256')
      .update(JSON.stringify({
        report_id: req.report_id,
        manifest_id: req.manifest_id,
        expected_report_sha256: req.expected_report_sha256,
        collection_id: req.collection_id,
        expected_collection_revision: req.expected_collection_revision,
        plan_id: req.plan_id,
        slot_id: req.slot_id,
        expected_plan_revision: req.expected_plan_revision,
        expected_slot_revision: req.expected_slot_revision,
        preview_digest: req.preview_digest,
        acknowledge_historical_report: req.acknowledge_historical_report
      }))
      .digest('hex');

    const existingIdempotency = getReportCheckInLinkIdempotency(profileId, req.idempotency_key);
    if (existingIdempotency) {
      if (existingIdempotency.payloadHash !== payloadHash) {
        throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
          `Idempotency key '${req.idempotency_key}' was already used with a different payload.`,
          'IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH'
        );
      }
      return existingIdempotency.response as ConfirmReportCheckInLinkResponse;
    }

    // 2. Validate live entities & state
    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(req.report_id);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(req.report_id);
    }
    if (!report) {
      throw new Error(`Report '${req.report_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (report.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Report belongs to profile '${report.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }
    if (report.manifest_id !== req.manifest_id) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Report manifest mismatch: expected '${req.manifest_id}', got '${report.manifest_id}'.`,
        'MANIFEST_MISMATCH'
      );
    }
    if (report.sha256.toLowerCase() !== req.expected_report_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Report SHA-256 mismatch: expected '${req.expected_report_sha256}', got '${report.sha256}'.`,
        'REPORT_SHA256_MISMATCH'
      );
    }

    const collection = getReviewCollection(report.collection_id);
    if (!collection) {
      throw new Error(`Collection '${report.collection_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (collection.owning_profile !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Collection belongs to profile '${collection.owning_profile}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }
    if (collection.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_collection_revision) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Collection revision drift: expected ${req.expected_collection_revision}, current is ${collection.optimistic_revision}.`,
        'CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    // Plan & slot checks
    const plan = getCheckInPlan(req.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`Check-in plan '${req.plan_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Plan belongs to profile '${plan.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }
    if (plan.status !== 'active') {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Plan '${plan.id}' is not active (status: '${plan.status}').`,
        'PLAN_INACTIVE'
      );
    }
    if (plan.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_plan_revision) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Plan revision drift: expected ${req.expected_plan_revision}, current is ${plan.optimistic_revision}.`,
        'CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT'
      );
    }

    const entry = getCheckInEntry(req.slot_id);
    if (!entry) {
      throw new Error(`Check-in slot '${req.slot_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (entry.plan_id !== plan.id) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Slot '${req.slot_id}' does not belong to plan '${plan.id}'.`,
        'SLOT_PLAN_MISMATCH'
      );
    }
    if (entry.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_slot_revision) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Slot revision drift: expected ${req.expected_slot_revision}, current is ${entry.optimistic_revision}.`,
        'CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT'
      );
    }
    if (entry.is_retired || entry.is_superseded || entry.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user' || entry.session_id) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Slot '${req.slot_id}' is no longer eligible for linking (retired, superseded, skipped, or assigned).`,
        'SLOT_INELIGIBLE'
      );
    }

    const effectiveDate = entry.effective_date || entry.slot_date;
    const todayInPlanTz = getCivilDateInTimezone(plan.timezone);
    if (effectiveDate < todayInPlanTz) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Slot date '${effectiveDate}' is in the past in plan timezone '${plan.timezone}'.`,
        'SLOT_PAST_DUE'
      );
    }

    // Historical report check
    let isHistorical = false;
    if (collection.optimistic_revision > report.collection_revision) {
      isHistorical = true;
    } else {
      const allMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collection.collection_id);
      for (const cm of allMembers) {
        const expectedRev = report.resolved_member_revisions[cm.view_id];
        const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(cm.view_id);
        if (currentView && expectedRev !== undefined && currentView.optimistic_revision > expectedRev) {
          isHistorical = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (isHistorical && !req.acknowledge_historical_report) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        'Report is historical. Explicit acknowledge_historical_report confirmation is required.',
        'HISTORICAL_REPORT_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED'
      );
    }

    // Recalculate preview digest to enforce zero-drift invariant
    const canonicalPayload = [
      report.report_id,
      report.manifest_id,
      report.sha256.toLowerCase(),
      report.collection_id,
      collection.optimistic_revision,
      plan.id,
      plan.optimistic_revision,
      entry.id,
      entry.optimistic_revision,
      effectiveDate,
      plan.timezone
    ].join(':');

    const expectedPreviewDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalPayload).digest('hex');
    if (expectedPreviewDigest !== req.preview_digest) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        'Preview digest mismatch: state drifted between preview and confirm. Please refresh preview.',
        'PREVIEW_DIGEST_MISMATCH'
      );
    }

    // Check duplicate active link
    const existingActiveLink = getActiveReportCheckInLinkForPair(report.report_id, entry.id);
    if (existingActiveLink) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
        `Active link between report '${report.report_id}' and slot '${entry.id}' already exists.`,
        'DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_LINK'
      );
    }

    // 3. Execute atomic SQLite transaction
    const db = getDb();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const linkId = `rcl_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

    const newLink: ReportCheckInLink = {
      link_id: linkId,
      profile_id: profileId,
      report_id: report.report_id,
      manifest_id: report.manifest_id,
      report_sha256: report.sha256,
      collection_id: report.collection_id,
      collection_revision: collection.optimistic_revision,
      plan_id: plan.id,
      slot_id: entry.id,
      plan_revision: plan.optimistic_revision,
      slot_revision: entry.optimistic_revision,
      initial_slot_date: entry.slot_date,
      effective_date: effectiveDate,
      timezone: plan.timezone,
      segment_id: entry.schedule_segment_id ?? null,
      status: 'active',
      unlinked_at_utc: null,
      unlink_reason: null,
      optimistic_revision: 1,
      created_at_utc: nowIso,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    const response: ConfirmReportCheckInLinkResponse = {
      success: true,
      link: newLink,
      report_status: isHistorical ? 'historical' : 'current',
      slot_status: 'pending_unassigned'
    };

    db.transaction(() => {
      // Final lock check inside transaction
      const doubleCheck = getActiveReportCheckInLinkForPair(report!.report_id, entry!.id);
      if (doubleCheck) {
        throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
          `Active link between report '${report!.report_id}' and slot '${entry!.id}' already exists.`,
          'DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_LINK'
        );
      }

      saveReportCheckInLink(newLink);
      recordReportCheckInLinkAction(newLink.link_id, profileId, 'create_link', 1, {
        report_id: newLink.report_id,
        manifest_id: newLink.manifest_id,
        slot_id: newLink.slot_id,
        plan_id: newLink.plan_id,
        preview_digest: req.preview_digest
      });
      saveReportCheckInLinkIdempotency(
        profileId,
        req.idempotency_key,
        newLink.link_id,
        'confirm_link',
        payloadHash,
        response
      );
    })();

    return response;
  }

  /**
   * Performs soft-unlink preserving report bytes, review notes, slot observations, and plans.
   */
  public static async softUnlink(
    profileId: string,
    rawReq: unknown
  ): Promise<SoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkResponse> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);
    const req = validateSoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkRequestStrict(rawReq);

    // 1. Idempotency check if key provided
    let payloadHash: string | undefined = undefined;
    if (req.idempotency_key) {
      payloadHash = crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(JSON.stringify({
          link_id: req.link_id,
          expected_revision: req.expected_revision,
          unlink_reason: req.unlink_reason
        }))
        .digest('hex');

      const existingIdempotency = getReportCheckInLinkIdempotency(profileId, req.idempotency_key);
      if (existingIdempotency) {
        if (existingIdempotency.payloadHash !== payloadHash) {
          throw new ReportCheckInLinkConflictError(
            `Idempotency key '${req.idempotency_key}' was already used with a different payload.`,
            'IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH'
          );
        }
        return existingIdempotency.response as SoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkResponse;
      }
    }

    // 2. Fetch existing link
    const existing = getReportCheckInLink(req.link_id);
    if (!existing) {
      throw new Error(`Report check-in link '${req.link_id}' not found.`);
    }
    if (existing.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Link belongs to profile '${existing.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    if (existing.status === 'soft_unlinked') {
      // Already soft-unlinked
      if (existing.optimistic_revision === req.expected_revision) {
        return { success: true, link: existing };
      }
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Link revision conflict: expected ${req.expected_revision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}.`,
        existing.link_id,
        req.expected_revision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    if (existing.optimistic_revision !== req.expected_revision) {
      throw new ReportCheckInLinkConcurrencyConflictError(
        `Link revision conflict: expected ${req.expected_revision}, current is ${existing.optimistic_revision}.`,
        existing.link_id,
        req.expected_revision,
        existing.optimistic_revision
      );
    }

    // 3. CAS update in SQLite transaction
    const db = getDb();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const nextRevision = existing.optimistic_revision + 1;

    const updatedLink: ReportCheckInLink = {
      ...existing,
      status: 'soft_unlinked',
      unlinked_at_utc: nowIso,
      unlink_reason: req.unlink_reason || 'user_soft_unlink',
      optimistic_revision: nextRevision,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    const response: SoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkResponse = {
      success: true,
      link: updatedLink
    };

    db.transaction(() => {
      const ok = updateReportCheckInLinkWithCas(req.expected_revision, updatedLink);
      if (!ok) {
        const fresh = getReportCheckInLink(req.link_id);
        throw new ReportCheckInLinkConcurrencyConflictError(
          `Link revision CAS conflict for '${req.link_id}'.`,
          req.link_id,
          req.expected_revision,
          fresh ? fresh.optimistic_revision : -1
        );
      }

      recordReportCheckInLinkAction(updatedLink.link_id, profileId, 'soft_unlink', nextRevision, {
        unlink_reason: updatedLink.unlink_reason
      });

      if (req.idempotency_key && payloadHash) {
        saveReportCheckInLinkIdempotency(
          profileId,
          req.idempotency_key,
          updatedLink.link_id,
          'soft_unlink',
          payloadHash,
          response
        );
      }
    })();

    return response;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves links for a report, evaluating the dynamic status of each linked target slot.
   */
  public static async getLinksByReport(
    profileId: string,
    reportId: string,
    includeUnlinked = false
  ): Promise<ReportCheckInLinkWithSlotStatus[]> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);

    // Verify report ownership if report exists
    let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(reportId);
    if (!report) {
      report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(reportId);
    }
    if (report && report.profile_id !== profileId) {
      throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
        `Report belongs to profile '${report.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
      );
    }

    const links = listReportCheckInLinksForReport(reportId, profileId, includeUnlinked);
    const result: ReportCheckInLinkWithSlotStatus[] = [];

    for (const link of links) {
      const plan = getCheckInPlan(link.plan_id);
      const entry = getCheckInEntry(link.slot_id);
      const collection = getReviewCollection(link.collection_id);

      let slotStatus: LinkedSlotStatus = 'pending_unassigned';
      let slotLabelRu = 'Ожидает измерения';
      let sessionId: string | null = null;
      let qualityScore: number | null = null;

      if (!entry || entry.is_retired) {
        slotStatus = 'slot_retired';
        slotLabelRu = 'Слот отозван';
      } else if (entry.is_superseded) {
        slotStatus = 'slot_superseded';
        slotLabelRu = 'Слот заменён новой версией расписания';
      } else if (entry.schedule_decision === 'skipped_by_user') {
        slotStatus = 'slot_skipped';
        slotLabelRu = 'Слот пропущен спортсменом';
      } else if (entry.session_id) {
        slotStatus = 'session_assigned';
        slotLabelRu = 'Сессия привязана';
        sessionId = entry.session_id;
        qualityScore = entry.quality_score ?? null;
      } else {
        const planTz = plan ? plan.timezone : link.timezone;
        const todayInTz = getCivilDateInTimezone(planTz);
        const effectiveDate = entry.effective_date || entry.slot_date;
        if (effectiveDate < todayInTz) {
          slotStatus = 'date_past_due';
          slotLabelRu = 'Срок наблюдения прошёл';
        } else {
          slotStatus = 'pending_unassigned';
          slotLabelRu = 'Ожидает измерения';
        }
      }

      result.push({
        ...link,
        report_filename: report ? report.filename : 'report.html',
        report_format: report ? report.format : 'html',
        collection_title: collection ? collection.title : 'Коллекция',
        plan_title: plan ? plan.title : 'План наблюдения',
        slot_status: slotStatus,
        slot_status_label_ru: slotLabelRu,
        session_id: sessionId,
        quality_score: qualityScore
      });
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves links for a check-in slot, evaluating dynamic status of linked comparison reports.
   */
  public static async getLinksBySlot(
    profileId: string,
    slotId: string,
    includeUnlinked = false
  ): Promise<ReportCheckInLinkWithReportStatus[]> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);

    // Verify slot ownership if slot exists
    const entry = getCheckInEntry(slotId);
    if (entry) {
      const plan = getCheckInPlan(entry.plan_id);
      if (plan && plan.profile_id !== profileId) {
        throw new CrossProfileAccessError(
          `Slot belongs to profile '${plan.profile_id}', requested under '${profileId}'`
        );
      }
    }

    const links = listReportCheckInLinksForSlot(slotId, profileId, includeUnlinked);
    const result: ReportCheckInLinkWithReportStatus[] = [];

    const appDataDir = getAppDataDir();
    const normalizedAppDir = path.resolve(appDataDir);

    for (const link of links) {
      let report = getCollectionComparisonReport(link.report_id);
      if (!report) {
        report = getCollectionComparisonReportByManifest(link.manifest_id);
      }
      const plan = getCheckInPlan(link.plan_id);
      const collection = getReviewCollection(link.collection_id);

      let reportStatus: CollectionComparisonReportStatus = 'unavailable';
      let reportLabelRu = 'Файл отчёта недоступен';
      let isAvailable = false;

      if (report) {
        const filePath = report.published_path || report.staging_path;
        let fileExists = false;
        let shaMatch = false;

        if (filePath) {
          try {
            const resolvedPath = path.resolve(filePath);
            if (resolvedPath.startsWith(normalizedAppDir) && fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {
              fileExists = true;
              const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(resolvedPath);
              const actualSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
              if (actualSha.toLowerCase() === report.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
                shaMatch = true;
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {
            fileExists = false;
          }
        }

        if (!fileExists) {
          reportStatus = 'unavailable';
          reportLabelRu = 'Файл отчёта отсутствует на диске';
          isAvailable = false;
        } else if (!shaMatch) {
          reportStatus = 'integrity_failed';
          reportLabelRu = 'Нарушена целостность файла (SHA-256)';
          isAvailable = false;
        } else {
          isAvailable = true;
          let isHistorical = false;
          if (collection && collection.optimistic_revision > report.collection_revision) {
            isHistorical = true;
          } else if (collection) {
            const allMembers = getReviewCollectionMembers(collection.collection_id);
            for (const cm of allMembers) {
              const expectedRev = report.resolved_member_revisions[cm.view_id];
              const currentView = getSavedLongitudinalView(cm.view_id);
              if (currentView && expectedRev !== undefined && currentView.optimistic_revision > expectedRev) {
                isHistorical = true;
                break;
              }
            }
          }

          if (isHistorical) {
            reportStatus = 'historical';
            reportLabelRu = 'Архивный (коллекция обновилась)';
          } else {
            reportStatus = 'current';
            reportLabelRu = 'Актуальный';
          }
        }
      }

      result.push({
        ...link,
        report_filename: report ? report.filename : 'report.html',
        report_format: report ? report.format : 'html',
        collection_title: collection ? collection.title : 'Коллекция',
        plan_title: plan ? plan.title : 'План наблюдения',
        report_status: reportStatus,
        report_status_label_ru: reportLabelRu,
        is_report_available: isAvailable
      });
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Lists links for an athlete profile.
   */
  public static async listLinksForProfile(
    profileId: string,
    options?: { status?: string; limit?: number }
  ): Promise<ReportCheckInLink[]> {
    this.validateProfileId(profileId);
    return listReportCheckInLinksForProfile(profileId, options);
  }

  private static validateProfileId(profileId: string): void {
    if (!profileId || typeof profileId !== 'string' || profileId.trim() === '') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('profile_id is required', 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID');
    }
    const trimmed = profileId.trim();
    if (trimmed === 'all' || trimmed === 'default') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
        "Special profile IDs 'all' and 'default' are strictly prohibited",
        'INVALID_PROFILE_ID'
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * cohortExportService.ts
 *
 * Bounded Cohort Research Evidence Export Service.
 * Bundles multiple explicitly selected sessions with strict profile isolation,
 * per-session validation, cryptographic cohort manifest, and tamper-evident checksums.
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as os from 'os';
import AdmZip from 'adm-zip';
import { ZipArchive } from 'archiver';
import {
  CohortResearchManifest,
  CohortSessionSummary,
  ResearchExportOptions,
  ResearchBundleValidationResult,
  RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/canonical/ResearchEvidenceContract';
import { exportResearchBundle, deterministicJsonStringify } from './researchExportService';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import { APP_VERSION, RELEASE_COMMIT } from '../../shared/buildInfo';

export interface CohortExportResult {
  cohortPath: string;
  manifest: CohortResearchManifest;
  validation: ResearchBundleValidationResult;
}

export const MAX_COHORT_SESSIONS = 50;

/**
 * Export bounded cohort of sessions into a reproducible research bundle.
 */
export async function exportCohortResearchBundle(
  sessionIds: string[],
  options: ResearchExportOptions
): Promise<CohortExportResult> {
  if (!Array.isArray(sessionIds) || sessionIds.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Cohort export requires a non-empty array of session IDs');
  }

  if (sessionIds.length > MAX_COHORT_SESSIONS) {
    throw new Error(`Cohort export exceeds maximum allowed sessions (${MAX_COHORT_SESSIONS}). Requested: ${sessionIds.length}`);
  }

  // Deduplicate session IDs while preserving order
  const uniqueSessionIds = Array.from(new Set(sessionIds));

  // Verify all sessions exist in database
  const db = getDb();
  for (const sId of uniqueSessionIds) {
    let exists = false;
    try {
      const row = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sId);
      if (row) exists = true;
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!exists) {
      throw new Error(`Session '${sId}' not found in database`);
    }
  }

  // Atomic cohort staging directory
  const cohortTempBase = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `cohort_reb_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(cohortTempBase, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cohortTempBase, 'sessions'), { recursive: true });

  const sessionSummaries: CohortSessionSummary[] = [];
  let totalBytes = 0;

  try {
    for (const sId of uniqueSessionIds) {
      // Export each individual session as directory to embed cleanly
      const sessionExport = await exportResearchBundle(sId, {
        ...options,
        sessionId: sId,
        format: 'directory',
        targetDirectory: path.join(cohortTempBase, 'sessions')
      });

      if (!sessionExport.validation.valid) {
        throw new Error(`Individual session bundle validation failed for session ${sId}: ${sessionExport.validation.errors.join(', ')}`);
      }

      const folderName = path.basename(sessionExport.bundlePath);
      const sessionRelativePath = `sessions/${folderName}`;

      // Calculate total directory byte size and folder hash
      let folderBytes = 0;
      function getDirSize(dir: string): number {
        let size = 0;
        const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
        for (const entry of entries) {
          const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
          if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            size += getDirSize(full);
          } else if (entry.isFile()) {
            size += fs.statSync(full).size;
          }
        }
        return size;
      }
      folderBytes = getDirSize(sessionExport.bundlePath);
      totalBytes += folderBytes;

      sessionSummaries.push({
        session_id: sId,
        profile_id: sessionExport.manifest.session.profile_id,
        session_name: sessionExport.manifest.session.session_name,
        bundle_path: sessionRelativePath,
        bundle_sha256: sessionExport.manifest.bundle_hash,
        duration_seconds: sessionExport.manifest.session.duration_seconds,
        recorded_at_utc: sessionExport.manifest.session.recorded_at_utc
      });
    }

    // Sort session summaries by session_id for deterministic cohort hash
    sessionSummaries.sort((a, b) => a.session_id.localeCompare(b.session_id));

    // Compute cohort bundle hash from sorted session hashes
    const cohortHashSource = sessionSummaries.map(s => `${s.bundle_sha256}  ${s.session_id}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    const cohortBundleHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(cohortHashSource, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    const createdUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const cohortId = `cohort_${createdUtc.substring(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '')}_${cohortBundleHash.substring(0, 10)}`;

    // Build cohort_manifest.json
    const cohortManifest: CohortResearchManifest = {
      schema_version: RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      cohort_id: cohortId,
      created_at_utc: createdUtc,
      generator: {
        name: 'CardioLab Workstation',
        version: APP_VERSION,
        git_head: RELEASE_COMMIT,
        timestamp_utc: createdUtc
      },
      sessions: sessionSummaries,
      total_sessions: sessionSummaries.length,
      total_bytes: totalBytes,
      bundle_hash: cohortBundleHash,
      validation_status: 'valid'
    };

    const manifestJsonStr = deterministicJsonStringify(cohortManifest);
    const manifestPath = path.join(cohortTempBase, 'cohort_manifest.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, manifestJsonStr, 'utf8');

    // Create checksums catalog of all files across all sessions
    const fileChecksums: Array<{ path: string; sha256: string }> = [];
    function collectFiles(dir: string, base: string) {
      const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
        const rel = path.relative(base, full).replace(/\\/g, '/');
        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
          collectFiles(full, base);
        } else if (entry.isFile()) {
          const buf = fs.readFileSync(full);
          const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
          fileChecksums.push({ path: rel, sha256: hash });
        }
      }
    }
    collectFiles(cohortTempBase, cohortTempBase);
    fileChecksums.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));

    const checksumLines = fileChecksums.map(f => `${f.sha256}  ${f.path}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cohortTempBase, 'checksums.sha256'), checksumLines, 'utf8');

    // Delivery
    const targetDir = options.targetDirectory || path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cardiolab_research_bundles');
    if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const baseName = `${cohortId}`;

    if (options.format === 'directory') {
      const destDir = path.join(targetDir, baseName);
      if (fs.existsSync(destDir)) {
        fs.rmSync(destDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
      fs.cpSync(cohortTempBase, destDir, { recursive: true });

      const validation = await validateCohortBundle(destDir);
      return {
        cohortPath: destDir,
        manifest: cohortManifest,
        validation
      };
    } else {
      const zipDestination = path.join(targetDir, `${baseName}.zip`);
      const tempZip = `${zipDestination}.tmp-${Date.now()}`;

      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const output = fs.createWriteStream(tempZip);
        const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

        output.on('close', () => resolve());
        archive.on('error', (err: any) => reject(err));

        archive.pipe(output);
        archive.directory(cohortTempBase, false);
        archive.finalize();
      });

      fs.renameSync(tempZip, zipDestination);

      const validation = await validateCohortBundle(zipDestination);
      return {
        cohortPath: zipDestination,
        manifest: cohortManifest,
        validation
      };
    }
  } finally {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(cohortTempBase)) {
        fs.rmSync(cohortTempBase, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

/**
 * Validate cohort bundle directory or ZIP archive.
 */
export async function validateCohortBundle(
  cohortPathOrZip: string
): Promise<ResearchBundleValidationResult> {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (!fs.existsSync(cohortPathOrZip)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      manifest_valid: false,
      members_valid: false,
      checksums_match: false,
      inspected_members: 0,
      errors: [`Cohort target does not exist: ${cohortPathOrZip}`],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  const stat = fs.statSync(cohortPathOrZip);
  let cohortManifest: CohortResearchManifest | undefined;
  let fileBuffers: Map<string, Buffer> = new Map();

  if (stat.isFile()) {
    try {
      const zip = new AdmZip(cohortPathOrZip);
      const entries = zip.getEntries();
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (entry.isDirectory) continue;
        const entryName = entry.entryName.replace(/\\/g, '/');
        if (entryName.includes('..') || entryName.startsWith('/') || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(entryName)) {
          errors.push(`Directory traversal attempt detected in cohort entry: '${entryName}'`);
          continue;
        }
        fileBuffers.set(entryName, entry.getData());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        manifest_valid: false,
        members_valid: false,
        checksums_match: false,
        inspected_members: 0,
        errors: [`Failed to read cohort ZIP archive: ${err.message}`],
        warnings: []
      };
    }
  } else if (stat.isDirectory()) {
    function readDirRecursive(dir: string, base: string) {
      const list = fs.readdirSync(dir);
      for (const item of list) {
        const full = path.join(dir, item);
        const rel = path.relative(base, full).replace(/\\/g, '/');
        const st = fs.statSync(full);
        if (st.isDirectory()) {
          readDirRecursive(full, base);
        } else if (st.isFile()) {
          fileBuffers.set(rel, fs.readFileSync(full));
        }
      }
    }
    readDirRecursive(cohortPathOrZip, cohortPathOrZip);
  }

  // 1. Read cohort_manifest.json
  const manifestBuf = fileBuffers.get('cohort_manifest.json');
  if (!manifestBuf) {
    errors.push('Missing required member "cohort_manifest.json" in cohort bundle');
  } else {
    try {
      cohortManifest = JSON.parse(manifestBuf.toString('utf8')) as CohortResearchManifest;
      if (cohortManifest.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
        errors.push(`Invalid cohort manifest schema_version: expected '1.0.0', got '${cohortManifest.schema_version}'`);
      }
      if (!cohortManifest.cohort_id) {
        errors.push('Missing cohort_id in cohort manifest');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(cohortManifest.sessions) || cohortManifest.sessions.length === 0) {
        errors.push('Cohort manifest sessions list must be a non-empty array');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      errors.push(`Failed to parse cohort_manifest.json: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  // 2. Verify all session bundle hashes
  if (cohortManifest && Array.isArray(cohortManifest.sessions)) {
    for (const sessionSummary of cohortManifest.sessions) {
      const manifestPathInCohort = `${sessionSummary.bundle_path}/manifest.json`.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      const sessionManifestBuf = fileBuffers.get(manifestPathInCohort);

      if (!sessionManifestBuf) {
        errors.push(`Session manifest '${manifestPathInCohort}' missing in cohort bundle`);
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const sManifest = JSON.parse(sessionManifestBuf.toString('utf8'));
        if (sManifest.bundle_hash !== sessionSummary.bundle_sha256) {
          errors.push(`Session ${sessionSummary.session_id} bundle hash mismatch: cohort says ${sessionSummary.bundle_sha256}, session manifest says ${sManifest.bundle_hash}`);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        errors.push(`Failed to parse session manifest '${manifestPathInCohort}': ${err.message}`);
      }
    }

    // Verify cohort bundle_hash
    const sorted = [...cohortManifest.sessions].sort((a, b) => a.session_id.localeCompare(b.session_id));
    const expectedHashSource = sorted.map(s => `${s.bundle_sha256}  ${s.session_id}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    const computedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(expectedHashSource, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    if (computedHash.toLowerCase() !== cohortManifest.bundle_hash.toLowerCase()) {
      errors.push(`Cohort bundle_hash mismatch: manifest says ${cohortManifest.bundle_hash}, computed is ${computedHash}`);
    }
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    manifest_valid: errors.length === 0 && !!cohortManifest,
    members_valid: errors.length === 0,
    checksums_match: errors.length === 0,
    inspected_members: fileBuffers.size,
    errors,
    warnings,
    cohort_manifest: cohortManifest
  };
}

export function getFeatureMaturitySummary(): Record<string, 'production' | 'preview' | 'experimental' | 'deprecated'> {
  const map: Record<string, 'production' | 'preview' | 'experimental' | 'deprecated'> = {};
  for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY)) {
    if (entry.maturity_level === 'Validated') {
      map[key] = 'production';
    } else if (entry.maturity_level === 'Bounded') {
      map[key] = 'preview';
    } else {
      map[key] = 'experimental';
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Deterministically serialize any JavaScript object or primitive to JSON:
 * - Object keys sorted alphabetically at all depth levels
 * - 2-space indentation
 * - Standard dot-decimal formatting for floats
 * - Trailing newline
 */
export function deterministicJsonStringify(val: any): string {
  function sortKeys(obj: any): any {
    if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
      return obj;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return obj.map(sortKeys);
    }
    const sortedKeys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
    const result: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const key of sortedKeys) {
      const v = obj[key];
      if (v !== undefined) {
        result[key] = sortKeys(v);
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  const sorted = sortKeys(val);
  return JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2) + '\n';
}

/**
 * Format number with dot decimal or empty string if null/undefined/NaN.
 */
function formatNumber(num: number | null | undefined, precision?: number): string {
  if (num === null || num === undefined || isNaN(num) || !isFinite(num)) {
    return '';
  }
  if (precision !== undefined) {
    return num.toFixed(precision);
  }
  return String(num);
}

/**
 * Generate preview of export members and sizes before writing.
 */
export async function getResearchExportPreview(
  sessionId: string,
  options?: Partial<ResearchExportOptions>
): Promise<ResearchExportPreview> {
  const canonicalResult = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId);
  const signals = getSessionSignals(sessionId);

  const hasRr = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'RR');
  const hasHr = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'HR');
  const hasEcg = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ECG');
  const hasAcc = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ACC');

  const channelsAvailable: string[] = [];
  if (hasRr) channelsAvailable.push('RR');
  if (hasHr) channelsAvailable.push('HR');
  if (hasEcg) channelsAvailable.push('ECG');
  if (hasAcc) channelsAvailable.push('ACC');

  const includeNormalizedRr = options?.includeNormalizedRr !== false;
  const includeNormalizedHr = options?.includeNormalizedHr !== false;
  const includeNormalizedEcg = !!options?.includeNormalizedEcg;
  const includeNormalizedAcc = !!options?.includeNormalizedAcc;

  const channelsIncluded: string[] = [];
  if (hasRr && includeNormalizedRr) channelsIncluded.push('RR');
  if (hasHr && includeNormalizedHr) channelsIncluded.push('HR');
  if (hasEcg && includeNormalizedEcg) channelsIncluded.push('ECG');
  if (hasAcc && includeNormalizedAcc) channelsIncluded.push('ACC');

  const durationSec = canonicalResult.timing?.duration_seconds || 60;
  const totalBeats = canonicalResult.quality_summary?.total_beats || Math.round(durationSec * 1.2);

  const previewMembers: ResearchExportPreview['estimated_members'] = [
    {
      path: 'manifest.json',
      estimated_bytes: 2048,
      description: 'Research evidence bundle manifest with cryptographic provenance and maturity'
    },
    {
      path: 'checksums.sha256',
      estimated_bytes: 512,
      description: 'Standard sha256sum verification catalog'
    },
    {
      path: 'canonical_session.json',
      estimated_bytes: 25000,
      description: 'Complete canonical session result with lineage and timing authority'
    },
    {
      path: 'canonical_beat_ledger.csv',
      estimated_bytes: Math.max(1024, totalBeats * 90),
      description: 'Audit-ready beat ledger with per-beat classifications and zero-correction guarantee'
    },
    {
      path: 'canonical_metrics.json',
      estimated_bytes: 8192,
      description: 'Core and advanced session metrics with task eligibility and maturity classification'
    },
    {
      path: 'provenance_and_limitations.md',
      estimated_bytes: 4096,
      description: 'Scientific methodology documentation, clock domains, and non-diagnostic research limitations'
    }
  ];

  if (includeNormalizedRr) {
    previewMembers.push({
      path: 'normalized_channels/rr_intervals.csv',
      estimated_bytes: Math.max(512, totalBeats * 35),
      description: 'Normalized RR interval series with NN acceptance flags'
    });
  }

  if (includeNormalizedHr) {
    previewMembers.push({
      path: 'normalized_channels/heart_rate_1hz.csv',
      estimated_bytes: Math.max(512, durationSec * 32),
      description: 'Normalized 1 Hz heart rate cadence points'
    });
  }

  const rawSignalIncluded = (includeNormalizedEcg && hasEcg) || (includeNormalizedAcc && hasAcc);

  if (includeNormalizedEcg && hasEcg) {
    const ecgSamples = Math.round(durationSec * 130);
    previewMembers.push({
      path: 'normalized_channels/ecg_normalized.csv',
      estimated_bytes: Math.max(10240, ecgSamples * 32),
      description: 'Raw 130 Hz electrocardiogram samples (µV) with timestamps',
      is_raw_signal: true
    });
  }

  if (includeNormalizedAcc && hasAcc) {
    const accSamples = Math.round(durationSec * 200);
    previewMembers.push({
      path: 'normalized_channels/acc_normalized.csv',
      estimated_bytes: Math.max(10240, accSamples * 45),
      description: 'Raw 200 Hz tri-axial accelerometer samples (mG) with magnitude',
      is_raw_signal: true
    });
  }

  const totalEstimatedBytes = previewMembers.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.estimated_bytes, 0);

  let privacyWarning: string | undefined;
  if (rawSignalIncluded) {
    privacyWarning = 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Включены высокочастотные необработанные сигналы (ECG/ACC). Необработанные сигналы могут содержать индивидуальные морфологические биометрические признаки. Передавайте только авторизованным исследователям с информированным согласием.';
  }

  return {
    session_id: sessionId,
    profile_id: canonicalResult.profile_id || 'default',
    estimated_members: previewMembers,
    total_estimated_bytes: totalEstimatedBytes,
    contains_raw_signals: rawSignalIncluded,
    raw_signal_opt_in: rawSignalIncluded,
    privacy_warning: privacyWarning,
    task_eligibility: mapTaskEligibility(canonicalResult.task_eligibility),
    feature_maturity: getFeatureMaturitySummary(),
    limitations: canonicalResult.limitations || [],
    channels_available: channelsAvailable,
    channels_included: channelsIncluded
  };
}

/**
 * Generate the canonical beat ledger CSV content from CanonicalSessionResult.
 */
export function serializeBeatLedgerCsv(canonicalResult: CanonicalSessionResult): string {
  const headers = [
    'beat_index',
    'source_file_id',
    'source_row_index',
    'phone_timestamp_str',
    'phone_timestamp_ms',
    'sensor_timestamp_ns',
    'relative_timestamp_ms',
    'raw_rr_ms',
    'raw_is_valid',
    'parser_status',
    'classification_status',
    'accepted_for_nn',
    'exclusion_reasons',
    'instantaneous_hr_bpm',
    'algorithm_version'
  ];

  const lines: string[] = [headers.join(',')];
  const beats = canonicalResult.canonical_beat_ledger?.beats || [];

  for (const b of beats) {
    const row = [
      formatNumber(b.beat_index),
      b.source_file_id || '',
      formatNumber(b.source_row_index),
      b.phone_timestamp_str ? `"${b.phone_timestamp_str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : '',
      formatNumber(b.phone_timestamp_ms),
      formatNumber(b.sensor_timestamp_ns),
      formatNumber(b.relative_timestamp_ms),
      formatNumber(b.raw_rr_ms, 1),
      b.raw_is_valid !== null ? String(b.raw_is_valid) : '',
      b.parser_status || '',
      b.classification_status || '',
      String(b.accepted_for_nn),
      b.exclusion_reasons?.length ? `"${b.exclusion_reasons.join('; ').replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : '',
      formatNumber(b.instantaneous_hr_bpm, 1),
      b.algorithm_version || '1.0.0'
    ];
    lines.push(row.join(','));
  }

  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Generate normalized RR intervals CSV content.
 */
export function serializeNormalizedRrCsv(canonicalResult: CanonicalSessionResult): string {
  const headers = ['time_offset_ms', 'rr_interval_ms', 'accepted_for_nn', 'instantaneous_hr_bpm'];
  const lines: string[] = [headers.join(',')];
  const beats = canonicalResult.canonical_beat_ledger?.beats || [];

  for (const b of beats) {
    if (b.raw_rr_ms === null) continue;
    const row = [
      formatNumber(b.relative_timestamp_ms !== null ? b.relative_timestamp_ms : (b.beat_index * 800)),
      formatNumber(b.raw_rr_ms, 1),
      String(b.accepted_for_nn),
      formatNumber(b.instantaneous_hr_bpm, 1)
    ];
    lines.push(row.join(','));
  }

  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Generate normalized 1 Hz HR cadence CSV content.
 */
export async function serializeNormalizedHrCsv(
  sessionId: string,
  canonicalResult: CanonicalSessionResult
): Promise<string> {
  const headers = ['timestamp_iso', 'time_offset_seconds', 'hr_bpm'];
  const lines: string[] = [headers.join(',')];

  const signals = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
  const hrFile = signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'HR');

  if (hrFile) {
    const rawPath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${hrFile.id}_hr.txt.gz`);
    if (fs.existsSync(rawPath)) {
      const points = await readHRGz(rawPath);
      if (points.length > 0) {
        const baseMs = points[0].timeMs;
        for (const pt of points) {
          const offsetSec = Math.max(0, Math.round((pt.timeMs - baseMs) / 1000));
          const iso = new Date(pt.timeMs).toISOString();
          lines.push(`${iso},${offsetSec},${pt.hrBpm}`);
        }
        return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
      }
    }
  }

  // Fallback to instantaneous HR from accepted beats if no separate HR file
  const beats = canonicalResult.canonical_beat_ledger?.beats || [];
  let prevSec = -1;
  const startMs = canonicalResult.timing?.start_time_utc ? new Date(canonicalResult.timing.start_time_utc).getTime() : 0;

  for (const b of beats) {
    if (b.instantaneous_hr_bpm && b.accepted_for_nn) {
      const offsetMs = b.relative_timestamp_ms !== null ? b.relative_timestamp_ms : (b.beat_index * 800);
      const sec = Math.floor(offsetMs / 1000);
      if (sec !== prevSec) {
        prevSec = sec;
        const iso = new Date(startMs + offsetMs).toISOString();
        lines.push(`${iso},${sec},${Math.round(b.instantaneous_hr_bpm)}`);
      }
    }
  }

  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Generate normalized ECG CSV content (if opted in).
 */
export async function serializeNormalizedEcgCsv(sessionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const signals = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
  const ecgFile = signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ECG');
  if (!ecgFile) return null;

  const rawPath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${ecgFile.id}_ecg.txt.gz`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(rawPath)) return null;

  const points = await readECGGz(rawPath);
  if (points.length === 0) return null;

  const headers = ['time_offset_ms', 'sample_index', 'ecg_uv'];
  const lines: string[] = [headers.join(',')];
  const baseMs = points[0].timeMs;

  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
    const pt = points[i];
    const offsetMs = pt.timeMs - baseMs;
    lines.push(`${formatNumber(offsetMs)},${i},${formatNumber(pt.ecgUv, 2)}`);
  }

  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Generate normalized ACC CSV content (if opted in).
 */
export async function serializeNormalizedAccCsv(sessionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const signals = getSessionSignals(sessionId);
  const accFile = signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ACC');
  if (!accFile) return null;

  const rawPath = path.join(getRawLogsDir(), `${accFile.id}_acc.txt.gz`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(rawPath)) return null;

  const points = await readACCGz(rawPath);
  if (points.length === 0) return null;

  const headers = ['time_offset_ms', 'sample_index', 'acc_x_mg', 'acc_y_mg', 'acc_z_mg', 'magnitude_mg'];
  const lines: string[] = [headers.join(',')];
  const baseMs = points[0].timeMs;

  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
    const pt = points[i];
    const offsetMs = pt.timeMs - baseMs;
    lines.push(`${formatNumber(offsetMs)},${i},${formatNumber(pt.x, 2)},${formatNumber(pt.y, 2)},${formatNumber(pt.z, 2)},${formatNumber(pt.magnitude, 2)}`);
  }

  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Generate methodology provenance and limitations document in Markdown.
 */
export function generateProvenanceMarkdown(
  canonicalResult: CanonicalSessionResult,
  channels: { available: string[]; included: string[]; raw_signal_opt_in: boolean }
): string {
  const s = canonicalResult;
  const timing = s.timing || {} as any;
  const quality = s.quality_summary || {} as any;
  const eligibility = mapTaskEligibility(s.task_eligibility);
  const maturity = getFeatureMaturitySummary();

  return `# Research Provenance, Timebase & Scientific Limitations

## 1. Identity & Session Metadata
- **Session ID:** \`${s.session_id}\`
- **Profile ID:** \`${s.profile_id || 'default'}\`
- **Canonical Result Identity:** \`${s.canonical_result_identity?.canonical_result_hash || 'N/A'}\`
- **Recorded Start UTC:** \`${timing.start_time_utc || 'N/A'}\`
- **Recorded End UTC:** \`${timing.end_time_utc || 'N/A'}\`
- **Session Duration:** ${timing.duration_seconds || 0} seconds
- **Generator Software:** CardioLab Workstation v${APP_VERSION} (Commit: ${RELEASE_COMMIT || 'development'})

## 2. Timebase Semantics & Clock Authority
- **Canonical Timebase:** \`${timing.canonical_timebase || 'sensor_monotonic_ns'}\`
- **Timebase Authority:** \`${timing.timebase_authority || 'Polar H10 internal quartz RTC / Monotonic clock'}\`
- **Monotonic Guarantee:** \`${timing.timebase_monotonic !== false}\`
- **Timezone Provenance:** \`${timing.timezone_provenance || 'utc_explicit'}\`
- **Ambiguity Status:** \`${timing.ambiguity_status || 'unambiguous'}\`

## 3. Channels & Signal Availability
- **Available Channels:** ${channels.available.join(', ') || 'None'}
- **Included in Bundle:** ${channels.included.join(', ') || 'None'}
- **Raw High-Frequency Signals Opt-in:** \`${channels.raw_signal_opt_in}\`

## 4. Signal Quality & Artifact Metrics
- **Total Detected Beats:** ${quality.total_beats || 0}
- **Accepted NN Beats:** ${quality.accepted_nn_beats || 0}
- **Excluded Artifacts / Ectopic Beats:** ${quality.excluded_beats || 0}
- **Artifact Rate:** ${quality.artifact_percentage || 0}%
- **Max Consecutive Gap:** ${quality.max_consecutive_gap_seconds || 0} seconds
- **ECG Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR):** ${quality.ecg_snr_db !== undefined && quality.ecg_snr_db !== null ? `${quality.ecg_snr_db} dB` : 'N/A'}

## 5. Frozen Protocol & Task Eligibility
This export follows **Frozen Protocol v1.1.0**.
Eligibility evaluations per analytic task:
${Object.entries(eligibility)
  .map(([task, el]) => `- **${task}:** ${el?.eligible ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INELIGIBLE'}${el?.reasons?.length ? ` (${el.reasons.join(', ')})` : ''}`)
  .join('\n') || '- None recorded'}

## 6. Feature Maturity Matrix
${Object.entries(maturity)
  .map(([feat, mat]) => `- **${feat}:** \`${mat}\``)
  .join('\n') || '- None recorded'}

## 7. Scientific Limitations & Disclaimers
${(s.limitations || []).map(lim => `- ${lim}`).join('\n') || '- No specific limitations noted.'}

> **Non-Diagnostic Notice:** CardioLab Workstation is designed exclusively for athletic performance tracking, physiological research, and sports science analysis. It is NOT a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis, clinical decision-making, or emergency screening.
`;
}

/**
 * Export research evidence bundle to disk or ZIP archive.
 */
export async function exportResearchBundle(
  sessionId: string,
  options: ResearchExportOptions
): Promise<{
  bundlePath: string;
  manifest: ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest;
  validation: ResearchBundleValidationResult;
}> {
  const canonicalResult = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId);
  const signals = getSessionSignals(sessionId);

  const hasRr = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'RR');
  const hasHr = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'HR');
  const hasEcg = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ECG');
  const hasAcc = !!signals.find(s => s.signal_type === 'ACC');

  const channelsAvailable: string[] = [];
  if (hasRr) channelsAvailable.push('RR');
  if (hasHr) channelsAvailable.push('HR');
  if (hasEcg) channelsAvailable.push('ECG');
  if (hasAcc) channelsAvailable.push('ACC');

  const includeNormalizedRr = options.includeNormalizedRr !== false;
  const includeNormalizedHr = options.includeNormalizedHr !== false;
  const includeNormalizedEcg = !!options.includeNormalizedEcg;
  const includeNormalizedAcc = !!options.includeNormalizedAcc;

  const channelsIncluded: string[] = [];
  if (hasRr && includeNormalizedRr) channelsIncluded.push('RR');
  if (hasHr && includeNormalizedHr) channelsIncluded.push('HR');
  if (hasEcg && includeNormalizedEcg) channelsIncluded.push('ECG');
  if (hasAcc && includeNormalizedAcc) channelsIncluded.push('ACC');

  const rawSignalIncluded = (includeNormalizedEcg && hasEcg) || (includeNormalizedAcc && hasAcc);

  // Setup atomic staging directory
  const tempBase = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `reb_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(tempBase, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(tempBase, 'normalized_channels'), { recursive: true });

  const members: BundleMemberEntry[] = [];

  try {
    // 1. canonical_session.json
    const sessionJsonStr = deterministicJsonStringify(canonicalResult);
    const sessionJsonPath = path.join(tempBase, 'canonical_session.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(sessionJsonPath, sessionJsonStr, 'utf8');
    const sessionHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(sessionJsonStr, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    members.push({
      path: 'canonical_session.json',
      byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(sessionJsonStr, 'utf8'),
      sha256: sessionHash,
      content_type: 'application/json',
      description: 'Canonical session result with complete lineage and timing authority'
    });

    // 2. canonical_beat_ledger.csv
    const beatLedgerCsv = serializeBeatLedgerCsv(canonicalResult);
    const beatLedgerPath = path.join(tempBase, 'canonical_beat_ledger.csv');
    fs.writeFileSync(beatLedgerPath, beatLedgerCsv, 'utf8');
    const beatLedgerHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(beatLedgerCsv, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    members.push({
      path: 'canonical_beat_ledger.csv',
      byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(beatLedgerCsv, 'utf8'),
      sha256: beatLedgerHash,
      content_type: 'text/csv',
      description: 'Audit-ready beat ledger with per-beat classifications'
    });

    // 3. canonical_metrics.json
    const metricsPayload = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      session_id: canonicalResult.session_id,
      profile_id: canonicalResult.profile_id,
      computed_at_utc: canonicalResult.provenance?.timestamp_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
      timing: canonicalResult.timing,
      quality_summary: canonicalResult.quality_summary,
      core_metrics: canonicalResult.core_metrics,
      advanced_metrics: canonicalResult.advanced_metrics,
      task_eligibility: mapTaskEligibility(canonicalResult.task_eligibility),
      feature_maturity: getFeatureMaturitySummary(),
      limitations: canonicalResult.limitations
    };
    const metricsJsonStr = deterministicJsonStringify(metricsPayload);
    const metricsJsonPath = path.join(tempBase, 'canonical_metrics.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(metricsJsonPath, metricsJsonStr, 'utf8');
    const metricsHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(metricsJsonStr, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    members.push({
      path: 'canonical_metrics.json',
      byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(metricsJsonStr, 'utf8'),
      sha256: metricsHash,
      content_type: 'application/json',
      description: 'Core and advanced session metrics with task eligibility and maturity'
    });

    // 4. provenance_and_limitations.md
    const provenanceMd = generateProvenanceMarkdown(canonicalResult, {
      available: channelsAvailable,
      included: channelsIncluded,
      raw_signal_opt_in: rawSignalIncluded
    });
    const provenancePath = path.join(tempBase, 'provenance_and_limitations.md');
    fs.writeFileSync(provenancePath, provenanceMd, 'utf8');
    const provenanceHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(provenanceMd, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    members.push({
      path: 'provenance_and_limitations.md',
      byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(provenanceMd, 'utf8'),
      sha256: provenanceHash,
      content_type: 'text/markdown',
      description: 'Scientific methodology documentation, clock domains, and limitations'
    });

    // 5. normalized_channels/rr_intervals.csv
    if (includeNormalizedRr) {
      const rrCsv = serializeNormalizedRrCsv(canonicalResult);
      const rrPath = path.join(tempBase, 'normalized_channels', 'rr_intervals.csv');
      fs.writeFileSync(rrPath, rrCsv, 'utf8');
      const rrHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rrCsv, 'utf8').digest('hex');
      members.push({
        path: 'normalized_channels/rr_intervals.csv',
        byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(rrCsv, 'utf8'),
        sha256: rrHash,
        content_type: 'text/csv',
        description: 'Normalized RR interval series with NN acceptance flags'
      });
    }

    // 6. normalized_channels/heart_rate_1hz.csv
    if (includeNormalizedHr) {
      const hrCsv = await serializeNormalizedHrCsv(sessionId, canonicalResult);
      const hrPath = path.join(tempBase, 'normalized_channels', 'heart_rate_1hz.csv');
      fs.writeFileSync(hrPath, hrCsv, 'utf8');
      const hrHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(hrCsv, 'utf8').digest('hex');
      members.push({
        path: 'normalized_channels/heart_rate_1hz.csv',
        byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(hrCsv, 'utf8'),
        sha256: hrHash,
        content_type: 'text/csv',
        description: 'Normalized 1 Hz heart rate cadence points'
      });
    }

    // 7. normalized_channels/ecg_normalized.csv (opt-in)
    if (includeNormalizedEcg && hasEcg) {
      const ecgCsv = await serializeNormalizedEcgCsv(sessionId);
      if (ecgCsv) {
        const ecgPath = path.join(tempBase, 'normalized_channels', 'ecg_normalized.csv');
        fs.writeFileSync(ecgPath, ecgCsv, 'utf8');
        const ecgHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(ecgCsv, 'utf8').digest('hex');
        members.push({
          path: 'normalized_channels/ecg_normalized.csv',
          byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(ecgCsv, 'utf8'),
          sha256: ecgHash,
          content_type: 'text/csv',
          description: 'High-frequency normalized electrocardiogram samples'
        });
      }
    }

    // 8. normalized_channels/acc_normalized.csv (opt-in)
    if (includeNormalizedAcc && hasAcc) {
      const accCsv = await serializeNormalizedAccCsv(sessionId);
      if (accCsv) {
        const accPath = path.join(tempBase, 'normalized_channels', 'acc_normalized.csv');
        fs.writeFileSync(accPath, accCsv, 'utf8');
        const accHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(accCsv, 'utf8').digest('hex');
        members.push({
          path: 'normalized_channels/acc_normalized.csv',
          byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(accCsv, 'utf8'),
          sha256: accHash,
          content_type: 'text/csv',
          description: 'High-frequency normalized tri-axial accelerometer samples'
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort members deterministically by relative path
    members.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));

    // 9. checksums.sha256
    const checksumLines = members.map(m => `${m.sha256}  ${m.path}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    const checksumPath = path.join(tempBase, 'checksums.sha256');
    fs.writeFileSync(checksumPath, checksumLines, 'utf8');
    const checksumHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(checksumLines, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    members.push({
      path: 'checksums.sha256',
      byte_size: Buffer.byteLength(checksumLines, 'utf8'),
      sha256: checksumHash,
      content_type: 'text/plain',
      description: 'Standard sha256sum verification catalog'
    });

    // Sort again to include checksums.sha256 in manifest members list
    members.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));

    // Compute bundle hash over sorted member hashes
    const bundleHashSource = members.map(m => `${m.sha256}  ${m.path}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    const bundleHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bundleHashSource, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    // 10. manifest.json
    const createdUtc = new Date().toISOString();
    const manifest: ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest = {
      schema_version: RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      bundle_type: 'session_evidence',
      bundle_id: `reb_${sessionId}_${bundleHash.substring(0, 12)}`,
      created_at_utc: createdUtc,
      generator: {
        name: 'CardioLab Workstation',
        version: APP_VERSION,
        git_head: RELEASE_COMMIT,
        timestamp_utc: createdUtc
      },
      session: {
        session_id: sessionId,
        profile_id: canonicalResult.profile_id || 'default',
        recorded_at_utc: canonicalResult.timing?.start_time_utc || createdUtc,
        duration_seconds: canonicalResult.timing?.duration_seconds || 0,
        sample_rate_hz: {
          ecg: hasEcg ? 130 : undefined,
          acc: hasAcc ? 200 : undefined
        }
      },
      channels: {
        available: channelsAvailable,
        included: channelsIncluded,
        raw_signal_opt_in: rawSignalIncluded
      },
      task_eligibility: mapTaskEligibility(canonicalResult.task_eligibility),
      feature_maturity: getFeatureMaturitySummary(),
      limitations: canonicalResult.limitations || [],
      members,
      bundle_hash: bundleHash,
      validation_status: 'valid'
    };

    const manifestJsonStr = deterministicJsonStringify(manifest);
    const manifestPath = path.join(tempBase, 'manifest.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, manifestJsonStr, 'utf8');

    // Target delivery resolution
    const targetDir = options.targetDirectory || path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cardiolab_research_bundles');
    if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const timestampTag = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const baseName = `reb_${sessionId}_${timestampTag}`;

    if (options.format === 'directory') {
      const destinationPath = path.join(targetDir, baseName);
      if (fs.existsSync(destinationPath)) {
        fs.rmSync(destinationPath, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
      fs.cpSync(tempBase, destinationPath, { recursive: true });

      const validation = await validateResearchBundle(destinationPath);
      return {
        bundlePath: destinationPath,
        manifest,
        validation
      };
    } else {
      // Default: ZIP archive
      const zipDestination = path.join(targetDir, `${baseName}.zip`);
      const tempZip = `${zipDestination}.tmp-${Date.now()}`;

      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const output = fs.createWriteStream(tempZip);
        const archive = new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } });

        output.on('close', () => resolve());
        archive.on('error', (err: any) => reject(err));

        archive.pipe(output);
        archive.directory(tempBase, false);
        archive.finalize();
      });

      fs.renameSync(tempZip, zipDestination);

      const validation = await validateResearchBundle(zipDestination);
      return {
        bundlePath: zipDestination,
        manifest,
        validation
      };
    }
  } finally {
    // Clean staging
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(tempBase)) {
        fs.rmSync(tempBase, { recursive: true, force: true });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

/**
 * Independent Validator: validates either an extracted bundle directory or a .zip archive.
 * Recomputes all SHA-256 hashes, verifies sizes, checks manifest schema, and guarantees anti-traversal.
 */
export async function validateResearchBundle(
  bundlePathOrZip: string
): Promise<ResearchBundleValidationResult> {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  let inspectedCount = 0;

  if (!fs.existsSync(bundlePathOrZip)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      manifest_valid: false,
      members_valid: false,
      checksums_match: false,
      inspected_members: 0,
      errors: [`Bundle target does not exist: ${bundlePathOrZip}`],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  const stat = fs.statSync(bundlePathOrZip);
  let manifest: ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest | undefined;
  let fileBuffers: Map<string, Buffer> = new Map();

  if (stat.isFile()) {
    // ZIP bundle
    try {
      const zip = new AdmZip(bundlePathOrZip);
      const entries = zip.getEntries();

      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (entry.isDirectory) continue;
        const entryName = entry.entryName.replace(/\\/g, '/');

        // Anti-traversal and safety checks
        if (entryName.includes('..') || entryName.startsWith('/') || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(entryName)) {
          errors.push(`Directory traversal attempt detected in entry: '${entryName}'`);
          continue;
        }

        const data = entry.getData();
        fileBuffers.set(entryName, data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        manifest_valid: false,
        members_valid: false,
        checksums_match: false,
        inspected_members: 0,
        errors: [`Failed to read ZIP archive: ${err.message}`],
        warnings: []
      };
    }
  } else if (stat.isDirectory()) {
    // Extracted directory bundle
    function readDirRecursive(dir: string, base: string) {
      const list = fs.readdirSync(dir);
      for (const item of list) {
        const full = path.join(dir, item);
        const rel = path.relative(base, full).replace(/\\/g, '/');
        const st = fs.statSync(full);
        if (st.isDirectory()) {
          readDirRecursive(full, base);
        } else if (st.isFile()) {
          fileBuffers.set(rel, fs.readFileSync(full));
        }
      }
    }
    readDirRecursive(bundlePathOrZip, bundlePathOrZip);
  } else {
    return {
      valid: false,
      manifest_valid: false,
      members_valid: false,
      checksums_match: false,
      inspected_members: 0,
      errors: ['Bundle target is neither a regular file nor a directory'],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  // 1. Check for manifest.json
  const manifestBuf = fileBuffers.get('manifest.json');
  if (!manifestBuf) {
    errors.push('Required member "manifest.json" missing from bundle');
  } else {
    try {
      const rawJson = JSON.parse(manifestBuf.toString('utf8'));
      const shapeCheck = validateResearchManifestShape(rawJson);
      if (!shapeCheck.valid) {
        errors.push(...shapeCheck.errors);
      } else {
        manifest = rawJson as ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      errors.push(`Failed to parse manifest.json: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  // 2. Check for checksums.sha256
  const checksumsBuf = fileBuffers.get('checksums.sha256');
  const actualChecksumMap = new Map<string, string>();
  if (!checksumsBuf) {
    errors.push('Required member "checksums.sha256" missing from bundle');
  } else {
    const checksumLines = checksumsBuf.toString('utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
    for (const line of checksumLines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed) continue;
      const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
      if (parts.length >= 2) {
        const hash = parts[0];
        const filePath = parts.slice(1).join(' ').replace(/\\/g, '/');
        actualChecksumMap.set(filePath, hash);
      }
    }
  }

  let membersValid = true;
  let checksumsMatch = true;

  // 3. Verify every member in manifest
  if (manifest && Array.isArray(manifest.members)) {
    for (const member of manifest.members) {
      inspectedCount++;
      const fileData = fileBuffers.get(member.path);

      if (!fileData) {
        errors.push(`Manifest member "${member.path}" not found in bundle`);
        membersValid = false;
        continue;
      }

      if (fileData.length !== member.byte_size) {
        errors.push(`Member "${member.path}" size mismatch: manifest says ${member.byte_size} bytes, actual is ${fileData.length} bytes`);
        membersValid = false;
      }

      const computedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileData).digest('hex');
      if (computedHash.toLowerCase() !== member.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        errors.push(`Member "${member.path}" SHA-256 mismatch: manifest says ${member.sha256}, computed is ${computedHash}`);
        membersValid = false;
      }

      // Check against checksums.sha256 catalog (checksums.sha256 doesn't contain itself in catalog)
      if (member.path !== 'checksums.sha256') {
        const catalogHash = actualChecksumMap.get(member.path);
        if (!catalogHash) {
          errors.push(`Member "${member.path}" not found in checksums.sha256 catalog`);
          checksumsMatch = false;
        } else if (catalogHash.toLowerCase() !== computedHash.toLowerCase()) {
          errors.push(`Member "${member.path}" catalog hash (${catalogHash}) does not match computed hash (${computedHash})`);
          checksumsMatch = false;
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Verify bundle_hash
    const sortedMembers = [...manifest.members].sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    const bundleHashSource = sortedMembers.map(m => `${m.sha256}  ${m.path}`).join('\n') + '\n';
    const computedBundleHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bundleHashSource, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    if (computedBundleHash.toLowerCase() !== manifest.bundle_hash.toLowerCase()) {
      errors.push(`Bundle hash mismatch: manifest says ${manifest.bundle_hash}, computed is ${computedBundleHash}`);
      membersValid = false;
    }
  } else {
    membersValid = false;
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    manifest_valid: errors.length === 0 && !!manifest,
    members_valid: membersValid && errors.length === 0,
    checksums_match: checksumsMatch && errors.length === 0,
    inspected_members: inspectedCount,
    errors,
    warnings,
    manifest
  };
}
