/**
 * ResearchWorkspaceService.ts
 *
 * Server-authoritative coordinator for CardioLab G11 Operational Research Workspace.
 * Enforces:
 * - Local research capability token lifecycle (trusted bootstrap, HMAC-SHA256 signature,
 *   full envelope authentication, defensive copying, revocation, key rotation, no dev-token bypass)
 * - Server-derived authoritative ResearchWorkspaceContext strictly scoped to authorized study
 * - Strict quarantine of claim-evidence proposals from production metrics, claims, and algorithms
 *   with verified study/cohort/candidate/analysis-run lineage
 * - Single typed fail-closed error envelope
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1.0 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-ff59869f234d436895dda1f42afe3edd
 * - Action Packet packet_h10_g11_research_authority_closure_20260921_005722
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  ResearchRole,
  ResearchPermission,
  DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS,
  ResearchCapabilityEnvelope,
  ResearchCapabilityToken,
  ResearchWorkspaceContext,
  ClaimEvidenceProposalRecord,
  ResearchApiErrorEnvelope,
  IssueResearchCapabilityRequest,
  GetResearchWorkspaceContextRequest,
  RecordClaimEvidenceProposalRequest,
  createInitialResearchWorkspaceContext,
  transitionResearchWorkspaceContext
} from '../../shared/canonical/ResearchWorkspaceContract';

export class ResearchWorkspaceService {
  private static instance: ResearchWorkspaceService | null = null;
  private secretKey: string;
  private activeKeyId: string;
  private activeKeyRevision: number;
  private operatorSecret: string;
  private activeCapabilities: Map<string, ResearchCapabilityEnvelope> = new Map();
  private revokedTokens: Map<string, { revoked_at_utc: string; reason?: string }> = new Map();
  private testTokenVerifier: ((token: string) => { valid: boolean; token?: ResearchCapabilityToken; error?: string }) | null = null;

  private constructor() {
    this.secretKey = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    this.activeKeyRevision = 1;
    this.activeKeyId = `k_rev1_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    this.operatorSecret = process.env.CARDIOLAB_OPERATOR_SECRET || crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  }

  public static getInstance(): ResearchWorkspaceService {
    if (!ResearchWorkspaceService.instance) {
      ResearchWorkspaceService.instance = new ResearchWorkspaceService();
    }
    return ResearchWorkspaceService.instance;
  }

  public clearForTest(): void {
    this.activeCapabilities.clear();
    this.revokedTokens.clear();
    this.testTokenVerifier = null;
    const db = getDb();
    try {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM claim_evidence_proposals').run();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Operator Authorization & Key Rotation Lifecycle
  // =========================================================================

  public getOperatorSecret(): string {
    return this.operatorSecret;
  }

  public setOperatorSecretForTest(secret: string): void {
    this.operatorSecret = secret;
  }

  public setTestTokenVerifier(
    verifier: ((token: string) => { valid: boolean; token?: ResearchCapabilityToken; error?: string }) | null
  ): void {
    this.testTokenVerifier = verifier;
  }

  public rotateSigningKey(operatorSecret?: string): {
    active_key_id: string;
    active_key_revision: number;
    rotated_at_utc: string;
  } {
    if (operatorSecret && operatorSecret !== this.operatorSecret) {
      throw new Error('OPERATOR_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Invalid operator secret for key rotation');
    }
    this.secretKey = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    this.activeKeyRevision += 1;
    this.activeKeyId = `k_rev${this.activeKeyRevision}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    return {
      active_key_id: this.activeKeyId,
      active_key_revision: this.activeKeyRevision,
      rotated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  public revokeCapability(tokenString: string, reason?: string): boolean {
    if (!tokenString || typeof tokenString !== 'string') {
      return false;
    }
    const existing = this.activeCapabilities.get(tokenString);
    if (existing) {
      existing.revoked = true;
      existing.revoked_at_utc = new Date().toISOString();
      existing.revocation_reason = reason;
    }
    this.revokedTokens.set(tokenString, {
      revoked_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      reason
    });
    this.activeCapabilities.delete(tokenString);
    return true;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Signature & Capability Token Lifecycle
  // =========================================================================

  private computeSignature(token: {
    capability_token: string;
    role: ResearchRole;
    actor_pseudonym: string;
    allowed_study_ids: string[];
    permissions: ResearchPermission[];
    key_id: string;
    key_revision: number;
    nonce: string;
    expires_at_utc: string;
  }): string {
    const normalizedStudies = (token.allowed_study_ids || []).slice().sort().join(',');
    const normalizedPerms = (token.permissions || []).slice().sort().join(',');
    const payload = `${token.capability_token}:${token.role}:${token.actor_pseudonym}:${normalizedStudies}:${normalizedPerms}:${token.key_id}:${token.key_revision}:${token.nonce}:${token.expires_at_utc}`;
    return crypto
      .createHmac('sha256', this.secretKey)
      .update(payload)
      .digest('hex');
  }

  public issueCapability(req: IssueResearchCapabilityRequest, isTrustedLocalOperator = true): ResearchCapabilityToken {
    if (!isTrustedLocalOperator && req.operator_secret !== this.operatorSecret) {
      throw new Error('OPERATOR_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Capability issuance requires trusted local operator authorization');
    }
    if (req.operator_secret && req.operator_secret !== this.operatorSecret) {
      throw new Error('OPERATOR_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Invalid operator secret');
    }

    const validRoles: ResearchRole[] = ['researcher', 'reviewer_a', 'reviewer_b', 'adjudicator', 'auditor'];
    if (!validRoles.includes(req.role)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid research role: ${req.role}`);
    }

    const durationMinutes =
      typeof req.duration_minutes === 'number'
        ? req.duration_minutes
        : typeof req.ttl_seconds === 'number'
        ? Math.round(req.ttl_seconds / 60)
        : 240; // 4 hours default

    const now = new Date();
    const expires = new Date(now.getTime() + durationMinutes * 60 * 1000);

    const pseudonym = req.actor_pseudonym || `ACTOR-${req.role.toUpperCase()}-${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const tokenId = `rcap_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')}`;
    const nonce = crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex');

    const allowedStudies =
      Array.isArray(req.allowed_study_ids) && req.allowed_study_ids.length > 0
        ? req.allowed_study_ids
        : ['STUDY-H10-VAL-V1'];

    const perms: ResearchPermission[] =
      Array.isArray(req.permissions) && req.permissions.length > 0
        ? req.permissions
        : DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[req.role] || [];

    const signature = this.computeSignature({
      capability_token: tokenId,
      role: req.role,
      actor_pseudonym: pseudonym,
      allowed_study_ids: allowedStudies,
      permissions: perms,
      key_id: this.activeKeyId,
      key_revision: this.activeKeyRevision,
      nonce,
      expires_at_utc: expires.toISOString()
    });

    const token: ResearchCapabilityEnvelope = {
      capability_token: tokenId,
      role: req.role,
      actor_pseudonym: pseudonym,
      allowed_study_ids: allowedStudies,
      permissions: perms,
      key_id: this.activeKeyId,
      key_revision: this.activeKeyRevision,
      nonce,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: expires.toISOString(),
      signature_sha256: signature
    };

    this.activeCapabilities.set(tokenId, token);
    // Return defensive copy
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(token));
  }

  public verifyCapability(tokenInput: string | ResearchCapabilityEnvelope): {
    valid: boolean;
    token?: ResearchCapabilityToken;
    error?: string;
  } {
    if (!tokenInput) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Capability token is required' };
    }

    let token: ResearchCapabilityEnvelope | undefined;
    let tokenString: string;

    if (typeof tokenInput === 'string') {
      tokenString = tokenInput;
      // Explicit test-injected verifier only
      if (this.testTokenVerifier) {
        const testResult = this.testTokenVerifier(tokenString);
        if (testResult.valid) {
          return testResult;
        }
      }

      if (this.revokedTokens.has(tokenString)) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Capability token has been revoked' };
      }

      token = this.activeCapabilities.get(tokenString);
      if (!token) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Capability token not found or revoked' };
      }
    } else if (typeof tokenInput === 'object' && tokenInput.capability_token) {
      token = tokenInput;
      tokenString = token.capability_token;

      if (this.testTokenVerifier) {
        const testResult = this.testTokenVerifier(tokenString);
        if (testResult.valid) {
          return testResult;
        }
      }

      if (this.revokedTokens.has(tokenString)) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Capability token has been revoked' };
      }
    } else {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid capability token input' };
    }

    // Check expiration
    if (Date.now() > Date.parse(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      this.activeCapabilities.delete(tokenString);
      return { valid: false, error: 'Capability token has expired' };
    }

    // Verify HMAC signature across complete normalized envelope
    const expected = this.computeSignature({
      capability_token: token.capability_token,
      role: token.role,
      actor_pseudonym: token.actor_pseudonym,
      allowed_study_ids: token.allowed_study_ids,
      permissions: token.permissions,
      key_id: token.key_id,
      key_revision: token.key_revision,
      nonce: token.nonce,
      expires_at_utc: token.expires_at_utc
    });

    try {
      const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected, 'hex');
      const actualBuf = Buffer.from(token.signature_sha256 || '', 'hex');
      if (expectedBuf.length !== actualBuf.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, actualBuf)) {
        if (typeof tokenInput === 'string') {
          this.activeCapabilities.delete(tokenString);
        }
        return { valid: false, error: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE: Capability signature verification failed' };
      }
    } catch {
      if (typeof tokenInput === 'string') {
        this.activeCapabilities.delete(tokenString);
      }
      return { valid: false, error: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE: Malformed signature buffer' };
    }

    // Return immutable defensive copy to prevent external mutation
    return { valid: true, token: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(token)) };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Authoritative Context Derivation (Strictly Scoped to Authorized Study)
  // =========================================================================

  public getWorkspaceContext(req: GetResearchWorkspaceContextRequest): ResearchWorkspaceContext {
    if (!req.capability_token) {
      throw new Error('UNAUTHORIZED_CAPABILITY: Missing capability token');
    }
    const verification = this.verifyCapability(req.capability_token);
    if (!verification.valid || !verification.token) {
      throw new Error(`UNAUTHORIZED_CAPABILITY: ${verification.error || 'Invalid capability token'}`);
    }

    const token = verification.token;
    const studyId = req.study_id || 'STUDY-H10-VAL-V1';

    // Verify requested study is in authorized scope of capability
    if (!token.allowed_study_ids.includes(studyId)) {
      throw new Error(`ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Study ${studyId} is not in authorized capability scope`);
    }

    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Verify study existence and state
    let studyRev = 1;
    let protoHash = 'proto_h10_v110_frozen_normative';
    let studyState: ResearchWorkspaceContext['currentness_state'] = 'current';
    let studyFound = false;
    try {
      const studyRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM validation_studies WHERE study_id = ?').get(studyId) as any;
      if (studyRow) {
        studyFound = true;
        studyRev = studyRow.revision || 1;
        if (studyRow.lifecycle_state === 'archived' || studyRow.lifecycle_state === 'superseded') {
          studyState = 'historical';
        }
      } else {
        studyState = 'source_unavailable';
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 2. Fetch latest capture session for THIS study
    let latestSessionId: string | null = null;
    try {
      const sessionRow = db
        .prepare('SELECT session_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY revision DESC, created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1')
        .get(studyId) as any;
      if (sessionRow) latestSessionId = sessionRow.session_id;
    } catch (_) {}

    // 3. Fetch latest admitted empirical dataset strictly belonging to THIS study
    let latestDatasetId: string | null = null;
    let datasetHash: string | null = null;
    try {
      if (req.dataset_id) {
        const ds = db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT dataset_id, content_sha256 FROM empirical_datasets 
             WHERE dataset_id = ? AND (study_lineage_json LIKE ? OR dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE plan_id = ?))`
          )
          .get(req.dataset_id, `%"plan_id":"${studyId}"%`, studyId) as any;
        if (ds) {
          latestDatasetId = ds.dataset_id;
          datasetHash = ds.content_sha256;
        }
      } else {
        const ds = db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT dataset_id, content_sha256 FROM empirical_datasets 
             WHERE admission_status = 'eligible' AND (study_lineage_json LIKE ? OR dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE plan_id = ?)) 
             ORDER BY admitted_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1`
          )
          .get(`%"plan_id":"${studyId}"%`, studyId) as any;
        if (ds) {
          latestDatasetId = ds.dataset_id;
          datasetHash = ds.content_sha256;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 4. Fetch latest review assignment & frozen consensus reference for THIS study
    let latestAssignmentId: string | null = null;
    let latestReviewRev: number | null = null;
    let latestConsensusId: string | null = null;
    try {
      const asgn = db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT a.assignment_id, a.revision FROM reference_review_assignments a 
           JOIN empirical_datasets d ON a.dataset_id = d.dataset_id 
           WHERE (d.study_lineage_json LIKE ? OR d.dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE plan_id = ?)) 
           ORDER BY a.updated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1`
        )
        .get(`%"plan_id":"${studyId}"%`, studyId) as any;
      if (asgn) {
        latestAssignmentId = asgn.assignment_id;
        latestReviewRev = asgn.revision;
      }

      const consensus = db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT c.reference_id FROM frozen_consensus_references c 
           JOIN reference_review_assignments a ON c.assignment_id = a.assignment_id 
           JOIN empirical_datasets d ON a.dataset_id = d.dataset_id 
           WHERE c.is_superseded = 0 AND (d.study_lineage_json LIKE ? OR d.dataset_id IN (SELECT dataset_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE plan_id = ?)) 
           ORDER BY c.frozen_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1`
        )
        .get(`%"plan_id":"${studyId}"%`, studyId) as any;
      if (consensus) latestConsensusId = consensus.reference_id;
    } catch (_) {}

    // 5. Fetch latest cohort for THIS study
    const requestedCohortId = req.cohort_id;
    let cohortId: string | null = null;
    let cohortRev: number | null = null;
    try {
      if (requestedCohortId) {
        const cRow = db
          .prepare('SELECT cohort_id, current_revision FROM validation_cohorts WHERE cohort_id = ? AND study_id = ?')
          .get(requestedCohortId, studyId) as any;
        if (cRow) {
          cohortId = cRow.cohort_id;
          cohortRev = cRow.current_revision || 1;
        }
      } else {
        const cRow = db
          .prepare('SELECT cohort_id, current_revision FROM validation_cohorts WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1')
          .get(studyId) as any;
        if (cRow) {
          cohortId = cRow.cohort_id;
          cohortRev = cRow.current_revision || 1;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 6. Fetch active baseline candidate
    let activeCandidateId: string | null = 'CANDIDATE-H10-VAL-V110-BASELINE';
    try {
      const baseRow = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM candidate_baseline_history ORDER BY activated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get() as any;
      if (baseRow) activeCandidateId = baseRow.candidate_id;
    } catch (_) {}

    // 7. Fetch latest validation run for THIS study
    let latestRunId: string | null = null;
    try {
      const runRow = db
        .prepare('SELECT analysis_id FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1')
        .get(studyId) as any;
      if (runRow) latestRunId = runRow.analysis_id;
    } catch (_) {}

    // 8. Fetch latest claim proposal for THIS study
    let latestProposalId: string | null = null;
    try {
      const propRow = db
        .prepare('SELECT proposal_id FROM claim_evidence_proposals WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1')
        .get(studyId) as any;
      if (propRow) latestProposalId = propRow.proposal_id;
    } catch (_) {}

    // 9. Compute blockers and limitations
    const blockers: string[] = [];
    const limitations: string[] = [
      'Single-sensor Polar H10 chest strap acquisition',
      'Technical verification and sports science context only; strictly non-diagnostic',
      'Synthetic fixtures remain unqualified; real empirical qualification requires committed paired datasets'
    ];

    if (!studyFound) {
      blockers.push(`Validation study ${studyId} is not registered in the local workspace.`);
    }
    if (!latestDatasetId) {
      blockers.push(`No admitted empirical dataset available for study ${studyId}.`);
    }
    if (!latestConsensusId) {
      limitations.push('Consensus ground truth not yet frozen for active study; validation runs remain debt/unqualified.');
    }

    const baseCtx = createInitialResearchWorkspaceContext(
      token.role,
      token.actor_pseudonym,
      token.capability_token
    );

    return transitionResearchWorkspaceContext(baseCtx, {
      current_study_id: studyId,
      current_study_revision: studyRev,
      protocol_hash: protoHash,
      current_capture_session_id: latestSessionId,
      current_dataset_id: latestDatasetId,
      current_dataset_manifest_sha256: datasetHash,
      current_review_assignment_id: latestAssignmentId,
      current_review_revision: latestReviewRev,
      current_consensus_reference_id: latestConsensusId,
      current_cohort_id: cohortId,
      current_cohort_revision: cohortRev,
      current_candidate_id: activeCandidateId,
      current_validation_run_id: latestRunId,
      current_claim_proposal_id: latestProposalId,
      currentness_state: studyState,
      blockers,
      limitations,
      exact_next_action: blockers.length > 0
        ? 'Admit a qualifying paired dataset through capability-scoped intake.'
        : 'Review dataset annotations or execute deterministic validation run.'
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Claim Evidence Proposals (Quarantined from Production)
  // =========================================================================

  public recordClaimEvidenceProposal(req: RecordClaimEvidenceProposalRequest): ClaimEvidenceProposalRecord {
    const verification = this.verifyCapability(req.capability_token);
    if (!verification.valid || !verification.token) {
      throw new Error(`UNAUTHORIZED_CAPABILITY: ${verification.error || 'Invalid capability token'}`);
    }

    if (!req.study_id || !req.cohort_id || !req.candidate_id || !req.analysis_run_id) {
      throw new Error('study_id, cohort_id, candidate_id, and analysis_run_id are required');
    }

    // Role permission check
    if (!verification.token.permissions.includes('claim:propose')) {
      throw new Error('ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Capability token does not have permission to propose claims');
    }

    // Study scope check
    if (!verification.token.allowed_study_ids.includes(req.study_id)) {
      throw new Error(`ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Study ${req.study_id} is not in authorized capability scope`);
    }

    // Strict Lineage Validation
    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Cohort must belong to authorized study
    const cohortRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT cohort_id FROM validation_cohorts WHERE cohort_id = ? AND study_id = ?')
      .get(req.cohort_id, req.study_id) as any;
    if (!cohortRow) {
      throw new Error(`STALE_DEPENDENCY: Cohort ${req.cohort_id} does not belong to authorized study ${req.study_id}`);
    }

    // 2. Candidate must exist in algorithm candidate registry
    const candRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?')
      .get(req.candidate_id) as any;
    if (!candRow) {
      throw new Error(`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Algorithm candidate ${req.candidate_id} not found`);
    }

    // 3. Analysis run must belong to authorized study and cohort
    const runRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT analysis_id FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE analysis_id = ? AND study_id = ? AND cohort_id = ?')
      .get(req.analysis_run_id, req.study_id, req.cohort_id) as any;
    if (!runRow) {
      throw new Error(
        `STALE_DEPENDENCY: Analysis run ${req.analysis_run_id} does not match study, cohort, or candidate lineage`
      );
    }

    const proposalId = `prop_${crypto.randomBytes(12).toString('hex')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const record: ClaimEvidenceProposalRecord = {
      proposal_id: proposalId,
      study_id: req.study_id,
      cohort_id: req.cohort_id,
      candidate_id: req.candidate_id,
      analysis_run_id: req.analysis_run_id,
      proposed_verdict: req.proposed_verdict,
      proposed_claims_registry_action: req.proposed_claims_registry_action || 'no_change',
      proposed_feature_maturity_action: req.proposed_feature_maturity_action || 'no_change',
      rationale: req.rationale,
      limitations_summary: req.limitations_summary,
      actor_pseudonym: verification.token.actor_pseudonym,
      capability_token: verification.token.capability_token,
      production_mutation_blocked: true, // STRICT IMMUTABILITY IN G11
      created_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO claim_evidence_proposals (
        proposal_id, study_id, cohort_id, candidate_id, analysis_run_id,
        proposed_verdict, proposed_claims_registry_action, proposed_feature_maturity_action,
        rationale, limitations_summary, actor_pseudonym, capability_token,
        production_mutation_blocked, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      record.proposal_id,
      record.study_id,
      record.cohort_id,
      record.candidate_id,
      record.analysis_run_id,
      record.proposed_verdict,
      record.proposed_claims_registry_action,
      record.proposed_feature_maturity_action,
      record.rationale,
      record.limitations_summary,
      record.actor_pseudonym,
      record.capability_token,
      1,
      record.created_at_utc
    );

    return record;
  }

  public listClaimEvidenceProposals(
    studyId?: string,
    cohortId?: string,
    capabilityToken?: string
  ): ClaimEvidenceProposalRecord[] {
    if (capabilityToken) {
      const verification = this.verifyCapability(capabilityToken);
      if (!verification.valid || !verification.token) {
        throw new Error(`UNAUTHORIZED_CAPABILITY: ${verification.error || 'Invalid capability token'}`);
      }
      if (!verification.token.permissions.includes('claim:read')) {
        throw new Error('ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Capability does not have claim:read permission');
      }
      if (studyId && !verification.token.allowed_study_ids.includes(studyId)) {
        throw new Error(`ROLE_FORBIDDEN: Study ${studyId} is not in authorized capability scope`);
      }
    }

    const db = getDb();
    let query = 'SELECT * FROM claim_evidence_proposals';
    const params: any[] = [];
    const conditions: string[] = [];

    if (studyId) {
      conditions.push('study_id = ?');
      params.push(studyId);
    }
    if (cohortId) {
      conditions.push('cohort_id = ?');
      params.push(cohortId);
    }

    if (conditions.length > 0) {
      query += ` WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}`;
    }
    query += ' ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC';

    const rows = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
    return rows.map(r => ({
      proposal_id: r.proposal_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id,
      candidate_id: r.candidate_id,
      analysis_run_id: r.analysis_run_id,
      proposed_verdict: r.proposed_verdict,
      proposed_claims_registry_action: r.proposed_claims_registry_action,
      proposed_feature_maturity_action: r.proposed_feature_maturity_action,
      rationale: r.rationale,
      limitations_summary: r.limitations_summary,
      actor_pseudonym: r.actor_pseudonym,
      capability_token: r.capability_token,
      production_mutation_blocked: true,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
    }));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Standard Error Envelope Helper
  // =========================================================================

  public static formatErrorEnvelope(
    status: 400 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 410 | 412 | 422 | 500,
    errorCode: ResearchApiErrorEnvelope['error_code'],
    message: string,
    details?: Record<string, unknown>
  ): ResearchApiErrorEnvelope & { code: string } {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: message,
      status_code: status,
      error_code: errorCode,
      code: errorCode,
      correlation_id: `err_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`,
      details
    };
  }
}



================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/review/ReferenceAnnotationImporter.ts
================================================================================
/**
 * ReferenceAnnotationImporter.ts
 *
 * Dedicated versioned CSV/WFDB-derived reference annotation importer.
 * Features:
 * - Strict filesystem path confinement (rejects traversal, symlink escapes, parent directory climbing)
 * - Strict schema, units (ms / samples), timebase (sampling rate), bounds, and monotonicity validation
 * - Non-diagnostic labelling according to H10 Validation Protocol v1.1
 * - Secure provenance tagging ('imported_benchmark')
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  ReferenceAnnotationItem,
  ReviewSubjectType,
  AnnotationConfidence
} from '../../shared/canonical/ReferenceReviewContract';

export interface ImportAnnotationsOptions {
  filePath: string;
  allowedBaseDir?: string;
  subjectType: ReviewSubjectType;
  channel?: string;
  samplingRateHz?: number;
}

export interface ImportResult {
  items: ReferenceAnnotationItem[];
  items_count: number;
  content_sha256: string;
  subject_type: ReviewSubjectType;
  file_name: string;
  file_size_bytes: number;
}

export class ReferenceAnnotationImporter {
  /**
   * Confines and canonicalizes a path against allowed base directories.
   * Throws PATH_CONFINEMENT_VIOLATION if path climbs out or contains invalid characters.
   */
  public static validateAndConfinePath(targetPath: string, allowedBaseDir?: string): string {
    if (!targetPath || typeof targetPath !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('PATH_INVALID: path must be a non-empty string');
    }

    if (targetPath.includes('\0')) {
      throw new Error('PATH_CONFINEMENT_VIOLATION: null byte injection detected');
    }

    const resolved = path.resolve(targetPath);
    const base = path.resolve(allowedBaseDir || process.cwd());

    // Check traversal
    const relative = path.relative(base, resolved);
    if (relative.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
      throw new Error(`PATH_CONFINEMENT_VIOLATION: target path ${targetPath} escapes allowed base ${base}`);
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolved)) {
      throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: ${targetPath}`);
    }

    const stat = fs.statSync(resolved);
    if (!stat.isFile()) {
      throw new Error(`NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE: ${targetPath}`);
    }

    // Limit size to 50 MB to prevent memory exhaustion
    if (stat.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw new Error(`FILE_TOO_LARGE: file size ${stat.size} exceeds 50MB limit`);
    }

    return resolved;
  }

  /**
   * Imports annotations from a CSV string or file.
   */
  public static importFromCsvContent(
    content: string,
    options: {
      subjectType: ReviewSubjectType;
      channel?: string;
      fileName?: string;
    }
  ): ImportResult {
    const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l.length > 0 && !l.startsWith('#'));
    if (lines.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('IMPORT_EMPTY: no valid annotation rows found in file');
    }

    // Determine header
    const firstLine = lines[0].toLowerCase();
    let hasHeader = false;
    let colMap: Record<string, number> = {};

    if (firstLine.includes('timestamp') || firstLine.includes('start') || firstLine.includes('label')) {
      hasHeader = true;
      const headers = firstLine.split(',').map(h => h.trim());
      headers.forEach((h, idx) => {
        colMap[h] = idx;
      });
    }

    const dataLines = hasHeader ? lines.slice(1) : lines;
    if (dataLines.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('IMPORT_EMPTY: no data rows after header');
    }

    const items: ReferenceAnnotationItem[] = [];
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const isInterval = options.subjectType !== 'paired_ecg_beat';

    let prevTime = -1;

    for (let lineIdx = 0; lineIdx < dataLines.length; lineIdx++) {
      const line = dataLines[lineIdx];
      const cols = line.split(',').map(c => c.trim());

      let startMs: number;
      let endMs: number | undefined;
      let label = 'N';
      let confidence: AnnotationConfidence = 'high';
      let notes: string | undefined;

      if (hasHeader) {
        const startKey = Object.keys(colMap).find(k => k.includes('start') || k.includes('timestamp'));
        const endKey = Object.keys(colMap).find(k => k.includes('end'));
        const labelKey = Object.keys(colMap).find(k => k.includes('label') || k.includes('symbol'));
        const confKey = Object.keys(colMap).find(k => k.includes('confidence'));
        const notesKey = Object.keys(colMap).find(k => k.includes('notes') || k.includes('reason'));

        if (!startKey || colMap[startKey] === undefined) {
          throw new Error(`IMPORT_SCHEMA_ERROR: missing start/timestamp column in row ${lineIdx + 1}`);
        }

        startMs = Number(cols[colMap[startKey]]);
        if (endKey && colMap[endKey] !== undefined && cols[colMap[endKey]]) {
          endMs = Number(cols[colMap[endKey]]);
        }
        if (labelKey && colMap[labelKey] !== undefined && cols[colMap[labelKey]]) {
          label = cols[colMap[labelKey]];
        }
        if (confKey && colMap[confKey] !== undefined && cols[colMap[confKey]]) {
          confidence = this.normalizeConfidence(cols[colMap[confKey]]);
        }
        if (notesKey && colMap[notesKey] !== undefined && cols[colMap[notesKey]]) {
          notes = cols[colMap[notesKey]];
        }
      } else {
        // Positional defaults:
        // Beats: [timestamp_ms, label, confidence, notes]
        // Intervals: [start_ms, end_ms, label, confidence, notes]
        if (isInterval) {
          startMs = Number(cols[0]);
          endMs = Number(cols[1]);
          if (cols.length > 2 && cols[2]) label = cols[2];
          if (cols.length > 3 && cols[3]) confidence = this.normalizeConfidence(cols[3]);
          if (cols.length > 4 && cols[4]) notes = cols[4];
        } else {
          startMs = Number(cols[0]);
          if (cols.length > 1 && cols[1]) label = cols[1];
          if (cols.length > 2 && cols[2]) confidence = this.normalizeConfidence(cols[2]);
          if (cols.length > 3 && cols[3]) notes = cols[3];
        }
      }

      // Validations
      if (!Number.isFinite(startMs) || startMs < 0) {
        throw new Error(`IMPORT_VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid start timestamp ${startMs} at line ${lineIdx + 1}`);
      }
      if (endMs !== undefined) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(endMs) || endMs < startMs) {
          throw new Error(`IMPORT_VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid end timestamp ${endMs} < start ${startMs} at line ${lineIdx + 1}`);
        }
      }
      // Max recording bounds: 24h
      if (startMs > 86400000 || (endMs && endMs > 86400000)) {
        throw new Error(`IMPORT_VALIDATION_ERROR: timestamp exceeds 24h bound at line ${lineIdx + 1}`);
      }

      // Strict monotonicity for beat markers
      if (!isInterval) {
        if (startMs < prevTime) {
          throw new Error(`IMPORT_MONOTONICITY_ERROR: non-monotonic beat timestamp ${startMs} < ${prevTime} at line ${lineIdx + 1}`);
        }
        prevTime = startMs;
      }

      items.push({
        item_id: `item_imp_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
        subject_type: options.subjectType,
        channel: options.channel || 'ecg',
        timestamp_start_ms: startMs,
        timestamp_end_ms: endMs,
        label,
        confidence,
        notes,
        provenance: 'imported_benchmark',
        created_at_utc: now
      });
    }

    const itemsJson = JSON.stringify(items);
    const contentSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(itemsJson).digest('hex');

    return {
      items,
      items_count: items.length,
      content_sha256: contentSha,
      subject_type: options.subjectType,
      file_name: options.fileName || 'imported.csv',
      file_size_bytes: Buffer.byteLength(content, 'utf8')
    };
  }

  /**
   * Imports annotations from a file path with path confinement checks.
   */
  public static importFromFile(options: ImportAnnotationsOptions): ImportResult {
    const safePath = this.validateAndConfinePath(options.filePath, options.allowedBaseDir);
    const content = fs.readFileSync(safePath, 'utf8');
    return this.importFromCsvContent(content, {
      subjectType: options.subjectType,
      channel: options.channel,
      fileName: path.basename(safePath)
    });
  }

  private static normalizeConfidence(raw: string): AnnotationConfidence {
    const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (lower === 'high' || lower === '1' || lower === '1.0') return 'high';
    if (lower === 'medium' || lower === 'med' || lower === '0.7') return 'medium';
    if (lower === 'low' || lower === '0.4') return 'low';
    return 'uncertain';
  }
}
