/**
 * ReferenceReviewService.ts
 *
 * Backend service implementing independent reference review assignments,
 * blinded dual-review submission, conflict detection, consensus adjudication,
 * frozen reference hashing, and restart-safe SQLite durability.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - ReferenceReviewContract.ts
 * - QRA-03, QRA-04, QRA-05, QRA-06
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import {
  ReviewSubjectType,
  ReviewLifecycleState,
  ReviewerRole,
  ReferenceAnnotationItem,
  ReferenceAnnotationSet,
  ReferenceReviewAssignment,
  ReviewConflictDetail,
  ReferenceAdjudicationRecord,
  FrozenConsensusReference,
  AdjudicationVerdict,
  ReferenceAgreementSummary,
  ConsensusEligibilityStatus,
  ReferenceLifecycleEvent,
  ReferenceAnnotationRevision,
  AnnotationConfidence
} from '../../shared/canonical/ReferenceReviewContract';

export interface CreateAssignmentParams {
  dataset_id: string;
  subject_type: ReviewSubjectType;
  reviewer_a_token: string;
  reviewer_b_token: string;
  adjudicator_token: string;
  reviewer_a_pseudonym?: string;
  reviewer_b_pseudonym?: string;
  adjudicator_pseudonym?: string;
  blinding_mode?: 'double_blind' | 'single_blind' | 'open_consensus';
  notes?: string;
  allow_synthetic_test_separation?: boolean;
}

export interface SaveAnnotationsParams {
  assignment_id: string;
  reviewer_token: string;
  reviewer_role: ReviewerRole;
  items: ReferenceAnnotationItem[];
  submit?: boolean;
  expected_revision?: number;
}

export interface AdjudicateParams {
  assignment_id: string;
  adjudicator_token: string;
  verdict: AdjudicationVerdict;
  rationale: string;
  resolved_items?: ReferenceAnnotationItem[];
  expected_revision?: number;
}

export class ReferenceReviewService {
  private static instance: ReferenceReviewService;

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): ReferenceReviewService {
    if (!ReferenceReviewService.instance) {
      ReferenceReviewService.instance = new ReferenceReviewService();
    }
    return ReferenceReviewService.instance;
  }

  public clearAllForTest(): void {
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_lifecycle_events').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_annotation_revisions').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM frozen_consensus_references').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_adjudications').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_conflicts').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_annotation_sets').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_review_assignments').run();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Assignment Management (QRA-03)
  // =========================================================================

  public createAssignment(params: CreateAssignmentParams): ReferenceReviewAssignment {
    const db = getDb();
    if (!params.dataset_id || !params.subject_type || !params.reviewer_a_token || !params.reviewer_b_token || !params.adjudicator_token) {
      throw new Error('MISSING_REQUIRED_ASSIGNMENT_PARAMS');
    }

    // Ensure dataset exists
    const datasetRow = db.prepare('SELECT dataset_id FROM empirical_datasets WHERE dataset_id = ?').get(params.dataset_id);
    if (!datasetRow) {
      throw new Error(`DATASET_NOT_FOUND: ${params.dataset_id}`);
    }

    // Check separation of roles: reviewers cannot be identical, adjudicator must be separate unless synthetic test mode
    if (!params.allow_synthetic_test_separation) {
      if (params.reviewer_a_token === params.reviewer_b_token) {
        throw new Error('REVIEWERS_MUST_BE_INDEPENDENT: reviewer_a and reviewer_b tokens cannot match');
      }
      if (params.reviewer_a_token === params.adjudicator_token) {
        throw new Error('ROLES_MUST_BE_SEPARATED: reviewer_a and adjudicator tokens cannot match');
      }
      if (params.reviewer_b_token === params.adjudicator_token) {
        throw new Error('ROLES_MUST_BE_SEPARATED: reviewer_b and adjudicator tokens cannot match');
      }
    }

    const assignmentId = `asgn_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const blindingMode = params.blinding_mode || 'double_blind';

    const revAPseudonym = params.reviewer_a_pseudonym || `rev_pseudo_a_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const revBPseudonym = params.reviewer_b_pseudonym || `rev_pseudo_b_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const adjPseudonym = params.adjudicator_pseudonym || `adj_pseudo_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

    const assignment: ReferenceReviewAssignment = {
      assignment_id: assignmentId,
      dataset_id: params.dataset_id,
      subject_type: params.subject_type,
      revision: 1,
      lifecycle_state: 'assigned',
      reviewer_a_token: params.reviewer_a_token,
      reviewer_b_token: params.reviewer_b_token,
      adjudicator_token: params.adjudicator_token,
      reviewer_a_pseudonym: revAPseudonym,
      reviewer_b_pseudonym: revBPseudonym,
      adjudicator_pseudonym: adjPseudonym,
      consensus_eligibility: 'insufficient',
      blinding_mode: blindingMode,
      is_blinded: blindingMode !== 'open_consensus',
      notes: params.notes,
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO reference_review_assignments (
        assignment_id, dataset_id, subject_type, revision, lifecycle_state,
        reviewer_a_token, reviewer_b_token, adjudicator_token,
        reviewer_a_pseudonym, reviewer_b_pseudonym, adjudicator_pseudonym,
        consensus_eligibility, blinding_mode,
        is_blinded, notes, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      assignment.assignment_id,
      assignment.dataset_id,
      assignment.subject_type,
      assignment.revision,
      assignment.lifecycle_state,
      assignment.reviewer_a_token,
      assignment.reviewer_b_token,
      assignment.adjudicator_token,
      assignment.reviewer_a_pseudonym || null,
      assignment.reviewer_b_pseudonym || null,
      assignment.adjudicator_pseudonym || null,
      assignment.consensus_eligibility || null,
      assignment.blinding_mode,
      assignment.is_blinded ? 1 : 0,
      assignment.notes || null,
      assignment.created_at_utc,
      assignment.updated_at_utc
    );

    this.logLifecycleEvent(
      assignmentId,
      'assignment_created',
      'system',
      undefined,
      { dataset_id: params.dataset_id, subject_type: params.subject_type, blinding_mode: blindingMode }
    );

    return assignment;
  }

  public getAssignment(assignmentId: string): ReferenceReviewAssignment | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_review_assignments WHERE assignment_id = ?').get(assignmentId) as any;
    if (!row) return undefined;
    return this.mapAssignmentRow(row);
  }

  public getPublicAssignment(assignmentId: string): ReferenceReviewAssignment | undefined {
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (!assignment) return undefined;
    return {
      ...assignment,
      reviewer_a_token: '[PROTECTED_CAPABILITY]',
      reviewer_b_token: '[PROTECTED_CAPABILITY]',
      adjudicator_token: '[PROTECTED_CAPABILITY]'
    };
  }

  public listAssignments(datasetId?: string): ReferenceReviewAssignment[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (datasetId) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_review_assignments WHERE dataset_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all(datasetId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_review_assignments ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all();
    }
    return rows.map(r => this.mapAssignmentRow(r));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. Annotations & Blinding Enforcement (QRA-04, QRA-05)
  // =========================================================================

  public saveAnnotations(params: SaveAnnotationsParams): ReferenceAnnotationSet {
    const db = getDb();
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(params.assignment_id);
    if (!assignment) {
      throw new Error(`ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: ${params.assignment_id}`);
    }

    if (['frozen', 'rejected', 'superseded'].includes(assignment.lifecycle_state)) {
      throw new Error(`ASSIGNMENT_TERMINAL_STATE: cannot add annotations in state ${assignment.lifecycle_state}`);
    }

    // Verify reviewer identity against assignment
    if (params.reviewer_role === 'reviewer_a' && assignment.reviewer_a_token !== params.reviewer_token) {
      throw new Error('UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEWER_TOKEN: token does not match reviewer_a');
    }
    if (params.reviewer_role === 'reviewer_b' && assignment.reviewer_b_token !== params.reviewer_token) {
      throw new Error('UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEWER_TOKEN: token does not match reviewer_b');
    }

    // Validate annotation items (monotonicity, bounds, no empty labels)
    for (const item of params.items) {
      if (item.timestamp_start_ms < 0) {
        throw new Error(`INVALID_TIMESTAMP: ${item.timestamp_start_ms}`);
      }
      if (item.timestamp_end_ms !== undefined && item.timestamp_end_ms < item.timestamp_start_ms) {
        throw new Error(`INVALID_INTERVAL: end ${item.timestamp_end_ms} < start ${item.timestamp_start_ms}`);
      }
      if (!item.label || item.label.trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('EMPTY_ANNOTATION_LABEL');
      }
      // Ensure subject type matches
      item.subject_type = assignment.subject_type;
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const itemsJson = JSON.stringify(params.items);
    const contentSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(itemsJson).digest('hex');

    // Check if set already exists
    const existingSetRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_sets
      WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_token = ?
    `).get(params.assignment_id, params.reviewer_token) as any;

    let annotationSet: ReferenceAnnotationSet;

    const pseudonym = params.reviewer_role === 'reviewer_a'
      ? assignment.reviewer_a_pseudonym
      : assignment.reviewer_b_pseudonym;

    if (existingSetRow) {
      const currentRev = Number(existingSetRow.revision);
      if (existingSetRow.lifecycle_state === 'submitted') {
        throw new Error('IMMUTABLE_SUBMITTED_REVISION: submitted annotations cannot be overwritten; create a new superseding revision');
      }

      if (params.expected_revision !== undefined && params.expected_revision !== currentRev) {
        throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: expected revision ${params.expected_revision}, current ${currentRev}`);
      }

      const nextRev = currentRev + 1;
      const targetState = params.submit ? 'submitted' : 'draft';

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE reference_annotation_sets SET
          revision = ?,
          lifecycle_state = ?,
          items_count = ?,
          content_sha256 = ?,
          items_json = ?,
          reviewer_pseudonym = ?,
          submitted_at_utc = ?,
          updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE annotation_set_id = ?
      `).run(
        nextRev,
        targetState,
        params.items.length,
        contentSha256,
        itemsJson,
        pseudonym || null,
        params.submit ? now : null,
        now,
        existingSetRow.annotation_set_id
      );

      annotationSet = {
        annotation_set_id: existingSetRow.annotation_set_id,
        assignment_id: params.assignment_id,
        reviewer_role: params.reviewer_role,
        reviewer_token: params.reviewer_token,
        reviewer_pseudonym: pseudonym,
        revision: nextRev,
        lifecycle_state: targetState,
        items_count: params.items.length,
        content_sha256: contentSha256,
        items: params.items,
        created_at_utc: existingSetRow.created_at_utc,
        updated_at_utc: now,
        submitted_at_utc: params.submit ? now : undefined
      };
    } else {
      const setId = `ann_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
      const targetState = params.submit ? 'submitted' : 'draft';

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO reference_annotation_sets (
          annotation_set_id, assignment_id, reviewer_role, reviewer_token, reviewer_pseudonym, revision,
          lifecycle_state, items_count, content_sha256, items_json, submitted_at_utc,
          created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        setId,
        params.assignment_id,
        params.reviewer_role,
        params.reviewer_token,
        pseudonym || null,
        1,
        targetState,
        params.items.length,
        contentSha256,
        itemsJson,
        params.submit ? now : null,
        now,
        now
      );

      annotationSet = {
        annotation_set_id: setId,
        assignment_id: params.assignment_id,
        reviewer_role: params.reviewer_role,
        reviewer_token: params.reviewer_token,
        reviewer_pseudonym: pseudonym,
        revision: 1,
        lifecycle_state: targetState,
        items_count: params.items.length,
        content_sha256: contentSha256,
        items: params.items,
        created_at_utc: now,
        updated_at_utc: now,
        submitted_at_utc: params.submit ? now : undefined
      };
    }

    // Append-only revision tracking (QRAFIX-02)
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO reference_annotation_revisions (
        revision_id, assignment_id, reviewer_role, reviewer_pseudonym, revision_number,
        items_count, content_sha256, items_json, lifecycle_state, superseded_by_revision,
        created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      `rev_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
      params.assignment_id,
      params.reviewer_role,
      pseudonym || null,
      annotationSet.revision,
      params.items.length,
      contentSha256,
      itemsJson,
      annotationSet.lifecycle_state,
      null,
      now
    );

    // Record lifecycle event
    this.logLifecycleEvent(
      params.assignment_id,
      params.submit ? 'revision_submitted' : 'revision_drafted',
      params.reviewer_role,
      pseudonym,
      {
        revision: annotationSet.revision,
        items_count: params.items.length,
        content_sha256: contentSha256
      }
    );

    // Check if both reviewers have submitted to trigger conflict detection & unblinding
    this.checkSubmissionConvergence(params.assignment_id);

    return annotationSet;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves an annotation set respecting blinding rules.
   * Reviewer A cannot see Reviewer B's set until both have submitted (or if blinding_mode is open_consensus).
   */
  public getAnnotationSet(assignmentId: string, reviewerRole: ReviewerRole, requestingRole: ReviewerRole): ReferenceAnnotationSet | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (!assignment) return undefined;

    // Check blinding rule
    if (assignment.is_blinded && requestingRole !== 'adjudicator' && requestingRole !== reviewerRole) {
      // If assignment is not yet submitted by both, access is denied
      if (assignment.lifecycle_state === 'assigned' || assignment.lifecycle_state === 'in_review') {
        throw new Error('BLINDED_ACCESS_DENIED: peer annotations are hidden until both submissions are complete');
      }
    }

    const row = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_sets
      WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ?
    `).get(assignmentId, reviewerRole) as any;

    if (!row) return undefined;
    return this.mapAnnotationSetRow(row);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. Dual Review Convergence & Conflict Detection (QRA-05, QRAFIX-02, QRAFIX-03)
  // =========================================================================

  private checkSubmissionConvergence(assignmentId: string): void {
    const db = getDb();
    const sets = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_sets
      WHERE assignment_id = ? AND lifecycle_state = 'submitted'
    `).all(assignmentId) as any[];

    if (sets.length === 2) {
      // Both submitted! Transition out of blinding and run conflict detection
      const setA = sets.find(s => s.reviewer_role === 'reviewer_a');
      const setB = sets.find(s => s.reviewer_role === 'reviewer_b');

      if (setA && setB) {
        this.logLifecycleEvent(
          assignmentId,
          'blinding_released',
          'system',
          undefined,
          { assignment_id: assignmentId }
        );

        const conflicts = this.detectConflicts(
          assignmentId,
          JSON.parse(setA.items_json),
          JSON.parse(setB.items_json)
        );

        if (conflicts.length > 0) {
          this.logLifecycleEvent(
            assignmentId,
            'conflict_detected',
            'system',
            undefined,
            { conflicts_count: conflicts.length }
          );
        }

        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const nextState: ReviewLifecycleState = conflicts.length > 0 ? 'conflict_detected' : 'adjudicated';

        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET
            lifecycle_state = ?,
            is_blinded = 0,
            revision = revision + 1,
            updated_at_utc = ?
          WHERE assignment_id = ?
        `).run(nextState, now, assignmentId);

        // Compute agreement summary & initial consensus eligibility
        this.calculateAgreementSummary(assignmentId);
      }
    } else if (sets.length === 1) {
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET
          lifecycle_state = 'in_review',
          updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE assignment_id = ? AND lifecycle_state = 'assigned'
      `).run(now, assignmentId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Technical non-diagnostic conflict detector.
   * Matches beat markers with $\pm 20$ ms tolerance and checks label/confidence agreement.
   * Interval subjects require significant overlap (IoU $\ge 0.7$).
   */
  public detectConflicts(
    assignmentId: string,
    itemsA: ReferenceAnnotationItem[],
    itemsB: ReferenceAnnotationItem[]
  ): ReviewConflictDetail[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const conflicts: ReviewConflictDetail[] = [];
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    const subjectType = assignment?.subject_type || 'paired_ecg_beat';

    // Delete existing conflicts for this assignment
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM reference_conflicts WHERE assignment_id = ?').run(assignmentId);

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const matchedB = new Set<number>();

    const beatTolMs = 20; // 20ms tolerance for ECG beats per Protocol v1.1.0

    for (const itemA of itemsA) {
      let matchedIdx = -1;
      let minDelta = Infinity;
      let bestIoU = -1;

      for (let i = 0; i < itemsB.length; i++) {
        if (matchedB.has(i)) continue;
        const itemB = itemsB[i];

        if (subjectType === 'paired_ecg_beat') {
          const delta = Math.abs(itemA.timestamp_start_ms - itemB.timestamp_start_ms);
          if (delta <= beatTolMs && delta < minDelta) {
            minDelta = delta;
            matchedIdx = i;
          }
        } else {
          // Interval matching using IoU
          const startA = itemA.timestamp_start_ms;
          const endA = itemA.timestamp_end_ms ?? itemA.timestamp_start_ms;
          const startB = itemB.timestamp_start_ms;
          const endB = itemB.timestamp_end_ms ?? itemB.timestamp_start_ms;

          const startMax = Math.max(startA, startB);
          const endMin = Math.min(endA, endB);
          const intersection = Math.max(0, endMin - startMax);
          const union = Math.max(endA, endB) - Math.min(startA, startB);
          const iou = union > 0 ? intersection / union : 0;

          if (iou > bestIoU && iou >= 0.1) {
            bestIoU = iou;
            matchedIdx = i;
          }
        }
      }

      if (matchedIdx !== -1) {
        matchedB.add(matchedIdx);
        const itemB = itemsB[matchedIdx];

        if (subjectType === 'paired_ecg_beat') {
          // Check for label mismatch
          if (itemA.label !== itemB.label) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'label_mismatch',
              delta_ms: minDelta !== Infinity ? minDelta : undefined,
              reason_code: `LABEL_DISAGREEMENT: ${itemA.label} vs ${itemB.label}`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
          // Check for timing offset
          if (minDelta > 10 && minDelta !== Infinity) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'timing_offset',
              delta_ms: minDelta,
              reason_code: `TIMING_OFFSET_EXCEEDS_10MS: ${minDelta}ms`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
          // Check for confidence discrepancy
          if (Math.abs(this.getConfidenceScore(itemA.confidence) - this.getConfidenceScore(itemB.confidence)) > 0.3) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'confidence_discrepancy',
              delta_ms: Math.round(Math.abs(this.getConfidenceScore(itemA.confidence) - this.getConfidenceScore(itemB.confidence)) * 100) / 100,
              reason_code: `CONFIDENCE_DISCREPANCY: ${itemA.confidence} vs ${itemB.confidence}`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Interval subject conflict checks
          if (bestIoU < 0.7) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'interval_overlap_mismatch',
              delta_ms: Math.round(bestIoU * 100) / 100,
              reason_code: `INTERVAL_IOU_BELOW_0.7: IoU is ${bestIoU.toFixed(3)}`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
          if (itemA.label !== itemB.label) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'label_mismatch',
              reason_code: `LABEL_DISAGREEMENT: ${itemA.label} vs ${itemB.label}`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
          if (Math.abs(this.getConfidenceScore(itemA.confidence) - this.getConfidenceScore(itemB.confidence)) > 0.3) {
            conflicts.push({
              conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
              assignment_id: assignmentId,
              subject_type: subjectType,
              item_a: itemA,
              item_b: itemB,
              disagreement_type: 'confidence_discrepancy',
              reason_code: `CONFIDENCE_DISCREPANCY: ${itemA.confidence} vs ${itemB.confidence}`,
              detected_at_utc: now
            });
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Missing in B
        conflicts.push({
          conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
          assignment_id: assignmentId,
          subject_type: subjectType,
          item_a: itemA,
          disagreement_type: 'missing_in_b',
          reason_code: `ITEM_NOT_FOUND_IN_REVIEWER_B: at ${itemA.timestamp_start_ms}ms`,
          detected_at_utc: now
        });
      }
    }

    // Any remaining items in B missing in A
    for (let i = 0; i < itemsB.length; i++) {
      if (!matchedB.has(i)) {
        conflicts.push({
          conflict_id: `conf_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`,
          assignment_id: assignmentId,
          subject_type: subjectType,
          item_b: itemsB[i],
          disagreement_type: 'missing_in_a',
          reason_code: `ITEM_NOT_FOUND_IN_REVIEWER_A: at ${itemsB[i].timestamp_start_ms}ms`,
          detected_at_utc: now
        });
      }
    }

    // Persist conflicts
    for (const c of conflicts) {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO reference_conflicts (
          conflict_id, assignment_id, subject_type, item_a_json, item_b_json,
          disagreement_type, delta_ms, reason_code, detected_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        c.conflict_id,
        c.assignment_id,
        c.subject_type,
        c.item_a ? JSON.stringify(c.item_a) : null,
        c.item_b ? JSON.stringify(c.item_b) : null,
        c.disagreement_type,
        c.delta_ms ?? null,
        c.reason_code,
        c.detected_at_utc
      );
    }

    return conflicts;
  }

  public getConflicts(assignmentId: string): ReviewConflictDetail[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_conflicts WHERE assignment_id = ? ORDER BY detected_at_utc ASC').all(assignmentId) as any[];
    return rows.map(r => ({
      conflict_id: r.conflict_id,
      assignment_id: r.assignment_id,
      subject_type: r.subject_type as ReviewSubjectType,
      item_a: r.item_a_json ? JSON.parse(r.item_a_json) : undefined,
      item_b: r.item_b_json ? JSON.parse(r.item_b_json) : undefined,
      disagreement_type: r.disagreement_type,
      delta_ms: r.delta_ms !== null ? Number(r.delta_ms) : undefined,
      reason_code: r.reason_code,
      detected_at_utc: r.detected_at_utc
    }));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. Adjudication & Consensus Freeze (QRA-05, QRA-06, QRAFIX-02, QRAFIX-03)
  // =========================================================================

  public adjudicateAssignment(params: AdjudicateParams): ReferenceAdjudicationRecord {
    const db = getDb();
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(params.assignment_id);
    if (!assignment) {
      throw new Error(`ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: ${params.assignment_id}`);
    }

    if (assignment.adjudicator_token !== params.adjudicator_token) {
      throw new Error('UNAUTHORIZED_ADJUDICATOR: token does not match assignment adjudicator');
    }

    if (params.expected_revision !== undefined && params.expected_revision !== assignment.revision) {
      throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: expected revision ${params.expected_revision}, current ${assignment.revision}`);
    }

    if (!params.rationale || params.rationale.trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('ADJUDICATION_RATIONALE_REQUIRED');
    }

    const setA = this.getAnnotationSet(params.assignment_id, 'reviewer_a', 'adjudicator');
    const setB = this.getAnnotationSet(params.assignment_id, 'reviewer_b', 'adjudicator');

    if (!setA || !setB) {
      throw new Error('BOTH_REVIEW_SETS_REQUIRED_FOR_ADJUDICATION');
    }

    let finalItems: ReferenceAnnotationItem[] = [];

    switch (params.verdict) {
      case 'accept_reviewer_a':
        finalItems = [...setA.items];
        break;
      case 'accept_reviewer_b':
        finalItems = [...setB.items];
        break;
      case 'consensus_merged':
        if (!params.resolved_items || params.resolved_items.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('CONSENSUS_MERGED_REQUIRES_RESOLVED_ITEMS');
        }
        finalItems = [...params.resolved_items];
        break;
      case 'mark_unresolved_quality_limited':
      case 'reject_subject':
        finalItems = [];
        break;
    }

    const adjudicationId = `adj_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const resolvedItemsJson = JSON.stringify(finalItems);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO reference_adjudications (
        adjudication_id, assignment_id, adjudicator_token, revision, verdict,
        rationale, resolved_items_json, adjudicated_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      adjudicationId,
      params.assignment_id,
      params.adjudicator_token,
      assignment.revision,
      params.verdict,
      params.rationale,
      resolvedItemsJson,
      now
    );

    const nextState: ReviewLifecycleState = params.verdict === 'reject_subject'
      ? 'rejected'
      : 'adjudicated';

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET
        lifecycle_state = ?,
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE assignment_id = ?
    `).run(nextState, now, params.assignment_id);

    this.logLifecycleEvent(
      params.assignment_id,
      'adjudication_submitted',
      'adjudicator',
      assignment.adjudicator_pseudonym,
      {
        verdict: params.verdict,
        rationale: params.rationale,
        resolved_items_count: finalItems.length
      }
    );

    // Recompute agreement summary with new state
    this.calculateAgreementSummary(params.assignment_id);

    return {
      adjudication_id: adjudicationId,
      assignment_id: params.assignment_id,
      adjudicator_token: params.adjudicator_token,
      adjudicator_pseudonym: assignment.adjudicator_pseudonym,
      revision: assignment.revision,
      verdict: params.verdict,
      rationale: params.rationale,
      resolved_items: finalItems,
      adjudicated_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  public freezeConsensusReference(assignmentId: string, adjudicatorToken: string): FrozenConsensusReference {
    const db = getDb();
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (!assignment) {
      throw new Error(`ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: ${assignmentId}`);
    }

    if (assignment.adjudicator_token !== adjudicatorToken) {
      throw new Error('UNAUTHORIZED_ADJUDICATOR: token does not match');
    }

    // Fail-closed consensus eligibility check (QRAFIX-03)
    const summary = this.calculateAgreementSummary(assignmentId);
    if (['unresolved', 'rejected', 'insufficient'].includes(summary.consensus_eligibility)) {
      throw new Error(`CANNOT_FREEZE_INELIGIBLE_REFERENCE: assignment consensus eligibility is '${summary.consensus_eligibility}' (${summary.eligibility_reasons.join(', ')})`);
    }

    if (assignment.lifecycle_state !== 'adjudicated') {
      throw new Error(`CANNOT_FREEZE_UNADJUDICATED: current state is ${assignment.lifecycle_state}`);
    }

    // Get last adjudication or consensus items
    const adjRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM reference_adjudications
      WHERE assignment_id = ? ORDER BY adjudicated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(assignmentId) as any;

    let items: ReferenceAnnotationItem[] = [];
    if (adjRow) {
      items = JSON.parse(adjRow.resolved_items_json);
    } else {
      // In case of 0 conflicts, both sets agreed
      const setA = this.getAnnotationSet(assignmentId, 'reviewer_a', 'adjudicator');
      if (setA) items = setA.items;
    }

    const setARow = db.prepare('SELECT annotation_set_id FROM reference_annotation_sets WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ?').get(assignmentId, 'reviewer_a') as any;
    const setBRow = db.prepare('SELECT annotation_set_id FROM reference_annotation_sets WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ?').get(assignmentId, 'reviewer_b') as any;

    const itemsJson = JSON.stringify(items);
    const referenceSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(itemsJson).digest('hex');
    const referenceId = `ref_froz_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const lineage = {
      reviewer_a_set_id: setARow?.annotation_set_id || '',
      reviewer_b_set_id: setBRow?.annotation_set_id || '',
      adjudication_id: adjRow?.adjudication_id,
      protocol_version: '1.1.0',
      candidate_head: '7b3e0865b303b4861a3171cfefedc109dfeafdf6',
      adjudicator_token: adjudicatorToken,
      adjudicator_pseudonym: assignment.adjudicator_pseudonym
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO frozen_consensus_references (
        reference_id, dataset_id, assignment_id, subject_type, reference_sha256,
        items_count, consensus_items_json, consensus_eligibility, lineage_json, is_superseded, superseded_by,
        frozen_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      referenceId,
      assignment.dataset_id,
      assignment.assignment_id,
      assignment.subject_type,
      referenceSha256,
      items.length,
      itemsJson,
      summary.consensus_eligibility,
      JSON.stringify(lineage),
      0,
      null,
      now
    );

    // Update assignment to frozen
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET
        lifecycle_state = 'frozen',
        revision = revision + 1,
        updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE assignment_id = ?
    `).run(now, assignmentId);

    this.logLifecycleEvent(
      assignmentId,
      'consensus_frozen',
      'adjudicator',
      assignment.adjudicator_pseudonym,
      {
        reference_id: referenceId,
        items_count: items.length,
        reference_sha256: referenceSha256,
        consensus_eligibility: summary.consensus_eligibility
      }
    );

    return {
      reference_id: referenceId,
      dataset_id: assignment.dataset_id,
      assignment_id: assignment.assignment_id,
      subject_type: assignment.subject_type,
      reference_sha256: referenceSha256,
      items_count: items.length,
      consensus_items: items,
      consensus_eligibility: summary.consensus_eligibility,
      lineage,
      is_superseded: false,
      frozen_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  public getFrozenReference(referenceId: string): FrozenConsensusReference | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM frozen_consensus_references WHERE reference_id = ?').get(referenceId) as any;
    if (!row) return undefined;
    return this.mapFrozenRefRow(row);
  }

  public listFrozenReferences(datasetId?: string): FrozenConsensusReference[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (datasetId) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM frozen_consensus_references WHERE dataset_id = ? ORDER BY frozen_at_utc DESC').all(datasetId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM frozen_consensus_references ORDER BY frozen_at_utc DESC').all();
    }
    return rows.map(r => this.mapFrozenRefRow(r));
  }

  /**
   * Supersedes a frozen reference, marking dependent empirical validation runs as stale.
   */
  public supersedeReference(oldReferenceId: string, newReferenceId: string): void {
    const db = getDb();
    const oldRef = this.getFrozenReference(oldReferenceId);
    if (!oldRef) {
      throw new Error(`REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: ${oldReferenceId}`);
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE frozen_consensus_references SET
        is_superseded = 1,
        superseded_by = ?
      WHERE reference_id = ?
    `).run(newReferenceId, oldReferenceId);

    // Invalidate dependent empirical validation runs
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE empirical_validation_runs SET
        maturity_state = 'not_evaluated',
        evidence_debt_recorded = 1,
        debt_description = 'SUPERSEDED_REFERENCE_INVALIDATION: consensus ground truth was superseded by ' || ?
      WHERE frozen_reference_id = ?
    `).run(newReferenceId, oldReferenceId);

    this.logLifecycleEvent(
      oldRef.assignment_id,
      'reference_superseded',
      'system',
      undefined,
      { old_reference_id: oldReferenceId, new_reference_id: newReferenceId }
    );
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 5. Lifecycle Events & Audit Trail
  // =========================================================================

  public logLifecycleEvent(
    assignmentId: string,
    eventType: ReferenceLifecycleEvent['event_type'],
    actorRole: ReviewerRole | 'system',
    actorPseudonym?: string,
    details?: any
  ): ReferenceLifecycleEvent {
    const db = getDb();
    const eventId = `ev_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const detailsJson = JSON.stringify(details || {});

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO reference_lifecycle_events (
        event_id, assignment_id, event_type, actor_role, actor_pseudonym, details_json, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      eventId,
      assignmentId,
      eventType,
      actorRole,
      actorPseudonym || null,
      detailsJson,
      now
    );

    return {
      event_id: eventId,
      assignment_id: assignmentId,
      event_type: eventType,
      actor_role: actorRole,
      actor_pseudonym: actorPseudonym,
      details_json: detailsJson,
      created_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  public getLifecycleEvents(assignmentId: string): ReferenceLifecycleEvent[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_lifecycle_events WHERE assignment_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC').all(assignmentId) as any[];
    return rows.map(r => ({
      event_id: r.event_id,
      assignment_id: r.assignment_id,
      event_type: r.event_type,
      actor_role: r.actor_role,
      actor_pseudonym: r.actor_pseudonym || undefined,
      details_json: r.details_json,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
    }));
  }

  public getRevisions(assignmentId: string, reviewerRole?: ReviewerRole): ReferenceAnnotationRevision[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (reviewerRole) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_revisions WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ? ORDER BY revision_number ASC').all(assignmentId, reviewerRole);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_revisions WHERE assignment_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC').all(assignmentId);
    }
    return rows.map(r => ({
      revision_id: r.revision_id,
      assignment_id: r.assignment_id,
      reviewer_role: r.reviewer_role,
      reviewer_pseudonym: r.reviewer_pseudonym || undefined,
      revision_number: Number(r.revision_number),
      items_count: Number(r.items_count),
      content_sha256: r.content_sha256,
      items: JSON.parse(r.items_json),
      lifecycle_state: r.lifecycle_state,
      superseded_by_revision: r.superseded_by_revision !== null ? Number(r.superseded_by_revision) : undefined,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
    }));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. Technical Agreement Summary & Consensus Eligibility (QRAFIX-03)
  // =========================================================================

  public calculateAgreementSummary(assignmentId: string): ReferenceAgreementSummary {
    const db = getDb();
    const assignment = this.getAssignment(assignmentId);
    if (!assignment) {
      throw new Error(`ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: ${assignmentId}`);
    }

    const setARow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_sets WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ?').get(assignmentId, 'reviewer_a') as any;
    const setBRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reference_annotation_sets WHERE assignment_id = ? AND reviewer_role = ?').get(assignmentId, 'reviewer_b') as any;

    const revA = setARow ? Number(setARow.revision) : 0;
    const revB = setBRow ? Number(setBRow.revision) : 0;
    const itemsA: ReferenceAnnotationItem[] = setARow ? JSON.parse(setARow.items_json) : [];
    const itemsB: ReferenceAnnotationItem[] = setBRow ? JSON.parse(setBRow.items_json) : [];

    const totalA = itemsA.length;
    const totalB = itemsB.length;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (totalA === 0 && totalB === 0) {
      const summary: ReferenceAgreementSummary = {
        assignment_id: assignmentId,
        dataset_id: assignment.dataset_id,
        subject_type: assignment.subject_type,
        reviewer_a_revision: revA,
        reviewer_b_revision: revB,
        total_reviewer_a_items: 0,
        total_reviewer_b_items: 0,
        matched_items_count: 0,
        unmatched_a_count: 0,
        unmatched_b_count: 0,
        match_rate: 0,
        timing_difference_ms: { mean: 0, median: 0, p95: 0, max: 0 },
        label_concordance_rate: 0,
        confidence_discrepancy_count: 0,
        unresolved_conflicts_count: 0,
        consensus_eligibility: 'insufficient',
        eligibility_reasons: ['NO_ANNOTATION_ITEMS_PRESENT'],
        computed_at_utc: now
      };
      db.prepare('UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET consensus_eligibility = ?, updated_at_utc = ? WHERE assignment_id = ?').run('insufficient', now, assignmentId);
      return summary;
    }

    const matchedBIndices = new Set<number>();
    const timingDeltas: number[] = [];
    const ious: number[] = [];
    let matchedCount = 0;
    let labelMatches = 0;
    let confidenceDiscrepancies = 0;

    const isBeat = assignment.subject_type === 'paired_ecg_beat';
    const beatTolMs = 20;

    for (const itemA of itemsA) {
      let bestIdx = -1;
      let bestDelta = Infinity;
      let bestIoU = -1;

      for (let j = 0; j < itemsB.length; j++) {
        if (matchedBIndices.has(j)) continue;
        const itemB = itemsB[j];

        if (isBeat) {
          const delta = Math.abs(itemA.timestamp_start_ms - itemB.timestamp_start_ms);
          if (delta <= beatTolMs && delta < bestDelta) {
            bestDelta = delta;
            bestIdx = j;
          }
        } else {
          const startA = itemA.timestamp_start_ms;
          const endA = itemA.timestamp_end_ms ?? itemA.timestamp_start_ms;
          const startB = itemB.timestamp_start_ms;
          const endB = itemB.timestamp_end_ms ?? itemB.timestamp_start_ms;

          const startMax = Math.max(startA, startB);
          const endMin = Math.min(endA, endB);
          const intersection = Math.max(0, endMin - startMax);
          const union = Math.max(endA, endB) - Math.min(startA, startB);
          const iou = union > 0 ? intersection / union : 0;

          if (iou > bestIoU && iou >= 0.1) {
            bestIoU = iou;
            bestIdx = j;
          }
        }
      }

      if (bestIdx !== -1) {
        matchedBIndices.add(bestIdx);
        matchedCount++;
        const itemB = itemsB[bestIdx];

        if (isBeat) {
          timingDeltas.push(bestDelta);
        } else {
          ious.push(bestIoU);
        }

        if (itemA.label === itemB.label) {
          labelMatches++;
        }

        if (Math.abs(this.getConfidenceScore(itemA.confidence) - this.getConfidenceScore(itemB.confidence)) > 0.3) {
          confidenceDiscrepancies++;
        }
      }
    }

    const unmatchedA = totalA - matchedCount;
    const unmatchedB = totalB - matchedCount;
    const denom = Math.max(totalA, totalB, 1);
    const matchRate = Math.round((matchedCount / denom) * 1000) / 1000;
    const labelConcordanceRate = matchedCount > 0 ? Math.round((labelMatches / matchedCount) * 1000) / 1000 : 0;

    let timingStats = { mean: 0, median: 0, p95: 0, max: 0 };
    if (timingDeltas.length > 0) {
      timingDeltas.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const sum = timingDeltas.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      const mean = Math.round((sum / timingDeltas.length) * 100) / 100;
      const median = timingDeltas[Math.floor(timingDeltas.length / 2)];
      const p95Idx = Math.min(Math.floor(timingDeltas.length * 0.95), timingDeltas.length - 1);
      const p95 = timingDeltas[p95Idx];
      const max = timingDeltas[timingDeltas.length - 1];
      timingStats = { mean, median, p95, max };
    }

    let intervalStats: ReferenceAgreementSummary['interval_overlap_stats'] = undefined;
    if (!isBeat && ious.length > 0) {
      ious.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const sum = ious.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      const mean_iou = Math.round((sum / ious.length) * 1000) / 1000;
      const min_iou = Math.round(ious[0] * 1000) / 1000;
      const below_threshold_count = ious.filter(iou => iou < 0.7).length;
      intervalStats = { mean_iou, min_iou, below_threshold_count };
    }

    const conflicts = this.getConflicts(assignmentId);
    const isAdjudicated = assignment.lifecycle_state === 'adjudicated' || assignment.lifecycle_state === 'frozen';
    const isRejected = assignment.lifecycle_state === 'rejected';
    const unresolvedConflictsCount = isAdjudicated || isRejected ? 0 : conflicts.length;

    const reasons: string[] = [];
    let eligibility: ConsensusEligibilityStatus = 'authoritative';

    if (isRejected) {
      eligibility = 'rejected';
      reasons.push('ASSIGNMENT_EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_BY_ADJUDICATOR');
    } else if (totalA === 0 || totalB === 0) {
      eligibility = 'insufficient';
      reasons.push('INCOMPLETE_OR_EMPTY_REVIEWER_SUBMISSIONS');
    } else if (unresolvedConflictsCount > 0) {
      eligibility = 'unresolved';
      reasons.push(`UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS_COUNT: ${unresolvedConflictsCount}`);
    } else {
      if (matchRate < 0.8) {
        eligibility = 'quality_limited';
        reasons.push(`INTER_REVIEWER_MATCH_RATE_BELOW_0.8: ${(matchRate * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
      }
      if (intervalStats && intervalStats.mean_iou < 0.7) {
        eligibility = 'quality_limited';
        reasons.push(`INTERVAL_MEAN_IOU_BELOW_0.7: ${intervalStats.mean_iou.toFixed(3)}`);
      }
      if (timingStats.p95 > 15 && isBeat) {
        eligibility = 'quality_limited';
        reasons.push(`P95_TIMING_OFFSET_EXCEEDS_15MS: ${timingStats.p95}ms`);
      }
    }

    if (reasons.length === 0) {
      reasons.push('CONCORDANCE_CRITERIA_MET_NO_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS');
    }

    const summary: ReferenceAgreementSummary = {
      assignment_id: assignmentId,
      dataset_id: assignment.dataset_id,
      subject_type: assignment.subject_type,
      reviewer_a_revision: revA,
      reviewer_b_revision: revB,
      total_reviewer_a_items: totalA,
      total_reviewer_b_items: totalB,
      matched_items_count: matchedCount,
      unmatched_a_count: unmatchedA,
      unmatched_b_count: unmatchedB,
      match_rate: matchRate,
      timing_difference_ms: timingStats,
      interval_overlap_stats: intervalStats,
      label_concordance_rate: labelConcordanceRate,
      confidence_discrepancy_count: confidenceDiscrepancies,
      unresolved_conflicts_count: unresolvedConflictsCount,
      consensus_eligibility: eligibility,
      eligibility_reasons: reasons,
      computed_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE reference_review_assignments SET
        consensus_eligibility = ?,
        updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE assignment_id = ?
    `).run(eligibility, now, assignmentId);

    return summary;
  }

  public evaluateConsensusEligibility(assignmentId: string): { status: ConsensusEligibilityStatus; reasons: string[]; summary: ReferenceAgreementSummary } {
    const summary = this.calculateAgreementSummary(assignmentId);
    return {
      status: summary.consensus_eligibility,
      reasons: summary.eligibility_reasons,
      summary
    };
  }

  public getConfidenceScore(confidence: AnnotationConfidence): number {
    switch (confidence) {
      case 'high': return 1.0;
      case 'medium': return 0.7;
      case 'low': return 0.4;
      case 'uncertain': return 0.1;
      default: return 0.5;
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Helper mappers
  // =========================================================================

  private mapAssignmentRow(row: any): ReferenceReviewAssignment {
    return {
      assignment_id: row.assignment_id,
      dataset_id: row.dataset_id,
      subject_type: row.subject_type as ReviewSubjectType,
      revision: Number(row.revision),
      lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as ReviewLifecycleState,
      reviewer_a_token: row.reviewer_a_token,
      reviewer_b_token: row.reviewer_b_token,
      adjudicator_token: row.adjudicator_token,
      reviewer_a_pseudonym: row.reviewer_a_pseudonym || undefined,
      reviewer_b_pseudonym: row.reviewer_b_pseudonym || undefined,
      adjudicator_pseudonym: row.adjudicator_pseudonym || undefined,
      consensus_eligibility: (row.consensus_eligibility as ConsensusEligibilityStatus) || undefined,
      blinding_mode: row.blinding_mode,
      is_blinded: Boolean(row.is_blinded),
      notes: row.notes || undefined,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapAnnotationSetRow(row: any): ReferenceAnnotationSet {
    return {
      annotation_set_id: row.annotation_set_id,
      assignment_id: row.assignment_id,
      reviewer_role: row.reviewer_role as ReviewerRole,
      reviewer_token: row.reviewer_token,
      reviewer_pseudonym: row.reviewer_pseudonym || undefined,
      revision: Number(row.revision),
      lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state,
      items_count: Number(row.items_count),
      content_sha256: row.content_sha256,
      items: JSON.parse(row.items_json),
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc,
      submitted_at_utc: row.submitted_at_utc || undefined
    };
  }

  private mapFrozenRefRow(row: any): FrozenConsensusReference {
    return {
      reference_id: row.reference_id,
      dataset_id: row.dataset_id,
      assignment_id: row.assignment_id,
      subject_type: row.subject_type as ReviewSubjectType,
      reference_sha256: row.reference_sha256,
      items_count: Number(row.items_count),
      consensus_items: JSON.parse(row.consensus_items_json),
      consensus_eligibility: (row.consensus_eligibility as ConsensusEligibilityStatus) || undefined,
      lineage: JSON.parse(row.lineage_json),
      is_superseded: Boolean(row.is_superseded),
      superseded_by: row.superseded_by || undefined,
      frozen_at_utc: row.frozen_at_utc
    };
  }
}

import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { PathSanitizer } from './PathSanitizer';
import {
  LicenseFulfillmentRequest,
  LicenseFulfillmentResponse,
  FulfillmentResponseImportPlan,
  FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan,
  DesktopFileCapabilityReference,
  validatePrivacySanitization,
  computeResponseHash
} from '../../shared/canonical/LicenseFulfillmentContract';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';
import { licenseFulfillmentService } from '../entitlements/licenseFulfillmentService';

export interface CommercialExportCapabilityToken {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  token_id: string;
  capability_ref: string;
  purpose: 'fulfillment_request_destination';
  display_name: string;
  operation: 'write';
  project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab';
  environment: 'production' | 'test';
  workspace_digest: string;
  request_id: string;
  request_hash: string;
  target_dir: string;
  target_filename: string;
  destination_path: string;
  issued_at_utc: string;
  expires_at_utc: string;
  consumed: boolean;
  revoked: boolean;
}

export interface CommercialImportCapabilityToken {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  token_id: string;
  capability_ref: string;
  purpose: 'fulfillment_response_source';
  display_name: string;
  file_path: string;
  file_sha256: string;
  file_size_bytes: number;
  plan: FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan;
  parsed_response: LicenseFulfillmentResponse;
  issued_at_utc: string;
  expires_at_utc: string;
  consumed: boolean;
  revoked: boolean;
}

export class CommercialExchangeFileBroker {
  private static instance: CommercialExchangeFileBroker;
  private exportTokens: Map<string, CommercialExportCapabilityToken> = new Map();
  private importTokens: Map<string, CommercialImportCapabilityToken> = new Map();
  private readonly TOKEN_TTL_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes TTL
  public static readonly MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 64 * 1024; // 64 KB strict budget

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): CommercialExchangeFileBroker {
    if (!CommercialExchangeFileBroker.instance) {
      CommercialExchangeFileBroker.instance = new CommercialExchangeFileBroker();
    }
    return CommercialExchangeFileBroker.instance;
  }

  public clearForTest(): void {
    this.exportTokens.clear();
    this.importTokens.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Helper to mask a full filesystem path for privacy-safe reporting.
   */
  public maskPath(fullPath: string): string {
    const filename = path.basename(fullPath);
    return `.../${filename}`;
  }

  /**
   * Issues a short-lived, purpose-bound capability token for exporting a fulfillment request.
   */
  public issueExportCapability(params: {
    request_id: string;
    request_hash: string;
    target_dir?: string;
    target_filename?: string;
    destination_path?: string;
  }): CommercialExportCapabilityToken {
    if (!params.request_id || !params.request_hash) {
      throw new Error('CAPABILITY_PARAM_INVALID: request_id and request_hash are required');
    }

    let resolvedDir: string;
    let filename: string;

    if (params.destination_path) {
      const resolvedDest = path.resolve(params.destination_path);
      resolvedDir = path.dirname(resolvedDest);
      filename = path.basename(resolvedDest);
    } else if (params.target_dir) {
      resolvedDir = path.resolve(params.target_dir);
      filename = params.target_filename
        ? PathSanitizer.validateSafeFilename(params.target_filename)
        : `cardiolab_fulfillment_request_${params.request_id}.json`;
    } else {
      throw new Error('CAPABILITY_PARAM_INVALID: Either destination_path or target_dir is required');
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedDir) || !fs.statSync(resolvedDir).isDirectory()) {
      throw new Error(`DESTINATION_DIRECTORY_INVALID: Directory does not exist or is not a directory: ${resolvedDir}`);
    }

    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')) {
      throw new Error(`DESTINATION_FILENAME_INVALID: Filename must end with .json: ${filename}`);
    }

    const destinationPath = path.join(resolvedDir, filename);

    // Verify containment (guards against complex trailing traversal edge cases)
    if (!PathSanitizer.isPathContained(destinationPath, resolvedDir)) {
      throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Target file escapes destination directory: ${destinationPath}`);
    }

    const workspaceDigest = licenseFulfillmentService.getPseudonymousWorkspaceDigest();

    const now = new Date();
    const tokenId = `comm_exp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const token: CommercialExportCapabilityToken = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      token_id: tokenId,
      capability_ref: tokenId,
      purpose: 'fulfillment_request_destination',
      display_name: filename,
      operation: 'write',
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: 'production',
      workspace_digest: workspaceDigest,
      request_id: params.request_id,
      request_hash: params.request_hash,
      target_dir: resolvedDir,
      target_filename: filename,
      destination_path: destinationPath,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: new Date(now.getTime() + this.TOKEN_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
      consumed: false,
      revoked: false
    };

    this.exportTokens.set(token.token_id, token);
    return token;
  }

  /**
   * Converts an internal capability token to a sanitized, opaque DesktopFileCapabilityReference
   * that contains zero filesystem paths or private state, safe for desktop boundary crossing.
   */
  public toCapabilityReference(token: CommercialExportCapabilityToken | CommercialImportCapabilityToken): DesktopFileCapabilityReference {
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      capability_ref: token.capability_ref,
      purpose: token.purpose,
      display_name: token.display_name,
      operation: token.purpose === 'fulfillment_request_destination' ? 'write' : 'read',
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: 'production',
      workspace_digest: 'workspace_digest' in token && token.workspace_digest ? token.workspace_digest : licenseFulfillmentService.getPseudonymousWorkspaceDigest(),
      request_id: 'request_id' in token ? token.request_id : token.plan.request_id,
      request_hash: 'request_hash' in token ? token.request_hash : token.plan.request_hash,
      issued_at_utc: token.issued_at_utc,
      expires_at_utc: token.expires_at_utc,
      consumed: token.consumed,
      revoked: token.revoked,
      file_size_bytes: 'file_size_bytes' in token ? token.file_size_bytes : undefined,
      file_sha256: 'file_sha256' in token ? token.file_sha256 : undefined
    };
  }

  /**
   * Issues an export capability and directly returns the sanitized, path-free DesktopFileCapabilityReference.
   */
  public issueExportCapabilityReference(params: {
    request_id: string;
    request_hash: string;
    target_dir?: string;
    target_filename?: string;
    destination_path?: string;
  }): DesktopFileCapabilityReference {
    const token = this.issueExportCapability(params);
    return this.toCapabilityReference(token);
  }

  /**
   * Publishes the request payload to disk atomically using the issued export capability token.
   */
  public publishExport(
    tokenId: string,
    requestPayload: LicenseFulfillmentRequest
  ): { success: boolean; destination_path_masked: string; file_sha256: string; file_size_bytes: number; capability_ref: string } {
    const token = this.exportTokens.get(tokenId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Export capability token "${tokenId}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has expired`);
    }

    if (token.request_id !== requestPayload.request_id || token.request_hash !== requestPayload.request_hash) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REQUEST_MISMATCH: Payload does not match issued export capability token`);
    }

    // Verify privacy sanitization before write
    const privacyCheck = validatePrivacySanitization(requestPayload);
    if (!privacyCheck.is_clean) {
      throw new Error(`PRIVACY_VIOLATION: Request contains privacy violations: ${privacyCheck.violations.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(requestPayload, null, 2);
    const buffer = Buffer.from(serialized, 'utf8');
    const fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

    // Atomic write via temp file
    const tempFile = path.join(token.target_dir, `.${token.target_filename}.${Date.now()}.${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}.tmp`);
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, buffer, { encoding: 'utf8', flag: 'w' });
      fs.renameSync(tempFile, token.destination_path);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(tempFile); } catch (_) {}
      }
      throw new Error(`EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to atomically write export file: ${err.message}`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;

    return {
      success: true,
      capability_ref: token.token_id,
      destination_path_masked: this.maskPath(token.destination_path),
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      file_size_bytes: buffer.byteLength
    };
  }

  /**
   * Preflights and issues a response import capability token from a local filesystem path.
   * Validates file size budget (max 64KB), UTF-8 encoding, non-binary content, JSON schema,
   * cryptographic response hash, request binding in database, and key validity.
   */
  public preflightResponseFile(
    filePath: string,
    verifierOrService?: any
  ): {
    token: CommercialImportCapabilityToken;
    plan: FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan;
    capability_ref: string;
    display_name: string;
  } {
    if (!filePath || typeof filePath !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('FILE_PATH_EMPTY: Response file path cannot be empty');
    }

    const resolved = path.resolve(filePath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolved) || !fs.statSync(resolved).isFile()) {
      throw new Error(`RESPONSE_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Response file does not exist or is not a file: ${filePath}`);
    }

    const stat = fs.statSync(resolved);
    if (stat.size === 0) {
      throw new Error('RESPONSE_FILE_EMPTY: Response file is empty (0 bytes)');
    }

    if (stat.size > CommercialExchangeFileBroker.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
      throw new Error(
        `RESPONSE_SIZE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Response file (${stat.size} bytes) exceeds maximum budget (${CommercialExchangeFileBroker.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES} bytes)`
      );
    }

    const rawBuffer = fs.readFileSync(resolved);

    // Reject binary payload (check for null bytes)
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(rawBuffer.length, 1024); i++) {
      if (rawBuffer[i] === 0) {
        throw new Error('RESPONSE_BINARY_PAYLOAD_REJECTED: Response file contains invalid binary content');
      }
    }

    const rawString = rawBuffer.toString('utf8');
    let parsed: LicenseFulfillmentResponse;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(rawString);
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`RESPONSE_MALFORMED_JSON: File is not valid JSON: ${err.message}`);
    }

    // Basic schema validation
    if (!parsed || parsed.schema_version !== '1.0.0' || !parsed.response_id || !parsed.request_id || !parsed.action) {
      throw new Error('RESPONSE_SCHEMA_INVALID: Missing required response envelope fields');
    }

    const fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawBuffer).digest('hex');
    const computedResponseHash = computeResponseHash(parsed);

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const blockers: string[] = [];

    // Verify response hash integrity
    if (parsed.response_hash && parsed.response_hash !== computedResponseHash) {
      blockers.push(`RESPONSE_HASH_MISMATCH: Stored hash "${parsed.response_hash}" does not match computed hash "${computedResponseHash}"`);
    }

    // Check request binding in local database
    let matchingReq: any = null;
    try {
      const db = getDb();
      matchingReq = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM fulfillment_requests WHERE request_id = ?').get(parsed.request_id) as any;
      if (!matchingReq) {
        blockers.push(`UNBOUND_RESPONSE: Request ID "${parsed.request_id}" was not generated by this workstation`);
      } else if (matchingReq.request_hash !== parsed.request_hash) {
        blockers.push(`REQUEST_HASH_MISMATCH: Request hash in response "${parsed.request_hash}" does not match workstation request "${matchingReq.request_hash}"`);
      } else if (matchingReq.status === 'fulfilled') {
        blockers.push(`REQUEST_ALREADY_FULFILLED: Request "${parsed.request_id}" has already been fulfilled`);
      } else if (matchingReq.status === 'cancelled') {
        blockers.push(`REQUEST_CANCELLED: Request "${parsed.request_id}" was cancelled`);
      }
    } catch {
      // If DB is inaccessible during early unit checks, warn
      warnings.push('Database request binding could not be verified during preflight');
    }

    // Check issuer key validity in active trust store
    try {
      let trustStore;
      if (verifierOrService && typeof verifierOrService.getTrustStore === 'function') {
        trustStore = verifierOrService.getTrustStore();
      } else if (verifierOrService && typeof verifierOrService.getVerifier === 'function') {
        trustStore = verifierOrService.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
      } else {
        trustStore = licenseFulfillmentService.getVerifier().getTrustStore();
      }
      const keyRecord = trustStore.publicKeys[parsed.key_id];
      if (!keyRecord) {
        blockers.push(`UNKNOWN_ISSUER_KEY: Signing key ID "${parsed.key_id}" not found in active trust store`);
      } else if (keyRecord.status === 'revoked') {
        blockers.push(`ISSUER_KEY_REVOKED: Signing key ID "${parsed.key_id}" has been revoked`);
      }
    } catch {
      // Verifier lookup error
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const capabilityRef = `comm_imp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const planId = `plan_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const displayName = path.basename(resolved);
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + this.TOKEN_TTL_MS).toISOString();

    const plan: FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      plan_id: planId,
      capability_ref: capabilityRef,
      response_id: parsed.response_id,
      file_size_bytes: stat.size,
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      response_schema: parsed.schema_version,
      response_hash: parsed.response_hash || computedResponseHash,
      request_id: parsed.request_id,
      request_hash: parsed.request_hash,
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: 'production',
      action: parsed.action,
      predecessor_license_id: parsed.predecessor_license_id || null,
      superseded_license_ids: parsed.superseded_license_ids || [],
      issuer_id: parsed.issuer_id,
      key_id: parsed.key_id,
      trust_bundle_id: parsed.trust_bundle_id,
      expected_revision: matchingReq ? (matchingReq.current_entitlement_revision || 1) : 1,
      valid: blockers.length === 0,
      warnings,
      blockers,
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt
    };

    const token: CommercialImportCapabilityToken = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      token_id: capabilityRef,
      capability_ref: capabilityRef,
      purpose: 'fulfillment_response_source',
      display_name: displayName,
      file_path: resolved,
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      file_size_bytes: stat.size,
      plan,
      parsed_response: parsed,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt,
      consumed: false,
      revoked: false
    };

    this.importTokens.set(token.token_id, token);

    return {
      token,
      plan,
      capability_ref: capabilityRef,
      display_name: displayName
    };
  }

  /**
   * Consumes an import capability token and returns the authenticated response payload.
   * Re-reads exact bytes from disk immediately before consumption to detect tampering.
   */
  public consumeImport(tokenId: string): LicenseFulfillmentResponse {
    const token = this.importTokens.get(tokenId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Import capability token "${tokenId}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has expired`);
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(token.file_path)) {
      throw new Error(`RESPONSE_FILE_NOT_FOUND: File on disk was removed before consumption: ${token.file_path}`);
    }

    // TOCTOU defense: re-read exact bytes and verify SHA-256 against preflight
    const currentBytes = fs.readFileSync(token.file_path);
    const currentSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(currentBytes).digest('hex');
    if (currentSha256 !== token.file_sha256) {
      throw new Error(
        `FILE_MUTATED_AFTER_PREFLIGHT: Response file was modified on disk after preflight inspection (preflight SHA-256: ${token.file_sha256}, current: ${currentSha256})`
      );
    }

    let parsed: LicenseFulfillmentResponse;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(currentBytes.toString('utf8'));
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`RESPONSE_MALFORMED_JSON: Re-read file failed JSON parse: ${err.message}`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;
    return parsed;
  }

  /**
   * Revokes an export or import capability token immediately.
   */
  public revokeCapability(capabilityRef: string, reason?: string): boolean {
    const expToken = this.exportTokens.get(capabilityRef);
    if (expToken) {
      expToken.revoked = true;
      return true;
    }
    const impToken = this.importTokens.get(capabilityRef);
    if (impToken) {
      impToken.revoked = true;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * High-level entry point: re-reads exact file bytes, verifies tamper protection,
   * enforces preflight blockers, and executes importAndApplyResponse atomically.
   */
  public consumeAndExecuteImport(
    capabilityToken: string,
    optionsOrService?: { idempotency_key?: string; fulfillmentService?: any } | any
  ): {
    success: boolean;
    status: 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'needs_information' | 'invalid_response';
    message: string;
    operator_message?: string | null;
    receipt?: any;
  } {
    const token = this.importTokens.get(capabilityToken);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Import capability token "${capabilityToken}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Import capability token "${capabilityToken}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Import capability token "${capabilityToken}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Import capability token "${capabilityToken}" has expired`);
    }

    // Fail closed if preflight identified blockers
    if (token.plan.blockers && token.plan.blockers.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED: Response import blocked by preflight checks: ${token.plan.blockers.join('; ')}`);
    }

    // Consume and authenticate with byte verification
    const responsePayload = this.consumeImport(capabilityToken);

    // Apply through license fulfillment service
    const svc = (optionsOrService && typeof optionsOrService.importAndApplyResponse === 'function')
      ? optionsOrService
      : (optionsOrService?.fulfillmentService || licenseFulfillmentService);
    const idempotencyKey = (optionsOrService && typeof optionsOrService.importAndApplyResponse !== 'function')
      ? optionsOrService.idempotency_key
      : undefined;

    const result = svc.importAndApplyResponse(responsePayload, {
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      expected_revision: token.plan.expected_revision
    });

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the most recent active unconsumed preflight plan if any, or null.
   */
  public getPendingPreflight(): {
    plan_id: string;
    capability_ref: string;
    response_hash: string;
    action: any;
    status: string;
    expires_at_utc: string;
  } | null {
    const now = new Date();
    for (const token of this.importTokens.values()) {
      if (!token.consumed && !token.revoked && new Date(token.expires_at_utc) > now) {
        return {
          plan_id: token.plan.plan_id,
          capability_ref: token.capability_ref,
          response_hash: token.plan.response_hash,
          action: token.plan.action,
          status: token.plan.valid ? 'valid' : 'blocked',
          expires_at_utc: token.expires_at_utc
        };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

export const commercialExchangeFileBroker = CommercialExchangeFileBroker.getInstance();
