import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export const WINDOWS_RESERVED_NAMES = new Set([
  'CON', 'PRN', 'AUX', 'NUL',
  'COM1', 'COM2', 'COM3', 'COM4', 'COM5', 'COM6', 'COM7', 'COM8', 'COM9',
  'LPT1', 'LPT2', 'LPT3', 'LPT4', 'LPT5', 'LPT6', 'LPT7', 'LPT8', 'LPT9'
]);

export interface ArchiveLimits {
  maxEntries?: number;
  maxTotalBytes?: number;
  maxRatio?: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_LIMITS: Required<ArchiveLimits> = {
  maxEntries: 1000,
  maxTotalBytes: 500 * 1024 * 1024, // 500 MB
  maxRatio: 100 // 100:1 ratio
};

export class PathSanitizer {
  /**
   * Checks whether targetPath is strictly inside allowedBaseDir.
   * Handles Windows case-insensitivity, realpath normalization, and directory traversal.
   */
  public static isPathContained(targetPath: string, allowedBaseDir: string): boolean {
    if (!targetPath || !allowedBaseDir) return false;

    try {
      const resolvedBase = path.resolve(allowedBaseDir);
      const resolvedTarget = path.resolve(targetPath);

      // Normalize for Windows / case-insensitive comparison
      const isWindows = process.platform === 'win32' || /^[a-zA-Z]:[/\\]/.test(resolvedBase);
      const normBase = isWindows ? resolvedBase.toLowerCase() : resolvedBase;
      const normTarget = isWindows ? resolvedTarget.toLowerCase() : resolvedTarget;

      const rel = path.relative(normBase, normTarget);

      // If relative path starts with '..' or is absolute, it is outside
      if (rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) {
        return false;
      }

      // Check realpath if both exist to guard against symlink / junction escapes
      if (fs.existsSync(resolvedBase) && fs.existsSync(resolvedTarget)) {
        const realBase = fs.realpathSync(resolvedBase);
        const realTarget = fs.realpathSync(resolvedTarget);
        const normRealBase = isWindows ? realBase.toLowerCase() : realBase;
        const normRealTarget = isWindows ? realTarget.toLowerCase() : realTarget;
        const realRel = path.relative(normRealBase, normRealTarget);
        if (realRel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(realRel)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Asserts that targetPath is strictly inside allowedBaseDir and returns the canonical path.
   * Throws Error if not contained.
   */
  public static sanitizePath(targetPath: string, allowedBaseDir: string): string {
    if (!this.isPathContained(targetPath, allowedBaseDir)) {
      throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Target path is outside the allowed directory boundary: ${targetPath}`);
    }
    return path.resolve(targetPath);
  }

  /**
   * Validates a safe individual filename (e.g. for exports or uploads).
   * Rejects slashes, traversal sequences, Windows device names, and alternate data streams.
   */
  public static validateSafeFilename(filename: string): string {
    if (!filename || typeof filename !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('FILENAME_EMPTY: Filename cannot be empty');
    }

    const trimmed = filename.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      throw new Error('FILENAME_EMPTY: Filename cannot be whitespace only');
    }

    // Reject null bytes or control characters
    if (/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/.test(trimmed)) {
      throw new Error(`FILENAME_INVALID_CONTROL_CHARS: Filename contains invalid control characters: ${trimmed}`);
    }

    // Reject slashes or path separators
    if (trimmed.includes('/') || trimmed.includes('\\')) {
      throw new Error(`FILENAME_PATH_SEPARATOR_FORBIDDEN: Filename must not contain path separators: ${trimmed}`);
    }

    // Reject traversal
    if (trimmed === '.' || trimmed === '..' || trimmed.includes('..')) {
      throw new Error(`FILENAME_TRAVERSAL_FORBIDDEN: Filename must not contain traversal elements: ${trimmed}`);
    }

    // Reject Alternate Data Streams (colon)
    if (trimmed.includes(':')) {
      throw new Error(`FILENAME_ADS_FORBIDDEN: Filename must not contain alternate data stream syntax: ${trimmed}`);
    }

    // Check Windows reserved names
    const baseNameWithoutExt = trimmed.split('.')[0].toUpperCase();
    if (WINDOWS_RESERVED_NAMES.has(baseNameWithoutExt)) {
      throw new Error(`FILENAME_RESERVED_DEVICE_NAME: Filename uses reserved Windows device name: ${trimmed}`);
    }

    return trimmed;
  }

  /**
   * Validates an archive member entry name against Zip Slip, absolute paths, and reserved names.
   */
  public static validateZipEntryName(entryName: string): string {
    if (!entryName || typeof entryName !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('ZIP_ENTRY_EMPTY: Archive entry name cannot be empty');
    }

    const normalized = entryName.replace(/\\/g, '/');

    // Reject absolute paths
    if (normalized.startsWith('/') || /^[a-zA-Z]:/i.test(normalized)) {
      throw new Error(`ZIP_SLIP_DETECTED: Absolute entry path is forbidden: ${entryName}`);
    }

    // Check path segments for traversal
    const segments = normalized.split('/');
    for (const seg of segments) {
      if (seg === '..' || seg === '.') {
        throw new Error(`ZIP_SLIP_DETECTED: Relative traversal "${seg}" is forbidden: ${entryName}`);
      }
      const baseUpper = seg.split('.')[0].toUpperCase();
      if (WINDOWS_RESERVED_NAMES.has(baseUpper)) {
        throw new Error(`ZIP_RESERVED_DEVICE_NAME: Entry segment uses reserved Windows device name: ${seg}`);
      }
      if (seg.includes(':')) {
        throw new Error(`ZIP_ADS_FORBIDDEN: Entry segment contains alternate data stream syntax: ${seg}`);
      }
    }

    return normalized;
  }

  /**
   * Validates archive limits against decompression bombs and resource exhaustion.
   */
  public static validateArchiveLimits(
    entries: Array<{ entryName: string; size: number; compressedSize?: number }>,
    limits: ArchiveLimits = DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_LIMITS
  ): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
    const maxEntries = limits.maxEntries ?? DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_LIMITS.maxEntries;
    const maxTotalBytes = limits.maxTotalBytes ?? DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_LIMITS.maxTotalBytes;
    const maxRatio = limits.maxRatio ?? DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_LIMITS.maxRatio;

    if (entries.length > maxEntries) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: `ARCHIVE_BOMB_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Entry count (${entries.length}) exceeds maximum limit (${maxEntries})`
      };
    }

    let totalUncompressed = 0;

    for (const entry of entries) {
      // Validate each entry name
      try {
        PathSanitizer.validateZipEntryName(entry.entryName);
      } catch (err: any) {
        return { valid: false, error: err.message };
      }

      totalUncompressed += entry.size;

      if (totalUncompressed > maxTotalBytes) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          error: `ARCHIVE_BOMB_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Total uncompressed size (${totalUncompressed} bytes) exceeds limit (${maxTotalBytes} bytes)`
        };
      }

      if (entry.compressedSize && entry.compressedSize > 0) {
        const ratio = entry.size / entry.compressedSize;
        if (ratio > maxRatio && entry.size > 1024 * 1024) { // Only enforce ratio if uncompressed > 1MB
          return {
            valid: false,
            error: `ARCHIVE_BOMB_RATIO_EXCEEDED: Member "${entry.entryName}" compression ratio (${Math.round(ratio)}:1) exceeds limit (${maxRatio}:1)`
          };
        }
      }
    }

    return { valid: true };
  }
}

export interface PathCapabilityToken {
  capability_id: string;
  allowed_base_dir: string;
  allowed_files: { channel: string; relative_path: string; sha256?: string }[];
  operation: 'study_preflight' | 'study_admission' | 'empirical_intake';
  session_id: string;
  session_revision: number;
  issued_at_utc: string;
  expires_at_utc: string;
  consumed: boolean;
}

export class StudyPathCapabilityService {
  private static instance: StudyPathCapabilityService;
  private capabilities: Map<string, PathCapabilityToken> = new Map();
  private readonly TOKEN_TTL_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes TTL

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): StudyPathCapabilityService {
    if (!StudyPathCapabilityService.instance) {
      StudyPathCapabilityService.instance = new StudyPathCapabilityService();
    }
    return StudyPathCapabilityService.instance;
  }

  public clearForTest(): void {
    this.capabilities.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Issues a short-lived, single-use capability token bound to verified directory and session revision.
   */
  public issueCapability(params: {
    allowed_base_dir: string;
    allowed_files: { channel: string; relative_path: string; sha256?: string }[];
    operation: 'study_preflight' | 'study_admission' | 'empirical_intake';
    session_id: string;
    session_revision: number;
  }): PathCapabilityToken {
    const resolvedBase = path.resolve(params.allowed_base_dir);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedBase) || !fs.statSync(resolvedBase).isDirectory()) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_BASE_DIR: Directory does not exist or is not a directory: ${params.allowed_base_dir}`);
    }

    // Verify all file paths are contained
    for (const f of params.allowed_files) {
      const fullPath = path.resolve(resolvedBase, f.relative_path);
      if (!PathSanitizer.isPathContained(fullPath, resolvedBase)) {
        throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_IN_CAPABILITY: File path escapes base directory: ${f.relative_path}`);
      }
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const token: PathCapabilityToken = {
      capability_id: `CAP-${crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      allowed_base_dir: resolvedBase,
      allowed_files: params.allowed_files,
      operation: params.operation,
      session_id: params.session_id,
      session_revision: params.session_revision,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: new Date(now.getTime() + this.TOKEN_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
      consumed: false
    };

    this.capabilities.set(token.capability_id, token);
    return token;
  }

  /**
   * Verifies and consumes a capability token, enforcing expiration, single-use, operation, and session revision.
   */
  public verifyAndConsume(
    capabilityId: string,
    operation: 'study_preflight' | 'study_admission' | 'empirical_intake',
    sessionId: string,
    sessionRevision: number
  ): PathCapabilityToken {
    const token = this.capabilities.get(capabilityId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Capability token ${capabilityId} is invalid or has not been issued.`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Capability token ${capabilityId} has already been used.`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Capability token ${capabilityId} has expired.`);
    }

    if (token.operation !== operation) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_OPERATION_MISMATCH: Token was issued for ${token.operation}, but requested for ${operation}.`);
    }

    if (token.session_id !== sessionId) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_SESSION_MISMATCH: Token was issued for session ${token.session_id}, but requested for ${sessionId}.`);
    }

    if (token.session_revision !== sessionRevision) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVISION_DRIFT: Token was issued for session revision ${token.session_revision}, but current revision is ${sessionRevision}.`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;
    return token;
  }
}

================================================================================

export class PilotFileCapabilityBroker {
  private static instance: PilotFileCapabilityBroker;
  private exportTokens: Map<string, PilotExportCapabilityToken> = new Map();
  private importTokens: Map<string, PilotImportCapabilityToken> = new Map();
  private readonly TOKEN_TTL_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes TTL

  public static readonly MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 256 * 1024; // 256 KB budget
  public static readonly MAX_BATCH_BYTES = 512 * 1024; // 512 KB budget
  public static readonly MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 512 * 1024; // 512 KB budget

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): PilotFileCapabilityBroker {
    if (!PilotFileCapabilityBroker.instance) {
      PilotFileCapabilityBroker.instance = new PilotFileCapabilityBroker();
    }
    return PilotFileCapabilityBroker.instance;
  }

  public clearForTest(): void {
    this.exportTokens.clear();
    this.importTokens.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Helper to mask a full filesystem path for privacy-safe reporting.
   */
  public maskPath(fullPath: string): string {
    const filename = path.basename(fullPath);
    return `.../${filename}`;
  }

  /**
   * Issues a short-lived capability token for exporting an issuance request.
   */
  public issueRequestExportCapability(params: {
    campaign_id: string;
    request_id: string;
    request_hash: string;
    target_dir?: string;
    target_filename?: string;
    destination_path?: string;
  }): PilotExportCapabilityToken {
    if (!params.campaign_id || !params.request_id || !params.request_hash) {
      throw new Error('CAPABILITY_PARAM_INVALID: campaign_id, request_id, and request_hash are required');
    }

    let resolvedDir: string;
    let filename: string;

    if (params.destination_path) {
      const resolvedDest = path.resolve(params.destination_path);
      resolvedDir = path.dirname(resolvedDest);
      filename = path.basename(resolvedDest);
    } else if (params.target_dir) {
      resolvedDir = path.resolve(params.target_dir);
      filename = params.target_filename
        ? PathSanitizer.validateSafeFilename(params.target_filename)
        : `pilot_issuance_request_${params.request_id}.json`;
    } else {
      throw new Error('CAPABILITY_PARAM_INVALID: Either destination_path or target_dir is required');
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedDir) || !fs.statSync(resolvedDir).isDirectory()) {
      throw new Error(`DESTINATION_DIRECTORY_INVALID: Directory does not exist or is not a directory: ${resolvedDir}`);
    }

    if (!filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')) {
      throw new Error(`DESTINATION_FILENAME_INVALID: Filename must end with .json: ${filename}`);
    }

    const destinationPath = path.join(resolvedDir, filename);

    if (!PathSanitizer.isPathContained(destinationPath, resolvedDir)) {
      throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Target file escapes destination directory: ${destinationPath}`);
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const tokenId = `pilot_exp_req_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const token: PilotExportCapabilityToken = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      token_id: tokenId,
      capability_ref: tokenId,
      purpose: 'pilot_issuance_request_destination',
      display_name: filename,
      operation: 'write',
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: 'production',
      campaign_id: params.campaign_id,
      request_id: params.request_id,
      request_hash: params.request_hash,
      target_dir: resolvedDir,
      target_filename: filename,
      destination_path: destinationPath,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: new Date(now.getTime() + this.TOKEN_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
      consumed: false,
      revoked: false
    };

    this.exportTokens.set(token.token_id, token);
    return token;
  }

  /**

  public issueDeliveryArtifactExportCapability(params: {

  /**
   * Publishes an issuance request payload to disk atomically using the export capability token.
   */
  public publishRequestExport(
    tokenId: string,
    requestPayload: PilotInviteIssuanceRequest
  ): {
    success: boolean;
    destination_path_masked: string;
    file_sha256: string;
    file_size_bytes: number;
    capability_ref: string;
  } {
    const token = this.exportTokens.get(tokenId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Export capability token "${tokenId}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has expired`);
    }

    if (token.purpose !== 'pilot_issuance_request_destination') {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_PURPOSE_MISMATCH: Token was not issued for request export`);
    }

    if (token.request_id !== requestPayload.request_id || token.request_hash !== requestPayload.request_hash) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REQUEST_MISMATCH: Payload does not match issued export capability token`);
    }

    // Verify privacy sanitization before write
    const privacyCheck = validatePilotPrivacySanitization(requestPayload);
    if (!privacyCheck.is_clean) {
      throw new Error(`PRIVACY_VIOLATION: Request contains privacy violations: ${privacyCheck.violations.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(requestPayload, null, 2);
    const buffer = Buffer.from(serialized, 'utf8');

    if (buffer.byteLength > PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
      throw new Error(
        `REQUEST_SIZE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Request payload (${buffer.byteLength} bytes) exceeds limit (${PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_REQUEST_BYTES} bytes)`
      );
    }

    const fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

    // Atomic write via temp file
    const tempFile = path.join(
      token.target_dir,
      `.${token.target_filename}.${Date.now()}.${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}.tmp`
    );
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, buffer, { encoding: 'utf8', flag: 'w' });
      fs.renameSync(tempFile, token.destination_path);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(tempFile);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      throw new Error(`EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to atomically write export file: ${err.message}`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;

    return {
      success: true,
      capability_ref: token.token_id,
      destination_path_masked: this.maskPath(token.destination_path),
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      file_size_bytes: buffer.byteLength
    };
  }

  /**
   * Publishes a delivery artifact to disk atomically using the export capability token.
   */
  public publishDeliveryArtifactExport(
    tokenId: string,
    artifactPayload: PilotInviteDeliveryArtifact
  ): {
    success: boolean;
    destination_path_masked: string;
    file_sha256: string;
    file_size_bytes: number;
    capability_ref: string;
  } {
    const token = this.exportTokens.get(tokenId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Export capability token "${tokenId}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Export capability token "${tokenId}" has expired`);
    }

    if (token.purpose !== 'pilot_delivery_artifact_destination') {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_PURPOSE_MISMATCH: Token was not issued for delivery artifact export`);
    }

    if (token.artifact_id !== artifactPayload.artifact_id) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH: Payload does not match issued export capability token`);
    }

    // Verify privacy sanitization (manifest and structure must not leak local paths or physiological series)
    const privacyCheck = validatePilotPrivacySanitization({
      artifact_id: artifactPayload.artifact_id,
      campaign_id: artifactPayload.campaign_id,
      batch_id: artifactPayload.batch_id,
      manifest: artifactPayload.manifest
    });
    if (!privacyCheck.is_clean) {
      throw new Error(`PRIVACY_VIOLATION: Artifact contains privacy violations: ${privacyCheck.violations.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(artifactPayload, null, 2);
    const buffer = Buffer.from(serialized, 'utf8');

    if (buffer.byteLength > PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES) {
      throw new Error(
        `ARTIFACT_SIZE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Artifact payload (${buffer.byteLength} bytes) exceeds limit (${PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES} bytes)`
      );
    }

    const fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');

    // Atomic write via temp file
    const tempFile = path.join(
      token.target_dir,
      `.${token.target_filename}.${Date.now()}.${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}.tmp`
    );
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, buffer, { encoding: 'utf8', flag: 'w' });
      fs.renameSync(tempFile, token.destination_path);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(tempFile);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      throw new Error(`EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to atomically write delivery artifact file: ${err.message}`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;

    return {
      success: true,
      capability_ref: token.token_id,
      destination_path_masked: this.maskPath(token.destination_path),
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      file_size_bytes: buffer.byteLength
    };
  }

  /**
   * Preflights an externally signed batch file and issues an import capability token.
   */
  public preflightSignedBatchFile(
    filePath: string,
    options?: { verifier?: any; expectedCampaignId?: string }
  ): {
    token: PilotImportCapabilityToken;
    plan: PilotInviteBatchImportPlan;
    capability_ref: string;
    display_name: string;
  } {
    if (!filePath || typeof filePath !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('FILE_PATH_EMPTY: Batch file path cannot be empty');
    }

    const resolved = path.resolve(filePath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolved) || !fs.statSync(resolved).isFile()) {
      throw new Error(`BATCH_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Batch file does not exist or is not a file: ${filePath}`);
    }

    const stat = fs.statSync(resolved);
    if (stat.size === 0) {
      throw new Error('BATCH_FILE_EMPTY: Batch file is empty (0 bytes)');
    }

    if (stat.size > PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_BATCH_BYTES) {
      throw new Error(
        `BATCH_SIZE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Batch file (${stat.size} bytes) exceeds maximum budget (${PilotFileCapabilityBroker.MAX_BATCH_BYTES} bytes)`
      );
    }

    const rawBuffer = fs.readFileSync(resolved);

    // Reject binary payload (null byte check)
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(rawBuffer.length, 1024); i++) {
      if (rawBuffer[i] === 0) {
        throw new Error('BATCH_BINARY_PAYLOAD_REJECTED: Batch file contains invalid binary content');
      }
    }

    const rawString = rawBuffer.toString('utf8');
    let parsed: PilotInviteBatchResponse;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(rawString);
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`BATCH_MALFORMED_JSON: File is not valid JSON: ${err.message}`);
    }

    // Envelope schema check
    if (
      !parsed ||
      parsed.schema_version !== '1.0.0' ||
      !parsed.batch_id ||
      !parsed.request_id ||
      !parsed.request_hash ||
      !parsed.campaign_id ||
      !Array.isArray(parsed.envelopes)
    ) {
      throw new Error('BATCH_SCHEMA_INVALID: Missing required batch envelope fields');
    }

    const fileSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawBuffer).digest('hex');
    const computedBatchHash = computeBatchResponseHash(parsed);

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const blockers: string[] = [];

    // Verify batch hash integrity
    if (parsed.batch_hash && parsed.batch_hash !== computedBatchHash) {
      blockers.push(`BATCH_HASH_MISMATCH: Stored hash "${parsed.batch_hash}" does not match computed hash "${computedBatchHash}"`);
    }

    // Check request binding in local database
    let matchingReq: any = null;
    let matchingCampaign: any = null;
    try {
      matchingReq = getPilotIssuanceRequest(parsed.request_id);
      if (!matchingReq) {
        blockers.push(`UNBOUND_REQUEST: Request ID "${parsed.request_id}" was not generated by this workstation`);
      } else {
        if (matchingReq.request_hash !== parsed.request_hash) {
          blockers.push(`REQUEST_HASH_MISMATCH: Request hash in batch "${parsed.request_hash}" does not match workstation request "${matchingReq.request_hash}"`);
        }
        if (matchingReq.campaign_id !== parsed.campaign_id) {
          blockers.push(`CAMPAIGN_MISMATCH: Batch campaign "${parsed.campaign_id}" does not match request campaign "${matchingReq.campaign_id}"`);
        }
        if (matchingReq.status === 'fulfilled') {
          blockers.push(`REQUEST_ALREADY_FULFILLED: Request "${parsed.request_id}" has already been fulfilled`);
        } else if (matchingReq.status === 'cancelled') {
          blockers.push(`REQUEST_CANCELLED: Request "${parsed.request_id}" was cancelled`);
        }

        matchingCampaign = getPilotCampaign(matchingReq.campaign_id);
        if (!matchingCampaign) {
          blockers.push(`CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND: Campaign "${matchingReq.campaign_id}" does not exist in local database`);
        } else if (matchingCampaign.state === 'closed' || matchingCampaign.state === 'archived') {
          blockers.push(`CAMPAIGN_TERMINATED: Campaign is ${matchingCampaign.state}`);
        }
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      warnings.push(`Database lookup error during preflight: ${e.message}`);
    }

    // Verify envelopes consistency
    let isRehearsal = false;
    const participantClassPolicy = matchingReq?.participant_class_policy || 'qualified_external';

    if (parsed.envelopes.length === 0) {
      blockers.push('BATCH_EMPTY: Batch contains zero envelopes');
    }

    if (matchingReq && parsed.envelopes.length > matchingReq.max_invites) {
      blockers.push(`ENVELOPE_COUNT_EXCEEDED: Batch contains ${parsed.envelopes.length} envelopes, exceeding request max ${matchingReq.max_invites}`);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < parsed.envelopes.length; i++) {
      const env = parsed.envelopes[i];
      if (!env.envelope_id || !env.signature || !env.nonce) {
        blockers.push(`ENVELOPE_MALFORMED: Envelope at index ${i} is missing required fields`);
        break;
      }
      if (env.cohort_id !== parsed.campaign_id && matchingReq && env.cohort_id !== matchingReq.cohort_id) {
        blockers.push(`COHORT_POLICY_MISMATCH: Envelope ${env.envelope_id} cohort "${env.cohort_id}" does not match policy`);
      }
      if (matchingReq && env.consent_policy_version !== matchingReq.consent_policy_version) {
        blockers.push(`CONSENT_POLICY_MISMATCH: Envelope ${env.envelope_id} consent version "${env.consent_policy_version}" does not match request "${matchingReq.consent_policy_version}"`);
      }
      if (env.participant_class_policy === 'internal_rehearsal' || env.trust_bundle_id === 'rehearsal_trust_bundle' || env.environment === 'rehearsal') {
        isRehearsal = true;
      }
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const capabilityRef = `pilot_imp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const planId = `plan_pilot_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const displayName = path.basename(resolved);
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + this.TOKEN_TTL_MS).toISOString();

    const plan: PilotInviteBatchImportPlan = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      plan_id: planId,
      capability_token: capabilityRef,
      batch_id: parsed.batch_id,
      request_id: parsed.request_id,
      request_hash: parsed.request_hash,
      campaign_id: parsed.campaign_id,
      campaign_revision: matchingCampaign ? matchingCampaign.revision : parsed.campaign_revision,
      issuer_id: parsed.issuer_id,
      key_id: parsed.key_id,
      trust_bundle_id: parsed.trust_bundle_id,
      file_size_bytes: stat.size,
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      envelopes_count: parsed.envelopes.length,
      participant_class_policy: participantClassPolicy,
      is_rehearsal: isRehearsal,
      expected_inventory_delta: parsed.envelopes.length,
      valid: blockers.length === 0,
      warnings,
      blockers,
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt
    };

    const token: PilotImportCapabilityToken = {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      token_id: capabilityRef,
      capability_ref: capabilityRef,
      purpose: 'pilot_signed_batch_source',
      display_name: displayName,
      operation: 'read',
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: isRehearsal ? 'rehearsal' : 'production',
      campaign_id: parsed.campaign_id,
      file_path: resolved,
      file_sha256: fileSha256,
      file_size_bytes: stat.size,
      plan,
      parsed_batch: parsed,
      issued_at_utc: now.toISOString(),
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt,
      consumed: false,
      revoked: false
    };

    this.importTokens.set(token.token_id, token);

    return {
      token,
      plan,
      capability_ref: capabilityRef,
      display_name: displayName
    };
  }

  /**
   * Consumes an import capability token, validating exact bytes and SHA-256 against preflight (TOCTOU defense).
   */
  public consumeImport(tokenId: string): PilotInviteBatchResponse {
    const token = this.importTokens.get(tokenId);
    if (!token) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND: Import capability token "${tokenId}" is invalid or expired`);
    }

    if (token.consumed) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has already been used`);
    }

    if (token.revoked) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has been revoked`);
    }

    if (new Date() > new Date(token.expires_at_utc)) {
      throw new Error(`CAPABILITY_EXPIRED: Import capability token "${tokenId}" has expired`);
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(token.file_path)) {
      throw new Error(`BATCH_FILE_NOT_FOUND: File on disk was removed before consumption: ${token.file_path}`);
    }

    // TOCTOU defense: re-read exact bytes and verify SHA-256 against preflight
    const currentBytes = fs.readFileSync(token.file_path);
    const currentSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(currentBytes).digest('hex');
    if (currentSha256 !== token.file_sha256) {
      throw new Error(
        `FILE_MUTATED_AFTER_PREFLIGHT: Batch file was modified on disk after preflight inspection (preflight SHA-256: ${token.file_sha256}, current: ${currentSha256})`
      );
    }

    let parsed: PilotInviteBatchResponse;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(currentBytes.toString('utf8'));
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`BATCH_MALFORMED_JSON: Re-read file failed JSON parse: ${err.message}`);
    }

    token.consumed = true;
    return parsed;
  }

  /**
   * Revokes an export or import capability token immediately.
   */
  public revokeCapability(capabilityRef: string): boolean {
    const expToken = this.exportTokens.get(capabilityRef);
    if (expToken) {
      expToken.revoked = true;
      return true;
    }
    const impToken = this.importTokens.get(capabilityRef);
    if (impToken) {
      impToken.revoked = true;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Converts a capability token to a sanitized, path-free reference for presentation.
   */
  public toCapabilityReference(
    token: PilotExportCapabilityToken | PilotImportCapabilityToken
  ): PilotCapabilityReference {
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      capability_ref: token.capability_ref,
      purpose: token.purpose,
      display_name: token.display_name,
      operation: token.operation,
      project_id: 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab',
      environment: token.environment,
      campaign_id: token.campaign_id,
      request_id: 'request_id' in token ? token.request_id : ('plan' in token ? token.plan.request_id : undefined),
      request_hash: 'request_hash' in token ? token.request_hash : ('plan' in token ? token.plan.request_hash : undefined),
      batch_id: 'batch_id' in token ? (token as any).batch_id : ('plan' in token ? token.plan.batch_id : undefined),
      issued_at_utc: token.issued_at_utc,
      expires_at_utc: token.expires_at_utc,
      consumed: token.consumed,
      revoked: token.revoked,
      file_size_bytes: 'file_size_bytes' in token ? token.file_size_bytes : undefined,
      file_sha256: 'file_sha256' in token ? token.file_sha256 : undefined
    };
  }
}

export const pilotFileCapabilityBroker = PilotFileCapabilityBroker.getInstance();

import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * Canary identifiers for privacy leak verification testing.
 */
export const CANARY_IDENTIFIERS = [
  'CANARY_SECRET_KEY_9999',
  'canary-auth-header-value',
  'canary-secret-value',
  'canary-token-value',
  'canary-pii-username',
  'canary-pii-user',
  'canary-raw-signal',
  'POLARH10_CANARY_DEVICE_ID',
  '00:11:22:33:44:55',
  'AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF'
] as const;

export class PrivacyRedactor {
  /**
   * Redacts sensitive strings including bearer tokens, passwords, secrets,
   * local OS home paths with usernames, MAC addresses, and canaries.
   */
  public static sanitizeString(input: string, debugMode = false): string {
    if (!input || typeof input !== 'string') return input;

    let res = input;

    // 1. Normalize line breaks to prevent log injection
    res = res.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');

    // 2. Redact FTP / credentials in URLs
    res = res.replace(/(ftp:\/\/)([^:@/]+)(:[^@/]+)?@/g, '$1<redacted>@');
    res = res.replace(/(https?:\/\/)([^:@/]+)(:[^@/]+)?@/g, '$1<redacted>@');

    // 3. Redact Windows user home paths (C:\Users\<username>\...) and Posix home paths (/Users/<username>/... or /home/<username>/...)
    if (!debugMode) {
      // Windows user paths
      res = res.replace(/([a-zA-Z]:\\Users\\)[^\\]+(\\[^"'\s\r\n]+)/gi, (_match, _prefix, subpath) => {
        const base = path.basename(subpath);
        return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
      });

      // Generic Windows absolute paths
      const winPathRegex = /[a-zA-Z]:\\[\\\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+(\.[\w\u0400-\u04FF]+)?/g;
      res = res.replace(winPathRegex, (match) => {
        const base = path.basename(match);
        return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
      });

      // Posix home and absolute paths
      res = res.replace(/(\/(?:home|Users)\/)[^/]+(\/[^"'\s\r\n]+)/gi, (_match, _prefix, subpath) => {
        const base = path.basename(subpath);
        return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
      });
      const posixPathRegex = /\/[\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+\/[\w\s\u0400-\u04FF.-]+(\.[\w\u0400-\u04FF]+)?/g;
      res = res.replace(posixPathRegex, (match) => {
        const base = path.basename(match);
        return `<redacted path>/${base}`;
      });
    }

    // 4. Redact MAC addresses (e.g. 00:11:22:33:44:55 or AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF)
    res = res.replace(/\b([0-9a-fA-F]{2}[:-]){5}([0-9a-fA-F]{2})\b/g, '<redacted mac>');

    // 5. Redact Bearer tokens, API keys, passwords, secrets
    res = res.replace(/(bearer\s+)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(auth(?:orization)?\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(access_token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(password\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(secret\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(launch_token\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(api_key\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/(?:device_id|device\s*id)\s*[:=]?\s*([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})/gi, (_m, devId) => `device ID: ${PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeDeviceId(devId)}`);
    res = res.replace(/(device_id\s*[:=]\s*)[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+/gi, '$1<redacted>');

    // 6. Redact Private Key blocks
    res = res.replace(/-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]+PRIVATE KEY-----/g, '<redacted private key>');

    // 7. Scrub specific canary tokens
    res = res.replace(/CANARY_SECRET_KEY_9999/gi, '<redacted secret>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-auth-header-value/gi, '<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-secret-value/gi, '<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-token-value/gi, '<redacted>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-pii-username/gi, '<redacted name>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-pii-user/gi, '<redacted name>');
    res = res.replace(/canary-raw-signal/gi, '<redacted biometrics>');
    res = res.replace(/POLARH10_CANARY_DEVICE_ID/gi, '<redacted device id>');

    return res;
  }

  /**
   * Redacts a device ID string (e.g. 130E4A2F -> 130E****).
   */
  public static sanitizeDeviceId(deviceId: string): string {
    if (!deviceId || typeof deviceId !== 'string') return '****';
    if (deviceId.length >= 4) {
      return deviceId.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(4, deviceId.length - 4));
    }
    return '****';
  }

  /**
   * Recursively sanitizes an object or array, stripping raw physiological data,
   * passwords, secrets, paths, and usernames.
   */
  public static sanitizeObject(obj: any, debugMode = false): any {
    if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj;

    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      if (obj.length > 10) {
        return { count: obj.length, sample_redacted: true, omitted: true };
      }
      return obj.map(item => PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeObject(item, debugMode));
    }

    if (typeof obj === 'object') {
      const redacted: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const key of Object.keys(obj)) {
        const val = obj[key];
        const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();

        // 1. Secrets & Credentials
        if (
          lowerKey.includes('password') ||
          lowerKey.includes('secret') ||
          lowerKey.includes('token') ||
          lowerKey.includes('auth') ||
          lowerKey === 'api_key' ||
          lowerKey === 'apikey'
        ) {
          redacted[key] = '<redacted>';
        }
        // 2. Device IDs
        else if (lowerKey.includes('deviceid') || lowerKey.includes('device_id')) {
          redacted[key] = typeof val === 'string' ? PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeDeviceId(val) : '<redacted device id>';
        }
        // 3. Local paths
        else if (lowerKey.includes('path') || lowerKey.includes('dir') || lowerKey.includes('folder')) {
          redacted[key] = typeof val === 'string' ? PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeString(val, debugMode) : '<redacted path>';
        }
        // 4. Personal notes & comments
        else if (lowerKey.includes('note') || lowerKey.includes('comment') || lowerKey.includes('personal')) {
          redacted[key] = '<redacted note>';
        }
        // 5. Usernames & personal identity
        else if (lowerKey.includes('username') || lowerKey.includes('displayname') || lowerKey.includes('user_name')) {
          redacted[key] = '<redacted name>';
        }
        // 6. Raw physiological arrays & signals
        else if (
          lowerKey === 'ecg' ||
          lowerKey === 'acc' ||
          lowerKey === 'ecg_microvolts' ||
          lowerKey === 'acc_samples' ||
          lowerKey === 'rr_intervals' ||
          lowerKey === 'raw_samples' ||
          lowerKey === 'rawpoints' ||
          lowerKey === 'intervals' ||
          lowerKey === 'samples' ||
          lowerKey === 'points' ||
          lowerKey === 'xs' ||
          lowerKey === 'ys'
        ) {
          if (Array.isArray(val)) {
            redacted[key] = { count: val.length, sample_redacted: true, omitted: true };
          } else {
            redacted[key] = '<redacted biometrics>';
          }
        }
        // 7. Recurse
        else {
          if (typeof val === 'string') {
            redacted[key] = PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeString(val, debugMode);
          } else {
            redacted[key] = PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeObject(val, debugMode);
          }
        }
      }
      return redacted;
    }

    if (typeof obj === 'string') {
      return PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeString(obj, debugMode);
    }

    return obj;
  }

  /**
   * Sanitizes a log record before disk persistence.
   */
  public static sanitizeLogRecord(record: any): any {
    return PrivacyRedactor.sanitizeObject(record);
  }

  /**
   * Canary detection utility: returns true if any un-redacted canary pattern is found in data.
   */
  public static containsCanary(data: any): boolean {
    const text = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
    for (const canary of CANARY_IDENTIFIERS) {
      if (text.includes(canary)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * CardioLab G4 — Guided Intake & Preflight Service
 *
 * Implements deterministic preflight analysis, staging isolation,
 * duplicate detection, security/traversal checks, stale fingerprint enforcement (412),
 * and safe idempotent session import.

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

import * as zlib from 'zlib';

  GuidedIntakePreflight,
  PreflightMember,
  PreflightStatus,
  PreflightIssue,
  PredictedCapability,
  PreflightDuplicateState,
  SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  PREFLIGHT_EXPIRY_MINUTES,
  IdempotencyConflictError
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';
import { evaluatePolarSensorLoggerEnvelope, PolarSensorLoggerEnvelopeEvaluation } from '../../shared/canonical/PolarSensorLoggerEnvelope';
import {
  saveGuidedPreflight,
  getGuidedPreflightByFingerprint,

export class StaleFingerprintError extends Error {
  public readonly currentFingerprint: string;
  public readonly expectedFingerprint: string;

  constructor(currentFingerprint: string, expectedFingerprint: string) {
    super(`Preflight fingerprint is stale. Expected '${expectedFingerprint}', got '${currentFingerprint}'. Precondition failed.`);
    this.name = 'StaleFingerprintError';
    this.currentFingerprint = currentFingerprint;
    this.expectedFingerprint = expectedFingerprint;
  }
}

export class PreflightExpiredError extends Error {
  constructor(preflightId: string) {
    super(`Preflight '${preflightId}' has expired.`);
    this.name = 'PreflightExpiredError';
  }
}

export class SecurityViolationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(`Security boundary violated: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'SecurityViolationError';
  }
}

export { IdempotencyConflictError };

export interface PreflightInputFile {
  originalPath: string;
  buffer?: Buffer;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  sha256?: string;
}

export interface ExecutePreflightImportResult {
  sessionId: string;
  episodeId: string;
  alreadyImported: boolean;
}

export type ExecutePreflightImportPromise = Promise<ExecutePreflightImportResult>;

export class GuidedIntakeService {

  /**
   * Computes deterministic SHA256 of file buffer
   */
  public computeSha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buffer).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Deterministically computes the request fingerprint from profile, intent, and files
   */
  public computeRequestFingerprint(params: {
    profile_id: string;
    task_intent: string;
    files: Array<{ name: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string }>;
  }): string {
    const sortedFiles = [...params.files].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      task_intent: params.task_intent,
      files: sortedFiles.map(f => ({ name: f.name, size: f.sizeBytes, sha256: f.sha256 }))
    });
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Executes Preflight in staging without mutating live DB records
   */
  public runPreflight(params: {
    profile_id: string;
    task_intent?: string;
    files: PreflightInputFile[];
    stagingBaseDir?: string;
  }): GuidedIntakePreflight {
    const taskIntent = params.task_intent || 'single_session_analysis';
    const now = new Date();
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + PREFLIGHT_EXPIRY_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);
    const preflightId = `pfl-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

    const stagingBase = params.stagingBaseDir || path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'staging');
    const stagingDir = path.join(stagingBase, preflightId);
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true });
    } catch (_) {}

    const discoveredMembers: PreflightMember[] = [];
    const issues: PreflightIssue[] = [];

    // Security check: path traversal
    for (const f of params.files) {
      const normalizedPath = f.originalPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      if (normalizedPath.includes('../') || normalizedPath.startsWith('/etc/') || normalizedPath.includes('..\\')) {
        throw new SecurityViolationError(`Path traversal attempt detected in path: ${f.originalPath}`);
      }
    }

    // Inspect files
    for (const f of params.files) {
      const baseName = path.basename(f.originalPath);
      let fileBuffer = f.buffer;
      if (!fileBuffer && f.originalPath && fs.existsSync(f.originalPath)) {
        try {
          fileBuffer = fs.readFileSync(f.originalPath);
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      let sizeBytes = f.sizeBytes ?? (fileBuffer ? fileBuffer.length : 0);
      let sha256 = f.sha256;
      if (!sha256 || sha256 === '0'.repeat(64)) {
        if (fileBuffer) {
          sha256 = this.computeSha256(fileBuffer);
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Cannot compute SHA-256 for file '${baseName}': missing buffer and unreadable path.`);
        }
      }

      const capabilityId = `cap-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

      // Stage file to disk collision-safely as single opaque capability if buffer exists (G49-OPS-001)
      if (fileBuffer) {
        try {
          fs.writeFileSync(path.join(stagingDir, `${capabilityId}.bin`), fileBuffer);
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Content-Aware Sniffing
      const sniffResult = sniffMemberContent({
        fileName: baseName,
        filePath: f.originalPath,
        buffer: fileBuffer,
        sizeBytes,
        sha256
      });

      const inspection = sniffResult.inspection;
      let signalType: 'ECG' | 'RR' | 'ACC' | 'METADATA' | 'UNKNOWN' = 'UNKNOWN';
      if (inspection.signal_class === 'RR') signalType = 'RR';
      else if (inspection.signal_class === 'ECG') signalType = 'ECG';
      else if (inspection.signal_class === 'ACC') signalType = 'ACC';
      else if (inspection.signal_class === 'METADATA') signalType = 'METADATA';

      const isCorrupt = sizeBytes === 0 || inspection.signal_class === 'MALFORMED';
      if (isCorrupt) {
        issues.push({
          code: 'FILE_EMPTY_OR_CORRUPT',
          severity: 'error',
          message_ru: `Файл ${baseName} пуст или поврежден`,
          message_en: `File ${baseName} is empty or corrupt`,
          remediation: 'Замените файл корректной записью'
        });
      }

      discoveredMembers.push({
        capability_id: capabilityId,
        ordinal: discoveredMembers.length,
        name: baseName,
        display_path: baseName,
        size_bytes: sizeBytes,
        sha256,
        signal_type: signalType,
        status: isCorrupt ? 'corrupt' : 'valid'
      });
    }

    // Duplicate detection in live database: full immutable byte hash is primary authority
    const db = getDb();
    let duplicateState: PreflightDuplicateState = {
      is_duplicate: false,
      duplicate_type: 'none'
    };

    try {
      for (const m of discoveredMembers) {
        if (m.status !== 'corrupt' && m.sha256 && m.sha256 !== '0'.repeat(64)) {
          // Check by sha256 in ingested_files
          const ingested = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM ingested_files WHERE sha256_hash = ? LIMIT 1').get(m.sha256) as any;
          if (ingested) {
            // Check if this file is part of a session owned by the caller profile
            const profileSession = db.prepare(`
              SELECT s.id, s.user_id FROM session_signals ss
              JOIN sessions s ON ss.session_id = s.id
              WHERE ss.file_id = ? AND (s.user_id = ? OR ? = 'all')
              LIMIT 1
            `).get(ingested.id, params.profile_id, params.profile_id) as any;

            if (profileSession) {
              duplicateState = {
                is_duplicate: true,
                duplicate_type: 'same_bytes_new_path',
                message_ru: `Файл с таким же содержимым уже был импортирован ранее (${ingested.filename})`,
                message_en: `File with identical content was previously imported (${ingested.filename})`
              };
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Calculate overall status
    let status: PreflightStatus = 'ready';
    if (discoveredMembers.length === 0) {
      status = 'unsupported';
      issues.push({
        code: 'NO_VALID_FILES',
        severity: 'error',
        message_ru: 'Не найдено ни одного файла для импорта',
        message_en: 'No files provided for import'
      });
    } else if (discoveredMembers.some(m => m.status === 'corrupt')) {
      status = 'blocked';
    } else if (duplicateState.is_duplicate) {
      status = 'needs_user_choice';
      issues.push({
        code: 'DUPLICATE_SOURCE_DETECTED',
        severity: 'warning',
        message_ru: duplicateState.message_ru || 'Обнаружен дубликат источника',
        message_en: duplicateState.message_en || 'Duplicate source detected',
        remediation: 'Подтвердите повторный импорт или выберите другую запись'
      });
    }

    // Evaluate H10 / PSL envelope admission
    const envelopeInput = params.files.map(f => {
      let contentStr: string | undefined = undefined;
      if (f.buffer) {
        try { contentStr = f.buffer.toString('utf8'); } catch (_) {}
      } else if (f.originalPath && fs.existsSync(f.originalPath)) {
        try { contentStr = fs.readFileSync(f.originalPath, 'utf8'); } catch (_) {}
      }
      return {
        name: f.originalPath,
        sizeBytes: f.sizeBytes,
        sha256: f.sha256,
        content: contentStr
      };
    });
    const envelopeEval = evaluatePolarSensorLoggerEnvelope(envelopeInput);

    if (taskIntent === 'pilot_journey') {
      for (const b of envelopeEval.blocking_reasons) {
        if (!issues.some(i => i.code === b.code)) {
          issues.push({
            code: b.code,
            severity: b.severity,
            message_ru: b.message_ru,
            message_en: b.message_en
          });
        }
      }
      if (envelopeEval.status === 'rejected' && status !== 'unsupported') {
        status = 'blocked';
      }
    }

    const predictedCapabilities: PredictedCapability[] = [
      {
        capability: 'hrv_analytics',
        available: discoveredMembers.some(m => m.signal_type === 'RR' || m.signal_type === 'ECG'),
        reason_ru: 'Требуется сигнал пульса (RR или ECG)',
        reason_en: 'Heart rate signal required (RR or ECG)'
      },
      {
        capability: 'cardiac_drift',
        available: discoveredMembers.some(m => m.signal_type === 'ECG' || m.signal_type === 'RR'),
        reason_ru: 'Требуется непрерывная запись ЧСС',
        reason_en: 'Continuous heart rate recording required'
      },
      {
        capability: 'motion_sqi',
        available: discoveredMembers.some(m => m.signal_type === 'ACC'),
        reason_ru: 'Требуется акселерометр для контекста движений',
        reason_en: 'Accelerometer required for motion context'
      }
    ];

    const fingerprint = this.computeRequestFingerprint({
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      task_intent: taskIntent,
      files: discoveredMembers.map(m => ({ name: m.name, sizeBytes: m.size_bytes, sha256: m.sha256 }))
    });

    const preflight: GuidedIntakePreflight = {
      schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      preflight_id: preflightId,
      request_fingerprint: fingerprint,
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      task_intent: taskIntent,
      discovered_members: discoveredMembers,
      format_support: envelopeEval.format_family === 'polar_sensor_logger_h10' ? 'polar_sensor_logger_h10' : 'polar_h10_csv',
      required_companions: [],
      optional_companions: ['ACC', 'METADATA'],
      duplicate_state: duplicateState,
      privacy_class: 'local_only',
      status,
      issues,
      predicted_capabilities: predictedCapabilities,
      staging_id: preflightId,
      expires_at_utc: expiresAt.toISOString(),
      created_at_utc: now.toISOString()
    };

    const preflightWithAdmission = {
      ...preflight,
      admission: envelopeEval
    };

    saveGuidedPreflight(preflightWithAdmission, stagingDir);
    return preflightWithAdmission;
  }

  /**
   * Executes verified import with exact unexpired fingerprint and idempotency key
   */
  public async executePreflightImport(params: {
    preflight_id: string;
    request_fingerprint: string;
    idempotency_key?: string;
    target_episode_id?: string;
  }): ExecutePreflightImportPromise {
    // 1. Fetch preflight record first to construct authoritative canonical command
    const record = getGuidedPreflightById(params.preflight_id);
    if (!record) {
      throw new Error(`Preflight '${params.preflight_id}' not found.`);
    }
    const preflight = record.preflight;

    // 2. Expiry check
    if (Date.parse(preflight.expires_at_utc) < Date.now()) {
      throw new PreflightExpiredError(params.preflight_id);
    }

    // 3. Stale Fingerprint check (Fail closed, returns 412)
    if (preflight.request_fingerprint !== params.request_fingerprint) {
      throw new StaleFingerprintError(params.request_fingerprint, preflight.request_fingerprint);
    }

    // 4. Fail closed on all non-ready preflights (G40-PILOT-001)
    if (preflight.status !== 'ready') {
      if (preflight.status === 'blocked') {
        throw new Error('Cannot import blocked preflight. Corrupt or unhandled issues exist.');
      }
      if (preflight.status === 'unsupported') {
        throw new Error('Cannot import unsupported preflight. Format not supported.');
      }
      if (preflight.status === 'needs_user_choice') {
        throw new Error('Cannot import preflight requiring user choice.');
      }
      throw new Error(`Cannot import preflight with status '${preflight.status}'.`);
    }

    // 5. Durable Idempotency check with full canonical command hashing (G42-AUTH-003)
    const canonicalCommand = {
      preflight_id: params.preflight_id,
      request_fingerprint: params.request_fingerprint,
      target_episode_id: params.target_episode_id || null,
      profile_id: preflight.profile_id,
      members: (preflight.discovered_members || []).map(m => ({
        name: m.name,
        sha256: m.sha256,
        size: m.size_bytes
      }))
    };
    const payloadHash = this.computeSha256(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(canonicalCommand)));

    if (params.idempotency_key) {
      const stored = getDurableImportIdempotency(params.idempotency_key);
      if (stored) {
        if (stored.payload_hash === payloadHash) {
          const cachedResult: ExecutePreflightImportResult = {
            sessionId: stored.result.sessionId,
            episodeId: stored.result.episodeId,
            alreadyImported: true
          };
          return Promise.resolve(cachedResult);
        } else {
          throw new IdempotencyConflictError('Idempotency conflict: same key with different payload.');
        }
      }
    }

    // 6. Anti-TOCTOU byte revalidation with strictly opaque staged capabilities (G40-PILOT-001, G47-SEAL-001, G49-OPS-001):
    // Reopen and re-hash approved files/staged bytes on disk in stagingDir strictly via opaque capability_id.bin.
    const stagingDir = record.stagingDir || path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'staging', preflight.staging_id || preflight.preflight_id);
    if (!stagingDir || !fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) {
      throw new StaleFingerprintError('missing_staging_dir', preflight.request_fingerprint);
    }

    const filesInStaging = fs.readdirSync(stagingDir);
    const approvedFiles = new Set<string>();
    for (const m of preflight.discovered_members) {
      if (!m.capability_id || typeof m.capability_id !== 'string' || m.capability_id.trim() === '') {
        throw new SecurityViolationError(`Preflight member '${m.name}' lacks authoritative opaque capability_id`);
      }
      approvedFiles.add(`${m.capability_id}.bin`);
    }

    // Fail closed if any unexpected file exists in staging (G48-AUTH-001, G49-OPS-001)
    for (const f of filesInStaging) {
      if (!approvedFiles.has(f)) {
        throw new SecurityViolationError(`Unexpected file found in staging directory: '${f}'`);
      }
    }

    const stagedBuffers: Array<{ member: PreflightMember; buffer: Buffer; filePath: string }> = [];
    for (const m of preflight.discovered_members) {
      const capPath = path.join(stagingDir, `${m.capability_id}.bin`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(capPath)) {
        throw new StaleFingerprintError('missing_capability_file', m.sha256);
      }

      const currentBuf = fs.readFileSync(capPath);
      const currentSha = this.computeSha256(currentBuf);
      if (currentBuf.length !== m.size_bytes || currentSha !== m.sha256) {
        throw new StaleFingerprintError(currentSha, m.sha256);
      }
      stagedBuffers.push({ member: m, buffer: currentBuf, filePath: capPath });
    }

    // G56-CARDINALITY-006: Pre-mutation single-session cardinality check
    // The one-recording intake command must yield exactly one canonical session candidate or fail closed before mutation
    if (preflight.task_intent === 'single_session_analysis' || preflight.task_intent === 'pilot_journey') {
      const rrFiles = stagedBuffers.filter(b => b.member.signal_type === 'RR');
      const ecgFiles = stagedBuffers.filter(b => b.member.signal_type === 'ECG');
      const hasDistinctRrBasenames = rrFiles.length > 1 && new Set(rrFiles.map(f => f.member.name)).size > 1;
      const hasDistinctEcgBasenames = ecgFiles.length > 1 && new Set(ecgFiles.map(f => f.member.name)).size > 1;
      if (hasDistinctRrBasenames || (rrFiles.length === 0 && hasDistinctEcgBasenames)) {
        throw new Error('[AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_SESSION_CANDIDATES] One-recording intake produced multiple session candidates; single-session cardinality required.');
      }
    }

    // 7. Validate target episode before starting import if requested (G45-CUTOVER-003, G45-CUTOVER-004, G46-CUTOVER-005, G47-SEAL-004, G48-AUTH-006)
    let episodeId = params.target_episode_id || '';
    let newlyCreatedEpisode = false;
    if (params.target_episode_id) {
      const ep = selfServiceEpisodeService.getEpisode(params.target_episode_id);
      if (!ep) {
        throw new Error(`[EPISODE_NOT_FOUND] Target episode '${params.target_episode_id}' not found.`);
      }
      if (ep.profile_id && preflight.profile_id && ep.profile_id !== preflight.profile_id) {
        throw new Error(`[CROSS_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN] Target episode '${params.target_episode_id}' belongs to '${ep.profile_id}', requested under '${preflight.profile_id}'.`);
      }
      if (ep.task_intent && preflight.task_intent && ep.task_intent !== preflight.task_intent) {
        throw new Error(`[EPISODE_TASK_MISMATCH:TASK_INTENT_MISMATCH] Target episode '${params.target_episode_id}' intent is '${ep.task_intent}', preflight intent is '${preflight.task_intent}'.`);
      }
      if (ep.lifecycle_state === 'completed' || ep.lifecycle_state === 'cancelled') {
        throw new Error(`[EPISODE_STATE_INVALID] Target episode '${params.target_episode_id}' is in terminal state '${ep.lifecycle_state}'.`);
      }
      if (ep.canonical_session_id) {
        throw new Error(`[EPISODE_ALREADY_BOUND] Target episode '${params.target_episode_id}' is already bound to session '${ep.canonical_session_id}'.`);
      }
      episodeId = params.target_episode_id;
    }

    // 8. Construct DiscoveredBundle for ordinary production import (G45-CUTOVER-001, G46-CUTOVER-001, G46-CUTOVER-002, G50-CMD-002)
    const discoveredFiles: DiscoveredFileItem[] = stagedBuffers.map(item => ({
      fileName: item.member.name,
      fullPath: item.filePath,
      sizeBytes: item.member.size_bytes,
      sha256: item.member.sha256,
      signalType: item.member.signal_type as DetectedSignalType,
      capability_id: item.member.capability_id,
      schemaType: (item.member.signal_type === 'RR'
        ? 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col'
        : (item.member.signal_type === 'ECG'
            ? 'polar_sensor_logger_ecg'
            : (item.member.signal_type === 'ACC'
                ? 'polar_sensor_logger_acc'
                : 'unknown'))) as any,
      rowCount: 0,
      isRowCountEstimated: false
    } as any));

    const bundle: DiscoveredBundle = {
      bundleId: `bundle-${preflight.preflight_id}`,
      bundleName: preflight.discovered_members[0]?.name || 'Polar_H10_Guided_Intake',
      deviceId: 'Polar_H10',
      profileId: preflight.profile_id,
      groupingBasis: 'filename_pattern',
      groupingConfidence: 'high',
      status: 'VALID',
      startTime: null,
      endTime: null,
      durationSeconds: null,
      isDurationEstimated: false,
      channels: preflight.discovered_members.map(m => m.signal_type as DetectedSignalType),
      files: discoveredFiles,
      warnings: [],
      userCorrections: [],
      selected: true
    };

    // 9. Delegate completely to ordinary production durable import job pipeline (G46-CUTOVER-001, G48-AUTH-002, G48-AUTH-005, G50-BIND-004, G52-BIND-003)
    const runImport = async (): Promise<ExecutePreflightImportResult> => {
      const { jobId } = startGuidedImportJob([bundle], {
        profileId: preflight.profile_id,
        idempotencyKey: params.idempotency_key,
        payloadHash,
        ...({
          targetEpisodeId: episodeId || params.target_episode_id || (preflight as any).target_episode_id || null,
          stagingDir,
          admission: (preflight as any).admission || null
        } as any)
      });

      const jobSnapshot = await awaitDurableImportJob(jobId);
      if (jobSnapshot.stage === 'failed' || jobSnapshot.stage === 'failed_recoverable' || jobSnapshot.stage === 'cancelled') {
        const firstErr = jobSnapshot.results.find(r => r.error)?.error || jobSnapshot.error || `Durable import job ended in stage '${jobSnapshot.stage}'`;
        if (firstErr.includes('Security boundary violated') || firstErr.includes('Cross-profile')) {
          throw new SecurityViolationError(firstErr);
        }
        throw new Error(firstErr);
      }

      const sessionResults = jobSnapshot.results.filter(r => r.session_id);
      if (sessionResults.length > 1) {
        throw new Error('[AMBIGUOUS_MULTI_SESSION_CANDIDATES] One-recording intake produced multiple session candidates.');
      }

      const stepRes = sessionResults[0];
      if (!stepRes || !stepRes.session_id) {
        throw new Error(jobSnapshot.results.find(r => r.error)?.error || jobSnapshot.error || 'No session was created by durable import');
      }

      const sessionId = stepRes.session_id;
      const sessRow = getDb().prepare('SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
      if (sessRow && sessRow.user_id && sessRow.user_id !== preflight.profile_id) {
        throw new SecurityViolationError(`Cross-profile session reuse rejected: session '${sessionId}' is owned by '${sessRow.user_id}', not '${preflight.profile_id}'.`);
      }

      const finalEpisodeId = (stepRes as any).episode_id || episodeId;

      invalidateCanonicalSessionCache(sessionId);

      return {
        sessionId,
        episodeId: finalEpisodeId,
        alreadyImported: Boolean(stepRes.already_imported)
      };
    };

    return runImport();
  }

  /**
   * Safely cancels preflight and purges staging directory without affecting accepted data
   */
  public cancelPreflight(preflightId: string): void {
    const record = getGuidedPreflightById(preflightId);
    if (record?.stagingDir && fs.existsSync(record.stagingDir)) {
      try {
        fs.rmSync(record.stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }
}

export const guidedIntakeService = new GuidedIntakeService();

/**
 * CardioLab G4 — Repeat Work Series Service
 *
 * Enforces strict distinct session semantics, profile ownership,
 * chronological validation, and synthetic rehearsal isolation.
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  RepeatWorkSeries,
  RepeatSeriesEpisodeBinding,
  SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';
import {
  createRepeatWorkSeries,
  getRepeatWorkSeries,
  updateRepeatWorkSeries,
  listRepeatWorkSeriesByProfile,
  getSelfServiceEpisode,
  getDb
} from '../db/db';

export class CrossProfileLinkError extends Error {
  constructor(seriesProfile: string, episodeProfile: string) {
    super(`Cross-profile linking rejected: Series belongs to profile '${seriesProfile}', but episode belongs to '${episodeProfile}'.`);
    this.name = 'CrossProfileLinkError';
  }
}

export class DuplicateSessionRepeatError extends Error {
  constructor(sessionId: string) {
    super(`Same-session repeat rejected: Session '${sessionId}' is already part of this series. Distinct sessions are required.`);
    this.name = 'DuplicateSessionRepeatError';
  }
}

export class AmbiguousChronologyError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(`Ambiguous chronology requires user choice: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'AmbiguousChronologyError';
  }
}

export class RepeatSeriesService {
  /**
   * Creates a new RepeatWorkSeries for a profile
   */
  public createSeries(params: {
    profile_id: string;
    task_lineage?: string;
  }): RepeatWorkSeries {
    const seriesId = `rws-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const series: RepeatWorkSeries = {
      schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      series_id: seriesId,
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      task_lineage: params.task_lineage || 'cardio_analytics_lineage',
      episodes: [],
      distinct_session_ids: [],
      compare_readiness: 'not_ready',
      compare_readiness_reason_ru: 'Требуется как минимум 2 независимые сессии для сравнения',
      compare_readiness_reason_en: 'Requires at least 2 independent sessions for comparison',
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    createRepeatWorkSeries(series);
    return series;
  }

  /**
   * Gets a series by ID
   */
  public getSeries(seriesId: string): RepeatWorkSeries | null {
    return getRepeatWorkSeries(seriesId);
  }

  /**
   * Lists series for a profile
   */
  public listSeries(profileId: string): RepeatWorkSeries[] {
    return listRepeatWorkSeriesByProfile(profileId);
  }

  /**
   * Adds an episode to a series with strict distinct session & profile validation
   */
  public addEpisodeToSeries(params: {
    series_id: string;
    episode_id: string;
    role?: 'baseline' | 'followup' | 'monitoring';
    allowReorder?: boolean;
  }): RepeatWorkSeries {
    const series = getRepeatWorkSeries(params.series_id);
    if (!series) {
      throw new Error(`RepeatWorkSeries '${params.series_id}' not found.`);
    }

    const episode = getSelfServiceEpisode(params.episode_id);
    if (!episode) {
      throw new Error(`SelfServiceWorkEpisode '${params.episode_id}' not found.`);
    }

    // 1. Cross-profile link check
    if (series.profile_id !== episode.profile_id) {
      throw new CrossProfileLinkError(series.profile_id, episode.profile_id);
    }

    // 2. Bound session check
    if (!episode.canonical_session_id) {
      throw new Error(`Episode '${params.episode_id}' has no bound canonical session.`);
    }

    // 3. Distinct session check: Same session cannot be added twice to create a fake repeat
    if (series.distinct_session_ids.includes(episode.canonical_session_id)) {
      throw new DuplicateSessionRepeatError(episode.canonical_session_id);
    }

    // 4. Chronology check
    const newCompletedAt = episode.completed_at_utc || episode.created_at_utc;
    if (series.episodes.length > 0) {
      const lastEp = series.episodes[series.episodes.length - 1];
      if (lastEp.completed_at_utc && newCompletedAt < lastEp.completed_at_utc && !params.allowReorder) {
        throw new AmbiguousChronologyError(
          `New episode completed at ${newCompletedAt}, which is earlier than previous episode at ${lastEp.completed_at_utc}.`
        );
      }
    }

    const newBinding: RepeatSeriesEpisodeBinding = {
      episode_id: episode.episode_id,
      session_id: episode.canonical_session_id,
      order_index: series.episodes.length + 1,
      role: params.role || (series.episodes.length === 0 ? 'baseline' : 'followup'),
      completed_at_utc: newCompletedAt
    };

    const updatedEpisodes = [...series.episodes, newBinding];
    const updatedDistinct = [...series.distinct_session_ids, episode.canonical_session_id];

    const isReady = updatedDistinct.length >= 2;
    const readinessReasonRu = isReady
      ? `В серии доступно ${updatedDistinct.length} независимых сессий для сравнительного анализа`
      : 'Требуется как минимум 2 независимые сессии для сравнения';
    const readinessReasonEn = isReady
      ? `${updatedDistinct.length} independent sessions available for comparison`
      : 'Requires at least 2 independent sessions for comparison';

    updateRepeatWorkSeries(series.series_id, {
      episodes: updatedEpisodes,
      distinct_session_ids: updatedDistinct,
      compare_readiness: isReady ? 'ready' : 'not_ready',
      compare_readiness_reason_ru: readinessReasonRu,
      compare_readiness_reason_en: readinessReasonEn
    });

    return getRepeatWorkSeries(series.series_id)!;
  }

  /**
   * Registers a natural repeat candidate in G3 tables if useful outcome is confirmed
   */
  public registerNaturalRepeatCandidateIfEligible(params: {
    baseline_session_id: string;
    repeat_session_id: string;
    participant_id: string;
    cohort_id: string;
    is_external_tester: boolean;
    baseline_completed_at: string;
    repeat_completed_at: string;
  }): { registered: boolean; candidate_id?: string; reason?: string } {
    if (params.baseline_session_id === params.repeat_session_id) {
      return { registered: false, reason: 'BASELINE_EQUALS_REPEAT' };
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const repeatId = `nr-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // Rehearsal isolation: external qualifier is only true if caller is genuine external participant
    const isQualified = params.is_external_tester ? 1 : 0;

    try {
      const stmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO beta_natural_repeats (
          repeat_id, participant_id, cohort_id,
          baseline_session_id, baseline_context_id, baseline_completed_at_utc,
          repeat_session_id, repeat_context_id, repeat_completed_at_utc,
          repeat_type, is_distinct_session, is_qualified_repeat, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      stmt.run(
        repeatId,
        params.participant_id,
        params.cohort_id,
        params.baseline_session_id,
        'ctx-baseline',
        params.baseline_completed_at,
        params.repeat_session_id,
        'ctx-repeat',
        params.repeat_completed_at,
        'self_service_series',
        1,
        isQualified,
        now
      );

      return { registered: true, candidate_id: repeatId };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { registered: false, reason: err.message };
    }
  }
}

export const repeatSeriesService = new RepeatSeriesService();
