/**
 * CardioLab G4 — Self-Service Work Episode Service
 *
 * Implements the server-side state machine, gate enforcement,
 * deterministic next-action derivation, and episode readiness snapshot.
 */

import {
  SelfServiceWorkEpisode,
  EpisodeLifecycleState,
  SelfServiceNextAction,
  NextActionCode,
  EpisodeReadinessSnapshot,
  SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  RecoveryDescriptor
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';
import {
  createSelfServiceEpisode,
  getSelfServiceEpisode,
  getSelfServiceEpisodeBySession,
  updateSelfServiceEpisode,
  listSelfServiceEpisodesByProfile,
  getDb
} from '../db/db';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export class IllegalTransitionError extends Error {
  public readonly fromState: EpisodeLifecycleState;
  public readonly toState: EpisodeLifecycleState;
  public readonly authoritativeEpisode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode;

  constructor(fromState: EpisodeLifecycleState, toState: EpisodeLifecycleState, episode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode) {
    super(`Illegal state transition from '${fromState}' to '${toState}' for episode '${episode.episode_id}'.`);
    this.name = 'IllegalTransitionError';
    this.fromState = fromState;
    this.toState = toState;
    this.authoritativeEpisode = episode;
  }
}

export class GateViolationError extends Error {
  public readonly gateName: string;
  public readonly reason: string;

  constructor(gateName: string, reason: string) {
    super(`Completion gate '${gateName}' violated: ${reason}`);
    this.name = 'GateViolationError';
    this.gateName = gateName;
    this.reason = reason;
  }
}

// Canonical transition map
const ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Record<EpisodeLifecycleState, Set<EpisodeLifecycleState>> = {
  draft: new Set(['preflight_ready', 'analysis_ready', 'cancelled', 'failed_terminal']),
  preflight_ready: new Set(['importing', 'analysis_ready', 'cancelled', 'failed_recoverable', 'draft']),
  importing: new Set(['analysis_ready', 'failed_recoverable', 'failed_terminal']),
  analysis_ready: new Set([
    'quality_review_required',
    'analysis_limited',
    'comparison_not_ready',
    'comparison_ready',
    'handoff_ready',
    'awaiting_outcome_confirmation',
    'completed',
    'source_unavailable',
    'failed_recoverable'
  ]),
  quality_review_required: new Set(['analysis_ready', 'analysis_limited', 'failed_recoverable', 'cancelled']),
  analysis_limited: new Set(['comparison_not_ready', 'comparison_ready', 'handoff_ready', 'awaiting_outcome_confirmation', 'completed', 'failed_recoverable']),
  comparison_not_ready: new Set(['comparison_ready', 'handoff_ready', 'awaiting_outcome_confirmation', 'completed', 'failed_recoverable']),
  comparison_ready: new Set(['handoff_ready', 'awaiting_outcome_confirmation', 'completed', 'failed_recoverable']),
  handoff_ready: new Set(['awaiting_outcome_confirmation', 'completed', 'failed_recoverable']),
  awaiting_outcome_confirmation: new Set(['completed', 'cancelled', 'failed_recoverable']),
  completed: new Set(['historical']),
  historical: new Set([]),
  source_unavailable: new Set(['analysis_ready', 'failed_recoverable', 'failed_terminal']),
  failed_recoverable: new Set(['draft', 'preflight_ready', 'importing', 'analysis_ready', 'failed_terminal', 'cancelled']),
  failed_terminal: new Set([]),
  cancelled: new Set([])
};

export class SelfServiceEpisodeService {
  /**
   * Initializes a new Work Episode
   */
  public createEpisode(params: {
    profile_id: string;
    actor_class?: 'qualified_external' | 'internal' | 'synthetic' | 'legacy_unqualified';
    task_intent?: string;
    canonical_session_id?: string;
    lifecycle_state?: EpisodeLifecycleState;
    completion_gates?: Partial<SelfServiceWorkEpisode['completion_gates']>;
  }): SelfServiceWorkEpisode {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const episodeId = `ep-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const episode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode = {
      schema_version: SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      episode_id: episodeId,
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      actor_class: params.actor_class || 'internal',
      task_intent: params.task_intent || 'single_session_analysis',
      canonical_session_id: params.canonical_session_id ?? null,
      canonical_session_hash: null,
      canonical_result_hash: null,
      window_id: null,
      window_revision: null,
      comparison_partner_session_id: null,
      comparison_hash: null,
      llm_pack_fingerprint: null,
      diary_entry_id: null,
      lifecycle_state: params.lifecycle_state || 'draft',
      completion_gates: {
        preflight_passed: Boolean(params.completion_gates?.preflight_passed),
        import_completed: Boolean(params.completion_gates?.import_completed ?? params.canonical_session_id),
        qc_evaluated: Boolean(params.completion_gates?.qc_evaluated),
        outcome_confirmed: Boolean(params.completion_gates?.outcome_confirmed)
      },
      blockers: [],
      recovery_history: [],
      repeat_classification: 'first_use',
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: null,
      provenance_version: '1.0.0'
    };

    createSelfServiceEpisode(episode);
    return episode;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves an episode by ID
   */
  public getEpisode(episodeId: string): SelfServiceWorkEpisode | null {
    return getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves an episode by session ID
   */
  public getEpisodeBySession(sessionId: string): SelfServiceWorkEpisode | null {
    return getSelfServiceEpisodeBySession(sessionId);
  }

  /**
   * Lists episodes for a profile
   */
  public listEpisodes(profileId: string): SelfServiceWorkEpisode[] {
    return listSelfServiceEpisodesByProfile(profileId);
  }

  /**
   * Transitions an episode to a new lifecycle state
   */
  public transitionEpisode(
    episodeId: string,
    targetState: EpisodeLifecycleState,
    contextUpdates?: Partial<SelfServiceWorkEpisode>
  ): SelfServiceWorkEpisode {
    const episode = getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
    if (!episode) {
      throw new Error(`SelfServiceWorkEpisode '${episodeId}' not found.`);
    }

    // Idempotent no-op
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === targetState) {
      if (contextUpdates) {
        updateSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId, contextUpdates);
        return getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId)!;
      }
      return episode;
    }

    // Check transition legality
    const allowed = ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[episode.lifecycle_state];
    if (!allowed || !allowed.has(targetState)) {
      throw new IllegalTransitionError(episode.lifecycle_state, targetState, episode);
    }

    // Enforce gates when transitioning to completed
    if (targetState === 'completed') {
      if (!episode.canonical_session_id && !contextUpdates?.canonical_session_id) {
        throw new GateViolationError('session_required', 'Episode cannot be completed without a bound canonical session.');
      }
      if (episode.completion_gates?.qc_evaluated === false && !contextUpdates?.completion_gates?.qc_evaluated) {
        throw new GateViolationError('qc_evaluated', 'Episode cannot bypass quality review prior to completion.');
      }
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const updates: Partial<SelfServiceWorkEpisode> = {
      ...contextUpdates,
      lifecycle_state: targetState,
      updated_at_utc: now,
      completed_at_utc: targetState === 'completed' ? (episode.completed_at_utc || now) : episode.completed_at_utc
    };

    updateSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId, updates);
    return getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId)!;
  }

  /**
   * Derives the deterministic recommended next action for the episode
   */
  public deriveNextAction(episodeId: string): SelfServiceNextAction {
    const episode = getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
    if (!episode) {
      return {
        action_code: 'FIX_INPUT',
        target_surface: 'intake',
        reason_ru: 'Эпизод работы не найден',
        reason_en: 'Work episode not found',
        blocking_facts: ['EPISODE_NOT_FOUND'],
        prerequisites: [],
        is_retry_safe: false,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.not_found'
      };
    }

    // 1. Recoverable failure state takes precedence
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'failed_recoverable' && episode.recovery_history.length > 0) {
      const activeRec = episode.recovery_history[0];
      return {
        action_code: 'FIX_INPUT',
        target_surface: 'recovery',
        reason_ru: activeRec.user_summary_ru,
        reason_en: activeRec.user_summary_en,
        blocking_facts: [activeRec.technical_code],
        prerequisites: activeRec.prerequisites,
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: `recovery.${activeRec.recovery_class}`
      };
    }

    // 2. Source unavailable
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'source_unavailable') {
      return {
        action_code: 'RESTORE_SOURCE_OR_PACK',
        target_surface: 'intake',
        reason_ru: 'Исходный файл сессии перемещен или недоступен на диске',
        reason_en: 'Session source file was moved or unavailable on disk',
        blocking_facts: ['SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'],
        prerequisites: ['restore_source_file'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.source_unavailable'
      };
    }

    // 3. Draft or preflight ready
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'draft' || episode.lifecycle_state === 'preflight_ready') {
      return {
        action_code: 'CONTINUE_IMPORT',
        target_surface: 'intake',
        reason_ru: 'Выполните импорт проверенных файлов в рабочую станцию',
        reason_en: 'Execute verified source import into workstation',
        blocking_facts: [],
        prerequisites: ['preflight_passed'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.continue_import'
      };
    }

    // 4. Importing
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'importing') {
      return {
        action_code: 'CONTINUE_IMPORT',
        target_surface: 'intake',
        reason_ru: 'Импорт сессии в процессе выполнения...',
        reason_en: 'Session import in progress...',
        blocking_facts: ['IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS'],
        prerequisites: [],
        is_retry_safe: false,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.importing'
      };
    }

    // 5. Quality review required
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'quality_review_required') {
      return {
        action_code: 'OPEN_QUALITY_REVIEW',
        target_surface: 'quality',
        reason_ru: 'Требуется инспекция качества сигнала и артефактов RR',
        reason_en: 'Signal quality and RR artifact inspection required',
        blocking_facts: ['QUALITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED'],
        prerequisites: ['inspect_rr_quality'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.open_quality_review'
      };
    }

    // 6. Comparison not ready
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'comparison_not_ready') {
      return {
        action_code: 'AWAIT_INDEPENDENT_HISTORY',
        target_surface: 'compare',
        reason_ru: 'Для канонического сравнения требуется отдельная независимая сессия',
        reason_en: 'Canonical comparison requires an independent peer session',
        blocking_facts: ['INSUFFICIENT_PEERS'],
        prerequisites: ['import_distinct_second_session'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.await_independent_history'
      };
    }

    // 7. Comparison ready
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'comparison_ready') {
      return {
        action_code: 'SELECT_COMPARISON_PARTNER',
        target_surface: 'compare',
        reason_ru: 'Выберите сессию-партнера для сравнительного анализа',
        reason_en: 'Select peer partner session for comparative analysis',
        blocking_facts: [],
        prerequisites: ['select_peer_session'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.select_comparison_partner'
      };
    }

    // 8. Handoff ready (export / AI pack)
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'handoff_ready') {
      return {
        action_code: 'OPEN_PRIVACY_PREVIEW',
        target_surface: 'export',
        reason_ru: 'Откройте предварительный просмотр экспорта с проверкой приватности',
        reason_en: 'Open privacy-safe export preview',
        blocking_facts: [],
        prerequisites: ['review_privacy_preview'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.open_privacy_preview'
      };
    }

    // 9. Awaiting outcome confirmation
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'awaiting_outcome_confirmation') {
      return {
        action_code: 'CONFIRM_OUTCOME',
        target_surface: 'outcome',
        reason_ru: 'Подтвердите получение полезного аналитического результата',
        reason_en: 'Confirm verified useful analytical outcome',
        blocking_facts: [],
        prerequisites: ['confirm_outcome'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.confirm_outcome'
      };
    }

    // 10. Completed
    if (episode.lifecycle_state === 'completed') {
      return {
        action_code: 'LINK_NEW_DISTINCT_SESSION',
        target_surface: 'intake',
        reason_ru: 'Сессия завершена. Подключите новую отдельную запись для продолжения серии',
        reason_en: 'Session complete. Attach a new distinct recording to continue series',
        blocking_facts: [],
        prerequisites: ['import_new_session'],
        is_retry_safe: true,
        is_destructive: false,
        localization_key: 'next_action.link_new_distinct_session'
      };
    }

    // Default analysis_ready
    return {
      action_code: 'CREATE_OR_SELECT_WINDOW',
      target_surface: 'windows',
      reason_ru: 'Выделите стационарное аналитическое окно или перейдите к экспорту',
      reason_en: 'Create stationary analytical window or proceed to export',
      blocking_facts: [],
      prerequisites: [],
      is_retry_safe: true,
      is_destructive: false,
      localization_key: 'next_action.create_window'
    };
  }

  /**
   * Compiles the authoritative EpisodeReadinessSnapshot for UI cards & status
   */
  public buildEpisodeReadinessSnapshot(episodeId: string): EpisodeReadinessSnapshot {
    const episode = getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
    if (!episode) {
      throw new Error(`SelfServiceWorkEpisode '${episodeId}' not found.`);
    }

    const nextAction = this.deriveNextAction(episodeId);
    const db = getDb();

    let qcStatus: 'passed' | 'limited' | 'failed' | 'not_computed' = 'not_computed';
    let rrAvailable = false;
    let windowsCount = 0;
    let comparisonReady = false;
    let exportReady = false;
    let diaryBound = false;

    if (episode.canonical_session_id) {
      try {
        const session = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(episode.canonical_session_id) as any;
        if (session) {
          rrAvailable = true;
          if (session.overall_quality_score != null) {
            qcStatus = session.overall_quality_score >= 0.7 ? 'passed' : session.overall_quality_score >= 0.4 ? 'limited' : 'failed';
          }
        }

        const windows = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) as c FROM named_windows WHERE session_id = ?').get(episode.canonical_session_id) as any;
        windowsCount = windows?.c || 0;

        const peerCount = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) as c FROM sessions WHERE id != ?').get(episode.canonical_session_id) as any;
        comparisonReady = (peerCount?.c || 0) >= 1;

        exportReady = Boolean(episode.canonical_session_id && qcStatus !== 'failed');
        diaryBound = Boolean(episode.diary_entry_id);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    return {
      episode_id: episode.episode_id,
      lifecycle_state: episode.lifecycle_state,
      source_status: episode.lifecycle_state === 'source_unavailable' ? 'unavailable' : 'available',
      qc_status: qcStatus,
      task_eligibility: {
        hrv_eligible: qcStatus !== 'failed' && rrAvailable,
        cardiac_drift_eligible: qcStatus === 'passed',
        aerobic_threshold_eligible: qcStatus === 'passed',
        ineligibility_reasons: qcStatus === 'failed' ? ['QC_FAILED_SIGNAL_DEGRADED'] : []
      },
      rr_available: rrAvailable,
      windows_count: windowsCount,
      active_window_id: episode.window_id,
      comparison_ready: comparisonReady,
      comparison_reason_ru: comparisonReady ? 'Доступны сессии-партнеры' : 'Требуется вторая независимая сессия',
      comparison_reason_en: comparisonReady ? 'Peer partner sessions available' : 'Independent second session required',
      export_ready: exportReady,
      diary_bound: diaryBound,
      next_action: nextAction,
      active_recovery: episode.recovery_history.length > 0 ? episode.recovery_history[0] : null,
      updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
}

export const selfServiceEpisodeService = new SelfServiceEpisodeService();

/**
 * CardioLab G4 — Self-Service Recovery Service
 *
 * Implements typed recovery descriptors for all 18 recovery classes,
 * ensures non-destructive data preservation, sanitizes PII/paths,
 * and tracks truthful support burden.
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  RecoveryDescriptor,
  RecoveryClass,
  SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';
import {
  recordSelfServiceSupportRecord,
  getSelfServiceSupportRecords,
  getSelfServiceEpisode,
  updateSelfServiceEpisode
} from '../db/db';

export class SelfServiceRecoveryService {
  /**
   * Sanitizes strings to prevent leaking local filesystem paths or PII
   */
  public sanitizeMessage(input: string): string {
    if (!input) return '';
    // Redact Windows and Unix file paths
    let sanitized = input.replace(/[A-Za-z]:\\[^ \t\r\n'"]+/g, '[REDACTED_LOCAL_PATH]');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/\/[^ \t\r\n'"]+\/[^ \t\r\n'"]+/g, '[REDACTED_PATH]');
    return sanitized;
  }

  /**
   * Builds a canonical RecoveryDescriptor for a specified recovery class
   */
  public buildDescriptor(params: {
    recovery_class: RecoveryClass;
    affected_identity: { type: string; id: string };
    customMessageRu?: string;
    customMessageEn?: string;
    retryCommand?: string;
  }): RecoveryDescriptor {
    const recoveryId = `rec-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const correlationId = `corr-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;

    let userSummaryRu = '';
    let userSummaryEn = '';
    let technicalCode = '';
    let fallbackAction = 'return_to_intake';
    let prerequisites: string[] = [];
    let escalationThreshold = 3;

    switch (params.recovery_class) {
      case 'unsupported_import':
        userSummaryRu = 'Формат файла не поддерживается или поврежден. Используйте стандартный CSV от Polar H10.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Unsupported file format. Please use standard Polar H10 CSV recording.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_UNSUPPORTED_IMPORT_FORMAT';
        prerequisites = ['check_file_format'];
        break;

      case 'stale_import':
        userSummaryRu = 'Параметры предварительной проверки устарели. Запустите проверку заново.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Preflight parameters became stale. Please re-run preflight.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_STALE_PREFLIGHT_FINGERPRINT';
        prerequisites = ['refresh_preflight'];
        break;

      case 'duplicate_import':
        userSummaryRu = 'Эта сессия уже была импортирована. Вы можете открыть существующую сессию.';
        userSummaryEn = 'This session was already imported. You may open existing session.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_DUPLICATE_SOURCE_RECORDING';
        fallbackAction = 'open_existing_session';
        break;

      case 'source_moved':
        userSummaryRu = 'Исходный файл перемещен, но его содержимое идентично. Выполните повторную привязку пути.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Source file moved with identical content. Re-link to verified path.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_SOURCE_FILE_MOVED';
        fallbackAction = 'relink_source_path';
        prerequisites = ['verify_new_path'];
        break;

      case 'source_changed':
        userSummaryRu = 'Содержимое исходного файла изменилось после импорта. Создана новая ревизия сессии.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Source file content changed after import. New session revision created.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_SOURCE_BYTES_MUTATED';
        break;

      case 'source_unavailable':
        userSummaryRu = 'Исходный файл сессии не найден на диске. Проверьте подключение накопителя.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Session source file not found on disk. Check storage connection.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_SOURCE_FILE_UNAVAILABLE';
        prerequisites = ['restore_storage_connection'];
        break;

      case 'result_stale':
        userSummaryRu = 'Канонический результат устарел после обновления правил. Требуется пересчет.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Canonical result is stale after boundary update. Recomputation required.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_CANONICAL_RESULT_STALE';
        fallbackAction = 'recompute_canonical_session';
        prerequisites = ['trigger_recalculation'];
        break;

      case 'result_partial':
        userSummaryRu = 'Расчет завершился с частичными ограничениями. Часть метрик недоступна.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Analysis finished with partial limitations. Some metrics withheld.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_PARTIAL_RESULT_METRICS';
        break;

      case 'result_withheld':
        userSummaryRu = 'Качество сигнала недостаточно для некоторых аналитических выводов.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Signal quality insufficient for definitive physiological inference.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_QC_METRIC_WITHHELD';
        break;

      case 'window_conflict':
        userSummaryRu = 'Конфликт ревизий аналитического окна. Черновик сохранен как отдельная ревизия.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Analytical window revision conflict. Draft preserved as new revision.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_WINDOW_REVISION_CONFLICT';
        fallbackAction = 'select_latest_revision';
        break;

      case 'comparison_not_ready':
        userSummaryRu = 'Для сравнительного анализа требуется как минимум 2 независимые сессии.';
        userSummaryEn = 'At least 2 independent sessions are required for comparative analysis.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_COMPARISON_INSUFFICIENT_PEERS';
        prerequisites = ['import_second_session'];
        break;

      case 'comparison_stale':
        userSummaryRu = 'Сессия-партнер была обновлена или пересчитана. Требуется обновить сравнение.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Comparison partner was updated or recomputed. Re-comparison required.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_COMPARISON_PARTNER_STALE';
        break;

      case 'preview_expired':
        userSummaryRu = 'Время предварительного просмотра истекло. Сформируйте предпросмотр заново.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Preview lease expired. Please refresh preview.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_PREVIEW_LEASE_EXPIRED';
        break;

      case 'pack_missing':
        userSummaryRu = 'Файл AI-пакета отсутствует в локальном хранилище. Выполните повторный экспорт.';
        userSummaryEn = 'AI interpretation pack missing from local storage. Re-export required.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_AI_PACK_MISSING';
        prerequisites = ['recompile_pack'];
        break;

      case 'pack_corrupt':
        userSummaryRu = 'Контрольная сумма AI-пакета не совпадает. Сформируйте пакет заново.';
        userSummaryEn = 'AI pack checksum mismatch. Re-compilation required.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_AI_PACK_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH';
        prerequisites = ['recompile_pack'];
        break;

      case 'job_interrupted':
        userSummaryRu = 'Фоновая задача была прервана или остановлена. Возобновите процесс с последней контрольной точки.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Durable job was interrupted or cancelled. Resume from checkpoint or restart.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_DURABLE_JOB_INTERRUPTED';
        fallbackAction = 'resume_durable_job';
        prerequisites = ['check_durable_checkpoint'];
        break;

      case 'diary_historical':
        userSummaryRu = 'Связанная сессия дневника обновлена. Запись переведена в статус архивной.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Bound diary session was updated. Entry marked as historical.';
        technicalCode = 'INFO_DIARY_LINEAGE_HISTORICAL';
        break;

      case 'diary_unlinked':
        userSummaryRu = 'Запись дневника не привязана к канонической сессии.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Diary entry is not linked to a canonical session.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_DIARY_ENTRY_UNLINKED';
        break;

      case 'entitlement_boundary':
        userSummaryRu = 'Срок действия пробного периода завершен. Просмотр и экспорт данных остаются доступными.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Trial period has ended. Existing data view and export remain fully accessible.';
        technicalCode = 'INFO_ENTITLEMENT_TRIAL_EXPIRED';
        fallbackAction = 'view_existing_data';
        break;

      case 'db_integrity_warning':
        userSummaryRu = 'Обнаружено предупреждение целостности базы данных. Создайте снимок безопасности и резервную копию.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Database integrity warning detected. Create safety snapshot and backup.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_DATABASE_INTEGRITY_WARNING';
        fallbackAction = 'create_safety_snapshot';
        prerequisites = ['check_db_integrity'];
        break;

      case 'backup_incompatible':
        userSummaryRu = 'Резервная копия несовместима с текущей версией или повреждена. Рабочее пространство не изменено.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Backup incompatible or tampered. Live workspace left untouched.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_BACKUP_INCOMPATIBLE';
        fallbackAction = 'inspect_backup_manifest';
        prerequisites = ['verify_backup_signature'];
        break;

      case 'storage_warning':
        userSummaryRu = 'На диске осталось мало свободного места для сохранения новых сессий.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Low disk space warning for new session storage.';
        technicalCode = 'WARN_STORAGE_LOW_SPACE';
        break;

      case 'unexpected_error':
      default:
        userSummaryRu = 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка. Данные сохранены в исходном виде.';
        userSummaryEn = 'Unexpected error occurred. Data preserved without modification.';
        technicalCode = 'ERR_UNEXPECTED_EXCEPTION';
        break;
    }

    if (params.customMessageRu) userSummaryRu = this.sanitizeMessage(params.customMessageRu);
    if (params.customMessageEn) userSummaryEn = this.sanitizeMessage(params.customMessageEn);

    return {
      recovery_id: recoveryId,
      recovery_class: params.recovery_class,
      user_summary_ru: userSummaryRu,
      user_summary_en: userSummaryEn,
      technical_code: technicalCode,
      affected_identity: params.affected_identity,
      data_preserved: true, // Non-destructive contract guarantee
      retry_command: params.retryCommand,
      prerequisites,
      fallback_action: fallbackAction,
      escalation_threshold: escalationThreshold,
      correlation_id: correlationId,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * Attaches a recovery descriptor to an episode
   */
  public attachRecoveryToEpisode(episodeId: string, descriptor: RecoveryDescriptor): void {
    const episode = getSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId);
    if (!episode) return;

    const history = [descriptor, ...episode.recovery_history];
    updateSelfServiceEpisode(episodeId, {
      lifecycle_state: 'failed_recoverable',
      recovery_history: history
    });

    // Record support tracking event
    this.recordSupportEvent({
      episode_id: episodeId,
      profile_id: episode.profile_id,
      event_type: 'recovery_offered',
      descriptor,
      user_minutes: 0.1,
      operator_minutes: 0.0 // Strictly zero operator burden for self-service
    });
  }

  /**
   * Records a support tracking event with strict separation of user vs operator minutes
   */
  public recordSupportEvent(params: {
    episode_id: string;
    profile_id: string;
    event_type: 'recovery_offered' | 'recovery_attempted' | 'resolved_self_service' | 'resolved_with_guidance' | 'defect' | 'unsupported' | 'unresolved';
    descriptor: RecoveryDescriptor;
    user_minutes?: number;
    operator_minutes?: number;
  }): void {
    const recordId = `rec-evt-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    recordSelfServiceSupportRecord({
      record_id: recordId,
      episode_id: params.episode_id,
      profile_id: params.profile_id,
      event_type: params.event_type,
      recovery_descriptor_json: JSON.stringify(params.descriptor),
      user_minutes_spent: params.user_minutes ?? 0.0,
      operator_minutes_spent: params.operator_minutes ?? 0.0,
      created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates support burden summary
   * Truth preservation: If 0 records exist, returns 'not_observed' with undefined minutes!
   */
  public evaluateSupportBurden(episodeId?: string): {
    observation_status: 'observed' | 'not_observed';
    total_episodes: number;
    user_minutes?: number;
    operator_minutes?: number;
  } {
    const records = getSelfServiceSupportRecords(episodeId);
    if (records.length === 0) {
      return {
        observation_status: 'not_observed',
        total_episodes: 0,
        user_minutes: undefined,
        operator_minutes: undefined
      };
    }

    const totalUser = records.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.user_minutes_spent || 0), 0);
    const totalOperator = records.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.operator_minutes_spent || 0), 0);

    return {
      observation_status: 'observed',
      total_episodes: records.length,
      user_minutes: Math.round(totalUser * 10) / 10,
      operator_minutes: Math.round(totalOperator * 10) / 10
    };
  }
}

export const selfServiceRecoveryService = new SelfServiceRecoveryService();

import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { initDb } from './db/db';
import { apiRouter } from './api/routes';
import { logger } from './logging/appLogger';

export interface RequestSpanTiming {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  status: number;
  durationMs: number;
  traceId: string;
  ts: string;
}

const MAX_SPAN_TIMINGS = 500;
const requestSpanTimings: RequestSpanTiming[] = [];

export function getRequestSpanTimings(): RequestSpanTiming[] {
  return [...requestSpanTimings];
}

/**
 * Compares two tokens in constant time using crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks.
 */
export function safeCompareTokens(provided?: string | null, expected?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!provided || !expected || typeof provided !== 'string' || typeof expected !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }
  const bufProvided = Buffer.from(provided, 'utf8');
  const bufExpected = Buffer.from(expected, 'utf8');
  if (bufProvided.length !== bufExpected.length) {
    return false;
  }
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufProvided, bufExpected);
}

export function startServer(port: number, token: string, frontendDistPath?: string) {
  const app = express();

  // Correlation ID and request latency telemetry middleware
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    const traceId = (req.headers['x-trace-id'] as string) || crypto.randomUUID();
    (req as any).traceId = traceId;
    res.setHeader('X-Trace-Id', traceId);

    const startHr = process.hrtime();
    const startTimeMs = Date.now();

    res.on('finish', () => {
      const diff = process.hrtime(startHr);
      const durationMs = Math.round((diff[0] * 1e3 + diff[1] * 1e-6) * 100) / 100;

      const span: RequestSpanTiming = {
        method: req.method,
        path: req.originalUrl || req.url,
        status: res.statusCode,
        durationMs,
        traceId,
        ts: new Date(startTimeMs).toISOString()
      };

      requestSpanTimings.push(span);
      if (requestSpanTimings.length > MAX_SPAN_TIMINGS) {
        requestSpanTimings.shift();
      }

      // Log slow requests (> 1000ms)
      if (durationMs > 1000 && req.path.startsWith('/api')) {
        logger.warn('diagnostics', `Slow request detected: ${req.method} ${req.path} (${durationMs}ms)`, {
          traceId,
          code: 'SLOW_HTTP_REQUEST',
          details: {
            method: req.method,
            path: req.path,
            status: res.statusCode,
            durationMs
          }
        });
      }
    });

    next();
  });

  // Local loopback restriction
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    const ip = req.socket.remoteAddress || '';
    const isLoopback =
      ip === '127.0.0.1' ||
      ip === '::1' ||
      ip === '::ffff:127.0.0.1' ||
      ip.startsWith('::ffff:127.');
    if (!isLoopback) {
      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Access denied: loopback only' });
      return;
    }
    next();
  });

  // Host and Origin validation
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    const host = req.headers['host'];
    const origin = req.headers['origin'];

    if (!host) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: missing Host header' });
      return;
    }

    const hostName = host.split(':')[0].toLowerCase();
    const isAllowedHost =
      hostName === '127.0.0.1' ||
      hostName === 'localhost' ||
      hostName === '::1' ||
      hostName === '[::1]';
    if (!isAllowedHost) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: invalid Host header' });
      return;
    }

    if (origin) {
      try {
        const originUrl = new URL(origin);
        const isAllowedOrigin =
          originUrl.hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
          originUrl.hostname === 'localhost' ||
          (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && originUrl.port === '5173');
        if (!isAllowedOrigin) {
          res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: invalid Origin header' });
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        res.status(400).json({ error: 'Access denied: malformed Origin header' });
        return;
      }
    }
    next();
  });

  // Token authentication middleware for all API requests
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (req.path.startsWith('/api')) {
      const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
      let reqToken: string | undefined;
      if (typeof authHeader === 'string' && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
        reqToken = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
      }

      // Browser source-runtime cookie fallback
      if (!reqToken && req.headers['cookie']) {
        const cookies = req.headers['cookie'].split(';');
        for (const c of cookies) {
          const [k, v] = c.trim().split('=');
          if (k === 'cardiolab_token' && v) {
            reqToken = decodeURIComponent(v);
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!reqToken || !safeCompareTokens(reqToken, token)) {
        res.status(401).json({ error: 'Access denied: invalid or missing token' });
        return;
      }
    }
    next();
  });

  // CORS Configuration (limited to development mode if needed)
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
    app.use(cors({ origin: ['http://localhost:5173', 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'] }));
  }

  app.use(express.json({ limit: '256kb' }));

  // Fail-closed JSON parsing and entity size error handler
  app.use((err: any, req: express.Request, res: express.Response, next: express.NextFunction) => {
    if (err instanceof SyntaxError && (err as any).status === 400 && 'body' in err) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Malformed JSON payload' });
      return;
    }
    if (err && (err.type === 'entity.too.large' || err.status === 413)) {
      res.status(413).json({ error: 'Payload too large: maximum allowed body is 256kb' });
      return;
    }
    next(err);
  });

  app.use('/api', apiRouter);

  // Catch-all for missing /api routes to ensure JSON 404, never SPA index.html
  app.use('/api/*', (req, res) => {
    res.status(404).json({ error: `API route not found: ${req.baseUrl}${req.path}` });
  });

  app.use('/reports/*', (req, res) => {
    res.status(404).json({ error: `Report route not found: ${req.baseUrl}${req.path}` });
  });

  let FRONTEND_DIST = frontendDistPath || path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist/frontend');
  if (!fs.existsSync(FRONTEND_DIST)) {
    const candidate1 = path.resolve(__dirname, '../frontend');
    const candidate2 = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../frontend');
    if (fs.existsSync(candidate1)) FRONTEND_DIST = candidate1;
    else if (fs.existsSync(candidate2)) FRONTEND_DIST = candidate2;
  }

  // Set cardiolab_token session cookie on root entrypoint for direct browser access
  app.get('/', (req, res, next) => {
    res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', `cardiolab_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`);
    next();
  });

  if (fs.existsSync(FRONTEND_DIST)) {
    app.use(express.static(FRONTEND_DIST, {
      setHeaders: (res, filePath) => {
        if (filePath.endsWith('index.html')) {
          res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', `cardiolab_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`);
        }
      }
    }));
    app.get('*', (req, res) => {
      const reqPath = req.path || '';
      if (
        reqPath.startsWith('/api') ||
        reqPath.startsWith('/reports') ||
        /\.(json|csv|zip|pdf|png|gz|txt|db)$/i.test(reqPath)
      ) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: `Resource not found: ${reqPath}` });
        return;
      }
      res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', `cardiolab_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`);
      res.sendFile(path.join(FRONTEND_DIST, 'index.html'));
    });
  } else {
    app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
      res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', `cardiolab_token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`);
      res.send('<p>Backend OK.</p>');
    });
  }

  try {
    initDb();
    logger.info('diagnostics', 'Database initialized');
    try {
      const { AiWorkspaceService } = require('./llmPack/aiWorkspaceService');
      const interruptedPacks = AiWorkspaceService.reconcileInterruptedJobs();
      if (interruptedPacks > 0) {
        logger.info('llm_pack', `Reconciled ${interruptedPacks} interrupted AI pack compilation jobs on startup`);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    // Start background recompute catch-up after 1.5s delay (non-blocking)
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const { HistoricalSessionRecomputeService } = require('./migration/historicalSessionRecomputeService');
        const { needsRecompute } = HistoricalSessionRecomputeService.getCandidateSessionIds();
        if (needsRecompute.length > 0) {
          HistoricalSessionRecomputeService.startBackgroundRecompute();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }, 1500);
    // Start external folder auto sync after 2.0s delay (non-blocking)
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const { externalFolderSyncService } = require('./sync/externalFolderSyncService');
        externalFolderSyncService.start();
      } catch (e) {}
    }, 2000);
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('diagnostics', 'Failed to initialize database', { details: { error: err.message } });
    throw err;
  }

  const server = app.listen(port, '127.0.0.1');
  return server;
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const PORT = parseInt(process.env.PORT || '3141', 10);
  const TOKEN = process.env.TOKEN || 'dev-token-xyz';
  startServer(PORT, TOKEN);
  console.log(`[H10 Cardio Lab] API server running at http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
}

FILE: src/backend/sessionizer/sessionizer.ts

import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { 
  getUngroupedFiles, 
  saveSession, 
  saveSessionSignals, 
  IngestedFileMetadata, 
  SessionMetadata 
} from '../db/db';
import { runQcForSession } from '../qc/coordinator';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';

interface SessionGroup {
  files: IngestedFileMetadata[];
  startTime: number; // epoch ms
  endTime: number; // epoch ms
}

/**
 * Scans ungrouped files in the database, clusters them into logical sessions,
 * registers the sessions and file mappings, and runs Quality Control (QC).
 */
export async function groupIngestedFilesIntoSessions(): Promise<void> {
  const files = getUngroupedFiles();
  if (files.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  // 1. Group files by device_id
  const filesByDevice: Record<string, IngestedFileMetadata[]> = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!filesByDevice[file.device_id]) {
      filesByDevice[file.device_id] = [];
    }
    filesByDevice[file.device_id].push(file);
  }

  // 2. Process sessions device by device
  for (const deviceId of Object.keys(filesByDevice)) {
    const sorted = filesByDevice[deviceId].sort((a, b) => {
      return new Date(a.start_time).getTime() - new Date(b.start_time).getTime();
    });

    const groups: SessionGroup[] = [];

    for (const file of sorted) {
      const fileStart = new Date(file.start_time).getTime();
      const fileEnd = new Date(file.end_time).getTime();

      let added = false;
      for (const group of groups) {
        // Group files if start time is within 300 seconds of session bounds OR if ranges overlap
        const startDiff = Math.abs(fileStart - group.startTime) / 1000;
        const endDiff = Math.abs(fileStart - group.endTime) / 1000;
        
        const isWithinWindow = startDiff <= 300 || endDiff <= 300;
        const isOverlapping = (fileStart <= group.endTime && fileEnd >= group.startTime);

        if (isWithinWindow || isOverlapping) {
          group.files.push(file);
          group.startTime = Math.min(group.startTime, fileStart);
          group.endTime = Math.max(group.endTime, fileEnd);
          added = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!added) {
        groups.push({
          files: [file],
          startTime: fileStart,
          endTime: fileEnd
        });
      }
    }

    // 3. Save session groups and trigger QC
    for (const group of groups) {
      const sessionId = randomUUID();

      // Find exact min start and max end strings from source files to preserve formatting
      let minStartStr = group.files[0].start_time;
      let maxEndStr = group.files[0].end_time;
      for (const f of group.files) {
        if (new Date(f.start_time).getTime() < new Date(minStartStr).getTime()) {
          minStartStr = f.start_time;
        }
        if (new Date(f.end_time).getTime() > new Date(maxEndStr).getTime()) {
          maxEndStr = f.end_time;
        }
      }

      const session: SessionMetadata = {
        id: sessionId,
        device_id: deviceId,
        start_time: minStartStr,
        end_time: maxEndStr,
        duration_seconds: (group.endTime - group.startTime) / 1000,
        overall_quality_score: 100.0 // Placeholder, will be updated by QC coordinator
      };

      logger.info('sessionizer', `Created session group for device ${deviceId}`, { sessionId, details: { fileCount: group.files.length } });

      const fileTypes = group.files.map(f => f.signal_type || '');
      const uniqueTypes = new Set(fileTypes);
      if (uniqueTypes.size !== fileTypes.length) {
        logger.warn('sessionizer', `Duplicate signal types detected in session group`, { sessionId, details: { fileTypes } });
      }

      saveSession(session);
      saveSessionSignals(sessionId, group.files.map(f => f.id));

      // Run Quality Control analysis on the newly created session
      await runQcForSession(sessionId);
    }
  }
}

import { getAppSetting, setAppSetting } from '../db/db';
import {
  UserDisplayPreferences,
  DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES,
  USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  validateUserDisplayPreferences
} from '../../shared/canonical/UserPreferencesContract';
import { logger } from '../logging/appLogger';

const SETTINGS_KEY = 'user_display_preferences';

export class OptimisticConcurrencyError extends Error {
  public code = 'OPTIMISTIC_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT';
  public currentRevision: number;
  public expectedRevision: number;

  constructor(currentRevision: number, expectedRevision: number) {
    super(`Settings revision conflict: expected ${expectedRevision}, but current is ${currentRevision}`);
    this.name = 'OptimisticConcurrencyError';
    this.currentRevision = currentRevision;
    this.expectedRevision = expectedRevision;
  }
}

/**
 * Returns the current authoritative user display preferences from SQLite app_settings.
 */
export function getUserPreferences(): UserDisplayPreferences {
  try {
    const raw = getAppSetting(SETTINGS_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      return { ...DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES };
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return {
      schema_version: USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      settings_revision: typeof parsed.settings_revision === 'number' ? parsed.settings_revision : 1,
      display_language: parsed.display_language === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ru',
      display_locale: parsed.display_locale === 'en-US' ? 'en-US' : (parsed.display_locale === 'en-GB' ? 'en-GB' : 'ru-RU'),
      display_timezone: parsed.display_timezone || 'UTC',
      updated_at_utc: parsed.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.warn('ui', `Failed to parse ${SETTINGS_KEY}, returning defaults: ${err.message}`);
    return { ...DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES };
  }
}

/**
 * Updates user display preferences with validation and optimistic concurrency control.
 */
export function updateUserPreferences(
  patch: Partial<UserDisplayPreferences>,
  expectedRevision?: number
): UserDisplayPreferences {
  const validation = validateUserDisplayPreferences(patch);
  if (!validation.valid) {
    const err = new Error(validation.error || 'Invalid preferences payload');
    (err as any).statusCode = 400;
    throw err;
  }

  const current = getUserPreferences();

  if (expectedRevision !== undefined && expectedRevision !== null) {
    if (current.settings_revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new OptimisticConcurrencyError(current.settings_revision, expectedRevision);
    }
  }

  const nextRevision = current.settings_revision + 1;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const next: UserDisplayPreferences = {
    schema_version: USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    settings_revision: nextRevision,
    display_language: patch.display_language || current.display_language,
    display_locale: patch.display_locale || current.display_locale,
    display_timezone: patch.display_timezone !== undefined ? patch.display_timezone : current.display_timezone,
    updated_at_utc: now
  };

  setAppSetting(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));

  logger.info('ui', `Updated user display preferences to revision ${nextRevision}`, {
    details: {
      language: next.display_language,
      locale: next.display_locale,
      timezone: next.display_timezone
    }
  });

  return next;
}

/**
 * Migrates existing renderer localStorage language setting to the authoritative store if not yet set.
 */
export function migratePreferencesFromLocalStorage(localStorageLang?: string): UserDisplayPreferences {
  const raw = getAppSetting(SETTINGS_KEY);
  if (raw) {
    return getUserPreferences(); // Already initialized
  }

  if (localStorageLang === 'en' || localStorageLang === 'ru') {
    const initial: UserDisplayPreferences = {
      schema_version: USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      settings_revision: 1,
      display_language: localStorageLang,
      display_locale: localStorageLang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU',
      display_timezone: 'UTC',
      updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    setAppSetting(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(initial));
    logger.info('ui', `Migrated display language from renderer localStorage: ${localStorageLang}`);
    return initial;
  }

  return getUserPreferences();
}

FILE: src/backend/signals/ecgStripSelection.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';

/**
 * Prioritizes selecting the best-quality 10-second ECG segment (1300 samples at 130 Hz).
 * Prefers segments outside the first 60s stabilization window, falling back to full-range search only if needed.
 */
export function getBestEcgStrip(
  ecgPoints: { timeMs: number; ecgUv: number }[],
  sessionStartMs?: number
): { timeMs: number; ecgUv: number }[] {
  if (ecgPoints.length === 0) return [];
  if (ecgPoints.length <= 1300) {
    return ecgPoints;
  }

  const startMs = sessionStartMs ?? ecgPoints[0].timeMs;
  const stabilizationCutoff = startMs + 60000;

  let bestIdx = 0;
  let minPenalty = Infinity;
  let hasPointsOutsideStab = false;

  // 1. Try to find the best segment outside the stabilization window
  for (let i = 0; i <= ecgPoints.length - 1300; i += 130) {
    const slice = ecgPoints.slice(i, i + 1300);
    const sliceStartMs = slice[0].timeMs;
    
    if (sliceStartMs < stabilizationCutoff) {
      continue;
    }
    
    hasPointsOutsideStab = true;

    // Count clipped points
    const clips = slice.filter(p => Math.abs(p.ecgUv) >= 19500).length;
    
    // Calculate differences
    const diffs: number[] = [];
    const vals: number[] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < slice.length; j++) {
      vals.push(slice[j].ecgUv);
      if (j > 0) {
        diffs.push(slice[j].ecgUv - slice[j - 1].ecgUv);
      }
    }
    
    // Variance of differences (HF noise indicator)
    const meanDiff = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / diffs.length;
    const varDiff = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - meanDiff) ** 2, 0) / diffs.length;

    // Range of values (Baseline drift/wander indicator)
    const maxVal = Math.max(...vals);
    const minVal = Math.min(...vals);
    const range = maxVal - minVal;

    // Variance of values (to penalize flatlines)
    const meanVal = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length;
    const varVal = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - meanVal) ** 2, 0) / vals.length;

    // Calculate score penalty
    let penalty = clips * 1000000 + varDiff * 10 + Math.abs(range - 1500);
    if (varVal < 500) {
      penalty += 10000000;
    }

    if (penalty < minPenalty) {
      minPenalty = penalty;
      bestIdx = i;
    }
  }

  // 2. Fallback to scanning full range if no segment could be found outside stabilization cutoff
  if (!hasPointsOutsideStab) {
    minPenalty = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i <= ecgPoints.length - 1300; i += 130) {
      const slice = ecgPoints.slice(i, i + 1300);
      const clips = slice.filter(p => Math.abs(p.ecgUv) >= 19500).length;
      
      const diffs: number[] = [];
      const vals: number[] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < slice.length; j++) {
        vals.push(slice[j].ecgUv);
        if (j > 0) {
          diffs.push(slice[j].ecgUv - slice[j - 1].ecgUv);
        }
      }
      
      const meanDiff = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / diffs.length;
      const varDiff = diffs.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - meanDiff) ** 2, 0) / diffs.length;

      const maxVal = Math.max(...vals);
      const minVal = Math.min(...vals);
      const range = maxVal - minVal;

      const meanVal = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length;
      const varVal = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - meanVal) ** 2, 0) / vals.length;

      let penalty = clips * 1000000 + varDiff * 10 + Math.abs(range - 1500);
      if (varVal < 500) {
        penalty += 10000000;
      }

      if (penalty < minPenalty) {
        minPenalty = penalty;
        bestIdx = i;
      }
    }
  }

  return ecgPoints.slice(bestIdx, bestIdx + 1300);
}

FILE: src/backend/signals/rawLogClassifier.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export type RawLogSchemaType =
  | 'RR_TEXT_STREAM'
  | 'ECG_TEXT_STREAM'
  | 'ACC_TEXT_STREAM'
  | 'HR_TEXT_STREAM'
  | 'UNKNOWN'
  | 'MALFORMED';

export type SignalType = 'RR' | 'ECG' | 'ACC' | 'HR' | 'UNKNOWN' | 'MALFORMED';

export interface RawLogContentClassification {
  schema_type: RawLogSchemaType;
  signal_type: SignalType;
  unit?: string;
  sample_rate_hz?: number;
  delimiter: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface RawLogFileClassification {
  filename: string;
  full_path: string;
  linked_ingested_file_id: string | null;
  filename_expected_type: SignalType;
  detected_schema: RawLogSchemaType;
  detected_signal_type: SignalType;
  schema_match: boolean;
  compressed_size_bytes: number;
  decompressed_row_count: number;
  sha256: string;
  header_preview: string;
  is_test_fixture_suspect: boolean;
  contamination_reason?: string | null;
}

export function classifyRawLogContent(firstLine: string, sampleLines: string[] = []): RawLogContentClassification {
  // Strip BOM if present
  let line = (firstLine || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
  const cleanedSamples = sampleLines.map(l => l.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const allLines = [line, ...cleanedSamples];

  // Sniff delimiter: ;, ,, \t
  let delimiter = ';';
  const semiCount = (line.match(/;/g) || []).length;
  const commaCount = (line.match(/,/g) || []).length;
  const tabCount = (line.match(/\t/g) || []).length;
  if (commaCount > semiCount && commaCount > tabCount) delimiter = ',';
  else if (tabCount > semiCount && tabCount > commaCount) delimiter = '\t';

  const lowerLine = line.toLowerCase();

  // 1. Explicit Header Checks
  if (lowerLine.includes('rr-interval [ms]') || lowerLine.includes('rr-interval') || lowerLine.includes('rr_interval') || lowerLine.includes('rr_ms') || lowerLine.includes('rr [ms]') || /\brr\b/.test(lowerLine)) {
    return { schema_type: 'RR_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'RR', unit: 'ms', delimiter };
  }
  if (lowerLine.includes('ecg [uv]') || lowerLine.includes('ecg_uv') || lowerLine.includes('ecg')) {
    return { schema_type: 'ECG_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'ECG', unit: 'uV', sample_rate_hz: 130, delimiter };
  }
  if (lowerLine.includes('x [mg]') || lowerLine.includes('y [mg]') || lowerLine.includes('z [mg]') || lowerLine.includes('x_mg') || lowerLine.includes('y_mg') || lowerLine.includes('z_mg')) {
    return { schema_type: 'ACC_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'ACC', unit: 'mg', delimiter };
  }
  if (lowerLine.includes('hr [bpm]') || lowerLine.includes('hrv [ms]') || lowerLine.includes('heart rate [bpm]') || lowerLine.includes('hr_bpm')) {
    return { schema_type: 'HR_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'HR', unit: 'bpm', delimiter };
  }

  // 2. Pattern Matching across all lines (semicolon, comma, tab)
  for (const sLine of allLines) {
    if (!sLine) continue;
    const parts = sLine.split(/[;,\t]/).map(p => p.trim());
    if (parts.length >= 2 && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(parts[0])) {
      // ECG: 3 or 4 columns with negative/positive uV values (e.g. timestamp;phone_timestamp;sample_idx;ecg)
      if (parts.length >= 3 && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[parts.length - 1]) && parts.length <= 4) {
        const val = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
        // ECG raw uV can be negative or positive, often around -500 to +1500
        if (parts.length === 4 && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[2]) && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[3])) {
          return { schema_type: 'ECG_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'ECG', unit: 'uV', sample_rate_hz: 130, delimiter };
        }
      }
      // ACC: 3 acceleration axes X, Y, Z (e.g. timestamp;phone_timestamp;x;y;z)
      if (parts.length >= 5 && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[2]) && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[3]) && /^-?\d+$/.test(parts[4])) {
        return { schema_type: 'ACC_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'ACC', unit: 'mg', delimiter };
      }
      // HR: timestamp;hr;hrv (e.g. 2026-08-30;72;820)
      if (parts.length === 3 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[1]) && /^\d+$/.test(parts[2])) {
        const hr = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
        if (hr >= 30 && hr <= 240) {
          return { schema_type: 'HR_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'HR', unit: 'bpm', delimiter };
        }
      }
      // RR: timestamp;rr (single RR value in ms, e.g. 2026-08-30...;845 or 845.2)
      if (parts.length === 2 && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(parts[1])) {
        return { schema_type: 'RR_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'RR', unit: 'ms', delimiter };
      }
      if (parts.length >= 4 && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(parts[parts.length - 1])) {
        const rrVal = parseFloat(parts[parts.length - 1]);
        if (rrVal >= 200 && rrVal <= 3000) {
          return { schema_type: 'RR_TEXT_STREAM', signal_type: 'RR', unit: 'ms', delimiter };
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return { schema_type: 'UNKNOWN', signal_type: 'UNKNOWN', delimiter: 'unknown' };
}

export function classifyRawLogFile(filePath: string): RawLogFileClassification {
  const fname = path.basename(filePath);
  const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
  const sizeBytes = stat.size;
  const fileBytes = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
  const fileSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBytes).digest('hex');

  const lowerName = fname.toLowerCase();
  let expectedType: SignalType = 'UNKNOWN';
  if (lowerName.includes('_rr.') || lowerName.endsWith('_rr.txt.gz')) expectedType = 'RR';
  else if (lowerName.includes('_ecg.') || lowerName.endsWith('_ecg.txt.gz')) expectedType = 'ECG';
  else if (lowerName.includes('_acc.') || lowerName.endsWith('_acc.txt.gz')) expectedType = 'ACC';
  else if (lowerName.includes('_hr.') || lowerName.endsWith('_hr.txt.gz')) expectedType = 'HR';

  let fileIdPrefix: string | null = null;
  const matchId = fname.match(/^([0-9a-fA-F-]+)_(rr|ecg|acc|hr)\./i);
  if (matchId) {
    fileIdPrefix = matchId[1];
  }

  let rowCount = 0;
  let headerLine = '';
  let sampleLines: string[] = [];
  let isMalformed = false;
  let schemaInfo: RawLogContentClassification = { schema_type: 'UNKNOWN', signal_type: 'UNKNOWN', delimiter: ';' };

  if (sizeBytes === 0) {
    isMalformed = true;
    schemaInfo = { schema_type: 'MALFORMED', signal_type: 'MALFORMED', delimiter: 'none', error: 'Empty file (0 bytes)' };
  } else {
    try {
      const decompressed = zlib.gunzipSync(fileBytes);
      const text = decompressed.toString('utf8');
      const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0);
      headerLine = lines[0] || '';
      sampleLines = lines.slice(1, 10);
      schemaInfo = classifyRawLogContent(headerLine, sampleLines);
      if (headerLine.includes('timestamp') || headerLine.includes('Phone')) {
        rowCount = Math.max(0, lines.length - 1);
      } else {
        rowCount = lines.length;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      isMalformed = true;
      schemaInfo = { schema_type: 'MALFORMED', signal_type: 'MALFORMED', delimiter: 'none', error: err.message };
    }
  }

  // Header/Schema wins over filename when they conflict
  const detectedSignalType = schemaInfo.signal_type;
  const schemaMatch = expectedType === detectedSignalType;

  // Structural contamination check (inspects header AND sample lines)
  const isFixtureContent = sampleLines.some(l => l.includes('2026-06-18 09:50:00.000')) ||
                           headerLine.includes('2026-06-18 09:50:00.000');
  const isFixtureName = fname.includes('acceptance') || fname.includes('fixture') || fname.includes('test_') || fname.includes('sample_polar_session');
  const isTestFixture = isFixtureContent || (isFixtureName && sizeBytes < 200);

  return {
    filename: fname,
    full_path: filePath,
    linked_ingested_file_id: fileIdPrefix,
    filename_expected_type: expectedType,
    detected_schema: schemaInfo.schema_type,
    detected_signal_type: detectedSignalType,
    schema_match: schemaMatch,
    compressed_size_bytes: sizeBytes,
    decompressed_row_count: rowCount,
    sha256: fileSha,
    header_preview: headerLine.substring(0, 100),
    is_test_fixture_suspect: isTestFixture,
    contamination_reason: isTestFixture ? (isFixtureContent ? 'Matches known test fixture timestamps' : 'Known test fixture name/size') : null
  };
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import { parseCanonicalRRRow } from '../../shared/canonical/CanonicalRRParser';
import { parseRawTimestamp } from '../../shared/canonical/TemporalContract';

export interface ParseOptions {
  startMs?: number;
  endMs?: number;
}

export interface ECGPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  ecgUv: number;
  sensorTsNs?: number;
  phoneTimestampMs?: number;
  relMs?: number;
}

export interface CanonicalEcgSeries {
  sample_rate_hz: number;
  samples_uv: number[];
  canonical_timestamps_ms: number[];
  phone_timestamps_ms?: number[];
  sensor_timestamps_ns?: number[];
  total_samples: number;
  timebase_type: 'sensor_relative_milliseconds' | 'phone_epoch_milliseconds';
  timebase_provenance: {
    axis: 'sensor_relative_milliseconds' | 'phone_epoch_milliseconds';
    sensor_monotonic_nanoseconds_available: boolean;
    phone_epoch_milliseconds_available: boolean;
    relative_milliseconds_available: boolean;
    is_monotonic: boolean;
    duration_seconds: number;
  };
}

/**
 * Parses raw ECG text lines into a structured CanonicalEcgSeries with derived clock domain availability.
 */
export function parseCanonicalEcgText(text: string): CanonicalEcgSeries {
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const samples_uv: number[] = [];
  const canonical_timestamps_ms: number[] = [];
  const phone_timestamps_ms: number[] = [];
  const sensor_timestamps_ns: number[] = [];

  let hasValidPhone = true;
  let hasValidSensorNs = true;
  let hasValidRelMs = true;
  let isHeader = true;
  let lastRelMs = -Infinity;
  let isMonotonic = true;

  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    if (isHeader) {
      isHeader = false;
      continue;
    }

    const parts = trimmed.split(/[;,]/).map(s => s.trim());
    if (parts.length < 4) continue;

    // 0: Phone timestamp
    const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(parts[0]);
    const phoneTs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
    if (isNaN(phoneTs)) {
      hasValidPhone = false;
    } else {
      phone_timestamps_ms.push(phoneTs);
    }

    // 1: Sensor timestamp [ns]
    const sensorNs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
    if (isNaN(sensorNs)) {
      hasValidSensorNs = false;
    } else {
      sensor_timestamps_ns.push(sensorNs);
    }

    // 2: timestamp [ms] (relative sensor ms)
    const relMs = parseFloat(parts[2]);
    if (isNaN(relMs)) {
      hasValidRelMs = false;
    } else {
      if (relMs < lastRelMs) {
        isMonotonic = false;
      }
      lastRelMs = relMs;
    }

    // 3: ecg [uV]
    const uv = parseFloat(parts[3]);
    if (isNaN(uv)) continue;

    samples_uv.push(uv);

    // Canonical timebase: use relative sensor milliseconds if valid; fallback to phone timestamp or sample grid
    if (!isNaN(relMs)) {
      canonical_timestamps_ms.push(relMs);
    } else if (!isNaN(phoneTs)) {
      canonical_timestamps_ms.push(phoneTs);
    } else {
      const idx = samples_uv.length - 1;
      canonical_timestamps_ms.push(Math.round(idx * (1000 / 130)));
    }
  }

  const total_samples = samples_uv.length;
  const sample_rate_hz = 130;
  const duration_seconds = total_samples > 0 ? Math.round((total_samples / sample_rate_hz) * 10) / 10 : 0;
  const timebase_type: 'sensor_relative_milliseconds' | 'phone_epoch_milliseconds' =
    hasValidRelMs && total_samples > 0 ? 'sensor_relative_milliseconds' : 'phone_epoch_milliseconds';

  return {
    sample_rate_hz,
    samples_uv,
    canonical_timestamps_ms,
    phone_timestamps_ms: hasValidPhone && phone_timestamps_ms.length === total_samples && total_samples > 0 ? phone_timestamps_ms : undefined,
    sensor_timestamps_ns: hasValidSensorNs && sensor_timestamps_ns.length === total_samples && total_samples > 0 ? sensor_timestamps_ns : undefined,
    total_samples,
    timebase_type,
    timebase_provenance: {
      axis: timebase_type,
      sensor_monotonic_nanoseconds_available: hasValidSensorNs && sensor_timestamps_ns.length === total_samples && total_samples > 0,
      phone_epoch_milliseconds_available: hasValidPhone && phone_timestamps_ms.length === total_samples && total_samples > 0,
      relative_milliseconds_available: hasValidRelMs && total_samples > 0,
      is_monotonic: isMonotonic && total_samples > 0,
      duration_seconds
    }
  };
}

export interface ACCPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  sensorTsNs: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
  magnitude: number;
}

export interface HRPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  hrBpm: number;
  hrvMs?: number;
  breathingRpm?: number;
}

export interface RRPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  rrMs: number;
  sensorTsNs?: number;
  phoneTimestampStr?: string;
}

export function validatePhoneTimestamp(phoneTs: number): void {
  // Reasonable absolute calendar date check (2015 to 2035)
  const minMs = 1420070400000;
  const maxMs = 2051155200000;
  if (isNaN(phoneTs) || phoneTs < minMs || phoneTs > maxMs) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid absolute calendar date anchor: ${phoneTs}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Returns a readable stream of lines from a gzipped file.
 */
export function getGzLineReader(filePath: string): readline.Interface {
  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
  const unzip = zlib.createGunzip();
  const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: fileStream.pipe(unzip),
    crlfDelay: Infinity
  });
  return rl;
}

/**
 * Normalizes a line: handles UTF-8 BOM, removes empty lines, and splits by semicolon.
 * Handles trailing semicolons safely.
 */
export function parseRawLine(line: string): string[] {
  let clean = line.trim();
  // Strip UTF-8 BOM if present
  if (clean.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF) {
    clean = clean.substring(1);
  }
  if (!clean) return [];
  
  const parts = clean.split(';');
  // Handle trailing separators by removing the last empty part if it's empty
  if (parts.length > 0 && parts[parts.length - 1].trim() === '') {
    parts.pop();
  }
  return parts.map(p => p.trim());
}

export function parseHRRow(parts: string[]): HRPoint | null {
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(parts[0]);
  const timeMs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
  validatePhoneTimestamp(timeMs);
  if (isNaN(timeMs)) return null;

  let hrBpm = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  if (parts.length >= 4 && hrBpm > 1000) {
    const altHr = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    if (!isNaN(altHr) && altHr > 0 && altHr <= 300) {
      hrBpm = altHr;
    }
  }
  if (isNaN(hrBpm)) return null;

  const hrvMs = parts[2] ? parseFloat(parts[2]) : undefined;
  const breathingRpm = parts[3] ? parseFloat(parts[3]) : undefined;

  return {
    timeMs,
    hrBpm,
    hrvMs: hrvMs && !isNaN(hrvMs) ? hrvMs : undefined,
    breathingRpm: breathingRpm && !isNaN(breathingRpm) ? breathingRpm : undefined
  };
}

export function parseRRRow(parts: string[]): RRPoint | null {
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  const line = parts.join(';');
  const canonicalRow = parseCanonicalRRRow(line, 0);
  if (canonicalRow.status === 'VALID_PARSED_ROW' && canonicalRow.raw_rr_ms !== null && canonicalRow.phone_timestamp_ms !== null) {
    return {
      timeMs: canonicalRow.phone_timestamp_ms,
      rrMs: canonicalRow.raw_rr_ms,
      sensorTsNs: canonicalRow.sensor_timestamp_ns !== null ? canonicalRow.sensor_timestamp_ns : undefined,
      phoneTimestampStr: canonicalRow.phone_timestamp_str
    };
  }
  return null;
}

export function parseECGRow(parts: string[]): ECGPoint | null {
  // Schema: Phone timestamp;sensor timestamp [ns];timestamp [ms];ecg [uV]
  if (parts.length < 4) return null;
  const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(parts[0]);
  const phoneTs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
  validatePhoneTimestamp(phoneTs);
  const sensorTsNs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
  const relMs = parseFloat(parts[2]);
  const ecgUv = parseFloat(parts[3]);
  
  if (isNaN(phoneTs) || isNaN(ecgUv)) return null;
  
  return {
    timeMs: phoneTs,
    ecgUv,
    phoneTimestampMs: isNaN(phoneTs) ? undefined : phoneTs,
    sensorTsNs: isNaN(sensorTsNs) ? undefined : sensorTsNs,
    relMs: isNaN(relMs) ? undefined : relMs
  };
}

export function parseACCRow(parts: string[]): ACCPoint | null {
  // Schema: Phone timestamp;sensor timestamp [ns];X [mg];Y [mg];Z [mg]
  if (parts.length < 5) return null;
  const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(parts[0]);
  const phoneTs = temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' ? new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime() : NaN;
  validatePhoneTimestamp(phoneTs);
  const sensorTsNs = parseFloat(parts[1]);
  const x = parseFloat(parts[2]);
  const y = parseFloat(parts[3]);
  const z = parseFloat(parts[4]);
  
  if (isNaN(phoneTs) || isNaN(sensorTsNs) || isNaN(x) || isNaN(y) || isNaN(z)) return null;
  
  const magnitude = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
  
  return {
    timeMs: phoneTs,
    sensorTsNs,
    x, y, z,
    magnitude
  };
}

/**
 * Reads and parses HR points from a gzipped log file.
 */
export async function readHRGz(filePath: string, options?: ParseOptions): Promise<HRPoint[]> {
  try {
    const rawBuf = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);
    let text: string;
    try {
      text = zlib.gunzipSync(rawBuf).toString('utf-8');
    } catch {
      text = rawBuf.toString('utf-8');
    }
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
    const points: HRPoint[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const line = lines[i].trim();
      if (!line) continue;
      const parts = parseRawLine(line);
      const pt = parseHRRow(parts);
      if (pt) {
        if (options?.startMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs < options.startMs) continue;
        if (options?.endMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs > options.endMs) continue;
        points.push(pt);
      }
    }
    return points;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

 * Reads and parses RR points from a gzipped log file.

      const pt = parseRRRow(parts);
      if (pt) {
        if (options?.startMs !== undefined && pt.timeMs < options.startMs) continue;

        points.push(pt);

/**
 * Reads and parses ECG points from a gzipped log file with windowed streaming.
 */
export async function readECGGz(filePath: string, options?: ParseOptions): Promise<ECGPoint[]> {
  const reader = getGzLineReader(filePath);
  const points: ECGPoint[] = [];
  let isHeader = true;
  for await (const line of reader) {
    if (isHeader) {
      isHeader = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (options && (options.startMs !== undefined || options.endMs !== undefined)) {
      const firstSemi = line.indexOf(';');
      if (firstSemi !== -1) {
        const tsStr = line.substring(0, firstSemi).trim();
        if (tsStr) {
          const phoneTs = new Date(tsStr).getTime();
          if (!isNaN(phoneTs)) {
            if (options.startMs !== undefined && phoneTs < options.startMs) continue;
            if (options.endMs !== undefined && phoneTs > options.endMs) break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const parts = parseRawLine(line);
    const pt = parseECGRow(parts);
    if (pt) {
      points.push(pt);
    }
  }
  return points;
}
