export interface PolarRrPacketParseResult {
  valid: boolean;
  rrMsList: number[];
  warnings: string[];
  hrBpm: number | null;
  energyExpendedJules?: number;
  unparsedBytes: number;
}

export function parsePolarRawRrPacketDetails(bytes: number[]): PolarRrPacketParseResult {
  if (!bytes || bytes.length < 2) {
    return { valid: false, rrMsList: [], warnings: ['Packet truncated: less than 2 bytes'], hrBpm: null, unparsedBytes: bytes ? bytes.length : 0 };
  }

  const flags = bytes[0];
  const isHr16 = (flags & 0x01) !== 0;
  const energyExp = (flags & 0x08) !== 0;
  const rrPresent = (flags & 0x10) !== 0;

  let offset = 1;

  // Heart Rate
  let hrBpm: number | null = null;
  if (isHr16) {
    if (offset + 2 > bytes.length) {
      return { valid: false, rrMsList: [], warnings: ['Truncated 16-bit HR payload'], hrBpm: null, unparsedBytes: bytes.length - offset };
    }
    hrBpm = bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8);
    offset += 2;
  } else {
    if (offset + 1 > bytes.length) {
      return { valid: false, rrMsList: [], warnings: ['Truncated 8-bit HR payload'], hrBpm: null, unparsedBytes: bytes.length - offset };
    }
    hrBpm = bytes[offset];
    offset += 1;
  }

  // Energy Expended
  let energyExpendedJules: number | undefined = undefined;
  if (energyExp) {
    if (offset + 2 > bytes.length) {
      return { valid: false, rrMsList: [], warnings: ['Truncated Energy Expended payload'], hrBpm, unparsedBytes: bytes.length - offset };
    }
    energyExpendedJules = bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8);
    offset += 2;
  }

  if (!rrPresent) {
    const unparsed = bytes.length - offset;
    return {
      valid: unparsed === 0,
      rrMsList: [],
      warnings: unparsed > 0 ? [`Trailing ${unparsed} bytes present when RR flag is false`] : [],
      hrBpm,
      energyExpendedJules,
      unparsedBytes: unparsed
    };
  }

  const rrMsList: number[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  let valid = true;

  while (offset + 1 < bytes.length) {
    const rawVal = bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8);
    const rrMs = Math.round((rawVal * 1000) / 1024);
    if (rrMs > 0 && rrMs < 3000) {
      rrMsList.push(rrMs);
    } else {
      warnings.push(`Physiologically out-of-bounds RR value: ${rrMs}ms`);
    }
    offset += 2;
  }

  const unparsed = bytes.length - offset;
  if (unparsed > 0) {
    valid = false;
    warnings.push(`Truncated trailing byte: ${unparsed} byte(s) unparsed`);
  }

  return {
    valid: valid && warnings.length === 0,
    rrMsList,
    warnings,
    hrBpm,
    energyExpendedJules,
    unparsedBytes: unparsed
  };
}

export function parsePolarRawRrPacket(bytes: number[]): number[] {
  const details = parsePolarRawRrPacketDetails(bytes);
  return details.valid ? details.rrMsList : [];
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/backend/sources/ftpClient.ts
================================================================================
import * as net from 'node:net';

export interface FtpResponse {
  code: number;
  text: string;
}

const ALLOWED_COMMANDS = new Set([
  'USER', 'PASS', 'PWD', 'CWD', 'TYPE', 'PASV', 'MLSD', 'LIST', 'SIZE', 'MDTM', 'RETR', 'QUIT', 'NOOP'
]);

function isCommandAllowed(cmdStr: string): boolean {
  const cmd = cmdStr.trim().split(/\s+/)[0].toUpperCase();
  return ALLOWED_COMMANDS.has(cmd);
}

export class FtpClient {
  private host: string;
  private port: number;
  private socket: net.Socket | null = null;
  private responseBuffer = '';
  private currentResponseLines: string[] = [];
  private pendingMultilineCode: string | null = null;
  private activeCommand: {
    resolve: (res: FtpResponse) => void;
    reject: (err: Error) => void;
    expectedCodes: number[];
    timer: NodeJS.Timeout;
  } | null = null;
  private timeoutMs = 5000;

  constructor(host: string, port = 21, timeoutMs = 5000) {
    this.host = host;
    this.port = port;
    this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs;
  }

  connect(): Promise<FtpResponse> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket = net.connect({ host: this.host, port: this.port }, () => {
        // Connected
      });

      this.socket.setTimeout(this.timeoutMs);

      const connectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.close();
        reject(new Error('FTP connection timeout'));
      }, this.timeoutMs);

      this.activeCommand = {
        resolve: (res) => {
          clearTimeout(connectTimer);
          resolve(res);
        },
        reject: (err) => {
          clearTimeout(connectTimer);
          this.close();
          reject(err);
        },
        expectedCodes: [220],
        timer: connectTimer
      };

      this.socket.on('data', (chunk) => {
        this.responseBuffer += chunk.toString();
        while (true) {
          const lineEnd = this.responseBuffer.indexOf('\r\n');
          if (lineEnd === -1) break;
          const line = this.responseBuffer.substring(0, lineEnd);
          this.responseBuffer = this.responseBuffer.substring(lineEnd + 2);
          this.handleResponseLine(line);
        }
      });

      this.socket.on('error', (err) => {
        this.cleanupActiveCommand();
        reject(err);
      });

      this.socket.on('close', () => {
        this.cleanupActiveCommand();
      });

      this.socket.on('timeout', () => {
        this.cleanupActiveCommand();
        this.close();
        reject(new Error('FTP socket timeout'));
      });
    });
  }

  async login(user: string, pass: string): Promise<void> {
    const userRes = await this.executeCommand(`USER ${user}`, [230, 331]);
    if (userRes.code === 331) {
      await this.executeCommand(`PASS ${pass}`, [230, 202]);
    }
  }

  async cwd(path: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeCommand(`CWD ${path}`, [250]);
  }

  async list(): Promise<string> {
    const pasvRes = await this.executeCommand('PASV', [227]);
    const { host: dataHost, port: dataPort } = this.parsePasvAddress(pasvRes.text);

    let finalDataHost = dataHost;
    if (this.isPrivateIp(dataHost) && !this.isPrivateIp(this.host)) {
      finalDataHost = this.host;
    }

    const dataSocket = net.connect({ host: finalDataHost, port: dataPort });
    dataSocket.setTimeout(this.timeoutMs);

    let dataBuffer = '';
    const dataPromise = new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
      dataSocket.on('data', (chunk) => {
        dataBuffer += chunk.toString('utf-8');
      });
      dataSocket.on('end', () => {
        resolve(dataBuffer);
      });
      dataSocket.on('error', (err) => {
        reject(err);
      });
      dataSocket.on('timeout', () => {
        dataSocket.destroy();
        reject(new Error('FTP data connection timeout'));
      });
    });

    try {
      let initRes;
      try {
        initRes = await this.executeCommand('MLSD', [150, 125, 226]);
      } catch (err: any) {
        initRes = await this.executeCommand('LIST', [150, 125, 226]);
      }

      if (initRes.code === 226) {
        dataSocket.destroy();
        return '';
      }

      const listData = await dataPromise;
      await this.waitForResponse([226, 250]);
      return listData;
    } catch (err) {
      dataSocket.destroy();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async retrieve(filename: string): Promise<Buffer> {
    const pasvRes = await this.executeCommand('PASV', [227]);
    const { host: dataHost, port: dataPort } = this.parsePasvAddress(pasvRes.text);

    let finalDataHost = dataHost;
    if (this.isPrivateIp(dataHost) && !this.isPrivateIp(this.host)) {
      finalDataHost = this.host;
    }

    const dataSocket = net.connect({ host: finalDataHost, port: dataPort });
    dataSocket.setTimeout(this.timeoutMs);

    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    const dataPromise = new Promise<Buffer>((resolve, reject) => {
      dataSocket.on('data', (chunk) => {
        chunks.push(chunk);
      });
      dataSocket.on('end', () => {
        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      });
      dataSocket.on('error', (err) => {
        reject(err);
      });
      dataSocket.on('timeout', () => {
        dataSocket.destroy();
        reject(new Error('FTP data connection timeout'));
      });
    });

    try {
      await this.executeCommand('TYPE I', [200]);

      const initRes = await this.executeCommand(`RETR ${filename}`, [150, 125, 226]);
      if (initRes.code === 226) {
        dataSocket.destroy();
        return Buffer.alloc(0);
      }

      const fileData = await dataPromise;
      await this.waitForResponse([226, 250]);
      return fileData;
    } catch (err) {
      dataSocket.destroy();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async size(filename: string): Promise<number> {
    const res = await this.executeCommand(`SIZE ${filename}`, [213]);
    const match = res.text.match(/^213\s+(\d+)/);
    if (!match) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to parse SIZE response: ${res.text}`);
    }
    return parseInt(match[1], 10);
  }

  async mdtm(filename: string): Promise<number> {
    const res = await this.executeCommand(`MDTM ${filename}`, [213]);
    const match = res.text.match(/^213\s+(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/);
    if (!match) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to parse MDTM response: ${res.text}`);
    }
    const year = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    const month = parseInt(match[2], 10) - 1;
    const day = parseInt(match[3], 10);
    const hour = parseInt(match[4], 10);
    const minute = parseInt(match[5], 10);
    const second = parseInt(match[6], 10);
    return Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
  }

  async quit(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.executeCommand('QUIT', [221]);
    } catch (err) {
      // Ignore errors on quit
    } finally {
      this.close();
    }
  }

  close() {
    this.cleanupActiveCommand();
    if (this.socket) {
      this.socket.destroy();
      this.socket = null;
    }
  }

  private waitForResponse(expectedCodes: number[], timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<FtpResponse> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (this.activeCommand) {
        return reject(new Error('FTP client is busy with another command'));
      }
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.cleanupActiveCommand();
        this.close();
        reject(new Error(`FTP response timeout waiting for codes: ${expectedCodes}`));
      }, timeoutMs);

      this.activeCommand = { resolve, reject, expectedCodes, timer };
    });
  }

  private executeCommand(cmdStr: string, expectedCodes: number[], timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<FtpResponse> {
    if (!this.socket) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('FTP client not connected'));
    }
    const isAllowed = isCommandAllowed(cmdStr);
    if (!isAllowed) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error(`FTP command forbidden by security policies: ${cmdStr}`));
    }

    const responsePromise = this.waitForResponse(expectedCodes, timeoutMs);
    this.socket.write(cmdStr + '\r\n');
    return responsePromise;
  }

  private cleanupActiveCommand() {
    if (this.activeCommand) {
      clearTimeout(this.activeCommand.timer);
      this.activeCommand = null;
    }
  }

  private handleResponseLine(line: string) {
    this.currentResponseLines.push(line);

    const match = line.match(/^(\d{3})([ -])(.*)$/);
    if (match) {
      const codeStr = match[1];
      const separator = match[2];

      if (this.pendingMultilineCode) {
        if (codeStr === this.pendingMultilineCode && separator === ' ') {
          const code = parseInt(codeStr, 10);
          const fullText = this.currentResponseLines.join('\n');
          this.resolveCommand(code, fullText);
        }
      } else {
        if (separator === '-') {
          this.pendingMultilineCode = codeStr;
        } else {
          const code = parseInt(codeStr, 10);
          this.resolveCommand(code, line);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private resolveCommand(code: number, text: string) {
    this.pendingMultilineCode = null;
    this.currentResponseLines = [];

    if (this.activeCommand) {
      const cmd = this.activeCommand;
      this.activeCommand = null;
      clearTimeout(cmd.timer);

      if (cmd.expectedCodes.includes(code)) {
        cmd.resolve({ code, text });
      } else {
        cmd.reject(new Error(`FTP command failed: expected [${cmd.expectedCodes}], got ${code}. Response: ${text}`));
      }
    }
  }

  private parsePasvAddress(pasvText: string): { host: string; port: number } {
    const match = pasvText.match(/(\d+),(\d+),(\d+),(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/);
    if (!match) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to parse PASV response: ${pasvText}`);
    }
    const host = `${match[1]}.${match[2]}.${match[3]}.${match[4]}`;
    const port = parseInt(match[5], 10) * 256 + parseInt(match[6], 10);
    return { host, port };
  }

  private isPrivateIp(ip: string): boolean {
    return (
      ip.startsWith('10.') ||
      ip.startsWith('192.168.') ||
      ip.startsWith('127.') ||
      ip.match(/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./) !== null
    );
  }
}

import { DataSourceAdapter, SourceFileEntry } from './sourceTypes';
import { FtpClient } from './ftpClient';
import { URL } from 'node:url';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';

export class FtpSourceAdapter implements DataSourceAdapter {
  private url: string;

  constructor(url: string) {
    this.url = url;
  }

  private getClient(): { client: FtpClient; path: string; username: string; pass: string } {
    try {
      const parsedUrl = new URL(this.url);
      if (parsedUrl.protocol !== 'ftp:') {
        throw new Error('Invalid protocol, must be ftp:');
      }
      const host = parsedUrl.hostname;
      if (!host) {
        throw new Error('Missing FTP hostname');
      }
      const port = parsedUrl.port ? parseInt(parsedUrl.port, 10) : 21;
      const username = decodeURIComponent(parsedUrl.username || 'anonymous');
      const password = decodeURIComponent(parsedUrl.password || 'anonymous');
      const path = decodeURIComponent(parsedUrl.pathname || '/');

      const client = new FtpClient(host, port, 5000);
      return { client, path, username, pass: password };
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid FTP URL: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async preflight(): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    let clientInfo;
    try {
      clientInfo = this.getClient();
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
    const { client, path, username, pass } = clientInfo;
    try {
      await client.connect();
      await client.login(username, pass);
      if (path && path !== '/') {
        await client.cwd(path);
      }
      await client.quit();
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      client.close();
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  async listFiles(): Promise<SourceFileEntry[]> {
    const { client, path, username, pass } = this.getClient();
    try {
      await client.connect();
      await client.login(username, pass);
      if (path && path !== '/') {
        await client.cwd(path);
      }
      const listText = await client.list();
      await client.quit();

      return this.parseListOutput(listText);
    } catch (err: any) {
      client.close();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async downloadFile(filename: string, tempLocalPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const { client, path, username, pass } = this.getClient();
    try {
      await client.connect();
      await client.login(username, pass);
      if (path && path !== '/') {
        await client.cwd(path);
      }
      const fileData = await client.retrieve(filename);
      await client.quit();

      fs.writeFileSync(tempLocalPath, fileData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      client.close();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async statFile(filename: string): Promise<{ size: number; mtimeMs: number }> {
    const { client, path, username, pass } = this.getClient();
    try {
      await client.connect();
      await client.login(username, pass);
      if (path && path !== '/') {
        await client.cwd(path);
      }
      const size = await client.size(filename);
      const mtimeMs = await client.mdtm(filename);
      await client.quit();

      return { size, mtimeMs };
    } catch (err: any) {
      client.close();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  private parseListOutput(text: string): SourceFileEntry[] {
    const entries: SourceFileEntry[] = [];
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);

    for (const line of lines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed) continue;

      // Try MLSD parsing
      if (trimmed.includes('type=') || trimmed.includes('size=')) {
        const parts = trimmed.split(';');
        if (parts.length > 1) {
          const filename = parts[parts.length - 1].trim();
          if (!filename || filename === '.' || filename === '..') continue;

          let size = 0;
          let mtimeMs = Date.now();
          let isDir = false;

          for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
            const fact = parts[i].trim();
            const [name, val] = fact.split('=');
            if (name && val) {
              const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
              if (lowerName === 'size') {
                size = parseInt(val, 10);
              } else if (lowerName === 'type') {
                isDir = val.toLowerCase() === 'dir';
              } else if (lowerName === 'modify') {
                const match = val.match(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/);
                if (match) {
                  const year = parseInt(match[1], 10);
                  const month = parseInt(match[2], 10) - 1;
                  const day = parseInt(match[3], 10);
                  const hour = parseInt(match[4], 10);
                  const minute = parseInt(match[5], 10);
                  const second = parseInt(match[6], 10);
                  mtimeMs = Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
                }
              }
            }
          }

          if (!isDir) {
            entries.push({ filename, size, mtimeMs });
          }
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Try LIST parsing fallback
      const cols = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
      if (cols.length >= 9) {
        const isDir = cols[0].startsWith('d');
        const size = parseInt(cols[4], 10);
        const name = cols.slice(8).join(' ');
        if (name === '.' || name === '..') continue;
        if (!isDir && !isNaN(size)) {
          entries.push({ filename: name, size, mtimeMs: Date.now() });
        }
      }
    }

    return entries;
  }
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { DataSourceAdapter, SourceFileEntry } from './sourceTypes';

export class LocalPathSourceAdapter implements DataSourceAdapter {
  private dirPath: string;

  constructor(dirPath: string) {
    this.dirPath = dirPath;
  }

  async preflight(): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    try {
      if (!fs.existsSync(this.dirPath)) {
        return { success: false, error: `Директория ${this.dirPath} не существует` };
      }
      const stat = await fs.promises.stat(this.dirPath);
      if (!stat.isDirectory()) {
        return { success: false, error: `Путь ${this.dirPath} не является директорией` };
      }
      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  }

  async listFiles(): Promise<SourceFileEntry[]> {
    try {
      const files = await fs.promises.readdir(this.dirPath);
      const entries: SourceFileEntry[] = [];
      for (const file of files) {
        const fullPath = path.join(this.dirPath, file);
        try {
          const stat = await fs.promises.stat(fullPath);
          if (stat.isFile()) {
            entries.push({
              filename: file,
              size: stat.size,
              mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs
            });
          }
        } catch {
          // Ignore files that cannot be statted
        }
      }
      return entries;
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`Ошибка при чтении директории: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async downloadFile(filename: string, tempLocalPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const srcPath = path.join(this.dirPath, filename);
    try {
      await fs.promises.copyFile(srcPath, tempLocalPath);
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`Ошибка копирования файла ${filename}: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async statFile(filename: string): Promise<{ size: number; mtimeMs: number }> {
    const srcPath = path.join(this.dirPath, filename);
    try {
      const stat = await fs.promises.stat(srcPath);
      return {
        size: stat.size,
        mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`Ошибка stat файла ${filename}: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }
}

import { getActiveDataSource } from '../db/db';
import { DataSourceAdapter } from './sourceTypes';
import { LocalPathSourceAdapter } from './localPathSource';

export async function createActiveSourceAdapter(): Promise<DataSourceAdapter> {
  const activeSource = getActiveDataSource();
  if (!activeSource) {
    throw new Error('Активный источник данных не настроен');
  }

  if (activeSource.type === 'local') {
    if (!activeSource.path) {
      throw new Error(`Локальный путь для источника "${activeSource.label}" не указан`);
    }
    return new LocalPathSourceAdapter(activeSource.path);
  } else if (activeSource.type === 'ftp') {
    try {
      const { FtpSourceAdapter } = await import('./ftpSource');
      if (!activeSource.url) {
        throw new Error(`FTP URL для источника "${activeSource.label}" не указан`);
      }
      return new FtpSourceAdapter(activeSource.url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(`FTP адаптер не поддерживается или не реализован в этой фазе: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error(`Неизвестный тип источника: ${activeSource.type}`);
}
