/**
 * AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.ts
 *
 * File-first, local-first service for managing Algorithm Candidates,
 * Component Manifests, Pre-specified Evaluation Plans, Holdout Partitions,
 * and Evidence-Gated Baseline History.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1.0 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-d2413a2e2e9b4c1fb0cfb051130147b9
 * - Action Packet packet_h10_algorithm_candidate_registry_governance_20260917_171502
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 * - Local-first, file-first, privacy-preserving boundaries
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  AlgorithmCandidateSpec,
  CandidateComponentSpec,
  EvaluationPlan,
  CandidateEvidenceDecision,
  BaselineHistoryEntry,
  CandidateLifecycleState,
  ScientificImpactClassification,
  DatasetPartitionClass,
  GovernanceDecisionAction,
  ALGORITHM_CANDIDATE_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION
} from '../../shared/canonical/AlgorithmCandidateRegistryContract';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';

export class AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService {
  private static instance: AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService;
  private projectRoot: string;

  private constructor(projectRoot?: string) {
    this.projectRoot = projectRoot || path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
    this.seedDefaultBaselineIfMissing();
  }

  public static getInstance(projectRoot?: string): AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService {
    if (!AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.instance) {
      AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.instance = new AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService(projectRoot);
    }
    return AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService.instance;
  }

  public setProjectRoot(rootPath: string): void {
    this.projectRoot = rootPath;
  }

  public getProjectRoot(): string {
    return this.projectRoot;
  }

  public clearForTest(): void {
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM candidate_baseline_history').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM candidate_evidence_decisions').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM candidate_evaluation_plans').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM algorithm_candidate_components').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM algorithm_candidates').run();
    this.seedDefaultBaselineIfMissing();
  }

  /**
   * Resolves the SHA-256 of the active working tree candidate manifest if present.
   */
  /**
   * Resolves the SHA-256 of the active working tree candidate manifest if present.
   */
  public getActiveSourceManifestSha256(): string | null {
    try {
      const manifestPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy', 'CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json');
      if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(manifestPath);
        return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Loads and parses the active candidate manifest if present.
   */
  public getCandidateManifest(): {
    head?: string;
    candidate_files?: Array<{ status: string; path: string; exists: boolean; size_bytes: number; sha256: string }>;
  } | null {
    try {
      const manifestPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy', 'CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json');
      if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
        return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Dynamically resolves the git commit HEAD from candidate manifest or local .git.
   */
  public getWorkingTreeGitHead(): string | null {
    try {
      const manifest = this.getCandidateManifest();
      if (manifest?.head && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(manifest.head)) {
        return manifest.head.toLowerCase();
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    try {
      const gitHeadPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.git', 'HEAD');
      if (fs.existsSync(gitHeadPath)) {
        const headRef = fs.readFileSync(gitHeadPath, 'utf8').trim();
        if (headRef.startsWith('ref: ')) {
          const refPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.git', headRef.slice(5).trim());
          if (fs.existsSync(refPath)) {
            const sha = fs.readFileSync(refPath, 'utf8').trim();
            if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(sha)) {
              return sha.toLowerCase();
            }
          }
        } else if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(headRef)) {
          return headRef.toLowerCase();
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Computes deterministic SHA-256 for a file relative to repository root.
   */
  public computeFileSha256(relPath: string): string | null {
    try {
      const fullPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, relPath);
      if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath);
        return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Computes semantic candidate content identity from protocol, manifest,
   * normalized component roles/paths/byte hashes, and canonical parameters,
   * EXCLUDING human labels, names, versions, and candidate IDs.
   * "Equivalent scientific content has one semantic identity."
   */
  public computeCandidateContentSha256(candidate: {
    source_manifest_sha256: string;
    protocol_version: string;
    scientific_impact?: string;
    components: Array<{
      source_path: string;
      source_sha256: string;
      role: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    parameter_digest_sha256: string;
    [key: string]: any;
  }): string {
    const sortedComponents = candidate.components.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      const r = a.role.localeCompare(b.role);
      return r !== 0 ? r : a.source_path.localeCompare(b.source_path);
    });
    const canonicalPayload = {
      protocol_version: candidate.protocol_version || 'v1.1.0',
      source_manifest_sha256: (candidate.source_manifest_sha256 || '').toLowerCase(),
      scientific_impact: candidate.scientific_impact || 'none',
      components: sortedComponents.map(c => ({
        source_path: c.source_path.replace(/\\/g, '/'),
        source_sha256: (c.source_sha256 || '').toLowerCase(),
        role: c.role
      })),
      parameter_digest_sha256: (candidate.parameter_digest_sha256 || '').toLowerCase()
    };
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(canonicalPayload), 'utf8').digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Seeds the default baseline algorithm candidate (Protocol v1.1.0 baseline)
   * using real disk SHA-256 checksums and dynamic git_head binding to CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json.
   * Unverifiable seeds become historical_unverified without promoted baseline history.
   */
  private seedDefaultBaselineIfMissing(): void {
    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?')
      .get('CANDIDATE-H10-VAL-V110-BASELINE');
    if (existing) return;

    // Real SHA-256 checksums of canonical components
    const qrsPath = 'src/backend/analytics/qrs.ts';
    const rrPath = 'src/shared/canonical/CanonicalRRParser.ts';
    const qrsSha = this.computeFileSha256(qrsPath);
    const rrSha = this.computeFileSha256(rrPath);
    const manifestSha = this.getActiveSourceManifestSha256();
    const gitHead = this.getWorkingTreeGitHead();

    const defaultParams = {
      protocol_version: 'v1.1.0',
      threshold_multiplier: 0.6,
      warmup_rejection_sec: 15.0,
      window_size_sec: 1.0
    };

    const paramJson = JSON.stringify(defaultParams);
    const paramDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(paramJson, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    // If components, manifest, or git head cannot be verified on disk, mark historical_unverified without fabrication
    if (!qrsSha || !rrSha || !manifestSha || !gitHead) {
      const unverifiedCandidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec = {
        candidate_id: 'CANDIDATE-H10-VAL-V110-BASELINE',
        candidate_name: 'H10 Offline Median Filter Baseline (v1.1.0)',
        candidate_version: '1.1.0',
        git_head: gitHead || '',
        source_manifest_sha256: manifestSha || '',
        protocol_version: 'v1.1.0',
        parent_candidate_id: null,
        scientific_impact: 'none',
        components: [
          {
            component_id: 'comp_qrs_offline_median',
            name: 'OfflineFullSequenceSeedRollingMedianFilter',
            version: '1.1.0',
            source_path: qrsPath,
            source_sha256: qrsSha || '',
            role: 'qrs_detector'
          },
          {
            component_id: 'comp_rr_canonical_parser',
            name: 'CanonicalRRParser',
            version: '1.1.0',
            source_path: rrPath,
            source_sha256: rrSha || '',
            role: 'rr_parser'
          }
        ],
        parameter_digest_sha256: paramDigest,
        parameters_json: paramJson,
        state: 'historical_unverified',
        registered_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        registered_by: 'system_seed',
        metadata: {
          seed_type: 'unverified_fallback_quarantine',
          quarantine: true,
          quarantine_reason: 'disk_components_manifest_or_git_head_unverified'
        }
      };
      this.insertCandidateDirect(unverifiedCandidate);
      return;
    }

    const defaultComponents: CandidateComponentSpec[] = [
      {
        component_id: 'comp_qrs_offline_median',
        name: 'OfflineFullSequenceSeedRollingMedianFilter',
        version: '1.1.0',
        source_path: qrsPath,
        source_sha256: qrsSha,
        role: 'qrs_detector'
      },
      {
        component_id: 'comp_rr_canonical_parser',
        name: 'CanonicalRRParser',
        version: '1.1.0',
        source_path: rrPath,
        source_sha256: rrSha,
        role: 'rr_parser'
      }
    ];

    const defaultCandidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec = {
      candidate_id: 'CANDIDATE-H10-VAL-V110-BASELINE',
      candidate_name: 'H10 Offline Median Filter Baseline (v1.1.0)',
      candidate_version: '1.1.0',
      git_head: gitHead,
      source_manifest_sha256: manifestSha,
      protocol_version: 'v1.1.0',
      parent_candidate_id: null,
      scientific_impact: 'none',
      components: defaultComponents,
      parameter_digest_sha256: paramDigest,
      parameters_json: paramJson,
      state: 'active_source_baseline',
      registered_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      registered_by: 'system_seed',
      superseded_by: null,
      superseded_at_utc: null,
      rejection_reason: null,
      metadata: { seed_type: 'initial_normative_baseline' }
    };

    this.registerCandidate(defaultCandidate, { isSeed: true });

    // Record initial baseline history with verified manifest
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO candidate_baseline_history (
        entry_id, candidate_id, action_type, previous_candidate_id, decision_id,
        activated_at_utc, justification, source_manifest_verified
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
    `).run(
      'base_entry_initial_seed',
      defaultCandidate.candidate_id,
      'initial_seed',
      null,
      null,
      new Date().toISOString(),
      'Initial normative frozen baseline under Protocol v1.1.0'
    );
  }

  /**
   * Internal direct insertion for unverified seeds.
   */
  private insertCandidateDirect(candidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec): void {
    const db = getDb();
    const contentSha = this.computeCandidateContentSha256({
      source_manifest_sha256: candidate.source_manifest_sha256 || '',
      protocol_version: candidate.protocol_version || 'v1.1.0',
      scientific_impact: candidate.scientific_impact || 'none',
      components: candidate.components,
      parameter_digest_sha256: candidate.parameter_digest_sha256 || ''
    });

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO algorithm_candidates (
          candidate_id, candidate_name, candidate_version, git_head, source_manifest_sha256,
          candidate_content_sha256, protocol_version, parent_candidate_id, scientific_impact,
          parameter_digest_sha256, parameters_json, state, registered_at_utc, registered_by,
          superseded_by, superseded_at_utc, rejection_reason, metadata_json
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        candidate.candidate_id,
        candidate.candidate_name,
        candidate.candidate_version,
        (candidate.git_head || '').toLowerCase(),
        (candidate.source_manifest_sha256 || '').toLowerCase(),
        contentSha.toLowerCase(),
        candidate.protocol_version || 'v1.1.0',
        candidate.parent_candidate_id || null,
        candidate.scientific_impact || 'none',
        candidate.parameter_digest_sha256 || '',
        candidate.parameters_json || '{}',
        candidate.state || 'historical_unverified',
        candidate.registered_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
        candidate.registered_by || 'system',
        null,
        null,
        null,
        JSON.stringify(candidate.metadata || {})
      );

      const insertComp = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO algorithm_candidate_components (
          component_id, candidate_id, name, version, source_path, source_sha256, role
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      for (const comp of candidate.components) {
        insertComp.run(
          comp.component_id || `comp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
          candidate.candidate_id,
          comp.name,
          comp.version,
          comp.source_path.replace(/\\/g, '/'),
          (comp.source_sha256 || '').toLowerCase(),
          comp.role
        );
      }
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }
  }


  /**
   * Registers a new algorithm candidate with full component manifests and parameter digest.
   * Fail-closed: Validates mandatory fields, git commit head, source manifest sha256,
   * component membership in CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json, disk existence and sha256 match,
   * canonical parameter JSON digest, and blocks caller-supplied lifecycle state overrides.
   * Production registration has NO testAdapterBypass.
   * Runs inside an atomic SQLite transaction.
   */
  public registerCandidate(
    candidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec,
    options?: { isSeed?: boolean }
  ): AlgorithmCandidateSpec {
    return this.internalRegisterCandidate(candidate, {
      isSeed: options?.isSeed,
      enforceManifestMembership: !options?.isSeed
    });
  }

  /**
   * Isolated test fixture registration helper for testing synthetic candidates or historical setups.
   */
  public registerTestCandidateFixture(
    candidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec,
    options?: { isSeed?: boolean; skipManifestMembership?: boolean }
  ): AlgorithmCandidateSpec {
    return this.internalRegisterCandidate(candidate, {
      isSeed: options?.isSeed,
      enforceManifestMembership: !options?.skipManifestMembership
    });
  }

  private internalRegisterCandidate(
    candidate: AlgorithmCandidateSpec,
    options?: { isSeed?: boolean; enforceManifestMembership?: boolean }
  ): AlgorithmCandidateSpec {
    if (!candidate.candidate_id || !candidate.candidate_name || !candidate.candidate_version) {
      throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: candidate_id, name, and version are mandatory');
    }
    if (!candidate.git_head || !/^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(candidate.git_head)) {
      throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: git_head must be a valid commit SHA (40 hex characters)');
    }
    const protocolVersion = candidate.protocol_version || 'v1.1.0';
    if (!Array.isArray(candidate.components) || candidate.components.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: candidate must define at least one component');
    }

    // Source manifest SHA256 cannot be empty or 'unknown'
    let manifestSha = candidate.source_manifest_sha256;
    if (!manifestSha || manifestSha.trim() === '') {
      manifestSha = this.getActiveSourceManifestSha256() || '';
    }
    if (!manifestSha || manifestSha.toLowerCase() === 'unknown' || !/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(manifestSha)) {
      throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: source_manifest_sha256 must be a valid 64-hex SHA-256 hash');
    }
    candidate.source_manifest_sha256 = manifestSha;

    // Load candidate manifest if manifest membership enforcement is required
    let manifestFileMap: Map<string, { exists: boolean; size_bytes: number; sha256: string }> | null = null;
    if (options?.enforceManifestMembership) {
      const manifest = this.getCandidateManifest();
      if (!manifest || !Array.isArray(manifest.candidate_files)) {
        throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_FAILED: Candidate manifest .agy/CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json not found or malformed');
      }
      manifestFileMap = new Map();
      for (const f of manifest.candidate_files) {
        if (f.path) {
          manifestFileMap.set(f.path.replace(/\\/g, '/'), f);
        }
      }
    }

    // Verify each component with project confinement, manifest membership, and disk integrity
    for (const comp of candidate.components) {
      if (!comp.name || !comp.version || !comp.source_path || !comp.source_sha256 || !comp.role) {
        throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: All component fields (name, version, source_path, source_sha256, role) are mandatory');
      }
      if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(comp.source_sha256)) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: Component '${comp.name}' source_sha256 must be a 64-hex SHA-256 hash`);
      }

      // 1. Project-root confinement & path traversal prevention
      const normalizedPath = comp.source_path.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      if (path.isAbsolute(normalizedPath) || normalizedPath.startsWith('../') || normalizedPath.includes('/../')) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Component source_path '${comp.source_path}' violates project confinement`);
      }
      const fullPath = path.resolve(this.projectRoot, normalizedPath);
      const relPath = path.relative(this.projectRoot, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
      if (relPath.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(relPath)) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Component source_path '${comp.source_path}' escapes project root`);
      }

      // 2. Enforce manifest membership in CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json
      if (options?.enforceManifestMembership && manifestFileMap) {
        const entry = manifestFileMap.get(relPath);
        if (!entry) {
          throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_MANIFEST_MEMBERSHIP_VIOLATION: Component '${comp.name}' at '${comp.source_path}' is not present in active candidate manifest`);
        }
        if (!entry.sha256 || entry.sha256.toLowerCase() !== comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
          throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_MANIFEST_MEMBERSHIP_VIOLATION: Component '${comp.name}' at '${comp.source_path}' manifest sha256 '${entry.sha256}' does not match component sha256 '${comp.source_sha256}'`);
        }
      }

      // 3. Production disk verification: Component file MUST exist on disk and match SHA-256
      if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Component file '${comp.source_path}' does not exist on disk`);
      }

      const actualSha = this.computeFileSha256(relPath);
      if (!actualSha || actualSha.toLowerCase() !== comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Component '${comp.name}' at '${comp.source_path}' hash ${comp.source_sha256} does not match disk hash ${actualSha}`);
      }
    }

    // Canonicalize parameters JSON and verify parameter_digest_sha256
    let parsedParams: any = {};
    if (typeof candidate.parameters === 'object' && candidate.parameters !== null) {
      parsedParams = candidate.parameters;
    } else if (typeof candidate.parameters_json === 'string') {
      try {
        parsedParams = JSON.parse(candidate.parameters_json);
      } catch {
        throw new Error('CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: parameters_json must be valid JSON');
      }
    }

    // Canonical JSON stringification (recursive key sort)
    const canonicalize = (obj: any): any => {
      if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
      if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(canonicalize);
      const sortedKeys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
      const result: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const k of sortedKeys) {
        result[k] = canonicalize(obj[k]);
      }
      return result;
    };

    const canonicalParamsObj = canonicalize(parsedParams);
    const pJson = JSON.stringify(canonicalParamsObj);
    const computedParamDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(pJson, 'utf8').digest('hex');

    if (candidate.parameter_digest_sha256 && candidate.parameter_digest_sha256.toLowerCase() !== computedParamDigest.toLowerCase()) {
      throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION_INVALID: parameter_digest_sha256 mismatch. Declared: ${candidate.parameter_digest_sha256}, Computed: ${computedParamDigest}`);
    }
    const paramDigest = computedParamDigest;

    // Reject caller-supplied lifecycle state overrides during initial registration (forces 'registered')
    let finalState: CandidateLifecycleState = 'registered';
    if (options?.isSeed) {
      finalState = candidate.state || 'active_source_baseline';
    } else {
      finalState = 'registered';
    }

    // Compute semantic candidate content identity (independent of human labels and IDs)
    const contentSha = this.computeCandidateContentSha256({
      source_manifest_sha256: manifestSha,
      protocol_version: protocolVersion,
      scientific_impact: candidate.scientific_impact || 'none',
      components: candidate.components,
      parameter_digest_sha256: paramDigest
    });

    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?').get(candidate.candidate_id);
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Candidate with ID '${candidate.candidate_id}' is already registered`);
    }

    // Semantic content uniqueness check: equivalent scientific content must have one identity
    if (!options?.isSeed) {
      const existingContent = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_content_sha256 = ?')
        .get(contentSha.toLowerCase()) as any;
      if (existingContent) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_DUPLICATE_CONTENT_DETECTED: Candidate content matches already registered candidate '${existingContent.candidate_id}'`);
      }
    }

    // Validate parent candidate exists if specified
    if (candidate.parent_candidate_id) {
      const parent = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id, state FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?').get(candidate.parent_candidate_id) as any;
      if (!parent) {
        throw new Error(`PARENT_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND: Parent candidate '${candidate.parent_candidate_id}' does not exist`);
      }
    }

    const regAt = candidate.registered_at_utc || new Date().toISOString();

    // Atomic SQLite transaction
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO algorithm_candidates (
          candidate_id, candidate_name, candidate_version, git_head, source_manifest_sha256,
          candidate_content_sha256, protocol_version, parent_candidate_id, scientific_impact,
          parameter_digest_sha256, parameters_json, state, registered_at_utc, registered_by,
          superseded_by, superseded_at_utc, rejection_reason, metadata_json
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        candidate.candidate_id,
        candidate.candidate_name,
        candidate.candidate_version,
        candidate.git_head.toLowerCase(),
        manifestSha.toLowerCase(),
        contentSha.toLowerCase(),
        protocolVersion,
        candidate.parent_candidate_id || null,
        candidate.scientific_impact || 'none',
        paramDigest,
        pJson,
        finalState,
        regAt,
        candidate.registered_by || null,
        options?.isSeed ? (candidate.superseded_by || null) : null,
        options?.isSeed ? (candidate.superseded_at_utc || null) : null,
        options?.isSeed ? (candidate.rejection_reason || null) : null,
        JSON.stringify(candidate.metadata || {})
      );

      // Insert components
      const insertComp = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO algorithm_candidate_components (
          component_id, candidate_id, name, version, source_path, source_sha256, role
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      for (const comp of candidate.components) {
        insertComp.run(
          comp.component_id || `comp_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
          candidate.candidate_id,
          comp.name,
          comp.version,
          comp.source_path.replace(/\\/g, '/'),
          comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase(),
          comp.role
        );
      }

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    return this.getCandidate(candidate.candidate_id)!;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves a registered algorithm candidate with components.
   */
  public getCandidate(candidateId: string): AlgorithmCandidateSpec | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM algorithm_candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?').get(candidateId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;

    const comps = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM algorithm_candidate_components WHERE candidate_id = ?').all(candidateId) as any[];

    return {
      candidate_id: row.candidate_id,
      candidate_name: row.candidate_name,
      candidate_version: row.candidate_version,
      git_head: row.git_head,
      source_manifest_sha256: row.source_manifest_sha256,
      candidate_content_sha256: row.candidate_content_sha256 || undefined,
      protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
      parent_candidate_id: row.parent_candidate_id,
      scientific_impact: row.scientific_impact,
      components: comps.map(c => ({
        component_id: c.component_id,
        name: c.name,
        version: c.version,
        source_path: c.source_path,
        source_sha256: c.source_sha256,
        role: c.role
      })),
      parameter_digest_sha256: row.parameter_digest_sha256,
      parameters_json: row.parameters_json,
      state: row.state,
      registered_at_utc: row.registered_at_utc,
      registered_by: row.registered_by || undefined,
      superseded_by: row.superseded_by || null,
      superseded_at_utc: row.superseded_at_utc || null,
      rejection_reason: row.rejection_reason || null,
      metadata: row.metadata_json ? JSON.parse(row.metadata_json) : {}
    };
  }

  /**
   * Lists all registered algorithm candidates.
   */
  public listCandidates(): AlgorithmCandidateSpec[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT candidate_id FROM algorithm_candidates ORDER BY registered_at_utc ASC').all() as any[];
    return rows.map(r => this.getCandidate(r.candidate_id)!).filter(Boolean);
  }

  /**
   * Creates a pre-specified Evaluation Plan binding a candidate to cohort and partition rules.
   * Fail-closed:
   * - Verifies study_id, cohort_id, cohort_revision_number exist and cohort revision is frozen (is_frozen === 1) if present in DB.
   * - Verifies datasets in dataset_partitions exist and belong to the cohort revision if cohort_members table has rows for this revision.
   * - Prevents partition leakage: checks that no dataset or subject is shared between 'calibration' and 'holdout'.
   * - Verifies target_endpoints are non-empty and well-formed.
   * - Hashes deterministic plan_digest_sha256.
   */
  public createEvaluationPlan(params: {
    plan_id?: string;
    plan_name: string;
    candidate_id: string;
    study_id?: string;
    cohort_id?: string;
    cohort_revision_number?: number;
    protocol_version?: string;
    target_endpoints: string[];
    dataset_partitions: Record<string, DatasetPartitionClass>;
    allow_calibration_tuning?: boolean;
  }): EvaluationPlan {
    const candidate = this.getCandidate(params.candidate_id);
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Candidate '${params.candidate_id}' not found`);
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(params.target_endpoints) || params.target_endpoints.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Evaluation plan must specify at least one target endpoint');
    }

    // Fail-closed: Dataset partitions cannot be empty
    const partEntries = Object.entries(params.dataset_partitions || {});
    if (partEntries.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Evaluation plan must partition at least one dataset');
    }

    const holdoutDatasets = new Set<string>();
    const calibrationDatasets = new Set<string>();

    for (const [dsId, pClass] of partEntries) {
      if (pClass === 'holdout') {
        holdoutDatasets.add(dsId);
      } else if (pClass === 'calibration') {
        calibrationDatasets.add(dsId);
      }
    }

    // Partition leakage check: No dataset can be both holdout and calibration
    for (const hDs of holdoutDatasets) {
      if (calibrationDatasets.has(hDs)) {
        throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_LEAKAGE_DETECTED: Dataset '${hDs}' is present in both holdout and calibration partitions`);
      }
    }

    if (params.allow_calibration_tuning) {
      if (calibrationDatasets.size === 0) {
        throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Holdout partition datasets cannot be tuned. Calibration tuning requires calibration datasets.');
      }
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const studyId = params.study_id;
    if (!studyId || typeof studyId !== 'string' || studyId.trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: study_id is mandatory and must be explicitly specified');
    }
    const cohortId = params.cohort_id;
    if (!cohortId || typeof cohortId !== 'string' || cohortId.trim() === '') {
      throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: cohort_id is mandatory and must be explicitly specified');
    }
    const cohortRev = params.cohort_revision_number;
    if (typeof cohortRev !== 'number') {
      throw new Error('EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: cohort_revision_number is mandatory and must be explicitly specified');
    }

    const protoVer = params.protocol_version || candidate.protocol_version || 'v1.1.0';
    if (params.protocol_version && candidate.protocol_version && params.protocol_version !== candidate.protocol_version) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: Plan protocol version '${params.protocol_version}' does not match candidate protocol version '${candidate.protocol_version}'`);
    }

    // Verify study exists in database
    const studyRow = db.prepare('SELECT study_id FROM validation_studies WHERE study_id = ?').get(studyId) as any;
    if (!studyRow) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_STUDY_NOT_FOUND: Validation study '${studyId}' does not exist in database`);
    }

    // Verify cohort exists in database
    const cohortRow = db.prepare('SELECT cohort_id, study_id FROM validation_cohorts WHERE cohort_id = ?').get(cohortId) as any;
    if (!cohortRow) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_COHORT_NOT_FOUND: Validation cohort '${cohortId}' does not exist in database`);
    }

    // Verify cohort revision exists and is frozen
    const cohortRevRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT revision_id, is_frozen
      FROM cohort_revisions
      WHERE cohort_id = ? AND revision_number = ?
    `).get(cohortId, cohortRev) as any;

    if (!cohortRevRow) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_COHORT_REVISION_NOT_FOUND: Cohort revision ${cohortRev} for cohort '${cohortId}' does not exist in database`);
    }
    if (cohortRevRow.is_frozen !== 1) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Cohort revision ${cohortRev} for cohort '${cohortId}' is not frozen. Plans require a frozen cohort.`);
    }

    // Verify cohort members and check leakage across partitions
    const members = db.prepare(`
      SELECT member_id, dataset_id, subject_id, eligibility_status, dataset_sha256
      FROM cohort_members
      WHERE revision_id = ?
    `).all(cohortRevRow.revision_id) as any[];

    if (members.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_COHORT_EMPTY: Frozen cohort revision ${cohortRev} has no members`);
    }

    const eligibleMembers = members.filter(m => m.eligibility_status === 'eligible');
    const eligibleDsSet = new Set(eligibleMembers.map(m => m.dataset_id));

    for (const dsId of Object.keys(params.dataset_partitions)) {
      if (!eligibleDsSet.has(dsId)) {
        throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Dataset '${dsId}' is not an eligible member of frozen cohort revision ${cohortRev}`);
      }
    }

    // Check subject and source fingerprint leakage across partitions
    const holdoutSubjects = new Set<string>();
    const calibSubjects = new Set<string>();
    const holdoutFingerprints = new Set<string>();
    const calibFingerprints = new Set<string>();

    for (const m of eligibleMembers) {
      const pType = params.dataset_partitions[m.dataset_id];
      if (pType === 'holdout') {
        holdoutSubjects.add(m.subject_id);
        if (m.dataset_sha256) holdoutFingerprints.add(m.dataset_sha256);
      } else if (pType === 'calibration') {
        calibSubjects.add(m.subject_id);
        if (m.dataset_sha256) calibFingerprints.add(m.dataset_sha256);
      }
    }

    for (const s of holdoutSubjects) {
      if (calibSubjects.has(s)) {
        throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_LEAKAGE_DETECTED: Subject '${s}' is present in both holdout and calibration partitions`);
      }
    }

    for (const fp of holdoutFingerprints) {
      if (calibFingerprints.has(fp)) {
        throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_LEAKAGE_DETECTED: Dataset fingerprint '${fp}' is present in both holdout and calibration partitions`);
      }
    }

    // Validate target endpoints against study contract if defined
    const studyEndpoints = db.prepare('SELECT name, endpoint_id, metric_type FROM study_endpoints WHERE study_id = ?').all(studyId) as any[];
    if (studyEndpoints.length > 0) {
      const definedEndpoints = new Set([
        ...studyEndpoints.map(e => e.name),
        ...studyEndpoints.map(e => e.endpoint_id),
        ...studyEndpoints.map(e => e.metric_type)
      ]);
      for (const ep of params.target_endpoints) {
        if (!definedEndpoints.has(ep)) {
          throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_ENDPOINT_INVALID: Endpoint '${ep}' is not defined for study '${studyId}'`);
        }
      }
    }

    const planId = params.plan_id || `PLAN-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const allowTuning = Boolean(params.allow_calibration_tuning);

    // Canonical sorted representation of partitions
    const sortedPartKeys = Object.keys(params.dataset_partitions).sort();
    const canonicalPartitions: Record<string, DatasetPartitionClass> = {};
    for (const k of sortedPartKeys) {
      canonicalPartitions[k] = params.dataset_partitions[k];
    }

    const sortedEndpoints = params.target_endpoints.slice().sort();

    // Semantic plan digest: excludes human labels and identifiers (plan_id, plan_name)
    const planContent = {
      candidate_id: params.candidate_id,
      study_id: studyId,
      cohort_id: cohortId,
      cohort_revision_number: cohortRev,
      protocol_version: protoVer,
      target_endpoints: sortedEndpoints,
      dataset_partitions: canonicalPartitions,
      allow_calibration_tuning: allowTuning
    };

    const digest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(planContent), 'utf8').digest('hex');

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO candidate_evaluation_plans (
        plan_id, plan_name, candidate_id, study_id, cohort_id, cohort_revision_number,
        protocol_version, target_endpoints_json, dataset_partitions_json,
        allow_calibration_tuning, status, plan_digest_sha256, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      planId,
      params.plan_name,
      params.candidate_id,
      studyId,
      cohortId,
      cohortRev,
      protoVer,
      JSON.stringify(sortedEndpoints),
      JSON.stringify(canonicalPartitions),
      allowTuning ? 1 : 0,
      'draft',
      digest,
      createdAt
    );

    return this.getEvaluationPlan(planId)!;
  }

  /**
   * Freezes an Evaluation Plan, locking its partitions and endpoints immutably.
   * Idempotent check: returns existing if already frozen.
   */
  public freezeEvaluationPlan(planId: string, options?: { idempotent?: boolean }): EvaluationPlan {
    const plan = this.getEvaluationPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_NOT_FOUND: Plan '${planId}' does not exist`);
    if (plan.status === 'frozen') {
      if (options?.idempotent) return plan;
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_ERROR: Evaluation plan '${planId}' is already frozen`);
    }

    const frozenAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE candidate_evaluation_plans
      SET status = 'frozen', frozen_at_utc = ?
      WHERE plan_id = ?
    `).run(frozenAt, planId);

    return this.getEvaluationPlan(planId)!;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves an Evaluation Plan by ID.
   */
  public getEvaluationPlan(planId: string): EvaluationPlan | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidate_evaluation_plans WHERE plan_id = ?').get(planId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;

    return {
      plan_id: row.plan_id,
      plan_name: row.plan_name,
      candidate_id: row.candidate_id,
      study_id: row.study_id,
      cohort_id: row.cohort_id,
      cohort_revision_number: row.cohort_revision_number,
      protocol_version: row.protocol_version,
      target_endpoints: JSON.parse(row.target_endpoints_json),
      dataset_partitions: JSON.parse(row.dataset_partitions_json),
      allow_calibration_tuning: Boolean(row.allow_calibration_tuning),
      status: row.status,
      plan_digest_sha256: row.plan_digest_sha256,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      frozen_at_utc: row.frozen_at_utc || null
    };
  }

  /**
   * Records a bounded evidence decision for an evaluated candidate.
   * Fail-closed:
   * - Requires frozen evaluation plan.
   * - Validates analysis_run_id against study_analysis_runs if record exists.
   * - Checks that analysis_run binds to candidate (candidate_id === candidate_id or candidate_head === candidate.git_head)
   *   and analysis_run binds to evaluation_plan_id.
   * - Requires critical deviations to be mitigated for promotion or retain.
   * - Requires holdout verification for promotion.
   * - Blocks promotion for normative breaking or potential normative shift.
   */
  public recordCandidateDecision(params: {
    decision_id?: string;
    plan_id: string;
    candidate_id: string;
    analysis_run_id: string;
    action: GovernanceDecisionAction;
    overall_verdict?: 'PASS' | 'FAIL' | 'INCONCLUSIVE';
    rationale: string;
    holdout_verified?: boolean;
    critical_deviations_mitigated?: boolean;
    decided_by?: string;
  }): CandidateEvidenceDecision {
    const plan = this.getEvaluationPlan(params.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`EVALUATION_PLAN_NOT_FOUND: Plan '${params.plan_id}' does not exist`);
    }
    if (plan.status !== 'frozen' && plan.status !== 'completed') {
      throw new Error('DECISION_REJECTED: Evaluation plan must be frozen before recording an evidence decision');
    }

    const candidate = this.getCandidate(params.candidate_id);
    if (!candidate) {
      throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND: Candidate '${params.candidate_id}' does not exist`);
    }

    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Mandatory analysis run check: Record MUST exist in study_analysis_runs
    const analysisRun = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE analysis_id = ?
    `).get(params.analysis_run_id) as any;

    if (!analysisRun) {
      throw new Error(`ANALYSIS_RUN_NOT_FOUND: Study analysis run '${params.analysis_run_id}' not found in database`);
    }
    if (analysisRun.status !== 'completed') {
      throw new Error(`ANALYSIS_RUN_INCOMPLETE: Study analysis run '${params.analysis_run_id}' is in status '${analysisRun.status}', must be 'completed'`);
    }

    // 2. Verify candidate & plan bindings on analysis run
    if (analysisRun.study_id && analysisRun.study_id !== plan.study_id) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_DECISION_INVALID: Analysis run study '${analysisRun.study_id}' does not match plan study '${plan.study_id}'`);
    }
    if (analysisRun.cohort_id && analysisRun.cohort_id !== plan.cohort_id) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_DECISION_INVALID: Analysis run cohort '${analysisRun.cohort_id}' does not match plan cohort '${plan.cohort_id}'`);
    }
    if (analysisRun.candidate_id && analysisRun.candidate_id !== candidate.candidate_id) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_DECISION_INVALID: Analysis run candidate '${analysisRun.candidate_id}' does not match candidate '${candidate.candidate_id}'`);
    }
    if (analysisRun.candidate_head && analysisRun.candidate_head.toLowerCase() !== candidate.git_head.toLowerCase()) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_DECISION_INVALID: Analysis run candidate_head '${analysisRun.candidate_head}' does not match candidate git_head '${candidate.git_head}'`);
    }
    if (analysisRun.evaluation_plan_id && analysisRun.evaluation_plan_id !== plan.plan_id) {
      throw new Error(`EVIDENCE_DECISION_INVALID: Analysis run evaluation_plan_id '${analysisRun.evaluation_plan_id}' does not match plan '${plan.plan_id}'`);
    }

    // 3. Machine derivation of holdout verification
    // Must verify: 1) plan defines at least one holdout partition, 2) analysis run completed,
    // and 3) run results or completeness matrix has verified holdout evaluation evidence
    const hasHoldoutPartition = Object.values(plan.dataset_partitions).some(p => p === 'holdout');
    
    let runResults: any = null;
    try {
      if (analysisRun.results_json) {
        runResults = typeof analysisRun.results_json === 'string' ? JSON.parse(analysisRun.results_json) : analysisRun.results_json;
      }
    } catch {}

    let completeness: any = null;
    try {
      if (analysisRun.completeness_matrix_json) {
        completeness = typeof analysisRun.completeness_matrix_json === 'string' ? JSON.parse(analysisRun.completeness_matrix_json) : analysisRun.completeness_matrix_json;
      }
    } catch {}

    let derivedHoldoutVerified = false;
    if (hasHoldoutPartition && analysisRun.status === 'completed') {
      const holdoutFailed = (runResults && (runResults.holdout_verified === false || runResults.holdout_passed === false)) ||
                            (completeness && (completeness.holdout_complete === false || completeness.holdout_verified === false));
      if (!holdoutFailed && runResults && (runResults.verdict === 'PASS' || runResults.overall_verdict === 'PASS' || runResults.passed === true || runResults.holdout_verified === true)) {
        derivedHoldoutVerified = true;
      }
    }

    // 4. Machine derivation of critical deviations mitigation
    const openCriticalDeviations = db.prepare(`
      SELECT deviation_id FROM protocol_deviations
      WHERE study_id = ? AND (cohort_id IS NULL OR cohort_id = ?) AND severity = 'critical' AND resolution_status = 'open'
    `).all(plan.study_id, plan.cohort_id) as any[];

    let openDevsInRun = false;
    try {
      if (analysisRun.deviations_json) {
        const runDevs = typeof analysisRun.deviations_json === 'string' ? JSON.parse(analysisRun.deviations_json) : analysisRun.deviations_json;
        if (Array.isArray(runDevs)) {
          openDevsInRun = runDevs.some((d: any) => d.severity === 'critical' && (d.resolution_status === 'open' || !d.mitigated));
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const derivedCriticalDeviationsMitigated = (openCriticalDeviations.length === 0 && !openDevsInRun);

    // 5. Machine derivation of overall verdict from analysis run results
    // Default to INCONCLUSIVE, NEVER PASS
    let derivedOverallVerdict: 'PASS' | 'FAIL' | 'INCONCLUSIVE' = 'INCONCLUSIVE';
    if (runResults && typeof runResults === 'object') {
      if (runResults.verdict === 'PASS' || runResults.overall_verdict === 'PASS' || runResults.passed === true) {
        derivedOverallVerdict = 'PASS';
      } else if (runResults.verdict === 'FAIL' || runResults.overall_verdict === 'FAIL' || runResults.passed === false) {
        derivedOverallVerdict = 'FAIL';
      } else if (runResults.verdict === 'INCONCLUSIVE' || runResults.overall_verdict === 'INCONCLUSIVE') {
        derivedOverallVerdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE';
      } else {
        derivedOverallVerdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE';
      }
    }

    if (completeness && typeof completeness === 'object') {
      if (completeness.overall_state === 'insufficient_data' || completeness.overall_state === 'unresolved' || completeness.overall_state === 'failed' || completeness.complete === false) {
        derivedOverallVerdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE';
      }
    }

    if (!derivedCriticalDeviationsMitigated && derivedOverallVerdict === 'PASS') {
      derivedOverallVerdict = 'FAIL';
    }
    if (!derivedHoldoutVerified && derivedOverallVerdict === 'PASS') {
      derivedOverallVerdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE';
    }

    // Fail-closed truth: derived values override any caller parameters
    const finalVerdict = derivedOverallVerdict;
    const finalHoldoutVerified = derivedHoldoutVerified;
    const finalDeviationsMitigated = derivedCriticalDeviationsMitigated;

    // Fail-closed governance invariant checks:
    if (!finalDeviationsMitigated && (params.action === 'retain' || params.action === 'non_normative_change_eligible')) {
      throw new Error('GOVERNANCE_RULE_VIOLATION: Candidate promotion requires that critical deviations are mitigated');
    }

    if (!finalHoldoutVerified && params.action === 'non_normative_change_eligible') {
      throw new Error('GOVERNANCE_RULE_VIOLATION: Candidate promotion requires holdout verification');
    }

    if (candidate.scientific_impact === 'normative_breaking' && params.action !== 'reject') {
      throw new Error('GOVERNANCE_RULE_VIOLATION: Normative breaking candidates must be rejected under frozen Protocol v1.1.0');
    }

    if (candidate.scientific_impact === 'potential_normative_shift' && params.action === 'non_normative_change_eligible') {
      throw new Error('GOVERNANCE_RULE_VIOLATION: Potential normative shift cannot be auto-eligible as non-normative change; requires protocol decision');
    }

    const decisionId = params.decision_id || `DEC-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const decidedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const claimsAction = 'no_change';
    const featureAction = 'no_change';

    // Atomic SQLite transaction for decision insertion and candidate lifecycle update
    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO candidate_evidence_decisions (
          decision_id, plan_id, candidate_id, analysis_run_id, action, overall_verdict,
          rationale, holdout_verified, critical_deviations_mitigated,
          claims_registry_action, feature_maturity_action, decided_at_utc, decided_by
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        decisionId,
        params.plan_id,
        params.candidate_id,
        params.analysis_run_id,
        params.action,
        finalVerdict,
        params.rationale,
        finalHoldoutVerified ? 1 : 0,
        finalDeviationsMitigated ? 1 : 0,
        claimsAction,
        featureAction,
        decidedAt,
        params.decided_by || 'local_operator'
      );

      // Update candidate lifecycle state based on action
      if (params.action === 'reject') {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE algorithm_candidates
          SET state = 'rejected', rejection_reason = ?
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
        `).run(params.rationale, params.candidate_id);
      } else if (params.action === 'non_normative_change_eligible') {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE algorithm_candidates
          SET state = 'eligible_for_source_change'
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
        `).run(params.candidate_id);
      } else if (params.action === 'rollback_recommended') {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE algorithm_candidates
          SET state = 'rollback_recommended'
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
        `).run(params.candidate_id);
      }

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    return {
      decision_id: decisionId,
      plan_id: params.plan_id,
      candidate_id: params.candidate_id,
      analysis_run_id: params.analysis_run_id,
      action: params.action,
      overall_verdict: finalVerdict,
      rationale: params.rationale,
      holdout_verified: finalHoldoutVerified,
      critical_deviations_mitigated: finalDeviationsMitigated,
      claims_registry_action: claimsAction,
      feature_maturity_action: featureAction,
      decided_at_utc: decidedAt,
      decided_by: params.decided_by || 'local_operator',
      superseded_by: null
    };
  }

  /**
   * Alias for recordCandidateDecision matching evidence decision governance contract.
   */
  public recordEvidenceDecision(params: Parameters<AlgorithmCandidateRegistryService['recordCandidateDecision']>[0]): CandidateEvidenceDecision {
    return this.recordCandidateDecision(params);
  }

  /**
   * Promotes an eligible candidate to active baseline with supersession of previous baseline.
   * Fail-closed:
   * - Requires an active decision with action === 'non_normative_change_eligible',
   *   overall_verdict === 'PASS', holdout_verified === 1, and critical_deviations_mitigated === 1.
   * - SOURCE TRUTH CHECK: Candidate source manifest MUST equal active working tree manifest.
   *   A different-manifest candidate is eligible_for_source_change only and cannot become active_source_baseline!
   * - Component disk byte equality: every component must match current disk SHA.
   * - Performs atomic state updates and lineage insertion in SQLite transaction.
   */
  public promoteCandidateToBaseline(candidateId: string, decisionId: string, justification: string): BaselineHistoryEntry {
    const candidate = this.getCandidate(candidateId);
    if (!candidate) throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND: Candidate '${candidateId}' not found`);

    const db = getDb();

    // 1. Idempotency: if candidate is already current active baseline, return current entry
    const currentBaseline = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM candidate_baseline_history
      ORDER BY activated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    if (currentBaseline && currentBaseline.candidate_id === candidateId && candidate.state === 'active_source_baseline') {
      return {
        entry_id: currentBaseline.entry_id,
        candidate_id: currentBaseline.candidate_id,
        action_type: currentBaseline.action_type,
        previous_candidate_id: currentBaseline.previous_candidate_id || null,
        decision_id: currentBaseline.decision_id || null,
        activated_at_utc: currentBaseline.activated_at_utc,
        justification: currentBaseline.justification,
        source_manifest_verified: Boolean(currentBaseline.source_manifest_verified)
      };
    }

    // 2. Verify evidence decision
    const decision = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM candidate_evidence_decisions WHERE decision_id = ?
    `).get(decisionId) as any;

    if (!decision) {
      throw new Error(`PROMOTION_ERROR: Evidence decision '${decisionId}' does not exist`);
    }
    if (decision.candidate_id !== candidateId) {
      throw new Error(`PROMOTION_ERROR: Decision '${decisionId}' candidate '${decision.candidate_id}' does not match candidate to promote '${candidateId}'`);
    }
    if (decision.action !== 'non_normative_change_eligible') {
      throw new Error(`PROMOTION_ERROR: Candidate promotion requires decision action 'non_normative_change_eligible', found '${decision.action}'`);
    }
    if (decision.overall_verdict !== 'PASS') {
      throw new Error(`PROMOTION_ERROR: Candidate promotion requires PASS verdict, found '${decision.overall_verdict}'`);
    }
    if (decision.holdout_verified !== 1) {
      throw new Error('PROMOTION_ERROR: Candidate promotion requires verified holdout partition');
    }
    if (decision.critical_deviations_mitigated !== 1) {
      throw new Error('PROMOTION_ERROR: Candidate promotion requires all critical deviations to be mitigated');
    }

    // 3. Receipt-Gated Runtime Activation check
    const receiptPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy', 'verification', 'VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json');
    if (!fs.existsSync(receiptPath)) {
      throw new Error('VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_MISSING: Promotion requires valid .agy/verification/VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json');
    }
    let receipt: any;
    try {
      receipt = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(receiptPath, 'utf8'));
    } catch {
      throw new Error('VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_INVALID: Could not parse .agy/verification/VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json');
    }
    if (
      !receipt.candidate_manifest_sha256 ||
      !candidate.source_manifest_sha256 ||
      receipt.candidate_manifest_sha256.toLowerCase() !== candidate.source_manifest_sha256.toLowerCase()
    ) {
      throw new Error(`VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_MISMATCH: Receipt candidate_manifest_sha256 '${receipt.candidate_manifest_sha256}' does not match candidate source manifest '${candidate.source_manifest_sha256}'`);
    }

    const wiPath = path.join(this.projectRoot, '.agy', 'WORK_ITEM.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(wiPath)) {
      try {
        const wi = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(wiPath, 'utf8'));
        if (wi.work_item_id && receipt.work_item_id && receipt.work_item_id !== wi.work_item_id) {
          throw new Error(`VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_WORK_ITEM_MISMATCH: Receipt work_item_id '${receipt.work_item_id}' does not match active work item '${wi.work_item_id}'`);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.message && err.message.startsWith('VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_')) throw err;
      }
    }

    if (Array.isArray(receipt.tests)) {
      const failed = receipt.tests.filter((t: any) => t.exit_code !== 0);
      if (failed.length > 0) {
        throw new Error('VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_TESTS_FAILED: Cannot promote candidate when verification receipt reports test failures');
      }
    }

    // 4. Source manifest truth check: Candidate manifest must match current working tree manifest
    const activeSourceManifest = this.getActiveSourceManifestSha256();
    if (
      !activeSourceManifest ||
      !candidate.source_manifest_sha256 ||
      activeSourceManifest.toLowerCase() !== candidate.source_manifest_sha256.toLowerCase()
    ) {
      throw new Error(`SOURCE_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: Candidate source manifest does not match active working tree manifest. Candidate is eligible_for_source_change only and cannot be promoted to active_source_baseline.`);
    }

    // 5. Verify disk byte equality for all components against active source tree
    for (const comp of candidate.components) {
      const actualSha = this.computeFileSha256(comp.source_path);
      if (!actualSha || actualSha.toLowerCase() !== comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Component '${comp.name}' does not match current source tree. Runtime baseline promotion forbidden.`);
      }
    }

    const prevCandidateId = currentBaseline ? currentBaseline.candidate_id : null;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const entryId = `base_entry_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      // Mark previous candidate superseded if different
      if (prevCandidateId && prevCandidateId !== candidateId) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE algorithm_candidates
          SET state = 'superseded', superseded_by = ?, superseded_at_utc = ?
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
        `).run(candidateId, now, prevCandidateId);
      }

      // Set candidate state active_source_baseline
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE algorithm_candidates
        SET state = 'active_source_baseline'
        WHERE candidate_id = ?
      `).run(candidateId);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO candidate_baseline_history (
          entry_id, candidate_id, action_type, previous_candidate_id, decision_id,
          activated_at_utc, justification, source_manifest_verified
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
      `).run(
        entryId,
        candidateId,
        'promotion',
        prevCandidateId,
        decisionId,
        now,
        justification
      );

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    return {
      entry_id: entryId,
      candidate_id: candidateId,
      action_type: 'promotion',
      previous_candidate_id: prevCandidateId,
      decision_id: decisionId,
      activated_at_utc: now,
      justification,
      source_manifest_verified: true
    };
  }

  /**
   * Rolls back active baseline to a specified prior candidate.
   * Fail-closed:
   * - Target candidate must exist.
   * - Target candidate MUST be present in prior baseline history (verified prior lineage).
   * - Requires a decision specifically with action 'rollback_recommended' tied to the currently active candidate.
   * - Idempotent: returns current entry if target candidate is already active baseline.
   * - Source-truthful: verifies target candidate's component files and manifest match current disk bytes;
   *   if not, rollback cannot claim active_source_baseline (sets eligible_for_source_change).
   * - Updates states atomically in SQLite transaction.
   */
  public rollbackBaseline(targetCandidateId: string, decisionId: string, justification: string): BaselineHistoryEntry {
    const candidate = this.getCandidate(targetCandidateId);
    if (!candidate) throw new Error(`CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND: Candidate '${targetCandidateId}' not found`);

    const db = getDb();

    // Verify target candidate has prior lineage in baseline history
    const priorLineage = db.prepare(`
      SELECT entry_id FROM candidate_baseline_history WHERE candidate_id = ?
    `).get(targetCandidateId) as any;
    if (!priorLineage) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLBACK_INVALID: Target candidate '${targetCandidateId}' has no prior active baseline lineage in history`);
    }

    const currentBaseline = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM candidate_baseline_history
      ORDER BY activated_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    // Idempotency: if already current active baseline, return current entry
    if (currentBaseline && currentBaseline.candidate_id === targetCandidateId) {
      return {
        entry_id: currentBaseline.entry_id,
        candidate_id: currentBaseline.candidate_id,
        action_type: currentBaseline.action_type,
        previous_candidate_id: currentBaseline.previous_candidate_id || null,
        decision_id: currentBaseline.decision_id || null,
        activated_at_utc: currentBaseline.activated_at_utc,
        justification: currentBaseline.justification,
        source_manifest_verified: Boolean(currentBaseline.source_manifest_verified)
      };
    }

    // Verify rollback decision: MUST be 'rollback_recommended' AND tied to currently active candidate
    const decision = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidate_evidence_decisions WHERE decision_id = ?').get(decisionId) as any;
    if (!decision) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLBACK_INVALID: Evidence decision '${decisionId}' does not exist`);
    }
    if (decision.action !== 'rollback_recommended') {
      throw new Error(`ROLLBACK_INVALID: Rollback requires decision action 'rollback_recommended', found '${decision.action}'`);
    }
    if (currentBaseline && decision.candidate_id !== currentBaseline.candidate_id) {
      throw new Error(`ROLLBACK_INVALID: Rollback decision is tied to candidate '${decision.candidate_id}', but currently active baseline is '${currentBaseline.candidate_id}'`);
    }

    // Source-truthful check: verify target candidate's components and manifest match current disk bytes
    const activeSourceManifest = this.getActiveSourceManifestSha256();
    const manifestMatches = Boolean(
      activeSourceManifest &&
      candidate.source_manifest_sha256 &&
      activeSourceManifest.toLowerCase() === candidate.source_manifest_sha256.toLowerCase()
    );

    let componentsMatch = true;
    for (const comp of candidate.components) {
      const actualSha = this.computeFileSha256(comp.source_path);
      if (!actualSha || actualSha.toLowerCase() !== comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        componentsMatch = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!manifestMatches || !componentsMatch) {
      throw new Error(
        `ROLLBACK_INVALID: Target candidate source manifest and component bytes do not match active working tree source bytes (source_manifest_verified=false). Cannot add unverified baseline history entry.`
      );
    }

    const prevCandidateId = currentBaseline ? currentBaseline.candidate_id : null;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const entryId = `base_entry_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      if (prevCandidateId && prevCandidateId !== targetCandidateId) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE algorithm_candidates
          SET state = 'rolled_back'
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
        `).run(prevCandidateId);
      }

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE algorithm_candidates
        SET state = 'active_source_baseline'
        WHERE candidate_id = ?
      `).run(targetCandidateId);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO candidate_baseline_history (
          entry_id, candidate_id, action_type, previous_candidate_id, decision_id,
          activated_at_utc, justification, source_manifest_verified
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
      `).run(
        entryId,
        targetCandidateId,
        'rollback',
        prevCandidateId,
        decisionId,
        now,
        justification
      );

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      throw err;
    }

    return {
      entry_id: entryId,
      candidate_id: targetCandidateId,
      action_type: 'rollback',
      previous_candidate_id: prevCandidateId,
      decision_id: decisionId,
      activated_at_utc: now,
      justification,
      source_manifest_verified: true
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves full baseline history in chronological order.
   */
  public getBaselineHistory(): BaselineHistoryEntry[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM candidate_baseline_history ORDER BY activated_at_utc ASC').all() as any[];
    return rows.map(r => ({
      entry_id: r.entry_id,
      candidate_id: r.candidate_id,
      action_type: r.action_type,
      previous_candidate_id: r.previous_candidate_id || null,
      decision_id: r.decision_id || null,
      activated_at_utc: r.activated_at_utc,
      justification: r.justification,
      source_manifest_verified: Boolean(r.source_manifest_verified)
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Gets the currently active algorithm candidate baseline.
   * Fail-closed:
   * - Only considers entries where source_manifest_verified = 1.
   * - Verifies that candidate exists and state is 'active_source_baseline'.
   * - Re-verifies confirmed correspondence with current disk source manifest and components.
   * If any check fails, skips unverified candidate and returns null if no valid baseline matches.
   */
  public getActiveBaseline(): AlgorithmCandidateSpec | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT candidate_id, source_manifest_verified FROM candidate_baseline_history
      ORDER BY activated_at_utc DESC
    `).all() as any[];

    for (const row of rows) {
      if (!row.source_manifest_verified) {
        continue;
      }
      const candidate = this.getCandidate(row.candidate_id);
      if (!candidate || candidate.state !== 'active_source_baseline') {
        continue;
      }

      // Source-truthful check: verify candidate's components and manifest match current disk bytes
      const activeSourceManifest = this.getActiveSourceManifestSha256();
      if (
        !activeSourceManifest ||
        !candidate.source_manifest_sha256 ||
        activeSourceManifest.toLowerCase() !== candidate.source_manifest_sha256.toLowerCase()
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      let componentsMatch = true;
      for (const comp of candidate.components) {
        const actualSha = this.computeFileSha256(comp.source_path);
        if (!actualSha || actualSha.toLowerCase() !== comp.source_sha256.toLowerCase()) {
          componentsMatch = false;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (componentsMatch) {
        return candidate;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * StudyCohortService.ts
 *
 * File-first, local-first service for managing Validation Studies,
 * Cohort Revisions, Pre-specified Endpoints, Protocol Deviations,
 * and Fail-Closed Membership Assembly.
 *
 * Backed by durable SQLite tables with optimistic concurrency control and immutable hashing.
 *
 * Protocol v1.1.0 Normative & Frozen
 * DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 */

  public getStudy(studyId: string): ValidationStudy | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM validation_studies WHERE study_id = ?').get(studyId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;
    return this.mapStudyRow(row);
  }

  public createStudy(params: {
    study_id: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    target_hardware?: string;
    spec?: Partial<StudySpecification>;
  }): { success: boolean; study?: ValidationStudy; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT study_id FROM validation_studies WHERE study_id = ?').get(params.study_id);
    if (existing) {
      return { success: false, error: `Study with ID '${params.study_id}' already exists.` };
    }

    const fullSpec: StudySpecification = {
      protocol_version: '1.1.0',
      target_hardware: params.target_hardware || 'Polar H10 Chest Strap',
      inclusion_criteria: params.spec?.inclusion_criteria || ['Admitted dataset with required channels'],
      exclusion_criteria: params.spec?.exclusion_criteria || ['Corrupted or unverified timebase'],
      strata_definitions: params.spec?.strata_definitions || [{ stratum_id: 'default', description: 'Standard stratum' }],
      missingness_policy: params.spec?.missingness_policy || {
        allow_partial_channels: false,
        require_frozen_reference: true,
        max_missing_duration_seconds: 5,
        unresolved_conflict_handling: 'exclude'
      }
    };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO validation_studies (
        study_id, revision, title, protocol_version, description,

      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      params.study_id,
      1,
      params.title,
      '1.1.0',
      params.description,
      params.target_hardware || 'Polar H10 Chest Strap',
      'draft',
      JSON.stringify(fullSpec),
      now,
      now
    );

    return { success: true, study: this.getStudy(params.study_id)! };
  }

  public updateStudyLifecycle(
    studyId: string,
    state: ValidationStudyLifecycleState
  ): { success: boolean; study?: ValidationStudy; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const current = this.getStudy(studyId);
    if (!current) return { success: false, error: 'Study not found.' };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare('UPDATE validation_studies SET lifecycle_state = ?, updated_at_utc = ? WHERE study_id = ?').run(
      state,
      now,
      studyId
    );
    return { success: true, study: this.getStudy(studyId)! };
  }
