  public listCohorts(studyId?: string): ValidationCohort[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (studyId) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM validation_cohorts WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all(studyId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM validation_cohorts ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all();
    }
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapCohortRow(r));
  }

  public getCohort(cohortId: string): ValidationCohort | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM validation_cohorts WHERE cohort_id = ?').get(cohortId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;
    return this.mapCohortRow(row);
  }

  public createCohort(params: {
    cohort_id: string;
    study_id: string;
    name: string;
    description?: string;
  }): { success: boolean; cohort?: ValidationCohort; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const study = this.getStudy(params.study_id);
    if (!study) return { success: false, error: `Study '${params.study_id}' does not exist.` };

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT cohort_id FROM validation_cohorts WHERE cohort_id = ?').get(params.cohort_id);
    if (existing) return { success: false, error: `Cohort with ID '${params.cohort_id}' already exists.` };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const initialRevHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${params.cohort_id}-REV-1-${now}`).digest('hex');

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO validation_cohorts (
          cohort_id, study_id, name, description, current_revision,
          lifecycle_state, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        params.cohort_id,
        params.study_id,
        params.name,
        params.description || '',
        1,
        'draft',
        now,
        now
      );

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO cohort_revisions (
          revision_id, cohort_id, revision_number, is_frozen,
          revision_hash, inclusion_rules_json, exclusion_rules_json, members_count, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        `${params.cohort_id}-REV-1`,
        params.cohort_id,
        1,
        0,
        initialRevHash,
        JSON.stringify(study.spec.inclusion_criteria),
        JSON.stringify(study.spec.exclusion_criteria),
        0,
        now
      );
      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err: any) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to create cohort: ${err.message}` };
    }

    return { success: true, cohort: this.getCohort(params.cohort_id)! };
  }

  public getCohortRevision(cohortId: string, revisionNumber?: number): CohortRevision | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const cohort = this.getCohort(cohortId);
    if (!cohort) return null;

    const revNum = revisionNumber !== undefined ? revisionNumber : cohort.current_revision;
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM cohort_revisions WHERE cohort_id = ? AND revision_number = ?').get(
      cohortId,
      revNum
    ) as any;
    if (!row) return null;

    const revision = this.mapCohortRevisionRow(row);
    revision.members = this.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);
    return revision;
  }

  public listCohortMembers(revisionId: string): CohortMember[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM cohort_members WHERE revision_id = ? ORDER BY added_at_utc ASC').all(
      revisionId
    ) as any[];
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapMemberRow(r));
  }

  /**
   * Screen and add a dataset/member to the active draft revision of a cohort.
   * Fail-closed validation against:
   * - Admitted empirical dataset existence & integrity
   * - Frozen consensus reference authoritative status (if required by study spec)
   * - Candidate-bound validation run validity
   * - Duplicate subject / dataset inflation prevention
   */
  public screenAndAddMember(params: {
    cohort_id: string;
    dataset_id: string;
    subject_id?: string;
    stratum?: string;
    force_eligibility?: MemberEligibilityState;
    exclusion_reason?: string;
  }): { success: boolean; member?: CohortMember; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const cohort = this.getCohort(params.cohort_id);
    if (!cohort) return { success: false, error: 'Cohort not found.' };

    const revision = this.getCohortRevision(params.cohort_id);
    if (!revision) return { success: false, error: 'Cohort revision not found.' };
    if (revision.is_frozen) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Active cohort revision is frozen. Cannot mutate members. Create new revision.' };
    }

    const study = this.getStudy(cohort.study_id);
    if (!study) return { success: false, error: 'Parent study not found.' };

    // 1. Verify Dataset
    const dsRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM empirical_datasets WHERE dataset_id = ?').get(params.dataset_id) as any;
    if (!dsRow) {
      return { success: false, error: `Empirical dataset '${params.dataset_id}' not found in registry.` };
    }
    if (dsRow.admission_status !== 'admitted') {
      return { success: false, error: `Dataset '${params.dataset_id}' is not admitted (status: ${dsRow.admission_status}).` };
    }

    // Determine pseudonymous subject ID
    let resolvedSubjectId = params.subject_id;
    if (!resolvedSubjectId && dsRow.study_lineage_json) {
      try {
        const lineage = JSON.parse(dsRow.study_lineage_json);
        if (lineage.pseudonymous_participant_id) resolvedSubjectId = lineage.pseudonymous_participant_id;
      } catch {}
    }
    if (!resolvedSubjectId) {
      resolvedSubjectId = `SUBJ-${params.dataset_id.slice(0, 16)}`;
    }

    // Check for duplicate subject or dataset inflation in the same revision
    const existingMembers = revision.members || this.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);
    const hasDuplicateDataset = existingMembers.some((m) => m.dataset_id === params.dataset_id);
    if (hasDuplicateDataset) {
      return { success: false, error: `Dataset '${params.dataset_id}' is already enrolled in revision ${revision.revision_number}.` };
    }
    const hasDuplicateSubject = existingMembers.some((m) => m.subject_id === resolvedSubjectId);
    if (hasDuplicateSubject) {
      return { success: false, error: `Subject '${resolvedSubjectId}' is already enrolled in revision ${revision.revision_number} (inflation prohibited).` };
    }

    // 2. Verify Frozen Consensus Reference
    let frozenRefId: string | undefined = undefined;
    let refSha: string | undefined = undefined;
    const refRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM frozen_consensus_references WHERE dataset_id = ? ORDER BY frozen_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get(params.dataset_id) as any;
    if (refRow) {
      frozenRefId = refRow.reference_id;
      refSha = refRow.reference_sha256;
    }

    // 3. Verify Validation Run
    let valRunId: string | undefined = undefined;
    const runRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM empirical_validation_runs WHERE dataset_id = ? ORDER BY executed_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1').get(params.dataset_id) as any;
    if (runRow) {
      valRunId = runRow.run_id;
    }

    // Determine eligibility
    let eligibility: MemberEligibilityState = params.force_eligibility || 'eligible';
    let exclusionReason: string | undefined = params.exclusion_reason;

    if (study.spec.missingness_policy.require_frozen_reference && (!refRow || refRow.consensus_eligibility !== 'authoritative')) {
      eligibility = 'quality_limited';
      exclusionReason = refRow ? `Consensus reference eligibility is '${refRow.consensus_eligibility}', requires 'authoritative'.` : 'No frozen consensus reference ground truth available.';
    }

    const memberId = `MEM-${revision.revision_id}-${params.dataset_id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO cohort_members (
          member_id, revision_id, cohort_id, dataset_id, subject_id,
          stratum, eligibility_status, exclusion_reason, dataset_sha256,
          frozen_reference_id, reference_sha256, validation_run_id, added_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        memberId,
        revision.revision_id,
        cohort.cohort_id,
        params.dataset_id,
        resolvedSubjectId,
        params.stratum || 'default',
        eligibility,
        exclusionReason || null,
        dsRow.content_sha256,
        frozenRefId || null,
        refSha || null,
        valRunId || null,
        now
      );

      const countRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM cohort_members WHERE revision_id = ?').get(revision.revision_id) as { count: number };
      db.prepare('UPDATE cohort_revisions SET members_count = ? WHERE revision_id = ?').run(countRow.count, revision.revision_id);

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err: any) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to insert cohort member: ${err.message}` };
    }

    const inserted = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM cohort_members WHERE member_id = ?').get(memberId);
    return { success: true, member: this.mapMemberRow(inserted) };
  }

  /**
   * Freeze the current cohort revision.
   * Computes deterministic SHA-256 over all sorted member IDs, datasets, and references.
   * Locks the revision so membership can never be modified.
   */
  public freezeCohortRevision(cohortId: string): { success: boolean; revision?: CohortRevision; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const cohort = this.getCohort(cohortId);
    if (!cohort) return { success: false, error: 'Cohort not found.' };

    const revision = this.getCohortRevision(cohortId);
    if (!revision) return { success: false, error: 'Cohort revision not found.' };
    if (revision.is_frozen) {
      return { success: false, error: `Revision ${revision.revision_number} is already frozen.` };
    }

    const members = this.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);
    if (members.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Cannot freeze empty cohort revision. Must screen at least 1 member.' };
    }

    // Deterministic hash of members
    const sortedManifest = members
      .map((m) => ({
        member_id: m.member_id,
        subject_id: m.subject_id,
        dataset_id: m.dataset_id,
        dataset_sha256: m.dataset_sha256,
        stratum: m.stratum,
        eligibility_status: m.eligibility_status,
        frozen_reference_id: m.frozen_reference_id,
        reference_sha256: m.reference_sha256,
        validation_run_id: m.validation_run_id
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.member_id.localeCompare(b.member_id));

    const contentJson = JSON.stringify(sortedManifest);
    const revisionHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(contentJson).digest('hex');
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE cohort_revisions
        SET is_frozen = 1, frozen_at_utc = ?, revision_hash = ?
        WHERE revision_id = ?
      `).run(now, revisionHash, revision.revision_id);

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE validation_cohorts
        SET lifecycle_state = 'frozen', frozen_revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE cohort_id = ?
      `).run(revision.revision_number, now, cohortId);

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err: any) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to freeze revision: ${err.message}` };
    }

    return { success: true, revision: this.getCohortRevision(cohortId, revision.revision_number)! };
  }

  /**
   * Create a new draft revision of an existing cohort (e.g. after superseding).
   */
  public createNextCohortRevision(cohortId: string): { success: boolean; revision?: CohortRevision; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const cohort = this.getCohort(cohortId);
    if (!cohort) return { success: false, error: 'Cohort not found.' };

    const currentRev = this.getCohortRevision(cohortId);
    if (currentRev && !currentRev.is_frozen) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Current revision is still in draft. Freeze it before creating a new revision.' };
    }

    const nextRevNum = cohort.current_revision + 1;
    const nextRevId = `${cohortId}-REV-${nextRevNum}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const initialHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${nextRevId}-${now}`).digest('hex');

    const study = this.getStudy(cohort.study_id);
    const incRules = study ? study.spec.inclusion_criteria : [];
    const excRules = study ? study.spec.exclusion_criteria : [];

    db.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO cohort_revisions (
          revision_id, cohort_id, revision_number, is_frozen,
          revision_hash, inclusion_rules_json, exclusion_rules_json, members_count, created_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        nextRevId,
        cohortId,
        nextRevNum,
        0,
        initialHash,
        JSON.stringify(incRules),
        JSON.stringify(excRules),
        0,
        now
      );

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE validation_cohorts
        SET current_revision = ?, lifecycle_state = 'draft', updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE cohort_id = ?
      `).run(nextRevNum, now, cohortId);

      db.exec('COMMIT;');
    } catch (err: any) {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK;');
      return { success: false, error: `Failed to create next revision: ${err.message}` };
    }

    return { success: true, revision: this.getCohortRevision(cohortId, nextRevNum)! };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Endpoints
  // =========================================================================

  public listEndpoints(studyId: string): StudyEndpoint[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_endpoints WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY created_at_utc ASC').all(studyId) as any[];
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapEndpointRow(r));
  }

  public addEndpoint(params: Omit<StudyEndpoint, 'created_at_utc'>): { success: boolean; endpoint?: StudyEndpoint; error?: string } {
    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT endpoint_id FROM study_endpoints WHERE endpoint_id = ?').get(params.endpoint_id);
    if (existing) return { success: false, error: `Endpoint '${params.endpoint_id}' already exists.` };

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO study_endpoints (
        endpoint_id, study_id, name, metric_type, target_value,
        target_comparator, aggregation_mode, weighting_mode, description, created_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      params.endpoint_id,
      params.study_id,
      params.name,
      params.metric_type,
      params.target_value ?? null,
      params.target_comparator,
      params.aggregation_mode,
      params.weighting_mode,
      params.description || '',
      now
    );

    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_endpoints WHERE endpoint_id = ?').get(params.endpoint_id);
    return { success: true, endpoint: this.mapEndpointRow(row) };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Protocol Deviations
  // =========================================================================

  public recordDeviation(deviation: Omit<ProtocolDeviation, 'recorded_at_utc'>): ProtocolDeviation {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO protocol_deviations (
        deviation_id, study_id, cohort_id, dataset_id, category,
        severity, description, impact_assessment, resolution_status, recorded_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      deviation.deviation_id,
      deviation.study_id,
      deviation.cohort_id || null,
      deviation.dataset_id || null,
      deviation.category,
      deviation.severity,
      deviation.description,
      deviation.impact_assessment,
      deviation.resolution_status,
      now
    );

    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM protocol_deviations WHERE deviation_id = ?').get(deviation.deviation_id);
    return this.mapDeviationRow(row);
  }

  public listDeviations(studyId: string, cohortId?: string): ProtocolDeviation[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (cohortId) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM protocol_deviations WHERE study_id = ? AND (cohort_id = ? OR cohort_id IS NULL) ORDER BY recorded_at_utc DESC').all(studyId, cohortId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM protocol_deviations WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY recorded_at_utc DESC').all(studyId);
    }
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapDeviationRow(r));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Private Row Mappers
  // =========================================================================

  private mapStudyRow(r: any): ValidationStudy {
    return {
      study_id: r.study_id,
      revision: r.revision,
      title: r.title,
      protocol_version: r.protocol_version,
      description: r.description,
      target_hardware: r.target_hardware,
      lifecycle_state: r.lifecycle_state,
      spec: JSON.parse(r.spec_json),
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: r.updated_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapCohortRow(r: any): ValidationCohort {
    return {
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      name: r.name,
      description: r.description,
      current_revision: r.current_revision,
      lifecycle_state: r.lifecycle_state,
      frozen_revision: r.frozen_revision || undefined,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: r.updated_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapCohortRevisionRow(r: any): CohortRevision {
    return {
      revision_id: r.revision_id,
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id,
      revision_number: r.revision_number,
      is_frozen: r.is_frozen === 1,
      frozen_at_utc: r.frozen_at_utc || undefined,
      revision_hash: r.revision_hash,
      inclusion_rules: JSON.parse(r.inclusion_rules_json),
      exclusion_rules: JSON.parse(r.exclusion_rules_json),
      members_count: r.members_count,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapMemberRow(r: any): CohortMember {
    return {
      member_id: r.member_id,
      revision_id: r.revision_id,
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id,
      dataset_id: r.dataset_id,
      subject_id: r.subject_id,
      stratum: r.stratum,
      eligibility_status: r.eligibility_status,
      exclusion_reason: r.exclusion_reason || undefined,
      dataset_sha256: r.dataset_sha256,
      frozen_reference_id: r.frozen_reference_id || undefined,
      reference_sha256: r.reference_sha256 || undefined,
      validation_run_id: r.validation_run_id || undefined,
      added_at_utc: r.added_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapEndpointRow(r: any): StudyEndpoint {
    return {
      endpoint_id: r.endpoint_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      name: r.name,
      metric_type: r.metric_type,
      target_value: r.target_value !== null ? Number(r.target_value) : undefined,
      target_comparator: r.target_comparator,
      aggregation_mode: r.aggregation_mode,
      weighting_mode: r.weighting_mode,
      description: r.description,
      created_at_utc: r.created_at_utc
    };
  }

  private mapDeviationRow(r: any): ProtocolDeviation {
    return {
      deviation_id: r.deviation_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      cohort_id: r.cohort_id || undefined,
      dataset_id: r.dataset_id || undefined,
      category: r.category,
      severity: r.severity,
      description: r.description,
      impact_assessment: r.impact_assessment,
      resolution_status: r.resolution_status,
      recorded_at_utc: r.recorded_at_utc
    };
  }
}

/**
 * StudyGovernanceService.ts
 *
 * Implements protocol deviation tracking, cohort completeness matrices,
 * and fail-closed evidence decision governance.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-634ad96b79e740879439b4fb4314ebfc
 * - Action Packet ECA-05
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 * - Local-first, fail-closed boundaries (no unauthorized claims promotions)
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  CohortCompletenessMatrix,
  CompletenessMatrixEntry,
  CompletenessState,
  EvidenceDecision,
  EvidenceDecisionVerdict,
  ProtocolDeviation,
  ValidationCohort,
  ValidationStudy
} from '../../shared/canonical/StudyCohortContract';
import { StudyCohortService } from './StudyCohortService';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';

export interface RecordEvidenceDecisionParams {
  study_id: string;
  analysis_id: string;
  candidate_head: string;
  overall_verdict: EvidenceDecisionVerdict;
  rationale: string;
  limitations_summary: string;
  claims_registry_action?: 'no_change' | 'require_owner_decision';
  feature_maturity_action?: 'no_change' | 'require_owner_decision';
}

export class StudyGovernanceService {
  private static instance: StudyGovernanceService;

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): StudyGovernanceService {
    if (!StudyGovernanceService.instance) {
      StudyGovernanceService.instance = new StudyGovernanceService();
    }
    return StudyGovernanceService.instance;
  }

  /**
   * Computes the stratified cohort completeness matrix.
   */
  public computeCompletenessMatrix(
    studyId: string,
    cohortId: string,
    revisionNumber?: number
  ): CohortCompletenessMatrix {
    const cohortService = StudyCohortService.getInstance();
    const study = cohortService.getStudy(studyId);
    if (!study) {
      throw new Error(`STUDY_NOT_FOUND: Validation study '${studyId}' not found.`);
    }

    const cohort = cohortService.getCohort(cohortId);
    if (!cohort) {
      throw new Error(`COHORT_NOT_FOUND: Validation cohort '${cohortId}' not found.`);
    }

    const revNum = revisionNumber !== undefined ? revisionNumber : cohort.current_revision;
    const revision = cohortService.getCohortRevision(cohortId, revNum);
    if (!revision) {
      throw new Error(`REVISION_NOT_FOUND: Cohort revision ${revNum} not found.`);
    }

    const members = cohortService.listCohortMembers(revision.revision_id);
    const deviations = cohortService.listDeviations(studyId, cohortId);
    const db = getDb();

    // Group members by stratum
    const strataSet = new Set<string>();
    for (const m of members) {
      strataSet.add(m.stratum || 'default');
    }
    if (strataSet.size === 0) {
      for (const def of study.spec.strata_definitions || []) {
        strataSet.add(def.stratum_id);
      }
      if (strataSet.size === 0) {
        strataSet.add('default');
      }
    }

    const entries: CompletenessMatrixEntry[] = [];

    for (const stratum of Array.from(strataSet).sort()) {
      const stratumMembers = members.filter((m) => (m.stratum || 'default') === stratum);

      const receivedCount = stratumMembers.length;
      // Admitted: underlying dataset exists and admission_status == 'admitted'
      let admittedCount = 0;
      let reviewedCount = 0;
      let eligibleCount = 0;
      let analyzedCount = 0;
      let unresolvedCount = 0;

      for (const m of stratumMembers) {
        if (m.eligibility_status === 'eligible') {
          eligibleCount++;
        } else if (m.eligibility_status === 'unresolved') {
          unresolvedCount++;
        }

        if (m.frozen_reference_id) {
          reviewedCount++;
        }

        // Check empirical_datasets admission
        const ds = db.prepare('SELECT admission_status FROM empirical_datasets WHERE dataset_id = ?').get(m.dataset_id) as any;
        if (ds && ds.admission_status === 'admitted') {
          admittedCount++;
        }

        // Check if analyzed in validation runs
        const run = db.prepare('SELECT run_id FROM empirical_validation_runs WHERE dataset_id = ? LIMIT 1').get(m.dataset_id);
        if (run) {
          analyzedCount++;
        }
      }

      // Check for unmitigated critical or major deviations in this stratum
      const stratumDeviations = deviations.filter(
        (d) => d.resolution_status === 'open' && (d.severity === 'critical' || d.severity === 'major')
      );
      if (stratumDeviations.length > 0) {
        unresolvedCount += stratumDeviations.length;
      }

      let state: CompletenessState = 'complete';
      if (unresolvedCount > 0) {
        state = 'unresolved';
      } else if (receivedCount === 0) {
        state = 'insufficient_data';
      } else if (analyzedCount === 0) {
        state = 'not_evaluated';
      } else if (analyzedCount < eligibleCount) {
        state = 'insufficient_data';
      } else if (stratumMembers.some((m) => m.eligibility_status === 'quality_limited')) {
        state = 'quality_limited';
      } else {
        state = 'complete';
      }

      entries.push({
        stratum,
        planned_count: receivedCount, // In local file-first context, planned matches enrolled cohort targets
        received_count: receivedCount,
        admitted_count: admittedCount,
        reviewed_count: reviewedCount,
        eligible_count: eligibleCount,
        analyzed_count: analyzedCount,
        unresolved_count: unresolvedCount,
        completeness_state: state
      });
    }

    // Determine overall state
    let overallState: CompletenessState = 'complete';
    if (entries.some((e) => e.completeness_state === 'unresolved')) {
      overallState = 'unresolved';
    } else if (entries.some((e) => e.completeness_state === 'failed')) {
      overallState = 'failed';
    } else if (entries.some((e) => e.completeness_state === 'insufficient_data')) {
      overallState = 'insufficient_data';
    } else if (entries.some((e) => e.completeness_state === 'quality_limited')) {
      overallState = 'quality_limited';
    } else if (entries.every((e) => e.completeness_state === 'not_evaluated')) {
      overallState = 'not_evaluated';
    }

    const totalPlanned = entries.reduce((acc, e) => acc + e.planned_count, 0);
    const totalEligible = entries.reduce((acc, e) => acc + e.eligible_count, 0);
    const totalAnalyzed = entries.reduce((acc, e) => acc + e.analyzed_count, 0);

    return {
      study_id: studyId,
      cohort_id: cohortId,
      revision_number: revNum,
      overall_state: overallState,
      entries,
      summary: {
        total_planned: totalPlanned,
        total_eligible: totalEligible,
        total_analyzed: totalAnalyzed,
        total_deviations: deviations.length
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Records a formal evidence decision with fail-closed safety checks.
   */
  public recordEvidenceDecision(params: RecordEvidenceDecisionParams): {
    success: boolean;
    decision?: EvidenceDecision;
    error?: string;
  } {
    const db = getDb();
    const cohortService = StudyCohortService.getInstance();

    const study = cohortService.getStudy(params.study_id);
    if (!study) {
      return { success: false, error: `Study '${params.study_id}' does not exist.` };
    }

    // Fetch analysis run
    const runRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_analysis_runs WHERE analysis_id = ?').get(params.analysis_id) as any;
    if (!runRow) {
      return { success: false, error: `Study analysis run '${params.analysis_id}' not found.` };
    }
    if (runRow.status !== 'completed') {
      return { success: false, error: `Analysis run '${params.analysis_id}' is not in completed status (status: ${runRow.status}).` };
    }

    // Verify cohort revision is frozen
    const revision = cohortService.getCohortRevision(runRow.cohort_id, runRow.revision_number);
    if (!revision || !revision.is_frozen) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `COHORT_NOT_FROZEN: Evidence decisions require a frozen cohort revision (revision ${runRow.revision_number} is not frozen).`
      };
    }

    // Check for open critical deviations
    const deviations = cohortService.listDeviations(params.study_id, runRow.cohort_id);
    const openCriticalDeviations = deviations.filter(
      (d) => d.severity === 'critical' && d.resolution_status === 'open'
    );

    if (openCriticalDeviations.length > 0 && params.overall_verdict === 'authoritative_evidence') {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `UNRESOLVED_CRITICAL_DEVIATION: Cannot issue 'authoritative_evidence' verdict while ${openCriticalDeviations.length} critical protocol deviation(s) remain open.`
      };
    }

    // Completeness check
    const completenessMatrix: CohortCompletenessMatrix = JSON.parse(runRow.completeness_matrix_json);
    if (
      (completenessMatrix.overall_state === 'insufficient_data' || completenessMatrix.overall_state === 'unresolved') &&
      params.overall_verdict === 'authoritative_evidence'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `INCOMPLETE_COHORT: Cannot issue 'authoritative_evidence' verdict when completeness state is '${completenessMatrix.overall_state}'.`
      };
    }

    // Fail-closed governance: claims_registry_action and feature_maturity_action default to 'no_change'
    const claimsAction = params.claims_registry_action || 'no_change';
    const featureAction = params.feature_maturity_action || 'no_change';

    const decisionId = `DECISION-${Date.now()}-${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const decision: EvidenceDecision = {
      decision_id: decisionId,
      study_id: params.study_id,
      analysis_id: params.analysis_id,
      candidate_head: params.candidate_head,
      overall_verdict: params.overall_verdict,
      claims_registry_action: claimsAction,
      feature_maturity_action: featureAction,
      rationale: params.rationale,
      limitations_summary: params.limitations_summary,
      decided_at_utc: now
    };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO evidence_decisions (
        decision_id, study_id, analysis_id, candidate_head,
        overall_verdict, claims_registry_action, feature_maturity_action,
        rationale, limitations_summary, decided_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      decision.decision_id,
      decision.study_id,
      decision.analysis_id,
      decision.candidate_head,
      decision.overall_verdict,
      decision.claims_registry_action,
      decision.feature_maturity_action,
      decision.rationale,
      decision.limitations_summary,
      decision.decided_at_utc
    );

    return { success: true, decision: this.getEvidenceDecision(decisionId)! };
  }

  public getEvidenceDecision(decisionId: string): EvidenceDecision | null {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM evidence_decisions WHERE decision_id = ?').get(decisionId) as any;
    if (!row) return null;
    return this.mapDecisionRow(row);
  }

  public listEvidenceDecisions(studyId?: string): EvidenceDecision[] {
    const db = getDb();
    let rows: any[];
    if (studyId) {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM evidence_decisions WHERE study_id = ? ORDER BY decided_at_utc DESC').all(studyId);
    } else {
      rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM evidence_decisions ORDER BY decided_at_utc DESC').all();
    }
    return rows.map((r) => this.mapDecisionRow(r));
  }

  private mapDecisionRow(r: any): EvidenceDecision {
    return {
      decision_id: r.decision_id,
      study_id: r.study_id,
      analysis_id: r.analysis_id,
      candidate_head: r.candidate_head,
      overall_verdict: r.overall_verdict,
      claims_registry_action: r.claims_registry_action,
      feature_maturity_action: r.feature_maturity_action,
      rationale: r.rationale,
      limitations_summary: r.limitations_summary,
      decided_at_utc: r.decided_at_utc
    };
  }
}

/**
 * StudyOperationsService.ts
 *
 * File-first, local-first service for managing Study Acquisition Plans,
 * Capture Sessions, Preflight Gates, Data-only Kits, and Intake Handoff.
 * Backed by durable SQLite tables with optimistic concurrency control.
 *
 * Protocol v1.1.0 Normative & Frozen
 * DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  StudyAcquisitionPlan,
  StudyCaptureSession,
  StudySessionPreflightResult,
  StudyPreflightIssue,
  StudyAcquisitionKitManifest,
  STUDY_OPERATIONS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  StudySessionLifecycleState
} from '../../shared/canonical/StudyOperationsContract';
import {
  EmpiricalDatasetRecord,
  EmpiricalChannelType
} from '../../shared/canonical/EmpiricalDatasetContract';
import {
  EmpiricalDatasetIntakeService,
  IntakeRegistrationPayload
} from '../ingestion/EmpiricalDatasetIntakeService';
import { PathSanitizer, StudyPathCapabilityService } from '../security/PathSanitizer';
import { TimebaseSynchronizationService } from '../analytics/TimebaseSynchronizationService';
import { getDb } from '../db/db';

export class StudyOperationsService {
  private static instance: StudyOperationsService;

  private static readonly ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Record<StudySessionLifecycleState, StudySessionLifecycleState[]> = {
    draft: ['ready', 'recording_external', 'rejected'],
    ready: ['recording_external', 'files_received', 'rejected'],
    recording_external: ['files_received', 'rejected'],
    files_received: ['preflight_passed', 'quality_limited', 'rejected'],
    preflight_passed: ['admitted', 'rejected', 'quality_limited'],
    admitted: [], // terminal state
    quality_limited: ['admitted', 'rejected'],
    rejected: ['draft', 'ready', 'files_received'], // allow retry from draft/ready
    not_evaluated: ['draft', 'ready', 'files_received']
  };

  private constructor() {
    this.seedDefaultPlansIfMissing();
  }

  public static getInstance(): StudyOperationsService {
    if (!StudyOperationsService.instance) {
      StudyOperationsService.instance = new StudyOperationsService();
    }
    return StudyOperationsService.instance;
  }

    db.prepare('DELETE FROM study_capture_sessions').run();
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM study_acquisition_plans').run();
    this.seedDefaultPlansIfMissing();
  }

  public listPlans(): StudyAcquisitionPlan[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT spec_json FROM study_acquisition_plans ORDER BY plan_id ASC, revision DESC').all() as { spec_json: string }[];
    return rows.map(r => JSON.parse(r.spec_json) as StudyAcquisitionPlan);
  }

  public getPlan(planId: string, revision?: number): StudyAcquisitionPlan | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    let row: { spec_json: string } | undefined;
    if (revision !== undefined) {
      row = db.prepare('SELECT spec_json FROM study_acquisition_plans WHERE plan_id = ? AND revision = ?').get(planId, revision) as { spec_json: string } | undefined;
    } else {
      row = db.prepare('SELECT spec_json FROM study_acquisition_plans WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1').get(planId) as { spec_json: string } | undefined;
    }
    if (!row) return undefined;
    return JSON.parse(row.spec_json) as StudyAcquisitionPlan;
  }

  public registerPlan(plan: StudyAcquisitionPlan): StudyAcquisitionPlan {
    if (!plan.plan_id || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,64}$/.test(plan.plan_id)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid plan_id: ${plan.plan_id}`);
    }
    if (plan.quality_prerequisites.allow_acc_motion_as_workload_power !== false) {
      throw new Error('ACC_MOTION_SUBSTITUTION_PROHIBITED: allow_acc_motion_as_workload_power must be false.');
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const planToSave: StudyAcquisitionPlan = {
      ...plan,
      revision: plan.revision || 1,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    const db = getDb();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO study_acquisition_plans (plan_id, revision, plan_type, title, spec_json, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      planToSave.plan_id,
      planToSave.revision,
      planToSave.plan_type,
      planToSave.title,
      JSON.stringify(planToSave),
      planToSave.created_at_utc || nowIso,
      nowIso
    );

    return planToSave;
  }

  public listSessions(): StudyCaptureSession[] {
    const db = getDb();
    const rows = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_capture_sessions ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC').all() as any[];
    return rows.map(r => this.mapSessionRow(r));
  }

  public getSession(sessionId: string): StudyCaptureSession | undefined {
    const db = getDb();
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE session_id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!row) return undefined;
    return this.mapSessionRow(row);
  }

  private mapSessionRow(row: any): StudyCaptureSession {
    const db = getDb();
    const historyRows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT state, reason, transitioned_at_utc
      FROM study_session_lifecycle_events
      WHERE session_id = ?
      ORDER BY id ASC
    `).all(row.session_id) as any[];

    const lifecycleHistory = historyRows.map(h => ({
      state: h.state as StudySessionLifecycleState,
      transitioned_at_utc: h.transitioned_at_utc,
      reason: h.reason || undefined
    }));

    return {
      session_id: row.session_id,
      revision: row.revision,
      plan_id: row.plan_id,
      plan_revision: row.plan_revision,
      pseudonymous_participant_id: row.pseudonymous_participant_id,
      lifecycle_state: row.lifecycle_state as StudySessionLifecycleState,
      lifecycle_history: lifecycleHistory,
      capture_context: JSON.parse(row.capture_context_json),
      synchronization_evidence: JSON.parse(row.sync_evidence_json),
      expected_files: JSON.parse(row.expected_files_json),
      preflight_result: row.preflight_result_json ? JSON.parse(row.preflight_result_json) : undefined,
      admitted_dataset_id: row.admitted_dataset_id || undefined,
      created_at_utc: row.created_at_utc,
      updated_at_utc: row.updated_at_utc
    };
  }

  public createSession(params: {
    session_id: string;
    plan_id: string;
    pseudonymous_participant_id: string;
    environment?: 'indoor_trainer' | 'treadmill' | 'ergometer' | 'supine_rest' | 'other';
    notes?: string;
  }): StudyCaptureSession {
    const plan = this.getPlan(params.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`PLAN_NOT_FOUND: Plan with id ${params.plan_id} does not exist.`);
    }

    if (!params.session_id || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,64}$/.test(params.session_id)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid session_id: ${params.session_id}`);
    }

    if (!params.pseudonymous_participant_id || params.pseudonymous_participant_id.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new Error('pseudonymous_participant_id is required.');
    }

    const db = getDb();
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT session_id FROM study_capture_sessions WHERE session_id = ?').get(params.session_id);
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error(`SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS: Session ${params.session_id} already exists.`);
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const expectedFiles = plan.expected_channels.map(ch => ({
      relative_path: `${params.session_id}_${ch.channel.toLowerCase()}.${ch.channel === 'WORKLOAD_POWER' ? 'csv' : 'txt'}`,
      channel: ch.channel,
      expected_unit: ch.expected_unit,
      status: 'pending' as const
    }));

    const session: StudyCaptureSession = {
      session_id: params.session_id,
      revision: 1,
      plan_id: plan.plan_id,
      plan_revision: plan.revision,
      pseudonymous_participant_id: params.pseudonymous_participant_id,
      lifecycle_state: 'draft',
      lifecycle_history: [
        {
          state: 'draft',
          transitioned_at_utc: nowIso,
          reason: 'Session created'
        }
      ],
      capture_context: {
        environment: params.environment || 'indoor_trainer',
        sensor_location: 'chest_strap_polar_h10',
        recorded_date_utc: nowIso,
        notes: params.notes
      },
      synchronization_evidence: {
        method: plan.synchronization_requirement.method,
        declared_clock_reference: 'sensor_monotonic_ns',
        monotonic_verified: false
      },
      expected_files: expectedFiles,
      created_at_utc: nowIso,
      updated_at_utc: nowIso
    };

    db.transaction(() => {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO study_capture_sessions (
          session_id, revision, plan_id, plan_revision, pseudonymous_participant_id,
          lifecycle_state, capture_context_json, sync_evidence_json, expected_files_json,
          created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        session.session_id,
        session.revision,
        session.plan_id,
        session.plan_revision,
        session.pseudonymous_participant_id,
        session.lifecycle_state,
        JSON.stringify(session.capture_context),
        JSON.stringify(session.synchronization_evidence),
        JSON.stringify(session.expected_files),
        session.created_at_utc,
        session.updated_at_utc
      );

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO study_session_lifecycle_events (session_id, state, reason, transitioned_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(session.session_id, 'draft', 'Session created', nowIso);
    })();

    return session;
  }

  public updateSessionLifecycle(
    sessionId: string,
    newState: StudySessionLifecycleState,
    reason?: string,
    expectedRevision?: number
  ): StudyCaptureSession {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ${sessionId}`);
    }

    if (expectedRevision !== undefined && session.revision !== expectedRevision) {
      throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Session revision conflict. Expected ${expectedRevision}, but database has ${session.revision}.`);
    }

    // Validate lifecycle transition
    if (session.lifecycle_state !== newState) {
      const allowed = StudyOperationsService.ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[session.lifecycle_state] || [];
      if (!allowed.includes(newState)) {
        throw new Error(`ILLEGAL_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION: Cannot transition from ${session.lifecycle_state} to ${newState}. Allowed: ${allowed.join(', ')}`);
      }
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newRevision = session.revision + 1;
    const db = getDb();

    db.transaction(() => {
      const res = db.prepare(`
        UPDATE study_capture_sessions
        SET lifecycle_state = ?, revision = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE session_id = ? AND revision = ?
      `).run(newState, newRevision, nowIso, sessionId, session.revision);

      if (res.changes === 0) {
        throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Optimistic concurrency conflict while updating lifecycle for session ${sessionId}.`);
      }

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO study_session_lifecycle_events (session_id, state, reason, transitioned_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(sessionId, newState, reason || null, nowIso);
    })();

    return this.getSession(sessionId)!;
  }

  /**
   * Generates a data-only acquisition kit template.
   * Zero binaries or installers. Strictly specifications and checklists.
   */
  public generateAcquisitionKit(planId: string): StudyAcquisitionKitManifest {
    const plan = this.getPlan(planId);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`PLAN_NOT_FOUND: ${planId}`);
    }

    const checklist = [
      `# Study Acquisition Checklist: ${plan.title}`,
      '',
      '**Plan ID:** ' + plan.plan_id + ' (Revision ' + plan.revision + ')',
      '**Protocol Version:** ' + plan.protocol_version + ' (Normative & Frozen)',
      '**Target Hardware:** ' + plan.target_hardware,
      '',
      '## Non-Diagnostic Medical Device Disclaimer',
      '> **WARNING:** This acquisition kit and protocol are for non-diagnostic research and technical software benchmarking only.',
      '> Polar H10 and CardioLab are not clinical or diagnostic medical devices.',
      '',
      '## Distribution Deferral Notice',
      '> **DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true**: This package contains data specifications and checklists only. No application binaries or installers are included.',
      '',
      '## Pre-Flight Checklist',
      '- [ ] Verify skin contact and moisten Polar H10 strap electrodes with water/gel.',
      '- [ ] Confirm battery voltage > 3.0V (or reported level > 80%).',
      '- [ ] Mount sensor centered on lower chest xiphoid process.',
      plan.plan_type === 'hr_calibrated_workload'
        ? '- [ ] Calibrate direct mechanical ergometer / power meter (Zero-offset before session).\n- [ ] Note: Accelerometer (ACC) motion magnitude CANNOT substitute for mechanical power.'
        : '- [ ] Confirm simultaneous recording of ECG and raw RR streams on same device session.',
      `- [ ] Minimum continuous recording duration: ${plan.quality_prerequisites.min_continuous_duration_seconds} seconds.`,
      '- [ ] Confirm export files are saved in UTF-8 text format with monotonic timestamps.',
      ''
    ].join('\n');

    const expectedFilesTemplate = plan.expected_channels.map(ch => ({
      filename: `session_id_${ch.channel.toLowerCase()}.${ch.channel === 'WORKLOAD_POWER' ? 'csv' : 'txt'}`,
      format: ch.channel === 'WORKLOAD_POWER' ? 'CSV' : 'Polar Sensor Logger TXT',
      columns: ch.channel === 'ECG'
        ? ['timestamp [ms]', 'ecg [uV]']
        : ch.channel === 'RR'
          ? ['timestamp [ms]', 'rr_interval [ms]']
          : ch.channel === 'HR'
            ? ['timestamp [ms]', 'hr [bpm]']
            : ['timestamp [ms]', 'power [W]'],
      sample_rate_hz: ch.nominal_sample_rate_hz,
      unit: ch.expected_unit,
      notes: ch.description
    }));

    const syncGuide = [
      '# Channel Synchronization Guide',
      '',
      `Method: ${plan.synchronization_requirement.method}`,
      `Max acceptable clock uncertainty: ±${plan.synchronization_requirement.max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms} ms`,
      '',
      'For Polar H10 paired streams, the hardware sensor monotonic clock (timestamp [ms] or sensor timestamp [ns])',
      'originating from the onboard Nordic nRF52 micro-controller serves as the authoritative timebase anchor.',
      'Ensure neither stream undergoes lossy resample or variable smoothing prior to intake.'
    ].join('\n');

    return {
      kit_id: `KIT-${plan.plan_id}-R${plan.revision}`,
      plan_id: plan.plan_id,
      plan_title: plan.title,
      version: '1.1.0',
      distribution_deferred_statement: 'DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true: This package contains data specifications and checklists only. No application binaries or installers are included.',
      checklist_markdown: checklist,
      expected_files_template: expectedFilesTemplate,
      synchronization_guide_markdown: syncGuide,
      non_diagnostic_notice: 'Non-diagnostic research protocol only. Not certified for medical diagnosis or clinical decision making.'
    };
  }

  /**
   * Preflights an acquisition session against plan prerequisites,
   * checking file presence, schema, monotonic timebase, duration, and channel integrity.
   * Derives real timebase synchronization via TimebaseSynchronizationService.
   */
  public preflightSession(
    sessionId: string,
    baseDir: string,
    fileMap: { channel: EmpiricalChannelType; relative_path: string }[],
    options?: {
      capabilityId?: string;
      expectedRevision?: number;
    }
  ): StudySessionPreflightResult {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ${sessionId}`);
    }
    const plan = this.getPlan(session.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`PLAN_NOT_FOUND: ${session.plan_id}`);
    }

    if (options?.expectedRevision !== undefined && session.revision !== options.expectedRevision) {
      throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Session revision conflict on preflight. Expected ${options.expectedRevision}, found ${session.revision}.`);
    }

    // Verify capability token if provided
    let effectiveBaseDir = baseDir;
    if (options?.capabilityId) {
      const cap = StudyPathCapabilityService.getInstance().verifyAndConsume(
        options.capabilityId,
        'study_preflight',
        sessionId,
        session.revision
      );
      effectiveBaseDir = cap.allowed_base_dir;
    }

    const issues: StudyPreflightIssue[] = [];
    const rejectionReasons: string[] = [];
    const normalizedBase = path.resolve(effectiveBaseDir);

    const channelSummary: StudySessionPreflightResult['channel_summary'] = [];
    const channelMap = new Map<EmpiricalChannelType, { path: string; fullPath: string }>();

    for (const f of fileMap) {
      try {
        PathSanitizer.validateSafeFilename(path.basename(f.relative_path));
      } catch {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'UNSAFE_FILENAME',
          message: `Filename contains unsafe characters: ${f.relative_path}`,
          channel: f.channel,
          file: f.relative_path
        });
        continue;
      }

      const fullPath = path.resolve(normalizedBase, f.relative_path);
      if (!PathSanitizer.isPathContained(fullPath, normalizedBase)) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED',
          message: `Path escapes base directory: ${f.relative_path}`,
          channel: f.channel,
          file: f.relative_path
        });
        continue;
      }

      channelMap.set(f.channel, { path: f.relative_path, fullPath });
    }

    // Extracted timestamps for cross-channel synchronization check
    const channelTimestamps: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    const fileHashes: Record<string, string> = {};

    // Check required channels from plan
    for (const expected of plan.expected_channels) {
      const found = channelMap.get(expected.channel);
      if (expected.required && !found) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'MISSING_REQUIRED_CHANNEL',
          message: `Required channel ${expected.channel} is missing from session file map.`,
          channel: expected.channel
        });
        rejectionReasons.push(`Missing required channel: ${expected.channel}`);
        channelSummary.push({
          channel: expected.channel,
          present: false,
          duration_seconds: 0,
          sample_count: 0,
          is_monotonic: false,
          unit_matched: false
        });
        continue;
      }

      if (!found) continue;

      if (!fs.existsSync(found.fullPath)) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
          message: `File not found on disk: ${found.path}`,
          channel: expected.channel,
          file: found.path
        });
        rejectionReasons.push(`File missing on disk: ${found.path}`);
        channelSummary.push({
          channel: expected.channel,
          present: false,
          duration_seconds: 0,
          sample_count: 0,
          is_monotonic: false,
          unit_matched: false
        });
        continue;
      }

      const stat = fs.statSync(found.fullPath);
      if (stat.size === 0) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'EMPTY_FILE',
          message: `File is 0 bytes: ${found.path}`,
          channel: expected.channel,
          file: found.path
        });
        rejectionReasons.push(`Empty file: ${found.path}`);
        continue;
      }

      // Channel inspect: parse ALL text timestamps to verify monotonicity & duration
      const content = fs.readFileSync(found.fullPath, 'utf8');
      const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0 && !l.startsWith('#') && !l.startsWith('timestamp'));

      let isMonotonic = true;
      let lastTs = -Infinity;
      let sampleCount = lines.length;
      let durationSec = 0;
      const parsedTs: number[] = [];

      if (sampleCount > 1) {
        const firstParts = lines[0].split(/[;,\t\s]+/);
        const lastParts = lines[lines.length - 1].split(/[;,\t\s]+/);
        const tStart = parseFloat(firstParts[0]);
        const tEnd = parseFloat(lastParts[0]);

        if (!isNaN(tStart) && !isNaN(tEnd) && tEnd > tStart) {
          const scale = tEnd > 1e12 ? 1e-6 : 1.0;
          durationSec = (tEnd - tStart) * scale / 1000;
        }

        // Full-file monotonicity inspection across all lines
        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
          const parts = lines[i].split(/[;,\t\s]+/);
          const rawTs = parseFloat(parts[0]);
          if (!isNaN(rawTs)) {
            const normMs = rawTs > 1e12 ? rawTs * 1e-6 : rawTs;
            if (rawTs <= lastTs) {
              isMonotonic = false;
            }
            lastTs = rawTs;
            parsedTs.push(normMs);
          }
        }
      }

      channelTimestamps[expected.channel] = parsedTs;

      if (!isMonotonic) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS',
          message: `Channel ${expected.channel} timestamps are non-monotonic or contain backwards clock drift.`,
          channel: expected.channel,
          file: found.path
        });
        rejectionReasons.push(`Channel ${expected.channel} non-monotonic timestamps.`);
      }

      if (durationSec < expected.min_duration_seconds) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'blocker',
          code: 'INSUFFICIENT_DURATION',
          message: `Channel ${expected.channel} duration (${durationSec.toFixed(1)}s) is below minimum (${expected.min_duration_seconds}s).`,
          channel: expected.channel,
          file: found.path
        });
        rejectionReasons.push(`Channel ${expected.channel} duration below minimum.`);
      }

      const fileSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
      fileHashes[found.path] = fileSha;

      channelSummary.push({
        channel: expected.channel,
        present: true,
        duration_seconds: durationSec,
        sample_count: sampleCount,
        is_monotonic: isMonotonic,
        unit_matched: true,
        file_path: found.path,
        sha256: fileSha
      });
    }

    // ACC motion power substitution prohibition check
    if (plan.quality_prerequisites.allow_acc_motion_as_workload_power === false) {
      for (const f of fileMap) {
        if (f.channel === ('ACC' as any) && plan.plan_type === 'hr_calibrated_workload') {
          issues.push({
            severity: 'blocker',
            code: 'ACC_MOTION_SUBSTITUTION_REJECTED',
            message: 'Protocol prohibits substituting ACC motion magnitude for direct mechanical workload power.',
            channel: 'WORKLOAD_POWER',
            file: f.relative_path
          });
          rejectionReasons.push('ACC motion magnitude cannot substitute for mechanical workload power.');
        }
      }
    }

    // Synchronize channels using TimebaseSynchronizationService
    let syncPassed = true;
    let syncUncertaintyMs = plan.synchronization_requirement.max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms;
    if (plan.plan_type === 'paired_ecg_rr') {
      const ecgTs = channelTimestamps['ECG'] || [];
      const rrTs = channelTimestamps['RR'] || [];
      if (ecgTs.length > 0 && rrTs.length > 0) {
        const alignResult = TimebaseSynchronizationService.alignTimebases({
          primary_channel: 'ECG',
          secondary_channel: 'RR',
          primary_timestamps_ms: ecgTs,
          secondary_timestamps_ms: rrTs,
          max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms: plan.synchronization_requirement.max_acceptable_uncertainty_ms
        });
        if (!alignResult.is_aligned) {
          syncPassed = false;
          issues.push({
            severity: 'blocker',
            code: 'TIMEBASE_SYNC_FAILED',
            message: `Timebase alignment failed between ECG and RR: ${alignResult.notes.join(' ')}`
          });
          rejectionReasons.push('Timebase alignment failed between ECG and RR.');
        } else {
          syncUncertaintyMs = alignResult.residual_uncertainty_ms;
        }
      }
    }

    const blockers = issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'blocker');
    const passed = blockers.length === 0 && syncPassed;

    const evaluationId = `PREFLIGHT-${sessionId}-${Date.now()}`;
    const preflightResult: StudySessionPreflightResult = {
      evaluation_id: evaluationId,
      evaluated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      passed,
      issues,
      channel_summary: channelSummary,
      file_hashes: fileHashes,
      sync_summary: {
        is_synchronized: passed,
        uncertainty_ms: passed ? syncUncertaintyMs : 9999,
        method: plan.synchronization_requirement.method
      },
      task_readiness: {
        qrs_peak_detection_ready: passed && plan.target_tasks.includes('qrs_peak_detection'),
        ecg_rr_agreement_ready: passed && plan.target_tasks.includes('ecg_rr_agreement'),
        cardiac_drift_ready: passed && plan.target_tasks.includes('cardiac_drift_evaluation')
      },
      rejection_reasons: rejectionReasons
    };

    const nextState: StudySessionLifecycleState = passed ? 'preflight_passed' : 'rejected';
    const transitionReason = passed ? 'Preflight gate passed 100%' : `Preflight failed: ${rejectionReasons.join(', ')}`;

    // Persist preflight result and transition in SQLite transaction
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newRevision = session.revision + 1;
    const db = getDb();

    db.transaction(() => {
      const res = db.prepare(`
        UPDATE study_capture_sessions
        SET lifecycle_state = ?,
            revision = ?,
            preflight_result_json = ?,
            sync_evidence_json = ?,
            updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE session_id = ? AND revision = ?
      `).run(
        nextState,
        newRevision,
        JSON.stringify(preflightResult),
        JSON.stringify({
          ...session.synchronization_evidence,
          monotonic_verified: passed,
          estimated_uncertainty_ms: syncUncertaintyMs
        }),
        nowIso,
        sessionId,
        session.revision
      );

      if (res.changes === 0) {
        throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Optimistic concurrency conflict saving preflight for session ${sessionId}.`);
      }

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO study_session_lifecycle_events (session_id, state, reason, transitioned_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(sessionId, nextState, transitionReason, nowIso);
    })();

    return preflightResult;
  }

  /**
   * Admits a preflight-passed session into the empirical dataset registry,
   * preserving full study lineage (plan_id, session_id, revision) without synthetic contamination.
   */
  public admitSessionToEmpiricalRegistry(
    sessionId: string,
    baseDir: string,
    fileMap: { channel: EmpiricalChannelType; relative_path: string }[],
    options?: {
      capabilityId?: string;
      expectedRevision?: number;
    }
  ): EmpiricalDatasetRecord {
    let session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`SESSION_NOT_FOUND: ${sessionId}`);
    }
    const plan = this.getPlan(session.plan_id);
    if (!plan) {
      throw new Error(`PLAN_NOT_FOUND: ${session.plan_id}`);
    }

    if (options?.expectedRevision !== undefined && session.revision !== options.expectedRevision) {
      throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Session revision conflict on admission. Expected ${options.expectedRevision}, found ${session.revision}.`);
    }

    let effectiveBaseDir = baseDir;
    if (options?.capabilityId) {
      const cap = StudyPathCapabilityService.getInstance().verifyAndConsume(
        options.capabilityId,
        'study_admission',
        sessionId,
        session.revision
      );
      effectiveBaseDir = cap.allowed_base_dir;
    }

    // Run preflight if not done or failed
    if (!session.preflight_result || !session.preflight_result.passed) {
      const preflight = this.preflightSession(sessionId, effectiveBaseDir, fileMap);
      if (!preflight.passed) {
        throw new Error(`STUDY_SESSION_PREFLIGHT_FAILED: ${preflight.rejection_reasons.join(', ')}`);
      }
      session = this.getSession(sessionId)!;
    } else if (session.preflight_result && session.preflight_result.file_hashes) {
      // Re-verify file inventory and SHA-256 hashes against preflight results to block TOCTOU mutations
      for (const f of fileMap) {
        const fullPath = path.resolve(effectiveBaseDir, f.relative_path);
        if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
          throw new Error(`PREFLIGHT_FILE_MISSING: File '${f.relative_path}' missing during admission`);
        }
        const currentSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(fullPath)).digest('hex');
        const expectedSha = session.preflight_result.file_hashes[f.relative_path];
        if (expectedSha && currentSha !== expectedSha) {
          throw new Error(`PREFLIGHT_HASH_MISMATCH: File '${f.relative_path}' modified after preflight (TOCTOU violation). Expected ${expectedSha}, found ${currentSha}`);
        }
      }
    }

    const datasetClass = plan.plan_type === 'hr_calibrated_workload'
      ? 'external_workload_empirical'
      : 'paired_empirical';

    const intakePayload: IntakeRegistrationPayload = {
      dataset_id: `DS-STUDY-${sessionId}`,
      name: `Study Session ${sessionId} (${plan.title})`,
      dataset_class: datasetClass,
      source_name: `study_session:${sessionId}`,
      hardware: plan.target_hardware,
      license: plan.ethics_and_privacy.license,
      consent_boundary: plan.ethics_and_privacy.consent_statement,
      deidentification_method: 'pseudonymous_token',
      files: fileMap.map(f => ({
        path: f.relative_path,
        channel: f.channel,
        unit: plan.expected_channels.find(c => c.channel === f.channel)?.expected_unit || 'raw'
      })),
      study_lineage: {
        plan_id: plan.plan_id,
        session_id: session.session_id,
        plan_revision: plan.revision,
        admitted_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    };

    const intake = EmpiricalDatasetIntakeService.getInstance();
    const admittedRecord = intake.admitDataset(effectiveBaseDir, intakePayload);

    // Atomically transition session state to 'admitted'
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newRevision = session.revision + 1;
    const db = getDb();

    db.transaction(() => {
      const res = db.prepare(`
        UPDATE study_capture_sessions
        SET lifecycle_state = 'admitted',
            admitted_dataset_id = ?,
            revision = ?,
            updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE session_id = ? AND revision = ?
      `).run(admittedRecord.dataset_id, newRevision, nowIso, sessionId, session.revision);

      if (res.changes === 0) {
        throw new Error(`CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Optimistic concurrency conflict while admitting session ${sessionId}.`);
      }

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO study_session_lifecycle_events (session_id, state, reason, transitioned_at_utc)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(sessionId, 'admitted', `Admitted to empirical dataset registry as ${admittedRecord.dataset_id}`, nowIso);
    })();

    return admittedRecord;
  }
}

import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getAppDataDir } from '../db/db';
import { VERSION_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/versionContract';
import { BRAND_CONTRACT } from '../../shared/brandContract';
import { entitlementService } from '../entitlements/entitlementService';

export interface SupportBundleMetadata {
  bundle_id: string;
  generated_at_utc: string;
  brand: {
    product_name: string;
    internal_project_id: string;
  };
  version: {
    app_version: string;
    build_version: string;
    release_channel: string;
    database_schema_version: string;
  };
  environment: {
    platform: string;
    os_release: string;
    architecture: string;
    node_version: string;
  };
  diagnostics: {
    database_integrity: string;
    session_count: number;
    profile_count: number;
    llm_pack_count: number;
    local_event_count: number;
    incident_count: number;
    entitlement_tier: string;
    entitlement_status: string;
  };
  privacy_guarantees: {
    raw_physiological_series_excluded: true;
    local_absolute_paths_redacted: true;
    athlete_names_redacted: true;
    hardware_serials_redacted: true;
  };
  redacted_logs_summary: string[];
  recent_incidents?: any[];
}

export interface SupportBundleResult {
  bundle_id: string;
  metadata: SupportBundleMetadata;
  raw_json: string;
  sha256: string;
}

// Non-diagnostic privacy redaction helper for support export
export function redactSensitiveSupportText(text: string): string {
  let cleaned = text;
  // Redact Windows absolute user paths
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/[a-zA-Z]:\\Users\\[^\\]+/gi, 'C:\\Users\\[REDACTED]');
  // Redact Unix/Mac user paths
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\/Users\/[^\/]+/gi, '/Users/[REDACTED]');
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\/home\/[^\/]+/gi, '/home/[REDACTED]');
  // Redact potential 8-character device serial hexes
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\b[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}\b/g, '[DEVICE_SERIAL]');
  // Redact auth tokens
  cleaned = cleaned.replace(/Bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+/gi, 'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]');
  return cleaned;
}

export function compileSupportBundle(): SupportBundleResult {
  const db = getDb();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const bundleId = `support_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;

  // 1. Gather support telemetry counts safely
  let sessionCount = 0;
  let profileCount = 0;
  let packCount = 0;
  let eventCount = 0;
  let incidentCount = 0;
  let dbIntegrity = 'ok';

  try {
    const sRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM sessions').get() as any;
    sessionCount = sRow ? sRow.c : 0;
  } catch (_) { sessionCount = -1; }

  try {
    const pRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM user_profiles').get() as any;
    profileCount = pRow ? pRow.c : 0;
  } catch (_) { profileCount = -1; }

  try {
    const pkRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM llm_packs').get() as any;
    packCount = pkRow ? pkRow.c : 0;
  } catch (_) { packCount = -1; }

  try {
    const evRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM local_product_events').get() as any;
    eventCount = evRow ? evRow.c : 0;
  } catch (_) { eventCount = -1; }

  try {
    const incRow = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM support_incidents').get() as any;
    incidentCount = incRow ? incRow.c : 0;
  } catch (_) { incidentCount = 0; }

  try {
    const pragmaRes = db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get() as any;
    dbIntegrity = pragmaRes && pragmaRes.integrity_check ? pragmaRes.integrity_check : 'ok';
  } catch (_) { dbIntegrity = 'check_failed'; }

  // 1.1 Query recent support incidents with redacted messages
  let recentIncidents: any[] = [];
  try {
    const rawIncidents = db.prepare(`
      SELECT incident_id, timestamp_utc, severity, error_code, message, workflow, status
      FROM support_incidents
      ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC
      LIMIT 20
    `).all() as any[];
    recentIncidents = rawIncidents.map(inc => ({
      ...inc,
      message: redactSensitiveSupportText(inc.message || '')
    }));
  } catch (_) {}

  // 2. Gather recent error/warning logs with strict redaction
  const logsSummary: string[] = [];
  const logDir = path.join(getAppDataDir(), 'logs');
  if (fs.existsSync(logDir)) {
    try {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(logDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.log'));
      for (const file of files.slice(-2)) {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(logDir, file), 'utf8');
        const lines = content.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes('ERROR') || l.includes('WARN'));
        for (const line of lines.slice(-25)) {
          logsSummary.push(redactSensitiveSupportText(line.trim()));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const entitlement = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();

  const metadata: SupportBundleMetadata = {
    bundle_id: bundleId,
    generated_at_utc: now,
    brand: {
      product_name: BRAND_CONTRACT.product_display_name,
      internal_project_id: BRAND_CONTRACT.internal_project_id
    },
    version: {
      app_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.app_version,
      build_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.build_version,
      release_channel: VERSION_CONTRACT.release_channel,
      database_schema_version: VERSION_CONTRACT.database_schema_version
    },
    environment: {
      platform: os.platform(),
      os_release: os.release(),
      architecture: os.arch(),
      node_version: process.version
    },
    diagnostics: {
      database_integrity: dbIntegrity,
      session_count: sessionCount,
      profile_count: profileCount,
      llm_pack_count: packCount,
      local_event_count: eventCount,
      incident_count: incidentCount,
      entitlement_tier: entitlement.tier,
      entitlement_status: entitlement.status
    },
    privacy_guarantees: {
      raw_physiological_series_excluded: true,
      local_absolute_paths_redacted: true,
      athlete_names_redacted: true,
      hardware_serials_redacted: true
    },
    redacted_logs_summary: logsSummary,
    recent_incidents: recentIncidents
  };

  const rawJson = JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2);
  const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawJson, 'utf8').digest('hex');

  return {
    bundle_id: bundleId,
    metadata,
    raw_json: rawJson,
    sha256
  };
}

export async function generateSupportBundleZip(): Promise<{
  zipBuffer: Buffer;
  zipSha256: string;
  manifest: SupportBundleMetadata;
  files: string[];
}> {
  const AdmZip = require('adm-zip');
  const bundle = compileSupportBundle();
  const zip = new AdmZip();

  const manifestStr = JSON.stringify(bundle.metadata, null, 2);
  const systemInfoStr = JSON.stringify(
    {
      environment: bundle.metadata.environment,
      brand: bundle.metadata.brand,
      version: bundle.metadata.version,
      diagnostics: bundle.metadata.diagnostics
    },
    null,
    2
  );

  let eventsStr = '[]';
  try {
    const { getRecentWorkstationEvents } = require('../diagnostics/workstationEvents');
    eventsStr = JSON.stringify(getRecentWorkstationEvents(50), null, 2);
  } catch (_) {}

  let schemaSummaryStr = '{}';
  try {
    const db = getDb();
    const tables = db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").all() as any[];
    const tableSummaries: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const t of tables) {
      try {
        const countRow = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM ${t.name}`).get() as any;
        tableSummaries[t.name] = countRow ? countRow.c : 0;
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    schemaSummaryStr = JSON.stringify({ tables: tableSummaries, integrity: bundle.metadata.diagnostics.database_integrity }, null, 2);
  } catch (_) {}

  // Compute checksums for included components
  const incidentsStr = JSON.stringify(bundle.metadata.recent_incidents || [], null, 2);
  const filesMap: Record<string, string> = {
    'manifest.json': manifestStr,
    'system_info.json': systemInfoStr,
    'redacted_events.json': eventsStr,
    'db_schema_summary.json': schemaSummaryStr,
    'support_incidents.json': incidentsStr
  };

  const checksumLines: string[] = [];
  for (const [filename, content] of Object.entries(filesMap)) {
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content, 'utf8').digest('hex');
    checksumLines.push(`${hash}  ${filename}`);
    zip.addFile(filename, Buffer.from(content, 'utf8'));
  }

  const checksumsStr = checksumLines.join('\n') + '\n';
  zip.addFile('checksums.sha256', Buffer.from(checksumsStr, 'utf8'));

  const zipBuffer = zip.toBuffer();
  const zipSha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(zipBuffer).digest('hex');

  return {
    zipBuffer,
    zipSha256,
    manifest: bundle.metadata,
    files: [...Object.keys(filesMap), 'checksums.sha256']
  };
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

export interface FolderScanResult {

  folderPath: string;
  status: 'completed' | 'offline' | 'error';

export interface SyncScanResult {

export interface OverallSyncStatus {
  is_running: boolean;
  is_paused: boolean;
  active_folders_count: number;
  total_folders_count: number;
  health: 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'folder_missing' | 'error';
  last_scan_utc: string | null;
  total_discovered: number;
  total_imported: number;
  total_skipped: number;
  total_failed: number;
