/**
 * PairedEcgRrService.ts
 *
 * Implements paired Polar ECG/raw-RR file intake, durable session linkage,
 * timebase alignment, and technical agreement lifecycle management (PXR-03, PXR-04, PXR-05).
 *
 * Strict Invariants:
 * 1. Polar H10 ECG and raw-RR streams must be simultaneous and same-capture.
 * 2. Read-only guarantees: source files are never mutated, overwritten, or moved.
 * 3. Atomic CAS linkage: only one active linkage and active result per session.
 * 4. Fails closed to 'unavailable' when clock evidence or overlap is insufficient.
 * 5. Feature maturity remains ValidationDebt until physical in-vivo empirical acquisition passes.
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir } from '../db/db';
import { PathSanitizer } from '../security/PathSanitizer';
import {
  PairedEcgRrSourceSet,
  SessionPairedEcgRrLinkage,
  PairedEcgRrAlignmentResult,
  PairedEcgRrAgreementResult,
  PairedProvenanceClass
} from '../../shared/canonical/PairedEcgRrContract';
import { detectQrsFromSamples } from '../analytics/qrs';
import { PairedBenchmarkHarness } from '../analytics/PairedBenchmarkHarness';
import { parseCanonicalRRText } from '../../shared/canonical/CanonicalRRParser';
import { parseCanonicalEcgText } from '../signals/rawParsers';
import { calculateChannelSynchronization } from '../../shared/timeNormalization';

export interface PairedInspectionSummary {
  ecg_file_name: string;
  ecg_file_path: string;
  ecg_file_sha256: string;
  rr_file_name: string;
  rr_file_path: string;
  rr_file_sha256: string;
  provenance_class: PairedProvenanceClass;
  ecg_duration_seconds: number;
  rr_duration_seconds: number;
  is_eligible: boolean;
  blocking_reasons: string[];
}

export class PairedEcgRrService {
  /**
   * Computes sha256 checksum of a file without mutating it.
   */
  public static computeFileSha256(filePath: string): string {
    const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileBuf).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Inspects and validates a pair of ECG and RR files.
   */
  public static inspectPairedFiles(
    ecgFilePath: string,
    rrFilePath: string,
    provenanceClass: PairedProvenanceClass = 'operator_paired_files'
  ): {
    source_set: Omit<PairedEcgRrSourceSet, 'source_set_id' | 'imported_at_utc'>;
    blocking_reasons: string[];
  } {
    const resolvedEcg = path.resolve(ecgFilePath);
    const resolvedRr = path.resolve(rrFilePath);

    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedEcg)) {
      throw new Error(`PAIRED_FILE_NOT_FOUND: ECG file not found: ${ecgFilePath}`);
    }
    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedRr)) {
      throw new Error(`PAIRED_FILE_NOT_FOUND: RR file not found: ${rrFilePath}`);
    }

    PathSanitizer.validateSafeFilename(path.basename(resolvedEcg));
    PathSanitizer.validateSafeFilename(path.basename(resolvedRr));

    const ecgSha = this.computeFileSha256(resolvedEcg);
    const rrSha = this.computeFileSha256(resolvedRr);

    // Read and parse ECG
    let ecgText: string;
    const ecgBuf = fs.readFileSync(resolvedEcg);
    try {
      ecgText = zlib.gunzipSync(ecgBuf).toString('utf8');
    } catch {
      ecgText = ecgBuf.toString('utf8');
    }
    const ecgSeries = parseCanonicalEcgText(ecgText);

    // Read and parse RR
    let rrText: string;
    const rrBuf = fs.readFileSync(resolvedRr);
    try {
      rrText = zlib.gunzipSync(rrBuf).toString('utf8');
    } catch {
      rrText = rrBuf.toString('utf8');
    }
    const rrSeries = parseCanonicalRRText(rrText);

    const blockingReasons: string[] = [];

    if (ecgSeries.total_samples === 0) {
      blockingReasons.push('ECG file contains zero valid samples');
    }
    if (rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length === 0) {
      blockingReasons.push('RR file contains zero valid intervals');
    }

    if (ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.duration_seconds < 60) {
      blockingReasons.push(`ECG duration (${Math.round(ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.duration_seconds)}s) is under 60s minimum`);
    }
    
    // Compute RR duration from first and last valid points
    let rrDurationSec = 0;
    let rrIsMonotonic = true;
    if (rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length > 1) {
      const firstMs = rrSeries.valid_rr_points[0].timeMs;
      const lastMs = rrSeries.valid_rr_points[rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length - 1].timeMs;
      rrDurationSec = (lastMs - firstMs) / 1000;
      for (let i = 1; i < rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length; i++) {
        if (rrSeries.valid_rr_points[i].timeMs < rrSeries.valid_rr_points[i - 1].timeMs) {
          rrIsMonotonic = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (rrDurationSec < 60) {
      blockingReasons.push(`RR duration (${Math.round(rrDurationSec)}s) is under 60s minimum`);
    }

    if (!ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.is_monotonic) {
      blockingReasons.push('Non-monotonic ECG timestamps detected');
    }
    if (!rrIsMonotonic) {
      blockingReasons.push('Non-monotonic RR timestamps detected');
    }

    return {
      source_set: {
        ecg_file_id: path.basename(resolvedEcg),
        ecg_file_path: resolvedEcg,
        ecg_file_sha256: ecgSha,
        rr_file_id: path.basename(resolvedRr),
        rr_file_path: resolvedRr,
        rr_file_sha256: rrSha,
        provenance_class: provenanceClass,
        ecg_timebase: {
          start_time_utc: ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms ? new Date(ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms[0]).toISOString() : null,
          end_time_utc: ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms ? new Date(ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms[ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms.length - 1]).toISOString() : null,
          duration_seconds: ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.duration_seconds,
          sample_count: ecgSeries.total_samples,
          is_monotonic: ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.is_monotonic,
          sample_rate_hz: ecgSeries.sample_rate_hz
        },
        rr_timebase: {
          start_time_utc: rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length > 0 ? new Date(rrSeries.valid_rr_points[0].timeMs).toISOString() : null,
          end_time_utc: rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length > 0 ? new Date(rrSeries.valid_rr_points[rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length - 1].timeMs).toISOString() : null,
          duration_seconds: rrDurationSec,
          sample_count: rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length,
          is_monotonic: rrIsMonotonic
        },
        quality_state: blockingReasons.length === 0 ? 'valid' : 'quality_limited'
      },
      blocking_reasons: blockingReasons
    };
  }

  /**
   * Registers a paired source set into SQLite with deduplication.
   */
  public static registerPairedSourceSet(
    ecgFilePath: string,
    rrFilePath: string,
    provenanceClass: PairedProvenanceClass = 'operator_paired_files'
  ): PairedEcgRrSourceSet {
    const inspected = this.inspectPairedFiles(ecgFilePath, rrFilePath, provenanceClass);
    const db = getDb();

    // Deduplication check by joint hashes
    const existing = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM paired_ecg_rr_source_sets
      WHERE ecg_file_sha256 = ? AND rr_file_sha256 = ?
    `).get(inspected.source_set.ecg_file_sha256, inspected.source_set.rr_file_sha256) as any;

    if (existing) {
      // If the file path changed (e.g. temporary test directory or moved location), update it
      if (existing.ecg_file_path !== inspected.source_set.ecg_file_path || existing.rr_file_path !== inspected.source_set.rr_file_path) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE paired_ecg_rr_source_sets
          SET ecg_file_path = ?, rr_file_path = ?
          WHERE source_set_id = ?
        `).run(inspected.source_set.ecg_file_path, inspected.source_set.rr_file_path, existing.source_set_id);
        existing.ecg_file_path = inspected.source_set.ecg_file_path;
        existing.rr_file_path = inspected.source_set.rr_file_path;
      }

      return {
        source_set_id: existing.source_set_id,
        ecg_file_id: existing.ecg_file_id,
        ecg_file_path: existing.ecg_file_path,
        ecg_file_sha256: existing.ecg_file_sha256,
        rr_file_id: existing.rr_file_id,
        rr_file_path: existing.rr_file_path,
        rr_file_sha256: existing.rr_file_sha256,
        provenance_class: existing.provenance_class as PairedProvenanceClass,
        device_id: existing.device_id,
        ecg_timebase: {
          start_time_utc: existing.ecg_start_time_utc,
          end_time_utc: existing.ecg_end_time_utc,
          duration_seconds: existing.ecg_duration_seconds,
          sample_count: existing.ecg_sample_count,
          is_monotonic: existing.ecg_is_monotonic === 1,
          sample_rate_hz: existing.ecg_sample_rate_hz
        },
        rr_timebase: {
          start_time_utc: existing.rr_start_time_utc,
          end_time_utc: existing.rr_end_time_utc,
          duration_seconds: existing.rr_duration_seconds,
          sample_count: existing.rr_sample_count,
          is_monotonic: existing.rr_is_monotonic === 1
        },
        quality_state: existing.quality_state,
        imported_at_utc: existing.imported_at_utc
      };
    }

    const sourceSetId = `paired_src_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO paired_ecg_rr_source_sets (
        source_set_id, ecg_file_id, ecg_file_path, ecg_file_sha256,
        rr_file_id, rr_file_path, rr_file_sha256, provenance_class, device_id,
        ecg_duration_seconds, ecg_sample_count, ecg_is_monotonic, ecg_sample_rate_hz,
        ecg_start_time_utc, ecg_end_time_utc,
        rr_duration_seconds, rr_sample_count, rr_is_monotonic,
        rr_start_time_utc, rr_end_time_utc,
        quality_state, imported_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      sourceSetId,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_file_id,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_file_path,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_file_sha256,
      inspected.source_set.rr_file_id,
      inspected.source_set.rr_file_path,
      inspected.source_set.rr_file_sha256,
      inspected.source_set.provenance_class,
      inspected.source_set.device_id ?? null,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.duration_seconds,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.sample_count,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.is_monotonic ? 1 : 0,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.sample_rate_hz ?? 130,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.start_time_utc ?? null,
      inspected.source_set.ecg_timebase.end_time_utc ?? null,
      inspected.source_set.rr_timebase.duration_seconds,
      inspected.source_set.rr_timebase.sample_count,
      inspected.source_set.rr_timebase.is_monotonic ? 1 : 0,
      inspected.source_set.rr_timebase.start_time_utc ?? null,
      inspected.source_set.rr_timebase.end_time_utc ?? null,
      inspected.source_set.quality_state,
      now
    );

    return {
      source_set_id: sourceSetId,
      ...inspected.source_set,
      imported_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  /**
   * Links a paired source set to a session with atomic CAS and computes alignment and agreement.
   */
  public static linkPairedSourcesToSession(
    sessionId: string,
    sourceSetId: string,
    operatorConfirmedIntent = true
  ): {
    linkage: SessionPairedEcgRrLinkage;
    alignment: PairedEcgRrAlignmentResult;
    agreement: PairedEcgRrAgreementResult;
  } {
    const db = getDb();

    // Verify session
    const session = db.prepare('SELECT id, start_time, duration_seconds FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Session ${sessionId} does not exist`);
    }

    // Verify source set
    const sourceSetRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM paired_ecg_rr_source_sets WHERE source_set_id = ?').get(sourceSetId) as any;
    if (!sourceSetRow) {
      throw new Error(`PAIRED_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Paired source set ${sourceSetId} does not exist`);
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // Atomic CAS: deactivate current active linkage
    const currentActive = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_paired_ecg_rr_linkages WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1').get(sessionId) as any;
    let nextRevision = 1;
    if (currentActive) {
      nextRevision = currentActive.revision + 1;
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE session_paired_ecg_rr_linkages
        SET is_active = 0, status = 'superseded', updated_at_utc = ?
        WHERE link_id = ?
      `).run(now, currentActive.link_id);

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE paired_ecg_rr_agreement_revisions
        SET is_active = 0, lifecycle_state = 'superseded'
        WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1
      `).run(sessionId);
    }

    const linkId = `paired_link_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO session_paired_ecg_rr_linkages (
        link_id, session_id, source_set_id, revision, status,
        operator_confirmed_intent, is_active, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      linkId,
      sessionId,
      sourceSetId,
      nextRevision,
      'linked',
      operatorConfirmedIntent ? 1 : 0,
      1,
      now,
      now
    );

    const linkage: SessionPairedEcgRrLinkage = {
      link_id: linkId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_set_id: sourceSetId,
      revision: nextRevision,
      status: 'linked',
      operator_confirmed_intent: operatorConfirmedIntent,
      is_active: true,
      created_at_utc: now,
      updated_at_utc: now
    };

    // Perform alignment and technical agreement calculation
    const alignment = this.computeAlignment(linkId, sessionId, sourceSetRow);
    const agreement = this.computeAgreement(linkId, sessionId, alignment, sourceSetRow);

    return { linkage, alignment, agreement };
  }

  /**
   * Unlinks the active paired source set from a session.
   */
  public static unlinkPairedSourcesFromSession(sessionId: string, cause = 'operator_unlinked'): void {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE session_paired_ecg_rr_linkages
      SET is_active = 0, status = 'superseded', invalidation_cause = ?, updated_at_utc = ?
      WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1
    `).run(cause, now, sessionId);

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE paired_ecg_rr_agreement_revisions
      SET is_active = 0, lifecycle_state = 'superseded'
      WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1
    `).run(sessionId);
  }

  /**
   * Computes alignment between ECG and raw-RR timebases using ChannelSynchronization.
   */
  private static computeAlignment(
    linkId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    sourceSetRow: any
  ): PairedEcgRrAlignmentResult {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const ecgPath = sourceSetRow.ecg_file_path;
    const rrPath = sourceSetRow.rr_file_path;

    let ecgText: string = '';
    let rrText: string = '';
    try {
      const eBuf = fs.readFileSync(ecgPath);
      try { ecgText = zlib.gunzipSync(eBuf).toString('utf8'); } catch { ecgText = eBuf.toString('utf8'); }
      const rBuf = fs.readFileSync(rrPath);
      try { rrText = zlib.gunzipSync(rBuf).toString('utf8'); } catch { rrText = rBuf.toString('utf8'); }
    } catch {}

    const ecgSeries = parseCanonicalEcgText(ecgText);
    const rrSeries = parseCanonicalRRText(rrText);

    // Prepare synchronization inputs
    const ecgSyncPts = ecgSeries.canonical_timestamps_ms.map((ts, idx) => ({
      timeMs: ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms ? ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms[idx] : ts,
      sensorTsNs: ecgSeries.sensor_timestamps_ns ? ecgSeries.sensor_timestamps_ns[idx] : undefined
    }));

    const rrSyncPts = rrSeries.valid_rr_points.map(pt => ({
      timeMs: pt.timeMs,
      sensorTsNs: pt.sensorTsNs
    }));

    const sync = calculateChannelSynchronization(ecgSyncPts, rrSyncPts);

    const rrDurationSec = rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length > 1
      ? (rrSeries.valid_rr_points[rrSeries.valid_rr_points.length - 1].timeMs - rrSeries.valid_rr_points[0].timeMs) / 1000
      : 0;

    const overlapSec = Math.min(
      ecgSeries.timebase_provenance.duration_seconds,
      rrDurationSec
    );

    const alignmentId = `align_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
    const offsetMs = sync.channel_offset_seconds * 1000;
    const residualUncertaintyMs = sync.sync_method === 'sensor_clock_ns' ? 5.0 : 50.0;
    const confidence = sync.is_synchronized ? (sync.sync_method === 'sensor_clock_ns' ? 'high' : 'medium') : 'low';

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO paired_ecg_rr_alignments (
        alignment_id, link_id, session_id, source_set_id, revision,
        sync_method, offset_ms, drift_ppm, overlap_seconds,
        residual_uncertainty_ms, confidence, is_aligned, limitations_json, aligned_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      alignmentId,
      linkId,
      sessionId,
      sourceSetRow.source_set_id,
      sync.sync_method,
      Math.round(offsetMs * 10) / 10,
      Math.round(overlapSec * 10) / 10,
      residualUncertaintyMs,
      confidence,
      sync.is_synchronized ? 1 : 0,
      JSON.stringify(sync.limitations),
      now
    );

    return {
      alignment_id: alignmentId,
      link_id: linkId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      source_set_id: sourceSetRow.source_set_id,
      revision: 1,
      sync_method: sync.sync_method,
      offset_ms: Math.round(offsetMs * 10) / 10,
      drift_ppm: 0,
      overlap_seconds: Math.round(overlapSec * 10) / 10,
      residual_uncertainty_ms: residualUncertaintyMs,
      confidence,
      is_aligned: sync.is_synchronized,
      limitations: sync.limitations,
      aligned_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  /**
   * Runs QRS detection on the aligned ECG stream and evaluates technical agreement
   * against the aligned raw-RR stream using PairedBenchmarkHarness (PXR-05).
   */
  private static computeAgreement(
    linkId: string,
    sessionId: string,
    alignment: PairedEcgRrAlignmentResult,
    sourceSetRow: any
  ): PairedEcgRrAgreementResult {
    const db = getDb();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const ecgPath = sourceSetRow.ecg_file_path;
    const rrPath = sourceSetRow.rr_file_path;

    let ecgText: string = '';
    let rrText: string = '';
    try {
      const eBuf = fs.readFileSync(ecgPath);
      try { ecgText = zlib.gunzipSync(eBuf).toString('utf8'); } catch { ecgText = eBuf.toString('utf8'); }
      const rBuf = fs.readFileSync(rrPath);
      try { rrText = zlib.gunzipSync(rBuf).toString('utf8'); } catch { rrText = rBuf.toString('utf8'); }
    } catch {}

    const ecgSeries = parseCanonicalEcgText(ecgText);
    const rrSeries = parseCanonicalRRText(rrText);

    const limitations: string[] = [
      'Multi-modal ECG vs RR agreement requires simultaneous paired Polar ECG and raw RR recordings on a synchronous timebase.',
      'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 19-21.',
      'Feature is non-diagnostic; does not perform medical arrhythmia detection or disease screening.'
    ];

    if (!alignment.is_aligned || alignment.overlap_seconds < 60) {
      limitations.push('Timebase alignment uncertain or overlap duration under 60 seconds.');
      const resultId = `agr_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
      const emptySha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({ empty: true })).digest('hex');

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO paired_ecg_rr_agreement_revisions (
          result_id, session_id, link_id, alignment_id, revision, lifecycle_state,
          agreement_percent, match_rate_20ms, match_rate_50ms,
          total_evaluated_beats, matched_beats_count, unmatched_beats_count,
          mean_abs_error_ms, median_abs_error_ms, p95_abs_error_ms,
          quality_stratum, qrs_detector_version, protocol_authority,
          payload_sha256, is_active, limitations_json, calculated_at_utc
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 'current', NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'insufficient_data', '1.1.0', 'FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V1.1_TARGET_19_21', ?, 1, ?, ?)
      `).run(resultId, sessionId, linkId, alignment.alignment_id, emptySha, JSON.stringify(limitations), now);

      return {
        result_id: resultId,
        session_id: sessionId,
        link_id: linkId,
        alignment_id: alignment.alignment_id,
        revision: 1,
        lifecycle_state: 'current',
        agreement_percent: null,
        match_rate_50ms: null,
        total_evaluated_beats: 0,
        matched_beats_count: 0,
        unmatched_beats_count: 0,
        mean_abs_error_ms: null,
        median_abs_error_ms: null,
        p95_abs_error_ms: null,
        quality_stratum: 'insufficient_data',
        qrs_detector_version: '1.1.0',
        protocol_authority: 'FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V1.1_TARGET_19_21',
        payload_sha256: emptySha,
        is_active: true,
        limitations,
        calculated_at_utc: now
      };
    }

    // Detect QRS peaks from ECG
    const ecgSamples = ecgSeries.samples_uv;
    const qrsResult = detectQrsFromSamples(
      ecgSamples,
      ecgSeries.sample_rate_hz || 130,
      ecgSeries.phone_timestamps_ms ?? ecgSeries.canonical_timestamps_ms
    );
    const ecgPeakTimesMs = qrsResult.peak_timestamps_ms;

    // Prepare raw RR intervals and timestamps
    const rawRrsMs = rrSeries.valid_rr_points.map(pt => pt.rrMs);
    const rawRrTimesMs = rrSeries.valid_rr_points.map(pt => pt.timeMs);

    // Apply alignment offset
    const alignedRawRrTimesMs = rawRrTimesMs.map(t => t + alignment.offset_ms);

    // Run benchmark agreement
    const benchmark = PairedBenchmarkHarness.evaluateEcgRrAgreement(
      ecgPeakTimesMs,
      rawRrsMs,
      alignedRawRrTimesMs
    );

    // Evaluate 20ms tolerance
    let within20msCount = 0;
    const ecgRrIntervals: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < ecgPeakTimesMs.length; i++) {
      ecgRrIntervals.push(ecgPeakTimesMs[i] - ecgPeakTimesMs[i - 1]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ecgRrIntervals.length, rawRrsMs.length); i++) {
      if (Math.abs(ecgRrIntervals[i] - rawRrsMs[i]) <= 20) {
        within20msCount++;
      }
    }
    const matchRate20ms = ecgRrIntervals.length > 0 ? Math.round((within20msCount / ecgRrIntervals.length) * 1000) / 10 : null;

    const agreementVal = benchmark.match_rate_50ms;
    const unmatched = Math.max(0, benchmark.total_evaluated_beats - benchmark.matched_beats_count);

    const resultId = `agr_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
    const payloadObj = {
      agreement_percent: agreementVal,
      match_rate_50ms: benchmark.match_rate_50ms,
      match_rate_20ms: matchRate20ms,
      total_evaluated_beats: benchmark.total_evaluated_beats,
      matched_beats_count: benchmark.matched_beats_count,
      unmatched_beats_count: unmatched,
      mean_abs_error_ms: benchmark.mean_abs_difference_ms,
      p95_abs_error_ms: benchmark.p95_abs_difference_ms,
      quality_stratum: benchmark.quality_stratum,
      qrs_detector_version: '1.1.0'
    };
    const payloadSha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(payloadObj)).digest('hex');

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO paired_ecg_rr_agreement_revisions (
        result_id, session_id, link_id, alignment_id, revision, lifecycle_state,
        agreement_percent, match_rate_20ms, match_rate_50ms,
        total_evaluated_beats, matched_beats_count, unmatched_beats_count,
        mean_abs_error_ms, median_abs_error_ms, p95_abs_error_ms,
        quality_stratum, qrs_detector_version, protocol_authority,
        payload_sha256, is_active, limitations_json, calculated_at_utc
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 'current', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, '1.1.0', 'FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V1.1_TARGET_19_21', ?, 1, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      resultId,
      sessionId,
      linkId,
      alignment.alignment_id,
      agreementVal,
      matchRate20ms,
      benchmark.match_rate_50ms,
      benchmark.total_evaluated_beats,
      benchmark.matched_beats_count,
      unmatched,
      benchmark.mean_abs_difference_ms,
      benchmark.p95_abs_difference_ms,
      benchmark.quality_stratum,
      payloadSha,
      JSON.stringify(limitations),
      now
    );

    return {
      result_id: resultId,
      session_id: sessionId,
      link_id: linkId,
      alignment_id: alignment.alignment_id,
      revision: 1,
      lifecycle_state: 'current',
      agreement_percent: agreementVal,
      match_rate_20ms: matchRate20ms,
      match_rate_50ms: benchmark.match_rate_50ms,
      total_evaluated_beats: benchmark.total_evaluated_beats,
      matched_beats_count: benchmark.matched_beats_count,
      unmatched_beats_count: unmatched,
      mean_abs_error_ms: benchmark.mean_abs_difference_ms,
      median_abs_error_ms: null,
      p95_abs_error_ms: benchmark.p95_abs_difference_ms,
      quality_stratum: benchmark.quality_stratum as any,
      qrs_detector_version: '1.1.0',
      protocol_authority: 'FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V1.1_TARGET_19_21',
      payload_sha256: payloadSha,
      is_active: true,
      limitations,
      calculated_at_utc: now
    };
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves active paired source, linkage, alignment, and agreement for a session.
   */
  public static getActivePairedForSession(sessionId: string): {
    source_set?: PairedEcgRrSourceSet;
    linkage?: SessionPairedEcgRrLinkage;
    alignment?: PairedEcgRrAlignmentResult;
    agreement?: PairedEcgRrAgreementResult;
  } {
    const db = getDb();

    // Check explicit active linkage
    const linkRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM session_paired_ecg_rr_linkages
      WHERE session_id = ? AND is_active = 1
    `).get(sessionId) as any;

    if (linkRow) {
      const srcRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM paired_ecg_rr_source_sets WHERE source_set_id = ?').get(linkRow.source_set_id) as any;
      const alignRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM paired_ecg_rr_alignments WHERE link_id = ? ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1').get(linkRow.link_id) as any;
      const agrRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM paired_ecg_rr_agreement_revisions WHERE link_id = ? AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1').get(linkRow.link_id) as any;

      return {
        linkage: {
          link_id: linkRow.link_id,
          session_id: linkRow.session_id,
          source_set_id: linkRow.source_set_id,
          revision: linkRow.revision,
          status: linkRow.status,
          operator_confirmed_intent: linkRow.operator_confirmed_intent === 1,
          is_active: true,
          invalidation_cause: linkRow.invalidation_cause,
          created_at_utc: linkRow.created_at_utc,
          updated_at_utc: linkRow.updated_at_utc
        },
        source_set: srcRow ? {
          source_set_id: srcRow.source_set_id,
          ecg_file_id: srcRow.ecg_file_id,
          ecg_file_path: srcRow.ecg_file_path,
          ecg_file_sha256: srcRow.ecg_file_sha256,
          rr_file_id: srcRow.rr_file_id,
          rr_file_path: srcRow.rr_file_path,
          rr_file_sha256: srcRow.rr_file_sha256,
          provenance_class: srcRow.provenance_class as PairedProvenanceClass,
          device_id: srcRow.device_id,
          ecg_timebase: {
            start_time_utc: srcRow.ecg_start_time_utc,
            end_time_utc: srcRow.ecg_end_time_utc,
            duration_seconds: srcRow.ecg_duration_seconds,
            sample_count: srcRow.ecg_sample_count,
            is_monotonic: srcRow.ecg_is_monotonic === 1,
            sample_rate_hz: srcRow.ecg_sample_rate_hz
          },
          rr_timebase: {
            start_time_utc: srcRow.rr_start_time_utc,
            end_time_utc: srcRow.rr_end_time_utc,
            duration_seconds: srcRow.rr_duration_seconds,
            sample_count: srcRow.rr_sample_count,
            is_monotonic: srcRow.rr_is_monotonic === 1
          },
          quality_state: srcRow.quality_state,
          imported_at_utc: srcRow.imported_at_utc
        } : undefined,
        alignment: alignRow ? {
          alignment_id: alignRow.alignment_id,
          link_id: alignRow.link_id,
          session_id: alignRow.session_id,
          source_set_id: alignRow.source_set_id,
          revision: alignRow.revision,
          sync_method: alignRow.sync_method,
          offset_ms: alignRow.offset_ms,
          drift_ppm: alignRow.drift_ppm,
          overlap_seconds: alignRow.overlap_seconds,
          residual_uncertainty_ms: alignRow.residual_uncertainty_ms,
          confidence: alignRow.confidence,
          is_aligned: alignRow.is_aligned === 1,
          limitations: alignRow.limitations_json ? JSON.parse(alignRow.limitations_json) : [],
          aligned_at_utc: alignRow.aligned_at_utc
        } : undefined,
        agreement: agrRow ? {
          result_id: agrRow.result_id,
          session_id: agrRow.session_id,
          link_id: agrRow.link_id,
          alignment_id: agrRow.alignment_id,
          revision: agrRow.revision,
          lifecycle_state: agrRow.lifecycle_state,
          agreement_percent: agrRow.agreement_percent,
          match_rate_20ms: agrRow.match_rate_20ms,
          match_rate_50ms: agrRow.match_rate_50ms,
          total_evaluated_beats: agrRow.total_evaluated_beats,
          matched_beats_count: agrRow.matched_beats_count,
          unmatched_beats_count: agrRow.unmatched_beats_count,
          mean_abs_error_ms: agrRow.mean_abs_error_ms,
          median_abs_error_ms: agrRow.median_abs_error_ms,
          p95_abs_error_ms: agrRow.p95_abs_error_ms,
          quality_stratum: agrRow.quality_stratum,
          qrs_detector_version: agrRow.qrs_detector_version,
          protocol_authority: agrRow.protocol_authority,
          payload_sha256: agrRow.payload_sha256,
          is_active: agrRow.is_active === 1,
          limitations: agrRow.limitations_json ? JSON.parse(agrRow.limitations_json) : [],
          calculated_at_utc: agrRow.calculated_at_utc
        } : undefined
      };
    }

    return {};
  }
}

/**
 * src/backend/workspace/WholeProductWorkspaceService.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G25 — Whole-Product Workspace Snapshot Resolver.
 *
 * Consolidates all post-G20 surfaces into a single authoritative
 * WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot. Pure read: never mutates database selection.
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { getDb, getRawLogsDir, getSession, getSessionMetrics } from '../db/db';
import {
  WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot,
  WHOLE_PRODUCT_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  computeWholeProductDependencyFingerprint,
  validateWholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot,
  WholeProductSourceAvailability,
  WholeProductDiaryLineageStatus
} from '../../shared/canonical/WholeProductWorkspaceContract';
import { AthleteJourneyService } from '../journey/AthleteJourneyService';
import { getCanonicalSessionResult } from '../canonical/CanonicalSessionBuilder';
import { entitlementService } from '../entitlements/entitlementService';

export class WholeProductWorkspaceService {
  public static async resolveWholeProductSnapshot(
    profileId: string | null
  ): Promise<WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot> {
    // 1. Resolve base AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot
    const baseSnapshot = await AthleteJourneyService.resolveWorkspaceSnapshot(profileId);
    const ctx = baseSnapshot.context;
    const db = getDb();
    const rawLogsDir = getRawLogsDir();

    // 2. Profile State
    const profileState = {
      profile_id: ctx.profile.profile_id,
      display_name: ctx.profile.display_name,
      export_alias: ctx.profile.export_alias || ctx.profile.display_name,
      is_active: ctx.profile.mode === 'selected',
      athlete_selection_revision: baseSnapshot.selection_revision,
      selection_updated_at_utc: baseSnapshot.server_timestamp_utc
    };

    // 3. Source State & Physical Availability
    const sessionId = ctx.session.session_id;
    let sourceAvailability: WholeProductSourceAvailability = 'available';
    let originalPath: string | null = null;
    let sourceSha256: string | null = ctx.session.source_id;
    let deviceId: string | null = null;
    let deviceModel: string | null = null;
    let streamType: string | null = null;
    let importedAtUtc: string | null = null;
    let sessRow: any = null;
    let canonical: any = null;

    if (sessionId) {
      try {
        sessRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id = ?').get(sessionId) as any;
        if (sessRow) {
          deviceId = sessRow.device_id || null;
          deviceModel = sessRow.device_model || (deviceId ? (deviceId.toUpperCase().includes('H10') ? 'Polar H10' : deviceId) : null);
          importedAtUtc = sessRow.created_at || null;

          // Derive stream types from persisted signals
          try {
            const sigRows = db.prepare(
              'SELECT DISTINCT ifo.signal_type FROM session_signals ss JOIN ingested_files ifo ON ss.file_id = ifo.id WHERE ss.session_id = ?'
            ).all(sessionId) as any[];
            const types = sigRows.map(r => r.signal_type).filter(Boolean);
            streamType = types.length > 0 ? types.join('+') : (deviceId ? 'RR' : null);
          } catch (_) {
            streamType = deviceId ? 'RR' : null;
          }

          // Persisted G21 source-lifecycle availability
          if (sessRow.assignment_status === 'source_missing' || sessRow.assignment_status === 'source_unavailable' || sessRow.assignment_status === 'unlinked') {
            sourceAvailability = 'missing';
          } else if (sessRow.assignment_status === 'corrupt') {
            sourceAvailability = 'unreadable';
          } else if (sessRow.relinked_source_path && fs.existsSync(sessRow.relinked_source_path)) {
            sourceAvailability = 'available';
          } else {
            // Check ingested file status or rawLogsDir
            try {
              const fileRows = db.prepare(
                'SELECT ifo.filename FROM session_signals ss JOIN ingested_files ifo ON ss.file_id = ifo.id WHERE ss.session_id = ?'
              ).all(sessionId) as { filename: string }[];
              if (fileRows.length > 0) {
                const anyMissing = fileRows.some(f => {
                  const rawPath = f.filename ? path.join(rawLogsDir, f.filename) : '';
                  return !rawPath || !fs.existsSync(rawPath);
                });
                sourceAvailability = anyMissing ? 'missing' : 'available';
              } else {
                const defaultRrGz = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sessionId}_rr.txt.gz`);
                const defaultEcgGz = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sessionId}_ecg.txt.gz`);
                const defaultRr = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sessionId}_rr.txt`);
                const defaultEcg = path.join(rawLogsDir, `${sessionId}_ecg.txt`);
                sourceAvailability = (fs.existsSync(defaultRrGz) || fs.existsSync(defaultEcgGz) || fs.existsSync(defaultRr) || fs.existsSync(defaultEcg)) ? 'available' : 'missing';
              }
            } catch (_) {
              sourceAvailability = 'missing';
            }
          }

          // Redact absolute local path: expose basename only
          if (sessRow.relinked_source_path) {
            originalPath = path.basename(sessRow.relinked_source_path);
          } else {
            originalPath = null;
          }
        } else {
          sourceAvailability = 'missing';
        }
      } catch (_) {
        sourceAvailability = 'unreadable';
      }

      try {
        canonical = await getCanonicalSessionResult(sessionId, false);
      } catch (_) {}
    } else {
      sourceAvailability = 'available';
    }

    const sourceState = {
      source_id: ctx.session.source_id,
      device_id: deviceId,
      device_model: deviceModel,
      stream_type: streamType,
      source_sha256: sourceSha256,
      intake_status: ctx.session.currentness === 'unavailable' ? 'none' : 'clean',
      imported_at_utc: importedAtUtc,
      received_at_utc: importedAtUtc,
      original_path: originalPath,
      availability_status: sourceAvailability
    };

    // 4. Canonical Session State
    let metricsObj: Record<string, any> | null = null;
    if (sessionId) {
      try {
        metricsObj = getSessionMetrics(sessionId);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    let taskEligibility: Record<string, boolean> | null = null;
    if (sessionId) {
      if (canonical?.task_eligibility) {
        taskEligibility = {
          hrv_eligible: Boolean(canonical.task_eligibility.rmssd?.is_eligible),
          cardiac_drift_eligible: Boolean(canonical.task_eligibility.cardiac_drift?.is_eligible),
          aerobic_threshold_eligible: Boolean(canonical.task_eligibility.aerobic_threshold?.is_eligible)
        };
      } else if (sessRow?.task_eligibility) {
        try {
          const parsed = typeof sessRow.task_eligibility === 'string' ? JSON.parse(sessRow.task_eligibility) : sessRow.task_eligibility;
          taskEligibility = {
            hrv_eligible: Boolean(parsed.hrv_eligible ?? parsed.rmssd?.is_eligible),
            cardiac_drift_eligible: Boolean(parsed.cardiac_drift_eligible ?? parsed.cardiac_drift?.is_eligible),
            aerobic_threshold_eligible: Boolean(parsed.aerobic_threshold_eligible ?? parsed.aerobic_threshold?.is_eligible)
          };
        } catch {
          taskEligibility = null;
        }
      }
    }

    const sessionState = {
      session_id: sessionId,
      start_time_utc: sessionId ? (sessRow?.start_time || canonical?.session_timing?.session_start_utc || null) : null,
      end_time_utc: sessionId ? (sessRow?.end_time || canonical?.session_timing?.session_end_utc || null) : null,
      duration_seconds: sessionId ? (sessRow?.duration_seconds != null ? Number(sessRow.duration_seconds) : (canonical?.session_timing?.session_duration_seconds != null ? Number(canonical.session_timing.session_duration_seconds) : null)) : null,
      canonical_metrics: sessionId ? metricsObj : null,
      presentation: null,
      units: sessionId ? {
        rmssd: 'ms',
        sdnn: 'ms',
        mean_hr: 'bpm',
        cardiac_drift_pct: '%'
      } : null,
      overall_quality_score: sessionId ? (sessRow?.overall_quality_score != null ? Number(sessRow.overall_quality_score) : (sessRow?.quality_score != null ? Number(sessRow.quality_score) : (canonical?.quality_summary?.legacy_overall_quality_score != null ? Number(canonical.quality_summary.legacy_overall_quality_score) : null))) : null,
      coverage_pct: sessionId ? (sessRow?.data_completeness != null ? Number(sessRow.data_completeness) : (canonical?.quality_summary?.data_coverage_percent != null ? Number(canonical.quality_summary.data_coverage_percent) : (metricsObj?.artifact_percent != null ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - Number(metricsObj.artifact_percent))) : null))) : null,
      task_eligibility: taskEligibility,
      diagnostic_limitations: canonical?.diagnostic_limitations || []
    };


    // 5. Named Window State
    let windowName: string | null = null;
    let windowStartOffset: number | null = null;
    let windowEndOffset: number | null = null;
    if (sessionId && ctx.window?.active_window_id) {
      try {
        const winRow = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM session_named_windows WHERE id = ?').get(ctx.window.active_window_id) as any;
        if (winRow) {
          windowName = winRow.name || null;
          windowStartOffset = winRow.start_offset_seconds ?? null;
          windowEndOffset = winRow.end_offset_seconds ?? null;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const windowState = {
      active_window_id: ctx.window?.active_window_id || null,
      name: windowName,
      start_offset_seconds: windowStartOffset,
      end_offset_seconds: windowEndOffset,
      revision: ctx.window?.active_window_revision || null,
      root_window_id: ctx.window?.window_root_id || null,
      canonical_window_results: ctx.window?.window_metrics || null,
      baseline_comparison: null
    };

    // 6. Comparison State
    const activeSelectionIds: string[] = [];
    if (ctx.comparison.target_session_id) activeSelectionIds.push(ctx.comparison.target_session_id);
    if (ctx.comparison.peer_session_id) activeSelectionIds.push(ctx.comparison.peer_session_id);

    const comparisonState = {
      mode: ctx.comparison.mode,
      active_selection_ids: activeSelectionIds,
      baseline_session_id: ctx.comparison.target_session_id,
      canonical_comparison: null,
      saved_view_id: ctx.comparison.saved_view_id,
      saved_view_revision: ctx.comparison.saved_view_revision
    };

    // 7. Report and AI Pack State (Exact selection only, zero latest-row substitution)
    let activeReportId: string | null = null;
    let reportFormat: string | null = null;
    let reportGeneratedAtUtc: string | null = null;
    let packManifestSha256: string | null = null;
    let packageFilePath: string | null = null;

    const requestedPackId = ctx.export_diary?.active_pack_id || null;
    if (sessionId && requestedPackId) {
      try {
        const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM export_artifact_manifests WHERE session_id = ? AND (manifest_id = ? OR job_id = ?)').get(sessionId, requestedPackId, requestedPackId) as any;
        if (row) {
          activeReportId = row.manifest_id;
          reportFormat = row.format;
          reportGeneratedAtUtc = row.generated_at_utc;
          packManifestSha256 = row.sha256;
          packageFilePath = row.published_path || row.staging_path;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const reportAndPackState = {
      active_report_id: activeReportId,
      report_format: reportFormat,
      report_generated_at_utc: reportGeneratedAtUtc,
      ai_pack_preview_id: ctx.export_diary.export_preview_fingerprint,
      durable_job_id: null,
      job_status: null,
      provider_target: 'claude_chatgpt',
      manifest_sha256: packManifestSha256,
      package_file_path: packageFilePath
    };

    // 8. Diary State (Exact selection only, zero latest-row substitution)
    let diaryId: string | null = ctx.export_diary.active_diary_id;
    let diaryTitle: string | null = null;
    let diaryProvider: string | null = null;
    let diaryContentHash: string | null = null;
    let diaryLineage: WholeProductDiaryLineageStatus = 'none';

    if (diaryId) {
      try {
        const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM llm_diary WHERE id = ?').get(diaryId) as any;
        if (row) {
          diaryTitle = row.title || null;
          diaryProvider = row.provider || null;
          diaryContentHash = row.content_hash_sha256 || null;
          diaryLineage = row.session_id === sessionId ? 'current' : (row.session_id ? 'historical' : 'unlinked');
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const diaryState = {
      active_diary_id: diaryId,
      provider: diaryProvider,
      title: diaryTitle,
      source_type: 'consultation',
      text_content_hash: diaryContentHash,
      original_response_markdown: null,
      revision_number: 1,
      parent_entry_id: null,
      lineage_status: diaryLineage,
      is_favorite: false
    };

    // 9. Outcome State
    const outcomeState = {
      episode_id: ctx.episode_outcome.active_episode_id,
      preflight_status: null,
      useful_outcome_confirmed: ctx.episode_outcome.useful_outcome_confirmed,
      next_safe_action_route: ctx.exact_next_safe_action,
      useful_outcome_context: null,
      repeat_series_link: null
    };

    // 10. Privacy State
    const privacyState = {
      sensitive_opt_in: {
        raw_ecg: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_ecg),
        raw_acc: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_acc),
        raw_rr: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_rr),
        notes: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.notes),
        paths: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.paths),
        identifiers: Boolean(ctx.export_diary.sensitive_opt_in?.identifiers)
      },
      export_profile_alias: profileState.export_alias,
      support_bundle_redactions_active: true
    };

    // 11. Entitlement State
    const ent = entitlementService.getEntitlementState();
    const isRestricted = ent.status === 'expired' || ent.status === 'revoked';
    const entitlementState = {
      current_tier: isRestricted ? ent.tier : 'full_local_pro',
      expiration_timestamp_utc: ent.expires_at_utc || null,
      grace_status: ent.in_grace_period ? 'grace_period' : (ent.status || 'none'),
      feature_gates: {
        raw_export: !isRestricted,
        ai_pack: !isRestricted,
        comparisons: true,
        named_windows: true
      },
      existing_data_read_available: true
    };


    // 12. Calculate deterministic dependency fingerprint
    const dependencyFingerprint = computeWholeProductDependencyFingerprint({
      profile: profileState,
      source: sourceState,
      session: sessionState,
      window: windowState,
      comparison: comparisonState,
      report_and_pack: reportAndPackState,
      diary: diaryState,
      privacy: privacyState,
      entitlement: entitlementState
    });

    const currentnessCodes = [...baseSnapshot.currentness_codes];
    if (sourceAvailability !== 'available') {
      currentnessCodes.push(`source_${sourceAvailability}`);
    }

    const rawSnapshot: WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot = {
      schema_version: WHOLE_PRODUCT_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      profile: profileState,
      source: sourceState,
      session: sessionState,
      window: windowState,
      comparison: comparisonState,
      report_and_pack: reportAndPackState,
      diary: diaryState,
      outcome: outcomeState,
      privacy: privacyState,
      entitlement: entitlementState,
      dependency_fingerprint: dependencyFingerprint,
      currentness_codes: currentnessCodes,
      server_timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      next_safe_action: {
        route: ctx.exact_next_safe_action,
        action_type: 'navigate',
        description: `Navigate to ${ctx.exact_next_safe_action}`
      }
    };

    // Strict validation: fail closed on any defect
    return validateWholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot(rawSnapshot);
  }
}

export const ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_URLS = new Set([
  'https://polar.com',
  'https://polar.com/en/sensors/h10-heart-rate-sensor',
]);

/**
 * Validates whether a given URL is allowed to be opened in the default web browser.
 */
export function isAllowedExternalUrl(urlStr: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(urlStr);
    if (url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    return ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_URLS.has(url.origin) || ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_URLS.has(url.href);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function streamDownload(
  reqPath: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST',
  destinationPath: string,
  token: string,
  port: number,
  bodyData?: any
): Promise<void> {
  const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
  };
  if (bodyData) {
    fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(bodyData);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${reqPath}`, fetchOptions);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }

  if (!response.body) {
    throw new Error('Response body is not readable');
  }

  const fileStream = fs.createWriteStream(destinationPath);
  await pipeline(response.body as any, fileStream);
}

let mainWindow: BrowserWindow | null = null;

interface SavePackResult {
  pack_type?: 'methodology_audit_pack' | 'local_debug_pack';
  flow?: 'cancel' | 'save_success' | 'repeated_save' | 'write_failure' | 'large_streaming_success';
  native_dialog_used?: boolean;
  result_status?: 'saved' | 'cancelled' | 'failed';
  selected_path?: string;
  temporary_path?: string;
  temporary_file_removed?: boolean;
  final_file_exists?: boolean;
  preexisting_file_preserved?: boolean;
  size_bytes?: number;
  sha256?: string;
  zip_entry_count?: number;
  manifest_material_count?: number;
  manifest_self_describing_count?: number;
  expected_zip_member_count?: number;
  exact_member_set_parity?: boolean;
  raw_ecg_requested?: boolean;
  raw_ecg_present?: boolean;
  readBackValidated?: boolean;
  errorCode?: string;
  // compatibility fields:
  status?: string;
  filePath?: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  zipEntryCount?: number;
  manifestEntryCount?: number;
  safeMessage?: string;
}

function validateZip(filePath: string, expectedProfile: string | null): { valid: boolean; error?: string; sizeBytes: number; sha256: string; zipEntryCount: number; manifestEntryCount: number } {
  const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
  const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
  const sha256 = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fileContent).digest('hex').toUpperCase();

  let zip: any;
  try {
    zip = new AdmZip(filePath);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Invalid ZIP format: ${err.message}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: 0, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
  }

  const entries = zip.getEntries();
  const zipMembers: { name: string; size: number; content: Buffer }[] = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const name = entry.entryName;
    
    // 1. Validate flat archive structure (no directories/nested slashes)
    if (name.includes('/') || name.includes('\\')) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Slash detected in flat member name: '${name}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
    }
    
    // 2. Validate regex-based character restrictions
    const disallowedPatterns = [/[<>:"|?*]/, /[\x00-\x1F]/, /^\./, /^\s/, /\s$/];
    for (const pattern of disallowedPatterns) {
      if (pattern.test(name)) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Disallowed character pattern in member name: '${name}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
      }
    }

    zipMembers.push({ name, size: entry.header.size, content: entry.getData() });
  }

  const manifestEntry = zipMembers.find(m => m.name === '00_MANIFEST.json');
  if (!manifestEntry) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Manifest file (00_MANIFEST.json) not found in ZIP`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
  }

  let manifest: any;
  try {
    manifest = JSON.parse(manifestEntry.content.toString('utf8'));
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Failed to parse manifest: ${err.message}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
  }

  if (!manifest.files || !Array.isArray(manifest.files)) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Manifest does not contain a valid files array`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: 0 };
  }

  const manifestFiles: { name: string; size_bytes: number; sha256: string }[] = manifest.files;
  const manifestFileNames = new Set(manifestFiles.map(f => f.name));

  for (const mFile of manifestFiles) {
    const zipMember = zipMembers.find(z => z.name === mFile.name);
    if (!zipMember) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Manifest file '${mFile.name}' not found in ZIP archive`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (zipMember.size !== mFile.size_bytes) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Size mismatch for member '${mFile.name}': manifest says ${mFile.size_bytes}, ZIP entry is ${zipMember.size} bytes`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (mFile.sha256 !== null) {
      const calculatedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(zipMember.content).digest('hex').toLowerCase();
      if (calculatedHash !== mFile.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        return { valid: false, error: `SHA-256 mismatch for member '${mFile.name}': manifest says ${mFile.sha256}, calculated ${calculatedHash}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
      }
    }
  }

  const disclosedSet = new Set(manifestFileNames);

  for (const zMem of zipMembers) {
    if (!disclosedSet.has(zMem.name)) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Undisclosed member found in ZIP: '${zMem.name}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
  }

  for (const name of disclosedSet) {
    if (!zipMembers.some(z => z.name === name)) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Disclosed member '${name}' is missing from ZIP`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
  }

  const checksumsEntry = zipMembers.find(m => m.name === '99_CHECKSUMS.json');
  if (checksumsEntry) {
    let checksums: any;
    try {
      checksums = JSON.parse(checksumsEntry.content.toString('utf8'));
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Failed to parse checksums: ${err.message}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (checksums.algorithm !== 'sha256' || !checksums.checksums) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Invalid checksums registry format`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    for (const key of Object.keys(checksums.checksums)) {
      const zipMember = zipMembers.find(z => z.name === key);
      if (!zipMember) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Checksum registry lists nonexistent file: ${key}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
      }
      const calculatedHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(zipMember.content).digest('hex').toLowerCase();
      if (calculatedHash !== checksums.checksums[key].toLowerCase()) {
        return { valid: false, error: `Checksum mismatch in 99_CHECKSUMS.json for ${key}: expected ${checksums.checksums[key]}, got ${calculatedHash}`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
      }
    }
    if (!checksums.excluded || !checksums.excluded['00_MANIFEST.json'] || !checksums.excluded['99_CHECKSUMS.json']) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Checksum registry does not list required self-referential exclusions`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
  }

  if (expectedProfile !== null) {
    if (manifest.export_profile !== expectedProfile) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Profile mismatch: manifest has '${manifest.export_profile}', expected '${expectedProfile}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }

    const hasRawEcgInZip = zipMembers.some(z => z.name === 'ecg_full.csv' || z.name === 'signals/ecg_full.csv');
    const isRawEcgExcludedInManifest = manifest.excluded?.full_raw_ecg;
    
    if (hasRawEcgInZip && isRawEcgExcludedInManifest) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Raw ECG file is present in ZIP but manifest reports it as excluded`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (!hasRawEcgInZip && !isRawEcgExcludedInManifest) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Raw ECG file is missing from ZIP but manifest reports it as included`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }

    const { APP_VERSION, RELEASE_COMMIT } = require('../shared/buildInfo');
    if (manifest.app_version !== APP_VERSION) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Provenance mismatch: app_version in manifest is '${manifest.app_version}', but expected '${APP_VERSION}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (manifest.source_commit && manifest.source_commit !== RELEASE_COMMIT) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Provenance mismatch: source_commit in manifest is '${manifest.source_commit}', but expected '${RELEASE_COMMIT}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
  } else {
    const { APP_VERSION, RELEASE_COMMIT } = require('../shared/buildInfo');
    if (manifest.app_version !== APP_VERSION) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Provenance mismatch in methodology: app_version is '${manifest.app_version}', expected '${APP_VERSION}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
    if (manifest.source_commit && manifest.source_commit !== RELEASE_COMMIT) {
      return { valid: false, error: `Provenance mismatch in methodology: source_commit is '${manifest.source_commit}', expected '${RELEASE_COMMIT}'`, sizeBytes: stats.size, sha256, zipEntryCount: entries.length, manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length };
    }
  }

  return {
    valid: true,
    sizeBytes: stats.size,
    sha256,
    zipEntryCount: entries.length,
    manifestEntryCount: manifestFiles.length
  };
}

async function savePackStreamAndValidate(
  reqPath: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST',
  defaultFilename: string,
  filterName: string,
  extension: string,
  expectedProfile: string | null,
  bodyData?: any,
  native_dialog_used: boolean = false,
  flow: 'cancel' | 'save_success' | 'repeated_save' | 'write_failure' | 'large_streaming_success' = 'save_success'
): Promise<SavePackResult> {
  const pack_type = expectedProfile === null ? 'methodology_audit_pack' : 'local_debug_pack';
  const raw_ecg_requested = bodyData && bodyData.excludeEcgCsv === false;

  let tmpPath = '';
  let finalPath = '';
  let preexisting_exists_before = false;
  let preexisting_size_before = 0;
  let preexisting_mtime_before = 0;

  const result: SavePackResult = {
    pack_type,
    flow,
    native_dialog_used,
    result_status: 'failed',
    selected_path: '',
    temporary_path: '',
    temporary_file_removed: true,
    final_file_exists: false,
    preexisting_file_preserved: true,
    size_bytes: 0,
    sha256: '',
    zip_entry_count: 0,
    manifest_material_count: 0,
    manifest_self_describing_count: 0,
    expected_zip_member_count: 0,
    exact_member_set_parity: false,
    raw_ecg_requested,
    raw_ecg_present: false,
    readBackValidated: false,
    errorCode: '',
    // Compatibility fields:
    status: 'failed',
    filePath: '',
    sizeBytes: 0,
    zipEntryCount: 0,
    manifestEntryCount: 0
  };

  try {
    const port = getServerPort();
    const token = getServerToken();

    const { filePath: selectedPath, canceled } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow!, {
      title: `Save ${filterName}`,
      defaultPath: defaultFilename,
      filters: [{ name: filterName, extensions: [extension] }]
    });

    if (canceled || !selectedPath) {
      result.result_status = 'cancelled';
      result.status = 'cancelled';
      result.readBackValidated = false;
      return result;
    }

    finalPath = selectedPath;
    tmpPath = finalPath + '.tmp';
    result.selected_path = finalPath;
    result.filePath = finalPath;
    result.temporary_path = tmpPath;

    if (fs.existsSync(finalPath)) {
      preexisting_exists_before = true;
      const preStat = fs.statSync(finalPath);
      preexisting_size_before = preStat.size;
      preexisting_mtime_before = preStat.mtimeMs;
    }

    const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
      method,
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    };
    if (bodyData && method !== 'GET') {
      fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(bodyData);
    }

    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${reqPath}`, fetchOptions);
    if (!response.ok) {
      const text = await response.text();
      result.result_status = 'failed';
      result.status = 'failed';
      result.errorCode = 'HTTP_ERROR';
      result.safeMessage = `HTTP ${response.status}: ${text}`;
      return result;
    }

    const fileStream = fs.createWriteStream(tmpPath);
    if (!response.body) {
      throw new Error('Response body is not readable');
    }

    await pipeline(response.body as any, fileStream);
    result.temporary_file_removed = false;

    const validation = validateZip(tmpPath, expectedProfile);
    if (!validation.valid) {
      if (fs.existsSync(tmpPath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      result.temporary_file_removed = true;
      result.result_status = 'failed';
      result.status = 'failed';
      result.errorCode = 'ZIP_MANIFEST_PARITY_FAILED';
      result.safeMessage = `Validation failed: ${validation.error}`;
      return result;
    }

    await fs.promises.rename(tmpPath, finalPath);
    result.temporary_file_removed = true;
    const finalStat = await fs.promises.stat(finalPath);
    result.final_file_exists = finalStat.size > 0;

    const zip = new AdmZip(finalPath);
    const entries = zip.getEntries();
    const hasRawEcg = entries.some((e: any) => e.entryName === 'ecg_full.csv' || e.entryName === 'signals/ecg_full.csv');

    result.result_status = 'saved';
    result.status = 'saved';
    result.size_bytes = validation.sizeBytes;
    result.sizeBytes = validation.sizeBytes;
    result.sha256 = validation.sha256;
    result.zip_entry_count = validation.zipEntryCount;
    result.zipEntryCount = validation.zipEntryCount;
    result.manifest_material_count = validation.manifestEntryCount;
    result.manifestEntryCount = validation.manifestEntryCount;
    result.manifest_self_describing_count = 2;
    result.expected_zip_member_count = validation.manifestEntryCount;
    result.exact_member_set_parity = (validation.zipEntryCount === validation.manifestEntryCount);
    result.raw_ecg_present = hasRawEcg;
    result.readBackValidated = true;

    return result;
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Save pack failed: ${err.message}`);
    if (tmpPath && fs.existsSync(tmpPath)) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath); } catch (_) {}
    }
    result.temporary_file_removed = true;
    result.result_status = 'failed';
    result.status = 'failed';
    result.errorCode = err.code || 'WRITE_ERROR';
    result.safeMessage = err.message || 'Unknown error occurred during save';
    
    if (preexisting_exists_before && finalPath && fs.existsSync(finalPath)) {
      const postStat = fs.statSync(finalPath);
      result.preexisting_file_preserved = (postStat.size === preexisting_size_before && postStat.mtimeMs === preexisting_mtime_before);
    }
    
    return result;
  }
}

// 2. Intercept for runtime path inspection under actual app identity
const probePathArg = process.argv.find(arg => arg === '--h10-diagnose-runtime-paths' || arg.startsWith('--h10-diagnose-runtime-paths=') || arg === '--h10-probe-runtime-paths' || arg.startsWith('--h10-probe-runtime-paths='));
if (probePathArg) {
  app.on('ready', async () => {
    try {
      const projectRoot = process.cwd();
      const info = {
        schema_version: '1.0.0',
        resolved_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        resolution_status: 'electron_runtime_resolved',
        launch_mode: app.isPackaged ? 'actual_packaged_app_identity' : 'actual_dev_app_identity',
        app_name: app.getName(),
        app_version: app.getVersion(),
        app_path: app.getAppPath(),
        app_data_dir: app.getPath('appData'),
        user_data_dir: app.getPath('userData'),
        exec_path: process.execPath,
        is_packaged: app.isPackaged,
        electron_version: process.versions.electron,
        node_version: process.versions.node,
        platform: process.platform,
        env_inferred_user_data: path.join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab'),
        matches_env_inference: path.normalize(app.getPath('userData')).toLowerCase() === path.normalize(path.join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'h10-athlete-cardio-lab')).toLowerCase()
      };

      let outPath = path.join(projectRoot, '.agy', 'evidence', 'ELECTRON_RUNTIME_PATHS.json');
      if (probePathArg.includes('=')) {
        const customPath = probePathArg.split('=')[1];
        if (customPath && customPath.trim().length > 0) {
          outPath = path.isAbsolute(customPath) ? customPath : path.resolve(projectRoot, customPath);
        }
      }

      const outDir = path.dirname(outPath);
      if (!fs.existsSync(outDir)) fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });

      // Atomic write pattern: write to sibling temp file then rename
      const tempPath = `${outPath}.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}.tmp`;
      writeAuditFile(tempPath, JSON.stringify(info, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
      fs.renameSync(tempPath, outPath);

      process.stdout.write(`[H10-RUNTIME-PROBE] Electron runtime paths written to ${outPath}\n`);
      process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(info, null, 2) + '\n');
    } catch (err: any) {
      process.stderr.write(`[H10-RUNTIME-PROBE] Error probing runtime paths: ${err.message}\n`);
      process.exitCode = 1;
    } finally {
      app.quit();
    }
  });
}

        tempDb.exec('CREATE TABLE test_probe (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, val TEXT);');
        sqliteTestData.steps.push({ name: 'create_table', status: 'passed' });

        const insert = tempDb.prepare('INSERT INTO test_probe (val) VALUES (?);');
        insert.run('hello_rc2');
        sqliteTestData.steps.push({ name: 'insert_data', status: 'passed' });

        const query = tempDb.prepare('SELECT val FROM test_probe WHERE id = 1;');

        const selectOk = row?.val === 'hello_rc2';

        // Transaction
        tempDb.exec('BEGIN TRANSACTION;');

        // WAL

        const walOk = mode?.journal_mode === 'wal';

        }

        sqliteTestData.status = 'success';
      } catch (sqliteErr: any) {
        sqliteTestData.error = sqliteErr.message;
      }
