async function streamDownload(

  reqPath: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST',
  defaultFilename: string,
  filterName: string,
  extension: string,
  bodyData?: any
): Promise<{ success: boolean; path?: string; error?: string; cancelled?: boolean; size?: number }> {
  let filePath = '';
  try {
    const port = getServerPort();
    const token = getServerToken();
    
    const { filePath: selectedPath, canceled } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow!, {
      title: `Save ${filterName}`,
      defaultPath: defaultFilename,
      filters: [{ name: filterName, extensions: [extension] }]
    });
    
    if (canceled || !selectedPath) {
      return { success: false, cancelled: true };
    }
    filePath = selectedPath;
    
    const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
      method,
      headers: { 
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    };
    if (bodyData) {
      fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(bodyData);
    }
    
    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${reqPath}`, fetchOptions);
    if (!response.ok || response.redirected) {
      const text = await response.text();
      if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      return { success: false, error: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${text}` };
    }

    const contentType = (response.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
    
    // Read arrayBuffer to perform signature validation before finalizing file
    const arrayBuf = await response.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuf);

    // Signature validations
    const isSpaHtml = buffer.toString('utf8').includes('<div id="root">') || buffer.toString('utf8').includes('/assets/index-');
    if (isSpaHtml) {
      logger.error('diagnostics', `Export response for ${reqPath} returned SPA index.html instead of requested data.`);
      if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      return { success: false, error: 'Export failed: received SPA index HTML shell instead of requested file payload.' };
    }

    const isHtmlError = contentType.includes('text/html') && extension !== 'html';
    if (isHtmlError) {
      logger.error('diagnostics', `Export response for ${reqPath} returned HTML error page for non-HTML extension .${extension}.`);
      if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      return { success: false, error: `Export failed: server returned HTML page for extension .${extension}.` };
    }

    if (extension === 'pdf') {
      const headerStr = buffer.subarray(0, 5).toString('utf8');
      if (headerStr !== '%PDF-' || buffer.length < 100) {
        if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return { success: false, error: 'Export failed: response is not a valid PDF document.' };
      }
    } else if (extension === 'zip') {
      const isPkZip = buffer.length >= 4 && buffer[0] === 0x50 && buffer[1] === 0x4b;
      if (!isPkZip) {
        if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return { success: false, error: 'Export failed: response is not a valid ZIP archive (missing PK magic bytes).' };
      }
    } else if (extension === 'csv') {
      const isPkZip = buffer.length >= 4 && buffer[0] === 0x50 && buffer[1] === 0x4b;
      const textHead = buffer.subarray(0, 100).toString('utf8').toLowerCase();
      if (isPkZip || textHead.includes('<!doctype html>')) {
        if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return { success: false, error: 'Export failed: response is not a valid CSV text file.' };
      }
    } else if (extension === 'html') {
      const textHead = buffer.toString('utf8').toLowerCase();
      if (!textHead.includes('<!doctype html>') || textHead.includes('<div id="root"></div>')) {
        if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
          try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
        }
        return { success: false, error: 'Export failed: response is not a valid full HTML report document.' };
      }
    }
    
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, buffer);
    const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
    return { success: true, path: filePath, size: stats.size };
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `IPC download stream failed: ${err.message}`);
    if (filePath !== '' && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      try { fs.unlinkSync(filePath); } catch (_) {}
    }
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

let unresponsiveStartTime: number | null = null;

function recordHangIncident(win: BrowserWindow) {
  try {
    const logsDir = getLogsDir();
    if (!fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(logsDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const tsIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const tsFile = tsIso.replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const incidentPath = path.join(logsDir, `hang-incident-${tsFile}.json`);

    const memUsage = process.memoryUsage();
    const sysTelemetry = {
      platform: process.platform,
      arch: process.arch,
      node_version: process.version,
      electron_version: process.versions.electron,
      chrome_version: process.versions.chrome,
      total_mem_bytes: os.totalmem(),
      free_mem_bytes: os.freemem(),
      uptime_seconds: process.uptime(),
      load_avg: os.loadavg(),
      cpu_count: os.cpus().length,
      process_memory: {
        rss_bytes: memUsage.rss,
        heap_total_bytes: memUsage.heapTotal,
        heap_used_bytes: memUsage.heapUsed,
        external_bytes: memUsage.external
      }
    };

    let activeUrl = 'unknown';
    try {
      activeUrl = win.webContents.getURL();
    } catch {}

    const recentLogs = getRecentLogRecords ? getRecentLogRecords() : [];
    let recentSpans: any[] = [];
    try {
      recentSpans = getRequestSpanTimings ? getRequestSpanTimings() : [];
    } catch {}

    const incidentRecord = {
      schema_version: '1.0',
      incident_type: 'window_unresponsive',
      timestamp: tsIso,
      active_url: activeUrl,
      system_telemetry: sysTelemetry,
      recent_request_spans: recentSpans.slice(-50),
      recent_log_records: recentLogs.slice(-100)
    };

    fs.writeFileSync(incidentPath, JSON.stringify(incidentRecord, null, 2), 'utf8');
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Window unresponsive hang incident recorded: ${incidentPath}`, {
      code: 'WINDOW_HANG_INCIDENT',
      details: {
        incident_file: incidentPath,
        rss_mb: Math.round(memUsage.rss / (1024 * 1024)),
        active_url: activeUrl
      }
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.error('diagnostics', 'Failed to write hang incident file', { details: { error: err.message } });
  }
}

async function createWindow() {
  const port = getServerPort();
  const isHeadless = process.argv.includes('--headless') ||
                     process.argv.includes('--headless=new') ||
                     process.argv.includes('--test-smoke-headless') ||
                     process.env.HEADLESS === 'true';

  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    title: BRAND_CONTRACT.product_display_name,
    width: 1420,
    height: 900,
    show: !isHeadless,
    webPreferences: {
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      sandbox: true,
      webSecurity: true,
      allowRunningInsecureContent: false,
      experimentalFeatures: false,
      devTools: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
    }
  });

  mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(() => {
    return { action: 'deny' };
  });

  mainWindow.on('unresponsive', () => {
    unresponsiveStartTime = Date.now();
    logger.warn('diagnostics', 'BrowserWindow became unresponsive (renderer event loop hung)');
    if (mainWindow) {
      recordHangIncident(mainWindow);
    }
  });

  mainWindow.on('responsive', () => {
    const duration = unresponsiveStartTime ? Date.now() - unresponsiveStartTime : 0;
    unresponsiveStartTime = null;
    logger.info('diagnostics', `BrowserWindow regained responsiveness after ${duration}ms`);
  });

  mainWindow.webContents.on('render-process-gone', (_event, details) => {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Render process gone: reason=${details.reason}, exitCode=${details.exitCode}`, {
      code: 'RENDER_PROCESS_GONE',
      details
    });
  });

  mainWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (_event, errorCode, errorDescription, validatedURL) => {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Page failed to load: ${validatedURL}, error=${errorDescription} (${errorCode})`, {
      code: 'PAGE_DID_FAIL_LOAD',
      details: { errorCode, errorDescription, validatedURL }
    });
  });

  mainWindow.on('closed', () => {
    mainWindow = null;
  });

  // Load backend index route directly without token parameters in URL
  await mainWindow.loadURL(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
}

process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  try {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Uncaught exception in main process: ${err.message}`, {
      code: 'MAIN_UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION',
      details: { stack: err.stack }
    });
  } catch {}
});

process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
  try {
    logger.error('diagnostics', `Unhandled promise rejection in main process: ${reason}`, {
      code: 'MAIN_UNHANDLED_REJECTION',
      details: { reason: String(reason) }
    });
  } catch {}
});

const gotTheLock = app.requestSingleInstanceLock();
if (!gotTheLock) {
  app.quit();
} else {
  app.on('second-instance', () => {
    if (mainWindow) {
      if (mainWindow.isMinimized()) mainWindow.restore();
      mainWindow.focus();
    }
  });

  app.on('ready', async () => {
    try {
      checkAndMigrateLegacyUserData();
      await initBackendServer();
      setupSecurityHandlers();

      const { session: electronSession } = require('electron');
      const { shouldInterceptRequest } = require('../shared/tokenInterceptorFilter');
      electronSession.defaultSession.webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders((details: any, callback: any) => {
        const port = getServerPort();
        const token = getServerToken();
        const mainId = mainWindow ? mainWindow.webContents.id : undefined;

        try {
          const parsedUrl = new URL(details.url);
          const isSelf = parsedUrl.protocol === 'http:' && parsedUrl.hostname === '127.0.0.1' && parsedUrl.port === String(port);
          if (!isSelf && details.requestHeaders) {
            delete details.requestHeaders['Authorization'];
            delete details.requestHeaders['authorization'];
            delete details.requestHeaders['AUTHORIZATION'];
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        if (shouldInterceptRequest(details, port, mainId)) {
          details.requestHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }
        callback({ requestHeaders: details.requestHeaders });
      });

      const uuidRegex = /^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|session_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)$/i;

      function validateIpcSender(event: Electron.IpcMainInvokeEvent) {
        // 1. Validate webContents identity if mainWindow is active
        if (mainWindow && event.sender !== mainWindow.webContents) {
          logger.error('diagnostics', 'Blocked unauthorized IPC request: sender does not match mainWindow');
          throw new Error('Access denied: invalid sender webContents');
        }

        // 2. Validate senderFrame is mainFrame if frame navigation tracking is active
        if (mainWindow?.webContents?.mainFrame && event.senderFrame && event.senderFrame !== mainWindow.webContents.mainFrame) {
          logger.error('diagnostics', 'Blocked unauthorized IPC request: senderFrame is not mainFrame');
          throw new Error('Access denied: sender frame must be mainFrame');
        }

        // 3. Validate origin URL
        const url = event.sender.getURL();
        const port = getServerPort();
        const allowedPrefix1 = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
        const allowedPrefix2 = `http://localhost:${port}`;
        const devPrefix = 'http://localhost:5173';
        const isAllowed =
          url.startsWith(allowedPrefix1) ||
          url.startsWith(allowedPrefix2) ||
          (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && url.startsWith(devPrefix));

        if (!isAllowed) {
          logger.error('diagnostics', `Blocked unauthorized IPC request from sender: ${url}`);
          throw new Error('Access denied: unauthorized sender origin');
        }
      }

      // Preload bridge handlers
      ipcMain.handle('save-report', async (event, args: { sessionId: string; format: string; notes?: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!uuidRegex.test(args.sessionId)) throw new Error('Invalid Session ID format');
        if (args.format !== 'pdf' && args.format !== 'html') throw new Error('Invalid Report format');
        
        const ext = args.format;
        const notesQuery = args.notes ? `?notes=${encodeURIComponent(args.notes)}` : '';
        return await streamDownload(
          `/api/reports/${args.sessionId}/${ext}${notesQuery}`,
          'GET',
          `cardio_report_${args.sessionId}.${ext}`,
          ext.toUpperCase() + ' Report',
          ext
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-metrics-csv', async (event, args: { sessionId: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!uuidRegex.test(args.sessionId)) throw new Error('Invalid Session ID format');
        
        return await streamDownload(
          `/api/reports/${args.sessionId}/metrics.csv`,
          'GET',
          `metrics_${args.sessionId}.csv`,
          'Session Metrics CSV',
          'csv'
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-rr-csv', async (event, args: { sessionId: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!uuidRegex.test(args.sessionId)) throw new Error('Invalid Session ID format');
        
        return await streamDownload(
          `/api/reports/${args.sessionId}/rr.csv`,
          'GET',
          `rr_${args.sessionId}.csv`,
          'RR Intervals CSV',
          'csv'
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-consultation-bundle', async (event, args: { sessionId: string; includeRaw?: boolean }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!uuidRegex.test(args.sessionId)) throw new Error('Invalid Session ID format');
        
        if (args.includeRaw) {
          const { response } = await dialog.showMessageBox(mainWindow!, {
            type: 'warning',
            buttons: ['Отмена', 'Подтвердить'],
            defaultId: 0,
            title: 'Экспорт сырых данных (Privacy Contract)',
            message: 'Вы собираетесь экспортировать сырые данные ЭКГ и акселерометра в составе консультационного пакета.\n\nЭти файлы содержат детальные технические параметры вашей физиологической активности и не должны передаваться третьим лицам без явного согласия.\n\nВы подтверждаете согласие с условиями конфиденциальности?',
            cancelId: 0
          });
          if (response === 0) {
            return { success: false, cancelled: true };
          }
        }

        const rawQuery = args.includeRaw ? '?include_raw=true' : '?include_raw=false';
        return await streamDownload(
          `/api/reports/${args.sessionId}/bundle${rawQuery}`,
          'GET',
          `bundle_${args.sessionId}.zip`,
          'Consultation Bundle ZIP',
          'zip'
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-llm-pack', async (event, args: { packId: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const packIdRegex = /^pack_([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|session_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)_\d+$/i;
        if (!packIdRegex.test(args.packId)) throw new Error('Invalid Pack ID format');
        
        return await streamDownload(
          `/api/llm-pack/${args.packId}/download`,
          'GET',
          `llm_pack_${args.packId}.zip`,
          'LLM Pack ZIP',
          'zip'
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-methodology-audit-pack', async (event, request) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!request || typeof request !== 'object') {
          throw new Error('Invalid request shape');
        }
        
        const port = getServerPort();
        const token = getServerToken();
        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/methodology-pack/export`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          }
        });
        
        if (!response.ok) {
          const text = await response.text();
          return {
            status: 'failed',
            errorCode: 'HTTP_ERROR',
            safeMessage: `Failed to compile methodology pack on backend: ${text}`,
            readBackValidated: false
          };
        }
        
        const result = await response.json() as any;
        if (!result.filename) {
          return {
            status: 'failed',
            errorCode: 'COMPILE_ERROR',
            safeMessage: 'Backend export did not return a filename',
            readBackValidated: false
          };
        }
        
        return await savePackStreamAndValidate(
          `/api/methodology-pack/download/${result.filename}`,
          'GET',
          result.filename,
          'Methodology Audit Pack ZIP',
          'zip',
          null
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-local-debug-pack', async (event, request: { packId: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        if (!request || typeof request !== 'object' || typeof request.packId !== 'string') {
          throw new Error('Invalid request shape');
        }
        
        const packIdRegex = /^pack_([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|session_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)_\d+$/i;
        if (!packIdRegex.test(request.packId)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid Pack ID format');
        }

        const port = getServerPort();
        const token = getServerToken();
        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/llm-pack/${request.packId}`, {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: {
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          const text = await response.text();
          return {
            status: 'failed',
            errorCode: 'HTTP_ERROR',
            safeMessage: `Failed to retrieve LLM pack metadata: ${text}`,
            readBackValidated: false
          };
        }

        const pack = await response.json() as any;
        const profile = pack.export_profile;
        const allowedProfiles = ['antigravity_local_debug', 'chatgpt_web_full', 'gemini_web_compact'];
        if (!allowedProfiles.includes(profile)) {
          return {
            status: 'failed',
            errorCode: 'INVALID_PROFILE',
            safeMessage: `Profile '${profile}' is not authorized for saving.`,
            readBackValidated: false
          };
        }

        return await savePackStreamAndValidate(
          `/api/llm-pack/${request.packId}/download`,
          'GET',
          `llm_pack_${request.packId}.zip`,
          'Local Debug Pack ZIP',
          'zip',
          profile
        );
      });


      ipcMain.handle('save-diagnostic-bundle', async (event) => { // terminology wording guardrails
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 19).replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace('T', '_');
        return await streamDownload(
          '/api/diagnostics/bundle/export', // terminology wording guardrails
          'POST',
          `diagnostic_bundle_${timestamp}.zip`, // terminology wording guardrails
          'Diagnostic Bundle ZIP', // terminology wording guardrails
          'zip'
        );
      });

      ipcMain.handle('create-database-backup', async (event) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        
        const backupDir = path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'backups');
        if (!fs.existsSync(backupDir)) {
          fs.mkdirSync(backupDir, { recursive: true });
        }
        
        const timestamp = Date.now();
        const filename = `backup_${timestamp}.db`;
        const backupPath = path.join(backupDir, filename);

        // Verify destination exists (unique destination enforcement)
        if (fs.existsSync(backupPath)) {
          return { success: false, error: 'Backup destination already exists' };
        }

        try {
          const port = getServerPort();
          const token = getServerToken();
          
          const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/database/backup`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ backupPath })
          });

          const result = await response.json() as any;
          if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
            return { success: false, error: result.error || 'Backup operation failed on backend' };
          }

          const stats = fs.statSync(backupPath);
          return { 
            success: true, 
            filename,
            size: stats.size
          };
        } catch (err: any) {
          logger.error('diagnostics', `Database backup failed: ${err.message}`);
          if (fs.existsSync(backupPath)) {
            try { fs.unlinkSync(backupPath); } catch (_) {}
          }
          return { success: false, error: err.message };
        }
      });

      ipcMain.handle('show-save-backup-dialog', async (event, args) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
        const defaultFilename = args?.defaultFilename || `cardiolab_workspace_backup_${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.zip`;
        const result = await dialog.showSaveDialog(win || undefined as any, {
          title: 'Сохранить резервную копию CardioLab',
          defaultPath: defaultFilename,
          filters: [
            { name: 'Резервная копия CardioLab (*.zip)', extensions: ['zip', 'cardiolab-backup'] },
            { name: 'Все файлы (*.*)', extensions: ['*'] }
          ]
        });

        return {
          success: !result.canceled && !!result.filePath,
          filePath: result.filePath,
          canceled: result.canceled
        };
      });

      ipcMain.handle('show-open-backup-dialog', async (event) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
        const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(win || undefined as any, {
          title: 'Выбрать резервную копию CardioLab',
          properties: ['openFile'],
          filters: [
            { name: 'Резервная копия CardioLab (*.zip, *.cardiolab-backup)', extensions: ['zip', 'cardiolab-backup'] },
            { name: 'Все файлы (*.*)', extensions: ['*'] }
          ]
        });

        return {
          success: !result.canceled && result.filePaths && result.filePaths.length > 0,
          filePath: result.filePaths?.[0],
          canceled: result.canceled
        };
      });

      ipcMain.handle('show-save-fulfillment-request-dialog', async (event, args?: { defaultFilename?: string; requestId?: string; requestHash?: string }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
        const defaultFilename = args?.defaultFilename || `cardiolab_fulfillment_request_${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.json`;
        const result = await dialog.showSaveDialog(win || undefined as any, {
          title: 'Экспорт запроса на лицензирование CardioLab',
          defaultPath: defaultFilename,
          filters: [
            { name: 'Запрос на лицензирование (*.json)', extensions: ['json'] },
            { name: 'Все файлы (*.*)', extensions: ['*'] }
          ]
        });

        if (result.canceled || !result.filePath) {
          return {
            success: false,
            capability_ref: undefined,
            display_name: undefined,
            canceled: true
          };
        }

        const selectedPath = path.resolve(result.filePath);
        const displayName = path.basename(selectedPath);
        let capabilityRef: string | undefined = undefined;

        if (args?.requestId && args?.requestHash) {
          try {
            const token = commercialExchangeFileBroker.issueExportCapability({
              request_id: args.requestId,
              request_hash: args.requestHash,
              destination_path: selectedPath
            });
            capabilityRef = token.token_id;
          } catch (err: any) {
            logger.warn('lifecycle', `Failed to issue export capability from save dialog: ${err.message}`);
          }
        }

        return {
          success: !result.canceled && !!capabilityRef,
          capability_ref: capabilityRef,
          display_name: displayName,
          canceled: false
        };
      });

      ipcMain.handle('show-open-fulfillment-response-dialog', async (event) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
        const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(win || undefined as any, {
          title: 'Выбрать подписанный ответ оператора CardioLab',
          properties: ['openFile'],
          filters: [
            { name: 'Ответ / Лицензия CardioLab (*.json, *.lic)', extensions: ['json', 'lic'] },
            { name: 'Все файлы (*.*)', extensions: ['*'] }
          ]
        });

        if (result.canceled || !result.filePaths || result.filePaths.length === 0) {
          return {
            success: false,
            capability_ref: undefined,
            display_name: undefined,
            plan: undefined,
            canceled: true
          };
        }

        const selectedPath = path.resolve(result.filePaths[0]);
        const displayName = path.basename(selectedPath);

        try {
          const preflight = commercialExchangeFileBroker.preflightResponseFile(selectedPath);
          return {
            success: true,
            capability_ref: preflight.capability_ref,
            display_name: displayName,
            plan: preflight.plan,
            canceled: false
          };
        } catch (err: any) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: err.message,
            display_name: displayName,
            canceled: false
          };
        }
      });

      ipcMain.handle('get-safe-build-info', (event) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        
        const { APP_VERSION, BUILD_VERSION, RELEASE_CHANNEL, RELEASE_COMMIT } = require('../shared/buildInfo');
        
        return {
          app_is_packaged: app.isPackaged,
          app_version: APP_VERSION,
          build_version: BUILD_VERSION,
          electron_version: process.versions.electron,
          release_channel: RELEASE_CHANNEL,
          release_commit: RELEASE_COMMIT,
          runtime_mode: app.isPackaged ? 'production' : 'development'
        };
      });

      ipcMain.handle('save-page-snapshot', async (event, args: { htmlContent: string; suggestedFileName: string }) => {
        // 1. Validate sender and frame
        if (event.sender !== mainWindow?.webContents) {
          throw new Error('Access denied: invalid sender webContents');
        }
        if (event.senderFrame !== mainWindow?.webContents?.mainFrame) {
          throw new Error('Access denied: sender frame must be mainFrame');
        }

        // 2. Parse and validate URL
        const senderUrl = new URL(event.sender.getURL());
        if (senderUrl.protocol !== 'http:') {
          throw new Error('Access denied: invalid protocol');
        }
        if (senderUrl.hostname !== '127.0.0.1' && senderUrl.hostname !== 'localhost') {
          throw new Error('Access denied: invalid hostname');
        }
        if (senderUrl.port !== String(getServerPort())) {
          throw new Error('Access denied: invalid port');
        }

        // 3. Validate request parameters
        if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') {
          throw new Error('Invalid request shape: expected object');
        }
        if (typeof args.htmlContent !== 'string' || typeof args.suggestedFileName !== 'string') {
          throw new Error('Invalid request shape: htmlContent and suggestedFileName must be strings');
        }

        // 4. Validate and clean suggested filename (basename only, no traversal)
        const baseName = path.basename(args.suggestedFileName);
        if (baseName !== args.suggestedFileName || /[\\\/]/g.test(args.suggestedFileName) || args.suggestedFileName.includes('..') || /[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]/g.test(args.suggestedFileName)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid suggested filename: directory traversal or control characters are prohibited');
        }
        if (!args.suggestedFileName.endsWith('.html')) {
          throw new Error('Invalid suggested filename: extension must be .html');
        }

        // 5. Content checks
        const marker = '<!-- H10_ATHLETE_SNAPSHOT_v1.0 -->';
        if (!args.htmlContent.includes(marker)) {
          return { status: 'failed', safe_error_code: 'MISSING_SNAPSHOT_MARKER' };
        }
        if (args.htmlContent.trim().startsWith('{') && args.htmlContent.trim().endsWith('}')) {
          return { status: 'failed', safe_error_code: 'REJECTED_JSON_PAYLOAD' };
        }
        if (args.htmlContent.includes('<div id="root"></div>') && !args.htmlContent.includes('snapshot-full-page')) {
          return { status: 'failed', safe_error_code: 'REJECTED_VITE_SHELL' };
        }
        if (/<script[^>]*src=["']?http/gi.test(args.htmlContent)) {
          return { status: 'failed', safe_error_code: 'REJECTED_EXTERNAL_SCRIPT' };
        }

        // 6. Show save dialog
        const { filePath, canceled } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow!, {
          title: 'Сохранить снимок страницы',
          defaultPath: args.suggestedFileName,
          filters: [{ name: 'HTML Files', extensions: ['html'] }]
        });

        if (canceled || !filePath) {
          return { status: 'canceled' };
        }

        const resolvedPath = path.resolve(filePath);
        const tmpPath = resolvedPath + '.tmp';

        try {
          // Write sibling temp file
          await fs.promises.writeFile(tmpPath, args.htmlContent, 'utf8');

          // Read back and verify size and marker
          const readBack = await fs.promises.readFile(tmpPath, 'utf8');
          if (readBack !== args.htmlContent) {
            throw new Error('Integrity check failed: content mismatch');
          }
          const expectedSize = Buffer.byteLength(args.htmlContent, 'utf8');
          if (Buffer.byteLength(readBack, 'utf8') !== expectedSize) {
            throw new Error(`Integrity check failed: expected ${expectedSize} bytes, got ${Buffer.byteLength(readBack, 'utf8')} bytes`);
          }
          if (!readBack.includes(marker)) {
            throw new Error('Integrity check failed: missing marker in temporary file');
          }

          // Calculate SHA-256
          const crypto = require('crypto');
          const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(args.htmlContent, 'utf8').digest('hex');

          // Atomic rename
          await fs.promises.rename(tmpPath, resolvedPath);

          return {
            status: 'saved',
            filename: path.basename(resolvedPath),
            size_bytes: expectedSize,
            sha256: hash
          };
        } catch (err: any) {
          logger.error('diagnostics', `Snapshot save failed: ${err.message}`);
          
          if (fs.existsSync(tmpPath)) {
            try {
              fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath);
            } catch (_) {}
          }

          return {
            status: 'failed',
            safe_error_code: err.code || 'WRITE_ERROR'
          };
        }
      });

      ipcMain.handle('log-renderer-event', async (event, args: { level?: string; category?: string; message: string; params?: any }) => {
        validateIpcSender(event);
        try {
          const level = (args.level || 'info') as any;
          const category = (args.category || 'ui') as any;
          const message = args.message || 'Renderer event';
          if (logger[level as 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error']) {
            logger[level as 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error'](category, message, args.params);
          } else {
            logger.info(category, message, args.params);
          }
          return { success: true };
        } catch (err: any) {
          return { success: false, error: err.message };
        }
      });

      await createWindow();

    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.error('diagnostics', `Application startup failed: ${err.message}`);
      app.quit();
    }
  });

  app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
    if (process.platform !== 'darwin') {
      app.quit();
    }
  });

  app.on('will-quit', () => {
    try {
      const { session: electronSession } = require('electron');
      electronSession.defaultSession.webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders(null);
    } catch (err) {
      // ignore
    }
    stopBackendServer();
  });
}
}

================================================================================
FILE: src/electron/security.ts
================================================================================
import { app, session, shell, BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import { isAllowedExternalUrl } from './externalUrls';

/**
 * Registers global Electron security event listeners and session headers.
 */
export function setupSecurityHandlers() {
  // 1. Content Security Policy (CSP) headers injection
  session.defaultSession.webRequest.onHeadersReceived((details, callback) => {
    callback({
      responseHeaders: {
        ...details.responseHeaders,
        'Content-Security-Policy': [
          "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ws://127.0.0.1:* http://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* http://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';"
        ]
      }
    });
  });

  // 2. Navigation restrictions, webview blocking, and window controls
  app.on('web-contents-created', (event, contents) => {
    // Block WebViews
    contents.on('will-attach-webview', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
    });

    // Restrict in-app navigation to the local Express server origin
    contents.on('will-navigate', (e, navigationUrl) => {
      try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(navigationUrl);
        const isAllowedOrigin =
          parsedUrl.protocol === 'http:' &&
          (parsedUrl.hostname === '127.0.0.1' || parsedUrl.hostname === 'localhost');
        if (!isAllowedOrigin) {
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      } catch {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    });

    // Handle target="_blank" window creation
    contents.setWindowOpenHandler(({ url }) => {
      if (isAllowedExternalUrl(url)) {
        shell.openExternal(url).catch(() => {});
      }
      return { action: 'deny' };
    });
  });

  // 3. Deny-by-default permission requests (geolocation, camera, microphone, etc.)
  session.defaultSession.setPermissionRequestHandler((webContents, permission, callback) => {
    callback(false);
  });
}

FILE: src/electron/serverLifecycle.ts
================================================================================
import { app } from 'electron';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { Server } from 'http';
import { startServer } from '../backend/server';
import { logger } from '../backend/logging/appLogger';

let serverInstance: Server | null = null;
let serverPort = 0;
let serverToken = '';

export function getServerPort(): number {
  return serverPort;
}

export function getServerToken(): string {
  return serverToken;
}

/**
 * Initializes single-instance validation and boots the local Express server on a random port.
 */
export async function initBackendServer(): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const hasLock = app.requestSingleInstanceLock();
      if (!hasLock) {
        logger.error('diagnostics', 'Failed to acquire single-instance lock, quitting');
        app.quit();
        return reject(new Error('Another instance is already running'));
      }

      // Generate per-launch 256-bit cryptographically secure token
      serverToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

      // Bind to 127.0.0.1 only, port 0 triggers ephemeral auto-assignment (unless CARDIOLAB_PORT is specified)
      const requestedPort = process.env.CARDIOLAB_PORT ? parseInt(process.env.CARDIOLAB_PORT, 10) : 0;
      const targetPort = (!isNaN(requestedPort) && requestedPort > 0) ? requestedPort : 0;
      const frontendDistPath = require('path').join(app.getAppPath(), 'dist/frontend');
      const server = startServer(targetPort, serverToken, frontendDistPath);
      serverInstance = server;

      // Handle timeout
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (serverPort === 0) {
          server.close();
          reject(new Error('Server start timed out after 10000ms'));
        }
      }, 10000);

      server.on('listening', () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        const address = server.address();
        if (address && typeof address === 'object') {
          serverPort = address.port;
          logger.info('diagnostics', `Express server listening on 127.0.0.1:${serverPort}`);
          resolve();
        } else {
          reject(new Error('Failed to resolve server listening port'));
        }
      });

      server.on('error', (err: any) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        logger.error('diagnostics', `Express server error: ${err.message}`);
        reject(err);
      });

    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.error('diagnostics', `Failed to initialize Express server: ${err.message}`);
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Stops the Express server during application termination.
 */
export function stopBackendServer() {
  if (serverInstance) {
    serverInstance.close();
    serverInstance = null;
    logger.info('diagnostics', 'Express server stopped');
  }
}

/**
 * Adapts an AthleteCoreJourneyContext to an ActiveWorkContext projection.
 * Ensures the frontend stores only the latest validated journey projection
 * while maintaining backward-compatible read access for legacy components.
 */
export function journeyContextToActiveWorkContext(journey: AthleteCoreJourneyContext): ActiveWorkContext {
  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    context_id: journey.context_id,
    profile_id: journey.profile.profile_id || 'unresolved',
    active_episode_id: journey.episode_outcome.active_episode_id,
    active_series_id: journey.episode_outcome.active_series_id,
    canonical_session_id: journey.session.session_id,
    canonical_source_id: journey.session.source_id,
    canonical_result_hash: journey.session.result_hash,
    active_window_id: journey.window?.active_window_id || null,
    active_window_revision: journey.window?.active_window_revision || null,
    compare_target_session_id: journey.comparison.target_session_id,
    compare_peer_session_id: journey.comparison.peer_session_id,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: journey.comparison.longitudinal_snapshot_id,
    saved_view_id: journey.comparison.saved_view_id,
    saved_view_revision: journey.comparison.saved_view_revision,
    active_pack_id: journey.export_diary.active_pack_id,
    active_diary_id: journey.export_diary.active_diary_id,
    privacy_mode: journey.privacy_entitlement.privacy_mode,
    currentness: journey.session.currentness,
    currentness_reason: journey.session.currentness_reason,
    derived_next_action_code: journey.exact_next_safe_action,
    context_generation: journey.context_generation,
    created_at_utc: journey.created_at_utc,
    updated_at_utc: journey.updated_at_utc
  };
}

/**
 * Maps ActiveWorkContext updates to Partial<AthleteCoreJourneyContext>
 */
export function activeWorkContextToJourneyUpdates(work: Partial<ActiveWorkContext>): Partial<AthleteCoreJourneyContext> {
  const updates: any = {};
  if (work.canonical_session_id !== undefined) {
    updates.session = { session_id: work.canonical_session_id };
  }
  if (work.compare_target_session_id !== undefined || work.compare_peer_session_id !== undefined) {
    updates.comparison = {
      target_session_id: work.compare_target_session_id ?? null,
      peer_session_id: work.compare_peer_session_id ?? null,
      mode: work.compare_peer_session_id ? 'explicit_ab' : (work.compare_target_session_id ? 'personal_baseline' : 'none')
    };
  }
  if (work.active_window_id !== undefined || work.active_window_revision !== undefined) {
    updates.window = {
      active_window_id: work.active_window_id ?? null,
      active_window_revision: work.active_window_revision ?? null
    };
  }
  if (work.active_pack_id !== undefined || work.active_diary_id !== undefined) {
    updates.export_diary = {
      active_pack_id: work.active_pack_id ?? null,
      active_diary_id: work.active_diary_id ?? null
    };
  }
  if (work.privacy_mode !== undefined) {
    updates.privacy_entitlement = {
      privacy_mode: work.privacy_mode
    };
  }
  return updates;
}

export class ApiHttpError extends Error {
  public readonly status: number;
  public readonly code?: string;
  public readonly details?: any;

  constructor(message: string, status: number, code?: string, details?: any) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiHttpError';
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ApiHttpError.prototype);
  }
}

let apiBaseUrl = (globalThis as any)?.__CARDIOLAB_API_BASE_URL__ || '/api';
export function setApiBaseUrlForTest(baseUrl: string): void {
  apiBaseUrl = baseUrl;
  if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
    (globalThis as any).__CARDIOLAB_API_BASE_URL__ = baseUrl;
  }
}
export function resetApiBaseUrlForTest(): void {
  apiBaseUrl = '/api';
  if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
    delete (globalThis as any).__CARDIOLAB_API_BASE_URL__;
  }
}
export async function getAuthToken(): Promise<string> {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI) {
    return '';
  }
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    if ((window as any).__CARDIOLAB_TOKEN__) {
      return (window as any).__CARDIOLAB_TOKEN__;
    }
    try {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const urlToken = urlParams.get('token');
      if (urlToken) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('cardiolab_token', urlToken);
        return urlToken;
      }
      const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('cardiolab_token');
      if (stored) return stored;
    } catch {}
  }
  return '';
}

export interface PrivilegedSessionState {
  researchToken: string | null;
  operatorSecret: string | null;
  reviewerTokens: Record<string, string>;
  ownerScientificSecret: string | null;
  boundStudyId?: string | null;
}

let privilegedSessionState: PrivilegedSessionState = {
  researchToken: null,
  operatorSecret: null,
  reviewerTokens: {},
  ownerScientificSecret: null,
  boundStudyId: null
};

export function setPrivilegedSessionState(updates: Partial<PrivilegedSessionState>): void {
  privilegedSessionState = {
    ...privilegedSessionState,
    ...updates,
    reviewerTokens: updates.reviewerTokens
      ? { ...privilegedSessionState.reviewerTokens, ...updates.reviewerTokens }
      : privilegedSessionState.reviewerTokens
  };
}

export function getPrivilegedSessionState(): Readonly<PrivilegedSessionState> {
  return privilegedSessionState;
}

export function clearPrivilegedSessionState(): void {
  privilegedSessionState = {
    researchToken: null,
    operatorSecret: null,
    reviewerTokens: {},
    ownerScientificSecret: null,
    boundStudyId: null
  };
}

async function apiFetch<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getAuthToken();
  const headers = new Headers(options?.headers);
  if (!headers.has('Content-Type')) {
    headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  }
  if (token) {
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  }

  // Automatic Privileged Credential Attachment
  const priv = getPrivilegedSessionState();
  if (priv.researchToken && !headers.has('X-Research-Capability') && !headers.has('Authorization')) {
    headers.set('X-Research-Capability', priv.researchToken);
  }
  if (priv.operatorSecret && !headers.has('X-Operator-Secret')) {
    headers.set('X-Operator-Secret', priv.operatorSecret);
  }
  if (priv.ownerScientificSecret && !headers.has('X-Owner-Scientific-Authorization')) {
    headers.set('X-Owner-Scientific-Authorization', priv.ownerScientificSecret);
  }
  if (!headers.has('X-Reviewer-Token')) {
    const match = path.match(/\/assignments\/([^/?]+)/);
    const assignmentId = match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : undefined;
    if (assignmentId && priv.reviewerTokens[assignmentId]) {
      headers.set('X-Reviewer-Token', priv.reviewerTokens[assignmentId]);
    } else if (priv.reviewerTokens['default']) {
      headers.set('X-Reviewer-Token', priv.reviewerTokens['default']);
    }
  }

  const effectiveBaseUrl = (globalThis as any)?.__CARDIOLAB_API_BASE_URL__ || apiBaseUrl;
  let targetUrl = `${effectiveBaseUrl}${path}`;
  if (!targetUrl.startsWith('http://') && !targetUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
    const origin = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location && window.location.origin && window.location.origin !== 'null' && !window.location.origin.includes(':0'))
      ? window.location.origin
      : (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.PORT ? `http://127.0.0.1:${process.env.PORT}` : 'http://127.0.0.1:3000');
    targetUrl = `${origin}${targetUrl.startsWith('/') ? '' : '/'}${targetUrl}`;
  }
  if (targetUrl.includes(':0/')) {
    const fallbackPort = (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.PORT) ? process.env.PORT : '3000';
    targetUrl = targetUrl.replace(':0/', `:${fallbackPort}/`);
  }

  const res = await fetch(targetUrl, {
    ...options,
    credentials: options?.credentials ?? 'same-origin',
    headers,
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let msg = `HTTP ${res.status}`;
    let code: string | undefined = undefined;
    let details: any = undefined;
    try {
      const data = await res.json();
      msg = data.error || msg;
      code = data.code;
      details = data;
    } catch {}
    throw new ApiHttpError(msg, res.status, code, details);
  }
  return res.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export const api = {
  getAuthToken,
  getStatus: () => apiFetch<StatusResponse>('/status'),
  getJourneySnapshot: getJourneySnapshotApi,
  getJourneyContext: getJourneyContextApi,
  getJourneySelection: getJourneySelectionApi,
  executeJourneyCommand: executeJourneyCommandApi,
  transitionJourneyContext: transitionJourneyContextApi,

  // G23 Authoritative Reporting & Export Workspace
  getExportWorkspaceSnapshot: (sessionId: string, profileId?: string) => {
    const q = profileId ? `?profileId=${encodeURIComponent(profileId)}` : '';
    return apiFetch<{ success: boolean; snapshot: ExportWorkspaceSnapshot }>(`/export/workspace/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}${q}`);
  },

  createExportPlan: (params: any) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; plan: ExportPlan }>('/export/plans', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(params)
    }),

  getExportPlan: (planId: string) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; plan: ExportPlan }>(`/export/plans/${encodeURIComponent(planId)}`),

  startExportJob: (planId: string, options?: { destinationDir?: string; idempotencyKey?: string }) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; job: ExportJobSnapshot }>('/export/jobs', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ planId, ...options })
    }),

  getExportJob: (jobId: string) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; job: ExportJobSnapshot }>(`/export/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`),

  cancelExportJob: (jobId: string) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; status: string }>(`/export/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/cancel`, {
      method: 'POST'
    }),

  retryExportJob: (jobId: string) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; job: ExportJobSnapshot }>(`/export/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/retry`, {
      method: 'POST'
    }),

  startBatchExportJob: (params: any) =>
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean; job: ExportJobSnapshot }>('/export/batch', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(params)
    }),

  getExportHistory: async (filter?: { sessionId?: string; profileId?: string; status?: string; page?: number; pageSize?: number }) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter?.sessionId) params.set('sessionId', filter.sessionId);
    if (filter?.profileId) params.set('profileId', filter.profileId);
    if (filter?.status) params.set('status', filter.status);
    if (filter?.page !== undefined) params.set('page', String(filter.page));
    if (filter?.pageSize !== undefined) params.set('pageSize', String(filter.pageSize));
    const q = params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
    const res = await apiFetch<any>(`/export/history${q}`);
    return {
      success: res.success ?? true,
      total: res.total ?? res.total_count ?? 0,
      total_count: res.total_count ?? res.total ?? 0,
      page: res.page ?? 1,
      pageSize: res.pageSize ?? res.page_size ?? 20,
      page_size: res.page_size ?? res.pageSize ?? 20,
      total_pages: res.total_pages ?? 1,
      artifacts: res.artifacts ?? res.rows ?? [],
      rows: res.rows ?? res.artifacts ?? []
    };
  },

  downloadExportArtifactUrl: (manifestId: string) => {
    let base = (globalThis as any)?.__CARDIOLAB_API_BASE_URL__ || apiBaseUrl;
    if (base.includes(':0')) {
      const fallbackPort = (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.PORT) ? process.env.PORT : '3000';
      base = base.replace(':0', `:${fallbackPort}`);
    }
    return `${base}/export/artifacts/${encodeURIComponent(manifestId)}/download`;
  },

  querySessionLibrary: (query: Partial<SessionLibraryQuery> = {}) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query.profile_id) params.set('profile_id', query.profile_id);
    if (query.search) params.set('search', query.search);
    if (query.activity_type) params.set('activity_type', query.activity_type);
    if (query.date_from) params.set('date_from', query.date_from);
    if (query.date_to) params.set('date_to', query.date_to);
    if (query.readiness && query.readiness !== 'all') params.set('readiness', query.readiness);
    if (query.baseline_eligible && query.baseline_eligible !== 'all') params.set('baseline_eligible', query.baseline_eligible);
    if (query.source_available && query.source_available !== 'all') params.set('source_available', query.source_available);
    if (query.signal_type && query.signal_type !== 'all') params.set('signal_type', query.signal_type);
    if (query.tags && query.tags.length > 0) params.set('tags', query.tags.join(','));
    if (query.include_ignored !== undefined) params.set('include_ignored', String(query.include_ignored));
    if (query.include_duplicates !== undefined) params.set('include_duplicates', String(query.include_duplicates));
    if (query.review_preset && query.review_preset !== 'all') params.set('review_preset', query.review_preset);
    if (query.sort_by) params.set('sort_by', query.sort_by);
    if (query.sort_dir) params.set('sort_dir', query.sort_dir);
    if (query.limit !== undefined) params.set('limit', String(query.limit));

    const q = params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
    return apiFetch<SessionLibraryPage>(`/library/sessions${q}`);
  },

  getSessions: (filters?: SessionQueryFilters | string) => {
    let q = '';
    if (typeof filters === 'string') {
      q = `?user_id=${encodeURIComponent(filters)}`;
    } else if (filters) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (filters.user_id) params.set('user_id', filters.user_id);
      if (filters.include_ignored !== undefined) params.set('include_ignored', String(filters.include_ignored));
      if (filters.search) params.set('search', filters.search);
      if (filters.activity_type) params.set('activity_type', filters.activity_type);
      if (filters.date_from) params.set('date_from', filters.date_from);
      if (filters.date_to) params.set('date_to', filters.date_to);
      if (filters.readiness && filters.readiness !== 'all') params.set('readiness', filters.readiness);
      if (filters.baseline_eligible && filters.baseline_eligible !== 'all') params.set('baseline_eligible', filters.baseline_eligible);
      if (filters.signal_type && filters.signal_type !== 'all') params.set('signal_type', filters.signal_type);
      if (filters.tag && filters.tag !== 'all') params.set('tag', filters.tag);
      if (filters.tags && filters.tags.length > 0) params.set('tags', filters.tags.join(','));
      if (filters.source_available && filters.source_available !== 'all') params.set('source_available', filters.source_available);
      if (filters.sort_by) params.set('sort_by', filters.sort_by);
      if (filters.sort_dir) params.set('sort_dir', filters.sort_dir);
      if (filters.limit !== undefined) params.set('limit', String(filters.limit));
      if (filters.offset !== undefined) params.set('offset', String(filters.offset));
      const str = params.toString();
      if (str) q = `?${str}`;
    }
    return apiFetch<SessionSummary[]>(`/sessions${q}`);
  },

  trackPricingEvent: (data: {
    event_type: string;
    plan_id?: string;
    tier?: string;
    source_view?: string;
    timestamp_utc?: string;
    exposure_id?: string;
    decline_reason?: string;
    price_sensitivity_feedback?: string;
    participant_id?: string;
  }) => {
    let action = 'offer_viewed';
    if (data.event_type === 'plan_interest_selected') {
      action = 'purchase_intent_clicked';
    } else if (data.event_type === 'declined') {
      action = 'offer_declined';
    } else if (data.event_type === 'feedback') {
      action = 'price_feedback_given';
    }
    return apiFetch<any>('/beta/pricing/action', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action,
        tier: data.tier,
        exposure_id: data.exposure_id,
        decline_reason: data.decline_reason,
        price_sensitivity_feedback: data.price_sensitivity_feedback,
        participant_id: data.participant_id
      })
    });
  },

    | 'auto_fit'
    | 'remove_ecg_csv'
    | 'one_ecg_strip'
    | 'switch_gemini_compact'
    | 'split_zip'
    | 'events_summary_only'
  >;
  plan?: PackPlan;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Diagnostics API clients
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const diagnosticsApi = {
  getLogsStatus: () => apiFetch<{
    current_log_path_redacted: string;
    current_log_size_bytes: number;
    last_log_timestamp: string | null;
    level: string;
    retention_days: number;
    max_file_size_mb: number;
  }>('/api/diagnostics/logs/status'),
  getLogLevel: async () => {
    const res = await apiFetch<{ level: string }>('/api/diagnostics/logs/status');
    return { level: res.level };
  },
  setLogLevel: (level: string) => apiFetch<{ success: boolean }>('/api/diagnostics/log-level', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ level })
  }),
  openLogFolder: () => apiFetch<{ success: boolean }>('/api/diagnostics/open-logs', { method: 'POST' }),
  clearLogs: () => apiFetch<{ success: boolean }>('/api/diagnostics/logs/clear', { method: 'POST' }),
  copyLastError: () => apiFetch<{ error: string }>('/api/diagnostics/last-error'),
  logEvent: (level: string, category: string, message: string, details?: any) => 
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean }>('/api/diagnostics/log', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ level, category, message, details })
    })
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trends 2.0 Interfaces
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface TrendPoint {
  session_id: string;
  start_time: string;
  value: number | null;
  quality_score: number | null;
  hrv_quality?: string;
  activity_type?: string;
  delta_vs_baseline?: number | null;
  status:
    | 'within_baseline'
    | 'above_baseline'
    | 'below_baseline'
    | 'quality_limited'
    | 'insufficient_data'
    | 'reference_only'
    | 'not_applicable';
}

export interface TrendMetricSeries {
  metric_key: string;
  label: string;
  unit: string;
  points: TrendPoint[];
}

export interface BaselineBand {
  available: boolean;
  median: number | null;
  p25: number | null;
  p75: number | null;
  min_sessions_required: number;
  sessions_used: number;
  reason?: string;
}

export interface TrendInterpretationCard {
  title: string;
  type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger';
  message: string;
  metric_key?: string;
  reliability: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
}

export interface BaselineQualificationBreakdown {
  total_sessions: number;
  duplicate_sessions_count: number;
  legacy_unverified_count: number;
  source_unavailable_count?: number;
  calibration_short_count: number;
  quality_excluded_count: number;
  ineligible_metrics_count: number;
  accepted_baseline_sessions_count: number;
  target_session_excluded: boolean;
  sessions_needed: number;
  explanation_ru: string;
  explanation_en: string;
}

export interface TrendsResponse {
  period: { start: string; end: string };
  user_id: string | null;
  activity_type: string | null;
  sessions_count: number;
  hidden_sessions_excluded: number;
  quality_summary: {
    average_quality_score: number | null;
    quality_limited_count: number;
    insufficient_count: number;
  };
  baseline: {
    rmssd_ms: BaselineBand;
    sdnn_ms: BaselineBand;
    pnn50_percent: BaselineBand;
    avg_hr_bpm: BaselineBand;
  };
  baseline_source: 'personal_activity_specific' | 'personal_global' | 'reference_fallback' | 'unavailable';
  baseline_confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'none';
  personal_baseline_available: boolean;
  sessions_required: number;
  sessions_used: number;
  quality_limited_excluded_count: number;
  baseline_qualification_breakdown?: BaselineQualificationBreakdown;
  text_summary?: string;
  metrics: TrendMetricSeries[];
  interpretation_cards: TrendInterpretationCard[];
  range_sessions: any[];
  summary_metrics?: {
    total_sessions: number;
    valid_sessions_count: number;
    average_quality: number | null;
    quality_limited_percent: number;
    avg_duration_minutes: number | null;
    avg_hr_drift_percent: number | null;
    avg_cardiac_drift: {
      value_percent: number | null;
      status: 'valid_experimental' | 'invalid_calculation' | 'not_applicable' | 'insufficient_valid_samples' | 'missing_workload_proxy';
      reasons: string[];
    };
    avg_recovery_1min: number | null;
    average_zones_distribution: Record<string, number>;
  };
  recompute_status?: RecomputeStatus;
}

export interface RecomputeStatus {
  is_running: boolean;
  total_candidates: number;
  already_valid: number;
  successfully_recomputed: number;
  source_unavailable: number;
  failed: number;
  pending: number;
  progress_percent: number;
  current_session_id: string | null;
  started_at_utc: string | null;
  completed_at_utc: string | null;
  duration_ms: number;
  error_messages: Record<string, string>;
}

export async function getResearchExportPreview(
  sessionId: string,
  options?: Partial<ResearchExportOptions>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; preview: ResearchExportPreview }> {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (options?.includeNormalizedRr !== undefined) query.set('includeNormalizedRr', String(options.includeNormalizedRr));
  if (options?.includeNormalizedHr !== undefined) query.set('includeNormalizedHr', String(options.includeNormalizedHr));
  if (options?.includeNormalizedEcg !== undefined) query.set('includeNormalizedEcg', String(options.includeNormalizedEcg));
  if (options?.includeNormalizedAcc !== undefined) query.set('includeNormalizedAcc', String(options.includeNormalizedAcc));

  const qs = query.toString();
  return apiFetch<{ success: boolean; preview: ResearchExportPreview }>(
    `/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/research/preview${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`
  );
}

): Promise<{

}> {
  return apiFetch<{
    success: boolean;
    bundle_path: string;
    manifest: ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest;
    validation: ResearchBundleValidationResult;
  }>(`/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/research/export`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(options)
  });
}

export async function listReleaseGateEvidenceApi(params?: { gateId?: string; candidateFreezeId?: string; status?: string }): Promise<{ success: boolean; evidence: any[]; error?: string }> {

  if (params?.gateId) query.set('gateId', params.gateId);
  if (params?.candidateFreezeId) query.set('candidateFreezeId', params.candidateFreezeId);
  if (params?.status) query.set('status', params.status);
  const qStr = query.toString();

export async function getJourneySnapshotApi(
  params?: string | JourneyContextRequestParams
): Promise<{ success: boolean; snapshot: AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot }> {
  const pid = typeof params === 'object' && params !== null
    ? params.profileId || params.profile_id || params.userId
    : params;
  const qStr = pid ? `?profile_id=${encodeURIComponent(pid)}` : '';
  const res = await apiFetch<{ success: boolean; snapshot: AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot }>(
    `/journey/snapshot${qStr}`
  );
  if (res.snapshot) {
    validateAthleteWorkspaceSnapshot(res.snapshot);
  }
  return res;
}

  envelope: AthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope

    success: boolean;
    selection: AthleteJourneySelectionState;
    context: AthleteCoreJourneyContext;
  }>('/journey/command', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(envelope)
  });
  if (res.context) {
    validateAthleteJourneyContext(res.context);
  }
  return res;
}

export function createJourneyCommandEnvelope(
  profileId: string,
  expectedRevision: number | null,
  command: AthleteJourneyCommand
): AthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope {
  const idemp = `cmd-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
  return {
    profile_id: profileId,
    expected_revision: expectedRevision,
    idempotency_key: idemp,
    command
  };
}

import type {
  CheckInAgendaQuery,
  CheckInAgendaResponse,
  CrossPlanReviewPreviewRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewPreviewResponse,
  CreateCrossPlanProgressReviewRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewRevisionPreviewRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewRevisionPreviewResponse,
  CommitCrossPlanReviewRevisionRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewRevisionDiffRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewRevisionDiffResponse,
  CrossPlanReviewRestorePreviewRequest,
  CrossPlanReviewRestorePreviewResponse,
  CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreRequest,
  CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreResponse,
  CrossPlanRevisionDiffSlotItem,
  CrossPlanDiffSlotStatus
} from '../shared/checkinContract';

export async function getCheckInAgendaApi(
  query: CheckInAgendaQuery
): Promise<{ success: boolean } & CheckInAgendaResponse> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (query.profile_id) params.set('profile_id', query.profile_id);
  if (query.from_date) params.set('from_date', query.from_date);
  if (query.to_date) params.set('to_date', query.to_date);
  if (query.status_filter) params.set('status_filter', query.status_filter);
  if (query.plan_id) params.set('plan_id', query.plan_id);
  if (query.include_retired) params.set('include_retired', 'true');
  if (query.limit) params.set('limit', String(query.limit));
  if (query.cursor) params.set('cursor', query.cursor);

  const q = params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : '';
  return apiFetch<{ success: boolean } & CheckInAgendaResponse>(`/checkin/agenda${q}`);
}

  CommitCrossPlanReviewRestoreResponse,
  CrossPlanRevisionDiffSlotItem,
  CrossPlanDiffSlotStatus
