import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sidebar, SidebarRoute } from './components/Sidebar';
import { ImportCenter } from './views/ImportCenter';
import { SessionsList } from './views/SessionsList';
import { SessionDetail } from './views/SessionDetail';
import { CompareView } from './views/CompareView';
import { ExportCenter } from './views/ExportCenter';
import { Trends } from './views/Trends';
import { Settings } from './views/Settings';
import { Reports } from './views/Reports';
import { Users } from './views/Users';
import { LlmDiary } from './views/LlmDiary';
import { RecoveryCenter } from './views/RecoveryCenter';
import {
  api,
  UserProfile,
  ActiveWorkContext,
  createInitialWorkContext,
  createUnresolvedWorkContext,
  transitionWorkContext,
  failClosedOnCrossProfile,
  sanitizeContextForStorage,
  parseContextFromStorage,
  AthleteCoreJourneyContext,
  createUnresolvedJourneyContext,
  createAthleteJourneyContext,
  transitionJourneyContext,
  failClosedOnCrossProfileJourney,
  journeyContextToActiveWorkContext,
  activeWorkContextToJourneyUpdates,
  JourneyComparisonMode,
  AthleteJourneyCommand,
  createJourneyCommandEnvelope
} from './api';
import {
  LocalProductAccessContext,
  createDefaultAthleteAccessContext
} from '../shared/canonical/LocalProductAccessContract';
import {
  getActiveLocalModeBroker,
  subscribeToModeBrokerChanges
} from './services/LocalModeBroker';
import { OnboardingModal } from './components/OnboardingModal';
import { PilotParticipantBanner } from './components/PilotParticipantBanner';
import { PilotParticipantView } from './views/PilotParticipantView';
import { BetaOperationsView } from './views/BetaOperationsView';
import { ResearchWorkspaceView } from './views/ResearchWorkspaceView';
import { CheckInWorkspaceView } from './views/CheckInWorkspaceView';
import { LockedAccessView } from './components/LockedAccessView';

type Route =
  | { view: 'import' }
  | { view: 'sessions' }
  | { view: 'session'; id: string }
  | { view: 'compare'; targetSessionId?: string; peerSessionId?: string }
  | { view: 'trends'; targetSessionId?: string }
  | { view: 'export'; sessionId?: string }
  | { view: 'reports'; sessionId?: string }
  | { view: 'checkin' }
  | { view: 'diary' }
  | { view: 'settings' }
  | { view: 'users' }
  | { view: 'recovery' }
  | { view: 'pilot_operator' }
  | { view: 'pilot_participant' }
  | { view: 'research' };

function App() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<Route>({ view: 'import' });
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const profilesRef = React.useRef<UserProfile[]>([]);
  profilesRef.current = profiles;
  const [activeUserId, setActiveUserId] = useState<string>('');
  const [showOnboarding, setShowOnboarding] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Authoritative Athlete Core Journey Context (Single Source of Truth)
  const [journeyContext, setJourneyContext] = useState<AthleteCoreJourneyContext>(() => {
    return createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
  });

  const journeyGenerationRef = React.useRef<number>(1);

  // ActiveWorkContext is maintained as an explicit one-way projection/adapter of Athlete Core
  const activeWorkContext = React.useMemo(() => {
    return journeyContextToActiveWorkContext(journeyContext);
  }, [journeyContext]);

  // Local product access context (starts strictly in athlete mode; capabilities are server-verified)
  const [accessContext, setAccessContext] = useState<LocalProductAccessContext>(() => {
    return createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(null);
  });

  // Bind to trusted local mode broker (fail-closed, no production window test setters)
  useEffect(() => {
    const broker = getActiveLocalModeBroker();
    broker.getAccessContext(activeUserId || null)
      .then(ctx => {
        if (ctx) setAccessContext(ctx);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    return subscribeToModeBrokerChanges((newCtx) => {
      setAccessContext(newCtx);
    });
  }, [activeUserId]);

  // Update access context when activeUserId changes; verify participant enrollment from server
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeUserId) {
      setAccessContext(createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(null));
      return;
    }
    let isMounted = true;
    api.getPilotActorContext(undefined, activeUserId)
      .then(res => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (res.success && res.actor_context?.is_enrolled) {
          const def = createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(activeUserId);
          setAccessContext({
            ...def,
            mode: 'participant',
            bound_profile_id: activeUserId,
            participant_status: 'valid',
            allowed_navigation: [
              ...def.allowed_navigation,
              'nav:participant_hub'
            ]
          });
        } else {
          setAccessContext(createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(activeUserId));
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setAccessContext(createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(activeUserId));
      });
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [activeUserId]);

  const requestGenerationRef = React.useRef<number>(activeWorkContext.context_generation);

  // Persist ActiveWorkContext safely as non-authoritative storage hint
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const sanitized = sanitizeContextForStorage(activeWorkContext);
      localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_active_work_context', sanitized);
    } catch {}
  }, [activeWorkContext]);

  // Fail-closed on cross-profile change: clean reset without leaking context
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeUserId) {
      const unresolved = createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
      journeyGenerationRef.current = unresolved.context_generation;
      setJourneyContext(unresolved);
      return;
    }
    try {
      failClosedOnCrossProfileJourney(journeyContext, activeUserId);
    } catch {
      const unresolved = createUnresolvedJourneyContext();
      journeyGenerationRef.current = unresolved.context_generation;
      setJourneyContext(unresolved);
    }
  }, [activeUserId]);

  // Authoritative server workspace snapshot synchronization on startup and profile switch
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const effectiveProfileId = activeUserId || 'unresolved';
    api.getJourneySnapshot(effectiveProfileId).then(res => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      if (res.success && res.snapshot) {
        selectionRevisionRef.current = res.snapshot.selection_revision;
        journeyGenerationRef.current = res.snapshot.selection_generation;
        setJourneyContext(res.snapshot.context);
      }
    }).catch(err => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      console.warn('[JourneySnapshot] Server snapshot load error:', err);
    });
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [activeUserId]);

  const selectionRevisionRef = React.useRef<number | null>(null);
  const activeUserIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(activeUserId);
  activeUserIdRef.current = activeUserId;

  const dispatchJourneyCommand = React.useCallback(async (command: AthleteJourneyCommand): Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null> => {
    const profileId = (command.command_type === 'select_profile' ? command.profile_id : activeUserIdRef.current) || 'unresolved';
    const envelope = createJourneyCommandEnvelope(
      profileId,
      selectionRevisionRef.current,
      command
    );
    try {
      const res = await api.executeJourneyCommand(envelope);
      if (res.success && res.context) {
        selectionRevisionRef.current = res.selection.selection_revision;
        journeyGenerationRef.current = res.context.context_generation;
        setJourneyContext(res.context);
        return res.context;
      }
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[JourneyCommand] Dispatch failed:', err);
      throw err;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    api.getOnboardingState().then(res => {
      if (!active) return;
      if (res && res.onboarding_completed) {
        setShowOnboarding(false);
        try { localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true'); } catch (_) {}
      } else {
        const localShown = (() => {
          try { return localStorage.getItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown') === 'true'; } catch (_) { return false; }
        })();
        if (!localShown) {
          api.getSessions().then(sessions => {
            if (!active) return;
            if (sessions && sessions.length > 0) {
              setShowOnboarding(false);
              try { localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true'); } catch (_) {}
              api.dismissOnboarding().catch(() => {});
            } else {
              setShowOnboarding(true);
            }
          }).catch(() => {
            if (!localShown && active) setShowOnboarding(true);
          });
        }
      }
    }).catch(() => {
      try {
        if (!localStorage.getItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown')) {
          api.getSessions().then(sessions => {
            if (!active) return;
            if (sessions && sessions.length > 0) {
              setShowOnboarding(false);
              try { localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true'); } catch (_) {}
            } else {
              setShowOnboarding(true);
            }
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, []);

  function loadProfiles() {
    api.getUserProfiles()
      .then(setProfiles)
      .catch(() => {});
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfiles();
  }, [route.view]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleHash() {
      const hash = window.location.hash || '';
      if (hash.startsWith('#/session/') || hash.startsWith('#/sessions/')) {
        const id = hash.replace(/^#\/sessions?\//, '').split('?')[0];
        if (id) {
          const curGen = ++requestGenerationRef.current;
          api.getSession(id)
            .then(async sess => {
              if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
              if (sess && sess.session) {
                const owner = sess.session.user_id;
                if (activeUserId && owner && owner !== activeUserId) {
                  console.warn(`[DeepLink] Refusing cross-profile session binding: session ${id} belongs to ${owner}, active user is ${activeUserId}`);
                  setRoute({ view: 'sessions' });
                  return;
                }
                try {
                  await dispatchJourneyCommand({ command_type: 'open_session', session_id: id });
                  if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                    setRoute({ view: 'session', id });
                  }
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn(`[DeepLink] open_session command failed for ${id}:`, err);
                  if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                    setRoute({ view: 'sessions' });
                  }
                }
              } else {
                setRoute({ view: 'sessions' });
              }
            })
            .catch(() => {
              if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
              setRoute({ view: 'sessions' });
            });
          return;
        }
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/trends')) {
        const queryIdx = hash.indexOf('?');
        if (queryIdx >= 0) {
          const params = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(queryIdx + 1));
          const targetSessionId = params.get('targetSessionId') || undefined;
          const userId = params.get('userId') || undefined;
          const curGen = ++requestGenerationRef.current;
          (async () => {
            if (userId && profilesRef.current.some(p => p.id === userId) && userId !== activeUserIdRef.current) {
              try {
                await dispatchJourneyCommand({ command_type: 'select_profile', profile_id: userId });
                setActiveUserId(userId);
                activeUserIdRef.current = userId;
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[DeepLink] Failed to switch profile for trends deep link:', err);
              }
            }
            if (targetSessionId) {
              const sess = await api.getSession(targetSessionId).catch(() => null);
              if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
              const effectiveUser = activeUserIdRef.current;
              if (sess?.session && effectiveUser && sess.session.user_id && sess.session.user_id !== effectiveUser) {
                console.warn(`[DeepLink] Refusing cross-profile trends target: session belongs to ${sess.session.user_id}`);
                setRoute({ view: 'trends' });
                return;
              }
              try {
                await dispatchJourneyCommand({
                  command_type: 'set_comparison',
                  mode: 'personal_baseline',
                  target_session_id: targetSessionId || null
                });
                if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                  setRoute({ view: 'trends', targetSessionId });
                }
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn(`[DeepLink] set_comparison command failed for trends:`, err);
                if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                  setRoute({ view: 'trends' });
                }
              }
              return;
            }
            if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
              setRoute({ view: 'trends' });
            }
          })();
          return;
        }
        setRoute({ view: 'trends' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/compare')) {
        const queryIdx = hash.indexOf('?');
        if (queryIdx >= 0) {
          const params = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(queryIdx + 1));
          const targetSessionId = params.get('targetSessionId') || undefined;
          const peerSessionId = params.get('peerSessionId') || undefined;
          const userId = params.get('userId') || undefined;
          const curGen = ++requestGenerationRef.current;
          (async () => {
            if (userId && profilesRef.current.some(p => p.id === userId) && userId !== activeUserIdRef.current) {
              try {
                await dispatchJourneyCommand({ command_type: 'select_profile', profile_id: userId });
                setActiveUserId(userId);
                activeUserIdRef.current = userId;
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[DeepLink] Failed to switch profile for compare deep link:', err);
              }
            }
            if (targetSessionId || peerSessionId) {
              const effectiveUser = activeUserIdRef.current;
              const [targetSess, peerSess] = await Promise.all([
                targetSessionId ? api.getSession(targetSessionId).catch(() => null) : null,
                peerSessionId ? api.getSession(peerSessionId).catch(() => null) : null
              ]);
              if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
              if (targetSess?.session && effectiveUser && targetSess.session.user_id && targetSess.session.user_id !== effectiveUser) {
                console.warn(`[DeepLink] Refusing cross-profile compare target: session belongs to ${targetSess.session.user_id}`);
                setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
                return;
              }
              if (peerSess?.session && effectiveUser && peerSess.session.user_id && peerSess.session.user_id !== effectiveUser) {
                console.warn(`[DeepLink] Refusing cross-profile compare peer: session belongs to ${peerSess.session.user_id}`);
                setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
                return;
              }
              try {
                await dispatchJourneyCommand({
                  command_type: 'set_comparison',
                  mode: peerSessionId ? 'explicit_ab' : (targetSessionId ? 'personal_baseline' : 'none'),
                  target_session_id: targetSessionId || null,
                  peer_session_id: peerSessionId || null
                });
                if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                  setRoute({ view: 'compare', targetSessionId, peerSessionId });
                }
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn(`[DeepLink] set_comparison command failed for compare:`, err);
                if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                  setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
                }
              }
              return;
            }
            if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
              setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
            }
          })();
          return;
        }
        setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/reports') || hash.startsWith('#/export')) {
        const queryIdx = hash.indexOf('?');
        if (queryIdx >= 0) {
          const params = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(queryIdx + 1));
          const sessionId = params.get('sessionId') || undefined;
          if (sessionId) {
            const curGen = ++requestGenerationRef.current;
            api.getSession(sessionId)
              .then(async sess => {
                if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
                const effectiveUser = activeUserIdRef.current;
                if (sess?.session && effectiveUser && sess.session.user_id && sess.session.user_id !== effectiveUser) {
                  console.warn(`[DeepLink] Refusing cross-profile export session: belongs to ${sess.session.user_id}`);
                  setRoute({ view: 'export' });
                  return;
                }
                try {
                  await dispatchJourneyCommand({ command_type: 'open_session', session_id: sessionId });
                  if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                    setRoute({ view: 'export', sessionId });
                  }
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn(`[DeepLink] open_session command failed for export ${sessionId}:`, err);
                  if (curGen === requestGenerationRef.current) {
                    setRoute({ view: 'export' });
                  }
                }
              })
              .catch(() => {
                if (curGen !== requestGenerationRef.current) return;
                setRoute({ view: 'export' });
              });
            return;
          }
          setRoute({ view: 'export' });
          return;
        }
        setRoute({ view: 'export' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/pilot/operator')) {
        setRoute({ view: 'pilot_operator' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/pilot/participant')) {
        setRoute({ view: 'pilot_participant' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/research')) {
        setRoute({ view: 'research' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/checkin')) {
        setRoute({ view: 'checkin' });
        return;
      }
      if (hash.startsWith('#/recovery') || hash.startsWith('#recovery')) {
        setRoute({ view: 'recovery' });
        return;
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHash);
    handleHash();
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', handleHash);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleError = (event: ErrorEvent) => {
      try {
        (window as any).electronAPI?.logEvent?.({
          level: 'error',
          category: 'ui',
          message: `Renderer unhandled error: ${event.message}`,
          params: {
            details: {
              filename: event.filename,
              lineno: event.lineno,
              colno: event.colno,
              stack: event.error?.stack
            }
          }
        });
      } catch {}
    };

    const handleRejection = (event: PromiseRejectionEvent) => {
      try {
        (window as any).electronAPI?.logEvent?.({
          level: 'error',
          category: 'ui',
          message: `Renderer unhandled rejection: ${String(event.reason)}`,
          params: {
            details: {
              reason: String(event.reason),
              stack: event.reason?.stack
            }
          }
        });
      } catch {}
    };

    window.addEventListener('error', handleError);
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', handleRejection);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('error', handleError);
      window.removeEventListener('unhandledrejection', handleRejection);
    };
  }, []);

  async function navigate(to: Route) {
    try {
      (window as any).electronAPI?.logEvent?.({
        level: 'info',
        category: 'ui',
        message: `Navigation: ${to.view}`,
        params: { details: { route: to } }
      });
    } catch {}

    if (to.view === 'session' && to.id) {
      try {
        await dispatchJourneyCommand({ command_type: 'open_session', session_id: to.id });
        try { window.location.hash = `#/session/${to.id}`; } catch {}
        setRoute(to);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[Navigation] open_session command failed for ${to.id}:`, err);
        setRoute({ view: 'sessions' });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (to.view === 'trends') {
      if (to.targetSessionId) {
        try {
          await dispatchJourneyCommand({
            command_type: 'set_comparison',
            mode: 'personal_baseline',
            target_session_id: to.targetSessionId
          });
          try { window.location.hash = `#/trends?targetSessionId=${to.targetSessionId}`; } catch {}
          setRoute(to);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`[Navigation] set_comparison trends failed:`, err);
          setRoute({ view: 'trends' });
        }
      } else {
        try { window.location.hash = '#/trends'; } catch {}
        setRoute(to);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (to.view === 'compare') {
      if (to.targetSessionId || to.peerSessionId) {
        try {
          await dispatchJourneyCommand({
            command_type: 'set_comparison',
            mode: to.peerSessionId ? 'explicit_ab' : (to.targetSessionId ? 'personal_baseline' : 'none'),
            target_session_id: to.targetSessionId || null,
            peer_session_id: to.peerSessionId || null
          });
          let h = '#/compare';
          const params = new URLSearchParams();
          if (to.targetSessionId) params.set('targetSessionId', to.targetSessionId);
          if (to.peerSessionId) params.set('peerSessionId', to.peerSessionId);
          const q = params.toString();
          try { window.location.hash = q ? `${h}?${q}` : h; } catch {}
          setRoute(to);
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`[Navigation] set_comparison compare failed:`, err);
          setRoute({ view: 'compare' });
        }
      } else {
        try { window.location.hash = '#/compare'; } catch {}
        setRoute(to);
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (to.view === 'export') {
        window.location.hash = to.sessionId ? `#/export?sessionId=${to.sessionId}` : '#/export';
      } else if (to.view === 'sessions') {
        window.location.hash = '#/sessions';
      } else if (to.view === 'import') {
        window.location.hash = '#/import';
      } else if (to.view === 'settings') {
        window.location.hash = '#/settings';
      } else if (to.view === 'checkin') {
        window.location.hash = '#/checkin';
      } else if (to.view === 'pilot_operator') {
        window.location.hash = '#/pilot/operator';
      } else if (to.view === 'pilot_participant') {
        window.location.hash = '#/pilot/participant';
      } else if (to.view === 'research') {
        window.location.hash = '#/research';
      } else if (to.view === 'recovery') {
        window.location.hash = '#/recovery';
      }
    } catch {}
    setRoute(to);
  }

  function navTabFromRoute(r: Route): SidebarRoute {
    if (r.view === 'session') return 'sessions';
    if (r.view === 'trends') return 'trends';
    if (r.view === 'reports') return 'export';
    if (r.view === 'research') return 'research';
    return r.view as SidebarRoute;
  }

  function handleSidebarNav(tab: SidebarRoute) {
    if (tab === 'reports' || tab === 'export') {
      navigate({ view: 'export' });
    } else if (tab === 'trends') {
      navigate({ view: 'trends' });
    } else if (tab === 'compare') {
      navigate({ view: 'compare' });
    } else {
      navigate({ view: tab });
    }
  }

  function handleActiveUserChange(newUserId: string) {
    setActiveUserId(newUserId);
    if (newUserId) {
      dispatchJourneyCommand({
        command_type: 'select_profile',
        profile_id: newUserId,
        is_aggregate_read_only: newUserId === 'all'
      });
    }
  }

  function renderView() {
    switch (route.view) {
      case 'import':
        return (
          <ImportCenter
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
            activeWorkContext={activeWorkContext}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'sessions':
        return (
          <SessionsList
            onSelectSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            profiles={profiles}
            onNavigateToCompare={(sid, peerSid) => navigate({ view: 'compare', targetSessionId: sid, peerSessionId: peerSid })}
          />
        );
      case 'session':
        return (
          <SessionDetail
            sessionId={route.id}
            onBack={() => navigate({ view: 'sessions' })}
            onNavigateToReports={(sid) => navigate({ view: 'export', sessionId: sid })}
            onNavigateToCompare={(sid) => navigate({ view: 'compare', targetSessionId: sid })}
            activeWorkContext={activeWorkContext}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'compare':
        return (
          <CompareView
            initialTargetSessionId={route.targetSessionId}
            initialPeerSessionId={route.peerSessionId}
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
            onNavigateToExport={(sid) => navigate({ view: 'export', sessionId: sid })}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'trends':
        return (
          <Trends 
            activeUserId={activeUserId} 
            targetSessionId={route.targetSessionId}
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })} 
            activeWorkContext={activeWorkContext}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'export':
        return (
          <ExportCenter
            initialSessionId={route.sessionId}
            onBack={() => navigate({ view: 'sessions' })}
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'reports':
        return (
          <Reports
            initialSessionId={route.sessionId}
            onBack={() => navigate({ view: 'sessions' })}
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'checkin':
        return (
          <CheckInWorkspaceView
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            profiles={profiles}
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
            onNavigateToTrends={(targetSessionId) => navigate({ view: 'trends', targetSessionId })}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'settings':
        return <Settings accessContext={accessContext} />;
      case 'users':
        return <Users />;
      case 'diary':
        return (
          <LlmDiary
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            profiles={profiles}
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
            journeyContext={journeyContext}
            onDispatchCommand={dispatchJourneyCommand}
          />
        );
      case 'pilot_operator':
        if (!accessContext.allowed_navigation.includes('nav:pilot_operator') && accessContext.mode !== 'pilot_operator') {
          return (
            <LockedAccessView
              targetMode="pilot_operator"
              onReturn={() => navigate({ view: 'import' })}
            />
          );
        }
        return <BetaOperationsView />;
      case 'pilot_participant':
        if (!accessContext.allowed_navigation.includes('nav:participant_hub') && accessContext.mode !== 'participant') {
          return (
            <LockedAccessView
              targetMode="pilot_participant"
              onReturn={() => navigate({ view: 'import' })}
            />
          );
        }
        return (
          <PilotParticipantView
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
            onNavigateToSession={(id) => navigate({ view: 'session', id })}
          />
        );
      case 'research':
        if (!accessContext.allowed_navigation.includes('nav:research_lab') && accessContext.mode !== 'research') {
          return (
            <LockedAccessView
              targetMode="research"
              onReturn={() => navigate({ view: 'import' })}
            />
          );
        }
        return <ResearchWorkspaceView />;
      case 'recovery':
        return (
          <RecoveryCenter
            activeProfileId={activeUserId}
            onNavigate={(dest) => {
              if (dest === 'import') navigate({ view: 'import' });
              else if (dest === 'settings') navigate({ view: 'settings' });
              else if (dest === 'sessions') navigate({ view: 'sessions' });
              else window.location.hash = dest;
            }}
          />
        );
      default:
        return <ImportCenter />;
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-layout">
      <Sidebar
        current={navTabFromRoute(route)}
        onNavigate={handleSidebarNav}
        profiles={profiles}
        activeUserId={activeUserId}
        onActiveUserChange={handleActiveUserChange}
        accessContext={accessContext}
      />
      <main className="main-content fade-in" key={JSON.stringify(route)}>
        {renderView()}
      </main>
      <OnboardingModal
        isOpen={showOnboarding}
        onClose={() => {
          setShowOnboarding(false);
          try { localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true'); } catch (_) {}
          api.dismissOnboarding().catch(() => {});
        }}
        onLoadSampleProject={async () => {
          setShowOnboarding(false);
          try { localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true'); } catch (_) {}
          try {
            await api.dismissOnboarding().catch(() => {});
            const res = await api.loadSampleProject();
            if (res.success && res.sessionId) {
              navigate({ view: 'session', id: res.sessionId });
            } else {
              navigate({ view: 'import' });
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Failed to load sample project');
            navigate({ view: 'import' });
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { OverlayRoot } from './OverlayRoot';
import { useFloatingPosition } from './useFloatingPosition';

export interface AppComboboxOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

interface AppComboboxProps {
  id?: string;
  options: AppComboboxOption[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export function AppCombobox({
  id,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  ariaLabel,
  placeholder = 'Type to search...'
}: AppComboboxProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [filterText, setFilterText] = useState('');
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listboxId = id ? `${id}-listbox` : 'app-combobox-listbox';

  const selectedOption = options.find(o => o.value === value);
  const floatingPos = useFloatingPosition(containerRef, isOpen);

  // Synchronize filterText with selectedOption when list is closed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      setFilterText(selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : '');
    }
  }, [isOpen, selectedOption]);

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      const target = event.target as Node;
      if (containerRef.current && containerRef.current.contains(target)) {
        return;
      }
      const overlayRoot = document.getElementById('overlay-root');
      if (overlayRoot && overlayRoot.contains(target)) {
        return;
      }
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const filteredOptions = options.filter(o =>
    o.label.toLowerCase().includes(filterText.toLowerCase())
  );

  // Update active index when list opens or filterText changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setActiveIndex(filteredOptions.length > 0 ? 0 : -1);
    } else {
      setActiveIndex(-1);
    }
  }, [isOpen, filterText, filteredOptions.length]);

  // Handle keyboard events
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return;

    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        if (activeIndex >= 0 && activeIndex < filteredOptions.length) {
          onChange(filteredOptions[activeIndex].value);
        }
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setIsOpen(false);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        setActiveIndex(prev => (prev < filteredOptions.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev));
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        setActiveIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : prev));
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (val: string) => {
    onChange(val);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setFilterText(e.target.value);
    if (!isOpen) setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef} 
      className="app-combobox-container"
      style={{
        position: 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        fontFamily: 'inherit',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #475569',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          paddingRight: '12px',
          boxShadow: isOpen ? '0 0 0 2px #38bdf8' : 'none',
        }}
      >
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          id={id}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-expanded={isOpen}
          aria-controls={isOpen ? listboxId : undefined}
          aria-label={ariaLabel}
          disabled={disabled}
          value={filterText}
          onChange={handleInputChange}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          onFocus={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(true)}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
            color: disabled ? '#64748b' : '#f8fafc',
            border: 'none',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            outline: 'none',
            cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'text',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
          }}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          tabIndex={-1}
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          style={{
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            color: '#94a3b8',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            padding: 0,
            fontSize: '0.6rem',
          }}
        >
          {isOpen ? '▲' : '▼'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {isOpen && filteredOptions.length > 0 && (
        <OverlayRoot>
          <ul
            id={listboxId}
            role="listbox"
            tabIndex={-1}
            aria-activedescendant={activeIndex >= 0 ? `${id}-opt-${activeIndex}` : undefined}
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: `${floatingPos.top}px`,
              left: `${floatingPos.left}px`,
              width: `${floatingPos.width}px`,
              zIndex: 99999,
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              padding: '4px 0',
              margin: 0,
              listStyle: 'none',
              maxHeight: '200px',
              overflowY: 'auto',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              backdropFilter: 'none',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none',
              transform: floatingPos.openUp ? 'translateY(-100%)' : 'none',
              isolation: 'isolate',
            }}
          >
            {filteredOptions.map((opt, index) => {
              const isActive = index === activeIndex;
              const isSelected = opt.value === value;
              return (
                <li
                  key={opt.value}
                  id={`${id}-opt-${index}`}
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={isSelected}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectOption(opt.value)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 12px',
                    fontSize: '0.875rem',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#38bdf8' : isSelected ? '#1e293b' : 'transparent',
                    color: isActive ? '#0f172a' : '#f8fafc',
                    outline: 'none',
                  }}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </OverlayRoot>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface AppDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  showInput?: boolean;
  inputPlaceholder?: string;
  requiredConfirmText?: string; // e.g. "DELETE LOCAL DERIVED DATA"
  isDestructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: (inputValue?: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function AppDialog({
  isOpen,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel = 'OK',
  cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
  showInput = false,
  inputPlaceholder = '',
  requiredConfirmText,
  isDestructive = false,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel
}: AppDialogProps) {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Focus trap and Escape key listener
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onCancel();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isConfirmDisabled = requiredConfirmText 
    ? inputValue !== requiredConfirmText
    : false;

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (isConfirmDisabled) return;
    onConfirm(showInput ? inputValue : undefined);
    setInputValue('');
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    onCancel();
    setInputValue('');
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="app-dialog-title"
      aria-describedby="app-dialog-desc"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 9999,
      }}
      onClick={handleCancel}
    >
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        style={{
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #475569',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          padding: '24px',
          maxWidth: '480px',
          width: '90%',
          boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          color: '#f8fafc',
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <h3 
          id="app-dialog-title" 
          style={{ 
            margin: '0 0 12px 0', 
            fontSize: '1.25rem', 
            color: isDestructive ? '#ef4444' : '#ffb74d' 
          }}
        >
          {title}
        </h3>
        <p id="app-dialog-desc" style={{ margin: '0 0 20px 0', color: '#cbd5e1', fontSize: '0.9rem', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
          {description}
        </p>

        {showInput && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
            {requiredConfirmText && (
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', margin: '0 0 6px 0' }}>
                Введите <strong>{requiredConfirmText}</strong> для подтверждения:
              </p>
            )}
            <input
              type="text"
              value={inputValue}
              onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={inputPlaceholder}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '8px 12px',
                backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                border: '1px solid #475569',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: '0.875rem',
                outline: 'none',
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '12px' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCancel}
            style={{
              padding: '8px 16px',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              color: '#94a3b8',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontWeight: 'bold',
            }}
          >
            {cancelLabel}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={isConfirmDisabled}
            style={{
              padding: '8px 16px',
              backgroundColor: isDestructive ? '#ef4444' : '#38bdf8',
              color: isDestructive ? '#ffffff' : '#0f172a',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              cursor: isConfirmDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              fontWeight: 'bold',
              opacity: isConfirmDisabled ? 0.5 : 1,
            }}
          >
            {confirmLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { OverlayRoot } from './OverlayRoot';
import { useFloatingPosition } from './useFloatingPosition';

export interface AppSelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

interface AppSelectProps {
  id?: string;
  options: AppSelectOption[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export function AppSelect({
  id,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  ariaLabel,
  placeholder = 'Select...'
}: AppSelectProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const listboxId = id ? `${id}-listbox` : 'app-select-listbox';

  const selectedOption = options.find(o => o.value === value);
  const floatingPos = useFloatingPosition(containerRef, isOpen);

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      const target = event.target as Node;
      if (containerRef.current && containerRef.current.contains(target)) {
        return;
      }
      const overlayRoot = document.getElementById('overlay-root');
      if (overlayRoot && overlayRoot.contains(target)) {
        return;
      }
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  // Update active index when list opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const idx = options.findIndex(o => o.value === value);
      setActiveIndex(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0);
    } else {
      setActiveIndex(-1);
    }
  }, [isOpen, value, options]);

  // Handle keyboard events
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return;

    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        if (activeIndex >= 0 && activeIndex < options.length) {
          onChange(options[activeIndex].value);
        }
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setIsOpen(false);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        setActiveIndex(prev => (prev < options.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev));
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      } else {
        setActiveIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : prev));
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isOpen) setActiveIndex(0);
    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isOpen) setActiveIndex(options.length - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (val: string) => {
    onChange(val);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef} 
      className="app-select-container"
      style={{
        position: 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        fontFamily: 'inherit',
      }}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        id={id}
        data-value={value}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-controls={isOpen ? listboxId : undefined}
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        disabled={disabled}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          padding: '8px 12px',
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          color: disabled ? '#64748b' : '#f8fafc',
          border: '1px solid #475569',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          textAlign: 'left',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          fontSize: '0.875rem',
          outline: 'none',
          boxShadow: isOpen ? '0 0 0 2px #38bdf8' : 'none',
        }}
      >
        <span>{selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : placeholder}</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.6rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isOpen ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <OverlayRoot>
          <ul
            id={listboxId}
            role="listbox"
            tabIndex={-1}
            aria-activedescendant={activeIndex >= 0 ? `${id}-opt-${activeIndex}` : undefined}
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: `${floatingPos.top}px`,
              left: `${floatingPos.left}px`,
              width: `${floatingPos.width}px`,
              zIndex: 99999,
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              padding: '4px 0',
              margin: 0,
              listStyle: 'none',
              maxHeight: '200px',
              overflowY: 'auto',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              backdropFilter: 'none',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none',
              transform: floatingPos.openUp ? 'translateY(-100%)' : 'none',
              isolation: 'isolate',
            }}
          >
            {options.map((opt, index) => {
              const isActive = index === activeIndex;
              const isSelected = opt.value === value;
              return (
                <li
                  key={opt.value}
                  id={`${id}-opt-${index}`}
                  data-value={opt.value}
                  className="app-select-option"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={isSelected}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectOption(opt.value)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 12px',
                    fontSize: '0.875rem',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#38bdf8' : isSelected ? '#1e293b' : 'transparent',
                    color: isActive ? '#0f172a' : '#f8fafc',
                    outline: 'none',
                  }}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </OverlayRoot>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';

interface BetaFeedbackModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function BetaFeedbackModal({ isOpen, onClose }: BetaFeedbackModalProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [rating, setRating] = useState<number>(5);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<'bug' | 'feature' | 'ux' | 'general'>('general');
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.submitBetaFeedback({
        rating,
        category,
        message: comments,
      });
      setSubmitted(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSubmitted(false);
        setComments('');
        onClose();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Failed to submit feedback');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="beta-feedback-title"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 1000,
        padding: '20px',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #334155',
          borderRadius: '12px',
          padding: '28px',
          maxWidth: '520px',
          width: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: '16px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <h3 id="beta-feedback-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem', color: '#f8fafc' }}>
            {t('betaFeedbackTitle')}
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              background: 'none',
              border: 'none',
              color: '#94a3b8',
              fontSize: '1.4rem',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
          {t('betaFeedbackDesc')}
        </div>

        {submitted ? (
          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#064e3b22',
              border: '1px solid #05966955',
              padding: '16px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              fontSize: '0.9rem',
              color: '#34d399',
              textAlign: 'center',
            }}
          >
            {t('betaFeedbackSubmitted')}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '14px' }}>
            {error && (
              <div
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: '#450a0a',
                  border: '1px solid #991b1b',
                  color: '#f87171',
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  fontSize: '0.85rem',
                }}
              >
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                {t('betaFeedbackRating')}
              </label>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((val) => (
                  <button
                    key={val}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setRating(val)}
                    style={{
                      flex: 1,
                      padding: '8px 0',
                      borderRadius: '6px',
                      border: rating === val ? '1px solid #3b82f6' : '1px solid #334155',
                      backgroundColor: rating === val ? '#1d4ed833' : '#0f172a',
                      color: rating === val ? '#60a5fa' : '#94a3b8',
                      fontWeight: rating === val ? 700 : 500,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    {val} ★
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Категория' : 'Category'}
              </label>
              <select
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as any)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                  color: '#e2e8f0',
                  border: '1px solid #334155',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  fontSize: '0.85rem',
                }}
              >
                <option value="general">{language === 'ru' ? 'Общее впечатление' : 'General Experience'}</option>
                <option value="bug">{language === 'ru' ? 'Ошибка / Баг' : 'Bug Report'}</option>
                <option value="feature">{language === 'ru' ? 'Предложение функции' : 'Feature Request'}</option>
                <option value="ux">{language === 'ru' ? 'Удобство интерфейса' : 'Usability / UI'}</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                {t('betaFeedbackComments')}

              <textarea

FILE: src/frontend/components/DataSourcesPanel.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { AppSelect } from './AppSelect';
import { AppDialog } from './AppDialog';

interface DataSourcesPanelProps {
  onSourceChanged?: () => void;
}

export function DataSourcesPanel({ onSourceChanged }: DataSourcesPanelProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [sources, setSources] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loadingSources, setLoadingSources] = useState(false);
  const [editingSourceId, setEditingSourceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sourceLabel, setSourceLabel] = useState('');
  const [sourceType, setSourceType] = useState<'local' | 'ftp'>('local');
  const [sourcePath, setSourcePath] = useState('');
  const [sourceUrl, setSourceUrl] = useState('');
  const [testingId, setTestingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dialog state
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [dialogTitle, setDialogTitle] = useState('');
  const [dialogDesc, setDialogDesc] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSources();
  }, []);

  const loadSources = async () => {
    setLoadingSources(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.getDataSources();
      setSources(res);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to load data sources', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingSources(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateOrUpdateSource = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = {
        label: sourceLabel,
        type: sourceType,
        path: sourceType === 'local' ? sourcePath : undefined,
        url: sourceType === 'ftp' ? sourceUrl : undefined,
      };
      if (editingSourceId) {
        await api.updateDataSource(editingSourceId, data);
      } else {
        await api.createDataSource(data);
      }
      resetSourceForm();
      await loadSources();
      if (onSourceChanged) {
        onSourceChanged();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleEditSource = (src: any) => {
    setEditingSourceId(src.id);
    setSourceLabel(src.label);
    setSourceType(src.type);
    setSourcePath(src.path || '');
    setSourceUrl(src.url || '');
  };

  const resetSourceForm = () => {
    setEditingSourceId(null);
    setSourceLabel('');
    setSourceType('local');
    setSourcePath('');
    setSourceUrl('');
  };

  const handleDeleteSource = async (id: string) => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.deleteDataSource(id);
      await loadSources();
      if (onSourceChanged) {
        onSourceChanged();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async (id: string) => {
    setTestingId(id);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.testDataSource(id);
      if (res.success) {
        setDialogTitle('Успешно');
        setDialogDesc('Соединение успешно проверено!');
        setDialogOpen(true);
      } else {
        setDialogTitle('Ошибка соединения');
        setDialogDesc(`Не удалось подключиться: ${res.error}`);
        setDialogOpen(true);
      }
      await loadSources();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setTestingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSetActiveSource = async (id: string) => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.setActiveDataSource(id);
      await loadSources();
      if (onSourceChanged) {
        onSourceChanged();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="card" id="data-sources-panel">
      <div className="section-title">Источники данных</div>
      <p style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
        Настройте папки импорта или FTP серверы для синхронизации записей Polar H10.
      </p>

      {error && (
        <div className="badge badge-danger" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}>{error}</div>
      )}

      {loadingSources ? (
        <span className="spinner" style={{ width: '16px', height: '16px' }} />
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
          {sources.map((src) => (
            <div key={src.id} className="data-source-item" style={{
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: src.is_active ? '1px solid var(--accent-active)' : '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              padding: '12px',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span className="source-label" style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: '0.88rem' }}>{src.label}</span>
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: '0.7rem',
                  padding: '2px 6px',
                  borderRadius: '4px',
                  backgroundColor: src.is_active ? '#10b98122' : '#64748b22',
                  color: src.is_active ? '#34d399' : '#94a3b8',
                  fontWeight: 'bold'
                }}>
                  {src.is_active ? 'Активный' : 'Неактивный'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="source-path" style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                {src.type === 'local' ? `Локальный путь: ${src.path}` : `FTP URL: ${src.url}`}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                Статус: <span className="source-status" style={{ color: src.last_status === 'ok' ? '#34d399' : src.last_status?.startsWith('error:') ? '#f87171' : '#94a3b8' }}>
                  {src.last_status === 'ok' ? 'Подключен' : src.last_status?.startsWith('error:') ? 'Ошибка подключения' : 'Не проверен'}
                </span>
                {src.last_checked_at && ` · ${new Date(src.last_checked_at).toLocaleTimeString()}`}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                {!src.is_active && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn btn-set-active"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: '#38bdf822', color: '#38bdf8', border: '1px solid #38bdf844' }}
                    onClick={() => handleSetActiveSource(src.id)}
                  >
                    Сделать активным
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn btn-test-connection"
                  style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: '#e2e8f022', color: '#e2e8f0', border: '1px solid #e2e8f044' }}
                  disabled={testingId === src.id}
                  onClick={() => handleTestConnection(src.id)}
                >
                  {testingId === src.id ? 'Проверка...' : 'Проверить'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn btn-edit-source"
                  style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: '#ffb74d22', color: '#ffb74d', border: '1px solid #ffb74d44' }}
                  onClick={() => handleEditSource(src)}
                >
                  Редактировать
                </button>
                {!src.is_active && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn btn-delete-source"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: '#ef444422', color: '#f87171', border: '1px solid #ef444444' }}
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteSource(src.id)}
                  >
                    Удалить
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Source Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleCreateOrUpdateSource} style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingTop: '16px' }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: '0.85rem', marginBottom: '12px', color: '#ffb74d' }}>
          {editingSourceId ? 'Редактировать источник' : 'Добавить новый источник'}
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label className="form-label" htmlFor="source-label-input">Название источника</label>
          <input
            id="source-label-input"
            className="form-input"
            type="text"
            placeholder="Например: Polar Logs на Диске Z"
            value={sourceLabel}
            onChange={(e) => setSourceLabel(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}>
          <label className="form-label" htmlFor="source-type-select">Тип источника</label>
          <AppSelect
            id="source-type-select"
            options={[
              { value: 'local', label: t('sourceTypeLocal') },
              { value: 'ftp', label: t('sourceTypeFtp') }
            ]}
            value={sourceType}
            onChange={(val) => setSourceType(val as any)}
          />
        </div>

        {sourceType === 'local' ? (
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label" htmlFor="source-path-input">Локальный путь к папке</label>
            <input
              id="source-path-input"
              className="form-input"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Пример: Z:\Polar Logs"
              value={sourcePath}
              onChange={(e) => setSourcePath(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label" htmlFor="source-url-input">FTP URL (включая учетные данные)</label>
            <input
              id="source-url-input"
              className="form-input"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Пример: ftp://athlete:password@192.168.1.100:21/logs"
              value={sourceUrl}
              onChange={(e) => setSourceUrl(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', marginTop: '16px' }}>
          <button className="btn btn-primary" type="submit" style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', padding: '6px 12px' }}>
            {editingSourceId ? 'Сохранить изменения' : 'Добавить источник'}
          </button>
          {editingSourceId && (
            <button className="btn btn-cancel-edit" type="button" onClick={resetSourceForm} style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', padding: '6px 12px', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
              Отмена
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>

      <AppDialog
        isOpen={dialogOpen}
        title={dialogTitle}
        description={dialogDesc}
        onConfirm={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
        onCancel={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useContext } from 'react';
import {
  SelfServiceWorkEpisode,
  EpisodeReadinessSnapshot,
  SelfServiceNextAction,
  RecoveryDescriptor,
  EpisodeLifecycleState
} from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';

export interface EpisodeHeaderProps {
  episode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode | null;
  readiness?: EpisodeReadinessSnapshot | null;
  onNextActionClick?: (action: SelfServiceNextAction) => void;
  onRecoveryClick?: (recovery: RecoveryDescriptor) => void;
  language?: 'ru' | 'en';
}

const STATE_LABELS_RU: Record<EpisodeLifecycleState, string> = {
  draft: 'Черновик задачи',
  preflight_ready: 'Предпроверка завершена',
  importing: 'Импорт сессии...',
  analysis_ready: 'Анализ готов',
  quality_review_required: 'Требуется проверка качества',
  analysis_limited: 'Анализ с ограничениями',
  comparison_not_ready: 'Сравнение: ожидание 2-й сессии',
  comparison_ready: 'Готово к сравнению',
  handoff_ready: 'Готово к экспорту',
  awaiting_outcome_confirmation: 'Ожидает подтверждения полезности',
  completed: 'Сессия завершена',
  historical: 'Архивная ревизия',
  source_unavailable: 'Исходный файл недоступен',
  failed_recoverable: 'Требуется восстановление',
  failed_terminal: 'Критическая ошибка',
  cancelled: 'Отменено'
};

const STATE_LABELS_EN: Record<EpisodeLifecycleState, string> = {
  draft: 'Draft Task',
  preflight_ready: 'Preflight Complete',
  importing: 'Importing Session...',
  analysis_ready: 'Analysis Ready',
  quality_review_required: 'Quality Review Required',
  analysis_limited: 'Analysis Limited',
  comparison_not_ready: 'Comparison: Waiting for 2nd Session',
  comparison_ready: 'Ready for Comparison',
  handoff_ready: 'Ready for Export',
  awaiting_outcome_confirmation: 'Awaiting Useful Outcome Confirmation',
  completed: 'Session Completed',
  historical: 'Historical Revision',
  source_unavailable: 'Source File Unavailable',
  failed_recoverable: 'Recovery Required',
  failed_terminal: 'Terminal Failure',
  cancelled: 'Cancelled'
};

export const EpisodeHeader: React.FC<EpisodeHeaderProps> = ({
  episode,
  readiness,
  onNextActionClick,
  onRecoveryClick,
  language = 'ru'
}) => {
  if (!episode) return null;

  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  const stateLabel = isRu
    ? STATE_LABELS_RU[episode.lifecycle_state] || episode.lifecycle_state
    : STATE_LABELS_EN[episode.lifecycle_state] || episode.lifecycle_state;

  const nextAction = readiness?.next_action;
  const activeRecovery = readiness?.active_recovery;

  return (
    <div
      role="region"
      aria-label={isRu ? 'Состояние пользовательской задачи' : 'Work Episode Status'}
      className="episode-header-card bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg p-4 mb-4 text-slate-100 shadow-sm"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        {/* Left: Status & Session Info */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase ${
              episode.lifecycle_state === 'completed'
                ? 'bg-emerald-800 text-emerald-100 border border-emerald-600'
                : episode.lifecycle_state === 'failed_recoverable'
                ? 'bg-amber-800 text-amber-100 border border-amber-600'
                : episode.lifecycle_state === 'source_unavailable' || episode.lifecycle_state === 'failed_terminal'
                ? 'bg-rose-800 text-rose-100 border border-rose-600'
                : 'bg-indigo-800 text-indigo-100 border border-indigo-600'
            }`}
          >
            {stateLabel}
          </span>

          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
            {isRu ? 'Эпизод:' : 'Episode:'} <code className="text-slate-400">{episode.episode_id}</code>
          </span>

          {episode.canonical_session_id && (
            <span className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              {isRu ? 'Сессия:' : 'Session:'} <code className="text-slate-300">{episode.canonical_session_id}</code>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right: Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {activeRecovery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={isRu ? 'Восстановить состояние' : 'Self-service recovery'}
              onClick={() => onRecoveryClick && onRecoveryClick(activeRecovery)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-600 text-amber-50 border border-amber-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400 transition-colors"
            >
              ⚠️ {isRu ? 'Восстановление данных' : 'Recover Data'}
              {activeRecovery.data_preserved && (
                <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs text-amber-200">({isRu ? 'сохранено' : 'safe'})</span>
              )}
            </button>
          )}

          {nextAction && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={isRu ? nextAction.reason_ru : nextAction.reason_en}
              onClick={() => onNextActionClick && onNextActionClick(nextAction)}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400 transition-colors"
            >
              ➡️ {isRu ? nextAction.reason_ru : nextAction.reason_en}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Why-Unavailable or Limitation Explanation */}
      {readiness?.comparison_reason_ru && !readiness.comparison_ready && episode.lifecycle_state === 'comparison_not_ready' && (
        <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-800/60 p-2 rounded border border-slate-700/50">
          ℹ️ {isRu ? readiness.comparison_reason_ru : readiness.comparison_reason_en}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
