import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { TierBadge } from './TierBadge';
import { EntitlementState, LicenseTier } from '../../shared/entitlementContract';
import { SanitizedEntitlementDiagnostics } from '../../shared/canonical/OfflineLicenseContract';
import {
  LicenseFulfillmentRequest,
  ActivationReceipt,
  CustomerLifecycleSnapshot,
  CommercialExchangeWorkspaceSnapshot,
  FulfillmentResponseImportPlan,
  FulfillmentAction,
  CustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot,
  LicenseSupportCaseSnapshot,
  FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan,
  CustomerLifecycleCommandReceipt
} from '../../shared/canonical/LicenseFulfillmentContract';

export const LicenseSettingsSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [entitlements, setEntitlements] = useState<EntitlementState | null>(null);
  const [diagnostics, setDiagnostics] = useState<SanitizedEntitlementDiagnostics | null>(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [showDiagnostics, setShowDiagnostics] = useState(false);
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);

  // G29/G30/G32/G33 Offline Commercial Exchange & Customer Activation State
  const [fulfillmentSnapshot, setFulfillmentSnapshot] = useState<CustomerLifecycleSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [commercialSnapshot, setCommercialSnapshot] = useState<CommercialExchangeWorkspaceSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [activationSnapshot, setActivationSnapshot] = useState<CustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [supportSnapshot, setSupportSnapshot] = useState<LicenseSupportCaseSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [activeRequest, setActiveRequest] = useState<LicenseFulfillmentRequest | null>(null);
  const [receipts, setReceipts] = useState<ActivationReceipt[]>([]);
  const [showReceipts, setShowReceipts] = useState(false);
  const [reqAction, setReqAction] = useState<FulfillmentAction>('renew');
  const [reqTier, setReqTier] = useState<LicenseTier>('professional');
  const [reqNote, setReqNote] = useState('');
  const [pendingPreflight, setPendingPreflight] = useState<{
    plan: FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan;
    capability_ref: string;
    display_name: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [exportReceipt, setExportReceipt] = useState<{
    destination_path_masked: string;
    file_sha256: string;
    file_size_bytes: number;
    capability_ref: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [fulfillmentMessage, setFulfillmentMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const fetchEntitlementData = async () => {
    try {
      const ent = await api.getEntitlements();
      if (ent) setEntitlements(ent);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load entitlements:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchFulfillmentData = async () => {
    try {
      const [snapRes, commSnapRes, actSnapRes, suppSnapRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        api.getFulfillmentSnapshot(),
        api.getCommercialExchangeSnapshot(),
        api.getProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot().catch(() => api.getCustomerActivationSnapshot()),
        api.getLicenseSupportCaseSnapshot()
      ]);

      if (snapRes.status === 'fulfilled' && snapRes.value) {
        setFulfillmentSnapshot(snapRes.value);
        setActiveRequest(snapRes.value.active_request);
        setReceipts(snapRes.value.recent_receipts);
      } else if (snapRes.status === 'rejected') {
        console.warn('Failed to load fulfillment snapshot:', snapRes.reason);
      }

      if (commSnapRes.status === 'fulfilled' && commSnapRes.value) {
        setCommercialSnapshot(commSnapRes.value);
      } else if (commSnapRes.status === 'rejected') {
        console.warn('Failed to load commercial exchange snapshot:', commSnapRes.reason);
      }

      if (actSnapRes.status === 'fulfilled' && actSnapRes.value) {
        const actSnap = actSnapRes.value;
        setActivationSnapshot(actSnap);
        if (!activeRequest && actSnap.active_request) {
          try {
            const activeRes = await api.getActiveFulfillmentRequest();
            if (activeRes?.request) {
              setActiveRequest(activeRes.request);
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Failed to load active fulfillment request:', e);
          }
        }
        if (actSnap.recent_receipts && actSnap.recent_receipts.length > 0) {
          setReceipts(actSnap.recent_receipts as any);
        }
      } else if (actSnapRes.status === 'rejected') {
        console.warn('Failed to load customer activation snapshot:', actSnapRes.reason);
      }

      if (suppSnapRes.status === 'fulfilled' && suppSnapRes.value) {
        setSupportSnapshot(suppSnapRes.value);
      } else if (suppSnapRes.status === 'rejected') {
        console.warn('Failed to load license support snapshot:', suppSnapRes.reason);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load fulfillment snapshot:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchDiagnostics = async () => {
    try {
      const diag = await api.getEntitlementDiagnostics();
      if (diag) setDiagnostics(diag);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load diagnostics:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchHistory = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.getEntitlementHistory();
      if (res && res.history) setHistory(res.history);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load license history:', err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchEntitlementData();
    fetchFulfillmentData();
  }, []);

  const handleRemoveLicense = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setStatusMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.removeLicense('User removed license');
      if (res.success) {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'info', text: res.message });
        await fetchEntitlementData();
        if (showDiagnostics) await fetchDiagnostics();
        if (showHistory) await fetchHistory();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Failed to remove license.' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateFulfillmentRequest = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setFulfillmentMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.createFulfillmentRequest({
        action: reqAction,
        requestedTier: reqTier,
        userNote: reqNote.trim() || undefined
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setFulfillmentMessage({ type: 'success', text: `Запрос на лицензирование (${reqAction} -> ${reqTier}) успешно сформирован!` });
        await fetchFulfillmentData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFulfillmentMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Ошибка создания запроса на лицензию' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelFulfillmentRequest = async (requestId: string) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setFulfillmentMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.cancelFulfillmentRequest(requestId, 'Cancelled by user from UI');
      if (res.success) {
        setFulfillmentMessage({ type: 'info', text: 'Запрос на лицензирование отменен.' });
        await fetchFulfillmentData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFulfillmentMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Ошибка отмены запроса' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadRequest = async () => {
    if (!activeRequest) return;
    if (window.electronAPI?.showSaveFulfillmentRequestDialog) {
      try {
        const suggested = `cardiolab_fulfillment_request_${activeRequest.request_id}.json`;
        const dialogResult = await window.electronAPI.showSaveFulfillmentRequestDialog({
          defaultFilename: suggested,
          requestId: activeRequest.request_id,
          requestHash: activeRequest.request_hash
        });
        if (dialogResult.canceled) {
          return;
        }

        const capToken = (dialogResult as any).capability_ref;
        if (!capToken) {
          throw new Error('Не удалось получить capability-токен экспорта от системы');
        }

        const pubRes = await api.publishCommercialExport(capToken, activeRequest);
        if (pubRes.success) {
          setExportReceipt(pubRes);
          setFulfillmentMessage({
            type: 'success',
            text: `Запрос успешно экспортирован в файл: ${pubRes.destination_path_masked} (SHA-256: ${pubRes.file_sha256.slice(0, 12)}...)`
          });
          await fetchFulfillmentData();
          return;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setFulfillmentMessage({
          type: 'error',
          text: `Ошибка сохранения через файловый брокер: ${err.message}`
        });
        return;
      }
    } else {
      setFulfillmentMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: 'Нативное сохранение файлов доступно только в приложении CardioLab Desktop.'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSelectResponseFileDesktop = async () => {
    if (!window.electronAPI?.showOpenFulfillmentResponseDialog) {
      setFulfillmentMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: 'Нативный выбор файла доступен только в приложении CardioLab Desktop.'
      });
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await window.electronAPI.showOpenFulfillmentResponseDialog();
      if (res.canceled) return;

      setIsLoading(true);
      setFulfillmentMessage({ type: 'info', text: 'Проверка структуры ответа через capability-брокер...' });

      if ((res as any).plan && (res as any).capability_ref) {
        setPendingPreflight({
          plan: (res as any).plan,
          capability_ref: (res as any).capability_ref,
          display_name: (res as any).display_name || 'response.json'
        });
        setFulfillmentMessage({
          type: 'info',
          text: `Файл ответа "${(res as any).display_name || 'response.json'}" проверен. Ознакомьтесь с планом активации перед подтверждением.`
        });
      } else {
        throw new Error((res as any).error || 'Preflight validation failed for selected response');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFulfillmentMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: `Ошибка проверки файла ответа: ${err.message}`
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmExecuteImport = async () => {
    if (!pendingPreflight) return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setFulfillmentMessage(null);
    try {
      const execRes = await api.executeCommercialImport(pendingPreflight.capability_ref);
      if (execRes.success) {
        setPendingPreflight(null);
        setFulfillmentMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: execRes.message || 'Ответ оператора успешно применен! Лицензия активирована.'
        });
        await fetchEntitlementData();
        await fetchFulfillmentData();
        if (showDiagnostics) await fetchDiagnostics();
        if (showHistory) await fetchHistory();
      } else {
        setFulfillmentMessage({
          type: execRes.status === 'needs_information' ? 'info' : 'error',
          text: `[${execRes.status.toUpperCase()}] ${execRes.message}${execRes.operator_message ? ` Причина: "${execRes.operator_message}"` : ''}`
        });
        await fetchFulfillmentData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFulfillmentMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: `Ошибка применения ответа оператора: ${err.message}`
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div id="section-license" role="region" aria-label="Offline License & Entitlement Lifecycle" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px', maxWidth: '900px' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f3f4f6' }}>
          Offline License & Entitlement Lifecycle
        </h3>
        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '14px', color: '#9ca3af', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          CardioLab operates in local-first, privacy-bounded mode. Licenses are verified asymmetrically offline via
          ECDSA/Ed25519 cryptography without cloud telemetry or external merchant callbacks.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Clock Rollback Warning */}
      {entitlements && entitlements.clock_healthy === false && (
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          padding: '12px 16px',
          color: '#fca5a5',
          fontSize: '14px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '12px'
        }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>⚠️</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Clock Anomaly Warning:</strong> A backward system clock jump was detected. Commercial gating is
            temporarily restricted to prevent replay attacks. Please restore your correct system clock time.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Current License Card */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
        border: '1px solid #374151',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '20px'
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#9ca3af', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em' }}>
              Active Edition
            </span>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginTop: '4px' }}>
              <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f9fafb' }}>
                {entitlements?.capabilities?.tier_display_name || 'Evaluation Trial'}
              </h4>
              {entitlements && (
                <TierBadge tier={entitlements.tier} isActive={!entitlements.is_expired} />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
            <span style={{
              display: 'inline-block',
              padding: '4px 10px',
              borderRadius: '9999px',
              fontSize: '12px',
              fontWeight: 600,
              backgroundColor: entitlements?.status === 'active' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)' :
                entitlements?.status === 'grace_period' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2)',
              color: entitlements?.status === 'active' ? '#34d399' :
                entitlements?.status === 'grace_period' ? '#fbbf24' : '#f87171',
              border: `1px solid ${entitlements?.status === 'active' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)' :
                entitlements?.status === 'grace_period' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)'}`
            }}>
              {entitlements?.status === 'active' ? '● Active' :
                entitlements?.status === 'grace_period' ? '▲ In Grace Period' :
                  entitlements?.status === 'revoked' ? '✕ Revoked' : '✕ Expired'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metadata Grid */}
        <div style={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))',
          gap: '12px',
          padding: '14px',
          backgroundColor: '#111827',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          fontSize: '13px'
        }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Licensee:</span>{' '}
            <strong style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>{entitlements?.licensee_name || 'Not assigned'}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Key Masked:</span>{' '}
            <code style={{ color: '#93c5fd', backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              {entitlements?.license_key_masked || 'NONE'}
            </code>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Key ID:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>{entitlements?.key_id || 'builtin-trial'}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Expires:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>
              {entitlements?.expires_at_utc ? new Date(entitlements.expires_at_utc).toLocaleDateString() : 'Perpetual / N/A'}
            </span>
          </div>
          {entitlements?.in_grace_period && (
            <div>
              <span style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }}>Grace Remaining:</span>{' '}
              <strong style={{ color: '#f59e0b' }}>{entitlements.grace_period_days || 7} days</strong>
            </div>
          )}
          {typeof entitlements?.days_remaining === 'number' && (
            <div>
              <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Days Remaining:</span>{' '}
              <strong style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>{entitlements.days_remaining}</strong>
            </div>
          )}
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Revision:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>rev-{entitlements?.active_revision || 1}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Trust Root:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#34d399', fontWeight: 500 }}>Active (Production)</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons for Active License */}
        {entitlements?.active_license_id && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', marginTop: '16px' }}>
            <button
              onClick={handleRemoveLicense}
              disabled={isLoading}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.4)',
                color: '#d1d5db',
                padding: '6px 12px',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                fontSize: '13px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}
            >
              Отозвать с устройства / Сбросить до пробного периода (Remove / Reset to Trial)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Scientific Invariance Guarantee Banner */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '14px 18px',
        fontSize: '13px',
        color: '#bfdbfe',
        lineHeight: 1.5
      }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#60a5fa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
          🛡️ Non-Negotiable Scientific Invariance Guarantee
        </div>
        License tiers and payment status <strong>NEVER alter</strong> detected QRS peaks, computed HRV metrics,
        TaskEligibility, quality thresholds, or clinical disclaimers. Commercial tiers gate workflow convenience,
        profile capacity, custom branding, and export depth only.
      </div>

      {/* Historical Data Protection Guarantee Banner */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '14px 18px',
        fontSize: '13px',
        color: '#a7f3d0',
        lineHeight: 1.5
      }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#34d399', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
          🔒 Non-Destructive Historical Data Guarantee
        </div>
        CardioLab guarantees that even if a trial expires or a license is revoked, <strong>all historical sessions,
        reports, and SQLite databases remain 100% readable and exportable</strong>. Expiry never deletes, encrypts, or
        silently locks existing athlete data.
      </div>

      {/* Primary Flow: Trusted Offline Commercial Exchange & Customer Lifecycle Authority (G30) */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
        border: '1px solid #374151',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '20px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: '16px'
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div>
            <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '16px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f3f4f6' }}>
              Trusted Offline Commercial Exchange & Customer Lifecycle (G30)
            </h4>
            <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '13px', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
              Request-bound signed responses, offline renewal/replacement lineage, capability-bound file broker, and support-safe activation recovery.
            </p>
          </div>
          <span style={{
            padding: '2px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            fontSize: '11px',
            fontWeight: 600,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)',
            color: '#34d399',
            border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)'
          }}>
            Primary Commercial Flow
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Safe Next Action Card */}
        {commercialSnapshot?.safe_next_action && (
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            padding: '12px 16px',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center'
          }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#93c5fd', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Рекомендуемое действие / Recommended Action
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f3f4f6', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                {commercialSnapshot.safe_next_action.label_ru} ({commercialSnapshot.safe_next_action.label})
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#9ca3af', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                {commercialSnapshot.safe_next_action.description_ru}
              </div>
            </div>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: '11px',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
              color: '#a5f3fc',
              borderRadius: '4px'
            }}>
              {commercialSnapshot.safe_next_action.action_code}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Support-Safe Guidance Alert */}
        {fulfillmentSnapshot?.support_safe_guidance && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '12px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            fontSize: '13px',
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            backgroundColor: fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'response_rejected'
              ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)'
              : fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'needs_information'
              ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)'
              : fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'request_pending'
              ? 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15)'
              : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)',
            border: `1px solid ${
              fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'response_rejected'
                ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)'
                : fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'needs_information'
                ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)'
                : fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.state === 'request_pending'
                ? 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)'
                : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)'
            }`,
            color: '#f3f4f6'
          }}>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '4px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
              <span>ℹ️</span>
              <span>{fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.instructions_ru}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '12px' }}>
              {fulfillmentSnapshot.support_safe_guidance.instructions}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Support & Self-Service Recovery Card (G32) */}
        {activationSnapshot?.support_recovery && activationSnapshot.support_recovery.recovery_class !== 'none' && (
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            padding: '14px 16px',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: '8px'
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>🛠️</span>
                <strong style={{ color: '#fca5a5', fontSize: '14px' }}>
                  Самообслуживание и восстановление лицензии / License Support & Recovery
                </strong>
              </div>
              <span style={{
                fontSize: '11px',
                padding: '2px 8px',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                fontWeight: 600,
                backgroundColor: '#7f1d1d',
                color: '#fecaca'
              }}>
                Класс: {activationSnapshot.support_recovery.recovery_class}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '13px', color: '#f3f4f6' }}>
              <strong>Причина:</strong> {activationSnapshot.support_recovery.typed_reasons?.join(', ') || 'N/A'} — {activationSnapshot.support_recovery.safe_next_action?.description_ru}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#34d399', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
              <span>🔒</span>
              <span>100% Data Preserved: Все исторические сессии и данные SQLite защищены и доступны.</span>
            </div>
            {activationSnapshot.support_recovery.safe_next_action && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '4px', display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#9ca3af' }}>Рекомендуемое действие:</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#93c5fd', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  {activationSnapshot.support_recovery.safe_next_action.label_ru} ({activationSnapshot.support_recovery.safe_next_action.label})
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Fulfillment Notification Banner */}
        {fulfillmentMessage && (
          <div style={{

                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const MaintenanceSupportSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [maintenanceStatus, setMaintenanceStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [showIncidents, setShowIncidents] = useState(false);
  const [isExportingBundle, setIsExportingBundle] = useState(false);

  const fetchStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.getMaintenanceStatus();
      if (res) setMaintenanceStatus(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load maintenance status:', err);
    }
  };

  const fetchIncidents = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.listSupportIncidents(25);
      if (res && res.incidents) setIncidents(res.incidents);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load support incidents:', err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStatus();
  }, []);

  const handleCheckUpdates = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.checkMaintenanceUpdate();
      if (res.updateAvailable) {
        setMessage({
          type: 'info',
          text: `Update available: v${res.manifest.version} (Channel: ${res.manifest.release_channel || 'default'})`
        });
      } else {
        setMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: res.status === 'disabled'
            ? 'Automatic update feed is currently disabled by security policy (Distribution Deferred).'
            : 'Application is currently up-to-date.'
        });
      }
      await fetchStatus();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Failed to check for updates.' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRollback = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.rollbackMaintenanceUpdate();
      if (res.success) {
        setMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: `Successfully rolled back to version ${res.rolled_back_to_version}.`
        });
        await fetchStatus();
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.error || 'Rollback failed.' });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Failed to execute rollback.' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadSupportBundle = async () => {
    setIsExportingBundle(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/support/bundle.zip');
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `cardiolab_support_bundle_${Date.now()}.zip`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      setMessage({ type: 'success', text: 'Support bundle ZIP exported successfully (privacy redacted).' });
      await fetchStatus();
      if (showIncidents) await fetchIncidents();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'Failed to export support bundle.' });
    } finally {
      setIsExportingBundle(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResolveIncident = async (incidentId: string) => {
    try {
      await api.resolveSupportIncident(incidentId, 'Resolved from Settings UI');
      await fetchIncidents();
      await fetchStatus();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: `Failed to resolve incident: ${err.message}` });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: '20px',
      backgroundColor: '#111827',
      borderRadius: '8px',
      padding: '24px',
      border: '1px solid #1f2937',
      color: '#f3f4f6'
    }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f3f4f6' }}>
            🛠️ Maintenance, Update Safety & Support Continuity
          </h3>
          <span style={{
            padding: '2px 8px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            fontSize: '11px',
            fontWeight: 600,
            backgroundColor: '#06b6d422',
            color: '#22d3ee',
            border: '1px solid #06b6d455',
            letterSpacing: '0.04em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase'
          }}>
            Distribution Deferred
          </span>
        </div>
        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '14px', color: '#9ca3af', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          Local-first operational safety. Enforces fail-closed cryptographic update verification, atomic staging sandboxes,
          anti-path-traversal isolation, pre-update rollback snapshots, and privacy-scanned support incident diagnostics.
        </p>
      </div>

      {message && (
        <div style={{
          padding: '12px 16px',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          fontSize: '13px',
          backgroundColor: message.type === 'success' ? '#064e3b' : message.type === 'error' ? '#7f1d1d' : '#1e3a8a',
          color: message.type === 'success' ? '#6ee7b7' : message.type === 'error' ? '#fca5a5' : '#93c5fd',
          border: `1px solid ${message.type === 'success' ? '#059669' : message.type === 'error' ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb'}`
        }}>
          {message.text}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Maintenance Status Overview */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
        border: '1px solid #374151',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        padding: '20px'
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#9ca3af', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em' }}>
              Maintenance State
            </span>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginTop: '4px' }}>
              <h4 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#f9fafb' }}>
                Status: {maintenanceStatus?.lifecycle_state || 'idle'}
              </h4>
              <span style={{
                padding: '2px 8px',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                fontSize: '12px',
                fontWeight: 600,
                backgroundColor: maintenanceStatus?.enabled ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)' : 'rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)',
                color: maintenanceStatus?.enabled ? '#34d399' : '#9ca3af'
              }}>
                {maintenanceStatus?.enabled ? 'Auto-Update Enabled' : 'Feed Disabled (Strict Policy)'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCheckUpdates}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 12px' }}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Checking...' : 'Check For Updates'}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDownloadSupportBundle}
              disabled={isExportingBundle}
              className="btn btn-primary"
              style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 12px' }}
            >
              {isExportingBundle ? 'Compiling ZIP...' : '📦 Export Support Bundle (ZIP)'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metadata Grid */}
        <div style={{
          display: 'grid',
          gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))',
          gap: '12px',
          padding: '14px',
          backgroundColor: '#111827',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          fontSize: '13px'
        }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Current Version:</span>{' '}
            <strong style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>{maintenanceStatus?.current_version || '1.0.1'}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Schema Version:</span>{' '}
            <code style={{ color: '#93c5fd', backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              {maintenanceStatus?.current_schema_version || '1.0.0'}
            </code>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Active Channel:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#e5e7eb', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
              {maintenanceStatus?.update_channel || 'beta'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Rollback Target:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: maintenanceStatus?.active_rollback_snapshot ? '#34d399' : '#9ca3af' }}>
              {maintenanceStatus?.active_rollback_snapshot?.previous_version || 'None (No active update)'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Recent Incidents:</span>{' '}
            <strong style={{ color: maintenanceStatus?.critical_incidents_count > 0 ? '#f87171' : '#e5e7eb' }}>
              {maintenanceStatus?.recent_incidents_count || 0} recorded
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span style={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}>Scientific Invariance:</span>{' '}
            <span style={{ color: '#34d399', fontWeight: 500 }}>Protocol v1.1.0 Preserved</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Rollback Actions if Available */}
        {maintenanceStatus?.active_rollback_snapshot && (
          <div style={{
            marginTop: '16px',
            padding: '12px',
            backgroundColor: '#374151',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center'
          }}>
            <div>
              <strong style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }}>Rollback Snapshot Available:</strong>{' '}
              <span style={{ color: '#d1d5db', fontSize: '13px' }}>
                Revert to {maintenanceStatus.active_rollback_snapshot.previous_version} (staged {maintenanceStatus.active_rollback_snapshot.staged_version})
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRollback}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#fca5a5', borderColor: '#ef4444' }}
            >
              Revert Update (Rollback)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Incident Log Accordion */}
      <div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setShowIncidents(!showIncidents);
            if (!showIncidents) fetchIncidents();
          }}
          className="btn btn-secondary"
          style={{ fontSize: '12px', padding: '6px 12px' }}
        >
          {showIncidents ? 'Hide Support Incident Ledger' : 'View Support Incident Ledger'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {showIncidents && (
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: '#111827',
          border: '1px solid #374151',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          padding: '16px'
        }}>
          <h5 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '14px', color: '#f3f4f6' }}>Recent Support Incidents & System Events</h5>
          {incidents.length === 0 ? (
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '13px', color: '#9ca3af' }}>No operational or maintenance incidents recorded.</p>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
              {incidents.map((inc, i) => (
                <div key={i} style={{
                  padding: '10px 14px',
                  backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  alignItems: 'center'
                }}>
                  <div>
                    <span style={{
                      display: 'inline-block',
                      padding: '2px 6px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      fontSize: '11px',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      textTransform: 'uppercase',
                      backgroundColor: inc.severity === 'critical' ? '#ef444433' : inc.severity === 'error' ? '#f8717133' : '#3b82f633',
                      color: inc.severity === 'critical' || inc.severity === 'error' ? '#fca5a5' : '#93c5fd',
                      marginRight: '8px'
                    }}>
                      {inc.severity}
                    </span>
                    <strong style={{ color: '#e5e7eb' }}>[{inc.error_code}]</strong> {inc.message}
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#9ca3af', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                      Workflow: {inc.workflow} | Status: <span style={{ color: inc.status === 'resolved' ? '#34d399' : '#fbbf24' }}>{inc.status}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                    <span style={{ color: '#6b7280', fontSize: '11px' }}>{new Date(inc.timestamp_utc).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    {inc.status !== 'resolved' && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleResolveIncident(inc.incident_id)}
                        className="btn btn-secondary"
                        style={{ fontSize: '11px', padding: '3px 8px' }}
                      >
                        Resolve
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, UserProfile, SessionSummary, LlmPackExportResponse, LlmPackPreflight, LlmPackPreviewResponse } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { AppSelect } from './AppSelect';

interface Props {
  sessionId: string;
  session: SessionSummary;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialNotes?: string;
  initialIncludeNotes?: boolean;
  onExportSuccess?: (res: LlmPackExportResponse) => void;
  initialWindowId?: string;
  initialWindowRevision?: number;
  initialComparisonId?: string;
  onNavigateToDiary?: () => void;
}

const PROMPT_TEMPLATES_LIST = [
  { id: '80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md', nameRu: 'Первичный обзор сессии', nameEn: 'Session First Look' },
  { id: '81_PROMPT_02_COMPARE_WITH_CONTEXT.md', nameRu: 'Сравнение с базой', nameEn: 'Compare with Compatible' },
  { id: '82_PROMPT_03_EXPLAIN_HRV_METRICS.md', nameRu: 'Разбор показателей HRV', nameEn: 'Explain HRV Metrics' },
  { id: '83_PROMPT_04_EXPLAIN_SIGNAL_QUALITY.md', nameRu: 'Разбор качества сигнала', nameEn: 'Signal Quality & Limits' },
  { id: '84_PROMPT_05_EXPLAIN_ADVANCED_METRICS.md', nameRu: 'Разбор Advanced метрик', nameEn: 'Advanced Metrics & Maturity' },
  { id: '85_PROMPT_06_METHODOLOGY_REVIEW.md', nameRu: 'Методологический обзор', nameEn: 'Methodology Review' },
  { id: '86_PROMPT_07_CONSULTATION_DISCUSSION_PREP.md', nameRu: 'Подготовка к обсуждению', nameEn: 'Consultation Discussion Prep' },
];

export function LlmExportModal({
  sessionId,
  session,
  onClose,
  initialNotes,
  initialIncludeNotes,
  onExportSuccess,
  initialWindowId,
  initialWindowRevision,
  initialComparisonId,
  onNavigateToDiary
}: Props) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  
  // State
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState<string>('');
  const [activityType, setActivityType] = useState<string>('unknown');
  const [exportProfile, setExportProfile] = useState<'chatgpt_web_full' | 'gemini_web_compact' | 'antigravity_local_debug'>('chatgpt_web_full');
  const [privacyLevel, setPrivacyLevel] = useState<'pseudonymized' | 'minimal' | 'internal_debug'>('pseudonymized');
  const [includeNotes, setIncludeNotes] = useState<boolean>(initialIncludeNotes !== undefined ? initialIncludeNotes : false);
  const [ecgStripsMode, setEcgStripsMode] = useState<'none' | 'candidate-only' | 'representative'>('none');
  const [selectedPrompt, setSelectedPrompt] = useState<string>('80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md');
  const [userGoal, setUserGoal] = useState<string>('session_first_look');
  const [rawSeriesOptIn, setRawSeriesOptIn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [signalExcerptOptIn, setSignalExcerptOptIn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [outputLanguage, setOutputLanguage] = useState<'ru' | 'en' | 'bilingual'>(language === 'ru' ? 'ru' : 'en');
  const [includePromptLibrary, setIncludePromptLibrary] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  const [excludeEcgCsv, setExcludeEcgCsv] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [limitEcgStrips, setLimitEcgStrips] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const [eventExportMode, setEventExportMode] = useState<'summary' | 'default' | 'debug'>('default');
  const [continueWithoutActivity, setContinueWithoutActivity] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [preflightLoading, setPreflightLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [inspectedFile, setInspectedFile] = useState<{ name: string; content: string } | null>(null);
  const [inspectingLoading, setInspectingLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preflight, setPreflight] = useState<LlmPackPreflight | null>(null);
  const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState<LlmPackPreviewResponse | null>(null);
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<LlmPackExportResponse | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [saveResult, setSaveResult] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);


  // Load session context on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    api.getSessionContext(sessionId)
      .then((context) => {
        if (context) {
          if (context.user_id) {
            setSelectedUserId(context.user_id);
          }
          setActivityType(context.activity_type || 'unknown');
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => console.error('Failed to load session context:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
  }, [sessionId]);

  // Load user profiles
  useEffect(() => {
    api.getUserProfiles()
      .then((res) => {
        setUsers(res);
        if (!selectedUserId) {
          if (session.user_id && res.some(u => u.id === session.user_id)) {
            setSelectedUserId(session.user_id);
          } else if (res.length > 0) {
            setSelectedUserId(res[0].id);
          }
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message));
  }, [session.user_id]);

  // Reset selected prompt if it becomes invalid for the current activity type
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedPrompt === '83_PROMPT_04_SLEEP_RECOVERY_REVIEW.md' && activityType !== 'sleep') {
      setSelectedPrompt('80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md');
    } else if (selectedPrompt === '82_PROMPT_03_CARDIO_TRAINING_REVIEW.md' && activityType !== 'cardio') {
      setSelectedPrompt('80_PROMPT_01_SESSION_FIRST_LOOK.md');
    }
  }, [activityType, selectedPrompt]);

  // Save handlers
  const handleUserChange = async (userId: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const targetUserId = userId === 'unassigned' || userId === '' ? null : userId;
      await api.saveSessionContext(sessionId, {
        user_id: targetUserId,
        activity_type: activityType,
        user_notes: initialNotes !== undefined ? initialNotes : undefined
      });
      setSelectedUserId(userId);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(`Failed to save athlete profile: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleActivityChange = async (newActivity: string) => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const targetUserId = selectedUserId === 'unassigned' || selectedUserId === '' ? null : selectedUserId;
      await api.saveSessionContext(sessionId, {
        user_id: targetUserId,
        activity_type: newActivity,
        user_notes: initialNotes !== undefined ? initialNotes : undefined
      });
      setActivityType(newActivity);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(`Failed to save activity type: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  // Preflight check
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedUserId) return;
    setPreflightLoading(true);
    api.preflightLlmPack({
      sessionId,
      userId: selectedUserId,
      exportProfile,
      privacyLevel,
      includeNotes,
      ecgStripsMode,
      selectedPrompt,
      includePromptLibrary,
      excludeEcgCsv,
      limitEcgStrips,
      eventExportMode
    })
      .then((res) => {
        setPreflight(res);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        setError(e.message);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        setPreflightLoading(false);
      });
  }, [sessionId, selectedUserId, exportProfile, privacyLevel, includeNotes, ecgStripsMode, selectedPrompt, includePromptLibrary, excludeEcgCsv, limitEcgStrips, eventExportMode]);

  // Adjust options based on profile changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (exportProfile === 'gemini_web_compact') {
      setEcgStripsMode('none');
      setSignalExcerptOptIn(false);
      setExcludeEcgCsv(true);
      setLimitEcgStrips(1);
      setEventExportMode('summary');
    } else if (exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full') {
      setEcgStripsMode('candidate-only');
      setSignalExcerptOptIn(true);
      setExcludeEcgCsv(true);
      setLimitEcgStrips(5);
      setEventExportMode('default');
    } else {
      setEcgStripsMode('candidate-only');
      setSignalExcerptOptIn(true);
      setExcludeEcgCsv(false);
      setLimitEcgStrips(undefined);
      setEventExportMode('default');
    }
  }, [exportProfile]);

  // Invalidate previewData and inspectedFile on any configuration change
  useEffect(() => {
    setPreviewData(null);
    setInspectedFile(null);
  }, [
    exportProfile,
    privacyLevel,
    includeNotes,
    ecgStripsMode,
    selectedPrompt,
    userGoal,
    rawSeriesOptIn,
    signalExcerptOptIn,
    selectedUserId,
    activityType,
    excludeEcgCsv,
    limitEcgStrips,
    eventExportMode,
    includePromptLibrary
  ]);

  const handlePreview = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setPreviewLoading(true);
    try {
      if (!selectedUserId) {
        throw new Error('Please select an athlete profile first.');
      }
      const targetUserId = selectedUserId === 'unassigned' || selectedUserId === '' ? null : selectedUserId;
      await api.saveSessionContext(sessionId, {
        user_id: targetUserId,
        activity_type: activityType,
        user_notes: initialNotes !== undefined ? initialNotes : undefined
      });

      const res = await api.previewLlmPack({
        sessionId,
        userId: selectedUserId,
        exportProfile,
        privacyLevel,
        includeNotes,
        ecgStripsMode,
        selectedPrompt,
        userGoal,
        rawSeriesOptIn,
        signalExcerptOptIn: signalExcerptOptIn || (ecgStripsMode !== 'none'),
        includePromptLibrary,
        excludeEcgCsv,
        limitEcgStrips,
        eventExportMode,
        windowId: initialWindowId,
        windowRevision: initialWindowRevision,
        comparisonId: initialComparisonId
      });
      setPreviewData(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Preview generation failed.');
    } finally {
      setPreviewLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExport = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      if (!selectedUserId) {
        throw new Error(isRu ? 'Пожалуйста, сначала выберите профиль атлета.' : 'Please select an athlete profile first.');
      }
      // Save context one last time before export to be absolutely sure notes and everything are persisted
      const targetUserId = selectedUserId === 'unassigned' || selectedUserId === '' ? null : selectedUserId;
      await api.saveSessionContext(sessionId, {
        user_id: targetUserId,
        activity_type: activityType,
        user_notes: initialNotes !== undefined ? initialNotes : undefined
      });

      let currentPreview = previewData;
      if (!currentPreview || !currentPreview.previewId) {
        currentPreview = await api.previewLlmPack({
          sessionId,
          userId: selectedUserId,
          exportProfile,
          privacyLevel,
          includeNotes,
          ecgStripsMode,
          selectedPrompt,
          userGoal,
          rawSeriesOptIn,
          signalExcerptOptIn: signalExcerptOptIn || (ecgStripsMode !== 'none'),
          includePromptLibrary,
          excludeEcgCsv,
          limitEcgStrips,
          eventExportMode,
          windowId: initialWindowId,
          windowRevision: initialWindowRevision,
          comparisonId: initialComparisonId
        });
        setPreviewData(currentPreview);
      }

      const res = await api.exportLlmPack({
        sessionId,
        userId: selectedUserId,
        exportProfile,
        privacyLevel,
        includeNotes,
        ecgStripsMode,
        selectedPrompt,
        userGoal,
        rawSeriesOptIn,
        signalExcerptOptIn: signalExcerptOptIn || (ecgStripsMode !== 'none'),
        previewId: currentPreview.previewId,
        expectedFingerprint: currentPreview.requestFingerprint,
        includePromptLibrary,
        excludeEcgCsv,
        limitEcgStrips,
        eventExportMode,
        windowId: initialWindowId,
        windowRevision: initialWindowRevision,
        comparisonId: initialComparisonId
      });
      setExportResult(res);
      onExportSuccess?.(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Export compilation failed.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyPrompt = async () => {
    if (!exportResult) return;
    try {
      const promptText = await api.getLlmPrompt(exportResult.packId, selectedPrompt);
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(promptText);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(`Не удалось скопировать промпт: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };


  const formatBytes = (bytes: number): string => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  };

  const handleAutoFit = () => {
    setExcludeEcgCsv(true);
    setLimitEcgStrips(1);
    if (exportProfile === 'chatgpt_web_full') {
      setExportProfile('gemini_web_compact');
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveEcgCsv = () => {
    setExcludeEcgCsv(true);
  };

  const handleOneEcgStrip = () => {
    setLimitEcgStrips(1);
  };

  const handleSwitchGeminiCompact = () => {
    setExportProfile('gemini_web_compact');
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (previewData && !exportResult) {
      api.cancelLlmPackPreview(previewData.previewId, sessionId, selectedUserId).catch(() => {});
    }
    onClose();
  };

  const userOptions = users.map(u => {
    const aliasLabel = isRu && u.export_alias === 'Athlete' ? 'Атлет' : u.export_alias;
    return { value: u.id, label: `${u.display_name} (${aliasLabel})` };
  });
  const profileOptions = [
    { value: 'chatgpt_web_full', label: isRu ? 'ChatGPT Web Full — полный ZIP' : 'ChatGPT Web Full (Full ZIP)' },
    { value: 'gemini_web_compact', label: isRu ? 'Gemini Web Compact — компактный ZIP до 10 файлов' : 'Gemini Web Compact (Max 10 files)' },
    { value: 'antigravity_local_debug', label: isRu ? 'Antigravity Local Debug — локальная отладка' : 'Antigravity Local Debug (Uncapped)' }
  ];
  const privacyOptions = [
    {
      value: 'pseudonymized',
      label: 'Pseudonymized (Retain export alias, redact real identifiers)'
    },
    {
      value: 'minimal',
      label: 'Minimal Data Exposure (Generic Athlete alias, strip troubleshooting keys)'
    },
    {
      value: 'internal_debug',
      label: 'Local Debug (Identifiers redacted, internal debug metadata enabled)'
    }
  ];
  const ecgOptions = [
    { value: 'none', label: isRu ? 'Не прикреплять' : 'None' },
    { value: 'candidate-only', label: isRu ? 'Только аномалии (кандидаты)' : 'Candidate-only (Around anomalies)' },
    { value: 'representative', label: isRu ? 'Характерные фрагменты (10с интервалы)' : 'Representative segments (10s intervals)' }
  ];
  const eventModeOptions = [
    { value: 'summary', label: isRu ? 'Только сводка' : 'Summary Only' },
    { value: 'default', label: isRu ? 'Сводка + плотность + примеры' : 'Default (Summary + Density + Samples)' },

Ключевые метрики объединены в 90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md для быстрой загрузки.' : 'ZIP is constrained to max 10 files. All key metrics are integrated inside 90_GEMINI_SINGLE_FILE.md for immediate upload.'}

Web upload limits disabled.'}

                    </button>
                  )}
                  {preflight.actionableFixes.includes('switch_gemini_compact') && (
                    <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost" style={styles.fixBtn} onClick={handleSwitchGeminiCompact}>
                      Переключить на Gemini compact
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  * Для разбиения на несколько ZIP вы можете выбрать более короткий диапазон сессии или уменьшить количество strips.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Exact Preview Data (V2) */}
            {previewData && (
              <div style={{ ...styles.previewContainer, border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: '0.88rem' }}>
                    {previewData.scannerResult.passed ? (
                      <span style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>✓ Сканер содержимого: Нарушений не обнаружено ({previewData.scannerResult.scannedFilesCount} файлов)</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span style={{ color: '#ef4444' }}>❌ Сканер обнаружил нарушения</span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    Оценочный ZIP: {formatBytes(previewData.estimatedZipBytes)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                  Канонический семантический хэш: <code style={{ color: '#60a5fa' }}>{previewData.canonicalSemanticHash}</code>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.fileListGrid}>
                  {previewData.files.map((file, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      style={{
                        ...styles.fileItem,
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        backgroundColor: inspectedFile?.name === file.name ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)' : undefined
                      }}
                      title={file.description}
                      onClick={async () => {
                        if (file.contentString) {
                          setInspectedFile({ name: file.name, content: file.contentString });
                        } else {
                          setInspectingLoading(true);
                          try {
                            const content = await api.getPreviewFileContent(previewData.previewId, file.name);
                            setInspectedFile({ name: file.name, content });
                          } catch (e: any) {
                            setError(`Ошибка загрузки ${file.name}: ${e.message}`);
                          } finally {
                            setInspectingLoading(false);
                          }
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <span>📄 {file.name} ({formatBytes(file.sizeBytes)})</span>
                      {file.isOptionalExcerpt && <span style={{ color: '#f59e0b', marginLeft: '4px' }}>[Excerpt]</span>}
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#60a5fa', marginLeft: 'auto', paddingLeft: '8px' }}>[Просмотр 👁️]</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {inspectingLoading && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#38bdf8', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                    Загрузка содержимого файла...
                  </div>
                )}

                {inspectedFile && (
                  <div style={{
                    marginTop: '12px',
                    padding: '12px',
                    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)',
                    borderRadius: '6px'
                  }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                      <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>📄 Содержимое: {inspectedFile.name}</strong>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="btn btn-ghost"
                        style={{ padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
                        onClick={() => setInspectedFile(null)}
                      >
                        ✕ Закрыть
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <pre style={{
                      maxHeight: '220px',
                      overflow: 'auto',
                      backgroundColor: '#020617',
                      padding: '8px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      color: '#e2e8f0',
                      whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
                      wordBreak: 'break-all'
                    }}>
                      {inspectedFile.content}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Preflight Planned Files (Fallback when no preview generated yet) */}
            {!previewData && preflight && (
              <div style={styles.previewContainer}>
                <div style={styles.previewHeader}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>Планируемое содержимое ZIP-архива ({preflight.plannedFiles.length} файлов)</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.fileListGrid}>
                  {preflight.plannedFiles.map((file, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={styles.fileItem}>
                      📄 {file}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Modal Actions */}
            <div style={styles.actions}>
              <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={handleClose} style={{ marginRight: '12px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Отмена' : 'Cancel'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn btn-ghost"
                onClick={handlePreview}
                disabled={isExportDisabled || loading || previewLoading}
                style={{ marginRight: '12px', border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)' }}
              >
                {previewLoading ? (isRu ? 'Проверка...' : 'Checking...') : (isRu ? '🔍 Предпросмотр файлов' : '🔍 Preview Files')}
              </button>
              <button
                id="btn-generate-llm-pack"
                className="btn btn-primary"
                onClick={handleExport}
                disabled={isExportDisabled || loading || previewLoading}
              >
                {loading ? (isRu ? 'Формирование пакета...' : 'Generating...') : (isRu ? '⚡ Сформировать ZIP-пакет' : '⚡ Generate Pack ZIP')}
              </button>
            </div>
            {isExportDisabled && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#f87171', textAlign: 'right', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                {!selectedUserId 
                  ? (isRu ? '⚠ Выберите профиль атлета перед экспортом' : '⚠ Please select an athlete profile')
                  : hasUnknownActivity && !continueWithoutActivity
                    ? (isRu ? '⚠ Выберите активность или подтвердите продолжение выше' : '⚠ Specify activity or confirm proceeding')
                    : isWebBudgetExceeded
                      ? (isRu ? '⚠ Превышен лимит файлов/символов для выбранного профиля' : '⚠ File/character limit exceeded')
                      : isLocalDebugBlocked
                        ? (isRu ? '⚠ Требуется подтвердить крупный локальный экспорт выше' : '⚠ Confirm large local export above')
                        : isInternalDebugRestricted
                          ? (isRu ? '⚠ Режим internal_debug разрешён только для локальной отладки' : '⚠ internal_debug restricted')
                          : null}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Success Screen */
          <div style={styles.body}>
            <div style={styles.successCard}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '3rem', marginBottom: '8px' }}>🎉</div>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'var(--accent-success)', margin: '0 0 8px 0' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Пакет LLM Pack успешно сформирован!' : 'LLM Pack Generated Successfully!'}
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '0.88rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {isRu
                  ? 'Пакет успешно скомпилирован и сохранён локально. Реальные идентификаторы атлета, пути и серийные номера оборудования очищены.'
                  : 'The package was successfully compiled and saved locally. Real athlete identities, paths, and Polar hardware details have been redacted.'}
              </p>

              <div style={styles.metaTable}>
                <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'ID пакета:' : 'Package ID:'}</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{exportResult.packId}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Имя файла:' : 'Filename:'}</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{exportResult.filename}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Размер ZIP:' : 'Size:'}</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{formatBytes(exportResult.sizeBytes)}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Файлов в архиве:' : 'Files Compiled:'}</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>
                    {isRu ? `${exportResult.entryCount} файлов` : `${exportResult.entryCount} entries`}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {exportResult.plan && (
                  <>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Текстовых символов:' : 'Text Characters:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>
                        {(() => {
                          const textChars = exportResult.plan.actual_text_characters || (exportResult.plan as any).actual_text_chars_total || (exportResult.plan.actual_text_bytes ? Math.round(exportResult.plan.actual_text_bytes * 0.95) : 0);
                          return isRu ? `${textChars.toLocaleString()} симв.` : `${textChars.toLocaleString()} chars`;
                        })()}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Объём текста:' : 'Text Bytes:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>{(exportResult.plan.actual_text_bytes ?? 0).toLocaleString()} B</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Объём бинарных данных:' : 'Binary Bytes:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>{(exportResult.plan.actual_binary_bytes ?? 0).toLocaleString()} B</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Общий несжатый объём:' : 'Uncompressed Size:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>{(exportResult.plan.actual_uncompressed_bytes ?? 0).toLocaleString()} B</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Размер ZIP-файла:' : 'ZIP File Size:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>{(exportResult.plan.actual_zip_bytes ?? 0).toLocaleString()} B</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                      <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Исключено дубликатов:' : 'Avoided Duplicates:'}</span>
                      <span style={styles.metaVal}>
                        {isRu
                          ? `${(exportResult.plan.duplicate_derived_files_avoided ?? 0).toLocaleString()} файлов`
                          : `${(exportResult.plan.duplicate_derived_files_avoided ?? 0).toLocaleString()} files`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
                <div style={styles.metaRow}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{isRu ? 'Директория экспорта:' : 'Export Directory:'}</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaValRed}>%LOCALAPPDATA%\H10AthleteCardioLab\llm_exports\</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.successActions}>
              <button
                className="btn"
                onClick={handleCopyPrompt}
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', border: '1px solid var(--border-medium)', color: '#fff' }}
              >
                📋 {copied ? (isRu ? 'Скопировано!' : 'Copied!') : (isRu ? 'Скопировать стартовый промпт' : 'Copy Start Prompt')}
              </button>
              
              {typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <button
                    id="btn-download-llm-pack-zip"
                    className="btn btn-primary"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        setSaveError(null);
                        setSaveResult(null);
                        const res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveLocalDebugPack({ packId: exportResult.packId });
                        if (res && res.status === 'saved') {
                          setSaveResult(res);
                        } else if (res && res.status === 'failed') {
                          setSaveError(res.safeMessage || 'Unknown save error');
                        }
                      } catch (e: any) {
                        setSaveError(e.message || 'Save exception');
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    ⬇️ {isRu ? 'Сохранить ZIP-архив...' : 'Download ZIP Archive'}
                  </button>
                  {saveResult && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#10b981', marginTop: '6px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      {isRu ? '✓ Сохранено в ' : '✓ Saved to '}<strong>{saveResult.filePath}</strong> ({saveResult.sizeBytes.toLocaleString()} {isRu ? 'байт' : 'bytes'})
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {saveError && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#ef4444', marginTop: '6px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      {isRu ? '❌ Ошибка: ' : '❌ Error: '}{saveError}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <a
                  href={api.downloadLlmPackUrl(exportResult.packId)}
                  download={exportResult.filename}
                  style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}
                >
                  <button className="btn btn-primary">
                    ⬇️ {isRu ? 'Сохранить ZIP-архив' : 'Download ZIP Archive'}
                  </button>
                </a>
              )}

              <button
                id="btn-goto-diary-from-export"
                className="btn btn-secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  onClose();
                  if (onNavigateToDiary) {
                    onNavigateToDiary();
                  } else {
                    window.location.hash = '#/diary';
                  }
                }}
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)', border: '1px solid #38bdf8', color: '#38bdf8' }}
              >
                📖 {isRu ? 'Импортировать в Дневник' : 'Import to Diary'}
              </button>

            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '16px' }}>
              <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>
                {isRu ? 'Закрыть' : 'Close'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';

export interface LockedAccessViewProps {
  targetMode: 'research' | 'pilot_operator' | 'pilot_participant';
  onReturn: () => void;
}

export function LockedAccessView({ targetMode, onReturn }: LockedAccessViewProps) {
  const { language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';

  const title = isRu ? 'Доступ ограничен' : 'Access Restricted';

  let description = '';
  let hint = '';

  switch (targetMode) {
    case 'research':
      description = isRu
        ? 'Исследовательское пространство доступно только авторизованным специалистам с локальным мандатом правомочий.'
        : 'Research workspace is accessible only to authorized operators with a verified local capability token.';
      hint = isRu
        ? 'Прямой доступ через URL или неавторизованные запросы заблокирован для защиты целостности данных.'
        : 'Direct URL hash navigation without verified local capability is blocked to ensure data integrity.';
      break;
    case 'pilot_operator':
      description = isRu
        ? 'Панель управления пилотом требует подтверждённых прав оператора.'
        : 'Pilot operations surface requires verified local operator authorization.';
      hint = isRu
        ? 'Для доступа к операционным функциям необходима авторизация через секрет оператора.'
        : 'Operator authorization is required to access participant and cohort management.';
      break;
    case 'pilot_participant':
      description = isRu
        ? 'Режим участника пилота недоступен. Требуется активная регистрация и привязка профиля к пилотному исследованию.'
        : 'Pilot participant mode is unavailable. Active enrollment and bound participant profile are required.';
      hint = isRu
        ? 'Обычные тренировочные и аналитические функции доступны в стандартном режиме атлета.'
        : 'Standard athlete training and analytics features are available in the regular athlete view.';
      break;
  }

  return (
    <div id="locked-access-view" style={styles.container}>
      <div style={styles.card}>
        <div style={styles.iconContainer}>
          <span style={styles.icon}>🔒</span>
        </div>
        <h2 id="locked-access-title" style={styles.title}>{title}</h2>
        <p id="locked-access-description" style={styles.description}>{description}</p>
        <p id="locked-access-hint" style={styles.hint}>{hint}</p>

        <div style={styles.actions}>
          <button
            id="btn-return-athlete"
            style={styles.primaryButton}
            onClick={onReturn}
          >
            {isRu ? 'Вернуться к анализу' : 'Return to Athlete Analysis'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const styles: Record<string, React.CSSProperties> = {
  container: {
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    minHeight: '60vh',
    padding: '32px 16px',
  },
  card: {
    maxWidth: '480px',
    width: '100%',
    background: 'hsl(222, 20%, 12%)',
    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
    borderRadius: '12px',
    padding: '36px 32px',
    textAlign: 'center',
    boxShadow: '0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
  },
  iconContainer: {
    width: '56px',
    height: '56px',
    borderRadius: '50%',
    background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
    border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)',
    display: 'flex',
