/**
 * CardioLab Workstation G5 — Longitudinal Timeline & Baseline Component
 * Accessible, bilingual (RU/EN), non-diagnostic, strictly truthful representation of longitudinal data.
 */

import React from 'react';
import {
  LongitudinalSnapshot,
  LongitudinalMetricBaseline,
  LongitudinalChangeCard,
  LongitudinalObservationPoint
} from '../../shared/longitudinalContract';

export interface LongitudinalTimelineProps {
  snapshot: LongitudinalSnapshot;
  locale?: 'ru' | 'en';
  onSelectSession?: (sessionId: string) => void;
  onSaveView?: () => void;
}

export const LongitudinalTimeline: React.FC<LongitudinalTimelineProps> = ({
  snapshot,
  locale = 'ru',
  onSelectSession,
  onSaveView
}) => {
  const isRu = locale === 'ru';
  const { query, per_metric_baselines, change_cards, ordered_observation_points } = snapshot;

  const independentCount = ordered_observation_points.filter(p => !p.is_duplicate_source && p.lineage_state === 'current').length;
  const duplicateCount = ordered_observation_points.filter(p => p.is_duplicate_source).length;

  return (
    <section
      role="region"
      aria-label={isRu ? 'Продольный анализ и персональный диапазон' : 'Longitudinal Analysis & Personal Baseline'}
      className="longitudinal-timeline-container"
      style={{
        padding: '1.25rem',
        backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
        borderRadius: '0.5rem',
        color: '#f9fafb',
        fontFamily: 'sans-serif'
      }}
    >
      {/* Header & Query Scope */}
      <header style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {isRu ? 'Персональная продольная динамика' : 'Personal Longitudinal Dynamics'}
          </h2>
          <p style={{ margin: '0.25rem 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.875rem', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
            {isRu ? 'Профиль' : 'Profile'}: <strong>{query.profile_id}</strong> | {isRu ? 'Независимых сессий' : 'Independent sessions'}: <strong>{independentCount}</strong>
            {duplicateCount > 0 && ` (${isRu ? 'дубликатов исключено' : 'duplicates excluded'}: ${duplicateCount})`}
          </p>
        </div>
        {onSaveView && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onSaveView}
            style={{
              padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
              backgroundColor: '#3b82f6',
              color: '#ffffff',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: '0.375rem',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontWeight: 500
            }}
          >
            {isRu ? 'Сохранить представление' : 'Save View'}
          </button>
        )}
      </header>

      {/* Per-Metric Baseline Cards */}
      <div
        role="group"
        aria-label={isRu ? 'Базовые референсные диапазоны по показателям' : 'Metric Baseline Reference Ranges'}
        style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))', gap: '0.75rem', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}
      >
        {Object.entries(per_metric_baselines).map(([metricKey, baseline]) => {
          return (
            <div
              key={metricKey}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#111827',
                padding: '1rem',
                borderRadius: '0.375rem',
                border: baseline.is_ready ? '1px solid #10b981' : '1px solid #6b7280'
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                  {metricKey} ({baseline.unit})
                </span>
                <span
                  style={{
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    padding: '0.125rem 0.5rem',
                    borderRadius: '0.25rem',
                    backgroundColor: baseline.is_ready ? '#065f46' : '#374151',
                    color: baseline.is_ready ? '#34d399' : '#d1d5db'
                  }}
                >
                  {baseline.is_ready
                    ? (isRu ? `Готов (${baseline.eligible_independent_peer_count} сессий)` : `Ready (${baseline.eligible_independent_peer_count} peers)`)
                    : (isRu ? `Недостаточно (${baseline.eligible_independent_peer_count}/${baseline.required_peer_count})` : `Insufficient (${baseline.eligible_independent_peer_count}/${baseline.required_peer_count})`)}
                </span>
              </div>

              {baseline.is_ready ? (
                <div style={{ marginTop: '0.75rem', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                  <div>{isRu ? 'Медиана' : 'Median'}: <strong>{baseline.median} {baseline.unit}</strong></div>
                  <div style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                    {isRu ? 'Диапазон (P25–P75)' : 'Range (P25–P75)'}: {baseline.p25} – {baseline.p75} {baseline.unit}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#9ca3af', margin: '0.5rem 0 0 0' }}>
                  {isRu
                    ? `Требуется минимум ${baseline.required_peer_count} качественных сессий.`
                    : `Requires at least ${baseline.required_peer_count} qualified sessions.`}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Target Change Cards (if target session selected) */}
      {snapshot.target_session_id && Object.keys(change_cards).length > 0 && (
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label={isRu ? 'Сопоставление целевой сессии с диапазоном' : 'Target Session Comparison Cards'}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#111827',
            padding: '1rem',
            borderRadius: '0.375rem',
            marginBottom: '1.5rem',
            border: '1px solid #374151'
          }}
        >
          <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 0.75rem 0', fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {isRu ? 'Сопоставление целевой сессии' : 'Target Session Comparison'} ({snapshot.target_session_id})
          </h3>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
            {Object.entries(change_cards).map(([mKey, card]) => (
              <div
                key={mKey}
                style={{
                  padding: '0.75rem',
                  backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
                  borderRadius: '0.25rem',
                  fontSize: '0.875rem'
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{mKey}</span>
                  <span
                    style={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      padding: '0.125rem 0.375rem',
                      borderRadius: '0.25rem',
                      backgroundColor: card.change_class === 'within_reference' ? '#1e3a8a' : '#374151',
                      color: '#e0e7ff'
                    }}
                  >
                    {card.change_class}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '0.375rem 0 0 0', color: '#d1d5db', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  {isRu ? card.descriptive_summary_ru : card.descriptive_summary_en}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p style={{ margin: '0.75rem 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#9ca3af', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            {isRu
              ? 'Данное сопоставление носит исключительно описательный характер и не является медицинским диагнозом или тренировочным предписанием.'
              : 'This comparison is strictly descriptive and does not constitute medical diagnosis or exercise prescription.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Observation Points Table */}
      <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '0.8125rem', textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #374151', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>#</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{isRu ? 'Сессия' : 'Session'}</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{isRu ? 'Дата/Время' : 'Date/Time'}</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{isRu ? 'Активность' : 'Activity'}</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>RMSSD (ms)</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>Avg HR (bpm)</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{isRu ? 'Статус' : 'Status'}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {ordered_observation_points.map((obs) => {
              const isTarget = obs.session_id === snapshot.target_session_id;
              const rmssd = obs.metrics['rmssd']?.value;
              const avgHr = obs.metrics['avg_hr']?.value;

              return (
                <tr
                  key={obs.session_id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectSession && onSelectSession(obs.session_id)}
                  style={{
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #2d3748',
                    backgroundColor: isTarget ? '#374151' : 'transparent',
                    cursor: onSelectSession ? 'pointer' : 'default'
                  }}
                >
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{obs.ordinal_index}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem', fontWeight: isTarget ? 600 : 400 }}>
                    {obs.session_id} {isTarget && (isRu ? '(целевая)' : '(target)')}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{obs.timestamp_utc.slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{obs.activity_type || '—'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>
                    {rmssd !== null && rmssd !== undefined ? rmssd : (isRu ? 'Удержан' : 'Withheld')}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>
                    {avgHr !== null && avgHr !== undefined ? avgHr : (isRu ? 'Удержан' : 'Withheld')}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>
                    {obs.is_duplicate_source ? (
                      <span style={{ color: '#f59e0b' }}>{isRu ? 'Дубликат' : 'Duplicate'}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>{isRu ? 'Независимая' : 'Independent'}</span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { metricDefinitions, MetricStatus } from '../../shared/metricDefinitions';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { TermTooltip } from './TermTooltip';

interface MetricCardProps {
  metricKey: string;
  value: string;
  unit?: string;
  color?: string;
  status?: MetricStatus;
  qualityNote?: string;
  hasBaseline?: boolean; // If false, show the "Недостаточно личной истории..." note
  interpretation?: string;
  isDeemphasized?: boolean;
  referenceValue?: string | null;
  blockingReasons?: string[];
}

export function MetricCard({
  metricKey,
  value,
  unit,
  color = '#38bdf8',
  status,
  qualityNote,
  hasBaseline = false,
  interpretation,
  isDeemphasized = false,
  referenceValue,
  blockingReasons
}: MetricCardProps) {
  const { language } = useT();

  const def = metricDefinitions[metricKey];
  if (!def) {
    // Fallback if metric key is not found
    return (
      <div className="kpi-card" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <div className="kpi-label">{metricKey}</div>
        <div className="kpi-value" style={{ color }}>{value}</div>
        <div className="kpi-unit">{unit}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const label = language === 'en' ? def.labelEn : def.labelRu;
  const displayUnit = unit || (language === 'en' ? def.unitEn : def.unitRu) || '';

  // Determine status automatically if not provided
  let resolvedStatus: MetricStatus = status || 'within_baseline';
  if (value === '—' || !value || value === 'NaN' || value === 'null') {
    resolvedStatus = 'insufficient_data';
  }

  // Wording for status pills
  const statusLabelsRu: Record<MetricStatus, string> = {
    within_baseline: 'В рамках личного baseline',
    above_baseline: 'Выше личного baseline',
    below_baseline: 'Ниже личного baseline',
    quality_limited: 'Ограничено качеством данных',
    insufficient_data: 'Недостаточно данных',
    not_applicable: 'Не применимо',
    unknown: 'Неизвестно',
    technical_error: 'Техническая ошибка',
  };

  const statusLabelsEn: Record<MetricStatus, string> = {
    within_baseline: 'Within baseline',
    above_baseline: 'Above baseline',
    below_baseline: 'Below baseline',
    quality_limited: 'Quality limited',
    insufficient_data: 'Insufficient data',
    not_applicable: 'Not applicable',
    unknown: 'Unknown',
    technical_error: 'Technical error',
  };

  const statusLabel = language === 'en' ? statusLabelsEn[resolvedStatus] : statusLabelsRu[resolvedStatus];

  // Colors for status pills
  const getStatusStyle = (statusVal: MetricStatus) => {
    switch (statusVal) {
      case 'within_baseline':
        return hasBaseline 
          ? { bg: '#22c55e22', border: '#22c55e44', text: '#4ade80' }
          : { bg: '#64748b22', border: '#64748b44', text: '#94a3b8' }; // Gray "reference" if no baseline
      case 'above_baseline':
      case 'below_baseline':
        return { bg: '#eab30822', border: '#eab30844', text: '#facc15' };
      case 'quality_limited':
        return { bg: '#eab30822', border: '#eab30844', text: '#facc15' };
      case 'insufficient_data':
      case 'not_applicable':
      case 'unknown':
        return { bg: '#64748b22', border: '#64748b44', text: '#94a3b8' };
      case 'technical_error':
        return { bg: '#ef444422', border: '#ef444444', text: '#f87171' };
    }
  };

  const statusStyle = getStatusStyle(resolvedStatus);

  return (
    <div 
      className="kpi-card" 
      style={{ 
        position: 'relative',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        padding: '16px',
        backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
        border: '1px solid #334155',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        minHeight: '140px',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header with Label and Help Button Tooltip */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontWeight: '500' }}>{label}</span>
        <TermTooltip
          metricKey={metricKey}
          hasBaseline={hasBaseline}
          resolvedStatus={resolvedStatus}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Value and Unit */}
      <div style={{ margin: '12px 0 8px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '4px' }}>
        {isDeemphasized || resolvedStatus === 'not_applicable' ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2px' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: '600', color: '#94a3b8', letterSpacing: '-0.01em' }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Недоступно для интерпретации' : 'Unavailable for interpretation'}
            </span>
            {(referenceValue || (value !== '—' && value)) && (
              <span 
                style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '2px' }}
                title={language === 'ru' ? 'Рассчитано справочно, заблокировано правилом валидности' : 'Calculated for audit reference only; blocked by eligibility criteria'}
              >
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Справочный расчет:' : 'Reference calculation:'} {referenceValue || value} {displayUnit}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '2rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color }}>{value}</span>
            {displayUnit && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#64748b', marginLeft: '6px' }}>{displayUnit}</span>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer with Status Pill */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
        {interpretation && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#cbd5e1', marginBottom: '2px', fontWeight: '500' }} className="kpi-interpretation-line">
            {interpretation}
          </div>
        )}
        <div 
          style={{
            alignSelf: 'flex-start',
            padding: '2px 8px',
            fontSize: '0.7rem',
            fontWeight: 'bold',
            borderRadius: '12px',
            backgroundColor: statusStyle.bg,
            border: `1px solid ${statusStyle.border}`,
            color: statusStyle.text,
          }}
        >
          {resolvedStatus === 'within_baseline' && !hasBaseline
            ? (language === 'en' ? 'Personal baseline is not formed' : 'Личный профиль не сформирован')
            : statusLabel}
        </div>
        {blockingReasons && blockingReasons.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '2px', lineHeight: '1.2' }}>
            {blockingReasons[0]}
          </div>
        )}
        {qualityNote && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#eab308' }}>{qualityNote}</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { api } from '../api';

interface OnboardingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onLoadSampleProject?: () => void;
}

export function OnboardingModal({ isOpen, onClose, onLoadSampleProject }: OnboardingModalProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [loadingSample, setLoadingSample] = React.useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleDismiss = async () => {
    if (loadingSample) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await api.dismissOnboarding();
    } catch (_) {}
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSample = async () => {
    if (loadingSample) return;
    setLoadingSample(true);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('cardiolab_onboarding_shown', 'true');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await api.dismissOnboarding();
      if (onLoadSampleProject) {
        await onLoadSampleProject();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error in handleSample:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingSample(false);
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="onboarding-title"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 1000,
        padding: '20px',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #334155',
          borderRadius: '12px',
          padding: '32px',
          maxWidth: '560px',
          width: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: '20px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '32px', filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,60,60,0.5))' }}>❤</span>
          <div>
            <h2 id="onboarding-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.4rem', color: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              {t('onboardingTitle')}
            </h2>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '2px' }}>
              {t('onboardingSubtitle')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#cbd5e1', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
          {t('onboardingWelcomeText')}
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
            border: '1px solid #f59e0b44',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            padding: '12px 16px',
            fontSize: '0.82rem',
            color: '#fbbf24',
            lineHeight: '1.4',
          }}
        >
          <strong>⚠️</strong> {t('onboardingNonMedical')}
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.80rem',
            color: '#94a3b8',
            lineHeight: '1.4',
            backgroundColor: '#0f172a80',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: '1px solid #334155'
          }}
        >
          <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Конфиденциальность:' : 'Privacy:'}</strong>{' '}
          {language === 'ru'
            ? 'Базовый анализ выполняется локально. Внешняя передача данных происходит исключительно по явному действию пользователя через видимый пакет экспорта.'
            : 'Core analysis runs locally. External transfer occurs only through an explicit user action and a visible export package.'}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px', marginTop: '8px' }}>
          <button
            id="onboarding-load-sample-btn"
            type="button"
            className="btn btn-primary"
            onClick={handleSample}
            disabled={loadingSample}
            style={{
              padding: '12px 20px',
              fontSize: '0.92rem',
              fontWeight: 600,
              backgroundColor: loadingSample ? '#2563eb88' : '#3b82f6',
              color: '#ffffff',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              cursor: loadingSample ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: '8px',
            }}
          >
            <span>{loadingSample ? '⏳' : '📁'}</span> {loadingSample ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Загрузка...' : 'Loading...') : t('onboardingLoadSample')}
          </button>

          <button
            id="onboarding-dismiss-btn"
            type="button"
            className="btn btn-secondary"
            onClick={handleDismiss}
            disabled={loadingSample}
            style={{
              padding: '10px 16px',
              fontSize: '0.88rem',
              backgroundColor: 'transparent',
              color: loadingSample ? '#64748b' : '#94a3b8',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              cursor: loadingSample ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {t('onboardingGetStarted')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  sessionId,
  onNavigateToSession,
  onReportGenerated
}: OneRecordingPilotCardProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [projection, setProjection] = useState<OneRecordingPilotProjection | null>(null);
  const [generatingReport, setGeneratingReport] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [confirmingOutcome, setConfirmingOutcome] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedAction, setSelectedAction] = useState<string>('store_in_personal_records');
  const [userNotes, setUserNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadProjection = async () => {
    if (!profileId || profileId === 'unresolved') {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await getPilotProjectionApi(profileId);
      if (res.success && res.projection) {
        setProjection(res.projection);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка загрузки проекции пилота';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProjection();
  }, [profileId, sessionId]);

  const handleGenerateReport = async () => {
    const targetSessionId = sessionId || projection?.session_id;
    if (!profileId || !targetSessionId) return;

    setGeneratingReport(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await generatePilotReportApi({
        sessionId: targetSessionId,
        profileId,
        contextType: projection?.context.type || 'whole_recording',
        windowRootId: projection?.context.window_id,
        windowRevision: projection?.context.window_revision
      });
      if (res.success && res.report) {
        setSuccessMsg(`Отчет пилота успешно сформирован (Манифест: ${res.report.manifest_id})`);
        if (onReportGenerated) {
          onReportGenerated(res.report);
        }
        await loadProjection();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка формирования отчета пилота';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setGeneratingReport(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmOutcome = async () => {
    const targetSessionId = sessionId || projection?.session_id;
    if (!profileId || !targetSessionId || !projection?.artifact?.artifact_id || !projection?.episode_id) return;

    setConfirmingOutcome(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const stableIdempotencyKey = `cmd-pilot-confirm-${profileId}-${projection.artifact.artifact_id}-${selectedAction}`;
      const res = await executeJourneyCommandApi({
        profile_id: profileId,
        expected_revision: projection.selection_revision,
        idempotency_key: stableIdempotencyKey,
        command: {
          command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome',
          artifact_id: projection.artifact.artifact_id,
          episode_id: projection.episode_id,
          selected_action: selectedAction,
          user_notes: userNotes.trim() ? userNotes.trim() : undefined
        }
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setSuccessMsg('Полезный исход успешно подтвержден и зафиксирован в локальной базе!');
        await loadProjection();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка подтверждения исхода пилота';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setConfirmingOutcome(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading && !projection) {
    return (
      <div id="one-recording-pilot-card" style={styles.card}>
        <span style={styles.loadingText}>Загрузка статуса одной записи...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!projection) {
    return null;
  }

  const isCompleted = projection.stage === 'completed' || projection.downstream_action.is_confirmed;
  const targetSession = sessionId || projection.session_id;

  return (
    <div id="one-recording-pilot-card" style={styles.card}>
      <div style={styles.statusHeader}>
        <div>
          <span style={styles.activeTag}>ONE-RECORDING PILOT</span>
          <h2 style={styles.cardTitle}>Анализ одной записи (Own-Data Pilot)</h2>
        </div>
        <div style={styles.participantMeta}>
          <div><strong>Стадия:</strong> {projection.stage}</div>
          <div><strong>Сессия:</strong> {targetSession || 'Не выбрана'}</div>
          <div><strong>Контекст:</strong> {projection.context.context_label}</div>
          <div><strong>Следующее действие:</strong> {projection.exact_next_safe_action}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {errorMsg && (
        <div style={styles.errorBox}>
          <span>⚠ {errorMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {successMsg && (
        <div style={styles.successBox}>
          <span>✓ {successMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {projection.quality && (
        <div style={styles.qualityBox}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
            <strong>Качество записи:</strong>{' '}
            {projection.quality.decision === 'usable'
              ? '✓ Пригодно'
              : projection.quality.decision === 'quality_limited'
              ? '⚠ Ограничено'
              : '✖ Недостаточно'}{' '}
            — {projection.quality.decision_reason_ru}
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '4px' }}>
            NN отсчетов: {projection.quality.accepted_nn_count} | Исключено: {projection.quality.excluded_count} |
            Покрытие: {(projection.quality.coverage_ratio * 100).toFixed(0)}%
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={styles.metricsGrid}>
        {Object.entries(projection.metrics || {}).map(([key, item]) => (
          <div key={key} style={styles.metricItem}>
            <span style={styles.metricLabel}>{item.label}</span>
            <span style={styles.metricValue}>
              {item.value !== null && item.value !== undefined
                ? `${typeof item.value === 'number' ? Math.round(item.value) : item.value} ${item.unit}`
                : '— (удержано)'}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: item.is_eligible ? '#34d399' : '#f87171' }}>
              {item.is_eligible ? 'Рассчитано' : item.withholding_reason || 'Удержано'}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={styles.buttonRow}>
        {!isCompleted && targetSession && (
          <button
            type="button"
            id="pilot-generate-report-btn"
            style={styles.primaryButton}
            onClick={handleGenerateReport}
            disabled={generatingReport || projection.quality?.decision === 'insufficient'}
          >
            {generatingReport ? 'Генерация отчета...' : 'Сформировать отчет пилота'}
          </button>
        )}

        {projection.artifact?.is_current && !projection.downstream_action.is_confirmed && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px', width: '100%', marginTop: '8px' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <select
                id="pilot-action-select"
                value={selectedAction}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedAction(e.target.value)}
                style={styles.selectInput}
              >
                <option value="store_in_personal_records">Сохранить в личных записях</option>
                <option value="continue_in_cardiolab">Продолжить анализ в CardioLab</option>
                <option value="open_in_external_analyzer">Экспорт для внешнего анализатора</option>
                <option value="share_manually">Экспорт для тренера/врача</option>
              </select>
              <input
                id="pilot-user-notes"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Заметка к сессии (необязательно)..."
                value={userNotes}
                onChange={(e) => setUserNotes(e.target.value)}
                style={styles.textInput}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                id="pilot-confirm-outcome-btn"
                style={styles.secondaryButton}
                onClick={handleConfirmOutcome}
                disabled={confirmingOutcome || !projection.episode_id}
                title={!projection.episode_id ? 'Требуется привязка к эпизоду' : undefined}
              >
                {confirmingOutcome ? 'Подтверждение...' : 'Подтвердить полезный исход'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {isCompleted && (
          <div style={styles.completedBadge}>
            ✓ Полезный исход подтвержден ({projection.downstream_action.action_code || 'store_in_personal_records'})
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

interface OverlayRootProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function OverlayRoot({ children }: OverlayRootProps) {
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let el = document.getElementById('overlay-root');
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = 'overlay-root';
      document.body.appendChild(el);
    }
    setTarget(el);
  }, []);

  if (!target) return null;

  return createPortal(children, target);
}

FILE: src/frontend/components/PageSnapshotButton.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { generatePageSnapshot } from '../snapshot/pageSnapshot';

interface Props {
  pageName: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export function PageSnapshotButton({ pageName, metadata = {} }: Props) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [includeNotes, setIncludeNotes] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'failed'>('idle');

  const handleExportSnapshot = async () => {
    setStatus('saving');
    try {
      const mainContent = document.querySelector('.main-content') as HTMLElement;
      if (!mainContent) {
        setStatus('failed');
        return;
      }

      let buildInfo = null;
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI) {
        buildInfo = await (window as any).electronAPI.getSafeBuildInfo();
      }

      const fullMetadata = {
        ...metadata,
        buildInfo
      };

      // Generate the snapshot using the PageSnapshot service
      const htmlContent = await generatePageSnapshot(pageName, mainContent, fullMetadata, { includeNotes });

      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
      const cleanPageName = pageName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
      const dateStr = timestamp.substring(0, 19).replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace('T', '_');
      const fileName = `h10_athlete_snapshot_${cleanPageName}_${dateStr}.html`;

      let saved = false;
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI) {
        const res = await (window as any).electronAPI.savePageSnapshot({ htmlContent, suggestedFileName: fileName });
        if (res.status === 'saved') {
          saved = true;
        } else if (res.status === 'canceled') {
          setStatus('idle');
          return;
        } else {
          setStatus('failed');
          setTimeout(() => setStatus('idle'), 5000);
          return;
        }
      } else if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).showSaveFilePicker) {
        try {
          const handle = await (window as any).showSaveFilePicker({
            suggestedName: fileName,
            types: [{
              description: 'HTML Document',
              accept: { 'text/html': ['.html'] }
            }]
          });
          const writable = await handle.createWritable();
          await writable.write(htmlContent);
          await writable.close();
          saved = true;
        } catch (err) {
          if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError') {
            setStatus('idle');
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!saved && (!window || !(window as any).electronAPI)) {
        const blob = new Blob([htmlContent], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8;' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = url;
        link.setAttribute('download', fileName);
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }

      setStatus('saved');
      setTimeout(() => setStatus('idle'), 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[PageSnapshot] Snapshot export failed:', err);
      setStatus('failed');
      setTimeout(() => setStatus('idle'), 5000);
    }
  };

  const statusLabels = {
    saving: language === 'ru' ? 'Сохранение...' : 'Saving...',
    saved: language === 'ru' ? 'Сохранено!' : 'Saved!',
    failed: language === 'ru' ? 'Ошибка!' : 'Failed!'
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
      <label style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={includeNotes}
          onChange={(e) => setIncludeNotes(e.target.checked)}
          style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
        />
        {language === 'ru' ? 'Включить видимые заметки' : 'Include visible notes'}
      </label>

      <button
        id="btn-export-snapshot"
        className="btn btn-ghost"
        onClick={handleExportSnapshot}
        disabled={status === 'saving'}
        style={{
          border: '1px solid var(--border-color)',
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '6px',
          cursor: 'pointer'
        }}
      >
        💾 {status === 'idle' ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Сохранить страницу' : 'Save Page') : statusLabels[status]}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';

interface PoincarePlotProps {
  intervals?: number[];
  pointPairs?: [number, number][];
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  canonicalSd1?: number | null;
  canonicalSd2?: number | null;
  canonicalRatio?: number | null;
  eligibilityState?: string;
  includedBeatCount?: number;
  artifactPercentage?: number;
}

/**
 * Canvas-based Poincaré scatter plot consuming strictly canonical MetricResults.
 * X-axis: RR[n], Y-axis: RR[n+1].
 */
export function PoincarePlot({
  intervals = [],
  pointPairs,
  width = 280,
  height = 280,
  canonicalSd1,
  canonicalSd2,
  canonicalRatio,
  eligibilityState,
  includedBeatCount,
  artifactPercentage
}: PoincarePlotProps) {
  const { language } = useT();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const closeButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [isZoomed, setIsZoomed] = useState(false);

  // Resolved point pairs strictly from canonical window
  const pairs: [number, number][] = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (pointPairs && pointPairs.length > 0) {
      return pointPairs;
    }
    if (intervals && intervals.length >= 2) {
      const p: [number, number][] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < intervals.length - 1; i++) {
        p.push([intervals[i], intervals[i + 1]]);
      }
      return p;
    }
    return [];
  }, [pointPairs, intervals]);

  const allVals = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (pairs.length > 0) {
      const vals: number[] = [];
      for (const [x, y] of pairs) {
        vals.push(x, y);
      }
      return vals;
    }
    return intervals;
  }, [pairs, intervals]);

  const range = allVals.length > 0 ? Math.max(...allVals) - Math.min(...allVals) : 0;
  const isInsufficient = pairs.length < 10 || range < 5 || eligibilityState === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';

  const displayBeatCount = includedBeatCount !== undefined
    ? includedBeatCount
    : (pairs.length > 0 ? pairs.length + 1 : intervals.length);

  // Draw canvas
  const drawCanvas = (canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, w: number, h: number) => {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = w * dpr;
    canvas.height = h * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${h}px`;
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // Clear background
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(13,17,23,0.0)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    if (isInsufficient || pairs.length === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.8)';
      ctx.font = '11px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(
        language === 'ru' 
          ? 'Недостаточно непрерывных данных (>=300с)' 
          : 'Insufficient continuous data (>=300s)',
        w / 2, 
        h / 2
      );
      return;
    }

    const PADDING = 40;
    const minV = Math.max(200, Math.min(...allVals) - 50);
    const maxV = Math.min(2000, Math.max(...allVals) + 50);
    const vRange = maxV - minV > 0 ? maxV - minV : 1;

    const toX = (v: number) => PADDING + ((v - minV) / vRange) * (w - PADDING * 2);
    const toY = (v: number) => h - PADDING - ((v - minV) / vRange) * (h - PADDING * 2);

    // Draw identity line (y = x)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.moveTo(toX(minV), toY(minV));
    ctx.lineTo(toX(maxV), toY(maxV));
    ctx.stroke();

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.font = '10px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('RR[n] (мс)', w / 2, h - 8);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(14, h / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText('RR[n+1] (мс)', 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    // Draw min/max labels
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(minV)}`, PADDING, h - PADDING + 14);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(maxV)}`, w - PADDING, h - PADDING + 14);

    // Draw points
    pairs.forEach(([x, y]) => {
      const dist = Math.abs(y - x);
      const hue = dist < 50 ? 152 : dist < 100 ? 38 : 6;
      const alpha = Math.min(0.7, 0.2 + 0.5 * (1 - dist / 400));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(toX(x), toY(y), w > 300 ? 3.5 : 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 80%, 60%, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.fill();
    });

    // Draw centroid
    const cx = pairs.reduce((s, p) => s + p[0], 0) / pairs.length;
    const cy = pairs.reduce((s, p) => s + p[1], 0) / pairs.length;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(toX(cx), toY(cy), 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,160,255,0.6)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,160,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (canvas) drawCanvas(canvas, width, height);
  }, [pairs, allVals, width, height, isInsufficient]);

  // Modal accessibility hooks
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isZoomed) return;
    
    closeButtonRef.current?.focus();

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsZoomed(false);
        triggerRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isZoomed]);

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsZoomed(false);
    setTimeout(() => triggerRef.current?.focus(), 50);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
      <div className="poincare-container" style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid #1e293b' }} />
        
        {!isInsufficient && pairs.length > 0 && (
          <button
            ref={triggerRef}
            type="button"
            id="btn-poincare-zoom"
            onClick={() => setIsZoomed(true)}
            aria-haspopup="dialog"
            aria-label={language === 'ru' ? 'Увеличить диаграмму Пуанкаре' : 'Enlarge Poincaré plot'}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: '45px',
              right: '15px',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85)',
              color: '#f8fafc',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '4px',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontWeight: 'bold',
            }}
          >
            🔍 {language === 'ru' ? 'Увеличить' : 'Enlarge'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Poincaré Metrics Display */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr',
        gap: '8px',
        backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
        padding: '10px',
        borderRadius: '6px',
        border: '1px solid #1e293b',
        fontSize: '0.8rem',
      }}>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>SD1 (Поперечная):</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{canonicalSd1 != null ? `${canonicalSd1.toFixed(1)} мс` : '—'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>SD2 (Продольная):</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{canonicalSd2 != null ? `${canonicalSd2.toFixed(1)} мс` : '—'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>SD1/SD2 Ratio:</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{canonicalRatio != null ? canonicalRatio.toFixed(2) : '—'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Применимость:' : 'Eligibility:'}</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: eligibilityState === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#34d399' : '#f87171' }}>
            {eligibilityState === 'ELIGIBLE' 
              ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Соответствует' : 'Eligible')
              : (language === 'ru' ? 'Не применимо' : 'Not Eligible')}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Удары NN (Окно):' : 'Window NN Beats:'}</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{displayBeatCount > 0 ? displayBeatCount : '—'}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Артефакты:' : 'Artifacts:'}</span>{' '}
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{artifactPercentage != null ? `${artifactPercentage.toFixed(1)}%` : '—'}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Explanation text block */}
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
        border: '1px solid #1e293b',
        borderRadius: '6px',
        padding: '12px',
        fontSize: '0.8rem',
        lineHeight: '1.4',
        color: '#94a3b8',
      }}>
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '4px' }}>
          <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Геометрическая интерпретация:' : 'Geometric Interpretation:'}
          </strong>{' '}
          {language === 'ru'
            ? 'Диаграмма Пуанкаре отражает геометрическое распределение последовательных пар кардиоинтервалов. SD1 измеряет дисперсию перпендикулярно линии идентичности, а SD2 — дисперсию вдоль линии идентичности.'
            : 'Poincaré plot reflects geometric dispersion of consecutive RR interval pairs. SD1 measures transverse dispersion perpendicular to identity line, while SD2 measures longitudinal dispersion along identity line.'}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Предупреждение:' : 'Warning:'}
          </strong>{' '}
          {language === 'ru'

            : 'This is a non-diagnostic plot. It does not diagnose cardiac rhythm disorders, illness, autonomic tone, or recovery state.'}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Zoom Modal overlay */}
      {isZoomed && (
        <div
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-labelledby="poincare-modal-title"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)',
            display: 'block',
            overflowY: 'auto',
            zIndex: 999,
            padding: '20px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
            border: '1px solid #334155',
            borderRadius: '12px',
            padding: '24px',
            maxWidth: '600px',
            width: '100%',
            margin: '40px auto',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: '16px',
            boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <h3 id="poincare-modal-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.2rem', color: '#f8fafc' }}>

              </h3>
              <button

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import {
  DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG,
  PricingExperimentConfig,
  PricingPlanOption
} from '../../shared/pricingExperimentContract';

interface PricingExperimentModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function PricingExperimentModal({ isOpen, onClose }: PricingExperimentModalProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PricingExperimentConfig>(DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG);
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [intentSubmitted, setIntentSubmitted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exposureId, setExposureId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      api.getPricingExperiment()
        .then((data) => {
          if (data && Array.isArray(data.plans)) {
            setConfig(data);
          }
          if (data && data.exposure_id) {
            setExposureId(data.exposure_id);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          // fallback to DEFAULT_PRICING_EXPERIMENT_CONFIG
        });

      // Track offer viewed
      api.trackPricingEvent({
        event_type: 'plans_viewed',
        source_view: 'PricingExperimentModal',
        timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSelectPlan = async (plan: PricingPlanOption) => {
    setSelectedPlan(plan.plan_id);
    setIntentSubmitted(true);
    try {
      await api.trackPricingEvent({
        event_type: 'plan_interest_selected',
        plan_id: plan.plan_id,
        tier: plan.tier,
        exposure_id: exposureId || undefined,
        source_view: 'PricingExperimentModal',
        timestamp_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch {
      // safe fallback
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="pricing-experiment-title"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 1000,
        padding: '20px',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #334155',
          borderRadius: '12px',
          padding: '28px',
          maxWidth: '800px',
          width: '100%',
          maxHeight: '90vh',
          overflowY: 'auto',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <h2 id="pricing-experiment-title" style={{ margin: 0, color: '#f8fafc', fontSize: '1.4rem' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Тарифные планы (Бета-исследование)' : 'Pricing Corridors (Closed Beta Research)'}
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              color: '#94a3b8',
              fontSize: '1.5rem',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '4px',
            }}
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            &times;
          </button>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            padding: '12px 16px',
            marginBottom: '20px',
            fontSize: '0.85rem',
            color: '#93c5fd',
            lineHeight: 1.5,
          }}
        >
          <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Исследовательские ценовые ориентиры (Beta): ' : 'Research Notice: '}</strong>
          {language === 'ru'
            ? 'Указанные ценовые коридоры являются гипотезами для исследования в рамках закрытого бета-тестирования и сбора обратной связи. Настоящая версия не является публичной офертой и не осуществляет приём платежей.'
            : (config.disclaimer?.startsWith('PRICING_EXPERIMENT_NOTICE:') ? config.disclaimer.replace('PRICING_EXPERIMENT_NOTICE: ', '') : config.disclaimer)}
        </div>

        {intentSubmitted && (
          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4)',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              padding: '12px 16px',
              marginBottom: '20px',
              color: '#4ade80',
              fontSize: '0.9rem',
            }}
          >
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Спасибо за ваш интерес! Это исследовательский опрос закрытого бета-тестирования. Реальные платежи не принимаются, оплата не требуется.'
              : 'Thank you for your feedback! This is a closed-beta willingness-to-pay research signal. No real payment is processed.'}
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '16px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
          {config.plans.map((plan) => {

            return (
              <div

                  backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                  border: isSelected ? '2px solid #3b82f6' : '1px solid #334155',
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  padding: '18px',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px 0', color: '#f1f5f9', fontSize: '1.1rem', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
                    {plan.tier}
                  </h3>
                  <div style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.8rem', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                    {plan.target_persona}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#38bdf8', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                    ${plan.suggested_price_usd}
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 400 }}>
                      {' '}/{plan.billing_model.replace('_', ' ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Коридор: ' : 'Corridor: '}${plan.price_corridor_min_usd} - ${plan.price_corridor_max_usd}
                  </div>
                  <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '18px', color: '#cbd5e1', fontSize: '0.82rem', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                    {plan.feature_highlights.map((feat, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx}>{feat}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleSelectPlan(plan)}
                  disabled={isSelected}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '20px',
                    padding: '10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    border: 'none',
                    backgroundColor: isSelected ? '#15803d' : '#2563eb',
                    color: '#ffffff',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    cursor: isSelected ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                    transition: 'background-color 0.2s',
                  }}
                >
                  {isSelected
                    ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Выбран (Отзыв учтен)' : 'Selected (Feedback Recorded)')
                    : (language === 'ru' ? 'Выразить интерес' : 'Express Interest')}
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              padding: '8px 16px',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              backgroundColor: '#334155',
              color: '#e2e8f0',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              fontSize: '0.9rem',
            }}
          >
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Закрыть' : 'Close'}
          </button>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
