  const [authorityClass, setAuthorityClass] = useState('operator_evidence');

  // Owner Decision Envelope Form State
  const [showDecisionModal, setShowDecisionModal] = useState(false);
  const [envelopeJson, setEnvelopeJson] = useState('');

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [gatesRes, preflightRes, decisionsRes] = await Promise.all([
        getReleaseGatesListApi(),
        evaluateFinalAcceptancePreflightApi(),
        listOwnerDecisionsApi({ activeOnly: true })
      ]);

      if (gatesRes.success) {
        setGates(gatesRes.gates || []);
        setCandidate(gatesRes.candidate);
      }
      if (preflightRes.success) {
        setPreflight(preflightRes.preflight);
      }
      if (decisionsRes.success) {
        setDecisions(decisionsRes.decisions || []);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Ошибка загрузки данных релизных гейтов');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleIntakeSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);
    try {
      let parsedMeta = {};
      if (metadataStr.trim()) {
        try {
          parsedMeta = JSON.parse(metadataStr);
        } catch {
          throw new Error('Некорректный JSON в поле метаданных');
        }
      }

      const res = await intakeReleaseGateEvidenceApi({
        gate_id: selectedGateId,
        issuer,
        evidence_type: evidenceType,
        file_path: filePath.trim() || undefined,
        metadata: parsedMeta,
        authority_class: authorityClass
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Ошибка регистрации свидетельства');
      }

      setSuccessMsg('Свидетельство успешно зарегистрировано и прошло валидацию');
      setShowIntakeModal(false);
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDecisionSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);
    try {
      let parsedEnvelope: any;
      try {
        parsedEnvelope = JSON.parse(envelopeJson);
      } catch {
        throw new Error('Некорректный JSON в поле OwnerDecisionEnvelope');
      }

      if (!parsedEnvelope.payload || !parsedEnvelope.signature || !parsedEnvelope.key_id) {
        throw new Error('OwnerDecisionEnvelope должен содержать поля: payload, signature, key_id');
      }

      const res = await recordOwnerDecisionApi(parsedEnvelope);

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || 'Ошибка верификации и фиксации решения владельца');
      }

      setSuccessMsg('Подписанное решение владельца успешно верифицировано и зафиксировано в реестре');
      setShowDecisionModal(false);
      setEnvelopeJson('');
      loadData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeDecision = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await revokeOwnerDecisionApi(id);
      if (res.success) {
        setSuccessMsg('Решение владельца отозвано');
        loadData();
      } else {
        setError(res.error || 'Не удалось отозвать решение');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="cardiolab-release-gates-section" style={{ padding: '16px', background: '#1e1e24', color: '#e0e0e0', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
        <div>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, color: '#fff', fontSize: '18px' }}>
            Готовность к релизу и внешние гейты (Release Readiness & External Gates)
          </h3>
          <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '13px', color: '#a0a0b0' }}>
            Строгий fail-closed контроль независимых проверок, юридических согласований, лицензий, EV-подписи и решений владельца.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={loadData}
          disabled={loading}
          style={{
            background: '#2b2b36',
            color: '#fff',
            border: '1px solid #444',
            padding: '6px 14px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            cursor: 'pointer'
          }}
        >
          {loading ? 'Обновление...' : 'Обновить статус'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Distribution Deferred Notice */}
      <div style={{
        background: '#2a2015',
        borderLeft: '4px solid #f59e0b',
        padding: '10px 14px',
        marginBottom: '16px',
        borderRadius: '0 4px 4px 0'
      }}>
        <strong style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }}>РЕЖИМ ОТЛОЖЕННОЙ ДИСТРИБУЦИИ (DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = TRUE)</strong>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '12px', color: '#fde68a' }}>
          Генерация исполняемых дистрибутивов (.exe, .msi, NSIS) строго запрещена до окончательной декларации владельца. Подготовленные документы и драфты не означают автоматического прохождения коммерческих и правовых гейтов.
        </p>
        {candidate && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: '6px', fontSize: '12px', color: '#d1d5db', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
            Кандидат: <strong>{candidate.candidate_freeze_id}</strong> | Commit: <strong>{candidate.candidate_commit_sha?.slice(0, 10)}</strong> | Версия: <strong>{candidate.candidate_version}</strong>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div style={{ background: '#451a1a', border: '1px solid #ef4444', color: '#fca5a5', padding: '10px', borderRadius: '4px', marginBottom: '16px', fontSize: '13px' }}>
          <strong>Ошибка:</strong> {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {successMsg && (
        <div style={{ background: '#143823', border: '1px solid #22c55e', color: '#86efac', padding: '10px', borderRadius: '4px', marginBottom: '16px', fontSize: '13px' }}>
          {successMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preflight Summary Banner */}
      {preflight && (
        <div style={{
          background: preflight.status === 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE' ? '#132e1b' : '#2d1515',
          border: `1px solid ${preflight.status === 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE' ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444'}`,
          padding: '14px',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          marginBottom: '18px'
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '12px', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em', color: '#9ca3af' }}>Статус префлайта финальной приемки:</span>
              <h4 style={{
                margin: '2px 0 0 0',
                color: preflight.status === 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE' ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171',
                fontSize: '16px'
              }}>
                {preflight.status === 'READY_TO_DECLARE_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE'
                  ? 'ГОТОВ К ДЕКЛАРАЦИИ ФИНАЛЬНОЙ ПРИЕМКИ (READY)'
                  : 'ЗАБЛОКИРОВАНО ВНЕШНИМИ ГЕЙТАМИ (BLOCKED - FAIL-CLOSED)'}
              </h4>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontSize: '12px', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
              <div>Внешних остановок: <strong>{preflight.external_hard_stops_count}</strong> | Ожидает владельца: <strong>{preflight.owner_decisions_pending_count}</strong></div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: '4px', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                Доверие владельца: <strong style={{ color: preflight.owner_trust_status === 'provisioned' ? '#4ade80' : '#f59e0b' }}>
                  {preflight.owner_trust_status === 'provisioned' ? 'PROVISIONED' : 'UNPROVISIONED (Fail-Closed)'}
                </strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {preflight.blocking_reasons && preflight.blocking_reasons.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', paddingTop: '10px', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' }}>
              <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#fca5a5' }}>Блокирующие причины:</strong>
              <ul style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', paddingLeft: '20px', fontSize: '12px', color: '#fca5a5' }}>
                {preflight.blocking_reasons.map((r: string, idx: number) => (
                  <li key={idx}>{r}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action Buttons */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowIntakeModal(true)}
          style={{
            background: '#2563eb',
            color: '#fff',
            border: 'none',
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            fontSize: '13px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 500
          }}
        >
          + Подать свидетельство (Intake Evidence)
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowDecisionModal(true)}
          style={{
            background: '#7c3aed',
            color: '#fff',
            border: 'none',
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            fontSize: '13px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 500
          }}
        >
          + Импорт решения владельца (Owner Decision Envelope)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Gates Table */}
      <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '12px', textAlign: 'left' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ background: '#262633', borderBottom: '2px solid #3b3b4f', color: '#9ca3af' }}>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Гейт ID</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Наименование</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Класс авторитета</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Категория</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Статус</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>Блокирующий</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {gates.map((g) => {
              const isVerified = g.status === 'verified';
              const isHardStop = g.status === 'external_hard_stop';
              const isOwnerReq = g.status === 'owner_decision_required';
              return (
                <tr key={g.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #2d2d3d' }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 600, color: '#93c5fd' }}>
                    {g.id}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: '#f3f4f6' }}>{g.name}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#888' }}>{g.description}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                    {g.required_authority_class}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                    {g.category}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px' }}>
                    <span style={{
                      display: 'inline-block',
                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: '10px',
                      fontSize: '11px',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      background: isVerified ? '#14532d' : (isHardStop ? '#7f1d1d' : (isOwnerReq ? '#581c87' : '#374151')),
                      color: isVerified ? '#86efac' : (isHardStop ? '#fca5a5' : (isOwnerReq ? '#d8b4fe' : '#d1d5db'))
                    }}>
                      {g.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    {g.is_blocking ? '🔴 Да' : '⚪ Нет'}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Owner Decisions Queue */}
      <div style={{ marginTop: '20px', borderTop: '1px solid #333', paddingTop: '16px' }}>
        <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '14px', color: '#fff' }}>
          Реестр решений владельца (Owner Decision Registry)
        </h4>
        {decisions.length === 0 ? (
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '12px', color: '#888' }}>
            Активных решений владельца не зафиксировано. Любая финальная приемка требует явного утверждения человеком.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
            {decisions.map((d) => (
              <div key={d.id} style={{
                background: '#252530',
                border: '1px solid #3b3b4f',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                padding: '10px 14px',
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center'
              }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '13px', color: d.decision === 'approved' ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171' }}>
                    [{d.decision?.toUpperCase()}] {d.decision_type} {d.gate_id ? `(${d.gate_id})` : ''}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#ccc', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                    {d.rationale}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#888', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                    Владелец: <strong>{d.owner_identity}</strong> | Ключ: <code>{d.key_id || 'N/A'}</code> | Дата: {new Date(d.recorded_at_utc).toLocaleString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {d.is_revocable === 1 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleRevokeDecision(d.id)}
                    style={{
                      background: '#7f1d1d',
                      color: '#fca5a5',
                      border: '1px solid #991b1b',
                      padding: '4px 10px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      fontSize: '11px',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    Отозвать
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Intake Evidence Modal */}
      {showIntakeModal && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 9999
        }}>
          <div style={{ background: '#22222c', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px', width: '500px', maxWidth: '90%' }}>
            <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 12px 0', color: '#fff' }}>Подача свидетельства релиза (Evidence Intake)</h4>
            <form onSubmit={handleIntakeSubmit}>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Целевой гейт:</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedGateId}
                  onChange={e => setSelectedGateId(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                >
                  {gates.map(g => (
                    <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>{g.id}: {g.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Кем выдано (Issuer):</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={issuer}
                  onChange={e => setIssuer(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Independent Auditor, Legal Counsel"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Тип свидетельства:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={evidenceType}
                  onChange={e => setEvidenceType(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. audit_receipt, release_payload_metadata"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Относительный путь к файлу (опционально):</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={filePath}
                  onChange={e => setFilePath(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. dist/release_payload_metadata.json"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Класс авторитета:</label>
                <select
                  value={authorityClass}
                  onChange={e => setAuthorityClass(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                >
                  <option value="operator_evidence">operator_evidence (Оператор)</option>
                  <option value="external_authority">external_authority (Внешний орган/аудитор)</option>
                  <option value="system_evaluator">system_evaluator (Системный валидатор)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Метаданные (JSON):</label>
                <textarea
                  value={metadataStr}
                  onChange={e => setMetadataStr(e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '11px' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '8px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowIntakeModal(false)}
                  style={{ background: '#374151', color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  Отмена
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  style={{ background: '#2563eb', color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  Зарегистрировать
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Owner Decision Envelope Import Modal */}
      {showDecisionModal && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 9999
        }}>
          <div style={{ background: '#22222c', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px', width: '560px', maxWidth: '95%' }}>
            <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', color: '#fff' }}>Импорт подписанного решения владельца (Owner Decision Envelope)</h4>
            
            <div style={{ background: '#1c1b29', border: '1px solid #4c1d95', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '10px', marginBottom: '14px', fontSize: '12px', color: '#d8b4fe' }}>
              <strong>Криптографический контур управления владельца:</strong>
              <div style={{ marginTop: '4px' }}>
                Прямой ввод решений оператором запрещен. Решения принимаются только в форме криптографически подписанного конверта <code>OwnerDecisionEnvelope</code> с Ed25519-подписью доверенного ключа владельца.
              </div>
              {preflight?.owner_trust_status === 'unprovisioned' && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: '6px', color: '#fca5a5', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  Статус доверия: UNPROVISIONED. В активном хранилище отсутствуют ключи владельца. До выпуска ключей гейт закрыт fail-closed.
                </div>
              )}
              {candidate && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: '6px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#9ca3af', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  WorkItem: {candidate.work_item_id} | Manifest: {candidate.manifest_sha256 ? candidate.manifest_sha256.slice(0, 16) + '...' : 'NONE'}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleDecisionSubmit}>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '12px', color: '#aaa', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                  Вставьте подписанный JSON конверта (OwnerDecisionEnvelope):
                </label>
                <textarea
                  required
                  value={envelopeJson}
                  onChange={e => setEnvelopeJson(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={'{\n  "payload": {\n    "decision_type": "final_acceptance_declaration",\n    "gate_id": "GATE-10-OWNER-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE",\n    "work_item_id": "' + (candidate?.work_item_id || 'wi-...') + '",\n    "candidate_manifest_sha256": "...",\n    "owner_identity": "Owner Name",\n    "decision": "approved",\n    "rationale": "...",\n    "decided_at_utc": "..."\n  },\n  "signature": "<base64 Ed25519>",\n  "key_id": "owner-root-key-1"\n}'}
                  rows={10}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px', background: '#181820', color: '#fff', border: '1px solid #444', borderRadius: '4px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '11px', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '8px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setShowDecisionModal(false); setEnvelopeJson(''); }}
                  style={{ background: '#374151', color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  Отмена
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  style={{ background: '#7c3aed', color: '#fff', border: 'none', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}
                >
                  Проверить подпись и импортировать
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { RRInspectionResponse, RRInspectionBeat } from '../../shared/canonical';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';

export interface RRInspectorModalProps {
  sessionId: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function RRInspectorModal({ sessionId, isOpen, onClose }: RRInspectorModalProps) {
  const { language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';

  const [data, setData] = useState<RRInspectionResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters and pagination state
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'accepted' | 'excluded'>('all');
  const [reasonCode, setReasonCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [timeFromSec, setTimeFromSec] = useState<string>('');
  const [timeToSec, setTimeToSec] = useState<string>('');
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState<number>(0);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState<number>(100);

  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Keyboard accessibility: ESC key to close
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Fetch data
  const fetchData = async () => {
    if (!sessionId || !isOpen) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const timeFromMs = timeFromSec.trim() ? Math.round(parseFloat(timeFromSec) * 1000) : undefined;
      const timeToMs = timeToSec.trim() ? Math.round(parseFloat(timeToSec) * 1000) : undefined;
      const res = await api.getRRInspection(sessionId, {
        filter,
        reasonCode: reasonCode.trim() || undefined,
        timeFromMs: !isNaN(Number(timeFromMs)) ? timeFromMs : undefined,
        timeToMs: !isNaN(Number(timeToMs)) ? timeToMs : undefined,
        offset,
        limit
      });
      setData(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Ошибка загрузки инспектора RR');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [sessionId, isOpen, filter, reasonCode, offset, limit]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalPages = data ? Math.ceil(data.pagination.total / limit) : 1;
  const currentPage = Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1;

  const handleApplyTimeFilter = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setOffset(0);
    fetchData();
  };

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setFilter('all');
    setReasonCode('');
    setTimeFromSec('');
    setTimeToSec('');
    setOffset(0);
  };

  const formatMs = (ms: number | null) => {
    if (ms === null || ms === undefined) return '—';
    return (ms / 1000).toFixed(3) + 's';
  };

  const renderPairBadge = (beat: RRInspectionBeat) => {
    switch (beat.successive_pair_status) {
      case 'valid_pair':
        return (
          <span style={{ color: '#22c55e', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            ✓ {beat.pair_diff_ms !== null ? `${beat.pair_diff_ms > 0 ? '+' : ''}${beat.pair_diff_ms} ms` : 'valid'}
          </span>
        );
      case 'broken_gap':
        return (
          <span style={{ color: '#ef4444', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            ⛔ {isRu ? 'Разрыв > 3с' : 'Gap > 3s'}
          </span>
        );
      case 'broken_exclusion':
        return (
          <span style={{ color: '#f59e0b', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
            ⚠️ {isRu ? 'Исключение' : 'Exclusion'}
          </span>
        );
      case 'broken_first_beat':
        return (
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
            1st beat
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
            {beat.successive_pair_status}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 9999,
        backdropFilter: 'blur(3px)',
        padding: '20px'
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        className="card"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="rr-inspector-title"
        style={{
          width: '95vw',
          maxWidth: '1280px',
          maxHeight: '92vh',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
          color: '#f8fafc',
          borderRadius: '12px',
          border: '1px solid #334155',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          overflow: 'hidden'
        }}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '16px 20px',
            borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            backgroundColor: '#1e293b'
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h2 id="rr-inspector-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
              🔬 {isRu ? 'Инспектор RR-интервалов (Read-Only)' : 'RR Interval Inspector (Read-Only)'}
              <span
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.7rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  backgroundColor: '#0284c7',
                  color: '#fff',
                  padding: '2px 8px',
                  borderRadius: '12px'
                }}
              >
                CANONICAL BEAT LEDGER
              </span>
            </h2>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
              {isRu ? 'Сессия:' : 'Session:'} <code style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>{sessionId}</code>
              {data?.stable_ordering_identity && (
                <span style={{ marginLeft: '12px' }}>
                  Hash: <code style={{ color: '#a855f7' }}>{data.stable_ordering_identity.substring(0, 16)}...</code>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={isRu ? 'Закрыть' : 'Close'}
            style={{
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              color: '#94a3b8',
              fontSize: '1.5rem',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              lineHeight: 1
            }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Coverage Summary & Method Eligibility Badges */}
        {data && data.status === 'available' && (
          <div
            style={{
              padding: '12px 20px',
              backgroundColor: '#131e32',
              borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: '8px'
            }}
          >
            {/* Badges Bar */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '12px', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Всего отсчетов:' : 'Total beats:'}</span>{' '}
                <strong style={{ color: '#f8fafc' }}>{data.coverage_summary.total_beats}</strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#22c55e' }}>{isRu ? 'Валидные NN:' : 'Accepted NN:'}</span>{' '}
                <strong style={{ color: '#22c55e' }}>{data.coverage_summary.accepted_nn_beats}</strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#ef4444' }}>{isRu ? 'Исключено:' : 'Excluded:'}</span>{' '}
                <strong style={{ color: '#ef4444' }}>{data.coverage_summary.excluded_beats}</strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Артефакты:' : 'Artifact ratio:'}</span>{' '}
                <strong>{(data.coverage_summary.artifact_percentage || 0).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Покрытие:' : 'Accepted coverage:'}</span>{' '}
                <strong>{Math.round(data.coverage_summary.accepted_coverage_seconds)}s ({((data.coverage_summary.accepted_coverage_ratio || 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)</strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', padding: '4px 10px', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Разрывы (>3с):' : 'Gaps (>3s):'}</span>{' '}
                <strong>{data.coverage_summary.gap_count}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Method Eligibility row */}
            {data.method_eligibility && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '0.75rem', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Допустимость методов:' : 'Method eligibility:'}</span>
                {Object.entries(data.method_eligibility).map(([method, info]) => (
                  <span
                    key={method}
                    style={{
                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      backgroundColor: info.state === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                      color: info.state === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171',
                      border: `1px solid ${info.state === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)'}`
                    }}
                    title={info.warnings.concat(info.limitations).join('; ')}
                  >
                    {method.toUpperCase()}: {info.state}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Filter Controls Toolbar */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '10px 20px',
            backgroundColor: '#0b1120',
            borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b',
            display: 'flex',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '12px'
          }}
        >
          {/* Status buttons */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '6px' }}>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setFilter('all'); setOffset(0); }}
              className="btn btn-sm"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: filter === 'all' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
                color: '#fff',
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                padding: '4px 12px'
              }}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Все отсчеты' : 'All Beats'}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setFilter('accepted'); setOffset(0); }}
              className="btn btn-sm"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: filter === 'accepted' ? '#16a34a' : '#1e293b',
                color: '#fff',
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                padding: '4px 12px'
              }}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Только NN (Валидные)' : 'NN Only (Accepted)'}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setFilter('excluded'); setOffset(0); }}
              className="btn btn-sm"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: filter === 'excluded' ? '#dc2626' : '#1e293b',
                color: '#fff',
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                padding: '4px 12px'
              }}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Только исключенные' : 'Excluded Only'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Time and reason filters */}
          <form onSubmit={handleApplyTimeFilter} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={isRu ? 'Причина исключения' : 'Reason code'}
              value={reasonCode}
              onChange={(e) => { setReasonCode(e.target.value); setOffset(0); }}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                width: '140px'
              }}
            />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>t:</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              placeholder="0s"
              value={timeFromSec}
              onChange={(e) => setTimeFromSec(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                padding: '4px 6px',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                width: '60px'
              }}
            />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              placeholder="max"
              value={timeToSec}
              onChange={(e) => setTimeToSec(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                padding: '4px 6px',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                width: '60px'
              }}
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="btn btn-sm btn-outline"
              style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 8px' }}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Применить' : 'Apply'}
            </button>
            {(reasonCode || timeFromSec || timeToSec || filter !== 'all') && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetFilters}
                className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost"
                style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 8px', color: '#f87171' }}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Сброс' : 'Reset'}
              </button>
            )}
          </form>

          {/* Limit selector */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
            <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Строк на стр.:' : 'Per page:'}</span>
            <select
              value={limit}
              onChange={(e) => { setLimit(Number(e.target.value)); setOffset(0); }}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                padding: '2px 6px',
                borderRadius: '4px'
              }}
            >
              <option value={50}>50</option>
              <option value={100}>100</option>
              <option value={250}>250</option>
              <option value={500}>500</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', position: 'relative' }}>
          {loading && (
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                inset: 0,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                zIndex: 10
              }}
            >
              <span className="spinner" />
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div style={{ padding: '24px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#f87171' }}>
              <p>⚠️ {error}</p>
              <button onClick={fetchData} className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style={{ marginTop: '8px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Повторить' : 'Retry'}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!loading && !error && data && data.status === 'unavailable' && (
            <div style={{ padding: '40px 20px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#f59e0b' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '2rem', marginBottom: '10px' }}>⚠️</div>
              <h3>{isRu ? 'Канонический журнал RR недоступен' : 'Canonical RR Ledger Unavailable'}</h3>
              <p style={{ maxWidth: '600px', margin: '8px auto', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                {data.unavailability_reason || (isRu ? 'Журнал отсчетов отсутствует для этой сессии.' : 'Beat ledger is missing for this session.')}
              </p>
              <button onClick={fetchData} className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style={{ marginTop: '12px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Проверить снова' : 'Check Again'}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!loading && !error && data && data.status === 'available' && data.beats.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ padding: '40px 20px', textAlign: 'center', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
              <p>{isRu ? 'Нет отсчетов, соответствующих заданным фильтрам.' : 'No beats matching current filters.'}</p>
              <button onClick={handleResetFilters} className="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style={{ marginTop: '8px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Сбросить фильтры' : 'Reset Filters'}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!loading && !error && data && data.status === 'available' && data.beats.length > 0 && (
            <table
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                borderCollapse: 'collapse',
                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                textAlign: 'left'
              }}
            >
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', color: '#94a3b8', position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 5 }}>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>#</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Время' : 'Time'}</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>RR (ms)</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>HR (bpm)</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Статус' : 'Status'}</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Смежная пара' : 'Successive Pair'}</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Сегмент' : 'Segment'}</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Исключения / Причины' : 'Exclusions / Reasons'}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {data.beats.map((b) => {
                  const isAccepted = b.accepted_for_nn;
                  return (
                    <React.Fragment key={b.ordinal}>
                      {b.is_gap_start && (
                        <tr style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' }}>
                          <td colSpan={8} style={{ padding: '4px 12px', color: '#f87171', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            ⚡ {isRu ? `РАЗРЫВ СИГНАЛА > 3000 мс (Длительность: ${b.gap_duration_ms ? Math.round(b.gap_duration_ms) + ' мс' : 'N/A'})` : `SIGNAL GAP > 3000 ms (Duration: ${b.gap_duration_ms ? Math.round(b.gap_duration_ms) + ' ms' : 'N/A'})`}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                      <tr
                        style={{
                          borderBottom: '1px solid #1e293b',
                          backgroundColor: isAccepted ? 'transparent' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05)'
                        }}
                      >
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{b.ordinal}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                          {formatMs(b.relative_timestamp_ms)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontWeight: 600, color: isAccepted ? '#38bdf8' : '#94a3b8' }}>
                          {b.raw_rr_ms !== null ? b.raw_rr_ms : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', color: '#f8fafc' }}>
                          {b.instantaneous_hr_bpm !== null ? Math.round(b.instantaneous_hr_bpm) : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>
                          <span
                            style={{
                              padding: '2px 6px',
                              borderRadius: '4px',
                              fontSize: '0.7rem',
                              fontWeight: 600,
                              backgroundColor: isAccepted ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2)',
                              color: isAccepted ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171'
                            }}
                          >
                            {isAccepted ? 'ACCEPTED NN' : 'EXCLUDED'}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>
                          {renderPairBadge(b)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                          seg #{b.segment_id}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '6px 12px', color: '#fca5a5', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                          {b.exclusion_reasons && b.exclusion_reasons.length > 0
                            ? b.exclusion_reasons.join(', ')
                            : '—'}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer with Pagination and Scientific Disclaimer */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '12px 20px',
            backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
            borderTop: '1px solid #334155',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: '8px'
          }}
        >
          {data && data.status === 'available' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                {isRu
                  ? `Показаны отсчеты ${offset + 1}–${Math.min(offset + limit, data.pagination.total)} из ${data.pagination.total}`
                  : `Showing beats ${offset + 1}–${Math.min(offset + limit, data.pagination.total)} of ${data.pagination.total}`}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setOffset(Math.max(0, offset - limit))}
                  disabled={offset === 0 || loading}
                  className="btn btn-sm"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: offset === 0 ? '#334155' : '#0284c7',
                    color: '#fff',
                    padding: '4px 12px'
                  }}
                >
                  ◀ {isRu ? 'Назад' : 'Prev'}
                </button>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#f8fafc' }}>
                  {currentPage} / {totalPages}
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setOffset(offset + limit)}
                  disabled={!data.pagination.has_more || loading}
                  className="btn btn-sm"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: !data.pagination.has_more ? '#334155' : '#0284c7',
                    color: '#fff',
                    padding: '4px 12px'
                  }}
                >
                  {isRu ? 'Вперед' : 'Next'} ▶
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Disclaimer */}
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {data?.scientific_disclaimer || (isRu
              ? 'Инспектор RR-интервалов носит исключительно исследовательский характер и отображает неизменяемый канонический журнал. Не является медицинским диагнозом.'
              : 'RR interval inspector is strictly informational and non-diagnostic. Displays immutable canonical ledger.')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

// Safe protocol checker
function isSafeUrl(url: string): boolean {
  try {
    const trimmed = url.trim().toLowerCase();
    return trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('mailto:');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// Inline parser that returns ReactNode[]
export function parseInlineMarkdown(text: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  const inlineRegex = /(?:`([^`]+)`)|(?:\*\*\*([^*]+)\*\*\*)|(?:\*\*([^*]+)\*\*)|(?:__([^_]+)__)|(?:\*([^*]+)\*)|(?:_([^_]+)_)|(?:\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\))|(?:<([^>]+)>)/g;

  const result: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match;

  inlineRegex.lastIndex = 0;
  let keyCounter = 0;

  while ((match = inlineRegex.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const matchIndex = match.index;
    
    if (matchIndex > lastIndex) {
      result.push(text.substring(lastIndex, matchIndex));
    }

    const [
      ,
      code,
      boldItalic,
      boldAsterisk,
      boldUnderscore,
      italicAsterisk,
      italicUnderscore,
      linkText,
      linkUrl,
      autolink
    ] = match;

    if (code !== undefined) {
      result.push(
        <code key={keyCounter++} className="inline-code">
          {code}
        </code>
      );
    } else if (boldItalic !== undefined) {
      result.push(<strong key={keyCounter++}><em>{boldItalic}</em></strong>);
    } else if (boldAsterisk !== undefined || boldUnderscore !== undefined) {
      result.push(<strong key={keyCounter++}>{boldAsterisk ?? boldUnderscore}</strong>);
    } else if (italicAsterisk !== undefined || italicUnderscore !== undefined) {
      result.push(<em key={keyCounter++}>{italicAsterisk ?? italicUnderscore}</em>);
    } else if (linkText !== undefined && linkUrl !== undefined) {
      if (isSafeUrl(linkUrl)) {
        result.push(
          <a
            key={keyCounter++}
            href={linkUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="md-link"
          >
            {linkText}
          </a>
        );
      } else {
        result.push(`${linkText} (${linkUrl})`);
      }
    } else if (autolink !== undefined) {
      if (isSafeUrl(autolink)) {
        result.push(
          <a
            key={keyCounter++}
            href={autolink.startsWith('mailto:') ? autolink : autolink}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="md-link"
          >
            {autolink}
          </a>
        );
      } else {
        result.push(`<${autolink}>`);
      }
    }

    lastIndex = inlineRegex.lastIndex;
  }

  if (lastIndex < text.length) {
    result.push(text.substring(lastIndex));
  }

  return result;
}

interface Block {
  type: 'heading' | 'paragraph' | 'blockquote' | 'list' | 'codeblock';
  level?: number;
  listType?: 'ordered' | 'unordered';
  items?: string[];
  content?: string;
  lang?: string;
}

export function parseMarkdownToBlocks(text: string): Block[] {
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  
  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // 1. Code Block
    if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
      const lang = line.trim().slice(3).trim();
      let codeContent = '';
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) {
        codeContent += lines[i] + '\n';
        i++;
      }
      if (codeContent.endsWith('\n')) {
        codeContent = codeContent.slice(0, -1);
      }
      blocks.push({
        type: 'codeblock',
        lang,
        content: codeContent
      });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Heading
    const headingMatch = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/);
    if (headingMatch) {
      blocks.push({
        type: 'heading',
        level: headingMatch[1].length,
        content: headingMatch[2].trim()
      });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // 3. Blockquote
    if (line.trim().startsWith('>')) {
      let quoteContent = '';
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('>')) {
        const contentLine = lines[i].trim().replace(/^>\s?/, '');
        quoteContent += contentLine + '\n';
        i++;
      }
      blocks.push({
        type: 'blockquote',
        content: quoteContent.trim()
      });
      continue;
    }

    // 4. List items (ordered and unordered)
    const ulMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)([-*+])\s+(.+)$/);
    const olMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(\d+)\.\s+(.+)$/);
    
    if (ulMatch) {
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length) {
        const itemMatch = lines[i].match(/^\s*[-*+]\s+(.+)$/);
        if (!itemMatch) break;
        items.push(itemMatch[1].trim());
        i++;
      }
      blocks.push({
        type: 'list',
        listType: 'unordered',
        items
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (olMatch) {
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length) {
        const itemMatch = lines[i].match(/^\s*\d+\.\s+(.+)$/);
        if (!itemMatch) break;
        items.push(itemMatch[1].trim());
        i++;
      }
      blocks.push({
        type: 'list',
        listType: 'ordered',
        items
      });
      continue;
    }

    // 5. Empty line
    if (line.trim() === '') {
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // 6. Paragraph (gather consecutive lines)
    let paragraphContent = '';
    while (i < lines.length) {
      const curLine = lines[i];
      if (curLine.trim() === '' ||
          curLine.trim().startsWith('```') ||
          curLine.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+/) ||
          curLine.trim().startsWith('>') ||
          curLine.match(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/) ||
          curLine.match(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/)) {
        break;
      }
      paragraphContent += (paragraphContent ? ' ' : '') + curLine.trim();
      i++;
    }

    if (paragraphContent) {
      blocks.push({
        type: 'paragraph',
        content: paragraphContent
      });
    }
  }

  return blocks;
}

export interface SafeMarkdownProps {
  text: string;
}

export const SafeMarkdown: React.FC<SafeMarkdownProps> = ({ text }) => {
  const blocks = useMemo(() => parseMarkdownToBlocks(text || ''), [text]);

  return (
    <div className="markdown-render-body">
      {blocks.map((block, idx) => {
        switch (block.type) {
          case 'heading': {
            const Tag = `h${block.level}` as keyof JSX.IntrinsicElements;
            const headingClass = `md-h${block.level}`;
            return React.createElement(
              Tag,
              { key: idx, className: headingClass },
              parseInlineMarkdown(block.content || '')
            );
          }

          case 'paragraph': {
            return (
              <p key={idx} className="md-p">
                {parseInlineMarkdown(block.content || '')}
              </p>
            );
          }

          case 'blockquote': {
            const quoteLines = (block.content || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
            return (
              <blockquote key={idx} className="md-quote">
                {quoteLines.map((ql, qIdx) => (
                  <p key={qIdx} className={qIdx > 0 ? 'mt-2' : ''}>
                    {parseInlineMarkdown(ql)}
                  </p>
                ))}
              </blockquote>
            );
          }

          case 'list': {
            const Tag = block.listType === 'ordered' ? 'ol' : 'ul';
            const listClass = block.listType === 'ordered' ? 'md-ol' : 'md-ul';
            
            return React.createElement(
              Tag,
              { key: idx, className: listClass },
              (block.items || []).map((item, itemIdx) => (
                <li key={itemIdx} className="md-li">
                  {parseInlineMarkdown(item)}
                </li>
              ))
            );
          }

          case 'codeblock': {
            return (
              <div key={idx} className="md-codeblock-container">
                {block.lang && (
                  <div className="md-codeblock-header">
                    {block.lang}
                  </div>
                )}
                <pre className="md-pre">
                  <code className="md-code">{block.content}</code>
                </pre>
              </div>
            );
          }

          default:
            return null;
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';

export type SafetyNoticeVariant = 'compact' | 'inline' | 'report' | 'modal';

interface SafetyNoticeProps {
  variant?: SafetyNoticeVariant;
  text?: string;
  customText?: string;
}

export function SafetyNotice({ variant = 'compact', text, customText }: SafetyNoticeProps) {
  const { t } = useT();
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);

  const displayNotice = text || customText;

  // Compact sidebar notice
  if (variant === 'compact') {
    return (
      <div 
        id="safety-notice-compact" 
        style={styles.compact}
        title={displayNotice || t('medicalDisclaimerText') || ''}
      >
        <span>⚠ {displayNotice || t('notMedical') || 'Не для медицинских целей'}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Inline disclosure notice on pages
  if (variant === 'inline') {
    return (
      <div id="safety-notice-inline" style={styles.inline}>
        <span style={styles.icon}>ℹ</span>
        <span style={styles.text}>
          {t('medicalDisclaimerText') || 'Инструмент информационный, не диагностический.'}
          <button 
            type="button"
            id="safety-notice-details-btn"
            style={styles.linkButton} 
            onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
          >
            {t('moreDetails') || 'Подробнее'}
          </button>
        </span>

        {showModal && (
          <div style={styles.overlay} onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
            <div style={styles.dialog} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <h3 style={styles.dialogTitle}>{t('medicalWarning') || 'Внимание'}</h3>
              <p style={styles.dialogText}>{t('medicalDisclaimerBox') || t('medicalDisclaimerText')}</p>
              <button 
                type="button"
                id="safety-notice-close-btn"
                style={styles.dialogBtn} 
                onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}
              >
                ОК
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Report safety notice (for generated reports / PDFs)
  if (variant === 'report') {
    return (
      <div id="safety-notice-report" style={styles.report}>
        <div style={styles.reportTitle}>⚠ {t('notMedical') || 'Не для медицинских целей'}</div>
        <p style={styles.reportText}>{t('disclaimerDetailed') || t('medicalDisclaimerBox')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Modal safety notice
  return (
    <div id="safety-notice-modal" style={styles.modalBg}>
      <div style={styles.modalContent}>
        <h3 style={styles.dialogTitle}>{t('medicalWarning') || 'Внимание'}</h3>
        <p style={styles.dialogText}>{t('medicalDisclaimerBox')}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import uPlot from 'uplot';
import 'uplot/dist/uPlot.min.css';
import { SignalFileSummary, CandidateFlag, api, EcgPeak, SessionQcMetrics } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { AppSelect } from './AppSelect';
import { calculateAccActivityStats, AccActivityStats } from '../../shared/accActivity';
import { TermTooltip } from './TermTooltip';

import { CanonicalSessionResult } from '../../shared/canonical/CanonicalSessionResult';

interface SignalChartProps {
  sessionId: string;
  signalFiles: SignalFileSummary[];
  flags: CandidateFlag[];
  sessionStartMs: number;
  qcMetrics?: SessionQcMetrics | null;
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null;
}

/** 
 * Convert parallel [x, y][] to uPlot's expected [xArr, yArr] format.
 * Inserts nulls for gaps where time differences exceed maxDeltaMs to prevent straight line bridging.
 * If treatZeroAsNull is true, zeroes (which signify missing data in heart rate signals) are also replaced with null.
 */
function toUPlotDataWithGaps(
  points: [number, number][], 
  maxDeltaMs: number,
  treatZeroAsNull = false
): [number[], (number | null)[]] {
  const xs: number[] = [];
  const ys: (number | null)[] = [];
  
  if (points.length === 0) return [xs, ys];
  
  const maxDeltaSeconds = maxDeltaMs / 1000;
  
  xs.push(points[0][0]);
  ys.push((treatZeroAsNull && points[0][1] === 0) ? null : points[0][1]);
  
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const prevTime = points[i - 1][0];
    const currTime = points[i][0];
    
    if (currTime - prevTime > maxDeltaSeconds) {
      xs.push((prevTime + currTime) / 2);
      ys.push(null);
    }
    
    xs.push(currTime);
    ys.push((treatZeroAsNull && points[i][1] === 0) ? null : points[i][1]);
  }
  
  return [xs, ys];
}

function formatElapsedTick(tickVal: number): string {
  if (tickVal < 0 || !isFinite(tickVal)) {
    return '—';
  }
  const s = tickVal;
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  const sec = Math.floor(s % 60);
  if (h > 0) {
    return `${h}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${m}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Computes min-max envelope for overview mode to avoid solid red/blue walls.
 */
function computeEcgEnvelope(
  points: [number, number][],
  bucketSize = 8,
  maxDeltaMs = 100
): [number[], (number | null)[], (number | null)[]] {
  const xs: number[] = [];
  const ysMax: (number | null)[] = [];
  const ysMin: (number | null)[] = [];
  
  if (points.length === 0) return [xs, ysMax, ysMin];
  
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i += bucketSize) {
    const slice = points.slice(i, i + bucketSize);
    const avgTime = slice.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p[0], 0) / slice.length;
    const vals = slice.map(p => p[1]);
    const maxVal = Math.max(...vals);
    const minVal = Math.min(...vals);
    
    if (xs.length > 0 && (avgTime - xs[xs.length - 1] * 1000) > maxDeltaMs) {
      xs.push((xs[xs.length - 1] * 1000 + avgTime) / 2000);
      ysMax.push(null);
      ysMin.push(null);
    }
    
    xs.push(avgTime / 1000);
    ysMax.push(maxVal);
    ysMin.push(minVal);
  }
  
  return [xs, ysMax, ysMin];
}

/**
 * Computes robust y-axis boundaries using p1-p99 percentiles with a 10% padding.
 * Scans all series to handle multi-series plots correctly.
 */
function getRobustRange(self: uPlot, minVal: number, maxVal: number, defaultPadding = 0.1): [number, number] {
  const validVals: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < self.data.length; i++) {
    const data = self.data[i] as (number | null)[];
    if (data) {
      for (let j = 0; j < data.length; j++) {
        const v = data[j];
        if (v !== null) validVals.push(v);
      }
    }
  }
  if (validVals.length > 0) {
    const sorted = [...validVals].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const p1 = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.01)];
    const p99 = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99)];
    const padding = (p99 - p1) * 0.1 || defaultPadding;
    return [p1 - padding, p99 + padding];
  }
  return [minVal, maxVal];
}

/**
 * Inserts nulls for gaps where time differences exceed maxDeltaMs.
 * Designed for multi-series sharing the same timestamps list.
 */
function toUPlotMultiDataWithGaps(
  xsOrig: number[],
  ySeries: number[][],
  maxDeltaMs: number
): [number[], ...((number | null)[])[]] {
  const xs: number[] = [];
  const ysArrays: (number | null)[][] = ySeries.map(() => []);

  if (xsOrig.length === 0) return [xs, ...ysArrays];

  xs.push(xsOrig[0] / 1000); // uPlot uses seconds
  for (let s = 0; s < ySeries.length; s++) {
    ysArrays[s].push(ySeries[s][0]);
  }

  for (let i = 1; i < xsOrig.length; i++) {
    const prevTime = xsOrig[i - 1];
    const currTime = xsOrig[i];

    if (currTime - prevTime > maxDeltaMs) {
      xs.push((prevTime + currTime) / 2000);
      for (let s = 0; s < ySeries.length; s++) {
        ysArrays[s].push(null);
      }
    }

    xs.push(currTime / 1000);
    for (let s = 0; s < ySeries.length; s++) {
      ysArrays[s].push(ySeries[s][i]);
    }
  }

  return [xs, ...ysArrays] as any;
}

export function SignalChart({
  sessionId,
  signalFiles,
  flags,
  sessionStartMs,
  qcMetrics,
  canonicalSession,
}: SignalChartProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  
  // Interactive ECG state
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'overview' | 'strip'>('overview');
  const [stripWindowSize, setStripWindowSize] = useState<10 | 30 | 60>(10);
  const [stripOffsetSeconds, setStripOffsetSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<'raw' | 'filtered' | 'corrected'>('raw');
  const [yScaleMode, setYScaleMode] = useState<'auto' | 'manual'>('auto');

  // ACC view mode: magnitude vs X/Y/Z axes
  const [accViewMode, setAccViewMode] = useState<'magnitude' | 'axes'>('magnitude');
  const [showAccChart, setShowAccChart] = useState(false);
  const [accStats, setAccStats] = useState<AccActivityStats | null>(null);

  // Loaded QRS Peaks
  const [ecgPeaks, setEcgPeaks] = useState<EcgPeak[]>([]);
  const [peaksQualityLimited, setPeaksQualityLimited] = useState(false);
  const [peaksWarnings, setPeaksWarnings] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Default selection tracking
  const [bestOffsetSeconds, setBestOffsetSeconds] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hasSetInitialOffset, setHasSetInitialOffset] = useState(false);

  const ecgPlotRef = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);
  const hrPlotRef = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);
  const accPlotRef = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);
  const overviewEcgDataRef = useRef<Record<string, any>>({});

  const ecgFile = signalFiles.find((f) => f.signal_type === 'ECG');
  const hrFile = signalFiles.find((f) => f.signal_type === 'HR');
  const accFile = signalFiles.find((f) => f.signal_type === 'ACC');

  // Compute total session duration with priority: canonicalSession -> ecgFile -> hrFile/accFile -> 300
  const maxSignalDuration = signalFiles.reduce((max, f) => {
    if (f.start_time && f.end_time) {
      const dur = (new Date(f.end_time).getTime() - new Date(f.start_time).getTime()) / 1000;
      return dur > max ? dur : max;
    }
    return max;
  }, 0);

  const durationSeconds = canonicalSession?.timing?.duration_seconds 
    || (ecgFile ? (new Date(ecgFile.end_time).getTime() - new Date(ecgFile.start_time).getTime()) / 1000 : 0)
    || maxSignalDuration
    || 300;

  const maxOffset = Math.max(0, durationSeconds - stripWindowSize);

  // Load peaks
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ecgFile) {
      api.getEcgPeaks(ecgFile.id)
        .then((res) => {
          setEcgPeaks(res.peaks || []);
          setPeaksQualityLimited(res.quality_limited || false);
          setPeaksWarnings(res.warnings || []);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [ecgFile?.id]);

  const visiblePeaks = useMemo(() => {
    return ecgPeaks.filter(p => {
      const peakSec = p.time_ms / 1000;
      const startSec = stripOffsetSeconds;
      const endSec = startSec + stripWindowSize;
      return peakSec >= startSec && peakSec <= endSec;
    });
  }, [ecgPeaks, stripOffsetSeconds, stripWindowSize]);

  const preferDensityLayout = useMemo(() => {
    return peaksQualityLimited || visiblePeaks.length > 50;
  }, [peaksQualityLimited, visiblePeaks.length]);

  // Set default strip offset using selection priorities
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasSetInitialOffset) return;

    if (bestOffsetSeconds !== null) {
      setStripOffsetSeconds(bestOffsetSeconds);
      setHasSetInitialOffset(true);
    } else if (flags.length > 0) {
      // Prefer representative event segment
      setStripOffsetSeconds(flags[0].timestamp_offset_ms / 1000);
      setHasSetInitialOffset(true);
    }
  }, [bestOffsetSeconds, flags, hasSetInitialOffset]);

  const handlePrevPage = () => {
    setStripOffsetSeconds(prev => Math.max(0, prev - stripWindowSize));
  };

  const handleNextPage = () => {
    setStripOffsetSeconds(prev => Math.min(maxOffset, prev + stripWindowSize));
  };

  const handleJumpToFlag = (offsetMs: number) => {
    setMode('strip');
    const offsetSec = offsetMs / 1000;
    const targetOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOffset, offsetSec - stripWindowSize / 2));
    setStripOffsetSeconds(targetOffset);
  };

  const handleJumpToBest = () => {
    if (bestOffsetSeconds !== null) {
      setMode('strip');
      setStripOffsetSeconds(bestOffsetSeconds);
    }
  };

  const destroyPlots = useCallback(() => {
    ecgPlotRef.current?.destroy();
    hrPlotRef.current?.destroy();
    accPlotRef.current?.destroy();
    ecgPlotRef.current = null;
    hrPlotRef.current = null;
    accPlotRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function build() {
      if (!containerRef.current) return;

      const width = containerRef.current.clientWidth || 860;
      const chartW = Math.max(width, 400);

      const commonOpts = (height: number, label: string, color: string) =>
        ({
          width: chartW,
          height,
          cursor: { sync: { key: 'cardio-sync' } },
          axes: [
            {
              stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
              ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
              grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
              values: (u: uPlot, ticks: number[]) =>
                ticks.map((tickVal) => formatElapsedTick(tickVal)),
            },
            {
              stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
              ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
              grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
            },
          ],
          series: [
            {},
            {
              label,
              stroke: color,
              width: 1.2,
              spanGaps: false,
            },
          ],
        } as uPlot.Options);

      // ---- ECG chart ----
      if (ecgFile && containerRef.current) {
        const ecgContainer = document.getElementById(`ecg-chart-${sessionId}`);
        if (!ecgContainer) return;

        try {
          let ecgData;
          if (mode === 'overview') {
            if (!overviewEcgDataRef.current[ecgFile.id]) {
              overviewEcgDataRef.current[ecgFile.id] = api.getEcgData(ecgFile.id, { points: 4000 });
            }
            ecgData = await overviewEcgDataRef.current[ecgFile.id];
            if (ecgData.best_offset_ms !== undefined && bestOffsetSeconds === null) {
              setBestOffsetSeconds(ecgData.best_offset_ms / 1000);
            }
          } else {
            const startMs = stripOffsetSeconds * 1000;
            const endMs = startMs + stripWindowSize * 1000;
            ecgData = await api.getEcgData(ecgFile.id, { 
              points: Math.min(20000, stripWindowSize * 250),
              start: startMs,
              end: endMs
            });
          }

          if (cancelled) return;

          const ecgOriginMs = ecgData?.time_origin_ms || 0;
          
          let xs: number[];
          let ys: (number | null)[];
          let ysMax: (number | null)[] = [];
          let ysMin: (number | null)[] = [];
          let dataVal: any;
          let seriesOpts: any;
          let bandsOpts: any;

          const isOverviewFallback = mode === 'overview' && ecgPeaks.length === 0;

          if (mode === 'overview' && !isOverviewFallback) {
            const numBins = 100;
            const binDuration = durationSeconds / numBins;
            xs = [];
            ysMax = [];
            ysMin = [];
            
            const flagTs = flags.map((f) => f.timestamp_offset_ms / 1000);
            const peakTs = ecgPeaks.map((p) => p.time_ms / 1000);
            
            for (let i = 0; i < numBins; i++) {
              const binStart = i * binDuration;
              const binEnd = binStart + binDuration;
              xs.push(binStart + binDuration / 2);
              
              const peakCount = peakTs.filter(ts => ts >= binStart && ts < binEnd).length;
              const bpm = binDuration > 0 ? Math.round((peakCount / binDuration) * 60) : 0;
              ysMax.push(bpm);
              
              const flagCount = flagTs.filter(ts => ts >= binStart && ts < binEnd).length;
              ysMin.push(flagCount);
            }

            dataVal = [xs, ysMax, ysMin];
            seriesOpts = [
              {},
              {
                label: language === 'ru' ? 'Плотность QRS (BPM)' : 'QRS Density (BPM)',
                stroke: 'hsl(142, 70%, 45%)',
                width: 1.5,
              },
              {
                label: language === 'ru' ? 'Плотность артефактов' : 'Anomaly Density',
                stroke: 'hsl(0, 84%, 60%)',
                width: 1.5,
              }
            ];
            bandsOpts = [];
          } else {
            const gapped = toUPlotDataWithGaps(ecgData.points, 100);
            xs = gapped[0];
            ys = gapped[1];
            dataVal = [xs, ys!];
            seriesOpts = [
              {},
              {
                label: isOverviewFallback
                  ? (language === 'ru' ? 'ЭКГ сигнал (мкВ)' : 'ECG Signal (uV)')
                  : t('ecgYAxis'),
                stroke: isOverviewFallback
                  ? 'hsl(142, 70%, 45%)' // Green overview fallback
                  : 'hsl(220,90%,65%)', // Blue strip mode
                width: isOverviewFallback ? 1.0 : 1.2,
                spanGaps: false,
              }
            ];
          }

          const flagTs = flags.map((f) => f.timestamp_offset_ms / 1000);
          const opts: uPlot.Options = {
            width: chartW,
            height: 240,
            cursor: { sync: { key: 'cardio-sync' } },
            axes: [
              {
                stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
                grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
                values: (u: uPlot, ticks: number[]) =>
                  ticks.map((tickVal) => formatElapsedTick(tickVal)),
              },
              {
                stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
                grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
              },
            ],
            series: seriesOpts,
            bands: bandsOpts,
            scales: {
              y: {
                range: (self: uPlot, minVal: number, maxVal: number) => 
                  yScaleMode === 'auto'
                    ? getRobustRange(self, minVal, maxVal, 100)
                    : [-2000, 2000]
              }
            },
            plugins: [
              {
                hooks: {
                  draw: [
                    (u: uPlot) => {
                      const ctx = u.ctx;
                      ctx.save();
                      
                      // Scale clipping check
                      const yValMin = u.scales.y.min!;
                      const yValMax = u.scales.y.max!;
                      let hasClipped = false;
                      if (mode === 'overview' && ecgPeaks.length > 0) {
                        hasClipped = ysMax.some(y => y !== null && y >= 19500) || ysMin.some(y => y !== null && y <= -19500);
                      } else {
                        hasClipped = ys!.some(y => y !== null && (y >= 19500 || y <= -19500));
                      }

                      if (hasClipped) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.8)';
