                          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                          ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
                          flagTs.forEach((ts) => {
                            const px = u.valToPos(ts, 'x', true);
                            if (px >= u.bbox.left && px <= u.bbox.left + u.bbox.width) {
                              ctx.beginPath();
                              ctx.moveTo(px, u.bbox.top);
                              ctx.lineTo(px, u.bbox.top + u.bbox.height);
                              ctx.stroke();
                            }
                          });
                        } else {
                          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
                          ctx.fillRect(u.bbox.left, u.bbox.top, u.bbox.width, 10);
                          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7)';
                          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                          flagTs.forEach((ts) => {
                            const px = u.valToPos(ts, 'x', true);
                            if (px >= u.bbox.left && px <= u.bbox.left + u.bbox.width) {
                              ctx.beginPath();
                              ctx.moveTo(px, u.bbox.top);
                              ctx.lineTo(px, u.bbox.top + 10);
                              ctx.stroke();
                            }
                          });
                        }
                      }

                      // Render R-peak candidates
                      if (mode === 'strip') {
                        if (visiblePeaks.length <= 100 && !preferDensityLayout) {
                          ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
                          ctx.strokeStyle = '#047857';
                          ctx.lineWidth = 1;

                          visiblePeaks.forEach((p) => {
                            const peakSec = p.time_ms / 1000;
                            const px = u.valToPos(peakSec, 'x', true);

                            let closestVal = 0;
                            let closestDist = Infinity;
                            const xsData = u.data[0];
                            const ysData = u.data[1] as (number | null)[];
                            if (xsData && ysData) {
                              for (let j = 0; j < xsData.length; j++) {
                                const dist = Math.abs(xsData[j] - peakSec);
                                if (dist < closestDist && ysData[j] !== null) {
                                  closestDist = dist;
                                  closestVal = ysData[j]!;
                                }
                              }
                            }

                            const py = u.valToPos(closestVal, 'y', true);
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(px, py, 3.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                            ctx.fill();
                            ctx.stroke();
                          });
                        } else {
                          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
                          ctx.fillRect(u.bbox.left, u.bbox.top + 10, u.bbox.width, 10);
                          ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981';
                          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                          visiblePeaks.forEach((p) => {
                            const px = u.valToPos(p.time_ms / 1000, 'x', true);
                            if (px >= u.bbox.left && px <= u.bbox.left + u.bbox.width) {
                              ctx.beginPath();
                              ctx.moveTo(px, u.bbox.top + 10);
                              ctx.lineTo(px, u.bbox.top + 18);
                              ctx.stroke();
                            }
                          });
                        }
                      }
                      ctx.restore();
                    },
                  ],
                },
              },
            ],
          };

          if (mode === 'strip') {
            const startSec = stripOffsetSeconds;
            const endSec = startSec + stripWindowSize;
            opts.scales = {
              ...opts.scales,
              x: { min: startSec, max: endSec }
            };
          }

          ecgPlotRef.current = new uPlot(opts, dataVal, ecgContainer);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('ECG load failed', e);
        }
      }

      // ---- HR chart ----
      if (hrFile && containerRef.current) {
        const hrContainer = document.getElementById(`hr-chart-${sessionId}`);
        if (!hrContainer) return;

        try {
          const hrData = await api.getHrData(hrFile.id);
          if (cancelled) return;
          
          const [xs, ys] = toUPlotDataWithGaps(hrData.points, 2500, true);

          const opts: uPlot.Options = {
            ...commonOpts(150, t('hrYAxis'), 'hsl(6,90%,65%)'),
            scales: {
              y: {
                range: (self: uPlot, minVal: number, maxVal: number) =>
                  getRobustRange(self, minVal, maxVal, 5)
              }
            },
            plugins: [
              {
                hooks: {
                  draw: [
                    (u: uPlot) => {
                      const ctx = u.ctx;
                      ctx.save();
                      const stabEndSec = 60;
                      const startPos = u.valToPos(0, 'x', true);
                      const endPos = u.valToPos(stabEndSec, 'x', true);
                      
                      if (startPos < u.bbox.left + u.bbox.width && endPos > u.bbox.left) {
                        const drawStart = Math.max(u.bbox.left, startPos);
                        const drawEnd = Math.min(u.bbox.left + u.bbox.width, endPos);
                        
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.08)';
                        ctx.fillRect(drawStart, u.bbox.top, drawEnd - drawStart, u.bbox.height);
                        
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(endPos, u.bbox.top);
                        ctx.lineTo(endPos, u.bbox.top + u.bbox.height);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.8)';
                        ctx.font = '9px sans-serif';
                        ctx.fillText(
                          language === 'ru' ? 'Стабилизация записи' : 'Recording stabilization', 
                          startPos + 6, 
                          u.bbox.top + 14
                        );
                      }
                      ctx.restore();
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            ]
          };
          
          if (mode === 'strip') {
            const startSec = stripOffsetSeconds;
            const endSec = startSec + stripWindowSize;
            opts.scales = {
              ...opts.scales,
              x: { min: startSec, max: endSec }
            };
          }

          hrPlotRef.current = new uPlot(opts, [xs, ys], hrContainer);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('HR load failed', e);
        }
      }

      // ---- ACC chart ----
      if (accFile && containerRef.current) {
        const accContainer = document.getElementById(`acc-chart-${sessionId}`);
        if (!accContainer) return;

        try {
          const accData = await api.getAccData(accFile.id);
          if (cancelled) return;

          const stats = calculateAccActivityStats(accData.points, durationSeconds);
          setAccStats(stats);

          if (!showAccChart) {
            return;
          }

          let xs: number[];
          let ysData: (number | null)[][];
          let seriesOpts: any[];

          const timeMsList = accData.points.map(p => p[0]);

          if (accViewMode === 'axes' && accData.axes) {
            const xVals = accData.axes.x.map(p => p[1] / 1000);
            const yVals = accData.axes.y.map(p => p[1] / 1000);
            const zVals = accData.axes.z.map(p => p[1] / 1000);
            
            const gapped = toUPlotMultiDataWithGaps(timeMsList, [xVals, yVals, zVals], 1000);
            xs = gapped[0];
            ysData = [gapped[1], gapped[2], gapped[3]];

            seriesOpts = [
              {},
              { label: 'X', stroke: 'hsl(6,90%,65%)', width: 1.2, spanGaps: false },
              { label: 'Y', stroke: 'hsl(152,75%,55%)', width: 1.2, spanGaps: false },
              { label: 'Z', stroke: 'hsl(220,85%,65%)', width: 1.2, spanGaps: false },
            ];
          } else {
            const magVals = accData.points.map(p => p[1] / 1000);
            const gapped = toUPlotMultiDataWithGaps(timeMsList, [magVals], 1000);
            xs = gapped[0];
            ysData = [gapped[1]];

            seriesOpts = [
              {},
              { label: t('accChartTitle'), stroke: 'hsl(38,90%,60%)', width: 1.2, spanGaps: false },
            ];
          }

          const opts: uPlot.Options = {
            width: chartW,
            height: 140,
            cursor: { sync: { key: 'cardio-sync' } },
            axes: [
              {
                stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
                grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
                values: (u: uPlot, ticks: number[]) =>
                  ticks.map((tickVal) => formatElapsedTick(tickVal)),
              },
              {
                stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
                grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
              },
            ],
            series: seriesOpts,
            scales: {
              y: {
                range: (self: uPlot, minVal: number, maxVal: number) =>
                  getRobustRange(self, minVal, maxVal, 0.1)
              }
            }
          };

          if (mode === 'strip') {
            const startSec = stripOffsetSeconds;
            const endSec = startSec + stripWindowSize;
            opts.scales = {
              ...opts.scales,
              x: { min: startSec, max: endSec }
            };
          }

          accPlotRef.current = new uPlot(opts, [xs, ...ysData], accContainer);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('ACC load failed', e);
        }
      }
    }

    destroyPlots();
    build();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      destroyPlots();
    };
  }, [
    sessionId, 
    ecgFile?.id, 
    hrFile?.id, 
    accFile?.id, 
    sessionStartMs, 
    flags.length, 
    t, 
    destroyPlots, 
    mode, 
    stripWindowSize, 
    stripOffsetSeconds, 
    accViewMode, 
    showAccChart,
    yScaleMode, 
    ecgPeaks
  ]);

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} style={{ overflowX: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* ECG File Block */}
      {ecgFile ? (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '16px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' }}>
            <div className="chart-title" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
              {t('ecgChartTitle')}
              {peaksQualityLimited && (
                <span className="badge badge-warning" style={{ textTransform: 'none', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'качество ограничено' : 'quality limited'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Mode & Scale Controls */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {/* Raw / Filtered Select */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                <select
                  id="select-filter-mode"
                  value={filterMode}
                  onChange={(e) => setFilterMode(e.target.value as any)}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                    color: '#cbd5e1',
                    border: '1px solid #475569',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    padding: '3px 6px',
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="raw">{language === 'en' ? 'Raw signal' : 'Сырой сигнал'}</option>
                  <option value="filtered" disabled>
                    {language === 'en' ? 'Filtered (N/A)' : 'Фильтрованный (н/д)'}
                  </option>
                  <option value="corrected" disabled>
                    {language === 'en' ? 'Baseline corrected (N/A)' : 'Коррекция базовой линии (н/д)'}
                  </option>
                </select>
                <TermTooltip 
                  term={language === 'en' ? 'Filtering' : 'Фильтрация'} 
                  definition={
                    language === 'en' 
                      ? 'ECG signal filtering and baseline drift correction were not performed; only the raw signal is available.'
                      : 'Фильтрация сигнала ЭКГ и коррекция дрейфа базовой линии не проводились; доступен только исходный (сырой) сигнал.'
                  }
                />
              </div>

              {/* Y Scale Selection */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="btn-scale-auto"
                  onClick={() => setYScaleMode('auto')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 8px',
                    fontSize: '0.72rem',
                    backgroundColor: yScaleMode === 'auto' ? '#334155' : '#1e293b',
                    color: '#cbd5e1',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Auto Y' : 'Авто Y'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="btn-scale-manual"
                  onClick={() => setYScaleMode('manual')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 8px',
                    fontSize: '0.72rem',
                    backgroundColor: yScaleMode === 'manual' ? '#334155' : '#1e293b',
                    color: '#cbd5e1',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderLeft: '1px solid #475569',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Manual Y (±2mV)' : 'Ручной Y (±2мВ)'}
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Overview / Strip Mode Toggle */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', padding: '2px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="btn-mode-overview"
                  onClick={() => setMode('overview')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 10px',
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    backgroundColor: mode === 'overview' ? '#38bdf8' : 'transparent',
                    color: mode === 'overview' ? '#0f172a' : '#cbd5e1',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '3px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Overview' : 'Обзор'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="btn-mode-strip"
                  onClick={() => setMode('strip')}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 10px',
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    backgroundColor: mode === 'strip' ? '#38bdf8' : 'transparent',
                    color: mode === 'strip' ? '#0f172a' : '#cbd5e1',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '3px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Strip' : 'Лента'}
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Strip Window Size */}
              {mode === 'strip' && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                  {[10, 30, 60].map((size) => (
                    <button
                      key={size}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setStripWindowSize(size as any);
                        setStripOffsetSeconds(prev => Math.min(Math.max(0, durationSeconds - size), prev));
                      }}
                      style={{
                        padding: '4px 8px',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        backgroundColor: stripWindowSize === size ? '#334155' : '#1e293b',
                        color: '#cbd5e1',
                        border: 'none',
                        borderRight: size !== 60 ? '1px solid #475569' : 'none',
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                    >
                      {size}s
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quality Notice */}
          {peaksQualityLimited && (
            <div className="ecg-quality-limited-banner" style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2)',
              borderRadius: '4px',
              padding: '8px 12px',
              fontSize: '0.8rem',
              color: '#f87171',
            }}>
              ⚠️ {language === 'en'
                ? 'No stable high-quality segment found; showing available segment with limitations.'
                : 'Нет устойчивого качественного фрагмента; показан доступный участок с ограничениями.'}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Scale Clipping Notice */}
          {(() => {
            const clipSec = canonicalSession
              ? (canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.clipping.value ?? null)
              : (qcMetrics?.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? null);
            if (clipSec === null || clipSec <= 0) return null;
            return (
              <div className="ecg-clipping-banner" style={{
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2)',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                padding: '8px 12px',
                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                color: '#fbbf24',
              }}>
                ⚠️ {language === 'en'
                  ? `Signal clipping detected: ${clipSec.toFixed(1)} seconds of the recording exceeded measurement bounds.`
                  : `Обнаружен выход сигнала за пределы диапазона (клиппинг): ${clipSec.toFixed(1)} сек. записи обрезано.`}
              </div>
            );
          })()}

          {/* Strip Mode Navigation & Jumps */}
          {mode === 'strip' && (
            <div 
              style={{ 
                display: 'flex', 
                justifyContent: 'space-between', 
                alignItems: 'center', 
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b', 
                padding: '6px 10px', 
                borderRadius: '6px',
                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: '8px'
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '6px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={stripOffsetSeconds === 0}
                  onClick={handlePrevPage}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 10px',
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    backgroundColor: stripOffsetSeconds === 0 ? '#1e293b' : '#334155',
                    color: stripOffsetSeconds === 0 ? '#64748b' : '#f8fafc',
                    border: '1px solid #475569',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    cursor: stripOffsetSeconds === 0 ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  ◀ {language === 'en' ? 'Back' : 'Назад'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={stripOffsetSeconds >= maxOffset}
                  onClick={handleNextPage}
                  style={{
                    padding: '4px 10px',
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    backgroundColor: stripOffsetSeconds >= maxOffset ? '#1e293b' : '#334155',
                    color: stripOffsetSeconds >= maxOffset ? '#64748b' : '#f8fafc',
                    border: '1px solid #475569',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    cursor: stripOffsetSeconds >= maxOffset ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Next' : 'Вперед'} ▶
                </button>
                <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', marginLeft: '6px', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                  {Math.floor(stripOffsetSeconds)}s - {Math.floor(stripOffsetSeconds + stripWindowSize)}s / {Math.floor(durationSeconds)}s
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Jump controls */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {bestOffsetSeconds !== null && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleJumpToBest}
                    style={{
                      padding: '4px 8px',
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)',
                      color: '#38bdf8',
                      border: '1px solid #38bdf8',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    ⭐ {language === 'en' ? 'Jump to Best Segment' : 'Перейти к лучшему участку'}
                  </button>
                )}

                {flags.length > 0 && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '6px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                      {language === 'en' ? 'Jump to event:' : 'Событие:'}
                    </span>
                    <AppSelect
                      id="select-jump-event"
                      value=""
                      onChange={(val) => {
                        if (val) {
                          handleJumpToFlag(parseFloat(val));
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder={language === 'en' ? '-- Select event --' : '-- Выбрать событие --'}
                      options={flags.map((f, idx) => ({
                        value: String(f.timestamp_offset_ms),
                        label: `${idx + 1}. ${f.description_ru} (${Math.round(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 1000)}s)`
                      }))}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {mode === 'overview' && !ecgFile ? (
            <div style={{
              height: '140px',
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #1e293b',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              alignItems: 'center',
              color: '#94a3b8',
              fontSize: '0.85rem',
              margin: '8px 0'
            }} className="ecg-empty-state-overlay">
              ℹ️ {language === 'ru'
                ? 'Данные сырой ЭКГ недоступны для этой сессии.'
                : 'Raw ECG data unavailable for this session.'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div id={`ecg-chart-${sessionId}`} />
              {mode === 'overview' && ecgPeaks.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)',
                  borderRadius: '4px',
                  fontSize: '0.8rem',
                  color: '#38bdf8',
                  marginTop: '6px'
                }} className="ecg-qrs-unavailable-banner">
                  ℹ️ {language === 'ru'
                    ? 'Сырой сигнал ЭКГ доступен. QRS-комплексы / пики не вычислены для данной записи.'
                    : 'Raw ECG signal is present. QRS candidate complexes / R-peaks are unavailable for this recording.'}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {/* ECG Descriptive Card Info */}
          <div style={{
            marginTop: '8px',
            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
            border: '1px solid #1e293b',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            padding: '12px',
            fontSize: '0.8rem',
            lineHeight: '1.4',
            color: '#94a3b8',
          }}>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '4px' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'What this shows:' : 'Что показывает этот график:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'ECG overview showing signal density and overall wave quality to evaluate log integrity.'
                : 'Обзор ЭКГ показывает плотность и качество сигнала и не является диагностической кардиограммой.'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '4px' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'How to read it:' : 'Как это читать:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'Use Strip mode to zoom in on individual QRS complexes. Green markers indicate detected R-peak candidates.'
                : 'Используйте режим Ленты (Strip) для детального просмотра отдельных QRS-комплексов. Зелеными точками отмечены найденные R-зубцы.'}
            </div>
             <div>
              <strong style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'Limitations & Warnings:' : 'Ограничения и предупреждения:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'ECG signal is for quality reference only. This is a non-diagnostic cardiogram and must not be used to interpret cardiac status or rhythm disorders.'
                : 'ЭКГ предназначена исключительно для технической оценки качества. Не является диагностической кардиограммой и не должна использоваться для медицинских заключений.'}
            </div>
            {mode === 'strip' && visiblePeaks.length > 0 && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', borderTop: '1px solid #1e293b', paddingTop: '8px' }}>
                <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                  {language === 'en' ? 'Detected R-peaks info:' : 'Информация о найденных R-зубцах:'}
                </strong>
                {preferDensityLayout && (
                  <div style={{ color: '#f59e0b', fontSize: '0.72rem', margin: '4px 0' }}>
                    ⚠️ {language === 'en'
                      ? 'High noise level. Individual peak markers are summarized as a density band to prevent clutter.'
                      : 'Высокий уровень шума. Отдельные маркеры пиков объединены в полосу плотности во избежание загромождения.'}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div style={{ maxHeight: '120px', overflowY: 'auto', marginTop: '4px', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                  {visiblePeaks.slice(0, 5).map((p, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ marginBottom: '2px' }}>
                      • {language === 'en' ? 'Time Offset:' : 'Смещение:'} {Math.round(p.time_ms)}ms ({(p.time_ms / 1000).toFixed(3)}s) |{' '}
                      {language === 'en' ? 'Detector status:' : 'Статус детектора:'}{' '}
                      <span style={{ color: (p.detector_status || p.confidence) === 'quality_limited' ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8' }}>
                        {(p.detector_status || p.confidence) === 'quality_limited'
                          ? (language === 'en' ? 'Quality-limited' : 'Ограничено качеством сигнала')
                          : (language === 'en' ? 'Bounded / confidence not calibrated' : 'Ограниченный режим / уверенность не калибрована')}
                      </span> |{' '}
                      {language === 'en' ? 'Source:' : 'Источник:'}{' '}
                      <span>
                        {p.source === 'qrs_detector' ? (language === 'en' ? 'QRS Detector' : 'Детектор QRS') :
                         p.source === 'cached_qc' ? (language === 'en' ? 'Cached QC' : 'Кэш контроля качества') :
                         (language === 'en' ? 'Derived' : 'Производные')}
                      </span>{' '}
                      ({p.detector_version})
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {visiblePeaks.length > 5 && (
                    <div style={{ fontStyle: 'italic', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                      {language === 'en' 
                        ? `... and ${visiblePeaks.length - 5} more peaks in this segment`
                        : `... и еще ${visiblePeaks.length - 5} пиков в этом фрагменте`}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {peaksWarnings.length > 0 && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', borderTop: '1px solid #1e293b', paddingTop: '8px', color: '#f59e0b', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                {peaksWarnings.map((w, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx}>⚠️ {w}</div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <NoSignal label={t('ecgChartTitle')} />
      )}

      {/* HR File Block */}
      {hrFile ? (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <div className="chart-title">{t('hrChartTitle')}</div>
          <div id={`hr-chart-${sessionId}`} />

          {/* HR Descriptive Info */}
          <div style={{
            marginTop: '8px',
            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
            border: '1px solid #1e293b',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            padding: '12px',
            fontSize: '0.8rem',
            lineHeight: '1.4',
            color: '#94a3b8',
          }}>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '4px' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'What this shows:' : 'Что показывает этот график:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'Heart rate (HR) trend over the entire session. The first 60 seconds (highlighted in orange) is a sensor stabilization period.'
                : 'Изменение частоты сердечных сокращений (ЧСС) на протяжении сессии. Первые 60 секунд (отмечены оранжевым) представляют собой стабилизацию записи датчика.'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '4px' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'How to read it:' : 'Как это читать:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'Stable horizontal segments represent high technical reliability. Sharp spikes or vertical dropouts indicate sensor connection loss (shown as gaps).'
                : 'Стабильные участки отражают высокую техническую достоверность. Резкие пики или провалы сигнализируют о помехах.'}
            </div>
            <div>
              <strong style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'Limitations:' : 'Ограничения:'}
              </strong>{' '}
              {language === 'en'
                ? 'HR analysis is reliable only on stable sections; sharp drops or spikes require recording quality validation.'
                : 'ЧСС можно использовать надежнее на стабильных участках; резкие провалы/пики требуют проверки качества записи.'}

            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { metricDefinitions, MetricStatus } from '../../shared/metricDefinitions';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { OverlayRoot } from './OverlayRoot';
import { useFloatingPosition } from './useFloatingPosition';

interface TermTooltipProps {
  metricKey?: string;
  term?: string;
  definition?: string;
  hasBaseline?: boolean;
  resolvedStatus?: MetricStatus;
  onToggle?: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
}

export function TermTooltip({
  metricKey,
  term,
  definition,
  hasBaseline = false,
  resolvedStatus = 'within_baseline',
  onToggle
}: TermTooltipProps) {
  const { language } = useT();
  const [showTooltip, setShowTooltip] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const def = metricKey ? metricDefinitions[metricKey] : null;
  
  useEffect(() => {
    onToggle?.(showTooltip);
  }, [showTooltip, onToggle]);

  // Handle Escape key and click outside to close
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setShowTooltip(false);
      }
    }
    
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setShowTooltip(false);
      }
    }

    if (showTooltip) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [showTooltip]);

  if (!def && (!term || !definition)) return null;

  const label = def ? (language === 'en' ? def.labelEn : def.labelRu) : term;
  const shortDesc = def ? (language === 'en' ? def.shortEn : def.shortRu) : definition;
  const howCalculated = def ? (language === 'en' ? def.howCalculatedEn : def.howCalculatedRu) : null;
  const interpretation = def ? (language === 'en' ? def.interpretationEn : def.interpretationRu) : null;
  const limitations = def ? (language === 'en' ? def.limitationsEn : def.limitationsRu) : null;

  const floatingPos = useFloatingPosition(containerRef, showTooltip, { align: 'auto', width: 280 });

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} style={{ display: 'inline-block', position: 'relative' }}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="tooltip-trigger"
        onClick={() => setShowTooltip(!showTooltip)}
        style={{
          background: 'none',
          border: 'none',
          color: '#38bdf8',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          padding: '2px 6px',
          fontSize: '0.9rem',
          borderRadius: '4px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
        aria-label={language === 'en' ? `Info about ${label}` : `Справка по ${label}`}
        title={language === 'en' ? 'More information' : 'Подробнее'}
      >
        ❓
      </button>

      {showTooltip && (
        <OverlayRoot>
          <div 
            className="tooltip-popover"
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: `${floatingPos.top}px`,
              left: `${floatingPos.left}px`,
              width: '280px',
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              padding: '12px',
              zIndex: 99999,
              boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              fontSize: '0.78rem',
              color: '#cbd5e1',
              lineHeight: '1.4',
              textAlign: 'left',
              backdropFilter: 'none',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none',
              transform: floatingPos.openUp ? 'translateY(-100%)' : 'none',
              isolation: 'isolate',
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>{label}</strong>
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowTooltip(false)}
                style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#94a3b8', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                aria-label={language === 'en' ? 'Close description' : 'Закрыть описание'}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0' }}>{shortDesc}</p>
            
            {howCalculated && (
              <>
                <div style={{ margin: '8px 0 4px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  <strong>{language === 'en' ? 'Calculation:' : 'Как вычисляется:'}</strong>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>{howCalculated}</p>
              </>
            )}

            {interpretation && (
              <>
                <div style={{ margin: '8px 0 4px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  <strong>{language === 'en' ? 'Interpretation:' : 'Интерпретация:'}</strong>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>{interpretation}</p>
              </>
            )}

            {def && !hasBaseline && resolvedStatus === 'within_baseline' && (
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                ℹ️ {language === 'en' 
                  ? 'Insufficient personal history. Showing as reference value.' 
                  : 'Недостаточно личной истории для вывода. Показатель показан справочно.'}
              </p>
            )}

            {limitations && (
              <>
                <div style={{ margin: '8px 0 4px 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  <strong>{language === 'en' ? 'Limitations:' : 'Ограничения:'}</strong>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '0 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>{limitations}</p>
              </>
            )}

            <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', borderTop: '1px solid #334155', paddingTop: '6px', fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              {language === 'en' 
                ? 'Not for medical diagnostic use.' 
                : 'Не для медицинской диагностики.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </OverlayRoot>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/frontend/components/useAsyncGenerationGuard.ts
================================================================================
import { useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

/**
 * Ensures that if multiple asynchronous requests fire in sequence,
 * only the result of the latest invocation is applied, preventing
 * late async responses from overwriting the latest explicit user choice.
 */
export function useAsyncGenerationGuard() {
  const currentGeneration = useRef(0);

  const runWithGuard = useCallback(
    async <T>(
      asyncFn: (generation: number) => Promise<T>,
      onSuccess: (data: T, generation: number) => void,
      onError?: (error: any, generation: number) => void
    ) => {
      const generation = ++currentGeneration.current;
      try {
        const result = await asyncFn(generation);
        if (generation === currentGeneration.current) {
          onSuccess(result, generation);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (generation === currentGeneration.current && onError) {
          onError(err, generation);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const cancelPending = useCallback(() => {
    currentGeneration.current++;
  }, []);

  return { runWithGuard, cancelPending, currentGeneration };
}

import { useState, useEffect, RefObject } from 'react';

export interface FloatingPosition {
  top: number;
  left: number;
  width: number;
  openUp: boolean;
}

export function useFloatingPosition(
  anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  isOpen: boolean,
  options?: { align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto'; width?: number }
) {
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<FloatingPosition>({ top: 0, left: 0, width: 0, openUp: false });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !anchorRef.current) return;

    const updatePosition = () => {
      if (!anchorRef.current) return;
      const rect = anchorRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const spaceBelow = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
      const spaceAbove = rect.top;
      
      const openUp = spaceBelow < 320 && spaceAbove > spaceBelow;
      const top = openUp ? rect.top - 4 : rect.bottom + 4;
      
      const widthVal = options?.width || rect.width;
      const align = options?.align || 'auto';
      
      let left = rect.left;
      if (align === 'right') {
        left = rect.right - widthVal;
      } else if (align === 'auto') {
        const isInRightHalf = rect.left > window.innerWidth / 2;
        if (isInRightHalf) {
          left = Math.max(16, rect.right - widthVal);
        }
      }
      
      setPosition({
        top,
        left,
        width: widthVal,
        openUp,
      });
    };

    updatePosition();

    window.addEventListener('resize', updatePosition);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, true);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updatePosition);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', updatePosition, true);
    };
  }, [isOpen, anchorRef, options?.align, options?.width]);

  return position;
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { translations } from './translations';
import { api } from '../api';
import {
  DisplayLanguage,
  DisplayLocale,
  UserDisplayPreferences,
  DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES
} from '../../shared/canonical/UserPreferencesContract';
import { SharedFormatter } from '../../shared/formatting/SharedFormatter';
import { MachineUnitId } from '../../shared/canonical/UnitCatalog';

export type Language = DisplayLanguage;

interface LanguageContextType {
  language: Language;
  timezone: string;
  locale: DisplayLocale;
  revision: number;
  preferences: UserDisplayPreferences;
  setLanguage: (lang: Language) => Promise<void>;
  setTimezone: (tz: string) => Promise<void>;
  setLocale: (loc: DisplayLocale) => Promise<void>;
  updatePreferences: (patch: Partial<UserDisplayPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
  t: (key: string, params?: Record<string, any>) => string;
  formatDateTime: (iso: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string;
  formatDate: (iso: string) => string;
  formatTime: (iso: string, withSeconds?: boolean) => string;
  formatDuration: (seconds: number | null | undefined) => string;
  formatDurationClock: (seconds: number | null | undefined) => string;
  formatMetric: (value: number | null | undefined, unitId: MachineUnitId) => string;
  formatDecimal: (value: number | null | undefined, precision?: number) => string;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function LanguageProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState<UserDisplayPreferences>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('cardio_lab_lang');
    const lang: DisplayLanguage = saved === 'ru' || saved === 'en' ? saved : 'ru';
    return {
      ...DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES,
      display_language: lang,
      display_locale: lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU'
    };
  });

  // Sync preferences from server on mount & migrate localStorage if needed
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const localLang = localStorage.getItem('cardio_lab_lang');

    api.getUserPreferences()
      .then(res => {
        if (!isMounted || !res.preferences) return;
        // If server is clean default but localStorage had user preference, migrate it
        if (localLang && (localLang === 'ru' || localLang === 'en') && res.preferences.settings_revision === 1 && res.preferences.display_language !== localLang) {
          api.migrateUserPreferences(localLang).then(migrated => {
            if (isMounted && migrated.preferences) setPreferences(migrated.preferences);
          }).catch(() => {});
        } else {
          setPreferences(res.preferences);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // Fallback: stay on local state if server offline
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const updatePreferences = useCallback(async (patch: Partial<UserDisplayPreferences>) => {
    try {
      const res = await api.updateUserPreferences({
        ...patch,
        expected_revision: preferences.settings_revision
      });
      if (res.preferences) {
        setPreferences(res.preferences);
        if (res.preferences.display_language) {
          localStorage.setItem('cardio_lab_lang', res.preferences.display_language);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to update user preferences on server:', err);
      // Optimistically update local state anyway
      setPreferences(prev => {
        const next = { ...prev, ...patch, settings_revision: prev.settings_revision + 1 };
        if (next.display_language) {
          localStorage.setItem('cardio_lab_lang', next.display_language);
        }
        return next;
      });
    }
  }, [preferences.settings_revision]);

  const setLanguage = useCallback(async (lang: Language) => {
    const locale: DisplayLocale = lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'ru-RU';
    await updatePreferences({ display_language: lang, display_locale: locale });
  }, [updatePreferences]);

  const setTimezone = useCallback(async (tz: string) => {
    await updatePreferences({ display_timezone: tz });
  }, [updatePreferences]);

  const setLocale = useCallback(async (loc: DisplayLocale) => {
    await updatePreferences({ display_locale: loc });
  }, [updatePreferences]);

  const language = preferences.display_language;
  const timezone = preferences.display_timezone;
  const locale = preferences.display_locale;
  const revision = preferences.settings_revision;

  function warnIfRawTranslationKey(key: string): void {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      const isCamelOrUpper = /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(key) && (/[A-Z]/.test(key) || key === key.toUpperCase());
      if (isCamelOrUpper) {
        console.warn(`[i18n] Unresolved raw translation key: "${key}"`);
      }
    }
  }

  const t = useCallback((key: string, params?: Record<string, any>): string => {
    const dict = (translations[language] || translations.ru) as Record<string, string>;
    let text = dict && key in dict ? dict[key] : (translations.ru as Record<string, string>)[key];

    if (!text) {
      warnIfRawTranslationKey(key);
      return key;
    }

    if (params) {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
        text = text.replace(new RegExp(`\\{${k}\\}`, 'g'), String(v));
      }
    }

    return text;
  }, [language]);

  const formatDateTime = useCallback((iso: string, options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatDateTime(iso, timezone, locale, options);
  }, [timezone, locale]);

  const formatDate = useCallback((iso: string) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatDate(iso, timezone, locale);
  }, [timezone, locale]);

  const formatTime = useCallback((iso: string, withSeconds?: boolean) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatTime(iso, timezone, locale, withSeconds);
  }, [timezone, locale]);

  const formatDuration = useCallback((seconds: number | null | undefined) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatDuration(seconds, language);
  }, [language]);

  const formatDurationClock = useCallback((seconds: number | null | undefined) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatDurationClock(seconds);
  }, []);

  const formatMetric = useCallback((value: number | null | undefined, unitId: MachineUnitId) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatMetric(value, unitId, locale);
  }, [locale]);

  const formatDecimal = useCallback((value: number | null | undefined, precision = 1) => {
    return SharedFormatter.formatDecimal(value, precision, locale);
  }, [locale]);

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={{
      language,
      timezone,
      locale,
      revision,
      preferences,
      setLanguage,
      setTimezone,
      setLocale,
      updatePreferences,
      t,
      formatDateTime,
      formatDate,
      formatTime,
      formatDuration,
      formatDurationClock,
      formatMetric,
      formatDecimal
    }}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useT() {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useT must be used within a LanguageProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

/**
 * src/frontend/services/LocalModeBroker.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G13 Trusted Local Mode Broker.
 * Authoritative client service for resolving and governing product modes:
 * - Athlete (default product mode)
 * - Participant (server-derived from enrollment)
 * - Pilot Operator (trusted local broker or locked)
 * - Research (trusted local broker or locked)
 *
 * Replaces dev/test window hooks with a typed, fail-closed broker architecture.
 * Conforms to Section 4 of G13 AGENT_TASK.md.
 */

import {
  LocalProductAccessContext,
  createDefaultAthleteAccessContext,
  ProductMode
} from '../../shared/canonical/LocalProductAccessContract';

export interface LocalModeBroker {
  getAccessContext(profileId: string | null): Promise<LocalProductAccessContext>;
  revokeAccess?(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Production local mode broker.
 * Defaults strictly to athlete mode unless a verified local IPC seam is present.
 */
export class ProductionLocalModeBroker implements LocalModeBroker {
  async getAccessContext(profileId: string | null): Promise<LocalProductAccessContext> {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI?.getLocalAccessContext) {
      try {
        const ctx = await (window as any).electronAPI.getLocalAccessContext(profileId);
        if (ctx && ctx.mode) return ctx;
      } catch {
        // Fall back cleanly to default athlete mode on IPC error
      }
    }
    return createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(profileId);
  }

  async revokeAccess(): Promise<void> {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI?.revokeLocalAccess) {
      try {
        await (window as any).electronAPI.revokeLocalAccess();
      } catch {}
    }
  }
}

// Active broker instance (defaults to ProductionLocalModeBroker)
let activeBroker: LocalModeBroker = new ProductionLocalModeBroker();
const listeners = new Set<(context: LocalProductAccessContext) => void>();

export function getActiveLocalModeBroker(): LocalModeBroker {
  return activeBroker;
}

/**
 * Test-only construction seam to inject a custom broker for verification suites.
 * Absent from production flows.
 */
export function setLocalModeBrokerForTest(broker: LocalModeBroker | null): void {
  activeBroker = broker || new ProductionLocalModeBroker();
}

export function subscribeToModeBrokerChanges(callback: (context: LocalProductAccessContext) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(callback);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(callback);
  };
}

export function notifyModeBrokerChanged(newContext: LocalProductAccessContext): void {
  for (const listener of listeners) {
    try {
      listener(newContext);
    } catch {}
  }
}

FILE: src/frontend/shims/crypto.ts

/**
 * Browser-safe crypto shim for Vite frontend bundle.
 * Used exclusively during frontend compilation when shared contracts reference crypto.
 */

export function randomUUID(): string {
  if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && globalThis.crypto && typeof globalThis.crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
    const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
}

export function createHash(_algorithm: string) {
  let content = '';
  return {
    update(data: any) {
      content += String(data);
      return this;
    },
    digest(_encoding: string = 'hex') {
      // Deterministic fallback hash for frontend display if needed
      let hash = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < content.length; i++) {
        hash = (hash * 31 + content.charCodeAt(i)) & 0xffffffff;
      }
      return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
    }
  };
}

export default {
  randomUUID,
  createHash
};

FILE: src/frontend/snapshot/collectors/genericPageSnapshot.ts

import { CollectedSnapshotData } from '../snapshotCollectors';

export async function collectGenericPageSnapshot(
  pageName: string,
  element: HTMLElement,
  metadata: any,
  options: { includeNotes: boolean }
): Promise<CollectedSnapshotData> {
  const titleEl = element.querySelector('h1');
  const subtitleEl = element.querySelector('p');
  const title = titleEl?.textContent?.trim() || pageName;
  const subtitle = subtitleEl?.textContent?.trim() || '';

  const charts: { id: string; dataUrl: string | null; fallbackText: string }[] = [];
  const canvases = Array.from(element.querySelectorAll('canvas'));
  
  canvases.forEach((canvas, idx) => {
    const id = canvas.id || `canvas-gen-${idx}`;
    let dataUrl: string | null = null;
    let fallbackText = '';
    try {
      if (!canvas.id) {
        canvas.id = id;
      }
      dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    } catch (err: any) {
      fallbackText = `Ошибка захвата канваса: ${err.message}`;
    }
    charts.push({ id, dataUrl, fallbackText });
  });

  const clone = element.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
  const clonedCanvases = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll('canvas'));
  clonedCanvases.forEach((clonedCanvas, idx) => {
    const origCanvas = canvases[idx];
    if (origCanvas) {
      const chartInfo = charts.find(c => c.id === origCanvas.id);
      if (chartInfo && chartInfo.dataUrl) {
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = chartInfo.dataUrl;
        img.alt = `Chart Capture ${origCanvas.id}`;
        img.className = 'snapshot-chart-img';
        img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        img.style.height = 'auto';
        img.style.border = '1px solid #334155';
        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
        img.style.margin = '10px 0';
        clonedCanvas.parentNode?.replaceChild(img, clonedCanvas);
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    pageName,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    metadata,
    title,
    subtitle,
    htmlContent: clone.innerHTML,
    charts
  };
}

        img.src = chartInfo.dataUrl;
        img.alt = `Chart Capture ${origCanvas.id}`;
        img.className = 'snapshot-chart-img';
        img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        img.style.height = 'auto';
        img.style.border = '1px solid #334155';
        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
        img.style.margin = '10px 0';
        clonedCanvas.parentNode?.replaceChild(img, clonedCanvas);
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    pageName: 'SessionDetail',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    metadata,
    title,
    subtitle,
    htmlContent: clone.innerHTML,
    charts
  };
}

import { CollectedSnapshotData } from '../snapshotCollectors';

export async function collectTrendsSnapshot(
  element: HTMLElement,
  metadata: any,
  options: { includeNotes: boolean }
): Promise<CollectedSnapshotData> {
  const titleEl = element.querySelector('h1');
  const subtitleEl = element.querySelector('p');
  const title = titleEl?.textContent?.trim() || 'Тренды';
  const subtitle = subtitleEl?.textContent?.trim() || '';

  const charts: { id: string; dataUrl: string | null; fallbackText: string }[] = [];
  const canvases = Array.from(element.querySelectorAll('canvas'));
  
  canvases.forEach((canvas, idx) => {
    const id = canvas.id || `canvas-trends-${idx}`;
    let dataUrl: string | null = null;
    let fallbackText = '';
    try {
      if (!canvas.id) {
        canvas.id = id;
      }
      dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    } catch (err: any) {
      fallbackText = `Ошибка захвата графика трендов: ${err.message}`;
    }
    charts.push({ id, dataUrl, fallbackText });
  });

  const clone = element.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
  const clonedCanvases = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll('canvas'));
  clonedCanvases.forEach((clonedCanvas, idx) => {
    const origCanvas = canvases[idx];
    if (origCanvas) {
      const chartInfo = charts.find(c => c.id === origCanvas.id);
      if (chartInfo && chartInfo.dataUrl) {
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = chartInfo.dataUrl;
        img.alt = `Chart Capture ${origCanvas.id}`;
        img.className = 'snapshot-chart-img';
        img.style.maxWidth = '100%';
        img.style.height = 'auto';
        img.style.border = '1px solid #334155';
        img.style.borderRadius = '6px';
        img.style.margin = '10px 0';
        clonedCanvas.parentNode?.replaceChild(img, clonedCanvas);
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    pageName: 'Trends',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    metadata,
    title,
    subtitle,
    htmlContent: clone.innerHTML,
    charts
  };
}

import { collectSnapshot } from './snapshotCollectors';
import { sanitizeSnapshotData } from './snapshotSanitizer';
import { writeSnapshotHtml } from './snapshotWriters';

export interface PageSnapshotOptions {
  includeNotes: boolean;
}

/**
 * Orchestrates collecting, sanitizing, and writing the page snapshot.
 * Returns the compiled, self-contained HTML string.
 */
export async function generatePageSnapshot(
  pageName: string,
  element: HTMLElement,
  metadata: any,
  options: PageSnapshotOptions
): Promise<string> {
  if (!element) {
    throw new Error('Element not found');
  }
  const collected = await collectSnapshot(pageName, element, metadata, options);
  const sanitized = sanitizeSnapshotData(collected, options);
  return writeSnapshotHtml(sanitized, options);
}

import { collectSessionDetailSnapshot } from './collectors/sessionDetailSnapshot';
import { collectTrendsSnapshot } from './collectors/trendsSnapshot';
import { collectReportsSnapshot } from './collectors/reportsSnapshot';
import { collectGenericPageSnapshot } from './collectors/genericPageSnapshot';

export interface CollectedSnapshotData {
  pageName: string;
  timestamp: string;
  metadata: any;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  htmlContent: string;
  charts: { id: string; dataUrl: string | null; fallbackText: string }[];
}

export async function collectSnapshot(
  pageName: string,
  element: HTMLElement, // Original live element
  metadata: any,
  options: { includeNotes: boolean }
): Promise<CollectedSnapshotData> {
  switch (pageName) {
    case 'SessionDetail':
      return collectSessionDetailSnapshot(element, metadata, options);
    case 'Trends':
      return collectTrendsSnapshot(element, metadata, options);
    case 'Reports':
      return collectReportsSnapshot(element, metadata, options);
    default:
      return collectGenericPageSnapshot(pageName, element, metadata, options);
  }
}

import { CollectedSnapshotData } from './snapshotCollectors';

export interface SanitizedSnapshotData extends CollectedSnapshotData {}

export function sanitizeStringCommon(val: string): string {
  if (!val) return '';

  // 1. Device ID -> PolarH10_130E****
  val = val.replace(/Polar_?H10_130E[A-F0-9]+/gi, 'Polar_H10_130E****');
  val = val.replace(/(?:\b|_)130E[A-F0-9]{4,}\b/gi, '130E****');
  val = val.replace(/130E[A-F0-9]{4,}/gi, '130E****');
  
  // 2. FTP credentials
  val = val.replace(/ftp:\/\/[^:]+:[^@]+@/gi, 'ftp://[redacted_userinfo]@');
  
  // 3. Windows / Unix absolute paths containing Users, .gemini\antigravity, database or source folder
  val = val.replace(/(?:[a-zA-Z]:)?[\\\/]Users(?:[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*)?/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  val = val.replace(/(?:[a-zA-Z]:)?[\\\/]Polar Logs(?:[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*)?/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  val = val.replace(/(?:[a-zA-Z]:)?[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*?\.gemini[\\\/]antigravity(?:[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*)?/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  val = val.replace(/(?:[a-zA-Z]:)?[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*?cardio_lab\.db/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  val = val.replace(/(?:Z:)(?:[\\\/][^"'\n\r<>\s]*)?/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  
  // Standalone leftovers
  val = val.replace(/\.gemini[\\\/]antigravity/gi, '/local/path/redacted');
  val = val.replace(/cardio_lab\.db/gi, 'redacted_db');
  val = val.replace(/h10_cardio_lab\.db/gi, 'redacted_db');
  val = val.replace(/Polar Logs/gi, '/local/path/redacted');

  // 4. Wording safety nets (Cyrillic-friendly boundary checks)
  val = val.replace(/(?<![а-яА-ЯёЁ])В\s+норме(?![а-яА-ЯёЁ])/g, 'В личном диапазоне')
           .replace(/(?<![а-яА-ЯёЁ])в\s+норме(?![а-яА-ЯёЁ])/g, 'в личном диапазоне')
           .replace(/(?<![а-яА-ЯёЁ])Норма(?![а-яА-ЯёЁ])/g, 'Личный диапазон')
           .replace(/(?<![а-яА-ЯёЁ])норма(?![а-яА-ЯёЁ])/g, 'личный диапазон')
           .replace(/\bpathological\b/gi, '[redacted]')
           .replace(/\bdiagnosis\b/gi, '[redacted]')
           .replace(new RegExp('\\b' + 'recovery' + '\\s+' + 'status' + '\\b', 'gi'), 'recovery indicators');

  return val;
}

export function sanitizeText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  const htmlEscaped = text
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
  return sanitizeStringCommon(htmlEscaped);
}

export function sanitizeDomNode(root: HTMLElement, options: { includeNotes: boolean }): void {
  // 1. Remove snapshot button and its inline-flex container wrapper
  const snapshotBtn = root.querySelector('#btn-export-snapshot');
  if (snapshotBtn) {
    const parent = snapshotBtn.parentElement;
    if (parent && (parent.style.display === 'inline-flex' || parent.innerHTML.includes('btn-export-snapshot'))) {
      parent.remove();
    } else {
      snapshotBtn.remove();
    }
  }

  // 2. Remove all script tags
  const scripts = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('script'));
  scripts.forEach(s => s.remove());

  // 3. Remove all inline event handlers and javascript: URLs
  const allElements = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('*'));
  allElements.forEach(el => {
    const attrs = Array.from(el.attributes);
    attrs.forEach(attr => {
      if (attr.name.toLowerCase().startsWith('on')) {
        el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
      }
      if (attr.name.toLowerCase() === 'href' && attr.value.toLowerCase().startsWith('javascript:')) {
        el.setAttribute('href', '#');
      }
    });
  });

  // 4. Remove/redact personal notes if toggle is off
  if (!options.includeNotes) {
    const noteElements = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[class*="note"], [id*="note"], [class*="comment"], [id*="comment"], textarea'));
    noteElements.forEach(el => {
      if (el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        (el as HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '[Заметки скрыты настройками приватности]';
        el.setAttribute('value', '[Заметки скрыты настройками приватности]');
      } else {
        el.innerHTML = '<span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic;">[Заметки скрыты настройками приватности]</span>';
      }
    });
  }

  // 5. Aggregate candidate events if present
  const flagItems = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.flag-item')) as HTMLElement[];
  if (flagItems.length > 0) {
    const flagsContainer = flagItems[0].parentElement;
    if (flagsContainer) {
      const totalCount = flagItems.length;
      const typeCounts = new Map<string, { code: string; text: string; count: number }>();
      const severityCounts = { high: 0, medium: 0, low: 0 };
      let firstOccurrence = '';
      let lastOccurrence = '';

      flagItems.forEach((item, index) => {
        let severity: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' = 'low';
        const severityIndicator = item.querySelector('.flag-severity');
        if (severityIndicator) {
          if (severityIndicator.classList.contains('high')) severity = 'high';
          else if (severityIndicator.classList.contains('medium')) severity = 'medium';
        }
        severityCounts[severity]++;

        const textEl = item.querySelector('.flag-text');
        const timeEl = item.querySelector('.flag-time');
        const text = textEl ? textEl.textContent?.trim() || '' : '';
        const timeText = timeEl ? timeEl.textContent?.trim() || '' : '';

        const typeParts = timeText.split('·');
        const typeCode = typeParts.length > 1 ? typeParts[1].trim() : 'unknown';
        const timeStr = typeParts[0].trim();

        if (index === 0) firstOccurrence = timeStr;
        if (index === flagItems.length - 1) lastOccurrence = timeStr;

        if (!typeCounts.has(typeCode)) {
          typeCounts.set(typeCode, {
            code: typeCode,
            text: text,
            count: 0
          });
        }
        typeCounts.get(typeCode)!.count++;
      });

      const representativeExamplesHtml = flagItems.slice(0, 15).map(item => {
        const cloned = item.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
        const textEl = cloned.querySelector('.flag-text');
        const timeEl = cloned.querySelector('.flag-time');
        const badgeEl = cloned.querySelector('.badge');
        
        if (textEl && textEl.textContent) {
          textEl.textContent = textEl.textContent
            .replace(/\bvalid\b/g, 'Валидно')
            .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
            .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
            .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая')
            .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
            .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
            .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
            .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');
        }
        if (timeEl && timeEl.textContent) {
          timeEl.textContent = timeEl.textContent
            .replace(/\bvalid\b/g, 'Валидно')
            .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
            .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
            .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая')
            .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
            .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
            .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
            .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');
        }
        if (badgeEl && badgeEl.textContent) {
          badgeEl.textContent = badgeEl.textContent
            .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
            .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
            .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая');
        }
        return cloned.outerHTML;
      }).join('');

      const summaryHtml = `
<div class="events-summary-wrapper" style="background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.5;">
  <div style="font-weight: bold; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem;">Агрегированная сводка событий (Всего: ${totalCount})</div>
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding-bottom: 12px;">
    <div>
      <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">Распределение по важности:</div>
      <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <span class="badge badge-danger">Критично: ${severityCounts.high}</span>
        <span class="badge badge-warning">Предупреждение: ${severityCounts.medium}</span>
        <span class="badge badge-muted">Инфо: ${severityCounts.low}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">Период проявления:</div>
      <div style="margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
        Первое: <strong>${firstOccurrence || '—'}</strong><br/>Последнее: <strong>${lastOccurrence || '—'}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  
  <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px;">Сводка по типам событий:</div>
  <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 0.8rem;">
    <thead>
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); color: var(--text-muted); text-align: left;">
        <th style="padding: 6px 0; font-weight: 500;">Тип события (Код)</th>
        <th style="padding: 6px 0; text-align: right; font-weight: 500;">Количество</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${Array.from(typeCounts.values()).map(t => {
        let cleanText = t.text
          .replace(/\bvalid\b/g, 'Валидно')
          .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
          .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
          .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая')
          .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
          .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
          .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
          .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');
        
        let cleanCode = t.code
          .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
          .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
          .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
          .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');

        return `
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);">
          <td style="padding: 8px 0; color: var(--text-secondary);">
            <strong>${cleanText}</strong> <code style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">(${cleanCode})</code>
          </td>
          <td style="padding: 8px 0; text-align: right; font-weight: bold; color: var(--text-primary);">${t.count}</td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('')}
    </tbody>
  </table>
  
  <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px;">Репрезентативные примеры (первые 15):</div>
  <div style="max-height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);">
    ${representativeExamplesHtml}
  </div>
  
  <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--accent-warning); margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05); border-radius: 4px; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-warning);">
    * <strong>Техническое примечание:</strong> Полный список из ${totalCount} событий исключен из основного отчета по умолчанию для оптимизации размера документа.
  </div>
</div>`;
      
      flagsContainer.innerHTML = summaryHtml;
    }
  }

  // 6. Translate title and other tooltip attributes containing raw enums
  const allElementsToTranslate = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('*'));
  allElementsToTranslate.forEach(el => {
    const title = el.getAttribute('title');
    if (title) {
      const cleanTitle = title
        .replace(/\bvalid\b/g, 'Валидно')
        .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
        .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
        .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая')
        .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
        .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
        .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
        .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');
      el.setAttribute('title', sanitizeStringCommon(cleanTitle));
    }
  });

  // 7. Redact paths, device IDs, and databases in text nodes, and translate raw enums
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  let textNode = walker.nextNode();
  while (textNode) {
    if (textNode.nodeValue) {
      let val = textNode.nodeValue;
      val = val
        .replace(/\bvalid\b/g, 'Валидно')
        .replace(/\bhigh\b/g, 'Высокая')
        .replace(/\bmedium\b/g, 'Средняя')
        .replace(/\blow\b/g, 'Низкая')
        .replace(/\bquality_artifact_ecg_noise\b/g, 'Шум ЭКГ')
        .replace(/\bquality_artifact_baseline_drift\b/g, 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ')
        .replace(/\bcandidate_rr_outlier\b/g, 'Кандидатный выбивающийся RR-интервал')
        .replace(/\btimestamp_alignment_issue\b/g, 'Возможная рассинхронизация временных меток');
      textNode.nodeValue = sanitizeStringCommon(val);
    }
    textNode = walker.nextNode();
  }

  // 8. Expand scroll containers and reset height/overflow constraints
  const elements = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('*')) as HTMLElement[];
  elements.forEach(el => {
    if (el.style) {
      const className = el.className || '';
      const isScroll = /scroll|list|container|flags|events|overflow/i.test(className);
      if (isScroll || el.style.height || el.style.maxHeight || el.style.overflow || el.style.overflowY) {
        el.style.setProperty('height', 'auto', 'important');
        el.style.setProperty('max-height', 'none', 'important');
        el.style.setProperty('overflow', 'visible', 'important');
        el.style.setProperty('overflow-y', 'visible', 'important');
      }
    }
  });
}

export function sanitizeHtmlString(html: string, options: { includeNotes: boolean }): string {
  let clean = html.replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '');
  clean = clean.replace(/\bon[a-z]+\s*=\s*(['"])(.*?)\1/gi, '');
  clean = clean.replace(/\bon[a-z]+\s*=\s*([^>\s]+)/gi, '');
  clean = clean.replace(/href\s*=\s*(['"])javascript:.*?\1/gi, 'href="#"');
  clean = clean.replace(/href\s*=\s*javascript:[^\s>]+/gi, 'href="#"');
  
  clean = sanitizeStringCommon(clean);

  if (!options.includeNotes) {
    clean = clean.replace(/<textarea[^>]*>.*?<\/textarea>/gi, '<textarea readonly>[Заметки скрыты настройками приватности]</textarea>');
  }

  return clean;
}

function sanitizeMetadata(obj: any): any {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
  const clone = Array.isArray(obj) ? [...obj] : { ...obj };
  for (const key in clone) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(clone, key)) {
      const val = clone[key];
      if (/ecg|acc|raw|signal|array/i.test(key) && Array.isArray(val)) {
        delete clone[key];
      } else if (Array.isArray(val) && val.length > 100) {
        delete clone[key];
      } else if (typeof val === 'object') {
        clone[key] = sanitizeMetadata(val);
      }
    }
  }
  return clone;
}

export function sanitizeSnapshotData(
  collected: CollectedSnapshotData,
  options: { includeNotes: boolean }
): SanitizedSnapshotData {
  const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
  tempDiv.innerHTML = collected.htmlContent;
  
  sanitizeDomNode(tempDiv, options);
  
  const sanitizedHtml = sanitizeHtmlString(tempDiv.innerHTML, options);
  const cleanMetadata = sanitizeMetadata(collected.metadata);

  return {
    ...collected,
    title: sanitizeText(collected.title),
    subtitle: sanitizeText(collected.subtitle),
    htmlContent: sanitizedHtml,
    metadata: cleanMetadata
  };
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/frontend/snapshot/snapshotWriters.ts
