import { SanitizedSnapshotData, sanitizeText } from './snapshotSanitizer';

function translateEnum(val: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!val) return '—';
  const clean = val.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (clean === 'excellent') return 'Отличное';
  if (clean === 'good') return 'Хорошее';
  if (clean === 'usable') return 'Пригодное';
  if (clean === 'poor') return 'Низкое';
  if (clean === 'valid') return 'Валидно';
  if (clean === 'high') return 'Высокая / Высокое';
  if (clean === 'medium') return 'Средняя / Среднее';
  if (clean === 'low') return 'Низкая / Низкое';
  if (clean === 'none') return 'Отсутствует';
  if (clean === 'quality_limited') return 'Ограничено качеством';
  if (clean === 'insufficient_data') return 'Недостаточно данных';
  if (clean === 'not_applicable') return 'Не применимо';
  if (clean === 'within_baseline') return 'В пределах личного диапазона';
  if (clean === 'above_baseline') return 'Выше личного диапазона';
  if (clean === 'below_baseline') return 'Ниже личного диапазона';
  if (clean === 'quality_optimal') return 'Оптимальное';
  if (clean === 'quality_eligible') return 'Допустимое';
  if (clean === 'quality_unverified') return 'Не верифицировано';
  return val;
}

export function writeSnapshotHtml(
  data: SanitizedSnapshotData,
  options: { includeNotes: boolean }
): string {
  let cssRules = '';
  try {
    const styleSheets = Array.from(document.styleSheets);
    styleSheets.forEach(sheet => {
      try {
        const rules = Array.from(sheet.cssRules || []);
        rules.forEach(rule => {
          cssRules += rule.cssText + '\n';
        });
      } catch {
        // Safe cross-origin skip
      }
    });
  } catch {
    // Fail-safe
  }

  const metadata = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data.metadata || {}));
  let activeUser = metadata.activeUser || metadata.userId || 'default_user';
  if (/^(Polar|130E)/i.test(activeUser)) {
    activeUser = 'default_user';
  }
  metadata.activeUser = activeUser;
  if (metadata.userId) {
    metadata.userId = activeUser;
  }

  let deviceId = metadata.deviceId || metadata.device_id || '';
  if (deviceId) {
    if (/130E[A-F0-9]{4,}/i.test(deviceId)) {
      deviceId = '130E****';
    } else {
      deviceId = deviceId.replace(/\b130E[A-F0-9]{4,}\b/gi, '130E****');
      if (!/130E\*\*\*\*/i.test(deviceId)) {
        deviceId = '130E****';
      }
    }
  } else {
    deviceId = '130E****';
  }
  metadata.deviceId = deviceId;
  if (metadata.device_id) {
    metadata.device_id = deviceId;
  }

  const activityType = metadata.activityType || metadata.selectedCategory || 'unknown';
  const sessionId = metadata.sessionId || metadata.selectedSessionId || '';
  const pageName = data.pageName;
  const timestamp = data.timestamp;

  const buildInfo = metadata.buildInfo || {};
  const isPackaged = buildInfo.app_is_packaged !== undefined ? buildInfo.app_is_packaged : (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronBridge?.isPackaged === true);
  const appVersion = buildInfo.app_version || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronBridge?.appVersion) || '1.0.1-rc.8';
  const buildVersion = buildInfo.build_version || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronBridge?.buildVersion) || '1.0.1.8';
  const electronVersion = buildInfo.electron_version || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronBridge?.electronVersion) || (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.versions?.electron) || '43.0.0';
  const releaseCommit = buildInfo.release_commit || 'placeholder';

  // Inject provenance into metadata for the json block
  metadata.provenance = {
    generator: 'PageSnapshotService',
    route: `/${pageName}`,
    collector: `${pageName}Collector`,
    generated_at: timestamp,
    source: metadata.source || 'live_dom',
    source_type: 'live_dom_service',
    app_is_packaged: isPackaged,
    app_version: appVersion,
    build_version: buildVersion,
    electron_version: electronVersion,
    release_channel: buildInfo.release_channel || 'rc',
    release_commit: releaseCommit,
    runtime_mode: isPackaged ? 'packaged' : 'development',
    generator_file: 'snapshotWriters.ts'
  };

  let llmText = `
=== LLM ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===
Page Purpose: ${data.title}
Route: /${pageName}
Timestamp: ${timestamp}
Active User: ${activeUser}
Device ID: ${deviceId}
Activity Type: ${activityType}
Session ID: ${sessionId}

--- PROVENANCE ---
Generator: PageSnapshotService
Route: /${pageName}
Collector: ${pageName}Collector
Generated At: ${timestamp}
Source: ${metadata.source || 'live_dom'}
Source Type: ${metadata.sourceType || metadata.source_type || 'live_dom_service'}
Production Path Used: ${metadata.productionPathUsed !== undefined ? metadata.productionPathUsed : true}
Generator File: snapshotWriters.ts
Test or Script Command: ${metadata.testOrScriptCommand || metadata.test_or_script_command || 'npm run dev'}
App Is Packaged: ${isPackaged}
App Version: ${appVersion}
Build Version: ${buildVersion}
Release Commit: ${releaseCommit}
Electron Version: ${electronVersion}
Release Channel: rc
Runtime Mode: ${isPackaged ? 'packaged' : 'development'}

--- KEY METRICS & ANALYSIS ---
`;

  if (pageName === 'SessionDetail') {
    llmText += `
Session Details Summary:
- Average HR: ${metadata.avgHr || '—'} bpm
- RMSSD: ${metadata.rmssd || '—'} ms
- SDNN: ${metadata.sdnn || '—'} ms
- PNN50: ${metadata.pnn50 || '—'} %
- ECG/RR Match Quality: ${translateEnum(metadata.ecgRrMatchQuality)}
- Quality Score: ${metadata.qualityScore || metadata.overallQuality || '—'} %
- Duration: ${metadata.durationSeconds || '—'} sec
- Active User: ${activeUser}
- Activity Type: ${activityType}
- Session ID: ${sessionId}
- Baseline Status (Average HR): ${translateEnum(metadata.avgHrStatus)}
- Baseline Status (RMSSD): ${translateEnum(metadata.rmssdStatus)}
- Baseline Status (SDNN): ${translateEnum(metadata.sdnnStatus)}
- Baseline Status (pNN50): ${translateEnum(metadata.pnn50Status)}
- HRV Quality Status: ${translateEnum(metadata.hrvQuality)}
`;
  } else if (pageName === 'Trends') {
    llmText += `
Trends Data Summary:
- Personal Baseline Available: ${metadata.personalBaselineAvailable ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
- Sessions Used for Baseline: ${metadata.sessionsUsed !== undefined ? metadata.sessionsUsed : '—'}
- Active Category: ${metadata.selectedCategory || 'all'}
- Total Data Points: ${metadata.pointCounts !== undefined ? metadata.pointCounts : '—'}
- Baseline Confidence: ${translateEnum(metadata.confidence)}
`;
  } else {
    llmText += `
Generic view snapshot of ${pageName}.
`;
  }

  llmText += `
--- INFERENCES ---
What can be inferred:
- The user's visual dashboard and metrics as rendered in H10 Athlete Cardio Lab.
- General cardio metrics and HRV profiles if available.

What cannot be inferred:
- No medical diagnoses or direct clinical claims can be made. This is a non-diagnostic local dashboard.

--- SUGGESTED QUESTIONS FOR LLM ---
1. Проанализируй видимые показатели, качество записи, ограничения интерпретации и вопросы для ручной проверки.
2. Are there any visible anomalies in the Poincaré HRV cluster or ECG density?
3. How does this session compare to the baseline RMSSD/SDNN profile?
`;

  let bodyHtml = data.htmlContent;
  
  data.charts.forEach(c => {
    if (c.dataUrl) {
      const imgTag = `<img src="${c.dataUrl}" alt="Chart Capture ${c.id}" class="snapshot-chart-img" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 6px; margin: 10px 0;" />`;
      const canvasRegex = new RegExp(`<canvas[^>]*id=["']${c.id}["'][^>]*>.*?<\/canvas>`, 'gi');
      if (bodyHtml.match(canvasRegex)) {
        bodyHtml = bodyHtml.replace(canvasRegex, imgTag);
      } else {
        bodyHtml += `<div class="chart-append-fallback">${imgTag}</div>`;
      }
    } else {
      const warningBox = `
        <div class="card error-fallback-box" style="border: 1px solid var(--accent-danger); padding: 12px; margin: 12px 0;">
          <p style="color: var(--accent-danger); font-weight: bold; margin: 0 0 6px 0;">⚠️ Ошибка отрисовки графика (${c.id})</p>
          <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin: 0 0 8px 0;">${c.fallbackText}</p>
          <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.82rem;">
            <thead>
              <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; color: var(--text-muted);">
                <th style="text-align: left; padding: 4px;">Показатель</th>
                <th style="text-align: right; padding: 4px;">Значение</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr>
                <td style="padding: 4px;">Пользователь</td>
                <td style="text-align: right; padding: 4px;">${activeUser}</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td style="padding: 4px;">Категория</td>
                <td style="text-align: right; padding: 4px;">${activityType}</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td style="padding: 4px;">Session ID</td>
                <td style="text-align: right; padding: 4px;">${sessionId}</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      `;
      const canvasRegex = new RegExp(`<canvas[^>]*id=["']${c.id}["'][^>]*>.*?<\/canvas>`, 'gi');
      if (bodyHtml.match(canvasRegex)) {
        bodyHtml = bodyHtml.replace(canvasRegex, warningBox);
      } else {
        bodyHtml += warningBox;
      }
    }
  });

  const escapedMetadataJson = sanitizeText(JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2));

  return `<!-- H10_ATHLETE_SNAPSHOT_v1.0 -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>H10 Athlete Cardio Lab Snapshot - ${data.title}</title>
  <style>
    /* CSS Reset for full-page export */
    html, body, #root, .app-layout, .main-content {
      height: auto !important;
      overflow: visible !important;
    }
    /* Inlined App Styles */
    ${cssRules || `
      :root {
        --background: #0f172a;
        --card-bg: #1e293b;
        --text: #f8fafc;
        --text-muted: #94a3b8;
        --accent-primary: #3b82f6;
        --accent-danger: #ef4444;
      }
      body {
        background-color: var(--background);
        color: var(--text);
        font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 24px;
      }
      .card {
        background-color: var(--card-bg);
        border: 1px solid #334155;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
    `}
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- LLM_SUMMARY_START -->
  <!--
  ${llmText}
  -->
  <!-- LLM_SUMMARY_END -->

  <div style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted);">
    <strong>🔒 Локальный снимок экрана (конфиденциально)</strong><br />
    Этот файл содержит локальный слепок страницы. Все личные пути, пароли, сырые биометрические массивы и конфиденциальные данные Polar были автоматически вычищены или замаскированы. Файл не совершает сетевых запросов и не содержит исполняемых скриптов.
  </div>

  <div class="main-content snapshot-full-page">
    ${bodyHtml}
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top: 40px; border-top: 1px solid #334155; padding-top: 20px;">
    <h3 style="font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">Метаданные снимка (LLM-friendly)</h3>
    <pre id="llm-snapshot-metadata" data-type="application/json" style="background: #020617; border: 1px solid #1e293b; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; overflow-x: auto; color: #a7f3d0;">${escapedMetadataJson}</pre>
  </div>

</body>
</html>`;
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { EntitlementState } from '../../shared/entitlementContract';
import { PricingExperimentConfig, PricingPlanOption } from '../../shared/pricingExperimentContract';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { TierBadge } from '../components/TierBadge';
import { SupportBundleModal } from '../components/SupportBundleModal';
import { BetaFeedbackModal } from '../components/BetaFeedbackModal';

export function AboutView() {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [entitlements, setEntitlements] = useState<EntitlementState | null>(null);
  const [pricing, setPricing] = useState<PricingExperimentConfig | null>(null);
  const [licenseKeyInput, setLicenseKeyInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [licenseMsg, setLicenseMsg] = useState<{ text: string; success: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [applyingLicense, setApplyingLicense] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSupportModalOpen, setIsSupportModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isFeedbackModalOpen, setIsFeedbackModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const loadData = () => {
    api.getEntitlements()
      .then((data) => {
        if (data && data.tier) setEntitlements(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    api.getPricingExperiment()
      .then((data) => {
        if (data && Array.isArray(data.plans)) setPricing(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleApplyLicense = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!licenseKeyInput.trim()) return;
    setApplyingLicense(true);
    setLicenseMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.applyLicense(licenseKeyInput.trim());
      if (res.success) {
        setLicenseMsg({ text: res.message, success: true });
        setLicenseKeyInput('');
        loadData();
      } else {
        setLicenseMsg({ text: res.message, success: false });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLicenseMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Failed to apply license key', success: false });
    } finally {
      setApplyingLicense(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '32px 40px', maxWidth: '900px', margin: '0 auto' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '16px', marginBottom: '32px' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '42px', filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,60,60,0.5))' }}>❤</span>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.8rem', color: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 700 }}>
            CardioLab Workstation
          </h1>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
            {t('aboutVersion')}: <code style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>1.0.1-beta.11</code> · Windows x64
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid of cards */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
        {/* Card 1: Edition & Entitlements */}
        <div style={cardStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            <h2 style={sectionTitleStyle}>{t('aboutEntitlement')}</h2>
            {entitlements && <TierBadge tier={entitlements.tier} isActive={!entitlements.is_expired} />}
          </div>

          {entitlements && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px', fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
              <div>
                <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Статус:' : 'Status:'}</strong>{' '}
                <span style={{ color: !entitlements.is_expired ? '#34d399' : '#f87171' }}>
                  {!entitlements.is_expired
                    ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Активна' : 'Active')
                    : (language === 'ru' ? 'Истекла (только чтение)' : 'Expired (Read-only access)')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Проанализировано сессий:' : 'Analyzed sessions:'}</strong>{' '}
                {entitlements.trial_sessions_analyzed} / {entitlements.trial_session_limit || '∞'}
              </div>

              {/* Invariance declaration */}
              <div style={noticeBoxStyle}>
                <strong style={{ color: '#60a5fa' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Гарантия научной инвариантности:' : 'Scientific Invariance Guarantee:'}
                </strong>
                <p style={{ margin: '6px 0 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#93c5fd', lineHeight: '1.4' }}>
                  {language === 'ru'
                    ? 'Все научные алгоритмы, расчет показателей ВСР, спектральный анализ Welch и правила допуска сессий строго инвариантны во всех редакциях (Trial, Personal, Professional, Academic). Выбор лицензии влияет исключительно на коммерческие ограничения (число сессий, параллельные профили).'
                    : 'All scientific algorithms, HRV calculations, Welch spectral power, and task eligibility criteria remain invariant across all editions (Trial, Personal, Professional, Academic). Licensing only governs commercial usage boundaries.'}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* License Key entry */}
              <form onSubmit={handleApplyLicense} style={{ marginTop: '8px', display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder={language === 'ru' ? 'Введите лицензионный ключ...' : 'Enter license key...'}
                  value={licenseKeyInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setLicenseKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    padding: '8px 12px',
                    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                    border: '1px solid #334155',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: '#f8fafc',
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                  }}
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={applyingLicense || !licenseKeyInput.trim()}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: '#3b82f6',
                    color: '#ffffff',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    cursor: applyingLicense || !licenseKeyInput.trim() ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {applyingLicense ? '...' : (language === 'ru' ? 'Применить' : 'Apply')}
                </button>
              </form>
              {licenseMsg && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: licenseMsg.success ? '#34d399' : '#f87171' }}>
                  {licenseMsg.text}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Diagnostics & Beta Support */}
        <div style={cardStyle}>
          <h2 style={sectionTitleStyle}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Поддержка и обратная связь' : 'Support & Feedback'}
          </h2>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#cbd5e1', lineHeight: '1.5', margin: '0 0 16px' }}>
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Во время программы внешнего бета-тестирования вы можете создать безопасный архив технической поддержки или оставить отзыв о работе приложения.'
              : 'During the external beta program, you can generate a privacy-redacted support bundle or submit feedback regarding workstation stability.'}
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px' }}>
            <button
              id="about-open-support-btn"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsSupportModalOpen(true)}
              style={actionBtnStyle}
            >
              <span>📦</span> {t('supportBundleTitle')}
            </button>
            <button
              id="about-open-feedback-btn"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsFeedbackModalOpen(true)}
              style={{ ...actionBtnStyle, borderColor: '#05966955', color: '#34d399' }}
            >
              <span>💬</span> {t('betaFeedbackTitle')}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Pricing Corridors (Hypothesis only) */}
        {pricing && Array.isArray(pricing.plans) && (
          <div style={cardStyle}>
            <h2 style={sectionTitleStyle}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Исследовательские ценовые ориентиры (Beta)' : 'Planned Pricing Corridors (Beta Research)'}
            </h2>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#fbbf24', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: '6px', border: '1px solid #f59e0b33', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
              <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Исследовательские ценовые ориентиры (Beta):' : 'Notice:'}</strong>{' '}
              {language === 'ru'
                ? 'Указанные ценовые коридоры являются гипотезами для исследования в рамках закрытого бета-тестирования и сбора обратной связи. Настоящая версия не является публичной офертой и не осуществляет приём платежей.'
                : (pricing.disclaimer?.startsWith('PRICING_EXPERIMENT_NOTICE:') ? pricing.disclaimer.replace('PRICING_EXPERIMENT_NOTICE: ', '') : pricing.disclaimer)}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '12px' }}>
              {pricing.plans.map((p: PricingPlanOption) => (
                <div key={p.plan_id} style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', padding: '14px', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid #334155' }}>

                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#38bdf8', margin: '6px 0' }}>
                    ${p.suggested_price_usd} <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 400, color: '#94a3b8' }}>/ {p.billing_model}</span>

                </div>

        )}

        {/* Card 4: Legal & Non-Affiliation */}
        <div style={cardStyle}>
          <h2 style={sectionTitleStyle}>{t('aboutLegalTerms')}</h2>

            <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', padding: '12px', borderRadius: '6px', border: '1px solid #334155' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#e2e8f0' }}>Polar Electro Oy:</strong> {t('aboutNonAffiliation')}
            </div>
            <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', padding: '12px', borderRadius: '6px', border: '1px solid #f59e0b33', color: '#fbbf24' }}>
              <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Медицинское предупреждение:' : 'Medical Warning:'}</strong> {t('medicalDisclaimerText')}

                ? 'Все сторонние компоненты (Express, React, uPlot, PDFKit, Adm-Zip) используются в соответствии с лицензией MIT. Исходный код аналитических алгоритмов и документация подготовлены для открытой верификации.'
                : 'All third-party runtime components (Express, React, uPlot, PDFKit, Adm-Zip) are distributed under permissive MIT licenses. Verification datasets remain excluded from the distribution.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <SupportBundleModal isOpen={isSupportModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsSupportModalOpen(false)} />
      <BetaFeedbackModal isOpen={isFeedbackModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsFeedbackModalOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}

  borderRadius: '6px',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  display: 'inline-flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: '8px',
};


================================================================================
FILE: src/frontend/views/BetaOperationsView.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import {
  BetaCohort,
  BetaParticipant,
  SupportEpisode,
  SupportRootCauseClass,
  TriageSupportEpisodeRequest
} from '../../shared/betaContract';

export function BetaOperationsView() {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'cohorts' | 'invites' | 'participants' | 'decision' | 'bundles' | 'outcomes_support'>('cohorts');
  const [cohorts, setCohorts] = useState<BetaCohort[]>([]);
  const [participants, setParticipants] = useState<BetaParticipant[]>([]);
  const [invites, setInvites] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [activeContext, setActiveContext] = useState<any>(null);
  const [decisionMatrix, setDecisionMatrix] = useState<any>(null);
  const [cohortReport, setCohortReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [operatorSecret, setOperatorSecret] = useState<string>('');
  const [operatorVerified, setOperatorVerified] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [secretInput, setSecretInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [verifyingSecret, setVerifyingSecret] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [gateError, setGateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackMsg, setFeedbackMsg] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);

  // Triage modal state
  const [triagingEpisode, setTriagingEpisode] = useState<SupportEpisode | null>(null);
  const [triageCategory, setTriageCategory] = useState<'guidance' | 'defect' | 'self_service' | 'unsupported_input' | 'unresolved' | 'not_observed'>('guidance');
  const [triageRootCause, setTriageRootCause] = useState<SupportRootCauseClass>('user_guidance');
  const [triageOpMinutes, setTriageOpMinutes] = useState<number>(0);
  const [triageUserMinutes, setTriageUserMinutes] = useState<number>(0);
  const [triageStatus, setTriageStatus] = useState<'resolved' | 'unresolved' | 'unsupported_closed' | 'not_observed'>('resolved');
  const [triageNotes, setTriageNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [isSubmittingTriage, setIsSubmittingTriage] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Form states
  const [newCohortId, setNewCohortId] = useState('');
  const [newCohortName, setNewCohortName] = useState('');
  const [newCohortDesc, setNewCohortDesc] = useState('');
  const [newCohortSize, setNewCohortSize] = useState(30);

  const [inviteCohortId, setInviteCohortId] = useState('');
  const [inviteMaxUses, setInviteMaxUses] = useState(1);
  const [inviteNotes, setInviteNotes] = useState('');

  const [exportParticipantId, setExportParticipantId] = useState('');
  const [exportResult, setExportResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [importJson, setImportJson] = useState('');
  const [importResult, setImportResult] = useState<any>(null);

  // G3 Useful Outcome & Support states
  const [confirmSessionId, setConfirmSessionId] = useState('');
  const [confirmRecipientAction, setConfirmRecipientAction] = useState<'viewed_by_coach' | 'viewed_by_athlete' | 'stored_in_records' | 'shared_summary_confirmed'>('shared_summary_confirmed');
  const [confirmNotes, setConfirmNotes] = useState('');
  const [supportEpisodes, setSupportEpisodes] = useState<SupportEpisode[]>([]);
  const [naturalRepeats, setNaturalRepeats] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const refreshData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [cRes, pRes, ctxRes, dmRes, repRes, epRes, nrRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.listBetaCohorts().catch(() => ({ success: false, cohorts: [] })),
        api.listBetaParticipants().catch(() => ({ success: false, participants: [] })),
        api.getActiveBetaParticipant().catch(() => ({ success: false, active_context: null })),
        api.getBetaDecisionMatrix().catch(() => ({ success: false, decision_matrix: null })),
        api.getBetaCohortEvidenceReport().catch(() => ({ success: false, report: null })),
        api.listSupportEpisodes().catch(() => ({ success: false, episodes: [] })),
        api.listNaturalRepeats().catch(() => ({ success: false, repeats: [] }))
      ]);

      if (cRes.success && Array.isArray(cRes.cohorts)) {
        setCohorts(cRes.cohorts);
        if (!inviteCohortId && cRes.cohorts.length > 0) {
          setInviteCohortId(cRes.cohorts[0].cohort_id);
        }
      }
      if (pRes.success && Array.isArray(pRes.participants)) {
        setParticipants(pRes.participants);
        if (!exportParticipantId && pRes.participants.length > 0) {
          setExportParticipantId(pRes.participants[0].participant_id);
        }
      }
      if (ctxRes.success) {
        setActiveContext(ctxRes.active_context);
      }
      if (dmRes.success) {
        setDecisionMatrix(dmRes.decision_matrix);
      }
      if (repRes.success) {
        setCohortReport(repRes.report);
      }
      if (epRes.success && Array.isArray(epRes.episodes)) {
        setSupportEpisodes(epRes.episodes);
      }
      if (nrRes.success && Array.isArray(nrRes.repeats)) {
        setNaturalRepeats(nrRes.repeats);
      }

      if (operatorSecret) {
        const invRes = await api.listBetaInvites(undefined, operatorSecret).catch(() => ({ success: false, invites: [] }));
        if (invRes.success && Array.isArray(invRes.invites)) {
          setInvites(invRes.invites);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load Beta Operations data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (operatorVerified) {
      refreshData();
    }
  }, [operatorSecret, operatorVerified]);

  const handleCreateCohort = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newCohortId.trim() || !newCohortName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const payload: BetaCohort = {
        cohort_id: newCohortId.trim(),
        name: newCohortName.trim(),
        description: newCohortDesc.trim() || 'Operator created cohort',
        created_at_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        target_size: Number(newCohortSize) || 30,
        is_active: true,
        allowed_channels: ['invite_code', 'personal_referral', 'coach_referral']
      };
      const res = await api.registerBetaCohort(payload);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Когорта успешно создана' : 'Cohort created successfully', type: 'success' });
        setNewCohortId('');
        setNewCohortName('');
        setNewCohortDesc('');
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error creating cohort', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleIssueInvite = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inviteCohortId) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.issueBetaInvite(
        { cohort_id: inviteCohortId, max_uses: Number(inviteMaxUses) || 1, notes: inviteNotes.trim() },
        operatorSecret
      );
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({
          text: `${language === 'ru' ? 'Инвайт создан:' : 'Invite issued:'} ${res.invite?.invite_code || ''}`,
          type: 'success'
        });
        setInviteNotes('');
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error issuing invite', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeInvite = async (code: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await api.revokeBetaInvite(code, operatorSecret);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? `Инвайт ${code} отозван` : `Invite ${code} revoked`, type: 'success' });
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error revoking invite', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleSwitchParticipant = async (pid: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await api.switchActiveBetaParticipant(pid);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? `Активный контекст переключен на ${pid}` : `Active context switched to ${pid}`, type: 'success' });
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error switching participant', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleClearContext = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.clearActiveBetaParticipant();
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Активный контекст очищен' : 'Active context cleared', type: 'success' });
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error clearing context', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleExportBundle = async () => {
    if (!exportParticipantId) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.exportBetaEvidenceBundle(exportParticipantId, false);
      setExportResult(res);
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Бандл свидетельств успешно скомпилирован' : 'Evidence bundle compiled successfully', type: 'success' });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error exporting bundle', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleImportBundle = async () => {
    if (!importJson.trim()) return;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(importJson);
      const res = await api.importBetaEvidenceBundle(parsed);
      setImportResult(res);
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Бандл свидетельств успешно импортирован и проверен' : 'Evidence bundle imported and verified', type: 'success' });
      refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error importing bundle: invalid JSON or privacy violation', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmUsefulOutcome = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!confirmSessionId.trim()) return;
    try {
      const res = await api.confirmUsefulOutcome(confirmSessionId.trim(), {
        session_id: confirmSessionId.trim(),
        recipient_action: confirmRecipientAction,
        user_notes: confirmNotes.trim()
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({
          text: language === 'ru' ? `Полезный результат для сессии ${confirmSessionId} подтвержден!` : `Useful outcome confirmed for session ${confirmSessionId}!`,
          type: 'success'
        });
        setConfirmSessionId('');
        setConfirmNotes('');
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error confirming outcome', type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleVerifySecret = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!secretInput.trim()) return;
    setVerifyingSecret(true);
    setGateError(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.verifyOperatorSecret(secretInput.trim());
      if (res.valid) {
        setOperatorVerified(true);
        setOperatorSecret(secretInput.trim());
        setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Оператор успешно авторизован' : 'Operator successfully authorized', type: 'success' });
      } else {
        setGateError(res.error || (language === 'ru' ? 'Неверный секрет оператора' : 'Invalid operator secret'));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setGateError(err.message || (language === 'ru' ? 'Ошибка авторизации' : 'Authorization error'));
    } finally {
      setVerifyingSecret(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOperatorLogout = () => {
    setOperatorVerified(false);
    setOperatorSecret('');
    setSecretInput('');
    setInvites([]);
    setFeedbackMsg({ text: language === 'ru' ? 'Сессия оператора завершена' : 'Operator session locked', type: 'success' });
  };

  const handleOpenTriage = (ep: SupportEpisode) => {
    setTriagingEpisode(ep);
    setTriageCategory(ep.category || 'guidance');
    setTriageRootCause(ep.root_cause_class || 'user_guidance');
    setTriageOpMinutes(ep.operator_active_minutes || 0);
    setTriageUserMinutes(ep.user_active_minutes || 0);
    setTriageStatus(ep.resolution_status || 'resolved');
    setTriageNotes('');
  };

  const handleSubmitTriage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!triagingEpisode) return;
    setIsSubmittingTriage(true);
    try {
      const req: TriageSupportEpisodeRequest = {
        episode_id: triagingEpisode.episode_id,
        category: triageCategory,
        root_cause_class: triageRootCause,
        operator_active_minutes: Number(triageOpMinutes) || 0,
        user_active_minutes: Number(triageUserMinutes) || 0,
        resolution_status: triageStatus,
        triage_notes: triageNotes.trim()
      };
      const res = await api.triageSupportEpisode(req, operatorSecret);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackMsg({
          text: language === 'ru' ? `Обращение ${triagingEpisode.episode_id} успешно трировано!` : `Episode ${triagingEpisode.episode_id} triaged!`,
          type: 'success'
        });
        setTriagingEpisode(null);
        refreshData();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: err?.message || 'Error triaging episode', type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingTriage(false);
    }
  };

  if (!operatorVerified) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: '40px 24px', maxWidth: '600px', margin: '40px auto', color: '#f8fafc' }} data-testid="operator-access-gate">
        <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #1e293b', borderRadius: '12px', padding: '32px' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '2rem', marginBottom: '16px' }}>🔐</div>
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '1.4rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Операторский контур пилота (Operator Gate)' : 'Operator Access Gate'}
          </h2>
          <p style={{ margin: '0 0 24px 0', fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#94a3b8', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Управление когортами, выпуск/отзыв криптографических инвайтов, экспорт/импорт пакетов свидетельств и операционный триаж обращений требуют авторизации оператора.'
              : 'Cohort management, cryptographically signed invites, evidence bundle operations, and support triage require verified operator credentials.'}
          </p>

          {gateError && (
            <div id="operator-gate-error" style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: '6px', marginBottom: '16px', backgroundColor: '#7f1d1d', border: '1px solid #dc2626', color: '#fca5a5', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              ⚠ {gateError}
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleVerifySecret}>
            <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#cbd5e1', marginBottom: '6px', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Операторский ключ (Operator Secret)' : 'Operator Secret'}
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              id="operator-secret-input"
              value={secretInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSecretInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={language === 'ru' ? 'Введите секрет оператора...' : 'Enter operator secret...'}
              style={{ width: '100%', padding: '10px 14px', backgroundColor: '#020617', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', color: '#f8fafc', fontSize: '0.9rem', marginBottom: '20px' }}
              autoComplete="off"
              required
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              id="operator-login-btn"
              disabled={verifyingSecret || !secretInput.trim()}
              style={{ width: '100%', padding: '10px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.9rem' }}
            >
              {verifyingSecret ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Проверка...' : 'Verifying...') : (language === 'ru' ? 'Войти в операторский контур' : 'Unlock Operator Surface')}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '24px', maxWidth: '1200px', margin: '0 auto', color: '#f8fafc' }} data-testid="beta-operations-view">
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: '24px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', paddingBottom: '16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '1.6rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>
            🔬 {language === 'ru' ? 'Управление закрытым бета-тестированием (Beta Operations)' : 'Controlled Beta Operations & Decision Governance'}
          </h1>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.9rem', maxWidth: '800px' }}>
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Локальный пульт оператора: управление когортами, выпуск/отзыв инвайтов, псевдонимизированные участники, аудит согласий, экспорт/импорт свидетельств и матрица решений (Scale/Narrow/Pause).'
              : 'Local operator workspace: manage cohorts, issue/revoke invites, pseudonymous participants, consent audits, privacy-scanned evidence bundles and scale/narrow/pause decision matrix.'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Active Context Card */}
        <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #1e293b', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '10px 16px', minWidth: '280px' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Текущий активный контекст' : 'Active Tester Context'}
          </div>
          {activeContext ? (
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
                {activeContext.participant_id}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Когорта:' : 'Cohort:'} {activeContext.cohort_id} | {activeContext.is_external_tester ? 'External' : 'Internal'}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleClearContext}
                style={{ marginTop: '6px', fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '3px 8px', backgroundColor: '#334155', color: '#f8fafc', border: 'none', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
              >
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Очистить контекст' : 'Clear Context'}
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Не установлен (Default)' : 'None (Default)'}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Operator Session Bar */}
      <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '12px 16px', marginBottom: '20px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem' }}>🔑</span>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#34d399' }}>
              ✓ {language === 'ru' ? 'Оператор авторизован (сессия в памяти)' : 'Operator Verified (In-Memory Session)'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Ключ хранится исключительно в памяти и не сохраняется на диск.' : 'Credentials strictly memory-only; never persisted to disk or logs.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={refreshData}
            style={{ padding: '6px 14px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 600 }}
          >
            🔄 {language === 'ru' ? 'Обновить' : 'Refresh'}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            id="operator-logout-btn"
            onClick={handleOperatorLogout}
            style={{ padding: '6px 14px', backgroundColor: '#334155', color: '#f8fafc', border: 'none', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}
          >
            🔒 {language === 'ru' ? 'Заблокировать' : 'Lock'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Feedback Message */}
      {feedbackMsg && (
        <div style={{
          padding: '10px 16px',
          borderRadius: '6px',
          marginBottom: '20px',
          backgroundColor: feedbackMsg.type === 'success' ? '#064e3b' : '#7f1d1d',
          border: `1px solid ${feedbackMsg.type === 'success' ? '#059669' : '#dc2626'}`,
          color: '#f8fafc',
          fontSize: '0.88rem'
        }}>
          {feedbackMsg.text}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', paddingBottom: '10px', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('cohorts')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'cohorts' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          👥 {language === 'ru' ? 'Когорты' : 'Cohorts'} ({cohorts.length})
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('invites')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'invites' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          ✉️ {language === 'ru' ? 'Инвайты' : 'Invites'} ({invites.length})
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('participants')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'participants' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          👤 {language === 'ru' ? 'Участники и согласия' : 'Participants & Consent'} ({participants.length})
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('decision')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'decision' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          ⚖️ {language === 'ru' ? 'Матрица решений' : 'Decision Matrix'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('bundles')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'bundles' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          📦 {language === 'ru' ? 'Экспорт / Импорт бандлов' : 'Evidence Bundles'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('outcomes_support')}
          style={{
            padding: '8px 16px',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: activeTab === 'outcomes_support' ? '#0284c7' : '#1e293b',
            color: '#f8fafc',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: '0.85rem'
          }}
        >
          ✨ {language === 'ru' ? 'Полезные исходы и поддержка' : 'Useful Outcomes & Support'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab: Cohorts */}
      {activeTab === 'cohorts' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
          {/* Create Cohort Card */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newCohortId}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCohortId(e.target.value)}

                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}

                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Название когорты</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newCohortName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCohortName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Closed Beta Pilot 2"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Целевой размер (target_size)</label>

                  type="number"
                  value={newCohortSize}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCohortSize(Number(e.target.value))}

              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Описание</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newCohortDesc}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCohortDesc(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Athletes and coaches pilot"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  style={{ padding: '8px 20px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}

                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Зарегистрировать когорту' : 'Register Cohort'}

              </div>

            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>

            </h3>
            {cohorts.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Когорты не найдены' : 'No cohorts found'}</div>
            ) : (

                {cohorts.map((c) => (
                  <div key={c.cohort_id} style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '12px 16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: '1rem' }}>
                        {c.name} <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#64748b' }}>({c.cohort_id})</span>
                      </div>

                        {c.description} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Цель:' : 'Target:'} {c.target_size} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Каналы:' : 'Channels:'} {c.allowed_channels.join(', ')}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <span style={{
                        padding: '4px 10px',
                        borderRadius: '4px',
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        backgroundColor: c.is_active ? '#064e3b' : '#334155',
                        color: c.is_active ? '#34d399' : '#94a3b8'
                      }}>
                        {c.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab: Invites */}
      {activeTab === 'invites' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
          {/* Issue Invite Card */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>

            </h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleIssueInvite} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '16px' }}>

                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Когорта</label>
                <select
                  value={inviteCohortId}
                  onChange={(e) => setInviteCohortId(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}
                >
                  {cohorts.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.cohort_id} value={c.cohort_id}>{c.name} ({c.cohort_id})</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Макс. использований (max_uses)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={inviteMaxUses}
                  onChange={(e) => setInviteMaxUses(Number(e.target.value))}

                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', marginBottom: '4px' }}>Заметки (notes)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={inviteNotes}
                  onChange={(e) => setInviteNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Invite for coach John"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc' }}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ gridColumn: '1 / -1', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  style={{ padding: '8px 20px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}
                >
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Выпустить подписанный инвайт' : 'Issue Signed Invite'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Invite Registry List */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              📜 {language === 'ru' ? 'Реестр выданных инвайтов' : 'Issued Invites Registry'}
            </h3>
            {invites.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Инвайты не найдены (введите секрет оператора для доступа к реестру)' : 'No invites found (enter operator secret above to access registry)'}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                {invites.map((inv) => (
                  <div key={inv.invite_code} style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '12px 16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
                        {inv.invite_code}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                        {language === 'ru' ? 'Когорта:' : 'Cohort:'} {inv.cohort_id} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Использовано:' : 'Used:'} {inv.uses_count}/{inv.max_uses} | {inv.notes || 'No notes'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                      <span style={{
                        padding: '3px 8px',
                        borderRadius: '4px',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        backgroundColor: inv.is_revoked ? '#7f1d1d' : '#064e3b',
                        color: inv.is_revoked ? '#fca5a5' : '#34d399'
                      }}>
                        {inv.is_revoked ? 'REVOKED' : 'VALID'}
                      </span>
                      {!inv.is_revoked && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRevokeInvite(inv.invite_code)}
                          style={{ padding: '4px 10px', backgroundColor: '#ef4444', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}
                        >
                          {language === 'ru' ? 'Отозвать' : 'Revoke'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab: Participants & Consent */}
      {activeTab === 'participants' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              👥 {language === 'ru' ? 'Псевдонимизированные участники и аудит согласий' : 'Pseudonymous Participants & Consent Audit'}
            </h3>
            {participants.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ color: '#64748b' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Участники не зарегистрированы' : 'No participants registered'}</div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
                {participants.map((p) => {
                  const isActive = activeContext?.participant_id === p.participant_id;
                  return (
                    <div key={p.participant_id} style={{
                      backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                      border: `1px solid ${isActive ? '#38bdf8' : '#334155'}`,
                      borderRadius: '6px',
                      padding: '14px 16px',
                      display: 'flex',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      alignItems: 'center'
                    }}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                          <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, color: '#38bdf8', fontSize: '1rem' }}>
                            {p.participant_id}
                          </span>
                          <span style={{
                            padding: '2px 8px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            backgroundColor: p.participant_class === 'qualified_external' || p.is_external_tester ? '#1e3a8a' : '#374151',
                            color: p.participant_class === 'qualified_external' || p.is_external_tester ? '#93c5fd' : '#9ca3af'
                          }}>
                            {p.participant_class ? p.participant_class.toUpperCase() : (p.is_external_tester ? 'QUALIFIED_EXTERNAL' : 'INTERNAL')}
                          </span>
                          {isActive && (
                            <span style={{ padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: '4px', fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 700, backgroundColor: '#064e3b', color: '#34d399' }}>
                              ACTIVE
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                          {language === 'ru' ? 'Когорта:' : 'Cohort:'} <strong>{p.cohort_id}</strong> | {language === 'ru' ? 'Канал:' : 'Channel:'} {p.source_channel} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Тариф:' : 'Tier:'} {p.entitlement_tier} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Вариант:' : 'Variant:'} {p.experiment_variant_id}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                          📅 {language === 'ru' ? 'Согласие:' : 'Consent:'} {p.consent_given_at_utc || 'NONE'} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Политика:' : 'Policy ver:'} v{p.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0'} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Первый вход:' : 'First seen:'} {p.first_seen_at_utc}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        {!isActive && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleSwitchParticipant(p.participant_id)}
                            style={{ padding: '6px 14px', backgroundColor: '#334155', color: '#f8fafc', border: 'none', borderRadius: '4px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}
                          >
                            {language === 'ru' ? 'Переключить контекст' : 'Switch Context'}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab: Decision Matrix */}
      {activeTab === 'decision' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
          {/* Overall Verdict Banner */}
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
            border: '1px solid #334155',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            padding: '20px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between'
          }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#94a3b8', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Итоговое решение по закрытой бете (Overall Verdict):' : 'Overall Beta Decision Verdict:'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1.8rem', fontWeight: 800, color: decisionMatrix?.overall_verdict === 'inconclusive' ? '#f59e0b' : '#38bdf8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                {decisionMatrix?.overall_verdict?.toUpperCase() || 'INCONCLUSIVE'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                {decisionMatrix?.rationale_summary || (language === 'ru' ? 'Ожидание завершения окон наблюдения внешних участников.' : 'Awaiting external tester completed observation windows.')}

            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>

              </div>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: decisionMatrix?.external_evidence_status?.has_real_external_testers ? '#34d399' : '#f87171', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>

              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                {decisionMatrix?.external_evidence_status?.observation_window_status || 'awaiting_external_cohort_data'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Dimension Assessments Table */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              📊 {language === 'ru' ? 'Оценка стратегических измерений (6 Dimensions)' : 'Strategic Dimension Assessments (6 Dimensions)'}
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
              {decisionMatrix?.dimension_assessments?.map((dim: any) => (
                <div key={dim.dimension} style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '14px 16px' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#e2e8f0', fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
                      {dim.dimension}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <span style={{
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: '4px',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        backgroundColor: dim.evidence_status === 'mature' ? '#064e3b' : '#451a03',
                        color: dim.evidence_status === 'mature' ? '#34d399' : '#f59e0b'
                      }}>
                        {dim.evidence_status}
                      </span>
                      <span style={{
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: '4px',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        backgroundColor: dim.verdict_contribution === 'scale' ? '#064e3b' : '#374151',
                        color: dim.verdict_contribution === 'scale' ? '#34d399' : '#e5e7eb'
                      }}>
                        {dim.verdict_contribution.toUpperCase()}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>
                    {dim.metric_value}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Правило порога:' : 'Threshold Rule:'} {dim.threshold_rule}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                    {dim.notes}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab: Bundles */}
      {activeTab === 'bundles' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
          {/* Export Bundle Card */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              📤 {language === 'ru' ? 'Экспорт бандла свидетельств участника' : 'Export Participant Evidence Bundle'}
            </h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              <select
                value={exportParticipantId}
                onChange={(e) => setExportParticipantId(e.target.value)}
                style={{ padding: '8px 12px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '4px', color: '#f8fafc', minWidth: '240px' }}
              >
                {participants.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.participant_id} value={p.participant_id}>{p.participant_id} ({p.cohort_id})</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportBundle}
                style={{ padding: '8px 20px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Скомпилировать бандл' : 'Compile Bundle'}
              </button>
            </div>

            {exportResult && (
              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#34d399', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                  ✓ {language === 'ru' ? 'Бандл готов (Privacy Cleared):' : 'Bundle Ready (Privacy Cleared):'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  SHA-256: <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#38bdf8' }}>{exportResult.bundle?.manifest?.sha256 || 'N/A'}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Событий:' : 'Event Counts:'} {JSON.stringify(exportResult.bundle?.manifest?.event_counts || {})}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Import Bundle Card */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#1e293b', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px', padding: '20px' }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 16px 0', fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              📥 {language === 'ru' ? 'Импорт и валидация внешнего бандла свидетельств' : 'Import & Validate External Evidence Bundle'}
            </h3>
            <textarea
              value={importJson}
              onChange={(e) => setImportJson(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={language === 'ru' ? 'Вставьте JSON бандла свидетельств...' : 'Paste Evidence Bundle JSON here...'}
              rows={6}
              style={{ width: '100%', padding: '10px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #475569', borderRadius: '6px', color: '#f8fafc', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.8rem', marginBottom: '12px' }}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleImportBundle}
              style={{ padding: '8px 20px', backgroundColor: '#0284c7', color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600 }}
            >
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Импортировать и верифицировать' : 'Import & Verify'}
            </button>

            {importResult && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '16px', backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '6px', padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#34d399', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                  ✓ {language === 'ru' ? 'Результат импорта:' : 'Import Result:'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Статус:' : 'Status:'} {importResult.validation_status || 'verified'} | {language === 'ru' ? 'Импортировано событий:' : 'Imported events:'} {importResult.imported_events_count || 0}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

const ZONE_COLORS = [
  'hsl(210,80%,55%)',
  'hsl(152,70%,45%)',
  'hsl(50,90%,52%)',
