function formatDate(iso?: string, lang?: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return d.toLocaleDateString(lang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

export function CompareView({
  initialTargetSessionId,
  initialPeerSessionId,
  activeUserId,
  onNavigateToSession,
  onNavigateToExport,
  journeyContext
}: CompareViewProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';

  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<SessionSummary[]>([]);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [targetSessionId, setTargetSessionId] = useState<string>(initialTargetSessionId || '');
  const [compareMode, setCompareMode] = useState<'peer' | 'baseline'>(() => {
    const userKey = activeUserId || 'default';
    const saved = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(`cardiolab_compare_mode_${userKey}`) : null;
    if (saved === 'peer' || saved === 'baseline') return saved;
    return 'peer';
  });
  const [peerSessionId, setPeerSessionId] = useState<string>(initialPeerSessionId || '');
  
  const [targetCanonical, setTargetCanonical] = useState<CanonicalSessionResult | null>(null);
  const [peerCanonical, setPeerCanonical] = useState<CanonicalSessionResult | null>(null);
  const [canonicalComparison, setCanonicalComparison] = useState<CanonicalComparisonResult | null>(null);
  const [trendsData, setTrendsData] = useState<TrendsResponse | null>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showBaselineBreakdown, setShowBaselineBreakdown] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleSetCompareMode = (mode: 'peer' | 'baseline') => {
    setCompareMode(mode);
    const userKey = activeUserId || 'default';
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`cardiolab_compare_mode_${userKey}`, mode);
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleSetPeerSessionId = (peerId: string) => {
    setPeerSessionId(peerId);
    const userKey = activeUserId || 'default';
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`cardiolab_peer_session_${userKey}`, peerId);
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  // Load profiles, sessions, and trends
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    Promise.all([
      api.getUserProfiles().catch(() => []),
      api.getSessions(activeUserId).catch(() => []),
      api.getTrends({ user_id: activeUserId, target_session_id: initialTargetSessionId || undefined }).catch(() => null)
    ]).then(([profList, sessList, trends]) => {
      if (isCancelled) return;
      setProfiles(profList);
      setSessions(sessList);
      if (trends) setTrendsData(trends);

      if (sessList.length > 0) {
        const hasTarget = initialTargetSessionId && sessList.some(s => s.id === initialTargetSessionId);
        const selectedTarget = hasTarget ? initialTargetSessionId! : sessList[0].id;
        setTargetSessionId(selectedTarget);

        const userKey = activeUserId || 'default';
        const savedMode = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(`cardiolab_compare_mode_${userKey}`) : null;
        if (savedMode === 'peer' || savedMode === 'baseline') {
          setCompareMode(savedMode);
        } else if (!initialPeerSessionId) {
          const eligiblePeerCount = Math.max(0, sessList.length - 1);
          const baselineStatus = evaluateBaselineEligibility(eligiblePeerCount);
          if (baselineStatus.isEligible && trends?.personal_baseline_available) {
            setCompareMode('baseline');
          } else {
            setCompareMode('peer');
          }
        } else {
          setCompareMode('peer');
        }

        const savedPeerSessionId = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(`cardiolab_peer_session_${userKey}`) : null;

        // Pick initial peer session
        if (initialPeerSessionId && sessList.some(s => s.id === initialPeerSessionId && s.id !== selectedTarget)) {
          setPeerSessionId(initialPeerSessionId);
        } else if (savedPeerSessionId && sessList.some(s => s.id === savedPeerSessionId && s.id !== selectedTarget)) {
          setPeerSessionId(savedPeerSessionId);
        } else {
          const targetRep = sessList.find(x => x.id === selectedTarget)?.canonical_representative_id || selectedTarget;
          const targetUser = sessList.find(x => x.id === selectedTarget)?.user_id;
          const eligiblePeers = sessList.filter(s => 
            s.id !== selectedTarget && 
            (s.canonical_representative_id || s.id) !== targetRep &&
            (!targetUser || s.user_id === targetUser)
          );
          const fallbackPeers = sessList.filter(s => s.id !== selectedTarget);
          if (eligiblePeers.length > 0) {
            setPeerSessionId(eligiblePeers[0].id);
          } else if (fallbackPeers.length > 0) {
            setPeerSessionId(fallbackPeers[0].id);
          }
        }
      }
    }).catch(e => {
      if (!isCancelled) setError(e.message);
    })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => { isCancelled = true; };
  }, [activeUserId, initialTargetSessionId, initialPeerSessionId]);

  // Keep peer selection valid whenever sessions or target changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!targetSessionId || sessions.length <= 1) return;
    const targetRep = sessions.find(x => x.id === targetSessionId)?.canonical_representative_id || targetSessionId;
    const targetUser = sessions.find(x => x.id === targetSessionId)?.user_id;
    const currentPeerRep = sessions.find(x => x.id === peerSessionId)?.canonical_representative_id || peerSessionId;
    
    if (!peerSessionId || peerSessionId === targetSessionId || currentPeerRep === targetRep) {
      const eligible = sessions.find(s => 
        s.id !== targetSessionId && 
        (s.canonical_representative_id || s.id) !== targetRep &&
        (!targetUser || s.user_id === targetUser)
      );
      if (eligible) {
        setPeerSessionId(eligible.id);
      }
    }
  }, [targetSessionId, peerSessionId, sessions]);

  // Poll trends if background historical recompute is running
  useEffect(() => {
    const isRunning = trendsData?.recompute_status?.is_running ||
      (trendsData?.baseline_qualification_breakdown?.legacy_unverified_count ?? 0) > 0;
    if (!isRunning) return;

    let isCancelled = false;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      api.getTrends({ user_id: activeUserId, target_session_id: targetSessionId || undefined })
        .then(trends => {
          if (!isCancelled && trends) {
            setTrendsData(trends);
            if (!trends.recompute_status?.is_running &&
                (trends.baseline_qualification_breakdown?.legacy_unverified_count ?? 0) === 0) {
              clearInterval(interval);
            }
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 2000);

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [trendsData?.recompute_status?.is_running, trendsData?.baseline_qualification_breakdown?.legacy_unverified_count, activeUserId]);

  const handleTargetChange = (newTargetId: string) => {
    setTargetSessionId(newTargetId);
    const newTarget = sessions.find(x => x.id === newTargetId);
    const newTargetRep = newTarget?.canonical_representative_id || newTargetId;
    const newTargetUser = newTarget?.user_id;
    
    const eligiblePeers = sessions.filter(s => 
      s.id !== newTargetId && 
      (s.canonical_representative_id || s.id) !== newTargetRep &&
      (!newTargetUser || s.user_id === newTargetUser)
    );
    if (!peerSessionId || peerSessionId === newTargetId || !eligiblePeers.some(p => p.id === peerSessionId)) {
      if (eligiblePeers.length > 0) {
        setPeerSessionId(eligiblePeers[0].id);
      } else {
        const fallback = sessions.find(s => s.id !== newTargetId);
        if (fallback) setPeerSessionId(fallback.id);
      }
    }
  };

  // Load target canonical data
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    if (!targetSessionId) {
      setTargetCanonical(null);
      return;
    }
    api.getCanonicalSession(targetSessionId)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isCancelled) setTargetCanonical(res);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          console.warn('Canonical target load error:', e.message);
          setTargetCanonical(null);
        }
      });
    return () => { isCancelled = true; };
  }, [targetSessionId]);

  // Load peer canonical data or trends baseline
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    if (compareMode === 'peer') {
      if (!peerSessionId) {
        setPeerCanonical(null);
        return;
      }
      api.getCanonicalSession(peerSessionId)
        .then((res) => {
          if (!isCancelled) setPeerCanonical(res);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          if (!isCancelled) {
            console.warn('Canonical peer load error:', e.message);
            setPeerCanonical(null);
          }
        });
    } else {
      api.getTrends({ user_id: activeUserId, target_session_id: targetSessionId || undefined })
        .then((res) => {
          if (!isCancelled) setTrendsData(res);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          if (!isCancelled) {
            console.warn('Trends load error:', e.message);
            setTrendsData(null);
          }
        });
    }
    return () => { isCancelled = true; };
  }, [compareMode, peerSessionId, targetSessionId, activeUserId]);

  // Load authoritative canonical comparison
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    if (!targetSessionId) {
      setCanonicalComparison(null);
      return;
    }
    if (compareMode === 'peer' && !peerSessionId) {
      setCanonicalComparison(null);
      return;
    }
    api.getComparison({
      target_session_id: targetSessionId,
      peer_session_id: compareMode === 'peer' ? peerSessionId : undefined,
      mode: compareMode,
      user_id: activeUserId
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isCancelled) setCanonicalComparison(res);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          console.warn('Canonical comparison load error:', e.message);
          setCanonicalComparison(null);
        }
      });
    return () => { isCancelled = true; };
  }, [targetSessionId, peerSessionId, compareMode, activeUserId]);

  const targetSession = sessions.find(s => s.id === targetSessionId);
  const peerSession = sessions.find(s => s.id === peerSessionId);

  // Structured Compatibility Analysis
  const compatibility = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (compareMode === 'baseline') {
      const eligiblePeerCount = Math.max(0, sessions.length - 1);
      const sessionsCount = trendsData?.sessions_used ?? eligiblePeerCount;
      const baselineElig = evaluateBaselineEligibility(sessionsCount);
      const hasBaseline = Boolean(trendsData?.personal_baseline_available && baselineElig.isEligible && sessionsCount >= 5);

      if (!hasBaseline) {
        return {
          state: 'BASELINE_FORMING',
          level: 'WARNING',
          labelRu: 'Базовый коридор формируется',
          labelEn: 'Baseline corridor forming',
          badgeRu: 'ФОРМИРУЕТСЯ',
          badgeEn: 'FORMING',
          reasons: [isRu ? baselineElig.statusMessageRu : baselineElig.statusMessageEn],
          canCompare: false
        };
      }

      // Check target metrics eligibility
      const targetCanonicalHrvElig = targetCanonical?.core_metrics
        ? (
            (targetCanonical.core_metrics.rmssd?.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE' || targetCanonical.core_metrics.rmssd?.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') &&
            (targetCanonical.core_metrics.sdnn?.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE' || targetCanonical.core_metrics.sdnn?.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS')
          )
        : ((targetSession as any)?.evidence_mode === 'canonical' && targetSession?.rmssd !== null);

      if (!targetCanonicalHrvElig) {
        return {
          state: 'BASELINE_ACTIVE_TARGET_LIMITED',
          level: 'WARNING',
          labelRu: 'Базовый коридор активен · Метрики целевой сессии ограничены',
          labelEn: 'Baseline corridor active · Target session metrics limited',
          badgeRu: 'ОГРАНИЧЕНО',
          badgeEn: 'LIMITED',
          reasons: [
            isRu
              ? `Базовый коридор сформирован (${trendsData?.sessions_used || sessionsCount} сессий, LOO медиана p50).`
              : `Baseline corridor formed (${trendsData?.sessions_used || sessionsCount} sessions, LOO median p50).`,
            isRu
              ? 'Метрики вариабельности (HRV) целевой сессии недоступны для сравнения из-за качества или длительности.'
              : 'Target session HRV metrics unavailable for comparison due to quality or duration.'
          ],
          canCompare: true
        };
      }

      return {
        state: 'BASELINE_ACTIVE_FULLY_COMPARABLE',
        level: 'COMPATIBLE',
        labelRu: 'Базовый коридор активен · Полная совместимость (LOO)',
        labelEn: 'Baseline corridor active · Fully compatible (LOO)',
        badgeRu: 'СОВМЕСТИМЫ',
        badgeEn: 'COMPATIBLE',
        reasons: [
          isRu
            ? `Использовано ${trendsData?.sessions_used || sessionsCount} сессий когорты для расчета базового коридора (Leave-One-Out p50 / IQR).`
            : `Used ${trendsData?.sessions_used || sessionsCount} cohort sessions for baseline corridor (Leave-One-Out p50 / IQR).`,
          isRu
            ? 'Целевая сессия сопоставляется с индивидуальным референтным коридором без искажения собственного веса.'
            : 'Target session is compared against individual reference corridor without self-weight distortion.'
        ],
        canCompare: true
      };
    }

    if (!targetSession || !peerSession) {
      return {
        level: 'UNKNOWN',
        badgeRu: 'НЕ ВЫБРАНО',
        badgeEn: 'NOT SELECTED',
        labelRu: 'Выберите сессии',
        labelEn: 'Select sessions',
        reasons: [],
        canCompare: false
      };
    }

    const targetFingerprint = targetSession.canonical_representative_id || targetSession.id;
    const peerFingerprint = peerSession.canonical_representative_id || peerSession.id;

    // Evaluate canonical comparison compatibility contract
    const evalResult = evaluateCompareCompatibility(
      {
        id: targetSession.id,
        activity_type: targetSession.activity_type,
        canonical_fingerprint: targetFingerprint
      },
      {
        id: peerSession.id,
        activity_type: peerSession.activity_type,
        canonical_fingerprint: peerFingerprint
      }
    );

    if (!evalResult.canCompare) {
      return {
        state: 'PEER_INCOMPATIBLE',
        level: 'CONFLICT',
        badgeRu: 'НЕСОВМЕСТИМЫ',
        badgeEn: 'INCOMPATIBLE',
        labelRu: isRu ? evalResult.labelRu : evalResult.labelEn,
        labelEn: evalResult.labelEn,
        reasons: [isRu ? evalResult.reasonRu : evalResult.reasonEn],
        canCompare: false
      };
    }

    const reasonsRu: string[] = [];
    const reasonsEn: string[] = [];
    let isWarning = evalResult.level === 'limited';
    let isConflict = false;

    if (evalResult.level === 'limited') {
      reasonsRu.push(evalResult.reasonRu);
      reasonsEn.push(evalResult.reasonEn);
    }

    // 1. User profile match (strictly forbid mixing athletes)
    const u1 = targetSession.user_id || 'default';
    const u2 = peerSession.user_id || 'default';
    if (u1 !== u2 && u1 !== 'unassigned' && u2 !== 'unassigned') {
      isConflict = true;
      reasonsRu.push('Разные профили спортсменов. Межатлетическое сопоставление заблокировано для исключения ложных выводов.');
      reasonsEn.push('Different athlete profiles. Cross-athlete comparisons are blocked to prevent invalid conclusions.');
    }

    // 2. Activity type match
    if (targetSession.activity_type && peerSession.activity_type && targetSession.activity_type !== peerSession.activity_type) {
      isWarning = true;
      reasonsRu.push(`Разный тип активности: "${targetSession.activity_type}" против "${peerSession.activity_type}". Сопоставление носит ознакомительный характер.`);
      reasonsEn.push(`Different activity types: "${targetSession.activity_type}" vs "${peerSession.activity_type}". Comparison is observational.`);
    }

    // 3. Duration comparison
    const dur1 = targetSession.duration_seconds || 0;
    const dur2 = peerSession.duration_seconds || 0;
    if (dur1 > 0 && dur2 > 0) {
      const ratio = Math.abs(dur1 - dur2) / Math.max(dur1, dur2);
      if (ratio > 0.4) {
        isWarning = true;
        reasonsRu.push(`Существенная разница в длительности записи (${Math.round(dur1 / 60)} мин против ${Math.round(dur2 / 60)} мин).`);
        reasonsEn.push(`Noticeable difference in duration (${Math.round(dur1 / 60)} min vs ${Math.round(dur2 / 60)} min).`);
      }
    }

    // 4. Quality scores
    const q1 = normalizeQualityScore(targetSession.overall_quality_score).numericPercent ?? 100;
    const q2 = normalizeQualityScore(peerSession.overall_quality_score).numericPercent ?? 100;
    if (q1 < 70 || q2 < 70) {
      isWarning = true;
      reasonsRu.push('Одна из сессий имеет ограниченное качество сигнала (< 70%). Метрики могут содержать артефакты.');
      reasonsEn.push('One session has limited signal quality (< 70%). Metrics may contain artifacts.');
    }

    if (isConflict) {
      return {
        state: 'PEER_INCOMPATIBLE',
        level: 'CONFLICT',
        badgeRu: 'НЕСОВМЕСТИМЫ',
        badgeEn: 'INCOMPATIBLE',
        labelRu: isRu ? 'Несовместимы (разные профили атлетов)' : 'Incompatible (different athlete profiles)',
        labelEn: 'Incompatible (different athlete profiles)',
        reasons: isRu ? reasonsRu : reasonsEn,
        canCompare: false
      };
    }
    if (isWarning) {
      return {
        state: 'PEER_LIMITED',
        level: 'WARNING',
        badgeRu: 'ОГРАНИЧЕНО',
        badgeEn: 'LIMITED',
        labelRu: isRu ? (evalResult.level === 'limited' ? evalResult.labelRu : 'Условно совместимы') : (evalResult.level === 'limited' ? evalResult.labelEn : 'Conditionally compatible'),
        labelEn: evalResult.level === 'limited' ? evalResult.labelEn : 'Conditionally compatible',
        reasons: isRu ? reasonsRu : reasonsEn,
        canCompare: true
      };
    }
    return {
      state: 'PEER_COMPATIBLE',
      level: 'COMPATIBLE',
      badgeRu: 'СОВМЕСТИМЫ',
      badgeEn: 'COMPATIBLE',
      labelRu: isRu ? 'Полностью совместимы' : 'Fully compatible',
      labelEn: 'Fully compatible',
      reasons: isRu
        ? ['Одинаковый атлет, совпадающий тип активности, сопоставимая длительность и надежное качество.']
        : ['Same athlete, matching activity type, comparable duration, and reliable signal quality.'],
      canCompare: true
    };
  }, [compareMode, targetSession, peerSession, targetCanonical, peerCanonical, trendsData, sessions.length, isRu]);

  // Build Comprehensive Metric Comparison Rows
  const metricRows: MetricRow[] = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!targetSession) return [];

    const extractMetricData = (
      key: string,
      canonical: CanonicalSessionResult | null,
      session: SessionSummary | undefined
    ): { rawVal: number | null; eligState: TaskEligibilityState; blockReasons: string[] } => {
      if (!session) {
        return { rawVal: null, eligState: 'INCONCLUSIVE', blockReasons: [] };
      }

      // Core HRV & Mean HR from CanonicalResult
      if (canonical?.core_metrics) {
        if (key === 'rmssd') {
          const m = canonical.core_metrics.rmssd;
          const taskElig = canonical.task_eligibility?.hrv_rmssd || (canonical.task_eligibility as any)?.rmssd;
          const state = m?.eligibility_state || taskElig?.state || 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
          const reasons = m?.blocking_reasons || taskElig?.blocking_reasons || [];
          return { rawVal: m?.value ?? null, eligState: state, blockReasons: reasons };
        }
        if (key === 'sdnn') {
          const m = canonical.core_metrics.sdnn;
          const taskElig = canonical.task_eligibility?.hrv_sdnn || (canonical.task_eligibility as any)?.sdnn;
          const state = m?.eligibility_state || taskElig?.state || 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
          const reasons = m?.blocking_reasons || taskElig?.blocking_reasons || [];
          return { rawVal: m?.value ?? null, eligState: state, blockReasons: reasons };
        }
        if (key === 'pnn50') {
          const m = canonical.core_metrics.pnn50;
          const taskElig = canonical.task_eligibility?.hrv_pnn50 || (canonical.task_eligibility as any)?.pnn50;
          const state = m?.eligibility_state || taskElig?.state || 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
          const reasons = m?.blocking_reasons || taskElig?.blocking_reasons || [];
          return { rawVal: m?.value ?? null, eligState: state, blockReasons: reasons };
        }
        if (key === 'avg_hr') {
          const m = canonical.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm;
          const taskElig = canonical.task_eligibility?.mean_hr_rr;
          const state = m?.eligibility_state || taskElig?.state || 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
          const reasons = m?.blocking_reasons || taskElig?.blocking_reasons || [];
          return { rawVal: m?.value ?? session.avg_hr ?? null, eligState: state, blockReasons: reasons };
        }
      }

      // Recovery Kinetics
      if (key === 'recovery_1min') {
        const val = canonical?.recovery_metrics?.recovery_1min?.value_bpm_drop;
        const elig = canonical?.task_eligibility?.heart_rate_recovery?.state || (val !== undefined && val !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE');
        return {
          rawVal: val ?? null,
          eligState: val !== undefined && val !== null ? elig : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
          blockReasons: val !== undefined && val !== null ? [] : [isRu ? 'Сессия не содержит активной фазы восстановления (HRR)' : 'Session lacks active recovery phase']
        };
      }
      if (key === 'recovery_2min') {
        const val = canonical?.recovery_metrics?.recovery_2min?.value_bpm_drop;
        const elig = canonical?.task_eligibility?.heart_rate_recovery?.state || (val !== undefined && val !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE');
        return {
          rawVal: val ?? null,
          eligState: val !== undefined && val !== null ? elig : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
          blockReasons: val !== undefined && val !== null ? [] : [isRu ? 'Сессия не содержит 2-мин фазы восстановления' : 'Session lacks 2-min recovery phase']
        };
      }

      // Heart Rate Zones percentages
      if (key.startsWith('zone') && key.endsWith('_pct')) {
        const zoneIdx = parseInt(key.replace('zone', '').replace('_pct', ''), 10);
        const dist = canonical?.heart_rate_zones?.distribution;
        if (dist && dist.eligibility === 'eligible') {
          const zSecs = [dist.z1_seconds, dist.z2_seconds, dist.z3_seconds, dist.z4_seconds, dist.z5_seconds];
          const sec = zSecs[zoneIdx - 1] ?? 0;
          const totalSec = (dist.z1_seconds || 0) + (dist.z2_seconds || 0) + (dist.z3_seconds || 0) + (dist.z4_seconds || 0) + (dist.z5_seconds || 0);
          const pct = totalSec > 0 ? Math.round((sec / totalSec) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
          return {
            rawVal: pct,
            eligState: 'ELIGIBLE',
            blockReasons: []
          };
        }
        return {
          rawVal: null,
          eligState: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
          blockReasons: [isRu ? 'Зоны ЧСС не рассчитаны для данной записи' : 'HR zones not computed for this session']
        };
      }

      // Cardiac Drift Firewall: strictly ImplementationDebt / Unavailable for standalone H10
      if (key === 'cardiac_drift') {
        return {
          rawVal: null,
          eligState: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
          blockReasons: [isRu ? SCIENTIFIC_FIREWALL_NOTICES.cardiacDrift.ru : SCIENTIFIC_FIREWALL_NOTICES.cardiacDrift.en]
        };
      }

      // Basic HR & Context
      if (key === 'min_hr') {
        return {
          rawVal: session.min_hr ?? null,
          eligState: session.min_hr != null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
          blockReasons: []
        };
      }
      if (key === 'max_hr') {
        return {
          rawVal: session.max_hr ?? null,
          eligState: session.max_hr != null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
          blockReasons: []
        };
      }
      if (key === 'duration_min') {
        const dur = session.duration_seconds ? Math.round(session.duration_seconds / 6) / 10 : null;
        return {
          rawVal: dur,
          eligState: dur != null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
          blockReasons: []
        };
      }
      if (key === 'quality') {
        const q = normalizeQualityScore(session.overall_quality_score).numericPercent;
        return {
          rawVal: q,
          eligState: q != null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
          blockReasons: []
        };
      }

      const isCanonical = (session as any).evidence_mode === 'canonical';
      const rawVal = (session as any)[key] ?? null;
      return {
        rawVal,
        eligState: isCanonical && rawVal != null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
        blockReasons: isCanonical ? [] : ['Историческая запись без канонической верификации']
      };
    };

    const extractBaselineData = (
      key: string
    ): { rawVal: number | null; eligState: TaskEligibilityState; blockReasons: string[] } => {
      if (!trendsData?.baseline) {
        return { rawVal: null, eligState: 'INCONCLUSIVE', blockReasons: ['Базовый коридор не сформирован'] };
      }
      if (key === 'rmssd') {
        const b = trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms;
        return { rawVal: b.median, eligState: b.available ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', blockReasons: [] };
      }
      if (key === 'sdnn') {
        const b = trendsData.baseline.sdnn_ms;
        return { rawVal: b.median, eligState: b.available ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', blockReasons: [] };
      }
      if (key === 'pnn50') {
        const b = trendsData.baseline.pnn50_percent;
        return { rawVal: b.median, eligState: b.available ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', blockReasons: [] };
      }
      if (key === 'avg_hr') {
        const b = trendsData.baseline.avg_hr_bpm;
        return { rawVal: b.median, eligState: b.available ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', blockReasons: [] };
      }
      return { rawVal: null, eligState: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE', blockReasons: ['Показатель не входит в базовый коридор'] };
    };

    const defs = [
      // Core HRV
      { key: 'rmssd', categoryRu: 'Вариабельность сердечного ритма (ВСР)', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Variability (HRV)', nameRu: 'RMSSD (быстрая вариабельность)', nameEn: 'RMSSD (short-term HRV)', unit: isRu ? 'мс' : 'ms', higherIsBetter: true },
      { key: 'sdnn', categoryRu: 'Вариабельность сердечного ритма (ВСР)', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Variability (HRV)', nameRu: 'SDNN (общая вариабельность)', nameEn: 'SDNN (overall HRV)', unit: isRu ? 'мс' : 'ms', higherIsBetter: true },
      { key: 'pnn50', categoryRu: 'Вариабельность сердечного ритма (ВСР)', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Variability (HRV)', nameRu: 'pNN50 (интервалы > 50мс)', nameEn: 'pNN50 (>50ms percentage)', unit: '%', higherIsBetter: true },

      // HR Metrics
      { key: 'avg_hr', categoryRu: 'Показатели частоты сердечных сокращений', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Statistics', nameRu: 'Средняя ЧСС (Mean HR)', nameEn: 'Average HR', unit: isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm', higherIsBetter: false },
      { key: 'min_hr', categoryRu: 'Показатели частоты сердечных сокращений', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Statistics', nameRu: 'Минимальная ЧСС (Min HR)', nameEn: 'Minimum HR', unit: isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm', higherIsBetter: false },
      { key: 'max_hr', categoryRu: 'Показатели частоты сердечных сокращений', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Statistics', nameRu: 'Максимальная ЧСС (Max HR)', nameEn: 'Maximum HR', unit: isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm', higherIsBetter: false },

      // Recovery Kinetics
      { key: 'recovery_1min', categoryRu: 'Кинетика восстановления (HRR)', categoryEn: 'Recovery Kinetics (HRR)', nameRu: 'Восстановление за 1 мин (HRR 60s)', nameEn: 'Recovery HR 1 min (HRR 60s)', unit: isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm', higherIsBetter: true },
      { key: 'recovery_2min', categoryRu: 'Кинетика восстановления (HRR)', categoryEn: 'Recovery Kinetics (HRR)', nameRu: 'Восстановление за 2 мин (HRR 120s)', nameEn: 'Recovery HR 2 min (HRR 120s)', unit: isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm', higherIsBetter: true },

      // Intensity Zones
      { key: 'zone1_pct', categoryRu: 'Распределение зон интенсивности ЧСС', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Zone Distribution', nameRu: 'Зона 1: Восстановление (< 60%)', nameEn: 'Zone 1: Active Recovery (< 60%)', unit: '%' },
      { key: 'zone2_pct', categoryRu: 'Распределение зон интенсивности ЧСС', categoryEn: 'Heart Rate Zone Distribution', nameRu: 'Зона 2: Легкая аэробная (60-70%)', nameEn: 'Zone 2: Aerobic Base (60-70%)', unit: '%' },

      { key: 'duration_min', categoryRu: 'Контекст сессии и качество сигнала', categoryEn: 'Session Context & Signal Quality', nameRu: 'Длительность записи', nameEn: 'Duration', unit: isRu ? 'мин' : 'min' },
      { key: 'quality', categoryRu: 'Контекст сессии и качество сигнала', categoryEn: 'Session Context & Signal Quality', nameRu: 'Индекс качества сигнала', nameEn: 'Signal Quality Score', unit: '%', higherIsBetter: true }
    ];

    return defs.map(d => {
      const canonBand = (canonicalComparison?.metrics as any)?.[d.key];
      if (canonBand) {
        const isTargetElig = !canonBand.target_withheld && (canonBand.target_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE' || canonBand.target_eligibility === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS');
        const isRefElig = canonBand.median !== null && (canonBand.status === 'within_baseline' || canonBand.status === 'above_baseline' || canonBand.status === 'below_baseline' || canonBand.status === 'reference_only');

        const delta = canonBand.delta_vs_median;
        let deltaDisplay = '—';
        let deltaPct: number | null = null;
        let deltaPctDisplay = '—';

        if (delta !== null && canonBand.median !== null && isTargetElig && isRefElig) {
          const sign = delta > 0 ? '+' : '';
          deltaDisplay = `${sign}${delta.toFixed(1)} ${d.unit}`;
          if (canonBand.median !== 0) {
            deltaPct = Math.round((delta / canonBand.median) * 1000) / 10;
            const pctSign = deltaPct > 0 ? '+' : '';
            deltaPctDisplay = `${pctSign}${deltaPct.toFixed(1)}%`;
          }
        }

        const targetElig = evaluateMetricComparisonEligibility(
          d.key,
          isTargetElig ? canonBand.target_value : null,
          canonBand.target_eligibility,
          canonBand.exclusion_reasons,
          isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'
        );

        const refElig = evaluateMetricComparisonEligibility(
          d.key,
          isRefElig ? canonBand.median : null,
          isRefElig ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
          canonBand.status === 'insufficient_peers' ? [isRu ? 'Недостаточно сессий' : 'Insufficient sessions'] : [],
          isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'
        );

        return {
          ...d,
          targetVal: isTargetElig ? canonBand.target_value : null,
          targetElig,
          refVal: isRefElig ? canonBand.median : null,
          refElig,
          delta,
          deltaDisplay,
          deltaPct,
          deltaPctDisplay
        };
      }

      const targetRaw = extractMetricData(d.key, targetCanonical, targetSession);
      const targetElig = evaluateMetricComparisonEligibility(
        d.key,
        targetRaw.rawVal,
        targetRaw.eligState,
        targetRaw.blockReasons,
        isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'
      );

      const refRaw = compareMode === 'peer'
        ? extractMetricData(d.key, peerCanonical, peerSession)
        : extractBaselineData(d.key);

      const refElig = evaluateMetricComparisonEligibility(
        d.key,
        refRaw.rawVal,
        refRaw.eligState,
        refRaw.blockReasons,
        isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'
      );

      const deltaCalc = calculateMetricComparisonDelta(
        d.key,
        targetElig.isEligible ? targetElig.referenceNumericValue : null,
        targetElig.isEligible,
        refElig.isEligible ? refElig.referenceNumericValue : null,
        refElig.isEligible,
        isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'
      );

      return {
        ...d,
        targetVal: targetElig.referenceNumericValue,
        targetElig,
        refVal: refElig.referenceNumericValue,
        refElig,
        delta: deltaCalc.delta,
        deltaDisplay: deltaCalc.deltaDisplay,
        deltaPct: deltaCalc.deltaPct,
        deltaPctDisplay: deltaCalc.deltaPctDisplay
      };
    });
  }, [targetSession, peerSession, targetCanonical, peerCanonical, trendsData, canonicalComparison, compareMode, isRu]);

  // Synchronized Visual Context: HR Zones Distribution Bars

    const calcZonePcts = (dist: any) => {
      if (!dist || dist.eligibility !== 'eligible') return [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
      const z = [dist.z1_seconds || 0, dist.z2_seconds || 0, dist.z3_seconds || 0, dist.z4_seconds || 0, dist.z5_seconds || 0];
      const total = z.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      if (total <= 0) return [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
      return z.map(s => Math.round((s / total) * 1000) / 10);
    };

    const targetPcts = calcZonePcts(targetDist);
    const peerPcts = calcZonePcts(peerDist);

    return (

          </div>

            <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '6px', fontWeight: 600 }}>

              {isRu ? 'База сравнения:' : 'Reference:'}
            </label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', borderRadius: '6px', overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>

                onClick={() => handleSetCompareMode('peer')}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Сессия B (Парная)' : 'Session B (Peer)'}
              </button>
              <button
                id="compare-mode-baseline"
                type="button"
                className={`btn ${compareMode === 'baseline' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
                style={{ padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                onClick={() => handleSetCompareMode('baseline')}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Базовый коридор (LOO)' : 'Baseline Corridor (LOO)'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Peer Session (if peer mode) */}
          {compareMode === 'peer' && (
            <div style={{ flex: '1 1 320px' }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '6px', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                ⚖️ {isRu ? 'Сессия сравнения (Сессия B)' : 'Reference Session (Session B)'}
              </label>
              <AppSelect
                id="compare-peer-select"
                value={peerSessionId}
                onChange={handleSetPeerSessionId}
                options={filteredPeerSessions.map(s => {
                  const athlete = profiles.find(p => p.id === s.user_id)?.display_name || (isRu ? 'Без профиля' : 'Unassigned');
                  const dt = formatDate(s.start_time, language);
                  const isDup = s.canonical_representative_id && targetSession?.canonical_representative_id && s.canonical_representative_id === targetSession.canonical_representative_id;
                  return {
                    value: s.id,
                    label: `${dt} · ${s.activity_type || 'unknown'} · ${athlete}${isDup ? (isRu ? ' [дубликат]' : ' [duplicate]') : ''}`
                  };
                })}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Compatibility Status Banner */}
      <div 
        id="compare-compatibility-banner"
        className="card" 
        style={{ 
          marginBottom: '20px',
          borderLeft: `4px solid ${
            compatibility.level === 'COMPATIBLE' 
              ? 'var(--accent-success)' 
              : compatibility.level === 'WARNING' 
                ? 'var(--accent-warning)' 
                : 'var(--accent-danger)'
          }`,
          backgroundColor: compatibility.level === 'COMPATIBLE'
            ? 'var(--accent-success-bg)'
            : compatibility.level === 'WARNING'
              ? 'var(--accent-warning-bg)'
              : 'var(--accent-danger-bg)'
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>
            <span>
              {compatibility.level === 'COMPATIBLE' ? '✅' : compatibility.level === 'WARNING' ? '⚠️' : '⛔'}
            </span>
            <span>{isRu ? compatibility.labelRu : compatibility.labelEn}</span>
          </div>
          <span className="badge" style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
            {isRu
              ? ((compatibility as any).badgeRu || (
                  compatibility.level === 'COMPATIBLE'
                    ? 'Совместимы'
                    : compatibility.level === 'WARNING'
                      ? 'Ограничено'
                      : compatibility.level === 'CONFLICT'
                        ? 'Несовместимы'
                        : 'Не определено'
                ))
              : ((compatibility as any).badgeEn || compatibility.level)}
          </span>
        </div>
        {compatibility.reasons.length > 0 && (
          <ul style={{ margin: '0', paddingLeft: '20px', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {compatibility.reasons.map((r, idx) => (
              <li key={idx} style={{ marginTop: '3px' }}>{r}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Synchronized Visual HR Zones Bar */}
      {renderVisualHrZones()}

      {/* Side-by-Side Metric Comparison Table */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '24px', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '14px', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' }}>
          <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
            📈 {isRu ? 'Таблица сопоставления кардио-метрик' : 'Cardio Metrics Comparison Matrix'}
          </div>
          {compareMode === 'baseline' && Boolean(trendsData?.personal_baseline_available && (trendsData?.sessions_used ?? 0) >= 5) && (
            <button
              id="compare-toggle-baseline-breakdown-btn"
              type="button"
              className="btn btn-ghost"
              onClick={() => setShowBaselineBreakdown(!showBaselineBreakdown)}
              style={{
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                padding: '4px 10px',
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: '5px',
                color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                borderRadius: '6px'
              }}
            >
              <span>ℹ️</span>
              <span>
                {isRu
                  ? (showBaselineBreakdown ? 'Скрыть детали baseline ▲' : `Как сформирован baseline (принято ${trendsData?.sessions_used ?? sessions.length} сессий) ▼`)
                  : (showBaselineBreakdown ? 'Hide baseline details ▲' : `How baseline is formed (accepted ${trendsData?.sessions_used ?? sessions.length} sessions) ▼`)}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {compareMode === 'baseline' && showBaselineBreakdown && (
          <div id="compare-baseline-breakdown-card" style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            {renderBaselineQualificationCard(trendsData?.baseline_qualification_breakdown)}
          </div>
        )}

        {compatibility.canCompare === false ? (
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '36px 16px', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '2.2rem', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
              {compareMode === 'baseline' ? '📊' : '🚫'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '1.05rem', color: compareMode === 'baseline' ? 'var(--accent-warning)' : 'var(--accent-danger)', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              {compareMode === 'baseline'
                ? (isRu ? 'Индивидуальный базовый коридор ещё не сформирован' : 'Personal baseline corridor not yet established')
                : (isRu ? 'Сравнение заблокировано' : 'Comparison Blocked')}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', maxWidth: '520px', margin: '0 auto', color: 'var(--text-muted)', lineHeight: '1.4' }}>
              {compatibility.reasons.join(' ')}
            </div>
            {compareMode === 'baseline' && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '14px' }}>
                {renderBaselineQualificationCard(trendsData?.baseline_qualification_breakdown)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.88rem' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-medium)', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>{isRu ? 'Показатель' : 'Metric'}</th>
                <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                  {isRu ? 'Сессия A (Целевая)' : 'Session A (Target)'}
                  {targetSession && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {formatDate(targetSession.start_time, language)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </th>
                <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                  {compareMode === 'peer' 
                    ? (isRu ? 'Сессия B (База)' : 'Session B (Reference)') 
                    : (isRu ? 'Baseline (LOO p50)' : 'Baseline (LOO p50)')}
                  {compareMode === 'peer' && peerSession && (
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {formatDate(peerSession.start_time, language)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </th>
                <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>Δ {isRu ? 'Разница' : 'Difference'}</th>
                <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>% {isRu ? 'Изменение' : 'Change'}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {metricRows.map((row, idx) => {
                const hasDelta = row.delta !== null;
                const isPositive = (row.delta || 0) > 0;
                const isZero = (row.delta || 0) === 0;
                const prevCat = idx > 0 ? metricRows[idx - 1].categoryRu : '';
                const showCatHeader = row.categoryRu !== prevCat;

                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={row.key}>
                    {showCatHeader && (
                      <tr style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)' }}>
                        <td colSpan={5} style={{ padding: '8px 12px', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--accent-primary)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>
                          {isRu ? row.categoryRu : row.categoryEn}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                    <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                        {isRu ? row.nameRu : row.nameEn}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        {row.targetElig.isEligible ? (
                          <span>{row.targetElig.primaryDisplayValue} {row.unit}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <div>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>—</span>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--accent-warning)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                              {isRu ? 'Недоступно для сравнения' : 'Unavailable for comparison'}
                            </div>
                            {row.targetElig.reasonRu && (
                              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                                {isRu ? row.targetElig.reasonRu : row.targetElig.reasonEn}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        {row.refElig.isEligible ? (
                          <span>{row.refElig.primaryDisplayValue} {row.unit}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <div>
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 600 }}>—</span>
                            {compareMode === 'peer' && (
                              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--accent-warning)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                                {isRu ? 'Недоступно для сравнения' : 'Unavailable for comparison'}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        {hasDelta ? (
                          <span style={{
                            color: isZero 
                              ? 'var(--text-secondary)' 
                              : (row.higherIsBetter === undefined
                                ? 'var(--text-primary)'
                                : ((row.higherIsBetter && isPositive) || (!row.higherIsBetter && !isPositive)
                                  ? 'var(--accent-success)'
                                  : 'var(--accent-warning)')),
                            fontWeight: 500
                          }}>
                            {row.deltaDisplay} {row.unit}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                        {row.deltaPctDisplay !== '—' ? (
                          <span className="badge" style={{
                            backgroundColor: isZero 
                              ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' 
                              : (isPositive ? 'var(--accent-success-bg)' : 'var(--accent-warning-bg)'),
                            color: isZero 
                              ? 'var(--text-secondary)' 
                              : (isPositive ? 'var(--accent-success)' : 'var(--accent-warning)')
                          }}>
                            {row.deltaPctDisplay}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Quick Navigation Footers */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px', flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px' }}>
          {targetSessionId && onNavigateToSession && (
            <button
              id="compare-open-target-btn"
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              onClick={() => onNavigateToSession(targetSessionId)}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
            >
              🔍 {isRu ? 'Открыть Сессию A' : 'Open Session A'}
            </button>
          )}
          {compareMode === 'peer' && peerSessionId && onNavigateToSession && (
            <button
              id="compare-open-peer-btn"
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              onClick={() => onNavigateToSession(peerSessionId)}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
            >
              🔍 {isRu ? 'Открыть Сессию B' : 'Open Session B'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Reports, ReportsProps } from './Reports';
import { LlmExportModal } from '../components/LlmExportModal';
import { ResearchExportPanel } from '../components/ResearchExportPanel';
import { SessionSummary, api } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { PageSnapshotButton } from '../components/PageSnapshotButton';
import { AppSelect } from '../components/AppSelect';
import { SafetyNotice } from '../components/SafetyNotice';
import { ExportHistoryPage, ExportHistoryRow } from '../../shared/canonical/ExportWorkspaceContract';

export interface ExportCenterProps extends ReportsProps {
  initialTab?: 'reports' | 'ai_pack' | 'history' | 'research';
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes === 0) return '0 B';
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
}

function formatDate(iso: string, lang: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return d.toLocaleDateString(lang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
    day: '2-digit',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit'
  });
}

export function ExportCenter({
  initialSessionId,
  onBack,
  activeUserId,
  initialTab = 'reports',
  journeyContext
}: ExportCenterProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'reports' | 'ai_pack' | 'history' | 'research'>(initialTab);

  // State for AI Pack tab
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<SessionSummary[]>([]);
  const [selectedSessionId, setSelectedSessionId] = useState<string>(initialSessionId || '');
  const [selectedSession, setSelectedSession] = useState<SessionSummary | null>(null);
  const [showAiModal, setShowAiModal] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // State for History tab
  const [historyPage, setHistoryPage] = useState<ExportHistoryPage | null>(null);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getSessions(activeUserId)
      .then((data) => {
        setSessions(data);
        if (data.length > 0 && initialSessionId) {
          const match = data.find(s => s.id === initialSessionId);
          if (match) {
            setSelectedSessionId(match.id);
            setSelectedSession(match);
          }
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => console.warn('ExportCenter session load warning:', e));
  }, [activeUserId, initialSessionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedSessionId && sessions.length > 0) {
      const found = sessions.find(s => s.id === selectedSessionId) || null;
      setSelectedSession(found);
    } else {
      setSelectedSession(null);
    }
  }, [selectedSessionId, sessions]);

  // Load history when tab is activated or page changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'history') {
      setHistoryLoading(true);
      setHistoryError(null);
      api.getExportHistory({ page: currentPage, pageSize: 15, profileId: activeUserId })
        .then((res: ExportHistoryPage) => {
          setHistoryPage(res);
        })
        .catch((e: any) => {
          setHistoryError(e.message || 'Failed to load export history');
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setHistoryLoading(false);
        });
    }
  }, [activeTab, currentPage, activeUserId]);

  return (
    <div className="container" style={{ padding: '24px 0' }}>
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.4rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            📦 {isRu ? 'Центр экспорта' : 'Export Center'}
          </h2>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
            {isRu
              ? 'Единый центр формирования человекочитаемых отчётов, архивов, пакетов контекста для ИИ и журнала артефактов'
              : 'Unified hub for human reports, consultation bundles, AI interpretation packs, and artifact ledger'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <PageSnapshotButton pageName="ExportCenter" />
          {onBack && (
            <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onBack}>
              {isRu ? '← Назад' : '← Back'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Tabs Navigation */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', marginBottom: '20px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <button
          id="export-tab-reports"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('reports')}
          style={{
            padding: '10px 18px',
            fontSize: '0.9rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'reports' ? '2px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'reports' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          📄 {isRu ? 'Отчёты и архивы (PDF, HTML, CSV)' : 'Reports & Archives (PDF, HTML, CSV)'}
        </button>

        <button
          id="export-tab-ai-pack"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('ai_pack')}
          style={{
            padding: '10px 18px',
            fontSize: '0.9rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'ai_pack' ? '2px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'ai_pack' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          🤖 {isRu ? 'Пакет интерпретации ИИ 2.0 (AI Pack)' : 'AI Interpretation Pack 2.0'}
        </button>

        <button
          id="export-tab-history"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
          style={{
            padding: '10px 18px',
            fontSize: '0.9rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'history' ? '2px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'history' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          📜 {isRu ? 'История экспортов и артефакты' : 'Export History & Artifacts'}
        </button>

        <button
          id="export-tab-research"
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('research')}
          style={{
            padding: '10px 18px',
            fontSize: '0.9rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            borderBottom: activeTab === 'research' ? '2px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '2px solid transparent',
            color: activeTab === 'research' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-secondary)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          🔬 {isRu ? 'Исследования (Data Exchange)' : 'Research (Data Exchange)'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Human Reports & Archive */}
      {activeTab === 'reports' && (

            journeyContext={journeyContext}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: AI Interpretation Pack 2.0 */}
      {activeTab === 'ai_pack' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ padding: '24px' }}>
          <div className="section-title" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
            <span>🤖</span>
            <span>{isRu ? 'Пакет интерпретации ИИ (AI Interpretation Pack 2.0)' : 'AI Interpretation Pack 2.0'}</span>
          </div>

          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', lineHeight: '1.5', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
            {isRu
              ? 'Формирует структурированный, псевдонимизированный пакет данных и промптов для передачи во внешние LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Antigravity) с точным предпросмотром передаваемой информации и нулевой утечкой персональных данных.'
              : 'Generates a structured, pseudonymized context pack and prompt library for external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Antigravity) with exact privacy preview and zero personal data leakage.'}
          </p>

          <div style={{ maxWidth: '480px', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
            <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '6px', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {isRu ? 'Выберите сессию для экспорта ИИ-пакета:' : 'Select session for AI Pack export:'}
            </label>
            <AppSelect
              id="ai-pack-session-select"
              value={selectedSessionId}
              onChange={(val) => {
                setSelectedSessionId(val);
                const s = sessions.find(x => x.id === val) || null;
                setSelectedSession(s);
              }}
              options={sessions.map(s => {
                const dt = s.start_time ? new Date(s.start_time).toLocaleDateString(language === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : s.id;
                return {

        <div className="card" style={{ padding: '24px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            <div>
              <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.1rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                📜 {isRu ? 'Журнал созданных артефактов и файлов' : 'Export Artifacts Ledger'}
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {isRu
                  ? 'Серверный аудит всех сформированных отчетов и экспортов с проверкой целостности SHA-256 и статуса на диске.'
                  : 'Server-backed audit of all generated reports and exports with SHA-256 integrity and filesystem availability.'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setHistoryLoading(true);
                api.getExportHistory({ page: currentPage, pageSize: 15, profileId: activeUserId })
                  .then(setHistoryPage)
                  .finally(() => setHistoryLoading(false));
              }}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '6px 12px' }}
            >
              🔄 {isRu ? 'Обновить' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {historyError && (
            <div style={{ padding: '12px', background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)', borderRadius: '6px', color: 'var(--accent-danger)', marginBottom: '16px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              {historyError}
            </div>
          )}

          {historyLoading ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '40px 0' }}>
              <span className="spinner" />
            </div>
          ) : !historyPage || historyPage.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '40px 0', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
              {isRu ? 'История экспорта пуста. Сформируйте отчет или скачайте архив в первой вкладке.' : 'No export artifacts found. Generate a report in the first tab.'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
                <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: '0.82rem', textAlign: 'left' }}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Дата создания' : 'Generated At'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Формат' : 'Format'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Имя файла' : 'Filename'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Размер' : 'Size'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Хэш SHA-256' : 'SHA-256 Hash'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>{isRu ? 'Статус на диске' : 'Disk Status'}</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 8px', textAlign: 'right' }}>{isRu ? 'Действие' : 'Action'}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {historyPage.rows.map((row: ExportHistoryRow) => (
                      <tr key={row.manifest_id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                          {formatDate(row.generated_at_utc, language)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>
                          <span style={{
                            padding: '2px 6px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            background: row.format === 'pdf' ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' :
                              row.format === 'html' ? 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15)' :
                              row.format === 'metrics_csv' || row.format === 'rr_csv' ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15)',
                            color: row.format === 'pdf' ? '#f87171' :
                              row.format === 'html' ? '#60a5fa' :
                              row.format === 'metrics_csv' || row.format === 'rr_csv' ? '#4ade80' : '#c084fc'
                          }}>
                            {row.format.toUpperCase()}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)', maxWidth: '240px', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          {row.filename}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                          {formatBytes(row.size_bytes)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>
                          <code style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} title={row.sha256}>
                            {row.sha256.slice(0, 10)}...{row.sha256.slice(-6)}
                          </code>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px' }}>
                          {row.is_available ? (
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-success)', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                              ✓ {isRu ? 'Доступен' : 'Available'}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                              ⚠ {isRu ? 'Удален / недоступен' : 'Unavailable'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 8px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          {row.is_available ? (
                            <a
                              href={api.downloadExportArtifactUrl(row.manifest_id)}
                              download={row.filename}
                              className="btn btn-secondary"
                              style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 10px', textDecoration: 'none' }}
                            >
                              ⬇️ {isRu ? 'Скачать' : 'Download'}
                            </a>
                          ) : (
                            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Pagination Controls */}
              {historyPage.total_pages > 1 && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', marginTop: '20px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-secondary"
                    disabled={currentPage <= 1}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 10px' }}
                  >
                    ←
                  </button>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {isRu ? `Страница ${historyPage.page} из ${historyPage.total_pages}` : `Page ${historyPage.page} of ${historyPage.total_pages}`}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-secondary"
                    disabled={currentPage >= historyPage.total_pages}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.min(historyPage.total_pages, p + 1))}
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 10px' }}
                  >
                    →
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 4: Research Evidence Workspace */}
      {activeTab === 'research' && (
        <div>
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '12px 16px',
              background: 'rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.1)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3)',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              marginBottom: '16px'
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              🔬 {isRu
                ? 'Доступна исследовательская лаборатория (G10) с мандатами, приёмкой данных и консенсусным арбитражем.'
                : 'Role-bound Operational Research Workspace (G10) with capability tokens, dataset intake, and consensus adjudication is active.'}
            </div>
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary"
              onClick={() => { window.location.hash = '#/research'; }}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '6px 12px' }}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Открыть лабораторию →' : 'Open Workspace →'}
            </button>
          </div>

          <ResearchExportPanel
            sessions={sessions}
            selectedSessionId={selectedSessionId}
            onSelectSession={(val) => {
              setSelectedSessionId(val);
              const s = sessions.find(x => x.id === val) || null;
              setSelectedSession(s);
            }}
            activeUserId={activeUserId}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
FILE: src/frontend/views/ImportCenter.tsx
