import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, StatusResponse, DiscoveredBundle, GuidedDiscoveryResult, UserGroupingCorrection } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { PageSnapshotButton } from '../components/PageSnapshotButton';
import { DataSourcesPanel } from '../components/DataSourcesPanel';
import { localizeReason } from '../../shared/canonical/UserFacingTruthContract';

import { ActiveWorkContext, AthleteCoreJourneyContext, AthleteJourneyCommand } from '../api';

export interface ImportCenterProps {
  onNavigateToSession?: (sessionId: string) => void;
  activeWorkContext?: ActiveWorkContext | null;
  journeyContext?: AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null;
  onDispatchCommand?: (command: AthleteJourneyCommand) => Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null>;
}

export function ImportCenter({
  onNavigateToSession,
  activeWorkContext,
  journeyContext,
  onDispatchCommand
}: ImportCenterProps = {}) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'guided' | 'auto'>('guided');

  // Auto Ingest state
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StatusResponse | null>(null);
  const [statusError, setStatusError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [polling, setPolling] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailsOpen, setDetailsOpen] = useState(false);

  // Guided Import state
  const [targetFolder, setTargetFolder] = useState('');
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);
  const [scanResult, setScanResult] = useState<GuidedDiscoveryResult | null>(null);
  const [scanError, setScanError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [startingSync, setStartingSync] = useState(false);
  const [importStage, setImportStage] = useState<string>('');
  const [importProgressPercent, setImportProgressPercent] = useState<number>(0);
  const [importSuccessResult, setImportSuccessResult] = useState<any[] | null>(null);
  const [expandedBundleIds, setExpandedBundleIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [isDragOver, setIsDragOver] = useState(false);
  const [activeJobId, setActiveJobId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeFlowId, setActiveFlowId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getStatus()
      .then((s) => {
        setStatus(s);
        if (s.sourceAvailable && s.sourcePath) {
          setTargetFolder(s.sourcePath);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => setStatusError(e.message));

    pollStatus();
  }, []);

  const pollStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.getIngestStatus();
      setSyncStatus(res);
      if (res.running) {
        setPolling(true);
      } else {
        setPolling(false);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.warn('Failed to poll status', e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!polling) return;

    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await api.getIngestStatus();
        setSyncStatus(res);
        if (!res.running) {
          setPolling(false);
          api.getStatus().then(setStatus).catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Polling error', e);
      }
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [polling]);

  const handleStartSync = async () => {
    if (startingSync || syncStatus?.running) return;
    setStartingSync(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.startIngest();
      setSyncStatus(res.status);
      setPolling(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setStartingSync(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelSync = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.cancelIngest();
      setSyncStatus(res.status);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    }
  };

  const handleResetLock = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.resetStaleLock();
      setSyncStatus(res.status);
      setPolling(false);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    }
  };

  // Guided Import Actions
  const handleScanFolder = async () => {
    const folderToScan = targetFolder.trim();
    if (!folderToScan) {
      setScanError(language === 'ru' ? 'Папка не указана. Введите путь к папке или перетащите файлы.' : 'Folder path not specified. Enter folder path or drop files.');
      return;
    }

    setScanning(true);
    setScanError(null);
    setScanResult(null);
    setImportSuccessResult(null);

    try {
      const res = await api.getGuidedPreview({ folderPath: folderToScan, flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined });
      if (res.success) {
        setActiveFlowId(res.flow_id || (res.result as any)?.flow_id || null);
        setScanResult(res.result);
      } else {
        setScanError(language === 'ru' ? 'Не удалось обнаружить пакеты в указанной директории.' : 'Failed to discover bundles in specified directory.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setScanError(err.message || 'Ошибка сканирования');
    } finally {
      setScanning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleSelectBundle = (bundleId: string) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    const updated = scanResult.bundles.map(b => 
      b.bundleId === bundleId ? { ...b, selected: !b.selected } : b
    );
    setScanResult({ ...scanResult, bundles: updated });
  };

  const handleSelectAll = (select: boolean) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    const updated = scanResult.bundles.map(b => ({ ...b, selected: select }));
    setScanResult({ ...scanResult, bundles: updated });
  };

  const toggleExpandBundle = (bundleId: string) => {
    setExpandedBundleIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(bundleId)) next.delete(bundleId);
      else next.add(bundleId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  // --- Manual Grouping Correction Handlers ---
  const handleMoveFile = (filePath: string, fromBundleId: string, toBundleId: string) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    let fileToMove: any = null;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const correctionEntry = {
      action: 'move_file' as const,
      file_path: filePath,
      from_bundle_id: fromBundleId,
      to_bundle_id: toBundleId,
      timestamp_utc: nowIso
    };

    const newBundles = scanResult.bundles.map(bundle => {
      if (bundle.bundleId === fromBundleId) {
        const fileIdx = bundle.files.findIndex(f => f.fullPath === filePath);
        if (fileIdx >= 0) {
          fileToMove = bundle.files[fileIdx];
          const remainingFiles = bundle.files.filter(f => f.fullPath !== filePath);
          const remainingChannels = Array.from(new Set(remainingFiles.map(f => f.signalType)));
          return {
            ...bundle,
            files: remainingFiles,
            channels: remainingChannels,
            status: (remainingChannels.includes('RR') ? 'VALID' : 'WARNING') as any,
            userCorrections: [
              ...(bundle.userCorrections || []),
              correctionEntry
            ]
          };
        }
      }
      return bundle;
    }).filter(b => b.files.length > 0);

    if (fileToMove) {
      const finalBundles = newBundles.map(bundle => {
        if (bundle.bundleId === toBundleId) {
          const updatedFiles = [...bundle.files, fileToMove];
          const updatedChannels = Array.from(new Set(updatedFiles.map(f => f.signalType)));
          const channelCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
          for (const f of updatedFiles) {
            channelCounts[f.signalType] = (channelCounts[f.signalType] || 0) + 1;
          }
          const hasConflict = Object.values(channelCounts).some(c => c > 1);
          return {
            ...bundle,
            files: updatedFiles,
            channels: updatedChannels,
            status: (hasConflict ? 'CONFLICT' : (updatedChannels.includes('RR') ? 'VALID' : 'WARNING')) as any,
            selected: !hasConflict,
            userCorrections: [
              ...(bundle.userCorrections || []),
              correctionEntry
            ]
          };
        }
        return bundle;
      });

      setScanResult({ ...scanResult, bundles: finalBundles });

      fetch('/api/diagnostics/events', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          event_type: 'bundle_grouping_corrected',
          flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined,
          metadata: { action: 'move_file', from_bundle_id: fromBundleId, to_bundle_id: toBundleId, flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined }
        })
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFileFromImport = (filePath: string, fromBundleId: string) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const correctionEntry = {
      action: 'remove_file' as const,
      file_path: filePath,
      from_bundle_id: fromBundleId,
      to_bundle_id: 'removed',
      timestamp_utc: nowIso
    };

    const newBundles = scanResult.bundles.map(bundle => {
      if (bundle.bundleId === fromBundleId) {
        const remainingFiles = bundle.files.filter(f => f.fullPath !== filePath);
        const remainingChannels = Array.from(new Set(remainingFiles.map(f => f.signalType)));
        return {
          ...bundle,
          files: remainingFiles,
          channels: remainingChannels,
          status: (remainingChannels.includes('RR') ? 'VALID' : 'WARNING') as any,
          userCorrections: [
            ...(bundle.userCorrections || []),
            correctionEntry
          ]
        };
      }
      return bundle;
    }).filter(b => b.files.length > 0);

    setScanResult({ ...scanResult, bundles: newBundles });

    fetch('/api/diagnostics/events', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        event_type: 'bundle_grouping_corrected',
        flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined,
        metadata: { action: 'remove_file', from_bundle_id: fromBundleId, flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined }
      })
    }).catch(() => {});
  };

  const handleCreateNewBundleFromFile = (filePath: string, fromBundleId: string) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    let fileToMove: any = null;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const newBundleId = `bundle-user-${Date.now()}`;

    const correctionEntry = {
      action: 'create_bundle' as const,
      file_path: filePath,
      from_bundle_id: fromBundleId,
      to_bundle_id: newBundleId,
      timestamp_utc: nowIso
    };

    const remainingBundles = scanResult.bundles.map(bundle => {
      if (bundle.bundleId === fromBundleId) {
        fileToMove = bundle.files.find(f => f.fullPath === filePath);
        const remainingFiles = bundle.files.filter(f => f.fullPath !== filePath);
        const remainingChannels = Array.from(new Set(remainingFiles.map(f => f.signalType)));
        return {
          ...bundle,
          files: remainingFiles,
          channels: remainingChannels,
          status: (remainingChannels.includes('RR') ? 'VALID' : 'WARNING') as any,
          userCorrections: [
            ...(bundle.userCorrections || []),
            correctionEntry
          ]
        };
      }
      return bundle;
    }).filter(b => b.files.length > 0);

    if (fileToMove) {
      const newBundle: DiscoveredBundle = {
        bundleId: newBundleId,
        bundleName: `Выделенная сессия (${fileToMove.fileName})`,
        deviceId: 'Polar_H10',
        groupingBasis: 'single_file_fallback',
        groupingConfidence: 'high',
        status: (fileToMove.signalType === 'RR' ? 'VALID' : 'WARNING') as any,
        startTime: fileToMove.startTime || null,
        endTime: null,
        durationSeconds: fileToMove.durationSeconds || null,
        isDurationEstimated: true,
        channels: [fileToMove.signalType],
        files: [fileToMove],
        warnings: [],
        userCorrections: [correctionEntry],
        selected: true
      };

      setScanResult({ ...scanResult, bundles: [...remainingBundles, newBundle] });

      fetch('/api/diagnostics/events', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          event_type: 'bundle_grouping_corrected',
          flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined,
          metadata: { action: 'create_bundle', from_bundle_id: fromBundleId, to_bundle_id: newBundleId, flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined }
        })
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  // Execute Guided Import with Real-Time Backend Stage Polling
  const handleExecuteGuidedImport = async () => {
    if (importing) return;
    if (!scanResult) return;
    const selectedBundles = scanResult.bundles.filter(b => b.selected);
    if (selectedBundles.length === 0) return;

    // Check for unresolved conflicts
    const conflictBundles = selectedBundles.filter(b => b.status === 'CONFLICT');
    if (conflictBundles.length > 0) {
      setScanError(`Невозможно импортировать сессии со статусом Конфликт (${conflictBundles.map(b => b.bundleName).join(', ')}). Пожалуйста, устраните конфликт или снимите выбор.`);
      return;
    }

    setImporting(true);
    setScanError(null);
    setImportProgressPercent(5);
    setImportStage(language === 'ru' ? 'Инициализация задачи импорта...' : 'Initializing import job...');

    const hasManualCorrections = selectedBundles.some(b => (b.userCorrections && b.userCorrections.length > 0));
    const groupingDecision = hasManualCorrections ? 'manually_corrected' : 'auto_accepted';

    fetch('/api/diagnostics/events', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        event_type: 'bundle_grouping_confirmed',
        flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined,
        metadata: {
          decision: groupingDecision,
          flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined,
          selected_bundle_count: selectedBundles.length,
          total_bundle_count: scanResult.bundles.length,
          has_manual_corrections: hasManualCorrections
        }
      })
    }).catch(() => {});

    try {
      const initRes = await api.guidedImport(selectedBundles, false, activeFlowId || undefined);
      if (initRes.flow_id) {
        setActiveFlowId(initRes.flow_id);
      }
      if (initRes.jobId) {
        setActiveJobId(initRes.jobId);
        
        // Poll job status until completion
        const pollJobTimer = setInterval(async () => {
          try {
            const statusRes = await api.getGuidedImportStatus(initRes.jobId!);
            if (statusRes.success && statusRes.job) {
              const job = statusRes.job;
              setImportStage(job.stageLabelRu);
              setImportProgressPercent(job.progressPercent);

              if (job.stage === 'completed') {
                clearInterval(pollJobTimer);
                setImporting(false);
                setImportSuccessResult(job.results);
                api.getStatus().then(setStatus).catch(() => {});
              } else if (job.stage === 'failed') {
                clearInterval(pollJobTimer);
                setImporting(false);
                setScanError(job.error || 'Ошибка при выполнении импорта');
              }
            }
          } catch (pollErr: any) {
            console.warn('Error polling job status:', pollErr);
          }
        }, 400);
      } else if (initRes.importedSessions) {
        // Direct synchronous response
        setImportProgressPercent(100);
        setImportStage(language === 'ru' ? 'Импорт успешно завершен!' : 'Import completed!');
        setImportSuccessResult(initRes.importedSessions);
        setImporting(false);
        api.getStatus().then(setStatus).catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setScanError(err.message || 'Ошибка запуска импорта');
      setImporting(false);
    }
  };

  // Drag and drop handlers
  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(false);
    const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    const filePaths = files.map((f: any) => f.path || f.name).filter(Boolean);
    if (filePaths.length > 0) {
      setScanning(true);
      setScanError(null);
      try {
        const res = await api.getGuidedPreview({ filePaths, flow_id: activeFlowId || undefined });
        if (res.success) {
          setActiveFlowId(res.flow_id || (res.result as any)?.flow_id || null);
          setScanResult(res.result);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setScanError(err.message || 'Ошибка анализа перетащенных файлов');
      } finally {
        setScanning(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const selectedCount = scanResult ? scanResult.bundles.filter(b => b.selected).length : 0;
  const totalBundlesCount = scanResult ? scanResult.bundles.length : 0;

  return (
    <div className="fade-in">
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h1>{t('importTitle')}</h1>
          <p>{t('importSubtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <PageSnapshotButton pageName="ImportCenter" metadata={{ activeSource: status?.sourcePath }} />
      </div>

      {/* Mode Tab Switcher */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '20px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingBottom: '8px' }}>
        <button
          className={`btn ${activeTab === 'guided' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('guided')}
          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}
        >
          <span>📁</span>
          <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Импортировать записи' : 'Import Recordings'}</span>
        </button>
        <button
          className={`btn ${activeTab === 'auto' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('auto')}
          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}
        >
          <span>🔄</span>
          <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Автоматическая синхронизация (настройка)' : 'Auto Sync (Settings)'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'guided' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
          {/* Top Folder Selection & Drag/Drop Card */}
          <div 
            className={`card ${isDragOver ? 'drag-over' : ''}`}
            onDragOver={handleDragOver}
            onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
            onDrop={handleDrop}
            style={{ 
              border: isDragOver ? '2px dashed var(--accent-primary)' : '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
              transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
              backgroundColor: isDragOver ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.05)' : undefined
            }}
          >
            <div className="section-title" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
              <span>🔍</span>
              <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Выбор файлов или папки сессий Polar H10' : 'Select Polar H10 Session Files or Folder'}</span>
            </div>

            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
              {language === 'ru'
                ? 'Укажите папку с логами Polar Sensor Logger или перетащите файлы (_RR.txt, _ECG.txt, _ACC.txt, _HR.txt). Система автоматически сгруппирует связанные каналы в сессии с допуском на смещение таймстемпов.'
                : 'Specify Polar Sensor Logger directory or drag-and-drop log files (_RR.txt, _ECG.txt, _ACC.txt, _HR.txt). Associated channels will be grouped into unified sessions.'}
            </p>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <div style={{ flex: '1 1 300px', display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                <input
                  id="guided-import-input-folder"
                  type="text"
                  className="input"
                  style={{ width: '100%' }}
                  placeholder={language === 'ru' ? 'C:\\Users\\...\\Downloads или путь к папке' : 'C:\\path\\to\\folder'}
                  value={targetFolder}
                  onChange={(e) => setTargetFolder(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <button
                className="btn btn-primary"
                onClick={handleScanFolder}
                disabled={scanning || importing}
                style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}
              >
                <span>{scanning ? '⏳' : '🔎'}</span>
                <span>{scanning ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Сканирование...' : 'Scanning...') : (language === 'ru' ? 'Сканировать папку' : 'Scan Folder')}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {scanError && (
              <div className="alert alert-danger" style={{ marginTop: '14px' }}>
                <strong>Ошибка: </strong>{scanError}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Import Progress Bar (Real-Time Backend Driven) */}
          {importing && (
            <div className="card" style={{ border: '1px solid var(--accent-primary)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.05)' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>
                  ⚙️ {importStage || (language === 'ru' ? 'Обработка...' : 'Processing...')}
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                    {importProgressPercent}%
                  </div>
                  {activeJobId && (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
                      onClick={async () => {
                        try {
                          await api.cancelGuidedImport(activeJobId);
                          setImportStage(language === 'ru' ? 'Отмена запрошена...' : 'Cancellation requested...');
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          console.warn('Failed to cancel guided import', err);
                        }
                      }}
                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '2px 8px' }}
                    >
                      {language === 'ru' ? 'Отменить' : 'Cancel'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '8px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <div 
                  style={{ 
                    width: `${importProgressPercent}%`, 
                    height: '100%', 
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)', 
                    transition: 'width 0.3s ease' 
                  }} 
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Import Success Summary Card */}
          {importSuccessResult && (
            <div className="card" style={{ border: '1px solid #10b981', backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05)' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem', color: '#10b981' }}>✅</span>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, color: '#10b981' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Сессии успешно импортированы' : 'Sessions Imported Successfully'}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                {language === 'ru'
                  ? `Успешно сохранено ${importSuccessResult.length} сессий с расчетом канонических показателей ВСР и проверкой Task Eligibility.`
                  : `Successfully persisted ${importSuccessResult.length} sessions with canonical HRV metrics and Task Eligibility validation.`}
              </p>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                {importSuccessResult.map((res, idx) => (
                  <div 
                    key={idx}
                    style={{ 
                      display: 'flex', 
                      justifyContent: 'space-between', 
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      padding: '10px 14px',
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-card)',
                      borderRadius: '6px',
                      border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)'
                    }}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>{res.bundleName}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                        {res.startTime ? new Date(res.startTime).toLocaleString(language === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US') : '—'} • {res.durationSeconds ? `${Math.round(res.durationSeconds / 60)} мин` : '—'} • Каналы: {res.channels?.join(', ')}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '14px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                      {res.canonicalMetrics && (
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', fontSize: '0.8rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                          {/* RMSSD */}
                          <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: '4px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'inline-flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2px' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                              <span>RMSSD: <strong>{(() => {
                                const v = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd?.value : res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd;
                                return v !== null && v !== undefined ? `${Math.round(v)} мс` : '—';
                              })()}</strong></span>
                              {(() => {
                                const elig = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd?.eligibility_state : res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd_eligibility;
                                if (!elig) return null;
                                const col = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#10b981' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b';
                                const txt = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'Применимо' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'Применимо с замечаниями' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? 'Неприменимо' : 'Не определено';
                                return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: col }}>({txt})</span>;
                              })()}
                            </div>
                            {(() => {
                              const metric = res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd_metric || res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd;
                              const reasons = typeof metric === 'object' && metric
                                ? (metric.blocking_reasons || []).concat(metric.warnings || []).concat(metric.limitations || [])
                                : (res.canonicalMetrics.rmssd_reasons || []);
                              if (reasons.length > 0) return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{reasons.map((r: string) => localizeReason(r, language)).join('; ')}</span>;
                              return null;
                            })()}
                          </div>

                          {/* SDNN */}
                          <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: '4px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'inline-flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2px' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                              <span>SDNN: <strong>{(() => {
                                const v = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn?.value : res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn;
                                return v !== null && v !== undefined ? `${Math.round(v)} мс` : '—';
                              })()}</strong></span>
                              {(() => {
                                const elig = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn?.eligibility_state : res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn_eligibility;
                                if (!elig) return null;
                                const col = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#10b981' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b';
                                const txt = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'Применимо' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'Применимо с замечаниями' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? 'Неприменимо' : 'Не определено';
                                return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: col }}>({txt})</span>;
                              })()}
                            </div>
                            {(() => {
                              const metric = res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn_metric || res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn;
                              const reasons = typeof metric === 'object' && metric
                                ? (metric.blocking_reasons || []).concat(metric.warnings || []).concat(metric.limitations || [])
                                : (res.canonicalMetrics.sdnn_reasons || []);
                              if (reasons.length > 0) return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{reasons.map((r: string) => localizeReason(r, language)).join('; ')}</span>;
                              return null;
                            })()}
                          </div>

                          {/* pNN50 */}
                          <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: '4px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'inline-flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2px' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                              <span>pNN50: <strong>{(() => {
                                const v = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50 === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50?.value : res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50;
                                return v !== null && v !== undefined ? `${v.toFixed(1)}%` : '—';
                              })()}</strong></span>
                              {(() => {
                                const elig = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50 === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50?.eligibility_state : res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50_eligibility;
                                if (!elig) return null;
                                const col = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#10b981' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b';
                                const txt = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'Применимо' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'Применимо с замечаниями' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? 'Неприменимо' : 'Не определено';
                                return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: col }}>({txt})</span>;
                              })()}
                            </div>
                            {(() => {
                              const metric = res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50_metric || res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50;
                              const reasons = typeof metric === 'object' && metric
                                ? (metric.blocking_reasons || []).concat(metric.warnings || []).concat(metric.limitations || [])
                                : (res.canonicalMetrics.pnn50_reasons || []);
                              if (reasons.length > 0) return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{reasons.map((r: string) => localizeReason(r, language)).join('; ')}</span>;
                              return null;
                            })()}
                          </div>

                          {/* Mean HR */}
                          <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: '4px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', display: 'inline-flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '2px' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                              <span>ЧСС: <strong>{(() => {
                                const v = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm?.value : (res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr ?? null);
                                return v !== null && v !== undefined ? `${Math.round(v)} уд/мин` : '—';
                              })()}</strong></span>
                              {(() => {
                                const elig = typeof res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm === 'object' ? res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm?.eligibility_state : res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_eligibility;
                                if (!elig) return null;
                                const col = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? '#10b981' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b';
                                const txt = elig === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'Применимо' : elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' ? 'Применимо с замечаниями' : elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' ? 'Неприменимо' : 'Не определено';
                                return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 600, color: col }}>({txt})</span>;
                              })()}
                            </div>
                            {(() => {
                              const metric = res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_bpm;
                              const reasons = typeof metric === 'object' && metric
                                ? (metric.blocking_reasons || []).concat(metric.warnings || []).concat(metric.limitations || [])
                                : (res.canonicalMetrics.mean_hr_reasons || []);
                              if (reasons.length > 0) return <span style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{reasons.map((r: string) => localizeReason(r, language)).join('; ')}</span>;
                              return null;
                            })()}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {res.sessionId ? (
                        <button 
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (onNavigateToSession) {
                              onNavigateToSession(res.sessionId);
                            } else {
                              window.location.hash = `#/session/${res.sessionId}`;
                            }
                          }}
                          className="btn btn-sm btn-primary"
                          style={{ textDecoration: 'none', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                        >
                          <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Перейти к сессии' : 'Open Session'}</span>
                          <span>→</span>
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <span style={{ color: '#ef4444', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{res.error || 'Ошибка'}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Discovered Bundles Preview */}
          {scanResult && scanResult.bundles.length > 0 && (
            <div className="card">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '10px' }}>
                <div>
                  <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Обнаруженные сессии' : 'Discovered Sessions'} ({scanResult.bundles.length})
                  </h3>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {language === 'ru' 
                      ? `Выбрано: ${selectedCount} из ${totalBundlesCount}. Проверьте состав каналов перед импортом.` 
                      : `Selected: ${selectedCount} of ${totalBundlesCount}. Review channel composition before import.`}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <button 
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" 
                    onClick={() => handleSelectAll(true)}
                    disabled={importing}
                  >
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Выбрать все' : 'Select All'}
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" 
                    onClick={() => handleSelectAll(false)}
                    disabled={importing}
                  >
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Снять выбор' : 'Deselect All'}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    className="btn btn-primary"
                    onClick={handleExecuteGuidedImport}
                    disabled={importing || selectedCount === 0}
                    style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', marginLeft: '6px' }}
                  >
                    <span>📥</span>
                    <span>
                      {importing
                        ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Импорт...' : 'Importing...')
                        : (language === 'ru' ? `Импортировать выбранные (${selectedCount})` : `Import Selected (${selectedCount})`)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Bundle Cards List */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '14px' }}>
                {scanResult.bundles.map((bundle) => {
                  const isExpanded = expandedBundleIds.has(bundle.bundleId);
                  const isConflict = bundle.status === 'CONFLICT';
                  const isWarning = bundle.status === 'WARNING';

                  let statusBadgeColor = '#10b981';
                  let statusLabel = language === 'ru' ? 'Готов к импорту' : 'Ready to Import';
                  if (isConflict) {
                    statusBadgeColor = '#ef4444';
                    statusLabel = language === 'ru' ? 'Конфликт каналов' : 'Channel Conflict';
                  } else if (isWarning) {
                    statusBadgeColor = '#f59e0b';
                    statusLabel = language === 'ru' ? 'Неполный пакет (без RR)' : 'Partial Bundle';
                  }

                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={bundle.bundleId}
                      style={{ 
                        border: `1px solid ${isConflict ? '#ef4444' : (bundle.selected ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--border-subtle)')}`,
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        padding: '14px',
                        backgroundColor: bundle.selected ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.02)' : 'var(--bg-card)',
                        transition: 'border 0.2s ease'
                      }}
                    >
                      {/* Bundle Top Row */}
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: '10px' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
                          <input 
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={bundle.selected}
                            disabled={isConflict || importing}
                            onChange={() => handleToggleSelectBundle(bundle.bundleId)}
                            style={{ width: '18px', height: '18px', cursor: isConflict ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' }}
                          />
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                              <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>{bundle.bundleName}</span>
                              <span 
                                style={{ 
                                  fontSize: '0.7rem', 
                                  padding: '2px 6px', 
                                  borderRadius: '4px', 
                                  backgroundColor: `${statusBadgeColor}20`,
                                  color: statusBadgeColor,
                                  fontWeight: 600
                                }}
                              >
                                {statusLabel}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                              {bundle.startTime ? new Date(bundle.startTime).toLocaleString(language === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US') : '—'} • 
                              {bundle.durationSeconds ? ` ${bundle.isDurationEstimated ? '~' : ''}${Math.round(bundle.durationSeconds / 60)} мин • ` : ' '}
                              Устройство: <code>{bundle.deviceId}</code>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Channel Badges */}
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '6px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                          {['RR', 'ECG', 'ACC', 'HR'].map((ch) => {
                            const hasChannel = bundle.channels.includes(ch as any);
                            return (
                              <span
                                key={ch}
                                style={{
                                  padding: '3px 8px',
                                  borderRadius: '4px',
                                  fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                  fontWeight: 600,
                                  backgroundColor: hasChannel ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                                  color: hasChannel ? '#000' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                                  opacity: hasChannel ? 1 : 0.4
                                }}
                              >
                                {ch}
                              </span>
                            );
                          })}

                          <button 
                            className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost"
                            onClick={() => toggleExpandBundle(bundle.bundleId)}
                            style={{ marginLeft: '6px', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Свернуть' : 'Collapse') : (language === 'ru' ? `Файлы (${bundle.files.length})` : `Files (${bundle.files.length})`)}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Warnings */}
                      {bundle.warnings.length > 0 && (
                        <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: '4px', backgroundColor: isConflict ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)' : 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)', color: isConflict ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                          {bundle.warnings.map((w, wIdx) => <div key={wIdx}>⚠️ {w}</div>)}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Expanded Files & Grouping Corrections */}
                      {isExpanded && (
                        <div style={{ marginTop: '12px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingTop: '10px' }}>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '8px', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                            {language === 'ru' ? 'Состав файлов и ручная корректировка группировки:' : 'Files in bundle & manual grouping corrections:'}
                          </div>
                          
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '6px' }}>
                            {bundle.files.map((file, fIdx) => (
                              <div 
                                key={fIdx}
                                style={{ 
                                  display: 'flex', 
                                  justifyContent: 'space-between', 
                                  alignItems: 'center',
                                  padding: '6px 10px',
                                  borderRadius: '4px',
                                  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                                  fontSize: '0.8rem'
                                }}
                              >
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>{file.signalType}</span>
                                  <code>{file.fileName}</code>
                                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>({Math.round(file.sizeBytes / 1024)} KB)</span>
                                  {file.rowCount > 0 && (
                                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>• {file.isRowCountEstimated ? '~' : ''}{file.rowCount} строк</span>
                                  )}
                                </div>

                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '6px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                                  {/* Move to another session selector */}
                                  {scanResult.bundles.length > 1 && (
                                    <select
                                      className="input input-sm"
                                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '2px 4px' }}
                                      defaultValue=""
                                      onChange={(e) => {
                                        if (e.target.value) {
                                          handleMoveFile(file.fullPath, bundle.bundleId, e.target.value);
                                        }
                                      }}
                                    >
                                      <option value="" disabled>Переместить в...</option>
                                      {scanResult.bundles
                                        .filter(other => other.bundleId !== bundle.bundleId)
                                        .map(other => (
                                          <option key={other.bundleId} value={other.bundleId}>
                                            {other.bundleName}
                                          </option>
                                        ))
                                      }
                                    </select>
                                  )}

                                  {bundle.files.length > 1 && (
                                    <button
                                      className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost"
                                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '2px 6px' }}
                                      onClick={() => handleCreateNewBundleFromFile(file.fullPath, bundle.bundleId)}
                                      title="Создать отдельную сессию из этого файла"
                                    >
                                      Выделить
                                    </button>
                                  )}

                                  <button
                                    className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost"
                                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '2px 6px', color: '#ef4444' }}
                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveFileFromImport(file.fullPath, bundle.bundleId)}
                                    title="Исключить файл из импорта"
                                  >
                                    ✕
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Empty scan state */}
          {scanResult && scanResult.bundles.length === 0 && (
            <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '30px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '2rem' }}>📭</span>
              <h3>{language === 'ru' ? 'Файлы логов Polar не найдены' : 'No Polar log files found'}</h3>
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {language === 'ru' 
                  ? 'Убедитесь, что в указанной папке находятся файлы формата Polar_H10_..._RR.txt или перетащите файлы в окно.' 
                  : 'Ensure the selected folder contains Polar_H10_..._RR.txt files or drag and drop logs directly.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Auto Ingest Tab (Maintains compatibility) */}
      {activeTab === 'auto' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
          {statusError && (
            <div className="alert alert-danger">
              {t('errorLoadingStatus')}: {statusError}
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="alert alert-danger">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="card">
            <div className="section-title">
              <span>🔄</span> {t('activeFolder')}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '15px' }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: '4px', border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                {status?.sourcePath || t('noActiveFolder')}
              </div>
              <button 
                className="btn btn-primary"
                onClick={handleStartSync}
                disabled={syncStatus?.running || startingSync || !status?.sourcePath}
              >
                {syncStatus?.running || startingSync ? t('syncInProgress') : t('startManualSync')}
              </button>
            </div>

            {syncStatus?.running && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={handleCancelSync}>
                  {t('cancelSync')}
                </button>
                <span className="badge badge-warning">{t('syncingBackground')}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {syncStatus?.isStale && (
              <div className="alert alert-warning" style={{ marginTop: '10px' }}>
                <span>{t('staleLockDetected')}</span>
                <button className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" style={{ marginLeft: '10px' }} onClick={handleResetLock}>
                  {t('resetLock')}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <DataSourcesPanel onSourceChanged={() => api.getStatus().then(setStatus).catch(() => {})} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
