import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { SafeMarkdown } from '../components/SafeMarkdown';
import {
  api,
  UserProfile,
  LlmDiaryRecord,
  LlmProvider,
  SessionSummary,
  AthleteCoreJourneyContext,
  AthleteJourneyCommand
} from '../api';
import { AppDialog } from '../components/AppDialog';
import { AppSelect } from '../components/AppSelect';
import { PageSnapshotButton } from '../components/PageSnapshotButton';

interface LlmDiaryProps {
  activeUserId: string;
  profiles: UserProfile[];
  onNavigateToSession: (id: string) => void;
  journeyContext?: AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null;
  onDispatchCommand?: (command: AthleteJourneyCommand) => Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null>;
}

function getLineageBadge(diary: LlmDiaryRecord, isRu: boolean) {
  const state = diary.lineage_state || (diary.artifact_state as any) || 'unlinked';
  let label = isRu ? 'Не привязано' : 'Unlinked';
  let bg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)';
  let color = '#94a3b8';

  if (state === 'current') {
    label = isRu ? 'Актуально' : 'Current';
    bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
    color = '#10b981';
  } else if (state === 'historical') {
    label = isRu ? 'Ревизия окна' : 'Historical';
    bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
    color = '#f59e0b';
  } else if (state === 'source_changed') {
    label = isRu ? 'Сессия изменена' : 'Source Changed';
    bg = 'rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15)';
    color = '#f97316';
  } else if (state === 'artifact_missing') {
    label = isRu ? 'Пакет отсутствует' : 'Missing Pack';
    bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
    color = '#ef4444';
  }

  const title = diary.lineage_info?.explanation || (isRu ? `Состояние привязки: ${label}` : `Lineage: ${label}`);

  return (
    <span
      className="badge"
      title={title}
      style={{
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        backgroundColor: bg,
        color,
        fontWeight: 600,
        border: `1px solid ${color}40`,
        padding: '2px 6px',
        borderRadius: '4px'
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function LlmDiary({
  activeUserId,
  profiles = [],
  onNavigateToSession,
  journeyContext
}: LlmDiaryProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();

  // Diaries & detail state
  const [diaries, setDiaries] = useState<LlmDiaryRecord[]>([]);
  const [selectedDiary, setSelectedDiary] = useState<LlmDiaryRecord | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [deleteDialogId, setDeleteDialogId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters state
  const [filterUserId, setFilterUserId] = useState(activeUserId);
  const [filterProvider, setFilterProvider] = useState<string>('');
  const [filterActivity, setFilterActivity] = useState<string>('');
  const [filterSearch, setFilterSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [filterFavorite, setFilterFavorite] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Import Modal state
  const [showImport, setShowImport] = useState(false);
  const [importUserId, setImportUserId] = useState(activeUserId || (profiles?.[0]?.id ?? ''));
  const [importProvider, setImportProvider] = useState<LlmProvider>('chatgpt');
  const [importModelLabel, setImportModelLabel] = useState('');
  const [importContent, setImportContent] = useState('');
  const [importSourceType, setImportSourceType] = useState<'file' | 'pasted_text'>('file');
  const [importSourceFilename, setImportSourceFilename] = useState('');
  const [importSourceExt, setImportSourceExt] = useState<'.md' | '.txt' | undefined>(undefined);
  const [importSessionId, setImportSessionId] = useState('');
  const [importPackId, setImportPackId] = useState('');

  // Dropdown options
  const [userSessions, setUserSessions] = useState<SessionSummary[]>([]);
  const [userPacks, setUserPacks] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // UI state
  const [dragActive, setDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Sync filter user id with active user profile
  useEffect(() => {
    setFilterUserId(activeUserId);
  }, [activeUserId]);

  // Load diaries when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDiaries();
  }, [filterUserId, filterProvider, filterActivity, filterSearch, filterFavorite]);

  // Load sessions and packs when import user id changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (importUserId) {
      api.getSessions(importUserId)
        .then(setUserSessions)
        .catch(err => console.error('Failed to get sessions:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)));

      api.getLlmPacks(importUserId)
        .then(setUserPacks)
        .catch(err => console.error('Failed to get LLM packs:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)));
    } else {
      setUserSessions([]);
      setUserPacks([]);
    }
    setImportSessionId('');
    setImportPackId('');
  }, [importUserId]);

  const loadDiaries = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.getLlmDiaries({
      user_id: filterUserId || undefined,
      provider: filterProvider || undefined,
      activity_type: filterActivity || undefined,
      search: filterSearch || undefined,
      favorite_only: filterFavorite || undefined
    })
      .then((data) => {
        setDiaries(data);
        if (data.length > 0) {
          if (selectedDiary) {
            const updated = data.find(d => d.id === selectedDiary.id);
            setSelectedDiary(updated || data[0]);
          } else {
            setSelectedDiary(data[0]);
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedDiary(null);
        }
      })
      .catch(err => console.error('Failed to get LLM diaries:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  const handleFavoriteToggle = async (diary: LlmDiaryRecord) => {
    try {
      await api.toggleLlmDiaryFavorite(diary.id, !diary.is_favorite);
      const updatedList = diaries.map(d => d.id === diary.id ? { ...d, is_favorite: !d.is_favorite } : d);
      setDiaries(updatedList);
      if (selectedDiary && selectedDiary.id === diary.id) {
        setSelectedDiary({ ...selectedDiary, is_favorite: !selectedDiary.is_favorite });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorText(err.message || 'Error toggling favorite');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteDiary = (id: string) => {
    setDeleteDialogId(id);
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteDialogId) return;
    try {
      await api.deleteLlmDiary(deleteDialogId);
      setSelectedDiary(null);
      loadDiaries();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorText(err.message || 'Error deleting entry');
    } finally {
      setDeleteDialogId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDrag = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (e.type === 'dragenter' || e.type === 'dragover') {
      setDragActive(true);
    } else if (e.type === 'dragleave') {
      setDragActive(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setDragActive(false);

    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
      processFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      processFile(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  };

  const processFile = (file: File) => {
    setImportError(null);

    if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setImportError(language === 'ru' ? 'Размер файла превышает лимит 2 МБ' : 'File size exceeds 2 MB limit');
      return;
    }

    const nameLower = file.name.toLowerCase();
    if (!nameLower.endsWith('.md') && !nameLower.endsWith('.txt')) {
      setImportError(language === 'ru' ? 'Разрешены только файлы с расширением .md или .txt' : 'Only .md and .txt files are allowed');
      return;
    }

    const ext = nameLower.endsWith('.md') ? '.md' : '.txt';
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (evt) => {
      const text = evt.target?.result as string;
      setImportContent(text);
      setImportSourceFilename(file.name);
      setImportSourceExt(ext);
      setImportSourceType('file');
    };
    reader.onerror = () => {
      setImportError(language === 'ru' ? 'Ошибка чтения файла' : 'Error reading file');
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const handleImportSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!importUserId) {
      setImportError(language === 'ru' ? 'Пожалуйста, выберите спортсмена' : 'Please select an athlete');
      return;
    }
    if (!importContent.trim()) {
      setImportError(language === 'ru' ? 'Контент отчета пуст' : 'Report content is empty');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setImportError(null);

    try {
      await api.importLlmDiary({
        userId: importUserId,
        sessionId: importSessionId || undefined,
        packId: importPackId || undefined,
        provider: importProvider,
        modelLabel: importModelLabel || undefined,
        content: importContent,
        sourceType: importSourceType,
        sourceFilename: importSourceType === 'file' ? importSourceFilename : undefined,
        sourceExt: importSourceType === 'file' ? importSourceExt : undefined
      });

      setImportContent('');
      setImportSourceFilename('');
      setImportSourceExt(undefined);
      setImportModelLabel('');
      setImportSessionId('');
      setImportPackId('');
      setShowImport(false);

      loadDiaries();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setImportError(err.message || 'Failed to import report');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const getProviderLabel = (prov: string) => {
    switch (prov) {
      case 'chatgpt': return 'ChatGPT';
      case 'gemini': return 'Gemini';
      case 'antigravity': return 'Antigravity';
      default: return prov;
    }
  };

  const formatDateTime = (isoString?: string | null) => {
    if (!isoString) return '';
    try {
      const d = new Date(isoString);
      return d.toLocaleString(language === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit'
      });
    } catch {
      return isoString;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fade-in" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h1>{t('diaryTitle')}</h1>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{t('diarySubtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <PageSnapshotButton pageName="LlmDiary" metadata={{ diaryCount: diaries.length }} />
          <button
            className="btn btn-primary"
            onClick={() => {
              setImportError(null);
              setShowImport(true);
            }}
          >
            ➕ {t('diaryImportBtn')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={styles.splitLayout}>
        <div style={styles.leftPane}>
          <div className="card" style={{ padding: '14px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '8px' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                className="form-input"
                placeholder={t('diarySearchPlaceholder')}
                value={filterSearch}
                onChange={(e) => setFilterSearch(e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
              />

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', width: '100%' }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="filter-provider"
                    value={filterProvider}
                    onChange={setFilterProvider}
                    placeholder={t('diaryFilterAllProviders')}
                    options={[
                      { value: 'chatgpt', label: 'ChatGPT' },
                      { value: 'gemini', label: 'Gemini / AI Studio' },
                      { value: 'antigravity', label: 'Antigravity' },
                      { value: 'other', label: 'Other' }
                    ]}
                  />
                </div>

                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="filter-activity"
                    value={filterActivity}
                    onChange={setFilterActivity}
                    placeholder={t('diaryFilterAllActivities')}
                    options={[
                      { value: 'cardio', label: t('activityCardio') },
                      { value: 'sleep', label: t('activitySleep') },
                      { value: 'mixed', label: t('activityMixed') },
                      { value: 'resting_hrv', label: t('activityRestingHrv') },
                      { value: 'recovery', label: t('activityRecovery') },
                      { value: 'strength', label: t('activityStrength') },
                      { value: 'other', label: t('activityOther') }
                    ]}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={filterFavorite}
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterFavorite(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span>⭐ {t('diaryFilterFavorites')}</span>
                </label>

                {filterUserId && (
                  <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                    👤 {profiles.find(p => p.id === filterUserId)?.display_name}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={styles.listContainer}>
            {loading ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '40px' }}>
                <span className="spinner" />
              </div>
            ) : diaries.length === 0 ? (
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', padding: '40px 20px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                {t('diaryEmptyState')}
              </div>
            ) : (
              diaries.map((diary) => {
                const isSelected = selectedDiary?.id === diary.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={diary.id}
                    className="card fade-in"
                    style={{
                      ...styles.diaryCard,
                      borderLeft: isSelected ? '4px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                      background: isSelected ? 'rgba(60,130,255,0.06)' : 'var(--bg-card)',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedDiary(diary)}
                  >
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: '600', fontSize: '0.9rem', color: isSelected ? 'var(--accent-primary-light)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                        {diary.title}
                      </div>
                      <button
                        style={styles.starBtn}
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleFavoriteToggle(diary);
                        }}
                      >
                        {diary.is_favorite ? '★' : '☆'}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '6px', marginTop: '6px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <span className={`signal-tag ${diary.provider}`} style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem' }}>
                        {getProviderLabel(diary.provider)}
                      </span>
                      {diary.activity_type && (
                        <span className="signal-tag rr" style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', background: 'rgba(50,200,130,0.1)' }}>
                          {t(`activity${diary.activity_type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + diary.activity_type.slice(1)}` as any)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {getLineageBadge(diary, language === 'ru')}
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: '8px', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      <span>👤 {diary.display_name}</span>
                      <span>📅 {(diary.imported_at || diary.created_at || '').substring(0, 10)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={styles.rightPane}>
          {selectedDiary ? (
            <div className="card fade-in" style={styles.detailCard}>
              <div style={styles.detailHeader}>
                <div>
                  <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.25rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    {selectedDiary.title}
                  </h2>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', marginTop: '6px', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <span className={`signal-tag ${selectedDiary.provider}`}>
                      {getProviderLabel(selectedDiary.provider)}
                    </span>
                    {selectedDiary.model_label && (
                      <span className="signal-tag ecg" style={{ background: 'rgba(60,130,255,0.1)' }}>
                        {selectedDiary.model_label}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {selectedDiary.activity_type && (
                      <span className="signal-tag rr" style={{ background: 'rgba(50,200,130,0.1)' }}>
                        {t(`activity${selectedDiary.activity_type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + selectedDiary.activity_type.slice(1)}` as any)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {getLineageBadge(selectedDiary, language === 'ru')}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-ghost"
                    onClick={() => handleFavoriteToggle(selectedDiary)}
                    style={{ fontSize: '1rem', padding: '4px 10px' }}
                  >
                    {selectedDiary.is_favorite ? '★ Избранное' : '☆ В избранное'}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-danger"
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteDiary(selectedDiary.id)}
                    style={{ padding: '4px 10px', background: 'rgba(255, 70, 70, 0.1)', color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}
                  >
                    🗑️
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {selectedDiary.lineage_info?.needs_reinterpretation && (
                <div style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  padding: '10px 14px',
                  marginBottom: '16px',
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  color: '#fbbf24'
                }}>
                  ⚠️ <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Рекомендована переинтерпретация:' : 'Re-interpretation recommended:'}</strong>{' '}
                  {selectedDiary.lineage_info.explanation}
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={styles.metaGrid}>
                <div style={styles.metaItem}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{t('diaryCardCreated')}:</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{formatDateTime(selectedDiary.created_at)}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.metaItem}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{t('diaryCardImported')}:</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{formatDateTime(selectedDiary.imported_at)}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={styles.metaItem}>
                  <span style={styles.metaLabel}>{t('diarySelectUser')}:</span>
                  <span style={styles.metaVal}>{selectedDiary.display_name}</span>
                </div>
                {selectedDiary.source_filename && (
                  <div style={styles.metaItem}>
                    <span style={styles.metaLabel}>Файл:</span>
                    <span style={styles.metaVal} title={selectedDiary.source_filename}>
                      {selectedDiary.source_filename.length > 25
                        ? selectedDiary.source_filename.substring(0, 22) + '...'
                        : selectedDiary.source_filename}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {selectedDiary.session_id && (
                  <div style={styles.metaItem}>
                    <span style={styles.metaLabel}>Связанная сессия:</span>
                    <span style={styles.metaVal}>
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-ghost"
                        onClick={() => onNavigateToSession(selectedDiary.session_id!)}
                        style={{ padding: '0', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--accent-primary-light)', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', textDecoration: 'underline' }}
                      >
                        ⏱️ Посмотреть сессию
                      </button>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={styles.disclaimerBox}>
                <strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '2px' }}>📖 {t('diarySubjectiveNote')}</strong>
                {t('diarySubjectiveDesc')}
              </div>

              <hr style={{ border: 'none', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', margin: '20px 0' }} />

              <div style={styles.contentArea}>
                <SafeMarkdown text={selectedDiary.response_md} />
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={styles.placeholderPane}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '3rem', opacity: 0.3, marginBottom: '10px' }}>📖</span>
              <p>{language === 'ru' ? 'Выберите запись дневника для просмотра деталей' : 'Select a diary entry to view details'}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {showImport && (
        <div style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <div className="card fade-in" style={styles.modalCard}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>📥 {t('diaryImportBtn')}</h3>
              <button
                className="btn btn-ghost"
                onClick={() => setShowImport(false)}
                style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem', padding: '0 6px' }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleImportSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '12px' }}>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diarySelectUser')}</label>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="select-diary-user"
                    value={importUserId}
                    onChange={(val) => setImportUserId(val)}
                    placeholder={language === 'en' ? '-- Select --' : '-- Выберите --'}
                    options={profiles.map(p => ({
                      value: p.id,
                      label: p.display_name
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diarySelectSession')}</label>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="select-diary-session"
                    value={importSessionId}
                    onChange={setImportSessionId}
                    placeholder={language === 'en' ? '-- No Link --' : '-- Нет связи --'}
                    options={userSessions.map(s => ({
                      value: s.id,
                      label: `${s.start_time.substring(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')} (${t(`activity${s.signal_types.includes('ecg') ? 'Cardio' : 'Other'}` as any)})`
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '12px' }}>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diaryProviderLabel')}</label>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="select-diary-provider"
                    value={importProvider}
                    onChange={(val) => setImportProvider(val as LlmProvider)}
                    options={[
                      { value: 'chatgpt', label: 'ChatGPT (OpenAI)' },
                      { value: 'gemini', label: 'Gemini / AI Studio (Google)' },
                      { value: 'antigravity', label: 'Antigravity (Local)' },
                      { value: 'other', label: 'Other' }
                    ]}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diaryModelLabel')}</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="form-input"
                    placeholder="e.g. gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro"
                    value={importModelLabel}
                    onChange={(e) => setImportModelLabel(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {userPacks.length > 0 && (
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diarySelectPack')}</label>
                  <AppSelect
                    id="select-diary-pack"
                    value={importPackId}
                    onChange={setImportPackId}
                    placeholder={language === 'en' ? '-- No Link --' : '-- Нет связи --'}
                    options={userPacks.map(p => ({
                      value: p.id,
                      label: `${p.filename} (${p.export_profile})`
                    }))}
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '16px', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="importSourceType"
                    checked={importSourceType === 'file'}
                    onChange={() => setImportSourceType('file')}
                  />
                  <span>📁 {language === 'ru' ? 'Загрузить файл' : 'File Upload'}</span>
                </label>
                <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="importSourceType"
                    checked={importSourceType === 'pasted_text'}
                    onChange={() => setImportSourceType('pasted_text')}
                  />
                  <span>✍ {language === 'ru' ? 'Вставить текст' : 'Paste Text'}</span>
                </label>
              </div>

              {importSourceType === 'file' ? (
                <div
                  style={{
                    ...styles.dropZone,
                    borderColor: dragActive ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--border-subtle)',
                    background: dragActive ? 'rgba(60,130,255,0.04)' : 'transparent'
                  }}
                  onDragEnter={handleDrag}
                  onDragOver={handleDrag}
                  onDragLeave={handleDrag}
                  onDrop={handleDrop}
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                >
                  <input
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                    onChange={handleFileChange}
                    accept=".md,.txt"
                  />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '2rem', opacity: 0.5 }}>📥</span>
                  <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 0', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{t('diaryDragDropHint')}</p>
                  {importSourceFilename && (
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', color: 'var(--accent-primary-light)', fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
                      Selected: {importSourceFilename}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">{t('diaryPasteLabel')}</label>
                  <textarea
                    className="form-input"
                    rows={8}
                    style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                    value={importContent}
                    onChange={(e) => setImportContent(e.target.value)}
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              {importError && (
                <div className="badge badge-danger" style={{ padding: '8px 12px', fontSize: '0.8rem', width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
                  ⚠️ {importError}
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '10px', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn btn-ghost"
                  onClick={() => setShowImport(false)}
                >
                  Отмена
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="btn btn-primary"
                  disabled={isSubmitting || !importContent.trim()}
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? 'Импорт...' : 'Импортировать'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <AppDialog
        isOpen={deleteDialogId !== null}
        title={language === 'en' ? 'Delete Diary Entry' : 'Удалить запись'}
        description={t('diaryDeleteConfirm')}
        confirmLabel={language === 'en' ? 'Delete' : 'Удалить'}
        cancelLabel={language === 'en' ? 'Cancel' : 'Отмена'}
        isDestructive={true}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDelete}
        onCancel={() => setDeleteDialogId(null)}
      />

      <AppDialog
        isOpen={errorText !== null}
        title={t('error') || 'Ошибка'}
        description={errorText || ''}
        confirmLabel="ОК"
        onConfirm={() => setErrorText(null)}
        onCancel={() => setErrorText(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

================================================================================
FILE: src/frontend/views/PilotParticipantView.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  api,
  EnrollmentSnapshot,
  PilotActorContext,
  SupportEpisode,
  BetaEvidenceExportBundle,
  getPilotProjectionApi,
  generatePilotReportApi,
  executeJourneyCommandApi,
  OneRecordingPilotProjection
} from '../api';
import { PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION } from '../../shared/betaContract';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { OneRecordingPilotCard } from '../components/OneRecordingPilotCard';

interface PilotParticipantViewProps {
  activeUserId?: string;
  onNavigateToSession?: (sessionId: string) => void;
}

export function PilotParticipantView({ activeUserId, onNavigateToSession }: PilotParticipantViewProps) {
  const { t } = useT();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [actorContext, setActorContext] = useState<PilotActorContext | null>(null);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<EnrollmentSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [supportEpisodes, setSupportEpisodes] = useState<SupportEpisode[]>([]);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Enrollment form states
  const [inviteCode, setInviteCode] = useState<string>('');
  const [consentChecked, setConsentChecked] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Support request form states
  const [showSupportModal, setShowSupportModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [supportReason, setSupportReason] = useState<string>('');
  const [supportCategory, setSupportCategory] = useState<'guidance' | 'defect' | 'self_service' | 'unsupported_input'>('guidance');
  const [userActiveMinutes, setUserActiveMinutes] = useState<number>(5);

  // Evidence export states
  const [exportingEvidence, setExportingEvidence] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showExportModal, setShowExportModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [evidenceBundle, setEvidenceBundle] = useState<BetaEvidenceExportBundle | null>(null);

  // G40 One-Recording Pilot states
  const [pilotProjection, setPilotProjection] = useState<OneRecordingPilotProjection | null>(null);
  const [generatingReport, setGeneratingReport] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [confirmingOutcome, setConfirmingOutcome] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      if (activeUserId) {
        try {
          const projRes = await getPilotProjectionApi(activeUserId);
          if (projRes.success && projRes.projection) {
            setPilotProjection(projRes.projection);
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      const res = await api.getPilotActorContext(undefined, activeUserId);
      if (res.success && res.actor_context) {
        setActorContext(res.actor_context);
        if (res.actor_context.participant_id && res.actor_context.is_enrolled) {
          const [snapRes, epRes] = await Promise.all([
            api.getParticipantSnapshot(res.actor_context.participant_id).catch(() => ({ success: false, snapshot: null })),
            api.listSupportEpisodes(res.actor_context.participant_id).catch(() => ({ success: false, episodes: [] }))
          ]);
          if (snapRes.success && snapRes.snapshot) {
            setSnapshot(snapRes.snapshot);
          }
          if (epRes.success && Array.isArray(epRes.episodes)) {
            setSupportEpisodes(epRes.episodes);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка загрузки данных участника';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [activeUserId]);

  const handleEnrollment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activeUserId) {
      setErrorMsg('Для регистрации в пилоте выберите профиль атлета в боковом меню');
      return;
    }
    if (!inviteCode.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Пожалуйста, введите код приглашения');
      return;
    }
    if (!consentChecked) {
      setErrorMsg('Необходимо подтвердить Информированное согласие');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await api.enrollBetaParticipant({
        invite_code: inviteCode.trim(),
        profile_id: activeUserId,
        consent_version: PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION,
        consent_given_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      if (res.success && res.participant) {
        setSuccessMsg(`Успешная регистрация! Ваш ID участника: ${res.participant.participant_id}`);
        await loadData();
      } else {
        setErrorMsg('Ошибка регистрации в пилоте');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Не удалось зарегистрироваться в пилоте';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSupportSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!actorContext?.participant_id || !actorContext?.cohort_id) return;
    if (!supportReason.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Укажите причину обращения в поддержку');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      // Participant submits only reason, category, and user active time (never operator time or resolution status)
      const res = await api.recordSupportEpisode({
        participant_id: actorContext.participant_id,
        cohort_id: actorContext.cohort_id,
        reason: supportReason.trim(),
        category: supportCategory,
        user_active_minutes: Number(userActiveMinutes) || 0
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setSuccessMsg('Обращение в поддержку успешно зарегистрировано');
        setShowSupportModal(false);
        setSupportReason('');
        await loadData();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка при отправке обращения';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportEvidence = async () => {
    if (!actorContext?.participant_id) return;
    setExportingEvidence(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.exportBetaEvidenceBundle(actorContext.participant_id, false);
      if (res.success && res.bundle) {
        setEvidenceBundle(res.bundle);
        setShowExportModal(false);
        setSuccessMsg('Пакет свидетельств успешно сформирован и проверен сканером приватности');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка формирования пакета свидетельств';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setExportingEvidence(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGeneratePilotReport = async () => {
    if (!activeUserId || !pilotProjection?.session_id) return;
    setGeneratingReport(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await generatePilotReportApi({
        sessionId: pilotProjection.session_id,
        profileId: activeUserId,
        contextType: pilotProjection.context.type,
        windowRootId: pilotProjection.context.window_id,
        windowRevision: pilotProjection.context.window_revision
      });
      if (res.success && res.report) {
        setSuccessMsg(`Отчет пилота успешно сформирован (Манифест: ${res.report.manifest_id})`);
        await loadData();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка формирования отчета пилота';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setGeneratingReport(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmPilotOutcome = async () => {
    if (!activeUserId || !pilotProjection?.session_id || !pilotProjection?.artifact?.artifact_id) return;
    setConfirmingOutcome(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await executeJourneyCommandApi({
        profile_id: activeUserId,
        expected_revision: pilotProjection.selection_revision,
        idempotency_key: `cmd-${Date.now()}`,
        command: {
          command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome',
          artifact_id: pilotProjection.artifact.artifact_id,
          episode_id: pilotProjection.episode_id || 'pilot_episode',
          selected_action: 'store_in_personal_records'
        }
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setSuccessMsg('Исход пилота успешно подтвержден!');
        await loadData();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка подтверждения исхода пилота';
      setErrorMsg(msg);
    } finally {
      setConfirmingOutcome(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={styles.container}>
        <p style={styles.loadingText}>Загрузка портала пилота...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isEnrolled = actorContext?.role === 'participant' && actorContext?.is_enrolled;

  return (
    <div id="pilot-participant-view" style={styles.container}>
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={styles.title}>Контролируемый пилот CardioLab</h1>
          <p style={styles.subtitle}>
            Пользовательский контур валидации спортивно-аналитического функционала
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          id="pilot-back-to-sessions-btn"
          style={styles.navButton}
          onClick={() => {
            window.location.hash = '#/sessions';
          }}
        >
          ← К тренировкам
        </button>
      </div>

      {errorMsg && (
        <div id="pilot-error-banner" style={styles.errorBox}>
          <span>⚠ {errorMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {successMsg && (
        <div id="pilot-success-banner" style={styles.successBox}>
          <span>✓ {successMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!isEnrolled ? (
        /* Enrollment Surface */
        <div id="pilot-enrollment-card" style={styles.card}>
          <h2 style={styles.cardTitle}>Регистрация участника пилота</h2>
          <p style={styles.cardDesc}>
            Для участия в контролируемом тестировании введите код приглашения, выданный оператором, и ознакомьтесь с информированным согласием.
          </p>

          <form onSubmit={handleEnrollment} style={styles.form}>
            <div style={styles.formGroup}>
              <label style={styles.label}>Код приглашения (Invite Code)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="pilot-invite-input"
                style={styles.input}
                value={inviteCode}
                onChange={(e) => setInviteCode(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="INV-XXXX-YYYY"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div style={styles.formGroup}>
              <label style={styles.label}>Профиль атлета</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="pilot-profile-input"
                style={{
                  ...styles.input,
                  backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                  color: activeUserId ? '#94a3b8' : '#f87171'
                }}
                value={activeUserId || 'Профиль не выбран (требуется выбор атлета)'}
                disabled
              />
              <span style={styles.helperText}>
                {activeUserId
                  ? 'Пилот будет привязан к текущему активному профилю атлета.'
                  : 'Для участия в пилоте выберите профиль атлета в меню слева.'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.consentBox}>
              <h3 style={styles.consentTitle}>
                Информированное согласие на участие в тестировании (версия {PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION})
              </h3>
              <div style={styles.consentText}>
                <p>
                  1. <strong>Немедицинское назначение:</strong> Программный комплекс H10 Athlete Cardio Lab предназначен исключительно для информационных, научно-исследовательских и спортивно-тренировочных целей. ПО не является медицинским изделием и не ставит медицинских диагнозов.
                </p>
                <p>
                  2. <strong>Анализ R-R и ЭКГ:</strong> Вычисления дрейфа ЧСС, аэробных порогов и показателей ВСР основаны на математических алгоритмах обработки временных рядов нагрузочного тестирования.
                </p>
                <p>
                  3. <strong>Локальное хранение:</strong> Ваши исходные файлы и результаты анализа хранятся локально на вашем компьютере. Передача данных оператору осуществляется только при явном экспорте обезличенного пакета свидетельств.
                </p>
              </div>

              <label style={styles.checkboxLabel}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="pilot-consent-checkbox"
                  checked={consentChecked}
                  onChange={(e) => setConsentChecked(e.target.checked)}
                  required
                />
                <span style={{ marginLeft: '8px' }}>
                  Я прочитал(а) и принимаю условия Информированного согласия (v{PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION})
                </span>
              </label>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              id="pilot-enroll-submit-btn"
              style={styles.primaryButton}
              disabled={isSubmitting || !consentChecked || !inviteCode.trim()}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Проверка и регистрация...' : 'Зарегистрироваться в пилоте'}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* Enrolled Dashboard */
        <div style={styles.dashboard}>
          {/* G41 One-Recording Pilot Component */}
          <OneRecordingPilotCard profileId={activeUserId || ''} />

          <div id="pilot-status-card" style={styles.card}>
            <div style={styles.statusHeader}>
              <div>
                <span style={styles.activeTag}>АКТИВНЫЙ УЧАСТНИК</span>
                <h2 style={styles.cardTitle}>Статус участия в пилоте</h2>
              </div>
              <div style={styles.participantMeta}>
                <div><strong>ID:</strong> {actorContext?.participant_id}</div>
                <div><strong>Когорта:</strong> {actorContext?.cohort_id}</div>
                <div><strong>Согласие:</strong> v{snapshot?.consent_policy_version || PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.metricsGrid}>
              <div style={styles.metricItem}>
                <span style={styles.metricLabel}>Класс участника</span>
                <span style={styles.metricValue}>{snapshot?.participant_class ?? '—'}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={styles.metricItem}>
                <span style={styles.metricLabel}>Статус квалификации</span>
                <span style={styles.metricValue}>{snapshot?.qualification_state ?? '—'}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={styles.metricItem}>
                <span style={styles.metricLabel}>Обращения в поддержку</span>
                <span style={styles.metricValue}>{supportEpisodes.length}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={styles.metricItem}>
                <span style={styles.metricLabel}>Тарифный уровень</span>
                <span style={styles.metricValue}>{snapshot?.entitlement_tier ?? '—'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={styles.buttonRow}>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="pilot-request-support-btn"
                style={styles.secondaryButton}
                onClick={() => setShowSupportModal(true)}
              >
                Сообщить о проблеме / Задать вопрос
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="pilot-export-evidence-btn"
                style={styles.secondaryButton}
                onClick={() => setShowExportModal(true)}
                disabled={exportingEvidence}
              >
                {exportingEvidence ? 'Экспорт...' : 'Экспорт пакета свидетельств'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Support Episodes List */}
          <div id="pilot-support-history-card" style={styles.card}>
            <h3 style={styles.cardTitle}>История обращений в поддержку</h3>
            {supportEpisodes.length === 0 ? (
              <p style={styles.emptyText}>Обращений пока не зарегистрировано.</p>
            ) : (
              <table style={styles.table}>

                        {ep.reported_at_utc ? new Date(ep.reported_at_utc).toLocaleString('ru-RU') : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={styles.td}>{ep.reason}</td>
                      <td style={styles.td}>{ep.category}</td>
                      <td style={styles.td}>{ep.user_active_minutes} мин</td>
                      <td style={styles.td}>
                        <span style={ep.resolution_status === 'resolved' ? styles.statusResolved : styles.statusPending}>
                          {ep.resolution_status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Evidence Bundle Preview */}
          {evidenceBundle && (
            <div id="pilot-evidence-preview-card" style={styles.card}>
              <h3 style={styles.cardTitle}>Сформированный пакет свидетельств</h3>
              <p style={styles.cardDesc}>
                Пакет проверен локальным сканером приватности: персональные пути и системные ключи отсутствуют.
              </p>
              <div style={styles.bundleMeta}>
                <div><strong>Хэш пакета (SHA-256):</strong> {evidenceBundle.manifest.sha256.slice(0, 16)}...</div>
                <div><strong>Исходов:</strong> {evidenceBundle.accepted_outcomes?.length || 0}</div>
                <div><strong>Повторов:</strong> {evidenceBundle.natural_repeats?.length || 0}</div>
                <div><strong>Обращений:</strong> {evidenceBundle.support_episodes?.length || 0}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Support Request Modal */}
      {showSupportModal && (
        <div style={styles.modalOverlay} onClick={() => setShowSupportModal(false)}>
          <div style={styles.modalContent} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 style={styles.modalTitle}>Обращение в поддержку пилота</h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleSupportSubmit} style={styles.form}>
              <div style={styles.formGroup}>
                <label style={styles.label}>Опишите проблему или вопрос</label>
                <textarea
                  id="support-reason-input"
                  style={styles.textarea}
                  value={supportReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupportReason(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Что произошло или с чем возникли затруднения?"
                  rows={4}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div style={styles.formGroup}>
                <label style={styles.label}>Категория вопроса</label>
                <select
                  id="support-category-select"
                  style={styles.select}
                  value={supportCategory}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupportCategory(e.target.value as any)}
                >
                  <option value="guidance">Инструкция / Как использовать функцию</option>
                  <option value="data_format_issue">Проблема с форматом данных Polar</option>
                  <option value="defect">Ошибка / Дефект программы</option>
                  <option value="unsupported_input">Неподдерживаемый файл / датчик</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div style={styles.formGroup}>
                <label style={styles.label}>Примерно сколько минут вы потратили на попытку решения?</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  id="support-user-minutes-input"
                  style={styles.input}
                  value={userActiveMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserActiveMinutes(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0))}
                  min={0}
                  max={600}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={styles.modalActions}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  style={styles.cancelButton}
                  onClick={() => setShowSupportModal(false)}
                >
                  Отмена
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  id="support-submit-btn"
                  style={styles.primaryButton}
                  disabled={isSubmitting || !supportReason.trim()}
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? 'Отправка...' : 'Отправить'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Evidence Export Privacy Preview Modal */}
      {showExportModal && (
        <div id="pilot-export-preview-modal" style={styles.modalOverlay} onClick={() => setShowExportModal(false)}>
          <div style={styles.modalContent} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <h3 style={styles.modalTitle}>Предварительный просмотр экспорта свидетельств</h3>
            <p style={styles.cardDesc}>
              Экспортируемый пакет содержит исключительно обезличенные метаданные и метрики ценности для научной валидации:
            </p>
            <div style={styles.consentBox}>
              <div style={styles.consentText}>
                <p>✓ <strong>Приватность сигналов:</strong> Исходные временные ряды R-R, ЭКГ и акселерометрии НЕ экспортируются.</p>
                <p>✓ <strong>Анонимность:</strong> Персональные идентификаторы (ФИО, email, серийные номера устройств, пути файловой системы) исключены.</p>
                <p>✓ <strong>Секреты:</strong> Приватные ключи, токены авторизации и коды приглашений отфильтрованы и недоступны в экспорте.</p>
                <p>✓ <strong>Состав:</strong> Сводка принятых исходов ({snapshot?.participant_id || 'участник'}), время до первой ценности (TTV) и агрегированные события функций.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={styles.modalActions}>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="export-modal-cancel-btn"
                style={styles.cancelButton}
                onClick={() => setShowExportModal(false)}
              >
                Отмена
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="export-modal-confirm-btn"
                style={styles.primaryButton}
                onClick={handleExportEvidence}
                disabled={exportingEvidence}
              >
                {exportingEvidence ? 'Формирование пакета...' : 'Подтвердить и экспортировать'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { getRecoveryCenterProjectionApi, executeRecoveryActionApi } from '../api';
import { RecoveryCenterStateProjection, RecoveryCommand } from '../../shared/canonical/WholeProductWorkspaceContract';
import { RecoveryDescriptor } from '../../shared/selfServiceContract';

interface RecoveryCenterProps {
  activeProfileId?: string;
  onNavigate?: (route: string) => void;
}

export const RecoveryCenter: React.FC<RecoveryCenterProps> = ({ activeProfileId, onNavigate }) => {
  const [projection, setProjection] = useState<RecoveryCenterStateProjection | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [executing, setExecuting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionSuccessMessage, setActionSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRecoveryProjection();
  }, [activeProfileId]);

  const loadRecoveryProjection = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const res = await getRecoveryCenterProjectionApi(activeProfileId);
      if (res && res.projection) {
        setProjection(res.projection);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Ошибка загрузки проекции восстановления');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrimaryAction = async () => {
    if (!projection?.primary_action) return;
    const action = projection.primary_action;

    // If an executable command is attached and is not a pure navigation, execute it
    if (action.executable_command && action.executable_command.command_type !== 'navigate') {
      try {
        setExecuting(true);
        setError(null);
        setActionSuccessMessage(null);
        const res = await executeRecoveryActionApi(action.executable_command, activeProfileId);
        if (res.projection) {
          setProjection(res.projection);
        }
        setActionSuccessMessage(`Действие "${action.label_ru}" успешно выполнено.`);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err?.message || 'Ошибка выполнения восстановительного действия');
      } finally {
        setExecuting(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    const route = action.route;
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate(route.replace(/^#\/?/, ''));
    } else {
      window.location.hash = route;
    }
  };


  if (loading && !projection) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto text-slate-300">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-5 w-5 border-b-2 border-indigo-500"></div>
          <span>Загрузка состояния Центра восстановления...</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const primaryAction = projection?.primary_action;
  const descriptors = projection?.recovery_descriptors || [];
  const dbStatus = projection?.database_integrity;
  const storageStatus = projection?.storage_status;
  const supportBurden = projection?.support_burden;

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6 text-slate-100" data-testid="recovery-center-view">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-700/60 pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-emerald-400">🛡️</span> Центр восстановления и целостности
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Центр восстановления и целостности — безопасное восстановление без потери пользовательских данных.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              data-testid="recovery-data-preserved-badge"
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                projection?.data_preserved !== false
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30'
                  : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/30'
              }`}
            >
              {projection?.data_preserved !== false
                ? (storageStatus?.raw_logs_dir_exists === false ? 'Данные сохранены / источник недоступен' : 'Гарантия: Данные сохранены')
                : 'Внимание: Нарушение сохранности данных'}
            </span>
            <button
              onClick={loadRecoveryProjection}
              className="px-3 py-1 text-xs bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 rounded transition"
            >
              Обновить
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/40 rounded-lg text-red-200 text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {actionSuccessMessage && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-lg text-emerald-200 text-sm">
          {actionSuccessMessage}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Primary Action Hero Card */}
      {primaryAction && (
        <div className="p-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 to-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-indigo-400">
                Рекомендуемое действие
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100 mt-1">
                {primaryAction.label_ru}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 mt-0.5">
                {primaryAction.description_ru}
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handlePrimaryAction}
              disabled={executing}
              data-testid="recovery-primary-action-btn"
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow transition flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <span>{executing ? 'Выполняется...' : primaryAction.label_ru}</span>
              <span>→</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Integrity & Diagnostics Matrix */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* Database Integrity */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg space-y-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">База данных</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
                dbStatus?.status === 'ok' ? 'bg-emerald-400' : 'bg-amber-400'
              }`}
            />
            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">
              {dbStatus?.status === 'ok' ? 'Целостность подтверждена' : 'Требует внимания'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate">{dbStatus?.details}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Local Storage */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg space-y-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Хранилище сырых логов</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
                storageStatus?.raw_logs_dir_exists ? 'bg-emerald-400' : 'bg-amber-400'
              }`}
            />
            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">
              {storageStatus?.raw_logs_dir_exists ? 'Каталог доступен' : 'Каталог не найден'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Локальный файловый доступ без облака</p>
        </div>

        {/* Support Burden */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg space-y-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Поддержка</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
                supportBurden?.observation_status === 'observed' && (supportBurden?.operator_minutes || 0) > 0
                  ? 'bg-amber-400'
                  : 'bg-emerald-400'
              }`}
            />
            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">
              {supportBurden?.observation_status === 'observed' && (supportBurden?.operator_minutes || 0) > 0
                ? `${Math.round(supportBurden.operator_minutes || 0)} мин. оператора`
                : 'Автономный режим (0 мин)'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            {supportBurden?.observation_status === 'observed' && (supportBurden?.operator_minutes || 0) > 0
              ? `${Math.round(supportBurden.operator_minutes || 0)} минут участия оператора`
              : '0 минут участия оператора'}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recovery Descriptors / Active Recoverable Items */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-md font-semibold text-slate-200">
          Активные ситуации восстановления ({descriptors.length})
        </h3>

        {descriptors.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-5 bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-lg text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
            Все компоненты функционируют штатно. Ситуаций восстановления не обнаружено.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {descriptors.map((desc: RecoveryDescriptor) => (
              <div
                key={desc.recovery_id}
                className="p-4 bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg space-y-2"
                data-testid={`recovery-item-${desc.recovery_class}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200">{desc.user_summary_ru}</p>
                    {desc.user_summary_en && desc.user_summary_en !== desc.user_summary_ru && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{desc.user_summary_en}</p>
                    )}
                    <details className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2 cursor-pointer">
                      <summary className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-300 select-none">
                        Технические сведения ({desc.technical_code})
                      </summary>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1.5 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                        <span className="font-mono bg-slate-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-amber-300">
                          {desc.technical_code}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400">
                          ID: <span className="font-mono">{desc.recovery_id}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500">
                          Корреляция: <span className="font-mono">{desc.correlation_id}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </details>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded border ${
                    (desc as any).data_preserved !== false
                      ? 'bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-600/30'
                      : 'bg-red-950/40 text-red-400 border-red-600/30'
                  }`}>
                    {(desc as any).data_preserved !== false ? 'Данные сохранены' : 'Требует внимания'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Diagnostic Support Bundle Notice */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
        <div>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">Приватность диагностики: </span>
          <span>
            Сырые физиологические сигналы (ECG/ACC/RR), заметки и личные пути автоматически исключаются
            из диагностического пакета поддержки.
          </span>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            window.location.hash = '#settings';
          }}
          className="ml-4 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded border border-slate-700 transition shrink-0"
        >
          Настройки и бэкап →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
