import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, SessionSummary, UserProfile, SessionDetail, LlmPackExportResponse, AthleteCoreJourneyContext, AthleteJourneyCommand } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { AppSelect } from '../components/AppSelect';
import { SafetyNotice } from '../components/SafetyNotice';
import { LlmExportModal } from '../components/LlmExportModal';
import { PageSnapshotButton } from '../components/PageSnapshotButton';
import { formatVisibleEnum } from '../../shared/provenance';
import { getSessionProvenance } from '../../shared/methodologyRegistry';
import { evaluateExportEligibility, ExportFormatKey, normalizeQualityScore } from '../../shared/canonical/UserFacingTruthContract';

export interface ReportsProps {
  initialSessionId?: string;
  onBack?: () => void;
  activeUserId?: string;
  journeyContext?: AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null;
  onDispatchCommand?: (command: AthleteJourneyCommand) => Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null>;
}

function formatDate(iso: string, lang: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return d.toLocaleDateString(lang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
    day: '2-digit',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit'
  });
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
}

export function Reports({
  initialSessionId,
  onBack,
  activeUserId,
  journeyContext
}: ReportsProps) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<SessionSummary[]>([]);
  const [selectedSessionId, setSelectedSessionId] = useState<string>('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [includeRawLogs, setIncludeRawLogs] = useState(false);

  // New state
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [sessionDetail, setSessionDetail] = useState<SessionDetail | null>(null);
  const [showLlmExportModal, setShowLlmExportModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [includeNotesInLlm, setIncludeNotesInLlm] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [lastExportResult, setLastExportResult] = useState<LlmPackExportResponse | null>(null);
  const [promptCopied, setPromptCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [methodologyExportLoading, setMethodologyExportLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [methodologyResult, setMethodologyResult] = useState<{ filename: string; sha256: string; sizeBytes: number } | null>(null);
  const [nativeExportSuccess, setNativeExportSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleExportMethodology = async () => {
    try {
      setMethodologyExportLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI) {
        const res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveMethodologyAuditPack({});
        if (res && res.status === 'saved') {
          setMethodologyResult({
            filename: res.filePath,
            sha256: res.sha256,
            sizeBytes: res.sizeBytes
          });
        } else if (res && res.status === 'failed') {
          setError(res.safeMessage || 'Failed to save methodology pack');
        }
      } else {
        const res = await api.exportMethodologyPack();
        setMethodologyResult(res);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message || 'Failed to export methodology pack');
    } finally {
      setMethodologyExportLoading(false);
    }
  };


  useEffect(() => {
    api.getUserProfiles()
      .then((data) => setProfiles(data))
      .catch((e) => console.error('Failed to get user profiles:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.getSessions(activeUserId)
      .then((data) => {
        setSessions(data);
        if (data.length > 0 && initialSessionId) {
          const hasInitial = data.some(s => s.id === initialSessionId);
          setSelectedSessionId(hasInitial ? initialSessionId : '');
        } else {
          setSelectedSessionId('');
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [initialSessionId, activeUserId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedSessionId) {
      setSessionDetail(null);
      return;
    }
    api.getSessionDetail(selectedSessionId)
      .then((detail) => setSessionDetail(detail))
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message));
  }, [selectedSessionId]);

  const selectedSession = sessions.find(s => s.id === selectedSessionId);
  const hasUnknownActivity = Boolean(selectedSession && (!selectedSession.activity_type || selectedSession.activity_type === 'unknown'));

  const isExportEligible = (formatKey: ExportFormatKey): boolean => {
    if (!selectedSession) return false;
    return evaluateExportEligibility(formatKey, selectedSession, true).isEligible;
  };

  const handleUserChange = async (userId: string) => {
    if (!selectedSessionId || !selectedSession) return;
    const originalUserId = selectedSession.user_id;
    const targetUserId = userId === 'unassigned' ? null : userId;

    setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === selectedSessionId ? { ...s, user_id: targetUserId } : s));

    try {
      await api.saveSessionContext(selectedSessionId, {
        user_id: targetUserId,
        activity_type: selectedSession.activity_type || 'unknown'
      });
      // reload details
      const detail = await api.getSessionDetail(selectedSessionId);
      setSessionDetail(detail);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === selectedSessionId ? { ...s, user_id: originalUserId } : s));
      setError(e.message || 'Ошибка сохранения спортсмена');
    }
  };

  const handleActivityChange = async (activityType: string) => {
    if (!selectedSessionId || !selectedSession) return;
    const originalActivity = selectedSession.activity_type;

    setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === selectedSessionId ? { ...s, activity_type: activityType } : s));

    try {
      await api.saveSessionContext(selectedSessionId, {
        user_id: selectedSession.user_id || null,
        activity_type: activityType
      });
      const detail = await api.getSessionDetail(selectedSessionId);
      setSessionDetail(detail);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setSessions(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === selectedSessionId ? { ...s, activity_type: originalActivity } : s));
      setError(e.message || 'Ошибка сохранения типа активности');
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = async (format: 'pdf' | 'html' | 'metrics.csv' | 'rr.csv' | 'bundle') => {
    if (!selectedSessionId || !selectedSession) return;
    const formatKey: ExportFormatKey = 
      format === 'pdf' ? 'pdf_report' :
      format === 'html' ? 'html_report' :
      format === 'metrics.csv' ? 'csv_metrics' :
      format === 'rr.csv' ? 'rr_csv' : 'discussion_bundle';
    const eligibility = evaluateExportEligibility(formatKey, selectedSession, true);
    if (!eligibility.isEligible) {
      setError(eligibility.blockingReasonRu || 'Экспорт недоступен');
      return;
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI) {
      try {
        let res;
        if (format === 'pdf' || format === 'html') {
          res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveReport({
            sessionId: selectedSessionId,
            format,
            notes: notes.trim()
          });
        } else if (format === 'metrics.csv') {
          res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveMetricsCsv({
            sessionId: selectedSessionId
          });
        } else if (format === 'rr.csv') {
          res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveRrCsv({
            sessionId: selectedSessionId
          });
        } else if (format === 'bundle') {
          res = await (window as any).electronAPI.saveConsultationBundle({
            sessionId: selectedSessionId,
            includeRaw: includeRawLogs
          });
        }
        if (res && res.error) {
          setError(res.error);
        } else if (res && (res.success || res.path || res.filePath || res.status === 'saved')) {
          const outName = res.path || res.filePath || format;
          setNativeExportSuccess(isRu ? `Файл успешно сохранен: ${outName}` : `File saved successfully: ${outName}`);
          setError(null);
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        setError(e.message || 'Ошибка сохранения файла');
      }
      return;
    }

    // Web execution: Create authoritative plan and durable job
    const canonicalFormatMap: Record<string, string> = {
      'pdf': 'pdf',
      'html': 'html',
      'metrics.csv': 'metrics_csv',
      'rr.csv': 'rr_csv',
      'bundle': 'consultation_bundle'
    };

    setError(null);
    setNativeExportSuccess(null);

    try {
      const planRes = await api.createExportPlan({
        sessionId: selectedSessionId,
        profileId: selectedSession.user_id || activeUserId || undefined,
        selectedFormats: [canonicalFormatMap[format]],
        sensitiveOptIns: {
          includeRawSignals: format === 'bundle' ? includeRawLogs : false,
          includeUserNotes: Boolean(notes.trim())
        },
        boundedNotes: notes.trim() || undefined,
        displayLocale: language,
        displayTimezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone
      });

      if (planRes && planRes.plan) {
        const jobRes = await api.startExportJob(planRes.plan.plan_id);
        if (jobRes && jobRes.job) {
          let currentJob = jobRes.job;
          const startTime = Date.now();
          while (currentJob.status === 'queued' || currentJob.status === 'running') {
            if (Date.now() - startTime > 20000) break;
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
            const polled = await api.getExportJob(currentJob.job_id);
            if (polled && polled.job) {
              currentJob = polled.job;
            }
          }

          if (currentJob.status === 'completed' || currentJob.status === 'partial') {
            const artifacts = currentJob.artifacts || [];
            const target = artifacts.find((a: any) => a.format === canonicalFormatMap[format]) || artifacts[0];
            if (target) {
              setNativeExportSuccess(
                isRu 
                  ? `Экспорт готов: ${target.filename} (${formatBytes(target.size_bytes)})`
                  : `Export ready: ${target.filename} (${formatBytes(target.size_bytes)})`
              );
              const downloadUrl = api.downloadExportArtifactUrl(target.manifest_id);
              const link = document.createElement('a');
              link.href = downloadUrl;
              link.download = target.filename;
              link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
              document.body.appendChild(link);
              link.click();
              document.body.removeChild(link);
              return;
            }
          } else if (currentJob.status === 'failed') {
            setError(currentJob.error_message || (isRu ? 'Ошибка при формировании экспорта' : 'Export job failed'));
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (jobErr) {
      console.warn('Durable job pipeline fallback to direct stream:', jobErr);
    }

    // Direct stream fallback
    let url = `/api/reports/${selectedSessionId}/${format}`;
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (format !== 'metrics.csv' && format !== 'rr.csv' && notes.trim()) {
      params.append('notes', notes.trim());
    }
    if (format === 'bundle' && includeRawLogs) {
      params.append('include_raw', 'true');
    }
    const q = params.toString();
    if (q) {
      url += `?${q}`;
    }

    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: '80px' }}>
        <span className="spinner" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fade-in">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '24px' }}>
        <div>
          <h1>{t('reportsTitle')}</h1>
          <p>{t('reportsSubtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <PageSnapshotButton pageName="Reports" metadata={{ selectedSessionId }} />
          {onBack && (
            <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onBack}>
              {t('backToList')}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,70,50,0.3)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {nativeExportSuccess && (
        <div id="export-success-banner" className="card" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--accent-success)', marginBottom: '16px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.08)' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--accent-success)', margin: 0, fontWeight: 600 }}>✓ {nativeExportSuccess}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {sessions.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card">
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{t('noDataSync')}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
          {/* Inline warning for unknown activity type */}
          {hasUnknownActivity && (
            <div className="info-banner" style={{
              padding: '10px 14px',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08)',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25)',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              fontSize: '0.85rem'
            }}>
              ℹ️ <strong>Контекст активности:</strong> Тип активности для этой сессии не указан ("unknown"). Базовые отчеты и экспорт доступны; для физиологических расчетов (аэробное разобщение) рекомендуется выбрать тип активности.
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '24px', alignItems: 'start' }}>
            {/* Left panel: selection + preview + notes */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
              
              {/* Selection */}
              <div className="card">
                <div className="section-title">{t('selectSession')}</div>
                <AppSelect

function PreviewItem({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingBottom: '6px' }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: '600', color: 'var(--text-primary)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ExportFormatItem({
  id,
  title,
  desc,
  btnLabel,
  onDownload,
  disabled,
  children
}: {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  desc: string;
  btnLabel: string;
  onDownload: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '16px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingBottom: '16px', alignItems: 'center', opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: '700', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{title}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '4px' }}>{desc}</div>
        {children}
      </div>
      <button
        id={id}
        className="btn btn-secondary"
        style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '8px 14px', cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer' }}
        onClick={onDownload}
        disabled={disabled}
      >
        {btnLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function getMaturityBadge(featureId: string, lang: string, isSessionEligible: boolean = true) {
  const entry = FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY[featureId];
  if (!entry) return null;

  const level = entry.maturity_level;
  let bg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)';
  let color = 'var(--text-secondary)';
  let label: string = level;

  if (level === 'Validated') {
    if (isSessionEligible) {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
      color = '#10b981';
      label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Валидировано' : 'Validated';
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)';
      color = 'var(--text-muted)';
      label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Справка: Метод валидирован' : 'Ref: Method Validated';
    }
  } else if (level === 'Bounded') {
    bg = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)';
    color = 'var(--accent-primary)';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Ограничено' : 'Bounded';
  } else if (level === 'Experimental') {
    bg = 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15)';
    color = '#a855f7';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Эксперимент' : 'Experimental';
  } else if (level === 'ValidationDebt') {
    bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
    color = '#f59e0b';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Требует валидации' : 'Validation Debt';
  } else if (level === 'ImplementationDebt') {
    bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
    color = '#ef4444';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Требует реализации' : 'Implementation Debt';
  } else if (level === 'Unavailable') {
    bg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)';
    color = '#94a3b8';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Недоступно' : 'Unavailable';
  }

  return (
    <span 
      className="badge" 
      title={entry.user_facing_disclosure}
      style={{ marginLeft: '6px', fontSize: '0.7rem', backgroundColor: bg, color, fontWeight: 600 }}
    >
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

function getEligibilityBadge(state?: string, lang: string = 'ru') {
  if (!state) return null;
  let bg = '#6b7280';
  let color = '#ffffff';
  let label = state;

  if (state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
    bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
    color = '#10b981';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Валидировано' : 'Eligible';
  } else if (state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
    color = '#f59e0b';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'С предупреждениями' : 'With Warnings';
  } else if (state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
    color = '#ef4444';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Не применимо' : 'Not Eligible';
  } else if (state === 'INCONCLUSIVE') {
    bg = 'rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.15)';
    color = '#9ca3af';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Неопределено' : 'Inconclusive';
  } else if (state === 'IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_VALIDATED') {
    bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
    color = '#f59e0b';
    label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Не валидировано' : 'Not Validated';
  }

  return (
    <span 
      className="badge" 
      style={{ marginLeft: '6px', fontSize: '0.65rem', backgroundColor: bg, color, fontWeight: 600, border: `1px solid ${color}40` }}
    >
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

function getSessionApplicabilityBadge(state?: string, fallbackFeatureId?: string, lang: string = 'ru') {
  if (state) {
    let bg = 'rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.15)';
    let color = '#9ca3af';
    let label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Недостаточно данных' : 'Inconclusive';
    let title = '';

    if (state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
      color = '#10b981';
      label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Доступно' : 'Eligible';
      title = lang === 'ru' ? 'Критерии применимости выполнены' : 'Eligibility criteria met';
    } else if (state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
      bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
      color = '#f59e0b';
      label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Ограничено' : 'Limited';
      title = lang === 'ru' ? 'Применимо с предупреждениями' : 'Eligible with warnings';
    } else if (state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      color = '#ef4444';
      label = lang === 'ru' ? 'Не применимо' : 'Not eligible';
      title = lang === 'ru' ? 'Сессия не соответствует критериям метода' : 'Session does not meet method prerequisites';
    }
    return (
      <span 
        className="badge" 
        title={title}
        style={{ marginLeft: '6px', fontSize: '0.65rem', backgroundColor: bg, color, fontWeight: 600, border: `1px solid ${color}40` }}
      >
        {label}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (fallbackFeatureId) {
    return getMaturityBadge(fallbackFeatureId, lang);
  }
  return null;
}

interface Props {

function formatDuration(seconds: number, lang: string): string {
  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
  if (lang === 'ru') {
    if (h > 0) return `${h}ч ${m}м`;
    return `${m}м`;
  } else {
    if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
    return `${m}m`;
  }
}

function formatDate(iso: string, lang: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(lang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
    day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric',
    hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

  const [trends, setTrends] = useState<TrendsResponse | null>(null);

  const [recalStatus, setRecalStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'running' | 'success' | 'failed' | 'needs_source'>('idle');

  // Named Analysis Windows (REC-007)
  const [namedWindows, setNamedWindows] = useState<SessionNamedWindow[]>([]);
  const [windowFormOpen, setWindowFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newWindowName, setNewWindowName] = useState('');
  const [newWindowStart, setNewWindowStart] = useState(0);
  const [newWindowEnd, setNewWindowEnd] = useState(300);
  const [windowLoading, setWindowLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleNextAction = async (action: SelfServiceNextAction) => {
    switch (action.action_code) {
      case 'OPEN_QUALITY_REVIEW':
        setShowRRInspector(true);
        break;
      case 'CREATE_OR_SELECT_WINDOW':
        setWindowFormOpen(true);
        break;
      case 'SELECT_COMPARISON_PARTNER':
      case 'AWAIT_INDEPENDENT_HISTORY':
        if (onNavigateToCompare) {
          onNavigateToCompare(sessionId);
        }
        break;
      case 'OPEN_PRIVACY_PREVIEW':
      case 'EXPORT_AI_PACK':
        setShowLlmExportModal(true);
        break;
      case 'CONFIRM_OUTCOME':
        if (episode) {
          try {
            await api.confirmEpisodeOutcome(episode.episode_id, {
              confirmed_by: 'participant',
              recipient_action: 'stored_in_records',
              user_notes: annotation.user_notes || undefined
            });
            const updatedEp = await api.getEpisode(episode.episode_id);
            if (updatedEp.success) setEpisode(updatedEp.episode);
            const rSnap = await api.getEpisodeReadiness(episode.episode_id);
            if (rSnap.success) setReadiness(rSnap.snapshot);
          } catch (e: any) {
            setErrorDialogText(e.message || 'Ошибка подтверждения полезности');
          }
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  };

  const handleRecovery = (recovery: RecoveryDescriptor) => {
    setErrorDialogText(
      `${language === 'ru' ? 'Восстановление:' : 'Recovery:'} ${language === 'ru' ? recovery.user_summary_ru : recovery.user_summary_en}${recovery.retry_command ? `\nКоманда: ${recovery.retry_command}` : ''}`
    );
  };

  const loadSession = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setData(null);
    setRrData(null);
    setTrends(null);
    setEpisode(null);
    setReadiness(null);
    setAnnotation({
      activity_type: 'unknown',
      activity_label_custom: '',
      user_notes: '',
      perceived_effort: '',
      sleep_quality_subjective: '',
    });

    api.getSessionDetail(sessionId)
      .then(async (detail) => {
        setData(detail);
        const rrFile = detail.signalFiles.find((f) => f.signal_type === 'RR');
        if (rrFile) {
          try {
            const rr = await api.getRrData(rrFile.id);
            setRrData(rr);
          } catch {
            // RR optional
          }
        }

        // G6 Connected Work Episode resolution
        const profileId = detail.session?.user_id || activeWorkContext?.profile_id || 'default';
        try {
          let resolvedEpisode: SelfServiceWorkEpisode | null = null;
          if (activeWorkContext?.active_episode_id) {
            try {
              const epRes = await api.getEpisode(activeWorkContext.active_episode_id);
              if (epRes.success && epRes.episode.canonical_session_id === sessionId) {
                resolvedEpisode = epRes.episode;
              }
            } catch {}
          }
          if (!resolvedEpisode) {
            const attachRes = await api.attachLegacySessionToEpisode({
              session_id: sessionId,
              profile_id: profileId,
              task_intent: 'canonical_inspection'
            });
            if (attachRes.success) {
              resolvedEpisode = attachRes.episode;
            }
          }
          if (resolvedEpisode) {
            setEpisode(resolvedEpisode);
            try {
              const rSnap = await api.getEpisodeReadiness(resolvedEpisode.episode_id);
              if (rSnap.success) {
                setReadiness(rSnap.snapshot);
              }
            } catch {}
          }
        } catch {}
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));

    api.getNamedWindows(sessionId)
      .then((res) => setNamedWindows(res.windows || []))
      .catch(() => {});

    api.getSessionAnnotation(sessionId)
      .then((ann) => {
        if (ann) {
          setAnnotation({
            activity_type: ann.activity_type || 'unknown',
            activity_label_custom: ann.activity_label_custom || '',
            user_notes: ann.user_notes || '',
            perceived_effort: ann.perceived_effort ? String(ann.perceived_effort) : '',
            sleep_quality_subjective: ann.sleep_quality_subjective ? String(ann.sleep_quality_subjective) : '',
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  };

  const handleCreateWindow = async () => {
    if (!newWindowName.trim()) return;
    setWindowLoading(true);
    try {
      await api.createNamedWindow(sessionId, {
        name: newWindowName.trim(),
        startOffsetSeconds: Number(newWindowStart),
        endOffsetSeconds: Number(newWindowEnd),
        userId: data?.session?.user_id || undefined
      });
      const res = await api.getNamedWindows(sessionId);
      setNamedWindows(res.windows || []);
      setWindowFormOpen(false);
      setNewWindowName('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorDialogText(err.message || 'Ошибка создания аналитического окна');
    } finally {
      setWindowLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteWindow = async (winId: string) => {
    try {
      await api.deleteNamedWindow(sessionId, winId);
      setNamedWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== winId));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorDialogText(err.message || 'Ошибка удаления аналитического окна');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSession();
  }, [sessionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data?.session?.user_id) {
      const actType = annotation.activity_type && annotation.activity_type !== 'unknown' ? annotation.activity_type : undefined;
      api.getTrends({ user_id: data.session.user_id, activity_type: actType })
        .then(setTrends)
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [data?.session?.user_id, annotation.activity_type]);

  const handleRecalculate = async () => {
    setRecalStatus('running');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}/recalculate`, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'completed') {
        setRecalStatus('success');
        loadSession();
      } else if (data.status === 'needs_source_files') {
        setRecalStatus('needs_source');
        setErrorDialogText(t('needsSourceFiles'));
      } else {
        setRecalStatus('failed');
        setErrorDialogText(t('recalculateFailed'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setRecalStatus('failed');
      setErrorDialogText(t('recalculateFailed'));
    }
  };

  const handleCopyUuid = () => {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(sessionId);
      setUuidCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setUuidCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: '80px' }}>
        <span className="spinner" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return (
      <div>
        <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onBack} style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          {t('backToList')}
        </button>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error || t('sessionNotFound')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, flags, signalFiles } = data;
  const sessionStartMs = new Date(session.start_time).getTime();

  const presentationSummary = getCanonicalPresentationSummary({
    session,
    canonicalSession: data.canonical_session,
    qcMetrics,
    analyticsMetrics
  });

  // Parse zones: Prioritize CanonicalSessionResult.heart_rate_zones
  let zones: Record<string, number> = {};
  let hrZoneConfig: any = null;
  let hrZoneDistribution: any = null;
  let isCanonicalEligible = false;
  let isLegacySession = false;
  let hrIneligibleReason: string | undefined = undefined;

  if (data.canonical_session?.heart_rate_zones) {
    const cZones = data.canonical_session.heart_rate_zones;
    hrZoneConfig = cZones.configuration;
    hrZoneDistribution = cZones.distribution;
    if (cZones.distribution && cZones.distribution.eligibility === 'eligible' && cZones.distribution.z1_seconds !== null) {
      isCanonicalEligible = true;
      zones = {
        '1': cZones.distribution.z1_seconds!,
        '2': cZones.distribution.z2_seconds ?? 0,
        '3': cZones.distribution.z3_seconds ?? 0,
        '4': cZones.distribution.z4_seconds ?? 0,
        '5': cZones.distribution.z5_seconds ?? 0
      };
    } else {
      isCanonicalEligible = false;
      hrIneligibleReason = cZones.distribution?.limitations?.[0] || 'Ineligible for canonical 1-Hz HR zone distribution';
    }
  } else if (analyticsMetrics?.time_in_zones) {
    isLegacySession = true;
    try {
      zones = JSON.parse(analyticsMetrics.time_in_zones);
    } catch {}
  }

  const totalZoneTime = (Object.values(zones).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) + (hrZoneDistribution?.unclassified_seconds || 0)) || 1;

  // Parse channel matching metrics
  let matchMetrics: any = null;
  try {
    if (qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json) {
      matchMetrics = JSON.parse(qcMetrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json);
    }
  } catch {}

  async function handleSaveAnnotation(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setAnnotationSaving(true);
    setAnnotationSavedMsg(false);
    try {
      await api.saveSessionAnnotation(sessionId, {
        activity_type: annotation.activity_type,
        activity_label_custom: annotation.activity_label_custom || null,
        user_notes: annotation.user_notes || null,
        perceived_effort: annotation.perceived_effort ? parseInt(annotation.perceived_effort, 10) : null,
        sleep_quality_subjective: annotation.sleep_quality_subjective ? parseInt(annotation.sleep_quality_subjective, 10) : null,
      });
      setAnnotationSavedMsg(true);
      setTimeout(() => setAnnotationSavedMsg(false), 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorDialogText(err.message || 'Error saving annotation');
    } finally {
      setAnnotationSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function handleOpenExportPack() {
    setShowLlmExportModal(true);
  }

  // Localize QC severity and monotonicity values
  function qcValueTranslation(val: string | number | null | undefined, key: string): string {
    if (val == null) return '—';
    const sVal = String(val);
    if (key === 'monotonicity') {
      if (sVal === 'valid' || sVal === 'OK') return language === 'ru' ? 'В норме' : 'Valid';
      if (sVal === 'invalid' || sVal === 'ERROR') return language === 'ru' ? 'Нарушена' : 'Invalid';
      return sVal;
    }
    if (key === 'motion') {
      if (sVal === 'low') return t('motionLow');
      if (sVal === 'medium') return t('motionMedium');
      if (sVal === 'high') return t('motionHigh');
    }
    return sVal;
  }

  const hasBaseline = trends?.personal_baseline_available ?? false;
  const isCanonical = !!data.canonical_session;
  const canonicalSession = data.canonical_session;

  const rmssdVal = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.value : (!isCanonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null) : null);
  const sdnnVal = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.value : (!isCanonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null) : null);
  const pnn50Val = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.value : (!isCanonical ? (analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null) : null);
  const avgHrVal = canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value ?? null) : session.avg_hr;
  const meanRrVal = canonicalSession ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.value : null;

  const rmssdElig = canonicalSession
    ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_state
    : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));

  const sdnnElig = canonicalSession
    ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_state
    : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));

  const pnn50Elig = canonicalSession
    ? canonicalSession.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_state
    : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality && analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality !== 'insufficient_data' ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'));

  // avg_hr
  const avgHrBaseline = getBaselinePresentation(trends, 'avg_hr', avgHrVal);
  let avgHrStatus: MetricStatus = isCanonical && avgHrBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' ? avgHrBaseline.personal_comparison_status as MetricStatus : 'within_baseline';
  let avgHrInterpretation = '';
  if (isCanonical && avgHrBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' && trends?.baseline?.avg_hr_bpm && trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p25 != null && trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm.p75 != null) {
    const band = trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm;
    avgHrInterpretation = language === 'ru'
      ? `Личный диапазон: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} уд/мин`
      : `Baseline: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} bpm`;
  } else {
    const band = trends?.baseline?.avg_hr_bpm;
    avgHrInterpretation = band && band.p25 != null && band.p75 != null
      ? (language === 'ru' ? `Справочный коридор: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} уд/мин` : `Reference: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} bpm`)
      : (language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (нет baseline)' : 'Reference (no baseline)');
  }

  // rmssd
  const rmssdBaseline = getBaselinePresentation(trends, 'rmssd', rmssdVal);
  let rmssdStatus: MetricStatus = !isCanonical || rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' || rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || rmssdElig === 'INCONCLUSIVE'
    ? 'quality_limited'
    : (rmssdBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' ? rmssdBaseline.personal_comparison_status as MetricStatus : 'within_baseline');
  let rmssdInterpretation = '';
  if (!isCanonical) {
    rmssdInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (историческая запись, не верифицирована)' : 'Reference (legacy unverified recording)';
  } else if (rmssdElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    rmssdInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (недостаточно данных / длительности)' : 'Reference (insufficient data / duration)';
  } else if (rmssdElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    rmssdInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (ограничено качеством)' : 'Reference (quality limited)';
  } else if (rmssdBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' && trends?.baseline?.rmssd_ms && trends.baseline.rmssd_ms.p25 != null && trends.baseline.rmssd_ms.p75 != null) {
    const band = trends.baseline.rmssd_ms;
    rmssdInterpretation = language === 'ru'
      ? `Личный диапазон: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} мс`
      : `Baseline: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} ms`;
  } else {
    const band = trends?.baseline?.rmssd_ms;
    rmssdInterpretation = band && band.p25 != null && band.p75 != null
      ? (language === 'ru' ? `Справочный коридор: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} мс` : `Reference: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} ms`)
      : (language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (нет baseline)' : 'Reference (no baseline)');
  }

  // sdnn
  const sdnnBaseline = getBaselinePresentation(trends, 'sdnn', sdnnVal);
  let sdnnStatus: MetricStatus = !isCanonical || sdnnElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' || sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || sdnnElig === 'INCONCLUSIVE'
    ? 'quality_limited'
    : (sdnnBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' ? sdnnBaseline.personal_comparison_status as MetricStatus : 'within_baseline');
  let sdnnInterpretation = '';
  if (!isCanonical) {
    sdnnInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (историческая запись, не верифицирована)' : 'Reference (legacy unverified recording)';
  } else if (sdnnElig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    sdnnInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (недостаточно данных / длительности)' : 'Reference (insufficient data / duration)';
  } else if (sdnnElig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    sdnnInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (ограничено качеством)' : 'Reference (quality limited)';
  } else if (sdnnBaseline.eligibility === 'eligible' && trends?.baseline?.sdnn_ms && trends.baseline.sdnn_ms.p25 != null && trends.baseline.sdnn_ms.p75 != null) {
    const band = trends.baseline.sdnn_ms;
    sdnnInterpretation = language === 'ru'
      ? `Личный диапазон: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} мс`
      : `Baseline: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} ms`;
  } else {
    const band = trends?.baseline?.sdnn_ms;
    sdnnInterpretation = band && band.p25 != null && band.p75 != null
      ? (language === 'ru' ? `Справочный коридор: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} мс` : `Reference: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} ms`)
      : (language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (нет baseline)' : 'Reference (no baseline)');
  }

  // pnn50
  const pnn50Baseline = getBaselinePresentation(trends, 'pnn50', pnn50Val);
  let pnn50Status: MetricStatus = !isCanonical || pnn50Elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' || pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || pnn50Elig === 'INCONCLUSIVE'
    ? 'quality_limited'
    : (pnn50Baseline.eligibility === 'eligible' ? pnn50Baseline.personal_comparison_status as MetricStatus : 'within_baseline');
  let pnn50Interpretation = '';
  if (!isCanonical) {
    pnn50Interpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (историческая запись, не верифицирована)' : 'Reference (legacy unverified recording)';
  } else if (pnn50Elig === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    pnn50Interpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (недостаточно данных / длительности)' : 'Reference (insufficient data / duration)';
  } else if (pnn50Elig === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    pnn50Interpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (ограничено качеством)' : 'Reference (quality limited)';
  } else if (pnn50Baseline.eligibility === 'eligible' && trends?.baseline?.pnn50_percent && trends.baseline.pnn50_percent.p25 != null && trends.baseline.pnn50_percent.p75 != null) {
    const band = trends.baseline.pnn50_percent;
    pnn50Interpretation = language === 'ru'
      ? `Личный диапазон: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} %`
      : `Baseline: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} %`;
  } else {
    const band = trends?.baseline?.pnn50_percent;
    pnn50Interpretation = band && band.p25 != null && band.p75 != null
      ? (language === 'ru' ? `Справочный коридор: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} %` : `Reference: ${Math.round(band.p25!)} - ${Math.round(band.p75!)} %`)
      : (language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (нет baseline)' : 'Reference (no baseline)');
  }

  // aerobic decoupling
  const driftAnalysis = getDriftAnalysis(session, analyticsMetrics, session.activity_type || annotation.activity_type);
  let driftInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (нет данных)' : 'Reference (no data)';
  if (isCanonical) {
    driftInterpretation = language === 'ru'
      ? 'Недоступно: требуются согласованный датчик мощности и длительность >= 20 мин'
      : 'Unavailable: requires external power meter and duration >= 20 min';
  } else if (driftAnalysis.status === 'not_applicable') {
    driftInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (только для кардио)' : 'Reference (cardio only)';
  } else if (driftAnalysis.status === 'insufficient_coverage') {
    driftInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Справочно (длительность < 10 мин)' : 'Reference (duration < 10m)';
  } else if (driftAnalysis.status === 'valid_experimental') {
    driftInterpretation = language === 'ru' ? 'Экспериментальный расчет (LEGACY)' : 'Experimental calculation (LEGACY)';
  }

  return (
    <div className="fade-in" id="session-detail-container" data-session-id={sessionId}>
      {episode && (
        <EpisodeHeader
          episode={episode}
          readiness={readiness}
          onNextActionClick={handleNextAction}
          onRecoveryClick={handleRecovery}
          language={language as any}
        />
      )}

      {!isCanonical && (
        <div style={{
          background: 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.08)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.3)',
          color: '#facc15',
          padding: '12px 16px',
          marginBottom: '20px',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          fontSize: '0.88rem'
        }}>
          ⚠️ <strong>{language === 'ru' ? 'Режим исторической записи (LEGACY UNVERIFIED):' : 'Legacy Unverified Mode:'}</strong>{' '}
          {language === 'ru'
            ? 'Сессия не была пересчитана по каноническому протоколу v1.1. Показатели представлены справочно и не участвуют в личных базовых интервалах.'
            : 'Session was not computed under Frozen Protocol v1.1. Metrics are provided for reference only.'}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Header & Unified Action Bar */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '16px', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '14px' }}>
          <button className="btn btn-ghost" id="btn-back" onClick={onBack}>{t('backToList')}</button>
          <div>
            <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', margin: 0 }}>{formatDate(session.start_time, language)}</h1>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', display: 'flex', gap: '12px', marginTop: '2px' }}>
              <span>⏱ {formatDuration(session.duration_seconds, language)}</span>
              <span>📱 {session.device_id === 'SYNTHETIC_H10_BETA' ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Демонстрационная сессия' : 'Demo Session') : session.device_id}</span>
              {canonicalSession && (
                <span 
                  onClick={handleCopyUuid} 
                  style={{ cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--accent-primary)', textDecoration: 'underline' }}
                  title="Нажмите, чтобы скопировать Session UUID"
                >
                  🆔 {sessionId.slice(0, 8)}... {uuidCopied ? '✓ скопирован' : ''}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {/* Export Dropdown Menu */}
          <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary"
              onClick={() => setShowExportMenu(!showExportMenu)}
              style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}
            >
              <span>📥</span>
              <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Экспорт' : 'Export'}</span>
              <span>▾</span>
            </button>

            {showExportMenu && (
              <div 
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '100%',
                  right: 0,

                                ? 'Сессия подходит для отслеживания базовой вариабельности (RMSSD, ЧСС). Для спектрального анализа требуется непрерывный RR-поток без разрывов таймбейса и артефактов (в текущей записи непрерывный сегмент RR недостаточен или нарушена монотонность).'

                                ? 'Session suitable for core HRV (RMSSD, HR). Spectral analysis requires a continuous RR stream without timebase gaps or excessive artifacts (the continuous RR segment in this recording is insufficient or non-monotonic).'

            const rmssdEval = jMetrics?.rmssd ? {
              primaryDisplayValue: jMetrics.rmssd.value !== null ? `${Math.round(jMetrics.rmssd.value)}` : '—',
              unit: jMetrics.rmssd.unit,
              isEligible: jMetrics.rmssd.is_eligible,
              isDeemphasized: !jMetrics.rmssd.is_eligible,
              referenceValue: null,
              blockingReasons: jMetrics.rmssd.withholding_reason ? [jMetrics.rmssd.withholding_reason] : []

              unit: jMetrics.sdnn.unit,

              isDeemphasized: !jMetrics.sdnn.is_eligible,

              unit: jMetrics.pnn50.unit,
              isEligible: jMetrics.pnn50.is_eligible,
              isDeemphasized: !jMetrics.pnn50.is_eligible,
              referenceValue: null,
              blockingReasons: jMetrics.pnn50.withholding_reason ? [jMetrics.pnn50.withholding_reason] : []
            } : evaluateUserFacingMetric('pnn50', pnn50Val, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.pnn50, language);

            const meanRrEval = jMetrics?.mean_rr ? {
              primaryDisplayValue: jMetrics.mean_rr.value !== null ? `${Math.round(jMetrics.mean_rr.value)}` : '—',
              unit: jMetrics.mean_rr.unit,
              isEligible: jMetrics.mean_rr.is_eligible,
              isDeemphasized: !jMetrics.mean_rr.is_eligible,
              referenceValue: null,
              blockingReasons: jMetrics.mean_rr.withholding_reason ? [jMetrics.mean_rr.withholding_reason] : []
            } : evaluateUserFacingMetric('mean_rr', meanRrVal, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.mean_hr_rr, language);

            return (
              <div className="kpi-grid" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                <MetricCard
                  metricKey="avg_hr"
                  value={avgHrEval.primaryDisplayValue}
                  color="hsl(6,90%,65%)"
                  status={avgHrStatus}
                  hasBaseline={hasBaseline}
                  interpretation={avgHrInterpretation}
                  isDeemphasized={avgHrEval.isDeemphasized}
                  referenceValue={avgHrEval.referenceValue}
                  blockingReasons={avgHrEval.blockingReasons}
                />
                <MetricCard
                  metricKey="rmssd"
                  value={rmssdEval.primaryDisplayValue}
                  color="hsl(152,75%,55%)"
                  status={rmssdEval.isEligible ? rmssdStatus : 'not_applicable'}
                  hasBaseline={hasBaseline && rmssdEval.isEligible}
                  interpretation={rmssdInterpretation}
                  isDeemphasized={rmssdEval.isDeemphasized}
                  referenceValue={rmssdEval.referenceValue}
                  blockingReasons={rmssdEval.blockingReasons}
                />
                <MetricCard
                  metricKey="sdnn"
                  value={sdnnEval.primaryDisplayValue}
                  color="hsl(220,85%,65%)"
                  status={sdnnEval.isEligible ? sdnnStatus : 'not_applicable'}
                  hasBaseline={hasBaseline && sdnnEval.isEligible}
                  interpretation={sdnnInterpretation}
                  isDeemphasized={sdnnEval.isDeemphasized}
                  referenceValue={sdnnEval.referenceValue}
                  blockingReasons={sdnnEval.blockingReasons}
                />
                <MetricCard
                  metricKey="pnn50"
                  value={pnn50Eval.primaryDisplayValue}
                  color="hsl(270,75%,65%)"
                  status={pnn50Eval.isEligible ? pnn50Status : 'not_applicable'}
                  hasBaseline={hasBaseline && pnn50Eval.isEligible}
                  interpretation={pnn50Interpretation}
                  isDeemphasized={pnn50Eval.isDeemphasized}
                  referenceValue={pnn50Eval.referenceValue}
                  blockingReasons={pnn50Eval.blockingReasons}
                />
                {meanRrVal != null && (
                  <MetricCard
                    metricKey="mean_rr"
                    value={meanRrEval.primaryDisplayValue}
                    color="hsl(180,75%,55%)"
                    status={meanRrEval.isEligible ? 'within_baseline' : 'not_applicable'}
                    hasBaseline={false}
                    interpretation={language === 'ru' ? 'Средний интервал между ударами (мс)' : 'Average interbeat interval (ms)'}
                    isDeemphasized={meanRrEval.isDeemphasized}
                    referenceValue={meanRrEval.referenceValue}
                    blockingReasons={meanRrEval.blockingReasons}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })()}

          {/* Synchronized signal chart */}
          <div className="chart-container" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
            <div className="section-title">{t('activeSignals')}</div>
            <SignalChart
              sessionId={sessionId}
              signalFiles={signalFiles}
              flags={flags}
              sessionStartMs={sessionStartMs}
              qcMetrics={qcMetrics}
              canonicalSession={canonicalSession}
            />
          </div>

          {/* HR Zones & Recovery summary */}
          {(() => {
            const rec1 = canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.recovery_metrics?.recovery_1min?.value_bpm_drop ?? null) : (analyticsMetrics?.recovery_1min ?? null);
            const rec2 = canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.recovery_metrics?.recovery_2min?.value_bpm_drop ?? null) : (analyticsMetrics?.recovery_2min ?? null);
            const isRecAvailable = rec1 !== null || rec2 !== null;

            const hrZonesCard = (
              <div className="card" id="card-hr-zones" style={{ marginBottom: isRecAvailable ? 0 : '12px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                  <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{t('timeInZones')}</div>
                  {getMaturityBadge('hr_zone_distribution', language)}
                </div>
                {hrZoneConfig && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Модель зон' : 'Zone model'}: <strong>{hrZoneConfig.mode}</strong> ({hrZoneConfig.source})
                  </div>
                )}
                {isLegacySession && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                    <em>{language === 'ru' ? 'Устаревший расчет (неавторитетный)' : 'Legacy calculation (non-authoritative)'}</em>
                  </div>
                )}
                {data.canonical_session && !isCanonicalEligible ? (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', padding: '12px 0' }}>
                    {language === 'ru'
                      ? `Расчет пульсовых зон недоступен: ${hrIneligibleReason || 'Недостаточная длительность (<60с) или пропуски каденса.'}`
                      : `HR zone distribution unavailable: ${hrIneligibleReason || 'Insufficient duration (<60s) or cadence gaps.'}`}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => {
                      const secs = zones[String(i + 1)] ?? zones[String(i)] ?? 0;
                      const pct = (secs / totalZoneTime) * 100;
                      const bpmRange = hrZoneConfig?.boundaries_bpm
                        ? i < 4
                          ? ` (${hrZoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[i]}–${hrZoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[i + 1]} bpm)`
                          : ` (≥${hrZoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[i]} bpm)`
                        : '';
                      const label = `${t('zone')} ${i + 1}${bpmRange}`;
                      const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
                      const s = Math.floor(secs % 60);
                      return (
                        <div className="zone-row" key={i}>
                          <span className="zone-label">{label}</span>
                          <div className="zone-bar-track">
                            <div
                              className="zone-bar-fill"
                              style={{ width: `${pct}%`, background: ZONE_COLORS[i] }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <span className="zone-duration">{m}:{s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                    {hrZoneDistribution && hrZoneDistribution.unclassified_seconds > 0 && (() => {
                      const unclassSecs = hrZoneDistribution.unclassified_seconds;
                      const unclassPct = (unclassSecs / totalZoneTime) * 100;
                      const m = Math.floor(unclassSecs / 60);
                      const s = Math.floor(unclassSecs % 60);
                      const belowLabel = hrZoneConfig?.boundaries_bpm?.[0]
                        ? `${language === 'ru' ? 'Ниже зоны 1' : 'Below Zone 1'} (<${hrZoneConfig.boundaries_bpm[0]} bpm)`
                        : (language === 'ru' ? 'Ниже зоны 1' : 'Below Zone 1');
                      return (
                        <div className="zone-row" style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}>
                          <span className="zone-label" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{belowLabel}</span>
                          <div className="zone-bar-track">
                            <div
                              className="zone-bar-fill"
                              style={{ width: `${unclassPct}%`, background: '#64748b' }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <span className="zone-duration" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{m}:{s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '11px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '8px', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)', paddingTop: '6px' }}>
                      <span>{language === 'ru' ? 'Всего проанализировано:' : 'Total Analyzed Time:'}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{formatDuration(totalZoneTime, language)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );

            if (isRecAvailable) {
              return (
                <div className="grid-2" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  {hrZonesCard}
                  <div className="card" id="card-recovery">
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                      <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{t('tabRecovery')}</div>
                      {getMaturityBadge('heart_rate_recovery', language)}
                    </div>
                    <RecoveryRow label={t('min1')} value={rec1} unit={t('bpmUnit')} />
                    <RecoveryRow label={t('min2')} value={rec2} unit={t('bpmUnit')} />
                    <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '8px', marginBottom: 0 }}>
                      {language === 'ru'
                        ? 'Описательный показатель восстановления ЧСС; не является клинической оценкой или предписанием готовности.'
                        : 'Descriptive heart rate recovery metric; not clinical assessment or readiness prescription.'}
                    </p>
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '14px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)', paddingTop: '10px' }}>
                      <QcRow label={t('qcMonotonicity')} value={qcValueTranslation(qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status, 'monotonicity')} />
                      <QcRow label={t('qcMissingSamples')} value={qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count?.toString() ?? '—'} />
                      <QcRow label={t('qcMotion')} value={qcValueTranslation(canonicalSession ? (canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null) : qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity, 'motion')} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            }

            // Compact Progressive Disclosure when Recovery is not applicable
            return (
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                {hrZonesCard}
                <div 
                  className="card" 
                  id="card-recovery"
                  style={{
                    padding: '10px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '12px',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem'
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    <span>ℹ️</span>
                    <span>
                      {language === 'ru' 
                        ? 'Восстановление ЧСС недоступно: валидная фаза снижения пульса после нагрузки не зафиксирована.'
                        : 'Heart rate recovery unavailable: valid post-exercise deceleration phase was not recorded.'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', opacity: 0.6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? '2-мин кинетика (исследование)' : '2-min kinetics (experimental)'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}

          {/* Activity Segmentation Card */}
          {(() => {
            const seg = canonicalSession?.activity_segmentation;
            if (!seg) return null;

            const total = seg.total_duration_seconds;
            const act = seg.active_duration_seconds;
            const inact = seg.inactive_duration_seconds;
            const unc = seg.uncertain_duration_seconds;
            const unavail = seg.unavailable_duration_seconds;

            const actPct = total > 0 ? ((act / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
            const inactPct = total > 0 ? ((inact / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
            const uncPct = total > 0 ? ((unc / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
            const unavailPct = total > 0 ? ((unavail / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';

            return (
              <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? 'Сегментация двигательной активности' : 'Session Activity Segmentation'}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                    <span className="badge badge-success" style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>
                      {language === 'ru' ? 'Сверено 100%' : 'Reconciled 100%'}
                    </span>
                    {getMaturityBadge('activity_segmentation', language)}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru'
                    ? '1-секундная эпоховая классификация фаз активности (активная, покой, неопределенная) с точной балансировкой общей длительности. Ускорение акселерометра отражает контекст движений, а не механическую мощность или нагрузку.'
                    : '1-second epoch classification of activity phases (active, inactive, uncertain) with exact duration reconciliation. Accelerometer signal provides motion stability context, not mechanical power or workload.'}
                </p>

                {/* Progress bar visualizer */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: '14px', borderRadius: '4px', overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: '14px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
                  {act > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ width: `${(act / total) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: '#10b981' }} title={`Active: ${act}s (${actPct}%)`} />
                  )}
                  {inact > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ width: `${(inact / total) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: '#3b82f6' }} title={`Inactive: ${inact}s (${inactPct}%)`} />
                  )}
                  {unc > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ width: `${(unc / total) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: '#f59e0b' }} title={`Uncertain: ${unc}s (${uncPct}%)`} />
                  )}
                  {unavail > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ width: `${(unavail / total) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: '#6b7280' }} title={`Unavailable: ${unavail}s (${unavailPct}%)`} />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr))', gap: '12px' }}>
                  <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', borderLeft: '3px solid #10b981' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Активность' : 'Active'}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '2px' }}>{act} с ({actPct}%)</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', borderLeft: '3px solid #3b82f6' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Покой' : 'Inactive'}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '2px' }}>{inact} с ({inactPct}%)</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', borderLeft: '3px solid #f59e0b' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Неопределено' : 'Uncertain'}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '2px' }}>{unc} с ({uncPct}%)</div>
                  </div>
                  {unavail > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', borderLeft: '3px solid #6b7280' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Недоступно' : 'Unavailable'}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '2px' }}>{unavail} с ({unavailPct}%)</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '10px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru'
                    ? `Сумма сегментов: ${act + inact + unc + unavail} с / Всего: ${total} с (Погрешность: ${seg.reconciliation_error_seconds} с)`
                    : `Segment sum: ${act + inact + unc + unavail}s / Total: ${total}s (Reconciliation error: ${seg.reconciliation_error_seconds}s)`}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: Spectral Analysis (Frequency Domain) */}
      {activeTab === 'spectral' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '14px', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' }}>
            <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Спектральный анализ вариабельности (Welch FFT)' : 'Spectral HRV Analysis (Welch FFT)'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
              {getSessionApplicabilityBadge(canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.frequency_domain_hrv?.state || canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.frequency_domain_hrv_welch?.state, undefined, language)}
              {getMaturityBadge('frequency_domain_hrv', language, (canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.frequency_domain_hrv?.state || canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.frequency_domain_hrv_welch?.state) === 'ELIGIBLE')}
            </div>
          </div>

          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Спектральный анализ вычисляется методом Welch (окно Ханна, 256 отсчётов, 50% перекрытие, 4 Гц сплайн-интерполяция) строго для непрерывных записей длительностью не менее 300 секунд (Frozen Protocol v1.1).'
              : 'Spectral analysis is computed via Welch method (Hann window, 256 samples, 50% overlap, 4 Hz spline interpolation) strictly for continuous recordings >= 300s (Frozen Protocol v1.1).'}
          </p>

          {(() => {
            const fd = canonicalSession?.advanced_metrics?.frequency_domain;
            const ls = canonicalSession?.advanced_metrics?.lomb_scargle;
            const freqTask = canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.frequency_domain_hrv_welch;
            const lfEval = evaluateUserFacingMetric('lf_power', fd?.lf?.value, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.lf_power || freqTask, language);
            const hfEval = evaluateUserFacingMetric('hf_power', fd?.hf?.value, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.hf_power || freqTask, language);
            const lfHfEval = evaluateUserFacingMetric('lf_hf_ratio', fd?.lf_hf_ratio?.value, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.lf_hf_ratio || freqTask, language);

            const dur = canonicalSession?.timing?.duration_seconds || session.duration_seconds || 0;
            const continuousSegment = freqTask?.observed_prerequisites?.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds
              ?? (canonicalSession?.quality_summary as any)?.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds
              ?? freqTask?.observed_prerequisites?.accepted_coverage_seconds
              ?? 0;
            const durOk = dur >= 300;
            const continuousOk = continuousSegment >= 300;
            const artPct = canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.artifact_percentage ?? 0;
            const artOk = artPct <= 5.0;
            const maxGap = canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.max_consecutive_gap_seconds ?? 0;
            const segOk = continuousOk && maxGap <= 3.0;

            return (
              <>
                {/* Spectral Method Selection Toggle (Progressive disclosure under Research Methods) */}
                {showResearchTabs && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {language === 'ru' ? 'Метод расчёта:' : 'Method:'}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      className={`btn ${spectralMethod === 'welch' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 10px' }}
                      onClick={() => setSpectralMethod('welch')}
                    >
                      Welch FFT ({language === 'ru' ? 'Канонический эталон' : 'Validated Default'})
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className={`btn ${spectralMethod === 'lomb_scargle' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', padding: '4px 10px' }}
                      onClick={() => setSpectralMethod('lomb_scargle')}
                    >
                      Lomb-Scargle ({language === 'ru' ? 'Экспериментальный' : 'Experimental'})
                    </button>
                    {spectralMethod === 'lomb_scargle' && getMaturityBadge('lomb_scargle_periodogram', language)}
                  </div>
                )}

                {spectralMethod === 'welch' ? (
                  <>
                    {freqTask?.state !== 'ELIGIBLE' && (
                      <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px', padding: '12px 16px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25)', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#f87171', fontSize: '0.85rem', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
                          {language === 'ru' ? 'Критерии применимости спектрального анализа (Welch FFT):' : 'Spectral HRV (Welch FFT) Prerequisite Checklist:'}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '8px', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                          <div>
                            {durOk ? '✅' : '❌'} {language === 'ru' ? 'Общая длительность ≥ 300 с:' : 'Total duration ≥ 300s:'} <strong>{formatDuration(dur, language)}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            {continuousOk ? '✅' : '❌'} {language === 'ru' ? 'Непрерывный сегмент RR ≥ 300 с:' : 'Continuous RR segment ≥ 300s:'} <strong>{Math.round(continuousSegment)} с</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            {artOk ? '✅' : '❌'} {language === 'ru' ? 'Доля артефактов ≤ 5%:' : 'Artifacts ≤ 5%:'} <strong>{artPct.toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            {segOk ? '✅' : '❌'} {language === 'ru' ? 'Непрерывность без пауз >3 с' : 'No gaps > 3s'}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {freqTask?.blocking_reasons && freqTask.blocking_reasons.length > 0 && (
                          <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#fca5a5' }}>
                            {language === 'ru' ? 'Причина блокировки:' : 'Blocking reason:'} {localizeBlockingReason(freqTask.blocking_reasons[0], language as any)}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '16px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                      <div style={{ padding: '14px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', border: '1px solid var(--border-color)' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>LF Power (0.04 - 0.15 Hz)</div>
                          <span className={`badge ${lfEval.isEligible ? (lfEval.eligibilityState === 'ELIGIBLE' ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning') : 'badge-muted'}`}>
                            {lfEval.eligibilityBadgeLabel}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '6px', color: lfEval.isDeemphasized ? '#94a3b8' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                          {lfEval.primaryDisplayValue}{lfEval.primaryDisplayValue !== '—' && !lfEval.primaryDisplayValue.includes('ms²') ? ' ms²' : ''}
                          {lfEval.isDeemphasized && lfEval.referenceValue && (
