                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 600, marginTop: '6px' }}>
                        {a2?.alpha !== null && a2?.alpha !== undefined ? `${a2.alpha}` : '—'}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                        {a2?.r_squared !== null && a2?.r_squared !== undefined ? `R² = ${a2.r_squared}` : ''}
                        {a2?.points_count ? ` (${a2.points_count} scales)` : ''}
                      </div>
                      {a2?.limitations && a2.limitations.length > 0 && (
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                          {a2.limitations[0]}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                        {language === 'ru' ? 'Длиннопериодные корреляции' : 'Long-term fractal correlations'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', padding: '10px 12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px', borderLeft: '3px solid var(--accent-info)' }}>
                    ℹ️ {language === 'ru'
                      ? 'DFA отражает фрактальное масштабирование и автомодельность вариабельности ритма. Значения α ~ 1.0 указывают на 1/f флуктуации (розовый шум), α ~ 0.5 на белый шум, α ~ 1.5 на броуновское движение. Не является клиническим диагнозом.'
                      : 'DFA reflects fractal power-law scaling of cardiac interval series. α ~ 1.0 indicates 1/f fractal dynamics, α ~ 0.5 white noise, α ~ 1.5 Brownian noise. Not for clinical diagnosis.'}
                  </div>
                </>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: Signals & ECG/RR Matching */}
      {activeTab === 'signals' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '14px', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' }}>
            <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Согласованность каналов ЭКГ и ЧСС/RR' : 'ECG & HR/RR Channel Alignment'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
              {getSessionApplicabilityBadge(canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.ecg_rr_agreement?.state, undefined, language)}
              {getMaturityBadge('ecg_rr_agreement', language, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.ecg_rr_agreement?.state === 'ELIGIBLE')}
            </div>
          </div>

          {canonicalSession && canonicalSession.task_eligibility?.ecg_rr_agreement?.state !== 'ELIGIBLE' ? (
            <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem', textAlign: 'center', padding: '20px 0' }}>
              {language === 'ru'
                ? 'Функция заблокирована: отсутствуют валидированные парные синхронные записи Polar ЭКГ и RR (требуется парный эталон)'
                : 'Feature dataset-blocked: requires validated paired simultaneous Polar ECG + raw RR recordings'}
            </div>
          ) : matchMetrics && matchMetrics.quality !== 'not_applicable' && matchMetrics.match_rate_50ms !== null ? (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: '12px' }}>
                <div style={{ padding: '10px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Совпадение 20мс:' : 'Match Rate (20ms):'}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{matchMetrics.match_rate_20ms != null ? `${matchMetrics.match_rate_20ms}%` : '—'}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ padding: '10px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Совпадение 50мс:' : 'Match Rate (50ms):'}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{matchMetrics.match_rate_50ms != null ? `${matchMetrics.match_rate_50ms}%` : '—'}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ padding: '10px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Медиана ошибки:' : 'Median Error:'}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{matchMetrics.median_abs_error_ms != null ? `${matchMetrics.median_abs_error_ms} мс` : '—'}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ padding: '10px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Сдвиг (лаг):' : 'Signal Lag:'}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{matchMetrics.estimated_lag_ms != null ? `${matchMetrics.estimated_lag_ms} мс` : '—'}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem', textAlign: 'center', padding: '20px 0' }}>
              {matchMetrics?.reason || (language === 'ru' ? 'Недостаточно данных для сопоставления ЭКГ и RR' : 'Insufficient data for ECG/RR alignment')}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 5: Aerobic Decoupling (Cardiac Drift) */}
      {activeTab === 'drift' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '14px', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '8px' }}>
            <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Аэробное разобщение (Кардиальный дрифт)' : 'Aerobic Decoupling (Cardiac Drift)'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
              {getSessionApplicabilityBadge(canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.cardiac_drift?.state, undefined, language)}
              {getMaturityBadge('cardiac_drift', language, canonicalSession?.task_eligibility?.cardiac_drift?.state === 'ELIGIBLE')}
            </div>
          </div>

          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
            {language === 'ru'
              ? 'Оценивает отношение ЧСС к внешней мощности/темпу в первой и второй половине равномерной кардиотренировки (длительность >= 20 мин, требуется внешний измеритель мощности).'
              : 'Evaluates heart rate to external workload power/pace ratio between first and second halves of steady-state exercise (duration >= 20 min, requires external power/pace meter).'}
          </p>

          <div style={{ padding: '16px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', width: 'fit-content' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{language === 'ru' ? 'Коэффициент дрифта:' : 'Drift Ratio:'}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'var(--accent-primary)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
              {canonicalSession?.advanced_metrics?.cardiac_drift?.value != null
                ? `${canonicalSession.advanced_metrics.cardiac_drift.value.toFixed(1)}%`
                : '—'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '4px' }}>
              {canonicalSession?.advanced_metrics?.cardiac_drift?.value != null
                ? driftInterpretation
                : (language === 'ru'
                    ? 'Недоступно: требуются данные внешнего измерителя мощности (ACC не является суррогатом мощности)'
                    : 'Unavailable: requires external workload power meter (ACC is not a workload power surrogate)')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 6: Annotations and User Notes */}
      {activeTab === 'annotations' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
          <div className="section-title">{t('activityTypeLabel') || 'Activity Annotation'}</div>
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveAnnotation}>
            <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}>
              <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{t('activityTypeLabel')}</label>
              <AppSelect
                id="activity-type-selector"
                options={[
                  { value: 'unknown', label: t('activityUnknown') },
                  { value: 'cardio', label: t('activityCardio') },
                  { value: 'sleep', label: t('activitySleep') },
                  { value: 'mixed', label: t('activityMixed') },
                  { value: 'resting_hrv', label: t('activityRestingHrv') },
                  { value: 'recovery', label: t('activityRecovery') },
                  { value: 'strength', label: t('activityStrength') },
                  { value: 'other', label: t('activityOther') }
                ]}
                value={annotation.activity_type}
                onChange={(val) => setAnnotation({ ...annotation, activity_type: val })}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}>
              <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{t('activityLabelCustom')}</label>
              <input
                className="form-input"
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. Утренняя пробежка"
                value={annotation.activity_label_custom}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnotation({ ...annotation, activity_label_custom: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{t('perceivedEffortLabel')}</label>
                <input
                  className="form-input"
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={10}
                  placeholder="1-10"
                  value={annotation.perceived_effort}
                  onChange={(e) => setAnnotation({ ...annotation, perceived_effort: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{t('sleepQualityLabel')}</label>
                <input
                  className="form-input"
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={10}
                  placeholder="1-10"
                  value={annotation.sleep_quality_subjective}
                  onChange={(e) => setAnnotation({ ...annotation, sleep_quality_subjective: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>{t('notesLabel')}</label>
              <textarea
                className="form-input"
                style={{ minHeight: '80px', resize: 'vertical' }}
                placeholder="..."
                value={annotation.user_notes}
                onChange={(e) => setAnnotation({ ...annotation, user_notes: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '12px' }}>
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={annotationSaving} style={{ padding: '8px 16px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                {annotationSaving ? '...' : (t('saveAnnotationBtn') || 'Save Annotation')}
              </button>
              {annotationSavedMsg && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--accent-success)' }}>
                  {t('annotationSaved') || 'Annotation saved!'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Candidate flags & Clustered Events (AC-041, AC-042, FIN-031) */}
      {flags.length > 0 && (() => {
        // Deterministic clustering into meaningful categories
        const categories: Record<string, { labelRu: string; labelEn: string; severity: string; count: number; clusterCount: number; clusters: Set<number>; items: typeof flags }> = {
          ectopic: {
            labelRu: 'Кандидатные эктопические комплексы (преждевременные сокращения)',
            labelEn: 'Ectopic beat candidates',
            severity: 'medium',
            count: 0,
            clusterCount: 0,
            clusters: new Set(),
            items: []
          },
          rr_outlier: {
            labelRu: 'Выбросы и резкие скачки кардиоинтервалов (RR Outliers)',
            labelEn: 'RR Interval Outliers & Sudden Steps',
            severity: 'low',
            count: 0,
            clusterCount: 0,
            clusters: new Set(),
            items: []
          },
          tachycardia: {
            labelRu: 'Эпизоды подозрения на тахикардию',
            labelEn: 'Tachycardia suspicion episodes',
            severity: 'high',
            count: 0,
            clusterCount: 0,
            clusters: new Set(),
            items: []
          },
          bradycardia: {
            labelRu: 'Эпизоды подозрения на брадикардию',
            labelEn: 'Bradycardia suspicion episodes',
            severity: 'high',
            count: 0,
            clusterCount: 0,
            clusters: new Set(),
            items: []
          },
          other: {
            labelRu: 'Прочие кандидатные отклонения',
            labelEn: 'Other candidate flags',
            severity: 'low',
            count: 0,
            clusterCount: 0,
            clusters: new Set(),
            items: []
          }
        };

        for (const f of flags) {
          const catKey = f.flag_type in categories ? f.flag_type : (f.flag_type === 'noise' || f.flag_type.includes('outlier') ? 'rr_outlier' : 'other');
          const cat = categories[catKey];
          cat.count++;
          cat.items.push(f);
          const epoch = Math.floor(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 30000);
          cat.clusters.add(epoch);
        }

        const activeCategories = Object.entries(categories).filter(([_, c]) => c.count > 0);
        const totalClusters = new Set(flags.map(f => Math.floor(f.timestamp_offset_ms / 30000))).size;

        return (
          <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '20px' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
              <div className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? 'Кандидатные события и артефакты ритма' : 'Candidate Events & Rhythm Artifacts'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {language === 'ru'
                  ? `Событий: ${flags.length} · 30-сек кластеров: ${totalClusters}`
                  : `Total flags: ${flags.length} · 30s clusters: ${totalClusters}`}
              </div>
            </div>

            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              {t('nonDiagnosticMarker')}
            </p>

            {/* Clustered Category Summary Grid */}
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
              {activeCategories.map(([k, cat]) => (
                <div key={k} style={{ padding: '12px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '6px', border: '1px solid var(--border-color)' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                      {language === 'ru' ? cat.labelRu : cat.labelEn}
                    </span>
                    <span className={`badge ${cat.severity === 'high' ? 'badge-danger' : cat.severity === 'medium' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-muted'}`}>
                      {cat.count}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                    {language === 'ru' ? `Кластеров (30 с): ${cat.clusters.size}` : `Clusters (30s): ${cat.clusters.size}`}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* On-demand raw inspection */}
            <details style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}>
              <summary style={{ cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--accent-primary)', padding: '6px 0' }}>
                {language === 'ru' ? `Показать детальный список событий (${Math.min(flags.length, 50)} из ${flags.length})...` : `Show detailed events list (${Math.min(flags.length, 50)} of ${flags.length})...`}
              </summary>
              <div style={{ maxHeight: '280px', overflowY: 'auto', marginTop: '10px' }}>
                {flags.slice(0, 50).map((f) => {
                  const ms = f.timestamp_offset_ms;
                  const m = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
                  const s = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
                  const localizedDesc = language === 'ru' ? f.description_ru : (f.flag_type === 'ectopic' ? 'Ectopic beat' : f.flag_type === 'tachycardia' ? 'Tachycardia suspicion' : f.flag_type === 'bradycardia' ? 'Bradycardia suspicion' : f.description_ru || f.flag_type);
                  const localizedSeverity = f.severity === 'high' ? t('severityCritical') : f.severity === 'medium' ? t('severityWarning') : f.severity;
                  return (
                    <div className="flag-item" key={f.id}>
                      <span className={`flag-severity ${f.severity}`} />
                      <div>
                        <div className="flag-text">{localizedDesc}</div>
                        <div className="flag-time">
                          {m}:{s.toString().padStart(2, '0')} {t('minutes')} · {f.flag_type}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className={`badge ${f.severity === 'high' ? 'badge-danger' : f.severity === 'medium' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-muted'}`}
                        style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}
                      >
                        {localizedSeverity}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </details>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* Named Analysis Windows (REC-007) */}
      <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '24px' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {language === 'ru' ? 'Аналитические окна (Named Windows)' : 'Named Analysis Windows'}
            </h3>
            <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {language === 'ru'
                ? 'Выделенные срезы сессии (разминка, интервалы, тест). Не изменяют базовый коридор всей сессии.'
                : 'Custom session slices (warm-up, intervals, test). Do not alter full-session baseline corridor.'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            className="btn btn-outline"
            style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '6px 12px' }}
            onClick={() => setWindowFormOpen(!windowFormOpen)}
          >
            {windowFormOpen
              ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Отмена' : 'Cancel')
              : (language === 'ru' ? '+ Добавить окно' : '+ Add Window')}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Add Window Form */}
        {windowFormOpen && (
          <div style={{ padding: '16px', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', borderRadius: '8px', marginBottom: '16px', border: '1px solid var(--border-color)' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: '12px', alignItems: 'end' }}>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Название окна' : 'Window Name'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="input"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                  placeholder={language === 'ru' ? 'Например: Разминка 5 мин' : 'e.g. 5-min Warmup'}
                  value={newWindowName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewWindowName(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Начало (сек)' : 'Start (sec)'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  className="input"
                  min={0}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                  value={newWindowStart}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewWindowStart(Number(e.target.value))}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                  {language === 'ru' ? 'Окончание (сек)' : 'End (sec)'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  className="input"
                  min={1}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                  value={newWindowEnd}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewWindowEnd(Number(e.target.value))}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <button
                  className="btn btn-primary"
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '7px 12px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                  disabled={windowLoading || !newWindowName.trim() || newWindowEnd <= newWindowStart}
                  onClick={handleCreateWindow}
                >
                  {windowLoading ? (language === 'ru' ? 'Расчет...' : 'Calculating...') : (language === 'ru' ? 'Рассчитать и сохранить' : 'Calculate & Save')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {newWindowEnd - newWindowStart < 300 && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '8px', fontSize: '0.73rem', color: 'var(--accent-warning, #f59e0b)' }}>
                ℹ {language === 'ru'
                  ? 'Окно менее 300 секунд (5 мин): метрики SDNN и pNN50 будут скрыты согласно стандарту Task Force 1996.'
                  : 'Window duration is under 300s (5 min): SDNN and pNN50 will be withheld per Task Force 1996 standards.'}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Windows List */}
        {namedWindows.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: '20px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
            {language === 'ru' ? 'Нет созданных аналитических окон. Нажмите «+ Добавить окно» для анализа интервала.' : 'No named windows defined. Click "+ Add Window" to analyze a specific segment.'}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
            {namedWindows.map((win) => {
              const m = win.metrics;
              const dur = Math.round(win.endOffsetSeconds - win.startOffsetSeconds);
              return (
                <div
                  key={win.id}
                  style={{
                    padding: '12px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-color)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '12px'
                  }}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.9rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                        {win.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="badge" style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)', color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>
                        {win.startOffsetSeconds}с – {win.endOffsetSeconds}с ({dur}с)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '16px', marginTop: '6px', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      <span>ЧСС ср: <strong>{m?.meanHr !== null && m?.meanHr !== undefined ? `${m.meanHr} уд/мин` : '—'}</strong></span>
                      <span>RMSSD: <strong>{m?.rmssd !== null && m?.rmssd !== undefined ? `${m.rmssd} мс` : '—'}</strong></span>
                      <span>
                        SDNN: <strong>{m?.sdnn !== null && m?.sdnn !== undefined ? `${m.sdnn} мс` : (language === 'ru' ? 'Скрыто (<300 с)' : 'Withheld (<300s)')}</strong>
                      </span>
                      <span>Отсчетов: <strong>{m?.beatCount ?? 0}</strong></span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-ghost"
                    style={{ color: '#ef4444', fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '4px 8px' }}
                    title={language === 'ru' ? 'Удалить окно' : 'Delete window'}
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteWindow(win.id)}
                  >
                    🗑
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Manifest Modal */}
      {showManifestModal && canonicalSession && (
        <OverlayRoot>
          <div
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              zIndex: 99999
            }}
            onClick={() => setShowManifestModal(false)}
          >
            <div
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                padding: '24px',
                maxWidth: '650px',
                width: '90%',
                maxHeight: '85vh',
                overflowY: 'auto'
              }}
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '16px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', paddingBottom: '8px' }}>

                <button 
                  className="btn btn-ghost" 
                  onClick={() => setShowManifestModal(false)}
                  style={{ padding: '4px 8px' }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '10px' }}>
                {(canonicalSession.source_bundle_manifest?.source_files || (canonicalSession as any).manifest?.source_files || []).map((file: any, fIdx: number) => (

                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#38bdf8', marginTop: '4px', wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                      SHA-256: {file.sha256 || 'не вычислен'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </OverlayRoot>
      )}

      {showLlmExportModal && (
        <LlmExportModal
          sessionId={sessionId}
          session={session}
          onClose={() => setShowLlmExportModal(false)}
        />
      )}
      {showRRInspector && (

      <AppDialog

        confirmLabel="ОК"
        onConfirm={() => setErrorDialogText(null)}
        onCancel={() => setErrorDialogText(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function QualityBadgeWithPopover({ score, qcMetrics, hrvQuality, canonicalSession }: { score?: number | null; qcMetrics: any; hrvQuality?: string | null; canonicalSession?: any }) {
  const [showTooltip, setShowTooltip] = useState(false);
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const normalized = normalizeQualityScore(score);
  const numScore = normalized.numericPercent ?? 100;
  const cls = numScore >= 80 ? 'badge-success' : numScore >= 60 ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-danger';
  const floatingPos = useFloatingPosition(containerRef, showTooltip, { align: 'auto', width: 280 });

  // Escape key support
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setShowTooltip(false);
      }
    }
    if (showTooltip) {
      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [showTooltip]);

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-block' }}>
      <span 
        id="badge-session-quality"
        className={`badge ${cls}`} 
        onClick={() => setShowTooltip(!showTooltip)}
        style={{ cursor: 'pointer', padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
        title={language === 'en' ? 'Click for quality breakdown' : 'Нажмите для детализации качества'}
      >
        {normalized.displayString}
      </span>
      {showTooltip && qcMetrics && (
        <OverlayRoot>
          <div
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: `${floatingPos.top}px`,
              left: `${floatingPos.left}px`,
              width: '280px',
              backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              padding: '12px',
              zIndex: 99999,
              boxShadow: '0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              fontSize: '0.78rem',
              color: '#cbd5e1',
              lineHeight: '1.4',
              textAlign: 'left',
              backdropFilter: 'none',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none',
              transform: floatingPos.openUp ? 'translateY(-100%)' : 'none',
              isolation: 'isolate',
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '8px', borderBottom: '1px solid #334155', paddingBottom: '4px' }}>
              <strong style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>
                {language === 'en' ? 'Quality Breakdown' : 'Детализация качества'}
              </strong>
              <button 
                type="button" 
                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setShowTooltip(false); }}
                style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#94a3b8', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0 }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcOverall')}:</span>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: '500' }}>{score !== null && score !== undefined ? `${score.toFixed(0)}%` : '—'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcHr')}:</span>
              <span>
                {qcMetrics.missing_samples_count === 0 
                  ? (language === 'en' ? 'Excellent' : 'Отличное') 
                  : (language === 'en' ? `Gaps: ${qcMetrics.missing_samples_count}` : `Пропусков: ${qcMetrics.missing_samples_count}`)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcHrv')}:</span>
              <span style={{ color: hrvQuality === 'quality_limited' ? '#f87171' : '#4ade80', fontWeight: '500' }}>
                {t(hrvQuality || 'quality_unknown')}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcEcg')}:</span>
              <span>
                {(() => {
                  if (canonicalSession) {
                    const noiseVal = canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.noisy_window_fraction?.value;
                    return (noiseVal !== undefined && noiseVal !== null)
                      ? (language === 'en' ? `Flagged noisy: ${(noiseVal * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : `Зашумленные фрагменты: ${(noiseVal * 100).toFixed(0)}%`)
                      : '—';
                  }
                  const noiseVal = qcMetrics?.ecg_noise_ratio;
                  return (noiseVal !== undefined && noiseVal !== null)
                    ? (language === 'en' ? `Flagged noisy: ${(noiseVal * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : `Зашумленные фрагменты: ${(noiseVal * 100).toFixed(0)}%`)
                    : '—';
                })()}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{language === 'en' ? 'ECG SNR:' : 'SNR ЭКГ:'}</span>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: '500' }}>
                {canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.snr?.value_db !== undefined && canonicalSession?.ecg_evidence?.snr?.value_db !== null
                  ? `${canonicalSession.ecg_evidence.snr.value_db} dB`
                  : (canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.ecg_snr_db !== undefined && canonicalSession?.quality_summary?.ecg_snr_db !== null
                    ? `${canonicalSession.quality_summary.ecg_snr_db} dB`
                    : 'N/A')}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcEcgRrMatch')}:</span>
              <span>
                {canonicalSession
                  ? (canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement?.value_percent !== null && canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement?.value_percent !== undefined
                    ? `${Math.round(canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent)}%`
                    : (language === 'ru' ? '— (заблокировано)' : '— (blocked)'))
                  : (qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_consistency != null ? `${Math.round(qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency * 100)}%` : '—')}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', margin: '4px 0' }}>
              <span>{t('qcAcc')}:</span>
              <span>
                {(() => {
                  const motionSev = canonicalSession
                    ? (canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null)
                    : (qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity ?? null);
                  return motionSev === 'low' ? (language === 'en' ? 'Low' : 'Низкая') :
                         motionSev === 'medium' ? (language === 'en' ? 'Medium' : 'Средняя') :
                         motionSev === 'high' ? (language === 'en' ? 'High' : 'Высокая') : '—';
                })()}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8', borderTop: '1px solid #334155', paddingTop: '6px', marginTop: '6px', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              {t('qualityDecompDesc')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </OverlayRoot>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function RecoveryRow({ label, value, unit }: { label: string; value: number | null | undefined; unit: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '8px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{label}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: '600', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
        {value != null ? `−${value} ${unit}` : '—'}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function QcRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '6px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{label}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
