function formatDateShort(iso: string, lang: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(lang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
}

interface MetricInterpretation {
  whatChanged: string;
  baselineStatus: string;
  qualityLimitedPoints: string;
  gapsText: string;
  canInfer: string;
  cannotInfer: string;
}

function MetricInterpretationPanel({
  metricKey,
  trendsData,
  hasGaps,
  language,
  t
}: {
  metricKey: 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'avg_hr';
  trendsData: TrendsResponse;
  hasGaps: boolean;
  language: string;
  t: (k: string) => string;
}) {
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  const isBaselineAvailable = trendsData.personal_baseline_available;

  let band: any = null;
  let latestVal: number | null = null;
  let unit = '';
  let desc = '';

  if (metricKey === 'rmssd') {
    band = trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms;
    const series = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'rmssd_ms');
    const validPoints = series?.points?.filter(p => p.value !== null && typeof p.value === 'number') || [];
    latestVal = validPoints.length > 0 
      ? validPoints[validPoints.length - 1].value 
      : null;
    unit = isRu ? ' мс' : ' ms';
    desc = t('trendHrvDesc');
  } else if (metricKey === 'sdnn') {
    band = trendsData.baseline.sdnn_ms;
    const series = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'sdnn_ms');
    const validPoints = series?.points?.filter(p => p.value !== null && typeof p.value === 'number') || [];
    latestVal = validPoints.length > 0 
      ? validPoints[validPoints.length - 1].value 
      : null;
    unit = isRu ? ' мс' : ' ms';
    desc = isRu
      ? 'общая вариабельность ритма сердца за время записи (стандартное отклонение NN-интервалов)'
      : 'overall heart rate variability during the recording (standard deviation of NN intervals)';
  } else if (metricKey === 'avg_hr') {
    band = trendsData.baseline.avg_hr_bpm;
    const series = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'avg_hr_bpm');
    const validPoints = series?.points?.filter(p => p.value !== null && typeof p.value === 'number') || [];
    latestVal = validPoints.length > 0 
      ? validPoints[validPoints.length - 1].value 
      : null;
    unit = isRu ? ' уд/мин' : ' bpm';
    desc = isRu 
      ? 'средняя частота сердечных сокращений во время записи'
      : 'average heart rate during recording';
  }

  // 1. What changed
  let whatChanged = '';
  if (latestVal !== null && band && band.median !== null) {
    const diff = latestVal - band.median;
    const absDiff = Math.abs(diff);
    if (absDiff < (metricKey === 'avg_hr' ? 3 : 5)) {
      whatChanged = isRu
        ? `Показатель стабилен (последнее значение ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} близко к медиане ${band.median}${unit})`
        : `Metric is stable (latest value ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} is close to median ${band.median}${unit})`;
    } else if (diff > 0) {
      whatChanged = isRu
        ? `Показатель выше медианы baseline (последнее значение ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} против медианы ${band.median}${unit})`
        : `Metric is above baseline median (latest value ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} vs median ${band.median}${unit})`;
    } else {
      whatChanged = isRu
        ? `Показатель ниже медианы baseline (последнее значение ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} против медианы ${band.median}${unit})`
        : `Metric is below baseline median (latest value ${latestVal.toFixed(1)}${unit} vs median ${band.median}${unit})`;
    }
  } else {
    whatChanged = isRu
      ? 'Недостаточно данных для оценки изменений'
      : 'Insufficient data to evaluate changes';
  }

  // 2. Baseline / reference status (no "норма"!)
  let statusText = '';
  if (latestVal !== null && band) {
    if (band.available) {
      if (latestVal > band.p75) {
        statusText = t('trendStatusAbove');
      } else if (latestVal < band.p25) {
        statusText = t('trendStatusBelow');
      } else {
        statusText = t('trendStatusWithin');
      }
    } else {
      statusText = t('trendStatusInsufficient');
      if (band.p25 !== null && band.p75 !== null) {
        statusText += ` (${t('trendStatusReference')})`;
      }
    }
  } else {
    statusText = isRu ? 'нет данных' : 'no data';
  }

  // 3. Quality limited points in this filter view
  const limitedCount = trendsData.quality_summary?.quality_limited_count ?? 0;
  const qualityLimitedText = limitedCount > 0
    ? (isRu
        ? `Присутствует ${limitedCount} сессий с ограничениями качества. Выводы по этим точкам ограничены.`
        : `There are ${limitedCount} quality-limited sessions. Conclusions for these points are limited.`)
    : (isRu
        ? 'Все сессии имеют достаточное качество.'
        : 'All sessions have sufficient quality.');

  // 4. Gaps text
  const gapsText = hasGaps
    ? (isRu
        ? 'Обнаружены длительные перерывы в измерениях (> 3 дней). Линия тренда прерывается во избежание ложной интерполяции.'
        : 'Long measurement gaps detected (> 3 days). Trend line is broken to avoid false interpolation.')
    : (isRu
        ? 'Регулярные измерения без длительных пробелов.'
        : 'Regular measurements without long gaps.');

  // 5. Can infer / Cannot infer (safe wording)
  let canInfer = '';
  if (metricKey === 'rmssd') {
    canInfer = isRu
      ? 'краткосрочную вариабельность NN/RR-интервалов относительно личного диапазона при данном качестве записи'
      : 'short-term NN/RR interval variability relative to the personal range under comparable recording conditions';
  } else if (metricKey === 'sdnn') {
    canInfer = isRu
      ? 'общую вариабельность ритма сердца за время записи'
      : 'overall heart rate variability during the recording period';
  } else {
    canInfer = isRu
      ? 'среднюю ЧСС, отражающую хронотропную функцию сердца в покое или при нагрузке'
      : 'average heart rate reflecting chronotropic heart function at rest or during exercise';
  }

  const cannotInfer = isRu
    ? 'оценку заболеваний сердца, патологию проводящей системы, либо функциональное восстановление как прямой однозначный вывод без медицинского обследования'
    : 'heart disease evaluation, conduction system anomalies, or fitness recovery as a direct conclusion without a physician check';

  const relatedBackendCards = trendsData.interpretation_cards.filter(c => {
    if (metricKey === 'rmssd' && c.metric_key === 'rmssd_ms') return true;
    if (metricKey === 'sdnn' && c.metric_key === 'sdnn_ms') return true;
    if (metricKey === 'avg_hr' && c.metric_key === 'avg_hr_bpm') return true;
    return false;
  });

  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: '10px', padding: '14px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.3)', border: '1px solid #334155', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
      <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#e2e8f0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
        <span>ℹ️</span> {isRu ? 'Интерпретация и контекст метрики' : 'Metric Interpretation & Context'}
      </h4>
      
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', gap: '8px', fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Описание:' : 'Description:'} </strong>
          <span style={{ fontStyle: 'italic' }}>{desc}</span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Динамика изменений:' : 'What changed:'} </strong>
          {whatChanged}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Статус:' : 'Status:'} </strong>
          <span style={{
            color: statusText.includes('выше') ? '#4ade80' : statusText.includes('ниже') ? '#f87171' : '#38bdf8',
            fontWeight: '600'
          }}>{statusText}</span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Ограничения по качеству:' : 'Quality limits:'} </strong>
          {qualityLimitedText}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#94a3b8' }}>{isRu ? 'Пропуски данных:' : 'Gaps:'} </strong>
          {gapsText}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#4ade80' }}>{isRu ? '✓ Можно определить:' : '✓ Can infer:'} </strong>
          {canInfer}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>{isRu ? '✗ Нельзя определить:' : '✗ Cannot infer:'} </strong>
          {cannotInfer}
        </div>
      </div>

      {relatedBackendCards.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: '12px', paddingTop: '12px', borderTop: '1px solid #334155' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: '6px', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
            {isRu ? 'Аналитические выводы:' : 'Analytical conclusions:'}
          </div>
          {relatedBackendCards.map((card, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              style={{
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                padding: '8px 12px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                borderLeft: `3px solid ${
                  card.type === 'success' ? '#22c55e' :
                  card.type === 'danger' ? '#ef4444' :
                  card.type === 'warning' ? '#eab308' : '#38bdf8'
                }`,
                color: '#cbd5e1',
                lineHeight: '1.4',
                marginBottom: '4px'
              }}
            >
              <strong>{card.title}</strong>: {card.message}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function AdditionalMetricsPanel({
  trendsData,
  language,
  t
}: {
  trendsData: TrendsResponse;
  language: string;
  t: (k: string) => string;
}) {
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  
  const avgQuality = trendsData.quality_summary?.average_quality_score ?? null;
  const qualityLimitedCount = trendsData.quality_summary?.quality_limited_count ?? 0;
  const avgRecovery = trendsData.summary_metrics?.avg_recovery_1min ?? null;
  const drift = trendsData.summary_metrics?.avg_cardiac_drift;
  const zones = trendsData.summary_metrics?.average_zones_distribution;
  
  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: '20px', padding: '16px' }}>
      <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 12px 0', fontSize: '1rem', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>
        {isRu ? 'Дополнительные метрики тренда' : 'Additional Trend Metrics'}
      </h3>
      
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: '16px' }}>
        <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.2)' }}>
          <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
            📊 {isRu ? 'Качество записи и HRV-анализ' : 'Recording Quality & HRV Analysis'}
          </h4>
          <ul style={{ margin: '0', paddingLeft: '18px', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#cbd5e1', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
            <li>
              <strong>{isRu ? 'Среднее качество сигнала:' : 'Average Signal Quality:'}</strong>{' '}
              {avgQuality !== null ? `${avgQuality}%` : '—'}
            </li>
            <li>
              <strong>{isRu ? 'Сессий с артефактами:' : 'Sessions with Artifacts:'}</strong>{' '}
              {qualityLimitedCount}
            </li>
            <li>
              <span style={{ color: '#eab308' }}>
                ⚠️ {isRu ? 'Выводы по сессиям с ограничениями качества носят справочный характер.' : 'Conclusions for quality-limited sessions are reference-only.'}
              </span>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        {avgRecovery !== null && (
          <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.2)' }}>
            <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              ⏱️ {isRu ? 'Восстановление пульса' : 'Heart Rate Recovery'}
            </h4>
            <ul style={{ margin: '0', paddingLeft: '18px', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#cbd5e1', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
              <li>
                <strong>{isRu ? 'Среднее снижение ЧСС за 1-ю минуту:' : 'Average HR drop in 1st minute:'}</strong>{' '}
                {avgRecovery} {isRu ? 'уд/мин' : 'bpm'}
              </li>
              <li>
                <strong>{isRu ? 'Оценка:' : 'Evaluation:'}</strong>{' '}
                {avgRecovery >= 12 
                  ? (isRu ? 'целевой ориентир достигнут (> 12 уд/мин)' : 'target guide reached (> 12 bpm)')
                  : (isRu ? 'сниженный показатель (< 12 уд/мин), возможен недостаток восстановления' : 'low rate (< 12 bpm), potential recovery deficit')}
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {drift && drift.status === 'valid_experimental' && drift.value_percent !== null && (
          <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.2)' }}>
            <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              📈 {isRu ? 'Кардиоваскулярный дрейф' : 'Cardiac Cardiovascular Drift'}
            </h4>
            <ul style={{ margin: '0', paddingLeft: '18px', fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#cbd5e1', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
              <li>
                <strong>{isRu ? 'Средний дрейф пульса:' : 'Average HR Drift:'}</strong>{' '}
                {drift.value_percent}%
              </li>
              <li>
                <strong>{isRu ? 'Статус:' : 'Status:'}</strong>{' '}
                {drift.value_percent <= 10 
                  ? (isRu ? 'стабильное аэробное согласование' : 'stable aerobic coupling')
                  : (isRu ? 'повышенный дрейф, возможная дегидратация или утомление' : 'elevated drift, potential dehydration or fatigue')}
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {zones && Object.values(zones).some(v => v > 0) && (
          <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.2)' }}>
            <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 8px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
              🎯 {isRu ? 'Распределение по пульсовым зонам' : 'Heart Rate Zones Distribution'}
            </h4>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#cbd5e1', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
              {['zone1', 'zone2', 'zone3', 'zone4', 'zone5'].map(k => {
                const val = zones[k] || 0;
                if (val === 0) return null;
                return (
                  <div key={k} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                    <span>{k.replace('zone', isRu ? 'Зона ' : 'Zone ')}:</span>
                    <strong>{val}%</strong>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const insertGaps = (points: TrendPoint[], thresholdSeconds = 3 * 24 * 3600): (TrendPoint & { isMockGapPoint?: boolean })[] => {
  if (points.length <= 1) return points;
  const result: (TrendPoint & { isMockGapPoint?: boolean })[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
    if (i > 0) {
      const prevTime = new Date(points[i - 1].start_time).getTime();
      const currTime = new Date(points[i].start_time).getTime();
      const diffSec = (currTime - prevTime) / 1000;
      if (diffSec > thresholdSeconds) {
        const midTimeIso = new Date(prevTime + (currTime - prevTime) / 2).toISOString();
        result.push({
          session_id: 'gap-' + prevTime + '-' + currTime,
          start_time: midTimeIso,
          value: null,
          status: 'gap',
          isMockGapPoint: true
        } as any);
      }
    }
    result.push(points[i]);
  }
  return result;
};

export function Trends({ 
  activeUserId, 
  targetSessionId,
  onNavigateToSession,
  activeWorkContext,
  journeyContext
}: { 
  activeUserId?: string; 
  targetSessionId?: string;
  onNavigateToSession?: (id: string) => void;
  activeWorkContext?: ActiveWorkContext | null;
  journeyContext?: AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null;
  onDispatchCommand?: (command: AthleteJourneyCommand) => Promise<AthleteCoreJourneyContext | null>;
}) {
  const { t, language } = useT();
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState<string>('all');
  const [periodWindow, setPeriodWindow] = useState<'2w' | '4w' | '3m' | '6m' | 'all'>('all');
  const [explanationSessionId, setExplanationSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [explanationData, setExplanationData] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [explanationLoading, setExplanationLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // G5 Longitudinal State
  const [longitudinalSnapshot, setLongitudinalSnapshot] = useState<LongitudinalSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [loadingLongitudinal, setLoadingLongitudinal] = useState(false);
  const [savedViews, setSavedViews] = useState<SavedLongitudinalView[]>([]);
  const [showSaveViewModal, setShowSaveViewModal] = useState(false);
  const [newViewName, setNewViewName] = useState('');
  const [viewSaveMessage, setViewSaveMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [trendsData, setTrendsData] = useState<TrendsResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [tableSortKey, setTableSortKey] = useState<string>('start_time');
  const [tableSortDir, setTableSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');

  const [hoveredSession, setHoveredSession] = useState<{
    x: number;
    y: number;
    date: string;
    value: number;
    reason: string;
    visible: boolean;
  }>({ x: 0, y: 0, date: '', value: 0, reason: '', visible: false });

  const TrendsContainer = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const rmssdRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const sdnnRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hrRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const rmssdPlot = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);
  const sdnnPlot = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);
  const hrPlot = useRef<uPlot | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    api.getTrends({
      user_id: activeUserId,
      activity_type: activity,
      window: periodWindow
    })
      .then(setTrendsData)
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [activeUserId, activity, periodWindow]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const profileId = activeUserId || activeWorkContext?.profile_id || 'default';
    setLoadingLongitudinal(true);
    api.queryLongitudinalSeries({
      profile_id: profileId,
      target_session_id: targetSessionId
    }).then((res) => {
      if (res.success && res.snapshot) {
        setLongitudinalSnapshot(res.snapshot);
      }
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Longitudinal query failed:', err);
    }).finally(() => {
      setLoadingLongitudinal(false);
    });

    api.listSavedLongitudinalViews(profileId)
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.success && res.views) {
          setSavedViews(res.views);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [activeUserId, targetSessionId, activeWorkContext?.profile_id]);

  const handleSaveViewSubmit = async () => {
    if (!longitudinalSnapshot || !newViewName.trim()) return;
    try {
      const profileId = activeUserId || activeWorkContext?.profile_id || 'default';
      const res = await api.createSavedLongitudinalView({
        name: newViewName.trim(),
        profile_id: profileId,
        normalized_query: longitudinalSnapshot.query
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setSavedViews(prev => [res.view, ...prev]);
        setShowSaveViewModal(false);
        setNewViewName('');
        setViewSaveMessage(isRu ? 'Представление сохранено!' : 'View saved!');
        setTimeout(() => setViewSaveMessage(null), 3000);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || 'Ошибка сохранения представления');
    }
  };

  const handleOpenExplanation = async (sessionId: string) => {
    setExplanationSessionId(sessionId);
    setExplanationLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await api.getBaselineExplanation(sessionId);
      setExplanationData(data);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setExplanationData({ error: e.message || 'Ошибка загрузки объяснения' });
    } finally {
      setExplanationLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading || !trendsData || trendsData.sessions_count === 0) return;

    const rmssdSeries = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'rmssd_ms');
    const sdnnSeries = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'sdnn_ms');
    const hrSeries = trendsData.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'avg_hr_bpm');

    if (!rmssdSeries || !sdnnSeries || !hrSeries) return;

    const rawPoints = rmssdSeries.points;
    const gappedBasePoints = insertGaps(rawPoints);
    const xs = gappedBasePoints.map(p => new Date(p.start_time).getTime() / 1000);

    const makeGappedSeriesPoints = (origPoints: TrendPoint[]) => {
      return gappedBasePoints.map(bp => {
        if (bp.isMockGapPoint) {
          return {
            session_id: bp.session_id,
            start_time: bp.start_time,
            value: null,
            status: 'gap'
          };
        }
        const found = origPoints.find(op => op.session_id === bp.session_id);
        return found || {
          session_id: bp.session_id,
          start_time: bp.start_time,
          value: null,
          status: 'gap'
        };
      });
    };

    const gappedRmssd = makeGappedSeriesPoints(rmssdSeries.points) as TrendPoint[];
    const gappedSdnn = makeGappedSeriesPoints(sdnnSeries.points) as TrendPoint[];
    const gappedHr = makeGappedSeriesPoints(hrSeries.points) as TrendPoint[];

    const makePlotData = (seriesPoints: TrendPoint[], baselineBand: BaselineBand) => {
      const allSessionsList = trendsData.range_sessions || (trendsData as any).sessions || [];
      const valMain = seriesPoints.map(p => {
        const session = allSessionsList.find(s => s.id === p.session_id);
        if (session && session.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') return undefined;
        return p.value === null ? undefined : p.value;
      }) as any as number[];

      const valLimited = seriesPoints.map(p => {
        const session = allSessionsList.find(s => s.id === p.session_id);
        if (session && session.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
          return p.value === null ? undefined : p.value;
        }
        return undefined;
      }) as any as number[];

      const p25s = seriesPoints.map(() => baselineBand.p25 !== null ? baselineBand.p25 : undefined) as any as number[];
      const p75s = seriesPoints.map(() => baselineBand.p75 !== null ? baselineBand.p75 : undefined) as any as number[];
      const medians = seriesPoints.map(() => baselineBand.median !== null ? baselineBand.median : undefined) as any as number[];
      return [xs, valMain, valLimited, p25s, p75s, medians];
    };

    const commonOpts = (
      container: HTMLDivElement | null,
      label: string,
      color: string,
      baselineBand: BaselineBand,
      plotData: any[]
    ): uPlot | undefined => {
      if (!container) return undefined;

      const w = container.clientWidth || 700;
      const formatLegendVal = (_u: uPlot, val: number | null) => {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '';
        return typeof val === 'number' ? val.toFixed(1) : String(val);
      };

      const seriesOpts: uPlot.Series[] = [
        {}, // X axis
        {
          label,
          stroke: color,
          width: 2,
          points: { show: true, size: 6, fill: color },
          spanGaps: false,
          value: formatLegendVal,
        },
        {
          label: isRu ? 'Ограничено качеством' : 'Quality Limited',
          stroke: 'transparent',
          width: 0,
          points: { show: true, size: 8, fill: '#eab308' },
          spanGaps: false,
          value: formatLegendVal,
        }
      ];

      if (baselineBand.median !== null) {
        seriesOpts.push(
          {
            label: 'p25',
            stroke: 'transparent',
            width: 0,
            points: { show: false },
            value: () => ''
          },
          {
            label: 'p75',
            stroke: 'transparent',
            width: 0,
            points: { show: false },
            value: () => ''
          },
          {
            label: baselineBand.available 
              ? (isRu ? 'Медиана baseline' : 'Baseline Median') 
              : (isRu ? 'Справочный ориентир (медиана)' : 'Reference Median'),
            stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)',
            width: 1,
            dash: [5, 5],
            points: { show: false },
            value: formatLegendVal
          }
        );
      }

      const opts: uPlot.Options = {
        width: Math.max(w, 400),
        height: 160,
        cursor: { sync: { key: 'trends-sync' } },
        axes: [
          {
            stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
            ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
            grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
            values: (u, ticks) => ticks.map((t) => formatDateShort(new Date(t * 1000).toISOString(), language)),
          },
          {
            stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
            ticks: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' },
            grid: { stroke: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' },
          },
        ],
        series: seriesOpts,
        bands: baselineBand.median !== null ? [
          {
            series: [3, 4],
            fill: baselineBand.available ? 'rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.08)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.08)'
          }
        ] : undefined,
        hooks: {
          setCursor: [
            self => {
              const { idx, left, top } = self.cursor;
              if (idx !== null && idx !== undefined && left !== undefined && top !== undefined && left >= 0 && top >= 0) {
                const bp = gappedBasePoints[idx];
                if (bp && !bp.isMockGapPoint) {
                  const session = trendsData.range_sessions.find(s => s.id === bp.session_id);
                  if (session && session.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
                    const rect = self.over.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const containerRect = TrendsContainer.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const x = rect.left - (containerRect?.left || 0) + left + 15;
                    const y = rect.top - (containerRect?.top || 0) + top - 45;
                    setHoveredSession({
                      x,
                      y,
                      date: formatDateShort(bp.start_time, language),
                      value: bp.value || 0,
                      reason: isRu 
                        ? 'Низкое качество сигнала / высокий уровень шума (рекомендуется пересчет)' 
                        : 'Poor signal quality / high noise level (recalculation recommended)',
                      visible: true
                    });
                    return;
                  }
                }
              }
              setHoveredSession(prev => prev.visible ? { ...prev, visible: false } : prev);
            }
          ]
        }
      };

      return new uPlot(opts, plotData, container);
    };

    rmssdPlot.current?.destroy();
    sdnnPlot.current?.destroy();
    hrPlot.current?.destroy();

    const rmssdData = makePlotData(gappedRmssd, trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms);
    const sdnnData = makePlotData(gappedSdnn, trendsData.baseline.sdnn_ms);
    const hrData = makePlotData(gappedHr, trendsData.baseline.avg_hr_bpm);

    if (rmssdRef.current) {
      rmssdPlot.current = commonOpts(rmssdRef.current, `${t('thRmssd')} (${t('msUnit')})`, 'hsl(152,75%,55%)', trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms, rmssdData) || null;
    }
    if (sdnnRef.current) {
      sdnnPlot.current = commonOpts(sdnnRef.current, `SDNN (${t('msUnit')})`, 'hsl(220,85%,65%)', trendsData.baseline.sdnn_ms, sdnnData) || null;
    }
    if (hrRef.current) {
      hrPlot.current = commonOpts(hrRef.current, t('thAvgHr'), 'hsl(6,90%,65%)', trendsData.baseline.avg_hr_bpm, hrData) || null;
    }

    return () => {
      rmssdPlot.current?.destroy();
      sdnnPlot.current?.destroy();
      hrPlot.current?.destroy();
    };
  }, [trendsData, loading, language, t]);

  const activityOptions = [
    { value: 'all', label: isRu ? 'Все активности' : 'All Activities' },
    { value: 'cardio', label: isRu ? 'Кардио' : 'Cardio' },
    { value: 'sleep', label: isRu ? 'Сон' : 'Sleep' },
    { value: 'mixed', label: isRu ? 'Смешанная' : 'Mixed' },
    { value: 'morning_hrv', label: isRu ? 'Утренний HRV' : 'Morning HRV' },
    { value: 'recovery', label: isRu ? 'Восстановление' : 'Recovery' },
    { value: 'strength', label: isRu ? 'Силовая' : 'Strength' },
    { value: 'other', label: isRu ? 'Другое' : 'Other' }
  ];

  const getStatusBadgeColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'above_baseline': return '#22c55e';
      case 'below_baseline': return '#ef4444';
      case 'within_baseline': return '#0ea5e9';
      case 'quality_limited': return '#eab308';
      case 'insufficient_data': return '#64748b';
      case 'reference_only': return '#64748b';
      default: return 'transparent';
    }
  };

  const getStatusText = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'above_baseline': return t('trendStatusAbove');
      case 'below_baseline': return t('trendStatusBelow');
      case 'within_baseline': return t('trendStatusWithin');
      case 'quality_limited': return t('trendQualityLimitedHover');
      case 'insufficient_data': return t('trendStatusInsufficient');
      case 'reference_only': return t('trendStatusReference');
      default: return 'н/д';
    }
  };

  const sessionsCount = trendsData?.sessions_count ?? 0;
  const avgQuality = trendsData?.quality_summary?.average_quality_score ?? null;
  const limitedCount = trendsData?.quality_summary?.quality_limited_count ?? 0;
  const rangeSessions = trendsData?.range_sessions || (trendsData as any)?.sessions || [];

  const isBaselineAvailable = trendsData?.personal_baseline_available ?? false;
  let reliability: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' = 'low';
  if (isBaselineAvailable && avgQuality !== null && avgQuality >= 80) {
    reliability = 'high';
  } else if (sessionsCount >= 3) {
    reliability = 'medium';
  }

  const handleTableSort = (key: string) => {
    if (key === tableSortKey) {
      setTableSortDir(d => d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setTableSortKey(key);
      setTableSortDir('desc');
    }
  };

  const sortArrow = (key: string) => {
    if (tableSortKey !== key) return null;
    return tableSortDir === 'asc' ? ' ▲' : ' ▼';
  };

  const sortedSessions = [...rangeSessions].sort((a, b) => {
    let av = a[tableSortKey];
    let bv = b[tableSortKey];

    if (tableSortKey === 'start_time') {
      av = new Date(av).getTime();
      bv = new Date(bv).getTime();
    }

    if (av === null || av === undefined) return tableSortDir === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
    if (bv === null || bv === undefined) return tableSortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

    if (typeof av === 'string') {
      return tableSortDir === 'asc' ? av.localeCompare(bv) : bv.localeCompare(av);
    }
    return tableSortDir === 'asc' ? av - bv : bv - av;
  });

  const rmssdSeries = trendsData?.metrics.find(m => m.metric_key === 'rmssd_ms');
  const xs = rmssdSeries ? rmssdSeries.points.map(p => new Date(p.start_time).getTime() / 1000) : [];
  const hasGaps = xs.some((x, idx) => idx > 0 && (x - xs[idx-1]) > 3 * 24 * 3600);

  const selectedActivityName = activityOptions.find(opt => opt.value === activity)?.label || activity;

  return (
    <div className="fade-in" ref={TrendsContainer} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h1>{t('trendsTitle')}</h1>
          <p>{t('trendsSubtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {/* Period Selector */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '4px', background: '#1e293b', padding: '3px', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid #334155' }}>
            {(['2w', '4w', '3m', '6m', 'all'] as const).map(w => (
              <button
                key={w}
                type="button"
                id={`period-btn-${w}`}
                className={periodWindow === w ? 'btn-period-active' : ''}
                onClick={() => setPeriodWindow(w)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  borderRadius: '5px',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: periodWindow === w ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'transparent',
                  color: periodWindow === w ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                  fontWeight: periodWindow === w ? 'bold' : 'normal',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease'
                }}
              >
                {w === '2w' ? (isRu ? '2 недели' : '2 weeks') :
                 w === '4w' ? (isRu ? '4 недели' : '4 weeks') :
                 w === '3m' ? (isRu ? '3 месяца' : '3 months') :
                 w === '6m' ? (isRu ? '6 месяцев' : '6 months') : (isRu ? 'Вся история' : 'All')}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {isRu ? 'Категория:' : 'Category:'}
            </label>
            <select 
              id="trends-category-select"
              value={activity} 
              onChange={(e) => setActivity(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 12px',
                fontSize: '0.85rem',
                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                border: '1px solid #334155',
                borderRadius: '6px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}
            >
              {activityOptions.map(opt => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <PageSnapshotButton
            pageName="Trends"
            metadata={{
              activeUser: activeUserId,
              selectedCategory: activity,
              personalBaselineAvailable: trendsData?.personal_baseline_available ?? false,
              sessionsUsed: trendsData?.sessions_used ?? 0,
              pointCounts: trendsData?.metrics?.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.points?.length || 0), 0) || 0,
              filters: { activity, period: trendsData?.period },
              confidence: trendsData?.baseline_confidence || 'none'
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {targetSessionId && (
        <div className="card" style={{
          borderColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)',
          marginBottom: '16px',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center'
        }}>
          <div>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--accent-primary)', marginRight: '8px' }}>
              🎯 {isRu ? 'Целевая сессия для сравнения:' : 'Target Comparison Session:'}
            </span>
            <code style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>{targetSessionId}</code>
          </div>
          {onNavigateToSession && (
            <button 
              className="btn btn-secondary" 
              style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
              onClick={() => onNavigateToSession(targetSessionId)}
            >
              {isRu ? 'Открыть паспорт' : 'Open Passport'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,70,50,0.3)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: '80px' }}>
          <span className="spinner" />
        </div>
      ) : sessionsCount === 0 ? (
        <div className="card">
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            {isRu ? 'Нет записанных тренировок с выбранными фильтрами.' : 'No sessions recorded with selected filters.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {viewSaveMessage && (
            <div className="card" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)', borderColor: '#10b981', color: '#10b981', marginBottom: '16px', padding: '10px 14px' }}>
              ✓ {viewSaveMessage}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* G5 Longitudinal Timeline & Personal Baseline */}
          {longitudinalSnapshot && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '24px' }}>
              <LongitudinalTimeline
                snapshot={longitudinalSnapshot}
                locale={isRu ? 'ru' : 'en'}
                onSelectSession={(sid) => onNavigateToSession && onNavigateToSession(sid)}
                onSaveView={() => setShowSaveViewModal(true)}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {activity !== 'all' && !isBaselineAvailable && (
            <div className="card" style={{
              borderColor: 'var(--accent-warning)',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(234,179,8,0.06)',
              marginBottom: '16px',
              padding: '12px 16px',
              borderLeft: '4px solid var(--accent-warning)'
            }}>
              <p style={{ margin: '0', fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#facc15', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                ⚠️ {t('trendFilterInsufficient')} ({sessionsCount} / 5)
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr))', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
            <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Всего сессий' : 'Total Sessions'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: '#f8fafc' }}>{sessionsCount}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Среднее качество' : 'Average Quality'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: '#38bdf8' }}>{avgQuality ? `${avgQuality}%` : '—'}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Ограничено качеством' : 'Quality Limited'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: limitedCount > 0 ? '#eab308' : '#f8fafc' }}>{limitedCount}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="card" style={{ padding: '12px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
                {isRu ? 'Исключено скрытых' : 'Excluded Hidden'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1.4rem', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{trendsData?.hidden_sessions_excluded ?? 0}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {trendsData && (
            <div className="card" style={{ padding: '16px', marginBottom: '20px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5)', border: '1px solid #334155' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: '16px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px' }}>
                  <div style={{ 
                    width: '10px', 
                    height: '10px', 
                    borderRadius: '50%', 
                    backgroundColor: isBaselineAvailable ? '#22c55e' : '#eab308' 
                  }} />
                  <div>
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#f1f5f9', display: 'block' }}>
                      {isBaselineAvailable 
                        ? (isRu ? `Личный физиологический профиль (Baseline) — ${selectedActivityName}` : `Personal physiological baseline — ${selectedActivityName}`) 
                        : (isRu ? 'Справочный ориентир (Reference Fallback)' : 'Reference Guide (Global Fallback)')}
                    </strong>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {isBaselineAvailable 
                        ? (isRu 
                            ? `Профиль сформирован на основе ${trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms.sessions_used} качественных сессий.` 
                            : `Profile built using ${trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms.sessions_used} high-quality sessions.`) 
                        : (trendsData.baseline_qualification_breakdown ? (
                            <span>
                              {isRu ? trendsData.baseline_qualification_breakdown.explanation_ru : trendsData.baseline_qualification_breakdown.explanation_en}
                            </span>
                          ) : (isRu 
                            ? `Недостаточно качественных сессий (${trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms.sessions_used} из 5). В качестве справочных ориентиров показаны глобальные ориентиры.` 
                            : `Insufficient quality sessions (${trendsData.baseline.rmssd_ms.sessions_used} of 5). Using global reference guides.`))
                      }
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    {isRu ? 'Уровень достоверности:' : 'Confidence Level:'}
                  </span>
                  <span 
                    style={{ 
                      fontSize: '0.78rem', 
                      fontWeight: 'bold',
                      padding: '4px 10px', 
                      borderRadius: '20px', 
                      backgroundColor: 
                        reliability === 'high' ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : 
                        reliability === 'medium' ? 'rgba(14,165,233,0.1)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)',
                      color: 
                        reliability === 'high' ? '#4ade80' : 
                        reliability === 'medium' ? '#38bdf8' : '#f87171',
                      border: `1px solid ${
                        reliability === 'high' ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.2)' : 
                        reliability === 'medium' ? 'rgba(14,165,233,0.2)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)'
                      }`
                    }}
                  >
                    {reliability === 'high' ? (isRu ? 'Высокий' : 'High') : reliability === 'medium' ? (isRu ? 'Средний' : 'Medium') : (isRu ? 'Низкий' : 'Low')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              {!isBaselineAvailable && trendsData.baseline_qualification_breakdown && (() => {
                const b = trendsData.baseline_qualification_breakdown;
                return (
                  <div style={{ marginTop: '12px', paddingTop: '10px', borderTop: '1px solid #334155' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                      {isRu ? 'Квалификация сессий для личного базового коридора:' : 'Session qualification breakdown for personal baseline:'}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr))', gap: '6px', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{isRu ? 'Всего записей:' : 'Total sessions:'}</span> <strong>{b.total_sessions}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{isRu ? 'Дубликаты:' : 'Duplicates:'}</span> <strong>{b.duplicate_sessions_count}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{isRu ? 'Калибровка (< 60 с):' : 'Calibration (< 60s):'}</span> <strong>{b.calibration_short_count}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{isRu ? 'Ограничено качеством:' : 'Quality limited:'}</span> <strong>{b.quality_excluded_count}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{isRu ? 'Требуют перерасчета:' : 'Require recalculation:'}</span> <strong>{b.legacy_unverified_count}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ padding: '4px 8px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08)', borderRadius: '4px', border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)' }}>
                        <span style={{ color: '#34d399' }}>{isRu ? 'Принято для baseline:' : 'Accepted for baseline:'}</span> <strong style={{ color: '#34d399' }}>{b.accepted_baseline_sessions_count} / 5</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="chart-wrapper-group" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '24px' }}>
            <div>
              <TrendPanel 
                title={`${t('thRmssd')} (${t('msUnit')}) — ${t('rmssdLabel')}`} 
                metricKey="rmssd" 
                containerRef={rmssdRef}
                baseline={trendsData?.baseline.rmssd_ms}
                unit="мс"
                hasGaps={hasGaps}
                t={t}
              />
              {trendsData && (
                <MetricInterpretationPanel 
                  metricKey="rmssd"
                  trendsData={trendsData}
                  hasGaps={hasGaps}
                  language={language}
                  t={t}
                />
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <TrendPanel 
                title={`SDNN (${t('msUnit')}) — ${t('sdnnLabel')}`} 
                metricKey="sdnn" 
                containerRef={sdnnRef} 
                baseline={trendsData?.baseline.sdnn_ms}
                unit="мс"
                hasGaps={hasGaps}
                t={t}
              />
              {trendsData && (
                <MetricInterpretationPanel 
                  metricKey="sdnn"
                  trendsData={trendsData}
                  hasGaps={hasGaps}
                  language={language}
                  t={t}
                />
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <TrendPanel 
                title={`${t('thAvgHr')} (${t('bpmUnit')})`} 
                metricKey="avg_hr" 
                containerRef={hrRef}
                baseline={trendsData?.baseline.avg_hr_bpm}
                unit="уд/мин"
                hasGaps={hasGaps}
                t={t}
              />
              {trendsData && (
                <MetricInterpretationPanel 
                  metricKey="avg_hr"
                  trendsData={trendsData}
                  hasGaps={hasGaps}
                  language={language}
                  t={t}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {trendsData && (
            <AdditionalMetricsPanel 
              trendsData={trendsData}
              language={language}
              t={t}
            />
          )}

          <div className="card" style={{ marginTop: '24px', padding: '0', overflow: 'auto' }}>
            <table className="data-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('start_time')}>
                    {t('thDate')}{sortArrow('start_time')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('duration_seconds')}>
                    {t('thDuration')}{sortArrow('duration_seconds')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('active_duration_seconds')}>
                    {isRu ? 'Активное время' : 'Active Duration'}{sortArrow('active_duration_seconds')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('activity_type')}>
                    {isRu ? 'Тип' : 'Type'}{sortArrow('activity_type')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('rmssd')}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                      <span>{t('thRmssd')}</span>
                      <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><TermTooltip metricKey="rmssd" /></span>
                    </div>
                    {sortArrow('rmssd')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('sdnn')}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                      <span>SDNN</span>
                      <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><TermTooltip metricKey="sdnn" /></span>
                    </div>
                    {sortArrow('sdnn')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('pnn50')}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                      <span>pNN50</span>
                      <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><TermTooltip metricKey="pnn50" /></span>
                    </div>
                    {sortArrow('pnn50')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('avg_hr')}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
                      <span>{t('thAvgHr')}</span>
                      <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><TermTooltip metricKey="avg_hr" /></span>
                    </div>
                    {sortArrow('avg_hr')}
                  </th>
                  <th style={{ cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }} onClick={() => handleTableSort('hrv_quality')}>
                    {isRu ? 'Качество записи' : 'Quality'}{sortArrow('hrv_quality')}
                  </th>
                  <th>{isRu ? 'Baseline статус' : 'Baseline Status'}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {sortedSessions.map((r) => {
                  const handleRowSelection = () => {
                    if (onNavigateToSession) {
                      onNavigateToSession(r.id);
                    }
                  };

                  const getQualityBadgeText = (val: string) => {
                    switch (val) {
                      case 'excellent': return isRu ? 'Отличное' : 'Excellent';
                      case 'good': return isRu ? 'Хорошее' : 'Good';
                      case 'quality_limited': return isRu ? '⚠️ Шум/Лимит' : '⚠️ Quality Limited';
                      case 'insufficient_data': return isRu ? 'Мало данных' : 'Insufficient Data';
                      default: return val || 'н/д';
                    }
                  };

                  const getActivityLabel = (val: string) => {
                    switch (val) {
                      case 'cardio': return isRu ? 'Кардио' : 'Cardio';
                      case 'sleep': return isRu ? 'Сон' : 'Sleep';
                      case 'mixed': return isRu ? 'Смешанная' : 'Mixed';
                      case 'morning_hrv': return isRu ? 'Утренний HRV' : 'Morning HRV';
                      case 'recovery': return isRu ? 'Восстановление' : 'Recovery';
                      case 'strength': return isRu ? 'Силовая' : 'Strength';
                      case 'other': return isRu ? 'Другое' : 'Other';
                      default: return val || 'н/д';
                    }
                  };

                  const isTarget = r.id === targetSessionId;

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={r.id}
                      onClick={handleRowSelection}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleRowSelection();
                        }
                      }}
                      tabIndex={0}
                      className="focusable-row"
                      style={{ 
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                        borderLeft: isTarget ? '4px solid var(--accent-primary)' : undefined,
                        backgroundColor: isTarget ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)' : undefined
                      }}
                    >
                      <td style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>

                        {isTarget && (
                          <span 
                            className="badge" 
                            style={{ marginLeft: '6px', backgroundColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)', color: 'var(--accent-primary)', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}
                          >
                            🎯 {isRu ? 'Цель' : 'Target'}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>{Math.round(r.duration_seconds / 60)} {t('minutes')}</td>
                      <td>
                        {r.active_duration_seconds !== null && r.active_duration_seconds !== undefined
                          ? `${Math.round(r.active_duration_seconds / 60)} ${t('minutes')}`
                          : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td>{getActivityLabel(r.activity_type)}</td>
                      <td>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                          <span>{r.rmssd?.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}</span>
                          {r.rmssd && trendsData?.baseline.rmssd_ms.available && (
                            <span 
                              style={{ 
                                width: '6px', 
                                height: '6px', 
                                borderRadius: '50%', 
                                backgroundColor: getStatusBadgeColor(
                                  trendsData.metrics[0].points.find(p => p.session_id === r.id)?.status || ''
                                ) 
                              }} 
                              title={getStatusText(trendsData.metrics[0].points.find(p => p.session_id === r.id)?.status || '')}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td>{r.sdnn?.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}</td>
                      <td>{r.pnn50?.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}%</td>
                      <td>{r.avg_hr ? `${Math.round(r.avg_hr)}` : '—'}</td>
                      <td>
                        <span 
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            padding: '2px 6px',
                            borderRadius: '4px',
                            backgroundColor: r.hrv_quality === 'excellent' ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' : r.hrv_quality === 'good' ? 'rgba(14,165,233,0.1)' : r.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? 'rgba(234,179,8,0.1)' : 'rgba(100,116,139,0.1)',
                            color: r.hrv_quality === 'excellent' ? '#4ade80' : r.hrv_quality === 'good' ? '#38bdf8' : r.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited' ? '#facc15' : '#94a3b8'
                          }}
                        >
                          {getQualityBadgeText(r.hrv_quality)}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        {r.baseline_eligible ? (
                          <span 
                            className="badge" 
                            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.15)', color: '#4ade80', fontSize: '0.72rem', padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                          >
                            🎯 {isRu ? 'В baseline' : 'Eligible'}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}>
                            <span 
                              className="badge" 
                              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)', color: '#f87171', fontSize: '0.72rem', padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: '4px' }}
                            >
                              ✕ {isRu ? 'Исключена' : 'Excluded'}
                            </span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="baseline-explain-btn btn-why-excluded"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenExplanation(r.id)}
                              style={{
                                padding: '2px 6px',
                                fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
                                color: '#38bdf8',
                                border: '1px solid #334155',
                                borderRadius: '4px',
                                cursor: 'pointer'
                              }}
                              title={isRu ? 'Почему эта запись не в baseline?' : 'Why is this session excluded from baseline?'}
                            >
                              ℹ️ {isRu ? 'Почему?' : 'Why?'}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {hoveredSession.visible && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          left: hoveredSession.x,
          top: hoveredSession.y,
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          border: '1px solid #eab308',
          borderRadius: '4px',
          padding: '8px',
          zIndex: 10000,
          color: '#f8fafc',
          fontSize: '0.78rem',
          boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}>
          <strong style={{ color: '#eab308' }}>⚠️ {t('trendQualityLimitedHover')}</strong>
          <div>{hoveredSession.date} · {hoveredSession.value.toFixed(1)}</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#cbd5e1' }}>{hoveredSession.reason}</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Excluded Session Explanation Modal */}
      {explanationSessionId && (
        <div
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            zIndex: 9999,
          }}
          onClick={() => { setExplanationSessionId(null); setExplanationData(null); }}
        >
          <div
            id="modal-baseline-explanation"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
              border: '1px solid #475569',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              padding: '24px',
              maxWidth: '520px',
              width: '90%',
              boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
              color: '#f8fafc',
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 12px 0', fontSize: '1.15rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>
              ℹ️ {isRu ? 'Статус включения в Baseline' : 'Baseline Eligibility Breakdown'}
            </h3>

            {explanationLoading ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '20px' }}>
                <span className="spinner" />
              </div>
            ) : explanationData ? (
              <div>
                <p style={{ margin: '0 0 12px 0', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  {isRu ? 'Сессия:' : 'Session:'} <code>{explanationSessionId}</code>
                </p>
                <div
                  style={{
                    padding: '12px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    backgroundColor: (explanationData.eligible || explanationData.is_eligible) ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
                    border: `1px solid ${(explanationData.eligible || explanationData.is_eligible) ? '#22c55e44' : '#ef444444'}`,
                    marginBottom: '16px'
                  }}
                >
                  <strong style={{ color: (explanationData.eligible || explanationData.is_eligible) ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171', display: 'block', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
                    {(explanationData.eligible || explanationData.is_eligible)
                      ? (isRu ? '✓ Сессия допущена в личный baseline' : '✓ Session is eligible for baseline')
                      : (isRu ? '✕ Сессия исключена из личного baseline' : '✕ Session excluded from personal baseline')}
                  </strong>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: '6px' }}>
                    <span style={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      backgroundColor: explanationData.rmssd_included ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                      color: explanationData.rmssd_included ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171'
                    }}>
                      RMSSD: {explanationData.rmssd_included ? (isRu ? 'Включен' : 'Included') : (isRu ? 'Исключен' : 'Excluded')}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      backgroundColor: explanationData.sdnn_included ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                      color: explanationData.sdnn_included ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171'
                    }}>
                      SDNN: {explanationData.sdnn_included ? (isRu ? 'Включен' : 'Included') : (isRu ? 'Исключен' : 'Excluded')}
                    </span>
                    <span style={{
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      padding: '2px 8px',
                      borderRadius: '4px',
                      backgroundColor: explanationData.mean_hr_included ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                      color: explanationData.mean_hr_included ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171'
                    }}>
                      ЧСС: {explanationData.mean_hr_included ? (isRu ? 'Включен' : 'Included') : (isRu ? 'Исключен' : 'Excluded')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#cbd5e1', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: '8px', color: '#e2e8f0' }}>
                    {isRu ? 'Точные критерии и причины исключения:' : 'Exact Criteria & Exclusion Reasons:'}
                  </div>
                  {explanationData.reasons && explanationData.reasons.length > 0 ? (
                    <ul style={{ margin: '0', paddingLeft: '20px', lineHeight: '1.6' }}>
                      {explanationData.reasons.map((r: string, idx: number) => (
                        <li key={idx} style={{ color: r.includes('пригодна') ? '#4ade80' : '#cbd5e1' }}>
                          {r}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  ) : (
                    <p style={{ margin: '0', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                      {explanationData.explanation_ru || explanationData.summary_ru || (isRu ? 'Причины не указаны' : 'No reasons stated')}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b', borderTop: '1px solid #334155', paddingTop: '10px' }}>
                  <span>{isRu ? 'Орган протокола:' : 'Protocol Authority:'} Frozen Protocol v1.1 / TaskEligibility.ts</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '16px' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                id="btn-close-baseline-modal"
                onClick={() => { setExplanationSessionId(null); setExplanationData(null); }}
                style={{
                  padding: '8px 18px',
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                  color: '#ffffff',
                  border: 'none',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                }}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Закрыть' : 'Close'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Save Longitudinal View Modal */}
      {showSaveViewModal && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          inset: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 1000,
          padding: '1rem'
        }}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
            padding: '1.5rem',
            borderRadius: '0.5rem',
            maxWidth: '400px',
            width: '100%',
            border: '1px solid #334155',
            color: '#f8fafc'
          }}>
            <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem 0', fontSize: '1.1rem' }}>
              {isRu ? 'Сохранить продольное представление' : 'Save Longitudinal View'}
            </h3>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newViewName}
              onChange={(e) => setNewViewName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isRu ? 'Название представления...' : 'View name...'}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '0.5rem',
                borderRadius: '0.375rem',
                border: '1px solid #475569',
                backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                color: '#f8fafc',
                marginBottom: '1rem'
              }}
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowSaveViewModal(false)}
                style={{
                  padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
                  borderRadius: '0.375rem',
                  border: '1px solid #475569',
                  backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                  color: '#94a3b8',
                  cursor: 'pointer'
                }}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Отмена' : 'Cancel'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveViewSubmit}
                style={{
                  padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
                  borderRadius: '0.375rem',
                  border: 'none',
                  backgroundColor: '#3b82f6',
                  color: '#ffffff',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 600
                }}
              >
                {isRu ? 'Сохранить' : 'Save'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function TrendPanel({
  title,
  metricKey,
  containerRef,
  baseline,
  unit,
  hasGaps,
  t
}: {
  title: string;
  metricKey?: string;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  baseline?: BaselineBand;
  unit: string;
  hasGaps: boolean;
  t: (k: string) => string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="chart-container" style={{ marginBottom: '16px', position: 'relative' }}>
      <div className="chart-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
        <div className="chart-title" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', margin: '0' }}>
          <span>{title}</span>
          {metricKey && <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><TermTooltip metricKey={metricKey} /></span>}
        </div>
        {baseline && baseline.median !== null && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
            {baseline.available ? (t('trendStatusWithin') + ' baseline') : t('trendStatusReference')}: {baseline.p25} – {baseline.p75} {unit} (медиана: {baseline.median})
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {hasGaps && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontStyle: 'italic', marginBottom: '4px' }}>
          ⚠️ {t('trendGapWarning')}
        </div>
      )}

      <div ref={containerRef} />
    </div>
  );
}
