import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, UserProfile } from '../api';
import { useT } from '../i18n/LanguageContext';
import { AppDialog } from '../components/AppDialog';
import { AppSelect } from '../components/AppSelect';
import { PageSnapshotButton } from '../components/PageSnapshotButton';

export function Users() {
  const { t } = useT();
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteProfileId, setDeleteProfileId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [alertText, setAlertText] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Form state
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    id: '',
    display_name: '',
    export_alias: '',
    relationship_label: 'self',
    age: '',
    resting_hr: '',
    max_hr: '',
  });

  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfiles();
  }, []);

  function loadProfiles() {
    setLoading(true);
    api.getUserProfiles()
      .then(setProfiles)
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }

  function handleEdit(user: UserProfile) {
    setEditingId(user.id);
    setFormData({
      id: user.id,
      display_name: user.display_name,
      export_alias: user.export_alias,
      relationship_label: user.relationship_label || 'self',
      age: user.age ? String(user.age) : '',
      resting_hr: user.resting_hr ? String(user.resting_hr) : '',
      max_hr: user.max_hr ? String(user.max_hr) : '',
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  function handleAddNew() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setFormData({
      id: '',
      display_name: '',
      export_alias: '',
      relationship_label: 'self',
      age: '',
      resting_hr: '',
      max_hr: '',
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  }

  const [deleteDisposition, setDeleteDisposition] = useState<'detach_as_unassigned' | 'reassign_to_selected_profile'>('detach_as_unassigned');
  const [targetReassignProfileId, setTargetReassignProfileId] = useState<string>('');

  async function handleDelete(id: string) {
    if (id === 'default' || id === '1') {
      setAlertText(t('errorDeleteDefault') || 'Удаление основного профиля приложения запрещено');
      return;
    }
    setDeleteProfileId(id);
    setDeleteDisposition('detach_as_unassigned');
    const otherProfiles = profiles.filter(p => p.id !== id);
    if (otherProfiles.length > 0) {
      setTargetReassignProfileId(otherProfiles[0].id);
    }
  }

  async function handleConfirmDelete() {
    if (!deleteProfileId) return;
    try {
      const plan = await api.planLifecycle('delete_profile', deleteProfileId, {
        disposition: deleteDisposition,
        target_profile_id: deleteDisposition === 'reassign_to_selected_profile' ? targetReassignProfileId : null
      });
      if (plan.blockers && plan.blockers.length > 0) {
        setAlertText(plan.blockers.join('\n'));
        return;
      }
      await api.deleteProfileLifecycle(
        deleteProfileId,
        deleteDisposition,
        deleteDisposition === 'reassign_to_selected_profile' ? targetReassignProfileId : null,
        plan.cas_token
      );
      loadProfiles();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setDeleteProfileId(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const { id, display_name, export_alias, relationship_label, age, resting_hr, max_hr } = formData;

    if (!id || !display_name || !export_alias) {
      setError('Please fill in ID, Display Name, and Export Alias');
      return;
    }

    // ID must be alphanumeric
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(id)) {
      setError('ID must be alphanumeric (letters, numbers, _ or - only)');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const payload = {
        id,
        display_name,
        export_alias,
        relationship_label,
        age: age ? parseInt(age, 10) : null,
        resting_hr: resting_hr ? parseInt(resting_hr, 10) : null,
        max_hr: max_hr ? parseInt(max_hr, 10) : null,
        is_active: 1,
      };

      if (editingId) {
        await api.updateUserProfile(editingId, payload);
      } else {
        // Check if ID already exists
        if (profiles.some((p) => p.id === id)) {
          setError(`Profile with ID "${id}" already exists`);
          return;
        }
        await api.createUserProfile(payload);
      }

      setShowForm(false);
      loadProfiles();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  }

  function getRelationshipText(rel?: string | null) {
    switch (rel) {
      case 'self': return t('relationshipSelf');
      case 'wife': return t('relationshipWife');
      case 'sister': return t('relationshipSister');
      case 'other': return t('relationshipOther');
      default: return rel || '—';
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', marginTop: '80px' }}>
        <span className="spinner" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fade-in">
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <div>
          <h1>{t('usersTitle')}</h1>
          <p>{t('usersSubtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <PageSnapshotButton pageName="Users" metadata={{ profilesCount: profiles.length }} />
          {!showForm && (
            <button className="btn-primary" onClick={handleAddNew}>
              {t('addUser')}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(255,70,50,0.3)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--accent-danger)' }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {showForm && (
        <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: '24px', maxWidth: '600px' }}>
          <div className="section-title">
            {editingId ? t('editUser') : t('addUser')}
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '16px' }}>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="user-id">ID</label>
                <input
                  id="user-id"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="text"
                  disabled={!!editingId}
                  placeholder="e.g. wife_profile"
                  value={formData.id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, id: e.target.value })}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="display-name">{t('displayName')}</label>
                <input
                  id="display-name"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Аня"
                  value={formData.display_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, display_name: e.target.value })}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="export-alias">{t('exportAlias')}</label>
                <input
                  id="export-alias"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Wife"
                  value={formData.export_alias}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, export_alias: e.target.value })}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="relationship">{t('relationshipLabel')}</label>
                <AppSelect
                  id="relationship"
                  value={formData.relationship_label}
                  onChange={(val) => setFormData({ ...formData, relationship_label: val })}
                  options={[
                    { value: 'self', label: t('relationshipSelf') },
                    { value: 'wife', label: t('relationshipWife') },
                    { value: 'sister', label: t('relationshipSister') },
                    { value: 'other', label: t('relationshipOther') }
                  ]}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="age">{t('age')}</label>
                <input
                  id="age"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="number"
                  placeholder="e.g. 30"
                  value={formData.age}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, age: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="resting-hr">{t('restingHrLabel')}</label>
                <input
                  id="resting-hr"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="number"
                  placeholder="e.g. 60"
                  value={formData.resting_hr}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, resting_hr: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="max-hr">{t('maxHrLabel')}</label>
                <input
                  id="max-hr"
                  className="form-input"
                  type="number"
                  placeholder="e.g. 190"
                  value={formData.max_hr}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, max_hr: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px', marginTop: '20px' }}>
              <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
                {t('saveProfileBtn')}

              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn-secondary"
                onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}
                style={{ background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' }}
              >
                {t('backToList') || 'Cancel'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: '20px' }}>
        {profiles.map((user) => (

            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.1rem', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {user.display_name}
                </h3>

              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '8px 16px' }}>

                type="button"

================================================================================

export type AccMovementPattern = 'dynamic_motion_observed' | 'predominantly_static' | 'insufficient_data';

export type AccActivityStats = {
  coverage_percent: number;
  raw_mag_mg_median: number | null;
  dynamic_mag_mg_median: number | null;
  dynamic_mag_mg_p95: number | null;
  stationary_percent: number;
  low_motion_percent: number;
  medium_motion_percent: number;
  high_motion_percent: number;
  movement_pattern: AccMovementPattern;
  reason: string[];
  sample_rate_hz?: number;
  time_unit: 'seconds';
};

function calculateMedian(arr: number[]): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
  return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
}

function calculatePercentile(arr: number[], p: number): number {
  if (arr.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(sorted.length * p));
  return sorted[idx];
}

export function calculateAccActivityStats(
  points: [number, number][],
  durationSeconds: number,
  sampleRateHz?: number
): AccActivityStats {
  if (points.length === 0 || durationSeconds <= 0) {
    return {
      coverage_percent: 0,
      raw_mag_mg_median: null,
      dynamic_mag_mg_median: null,
      dynamic_mag_mg_p95: null,
      stationary_percent: 0,
      low_motion_percent: 0,
      medium_motion_percent: 0,
      high_motion_percent: 0,
      movement_pattern: 'insufficient_data',
      reason: ['Недостаточно данных для анализа активности.'],
      sample_rate_hz: sampleRateHz,
      time_unit: 'seconds'
    };
  }

  const rawMags = points.map(p => p[1]);
  const rawMagMedian = calculateMedian(rawMags);

  // Compute dynamic magnitude (mG) after subtracting rolling median
  // window size = 5 (implementation_assumption)
  const windowSize = 5;
  const dynamicMags: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
    const start = Math.max(0, i - Math.floor(windowSize / 2));
    const end = Math.min(points.length - 1, i + Math.floor(windowSize / 2));
    const windowValues = rawMags.slice(start, end + 1);
    const rollingMedian = calculateMedian(windowValues);
    // dynamic motion = deviation from rolling baseline
    const dynamic = Math.abs(rawMags[i] - rollingMedian);
    dynamicMags.push(dynamic);
  }

  const dynamicMagMedian = calculateMedian(dynamicMags);
  const dynamicMagP95 = calculatePercentile(dynamicMags, 0.95);

  // Calculate percentages based on implementation_assumption thresholds
  let stationaryCount = 0;
  let lowCount = 0;
  let medCount = 0;
  let highCount = 0;

  dynamicMags.forEach((val) => {
    if (val < 15) {
      stationaryCount++;
    } else if (val < 150) {
      lowCount++;
    } else if (val < 500) {
      medCount++;
    } else {
      highCount++;
    }
  });

  const total = dynamicMags.length;
  const stationaryPercent = Math.round((stationaryCount / total) * 100);
  const lowPercent = Math.round((lowCount / total) * 100);
  const medPercent = Math.round((medCount / total) * 100);
  const highPercent = Math.round((highCount / total) * 100);

  // Compute coverage (acc points duration vs session duration; strictly elapsed seconds)
  const timeSpanSeconds = Math.abs(points[points.length - 1][0] - points[0][0]);
  const coveragePercent = durationSeconds > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((timeSpanSeconds / durationSeconds) * 100)) : 0;

  // Determine movement pattern from observed dynamic acceleration
  let movementPattern: AccMovementPattern = 'dynamic_motion_observed';
  const reason: string[] = [];

  if (total < 20) {
    movementPattern = 'insufficient_data';
    reason.push('Недостаточная продолжительность записи акселерометра.');
  } else if (stationaryPercent >= 90) {
    movementPattern = 'predominantly_static';
    reason.push('Преимущественно статичное положение датчика (динамическое движение минимально или отсутствует).');
  } else {
    movementPattern = 'dynamic_motion_observed';
    reason.push('Зафиксирован динамический характер движения датчика.');
  }

  return {
    coverage_percent: coveragePercent,
    raw_mag_mg_median: Math.round(rawMagMedian),
    dynamic_mag_mg_median: Math.round(dynamicMagMedian),
    dynamic_mag_mg_p95: Math.round(dynamicMagP95),
    stationary_percent: stationaryPercent,
    low_motion_percent: lowPercent,
    medium_motion_percent: medPercent,
    high_motion_percent: highPercent,
    movement_pattern: movementPattern,
    reason,
    sample_rate_hz: sampleRateHz,
    time_unit: 'seconds'
  };
}

/**
 * CardioLab Workstation G6 — ActiveWorkContext Contract
 *
 * Defines the unified, bounded projection of active user context spanning G1–G5 authorities:
 * - Profile identity
 * - G4 Work Episode and Repeat Series
 * - G3 Canonical Session, Source, and Result
 * - G2 Analysis Window and Revision
 * - G2 Comparison (Target / Peer)
 * - G5 Longitudinal Snapshot and Saved View
 * - G4 LLM Pack and Diary lineage
 * - Privacy mode and Currentness lifecycle
 * - Monotonic generation counter for late async response protection
 */

export const ACTIVE_WORK_CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type ContextCurrentness =
  | 'current'
  | 'historical'
  | 'superseded'
  | 'unavailable';

export type ContextPrivacyMode =
  | 'standard'
  | 'strict_anonymized';

export interface ActiveWorkContext {
  schema_version: string;
  context_id: string;
  profile_id: string;
  active_episode_id: string | null;
  active_series_id: string | null;
  canonical_session_id: string | null;
  canonical_source_id: string | null;
  canonical_result_hash: string | null;
  active_window_id: string | null;
  active_window_revision: number | null;
  compare_target_session_id: string | null;
  compare_peer_session_id: string | null;
  longitudinal_snapshot_id: string | null;
  saved_view_id: string | null;
  saved_view_revision: number | null;
  active_pack_id: string | null;
  active_diary_id: string | null;
  privacy_mode: ContextPrivacyMode;
  currentness: ContextCurrentness;
  currentness_reason: string | null;
  derived_next_action_code: string | null;
  context_generation: number;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export class CrossProfileContextError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly expectedProfileId: string,
    public readonly conflictingProfileId: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'CrossProfileContextError';
  }
}

export class ContextGenerationRaceError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly currentGeneration: number,
    public readonly incomingGeneration: number
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ContextGenerationRaceError';
  }
}

export class ActiveContextValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'INVALID_CONTEXT') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ActiveContextValidationError';
  }
}

/**
 * Creates an unresolved active work context when no profile has been selected yet.
 * Ensures zero fabricated default profile exists.

export function createUnresolvedWorkContext(): ActiveWorkContext {

  };
}

/**
 * Creates a clean default active work context for a given athlete profile.
 */
export function createInitialWorkContext(profileId: string): ActiveWorkContext {
  if (!profileId || typeof profileId !== 'string' || profileId.trim() === '') {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('A non-empty profile_id is required to create an ActiveWorkContext');
  }
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    schema_version: ACTIVE_WORK_CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    context_id: `ctx-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
    profile_id: profileId.trim(),
    active_episode_id: null,
    active_series_id: null,
    canonical_session_id: null,
    canonical_source_id: null,
    canonical_result_hash: null,
    active_window_id: null,
    active_window_revision: null,
    compare_target_session_id: null,
    compare_peer_session_id: null,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: null,
    saved_view_id: null,
    saved_view_revision: null,
    active_pack_id: null,
    active_diary_id: null,
    privacy_mode: 'standard',
    currentness: 'current',
    currentness_reason: null,
    derived_next_action_code: null,
    context_generation: 1,
    created_at_utc: now,
    updated_at_utc: now
  };
}

/**
 * Strict validator for ActiveWorkContext objects.
 */
export function validateActiveWorkContext(context: unknown): ActiveWorkContext {
  if (!context || typeof context !== 'object') {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('Context must be a non-null object');
  }
  const c = context as Partial<ActiveWorkContext>;
  if (!c.context_id || typeof c.context_id !== 'string') {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('Context missing valid context_id');
  }
  if (!c.profile_id || typeof c.profile_id !== 'string' || c.profile_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('Context missing valid profile_id');
  }
  if (typeof c.context_generation !== 'number' || c.context_generation < 1) {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('Context must have context_generation >= 1');
  }

  const validCurrentness: ContextCurrentness[] = ['current', 'historical', 'superseded', 'unavailable'];
  if (!c.currentness || !validCurrentness.includes(c.currentness)) {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError(`Invalid currentness state '${c.currentness}'`);
  }

  const validPrivacy: ContextPrivacyMode[] = ['standard', 'strict_anonymized'];
  if (!c.privacy_mode || !validPrivacy.includes(c.privacy_mode)) {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError(`Invalid privacy_mode '${c.privacy_mode}'`);
  }

  return {
    schema_version: c.schema_version || ACTIVE_WORK_CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    context_id: c.context_id,
    profile_id: c.profile_id.trim(),
    active_episode_id: c.active_episode_id || null,
    active_series_id: c.active_series_id || null,
    canonical_session_id: c.canonical_session_id || null,
    canonical_source_id: c.canonical_source_id || null,
    canonical_result_hash: c.canonical_result_hash || null,
    active_window_id: c.active_window_id || null,
    active_window_revision: typeof c.active_window_revision === 'number' ? c.active_window_revision : null,
    compare_target_session_id: c.compare_target_session_id || null,
    compare_peer_session_id: c.compare_peer_session_id || null,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: c.longitudinal_snapshot_id || null,
    saved_view_id: c.saved_view_id || null,
    saved_view_revision: typeof c.saved_view_revision === 'number' ? c.saved_view_revision : null,
    active_pack_id: c.active_pack_id || null,
    active_diary_id: c.active_diary_id || null,
    privacy_mode: c.privacy_mode,
    currentness: c.currentness,
    currentness_reason: c.currentness_reason || null,
    derived_next_action_code: c.derived_next_action_code || null,
    context_generation: c.context_generation,
    created_at_utc: c.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at_utc: c.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

/**
 * Ensures strict profile isolation: throws CrossProfileContextError if incoming profile does not match.
 */
export function failClosedOnCrossProfile(context: ActiveWorkContext, candidateProfileId: string): void {
  if (candidateProfileId && candidateProfileId !== context.profile_id) {
    throw new CrossProfileContextError(
      `Cross-profile context violation: active context is bound to profile '${context.profile_id}', but operation attempted for '${candidateProfileId}'.`,
      context.profile_id,
      candidateProfileId
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Transitions context to a new state with incremented monotonic generation counter.
 */
export function transitionWorkContext(
  current: ActiveWorkContext,
  updates: Partial<Omit<ActiveWorkContext, 'context_id' | 'created_at_utc' | 'context_generation' | 'updated_at_utc'>>
): ActiveWorkContext {
  if (updates.profile_id && updates.profile_id !== current.profile_id) {
    failClosedOnCrossProfile(current, updates.profile_id);
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const nextGeneration = current.context_generation + 1;

  const nextContext: ActiveWorkContext = {
    ...current,
    ...updates,
    profile_id: updates.profile_id || current.profile_id,
    context_generation: nextGeneration,
    updated_at_utc: now
  };

  return validateActiveWorkContext(nextContext);
}

/**
 * Strips any sensitive or forbidden fields before persisting to localStorage or URL hash.
 * Guarantees no raw signal data, local filesystem paths, athlete notes, or secrets are saved.
 */
export function sanitizeContextForStorage(context: ActiveWorkContext): string {
  const safeRepresentation = {
    schema_version: context.schema_version,
    context_id: context.context_id,
    profile_id: context.profile_id,
    active_episode_id: context.active_episode_id,
    active_series_id: context.active_series_id,
    canonical_session_id: context.canonical_session_id,
    active_window_id: context.active_window_id,
    active_window_revision: context.active_window_revision,
    compare_target_session_id: context.compare_target_session_id,
    compare_peer_session_id: context.compare_peer_session_id,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: context.longitudinal_snapshot_id,
    saved_view_id: context.saved_view_id,
    saved_view_revision: context.saved_view_revision,
    privacy_mode: context.privacy_mode,
    currentness: context.currentness,
    derived_next_action_code: context.derived_next_action_code,
    context_generation: context.context_generation,
    updated_at_utc: context.updated_at_utc
  };

  const serialized = JSON.stringify(safeRepresentation);

  // Security checks: fail closed if filesystem path or secret tokens leaked into serialized context
  if (/([A-Za-z]:\\|\/Users\/|\/home\/)/i.test(serialized)) {
    throw new ActiveContextValidationError('Security violation: Local filesystem path detected in context serialization', 'STORAGE_PATH_LEAK');
  }

  return serialized;
}

/**
 * Safely parses and re-validates ActiveWorkContext from localStorage string.
 */
export function parseContextFromStorage(raw: string | null): ActiveWorkContext | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || !parsed.profile_id || parsed.profile_id === 'default' || parsed.profile_id === 'unresolved') {
      return null;
    }
    return validateActiveWorkContext({
      ...parsed,
      canonical_source_id: null,
      canonical_result_hash: null,
      active_pack_id: null,
      active_diary_id: null,
      currentness_reason: null,
      created_at_utc: parsed.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export interface BaselinePresentation {
  eligibility: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible' | 'insufficient_data';
  source: 'personal_activity_specific' | 'personal_global' | 'reference_fallback' | 'unavailable';
  sessions_used: number;
  sessions_required: number;
  personal_comparison_status: 'within_baseline' | 'above_baseline' | 'below_baseline' | 'unavailable';
  reference_corridor_status: 'within_reference' | 'above_reference' | 'below_reference' | 'unavailable';
  availability_reason: string;
}

export function getBaselinePresentation(
  trends: {
    personal_baseline_available: boolean;
    baseline_source: string;
    sessions_used: number;
    sessions_required: number;
    baseline: any;
  } | null | undefined,
  metricKey: 'rmssd' | 'sdnn' | 'pnn50' | 'avg_hr',
  value: number | null
): BaselinePresentation {
  const defaultRes: BaselinePresentation = {
    eligibility: 'insufficient_data',
    source: 'unavailable',
    sessions_used: 0,
    sessions_required: 5,
    personal_comparison_status: 'unavailable',
    reference_corridor_status: 'unavailable',
    availability_reason: 'no_baseline_data'
  };

  if (!trends) return defaultRes;

  const eligibility = trends.personal_baseline_available ? 'eligible' as const : 'not_eligible' as const;
  const source = (trends.baseline_source || 'unavailable') as BaselinePresentation['source'];
  const sessions_used = trends.sessions_used ?? 0;
  const sessions_required = trends.sessions_required ?? 5;

  let personal_comparison_status: BaselinePresentation['personal_comparison_status'] = 'unavailable';
  let reference_corridor_status: BaselinePresentation['reference_corridor_status'] = 'unavailable';

  let band: any = null;
  if (trends.baseline) {
    if (metricKey === 'rmssd') band = trends.baseline.rmssd_ms;
    else if (metricKey === 'sdnn') band = trends.baseline.sdnn_ms;
    else if (metricKey === 'pnn50') band = trends.baseline.pnn50_percent;
    else if (metricKey === 'avg_hr') band = trends.baseline.avg_hr_bpm;
  }

  if (value !== null && value !== undefined && band && band.median !== null && band.p25 !== null && band.p75 !== null) {
    if (trends.personal_baseline_available) {
      if (value > band.p75) personal_comparison_status = 'above_baseline';
      else if (value < band.p25) personal_comparison_status = 'below_baseline';
      else personal_comparison_status = 'within_baseline';
    } else {
      if (value > band.p75) reference_corridor_status = 'above_reference';
      else if (value < band.p25) reference_corridor_status = 'below_reference';
      else reference_corridor_status = 'within_reference';
    }
  }

  return {
    eligibility,
    source,
    sessions_used,
    sessions_required,
    personal_comparison_status,
    reference_corridor_status,
    availability_reason: trends.personal_baseline_available ? 'eligible' : 'insufficient_sessions'
  };
}

/**
 * Controlled Closed Beta, Monetization Validation & Market Evidence Contract
 * Schema Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * Grounded in strategy requirements:
 * 1. Local-first, privacy-safe beta evidence collection without mandatory cloud telemetry.
 * 2. Strict prohibition of raw physiological series, personal identifiers, and medical claims.
 * 3. Formal North Star metric: Accepted Session Outcomes per Active User.
 * 4. Event-derived Time-to-Value (TTV) with descriptive distributions.
 * 5. Feature-value tracking separating high-value actions and Advanced depth.
 * 6. Trial experiment accounting and pricing corridor validation.
 * 7. Evidence export/import bundle specification with manifest & verification.
 * 8. Scale / narrow / pause decision framework defaulting to inconclusive when external data is pending.
 */

import { LicenseTier } from './entitlementContract';

export const BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION = '2.0.0';
export const BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1 = '1.0.0';

export type SourceChannel =
  | 'invite_code'
  | 'personal_referral'
  | 'coach_referral'
  | 'academic_outreach'
  | 'community_discord'
  | 'youtube_workflow'
  | 'direct_inquiry'
  | 'synthetic_fixture';

export type ParticipantClass =
  | 'qualified_external'
  | 'internal'
  | 'synthetic'
  | 'legacy_unqualified'
  | 'internal_rehearsal';

export function normalizeBetaLicenseTier(tier?: string): LicenseTier {
  if (!tier) return 'trial';
  const lower = tier.toLowerCase();
  if (lower === 'pro') return 'professional';
  if (lower === 'team') return 'personal';
  if (lower === 'free') return 'trial';
  if (lower === 'trial' || lower === 'beta' || lower === 'personal' || lower === 'professional' || lower === 'academic') {
    return lower as LicenseTier;
  }
  return 'trial';
}

  category: 'self_service' | 'guidance' | 'defect' | 'unsupported_input' | 'unresolved' | 'not_observed';
  resolution_status: 'resolved' | 'unresolved' | 'unsupported_closed' | 'not_observed';
  reported_at_utc: string;
  resolved_at_utc?: string;
  root_cause_class?: SupportRootCauseClass;
  history?: SupportTriageHistoryEntry[];
}

/**
 * Prohibited fields scanner for central beta evidence bundles.
 * Strict fail-closed privacy boundary: no raw physiology, athlete names, local paths, credentials, or medical claims.
 */
export const PROHIBITED_CENTRAL_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS = [
  /rr_intervals?/i,
  /ecg_samples?/i,
  /acc_samples?/i,
  /raw_samples?/i,
  /athlete_name/i,
  /device_serial/i,
  /hardware_id/i,
  /[a-z]:\\users\\[^\s"']+/i, // Windows local user paths
  /\/home\/[^\s"']+/i,        // Unix local home paths
  /\/users\/[^\s"']+/i,       // macOS local user paths
  /password/i,
  /secret/i,
  /private_key/i,
  /auth_token/i,
  /diagnosis/i, // prohibited medical claim scanner pattern
  /arrhythmia/i, // prohibited diagnostic term scanner pattern
  /safe_to_train/i, // prohibited training readiness claim scanner pattern
  /medical_grade/i // prohibited medical grade claim scanner pattern
];

export function scanObjectForProhibitedFields(obj: any, pathPrefix = ''): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];

  function recurse(current: any, currentPath: string) {
    if (current === null || current === undefined) return;

    if (typeof current === 'string') {
      for (const pattern of PROHIBITED_CENTRAL_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS) {
        if (pattern.test(current)) {
          violations.push(`Pattern match [${pattern.toString()}] in value at ${currentPath}`);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(current)) {
      if (current.length > 500 && current.every((x) => typeof x === 'number')) {
        violations.push(`High-density numeric array detected at ${currentPath} (length: ${current.length}) - potential raw signal series`);
      }
      current.forEach((item, idx) => recurse(item, `${currentPath}[${idx}]`));
      return;
    }

    if (typeof current === 'object') {
      for (const key of Object.keys(current)) {
        const fullPath = currentPath ? `${currentPath}.${key}` : key;
        for (const pattern of PROHIBITED_CENTRAL_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS) {
          if (pattern.test(key)) {
            violations.push(`Pattern match [${pattern.toString()}] in property key at ${fullPath}`);
          }
        }
        recurse(current[key], fullPath);
      }
    }
  }

  recurse(obj, pathPrefix);
  return violations;
}

/**
 * Strategy North Star: Accepted Session Outcomes per Active User.
 * Requires:
 * 1. Supported bundle imported
 * 2. Grouping confirmed
 * 3. Canonical analysis completed
 * 4. Canonical result viewed
 * 5. No unresolved hard failure
 * 6. At least one meaningful follow-up action (comparison, report, AI pack, advanced detail)
 */
export type MeaningfulFollowUpAction =
  | 'comparison_opened'
  | 'report_exported'
  | 'llm_pack_generated'
  | 'advanced_detail_opened';

export const BETA_MILESTONE_GATES = [
  'supported_bundle_imported',
  'grouping_confirmed',
  'canonical_analysis_completed',
  'canonical_result_viewed',
  'no_unresolved_hard_failure',
  'first_meaningful_action_taken'
] as const;

export interface AcceptedSessionOutcome {
  outcome_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  bundle_imported: boolean;
  grouping_confirmed: boolean;
  canonical_analysis_completed: boolean;
  canonical_result_viewed: boolean;
  has_unresolved_hard_failure: boolean;
  meaningful_actions: MeaningfulFollowUpAction[];
  is_accepted_outcome: boolean; // True only if technical & useful confirmed
  is_sample_or_demo: boolean;
  completed_at_utc: string;
  // G3 Extended Properties
  technical_completion?: boolean;
  useful_outcome_confirmed?: boolean;
  confirmation_details?: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation;
  external_market_qualified?: boolean;
  qualification_reason?: string;
  is_accepted_external_outcome?: boolean;
  context_snapshot?: PilotWorkContext;
}

export function evaluateAcceptedSessionOutcome(record: {
  outcome_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  bundle_imported: boolean;
  grouping_confirmed: boolean;
  canonical_analysis_completed: boolean;
  canonical_result_viewed: boolean;
  has_unresolved_hard_failure: boolean;
  meaningful_actions?: MeaningfulFollowUpAction[];
  is_sample_or_demo?: boolean;
  completed_at_utc?: string;
  technical_completion?: boolean;
  useful_outcome_confirmed?: boolean;
  confirmation_details?: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation;
  external_market_qualified?: boolean;
  qualification_reason?: string;
  is_accepted_external_outcome?: boolean;
  context_snapshot?: PilotWorkContext;
}): AcceptedSessionOutcome {
  const technical =
    record.bundle_imported === true &&
    record.grouping_confirmed === true &&
    record.canonical_analysis_completed === true &&
    record.canonical_result_viewed === true &&
    record.has_unresolved_hard_failure === false;

  const usefulConfirmed =
    record.useful_outcome_confirmed !== undefined
      ? Boolean(record.useful_outcome_confirmed)
      : (record.meaningful_actions && record.meaningful_actions.length > 0) || Boolean(record.confirmation_details);

  const isAccepted = technical && usefulConfirmed;
  const marketQualified =
    record.external_market_qualified !== undefined
      ? Boolean(record.external_market_qualified)
      : !record.is_sample_or_demo;
  const isAcceptedExternal = isAccepted && marketQualified;

  return {
    outcome_id: record.outcome_id,
    session_id: record.session_id,
    participant_id: record.participant_id,
    cohort_id: record.cohort_id,
    bundle_imported: record.bundle_imported,
    grouping_confirmed: record.grouping_confirmed,
    canonical_analysis_completed: record.canonical_analysis_completed,
    canonical_result_viewed: record.canonical_result_viewed,
    has_unresolved_hard_failure: record.has_unresolved_hard_failure,
    meaningful_actions: record.meaningful_actions || [],
    is_accepted_outcome: isAccepted,
    is_sample_or_demo: record.is_sample_or_demo ?? !marketQualified,
    completed_at_utc: record.completed_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    technical_completion: technical,
    useful_outcome_confirmed: usefulConfirmed,
    confirmation_details: record.confirmation_details,
    external_market_qualified: marketQualified,
    qualification_reason: record.qualification_reason,
    is_accepted_external_outcome: isAcceptedExternal,
    context_snapshot: record.context_snapshot
  };
}

/**
 * MKT-R07 Natural Market Evidence Protocol
 *
 * Grounded in Astra/Sol Strategic Handoff:
 * - Versioned observation protocol separating active time, rework, baseline alternative,
 *   artifact action, recipient action, natural repeat, payer status, and privacy-minimized notes.
 * - Strict typing and separation of synthetic demo records vs natural market observations.
 * - Default status when no real authorized jobs exist is NOT_EVALUATED (truthful, not a product failure).
 * - No willingness-to-pay, CAC, retention, or repeat use can be derived from technical tests.
 */
export const MKT_R07_PROTOCOL_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type MktR07SourceType =
  | 'authorized_external_participant'
  | 'operator_field_study'
  | 'synthetic_fixture'
  | 'internal_automated_test';

export type MktR07EvidenceType =
  | 'natural_market_observation'
  | 'synthetic_demo';

export type MktR07ArtifactAction =
  | 'exported_report'
  | 'llm_pack_downloaded'
  | 'summary_shared'
  | 'none'
  | 'unknown';

export type MktR07RecipientAction =
  | 'viewed_by_coach'
  | 'viewed_by_athlete'
  | 'stored_in_records'
  | 'ignored'
  | 'none'
  | 'unknown';

export type MktR07NaturalRepeat =
  | 'first_use'
  | 'repeated_unprompted'
  | 'repeated_prompted'
  | 'abandoned'
  | 'unknown';

export type MktR07PayerState =
  | 'paid_subscription'
  | 'paid_one_time'
  | 'free_trial'
  | 'declined_to_pay'
  | 'unknown';

export interface MktR07Provenance {
  source_type: MktR07SourceType;
  observer_pseudonym?: string;
  captured_at_utc: string;
  environment_type: 'local_workstation' | 'test_runner' | 'sandbox';
  eligibility_confirmed: boolean;
}

export interface MktR07ObservationRecord {
  observation_id: string;
  protocol_version: string;
  candidate_freeze_id: string;
  candidate_commit: string;
  app_version: string;
  provenance: MktR07Provenance;
  evidence_type: MktR07EvidenceType;
  active_time_minutes: number | null;
  rework_count: number | null;
  baseline_alternative: string | null;
  artifact_action: MktR07ArtifactAction;
  recipient_action: MktR07RecipientAction;
  natural_repeat: MktR07NaturalRepeat;
  payer_state: MktR07PayerState;
  privacy_minimized_notes: string | null;
}

export function createBlankMktR07Protocol(overrides?: Partial<MktR07ObservationRecord>): MktR07ObservationRecord {
  const nowUtc = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    observation_id: overrides?.observation_id || `obs_mkt_r07_${Date.now()}`,
    protocol_version: MKT_R07_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    candidate_freeze_id: overrides?.candidate_freeze_id || 'freeze-cardiolab-workstation-1.0.1-beta.11-rc1',
    candidate_commit: overrides?.candidate_commit || '7b3e0865b303b4861a3171cfefedc109dfeafdf6',
    app_version: overrides?.app_version || '1.0.1-beta.11',
    provenance: {
      source_type: overrides?.provenance?.source_type || 'authorized_external_participant',
      observer_pseudonym: overrides?.provenance?.observer_pseudonym || 'operator_field_observer',
      captured_at_utc: overrides?.provenance?.captured_at_utc || nowUtc,
      environment_type: overrides?.provenance?.environment_type || 'local_workstation',
      eligibility_confirmed: overrides?.provenance?.eligibility_confirmed ?? false
    },
    evidence_type: overrides?.evidence_type || 'natural_market_observation',
    active_time_minutes: overrides?.active_time_minutes ?? null,
    rework_count: overrides?.rework_count ?? null,
    baseline_alternative: overrides?.baseline_alternative ?? 'unknown',
    artifact_action: overrides?.artifact_action ?? 'unknown',
    recipient_action: overrides?.recipient_action ?? 'unknown',
    natural_repeat: overrides?.natural_repeat ?? 'unknown',
    payer_state: overrides?.payer_state ?? 'unknown',
    privacy_minimized_notes: overrides?.privacy_minimized_notes ?? null
  };
}

export const VALID_MKT_R07_SOURCE_TYPES = new Set<string>([
  'authorized_external_participant',
  'operator_field_study',
  'synthetic_fixture',
  'internal_automated_test'
]);

export const VALID_MKT_R07_EVIDENCE_TYPES = new Set<string>([
  'natural_market_observation',
  'synthetic_demo'
]);

export const VALID_MKT_R07_ARTIFACT_ACTIONS = new Set<string>([
  'exported_report',
  'llm_pack_downloaded',
  'summary_shared',
  'none',
  'unknown'
]);

export const VALID_MKT_R07_RECIPIENT_ACTIONS = new Set<string>([
  'viewed_by_coach',
  'viewed_by_athlete',
  'stored_in_records',
  'ignored',
  'none',
  'unknown'
]);

export const VALID_MKT_R07_NATURAL_REPEATS = new Set<string>([
  'first_use',
  'repeated_unprompted',
  'repeated_prompted',
  'abandoned',
  'unknown'
]);

export const VALID_MKT_R07_PAYER_STATES = new Set<string>([
  'paid_subscription',
  'paid_one_time',
  'free_trial',
  'declined_to_pay',
  'unknown'
]);

export function validateMktR07ObservationRecord(record: any): { is_valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!record || typeof record !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record)) {
    return { is_valid: false, errors: ['MKT_R07_RECORD_NOT_AN_OBJECT'] };
  }

  const allowedKeys = new Set([
    'observation_id',
    'protocol_version',
    'candidate_freeze_id',
    'candidate_commit',
    'app_version',
    'provenance',
    'evidence_type',
    'active_time_minutes',
    'rework_count',
    'baseline_alternative',
    'artifact_action',
    'recipient_action',
    'natural_repeat',
    'payer_state',
    'privacy_minimized_notes'
  ]);

  for (const k of Object.keys(record)) {
    if (!allowedKeys.has(k)) {
      errors.push(`UNKNOWN_MKT_R07_KEY:${k}`);
    }
  }

  if (!record.observation_id || typeof record.observation_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('MISSING_OR_INVALID_OBSERVATION_ID');
  }
  if (record.protocol_version !== MKT_R07_PROTOCOL_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`UNSUPPORTED_MKT_R07_PROTOCOL_VERSION:${record.protocol_version}`);
  }
  if (!record.candidate_freeze_id || typeof record.candidate_freeze_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('MISSING_CANDIDATE_FREEZE_ID');
  }
  if (!record.candidate_commit || typeof record.candidate_commit !== 'string') {
    errors.push('MISSING_CANDIDATE_COMMIT');
  }
  if (!VALID_MKT_R07_EVIDENCE_TYPES.has(record.evidence_type)) {
    errors.push(`INVALID_EVIDENCE_TYPE:${record.evidence_type}`);
  }
  if (!VALID_MKT_R07_ARTIFACT_ACTIONS.has(record.artifact_action)) {
    errors.push(`INVALID_ARTIFACT_ACTION:${record.artifact_action}`);
  }
  if (!VALID_MKT_R07_RECIPIENT_ACTIONS.has(record.recipient_action)) {
    errors.push(`INVALID_RECIPIENT_ACTION:${record.recipient_action}`);
  }
  if (!VALID_MKT_R07_NATURAL_REPEATS.has(record.natural_repeat)) {
    errors.push(`INVALID_NATURAL_REPEAT:${record.natural_repeat}`);
  }
  if (!VALID_MKT_R07_PAYER_STATES.has(record.payer_state)) {
    errors.push(`INVALID_PAYER_STATE:${record.payer_state}`);
  }

  if (!record.provenance || typeof record.provenance !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record.provenance)) {
    errors.push('MISSING_OR_INVALID_PROVENANCE');
  } else {
    const provKeys = new Set(['source_type', 'observer_pseudonym', 'captured_at_utc', 'environment_type', 'eligibility_confirmed']);
    for (const pk of Object.keys(record.provenance)) {
      if (!provKeys.has(pk)) {
        errors.push(`UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE_KEY:${pk}`);
      }
    }
    if (!VALID_MKT_R07_SOURCE_TYPES.has(record.provenance.source_type)) {
      errors.push(`INVALID_PROVENANCE_SOURCE_TYPE:${record.provenance.source_type}`);
    }
    if (typeof record.provenance.eligibility_confirmed !== 'boolean') {
      errors.push('PROVENANCE_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIRMED_MUST_BE_BOOLEAN');
    }
    const capturedMs = Date.parse(record.provenance.captured_at_utc);
    if (Number.isNaN(capturedMs) || capturedMs > Date.now() + 300000) {
      errors.push(`INVALID_OR_FUTURE_CAPTURED_AT:${record.provenance.captured_at_utc}`);
    }
  }

  if (record.privacy_minimized_notes) {
    const violations = scanObjectForProhibitedFields({ notes: record.privacy_minimized_notes });
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      errors.push(`PRIVACY_VIOLATION_IN_NOTES:${violations.join('; ')}`);
    }
  }

  return { is_valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

/**
 * Filters and extracts ONLY genuine natural market observations.
 * Excludes synthetic fixtures, automated test records, and demo records.
 */
export function filterNaturalMarketObservations(records: MktR07ObservationRecord[]): MktR07ObservationRecord[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(records)) return [];
  return records.filter((r) => {
    if (r.evidence_type !== 'natural_market_observation') return false;
    if (r.provenance.source_type === 'synthetic_fixture' || r.provenance.source_type === 'internal_automated_test') return false;
    if (r.provenance.environment_type === 'test_runner') return false;
    if (r.provenance.eligibility_confirmed !== true) return false;
    if (r.natural_repeat === 'unknown' && r.payer_state === 'unknown' && r.artifact_action === 'unknown' && r.recipient_action === 'unknown') return false;
    return true;
  });
}

/**
 * Truthfully evaluates MKT-R07 status.
 * If zero natural market observations exist, status MUST be NOT_EVALUATED.
 * Technical tests and synthetic fixtures are NEVER converted into market validation.
 */
export function evaluateMktR07Status(records: MktR07ObservationRecord[]): {
  status: 'NOT_EVALUATED' | 'EVALUATED';
  natural_count: number;
  synthetic_count: number;
  repeat_observed: boolean;
  payer_observed: boolean;
  summary: string;
} {
  if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length === 0) {
    return {
      status: 'NOT_EVALUATED',
      natural_count: 0,
      synthetic_count: 0,
      repeat_observed: false,
      payer_observed: false,
      summary: 'MKT-R07 natural market observation is NOT_EVALUATED: zero observation records available.'
    };
  }

  const natural = filterNaturalMarketObservations(records);
  const syntheticCount = records.length - natural.length;

  if (natural.length === 0) {
    return {
      status: 'NOT_EVALUATED',
      natural_count: 0,
      synthetic_count: syntheticCount,
      repeat_observed: false,
      payer_observed: false,
      summary: `MKT-R07 natural market observation is NOT_EVALUATED: ${syntheticCount} synthetic records excluded; 0 real authorized external participant observations.`
    };
  }

  const repeatCount = natural.filter(r => r.natural_repeat === 'repeated_unprompted' || r.natural_repeat === 'repeated_prompted').length;
  const payerCount = natural.filter(r => r.payer_state === 'paid_subscription' || r.payer_state === 'paid_one_time').length;

  return {
    status: 'EVALUATED',
    natural_count: natural.length,
    synthetic_count: syntheticCount,
    repeat_observed: repeatCount > 0,
    payer_observed: payerCount > 0,
    summary: `MKT-R07 evaluated on ${natural.length} natural observation(s): repeat observed in ${repeatCount}, paid state observed in ${payerCount}.`
  };
}

/**
 * Beta Evidence Export Bundle & Manifest
 */
export interface BetaEvidenceBundleManifest {
  manifest_version: '1.0.0';
  bundle_id: string;
  participant_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  app_version: string;
  build_version: string;
  generated_at_utc: string;
  source_channel: SourceChannel;
  event_counts: {
    accepted_outcomes: number;
    ttv_records: number;
    feature_events: number;
    trust_events: number;
    wtp_interactions: number;
    feedback_submissions: number;
    support_incidents: number;
    mkt_r07_observations?: number;
    useful_confirmations?: number;
    work_contexts?: number;
    natural_repeats?: number;
    support_episodes?: number;
  };
  sha256: string;
}

export interface BetaEvidenceExportBundle {
  schema_version: typeof BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION | typeof BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1;
  manifest: BetaEvidenceBundleManifest;
  participant_profile: BetaParticipant;
  accepted_outcomes: AcceptedSessionOutcome[];
  ttv_records: TimeToValueRecord[];
  feature_events: FeatureUsageEvent[];
  trust_events: TrustFailureEvent[];
  wtp_interactions: WtpOfferInteraction[];
  feedback_submissions: BetaFeedbackSubmission[];
  support_incidents: BetaSupportIncident[];
  mkt_r07_observations?: MktR07ObservationRecord[];
  useful_confirmations?: UsefulOutcomeConfirmation[];
  work_contexts?: PilotWorkContext[];
  natural_repeats?: NaturalRepeatRecord[];
  support_episodes?: SupportEpisode[];
  privacy_verification: {
    scanned_at_utc: string;
    prohibited_pattern_violations: string[];
    is_privacy_cleared: boolean;
  };
}

export const ALLOWED_BUNDLE_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS = new Set([
  'schema_version',
  'manifest',
  'participant_profile',
  'accepted_outcomes',
  'ttv_records',
  'feature_events',
  'trust_events',
  'wtp_interactions',
  'feedback_submissions',
  'support_incidents',
  'mkt_r07_observations',
  'useful_confirmations',
  'work_contexts',
  'natural_repeats',
  'support_episodes',
  'privacy_verification'
]);

export function validateBetaEvidenceBundleStrict(bundle: any): { is_valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!bundle || typeof bundle !== 'object' || Array.isArray(bundle)) {
    return { is_valid: false, errors: ['BUNDLE_NOT_AN_OBJECT'] };
  }

  // Check top-level keys
  for (const key of Object.keys(bundle)) {
    if (!ALLOWED_BUNDLE_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.has(key)) {
      errors.push(`UNKNOWN_TOP_LEVEL_KEY:${key}`);
    }
  }

  if (bundle.schema_version !== BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION && bundle.schema_version !== BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1) {
    errors.push(`UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION:${bundle.schema_version}`);
  }

  // Validate manifest
  if (!bundle.manifest || typeof bundle.manifest !== 'object') {
    errors.push('MISSING_OR_INVALID_MANIFEST');
  } else {
    const allowedManifestKeys = new Set([
      'manifest_version', 'bundle_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id',
      'app_version', 'build_version', 'generated_at_utc', 'source_channel',
      'event_counts', 'sha256'
    ]);
    for (const k of Object.keys(bundle.manifest)) {
      if (!allowedManifestKeys.has(k)) {
        errors.push(`UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_KEY:${k}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // Validate participant_profile
  if (!bundle.participant_profile || typeof bundle.participant_profile !== 'object') {
    errors.push('MISSING_OR_INVALID_PARTICIPANT_PROFILE');
  } else {
    const allowedProfileKeys = new Set([
      'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'source_channel', 'invite_code', 'invite_token', 'enrollment_proof',
      'app_version', 'build_number', 'entitlement_tier', 'experiment_variant_id',
      'first_seen_at_utc', 'last_seen_at_utc', 'consent_given_at_utc', 'is_external_tester',
      'profile_id', 'consent_policy_version', 'participant_class'
    ]);
    for (const k of Object.keys(bundle.participant_profile)) {
      if (!allowedProfileKeys.has(k)) {
        errors.push(`UNKNOWN_PARTICIPANT_PROFILE_KEY:${k}`);
      }
    }

    const tier = bundle.participant_profile.entitlement_tier;
    if (!['trial', 'beta', 'personal', 'professional', 'academic'].includes(tier)) {
      errors.push(`INVALID_ENTITLEMENT_TIER:${tier}`);
    }

    // Check participant ID and cohort ID consistency
    if (bundle.manifest && bundle.participant_profile.participant_id !== bundle.manifest.participant_id) {
      errors.push(`PARTICIPANT_ID_MISMATCH:${bundle.participant_profile.participant_id} vs ${bundle.manifest.participant_id}`);
    }
    if (bundle.manifest && bundle.participant_profile.cohort_id !== bundle.manifest.cohort_id) {
      errors.push(`COHORT_ID_MISMATCH:${bundle.participant_profile.cohort_id} vs ${bundle.manifest.cohort_id}`);
    }

    // Future timestamp check
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    const consentTime = Date.parse(bundle.participant_profile.consent_given_at_utc);
    if (Number.isNaN(consentTime) || consentTime > nowMs + 300000) {
      errors.push(`INVALID_OR_FUTURE_CONSENT_TIME:${bundle.participant_profile.consent_given_at_utc}`);
    }
  }

  // Manifest event count consistency check
  if (bundle.manifest?.event_counts) {
    const counts = bundle.manifest.event_counts;
    if (counts.accepted_outcomes !== (bundle.accepted_outcomes?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:accepted_outcomes manifest=${counts.accepted_outcomes} vs array=${bundle.accepted_outcomes?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.ttv_records !== (bundle.ttv_records?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:ttv_records manifest=${counts.ttv_records} vs array=${bundle.ttv_records?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.feature_events !== (bundle.feature_events?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:feature_events manifest=${counts.feature_events} vs array=${bundle.feature_events?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.trust_events !== (bundle.trust_events?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:trust_events manifest=${counts.trust_events} vs array=${bundle.trust_events?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.wtp_interactions !== (bundle.wtp_interactions?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:wtp_interactions manifest=${counts.wtp_interactions} vs array=${bundle.wtp_interactions?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.feedback_submissions !== (bundle.feedback_submissions?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:feedback_submissions manifest=${counts.feedback_submissions} vs array=${bundle.feedback_submissions?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.support_incidents !== (bundle.support_incidents?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:support_incidents manifest=${counts.support_incidents} vs array=${bundle.support_incidents?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.mkt_r07_observations !== undefined && counts.mkt_r07_observations !== (bundle.mkt_r07_observations?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:mkt_r07_observations manifest=${counts.mkt_r07_observations} vs array=${bundle.mkt_r07_observations?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.useful_confirmations !== undefined && counts.useful_confirmations !== (bundle.useful_confirmations?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:useful_confirmations manifest=${counts.useful_confirmations} vs array=${bundle.useful_confirmations?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.work_contexts !== undefined && counts.work_contexts !== (bundle.work_contexts?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:work_contexts manifest=${counts.work_contexts} vs array=${bundle.work_contexts?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.natural_repeats !== undefined && counts.natural_repeats !== (bundle.natural_repeats?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:natural_repeats manifest=${counts.natural_repeats} vs array=${bundle.natural_repeats?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
    if (counts.support_episodes !== undefined && counts.support_episodes !== (bundle.support_episodes?.length ?? 0)) {
      errors.push(`MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH:support_episodes manifest=${counts.support_episodes} vs array=${bundle.support_episodes?.length ?? 0}`);
    }
  }

  // Allowed nested key sets
  const ALLOWED_OUTCOME_KEYS = new Set([
    'outcome_id', 'session_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id',
    'bundle_imported', 'grouping_confirmed', 'canonical_analysis_completed',
    'canonical_result_viewed', 'has_unresolved_hard_failure',
    'meaningful_actions', 'is_accepted_outcome', 'is_sample_or_demo', 'completed_at_utc',
    'technical_completion', 'useful_outcome_confirmed', 'confirmation_details',
    'external_market_qualified', 'qualification_reason', 'is_accepted_external_outcome', 'context_snapshot'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_TTV_KEYS = new Set([
    'record_id', 'session_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id',
    'import_started_at_ms', 'bundle_preview_ready_at_ms', 'bundle_confirmed_at_ms',
    'canonical_overview_ready_at_ms', 'first_meaningful_action_at_ms',
    'first_meaningful_action_type', 'is_sample_or_demo', 'created_at_utc'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_FEATURE_KEYS = new Set([
    'event_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'session_id',
    'feature_id', 'action', 'duration_viewed_sec', 'is_sample_or_demo', 'occurred_at_utc'
  ]);
  const VALID_FEATURE_IDS = new Set<string>([
    'ecg_view', 'acc_view', 'frequency_view', 'poincare_view', 'methodology_view',
    'artifact_ledger_view', 'hr_zone_view', 'comparison_view', 'report_export_csv',
    'report_export_pdf', 'report_export_html', 'report_export_bundle', 'llm_pack_gemini',
    'llm_pack_zip', 'ai_response_linked'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_TRUST_KEYS = new Set([
    'event_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'session_id',
    'error_type', 'reason_code', 'file_extension', 'user_corrected_successfully', 'occurred_at_utc'
  ]);
  const VALID_ERROR_TYPES = new Set<string>([
    'grouping_correction', 'unsupported_format', 'hard_parsing_failure',
    'output_parity_failure', 'silent_drop_detected', 'privacy_scan_violation',
    'warning_dismissed', 'warning_expanded'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_WTP_KEYS = new Set([
    'interaction_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'experiment_variant_id',
    'tier_shown', 'price_amount', 'currency', 'billing_model', 'action',
    'decline_reason', 'price_sensitivity_feedback', 'occurred_at_utc'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_FEEDBACK_KEYS = new Set([
    'feedback_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'app_version', 'category',
    'rating_1_to_5', 'message_bounded', 'session_context_ref', 'privacy_cleared', 'created_at_utc'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_SUPPORT_KEYS = new Set([
    'incident_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'issue_category',
    'associated_support_bundle', 'interaction_steps_count', 'resolution_status',
    'root_cause_class', 'unsupported_input_involved', 'reported_at_utc', 'resolved_at_utc'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_CONFIRMATION_KEYS = new Set([
    'confirmation_id', 'session_id', 'participant_id', 'context_id',
    'confirmed_by', 'recipient_action', 'confirmed_at_utc', 'user_notes',
    'context_token_hash', 'idempotency_key'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_WORK_CONTEXT_KEYS = new Set([
    'context_id', 'profile_id', 'session_id', 'canonical_session_hash',
    'window_id', 'window_revision', 'comparison_partner_session_id', 'comparison_hash',
    'report_artifact_hash', 'llm_pack_fingerprint', 'diary_entry_id',
    'task_category', 'artifact_category', 'recipient_category', 'privacy_decisions',
    'source_event_ids', 'timestamps', 'canonical_payload_hash', 'live_qualification'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_NATURAL_REPEAT_KEYS = new Set([
    'repeat_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'baseline_session_id',
    'baseline_context_id', 'baseline_completed_at_utc', 'repeat_session_id',
    'repeat_context_id', 'repeat_completed_at_utc', 'repeat_type',
    'is_distinct_session', 'is_qualified_repeat', 'baseline_source_hash',
    'repeat_source_hash', 'right_censored'
  ]);
  const ALLOWED_SUPPORT_EPISODE_KEYS = new Set([
    'episode_id', 'participant_id', 'cohort_id', 'reason',
    'interactions_count', 'user_active_minutes', 'operator_active_minutes',
    'category', 'resolution_status', 'reported_at_utc', 'resolved_at_utc',
    'root_cause_class', 'history'
  ]);

  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const pid = bundle.participant_profile?.participant_id;
  const cid = bundle.participant_profile?.cohort_id;

  const eventLists: Array<[string, any[], Set<string>]> = [
    ['accepted_outcomes', bundle.accepted_outcomes, ALLOWED_OUTCOME_KEYS],
    ['ttv_records', bundle.ttv_records, ALLOWED_TTV_KEYS],
    ['feature_events', bundle.feature_events, ALLOWED_FEATURE_KEYS],
    ['trust_events', bundle.trust_events, ALLOWED_TRUST_KEYS],
    ['wtp_interactions', bundle.wtp_interactions, ALLOWED_WTP_KEYS],
    ['feedback_submissions', bundle.feedback_submissions, ALLOWED_FEEDBACK_KEYS],
    ['support_incidents', bundle.support_incidents, ALLOWED_SUPPORT_KEYS],
    ['useful_confirmations', bundle.useful_confirmations, ALLOWED_CONFIRMATION_KEYS],
    ['work_contexts', bundle.work_contexts, ALLOWED_WORK_CONTEXT_KEYS],
    ['natural_repeats', bundle.natural_repeats, ALLOWED_NATURAL_REPEAT_KEYS],
    ['support_episodes', bundle.support_episodes, ALLOWED_SUPPORT_EPISODE_KEYS]
  ];

  for (const [name, list, allowedKeys] of eventLists) {
    if (list !== undefined && !Array.isArray(list)) {
      errors.push(`EVENT_LIST_NOT_ARRAY:${name}`);
    } else if (Array.isArray(list)) {
      list.forEach((item, idx) => {
        if (!item || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) {
          errors.push(`MALFORMED_EVENT_OBJECT:${name}[${idx}]`);
          return;
        }

        // Validate exact allowed keys
        for (const k of Object.keys(item)) {
          if (!allowedKeys.has(k)) {
            errors.push(`UNKNOWN_NESTED_KEY:${name}[${idx}].${k}`);
          }
        }

        // Participant ID & Cohort ID consistency
        if (item.participant_id && item.participant_id !== pid) {
          errors.push(`EVENT_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH:${name}[${idx}].participant_id=${item.participant_id} vs ${pid}`);
        }
        if (item.cohort_id && item.cohort_id !== cid) {
          errors.push(`EVENT_COHORT_MISMATCH:${name}[${idx}].cohort_id=${item.cohort_id} vs ${cid}`);
        }

        // Future timestamp validation
        const timeVal = item.occurred_at_utc || item.completed_at_utc || item.created_at_utc || item.reported_at_utc || item.confirmed_at_utc || item.repeat_completed_at_utc || item.timestamps?.created_at_utc;
        if (timeVal) {
          const parsed = Date.parse(timeVal);
          if (Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed > nowMs + 300000) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_OR_FUTURE_TIMESTAMP:${name}[${idx}] timestamp=${timeVal}`);
          }
        }

        // Specific nested validations
        if (name === 'feature_events' && item.feature_id) {
          if (!VALID_FEATURE_IDS.has(item.feature_id)) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_FEATURE_ID:${item.feature_id}`);
          }
        }
        if (name === 'trust_events' && item.error_type) {
          if (!VALID_ERROR_TYPES.has(item.error_type)) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_ERROR_TYPE:${item.error_type}`);
          }
        }
        if (name === 'wtp_interactions') {
          if (item.tier_shown && !['personal', 'professional', 'academic'].includes(item.tier_shown)) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_WTP_TIER:${item.tier_shown}`);
          }
          if (item.currency && !['EUR', 'USD'].includes(item.currency)) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_WTP_CURRENCY:${item.currency}`);
          }
          if (typeof item.price_amount === 'number' && item.price_amount <= 0) {
            errors.push(`INVALID_WTP_PRICE:${item.price_amount}`);
          }
        }
        if (name === 'feedback_submissions') {
          if (typeof item.message_bounded === 'string' && item.message_bounded.length > 1000) {
            errors.push(`FEEDBACK_MESSAGE_TOO_LONG:length=${item.message_bounded.length}`);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  if (bundle.mkt_r07_observations !== undefined) {
    if (!Array.isArray(bundle.mkt_r07_observations)) {
      errors.push('EVENT_LIST_NOT_ARRAY:mkt_r07_observations');
    } else {
      bundle.mkt_r07_observations.forEach((item: any, idx: number) => {
        const itemRes = validateMktR07ObservationRecord(item);
        if (!itemRes.is_valid) {
          errors.push(`INVALID_MKT_R07_OBSERVATION[${idx}]: ${itemRes.errors.join(', ')}`);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  return { is_valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

/**
 * Scale / Narrow / Pause Decision Framework
 */
export type BetaDecisionVerdict = 'scale' | 'narrow' | 'pause' | 'inconclusive';

export interface BetaDecisionDimensionAssessment {
  dimension: string;
  evidence_status: 'mature' | 'emerging' | 'insufficient_external_evidence';
  metric_value: string;
  threshold_rule: string;
  verdict_contribution: BetaDecisionVerdict;
  notes: string;
  is_normative?: boolean;
}

export interface BetaDecisionMatrix {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  generated_at_utc: string;
  work_item_id: string;
  target_git_head: string;
  overall_verdict: BetaDecisionVerdict;
  external_evidence_status: {
    real_invited_participants_count: number;
    has_real_external_testers: boolean;
    active_cohorts_count: number;
    observation_window_status: 'awaiting_external_cohort_data' | 'partial' | 'complete';
  };
  dimension_assessments: BetaDecisionDimensionAssessment[];
  summary_recommendation: string;
  confidence_limitations: string[];
}

/**
 * Adapts legacy Schema 1.0.0 beta evidence bundles to Schema 2.0.0.
 * In accordance with G3 requirements, legacy v1 bundles are classified as 'legacy_unqualified':
 * - participant_class is set to 'legacy_unqualified'
 * - is_external_tester is normalized to false to prevent unverified market inflation
 * - accepted outcomes have technical_completion set from is_accepted_outcome, but useful_outcome_confirmed
 *   and external_market_qualified set to false.
 */
export function adaptBetaBundleV1ToV2(bundle: any): BetaEvidenceExportBundle {
  if (!bundle || typeof bundle !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Cannot adapt invalid bundle');
  }
  const adapted: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bundle));
  const isV1 = adapted.schema_version === BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION_V1;
  adapted.schema_version = BETA_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION;

  if (adapted.participant_profile) {
    if (isV1) {
      adapted.participant_profile.participant_class = 'legacy_unqualified';
      adapted.participant_profile.is_external_tester = false;
      adapted.participant_profile.consent_policy_version = adapted.participant_profile.consent_policy_version || '1.0.0';
    } else if (!adapted.participant_profile.participant_class) {
      adapted.participant_profile.participant_class = adapted.participant_profile.is_external_tester
        ? 'qualified_external'
        : 'internal';
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(adapted.accepted_outcomes)) {
    adapted.accepted_outcomes = adapted.accepted_outcomes.map((o: any) => {
      const technical = o.technical_completion !== undefined ? Boolean(o.technical_completion) : Boolean(o.is_accepted_outcome);
      const usefulConfirmed = isV1 ? false : Boolean(o.useful_outcome_confirmed);
      const marketQualified = isV1 ? false : Boolean(o.external_market_qualified);
      return {
        ...o,
        technical_completion: technical,
        useful_outcome_confirmed: usefulConfirmed,
        external_market_qualified: marketQualified,
        qualification_reason: isV1 ? 'legacy_v1_bundle' : o.qualification_reason,
        is_accepted_external_outcome: technical && usefulConfirmed && marketQualified
      };
    });
  }

  return adapted as BetaEvidenceExportBundle;
}

export type PilotRole = 'participant' | 'operator' | 'unassigned';

export interface PilotActorContext {

  actor_id: string;
  is_operator: boolean;
  is_enrolled: boolean;
  participant_id?: string;
  profile_id?: string;
  cohort_id?: string;
  consent_version?: string;
  consent_given_at_utc?: string;
  enrollment_qualification?: 'qualified' | 'unqualified_pre_consent' | 'unqualified_synthetic' | 'unqualified_internal' | 'unqualified_legacy';
  entitlement_state?: string;
  active_context_fingerprint?: string;
  server_revision: string;
  safe_limitations: string[];
}

export const PILOT_CONSENT_VERSION = '2.0.0';

export interface EnrollParticipantRequest {
  invite_code: string;
  consent_version: string;
  consent_given_at_utc: string;
  profile_id: string;
  participant_pseudonym?: string;
}

export interface EnrollParticipantResponse {
  success: boolean;
  participant?: BetaParticipant;

/**
 * Validates whether public-facing copy complies with the hardware-neutral brand policy.
 * Public trade names must not be 'Polar H10 App' or 'Polar Cardio Lab'.
 * References to Polar / H10 must strictly appear in compatibility or non-affiliation contexts.
 */
export function validatePublicBrandSafety(text: string): { compliant: boolean; violations: string[] } {
  const violations: string[] = [];

  // Prohibited external software trade names that falsely imply affiliation
  const forbiddenBrandNames = [
    /polar\s+cardio\s+lab/i,
    /polar\s+h10\s+lab/i,
    /official\s+polar/i,
    /polar\s+workstation/i
  ];

  for (const regex of forbiddenBrandNames) {
    if (regex.test(text)) {
      violations.push(`Text contains prohibited affiliating trade name matching ${regex}`);
    }
  }

  return {
    compliant: violations.length === 0,
    violations
  };
}

/**
 * candidateChangeControl.ts
 *
 * Source change-control classification and candidate invalidation policy.
 * Implements Task FSR-07 for work item wi-2354052194e74c73bcd4c28877f50a53.
 */

export type SourceChangeCategory = 
  | 'product_logic'
  | 'api_schema_contract'
  | 'scientific_protocol'
  | 'test_evidence'
  | 'documentation'
  | 'control_plane'
  | 'ambient';

export interface ChangeClassificationResult {
  filePath: string;
  category: SourceChangeCategory;
  isCandidateDefining: boolean;
  requiresOwnerDecision: boolean;
  ownerDecisionReason?: string;
}

export interface CandidateDriftEvaluation {
  isAccepted: boolean;
  status: 'valid' | 'invalidated' | 'reconciliation_required';
  driftDetected: boolean;
  driftFiles: string[];
  reVerificationRequired: boolean;
  distributionDeferred: boolean;
}

/**
 * Classifies a project file change into normative categories and determines
 * whether it is candidate-defining or requires an explicit owner decision.
 */
export function classifySourceChange(filePath: string): ChangeClassificationResult {
  const norm = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');

  // 1. Scientific Protocol / Normative Claims
  if (
    norm.includes('ClaimsRegistry.ts') ||
    norm.includes('TaskEligibility.ts') ||
    norm.includes('protocolToleranceEvaluator.ts') ||
    norm.includes('MKT_R07_BLANK_OBSERVATION_PROTOCOL.json')
  ) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'scientific_protocol',
      isCandidateDefining: true,
      requiresOwnerDecision: true,
      ownerDecisionReason: 'Normative scientific protocol or non-diagnostic claims boundary modified. Requires explicit owner approval.'
    };
  }

  // 2. API, IPC, and Schema Contracts
  if (
    norm.startsWith('docs/snapshots/') ||
    norm.includes('routes.ts') ||
    norm.includes('preload.ts') ||
    norm.includes('CanonicalSessionResult.ts') ||
    norm.includes('ResearchEvidenceContract.ts') ||
    norm.includes('workspaceBackupContract.ts')
  ) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'api_schema_contract',
      isCandidateDefining: true,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  // 3. Product Application Logic
  if (
    norm.startsWith('src/backend/') ||
    norm.startsWith('src/frontend/') ||
    norm.startsWith('src/shared/') ||
    norm.startsWith('src/electron/')
  ) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'product_logic',
      isCandidateDefining: true,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  // 4. Test & Verification Suites
  if (norm.startsWith('tests/') || norm.startsWith('scripts/')) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'test_evidence',
      isCandidateDefining: true,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  // 5. Documentation
  if (norm.startsWith('docs/') || norm.endsWith('.md')) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'documentation',
      isCandidateDefining: false,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  // 6. Control plane
  if (norm.startsWith('.agy/') || norm.startsWith('.agents/')) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'control_plane',
      isCandidateDefining: false,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  // 7. Core project files
  if (
    norm === 'package.json' ||
    norm === 'package-lock.json' ||
    norm === 'tsconfig.json' ||
    norm === 'vite.config.ts' ||
    norm === 'vite.config.frontend.ts' ||
    norm === 'vitest.config.ts'
  ) {
    return {
      filePath,
      category: 'product_logic',
      isCandidateDefining: true,
      requiresOwnerDecision: false
    };
  }

  return {
    filePath,
    category: 'ambient',
    isCandidateDefining: false,
    requiresOwnerDecision: false
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates whether post-verification file changes invalidate current acceptance.
 */
export function evaluateCandidateDrift(
  statusString: string,
  modifiedFiles: string[]
): CandidateDriftEvaluation {
  const candidateDefiningChanges = modifiedFiles.filter(f => classifySourceChange(f).isCandidateDefining);
  const driftDetected = candidateDefiningChanges.length > 0;
  const isInvalidated = statusString !== 'current' || driftDetected;

  return {
    isAccepted: !isInvalidated,
    status: isInvalidated ? 'invalidated' : 'valid',
    driftDetected,
    driftFiles: candidateDefiningChanges,
    reVerificationRequired: isInvalidated,
    distributionDeferred: true
  };
}

export interface CommandImpactEvaluation {
  command: string;
  isReadOnly: boolean;
  isResultAuthority: boolean;
  isContextExport: boolean;
  causesInvalidation: boolean;
  reason: string;
}

/**
 * Evaluates whether a shell or node command execution causes candidate manifest invalidation.
 * Failed, denied, read-only, result-compilation and context-export operations do NOT invalidate.
 * Candidate invalidation requires actual candidate-defining drift.
 */
export function evaluateCommandCandidateImpact(
  command: string,
  exitCode: number = 0,
  hasSourceDrift: boolean = false
): CommandImpactEvaluation {
  const isResultAuthority = /Compile-ResultAuthority\.ps1/i.test(command);
  const isContextExport = /(Export-ProjectContextPack|companion-pack|companion-context)/i.test(command);
  const readOnlyPattern = /^\s*(git\s+(status|diff|rev-parse|log|show|branch|worktree\s+list)|get-content|get-childitem|test-path|select-string|node\s+(--check|scripts\/(?:check_|verify_|test_|generate_)[^\s]+\.(?:js|cjs|ts))|npm\s+(test|run\s+(test|typecheck))|npx\s+(vitest|tsc)|python\s+(scripts\/(?:reconcile|authoritative_closure|generate_|verify_|build_)[^\s]+\.py|-m\s+pytest|.*--version)|pwsh(\.exe)?\s+.*(?:test-|run_|verify_)[^\s]+\.ps1|pwsh(\.exe)?\s+(-noprofile\s+)?(-noninteractive\s+)?-command\s+["']?\s*(git\s+(status|diff|rev-parse|log|show|branch)|get-content|get-childitem|test-path|select-string))\b/i;
  const isReadOnly = readOnlyPattern.test(command);

  if (exitCode !== 0) {
    return {
      command,
      isReadOnly,
      isResultAuthority,
      isContextExport,
      causesInvalidation: false,
      reason: 'Failed commands do not invalidate candidate identity'
    };
  }

  if (isResultAuthority) {
    return {
      command,
      isReadOnly: true,
      isResultAuthority: true,
      isContextExport,
      causesInvalidation: false,
      reason: 'Result authority compilation maintains candidate identity snapshot'
    };
  }

  if (isContextExport) {
    return {
      command,
      isReadOnly: true,
      isResultAuthority: false,
      isContextExport: true,
      causesInvalidation: false,
      reason: 'Context export does not mutate candidate-defining sources'
    };
  }

  if (isReadOnly) {
    return {
      command,
      isReadOnly: true,
      isResultAuthority: false,
      isContextExport: false,
      causesInvalidation: false,
      reason: 'Read-only verification command does not mutate source candidate'
    };
  }

  if (hasSourceDrift) {
    return {
      command,
      isReadOnly: false,
      isResultAuthority: false,
      isContextExport: false,
      causesInvalidation: true,
      reason: 'Actual candidate-defining drift detected during command execution'
    };
  }

  return {
    command,
    isReadOnly: false,
    isResultAuthority: false,
    isContextExport: false,
    causesInvalidation: false,
    reason: 'Command completed without candidate-defining drift'
  };
}

// Hashing and Fingerprinting Helpers

export function computeAiWorkspaceFingerprint(
  snapshot: Omit<AiInterpretationWorkspaceSnapshot, 'snapshot_id' | 'dependency_fingerprint' | 'created_at_utc'>
): string {
  const norm = {
    schema_version: snapshot.schema_version,
    profile_id: snapshot.profile_id,
    profile_selection_revision: snapshot.profile_selection_revision,
    session_id: snapshot.session_id,
    source_id: snapshot.source_id,
    result_hash: snapshot.result_hash,
    ledger_hash: snapshot.ledger_hash,
    active_window_id: snapshot.active_window_id,
    active_window_revision: snapshot.active_window_revision,
    comparison_id: snapshot.comparison_id,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: snapshot.longitudinal_snapshot_id,
    prompt_library_version: snapshot.prompt_library_version,
    privacy_defaults: snapshot.privacy_defaults
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(norm)).digest('hex');
}

export function computeAiPlanHash(
  plan: Omit<AiPackPlan, 'plan_id' | 'plan_hash' | 'created_at_utc'>
): string {
  const norm = {
    schema_version: plan.schema_version,
    workspace_fingerprint: plan.workspace_fingerprint,
    session_id: plan.session_id,
    profile_id: plan.profile_id,
    prompt_id: plan.prompt_id,
    prompt_revision: plan.prompt_revision,
    prompt_hash: plan.prompt_hash,
    bounded_goal: plan.bounded_goal,
    bounded_notes: plan.bounded_notes,
    opt_ins: plan.opt_ins,
    locale: plan.locale,
    timezone: plan.timezone,
    projected_members: plan.projected_members.map(m => ({
      name: m.name,
      member_class: m.member_class,
      estimated_bytes: m.estimated_bytes
    })),
    privacy_decisions: plan.privacy_decisions
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(norm)).digest('hex');
}

export function computeAiManifestHash(
  manifest: Omit<AiPackManifest, 'manifest_id' | 'created_at_utc'>
): string {
  const norm = {
    schema_version: manifest.schema_version,
    job_id: manifest.job_id,
    pack_id: manifest.pack_id,
    session_id: manifest.session_id,
    profile_id: manifest.profile_id,
    filename: manifest.filename,
    size_bytes: manifest.size_bytes,
    sha256: manifest.sha256,
    canonical_semantic_hash: manifest.canonical_semantic_hash,
    members: manifest.members.map(m => ({
      name: m.name,
      member_class: m.member_class,
      size_bytes: m.size_bytes,
      sha256: m.sha256
    }))
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(norm)).digest('hex');
}

export function computeAiContentHash(content: string): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.from(content, 'utf8')).digest('hex');
}
