import { CanonicalSessionResult, computeCanonicalResultIdentity } from './CanonicalSessionResult';
import { FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY } from './FeatureMaturityRegistry';

export interface AICanonicalMetricEntry {
  metric_id: string;
  name: string;
  value: number | null;
  unit: string;
  eligibility: string;
  maturity: string;
}

export interface AIInterpretationPackContext {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  session_id: string;
  session_date: string;
  duration_seconds: number;
  duration_formatted: string;
  recording_context: string;
  signals_present: string[];
  quality: {
    total_beats: number;
    accepted_nn_beats: number;
    artifact_percentage: number;
  };
  core_metrics: Record<string, AICanonicalMetricEntry>;
  advanced_metrics: Record<string, AICanonicalMetricEntry>;
  task_eligibility: Record<string, {
    state: string;
    warnings: string[];
    limitations: string[];
  }>;
  provenance: {
    engine: string;
    protocol_authority: string;
    build_version: string;
    timestamp_utc: string;
  };
  suggested_non_medical_questions: string[];
  mandatory_disclaimer: string;
}

/**
 * Projects CanonicalSessionResult into a compact, privacy-safe, provider-neutral AI Interpretation Context.
 */
export function projectCanonicalSessionToAiPack(
  session: CanonicalSessionResult
): AIInterpretationPackContext {
  const durationSec = session.timing.duration_seconds;
  const mins = Math.floor(durationSec / 60);
  const secs = Math.round(durationSec % 60);
  const duration_formatted = `${mins}m ${secs}s`;

  const signals_present: string[] = [];
  if (session.signal_availability.has_rr) signals_present.push('RR');
  if (session.signal_availability.has_hr) signals_present.push('HR');
  if (session.signal_availability.has_ecg) signals_present.push('ECG');
  if (session.signal_availability.has_acc) signals_present.push('ACC');

  const core_metrics: Record<string, AICanonicalMetricEntry> = {
    rmssd: {
      metric_id: 'rmssd',
      name: 'RMSSD',
      value: session.core_metrics.rmssd.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.rmssd.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.time_domain_hrv_rmssd.maturity_level
    },
    sdnn: {
      metric_id: 'sdnn',
      name: 'SDNN',
      value: session.core_metrics.sdnn.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.sdnn.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.time_domain_hrv_sdnn.maturity_level
    },
    pnn50: {
      metric_id: 'pnn50',
      name: 'pNN50',
      value: session.core_metrics.pnn50.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.pnn50.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.pnn50.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.time_domain_hrv_pnn50.maturity_level
    },
    mean_hr_bpm: {
      metric_id: 'mean_hr_bpm',
      name: 'Mean HR',
      value: session.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.mean_hr_bpm.maturity_level
    },
    mean_rr_ms: {
      metric_id: 'mean_rr_ms',
      name: 'Mean RR',
      value: session.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.mean_rr_ms.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.mean_rr_ms.maturity_level
    }
  };

  const advanced_metrics: Record<string, AICanonicalMetricEntry> = {};
  if (session.advanced_metrics?.frequency_domain) {
    const fd = session.advanced_metrics.frequency_domain;
    advanced_metrics.lf = {
      metric_id: 'lf',
      name: 'LF Power',
      value: fd.lf.value,
      unit: fd.lf.unit,
      eligibility: fd.lf.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.frequency_domain_hrv.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.hf = {
      metric_id: 'hf',
      name: 'HF Power',
      value: fd.hf.value,
      unit: fd.hf.unit,
      eligibility: fd.hf.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.frequency_domain_hrv.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.lf_hf_ratio = {
      metric_id: 'lf_hf_ratio',
      name: 'LF/HF Ratio',
      value: fd.lf_hf_ratio.value,
      unit: fd.lf_hf_ratio.unit,
      eligibility: fd.lf_hf_ratio.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.frequency_domain_hrv.maturity_level
    };
  }

  if (session.advanced_metrics?.poincare) {
    const p = session.advanced_metrics.poincare;
    advanced_metrics.sd1 = {
      metric_id: 'sd1',
      name: 'Poincaré SD1',
      value: p.sd1.value,
      unit: p.sd1.unit,
      eligibility: p.sd1.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.poincare_nonlinear.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.sd2 = {
      metric_id: 'sd2',
      name: 'Poincaré SD2',
      value: p.sd2.value,
      unit: p.sd2.unit,
      eligibility: p.sd2.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.poincare_nonlinear.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.sd1_sd2_ratio = {
      metric_id: 'sd1_sd2_ratio',
      name: 'Poincaré SD1/SD2 Ratio',
      value: p.sd1_sd2_ratio.value,
      unit: p.sd1_sd2_ratio.unit,
      eligibility: p.sd1_sd2_ratio.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.poincare_nonlinear.maturity_level
    };
  }

  if (session.advanced_metrics?.dfa) {
    const dfa = session.advanced_metrics.dfa;
    advanced_metrics.dfa_alpha1 = {
      metric_id: 'dfa_alpha1',
      name: 'DFA Alpha 1 (Short-term)',
      value: dfa.alpha1?.alpha ?? null,
      unit: 'scaling',
      eligibility: dfa.alpha1?.eligibility === 'eligible' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.dfa_alpha1_alpha2.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.dfa_alpha2 = {
      metric_id: 'dfa_alpha2',
      name: 'DFA Alpha 2 (Long-term)',
      value: dfa.alpha2?.alpha ?? null,
      unit: 'scaling',
      eligibility: dfa.alpha2?.eligibility === 'eligible' ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.dfa_alpha1_alpha2.maturity_level
    };
  }

  if (session.advanced_metrics?.lomb_scargle) {
    const ls = session.advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle;
    advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle_lf = {
      metric_id: 'lomb_scargle_lf',
      name: 'Lomb-Scargle LF Power',
      value: ls.lf?.power_ms2 ?? null,
      unit: 'ms²',
      eligibility: ls.lf?.power_ms2 !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.lomb_scargle_periodogram.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle_hf = {
      metric_id: 'lomb_scargle_hf',
      name: 'Lomb-Scargle HF Power',
      value: ls.hf?.power_ms2 ?? null,
      unit: 'ms²',
      eligibility: ls.hf?.power_ms2 !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.lomb_scargle_periodogram.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.lomb_scargle_ratio = {
      metric_id: 'lomb_scargle_ratio',
      name: 'Lomb-Scargle LF/HF Ratio',
      value: ls.lf_hf_ratio ?? null,
      unit: 'ratio',
      eligibility: ls.lf_hf_ratio !== null ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.lomb_scargle_periodogram.maturity_level
    };
  }

  if (session.activity_segmentation) {
    const act = session.activity_segmentation;
    advanced_metrics.activity_active_duration = {
      metric_id: 'activity_active_duration',
      name: 'Active Duration (Motion Context)',
      value: act.active_duration_seconds,
      unit: 's',
      eligibility: 'ELIGIBLE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.activity_segmentation.maturity_level
    };
    advanced_metrics.activity_inactive_duration = {
      metric_id: 'activity_inactive_duration',
      name: 'Inactive Duration (Rest Context)',
      value: act.inactive_duration_seconds,
      unit: 's',
      eligibility: 'ELIGIBLE',
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.activity_segmentation.maturity_level
    };
  }

  const task_eligibility: Record<string, { state: string; warnings: string[]; limitations: string[] }> = {};
  for (const [taskId, taskRes] of Object.entries(session.task_eligibility)) {
    task_eligibility[taskId] = {
      state: taskRes.state,
      warnings: taskRes.warning_reasons,
      limitations: taskRes.limitations
    };
  }

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    session_id: session.session_id,
    session_date: session.timing.start_time_utc ? session.timing.start_time_utc.split('T')[0] : 'UNKNOWN_DATE',
    duration_seconds: Math.round(durationSec),
    duration_formatted,
    recording_context: 'resting',
    signals_present,
    quality: {
      total_beats: session.quality_summary.total_beats,
      accepted_nn_beats: session.quality_summary.accepted_nn_beats,
      artifact_percentage: session.quality_summary.artifact_percentage
    },
    core_metrics,
    advanced_metrics,
    task_eligibility,
    provenance: {
      engine: session.provenance.engine_name,
      protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
      build_version: session.provenance.build_version,
      timestamp_utc: session.provenance.timestamp_utc
    },
    suggested_non_medical_questions: [
      'How do these autonomic time-domain HRV metrics compare to general athletic baseline ranges for resting sessions?',
      'What physiological factors typically influence changes in RMSSD during recovery?',
      'How might recording duration and posture impact the interpretation of these interval distributions?'
    ],
    mandatory_disclaimer: 'NON-MEDICAL RESEARCH & ATHLETIC WORKSTATION NOTICE: All metrics and AI commentary are for athletic tracking, scientific research, and educational purposes only. This software is NOT a medical device and does NOT diagnose, treat, or screen for any medical condition, cardiac arrhythmia, or disease.'
  };
}

/**
 * Projects CanonicalSessionResult into the versioned provider-neutral
 * AIInterpretationPackContextV2 canonical semantic schema.
 */
export function projectCanonicalSessionToAiPackV2(
  session: CanonicalSessionResult,
  options?: ProjectAiPackV2Options
): AIInterpretationPackContextV2 {
  const durationSec = session.timing.duration_seconds;
  const mins = Math.floor(durationSec / 60);
  const secs = Math.round(durationSec % 60);
  const duration_formatted = `${mins}m ${secs}s`;

  const sigAvail = session.signal_availability || { has_rr: false, has_hr: false, has_ecg: false, has_acc: false };
  const signals_present: string[] = [];
  if (sigAvail.has_rr) signals_present.push('RR');
  if (sigAvail.has_hr) signals_present.push('HR');
  if (sigAvail.has_ecg) signals_present.push('ECG');
  if (sigAvail.has_acc) signals_present.push('ACC');

  const privacyLevel = options?.privacyLevel || 'pseudonymized';
  const includeNotes = options?.includeNotes ?? false;
  const rawSeriesOptIn = options?.rawSeriesOptIn ?? false;
  const userGoal: AIUserGoal = options?.userGoal || 'session_first_look';

  // 1. Core metrics projection
  const core_metrics: Record<string, AICanonicalMetricEntryV2> = {
    rmssd: {
      metric_id: 'rmssd',
      name: 'RMSSD',
      value: session.core_metrics.rmssd.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.rmssd.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.rmssd.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.time_domain_hrv_rmssd.maturity_level,
      method: session.core_metrics.rmssd.method_name || 'successive_differences_ms',
      version: session.core_metrics.rmssd.method_version || '1.1.0',
      limitations: (session.core_metrics.rmssd.limitations || []).slice()
    },
    sdnn: {
      metric_id: 'sdnn',
      name: 'SDNN',
      value: session.core_metrics.sdnn.value,
      unit: session.core_metrics.sdnn.unit,
      eligibility: session.core_metrics.sdnn.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.time_domain_hrv_sdnn.maturity_level,
      method: session.core_metrics.sdnn.method_name || 'sample_standard_deviation_n_minus_1_ms',
      version: session.core_metrics.sdnn.method_version || '1.1.0',
      limitations: (session.core_metrics.sdnn.limitations || []).slice()
    },
    pnn50: {
      metric_id: 'pnn50',
      name: 'pNN50',
      value: session.core_metrics.pnn50.value,

    },
    mean_hr_bpm: {

      eligibility: session.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.eligibility_state,
      maturity: FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY.mean_hr_bpm.maturity_level,

    mean_rr_ms: {

  // 2. Advanced metrics projection
  const fd = session.advanced_metrics?.frequency_domain;
  const pnc = session.advanced_metrics?.poincare;
  const hz = session.heart_rate_zones;
  const qrs = session.ecg_evidence?.qrs_detector;
  const snr = session.ecg_evidence?.snr;
  const ecgTech = session.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality;

  const advanced_metrics: AIInterpretationPackContextV2['advanced_metrics'] = {

    },
    heart_rate_recovery: {

  // 3. Task eligibility
  const task_eligibility: Record<string, { state: string; eligibility: string; warnings: string[]; limitations: string[] }> = {};
  for (const [taskId, taskRes] of Object.entries(session.task_eligibility)) {
    const stateVal = taskRes.state;
    task_eligibility[taskId] = {
      state: stateVal,
      eligibility: stateVal.toLowerCase(),
      warnings: (taskRes.warning_reasons || []).slice(),
      limitations: (taskRes.limitations || []).slice()
    };
  }

  // 4. Comparison context (canonical peers only)
  let comparison_context: AIComparisonContextV2;
  const peers = options?.comparisonPeers || [];
  const compatiblePeers = peers.filter(p => p.isCompatible);
  const excludedPeers = peers.filter(p => !p.isCompatible);

  if (compatiblePeers.length > 0) {
    const rmssdValues = compatiblePeers.map(p => p.metrics?.rmssd).filter((v): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
    const sdnnValues = compatiblePeers.map(p => p.metrics?.sdnn).filter((v): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
    const hrValues = compatiblePeers.map(p => p.metrics?.mean_hr).filter((v): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));

    const getMedian = (arr: number[]): number | null => {
      if (arr.length === 0) return null;
      const s = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const mid = Math.floor(s.length / 2);
      return s.length % 2 !== 0 ? s[mid] : (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2;
    };

    const rmssdMedian = getMedian(rmssdValues);
    const sdnnMedian = getMedian(sdnnValues);
    const hrMedian = getMedian(hrValues);

    const calcDiff = (curr: number | null, med: number | null, unit: string): AIComparisonMetricDiff => {
      if (curr === null || med === null) {
        return { current: curr, baseline_median: med, diff: null, diff_percent: null, unit };
      }
      const diff = Math.round((curr - med) * 10) / 10;
      const diff_percent = med !== 0 ? Math.round(((curr - med) / med) * 1000) / 10 : null;
      return { current: curr, baseline_median: med, diff, diff_percent, unit };
    };

    comparison_context = {
      target_session_id: session.session_id,
      compatible_peer_count: compatiblePeers.length,
      excluded_peer_count: excludedPeers.length,
      excluded_reasons: Array.from(new Set(excludedPeers.map(p => p.exclusionReason || 'incompatible_protocol_or_eligibility'))),
      status: 'available',
      comparisons: {
        rmssd: calcDiff(session.core_metrics.rmssd.value, rmssdMedian, 'ms'),
        sdnn: calcDiff(session.core_metrics.sdnn.value, sdnnMedian, 'ms'),
        mean_hr: calcDiff(session.core_metrics.mean_hr_bpm.value, hrMedian, 'bpm')
      },
      limitations: [
        `Сравнение выполнено исключительно с совместимыми сессиями (${compatiblePeers.length} шт.), записанными по Frozen Protocol v1.1.0.`
      ]
    };
  } else {
    comparison_context = {
      target_session_id: session.session_id,
      compatible_peer_count: 0,
      excluded_peer_count: excludedPeers.length,
      excluded_reasons: excludedPeers.length > 0 ? Array.from(new Set(excludedPeers.map(p => p.exclusionReason || 'incompatible_protocol_or_eligibility'))) : ['нет предыдущих сессий для данного профиля'],
      status: 'insufficient_compatible_sessions',
      comparisons: null,
      limitations: [
        'Недостаточно совместимых канонических сессий для расчета персонального бейзлайна.',
        'Использование сторонних обобщенных референсов в качестве персонального тренда запрещено.'
      ]
    };
  }

  // 5. Suggested questions based on explicit user goal
  const goalQuestions: Record<AIUserGoal, string[]> = {
    session_first_look: [
      'How do the measured resting/active heart rate and time-domain HRV markers (RMSSD, SDNN) reflect overall autonomic state during this recording?',
      'What are the primary signal quality warnings or limitations identified in the quality evidence?',
      'How does recording duration and signal completeness impact the analytical reliability of these calculated metrics?'
    ],
    compare_with_compatible: [
      'How do the core HRV metrics of this session compare against compatible peer sessions under the same protocol?',
      'Are observed differences in RMSSD and mean heart rate within typical athletic day-to-day variability or do they suggest a notable autonomic deviation?',
      'Were any historical sessions excluded from comparison due to protocol, duration, or eligibility incompatibility?'
    ],
    explain_hrv_metrics: [
      'What physiological mechanisms govern RMSSD versus SDNN in athletic cardiovascular monitoring?',
      'Why does pNN50 require strict NN beat filtering and how does artifact percentage affect this value?',
      'What are the mathematical limitations of time-domain HRV metrics for non-stationary recording intervals?'
    ],
    explain_signal_quality: [
      'What factors contributed to the artifact percentage and SNR levels recorded during this session?',
      'How did ECG technical quality and ACC motion context affect the eligibility of specific analysis tasks?',
      'Why are certain advanced metrics marked INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_ELIGIBLE based on data quality gates?'
    ],
    explain_advanced_metrics: [
      'How should the Poincaré SD1 and SD2 metrics be interpreted alongside frequency-domain LF and HF power?',
      'What is the declared Feature Maturity status for HR zones, QRS detection, and heart rate recovery in this pack?',
      'Why are experimental features such as Recovery or DFA bounded and what limitations apply to their interpretation?'
    ],
    methodology_review: [
      'How does Frozen Protocol v1.1.0 govern metric calculation, sample variance formulas, and eligibility thresholds?',
      'What independent reference oracles and validation baselines verify the algorithms in this workstation?',
      'What non-medical and non-diagnostic boundaries are enforced across all workstation outputs?'
    ]
  };

  const allWarnings: string[] = [];
  const allLimitations: string[] = [];
  for (const t of Object.values(session.task_eligibility)) {
    if (t.warning_reasons) allWarnings.push(...t.warning_reasons);
    if (t.limitations) allLimitations.push(...t.limitations);
  }

  // True canonical result identity
  const identity = session.canonical_result_identity || computeCanonicalResultIdentity(session);

  return {
    schema_version: '2.0.0',
    canonical_result_identity: {
      session_id: session.session_id,
      source_bundle_id: session.source_bundle_id ?? null,
      canonical_hash: identity.canonical_result_hash,
      hash_version: identity.hash_version,
      metrics_content_hash: identity.metrics_content_hash,
      task_eligibility_hash: identity.task_eligibility_hash
    },
    session_context: {
      session_id: session.session_id,
      session_alias: options?.sessionAlias || `Session_${session.session_id.substring(0, 8)}`,
      start_time_utc: session.timing.start_time_utc || 'UNKNOWN',
      end_time_utc: session.timing.end_time_utc,
      duration_seconds: Math.round(durationSec),
      duration_formatted,
      recording_context: options?.recordingContext || options?.activityType || 'unknown',
      signals_present
    },
    quality_evidence: {
      total_beats: session.quality_summary.total_beats,
      accepted_nn_beats: session.quality_summary.accepted_nn_beats,
      artifact_percentage: session.quality_summary.artifact_percentage,
      snr_db: snr?.value_db ?? session.quality_summary.ecg_snr_db ?? null,
      snr_quality_status: snr?.quality_status ?? null,
      ecg_clipping_fraction: ecgTech?.clipping?.value ?? null,
      ecg_noisy_window_fraction: ecgTech?.noisy_window_fraction?.value ?? null,
      ecg_baseline_drift_fraction: ecgTech?.baseline_drift?.value ?? null,
      motion_severity: accMov?.motion_severity ?? null,
      task_warnings: Array.from(new Set(allWarnings)),
      task_limitations: Array.from(new Set(allLimitations))
    },
    core_metrics,
    advanced_metrics,
    task_eligibility,
    comparison_context,
    privacy_projection: {
      privacy_level: privacyLevel,
      display_name_redacted: true,
      device_id_redacted: true,
      local_paths_redacted: true,
      notes_included: includeNotes,
      raw_physiological_series_included: rawSeriesOptIn,
      signal_excerpts_included: Boolean(options?.signalExcerptOptIn)
    },
    suggested_questions: goalQuestions[userGoal] || goalQuestions.session_first_look,
    methodology_and_limits: {
      non_medical_disclaimer: 'NON-MEDICAL RESEARCH & ATHLETIC WORKSTATION NOTICE: All metrics and AI commentary are for athletic tracking, scientific research, and educational purposes only. This software is NOT a medical device and does NOT diagnose, treat, or screen for any medical condition, cardiac arrhythmia, or disease.',
      non_diagnostic_notice: 'The LLM must NOT diagnose medical conditions, provide treatment recommendations, or evaluate cardiovascular safety clearance.',
      frozen_protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
      build_version: session.provenance.build_version,
      timestamp_utc: session.provenance.timestamp_utc
    },
    provenance: {
      engine: session.provenance.engine_name,
      protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
      build_version: session.provenance.build_version,
      timestamp_utc: session.provenance.timestamp_utc
    }
  };
}

function canonicalJsonStringify(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return '[' + obj.map(canonicalJsonStringify).join(',') + ']';
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  return '{' + keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + canonicalJsonStringify(obj[k])).join(',') + '}';
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic SHA-256 hash of the canonical semantic core of AIInterpretationPackContextV2.
 * Excludes layout-specific or transport fields so the semantic identity remains identical across all profiles.
 */
export function computeCanonicalSemanticHash(pack: AIInterpretationPackContextV2): string {
  const semanticCore = {
    schema_version: pack.schema_version,
    canonical_result_identity: pack.canonical_result_identity,
    duration_seconds: pack.session_context.duration_seconds,
    signals_present: pack.session_context.signals_present,
    quality_evidence: pack.quality_evidence,
    core_metrics: pack.core_metrics,
    advanced_metrics: pack.advanced_metrics,
    task_eligibility: pack.task_eligibility,
    comparison_context: pack.comparison_context,
    methodology_and_limits: pack.methodology_and_limits
  };
  const normalized = canonicalJsonStringify(semanticCore);
  const cryptoMod = require('crypto');
  return cryptoMod.createHash('sha256').update(normalized, 'utf8').digest('hex');
}

/**
 * AlgorithmCandidateRegistryContract.ts
 *
 * Canonical schema and types for Algorithm Candidate Registry,
 * Component Manifests, Parameter Digest, Evaluation Plans, Holdout Partitions,
 * and Evidence-Gated Change Governance.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1.0 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-d2413a2e2e9b4c1fb0cfb051130147b9
 * - Action Packet packet_h10_algorithm_candidate_registry_governance_20260917_171502
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 * - Local-first, file-first, privacy-preserving boundaries
 */

export const ALGORITHM_CANDIDATE_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

/**
 * Lifecycle states of an algorithm candidate.
 */
export type CandidateLifecycleState =
  | 'registered'
  | 'evaluating'
  | 'evaluated'
  | 'eligible_for_source_change'
  | 'active_source_baseline'
  | 'promoted'
  | 'superseded'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'rolled_back'
  | 'rollback_recommended'
  | 'historical_unverified';

/**
 * Scientific impact classification of candidate algorithm changes.
 */
export type ScientificImpactClassification =
  | 'none'                      // Non-functional, refactoring, performance without output changes
  | 'non_normative_improvement' // Fixes or refinements within existing protocol tolerance
  | 'potential_normative_shift' // Changes that alter core feature distributions or require protocol review
  | 'normative_breaking';       // Changes that violate or conflict with frozen protocol criteria

/**
 * Component manifest entry binding exact source files and versions.
 */
export interface CandidateComponentSpec {
  component_id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  source_path: string;
  source_sha256: string;
  role: 'qrs_detector' | 'rr_parser' | 'filter' | 'resampler' | 'qc' | 'feature_extractor' | 'other';
}

/**
 * Algorithm Candidate Specification.
 * Durable, content-hashed definition binding source manifest, components, and parameters.
 */
export interface AlgorithmCandidateSpec {
  candidate_id: string;               // Deterministic urn/uuid
  candidate_name: string;             // Human readable name, e.g. "QRS-Adaptive-Median-v2"
  candidate_version: string;          // SemVer e.g. "1.2.0"
  git_head: string;                   // Git commit SHA
  source_manifest_sha256?: string;    // Candidate manifest SHA-256
  candidate_content_sha256?: string;  // Deterministic content hash of canonical candidate definition
  protocol_version?: string;          // e.g. "v1.1.0"
  parent_candidate_id?: string | null;// Ancestor candidate if superseding/refining
  scientific_impact?: ScientificImpactClassification;
  components: CandidateComponentSpec[];
  parameter_digest_sha256?: string;   // SHA-256 of normalized configuration/parameters
  parameters_json?: string;           // Serialized JSON of algorithm parameter dictionary
  parameters?: Record<string, any>;   // In-memory or parsed parameters dictionary
  state?: CandidateLifecycleState;
  registered_at_utc?: string;
  registered_by?: string;
  superseded_by?: string | null;
  superseded_at_utc?: string | null;
  rejection_reason?: string | null;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Partition type for datasets in evaluation plans.
 * Holdout partition MUST NOT be used for calibration/tuning.
 */
export type DatasetPartitionClass =
  | 'holdout'      // Primary independent verification partition
  | 'calibration'  // Development / parameter selection partition
  | 'exploratory';  // Uncurated pilot observation

/**
 * Pre-specified Evaluation Plan.
 * Binds a registered candidate to explicit cohorts, datasets, endpoints, and partition rules.
 */
export interface EvaluationPlan {
  plan_id: string;
  plan_name: string;
  candidate_id: string;
  study_id: string;
  cohort_id: string;
  cohort_revision_number: number;
  protocol_version: string;

  timestamp_utc: string;
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint of analysis context.
 * Sensitive to user, session, canonical identity, window revision, comparison, privacy options, and notes.
 */
export function computeAnalysisContextFingerprint(
  input: Omit<AnalysisContextSnapshot, 'context_fingerprint' | 'timestamp_utc'>
): string {
  const normalized = {
    schema_version: input.schema_version,
    user_id: input.user_id,
    session_id: input.session_id,
    canonical_result_identity: input.canonical_result_identity,
    compare_mode: input.compare_mode,
    peer_session_id: input.peer_session_id,
    window_id: input.window_id,
    window_revision: input.window_revision,
    window_result_identity: input.window_result_identity,
    comparison_id: input.comparison_id,
    comparison_kind: input.comparison_kind,
    comparison_inputs: input.comparison_inputs,
    export_profile: input.export_profile,
    prompt_name: input.prompt_name,
    user_goal: input.user_goal,
    privacy_level: input.privacy_level,
    privacy_options: {
      rawSeriesOptIn: Boolean(input.privacy_options?.rawSeriesOptIn),
      signalExcerptOptIn: Boolean(input.privacy_options?.signalExcerptOptIn),
      includeNotes: Boolean(input.privacy_options?.includeNotes)
    },
    notes_hash: input.notes_hash || 'none',
    compiler_version: input.compiler_version,
    member_classes: [...(input.member_classes || [])].sort()
  };

  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalized)).digest('hex');
}

export function calculateDeterministicSha256(content: string): string {
  try {
    const cryptoMod = require('crypto');
    return cryptoMod.createHash('sha256').update(content, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  } catch {
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < content.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + content.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
  }
}

/**
 * Computes canonical fingerprint for an AthleteCoreJourneyContext.
 */
export function computeJourneyFingerprint(
  ctx: Omit<AthleteCoreJourneyContext, 'fingerprint'> | AthleteCoreJourneyContext
): string {
  const canonicalRepresentation = {
    schema_version: ctx.schema_version,
    profile_id: ctx.profile.profile_id,
    profile_mode: ctx.profile.mode,
    is_synthetic: ctx.profile.is_synthetic || ctx.session.is_synthetic,
    session_id: ctx.session.session_id,
    source_id: ctx.session.source_id,
    result_hash: ctx.session.result_hash,
    currentness: ctx.session.currentness,
    overall_quality_score: ctx.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score,
    activity_type: ctx.activity.activity_type,
    annotation_revision: ctx.activity.annotation_revision,
    active_window_id: ctx.window?.active_window_id || null,
    active_window_revision: ctx.window?.active_window_revision || null,
    compare_mode: ctx.comparison.mode,
    compare_target: ctx.comparison.target_session_id,
    compare_peer: ctx.comparison.peer_session_id,
    saved_view_id: ctx.comparison.saved_view_id,
    saved_view_revision: ctx.comparison.saved_view_revision,
    export_preview_fingerprint: ctx.export_diary.export_preview_fingerprint,
    active_pack_id: ctx.export_diary.active_pack_id,
    active_diary_id: ctx.export_diary.active_diary_id,
    privacy_mode: ctx.privacy_entitlement.privacy_mode,
    entitlement_status: ctx.privacy_entitlement.entitlement_status,
    context_generation: ctx.context_generation
  };
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonicalRepresentation));
}

      source_id: null,
      result_hash: null,
      ledger_hash: null,

      currentness_reason: null,
      is_synthetic: Boolean(opts?.isSynthetic),

      duration_seconds: null
    },

    },
    activity: {
      activity_type: null,
      activity_label_custom: null,
      perceived_effort: null,
      sleep_quality_subjective: null,
      user_notes: null,
      annotation_revision: 1,
      task_revision: 1
    },
    window: null,
    comparison: {
      mode: 'none',
      target_session_id: null,
      peer_session_id: null,

      saved_view_id: null,

/**
 * Validates AthleteCoreJourneyContext object structure and integrity.
 */
export function validateAthleteJourneyContext(ctx: unknown): AthleteCoreJourneyContext {
  if (!ctx || typeof ctx !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Journey context must be a non-null object');
  }
  const c = ctx as Partial<AthleteCoreJourneyContext>;
  if (!c.context_id || typeof c.context_id !== 'string') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Context missing valid context_id');
  }
  if (!c.profile || typeof c.profile !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Context missing profile state');
  }
  if (typeof c.context_generation !== 'number' || c.context_generation < 1) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('context_generation must be >= 1');
  }
  if (!c.session || typeof c.session !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Context missing session state');
  }
  if (!c.quality_metrics || typeof c.quality_metrics !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Context missing quality_metrics state');
  }
  if (!c.comparison || typeof c.comparison !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Context missing comparison state');
  }

  const validModes: JourneyProfileMode[] = ['unresolved', 'selected', 'aggregate'];
  if (!validModes.includes(c.profile.mode)) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError(`Invalid profile mode '${c.profile.mode}'`);
  }

  const validCurrentness: ContextCurrentness[] = ['current', 'historical', 'superseded', 'unavailable'];
  if (!validCurrentness.includes(c.session.currentness)) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError(`Invalid session currentness '${c.session.currentness}'`);
  }

  const sanitized: AthleteCoreJourneyContext = {
    schema_version: c.schema_version || ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    context_id: c.context_id,
    fingerprint: c.fingerprint || '',
    profile: {
      mode: c.profile.mode,
      profile_id: c.profile.profile_id || null,
      display_name: c.profile.display_name || null,
      export_alias: c.profile.export_alias || null,
      is_synthetic: Boolean(c.profile.is_synthetic),
      is_read_only: Boolean(c.profile.is_read_only)
    },
    session: {
      session_id: c.session.session_id || null,
      source_id: c.session.source_id || null,
      result_hash: c.session.result_hash || null,
      ledger_hash: c.session.ledger_hash || null,
      currentness: c.session.currentness,
      currentness_reason: c.session.currentness_reason || null,
      is_synthetic: Boolean(c.session.is_synthetic),
      start_time_utc: c.session.start_time_utc || null,
      duration_seconds: typeof c.session.duration_seconds === 'number' ? c.session.duration_seconds : null
    },
    quality_metrics: {
      overall_quality_score: typeof c.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score === 'number' ? c.quality_metrics.overall_quality_score : null,
      normalized_quality_percent: typeof c.quality_metrics.normalized_quality_percent === 'number' ? c.quality_metrics.normalized_quality_percent : null,
      quality_limitation: c.quality_metrics.quality_limitation || 'normal',
      metrics: c.quality_metrics.metrics || {},
      rr_continuity: c.quality_metrics.rr_continuity || null
    },
    activity: {
      activity_type: c.activity?.activity_type || null,
      activity_label_custom: c.activity?.activity_label_custom || null,
      perceived_effort: typeof c.activity?.perceived_effort === 'number' ? c.activity.perceived_effort : null,
      sleep_quality_subjective: typeof c.activity?.sleep_quality_subjective === 'number' ? c.activity.sleep_quality_subjective : null,
      user_notes: c.activity?.user_notes || null,
      annotation_revision: typeof c.activity?.annotation_revision === 'number' ? c.activity.annotation_revision : 1,
      task_revision: typeof c.activity?.task_revision === 'number' ? c.activity.task_revision : 1
    },
    window: c.window ? {
      active_window_id: c.window.active_window_id || null,
      active_window_revision: typeof c.window.active_window_revision === 'number' ? c.window.active_window_revision : null,
      window_root_id: c.window.window_root_id || null,
      window_metrics: c.window.window_metrics || null
    } : null,
    comparison: {
      mode: c.comparison.mode || 'none',
      target_session_id: c.comparison.target_session_id || null,
      peer_session_id: c.comparison.peer_session_id || null,
      comparison_compatibility: c.comparison.comparison_compatibility || null,
      longitudinal_snapshot_id: c.comparison.longitudinal_snapshot_id || null,
      saved_view_id: c.comparison.saved_view_id || null,
      saved_view_revision: typeof c.comparison.saved_view_revision === 'number' ? c.comparison.saved_view_revision : null,
      baseline_status: c.comparison.baseline_status || null,
      metric_readiness: c.comparison.metric_readiness || {}
    },
    episode_outcome: {
      active_episode_id: c.episode_outcome?.active_episode_id || null,
      active_series_id: c.episode_outcome?.active_series_id || null,
      local_outcome_id: c.episode_outcome?.local_outcome_id || null,
      useful_outcome_confirmed: Boolean(c.episode_outcome?.useful_outcome_confirmed),
      distinct_repeat_continuation_eligible: Boolean(c.episode_outcome?.distinct_repeat_continuation_eligible)
    },
    export_diary: {
      export_preview_fingerprint: c.export_diary?.export_preview_fingerprint || null,
      active_pack_id: c.export_diary?.active_pack_id || null,
      active_diary_id: c.export_diary?.active_diary_id || null,
      diary_lineage_currentness: c.export_diary?.diary_lineage_currentness || 'unavailable',
      diary_text: c.export_diary?.diary_text || null,
      sensitive_opt_in: {
        raw_ecg: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_ecg),
        raw_rr: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_rr),
        raw_acc: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_acc),
        notes: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.notes),
        identifiers: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.identifiers),
        paths: Boolean(c.export_diary?.sensitive_opt_in?.paths)
      }
    },
    privacy_entitlement: {
      privacy_mode: c.privacy_entitlement?.privacy_mode || 'standard',
      entitlement_status: c.privacy_entitlement?.entitlement_status || 'valid',
      existing_data_readable: c.privacy_entitlement?.existing_data_readable !== false,
      privacy_safe_export_allowed: c.privacy_entitlement?.privacy_safe_export_allowed !== false,
      limitations: c.privacy_entitlement?.limitations || []
    },
    exact_next_safe_action: c.exact_next_safe_action || 'nav:sessions',
    context_generation: c.context_generation,
    created_at_utc: c.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at_utc: c.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  };

  sanitized.fingerprint = computeJourneyFingerprint(sanitized);
  return sanitized;
}

/**
 * Enforces cross-profile isolation on journey context.
 */
export function failClosedOnCrossProfileJourney(
  context: AthleteCoreJourneyContext,
  candidateProfileId: string | null
): void {
  if (
    candidateProfileId &&
    context.profile.mode === 'selected' &&
    context.profile.profile_id &&
    candidateProfileId !== context.profile.profile_id
  ) {
    throw new CrossProfileJourneyError(
      `Cross-profile journey violation: context bound to '${context.profile.profile_id}', requested '${candidateProfileId}'`,
      context.profile.profile_id,
      candidateProfileId
    );
  }
}

export interface JourneyContextUpdates {
  profile?: Partial<JourneyProfileState>;
  session?: Partial<JourneySessionState>;
  quality_metrics?: Partial<JourneyQualityMetricsState>;
  activity?: Partial<JourneyActivityAnnotationState>;
  window?: JourneyWindowState | null;
  comparison?: Partial<JourneyComparisonState>;
  episode_outcome?: Partial<JourneyEpisodeOutcomeState>;
  export_diary?: Partial<JourneyExportDiaryState>;
  privacy_entitlement?: Partial<JourneyPrivacyEntitlementState>;
  exact_next_safe_action?: string;
}

/**
 * Transitions journey context with incremented generation and fresh fingerprint.
 */
export function transitionJourneyContext(
  current: AthleteCoreJourneyContext,
  updates: JourneyContextUpdates,
  expectedGeneration?: number
): AthleteCoreJourneyContext {
  if (expectedGeneration !== undefined && expectedGeneration !== current.context_generation) {
    throw new JourneyGenerationRaceError(
      `Stale context generation: expected ${expectedGeneration}, current is ${current.context_generation}`,
      current.context_generation,
      expectedGeneration
    );
  }

  if (updates.profile?.profile_id && updates.profile.profile_id !== current.profile.profile_id) {
    failClosedOnCrossProfileJourney(current, updates.profile.profile_id);
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const nextGeneration = current.context_generation + 1;

  const nextContext: AthleteCoreJourneyContext = {
    ...current,
    ...updates,
    profile: updates.profile ? { ...current.profile, ...updates.profile } : current.profile,
    session: updates.session ? { ...current.session, ...updates.session } : current.session,
    quality_metrics: updates.quality_metrics ? { ...current.quality_metrics, ...updates.quality_metrics } : current.quality_metrics,
    activity: updates.activity ? { ...current.activity, ...updates.activity } : current.activity,
    window: updates.window !== undefined ? updates.window : current.window,
    comparison: updates.comparison ? {
      ...current.comparison,
      ...updates.comparison,
      target_session_id: updates.comparison.target_session_id ?? current.comparison.target_session_id ?? (updates.session?.session_id ?? current.session.session_id)
    } : current.comparison,
    episode_outcome: updates.episode_outcome ? { ...current.episode_outcome, ...updates.episode_outcome } : current.episode_outcome,
    export_diary: updates.export_diary ? { ...current.export_diary, ...updates.export_diary } : current.export_diary,
    privacy_entitlement: updates.privacy_entitlement ? { ...current.privacy_entitlement, ...updates.privacy_entitlement } : current.privacy_entitlement,
    context_generation: nextGeneration,
    updated_at_utc: now,
    fingerprint: ''
  };

  return validateAthleteJourneyContext(nextContext);
}

/**
 * Sanitizes journey context before storage: guarantees no raw ECG/RR signal points,
 * local filesystem paths, or tokens are serialized.
 */
export function sanitizeJourneyContextForStorage(context: AthleteCoreJourneyContext): string {
  const safeRepresentation = {
    schema_version: context.schema_version,
    context_id: context.context_id,
    fingerprint: context.fingerprint,
    profile: {
      mode: context.profile.mode,
      profile_id: context.profile.profile_id,
      display_name: context.profile.display_name,
      is_synthetic: context.profile.is_synthetic
    },
    session: {
      session_id: context.session.session_id,
      source_id: context.session.source_id,
      currentness: context.session.currentness,
      is_synthetic: context.session.is_synthetic
    },
    comparison: {
      mode: context.comparison.mode,
      target_session_id: context.comparison.target_session_id,
      peer_session_id: context.comparison.peer_session_id,
      saved_view_id: context.comparison.saved_view_id
    },
    privacy_mode: context.privacy_entitlement.privacy_mode,
    context_generation: context.context_generation,
    updated_at_utc: context.updated_at_utc
  };

  const serialized = JSON.stringify(safeRepresentation);
  if (/([A-Za-z]:\\|\/Users\/|\/home\/)/i.test(serialized)) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Security violation: Local filesystem path detected in journey context serialization', 'STORAGE_PATH_LEAK');
  }

  return serialized;
}

export function computeSelectionFingerprint(
  selection: Omit<AthleteJourneySelectionState, 'selection_fingerprint'>
): string {
  const canonicalFields = {
    profile_id: selection.profile_id,
    is_aggregate_read_only: selection.is_aggregate_read_only,
    selection_revision: selection.selection_revision,
    context_generation: selection.context_generation,
    selected_session_id: selection.selected_session_id,
    comparison_mode: selection.comparison_mode,
    compare_target_session_id: selection.compare_target_session_id,
    compare_peer_session_id: selection.compare_peer_session_id,
    selected_window_root_id: selection.selected_window_root_id,
    selected_window_revision: selection.selected_window_revision,
    selected_saved_view_id: selection.selected_saved_view_id,
    selected_snapshot_id: selection.selected_snapshot_id,
    export_projection: selection.export_projection,
    sensitive_opt_in: selection.sensitive_opt_in,
    selected_preview_fingerprint: selection.selected_preview_fingerprint,
    selected_pack_id: selection.selected_pack_id,
    selected_diary_id: selection.selected_diary_id,
    last_route_view: selection.last_route_view,
    last_route_id: selection.last_route_id,
    exact_next_safe_action: selection.exact_next_safe_action,
    last_idempotency_key: selection.last_idempotency_key,
    last_command_type: selection.last_command_type,
    last_command_hash: selection.last_command_hash || null
  };
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonicalFields));
}

  profileId: string,

): AthleteJourneySelectionState {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const raw: Omit<AthleteJourneySelectionState, 'selection_fingerprint'> = {
    profile_id: profileId,
    is_aggregate_read_only: isAggregateReadOnly,
    selection_revision: 1,
    context_generation: 1,
    selected_session_id: null,
    comparison_mode: 'none',
    compare_target_session_id: null,
    compare_peer_session_id: null,
    selected_window_root_id: null,
    selected_window_revision: null,
    selected_saved_view_id: null,
    selected_snapshot_id: null,
    export_projection: null,
    sensitive_opt_in: { ...DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_EXPORT_OPT_IN },
    selected_preview_fingerprint: null,
    selected_pack_id: null,
    selected_diary_id: null,
    last_route_view: 'sessions',
    last_route_id: null,
    exact_next_safe_action: 'nav:sessions',
    last_idempotency_key: null,
    last_command_type: null,
    last_command_hash: null,
    created_at_utc: now,
    updated_at_utc: now
  };
  return {
    ...raw,
    selection_fingerprint: computeSelectionFingerprint(raw)
  };
}

export type AthleteJourneyCommandType =
  | 'select_profile'
  | 'open_session'
  | 'set_comparison'
  | 'select_window_revision'
  | 'select_longitudinal_view'
  | 'set_export_projection'
  | 'bind_pack_or_diary'
  | 'clear_dependent_selection'
  | 'resume_last_valid_selection'
  | 'set_pilot_context'
  | 'confirm_pilot_outcome';

export type AthleteJourneyCommand =
  | { command_type: 'select_profile'; profile_id: string; is_aggregate_read_only?: boolean }
  | { command_type: 'open_session'; session_id: string | null }
  | { command_type: 'set_comparison'; mode: JourneyComparisonMode; target_session_id?: string | null; peer_session_id?: string | null }
  | { command_type: 'select_window_revision'; window_root_id: string; window_revision: number }
  | { command_type: 'select_longitudinal_view'; saved_view_id?: string | null; snapshot_id?: string | null }
  | { command_type: 'set_export_projection'; export_projection?: string | null; sensitive_opt_in?: Partial<SensitiveExportOptIn> }
  | { command_type: 'bind_pack_or_diary'; pack_id?: string | null; diary_id?: string | null }
  | { command_type: 'clear_dependent_selection'; fields?: Array<'session' | 'comparison' | 'window' | 'longitudinal' | 'export_diary'> }
  | { command_type: 'resume_last_valid_selection' }
  | { command_type: 'set_pilot_context'; context_type: 'whole_recording' | 'named_window'; window_root_id?: string | null; window_revision?: number | null }
  | { command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome'; episode_id?: string | null; selected_action: string; artifact_id: string; user_notes?: string | null };

export interface AthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope {
  profile_id: string;
  expected_revision: number | null;
  idempotency_key: string;
  command: AthleteJourneyCommand;
}

export class JourneyCommandValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'INVALID_COMMAND') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'JourneyCommandValidationError';
  }
}

export class JourneyCommandConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'COMMAND_CONFLICT') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'JourneyCommandConflictError';
  }
}

export const FORBIDDEN_DERIVED_FIELD_NAMES = new Set([
  'metrics',
  'quality_metrics',
  'task_eligibility',
  'eligibility',
  'eligibility_state',
  'overall_quality_score',
  'normalized_quality_percent',
  'result_hash',
  'source_id',
  'currentness',
  'currentness_reason',
  'is_accepted_outcome',
  'useful_outcome_confirmed',
  'local_outcome_id',
  'evidence_qualification',
  'evidence_status',
  'raw_ecg',
  'raw_rr',
  'raw_acc',
  'canonical_result',
  'beat_ledger',
  'canonical_beat_ledger'
]);

export function checkForbiddenDerivedFields(obj: unknown, prefix = ''): void {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return;
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (key === 'sensitive_opt_in') {
      continue;
    }
    if (FORBIDDEN_DERIVED_FIELD_NAMES.has(key)) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
        `Security violation: Client command cannot submit derived analytical or authority field '${prefix}${key}'`,
        'FORBIDDEN_DERIVED_FIELD'
      );
    }
    if (val && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val)) {
      checkForbiddenDerivedFields(val, `${prefix}${key}.`);
    }
  }
}

export function sortKeysRecursively(val: any): any {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || typeof val !== 'object') {
    return val;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    return val.map(sortKeysRecursively);
  }
  const sortedObj: Record<string, any> = {};
  const keys = Object.keys(val).sort();
  for (const k of keys) {
    sortedObj[k] = sortKeysRecursively(val[k]);
  }
  return sortedObj;
}

export function computeCommandPayloadHash(
  profileId: string,
  expectedRevision: number | null,
  command: AthleteJourneyCommand
): string {
  const canonical = {
    profile_id: profileId,
    expected_revision: expectedRevision,
    command: sortKeysRecursively(command)
  };
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonical));
}

export function validateAthleteJourneyCommand(cmdRaw: unknown): AthleteJourneyCommand {
  if (!cmdRaw || typeof cmdRaw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(cmdRaw)) {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('Command payload must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_COMMAND');
  }

  checkForbiddenDerivedFields(cmdRaw);

  const cmd = cmdRaw as Record<string, any>;
  const validCommandTypes: AthleteJourneyCommandType[] = [
    'select_profile',
    'open_session',
    'set_comparison',
    'select_window_revision',
    'select_longitudinal_view',
    'set_export_projection',
    'bind_pack_or_diary',
    'clear_dependent_selection',
    'resume_last_valid_selection',
    'set_pilot_context',
    'confirm_pilot_outcome'
  ];

  if (!cmd.command_type || typeof cmd.command_type !== 'string' || !validCommandTypes.includes(cmd.command_type as AthleteJourneyCommandType)) {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`Unknown or invalid command_type '${cmd.command_type}'`, 'INVALID_COMMAND_TYPE');
  }

  const allowedKeysByCommand: Record<AthleteJourneyCommandType, string[]> = {
    select_profile: ['command_type', 'profile_id', 'is_aggregate_read_only'],
    open_session: ['command_type', 'session_id'],
    set_comparison: ['command_type', 'mode', 'target_session_id', 'peer_session_id'],
    select_window_revision: ['command_type', 'window_root_id', 'window_revision'],
    select_longitudinal_view: ['command_type', 'saved_view_id', 'snapshot_id'],
    set_export_projection: ['command_type', 'export_projection', 'sensitive_opt_in'],
    bind_pack_or_diary: ['command_type', 'pack_id', 'diary_id'],
    clear_dependent_selection: ['command_type', 'fields'],
    resume_last_valid_selection: ['command_type'],
    set_pilot_context: ['command_type', 'context_type', 'window_root_id', 'window_revision'],
    confirm_pilot_outcome: ['command_type', 'episode_id', 'selected_action', 'artifact_id', 'user_notes']
  };

  const allowed = new Set(allowedKeysByCommand[cmd.command_type as AthleteJourneyCommandType]);
  for (const k of Object.keys(cmd)) {
    if (!allowed.has(k)) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(
        `Unknown field '${k}' not permitted on command '${cmd.command_type}'`,
        'UNKNOWN_COMMAND_FIELD'
      );
    }
  }

  switch (cmd.command_type as AthleteJourneyCommandType) {
    case 'set_pilot_context': {
      if (!cmd.context_type || (cmd.context_type !== 'whole_recording' && cmd.context_type !== 'named_window')) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError("set_pilot_context requires context_type to be 'whole_recording' or 'named_window'", 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.context_type === 'named_window' && (!cmd.window_root_id || typeof cmd.window_root_id !== 'string')) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('named_window context requires window_root_id string', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'set_pilot_context',
        context_type: cmd.context_type,
        window_root_id: typeof cmd.window_root_id === 'string' ? cmd.window_root_id.trim() : null,
        window_revision: typeof cmd.window_revision === 'number' ? cmd.window_revision : null
      };
    }
    case 'confirm_pilot_outcome': {
      if (cmd.episode_id !== undefined && cmd.episode_id !== null && typeof cmd.episode_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('confirm_pilot_outcome requires episode_id string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (!cmd.selected_action || typeof cmd.selected_action !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('confirm_pilot_outcome requires selected_action string', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (!cmd.artifact_id || typeof cmd.artifact_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('confirm_pilot_outcome requires artifact_id string', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'confirm_pilot_outcome',
        episode_id: typeof cmd.episode_id === 'string' && cmd.episode_id.trim() ? cmd.episode_id.trim() : null,
        selected_action: cmd.selected_action.trim(),
        artifact_id: cmd.artifact_id.trim(),
        user_notes: typeof cmd.user_notes === 'string' ? cmd.user_notes.trim() : null
      };
    }
    case 'select_profile': {
      if (!cmd.profile_id || typeof cmd.profile_id !== 'string' || cmd.profile_id.trim() === '') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('select_profile requires non-empty profile_id', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.is_aggregate_read_only !== undefined && typeof cmd.is_aggregate_read_only !== 'boolean') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('is_aggregate_read_only must be a boolean', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'select_profile',
        profile_id: cmd.profile_id.trim(),
        ...(cmd.is_aggregate_read_only !== undefined ? { is_aggregate_read_only: cmd.is_aggregate_read_only } : {})
      };
    }
    case 'open_session': {
      if (cmd.session_id !== null && typeof cmd.session_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('open_session requires session_id to be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'open_session',
        session_id: typeof cmd.session_id === 'string' ? cmd.session_id.trim() : null
      };
    }
    case 'set_comparison': {
      const validModes: JourneyComparisonMode[] = ['explicit_ab', 'personal_baseline', 'none'];
      if (!cmd.mode || !validModes.includes(cmd.mode)) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`Invalid comparison mode '${cmd.mode}'`, 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.target_session_id !== undefined && cmd.target_session_id !== null && typeof cmd.target_session_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('target_session_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.peer_session_id !== undefined && cmd.peer_session_id !== null && typeof cmd.peer_session_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('peer_session_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'set_comparison',
        mode: cmd.mode,
        target_session_id: typeof cmd.target_session_id === 'string' ? cmd.target_session_id.trim() : (cmd.target_session_id === null ? null : undefined),
        peer_session_id: typeof cmd.peer_session_id === 'string' ? cmd.peer_session_id.trim() : (cmd.peer_session_id === null ? null : undefined)
      };
    }
    case 'select_window_revision': {
      if (!cmd.window_root_id || typeof cmd.window_root_id !== 'string' || cmd.window_root_id.trim() === '') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('select_window_revision requires non-empty window_root_id', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (typeof cmd.window_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(cmd.window_revision) || cmd.window_revision < 0) {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('window_revision must be a non-negative integer', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'select_window_revision',
        window_root_id: cmd.window_root_id.trim(),
        window_revision: cmd.window_revision
      };
    }
    case 'select_longitudinal_view': {
      if (cmd.saved_view_id !== undefined && cmd.saved_view_id !== null && typeof cmd.saved_view_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('saved_view_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.snapshot_id !== undefined && cmd.snapshot_id !== null && typeof cmd.snapshot_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('snapshot_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'select_longitudinal_view',
        saved_view_id: typeof cmd.saved_view_id === 'string' ? cmd.saved_view_id.trim() : (cmd.saved_view_id === null ? null : undefined),
        snapshot_id: typeof cmd.snapshot_id === 'string' ? cmd.snapshot_id.trim() : (cmd.snapshot_id === null ? null : undefined)
      };
    }
    case 'set_export_projection': {
      if (cmd.export_projection !== undefined && cmd.export_projection !== null && typeof cmd.export_projection !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('export_projection must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.sensitive_opt_in !== undefined) {
        if (!cmd.sensitive_opt_in || typeof cmd.sensitive_opt_in !== 'object' || Array.isArray(cmd.sensitive_opt_in)) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('sensitive_opt_in must be an object', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
        }
        const allowedOptInKeys = new Set(['raw_ecg', 'raw_rr', 'raw_acc', 'notes', 'identifiers', 'paths']);
        for (const [optKey, optVal] of Object.entries(cmd.sensitive_opt_in)) {
          if (!allowedOptInKeys.has(optKey)) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`Unknown sensitive_opt_in key '${optKey}'`, 'UNKNOWN_COMMAND_FIELD');
          }
          if (typeof optVal !== 'boolean') {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`sensitive_opt_in['${optKey}'] must be a boolean`, 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
          }
        }
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'set_export_projection',
        export_projection: typeof cmd.export_projection === 'string' ? cmd.export_projection.trim() : (cmd.export_projection === null ? null : undefined),
        sensitive_opt_in: cmd.sensitive_opt_in
      };
    }
    case 'bind_pack_or_diary': {
      if (cmd.pack_id !== undefined && cmd.pack_id !== null && typeof cmd.pack_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('pack_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      if (cmd.diary_id !== undefined && cmd.diary_id !== null && typeof cmd.diary_id !== 'string') {
        throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('diary_id must be a string or null', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'bind_pack_or_diary',
        pack_id: typeof cmd.pack_id === 'string' ? cmd.pack_id.trim() : (cmd.pack_id === null ? null : undefined),
        diary_id: typeof cmd.diary_id === 'string' ? cmd.diary_id.trim() : (cmd.diary_id === null ? null : undefined)
      };
    }
    case 'clear_dependent_selection': {
      if (cmd.fields !== undefined) {
        if (!Array.isArray(cmd.fields)) {
          throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('fields must be an array', 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
        }
        const allowedFields = new Set(['session', 'comparison', 'window', 'longitudinal', 'export_diary']);
        for (const f of cmd.fields) {
          if (!allowedFields.has(f)) {
            throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`Invalid dependent field '${f}'`, 'INVALID_COMMAND_ARG');
          }
        }
      }
      return {
        command_type: 'clear_dependent_selection',
        fields: cmd.fields
      };
    }
    case 'resume_last_valid_selection': {
      return {
        command_type: 'resume_last_valid_selection'
      };
    }
  }
}

export function validateAthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope(raw: unknown): AthleteJourneyCommandEnvelope {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('Command envelope must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_ENVELOPE');
  }

  // Fail closed on any client attempt to submit derived metrics, currentness, eligibility or outcome
  checkForbiddenDerivedFields(raw);

  const rawObj = raw as Record<string, any>;
  const allowedEnvelopeKeys = new Set(['profile_id', 'expected_revision', 'idempotency_key', 'command']);
  for (const k of Object.keys(rawObj)) {
    if (!allowedEnvelopeKeys.has(k)) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError(`Unknown envelope field '${k}'`, 'UNKNOWN_ENVELOPE_KEY');
    }
  }

  if (!rawObj.profile_id || typeof rawObj.profile_id !== 'string' || rawObj.profile_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('profile_id is required in command envelope', 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID');
  }

  if (rawObj.expected_revision !== null && rawObj.expected_revision !== undefined) {
    if (typeof rawObj.expected_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(rawObj.expected_revision) || rawObj.expected_revision < 1) {
      throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('expected_revision must be a positive integer or null', 'INVALID_REVISION');
    }
  }

  if (!rawObj.idempotency_key || typeof rawObj.idempotency_key !== 'string' || rawObj.idempotency_key.trim() === '') {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('idempotency_key is required in command envelope', 'MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY');
  }

  if (!rawObj.command || typeof rawObj.command !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyCommandValidationError('command payload must be a non-null object', 'MISSING_COMMAND');
  }

  const validatedCmd = validateAthleteJourneyCommand(rawObj.command);

  return {
    profile_id: rawObj.profile_id.trim(),
    expected_revision: typeof rawObj.expected_revision === 'number' ? rawObj.expected_revision : null,
    idempotency_key: rawObj.idempotency_key.trim(),
    command: validatedCmd
  };
}

export function computeCompleteDependencyFingerprint(params: CompleteDependencyFingerprintParams): string {
  const sorted = sortKeysRecursively({
    active_episode_id: params.active_episode_id || null,
    annotation_revision: params.annotation_revision ?? 0,
    compare_peer_session_id: params.compare_peer_session_id || null,
    compare_target_session_id: params.compare_target_session_id || null,
    comparison_mode: params.comparison_mode || 'none',
    currentness: params.currentness || 'unavailable',
    entitlement_status: params.entitlement_status || 'valid',
    export_projection: params.export_projection || null,
    ledger_hash: params.ledger_hash || null,
    local_outcome_id: params.local_outcome_id || null,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: params.longitudinal_snapshot_id || null,
    policy_versions: {
      compiler: params.policy_versions?.compiler || '1.0.0',
      entitlement: params.policy_versions?.entitlement || '1.0.0',
      privacy: params.policy_versions?.privacy || '1.0.0',
      schema: params.policy_versions?.schema || ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION
    },
    privacy_mode: params.privacy_mode || 'standard',
    profile_id: params.profile_id || null,
    profile_mode: params.profile_mode || 'unresolved',
    result_hash: params.result_hash || null,
    saved_view_id: params.saved_view_id || null,
    saved_view_revision: params.saved_view_revision ?? null,
    selected_diary_id: params.selected_diary_id || null,
    selected_pack_id: params.selected_pack_id || null,
    selected_preview_fingerprint: params.selected_preview_fingerprint || null,
    selected_window_revision: params.selected_window_revision ?? null,
    selected_window_root_id: params.selected_window_root_id || null,
    selection_generation: params.selection_generation ?? 1,
    selection_revision: params.selection_revision ?? null,
    sensitive_opt_in: {
      identifiers: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.identifiers),
      notes: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.notes),
      paths: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.paths),
      raw_acc: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_acc),
      raw_ecg: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_ecg),
      raw_rr: Boolean(params.sensitive_opt_in?.raw_rr)
    },
    session_id: params.session_id || null,
    source_id: params.source_id || null,
    task_revision: params.task_revision ?? 0
  });
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(sorted));
}

export function validateAthleteWorkspaceSnapshot(raw: unknown): AthleteWorkspaceSnapshot {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Workspace snapshot must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  const s = raw as Record<string, any>;
  if (!s.schema_version || typeof s.schema_version !== 'string') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Snapshot missing schema_version', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  if (!s.profile_state || typeof s.profile_state !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Snapshot missing profile_state', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  if (!s.context || typeof s.context !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Snapshot missing context', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  if (typeof s.dependency_fingerprint !== 'string' || s.dependency_fingerprint.length !== 64) {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Snapshot missing valid 64-char dependency_fingerprint', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  if (!s.policy_versions || typeof s.policy_versions !== 'object') {
    throw new JourneyValidationError('Snapshot missing policy_versions', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  const validatedContext = validateAthleteJourneyContext(s.context);
  return {
    schema_version: s.schema_version,
    profile_state: s.profile_state,
    is_aggregate_read_only: Boolean(s.is_aggregate_read_only),
    selection: s.selection || null,
    selection_revision: typeof s.selection_revision === 'number' ? s.selection_revision : null,
    selection_generation: typeof s.selection_generation === 'number' ? s.selection_generation : 1,
    context: validatedContext,
    dependency_fingerprint: s.dependency_fingerprint,
    policy_versions: {
      entitlement: String(s.policy_versions.entitlement || '1.0.0'),
      privacy: String(s.policy_versions.privacy || '1.0.0'),
      compiler: String(s.policy_versions.compiler || '1.0.0'),
      schema: String(s.policy_versions.schema || ATHLETE_CORE_JOURNEY_SCHEMA_VERSION)
    },
    currentness_codes: Array.isArray(s.currentness_codes) ? s.currentness_codes.map(String) : [],
    server_timestamp_utc: String(s.server_timestamp_utc || new Date().toISOString()),
    next_safe_action: s.next_safe_action ? {
      route: String(s.next_safe_action.route || 'sessions'),
      action_type: String(s.next_safe_action.action_type || 'navigate'),
      description: String(s.next_safe_action.description || '')
    } : null
  };
}

import { ParsedRRRow, RRRowParseStatus } from './CanonicalRRParser';
import { classifyRrSequence, RrClassificationResult } from '../../backend/analytics/hrv';

export type BeatClassificationCategory = 
  | 'valid_nn'
  | 'outlier_artifact'
  | 'physiologic_out_of_bounds'
  | 'explicit_source_invalid'
  | 'unparsed_or_corrupt';

export interface CanonicalBeatEntry {
  beat_index: number;
  source_file_id: string;
  source_row_index: number;
  phone_timestamp_str?: string;
  phone_timestamp_ms: number | null;
  sensor_timestamp_ns: number | null;
  relative_timestamp_ms: number | null;
  raw_rr_ms: number | null;
  raw_is_valid: boolean | null;
  parser_status: RRRowParseStatus;
  classification_status: BeatClassificationCategory;
  accepted_for_nn: boolean;
  exclusion_reasons: string[];
  rolling_median_ms?: number;
  deviation_percent?: number;
  instantaneous_hr_bpm?: number | null;
  algorithm_version: string;
  no_correction_guarantee: true;
}

export interface CanonicalBeatLedger {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  source_file_id: string;
  total_raw_rows: number;
  total_beats: number;
  accepted_nn_beats: number;
  excluded_beats: number;
  artifact_percentage: number;
  exclusion_breakdown: {
    explicit_source_invalid: number;
    physiologic_out_of_bounds: number;
    outlier_artifact: number;
    unparsed_or_corrupt: number;
  };
  beats: CanonicalBeatEntry[];
  clean_nn_intervals: number[];
}

/**
 * Builds a deterministic CanonicalBeatLedger from parsed rows and classifications.
 */
export function buildCanonicalBeatLedger(
  parsedRows: ParsedRRRow[],
  sourceFileId: string = 'SOURCE_DEFAULT'
): CanonicalBeatLedger {
  // Extract raw intervals for valid parsed rows to run classifier
  const validRows = parsedRows.filter(r => r.status === 'VALID_PARSED_ROW' && r.raw_rr_ms !== null);
  const rawIntervals = validRows.map(r => r.raw_rr_ms as number);

  // Run existing adaptive rolling median NN classifier
  const classifications: RrClassificationResult[] = rawIntervals.length > 0 
    ? classifyRrSequence(rawIntervals)
    : [];

  const beats: CanonicalBeatEntry[] = [];
  const clean_nn_intervals: number[] = [];

  const exclusion_breakdown = {
    explicit_source_invalid: 0,
    physiologic_out_of_bounds: 0,
    outlier_artifact: 0,
    unparsed_or_corrupt: 0
  };

  let validRowCounter = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < parsedRows.length; i++) {
    const row = parsedRows[i];

    // If row was unparsed / corrupted in parser
    if (row.status !== 'VALID_PARSED_ROW' || row.raw_rr_ms === null) {
      const isExplicitInvalid = row.status === 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_INVALID';
      const category: BeatClassificationCategory = isExplicitInvalid 
        ? 'explicit_source_invalid' 
        : 'unparsed_or_corrupt';

      if (isExplicitInvalid) {
        exclusion_breakdown.explicit_source_invalid++;
      } else {
        exclusion_breakdown.unparsed_or_corrupt++;
      }

      beats.push({
        beat_index: i,
        source_file_id: sourceFileId,
        source_row_index: row.row_index,
        phone_timestamp_str: row.phone_timestamp_str,
        phone_timestamp_ms: row.phone_timestamp_ms,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: row.sensor_timestamp_ns,
        relative_timestamp_ms: row.relative_timestamp_ms,
        raw_rr_ms: row.raw_rr_ms,
        raw_is_valid: row.raw_is_valid,
        parser_status: row.status,
        classification_status: category,
        accepted_for_nn: false,
        exclusion_reasons: [row.rejection_reason || 'Parser rejected row'],
        instantaneous_hr_bpm: null,
        algorithm_version: '1.0.0',
        no_correction_guarantee: true
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Row is a valid parsed RR
    const cls = classifications[validRowCounter];
    validRowCounter++;

    let category: BeatClassificationCategory = 'valid_nn';
    const reasons: string[] = [];

    if (cls) {
      if (cls.final_status === 'valid_nn' && cls.used_in_nn) {
        category = 'valid_nn';
        clean_nn_intervals.push(row.raw_rr_ms);
      } else if (cls.final_status === 'physiologic_out_of_bounds') {
        category = 'physiologic_out_of_bounds';
        exclusion_breakdown.physiologic_out_of_bounds++;
        if (cls.primary_exclusion_reason) reasons.push(cls.primary_exclusion_reason);
      } else {
        category = 'outlier_artifact';
        exclusion_breakdown.outlier_artifact++;
        if (cls.primary_exclusion_reason) reasons.push(cls.primary_exclusion_reason);
      }
    } else {
      category = 'valid_nn';
      clean_nn_intervals.push(row.raw_rr_ms);
    }

    const instHr = (row.raw_rr_ms !== null && row.raw_rr_ms > 0)
      ? Math.round((60000 / row.raw_rr_ms) * 10) / 10
      : null;

    beats.push({
      beat_index: i,
      source_file_id: sourceFileId,
      source_row_index: row.row_index,
      phone_timestamp_str: row.phone_timestamp_str,
      phone_timestamp_ms: row.phone_timestamp_ms,
      sensor_timestamp_ns: row.sensor_timestamp_ns,
      relative_timestamp_ms: row.relative_timestamp_ms,
      raw_rr_ms: row.raw_rr_ms,
      raw_is_valid: row.raw_is_valid,
      parser_status: row.status,
      classification_status: category,
      accepted_for_nn: category === 'valid_nn',
      exclusion_reasons: reasons,
      instantaneous_hr_bpm: instHr,
      algorithm_version: cls?.algorithm_version || '1.0.0',
      no_correction_guarantee: true
    });
  }

  const total_beats = parsedRows.length;
  const accepted_nn_beats = clean_nn_intervals.length;
  const excluded_beats = total_beats - accepted_nn_beats;
  const artifact_percentage = total_beats > 0 
    ? Math.round((excluded_beats / total_beats) * 10000) / 100 
    : 0;

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    source_file_id: sourceFileId,
    total_raw_rows: parsedRows.length,
    total_beats,
    accepted_nn_beats,
    excluded_beats,
    artifact_percentage,
    exclusion_breakdown,
    beats,
    clean_nn_intervals
  };
}
