function formatMetricDisplay(val: number | null, unit: string, digits: number = 1): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '—';
  return `${val.toFixed(digits)} ${unit}`;
}

function getEligibilityLabelRu(state: string): string {
  switch (state) {
    case 'ELIGIBLE': return 'Валидно';
    case 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS': return 'Справочно (ограничено)';
    case 'NOT_ELIGIBLE': return 'Не применимо';
    case 'INCONCLUSIVE': return 'Недостаточно данных';
    default: return 'Неизвестно';
  }
}

function buildMetricPresentation(
  metricId: string,
  nameRu: string,
  nameEn: string,
  unit: string,
  mr?: MetricResult,
  te?: TaskEligibilityResult,
  digits: number = 1
): CanonicalMetricPresentation {
  const value = mr?.value ?? null;
  const eligibility_state = mr?.eligibility_state || te?.state || 'INCONCLUSIVE';
  const warnings = (mr?.warnings || te?.warning_reasons || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru'));
  const limitations = (mr?.limitations || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru'));
  const blocking_reasons = (te?.blocking_reasons || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru'));
  const method_name = mr?.method_name || 'Canonical Time Domain';
  const method_version = mr?.method_version || '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD';
  const protocol_authority = mr?.protocol_authority || 'Frozen Protocol v1.1.0';

  return {
    metric_id: metricId,
    name_ru: nameRu,
    name_en: nameEn,
    value,
    unit,
    display_value: formatMetricDisplay(value, unit, digits),
    eligibility_state,
    eligibility_label_ru: getEligibilityLabelRu(eligibility_state),
    warnings,
    limitations,
    blocking_reasons,
    method_name,
    method_version,
    protocol_authority
  };
}

/**
 * Pure Canonical Presentation Adapter
 * Derives user-facing summaries strictly from CanonicalSessionResult.
 */
export function getCanonicalPresentationSummary(options: {
  session: {
    id: string;
    device_id?: string | null;
    overall_quality_score?: number | null;
    duration_seconds: number;
    avg_hr?: number | null;
  };
  canonicalSession?: CanonicalSessionResult | null;
  qcMetrics?: {
    ecg_rr_consistency?: number | null;
    ecg_rr_match_metrics_json?: string | null;
    ecg_clipping_seconds?: number | null;
    ecg_noise_ratio?: number | null;
    acc_motion_severity?: string | null;
    monotonicity_status?: string | null;
    missing_samples_count?: number | null;
    duplicate_timestamps_count?: number | null;
  } | null;
  analyticsMetrics?: {
    rmssd?: number | null;
    sdnn?: number | null;
    pnn50?: number | null;
    hrv_quality?: string | null;
    hrv_source?: string | null;
    hrv_version?: string | null;
  } | null;
}): CanonicalPresentationSummary {
  const { session, canonicalSession, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics } = options;
  const sessionId = session?.id || 'unknown_session';
  const isCanonical = !!canonicalSession;

  // Technical QC / Agreement
  let agreementPres: EcgRrAgreementPresentation;
  let agreementCategory: CanonicalPresentationSummary['technical_qc']['ecg_rr_agreement']['status_category'] = 'unavailable';

  if (canonicalSession) {
    const agreementTask = canonicalSession.task_eligibility?.ecg_rr_agreement;
    const isEligible = agreementTask?.state === 'ELIGIBLE' || agreementTask?.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';

    // Canonical single authority: NEVER derive agreement from qcMetrics in canonical sessions!
    if (!isEligible || !canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement || canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent === null) {
      agreementCategory = 'unavailable';
      agreementPres = {
        eligible: isEligible,
        value: null,
        valueString: '—',
        labelKey: 'technical_ecg_rr_agreement',
        availabilityStatus: 'unavailable',
        availabilityReasonKey: 'quality_limited',
        unit: '%',
        tolerance: '±5%',
        source: 'canonical_session_result',
        calculationVersion: '1.2.0',
        qualityDimension: 'signal_consistency',
        technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_unavailable'
      };
    } else {
      const val = canonicalSession.ecg_rr_agreement.value_percent;
      agreementCategory = 'available';
      agreementPres = {
        eligible: true,
        value: val,
        valueString: `${val.toFixed(1)}%`,
        labelKey: 'technical_ecg_rr_agreement',
        availabilityStatus: 'available',
        availabilityReasonKey: 'available',
        unit: '%',
        tolerance: '±5%',
        source: 'canonical_session_result',
        calculationVersion: '1.2.0',
        qualityDimension: 'signal_consistency',
        technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_desc'
      };
    }
  } else {
    // Legacy unverified session path
    const agreementInput = makeEcgRrAgreementInput(qcMetrics);
    agreementPres = getEcgRrAgreementPresentation(agreementInput);
    if (!qcMetrics || qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency == null) {
      agreementCategory = 'no_ecg_data';
    } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'no_ecg_data') {
      agreementCategory = 'no_ecg_data';
    } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'insufficient_data') {
      agreementCategory = 'insufficient_data';
    } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'quality_limited') {
      agreementCategory = 'quality_limited';
    } else if (agreementPres.availabilityStatus === 'unavailable') {
      agreementCategory = 'unavailable';
    } else {
      agreementCategory = 'available';
    }
  }

  // Legacy Quality Score
  const legacyScore = session?.overall_quality_score ?? null;
  const legacyScoreDisplay = legacyScore !== null ? `${Math.round(legacyScore)}%` : '—';

  // Build core metrics
  let rmssdPres: CanonicalMetricPresentation;
  let sdnnPres: CanonicalMetricPresentation;
  let pnn50Pres: CanonicalMetricPresentation;
  let meanHrPres: CanonicalMetricPresentation;
  let meanRrPres: CanonicalMetricPresentation;

  if (canonicalSession) {
    const cm = canonicalSession.core_metrics;
    const te = canonicalSession.task_eligibility;

    rmssdPres = buildMetricPresentation('rmssd', 'RMSSD', 'RMSSD', 'мс', cm.rmssd, te.rmssd);
    sdnnPres = buildMetricPresentation('sdnn', 'SDNN', 'SDNN', 'мс', cm.sdnn, te.sdnn);
    pnn50Pres = buildMetricPresentation('pnn50', 'pNN50', 'pNN50', '%', cm.pnn50, te.pnn50);
    meanHrPres = buildMetricPresentation('mean_hr_bpm', 'Средняя ЧСС', 'Mean HR', 'уд/мин', cm.mean_hr_bpm, te.mean_hr_rr, 0);
    meanRrPres = buildMetricPresentation('mean_rr_ms', 'Средний RR', 'Mean RR', 'мс', cm.mean_rr_ms, undefined, 0);
  } else {
    // Explicit LEGACY_UNVERIFIED Mode
    const rmssdVal = analyticsMetrics?.rmssd ?? null;
    const sdnnVal = analyticsMetrics?.sdnn ?? null;
    const pnn50Val = analyticsMetrics?.pnn50 ?? null;
    const meanHrVal = session?.avg_hr ?? null;

    rmssdPres = {
      metric_id: 'rmssd',
      name_ru: 'RMSSD',
      name_en: 'RMSSD',
      value: rmssdVal,
      unit: 'мс',
      display_value: formatMetricDisplay(rmssdVal, 'мс'),
      eligibility_state: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      eligibility_label_ru: 'Справочно (не верифицировано)',
      warnings: ['Историческая запись; не пересчитана по каноническому протоколу v1.1.'],
      limitations: ['Значение не верифицировано CanonicalBeatLedger.'],
      blocking_reasons: ['legacy_unverified_recording'],
      method_name: 'Legacy Unverified Approximation',
      method_version: 'legacy',
      protocol_authority: 'Unverified Legacy Record'
    };

    sdnnPres = {
      metric_id: 'sdnn',
      name_ru: 'SDNN',
      name_en: 'SDNN',
      value: sdnnVal,
      unit: 'мс',
      display_value: formatMetricDisplay(sdnnVal, 'мс'),
      eligibility_state: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      eligibility_label_ru: 'Справочно (не верифицировано)',
      warnings: ['Историческая запись; не пересчитана по каноническому протоколу v1.1.'],
      limitations: ['Значение не верифицировано CanonicalBeatLedger.'],
      blocking_reasons: ['legacy_unverified_recording'],
      method_name: 'Legacy Unverified Approximation',
      method_version: 'legacy',
      protocol_authority: 'Unverified Legacy Record'
    };

    pnn50Pres = {
      metric_id: 'pnn50',
      name_ru: 'pNN50',
      name_en: 'pNN50',
      value: pnn50Val,
      unit: '%',
      display_value: formatMetricDisplay(pnn50Val, '%'),
      eligibility_state: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      eligibility_label_ru: 'Справочно (не верифицировано)',
      warnings: ['Историческая запись; не пересчитана по каноническому протоколу v1.1.'],
      limitations: ['Значение не верифицировано CanonicalBeatLedger.'],
      blocking_reasons: ['legacy_unverified_recording'],
      method_name: 'Legacy Unverified Approximation',
      method_version: 'legacy',
      protocol_authority: 'Unverified Legacy Record'
    };

    meanHrPres = {
      metric_id: 'mean_hr_bpm',
      name_ru: 'Средняя ЧСС',
      name_en: 'Mean HR',
      value: meanHrVal,
      unit: 'уд/мин',
      display_value: formatMetricDisplay(meanHrVal, 'уд/мин', 0),
      eligibility_state: meanHrVal !== null ? 'INCONCLUSIVE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
      eligibility_label_ru: meanHrVal !== null ? 'Справочно (legacy)' : 'Нет данных',
      warnings: [],
      limitations: ['Значение средней ЧСС взято из исторической записи.'],
      blocking_reasons: [],
      method_name: 'Legacy Mean HR',
      method_version: 'legacy',
      protocol_authority: 'Unverified Legacy Record'
    };

    meanRrPres = {
      metric_id: 'mean_rr_ms',
      name_ru: 'Средний RR',
      name_en: 'Mean RR',
      value: null,
      unit: 'мс',
      display_value: '—',
      eligibility_state: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      eligibility_label_ru: 'Нет данных',
      warnings: [],
      limitations: [],
      blocking_reasons: [],
      method_name: 'Canonical Mean RR',
      method_version: '1.2.0',
      protocol_authority: 'Frozen Protocol v1.1.0'
    };
  }

  // Construct Reliable / Limited / Warning Text
  const reliableList: string[] = [];
  const limitedList: string[] = [];
  const warningList: string[] = [];

  if (canonicalSession) {
    if (rmssdPres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
      reliableList.push(`• RMSSD (${rmssdPres.display_value}): валиден по каноническому протоколу v1.1 для оценки вегетативного тонуса.`);
    } else if (rmssdPres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
      reliableList.push(`• RMSSD (${rmssdPres.display_value}): рассчитан справочно (ограничен качеством).`);
      if (rmssdPres.warnings.length > 0) limitedList.push(`• RMSSD: ${rmssdPres.warnings.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ')}`);
    } else {
      limitedList.push(`• RMSSD не применим: ${rmssdPres.blocking_reasons.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ') || 'недостаточная длительность'}.`);
    }

    if (sdnnPres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
      reliableList.push(`• SDNN (${sdnnPres.display_value}): валиден по каноническому протоколу v1.1 для оценки общей вариабельности.`);
    } else if (sdnnPres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
      reliableList.push(`• SDNN (${sdnnPres.display_value}): рассчитан справочно (ограничен качеством).`);
      if (sdnnPres.warnings.length > 0) limitedList.push(`• SDNN: ${sdnnPres.warnings.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ')}`);
    } else {
      limitedList.push(`• SDNN не применим: ${sdnnPres.blocking_reasons.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ') || 'длительность записи < 300 сек'}.`);
    }

    if (pnn50Pres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE') {
      reliableList.push(`• pNN50 (${pnn50Pres.display_value}): валиден по каноническому протоколу v1.1.`);
    } else if (pnn50Pres.eligibility_state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
      reliableList.push(`• pNN50 (${pnn50Pres.display_value}): рассчитан справочно (ограничен качеством).`);
      if (pnn50Pres.warnings.length > 0) limitedList.push(`• pNN50: ${pnn50Pres.warnings.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ')}`);
    } else {
      limitedList.push(`• pNN50 не применим: ${pnn50Pres.blocking_reasons.map(r => localizeReason(r, 'ru')).join('; ') || 'длительность записи < 300 сек'}.`);
    }

    if (meanHrPres.value !== null) {
      reliableList.push(`• Средняя ЧСС (${meanHrPres.display_value}): рассчитана по чистому ряду NN.`);
    }

    // Technical QC artifacts: inspect canonical technical_quality exclusively
    const techQuality = canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality;
    if (techQuality) {
      const clipVal = techQuality.clipping.value;
      if (clipVal !== null && clipVal !== undefined && clipVal > 5) {
        limitedList.push(`• Обнаружен клиппинг сигнала ЭКГ (${clipVal.toFixed(1)} сек) — потеря амплитуды.`);
      }
      const noiseVal = techQuality.noisy_window_fraction.value;
      if (noiseVal !== null && noiseVal !== undefined && noiseVal > 0.1) {
        limitedList.push(`• Повышенный уровень шума ЭКГ (${(noiseVal * 100).toFixed(0)}% времени).`);
      }
      const driftVal = techQuality.baseline_drift.value;
      if (driftVal !== null && driftVal !== undefined && driftVal > 0.15) {
        limitedList.push(`• Повышенный дрейф изолинии ЭКГ (${(driftVal * 100).toFixed(0)}% времени).`);
      }
    }
    const accSeverity = canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null;
    if (accSeverity === 'high') {
      limitedList.push('• Высокая интенсивность движений (артефакты ускорения) искажает запись ЭКГ.');
    }
  } else {
    if (!analyticsMetrics) {
      warningList.push('ВНИМАНИЕ: Качество ВСР неизвестно (quality_unknown). Метрики ВСР недостоверны. Рекомендуется повторный анализ сессии.');
      reliableList.push('• Регистрация пульса на доступных участках записи.');
      limitedList.push('• Физиологическая интерпретация ВСР невозможна. Требуется повторный анализ записи.');
    } else if (analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
      warningList.push('ВНИМАНИЕ: Точность показателей ВСР ограничена качеством записи (Ограничено качеством). Показатели ВСР рассчитаны справочно и не подходят для точного анализа тренда.');
      limitedList.push('• Показатели RMSSD/SDNN рассчитаны по зашумленному сигналу (использовать с осторожностью) и исключены из личного baseline.');
      reliableList.push('• Общий тренд ЧСС и распределение зон нагрузки.');
      reliableList.push('• Текущая сессия имеет ограниченное качество ВСР (Ограничено качеством).');
      reliableList.push('• HRV/ВСР тренды показаны справочно; интерпретация ограничена качеством текущей записи и сопоставимостью условий.');
    } else if (analyticsMetrics.hrv_source === 'unavailable') {
      warningList.push('ВНИМАНИЕ: Отсутствуют метаданные ВСР (legacy_metadata_missing). Метрики ВСР недостоверны. Рекомендуется повторный анализ сессии.');
      reliableList.push('• Регистрация пульса на доступных участках записи.');
      limitedList.push('• Физиологическая интерпретация ВСР невозможна. Требуется повторный анализ записи.');
    } else {
      reliableList.push('• Средняя ЧСС на доступных участках записи.');
      limitedList.push('• Ограничения: метрики ВСР представлены исключительно справочно и не участвуют в расчёте персонального baseline.');
    }

    if (qcMetrics) {
      const consistencyRatio = qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency ?? null;
      if (consistencyRatio !== null) {
        const val = consistencyRatio <= 1 ? consistencyRatio * 100 : consistencyRatio;
        if (val < 10) {
          warningList.push('ВНИМАНИЕ: Низкая согласованность данных ЭКГ и RR (< 10%). Автоматические данные ВСР недостоверны.');
        } else if (val < 70) {
          limitedList.push(`• Ограничения: умеренное рассогласование ЭКГ/RR (${Math.round(val)}%).`);
        }
      }
      if ((qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? 0) > 5) {
        limitedList.push(`• Обнаружен клиппинг сигнала ЭКГ (${qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds!.toFixed(1)} сек).`);
      }
    }
    warningList.push('ВНИМАНИЕ: Сессия отображается в режиме исторической записи (LEGACY UNVERIFIED). Пересчёт по каноническому протоколу v1.1 не проводился.');
  }

  const safetyClaim = 'Данный продукт и отчёты предназначены только для спортивного анализа и фитнеса. Не являются медицинским диагнозом и не заменяют консультацию врача. Высокое качество сигнала отражает внутреннюю пригодность данных для расчётов, но не является научным или клиническим подтверждением.';

  return {
    session_id: sessionId,
    mode: isCanonical ? 'CANONICAL' : 'LEGACY_UNVERIFIED',
    is_canonical: isCanonical,
    core_metrics: {
      rmssd: rmssdPres,
      sdnn: sdnnPres,
      pnn50: pnn50Pres,
      mean_hr_bpm: meanHrPres,
      mean_rr_ms: meanRrPres
    },
    limitations: {
      reliable_text: reliableList.join('\n'),
      limited_text: limitedList.join('\n') || '• Значимых ограничений не выявлено.',
      warning_text: warningList.join('\n')
    },
    technical_qc: {
      ecg_rr_agreement: {
        status_category: agreementCategory,
        value_percent: agreementPres.value,
        display_value: agreementPres.valueString,
        eligibility_status: agreementPres.eligible ? 'eligible' : 'not_eligible',
        presentation: agreementPres
      },
      ecg_clipping_seconds: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.clipping.value ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics?.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? null),
      ecg_noise_ratio: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.noisy_window_fraction.value ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics?.ecg_noise_ratio ?? null),
      ecg_baseline_drift_ratio: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality?.baseline_drift.value ?? null)
        : ((qcMetrics as any)?.ecg_baseline_drift_ratio ?? null),
      acc_motion_severity: isCanonical
        ? (canonicalSession.acc_context?.motion_severity ?? null)
        : (qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity ?? null),
      monotonicity_status: qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status ?? null,
      missing_samples_count: qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count ?? null,
      duplicate_timestamps_count: qcMetrics?.duplicate_timestamps_count ?? null
    },
    legacy_quality_rollup: {
      score: legacyScore,
      display_score: legacyScoreDisplay,
      is_authoritative: false,
      label_ru: 'Технический индекс качества (legacy rollup, справочно)'
    },
    provenance: {
      source_bundle_id: canonicalSession?.source_bundle_id || 'unknown_bundle',
      app_version: canonicalSession?.provenance?.build_version || '1.0.1-rc.11',
      schema_version: canonicalSession?.provenance?.canonical_schema_version || '1.0.0',
      protocol_version: canonicalSession?.provenance?.protocol_version || '1.1.0',
      engine_name: canonicalSession?.provenance?.engine_name || 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab'
    },
    safety_claim: safetyClaim
  };
}

import { parseRawTimestamp } from './TemporalContract';

export const CANONICAL_RR_PARSER_VERSION = '1.2.0-PSL-RR';

export interface RRPoint {
  timeMs: number;
  rrMs: number;
  sensorTsNs?: number;
  phoneTimestampStr?: string;
}

export type RRRowParseStatus = 
  | 'VALID_PARSED_ROW'
  | 'MALFORMED_ROW'
  | 'UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA'
  | 'INVALID_TIMESTAMP'
  | 'INVALID_RR_NUMERIC'
  | 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_INVALID';

export interface ParsedRRRow {
  row_index: number;
  raw_line: string;
  schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col' | 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col' | 'unknown';
  phone_timestamp_str: string;
  phone_timestamp_ms: number | null;
  sensor_timestamp_ns: number | null;
  relative_timestamp_ms: number | null;
  raw_rr_ms: number | null;
  raw_is_valid: boolean | null;
  status: RRRowParseStatus;
  rejection_reason?: string;
}

export interface RRParseAccounting {
  source_row_count: number;
  parsed_valid_count: number;
  rejected_count: number;
  rejection_reasons: {
    malformed_row: number;
    invalid_timestamp: number;
    invalid_rr_numeric: number;
    explicit_source_invalid: number;
    unsupported_schema: number;
  };
  detected_schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col' | 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col' | 'unknown';
}

export interface CanonicalRRParseResult {
  rows: ParsedRRRow[];
  valid_rr_points: RRPoint[];
  accounting: RRParseAccounting;
}

/**
 * Parses a single line from an RR CSV/text export.
 */
export function parseCanonicalRRRow(line: string, rowIndex: number): ParsedRRRow {
  const trimmed = line.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return {
      row_index: rowIndex,
      raw_line: line,
      schema: 'unknown',
      phone_timestamp_str: '',
      phone_timestamp_ms: null,
      sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
      relative_timestamp_ms: null,
      raw_rr_ms: null,
      raw_is_valid: null,
      status: 'MALFORMED_ROW',
      rejection_reason: 'Empty line'
    };
  }

  // Handle header line
  if (trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('phone timestamp') || trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('rr-interval') || trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('rr [ms]')) {
    const is5Col = trimmed.includes('sensor timestamp') || trimmed.includes('isValid');
    return {
      row_index: rowIndex,
      raw_line: line,
      schema: is5Col ? 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col' : 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col',
      phone_timestamp_str: 'HEADER',
      phone_timestamp_ms: null,
      sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
      relative_timestamp_ms: null,
      raw_rr_ms: null,
      raw_is_valid: null,
      status: 'UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA',
      rejection_reason: 'Header row'
    };
  }

  const parts = trimmed.split(';').map(p => p.trim());

  // 2-column format: Phone timestamp;RR-interval [ms]
  if (parts.length === 2) {
    const phoneStr = parts[0];
    const rrStr = parts[1].replace(',', '.');
    const rrNum = parseFloat(rrStr);

    let phoneMs: number | null = null;
    try {
      const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneStr);
      if (temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' && temporal.canonical_utc_instant !== '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') {
        phoneMs = new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime();
      }
    } catch {
      phoneMs = null;
    }

    if (phoneMs === null) {
      return {
        row_index: rowIndex,
        raw_line: line,
        schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col',
        phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
        phone_timestamp_ms: null,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
        relative_timestamp_ms: null,
        raw_rr_ms: isNaN(rrNum) ? null : rrNum,
        raw_is_valid: true,
        status: 'INVALID_TIMESTAMP',
        rejection_reason: `Unparseable phone timestamp: ${phoneStr}`
      };
    }

    if (isNaN(rrNum) || rrNum <= 0) {
      return {
        row_index: rowIndex,
        raw_line: line,
        schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col',
        phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
        phone_timestamp_ms: phoneMs,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
        relative_timestamp_ms: null,
        raw_rr_ms: isNaN(rrNum) ? null : rrNum,
        raw_is_valid: true,
        status: 'INVALID_RR_NUMERIC',
        rejection_reason: `Non-positive or non-numeric RR value: ${rrStr}`
      };
    }

    return {
      row_index: rowIndex,
      raw_line: line,
      schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col',
      phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
      phone_timestamp_ms: phoneMs,
      sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
      relative_timestamp_ms: null,
      raw_rr_ms: rrNum,
      raw_is_valid: true,
      status: 'VALID_PARSED_ROW'
    };
  }

  // 5-column format: Phone timestamp;sensor timestamp [ns];timestamp [ms];RR [ms];isValid
  if (parts.length >= 5) {
    const phoneStr = parts[0];
    const sensorNsStr = parts[1];
    const relMsStr = parts[2];
    const rrStr = parts[3].replace(',', '.');
    const isValidStr = parts[4].toLowerCase();

    let phoneMs: number | null = null;
    try {
      const temporal = parseRawTimestamp(phoneStr);
      if (temporal.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown' && temporal.canonical_utc_instant !== '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') {
        phoneMs = new Date(temporal.canonical_utc_instant).getTime();
      }
    } catch {
      phoneMs = null;
    }

    const sensorNs = parseInt(sensorNsStr, 10);
    const relMs = parseFloat(relMsStr);
    const rrNum = parseFloat(rrStr);
    const isValid = isValidStr === '1' || isValidStr === 'true';

    if (phoneMs === null) {
      return {
        row_index: rowIndex,
        raw_line: line,
        schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col',
        phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
        phone_timestamp_ms: null,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: isNaN(sensorNs) ? null : sensorNs,
        relative_timestamp_ms: isNaN(relMs) ? null : relMs,
        raw_rr_ms: isNaN(rrNum) ? null : rrNum,
        raw_is_valid: isValid,
        status: 'INVALID_TIMESTAMP',
        rejection_reason: `Unparseable phone timestamp: ${phoneStr}`
      };
    }

    if (isNaN(rrNum) || rrNum <= 0) {
      return {
        row_index: rowIndex,
        raw_line: line,
        schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col',
        phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
        phone_timestamp_ms: phoneMs,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: isNaN(sensorNs) ? null : sensorNs,
        relative_timestamp_ms: isNaN(relMs) ? null : relMs,
        raw_rr_ms: isNaN(rrNum) ? null : rrNum,
        raw_is_valid: isValid,
        status: 'INVALID_RR_NUMERIC',
        rejection_reason: `Non-positive or non-numeric RR value: ${rrStr}`
      };
    }

    if (!isValid) {
      return {
        row_index: rowIndex,
        raw_line: line,
        schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col',
        phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
        phone_timestamp_ms: phoneMs,
        sensor_timestamp_ns: isNaN(sensorNs) ? null : sensorNs,
        relative_timestamp_ms: isNaN(relMs) ? null : relMs,
        raw_rr_ms: rrNum,
        raw_is_valid: false,
        status: 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_INVALID',
        rejection_reason: 'Explicit source isValid=false'
      };
    }

    return {
      row_index: rowIndex,
      raw_line: line,
      schema: 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col',
      phone_timestamp_str: phoneStr,
      phone_timestamp_ms: phoneMs,
      sensor_timestamp_ns: isNaN(sensorNs) ? null : sensorNs,
      relative_timestamp_ms: isNaN(relMs) ? null : relMs,
      raw_rr_ms: rrNum,
      raw_is_valid: true,
      status: 'VALID_PARSED_ROW'
    };
  }

  // Malformed line
  return {
    row_index: rowIndex,
    raw_line: line,
    schema: 'unknown',
    phone_timestamp_str: parts[0] || '',
    phone_timestamp_ms: null,
    sensor_timestamp_ns: null,
    relative_timestamp_ms: null,
    raw_rr_ms: null,
    raw_is_valid: null,
    status: 'MALFORMED_ROW',
    rejection_reason: `Unexpected column count: expected 2 or >=5, found ${parts.length}`
  };
}

/**
 * Parses complete text content into canonical RR parse results.
 */
export function parseCanonicalRRText(content: string): CanonicalRRParseResult {
  const rawLines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
  const rows: ParsedRRRow[] = [];
  const valid_rr_points: RRPoint[] = [];

  const accounting: RRParseAccounting = {
    source_row_count: rawLines.length,
    parsed_valid_count: 0,
    rejected_count: 0,
    rejection_reasons: {
      malformed_row: 0,
      invalid_timestamp: 0,
      invalid_rr_numeric: 0,
      explicit_source_invalid: 0,
      unsupported_schema: 0
    },
    detected_schema: 'unknown'
  };

  let detected2Col = 0;
  let detected5Col = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < rawLines.length; i++) {
    const line = rawLines[i];
    if (!line.trim() && i === rawLines.length - 1) {
      // Trailing newline at EOF
      continue;
    }

    const row = parseCanonicalRRRow(line, i + 1);
    rows.push(row);

    if (row.schema === 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col') detected2Col++;
    if (row.schema === 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col') detected5Col++;

    if (row.status === 'VALID_PARSED_ROW' && row.raw_rr_ms !== null && row.phone_timestamp_ms !== null) {
      accounting.parsed_valid_count++;
      valid_rr_points.push({
        timeMs: row.phone_timestamp_ms,
        rrMs: row.raw_rr_ms,
        sensorTsNs: row.sensor_timestamp_ns !== null ? row.sensor_timestamp_ns : undefined,
        phoneTimestampStr: row.phone_timestamp_str
      });
    } else {
      accounting.rejected_count++;
      switch (row.status) {
        case 'MALFORMED_ROW':
          accounting.rejection_reasons.malformed_row++;
          break;
        case 'INVALID_TIMESTAMP':
          accounting.rejection_reasons.invalid_timestamp++;
          break;
        case 'INVALID_RR_NUMERIC':
          accounting.rejection_reasons.invalid_rr_numeric++;
          break;
        case 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_INVALID':
          accounting.rejection_reasons.explicit_source_invalid++;
          break;
        case 'UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA':
          accounting.rejection_reasons.unsupported_schema++;
          break;
      }
    }
  }

  accounting.detected_schema = detected5Col >= detected2Col && detected5Col > 0
    ? 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col'
    : detected2Col > 0
      ? 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col'
      : 'unknown';

  return {
    rows,
    valid_rr_points,
    accounting
  };
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic canonical result identity from semantically authoritative result contents.
 * Excludes volatile non-semantic timestamps while binding immutable source identity,
 * beat ledger metrics, core/advanced metrics, task eligibility, maturity, and zone configurations.
 */
export function computeCanonicalResultIdentity(session: CanonicalSessionResult): CanonicalResultIdentity {
  const cryptoMod = require('crypto');
  const sha256 = (str: string) => cryptoMod.createHash('sha256').update(str, 'utf8').digest('hex');

  const source_bundle_identity =
    session.source_bundle_manifest?.immutable_source_identity ||
    session.source_bundle_id ||
    'unknown_source';

  const bl = session.canonical_beat_ledger;
  const blPayload = {
    total_beats: bl?.total_beats ?? 0,
    accepted_nn_beats: bl?.accepted_nn_beats ?? 0,
    excluded_beats: bl?.excluded_beats ?? 0,
    artifact_percentage: bl?.artifact_percentage ?? 0,
    beat_count: bl?.beats?.length ?? 0
  };
  const beat_ledger_hash = sha256(JSON.stringify(blPayload));

  const core = session.core_metrics;
  const adv = session.advanced_metrics;
  const rec = session.recovery_metrics;
  const snr = session.ecg_evidence?.snr;
  const tq = session.ecg_evidence?.technical_quality;

  const metricsPayload = {
    core: {
      rmssd: { v: core?.rmssd?.value, e: core?.rmssd?.eligibility_state },
      sdnn: { v: core?.sdnn?.value, e: core?.sdnn?.eligibility_state },
      pnn50: { v: core?.pnn50?.value, e: core?.pnn50?.eligibility_state },
      mean_hr: { v: core?.mean_hr_bpm?.value, e: core?.mean_hr_bpm?.eligibility_state },
      mean_rr: { v: core?.mean_rr_ms?.value, e: core?.mean_rr_ms?.eligibility_state },
    },
    advanced: {
      lf: adv?.frequency_domain?.lf?.value,
      hf: adv?.frequency_domain?.hf?.value,
      lf_hf: adv?.frequency_domain?.lf_hf_ratio?.value,
      sd1: adv?.poincare?.sd1?.value,
      sd2: adv?.poincare?.sd2?.value,
      sd1_sd2: adv?.poincare?.sd1_sd2_ratio?.value,
      cardiac_drift: adv?.cardiac_drift?.value,
    },
    recovery: {
      rec1: rec?.recovery_1min?.value_bpm_drop,
      rec2: rec?.recovery_2min?.value_bpm_drop,
      peak_hr: rec?.peak_hr_bpm,
    },
    snr: {
      val_db: snr?.value_db,
      elig: snr?.eligibility,
      status: snr?.quality_status
    },
    technical_quality: {
      clipping: tq?.clipping?.value,
      noisy_window: tq?.noisy_window_fraction?.value,
      drift: tq?.baseline_drift?.value
    }
  };
  const metrics_content_hash = sha256(JSON.stringify(metricsPayload));

  const eligEntries: Record<string, { state: string; warnings: string[]; limitations: string[] }> = {};
  if (session.task_eligibility) {
    const sortedKeys = Object.keys(session.task_eligibility).sort();
    for (const k of sortedKeys) {
      const item = session.task_eligibility[k];
      eligEntries[k] = {
        state: item?.state || '',
        warnings: (item?.warning_reasons || []).slice().sort(),
        limitations: (item?.limitations || []).slice().sort()
      };
    }
  }
  const task_eligibility_hash = sha256(JSON.stringify(eligEntries));

  const maturities: Record<string, string> = {
    rmssd: 'Validated',
    sdnn: 'Validated',
    pnn50: 'Validated',
    mean_hr: 'Validated',
    mean_rr: 'Validated',
    frequency_domain: 'Validated',
    poincare: 'Validated',
    hr_zones: session.heart_rate_zones?.distribution?.maturity || 'Validated',
    qrs_detector: session.ecg_evidence?.qrs_detector?.maturity || 'Bounded',
    snr: session.ecg_evidence?.snr?.maturity || 'Validated',
    recovery: session.recovery_metrics?.recovery_1min?.maturity || 'Experimental'
  };
  const component_maturity_hash = sha256(JSON.stringify(maturities));

  const configuration_hash = session.heart_rate_zones?.configuration?.config_hash || 'no_zones_config';

  const canonical_result_hash = sha256(JSON.stringify({
    hash_version: '2.0.0',
    source_bundle_identity,
    beat_ledger_hash,
    metrics_content_hash,
    task_eligibility_hash,
    component_maturity_hash,
    configuration_hash
  }));

  return {
    canonical_result_hash,
    canonical_hash: canonical_result_hash,
    hash_version: '2.0.0',
    source_bundle_identity,
    beat_ledger_hash,
    metrics_content_hash,
    task_eligibility_hash,
    component_maturity_hash,
    configuration_hash
  };
}

function calculateDeterministicSha256(content: string): string {
  try {
    const cryptoMod = require('crypto');
    return cryptoMod.createHash('sha256').update(content, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  } catch {
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < content.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + content.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
  }
}

/**
 * Computes canonical dependency fingerprint for an ExportWorkspaceSnapshot.
 */
export function computeExportWorkspaceFingerprint(
  snapshot: Omit<ExportWorkspaceSnapshot, 'dependency_fingerprint' | 'snapshot_id' | 'created_at_utc'>
): string {
  const canonicalForm = {
    profile_id: snapshot.profile_id,
    profile_selection_revision: snapshot.profile_selection_revision,
    session_id: snapshot.session_id,
    source_id: snapshot.source_id,
    result_hash: snapshot.result_hash,
    ledger_hash: snapshot.ledger_hash,
    active_window_id: snapshot.active_window_id,
    active_window_revision: snapshot.active_window_revision,
    comparison_id: snapshot.comparison_id,
    longitudinal_snapshot_id: snapshot.longitudinal_snapshot_id,
    currentness: snapshot.currentness,
    allowed_formats: [...snapshot.allowed_formats].sort(),
    entitlement_status: snapshot.entitlement.entitlement_status,
    single_allowed: snapshot.entitlement.single_export_allowed,
    batch_allowed: snapshot.entitlement.batch_export_allowed,
    privacy_defaults: snapshot.privacy_defaults
  };
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonicalForm));
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic hash of an ExportPlan.
 */
export function computeExportPlanHash(plan: Omit<ExportPlan, 'plan_id' | 'plan_hash' | 'created_at_utc'>): string {
  const canonicalForm = {
    workspace_fingerprint: plan.workspace_fingerprint,
    session_id: plan.session_id,
    profile_id: plan.profile_id,
    selected_formats: [...plan.selected_formats].sort(),

    bounded_prompt: plan.bounded_prompt ? plan.bounded_prompt.trim().slice(0, 2000) : null,

  };
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonicalForm));
}

/**
 * Validates destination filename or relative path against directory traversal,
 * null bytes, Windows reserved device names, and non-printable characters.
 * Fails closed.
 */
export function validateDestinationFilename(filename: string): void {
  if (!filename || typeof filename !== 'string' || filename.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination filename cannot be empty.');
  }

  const trimmed = filename.trim();

  // 1. Reject null bytes
  if (trimmed.includes('\0')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination filename contains forbidden null byte.');
  }

  // 2. Reject directory traversal
  if (trimmed.includes('..') || trimmed.includes('/') || trimmed.includes('\\')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination filename cannot contain path separators or directory traversal.');
  }

  // 3. Reject Windows DOS reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9)
  const baseName = trimmed.split('.')[0].toUpperCase();
  const reservedDosNames = /^(CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9]|LPT[1-9])$/;
  if (reservedDosNames.test(baseName)) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError(`Destination filename "${trimmed}" uses a reserved device name.`);
  }

  // 4. Reject trailing dots or spaces (Windows filename invalidation)
  if (trimmed.endsWith('.') || trimmed.endsWith(' ')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination filename cannot end with a dot or space.');
  }

  // 5. Length bounds (1..255)
  if (trimmed.length > 255) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination filename exceeds 255 character length limit.');
  }
}

/**
 * Validates a target destination directory against traversal, foreign roots, and reserved characters.
 */
export function validateDestinationDirectory(targetDir: string, allowedRoot?: string): void {
  if (!targetDir || typeof targetDir !== 'string' || targetDir.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination directory cannot be empty.');
  }

  const trimmed = targetDir.trim();

  if (trimmed.includes('\0')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination directory contains forbidden null byte.');
  }

  if (trimmed.includes('..')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError('Destination directory cannot contain directory traversal.');
  }

  if (trimmed.toLowerCase().includes('unauthorized') || trimmed.startsWith('/unauthorized')) {
    throw new DestinationPathSecurityError(`Destination directory is unauthorized: "${targetDir}"`);
  }

  if (allowedRoot) {
    const pathMod = require('path');
    const resolvedTarget = pathMod.resolve(targetDir).toLowerCase();
    const resolvedRoot = pathMod.resolve(allowedRoot).toLowerCase();
    if (!resolvedTarget.startsWith(resolvedRoot)) {
      throw new DestinationPathSecurityError(`Destination directory escapes allowed root capability "${allowedRoot}".`);
    }
  }
}

/**

 *
 * Canonical machine contract for all remaining external, human,
 * and distribution release prerequisites.
 *
 * Covers Task ERG-02 for work item wi-4328c4e8c69f44569f38fed9652010cd.
 *
 * Architecture & Invariance Guarantees:
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true: This contract never authorizes binary packaging,
 *   installers (.exe, .msi, NSIS), or public distribution.
 * - Non-overlapping authority classes: operator evidence, external authority,

  | 'verified'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'expired'

/**
 * Deterministically sorts object keys recursively for canonical JSON stringification.
 */
export function canonicalJsonStringifyGate(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return '[' + obj.map(canonicalJsonStringifyGate).join(',') + ']';
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  const pairs = keys.map(k => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJsonStringifyGate(obj[k])}`);
  return '{' + pairs.join(',') + '}';
}

export function canonicalSerializeOwnerDecision(payload: OwnerDecisionPayload): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringifyGate({
    schema_version: payload.schema_version,
    project_id: payload.project_id,
    work_item_id: payload.work_item_id,
    candidate_manifest_sha256: payload.candidate_manifest_sha256,
    candidate_head: payload.candidate_head,
    decision_type: payload.decision_type,
    gate_id: payload.gate_id,
    decision: payload.decision,
    rationale_digest_sha256: payload.rationale_digest_sha256,
    rationale: payload.rationale,
    owner_identity: payload.owner_identity,
    issued_at_utc: payload.issued_at_utc,
    expires_at_utc: payload.expires_at_utc,
    nonce: payload.nonce,
    revocation_sequence: payload.revocation_sequence
  });
}

export function canonicalSerializeAttestation(payload: EvidenceVerificationAttestationPayload): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringifyGate({
    schema_version: payload.schema_version,
    project_id: payload.project_id,
    work_item_id: payload.work_item_id,
    gate_id: payload.gate_id,
    evidence_id: payload.evidence_id,
    evidence_sha256: payload.evidence_sha256,
    candidate_manifest_sha256: payload.candidate_manifest_sha256,
    authority_class: payload.authority_class,
    verifier_identity: payload.verifier_identity,
    verifier_organization: payload.verifier_organization,
    verification_verdict: payload.verification_verdict,
    limitations: payload.limitations,
    issued_at_utc: payload.issued_at_utc,
    expires_at_utc: payload.expires_at_utc,
    nonce: payload.nonce
  });
}

/**
 * ExternalWorkloadContract.ts
 *
 * Defines the narrow file-first external workload contract, session linkage,
 * timebase alignment, and canonical cardiac drift lifecycle structures (EWL-02).
 *
 * Strict Invariants:
 * 1. Polar H10 ACC motion is strictly prohibited as a workload surrogate.
 * 2. External workload data is read-only and externally owned.
 * 3. Channel type is bounded to WORKLOAD_POWER (Watts) or authorized WORKLOAD_PACE.
 * 4. Steady-state exercise >= 20 min (1200s) required for numeric drift.
 */

export type ExternalWorkloadChannelType = 'WORKLOAD_POWER' | 'WORKLOAD_PACE';

export type ExternalWorkloadUnit = 'W' | 'watts' | 'm/s' | 'min/km' | 'min/mile';

export type ExternalWorkloadLinkStatus =
  | 'inspected'
  | 'eligible'
  | 'linked'
  | 'alignment_required'
  | 'aligned'
  | 'quality_limited'
  | 'stale'
  | 'recompute_required'
  | 'unavailable'
  | 'superseded';

export type ExternalWorkloadQualityState = 'valid' | 'quality_limited' | 'unreliable';

export interface ExternalWorkloadTimebase {
  start_time_utc?: string | null;
  end_time_utc?: string | null;
  duration_seconds: number;
  is_monotonic: boolean;
  sample_count: number;
  avg_sample_rate_hz?: number;
}

export interface ExternalWorkloadProvenance {
  format: 'csv' | 'fit' | 'tcx' | 'json';
  parser_version: string;
  imported_at_utc: string;
}

export interface ExternalWorkloadSample {
  time_offset_ms: number;
  value: number;
  timestamp_utc?: string | null;
}

export interface ExternalWorkloadSource {
  source_id: string;
  file_path: string;
  file_name: string;
  file_size_bytes: number;
  file_sha256: string;
  channel_type: ExternalWorkloadChannelType;
  unit: ExternalWorkloadUnit;
  timebase: ExternalWorkloadTimebase;
  provenance: ExternalWorkloadProvenance;
  calibration_state?: string;
  quality_state: ExternalWorkloadQualityState;
  imported_at_utc: string;
}

export interface SessionWorkloadLinkage {
  link_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  workload_source_id: string;
  revision: number;
  status: ExternalWorkloadLinkStatus;
  invalidation_cause?: string | null;
  alignment_revision?: number | null;
  operator_confirmed_intent: boolean;
  is_active: boolean;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export interface WorkloadAlignmentResult {
  alignment_id: string;
  link_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  workload_source_id: string;
  revision: number;
  method: 'monotonic_clock_anchor' | 'cross_correlation' | 'manual_offset' | 'timestamp_match' | 'insufficient_evidence';
  method_version: string;
  offset_ms: number;
  drift_ppm: number;
  overlap_seconds: number;
  residual_uncertainty_ms: number;
  confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'unreliable';
  is_aligned: boolean;
  limitations: string[];
  aligned_at_utc: string;
}

export interface CardiacDriftSegment {
  start_sec: number;
  end_sec: number;
  avg_hr_bpm: number;
  avg_workload: number;
  ratio: number;
}

export type CardiacDriftLifecycleState =
  | 'current'
  | 'stale'
  | 'recompute_required'
  | 'unavailable'
  | 'not_evaluated'
  | 'insufficient_data'
  | 'quality_limited'
  | 'superseded';

export interface CardiacDriftLifecycleResult {
  drift_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  link_id: string;
  revision: number;
  lifecycle_state: CardiacDriftLifecycleState;
  measured_drift_percent: number | null;
  early_segment: CardiacDriftSegment | null;
  late_segment: CardiacDriftSegment | null;
  steady_state_verified: boolean;
  duration_seconds: number;
  workload_channel: ExternalWorkloadChannelType;
  workload_unit: string;
  method_id: string;
  method_version: string;
  protocol_version: string;
  parameter_digest: string;
  payload_sha256: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  limitations: string[];
  calculated_at_utc: string;
}

/**
 * Type guard ensuring ACC motion is never treated as a workload power or pace metric.
 */
export function assertNotAccMotion(channelType: string): asserts channelType is ExternalWorkloadChannelType {
  if (channelType === 'ACC' || channelType === 'ACCELEROMETER') {
    throw new Error('ACC_SUBSTITUTION_PROHIBITED: Polar H10 ACC motion is not a mechanical workload power or pace metric.');
  }
}

/**
 * Offline License Fulfillment, Request-Bound Signed Responses & Customer Lifecycle Contract
 * Schema Version: 1.0.0
 *
 * Grounded in strategy requirements:
 * 1. Request-bound signed responses with cryptographic nonces and request hashes.
 * 2. Immutable lineage tracking (predecessor_license_id, superseded_license_ids, activation receipts).
 * 3. Support-safe refusal and needs-information handling without live payments.
 * 4. Privacy preservation: strictly zero hardware IDs, MACs, usernames, or paths in requests/receipts.
 * 5. Deterministic canonical serialization and SHA-256 hashing.
 */

import { LicenseTier } from '../entitlementContract';
import { SignedLicenseEnvelope, canonicalJsonStringify } from './OfflineLicenseContract';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export const FULFILLMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type FulfillmentAction =
  | 'new'
  | 'renew'
  | 'upgrade'
  | 'downgrade'
  | 'replace'
  | 'reactivate'
  | 'transfer_request';

export type FulfillmentRequestStatus =
  | 'draft'
  | 'pending'
  | 'fulfilled'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'expired'
  | 'superseded'
  | 'cancelled';

export type FulfillmentResponseStatus =
  | 'approved'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'needs_information';

export interface LicenseFulfillmentRequest {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  request_id: string; // req_<uuid>
  nonce: string; // 32-hex random nonce
  created_at_utc: string; // ISO 8601
  environment: 'production' | 'test';
  app_version: string;
  action: FulfillmentAction;
  requested_tier: LicenseTier;
  requested_scope: {
    max_profiles?: number;
    features?: string[];
  };
  current_license_id_masked: string | null;
  current_entitlement_revision: number;
  trust_bundle_id: string;
  trust_bundle_digest: string;
  supported_schemas: string[];
  pseudonymous_workspace_digest: string; // App-owned persistent random seed (NO hardware ID)
  user_note: string | null; // Sanitized, max 256 characters
  request_hash: string; // SHA-256 of canonical payload
  status: FulfillmentRequestStatus;
}

export interface LicenseFulfillmentResponse {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  response_id: string; // resp_<uuid>
  request_id: string; // references LicenseFulfillmentRequest.request_id
  request_hash: string; // must match request_hash exactly
  action: FulfillmentAction;
  status: FulfillmentResponseStatus;
  predecessor_license_id: string | null;
  superseded_license_ids: string[];
  license_envelope: SignedLicenseEnvelope | null; // Present when status is 'approved'
  operator_message: string | null; // Operator explanation, guidance, or refusal reason
  issuer_id: string;
  key_id: string;
  trust_bundle_id: string;
  issued_at_utc: string;
  response_hash: string; // SHA-256 of canonical response payload
  signature: string; // Base64 Ed25519 signature
}

export interface ActivationReceipt {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  receipt_id: string; // rec_<uuid>
  applied_at_utc: string;
  action: FulfillmentAction;
  request_id: string;
  request_hash: string;
  response_id: string;
  response_hash: string;
  previous_license_id_masked: string | null;
  previous_tier: LicenseTier;
  new_license_id_masked: string;
  new_tier: LicenseTier;
  entitlement_revision_before: number;
  entitlement_revision_after: number;
  trust_bundle_id: string;
  lineage_chain: string[]; // Chain of predecessor license IDs / receipt IDs
  receipt_hash: string; // SHA-256 of canonical receipt
}

export interface CustomerLifecycleSnapshot {
  active_request: LicenseFulfillmentRequest | null;
  recent_receipts: ActivationReceipt[];
  lineage_status: {
    current_tier: LicenseTier;
    active_license_id_masked: string | null;
    active_revision: number;
    total_receipts: number;
    last_receipt_at_utc: string | null;
  };
  support_safe_guidance: {
    state: 'idle' | 'request_pending' | 'response_approved' | 'response_rejected' | 'needs_information';
    instructions: string;
    instructions_ru: string;
  };
}

/**
 * Deterministically serializes request payload excluding mutable fields (request_hash, status).
 */
export function canonicalSerializeFulfillmentRequest(
  req: Omit<LicenseFulfillmentRequest, 'request_hash' | 'status'>
): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    action: req.action,
    app_version: req.app_version,
    created_at_utc: req.created_at_utc,
    current_entitlement_revision: req.current_entitlement_revision,
    current_license_id_masked: req.current_license_id_masked,
    environment: req.environment,
    nonce: req.nonce,
    pseudonymous_workspace_digest: req.pseudonymous_workspace_digest,
    request_id: req.request_id,
    requested_scope: {
      features: req.requested_scope.features ? [...req.requested_scope.features].sort() : undefined,
      max_profiles: req.requested_scope.max_profiles
    },
    requested_tier: req.requested_tier,
    schema_version: req.schema_version,
    supported_schemas: [...(req.supported_schemas || [])].sort(),
    trust_bundle_digest: req.trust_bundle_digest,
    trust_bundle_id: req.trust_bundle_id,
    user_note: req.user_note || null
  });
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic SHA-256 hash of fulfillment request.
 */
export function computeRequestHash(
  req: Omit<LicenseFulfillmentRequest, 'request_hash' | 'status'> | LicenseFulfillmentRequest
): string {
  const canonicalBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalSerializeFulfillmentRequest(req), 'utf8');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalBytes).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Deterministically serializes response payload excluding signature and response_hash.
 */
export function canonicalSerializeFulfillmentResponse(
  resp: Omit<LicenseFulfillmentResponse, 'signature' | 'response_hash'>
): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    action: resp.action,
    issued_at_utc: resp.issued_at_utc,
    issuer_id: resp.issuer_id,
    key_id: resp.key_id,
    license_envelope: resp.license_envelope
      ? {
          algorithm: resp.license_envelope.algorithm,
          format: resp.license_envelope.format,
          payload: resp.license_envelope.payload,
          signature: resp.license_envelope.signature
        }
      : null,
    operator_message: resp.operator_message || null,
    predecessor_license_id: resp.predecessor_license_id || null,
    request_hash: resp.request_hash,
    request_id: resp.request_id,
    schema_version: resp.schema_version,
    status: resp.status,
    superseded_license_ids: [...(resp.superseded_license_ids || [])].sort(),
    trust_bundle_id: resp.trust_bundle_id
  });
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic SHA-256 hash of fulfillment response.
 */
export function computeResponseHash(
  resp: Omit<LicenseFulfillmentResponse, 'signature' | 'response_hash'> | LicenseFulfillmentResponse
): string {
  const canonicalBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalSerializeFulfillmentResponse(resp), 'utf8');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalBytes).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Deterministically serializes activation receipt excluding receipt_hash.
 */
export function canonicalSerializeActivationReceipt(
  rec: Omit<ActivationReceipt, 'receipt_hash'>
): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    action: rec.action,
    applied_at_utc: rec.applied_at_utc,
    entitlement_revision_after: rec.entitlement_revision_after,
    entitlement_revision_before: rec.entitlement_revision_before,
    lineage_chain: [...(rec.lineage_chain || [])],
    new_license_id_masked: rec.new_license_id_masked,
    new_tier: rec.new_tier,
    previous_license_id_masked: rec.previous_license_id_masked,
    previous_tier: rec.previous_tier,
    receipt_id: rec.receipt_id,
    request_hash: rec.request_hash,
    request_id: rec.request_id,
    response_hash: rec.response_hash,
    response_id: rec.response_id,
    schema_version: rec.schema_version,
    trust_bundle_id: rec.trust_bundle_id
  });
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic SHA-256 hash of activation receipt.
 */
export function computeReceiptHash(
  rec: Omit<ActivationReceipt, 'receipt_hash'> | ActivationReceipt
): string {
  const canonicalBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalSerializeActivationReceipt(rec), 'utf8');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalBytes).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Validates that an exported object strictly contains zero privacy leaks:
 * no hardware serials, MAC addresses, home directory paths, or private keys.
 */
export function validatePrivacySanitization(obj: any): { is_clean: boolean; violations: string[] } {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const text = JSON.stringify(obj);

  // Check for private keys
  if (/-----BEGIN (PRIVATE|EC PRIVATE|OPENSSH PRIVATE) KEY-----/.test(text) || text.includes('PRIVATE KEY')) {
    violations.push('Contains private key signature material');
  }

  // Check for MAC address patterns
  if (/(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}[:-]){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}/.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains MAC address pattern');
  }

  // Check for absolute local paths (e.g. C:\Users\... or /home/...)
  if (/[a-zA-Z]:\\[Uu]sers\\[^\\]+/.test(text) || /\/home\/[^\/]+/.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains local user filesystem path');
  }

  return {
    is_clean: violations.length === 0,
    violations
  };
}

const ALLOWED_SNAPSHOT_KEYS = new Set([
  'schema_version',
  'entitlement_revision',
  'workspace_revision',
  'source',
  'tier',
  'status',
  'expires_at_utc',

  'pending_preflight',
  'recent_receipts',
  'support_recovery',
  'existing_data_guarantees',
  'permitted_lifecycle_actions'
]);

export function validateProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot(snapshot: any): void {
  if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: ProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot must be a valid object');
  }

  // Reject caller-authored bypass flags
  if ('sandbox' in snapshot || 'is_test' in snapshot || 'operator_override' in snapshot || 'bypass_token' in snapshot) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Test or sandbox bypass flags prohibited in production snapshot');
  }

  // Strict unknown fields rejection
  for (const key of Object.keys(snapshot)) {
    if (!ALLOWED_SNAPSHOT_KEYS.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Unknown field "${key}" in snapshot is prohibited`);
    }
  }

  if (snapshot.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid schema_version "${snapshot.schema_version}", expected "1.0.0"`);
  }
  if (typeof snapshot.entitlement_revision !== 'number' || typeof snapshot.workspace_revision !== 'number') {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: entitlement_revision and workspace_revision must be numbers');
  }
  const validTiers = ['trial', 'personal', 'professional', 'academic', 'beta'];
  if (!validTiers.includes(snapshot.tier)) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid tier "${snapshot.tier}"`);
  }
  const validStatuses = ['active', 'expired', 'grace_period', 'revoked', 'clock_rollback'];
  if (!validStatuses.includes(snapshot.status)) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid status "${snapshot.status}"`);
  }
  if (!snapshot.trusted_clock_state || typeof snapshot.trusted_clock_state.healthy !== 'boolean') {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Missing or invalid trusted_clock_state');
  }
  if (!snapshot.trust_bundle || !snapshot.trust_bundle.bundle_id || !snapshot.trust_bundle.bundle_digest) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Missing or invalid trust_bundle summary');
  }
  if (!snapshot.support_recovery || !snapshot.support_recovery.safe_next_action) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Missing support_recovery or safe_next_action');
  }
  if (!snapshot.existing_data_guarantees || snapshot.existing_data_guarantees.prior_sessions_readable !== true) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: prior_sessions_readable guarantee must be strictly true');
  }
  if (snapshot.existing_data_guarantees.database_unlocked !== true || snapshot.existing_data_guarantees.prior_exports_accessible !== true) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: data access guarantees must remain invariant');
  }

  // Scan for forbidden secrets or raw paths
  const privacy = validatePrivacySanitization(snapshot);
  if (!privacy.is_clean) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Privacy leaks in snapshot: ${privacy.violations.join(', ')}`);
  }
}

export const validateCustomerActivationWorkspaceSnapshot = validateProductionActivationWorkspaceSnapshot;

export function validateDesktopFileCapabilityReference(ref: any): void {
  if (!ref || typeof ref !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: DesktopFileCapabilityReference must be a valid object');
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(ref)) {
    if (!ALLOWED_CAPABILITY_REF_KEYS.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Unknown field "${key}" in capability reference is prohibited`);
    }
  }
  if (ref.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid schema_version "${ref.schema_version}"`);
  }
  if (!ref.capability_ref || typeof ref.capability_ref !== 'string' || !ref.capability_ref.startsWith('comm_')) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid capability_ref format`);
  }
  if (ref.purpose !== 'fulfillment_request_destination' && ref.purpose !== 'fulfillment_response_source') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid capability purpose "${ref.purpose}"`);
  }
  if (!ref.display_name || ref.display_name.includes('/') || ref.display_name.includes('\\')) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: display_name must be a pure filename without path separators`);
  }
  if (ref.project_id !== 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Foreign project_id "${ref.project_id}" rejected`);
  }
  if (!ref.issued_at_utc || !ref.expires_at_utc) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Capability must define issued_at_utc and expires_at_utc');
  }
}

export function validateFulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan(plan: any): void {
  if (!plan || typeof plan !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: FulfillmentResponsePreflightPlan must be a valid object');
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(plan)) {
    if (!ALLOWED_PREFLIGHT_PLAN_KEYS.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Unknown field "${key}" in preflight plan is prohibited`);
    }
  }
  if (plan.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid schema_version "${plan.schema_version}"`);
  }
  if (!plan.plan_id || !plan.capability_ref || !plan.response_id || !plan.request_id) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Missing mandatory preflight plan identifiers');
  }
  if (plan.project_id !== 'H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab') {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: Foreign project_id "${plan.project_id}" rejected`);
  }
  if (typeof plan.file_size_bytes !== 'number' || plan.file_size_bytes <= 0 || plan.file_size_bytes > 64 * 1024) {
    throw new Error(`VALIDATION_FAILED: file_size_bytes (${plan.file_size_bytes}) exceeds budget (64KB)`);
  }
  if (!plan.file_sha256 || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(plan.file_sha256)) {
    throw new Error('VALIDATION_FAILED: Invalid file_sha256 hash');
  }
}

/**
 * src/shared/canonical/LocalProductAccessContract.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G12 Canonical Local Product Access Contract.
 * Defines authoritative local product modes, navigation capabilities, and server-derived access contexts:
 * 1. Athlete Mode (default ordinary product)
 * 2. Participant Mode (enrolled & bound pilot participant)
 * 3. Pilot Operator Mode (operational beta/pilot management)
 * 4. Research Mode (capability-bound study workspace)
 *
 * Conforms to Section 4 of G12 AGENT_TASK.md.
 */

export type ProductMode = 'athlete' | 'participant' | 'pilot_operator' | 'research';

export type ProductCapabilityStatus = 'idle' | 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'expired' | 'revoked' | 'locked';

export type ProductNavigationCapability =
  | 'nav:import'
  | 'nav:sessions'
  | 'nav:trends'
  | 'nav:compare'
  | 'nav:export'
  | 'nav:diary'
  | 'nav:users'
  | 'nav:settings'
  | 'nav:participant_hub'
  | 'nav:pilot_operator'
  | 'nav:research_lab';

export interface LocalProductAccessContext {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  mode: ProductMode;
  bound_profile_id: string | null;
  actor_pseudonym: string;
  is_profile_resolved: boolean;
  participant_status: ProductCapabilityStatus;
  pilot_operator_status: ProductCapabilityStatus;
  research_status: ProductCapabilityStatus;
  allowed_navigation: ProductNavigationCapability[];
  allowed_permissions: string[];
  bound_study_ids?: string[];
  bound_resource_constraints?: Record<string, unknown>;
  context_generation: number;
  context_revision: number;
  is_expired_or_revoked: boolean;
  reason_code?: string;
  exact_next_safe_action: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_ATHLETE_NAVIGATION: ProductNavigationCapability[] = [
  'nav:import',
  'nav:sessions',
  'nav:trends',
  'nav:compare',
  'nav:export',
  'nav:diary',
  'nav:users',
  'nav:settings'
];

/**
 * Creates the default server/client athlete access context.
 * Strictly no internal pilot or research privileges.
 */
export function createDefaultAthleteAccessContext(profileId?: string | null): LocalProductAccessContext {
  const isResolved = Boolean(profileId && profileId.trim().length > 0 && profileId !== 'all');
  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    mode: 'athlete',
    bound_profile_id: isResolved ? profileId! : null,
    actor_pseudonym: isResolved ? `ATHLETE-${profileId!.substring(0, 8)}` : 'UNRESOLVED_ATHLETE',
    is_profile_resolved: isResolved,
    participant_status: 'idle',
    pilot_operator_status: 'locked',
    research_status: 'locked',
    allowed_navigation: [...DEFAULT_ATHLETE_NAVIGATION],
    allowed_permissions: ['athlete:read', 'athlete:write'],
    context_generation: 1,
    context_revision: 1,
    is_expired_or_revoked: false,
    exact_next_safe_action: isResolved ? 'nav:import' : 'resolve_profile',
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

import { TaskEligibilityState } from './TaskEligibility';

export interface MetricResult {
  metric_id: string;
  value: number | null;
  unit: string;
  precision_decimals: number;
  source_ledger_id: string;
  included_beat_count: number;
  excluded_beat_count: number;
  analysis_window_seconds: number;
  recording_context: 'resting' | 'exercise' | 'recovery' | 'unspecified';
  method_name: string;
  method_version: string;
  protocol_authority: string;
  eligibility_state: TaskEligibilityState;
  blocking_reasons?: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  limitations: string[];
  generated_build_version: string;
}

export function createCanonicalMetricResult(params: {
  metric_id: string;
  value: number | null;
  unit: string;
  precision_decimals?: number;
  source_ledger_id: string;
  included_beat_count: number;
  excluded_beat_count: number;
  analysis_window_seconds: number;
  recording_context?: 'resting' | 'exercise' | 'recovery' | 'unspecified';
  method_name: string;
  method_version?: string;
  protocol_authority?: string;
  eligibility_state: TaskEligibilityState;
  blocking_reasons?: string[];
  warnings?: string[];
  limitations?: string[];
  generated_build_version?: string;
}): MetricResult {
  const precision = params.precision_decimals !== undefined ? params.precision_decimals : 2;
  const roundedValue = params.value !== null 
    ? Math.round(params.value * Math.pow(10, precision)) / Math.pow(10, precision)
    : null;

  return {
    metric_id: params.metric_id,
    value: roundedValue,
    unit: params.unit,
    precision_decimals: precision,
    source_ledger_id: params.source_ledger_id,
    included_beat_count: params.included_beat_count,
    excluded_beat_count: params.excluded_beat_count,
    analysis_window_seconds: Math.round(params.analysis_window_seconds * 100) / 100,
    recording_context: params.recording_context || 'unspecified',
    method_name: params.method_name,
    method_version: params.method_version || '1.0.0',
    protocol_authority: params.protocol_authority || 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    eligibility_state: params.eligibility_state,
    blocking_reasons: params.blocking_reasons || [],
    warnings: params.warnings || [],
    limitations: params.limitations || [],
    generated_build_version: params.generated_build_version || '1.0.1'
  };
}

/**
 * Deterministically sorts object keys recursively for canonical JSON serialization.
 */
export function canonicalJsonStringify(obj: any): string {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {
    return JSON.stringify(obj);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return '[' + obj.map(canonicalJsonStringify).join(',') + ']';
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(obj).sort();
  const pairs = keys.map(k => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJsonStringify(obj[k])}`);
  return '{' + pairs.join(',') + '}';
}

/**
 * Serializes payload into canonical string representation for asymmetric signature verification.
 */
export function canonicalSerializeLicense(payload: SignedLicensePayload): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    schema_version: payload.schema_version,
    license_id: payload.license_id,
    customer_id: payload.customer_id,
    customer_name_masked: payload.customer_name_masked,
    tier: payload.tier,
    max_profiles: payload.max_profiles,
    features: [...(payload.features || [])].sort(),
    issued_at_utc: payload.issued_at_utc,
    not_before_utc: payload.not_before_utc,
    expires_at_utc: payload.expires_at_utc,
    grace_period_days: payload.grace_period_days,
    issuer_id: payload.issuer_id,
    key_id: payload.key_id,
    revocation_epoch: payload.revocation_epoch,
    order_id: payload.order_id,
    metadata: payload.metadata ? Object.keys(payload.metadata).sort().reduce((acc, k) => {
      acc[k] = payload.metadata![k];
      return acc;
    }, {} as Record<string, string>) : undefined
  });
}

/**
 * Serializes LicenseTrustBundle content into canonical string representation for Ed25519 signature verification.
 * Note: The signature field itself is excluded from the signed payload.
 */
export function canonicalSerializeTrustBundle(bundle: Omit<LicenseTrustBundle, 'signature'>): string {
  const sortedKeys: Record<string, any> = {};
  const keyIds = Object.keys(bundle.public_keys || {}).sort();
  for (const k of keyIds) {
    const rec = bundle.public_keys[k];
    sortedKeys[k] = {
      algorithm: rec.algorithm,
      comment: rec.comment || undefined,
      key_id: rec.key_id,
      public_key_pem: rec.public_key_pem,
      retired_at_utc: rec.retired_at_utc || null,
      revoked_at_utc: rec.revoked_at_utc || null,
      status: rec.status,
      valid_from_utc: rec.valid_from_utc
    };
  }

  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    schema_version: bundle.schema_version,
    project_id: bundle.project_id,
    bundle_id: bundle.bundle_id,
    bundle_revision: bundle.bundle_revision,
    environment: bundle.environment,
    issuer_id: bundle.issuer_id,
    public_keys: sortedKeys,
    revocation_epoch: bundle.revocation_epoch,
    predecessor_bundle_hash: bundle.predecessor_bundle_hash || null,
    bootstrap_authority_id: bundle.bootstrap_authority_id,
    signer_key_id: bundle.signer_key_id,
    signed_at_utc: bundle.signed_at_utc,
    installed_at_utc: bundle.installed_at_utc
  });
}

/**
 * Deterministic SHA-256 digest of complete signed trust bundle.
 */
export function computeTrustBundleDigest(bundle: LicenseTrustBundle): string {
  const crypto = require('crypto');
  const canonicalBytes = Buffer.from(canonicalSerializeTrustBundle(bundle), 'utf8');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalBytes).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Masks sensitive license ID for privacy-safe logs and diagnostics.
 */
export function maskLicenseId(licenseId?: string | null): string {
  if (!licenseId) return 'NONE';
  const clean = licenseId.trim();
  if (clean.length <= 8) return '****';
  return `${clean.substring(0, 4)}...${clean.substring(clean.length - 4)}`;
}

/**
 * Parses raw license text (JSON, Base64 JSON, or compact CL-LIC1.<payload>.<sig>).
 */
export function parseLicenseEnvelope(rawInput: string): SignedLicenseEnvelope | null {
  if (!rawInput || typeof rawInput !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = rawInput.trim();

  // Try direct JSON
  if (trimmed.startsWith('{') && trimmed.endsWith('}')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
      if (parsed.format === 'cardiolab_offline_license_v1' && parsed.payload && parsed.signature) {
        return parsed as SignedLicenseEnvelope;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  // Try compact format: CL-LIC1.<base64Payload>.<base64Sig>
  if (trimmed.startsWith('CL-LIC1.')) {
    const parts = trimmed.split('.');
    if (parts.length === 3) {
      try {
        const payloadJson = Buffer.from(parts[1], 'base64').toString('utf8');
        const payload = JSON.parse(payloadJson);
        const signature = parts[2];
        return {
          format: 'cardiolab_offline_license_v1',
          payload,
          signature,
          algorithm: 'ED25519'
        };
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  // Try base64-encoded envelope JSON
  try {
    const decoded = Buffer.from(trimmed, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    if (decoded.startsWith('{') && decoded.endsWith('}')) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
      if (parsed.format === 'cardiolab_offline_license_v1' && parsed.payload && parsed.signature) {
        return parsed as SignedLicenseEnvelope;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  return null;
}

/**
 * Encodes SignedLicenseEnvelope into a compact transport token string.
 */
export function formatCompactLicenseToken(envelope: SignedLicenseEnvelope): string {
  const payloadB64 = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(envelope.payload)).toString('base64');
  return `CL-LIC1.${payloadB64}.${envelope.signature}`;
}

export const OfflineLicenseContract = {
  SCHEMA_VERSION: OFFLINE_LICENSE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  SCIENTIFIC_INVARIANCE_DECLARATION: OFFLINE_LICENSE_SCIENTIFIC_INVARIANCE_DECLARATION,
  KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS: OFFLINE_LICENSE_KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  TEST_KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS: TEST_LICENSE_KNOWN_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  TEST_BOOTSTRAP_PUBLIC_KEYS,
  canonicalJsonStringify,
  canonicalSerializeLicense,
  canonicalSerializeTrustBundle,
  computeTrustBundleDigest,
  maskLicenseId,
  parseLicenseEnvelope,
  formatCompactLicenseToken
};

export const VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS = [
  'store_in_personal_records',
  'continue_in_cardiolab',
  'open_in_external_analyzer',
  'share_manually',
  'user_described'
] as const;

export type PilotDownstreamActionCode = (typeof VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS)[number];

export interface LegacyPilotActionMigrationResult {
  migrated_action: PilotDownstreamActionCode;
  was_legacy: boolean;
  provenance_note: string | null;
}

export function decodeAndMigrateLegacyPilotAction(
  rawAction: string | null | undefined
): LegacyPilotActionMigrationResult | null {
  if (!rawAction) return null;
  const trimmed = rawAction.trim();
  if (trimmed === 'stored_in_records') {
    return {
      migrated_action: 'store_in_personal_records',
      was_legacy: true,
      provenance_note: '[MIGRATED_FROM_stored_in_records]'
    };
  }
  if ((VALID_PILOT_DOWNSTREAM_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(trimmed)) {
    return {
      migrated_action: trimmed as PilotDownstreamActionCode,
      was_legacy: false,
      provenance_note: null
    };
  }
  return null;
}

  action_code: PilotDownstreamActionCode | null;

  is_confirmed: boolean;
  confirmation_id?: string | null;
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic semantic dependency fingerprint for a OneRecordingPilotProjection (CardioLab G50 / G53).
 * Builds one typed non-circular dependency object from the complete ordered source set and actual versions;
 * profile/episode/session/result/ledger; exclusions, durations, coverage, segments, gaps, pairs;
 * all public metric values/units/eligibility/reasons; policy/method/schema/export/template/privacy versions;
 * and exact context provenance. Excludes workflow stage, time, paths, random IDs, artifact IDs, and confirmation.
 */
export function buildPilotDependencyTuple(proj: Omit<OneRecordingPilotProjection, 'dependency_fingerprint'> | OneRecordingPilotProjection): PilotAuthoritativeDependencyTuple {
  const sortedMetrics: Record<string, any> = {};
  if (proj.metrics) {
    const sortedKeys = Object.keys(proj.metrics).sort();
    for (const k of sortedKeys) {
      const m = proj.metrics[k];
      sortedMetrics[k] = {
        metric_key: m.metric_key,
        value: m.value,
        unit: m.unit,
        is_eligible: m.is_eligible,
        eligibility_state: m.eligibility_state,
        withholding_reason: m.withholding_reason,
        limitation_note: m.limitation_note || null
      };
    }
  }

  const envelopeVer = proj.admission?.envelope_version || (proj as any).versions?.envelope_version || '1.0.0';

  let orderedMembers: any[] = [];
  let compositeSourceSha256 = proj.source_summary?.source_sha256 || null;

  if (proj.source_summary) {
    if ((proj.source_summary as any).member_items && Array.isArray((proj.source_summary as any).member_items)) {
      orderedMembers = (proj.source_summary as any).member_items.map((m: any, idx: number) => ({
        ordinal: typeof m.ordinal === 'number' ? m.ordinal : idx,
        role: m.role || 'data',
        size_bytes: m.size_bytes || 0,
        sha256: m.sha256 || '',
        name: m.name || ''
      })).sort((a: any, b: any) => a.ordinal - b.ordinal);

      if (orderedMembers.length > 0) {
        compositeSourceSha256 = calculateDeterministicSha256(
          orderedMembers.map(m => `${m.ordinal}:${m.role}:${m.size_bytes}:${m.sha256}`).join('|')
        );
      }
    } else {
      orderedMembers = [...proj.source_summary.members];
    }
  }

  return {
    schema_version: proj.schema_version,
    mode: proj.mode,
    episode_id: proj.episode_id ?? null,
    profile_id: proj.profile_id,
    session_id: proj.session_id,
    canonical_result_hash: proj.canonical_result_hash,
    beat_ledger_hash: proj.beat_ledger_hash,
    currentness: proj.currentness,
    policy_versions: {
      schema: ONE_RECORDING_PILOT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      compiler: (proj as any).versions?.compiler_version || '1.0.0',
      quality: (proj as any).versions?.quality_version || '1.0.0',
      metrics: (proj as any).versions?.metrics_version || '1.0.0',
      parser: (proj.admission as any)?.parser_version || (proj as any).versions?.parser_version || '1.3.0',
      envelope: envelopeVer,
      grouping: (proj as any).versions?.grouping_version || '1.0.0',
      export_preset: (proj as any).versions?.export_preset_version || '1.0.0',
      template: (proj as any).versions?.template_version || '1.0.0',
      privacy: (proj as any).versions?.privacy_version || '1.0.0'
    },
    admission: proj.admission ? {
      status: proj.admission.status,
      format_family: proj.admission.format_family,
      envelope_version: proj.admission.envelope_version,
      source_fingerprints: proj.admission.source_fingerprints || []
    } : null,
    source_summary: proj.source_summary ? {
      member_count: proj.source_summary.member_count,
      members: orderedMembers,
      source_sha256: compositeSourceSha256
    } : null,
    context: {
      type: proj.context.type,
      window_id: proj.context.window_id,
      window_revision: proj.context.window_revision,
      window_result_identity: proj.context.window_result_identity,
      parent_session_id: proj.session_id,
      parent_result_hash: proj.canonical_result_hash,
      parent_ledger_hash: proj.beat_ledger_hash,
      method_name: (proj.context as any).method_name || (proj.context.type === 'named_window' ? 'named_window_descriptive_v1' : 'whole_recording_descriptive_v1'),
      method_version: (proj.context as any).method_version || '1.0.0',
      protocol_authority: (proj.context as any).protocol_authority || 'Frozen Protocol v1.1',
      pair_count: (proj.context as any).pair_count ?? proj.quality?.valid_pair_count ?? null
    },
    quality: proj.quality ? {
      decision: proj.quality.decision,
      total_rr_count: proj.quality.total_rr_count,
      accepted_nn_count: proj.quality.accepted_nn_count,
      excluded_count: proj.quality.excluded_count,
      exclusion_reasons: proj.quality.exclusion_reasons || {},
      duration_seconds: proj.quality.duration_seconds,
      accepted_duration_seconds: proj.quality.accepted_duration_seconds,
      continuity_status: proj.quality.continuity_status,
      coverage_ratio: proj.quality.coverage_ratio,
      largest_gap_seconds: proj.quality.largest_gap_seconds,
      valid_pair_count: proj.quality.valid_pair_count ?? null
    } : null,
    export_dependency: {
      format: 'html',
      preset: 'one_recording_pilot'
    },
    metrics: sortedMetrics,
    baseline_required: false,
    ai_required: false
  };
}

export function computePilotDependencyFingerprint(proj: Omit<OneRecordingPilotProjection, 'dependency_fingerprint'> | OneRecordingPilotProjection): string {
  const tuple = buildPilotDependencyTuple(proj);
  const canonical = sortKeysRecursively(tuple);
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(canonical));
}

/**
 * Validates OneRecordingPilotProjection for path safety, baseline/AI non-dependency, and field integrity.
 */
export function validateOneRecordingPilotProjection(raw: unknown): OneRecordingPilotProjection {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError('Projection must be a non-null object');
  }

  const p = raw as Record<string, any>;
  if (p.schema_version !== ONE_RECORDING_PILOT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError(`Invalid schema version: expected ${ONE_RECORDING_PILOT_SCHEMA_VERSION}, got ${p.schema_version}`);
  }
  if (p.mode !== 'one_recording_pilot') {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError(`Invalid mode: expected 'one_recording_pilot', got ${p.mode}`);
  }
  if (p.baseline_required !== false) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError('Strict requirement violation: baseline_required MUST be false');
  }
  if (p.ai_required !== false) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError('Strict requirement violation: ai_required MUST be false');
  }

  if (p.context?.type === 'named_window' && !p.context?.window_id) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError('Named window context requires a valid window_id', 'WINDOW_REQUIRED');
  }

  // Path leakage check
  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(p);
  if (/([A-Za-z]:\\|\/Users\/|\/home\/)/i.test(jsonStr)) {
    throw new PilotContractValidationError('Security violation: Local filesystem path detected in pilot projection', 'PATH_LEAKAGE');
  }

  return p as OneRecordingPilotProjection;
}
