export function canonicalSerializeIssuanceRequest(
  req: Omit<PilotInviteIssuanceRequest, 'request_hash' | 'status'>
): string {
  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    bounded_note: req.bounded_note || null,
    campaign_id: req.campaign_id,
    campaign_revision: req.campaign_revision,
    cohort_id: req.cohort_id,
    consent_policy_version: req.consent_policy_version,
    created_at_utc: req.created_at_utc,
    environment: req.environment,
    expires_at_utc: req.expires_at_utc,
    max_invites: req.max_invites,
    max_uses_per_invite: req.max_uses_per_invite,
    nonce: req.nonce,
    not_before_utc: req.not_before_utc,
    participant_class_policy: req.participant_class_policy,
    project_id: req.project_id,
    pseudonymous_workspace_digest: req.pseudonymous_workspace_digest,
    request_id: req.request_id,
    revocation_epoch: req.revocation_epoch,
    schema_version: req.schema_version,
    trust_bundle_id: req.trust_bundle_id
  });
}

export function computeIssuanceRequestHash(
  req: Omit<PilotInviteIssuanceRequest, 'request_hash' | 'status'> | PilotInviteIssuanceRequest
): string {
  const canonical = canonicalSerializeIssuanceRequest(req);
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.from(canonical, 'utf8')).digest('hex');
}

export function canonicalSerializeBatchResponse(
  resp: Omit<PilotInviteBatchResponse, 'signature' | 'batch_hash'>
): string {
  const sortedEnvelopes = [...(resp.envelopes || [])].sort((a, b) =>
    a.envelope_id.localeCompare(b.envelope_id)
  );

  return canonicalJsonStringify({
    batch_id: resp.batch_id,
    campaign_id: resp.campaign_id,
    campaign_revision: resp.campaign_revision,
    envelopes: sortedEnvelopes.map((e) => ({
      cohort_id: e.cohort_id,
      consent_policy_version: e.consent_policy_version,
      envelope_id: e.envelope_id,
      environment: e.environment,
      expires_at_utc: e.expires_at_utc,
      issuer_id: e.issuer_id,
      key_id: e.key_id,
      max_uses: e.max_uses,
      nonce: e.nonce,
      not_before_utc: e.not_before_utc,
      participant_class_policy: e.participant_class_policy,
      revocation_epoch: e.revocation_epoch,
      schema_version: e.schema_version,
      signature: e.signature,
      trust_bundle_id: e.trust_bundle_id
    })),
    envelopes_count: resp.envelopes_count,
    issued_at_utc: resp.issued_at_utc,
    issuer_id: resp.issuer_id,
    key_id: resp.key_id,
    request_hash: resp.request_hash,
    request_id: resp.request_id,
    schema_version: resp.schema_version,
    trust_bundle_id: resp.trust_bundle_id
  });
}

export function computeBatchResponseHash(
  resp: Omit<PilotInviteBatchResponse, 'signature' | 'batch_hash'> | PilotInviteBatchResponse
): string {
  const canonical = canonicalSerializeBatchResponse(resp);
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.from(canonical, 'utf8')).digest('hex');

export function canonicalSerializeDeliveryManifest(

/**
 * Validates that an exported object strictly contains zero privacy leaks:
 * no private keys, signing seeds, MAC addresses, home directory paths, athlete names, or physiological series.
 */
export function validatePilotPrivacySanitization(obj: any): { is_clean: boolean; violations: string[] } {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const text = JSON.stringify(obj);

  // Private key / signature seeds
  if (/-----BEGIN (PRIVATE|EC PRIVATE|OPENSSH PRIVATE) KEY-----/.test(text) || text.includes('PRIVATE KEY')) {
    violations.push('Contains private key signature material');
  }
  if (/signing_seed/i.test(text) || /operator_secret/i.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains signing secret pattern');
  }

  // MAC addresses
  if (/(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}[:-]){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}/.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains MAC address pattern');
  }

  // Filesystem local user paths
  if (/[a-zA-Z]:\\[Uu]sers\\[^\\]+/.test(text) || /\/home\/[^\/]+/.test(text) || /\/Users\/[^\/]+/.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains local user filesystem path');
  }

  // Personal / athlete identifiers
  if (/athlete_name/i.test(text) || /patient_name/i.test(text) || /device_serial/i.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains personal or hardware identifier pattern');
  }

  // Raw physiological series
  if (/rr_intervals?/i.test(text) || /ecg_samples?/i.test(text) || /acc_samples?/i.test(text)) {
    violations.push('Contains raw physiological series pattern');
  }

  return {
    is_clean: violations.length === 0,
    violations
  };
}

/**
 * Derives safe next action for a pilot campaign based on state and inventory.
 */
export function deriveCampaignSafeNextAction(
  state: CampaignState,
  counts: {
    total_requests: number;
    total_batches: number;
    total_invites_minted: number;
    active_invites: number;
    enrolled_participants: number;
  }
): {
  action_code: string;
  label: string;
  label_ru: string;
  description: string;
  description_ru: string;
} {
  switch (state) {
    case 'draft':
      return {
        action_code: 'CREATE_ISSUANCE_REQUEST',
        label: 'Create Issuance Request',
        label_ru: 'Создать запрос на выпуск приглашений',
        description: 'Lock campaign parameters and generate an offline invite issuance request for external signing.',
        description_ru: 'Зафиксировать параметры кампании и создать офлайн-запрос на подписание приглашений.'
      };
    case 'ready_for_signing':
      return {
        action_code: 'IMPORT_SIGNED_BATCH',
        label: 'Import Signed Batch',
        label_ru: 'Импортировать подписанный пакет',
        description: 'Open and preflight the externally signed invite batch file via trusted dialog.',
        description_ru: 'Открыть и проверить подписанный пакет приглашений через доверенный диалог.'
      };
    case 'active':
      if (counts.total_invites_minted > 0 && counts.enrolled_participants === 0) {
        return {
          action_code: 'EXPORT_DELIVERY_ARTIFACT',
          label: 'Export Delivery Artifact',
          label_ru: 'Экспортировать пакет доставки',
          description: 'Export sensitive delivery artifact for participant onboarding or execute operator rehearsal.',
          description_ru: 'Экспортировать пакет доставки для передачи участникам или провести репетицию оператора.'
        };
      }
      return {
        action_code: 'MONITOR_ENROLLMENT',
        label: 'Monitor Cohort Enrollment',
        label_ru: 'Мониторинг зачисления когорты',
        description: 'Track participant enrollment, consent compliance, and rehearsal outcomes.',
        description_ru: 'Отслеживать регистрацию участников, согласие и результаты репетиций.'
      };
    case 'paused':
      return {
        action_code: 'RESUME_OR_CLOSE',
        label: 'Resume or Close Campaign',
        label_ru: 'Возобновить или закрыть кампанию',
        description: 'New participant enrollments are temporarily blocked. Resume when ready or close permanently.',
        description_ru: 'Регистрация новых участников приостановлена. Возобновите или закройте кампанию.'
      };
    case 'closed':
    case 'archived':
      return {
        action_code: 'INSPECT_READINESS_REPORT',
        label: 'Inspect Cohort Report',
        label_ru: 'Просмотреть отчет по когорте',
        description: 'Campaign is finalized. Inspect truthful zero-external cohort evidence report.',
        description_ru: 'Кампания завершена. Просмотреть достоверный отчет доказательств готовности когорты.'
      };
  }
}

FILE: src/shared/canonical/PolarSensorLoggerEnvelope.ts

/**
 * src/shared/canonical/PolarSensorLoggerEnvelope.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G39 — Supported Polar H10 / Polar Sensor Logger (PSL) Envelope Contract.
 * Defines versioned admission rules, required/optional members, format detection,
 * candidate session grouping, and privacy-safe preflight evaluation without path leakage.
 */

import { parseRawTimestamp } from './TemporalContract';

export const POLAR_SENSOR_LOGGER_ENVELOPE_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type EnvelopeAdmissionStatus = 'supported' | 'supported_with_limits' | 'rejected';

export type EnvelopeSignalType = 'RR' | 'ECG' | 'ACC' | 'HR' | 'METADATA' | 'UNKNOWN';

export interface RecognizedEnvelopeMember {
  member_name: string;
  display_path: string;
  signal_type: EnvelopeSignalType;
  schema_variant: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  sha256: string;
  row_count: number;
  is_required: boolean;
  status: 'valid' | 'corrupt' | 'unsupported' | 'optional';
  issues: string[];
}

export interface CandidateSessionEnvelope {
  start_time_utc: string | null;
  end_time_utc: string | null;
  duration_seconds: number | null;
  sample_count: number;
  is_monotonic: boolean;
}

export interface EnvelopeIssue {
  code: string;
  severity: 'warning' | 'error';
  message_ru: string;
  message_en: string;
}

export interface PolarSensorLoggerEnvelopeEvaluation {
  schema_version: string;
  envelope_version: string;
  status: EnvelopeAdmissionStatus;
  format_family: 'polar_sensor_logger_h10' | 'unsupported_generic_csv' | 'unknown';
  recognized_members: RecognizedEnvelopeMember[];
  missing_required_members: string[];
  candidate_session: CandidateSessionEnvelope | null;
  blocking_reasons: EnvelopeIssue[];
  warnings: EnvelopeIssue[];
  next_safe_action: string;
  source_fingerprints: Array<{ member_name: string; sha256: string; size_bytes: number }>;
}

export interface EnvelopeInputFile {
  name: string;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  sha256?: string;
  content?: string;
}

/**
 * Strips local absolute filesystem paths to prevent path leakage in summaries and evidence.
 */
export function sanitizePath(inputPath: string): string {
  if (!inputPath) return '';
  // Remove Windows drive letters or unix root prefixes, keep only basename
  const normalized = inputPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const parts = normalized.split('/');
  return parts[parts.length - 1] || 'unnamed_file';
}

/**
 * Assesses whether a CSV line matches Polar Sensor Logger RR format (2-col or 5-col).
 */
export function detectRRSchema(headerOrFirstLine: string): 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col' | 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col' | 'unknown' {
  const lower = headerOrFirstLine.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('isvalid') || lower.includes('is_valid') || lower.includes('sensor timestamp [ns]') || lower.includes('sensor_timestamp_ns')) {
    return 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col';
  }
  const parts = headerOrFirstLine.split(/[;,]/);
  if (parts.length >= 5) {
    return 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col';
  }
  if (parts.length === 2) {
    return 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col';
  }
  return 'unknown';
}

/**
 * Evaluates an envelope of input files against the supported Polar H10 / PSL specification.
 */
export function evaluatePolarSensorLoggerEnvelope(files: EnvelopeInputFile[]): PolarSensorLoggerEnvelopeEvaluation {
  const blockingReasons: EnvelopeIssue[] = [];
  const warnings: EnvelopeIssue[] = [];
  const recognizedMembers: RecognizedEnvelopeMember[] = [];
  const sourceFingerprints: Array<{ member_name: string; sha256: string; size_bytes: number }> = [];

  if (!files || files.length === 0) {
    return {
      schema_version: '1.0.0',
      envelope_version: POLAR_SENSOR_LOGGER_ENVELOPE_VERSION,
      status: 'rejected',
      format_family: 'unknown',
      recognized_members: [],
      missing_required_members: ['RR'],
      candidate_session: null,
      blocking_reasons: [{
        code: 'NO_SOURCE_FILES',
        severity: 'error',
        message_ru: 'Файлы источника не предоставлены',
        message_en: 'No source files provided'
      }],
      warnings: [],
      next_safe_action: 'select_supported_h10_recording',
      source_fingerprints: []
    };
  }

  let rrMember: RecognizedEnvelopeMember | null = null;
  let candidateStartMs: number | null = null;
  let candidateEndMs: number | null = null;
  let candidateSampleCount = 0;
  let isMonotonicOverall = true;

  for (const f of files) {
    const cleanName = sanitizePath(f.name);
    const size = f.sizeBytes ?? (f.content ? Buffer.byteLength(f.content, 'utf8') : 0);
    const sha = f.sha256 || '0'.repeat(64);

    sourceFingerprints.push({
      member_name: cleanName,
      sha256: sha,
      size_bytes: size
    });

    if (size === 0) {
      blockingReasons.push({
        code: 'FILE_EMPTY',
        severity: 'error',
        message_ru: `Файл '${cleanName}' пуст (0 байт)`,
        message_en: `File '${cleanName}' is empty (0 bytes)`
      });
      recognizedMembers.push({
        member_name: cleanName,
        display_path: cleanName,
        signal_type: 'UNKNOWN',
        schema_variant: 'empty',
        size_bytes: 0,
        sha256: sha,
        row_count: 0,
        is_required: false,
        status: 'corrupt',
        issues: ['EMPTY_FILE']
      });
      continue;
    }

    const lines = f.content ? f.content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0) : [];
    const headerLine = lines[0] || cleanName;

    // Detect signal type
    let signalType: EnvelopeSignalType = 'UNKNOWN';
    let schemaVariant = 'unknown';
    const lowerName = cleanName.toLowerCase();

    if (lowerName.includes('psl') || lowerName.includes('rr') || headerLine.toLowerCase().includes('rr')) {
      signalType = 'RR';
      schemaVariant = detectRRSchema(headerLine);
    } else if (lowerName.includes('ecg') || headerLine.toLowerCase().includes('ecg')) {
      signalType = 'ECG';
      schemaVariant = 'polar_sensor_logger_ecg_4col';
    } else if (lowerName.includes('acc') || headerLine.toLowerCase().includes('acc') || headerLine.includes('X [mg]')) {
      signalType = 'ACC';
      schemaVariant = 'polar_sensor_logger_acc_5col';
    } else if (lowerName.includes('hr') || headerLine.toLowerCase().includes('bpm')) {
      signalType = 'HR';
      schemaVariant = 'polar_sensor_logger_hr';
    }

    if (signalType === 'UNKNOWN') {
      warnings.push({
        code: 'UNRECOGNIZED_MEMBER',
        severity: 'warning',
        message_ru: `Файл '${cleanName}' не распознан как канонический сигнал H10/PSL`,
        message_en: `File '${cleanName}' not recognized as canonical H10/PSL signal`
      });
      recognizedMembers.push({
        member_name: cleanName,
        display_path: cleanName,
        signal_type: 'UNKNOWN',
        schema_variant: 'unknown',
        size_bytes: size,
        sha256: sha,
        row_count: lines.length,
        is_required: false,
        status: 'unsupported',
        issues: ['UNRECOGNIZED_FORMAT']
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Inspect timestamps if content is provided
    let memberMonotonic = true;
    let memberStartMs: number | null = null;
    let memberEndMs: number | null = null;
    let memberValidRows = 0;

    if (lines.length > 1) {
      let lastTs = -Infinity;
      for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const line = lines[i];
        const parts = line.split(/[;,]/).map(s => s.trim());
        if (parts.length < 2) continue;

        const tsStr = parts[0];
        try {
          const parsed = parseRawTimestamp(tsStr);
          if (parsed.timebase_semantics !== 'unknown') {
            const ms = new Date(parsed.canonical_utc_instant).getTime();
            // Calendar sanity check (2015-2035)
            if (ms >= 1420070400000 && ms <= 2051155200000) {
              if (memberStartMs === null) memberStartMs = ms;
              memberEndMs = ms;
              if (ms < lastTs) {
                memberMonotonic = false;
              }
              lastTs = ms;
              memberValidRows++;
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore row timestamp error
        }
      }
    }

    if (!memberMonotonic) {
      isMonotonicOverall = false;
      blockingReasons.push({
        code: 'NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS',
        severity: 'error',
        message_ru: `Временные метки в файле '${cleanName}' нарушают строгую монотонность`,
        message_en: `Timestamps in '${cleanName}' violate strict monotonicity`
      });
    }

    const member: RecognizedEnvelopeMember = {
      member_name: cleanName,
      display_path: cleanName,
      signal_type: signalType,
      schema_variant: schemaVariant,
      size_bytes: size,
      sha256: sha,
      row_count: lines.length > 0 ? lines.length - 1 : 0,
      is_required: signalType === 'RR',
      status: memberMonotonic ? (signalType === 'RR' ? 'valid' : 'optional') : 'corrupt',
      issues: memberMonotonic ? [] : ['NON_MONOTONIC']
    };

    recognizedMembers.push(member);

    if (signalType === 'RR' && !rrMember) {
      rrMember = member;
      candidateStartMs = memberStartMs;
      candidateEndMs = memberEndMs;
      candidateSampleCount = memberValidRows;
    }
  }

  // Envelope Admission Checks
  const missingRequiredMembers: string[] = [];
  if (!rrMember) {
    missingRequiredMembers.push('RR');
    blockingReasons.push({
      code: 'MISSING_REQUIRED_RR_SIGNAL',
      severity: 'error',
      message_ru: 'Отсутствует обязательный сигнал ритмограммы (RR/PSL)',
      message_en: 'Missing required RR/PSL rhythmogram member'
    });
  }

  let candidateSession: CandidateSessionEnvelope | null = null;
  if (candidateStartMs !== null && candidateEndMs !== null) {
    const durationSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.round((candidateEndMs - candidateStartMs) / 1000));
    candidateSession = {
      start_time_utc: new Date(candidateStartMs).toISOString(),
      end_time_utc: new Date(candidateEndMs).toISOString(),
      duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
      sample_count: candidateSampleCount,
      is_monotonic: isMonotonicOverall
    };

    if (durationSeconds < 60) {
      warnings.push({
        code: 'SHORT_DURATION',
        severity: 'warning',
        message_ru: `Длительность записи (${durationSeconds}с) меньше рекомендуемой (>=60с)`,
        message_en: `Recording duration (${durationSeconds}s) is shorter than recommended (>=60s)`
      });
    }
  }

  let status: EnvelopeAdmissionStatus = 'supported';
  if (blockingReasons.length > 0) {
    status = 'rejected';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0 || !recognizedMembers.some(m => m.signal_type === 'ECG')) {
    status = 'supported_with_limits';
  }

  const formatFamily = recognizedMembers.some(m => m.signal_type === 'RR')
    ? 'polar_sensor_logger_h10'
    : 'unsupported_generic_csv';

  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    envelope_version: POLAR_SENSOR_LOGGER_ENVELOPE_VERSION,
    status,
    format_family: formatFamily,
    recognized_members: recognizedMembers,
    missing_required_members: missingRequiredMembers,
    candidate_session: candidateSession,
    blocking_reasons: blockingReasons,
    warnings: warnings,
    next_safe_action: status === 'supported' || status === 'supported_with_limits' ? 'proceed_to_preflight_import' : 'select_supported_h10_recording',
    source_fingerprints: sourceFingerprints
  };
}

/**
 * ReferenceReviewContract.ts
 *
 * Canonical schema and type definitions for Empirical Quality Review,
 * Independent Reference Annotation, Blinded Dual Review, Conflict Adjudication,
 * and Frozen Consensus Ground Truth.
 *
 * Conforms to:
 * - H10 Validation Protocol v1.1 (Normative & Frozen, non-diagnostic)
 * - Work Item wi-5523960836a84f9c944c0120dbb94936
 * - Action Packet QRA-01 through QRA-09
 * - DISTRIBUTION_DEFERRED = true
 * - Local-first, file-first, privacy-preserving boundaries
 */

export const REFERENCE_REVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

/**
 * Subject types that undergo independent empirical review and annotation.
 */
export type ReviewSubjectType =
  | 'paired_ecg_beat'
  | 'rr_exclusion_interval'
  | 'signal_quality_interval'
  | 'synchronization_anchor'
  | 'workload_steady_state_window';

/**
 * Pseudonymous role identifiers for reviewer separation.
 * Direct personal identities remain strictly excluded from canonical evidence.
 */
export type ReviewerRole = 'reviewer_a' | 'reviewer_b' | 'adjudicator';

/**
 * Lifecycle states of an empirical review assignment:
 * draft -> assigned -> in_review -> submitted -> conflict_detected / adjudication_required -> adjudicated -> frozen (or rejected / superseded)
 */
export type ReviewLifecycleState =
  | 'draft'
  | 'assigned'
  | 'in_review'
  | 'submitted'
  | 'conflict_detected'
  | 'adjudication_required'
  | 'adjudicated'
  | 'frozen'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'superseded';

/**
 * Origin and provenance of an individual annotation item.
 * Algorithm suggestions cannot become independent human ground truth automatically.
 */
export type AnnotationProvenanceType =
  | 'human_entered'
  | 'imported_benchmark'
  | 'synthetic_fixture'
  | 'algorithm_suggestion';

/**
 * Confidence level assigned by a reviewer or adjudicator.
 */
export type AnnotationConfidence = 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'uncertain';

/**
 * Single annotation item within a review set (e.g. detected R-peak, noise segment).
 */
export interface ReferenceAnnotationItem {
  item_id: string;
  subject_type: ReviewSubjectType;
  channel: string;
  timestamp_start_ms: number;
  timestamp_end_ms?: number;
  sample_index_start?: number;
  sample_index_end?: number;
  label: string;
  confidence: AnnotationConfidence;
  reason_code?: string;
  notes?: string;
  provenance: AnnotationProvenanceType;
  created_at_utc: string;
}

/**
 * An annotation set submitted by an individual pseudonymous reviewer.
 */
export interface ReferenceAnnotationSet {
  annotation_set_id: string;
  assignment_id: string;
  reviewer_role: ReviewerRole;
  reviewer_token: string;
  reviewer_pseudonym?: string;
  revision: number;
  lifecycle_state: 'draft' | 'submitted' | 'superseded';
  items_count: number;
  content_sha256: string;
  items: ReferenceAnnotationItem[];
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
  submitted_at_utc?: string;
}

/**
 * Review assignment connecting an eligible empirical dataset to two independent reviewers.
 */
export interface ReferenceReviewAssignment {
  assignment_id: string;
  dataset_id: string;
  subject_type: ReviewSubjectType;
  revision: number;
  lifecycle_state: ReviewLifecycleState;
  reviewer_a_token: string;
  reviewer_b_token: string;
  adjudicator_token: string;
  reviewer_a_pseudonym?: string;
  reviewer_b_pseudonym?: string;
  adjudicator_pseudonym?: string;
  consensus_eligibility?: ConsensusEligibilityStatus;
  blinding_mode: 'double_blind' | 'single_blind' | 'open_consensus';
  is_blinded: boolean;
  notes?: string;
  created_at_utc: string;
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

/**
 * Detected disagreement between reviewer_a and reviewer_b submissions.
 */
export interface ReviewConflictDetail {
  conflict_id: string;
  assignment_id: string;
  subject_type: ReviewSubjectType;
  item_a?: ReferenceAnnotationItem;
  item_b?: ReferenceAnnotationItem;
  disagreement_type:

/**

 * canonical data exchange, bundle verification, and cohort exports.

 */

export const RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type BundleValidationStatus = 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'unverified';

export interface BundleGeneratorInfo {
  name: string;

  timestamp_utc: string;
}

export interface SessionEvidenceMetadata {
  session_id: string;
  profile_id: string;
  session_name?: string;
  device_id?: string;
  firmware_version?: string;
  recorded_at_utc: string;
  duration_seconds: number;
  sample_rate_hz?: {
    ecg?: number;
    acc?: number;
    rr?: number;
  };
}

export interface BundleChannelInfo {
  available: string[];
  included: string[];
  raw_signal_opt_in: boolean;
  notes?: string;
}

export interface TaskEligibilityItem {
  eligible: boolean;
  state?: string;
  reasons?: string[];
}

export interface BundleTaskEligibility {
  orthostatic_test?: TaskEligibilityItem;
  hrv_short?: TaskEligibilityItem;
  hrv_long?: TaskEligibilityItem;
  prohibited_arrhythmia_screening?: TaskEligibilityItem; // non-diagnostic prohibited claim marker
  exercise_stress?: TaskEligibilityItem;
  [key: string]: TaskEligibilityItem | undefined;
}

export function mapTaskEligibility(
  records: Record<string, any> | undefined
): BundleTaskEligibility {
  const result: BundleTaskEligibility = {};
  if (!records) return result;
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(records)) {
    if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
      const isEligible = val.state === 'ELIGIBLE' || val.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' || val.eligible === true;
      const reasons = [
        ...(Array.isArray(val.blocking_reasons) ? val.blocking_reasons : []),
        ...(Array.isArray(val.warning_reasons) ? val.warning_reasons : []),
        ...(Array.isArray(val.reasons) ? val.reasons : [])
      ];
      result[key] = {
        eligible: isEligible,
        state: val.state || (isEligible ? 'ELIGIBLE' : 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'),
        reasons: reasons.length > 0 ? reasons : undefined
      };
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export interface BundleMemberEntry {
  path: string;
  byte_size: number;
  sha256: string;
  content_type: string;
  description: string;
}

  members: BundleMemberEntry[];
  bundle_hash: string;
  validation_status: BundleValidationStatus;
}

  valid: boolean;
  manifest_valid: boolean;
  members_valid: boolean;
  checksums_match: boolean;
  inspected_members: number;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  manifest?: ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest;
  cohort_manifest?: CohortResearchManifest;
}

/**
 * Validate that an unknown object conforms to ResearchEvidenceBundleManifest shape.
 */
export function validateResearchManifestShape(manifest: unknown): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!manifest || typeof manifest !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['Manifest must be a non-null object'] };
  }

  const m = manifest as Record<string, any>;
  if (m.schema_version !== '1.0.0') {
    errors.push(`Invalid or unsupported schema_version: expected '1.0.0', got '${m.schema_version}'`);
  }
  if (!['session_evidence', 'cohort_evidence'].includes(m.bundle_type)) {
    errors.push(`Invalid bundle_type: expected 'session_evidence' or 'cohort_evidence', got '${m.bundle_type}'`);
  }
  if (typeof m.bundle_id !== 'string' || !m.bundle_id.trim()) {
    errors.push('Missing or empty bundle_id');
  }
  if (typeof m.created_at_utc !== 'string' || !m.created_at_utc.endsWith('Z')) {
    errors.push('created_at_utc must be an ISO 8601 UTC string ending in Z');
  }
  if (!m.generator || typeof m.generator !== 'object' || typeof m.generator.name !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid generator object');
  }
  if (m.bundle_type === 'session_evidence') {
    if (!m.session || typeof m.session !== 'object') {
      errors.push('Missing session metadata in session_evidence bundle');
    } else {
      if (typeof m.session.session_id !== 'string' || !m.session.session_id) {
        errors.push('Missing session.session_id');
      }
      if (typeof m.session.profile_id !== 'string' || !m.session.profile_id) {
        errors.push('Missing session.profile_id');
      }
    }
    if (!m.channels || !Array.isArray(m.channels.available) || !Array.isArray(m.channels.included)) {
      errors.push('Missing or invalid channels specification');
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(m.members)) {
    errors.push('Manifest members must be an array');
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < m.members.length; i++) {
      const member = m.members[i];
      if (!member || typeof member !== 'object') {
        errors.push(`Member at index ${i} is not an object`);
        continue;
      }
      if (typeof member.path !== 'string' || !member.path.trim()) {
        errors.push(`Member at index ${i} has invalid path`);
      }
      if (typeof member.sha256 !== 'string' || member.sha256.length !== 64) {
        errors.push(`Member '${member.path || i}' has invalid sha256 (must be 64-character hex string)`);
      }
      if (typeof member.byte_size !== 'number' || member.byte_size < 0) {
        errors.push(`Member '${member.path || i}' has invalid byte_size`);
      }
    }
  }
  if (typeof m.bundle_hash !== 'string' || m.bundle_hash.length !== 64) {
    errors.push('bundle_hash must be a 64-character hex SHA-256 string');
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors,
  };
}

/**
 * Typed research API error envelope conforming to Section 4.3 of AGENT_TASK.
 */
export interface ResearchApiErrorEnvelope {
  success: false;
  error: string;
  status_code: 400 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 410 | 412 | 422 | 500;
  error_code:
    | 'INVALID_CONTRACT'
    | 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN'
    | 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'
    | 'OPTIMISTIC_CONFLICT'
    | 'CAPABILITY_EXPIRED'
    | 'STALE_DEPENDENCY'
    | 'UNSUPPORTED_OR_LIMITED'
    | 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
  correlation_id: string;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export function formatResearchApiError(
  errorCode: ResearchApiErrorEnvelope['error_code'] | string,
  message: string,
  correlationId?: string,
  details?: Record<string, unknown>
): ResearchApiErrorEnvelope & { code?: string } {
  let statusCode: ResearchApiErrorEnvelope['status_code'] = 400;
  let normalizedCode: ResearchApiErrorEnvelope['error_code'] = 'INVALID_CONTRACT';

  switch (errorCode) {
    case 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN':
    case 'UNAUTHORIZED':
      statusCode = 403;
      normalizedCode = 'ROLE_FORBIDDEN';
      break;
    case 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND':
    case 'NOT_FOUND':
      statusCode = 404;
      normalizedCode = 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND';
      break;
    case 'OPTIMISTIC_CONFLICT':
    case 'CONFLICT':
      statusCode = 409;
      normalizedCode = 'OPTIMISTIC_CONFLICT';
      break;
    case 'CAPABILITY_EXPIRED':
    case 'GONE':
      statusCode = 410;
      normalizedCode = 'CAPABILITY_EXPIRED';
      break;
    case 'STALE_DEPENDENCY':
    case 'FAIL_CLOSED_GATE':
      statusCode = 412;
      normalizedCode = 'STALE_DEPENDENCY';
      break;
    case 'UNSUPPORTED_OR_LIMITED':
      statusCode = 422;
      normalizedCode = 'UNSUPPORTED_OR_LIMITED';
      break;
    case 'INTERNAL_ERROR':
      statusCode = 500;
      normalizedCode = 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
      break;
    default:
      statusCode = 400;
      normalizedCode = 'INVALID_CONTRACT';
      break;
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    error: message,
    status_code: statusCode,
    error_code: normalizedCode,
    code: String(errorCode),
    correlation_id: correlationId || `corr_${Date.now()}`,
    details
  };
}

/**
 * Creates an initial server-derived ResearchWorkspaceContext.
 */
export function createInitialResearchWorkspaceContext(
  role: ResearchRole = 'researcher',
  actorPseudonym = 'RESEARCHER-LOCAL-DEV',
  capabilityToken = 'token-dev-researcher'
): ResearchWorkspaceContext {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const fingerprint = computeContextFingerprint(role, actorPseudonym, 'STUDY-H10-VAL-V1', 1);
  return {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    research_role: role,
    actor_pseudonym: actorPseudonym,
    capability_token: capabilityToken,
    current_study_id: 'STUDY-H10-VAL-V1',
    current_study_revision: 1,
    protocol_hash: 'proto_h10_v110_frozen_normative',
    current_capture_session_id: null,
    current_dataset_id: null,
    current_dataset_manifest_sha256: null,
    current_review_assignment_id: null,
    current_review_revision: null,
    current_consensus_reference_id: null,
    current_cohort_id: 'COHORT-H10-PRIMARY-V1',
    current_cohort_revision: 1,
    current_candidate_id: 'CANDIDATE-H10-VAL-V110-BASELINE',
    current_validation_run_id: null,
    current_claim_proposal_id: null,
    current_export_preview_id: null,
    currentness_state: 'current',
    blockers: [],
    limitations: [
      'Single-sensor Polar H10 chest strap acquisition',
      'Sports science and technical verification context only; strictly non-diagnostic',
      'Synthetic fixtures remain unqualified; real empirical qualification requires committed paired datasets'
    ],
    exact_next_action: 'Review study protocols or select local capability for preflight intake.',
    context_generation: 1,
    context_fingerprint: fingerprint,
    updated_at_utc: now
  };
}

/**
 * Validates a ResearchWorkspaceContext structure at runtime.
 */
export function validateResearchWorkspaceContext(ctx: unknown): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!ctx || typeof ctx !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['Context is null or not an object'] };
  }
  const c = ctx as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (c.schema_version !== '1.0.0') errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: ${c.schema_version}`);
  const validRoles = ['researcher', 'reviewer_a', 'reviewer_b', 'adjudicator', 'auditor'];
  if (!validRoles.includes(c.research_role as string)) errors.push(`Invalid research_role: ${c.research_role}`);
  if (!c.actor_pseudonym || typeof c.actor_pseudonym !== 'string') errors.push('Missing actor_pseudonym');
  if (!c.capability_token || typeof c.capability_token !== 'string') errors.push('Missing capability_token');
  const validStates = ['current', 'stale', 'historical', 'source_unavailable', 'legacy_unknown'];
  if (!validStates.includes(c.currentness_state as string)) errors.push(`Invalid currentness_state: ${c.currentness_state}`);
  if (!Number.isInteger(c.context_generation) || (c.context_generation as number) < 1) {
    errors.push(`Invalid context_generation: ${c.context_generation}`);
  }
  if (!c.context_fingerprint || typeof c.context_fingerprint !== 'string') errors.push('Missing context_fingerprint');

  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

/**
 * Transitions context monotonically with generation increment and fingerprint recomputation.
 */
export function transitionResearchWorkspaceContext(
  prev: ResearchWorkspaceContext,
  updates: Partial<ResearchWorkspaceContext>
): ResearchWorkspaceContext {
  const nextGen = prev.context_generation + 1;
  const nextStudyId = updates.current_study_id !== undefined ? updates.current_study_id : prev.current_study_id;
  const nextRole = updates.research_role || prev.research_role;
  const nextPseudonym = updates.actor_pseudonym || prev.actor_pseudonym;
  const fingerprint = computeContextFingerprint(nextRole, nextPseudonym, nextStudyId, nextGen);

  return {
    ...prev,
    ...updates,
    context_generation: nextGen,
    context_fingerprint: fingerprint,
    updated_at_utc: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

/**
 * Sanitizes context for local persistence: strips capabilities and local tokens.
 */
export function sanitizeResearchContextForStorage(ctx: ResearchWorkspaceContext): string {
  const safe = {
    ...ctx,
    capability_token: 'REDACTED_LOCAL_STORAGE'
  };
  return JSON.stringify(safe);
}

/**
 * Parses safely restored context from storage.
 */
export function parseResearchContextFromStorage(raw: string | null): ResearchWorkspaceContext | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    const { valid } = validateResearchWorkspaceContext(parsed);
    if (!valid) return null;
    return parsed as ResearchWorkspaceContext;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function computeContextFingerprint(
  role: string,
  pseudonym: string,
  studyId: string | null,
  generation: number
): string {
  const data = `${role}:${pseudonym}:${studyId || 'none'}:${generation}`;
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + data.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return `fp_ctx_${Math.abs(hash).toString(16)}`;
}

/**
 * CardioLab G22 — Authoritative Session Library & Curation Workspace Contracts
 *
 * Versioned, runtime-validated contracts for:
 * - SessionLibraryQuery & query fingerprinting (Section 4.1)
 * - SessionLibraryRow & row truth (Section 4.2)
 * - SessionLibraryPage & pagination (Section 4.3)
 * - SessionLibraryCommand (discriminated mutation union) (Section 4.4)
 * - BulkMutationReceipt & per-item outcomes (Section 4.5)
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  DetectedSignalType,
  DetectedSchemaType
} from './SourceBundleManifest';

export const SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';
export const SESSION_LIBRARY_QUERY_POLICY_VERSION = '1.0.0';

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. SessionLibraryQuery (Section 4.1)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type ReviewPresetFilter =
  | 'all'
  | 'unassigned_profile'
  | 'missing_activity'
  | 'not_evaluated'
  | 'quality_limited'
  | 'source_unavailable'
  | 'relink_available'
  | 'duplicate_decision_needed'
  | 'compare_ready'
  | 'baseline_ready';

export type SessionLibrarySortKey =
  | 'start_time'
  | 'duration_seconds'
  | 'avg_hr'
  | 'rmssd'
  | 'sdnn'
  | 'overall_quality_score'
  | 'readiness';

export type SessionLibrarySortDir = 'asc' | 'desc';

export interface SessionLibraryQuery {
  schema_version: string;
  query_policy_version: string;
  profile_id?: string | 'all' | 'unassigned';
  search?: string;
  activity_type?: string;
  date_from?: string;
  date_to?: string;
  readiness?: 'all' | 'ready' | 'limited' | 'unavailable';
  baseline_eligible?: 'all' | 'true' | 'false';
  source_available?: 'all' | 'true' | 'false';
  signal_type?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  include_ignored?: boolean;
  include_duplicates?: boolean;
  review_preset?: ReviewPresetFilter;
  sort_by: SessionLibrarySortKey;
  sort_dir: SessionLibrarySortDir;
  limit: number;
  offset: number;
  cursor?: string;
}

export function computeQueryFingerprint(query: Partial<SessionLibraryQuery>): string {
  const normalized = {
    profile_id: query.profile_id || 'all',
    search: (query.search || '').trim().toLowerCase(),
    activity_type: query.activity_type || 'all',
    date_from: query.date_from || '',
    date_to: query.date_to || '',
    readiness: query.readiness || 'all',
    baseline_eligible: query.baseline_eligible || 'all',
    source_available: query.source_available || 'all',
    signal_type: (query.signal_type || 'all').toUpperCase(),
    tags: Array.isArray(query.tags) ? [...query.tags].sort() : [],
    include_ignored: Boolean(query.include_ignored),
    include_duplicates: Boolean(query.include_duplicates),
    review_preset: query.review_preset || 'all',
    sort_by: query.sort_by || 'start_time',
    sort_dir: query.sort_dir || 'desc',
    limit: query.limit ?? 25,
    offset: query.offset ?? 0
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(normalized)).digest('hex');
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. SessionLibraryRow (Section 4.2)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type CanonicalEvaluationStatus =
  | 'evaluated'
  | 'not_evaluated'
  | 'unavailable'
  | 'legacy_unverified';

export type CanonicalCurrentness = 'current' | 'stale' | 'not_applicable';

export type SourceLifecycleState =
  | 'persisted_available'
  | 'source_unavailable'
  | 'source_changed'
  | 'relink_available'
  | 'legacy_unverified';

export type SessionRowAction =
  | 'edit_profile'
  | 'edit_activity'
  | 'edit_tags'
  | 'ignore'
  | 'restore'
  | 'relink'
  | 'recalculate'
  | 'compare';

export interface LongitudinalMetricReadiness {
  ready: boolean;
  reason_ru?: string;
  reason_en?: string;
}

export interface SessionLibraryRow {
  session_id: string;
  device_id: string;
  start_time_utc: string;
  end_time_utc: string;
  duration_seconds: number;
  profile_id: string | null;
  profile_name: string;
  activity_type: string;
  user_notes: string | null;
  tags: string[];
  signal_classes: DetectedSignalType[];
  canonical_result_id: string | null;
  canonical_evaluation_status: CanonicalEvaluationStatus;
  canonical_currentness: CanonicalCurrentness;
  avg_hr: number | null;
  rmssd: number | null;
  sdnn: number | null;
  pnn50: number | null;
  metrics_quality: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'insufficient_data';
  quality_score: number;
  readiness: 'ready' | 'limited' | 'unavailable';
  readiness_reasons: string[];
  baseline_eligible: boolean;
  baseline_reasons: string[];
  compare_ready: boolean;
  compare_blockers: string[];
  per_metric_longitudinal_readiness: Record<string, LongitudinalMetricReadiness>;
  source_lifecycle_state: SourceLifecycleState;
  source_sha256?: string;
  is_duplicate: boolean;
  duplicate_representative_id: string;
  duplicate_count: number;
  is_ignored: boolean;
  ignored_at_utc?: string;
  ignore_reason?: string;
  excluded_from_future_sync?: boolean;
  row_revision: number;
  row_fingerprint: string;
  allowed_actions: SessionRowAction[];
}

export function computeRowFingerprint(row: {
  session_id: string;
  row_revision: number;
  profile_id: string | null;
  activity_type: string;
  tags: string[];
  is_ignored: boolean;
  is_duplicate: boolean;
  canonical_result_id: string | null;
}): string {
  const payload = [
    row.session_id,
    row.row_revision,
    row.profile_id || '',
    row.activity_type,
    [...row.tags].sort().join(','),
    row.is_ignored ? '1' : '0',
    row.is_duplicate ? '1' : '0',
    row.canonical_result_id || ''
  ].join('|');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
}

  review_queue_counts: Record<ReviewPresetFilter, number>;

export function validateSessionLibraryQueryStrict(query: any): SessionLibraryQuery {
  if (!query || typeof query !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryQuery: must be an object.');
  }
  const sortKeys: SessionLibrarySortKey[] = [
    'start_time',
    'duration_seconds',
    'avg_hr',
    'rmssd',
    'sdnn',
    'overall_quality_score',
    'readiness'
  ];
  const sortDirs: SessionLibrarySortDir[] = ['asc', 'desc'];
  const sortBy = sortKeys.includes(query.sort_by) ? query.sort_by : 'start_time';
  const sortDir = sortDirs.includes(query.sort_dir) ? query.sort_dir : 'desc';

  const limit = typeof query.limit === 'number' && query.limit > 0 ? Math.min(query.limit, 1000) : 25;
  const offset = typeof query.offset === 'number' && query.offset >= 0 ? query.offset : 0;

  return {
    schema_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    query_policy_version: SESSION_LIBRARY_QUERY_POLICY_VERSION,
    profile_id: query.profile_id,
    search: query.search ? String(query.search).trim() : undefined,
    activity_type: query.activity_type,
    date_from: query.date_from,
    date_to: query.date_to,
    readiness: query.readiness,
    baseline_eligible: query.baseline_eligible,
    source_available: query.source_available,
    signal_type: query.signal_type,
    tags: Array.isArray(query.tags) ? query.tags.map((t: any) => String(t).trim()).filter(Boolean) : undefined,
    include_ignored: Boolean(query.include_ignored),
    include_duplicates: Boolean(query.include_duplicates),
    review_preset: query.review_preset,
    sort_by: sortBy,
    sort_dir: sortDir,
    limit,
    offset,
    cursor: query.cursor ? String(query.cursor) : undefined
  };
}

export function validateSessionLibraryRowStrict(row: any): SessionLibraryRow {
  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryRow: must be an object.');
  }
  if (!row.session_id || typeof row.session_id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryRow: missing session_id.');
  }
  return {
    session_id: String(row.session_id),
    device_id: String(row.device_id || 'unknown'),
    start_time_utc: String(row.start_time_utc || ''),
    end_time_utc: String(row.end_time_utc || ''),
    duration_seconds: Number(row.duration_seconds || 0),
    profile_id: row.profile_id ? String(row.profile_id) : null,
    profile_name: String(row.profile_name || 'Без профиля'),
    activity_type: String(row.activity_type || 'unknown'),
    user_notes: row.user_notes ? String(row.user_notes) : null,
    tags: Array.isArray(row.tags) ? row.tags.map(String) : [],
    signal_classes: Array.isArray(row.signal_classes) ? row.signal_classes : [],
    canonical_result_id: row.canonical_result_id ? String(row.canonical_result_id) : null,
    canonical_evaluation_status: row.canonical_evaluation_status || 'not_evaluated',
    canonical_currentness: row.canonical_currentness || 'not_applicable',
    avg_hr: row.avg_hr !== null && row.avg_hr !== undefined ? Number(row.avg_hr) : null,
    rmssd: row.rmssd !== null && row.rmssd !== undefined ? Number(row.rmssd) : null,
    sdnn: row.sdnn !== null && row.sdnn !== undefined ? Number(row.sdnn) : null,
    pnn50: row.pnn50 !== null && row.pnn50 !== undefined ? Number(row.pnn50) : null,
    metrics_quality: row.metrics_quality || 'insufficient_data',
    quality_score: Number(row.quality_score || 0),
    readiness: row.readiness || 'unavailable',
    readiness_reasons: Array.isArray(row.readiness_reasons) ? row.readiness_reasons.map(String) : [],
    baseline_eligible: Boolean(row.baseline_eligible),
    baseline_reasons: Array.isArray(row.baseline_reasons) ? row.baseline_reasons.map(String) : [],
    compare_ready: Boolean(row.compare_ready),
    compare_blockers: Array.isArray(row.compare_blockers) ? row.compare_blockers.map(String) : [],
    per_metric_longitudinal_readiness: row.per_metric_longitudinal_readiness || {},
    source_lifecycle_state: row.source_lifecycle_state || 'persisted_available',
    source_sha256: row.source_sha256 ? String(row.source_sha256) : undefined,
    is_duplicate: Boolean(row.is_duplicate),
    duplicate_representative_id: String(row.duplicate_representative_id || row.session_id),
    duplicate_count: Number(row.duplicate_count || 1),
    is_ignored: Boolean(row.is_ignored),
    ignored_at_utc: row.ignored_at_utc ? String(row.ignored_at_utc) : undefined,
    ignore_reason: row.ignore_reason ? String(row.ignore_reason) : undefined,
    excluded_from_future_sync: Boolean(row.excluded_from_future_sync),
    row_revision: Number(row.row_revision || 1),
    row_fingerprint: String(row.row_fingerprint || ''),
    allowed_actions: Array.isArray(row.allowed_actions) ? row.allowed_actions : []
  };
}

export function validateSessionLibraryPageStrict(page: any): SessionLibraryPage {
  if (!page || typeof page !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryPage: must be an object.');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(page.rows)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryPage: rows must be an array.');
  }
  return {
    schema_version: String(page.schema_version || SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION),
    query_fingerprint: String(page.query_fingerprint || ''),
    normalized_query: validateSessionLibraryQueryStrict(page.normalized_query || {}),
    rows: page.rows.map(validateSessionLibraryRowStrict),
    total_count: Number(page.total_count || 0),
    page_index: Number(page.page_index || 1),
    page_size: Number(page.page_size || 25),
    total_pages: Number(page.total_pages || 1),
    has_next_page: Boolean(page.has_next_page),
    has_prev_page: Boolean(page.has_prev_page),
    cursor: page.cursor ? String(page.cursor) : undefined,
    library_revision: Number(page.library_revision || 1),
    timestamp_utc: String(page.timestamp_utc || new Date().toISOString()),
    review_queue_counts: page.review_queue_counts || {
      all: 0,
      unassigned_profile: 0,
      missing_activity: 0,
      not_evaluated: 0,
      quality_limited: 0,
      source_unavailable: 0,
      relink_available: 0,
      duplicate_decision_needed: 0,
      compare_ready: 0,
      baseline_ready: 0
    }
  };
}

export function validateSessionLibraryCommandStrict(cmd: any): SessionLibraryCommand {
  if (!cmd || typeof cmd !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryCommand: must be an object.');
  }
  if (!cmd.idempotency_key || typeof cmd.idempotency_key !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid SessionLibraryCommand: idempotency_key is required.');
  }
  const type = cmd.command_type;
  if (![
    'assign_profile',
    'assign_activity',
    'update_tags',
    'ignore_sessions',
    'restore_sessions',
    'set_duplicate_representative',
    'relink_source',
    'recompute_sessions'
  ].includes(type)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid SessionLibraryCommand: unknown command_type '${type}'.`);
  }
  return cmd as SessionLibraryCommand;
}

export function validateBulkMutationReceiptStrict(receipt: any): BulkMutationReceipt {
  if (!receipt || typeof receipt !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid BulkMutationReceipt: must be an object.');
  }
  if (!receipt.receipt_id || !receipt.idempotency_key || !receipt.status) {
    throw new Error('Invalid BulkMutationReceipt: missing required receipt fields.');
  }
  return {
    schema_version: String(receipt.schema_version || SESSION_LIBRARY_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION),
    receipt_id: String(receipt.receipt_id),
    command_type: String(receipt.command_type),
    idempotency_key: String(receipt.idempotency_key),
    status: receipt.status,
    total_targets: Number(receipt.total_targets || 0),
    succeeded_targets: Array.isArray(receipt.succeeded_targets) ? receipt.succeeded_targets.map(String) : [],
    failed_targets: Array.isArray(receipt.failed_targets) ? receipt.failed_targets : [],
    conflicted_targets: Array.isArray(receipt.conflicted_targets) ? receipt.conflicted_targets : [],
    skipped_targets: Array.isArray(receipt.skipped_targets) ? receipt.skipped_targets : [],
    before_revisions: receipt.before_revisions || {},
    after_revisions: receipt.after_revisions || {},
    dependency_invalidations: Array.isArray(receipt.dependency_invalidations) ? receipt.dependency_invalidations.map(String) : [],
    retry_token: receipt.retry_token ? String(receipt.retry_token) : undefined,
    timestamp_utc: String(receipt.timestamp_utc || new Date().toISOString())
  };
}

import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export type DetectedSignalType = 'RR' | 'ECG' | 'ACC' | 'HR' | 'UNKNOWN';
export type DetectedSchemaType = 
  | 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_2col'
  | 'polar_sensor_logger_rr_5col'
  | 'polar_sensor_logger_ecg'
  | 'polar_sensor_logger_acc'
  | 'polar_sensor_logger_hr'
  | 'unknown';

export type TimebaseSemantics = 'phone_local_iso' | 'sensor_monotonic_ns' | 'relative_session_ms' | 'unknown';
export type GroupingBasis = 
  | 'import_batch' 
  | 'filename_pattern' 
  | 'timestamp_proximity' 
  | 'directory_structure' 
  | 'explicit_user_selection' 
  | 'sessionizer_lineage' 
  | 'source_range_overlap'
  | 'source_time_alignment'
  | 'user_confirmed'
  | 'ambiguous'
  | 'single_file_fallback';
export type GroupingConfidence = 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | 'unknown';

export interface SourceFileEntry {
  file_id: string;
  file_name: string;
  relative_path?: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  sha256: string | null;
  status?: 'valid' | 'missing' | 'unreadable' | 'corrupt';
  detected_signal: DetectedSignalType;
  detected_schema: DetectedSchemaType;
  row_count: number;
  time_range: {
    start_time_utc?: string;
    end_time_utc?: string;
    duration_seconds?: number;
    raw_source_timestamp?: string;
    source_offset_minutes?: number | null;
    timezone_provenance?: string;
    ambiguity_status?: string;
  };
  timebase_semantics: TimebaseSemantics;
  warnings: string[];
}

export interface UserGroupingCorrection {
  action: 'file_added' | 'file_removed' | 'bundle_split' | 'bundle_merged' | 'move_file' | 'remove_file' | 'create_bundle' | string;
  timestamp_utc: string;
  file_name?: string;
  file_path?: string;
  from_bundle_id?: string;
  to_bundle_id?: string;
  reason?: string;
}

export const SOURCE_BUNDLE_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';
export const IMPORT_PARSER_VERSION = '1.2.0';

export interface SourceBundleManifest {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  bundle_id: string;
  created_at_utc: string;
  device_info: {
    model?: string;
    firmware?: string;
    serial?: string;
    recorder_app?: string;
  };
  grouping_basis: GroupingBasis;
  grouping_confidence: GroupingConfidence;
  grouping_evidence: string[];
  user_grouping_corrections: UserGroupingCorrection[];
  import_parser_version: string;
  source_files: SourceFileEntry[];
  immutable_source_identity: string;
  warnings: string[];
}

export function computeSourceBundleIdentity(manifest: Omit<SourceBundleManifest, 'immutable_source_identity'>): string {
  const canonicalObj = {
    schema_version: manifest.schema_version,
    bundle_id: manifest.bundle_id,
    grouping_basis: manifest.grouping_basis,
    source_files: manifest.source_files.map(f => ({
      file_name: f.file_name,
      size_bytes: f.size_bytes,
      sha256: f.sha256 || 'null',
      detected_signal: f.detected_signal,
      detected_schema: f.detected_schema
    }))
  };
  const json = JSON.stringify(canonicalObj);
  return 'SHA256:' + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(json).digest('hex');
}

export function createSourceBundleManifest(
  params: Omit<SourceBundleManifest, 'schema_version' | 'immutable_source_identity' | 'grouping_evidence'> & {
    grouping_evidence?: string[];
  }
): SourceBundleManifest {
  const base: Omit<SourceBundleManifest, 'immutable_source_identity'> = {
    schema_version: '1.0.0',
    grouping_evidence: params.grouping_evidence || [],
    ...params
  };
  const immutable_source_identity = computeSourceBundleIdentity(base);
  return {
    ...base,
    immutable_source_identity
  };
}

export function computeCandidateBundleIdentity(candidate: {
  device_id: string;
  members: Array<{ sha256: string; signal_class: string; detected_schema: string }>;
  grouping_revision?: number;
}): string {
  const sortedMembers = [...candidate.members].sort((a, b) => a.sha256.localeCompare(b.sha256));
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    device_id: candidate.device_id,
    members: sortedMembers.map(m => ({
      sha256: m.sha256,
      signal_class: m.signal_class,
      detected_schema: m.detected_schema
    })),
    grouping_revision: candidate.grouping_revision || 1
  });
  return 'SHA256:' + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
}

export function computeDurablePlanFingerprint(params: {
  profile_id: string;
  task_intent: string;
  bundles: Array<{ bundle_id: string; immutable_source_identity: string; revision: number; selected: boolean }>;
  parser_version: string;
  import_options?: Record<string, any>;
}): string {
  const sortedBundles = [...params.bundles].sort((a, b) => a.bundle_id.localeCompare(b.bundle_id));
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    profile_id: params.profile_id,
    task_intent: params.task_intent,
    bundles: sortedBundles,
    parser_version: params.parser_version,
    import_options: params.import_options || {}
  });
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex');
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. Strict Runtime Validators
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function validateSourceMemberInspectionStrict(member: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!member || typeof member !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['SourceMemberInspection is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (!member.member_id || typeof member.member_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing member_id');
  if (!member.name || typeof member.name !== 'string') errors.push('Missing name');
  if (typeof member.size_bytes !== 'number' || member.size_bytes < 0) errors.push('size_bytes must be non-negative number');
  if (!member.sha256 || typeof member.sha256 !== 'string' || member.sha256.length !== 64 || member.sha256 === '0'.repeat(64)) {
    errors.push('sha256 must be a valid 64-char hex string and cannot be a zero hash');
  }
  const validClasses = ['RR', 'ECG', 'ACC', 'HR', 'METADATA', 'UNKNOWN', 'MALFORMED'];
  if (!validClasses.includes(member.signal_class)) {
    errors.push(`Invalid signal_class: ${member.signal_class}`);
  }
  if (typeof member.parser_compatible !== 'boolean') errors.push('parser_compatible must be boolean');
  if (!Array.isArray(member.rejection_reasons)) errors.push('rejection_reasons must be an array');
  if (!Array.isArray(member.warnings)) errors.push('warnings must be an array');
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateSourceBundleCandidateStrict(candidate: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!candidate || typeof candidate !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['SourceBundleCandidate is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (candidate.schema_version !== SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}`);
  }
  if (!candidate.bundle_id || typeof candidate.bundle_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing bundle_id');
  if (!candidate.immutable_source_identity || !candidate.immutable_source_identity.startsWith('SHA256:')) {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid immutable_source_identity (must start with SHA256:)');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(candidate.members) || candidate.members.length === 0) {
    errors.push('members must be a non-empty array');
  } else {
    candidate.members.forEach((m: any, idx: number) => {
      const v = validateSourceMemberInspectionStrict(m);
      if (!v.valid) errors.push(`Member[${idx}] error: ${v.errors.join('; ')}`);
    });
  }
  const validStatuses = ['ready', 'ready_with_warnings', 'needs_user_choice', 'partial', 'duplicate', 'unsupported', 'blocked'];
  if (!validStatuses.includes(candidate.status)) {
    errors.push(`Invalid candidate status: ${candidate.status}`);
  }
  if (typeof candidate.grouping_revision !== 'number' || candidate.grouping_revision < 1) {
    errors.push('grouping_revision must be an integer >= 1');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateDurableImportJobSnapshotStrict(job: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!job || typeof job !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['DurableImportJobSnapshot is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (job.schema_version !== SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}`);
  }
  if (!job.job_id || typeof job.job_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing job_id');
  if (!job.profile_id || typeof job.profile_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing profile_id');
  if (!job.plan_id || typeof job.plan_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing plan_id');
  if (!job.request_fingerprint || typeof job.request_fingerprint !== 'string') errors.push('Missing request_fingerprint');
  if (typeof job.progress_percent !== 'number' || job.progress_percent < 0 || job.progress_percent > 100) {
    errors.push('progress_percent must be a number between 0 and 100');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(job.steps)) errors.push('steps must be an array');
  if (!Array.isArray(job.results)) errors.push('results must be an array');
  if (typeof job.cancel_requested !== 'boolean') errors.push('cancel_requested must be boolean');
  if (typeof job.cancel_acknowledged !== 'boolean') errors.push('cancel_acknowledged must be boolean');
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateSourceRelinkDecisionStrict(decision: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!decision || typeof decision !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['SourceRelinkDecision is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (decision.schema_version !== SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SOURCE_INTAKE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}`);
  }
  if (!decision.decision_id || typeof decision.decision_id !== 'string') errors.push('Missing decision_id');
  const validRelinkTypes = [
    'same_bytes_new_path',
    'same_filename_different_bytes',
    'copied_alias',
    'source_unavailable',
    'source_changed',
    'source_restored',
    'new_recording'
  ];
  if (!validRelinkTypes.includes(decision.relink_type)) {
    errors.push(`Invalid relink_type: ${decision.relink_type}`);
  }
  if (!decision.source_sha256 || decision.source_sha256.length !== 64) {
    errors.push('source_sha256 must be a 64-character SHA-256 hash');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(decision.affected_session_ids)) {
    errors.push('affected_session_ids must be an array');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export const FROZEN_PROTOCOL_VERSION = '1.1.0';

export type TaskEligibilityState = 
  | 'ELIGIBLE'
  | 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS'
  | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
  | 'INCONCLUSIVE'
  | 'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
  | 'IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_VALIDATED'
  | 'UNSUPPORTED_INPUT';

export interface TaskEligibilityPrerequisites {
  available_channels: string[];
  total_duration_seconds: number;
  accepted_beat_count: number;
  artifact_percentage: number;
  has_monotonic_timebase: boolean;
  accepted_coverage_seconds?: number;
  longest_contiguous_segment_seconds?: number;
  max_gap_seconds?: number;
  ecg_continuous_window_seconds?: number;
  ecg_sample_rate_hz?: number;
  ecg_timebase_monotonic?: boolean;
}

export interface TaskEligibilityResult {
  task_id: string;
  task_version: string;
  protocol_authority: string;
  required_channels: string[];
  required_duration_seconds: number;
  state: TaskEligibilityState;
  blocking_reasons: string[];
  warning_reasons: string[];
  limitations: string[];
  observed_prerequisites: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites;
}

/**
 * Evaluates individual metric eligibility for RMSSD under Frozen Protocol v1.1.
 * Standard requirement: >= 300 seconds (5 min) OR >= 300 accepted NN intervals.
 */
export function evaluateRmssdEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'RMSSD reflects short-term successive beat difference variance; valid during resting or steady-state conditions.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 1.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('RR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required RR interval channel');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence detected');
  }

  const meetsDuration = prereqs.total_duration_seconds >= 300;
  const meetsBeats = prereqs.accepted_beat_count >= 300;

  if (!meetsDuration && !meetsBeats) {
    blocking.push(`Insufficient recording length for RMSSD: duration ${Math.round(prereqs.total_duration_seconds)}s (< 300s) and accepted beats ${prereqs.accepted_beat_count} (< 300 beats).`);
  } else if (!meetsDuration && meetsBeats) {
    warnings.push(`Ultra-short duration (${Math.round(prereqs.total_duration_seconds)}s < 300s) satisfied via accepted beat count (${prereqs.accepted_beat_count} >= 300 beats).`);
  }

  if (prereqs.artifact_percentage > 5.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: elevated artifact rate (${prereqs.artifact_percentage}%).`);
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'rmssd_metric_eligibility',
    task_version: '1.1.0',

  };

/**
 * Evaluates individual metric eligibility for Mean HR / Mean RR.
 * Standard requirement: valid monotonic RR stream and >= 30 accepted intervals for representative mean.
 */
export function evaluateMeanHrRrEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Mean HR / RR represents the average rhythm across accepted clean NN intervals.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Targets 4-5.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('RR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required RR interval channel');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence detected');
  }

  if (prereqs.accepted_beat_count < 1) {
    blocking.push('Zero accepted clean NN intervals available');
  } else if (prereqs.accepted_beat_count < 30) {
    warnings.push(`Low interval count (${prereqs.accepted_beat_count} < 30): mean reflects very short sample.`);
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'mean_hr_rr_metric_eligibility',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['RR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 60,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates combined task eligibility for Core Time-Domain HRV (RMSSD, SDNN, pNN50, mean HR/RR).
 * Requires all core metrics to satisfy Frozen Protocol v1.1 standards (>= 300s / 5 min).
 * Fails closed if any constituent metric standard is not met.
 */
export function evaluateCoreTimeDomainEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const rmssdElig = evaluateRmssdEligibility(prereqs);
  const sdnnElig = evaluateSdnnEligibility(prereqs);
  const pnn50Elig = evaluatePnn50Eligibility(prereqs);

  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Time-domain HRV reflects interval timing variability and requires stationary resting or steady-state conditions for physiological validity.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Targets 1-5.',
    'Not for medical diagnosis or clinical arrhythmia detection.'
  ];

  if (sdnnElig.state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || pnn50Elig.state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    if (rmssdElig.state === 'ELIGIBLE' || rmssdElig.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
      blocking.push(`Duration insufficient for complete time-domain suite: SDNN and pNN50 require >= 300s (observed ${Math.round(prereqs.total_duration_seconds)}s), though RMSSD is individually valid with ${prereqs.accepted_beat_count} beats.`);
    } else {
      blocking.push(...rmssdElig.blocking_reasons);
      if (sdnnElig.blocking_reasons.length > 0 && !blocking.includes(sdnnElig.blocking_reasons[0])) {
        blocking.push(...sdnnElig.blocking_reasons);
      }
    }
  }

  if (prereqs.artifact_percentage > 5.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: elevated artifact/exclusion rate (${prereqs.artifact_percentage}%).`);
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0 || rmssdElig.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' || sdnnElig.state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'core_time_domain_hrv',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['RR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 300,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates task eligibility for Advanced Spectral / Frequency-Domain HRV (Welch PSD).
 * Standard requirement: valid monotonic RR stream with continuous >= 300s analytical coverage.
 */
export function evaluateFrequencyDomainEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Frequency-domain HRV (Welch FFT) requires >= 300s (5 minutes) of continuous resting recording according to Task Force (1996) guidelines.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Targets 11-13 (lf_power, hf_power, lf_hf_ratio).',
    'Not for medical diagnosis or clinical autonomic balance assessment.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('RR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required RR channel');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence detected');
  }

  const effectiveDuration = prereqs.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds !== undefined
    ? prereqs.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds
    : (prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds !== undefined
      ? prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds
      : prereqs.total_duration_seconds);

  if (effectiveDuration < 300 || prereqs.total_duration_seconds < 300) {
    blocking.push(`Duration insufficient for standard frequency domain: ${Math.round(effectiveDuration)}s (minimum continuous required: 300s / 5 min)`);
  }

  if (prereqs.max_gap_seconds !== undefined && prereqs.max_gap_seconds > 3.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: source timestamp gap of ${Math.round(prereqs.max_gap_seconds * 10) / 10}s detected in session.`);
  }

  if (prereqs.artifact_percentage > 5.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: elevated artifact rate (${prereqs.artifact_percentage}%) impacts spectral estimation.`);
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'frequency_domain_hrv_welch',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['RR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 300,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

export function evaluateLfPowerEligibility(prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const base = evaluateFrequencyDomainEligibility(prereqs);
  return {
    ...base,
    task_id: 'lf_power_metric_eligibility',
    limitations: [
      'LF power (0.04 - 0.15 Hz) reflects baroreflex-mediated interval rhythms under resting conditions.',
      'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 11.'
    ]
  };
}

export function evaluateHfPowerEligibility(prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const base = evaluateFrequencyDomainEligibility(prereqs);
  return {
    ...base,
    task_id: 'hf_power_metric_eligibility',
    limitations: [
      'HF power (0.15 - 0.40 Hz) reflects respiratory sinus variation (RSA) under resting conditions.',
      'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 12.'
    ]
  };
}

export function evaluateLfHfRatioEligibility(prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const base = evaluateFrequencyDomainEligibility(prereqs);
  return {
    ...base,
    task_id: 'lf_hf_ratio_metric_eligibility',
    limitations: [
      'LF/HF ratio is a mathematical quotient of band powers; requires non-zero HF power and resting conditions.',
      'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 13.',
      'Non-diagnostic: ratio alone does not measure absolute autonomic balance or clinical state.'
    ]
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates task eligibility for Poincaré / Nonlinear HRV Analysis (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 ratio).
 * Standard requirement: valid monotonic RR stream with continuous >= 300s analytical coverage and >= 31 valid beats.
 */
export function evaluatePoincareEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Poincaré nonlinear geometry (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2) requires >= 300s (5 minutes) of continuous resting recording according to standard protocol guidelines.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Targets 14-16 (poincare_sd1, poincare_sd2, sd1_sd2_ratio).',
    'Non-diagnostic: interval dispersion geometry does not measure absolute autonomic balance or clinical disease.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('RR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required RR channel');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence detected');
  }

  const effectiveDuration = prereqs.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds !== undefined
    ? prereqs.longest_contiguous_segment_seconds
    : (prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds !== undefined
      ? prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds
      : prereqs.total_duration_seconds);

  if (effectiveDuration < 300 || prereqs.total_duration_seconds < 300) {
    blocking.push(`Duration insufficient for standard nonlinear analysis: ${Math.round(effectiveDuration)}s (minimum continuous required: 300s / 5 min)`);
  }

  if (prereqs.accepted_beat_count < 31) {
    blocking.push(`Insufficient valid beat count: ${prereqs.accepted_beat_count} (minimum required: 31 beats / 30 pairs)`);
  }

  if (prereqs.max_gap_seconds !== undefined && prereqs.max_gap_seconds > 3.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: source timestamp gap of ${Math.round(prereqs.max_gap_seconds * 10) / 10}s detected in session.`);
  }

  if (prereqs.artifact_percentage > 5.0) {
    warnings.push(`Advisory: elevated artifact rate (${prereqs.artifact_percentage}%) impacts nonlinear estimation.`);
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'poincare_nonlinear',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['RR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 300,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

  return {
