export interface CardiacDriftPrerequisites extends TaskEligibilityPrerequisites {
  has_external_workload?: boolean;
  workload_channel_type?: 'WORKLOAD_POWER' | 'WORKLOAD_PACE' | 'ACC';
  is_steady_state?: boolean;
  overlap_duration_seconds?: number;
}

/**
 * Evaluates task eligibility for Aerobic Decoupling / Cardiac Drift per Frozen Protocol v1.1.0 Target cardiac_drift_ratio.
 * Strict protocol rules:
 * - ACC motion magnitude is NEVER accepted as mechanical workload power.
 * - Requires external workload channel (power or authorized pace).
 * - Requires steady-state exercise effort (is_steady_state: true).
 * - Requires continuous overlap >= 1200 seconds (20 minutes).
 */
export function evaluateCardiacDriftEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites | CardiacDriftPrerequisites,
  hasPowerOrPace?: boolean
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Cardiac drift decoupling requires >= 20 minutes (1200s) of continuous steady-state exercise with aligned external workload power/speed data.',
    'Polar H10 ACC motion is not calibrated mechanical workload and is strictly prohibited as a surrogate.',
    'Non-diagnostic athletic metric only; does not provide medical or clinical cardiovascular assessment.'
  ];

  const driftPrereqs = prereqs as CardiacDriftPrerequisites;
  const isWorkloadLinked = typeof hasPowerOrPace === 'boolean'
    ? hasPowerOrPace
    : (driftPrereqs.has_external_workload ?? false);

  if (driftPrereqs.workload_channel_type === 'ACC') {
    blocking.push('ACC motion magnitude is not mechanical workload power. External power or pace meter is required.');
  }

  if (!isWorkloadLinked) {
    blocking.push('Missing aligned external workload power or pace data stream (ACC motion is not a workload power metric)');
  }

  if (driftPrereqs.is_steady_state === false) {
    blocking.push('Session is not steady-state exercise. Interval, variable, or resting sessions are ineligible.');
  }

  const overlap = driftPrereqs.overlap_duration_seconds ?? prereqs.total_duration_seconds;
  if (overlap < 1200) {
    blocking.push(`Duration insufficient: ${Math.round(overlap)}s (minimum required: 1200s / 20 min continuous overlap)`);
  }

  const state: TaskEligibilityState = blocking.length > 0 
    ? 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' 
    : (warnings.length > 0 ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : 'ELIGIBLE');

  return {
    task_id: 'cardiac_drift_ratio',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V1.1_TARGET_CARDIAC_DRIFT',
    required_channels: ['RR', 'WORKLOAD_POWER'],
    required_duration_seconds: 1200,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates individual metric eligibility for Heart Rate 5-Zone Distribution under Frozen Protocol v1.1.
 * Standard requirement: >= 60 seconds (60 samples at 1 Hz) and declared zone boundary array.
 */
export function evaluateHrZoneDistributionEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites,
  hasValidZones: boolean = true,
  isExplicitUserBasis: boolean = false,
  isCadenceEligible: boolean = true
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Heart Rate Zone distribution measures time spent in declared intensity bins.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target hr_zone_distribution.',
    'Zone boundaries represent the declared configuration model; fallback models do not imply validated personalized thresholds.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('HR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required HR channel');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence detected');
  }

  if (!hasValidZones) {
    blocking.push('Missing or malformed zone boundary configuration');
  }

  if (!isCadenceEligible) {
    blocking.push('HR timeseries fails strict 1-Hz cadence or contains gaps; no qualifying continuous segment >= 60 seconds detected.');
  }

  const durationSec = prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds !== undefined
    ? prereqs.accepted_coverage_seconds
    : prereqs.total_duration_seconds;

  if (durationSec < 60) {
    blocking.push(`Insufficient continuous 1-Hz HR recording length: coverage ${Math.round(durationSec)}s (< 60s minimum).`);
  }

  if (!isExplicitUserBasis) {
    warnings.push('Zone boundaries derived from profile or default fallback; not an explicitly configured user zone basis.');
  }

  let state: TaskEligibilityState = 'ELIGIBLE';
  if (blocking.length > 0) {
    state = 'NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  } else if (warnings.length > 0) {
    state = 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS';
  }

  return {
    task_id: 'hr_zone_distribution_eligibility',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['HR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 60,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates multi-modal ECG vs RR agreement eligibility.
 * Requires simultaneous paired Polar ECG and raw RR streams.
 * If simultaneous paired recordings are unavailable, truthfully evaluates to NOT_ELIGIBLE (dataset-blocked).
 */
export function evaluateEcgRrAgreementEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites,
  hasPairedEcgRr: boolean = false
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Multi-modal ECG vs RR agreement requires simultaneous paired Polar ECG and raw RR recordings on a synchronous timebase.',
    'Governed under Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 19-21.',
    'Feature is dataset-blocked pending in-vivo acquisition of paired streams; MIT-BIH or unaligned files cannot substitute.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('ECG') || !prereqs.available_channels.includes('RR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing simultaneous ECG and RR recording channels');
  }

  if (!hasPairedEcgRr) {
    blocking.push('Dataset-blocked: simultaneous paired Polar ECG and raw RR streams unavailable for this session');
  }

  if (prereqs.total_duration_seconds < 60) {
    blocking.push(`Duration insufficient: ${Math.round(prereqs.total_duration_seconds)}s (< 60s minimum)`);
  }

  const state: TaskEligibilityState = blocking.length > 0 ? 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' : 'ELIGIBLE';

  return {
    task_id: 'ecg_rr_agreement',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1',
    required_channels: ['ECG', 'RR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 60,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates technical ECG signal quality indicator (SQI) eligibility.
 * Evaluates technical screening aids (clipping, baseline drift, noisy chunks).
 */
export function evaluateExperimentalSqiEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'ECG signal quality indicators (clipping, baseline drift, high-frequency noise ratio) are experimental technical screening aids.',
    'SNR remains the validated computational ECG quality metric (5-15 Hz vs 40-65 Hz, Frozen Protocol v1.1 Target 14).',
    'Technical quality indices do not provide a universal ECG quality score or disease screening.'
  ];

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('ECG')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required ECG channel');
  }

  if (prereqs.ecg_continuous_window_seconds === undefined || prereqs.ecg_continuous_window_seconds === null) {
    blocking.push('No continuous ECG analytical window established');
  } else if (prereqs.ecg_continuous_window_seconds < 10) {
    blocking.push(`Insufficient continuous ECG window: ${Math.round(prereqs.ecg_continuous_window_seconds)}s (< 10s minimum)`);
  }

  if (prereqs.ecg_timebase_monotonic === false || !prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic ECG timebase or timestamp reset detected');
  }

  if (prereqs.ecg_sample_rate_hz !== undefined && (prereqs.ecg_sample_rate_hz < 125 || prereqs.ecg_sample_rate_hz > 135)) {
    warnings.push(`Non-nominal ECG sampling rate: ${prereqs.ecg_sample_rate_hz} Hz (nominal 130 Hz expected)`);
  }

  const state: TaskEligibilityState = blocking.length > 0
    ? 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
    : (warnings.length > 0 ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : 'ELIGIBLE');

  return {
    task_id: 'experimental_ecg_sqi',
    task_version: '1.1.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1',
    required_channels: ['ECG'],
    required_duration_seconds: 10,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

export interface RecoveryContinuityPrerequisites {
  has_transition: boolean;
  has_continuous_60s?: boolean;
  has_continuous_120s?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Evaluates Heart Rate Recovery (1-min and 2-min post-exercise drop) eligibility.
 * Requires continuous canonical HR data across the post-exercise transition window.
 */
export function evaluateHeartRateRecoveryEligibility(
  prereqs: TaskEligibilityPrerequisites,
  continuityOrTransition: boolean | RecoveryContinuityPrerequisites = false
): TaskEligibilityResult {
  const blocking: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const limitations: string[] = [
    'Heart Rate Recovery (1-min and 2-min) is an experimental observational metric.',
    'Requires an explicit exercise-to-rest transition window; not applicable to continuous steady-state or resting recordings.',
    'Descriptive athletic metric only; not intended for medical use or automated training readiness claims.'
  ];

  const continuity: RecoveryContinuityPrerequisites = typeof continuityOrTransition === 'boolean'
    ? { has_transition: continuityOrTransition, has_continuous_60s: continuityOrTransition, has_continuous_120s: continuityOrTransition }
    : continuityOrTransition;

  if (!prereqs.available_channels.includes('HR')) {
    blocking.push('Missing required HR channel for recovery drop calculation');
  }

  if (!prereqs.has_monotonic_timebase) {
    blocking.push('Non-monotonic or invalid timestamp sequence in heart rate stream');
  }

  if (!continuity.has_transition) {
    blocking.push('No exercise-to-rest transition window detected in recording');
  }

  if (prereqs.total_duration_seconds < 120) {
    blocking.push(`Insufficient total duration: ${Math.round(prereqs.total_duration_seconds)}s (< 120s minimum for 2-min recovery)`);
  }

  if (continuity.has_transition) {
    if (continuity.has_continuous_60s === false) {
      blocking.push('Discontinuous HR sampling in recovery window: gap detected between peak and 60s target');
    } else if (continuity.has_continuous_120s === false) {
      warnings.push('Discontinuous HR sampling between 60s and 120s: 2-minute recovery unavailable');
    }
  }

  const state: TaskEligibilityState = blocking.length > 0
    ? 'NOT_ELIGIBLE'
    : (warnings.length > 0 ? 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS' : 'ELIGIBLE');

  return {
    task_id: 'heart_rate_recovery',
    task_version: '1.0.0',
    protocol_authority: 'H10_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1',
    required_channels: ['HR'],
    required_duration_seconds: 120,
    state,
    blocking_reasons: blocking,
    warning_reasons: warnings,
    limitations,
    observed_prerequisites: prereqs
  };
}

import * as crypto from 'crypto';

export type TimebaseSemantics = 'phone_local_iso' | 'sensor_monotonic_ns' | 'relative_session_ms' | 'unknown';

export type TimezoneProvenance =
  | 'explicit_source_offset'
  | 'source_metadata_iana'
  | 'device_naive_wall_clock'
  | 'relative_clock_only';

export type TimeAmbiguityStatus =
  | 'unambiguous'
  | 'dst_fold_overlap'
  | 'dst_gap_missing'
  | 'device_clock_reset'
  | 'monotonic_jump_detected';

export interface CanonicalTemporalEvidence {
  raw_source_timestamp: string;
  canonical_utc_instant: string; // ISO 8601 with Z
  source_offset_minutes: number | null; // e.g. 180 for UTC+3, -240 for UTC-4, 330 for UTC+5:30, null if naive
  source_iana_zone: string | null; // e.g. 'Europe/Moscow' or null
  timezone_provenance: TimezoneProvenance;
  timebase_semantics: TimebaseSemantics;
  ambiguity_status: TimeAmbiguityStatus;
  is_monotonic: boolean;
  clock_resets_detected: number;
}

/**
 * Parses an offset string like "+03:00", "-04:00", "+05:30", "Z", or "+0300" into total minutes from UTC.
 */
export function parseOffsetMinutes(offsetStr: string): number | null {
  if (!offsetStr) return null;
  const trimmed = offsetStr.trim();
  if (trimmed === 'Z' || trimmed === 'z') return 0;
  
  const match = trimmed.match(/^([+-])(\d{1,2}):?(\d{2})?$/);
  if (!match) return null;

  const sign = match[1] === '-' ? -1 : 1;
  const hours = parseInt(match[2], 10);
  const minutes = match[3] ? parseInt(match[3], 10) : 0;

  if (isNaN(hours) || isNaN(minutes) || hours > 14 || minutes >= 60) {
    return null;
  }

  return sign * (hours * 60 + minutes);
}

/**
 * Formats offset minutes into standard "+HH:MM", "-HH:MM", or "Z" string.
 */
export function formatOffsetString(offsetMinutes: number, useZForZero = true): string {
  if (offsetMinutes === 0 && useZForZero) return 'Z';
  const sign = offsetMinutes >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
  const abs = Math.abs(offsetMinutes);
  const h = Math.floor(abs / 60);
  const m = abs % 60;
  return `${sign}${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Formats an IANA timezone offset string at a given instant (e.g. "+03:00" or "+05:30").
 */
export function getIanaOffsetMinutes(ianaZone: string, instantUtcMs: number = Date.now()): number {
  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: ianaZone,
      timeZoneName: 'longOffset',
      year: 'numeric'
    });
    const parts = formatter.formatToParts(new Date(instantUtcMs));
    const tzPart = parts.find(p => p.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value;
    if (tzPart) {
      // e.g. "GMT+3", "GMT+03:00", "GMT-04:00", "GMT"
      const m = tzPart.match(/GMT([+-]\d{1,2}(?::?\d{2})?)?/i);
      if (m && m[1]) {
        const parsed = parseOffsetMinutes(m[1]);
        if (parsed !== null) return parsed;
      } else if (m && !m[1]) {
        return 0; // GMT exact
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // Fallback using direct format diff
  try {
    const d = new Date(instantUtcMs);
    const utcStr = d.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'UTC' });
    const targetStr = d.toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: ianaZone });
    const diffMs = new Date(targetStr).getTime() - new Date(utcStr).getTime();
    return Math.round(diffMs / 60000);
  } catch (_) {
    return 0;
  }
}

/**
 * Detects whether a timestamp in a given IANA zone is during a DST fold (hour repeated) or gap (hour skipped).
 */
export function detectDstAmbiguity(instantUtcMs: number, ianaZone: string): TimeAmbiguityStatus {
  if (!ianaZone || ianaZone === 'UTC') return 'unambiguous';
  try {
    // Check offset 1 hour before and 1 hour after
    const offsetBefore = getIanaOffsetMinutes(ianaZone, instantUtcMs - 3600000);
    const offsetAfter = getIanaOffsetMinutes(ianaZone, instantUtcMs + 3600000);
    const offsetCurrent = getIanaOffsetMinutes(ianaZone, instantUtcMs);

    if (offsetBefore > offsetAfter && (offsetCurrent === offsetAfter || offsetCurrent === offsetBefore)) {
      // Offset decreased (fall back) - local time repeats
      return 'dst_fold_overlap';
    }
    if (offsetBefore < offsetAfter && (offsetCurrent === offsetAfter || offsetCurrent === offsetBefore)) {
      // Offset increased (spring forward) - local time skipped
      return 'dst_gap_missing';
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return 'unambiguous';
}

/**
 * Environment-invariant timestamp parser.
 *
 * CRITICAL INVARIANT: Does NOT use host process `new Date(naiveString)` which depends on host TZ.
 * If raw timestamp has no explicit timezone offset, it is parsed deterministically using Date.UTC(...)
 * with timezone_provenance: 'device_naive_wall_clock' and source_offset_minutes: null.
 *
 * This guarantees 100% identical canonical UTC instant and SHA-256 fingerprint regardless of whether
 * this code runs in UTC, Europe/Moscow (+3), America/New_York (-4/-5), or Asia/Kolkata (+5:30).
 */
export function parseRawTimestamp(
  raw: string,
  options?: {
    defaultOffsetMinutes?: number | null;
    knownIanaZone?: string | null;
    timebaseSemantics?: TimebaseSemantics;
  }
): CanonicalTemporalEvidence {
  const trimmed = (raw || '').trim();
  const timebase = options?.timebaseSemantics || 'phone_local_iso';

  if (!trimmed) {
    return {
      raw_source_timestamp: '',
      canonical_utc_instant: '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
      source_offset_minutes: null,
      source_iana_zone: options?.knownIanaZone || null,
      timezone_provenance: 'device_naive_wall_clock',
      timebase_semantics: timebase,
      ambiguity_status: 'unambiguous',
      is_monotonic: true,
      clock_resets_detected: 0
    };
  }

  // Regex matching ISO-8601 with optional offset:
  // Examples:
  // "2026-03-28 09:15:00.123"
  // "2026-03-28T09:15:00.123"
  // "2026-03-28T09:15:00.123Z"
  // "2026-03-28T09:15:00.123+03:00"
  // "2026-03-28T09:15:00.123+05:30"
  // "2026-03-28T09:15:00-04:00"
  const isoMatch = trimmed.match(
    /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})[T\s](\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\s*(Z|[+-]\d{1,2}(?::?\d{2})?))?$/i
  );

  if (isoMatch) {
    const year = parseInt(isoMatch[1], 10);
    const month = parseInt(isoMatch[2], 10) - 1; // 0-indexed
    const day = parseInt(isoMatch[3], 10);
    const hour = parseInt(isoMatch[4], 10);
    const minute = parseInt(isoMatch[5], 10);
    const second = parseInt(isoMatch[6], 10);
    const fractionStr = (isoMatch[7] || '0').slice(0, 3).padEnd(3, '0');
    const millisecond = parseInt(fractionStr, 10);
    const rawOffset = isoMatch[8];

    if (rawOffset) {
      // Explicit offset present in source timestamp
      const offsetMins = parseOffsetMinutes(rawOffset);
      const parsedOffset = offsetMins !== null ? offsetMins : 0;
      
      // Calculate UTC instant: subtract offset from local time
      const wallMs = Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond);
      const utcMs = wallMs - parsedOffset * 60000;
      const canonicalUtcIso = new Date(utcMs).toISOString();

      const ambiguity = options?.knownIanaZone ? detectDstAmbiguity(utcMs, options.knownIanaZone) : 'unambiguous';

      return {
        raw_source_timestamp: trimmed,
        canonical_utc_instant: canonicalUtcIso,
        source_offset_minutes: parsedOffset,
        source_iana_zone: options?.knownIanaZone || null,
        timezone_provenance: 'explicit_source_offset',
        timebase_semantics: timebase,
        ambiguity_status: ambiguity,
        is_monotonic: true,
        clock_resets_detected: 0
      };
    } else if (options?.defaultOffsetMinutes !== undefined && options.defaultOffsetMinutes !== null) {
      // Explicit caller-provided offset override (e.g. from session-level metadata)
      const offsetMins = options.defaultOffsetMinutes;
      const wallMs = Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond);
      const utcMs = wallMs - offsetMins * 60000;
      const canonicalUtcIso = new Date(utcMs).toISOString();

      return {
        raw_source_timestamp: trimmed,
        canonical_utc_instant: canonicalUtcIso,
        source_offset_minutes: offsetMins,
        source_iana_zone: options.knownIanaZone || null,
        timezone_provenance: 'source_metadata_iana',
        timebase_semantics: timebase,
        ambiguity_status: options.knownIanaZone ? detectDstAmbiguity(utcMs, options.knownIanaZone) : 'unambiguous',
        is_monotonic: true,
        clock_resets_detected: 0
      };
    } else {
      // Naive timestamp: no offset indicator.
      // Anchor deterministically to UTC reference without machine-local timezone shifting.
      const utcMs = Date.UTC(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond);
      const canonicalUtcIso = new Date(utcMs).toISOString();

      return {
        raw_source_timestamp: trimmed,
        canonical_utc_instant: canonicalUtcIso,
        source_offset_minutes: null,
        source_iana_zone: options?.knownIanaZone || null,
        timezone_provenance: 'device_naive_wall_clock',
        timebase_semantics: timebase,
        ambiguity_status: 'unambiguous',
        is_monotonic: true,
        clock_resets_detected: 0
      };
    }
  }

  // Fallback for numeric epoch timestamp (ms)
  const numericVal = parseFloat(trimmed);
  if (!isNaN(numericVal) && numericVal > 946684800000 && numericVal < 4102444800000) {
    // Plausible millisecond epoch between 2000 and 2100
    const d = new Date(numericVal);
    return {
      raw_source_timestamp: trimmed,
      canonical_utc_instant: d.toISOString(),
      source_offset_minutes: 0,
      source_iana_zone: options?.knownIanaZone || null,
      timezone_provenance: 'explicit_source_offset',
      timebase_semantics: timebase,
      ambiguity_status: 'unambiguous',
      is_monotonic: true,
      clock_resets_detected: 0
    };
  }

  // Unparseable fallback - deterministic epoch
  return {
    raw_source_timestamp: trimmed,
    canonical_utc_instant: '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    source_offset_minutes: null,
    source_iana_zone: options?.knownIanaZone || null,
    timezone_provenance: 'device_naive_wall_clock',
    timebase_semantics: 'unknown',
    ambiguity_status: 'unambiguous',
    is_monotonic: false,
    clock_resets_detected: 0
  };
}

/**
 * Computes deterministic temporal fingerprint for session duplicate detection.
 * Strictly environment-invariant.
 */
export function computeTemporalFingerprint(evidence: CanonicalTemporalEvidence): string {
  const payload = {
    raw: evidence.raw_source_timestamp,
    utc: evidence.canonical_utc_instant,
    offset: evidence.source_offset_minutes,
    provenance: evidence.timezone_provenance,
    timebase: evidence.timebase_semantics
  };
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(payload)).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * Returns the UnitDefinition for a given unit ID (or fallback).
 */
export function getUnitDefinition(unitId: string): UnitDefinition {
  if (unitId in UNIT_CATALOG) {
    return UNIT_CATALOG[unitId as MachineUnitId];
  }
  return {
    id: unitId as any,
    dimension: 'ratio',
    default_precision: 1,
    labels: { ru: unitId, en: unitId },
    symbol: unitId,
    description: unitId
  };
}

/**
 * Formats a metric value with its unit for human presentation.
 */
export function formatValueWithUnit(
  value: number | null | undefined,
  unitId: string,
  locale: 'ru' | 'en' | 'ru-RU' | 'en-US' = 'ru',
  options?: {
    precision?: number;
    showUnit?: boolean;
    compact?: boolean;
  }
): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || isNaN(value)) {
    return '—';
  }

  const def = getUnitDefinition(unitId);
  const prec = options?.precision !== undefined ? options.precision : def.default_precision;
  const isRu = locale.startsWith('ru');
  const unitLabel = isRu ? def.labels.ru : def.labels.en;

  const numFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(isRu ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: prec,
    maximumFractionDigits: prec
  });

  const formattedNum = numFormatter.format(value);

  if (options?.showUnit === false || !unitLabel) {
    return formattedNum;
  }

  // Non-breaking space for units except '%'
  const separator = unitLabel === '%' ? '' : '\u00A0';
  return `${formattedNum}${separator}${unitLabel}`;
}

/**
 * Formats a machine value for invariant CSV/JSON export.
 * Always produces dot-decimal numbers (e.g. "3.1415"), completely language-neutral.
 */
export function formatMachineValue(value: number | null | undefined, precision?: number): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || isNaN(value)) {
    return '';
  }
  if (precision !== undefined) {
    return value.toFixed(precision);
  }
  return String(value);
}

/**

 * Canonical Single Source of Truth for all User-Facing Presentation,

export function localizeReason(reason: string, language: 'ru' | 'en' = 'ru'): string {
  if (!reason) return '';
  if (language === 'en') return reason;
  if (REASON_TRANSLATIONS_RU[reason]) return REASON_TRANSLATIONS_RU[reason];

  // Dynamic regex / pattern matching for duration, counts, and QC warnings
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient for pNN50 standard')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Длительность недостаточна для стандарта pNN50: ${match[1]} с (< 300 с / 5 мин)` : 'Длительность недостаточна для стандарта pNN50 (< 300 с / 5 мин)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient for SDNN standard')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Длительность недостаточна для стандарта SDNN: ${match[1]} с (< 300 с / 5 мин)` : 'Длительность недостаточна для стандарта SDNN (< 300 с / 5 мин)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient for complete time-domain suite')) {
    return 'Длительность недостаточна для полного временного анализа (SDNN и pNN50 требуют >= 300 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient for standard frequency')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Длительность недостаточна для спектрального анализа: ${match[1]} с (минимум: 300 с / 5 мин)` : 'Длительность недостаточна для спектрального анализа (< 300 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient for standard nonlinear analysis') || reason.includes('Duration insufficient for Poincaré standard')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Длительность недостаточна для нелинейного анализа: ${match[1]} с (минимум: 300 с / 5 мин)` : 'Длительность недостаточна для нелинейного анализа (< 300 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Insufficient recording length for RMSSD')) {
    return 'Недостаточная длительность записи для стандарта RMSSD (< 300 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Insufficient continuous 1-Hz HR recording length')) {
    const match = reason.match(/coverage\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Недостаточная длина непрерывной записи ЧСС 1 Гц: ${match[1]} с (< 60 с)` : 'Недостаточная длина непрерывной записи ЧСС 1 Гц (< 60 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Insufficient continuous ECG window')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Недостаточное непрерывное окно ЭКГ: ${match[1]} с (< 10 с)` : 'Недостаточное непрерывное окно ЭКГ (< 10 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Insufficient valid beat count')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)/);
    return match ? `Недостаточно валидных ударов: ${match[1]} (требуется >= 31)` : 'Недостаточно валидных ударов (требуется >= 31)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Insufficient total duration')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Недостаточная общая длительность: ${match[1]} с (< 120 с)` : 'Недостаточная общая длительность (< 120 с)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Duration insufficient:')) {
    const match = reason.match(/:\s*(\d+)s/);
    return match ? `Недостаточная длительность записи: ${match[1]} с` : 'Недостаточная длительность записи';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Low interval count')) {
    const match = reason.match(/\((\d+)\s*</);
    return match ? `Малое число интервалов (${match[1]} < 30): среднее отражает очень короткую выборку` : 'Малое число интервалов (< 30): среднее отражает очень короткую выборку';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Advisory: elevated artifact rate') || reason.includes('Advisory: elevated artifact/exclusion rate')) {
    const match = reason.match(/\(([\d.]+)%\)/);
    return match ? `Повышенная доля артефактов (${match[1]}%)` : 'Повышенная доля артефактов';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Advisory: source timestamp gap of')) {
    const match = reason.match(/gap of\s*([\d.]+)s/);
    return match ? `Разрыв временных меток в источнике (${match[1]} с)` : 'Разрыв временных меток в источнике';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Non-nominal ECG sampling rate')) {
    const match = reason.match(/rate:\s*([\d.]+)\s*Hz/);
    return match ? `Нестандартная частота дискретизации ЭКГ: ${match[1]} Гц` : 'Нестандартная частота дискретизации ЭКГ';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Ultra-short duration')) {
    return 'Сверхкороткая запись (число принятых ударов >= 300)';
  }
  if (reason.includes('Zero accepted clean NN intervals')) {
    return 'Отсутствуют валидные чистые NN-интервалы';
  }

  return reason;
}

export const localizeBlockingReason = localizeReason;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. BOUNDED PRESENTATION EVALUATION (AC-027, AC-028)
// Eliminates the contradiction "Value Visible + Не применимо".
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface FormattedUserFacingMetric {
  metricKey: string;
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  isEligible: boolean;
  isDeemphasized: boolean;
  eligibilityState: SessionEligibility;
  eligibilityBadgeLabel: string;
  primaryDisplayValue: string;
  referenceValue: string | null;
  hasAdvisoryValue: boolean;
  blockingReasons: string[];
  warningReasons: string[];
  maturityLevel: FeatureMaturityLevel;
  displayColor: string;
}

export function evaluateUserFacingMetric(
  metricKey: string,
  rawNumericValue: number | null | undefined,
  eligibilityResult?: TaskEligibilityResult | null,
  language: 'ru' | 'en' = 'ru'
): FormattedUserFacingMetric {
  const spec = USER_FACING_METRICS[metricKey] || {
    key: metricKey,
    nameRu: metricKey,
    nameEn: metricKey,
    unitRu: '',
    unitEn: '',
    digits: 1,
    maturityKey: 'unknown',
    isPrimaryKpi: false,
    category: 'core_time' as const
  };

  const name = language === 'en' ? spec.nameEn : spec.nameRu;
  const unit = language === 'en' ? spec.unitEn : spec.unitRu;
  const maturityEntry = FEATURE_MATURITY_REGISTRY[spec.maturityKey];
  const maturityLevel: FeatureMaturityLevel = maturityEntry?.maturity_level || 'Validated';

  const state: SessionEligibility = eligibilityResult?.state || 'ELIGIBLE';
  const blocking = (eligibilityResult?.blocking_reasons || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, language));
  const warnings = (eligibilityResult?.warning_reasons || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, language));

  const hasValue = rawNumericValue !== null && rawNumericValue !== undefined && !isNaN(rawNumericValue);
  const formattedRaw = hasValue ? rawNumericValue!.toFixed(spec.digits) : null;

  if (state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
    // CONTRADICTION ELIMINATED: If NOT_ELIGIBLE, primary value is '—'.
    // If a numeric value exists in the engine, it is retained strictly as an audit reference, de-emphasized.
    const badgeLabel = language === 'en' ? 'Not applicable' : 'Не применимо';
    return {
      metricKey,
      name,
      unit,
      isEligible: false,
      isDeemphasized: true,
      eligibilityState: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
      eligibilityBadgeLabel: badgeLabel,
      primaryDisplayValue: '—',
      referenceValue: formattedRaw,
      hasAdvisoryValue: formattedRaw !== null,
      blockingReasons: blocking,
      warningReasons: warnings,
      maturityLevel,
      displayColor: '#94a3b8' // Muted neutral
    };
  }

  if (state === 'INCONCLUSIVE' || !hasValue) {
    const badgeLabel = language === 'en' ? 'Insufficient data' : 'Недостаточно данных';
    const effectiveBlocking = blocking.length > 0 ? blocking : [language === 'en' ? 'Insufficient data for analysis' : 'Недостаточно данных для анализа'];
    return {
      metricKey,
      name,
      unit,
      isEligible: false,
      isDeemphasized: true,
      eligibilityState: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
      eligibilityBadgeLabel: badgeLabel,
      primaryDisplayValue: '—',
      referenceValue: null,
      hasAdvisoryValue: false,
      blockingReasons: effectiveBlocking,
      warningReasons: warnings,
      maturityLevel,
      displayColor: '#94a3b8'
    };
  }

  if (state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS') {
    const badgeLabel = language === 'en' ? 'Advisory (limited)' : 'Справочно (ограничено)';
    return {
      metricKey,
      name,
      unit,
      isEligible: true,
      isDeemphasized: false,
      eligibilityState: 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS',
      eligibilityBadgeLabel: badgeLabel,
      primaryDisplayValue: formattedRaw!,
      referenceValue: formattedRaw!,
      hasAdvisoryValue: true,
      blockingReasons: [],
      warningReasons: warnings,
      maturityLevel,
      displayColor: '#facc15' // Warning yellow
    };
  }

  // Pure ELIGIBLE
  const badgeLabel = language === 'en' ? 'Valid' : 'Валидно';
  return {
    metricKey,
    name,
    unit,
    isEligible: true,
    isDeemphasized: false,
    eligibilityState: 'ELIGIBLE',
    eligibilityBadgeLabel: badgeLabel,
    primaryDisplayValue: formattedRaw!,
    referenceValue: formattedRaw!,
    hasAdvisoryValue: false,
    blockingReasons: [],
    warningReasons: [],
    maturityLevel,
    displayColor: '#38bdf8' // Standard cyan/blue
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. QUALITY SCORE NORMALIZATION (AC-032)
// Enforces single 0-100 scale; eliminates the 7180% scaling bug.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function normalizeQualityScore(rawScore: number | null | undefined): {
  numericPercent: number | null;
  displayString: string;
} {
  if (rawScore === null || rawScore === undefined || isNaN(rawScore)) {
    return { numericPercent: null, displayString: '—' };
  }

  let normalized: number;
  if (rawScore > 1.0) {
    // Already stored on a 0-100 scale (e.g. 71.8)
    normalized = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(rawScore)));
  } else if (rawScore > 0) {
    // Fraction 0.0 - 1.0 (e.g. 0.718)
    normalized = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(rawScore * 100)));
  } else {
    normalized = 0;
  }

  return {
    numericPercent: normalized,
    displayString: `${normalized}%`
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. PERSONAL BASELINE RECONCILIATION CONTRACT (AC-049, AC-050, AC-051)
// Frozen Protocol v1.1 mandates minimum 5 sessions for valid personal baseline.
// Default representation is median (p50), leave-one-out.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS = 5;

export interface BaselineEligibilityStatus {
  isEligible: boolean;
  currentSessionCount: number;
  requiredSessionCount: number;
  representation: 'median_p50';
  statusMessageRu: string;
  statusMessageEn: string;
}

export function evaluateBaselineEligibility(sessionCount: number): BaselineEligibilityStatus {
  const isEligible = sessionCount >= AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS;
  return {
    isEligible,
    currentSessionCount: sessionCount,
    requiredSessionCount: AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS,
    representation: 'median_p50',
    statusMessageRu: isEligible
      ? `Личный базовый профиль активен (сессий: ${sessionCount}, медиана p50)`
      : `Недостаточно данных для личного базового коридора (записано ${sessionCount} из ${AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS} сессий)`,
    statusMessageEn: isEligible
      ? `Personal baseline active (${sessionCount} sessions, median p50)`
      : `Insufficient data for personal baseline (${sessionCount} of ${AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS} sessions recorded)`
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 7. COMPARE COMPATIBILITY CONTRACT (AC-047, AC-048, AC-052)
// Forbids self-compare, duplicate-compare, and "Fully compatible" on unknown activity.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type CompareCompatibilityLevel = 'compatible' | 'limited' | 'incompatible';

export interface CompareCompatibilityResult {
  level: CompareCompatibilityLevel;
  canCompare: boolean;
  labelRu: string;
  labelEn: string;
  reasonRu: string;
  reasonEn: string;
}

export function evaluateCompareCompatibility(
  targetSession: { id: string; activity_type?: string | null; canonical_fingerprint?: string | null },
  peerSession: { id: string; activity_type?: string | null; canonical_fingerprint?: string | null }
): CompareCompatibilityResult {
  // 1. Self comparison is strictly forbidden
  if (targetSession.id === peerSession.id) {
    return {
      level: 'incompatible',
      canCompare: false,
      labelRu: 'Недопустимо (сравнение с собой)',
      labelEn: 'Invalid (self-comparison)',
      reasonRu: 'Сессия не может быть сопоставлена сама с собой.',
      reasonEn: 'A session cannot be compared against itself.'
    };
  }

  // 2. Duplicate canonical session comparison is forbidden
  const fp1 = targetSession.canonical_fingerprint || (targetSession as any).source_bundle_sha256;
  const fp2 = peerSession.canonical_fingerprint || (peerSession as any).source_bundle_sha256;
  if (fp1 && fp2 && fp1 === fp2) {
    return {
      level: 'incompatible',
      canCompare: false,
      labelRu: 'Недопустимо (дубликат сессии)',
      labelEn: 'Invalid (duplicate session)',
      reasonRu: 'Обе записи получены из одного и того же исходного пакета сигналов.',
      reasonEn: 'Both records originate from the exact same raw source bundle.'
    };
  }

  // 3. Unknown activity context forbids "Fully compatible"
  const targetAct = (targetSession.activity_type || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
  const peerAct = (peerSession.activity_type || 'unknown').toLowerCase();

  if (targetAct === 'unknown' || peerAct === 'unknown') {
    return {
      level: 'limited',
      canCompare: true,
      labelRu: 'Ограниченная совместимость (неизвестная активность)',
      labelEn: 'Limited compatibility (unknown activity)',
      reasonRu: 'Тип активности одной или обеих сессий не указан. Сопоставление носит исключительно ознакомительный характер.',
      reasonEn: 'Activity context is unknown for one or both sessions. Comparison is strictly observational.'
    };
  }

  if (targetAct !== peerAct) {
    return {
      level: 'limited',
      canCompare: true,
      labelRu: 'Разные типы активности',
      labelEn: 'Different activity types',
      reasonRu: `Сопоставляются разные контексты (${targetAct} против ${peerAct}). Базовые диапазоны могут различаться.`,
      reasonEn: `Comparing different activity contexts (${targetAct} vs ${peerAct}). Baseline ranges may differ.`
    };
  }

  return {
    level: 'compatible',
    canCompare: true,
    labelRu: 'Совместимы по контексту',
    labelEn: 'Context compatible',
    reasonRu: `Одинаковый тип активности (${targetAct}) и независимые исходные записи.`,
    reasonEn: `Identical activity context (${targetAct}) and distinct source bundles.`
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 8. EXPORT ELIGIBILITY CONTRACT (AC-055, AC-056)
// Unknown activity must NOT blanket-disable general exports.
// Only specialized physiological models (e.g. aerobic decoupling) require activity context.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type ExportFormatKey = 
  | 'html_report'
  | 'pdf_report'
  | 'csv_metrics'
  | 'rr_csv'
  | 'discussion_bundle'
  | 'llm_pack'
  | 'aerobic_decoupling_export';

export interface ExportEligibilityResult {
  isEligible: boolean;
  blockingReasonRu?: string;
  blockingReasonEn?: string;
  actionRequired?: 'set_activity' | 'recalculate' | 'none';
}

export function evaluateExportEligibility(
  format: ExportFormatKey,
  session: { id: string; duration_seconds: number; activity_type?: string | null },
  isCanonical: boolean
): ExportEligibilityResult {
  // Only aerobic decoupling strictly requires activity context
  if (format === 'aerobic_decoupling_export') {
    const act = (session.activity_type || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
    if (act === 'unknown') {
      return {
        isEligible: false,
        blockingReasonRu: 'Аэробное разобщение требует указания циклической кардио-активности (бег, вело и т.д.)',
        blockingReasonEn: 'Aerobic decoupling strictly requires cyclical cardio activity context (running, cycling, etc.)',
        actionRequired: 'set_activity'
      };
    }
    if (session.duration_seconds < 600) {
      return {
        isEligible: false,
        blockingReasonRu: 'Требуется непрерывная запись длительностью не менее 10 минут (600 с)',
        blockingReasonEn: 'Continuous recording >= 10 minutes (600s) required',
        actionRequired: 'none'
      };
    }
  }

  // All standard workstation exports (HTML, PDF, CSV, LLM Pack, Discussion ZIP) are eligible
  return {
    isEligible: true,
    actionRequired: 'none'
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 9. METRIC-LEVEL COMPARISON ELIGIBILITY & DELTA TRUTH CONTRACT (AC-047..AC-052)
// Enforces single-source scientific truth in CompareView (Peer & Baseline modes).
// Metrics marked NOT_ELIGIBLE/INCONCLUSIVE must not compute analytical deltas
// or display misleading percent changes.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface MetricComparisonEligibility {
  isEligible: boolean;
  state: SessionEligibility;
  primaryDisplayValue: string;
  referenceNumericValue: number | null;
  hasAdvisoryValue: boolean;
  reasonRu: string;
  reasonEn: string;
}

export function evaluateMetricComparisonEligibility(
  metricKey: string,
  rawNumericValue: number | null | undefined,
  eligibilityState?: TaskEligibilityState | null,
  blockingReasons?: string[] | null,
  language: 'ru' | 'en' = 'ru'
): MetricComparisonEligibility {
  const state: SessionEligibility = eligibilityState || 'ELIGIBLE';
  const hasValue = rawNumericValue !== null && rawNumericValue !== undefined && !isNaN(rawNumericValue);
  const spec = USER_FACING_METRICS[metricKey];
  const digits = spec?.digits ?? 1;
  const formattedRaw = hasValue ? rawNumericValue!.toFixed(digits) : null;

  const reasons = (blockingReasons || []).map(r => localizeReason(r, language));
  const defaultReasonRu = 'Метрика недоступна для аналитического сравнения';
  const defaultReasonEn = 'Metric not available for analytical comparison';
  const reason = reasons.length > 0 ? reasons[0] : (language === 'ru' ? defaultReasonRu : defaultReasonEn);

  if (state === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' || state === 'INCONCLUSIVE' || !hasValue) {
    return {
      isEligible: false,
      state,
      primaryDisplayValue: '—',
      referenceNumericValue: hasValue ? rawNumericValue! : null,
      hasAdvisoryValue: hasValue,
      reasonRu: language === 'ru' ? reason : defaultReasonRu,
      reasonEn: language === 'en' ? reason : defaultReasonEn
    };
  }

  // ELIGIBLE or ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS
  return {
    isEligible: true,
    state,
    primaryDisplayValue: formattedRaw!,
    referenceNumericValue: rawNumericValue!,
    hasAdvisoryValue: state === 'ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS',
    reasonRu: '',
    reasonEn: ''
  };
}

export interface MetricDeltaCalculationResult {
  delta: number | null;
  deltaDisplay: string;
  deltaPct: number | null;
  deltaPctDisplay: string;
  isPositive: boolean;
  isZero: boolean;
}

export function calculateMetricComparisonDelta(
  metricKey: string,
  targetValue: number | null,
  targetEligible: boolean,
  refValue: number | null,
  refEligible: boolean,
  language: 'ru' | 'en' = 'ru'
): MetricDeltaCalculationResult {
  const isRu = language === 'ru';
  if (!targetEligible || !refEligible || targetValue === null || refValue === null) {
    return {
      delta: null,
      deltaDisplay: '—',
      deltaPct: null,
      deltaPctDisplay: '—',
      isPositive: false,
      isZero: false
    };
  }

  const delta = Math.round((targetValue - refValue) * 10) / 10;
  const isPositive = delta > 0;
  const isZero = delta === 0;
  const deltaDisplay = isPositive ? `+${delta}` : `${delta}`;

  // Metric-safe relative-change policy:
  // 1. Absolute percentages (pNN50, zone percentages, artifact rate): show percentage points (п.п. / pp)
  // to prevent misleading arithmetic (+4000%).
  const isPercentagePoints = metricKey === 'pnn50' || metricKey.endsWith('_pct') || metricKey === 'artifact_percentage';
  if (isPercentagePoints) {
    const ppUnit = isRu ? 'п.п.' : 'pp';
    const ppDisplay = isPositive ? `+${delta} ${ppUnit}` : `${delta} ${ppUnit}`;
    return {
      delta,
      deltaDisplay,
      deltaPct: delta,
      deltaPctDisplay: ppDisplay,
      isPositive,
      isZero
    };
  }

  // 2. Denominator epsilon guard: if reference is near-zero (< 0.5), relative percent is misleading.
  if (Math.abs(refValue) < 0.5) {
    return {
      delta,
      deltaDisplay,
      deltaPct: null,
      deltaPctDisplay: '—',
      isPositive,
      isZero
    };
  }

  // 3. Normal relative percent change
  const deltaPct = Math.round(((targetValue - refValue) / Math.abs(refValue)) * 1000) / 10;
  const deltaPctDisplay = deltaPct > 0 ? `+${deltaPct}%` : `${deltaPct}%`;

  return {
    delta,
    deltaDisplay,
    deltaPct,
    deltaPctDisplay,
    isPositive,
    isZero
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 11. LEAVE-ONE-OUT (LOO) PERSONAL BASELINE CORRIDOR (AC-031)
// When evaluating a session against its cohort baseline, exclude the target session
// from the reference cohort to eliminate self-bias.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface LeaveOneOutBaselineResult {
  isEligible: boolean;
  sessionsUsed: number;
  median: number | null;
  p25: number | null;
  p75: number | null;
  iqr: number | null;
  statusRu: string;
  statusEn: string;
}

export function computeLeaveOneOutBaseline(
  sessions: Array<{ id: string; value: number | null; eligible: boolean }>,
  targetSessionId: string,
  minRequired: number = AUTHORITATIVE_BASELINE_MIN_SESSIONS
): LeaveOneOutBaselineResult {
  const pool = sessions.filter(
    s => s.id !== targetSessionId && s.eligible && s.value !== null && !isNaN(s.value!)
  );

  if (pool.length < minRequired) {
    return {
      isEligible: false,
      sessionsUsed: pool.length,
      median: null,
      p25: null,
      p75: null,
      iqr: null,
      statusRu: `Недостаточно сессий для базового коридора LOO (${pool.length} из ${minRequired})`,
      statusEn: `Insufficient sessions for LOO baseline corridor (${pool.length} of ${minRequired})`
    };
  }

  const values = pool.map(s => s.value!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const n = values.length;
  const median =
    n % 2 === 1
      ? values[Math.floor(n / 2)]
      : Math.round(((values[n / 2 - 1] + values[n / 2]) / 2) * 10) / 10;
  const p25 = values[Math.floor(n * 0.25)];
  const p75 = values[Math.floor(n * 0.75)];
  const iqr = Math.round((p75 - p25) * 10) / 10;

  return {
    isEligible: true,
    sessionsUsed: n,
    median,
    p25,
    p75,
    iqr,
    statusRu: `Личный базовый коридор (LOO, сессий: ${n}, медиана p50, IQR)`,
    statusEn: `Personal baseline corridor (LOO, sessions: ${n}, median p50, IQR)`
  };
}

/**
 * User Display Preferences & Localization Contract
 *
 * Persisted in the authoritative backend settings store and versioned across restarts.
 * Separates presentation preferences from invariant source truth and analytics.
 */

export type DisplayLanguage = 'ru' | 'en';
export type DisplayLocale = 'ru-RU' | 'en-US' | 'en-GB';

export interface UserDisplayPreferences {
  schema_version: '1.0.0';
  settings_revision: number;
  display_language: DisplayLanguage;
  display_locale: DisplayLocale;
  display_timezone: string; // IANA timezone ID, e.g. 'UTC', 'Europe/Moscow', 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Kolkata', or 'source_local'
  updated_at_utc: string;
}

export const USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export const DEFAULT_USER_DISPLAY_PREFERENCES: UserDisplayPreferences = {
  schema_version: USER_PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  settings_revision: 1,
  display_language: 'ru',
  display_locale: 'ru-RU',
  display_timezone: 'UTC',
  updated_at_utc: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
};

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES: readonly DisplayLanguage[] = ['ru', 'en'] as const;
export const SUPPORTED_LOCALES: readonly DisplayLocale[] = ['ru-RU', 'en-US', 'en-GB'] as const;

/**
 * Validates whether a timezone identifier is supported by Intl.DateTimeFormat or is 'source_local'.
 */
export function isValidIanaTimezone(tz: string): boolean {
  if (!tz || typeof tz !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = tz.trim();
  if (trimmed === 'source_local' || trimmed === 'UTC') return true;

  try {
    Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: trimmed });
    return true;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Validates preferences payload, returning error string if invalid.
 */
export function validateUserDisplayPreferences(prefs: Partial<UserDisplayPreferences>): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (prefs.display_language !== undefined && !SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(prefs.display_language as any)) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Unsupported display_language: ${prefs.display_language}. Supported: ${SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.join(', ')}` };
  }
  if (prefs.display_locale !== undefined && !SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(prefs.display_locale as any)) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Unsupported display_locale: ${prefs.display_locale}. Supported: ${SUPPORTED_LOCALES.join(', ')}` };
  }
  if (prefs.display_timezone !== undefined && !isValidIanaTimezone(prefs.display_timezone)) {
    return { valid: false, error: `Invalid or unsupported display_timezone: ${prefs.display_timezone}` };
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

/**
 * src/shared/canonical/WholeProductWorkspaceContract.ts
 *
 * CardioLab G25 — Whole-Product Source V1 Consolidated Workspace Authority.
 *
 * Unifies the post-G20 contracts into one authoritative WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot
 * that eliminates competing frontend currentness models and enforces single-lineage
 * truth across profile, source, canonical session, named windows, comparison,
 * reports, AI pack, diary, local outcomes, privacy, and entitlements.
 */

import { calculateDeterministicSha256, sortKeysRecursively } from './AthleteCoreJourneyContract';

export const WHOLE_PRODUCT_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type WholeProductSourceAvailability = 'available' | 'moved' | 'missing' | 'changed' | 'unreadable';

  display_name: string | null;

export interface WholeProductComparisonState {

  saved_view_id: string | null;

}

export interface WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot {
  schema_version: string;

  source: WholeProductSourceState;

export class WholeProductValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string) {
    super(`[WholeProductValidationError:${code}] ${message}`);
    this.name = 'WholeProductValidationError';
  }
}

export function computeWholeProductDependencyFingerprint(snapshot: {
  profile: WholeProductProfileState;
  source: WholeProductSourceState;
  session: WholeProductCanonicalSessionState;
  window: WholeProductNamedWindowState;
  comparison: WholeProductComparisonState;
  report_and_pack: WholeProductReportAndPackState;
  diary: WholeProductDiaryState;
  privacy: WholeProductPrivacyState;
  entitlement: WholeProductEntitlementState;
}): string {
  const payload = sortKeysRecursively({
    profile_id: snapshot.profile.profile_id,
    profile_revision: snapshot.profile.athlete_selection_revision,
    source_id: snapshot.source.source_id,
    source_sha256: snapshot.source.source_sha256,
    source_availability: snapshot.source.availability_status,
    session_id: snapshot.session.session_id,
    session_duration: snapshot.session.duration_seconds,
    window_id: snapshot.window.active_window_id,
    window_revision: snapshot.window.revision,
    comparison_mode: snapshot.comparison.mode,
    comparison_target: snapshot.comparison.baseline_session_id,
    saved_view_id: snapshot.comparison.saved_view_id,
    saved_view_revision: snapshot.comparison.saved_view_revision,
    report_id: snapshot.report_and_pack.active_report_id,
    pack_preview_id: snapshot.report_and_pack.ai_pack_preview_id,
    pack_manifest_sha256: snapshot.report_and_pack.manifest_sha256,
    diary_id: snapshot.diary.active_diary_id,
    diary_hash: snapshot.diary.text_content_hash,
    diary_lineage: snapshot.diary.lineage_status,
    sensitive_opt_in: snapshot.privacy.sensitive_opt_in,
    entitlement_tier: snapshot.entitlement.current_tier,
    entitlement_existing_read: snapshot.entitlement.existing_data_read_available
  });
  return calculateDeterministicSha256(JSON.stringify(payload));
}

export function validateWholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot(raw: unknown): WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Workspace snapshot must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }

  const s = raw as Record<string, any>;

  if (s.schema_version !== WHOLE_PRODUCT_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError(
      `Unsupported snapshot schema version '${s.schema_version}', expected '${WHOLE_PRODUCT_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION}'`,
      'UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION'
    );
  }

  if (!s.profile || typeof s.profile !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing profile state', 'MISSING_PROFILE_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.source || typeof s.source !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing source state', 'MISSING_SOURCE_STATE');
  }
  const validAvail: WholeProductSourceAvailability[] = ['available', 'moved', 'missing', 'changed', 'unreadable'];
  if (!validAvail.includes(s.source.availability_status)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError(`Invalid source availability status '${s.source.availability_status}'`, 'INVALID_SOURCE_AVAILABILITY');
  }

  if (!s.session || typeof s.session !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing session state', 'MISSING_SESSION_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.window || typeof s.window !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing window state', 'MISSING_WINDOW_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.comparison || typeof s.comparison !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing comparison state', 'MISSING_COMPARISON_STATE');
  }
  if (!['none', 'pair', 'longitudinal', 'explicit_ab', 'personal_baseline'].includes(s.comparison.mode)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError(`Invalid comparison mode '${s.comparison.mode}'`, 'INVALID_COMPARISON_MODE');
  }

  if (!s.report_and_pack || typeof s.report_and_pack !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing report_and_pack state', 'MISSING_REPORT_AND_PACK_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.diary || typeof s.diary !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing diary state', 'MISSING_DIARY_STATE');
  }
  const validLineage: WholeProductDiaryLineageStatus[] = ['current', 'historical', 'unlinked', 'restored', 'none'];
  if (!validLineage.includes(s.diary.lineage_status)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError(`Invalid diary lineage status '${s.diary.lineage_status}'`, 'INVALID_DIARY_LINEAGE');
  }

  if (!s.outcome || typeof s.outcome !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing outcome state', 'MISSING_OUTCOME_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.privacy || typeof s.privacy !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing privacy state', 'MISSING_PRIVACY_STATE');
  }

  if (!s.entitlement || typeof s.entitlement !== 'object') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing entitlement state', 'MISSING_ENTITLEMENT_STATE');
  }

  if (typeof s.dependency_fingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(s.dependency_fingerprint)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing valid 64-char hex dependency_fingerprint', 'INVALID_DEPENDENCY_FINGERPRINT');
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(s.currentness_codes)) {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot currentness_codes must be an array', 'INVALID_CURRENTNESS_CODES');
  }

  if (!s.next_safe_action || typeof s.next_safe_action !== 'object' || typeof s.next_safe_action.route !== 'string') {
    throw new WholeProductValidationError('Snapshot missing valid next_safe_action', 'INVALID_NEXT_SAFE_ACTION');
  }

  return s as WholeProductWorkspaceSnapshot;
}

// Prohibited diagnostic wording patterns in user-facing check-in text
const PROHIBITED_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS = [
  'болезн',
  'патолог',
  'диагноз',
  'диагностик',
  'инфаркт',
  'ишеми',
  'аритмия подтверждена',
  'лечен',
  'терапи',
  'клиническ'
];

export function validateCheckInWording(text?: string | null): { valid: boolean; violation?: string } {
  if (!text) return { valid: true };
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  for (const term of PROHIBITED_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS) {
    if (lower.includes(term)) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        violation: `Текст содержит недопустимую медицинскую или диагностическую терминологию: "${term}"`
      };
    }
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

export function isValidIanaTimezone(tz: string): boolean {
  if (!tz || typeof tz !== 'string') return false;
  try {
    Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: tz });
    return true;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Format a Date to local calendar string YYYY-MM-DD under a specific IANA timezone
 */
export function formatCalendarDate(date: Date, timezone: string): string {
  const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  });
  return formatter.format(date);
}

/**
 * Generates discrete calendar slot dates according to plan cadence and timezone.
 * Handles DST shifts and variable month lengths safely without rolling 7x24h skew.
 */
export function generateSlotDates(
  cadence: CheckInCadence,
  timezone: string,
  count: number,
  startDateStr?: string
): string[] {
  const result: string[] = [];
  const safeCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(count, 52));

  let startYear: number;
  let startMonth: number; // 0-based
  let startDay: number;

  if (startDateStr && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(startDateStr)) {
    const parts = startDateStr.split('-').map(Number);
    startYear = parts[0];
    startMonth = parts[1] - 1;
    startDay = parts[2];
  } else {
    const now = new Date();
    const parts = formatCalendarDate(now, timezone).split('-').map(Number);
    startYear = parts[0];
    startMonth = parts[1] - 1;
    startDay = parts[2];
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < safeCount; i++) {
    if (cadence === 'manual') {
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, startMonth, startDay + i * 7));
      result.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    } else if (cadence === 'weekly') {
      // Step by 7 calendar days
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, startMonth, startDay + i * 7));
      result.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    } else if (cadence === 'monthly') {
      // Step by calendar month, clamping to last day of month if necessary (e.g. Jan 31 -> Feb 28/29)
      const targetMonth = startMonth + i;
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, targetMonth, 1));
      const year = d.getUTCFullYear();
      const month = d.getUTCMonth();
      // Find days in this target month
      const daysInMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
      const clampedDay = Math.min(startDay, daysInMonth);
      const slotDate = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, clampedDay));
      result.push(slotDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    }
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * CardioLab — User-Controlled Data Lifecycle, Retention & Destructive-Action Safety Contract
 *
 * Defines the canonical contracts, data estate categories, operation types,
 * profile disposition modes, impact plan schema, and CAS authorization guards.
 */

export const DATA_LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA_VERSION = '1.0.0';

/**
 * Data Estate Classification:
 * - app_owned_durable: SQLite database tables, Polar raw compressed logs (raw_logs/*.txt.gz), quarantine logs.
 * - app_owned_rebuildable: Computed session metrics, derived QC metrics, candidate flags, comparison matrices, plot caches.
 * - app_owned_transient: Staging temp directories, runtime logs (*.log), SQLite WAL/SHM, ephemeral export previews.
 * - external_references: External folders/files on user filesystem tracked in sync_ledger / external_sync_folders (NEVER deleted).
 * - user_exports: PDF/HTML/CSV reports and LLM packs exported to user-selected locations (NEVER touched or pruned).
 */
export type DataEstateCategory =
  | 'app_owned_durable'
  | 'app_owned_rebuildable'
  | 'app_owned_transient'
  | 'external_references'
  | 'user_exports';

export interface EcgRrAgreementInput {
  match_rate_20ms: number | null;
  match_rate_50ms: number | null;
  mean_absolute_error_ms: number | null;
  median_absolute_error_ms: number | null;
  estimated_lag_ms: number | null;
  overlap_count: number | null;
  overlap_coverage: number | null;
  calculation_version: string | null;
  eligibility_status: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible' | 'insufficient_data';
  availability_reason: 'available' | 'quality_limited' | 'insufficient_data' | 'no_ecg_data';
}

export function makeEcgRrAgreementInput(
  qcMetrics: { ecg_rr_consistency?: number | null; ecg_rr_match_metrics_json?: string | null } | null | undefined
): EcgRrAgreementInput {
  if (!qcMetrics || qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency == null) {
    return {
      match_rate_20ms: null,
      match_rate_50ms: null,
      mean_absolute_error_ms: null,
      median_absolute_error_ms: null,
      estimated_lag_ms: null,
      overlap_count: null,
      overlap_coverage: null,
      calculation_version: 'pan_tompkins_v1.0',
      eligibility_status: 'insufficient_data',
      availability_reason: 'no_ecg_data'
    };
  }

  let matchMetrics: any = null;
  if (qcMetrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json) {
    try {
      matchMetrics = JSON.parse(qcMetrics.ecg_rr_match_metrics_json);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  let eligibility_status: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible' | 'insufficient_data' = 'eligible';
  let availability_reason: 'available' | 'quality_limited' | 'insufficient_data' | 'no_ecg_data' = 'available';

  const overlapCount = matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.compared_intervals_count : null;
  const overlapCoverage = matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.overlap_coverage_percent : null;

  if (overlapCount !== null && overlapCount < 50) {
    eligibility_status = 'insufficient_data';
    availability_reason = 'insufficient_data';
  } else if (overlapCoverage !== null && overlapCoverage < 50) {
    eligibility_status = 'not_eligible';
    availability_reason = 'quality_limited';
  } else if (overlapCount === null && qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency != null) {
    eligibility_status = 'eligible';
    availability_reason = 'available';
  } else if (overlapCount === null) {
    eligibility_status = 'insufficient_data';
    availability_reason = 'insufficient_data';
  }

  return {
    match_rate_20ms: matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.match_rate_20ms : null,
    match_rate_50ms: matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.match_rate_50ms : (qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency * 100),
    mean_absolute_error_ms: matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.mean_abs_error_ms : null,
    median_absolute_error_ms: matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.median_abs_error_ms : null,
    estimated_lag_ms: matchMetrics ? matchMetrics.estimated_lag_ms : null,
    overlap_count: overlapCount,
    overlap_coverage: overlapCoverage,
    calculation_version: 'pan_tompkins_v1.0',
    eligibility_status,
    availability_reason
  };
}

export interface EcgRrAgreementPresentation {
  eligible: boolean;
  value: number | null;
  valueString: string;
  labelKey: 'technical_ecg_rr_agreement';
  availabilityStatus: 'available' | 'unavailable';
  availabilityReasonKey: 'available' | 'quality_limited' | 'insufficient_data' | 'no_ecg_data';
  unit: string;
  tolerance: string;
  source: string;
  calculationVersion: string;
  qualityDimension: string;
  technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_desc' | 'ecg_rr_agreement_unavailable' | 'ecg_rr_agreement_insufficient' | 'ecg_rr_agreement_no_data';
}

export function getEcgRrAgreementPresentation(
  input: EcgRrAgreementInput
): EcgRrAgreementPresentation {
  const labelKey = 'technical_ecg_rr_agreement';
  const unit = '%';
  const tolerance = '±5%';
  const source = 'qrs_detector';
  const calculationVersion = input.calculation_version || 'pan_tompkins_v1.0';
  const qualityDimension = 'signal_consistency';

  if (input.availability_reason === 'no_ecg_data') {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      value: null,
      valueString: '—',
      labelKey,
      availabilityStatus: 'unavailable',
      availabilityReasonKey: 'no_ecg_data',
      unit,
      tolerance,
      source,
      calculationVersion,
      qualityDimension,
      technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_no_data'
    };
  }

  if (input.availability_reason === 'insufficient_data') {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      value: null,
      valueString: '—',
      labelKey,
      availabilityStatus: 'unavailable',
      availabilityReasonKey: 'insufficient_data',
      unit,
      tolerance,
      source,
      calculationVersion,
      qualityDimension,
      technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_insufficient'
    };
  }

  if (input.availability_reason === 'quality_limited') {
    return {
      eligible: false,
      value: null,
      valueString: '—',
      labelKey,
      availabilityStatus: 'unavailable',
      availabilityReasonKey: 'quality_limited',
      unit,
      tolerance,
      source,
      calculationVersion,
      qualityDimension,
      technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_unavailable'
    };
  }

  const value = input.match_rate_50ms !== null ? Math.round(input.match_rate_50ms) : null;
  const valueString = value !== null ? `${value}%` : '—';

  return {
    eligible: input.eligibility_status === 'eligible',
    value,
    valueString,
    labelKey,
    availabilityStatus: 'available',
    availabilityReasonKey: 'available',
    unit,
    tolerance,
    source,
    calculationVersion,
    qualityDimension,
    technicalInterpretationKey: 'ecg_rr_agreement_desc'
  };
}

export function calculateQrsPeakMatching(
  detectedPeaks: number[],
  referencePeaks: number[],
  toleranceMs: number = 50,
  minDurationSec: number = 0
): number | null {
  if (!detectedPeaks || !referencePeaks || detectedPeaks.length === 0 || referencePeaks.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const sortedDet = [...detectedPeaks].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const sortedRef = [...referencePeaks].sort((a, b) => a - b);

  if (minDurationSec > 0) {
    const detSpanSec = (sortedDet[sortedDet.length - 1] - sortedDet[0]) / 1000;
    const refSpanSec = (sortedRef[sortedRef.length - 1] - sortedRef[0]) / 1000;
    if (detSpanSec < minDurationSec || refSpanSec < minDurationSec) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  const nDet = sortedDet.length;
  const nRef = sortedRef.length;

  const adj: number[][] = Array.from({ length: nDet }, () => []);
  for (let i = 0; i < nDet; i++) {
    const edges: { refIdx: number; diff: number }[] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < nRef; j++) {
      const diff = Math.abs(sortedDet[i] - sortedRef[j]);
      if (diff <= toleranceMs) {
        edges.push({ refIdx: j, diff });
      }
    }
    edges.sort((e1, e2) => e1.diff - e2.diff || e1.refIdx - e2.refIdx);
    adj[i] = edges.map(e => e.refIdx);
  }

  const matchRef: number[] = new Array(nRef).fill(-1);
  const matchDet: number[] = new Array(nDet).fill(-1);

  function findAugmentingPath(u: number, visited: boolean[]): boolean {
    for (const v of adj[u]) {
      if (!visited[v]) {
        visited[v] = true;
        if (matchRef[v] < 0 || findAugmentingPath(matchRef[v], visited)) {
          matchRef[v] = u;
          matchDet[u] = v;
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  let matches = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < nDet; i++) {
    for (const v of adj[i]) {
      if (matchRef[v] < 0) {
        matchRef[v] = i;
        matchDet[i] = v;
        matches++;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < nDet; i++) {
    if (matchDet[i] < 0) {
      const visited = new Array(nRef).fill(false);
      if (findAugmentingPath(i, visited)) {
        matches++;
      }
    }
  }

  const rate = (matches / nRef) * 100;
  return Math.round(rate * 10) / 10;
}

/**
 * P5 Commercial Packaging & Entitlement Contract
 * Enforces strict separation between commercial feature access and scientific analytical truth.
 */

export type LicenseTier = 'trial' | 'beta' | 'personal' | 'professional' | 'academic';

export type EntitlementStatus = 'active' | 'expired' | 'grace_period' | 'revoked';

export type FeatureGateDenialReason =
  | 'TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED'
  | 'PROFILE_LIMIT_REACHED'
  | 'TRIAL_EXHAUSTED'
  | 'LICENSE_EXPIRED'
  | 'LICENSE_REVOKED'
  | 'CLOCK_ROLLBACK_DETECTED'
  | 'STALE_ENTITLEMENT_REVISION'
  | 'INVALID_SIGNATURE'
  | 'UNKNOWN_ISSUER'
  | 'ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH'
  | 'KEY_REVOKED_OR_RETIRED'
  | 'BATCH_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED'
  | 'AI_PACK_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED'
  | 'REPORT_CUSTOM_HEADER_NOT_PERMITTED';

    prior_sessions_readable: true;

  };
}

export const SCIENTIFIC_TIER_INVARIANT_DECLARATION = 
  'SCIENTIFIC_INVARIANT: License tier and payment status NEVER alter CanonicalSessionResult, ' +
  'TaskEligibility, FeatureMaturity, detected QRS peaks, computed HRV metrics, quality limits, ' +
  'or report accuracy. Paid tiers gate convenience, multi-profile scaling, and commercial rights only.';

/**
 * Checks if a requested capability is allowed for the given entitlement state.
 */
export function isCapabilityPermitted(
  state: EntitlementState,
  capability: keyof TierCapabilities
): boolean {
  if (capability === 'scientific_truth_unrestricted') {
    return true; // Always permitted under all states
  }

  // If expired or revoked, user has read-only access to existing data; gated features are denied
  if (state.is_expired || state.status === 'expired' || state.status === 'revoked') {
    return false;
  }

  return Boolean(state.capabilities[capability]);
}

/**
 * Evaluates capability access with structured denial reason.
 */
export function checkCapabilityAccess(
  state: EntitlementState,
  capability: keyof TierCapabilities
): { permitted: boolean; reason?: FeatureGateDenialReason; message?: string } {
  if (capability === 'scientific_truth_unrestricted') {
    return { permitted: true };
  }

  if (state.clock_healthy === false) {
    return {
      permitted: false,
      reason: 'CLOCK_ROLLBACK_DETECTED',
      message: 'Feature temporarily restricted due to detected system clock rollback. Please restore correct system time.'
    };
  }

  if (state.status === 'revoked') {
    return {
      permitted: false,
      reason: 'LICENSE_REVOKED',
      message: 'Active license has been revoked. Historical data remains accessible in read-only mode.'
    };
  }

  if (state.is_expired || state.status === 'expired') {
    return {
      permitted: false,
      reason: state.tier === 'trial' ? 'TRIAL_EXHAUSTED' : 'LICENSE_EXPIRED',
      message: state.tier === 'trial'
        ? 'Evaluation trial has expired. Historical data remains fully accessible.'
        : 'License has expired. Historical data remains fully accessible.'
    };
  }

  if (!state.capabilities[capability]) {
    let specificReason: FeatureGateDenialReason = 'TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED';
    if (capability === 'batch_export_allowed') specificReason = 'BATCH_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED';
    if (capability === 'ai_pack_export_allowed') specificReason = 'AI_PACK_EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED';
    if (capability === 'report_custom_header_allowed') specificReason = 'REPORT_CUSTOM_HEADER_NOT_PERMITTED';

    return {
      permitted: false,
      reason: specificReason,
      message: `Feature "${capability}" is not included in the ${state.capabilities.tier_display_name} tier.`
    };
  }

  return { permitted: true };
}
export interface TierCapabilities {
  tier: LicenseTier;
  tier_display_name: string;
  commercial_use_allowed: boolean;
  commercial_use?: boolean;
  max_athlete_profiles: number;
  max_profiles?: number;
  batch_export_allowed: boolean;
  ai_pack_export_allowed: boolean;
  report_custom_header_allowed: boolean;
  priority_support: boolean;
  scientific_truth_unrestricted: true; // Hard-coded invariant: scientific truth is never throttled
}

/**
 * Checks if user has reached the max profiles limit for their entitlement tier.
 */
export function isProfileLimitReached(
  state: EntitlementState,
  currentProfileCount: number
): boolean {
  const limit = state.capabilities.max_athlete_profiles ?? state.capabilities.max_profiles ?? 2;
  return currentProfileCount >= limit;
}

/**
 * Checks if the user is permitted to start/accept a new session analysis.
 * Expired trials or trials that reached their session quota cannot analyze new sessions.
 */
export function isNewAnalysisPermitted(state: EntitlementState): boolean {
  if (state.tier === 'trial') {
    if (state.is_expired || state.status === 'expired' || state.trial_status === 'expired') return false;
    if (typeof state.trial_sessions_analyzed === 'number' && typeof state.trial_session_limit === 'number' && state.trial_sessions_analyzed >= state.trial_session_limit) return false;
    if (typeof state.sessions_remaining === 'number' && state.sessions_remaining <= 0) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
