/**
 * Shared Formatter
 *
 * Centralized, environment-invariant formatting layer for instants, durations,
 * numbers, percentages, byte sizes, and canonical units.
 * Never implicitly defaults to host process or browser timezone.
 */

import { formatValueWithUnit, formatMachineValue, MachineUnitId } from '../canonical/UnitCatalog';
import { formatOffsetString, parseRawTimestamp } from '../canonical/TemporalContract';

export interface FormatDateTimeOptions {
  timezone?: string; // IANA zone, e.g. 'UTC', 'Europe/Moscow', 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Kolkata', or 'source_local'
  locale?: string; // e.g. 'ru-RU', 'en-US'
  includeSeconds?: boolean;
  dateStyle?: 'full' | 'long' | 'medium' | 'short';
  timeStyle?: 'full' | 'long' | 'medium' | 'short';
}

export class SharedFormatter {
  /**
   * Resolves effective IANA timezone (defaults to UTC).
   */
  public static resolveTimezone(tz?: string | null): string {
    if (!tz || tz === 'source_local' || tz === 'UTC') return 'UTC';
    try {
      Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { timeZone: tz });
      return tz;
    } catch (_) {
      return 'UTC';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resolves effective locale (defaults to ru-RU).
   */
  public static resolveLocale(loc?: string | null): string {
    if (!loc) return 'ru-RU';
    if (loc === 'ru' || loc.startsWith('ru')) return 'ru-RU';
    if (loc === 'en' || loc === 'en-US') return 'en-US';
    if (loc === 'en-GB') return 'en-GB';
    return loc;
  }

  /**
   * Formats an ISO UTC instant into a localized date and time string using an explicit timezone.
   */
  public static formatDateTime(
    instantIso: string,
    timezone = 'UTC',
    locale = 'ru-RU',
    options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
  ): string {
    if (!instantIso) return '—';
    try {
      const resolvedTz = this.resolveTimezone(timezone);
      const resolvedLoc = this.resolveLocale(locale);
      const d = new Date(instantIso);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return instantIso;

      const defaultOptions: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {
        timeZone: resolvedTz,
        year: 'numeric',
        month: '2-digit',
        day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
      };

      const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(resolvedLoc, options ? { timeZone: resolvedTz, ...options } : defaultOptions);
      return formatter.format(d);
    } catch (_) {
      return instantIso;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Formats an ISO UTC instant into a date string (YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY).
   */
  public static formatDate(instantIso: string, timezone = 'UTC', locale = 'ru-RU'): string {
    return this.formatDateTime(instantIso, timezone, locale, {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit'
    });
  }

  /**
   * Formats an ISO UTC instant into a time string (HH:MM:SS or HH:MM).
   */
  public static formatTime(
    instantIso: string,
    timezone = 'UTC',
    locale = 'ru-RU',
    withSeconds = true
  ): string {
    return this.formatDateTime(instantIso, timezone, locale, {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: withSeconds ? '2-digit' : undefined,
      hour12: false
    });
  }

  /**
   * Formats a duration in seconds into human-readable text (e.g. "5 мин 30 с" / "5 min 30 s").
   */
  public static formatDuration(seconds: number | null | undefined, locale: 'ru' | 'en' | 'ru-RU' | 'en-US' = 'ru'): string {
    if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || isNaN(seconds) || seconds < 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const isRu = typeof locale === 'string' && locale.startsWith('ru');
    const totalSec = Math.round(seconds);
    const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSec % 60;

    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (h > 0) parts.push(`${h} ${isRu ? 'ч' : 'h'}`);
    if (m > 0 || (h > 0 && s > 0)) parts.push(`${m} ${isRu ? 'мин' : 'min'}`);
    if (s > 0 || parts.length === 0) parts.push(`${s} ${isRu ? 'с' : 's'}`);

    return parts.join(' ');
  }

  /**
   * Formats a duration in seconds into clock representation (e.g. "05:30" or "01:05:30").
   */
  public static formatDurationClock(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || isNaN(seconds) || seconds < 0) {
      return '00:00';
    }
    const totalSec = Math.round(seconds);
    const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSec % 60;

    const mStr = String(m).padStart(2, '0');
    const sStr = String(s).padStart(2, '0');
    if (h > 0) {
      return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${mStr}:${sStr}`;
    }
    return `${mStr}:${sStr}`;
  }

  /**
   * Formats a decimal number with localized thousand and decimal separators.
   */
  public static formatDecimal(
    value: number | null | undefined,
    precision = 1,
    locale = 'ru-RU'
  ): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || isNaN(value)) {
      return '—';
    }
    const resolvedLoc = this.resolveLocale(locale);
    const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(resolvedLoc, {
      minimumFractionDigits: precision,
      maximumFractionDigits: precision
    });
    return formatter.format(value);
  }

  /**
   * Formats a percentage value (e.g. 15.5 -> "15,5 %" in ru-RU, "15.5%" in en-US).
   */
  public static formatPercent(
    value: number | null | undefined,
    precision = 1,
    locale = 'ru-RU'
  ): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || isNaN(value)) {
      return '—';
    }
    const isRu = locale.startsWith('ru');
    const num = this.formatDecimal(value, precision, locale);
    return isRu ? `${num}\u00A0%` : `${num}%`;
  }

  /**
   * Formats byte size into localized KB, MB, or GB.
   */
  public static formatByteSize(bytes: number | null | undefined, locale = 'ru'): string {
    if (bytes === null || bytes === undefined || isNaN(bytes) || bytes < 0) {
      return '—';
    }
    const isRu = locale.startsWith('ru');
    if (bytes < 1024) {
      return `${bytes}\u00A0${isRu ? 'байт' : 'bytes'}`;
    } else if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) {
      const kb = (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1);
      return `${kb}\u00A0${isRu ? 'КБ' : 'KB'}`;
    } else if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) {
      const mb = (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
      return `${mb}\u00A0${isRu ? 'МБ' : 'MB'}`;
    } else {
      const gb = (bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
      return `${gb}\u00A0${isRu ? 'ГБ' : 'GB'}`;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Formats a metric with its unit definition.
   */
  public static formatMetric(
    value: number | null | undefined,
    unitId: MachineUnitId,
    locale = 'ru-RU',
    options?: { precision?: number; showUnit?: boolean }
  ): string {
    return formatValueWithUnit(value, unitId, locale as any, options);
  }

  /**
   * Machine-oriented formatting for CSV and JSON exports (dot-decimal, language-neutral).
   */
  public static formatMachine(value: number | null | undefined, precision?: number): string {
    return formatMachineValue(value, precision);
  }
}

FILE: src/shared/hrZoneValidation.ts

import { CustomHeartRateZones } from './hrZones';

export interface ValidationResult {
  isValid: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export function validateCustomHeartRateZones(zones: Partial<CustomHeartRateZones> | null | undefined): ValidationResult {
  if (!zones) {
    return { isValid: false, error: 'Данные зон ЧСС отсутствуют' };
  }

  if (zones.mode === 'karvonen' || zones.mode === 'percent_hrmax') {
    return { isValid: true, error: null };
  }

  if (zones.mode !== 'custom_bpm') {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Неверный режим зон ЧСС: ${zones.mode}` };
  }

  const bounds = zones.boundariesBpm;
  if (!bounds || !Array.isArray(bounds) || bounds.length !== 6) {
    return { isValid: false, error: 'Должно быть ровно 6 границ зон ЧСС' };
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < bounds.length; i++) {
    const val = bounds[i];
    if (typeof val !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(val) || !Number.isInteger(val)) {
      return { isValid: false, error: `Каждая граница должна быть целым числом. Получено: ${val}` };
    }
    if (val < 30 || val > 240) {
      return { isValid: false, error: `Значения пульса должны быть в диапазоне 30–240 уд/мин. Ошибка на значении: ${val}` };
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < bounds.length - 1; i++) {
    if (bounds[i] >= bounds[i + 1]) {
      return { isValid: false, error: `Границы должны идти строго по возрастанию: ${bounds[i]} должно быть меньше, чем ${bounds[i + 1]}` };
    }
  }

  return { isValid: true, error: null };
}

export interface ZoneWarning {
  zoneIndex: number; // 0-based index
  zoneName: string;   // e.g. "Зона 1"
  width: number;
  message: string;
}

export function checkZoneWarnings(boundariesBpm: number[] | null | undefined): ZoneWarning[] {
  if (!boundariesBpm || !Array.isArray(boundariesBpm) || boundariesBpm.length !== 6) {
    return [];
  }
  const warnings: ZoneWarning[] = [];
  const zoneNames = ['Зона 1', 'Зона 2', 'Зона 3', 'Зона 4', 'Зона 5'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const width = boundariesBpm[i + 1] - boundariesBpm[i];
    if (width < 5) {
      warnings.push({
        zoneIndex: i,
        zoneName: zoneNames[i],
        width,
        message: `Зона слишком узкая; распределение времени по зонам может быть неинформативным. (${zoneNames[i]}: ширина ${width} уд/мин < 5)`
      });
    }
  }
  return warnings;
}

export class LongitudinalValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly code: string = 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'LongitudinalValidationError';
  }
}

export function validateLongitudinalSeriesQueryStrict(query: unknown): LongitudinalSeriesQuery {
  if (!query || typeof query !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Query must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_QUERY');
  }
  const q = query as Partial<LongitudinalSeriesQuery>;
  if (!q.profile_id || typeof q.profile_id !== 'string' || q.profile_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Query must contain a valid profile_id', 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID');
  }
  return {
    profile_id: q.profile_id.trim(),
    task_scope: q.task_scope,
    activity_type: q.activity_type,
    date_from: q.date_from,
    date_to: q.date_to,
    target_session_id: q.target_session_id,
    explicit_a_b_peer_id: q.explicit_a_b_peer_id,
    metric_set: q.metric_set,
    minimum_peers_policy: q.minimum_peers_policy || 'canonical_v1_1_min5',
    saved_view_id: q.saved_view_id,
    saved_view_revision: q.saved_view_revision,
    generation_id: q.generation_id,
    privacy_options: q.privacy_options || DEFAULT_LONGITUDINAL_PRIVACY_OPTIONS,
    cross_profile_research_mode: q.cross_profile_research_mode || false,
    selected_session_ids: Array.isArray(q.selected_session_ids) ? q.selected_session_ids : undefined,
    window_references: Array.isArray(q.window_references) ? q.window_references : undefined,
    cross_plan_provenance: Array.isArray(q.cross_plan_provenance) ? q.cross_plan_provenance : undefined,
    user_notes: typeof q.user_notes === 'string' ? q.user_notes : (q.user_notes === null ? null : undefined)
  };
}

const FORBIDDEN_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS = [
  'diagnosis',
  'better',
  'worse',
  'superior',
  'inferior',
  'pathology',
  'treatment',
  'prescription',
  'overtraining syndrome',
  'cardiac defect'
];

export function validateChangeCardStrict(card: unknown): LongitudinalChangeCard {
  if (!card || typeof card !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Change card must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_CHANGE_CARD');
  }
  const c = card as Partial<LongitudinalChangeCard>;
  if (!c.metric_key || typeof c.metric_key !== 'string') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Change card must contain metric_key', 'MISSING_METRIC_KEY');
  }
  if (c.is_diagnostic !== false) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Change card is_diagnostic flag must be strictly false', 'DIAGNOSTIC_FLAG_VIOLATION');
  }

  const validClasses: LongitudinalChangeClass[] = [
    'above_reference',
    'within_reference',
    'below_reference',
    'insufficient_history',
    'withheld',
    'not_comparable',
    'historical'
  ];

  if (!c.change_class || !validClasses.includes(c.change_class)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Invalid change_class '${c.change_class}'`, 'INVALID_CHANGE_CLASS');
  }

  // Wording safety: scan for forbidden prescriptive or diagnostic words
  const texts = [c.descriptive_summary_ru || '', c.descriptive_summary_en || ''];
  for (const text of texts) {
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    for (const term of FORBIDDEN_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS) {
      if (lower.includes(term)) {
        throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
          `Change card wording violation: contains forbidden term '${term}'`,
          'PRESCRIPTIVE_WORDING_VIOLATION'
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    metric_key: c.metric_key,
    target_value: c.target_value ?? null,
    reference_range: c.reference_range || null,
    change_class: c.change_class,
    descriptive_summary_ru: c.descriptive_summary_ru || '',
    descriptive_summary_en: c.descriptive_summary_en || '',
    limitations: Array.isArray(c.limitations) ? c.limitations : [],
    is_diagnostic: false
  };
}

export function validateLongitudinalSnapshotStrict(snapshot: unknown): LongitudinalSnapshot {
  if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Snapshot must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_SNAPSHOT');
  }
  const s = snapshot as Partial<LongitudinalSnapshot>;
  if (!s.snapshot_id || !s.profile_id || !s.query_fingerprint) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Snapshot missing required identities', 'MISSING_SNAPSHOT_IDENTITIES');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(s.ordered_session_ids) || !Array.isArray(s.ordered_observation_points)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Snapshot must contain ordered arrays', 'INVALID_ORDERED_ARRAYS');
  }
  if (!s.per_metric_baselines || typeof s.per_metric_baselines !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Snapshot must contain per_metric_baselines object', 'MISSING_BASELINES');
  }
  if (!s.change_cards || typeof s.change_cards !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Snapshot must contain change_cards object', 'MISSING_CHANGE_CARDS');
  }

  // Validate each change card
  for (const card of Object.values(s.change_cards)) {
    validateChangeCardStrict(card);
  }

  if (s.explicit_a_b_change_cards && typeof s.explicit_a_b_change_cards === 'object') {
    for (const card of Object.values(s.explicit_a_b_change_cards)) {
      validateChangeCardStrict(card);
    }
  }

  return {
    snapshot_id: s.snapshot_id,
    profile_id: s.profile_id,
    query_fingerprint: s.query_fingerprint,
    query: validateLongitudinalSeriesQueryStrict(s.query),
    ordered_session_ids: s.ordered_session_ids,
    ordered_observation_points: s.ordered_observation_points,
    per_metric_baselines: s.per_metric_baselines,
    change_cards: s.change_cards,
    target_session_id: s.target_session_id,
    explicit_a_b_peer_id: s.explicit_a_b_peer_id,
    explicit_a_b_change_cards: s.explicit_a_b_change_cards,
    policy_version: s.policy_version || '1.0.0',
    schema_version: s.schema_version || LONGITUDINAL_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    g4_episode_id: s.g4_episode_id,
    g4_series_id: s.g4_series_id,
    privacy_options: s.privacy_options || DEFAULT_LONGITUDINAL_PRIVACY_OPTIONS,
    aggregate_dependency_hash: s.aggregate_dependency_hash || '',
    is_current: typeof s.is_current === 'boolean' ? s.is_current : true,
    currentness_reason: s.currentness_reason || 'authoritative_calculation',
    created_at_utc: s.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

export function validateSavedLongitudinalViewStrict(view: unknown): SavedLongitudinalView {
  if (!view || typeof view !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Saved view must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_VIEW');
  }
  const v = view as Partial<SavedLongitudinalView>;
  if (!v.view_id || !v.name || !v.profile_id) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Saved view missing required identities', 'MISSING_VIEW_IDENTITIES');
  }
  if (typeof v.optimistic_revision !== 'number' || v.optimistic_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('optimistic_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_REVISION');
  }
  return {
    schema_version: v.schema_version || LONGITUDINAL_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    view_id: v.view_id,
    name: v.name.trim(),
    profile_id: v.profile_id.trim(),
    normalized_query: validateLongitudinalSeriesQueryStrict(v.normalized_query),
    metrics: Array.isArray(v.metrics) ? v.metrics : ['rmssd', 'avg_hr'],
    display_preferences: v.display_preferences || {},
    current_snapshot_id: v.current_snapshot_id || null,
    optimistic_revision: v.optimistic_revision,
    is_retired: Boolean(v.is_retired),
    selected_session_ids: Array.isArray(v.selected_session_ids) ? v.selected_session_ids : undefined,
    window_references: Array.isArray(v.window_references) ? v.window_references : undefined,
    cross_plan_provenance: Array.isArray(v.cross_plan_provenance) ? v.cross_plan_provenance : undefined,
    user_notes: typeof v.user_notes === 'string' ? v.user_notes : (v.user_notes === null ? null : undefined),
    created_at_utc: v.created_at_utc || new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at_utc: v.updated_at_utc || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

export function validateSavedReviewLibraryQueryStrict(query: unknown): SavedReviewLibraryQuery {
  if (!query || typeof query !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Library query must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_LIBRARY_QUERY');
  }
  const q = query as Partial<SavedReviewLibraryQuery>;

  let search: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof q.search === 'string') {
    const trimmed = q.search.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 100) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Search string exceeds maximum length of 100 characters', 'SEARCH_TOO_LONG');
    }
    search = trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : undefined;
  }

  const validTypes: SavedReviewLibraryQuery['type_filter'][] = ['all', 'manual', 'per_plan', 'cross_plan', 'unknown'];
  const type_filter = q.type_filter && validTypes.includes(q.type_filter) ? q.type_filter : 'all';

  const validStatuses: SavedReviewLibraryQuery['status_filter'][] = ['all', 'active', 'retired'];
  const status_filter = q.status_filter && validStatuses.includes(q.status_filter) ? q.status_filter : 'active';

  const validCurrentness: SavedReviewLibraryQuery['currentness_filter'][] = ['all', 'current', 'stale', 'source_unavailable', 'retired', 'unknown'];
  const currentness_filter = q.currentness_filter && validCurrentness.includes(q.currentness_filter) ? q.currentness_filter : 'all';

  let page_size = 10;
  if (typeof q.page_size === 'number') {
    if (Number.isFinite(q.page_size)) {
      page_size = Math.min(Math.max(Math.floor(q.page_size), 1), 50);
    }
  }

  const sort_direction: 'desc' | 'asc' = q.sort_direction === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';

  let cursor: string | null = null;
  if (typeof q.cursor === 'string' && q.cursor.trim() !== '') {
    cursor = q.cursor.trim();
  }

  return {
    profile_id: typeof q.profile_id === 'string' ? q.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    search,
    type_filter,
    status_filter,
    currentness_filter,
    favorite_only: Boolean(q.favorite_only),
    cursor,
    page_size,
    sort_direction
  };
}

export function validateToggleSavedReviewFavoriteRequestStrict(req: unknown): ToggleSavedReviewFavoriteRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Favorite request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_FAVORITE_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<ToggleSavedReviewFavoriteRequest>;
  if (!r.view_id || typeof r.view_id !== 'string' || r.view_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('view_id is required', 'MISSING_VIEW_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.is_favorite !== 'boolean') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('is_favorite must be a boolean', 'INVALID_FAVORITE_FLAG');
  }
  if (!r.idempotency_key || typeof r.idempotency_key !== 'string' || r.idempotency_key.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('idempotency_key is required', 'MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY');
  }
  if (r.expected_curation_revision !== undefined && (typeof r.expected_curation_revision !== 'number' || r.expected_curation_revision < 1)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_curation_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_CURATION_REVISION');
  }

  return {
    view_id: r.view_id.trim(),
    is_favorite: r.is_favorite,
    idempotency_key: r.idempotency_key.trim(),
    expected_curation_revision: r.expected_curation_revision
  };
}

export function validateArchiveSavedReviewRequestStrict(req: unknown): ArchiveSavedReviewRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Archive request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_ARCHIVE_REQUEST');

  if (!r.view_id || typeof r.view_id !== 'string' || r.view_id.trim() === '') {

  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');

  };

export function validateCreateReviewCollectionRequestStrict(req: unknown): CreateReviewCollectionRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Create collection request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_COLLECTION_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<CreateReviewCollectionRequest>;
  if (!r.profile_id || typeof r.profile_id !== 'string' || r.profile_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('profile_id is required', 'MISSING_PROFILE_ID');
  }
  if (!r.title || typeof r.title !== 'string' || r.title.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('title is required and cannot be empty', 'EMPTY_TITLE');
  }
  const title = r.title.trim();
  if (title.length > 120) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('title exceeds maximum length of 120 characters', 'TITLE_TOO_LONG');
  }
  let description: string | null = null;
  if (typeof r.description === 'string') {
    const trimmedDesc = r.description.trim();
    if (trimmedDesc.length > 500) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('description exceeds maximum length of 500 characters', 'DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG');
    }
    description = trimmedDesc.length > 0 ? trimmedDesc : null;
  }
  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;

  return {
    profile_id: r.profile_id.trim(),
    title,
    description,
    idempotency_key
  };
}

export function validateSetReviewCollectionMembersRequestStrict(req: unknown): SetReviewCollectionMembersRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Set collection members request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_MEMBERS_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<SetReviewCollectionMembersRequest>;
  if (!r.collection_id || typeof r.collection_id !== 'string' || r.collection_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('collection_id is required', 'MISSING_COLLECTION_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(r.members)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('members must be an array', 'INVALID_MEMBERS_ARRAY');
  }
  if (r.members.length > 100) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Collection members exceed maximum limit of 100', 'MEMBERS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');
  }
  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const sanitizedMembers: SetReviewCollectionMemberItem[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < r.members.length; i++) {
    const m = r.members[i];
    if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Member at index ${i} must be an object`, 'INVALID_MEMBER_ITEM');
    }
    if (!m.view_id || typeof m.view_id !== 'string' || m.view_id.trim() === '') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Member at index ${i} missing view_id`, 'MISSING_VIEW_ID');
    }
    const mode: ReviewCollectionReferenceMode = m.reference_mode === 'pin_revision' ? 'pin_revision' : 'follow_latest';
    const viewId = m.view_id.trim();
    let pinnedId: string | null = null;
    let pinnedNum: number | null = null;

    if (mode === 'pin_revision') {
      if (typeof m.pinned_revision_id === 'string' && m.pinned_revision_id.trim() !== '') {
        pinnedId = m.pinned_revision_id.trim();
      }
      if (typeof m.pinned_revision_number === 'number' && Number.isFinite(m.pinned_revision_number) && m.pinned_revision_number >= 1) {
        pinnedNum = Math.floor(m.pinned_revision_number);
      }
      if (!pinnedId && pinnedNum === null) {
        throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
          `Member at index ${i} with mode pin_revision requires pinned_revision_id or pinned_revision_number`,
          'MISSING_PINNED_REVISION'
        );
      }
    }

    const key = `${viewId}:${mode}:${pinnedId || (pinnedNum !== null ? `rev#${pinnedNum}` : 'latest')}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
        `Duplicate member in collection: view '${viewId}' with mode '${mode}' and revision '${pinnedId || pinnedNum || 'latest'}' already exists`,
        'DUPLICATE_COLLECTION_MEMBER'
      );
    }
    seen.add(key);

    sanitizedMembers.push({
      view_id: viewId,
      reference_mode: mode,
      pinned_revision_id: pinnedId,
      pinned_revision_number: pinnedNum
    });
  }

  return {
    collection_id: r.collection_id.trim(),
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    expected_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_revision),
    members: sanitizedMembers,
    idempotency_key
  };
}

  }
  if (!r.view_id || typeof r.view_id !== 'string' || r.view_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('view_id is required', 'MISSING_VIEW_ID');
  }
  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : `auto-idem-${randomUUID()}`;

  const mode: ReviewCollectionReferenceMode = r.reference_mode === 'pin_revision' ? 'pin_revision' : 'follow_latest';

  let pinnedNum: number | null = null;
  if (mode === 'pin_revision') {

  return {

export function validateCollectionComparisonRequestStrict(req: unknown): CollectionComparisonRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Comparison request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_COMPARISON_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<CollectionComparisonRequest>;
  if (!r.collection_id || typeof r.collection_id !== 'string' || r.collection_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('collection_id is required', 'MISSING_COLLECTION_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_collection_revision !== 'number' || r.expected_collection_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_collection_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(r.member_references)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('member_references must be an array', 'INVALID_MEMBER_REFERENCES');
  }
  if (r.member_references.length < 2 || r.member_references.length > 6) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
      `Collection comparison requires between 2 and 6 members, received ${r.member_references.length}`,
      'INVALID_MEMBER_COUNT'
    );
  }

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const sanitizedRefs: CollectionComparisonMemberReference[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < r.member_references.length; i++) {
    const item = r.member_references[i];
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Member reference at index ${i} must be an object`, 'INVALID_MEMBER_REFERENCE');
    }
    if (!item.view_id || typeof item.view_id !== 'string' || item.view_id.trim() === '') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Member reference at index ${i} missing view_id`, 'MISSING_VIEW_ID');
    }
    const viewId = item.view_id.trim();
    const mode: ReviewCollectionReferenceMode = item.reference_mode === 'pin_revision' ? 'pin_revision' : 'follow_latest';
    let pinnedId: string | null = null;
    let pinnedNum: number | null = null;

    if (mode === 'pin_revision') {
      if (typeof item.pinned_revision_id === 'string' && item.pinned_revision_id.trim() !== '') {
        pinnedId = item.pinned_revision_id.trim();
      }
      if (typeof item.pinned_revision_number === 'number' && Number.isFinite(item.pinned_revision_number) && item.pinned_revision_number >= 1) {
        pinnedNum = Math.floor(item.pinned_revision_number);
      }
    }

    const key = `${viewId}:${mode}:${pinnedId || (pinnedNum !== null ? `rev#${pinnedNum}` : 'latest')}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError(
        `Duplicate member reference in comparison: view '${viewId}' with mode '${mode}' and revision '${pinnedId || pinnedNum || 'latest'}' already selected`,
        'DUPLICATE_COMPARISON_MEMBER'
      );
    }
    seen.add(key);

    sanitizedRefs.push({
      view_id: viewId,
      reference_mode: mode,
      pinned_revision_id: pinnedId,
      pinned_revision_number: pinnedNum
    });
  }

  return {
    collection_id: r.collection_id.trim(),
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    expected_collection_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_collection_revision),
    member_references: sanitizedRefs,
    privacy_options: r.privacy_options
  };
}

export function validateCollectionComparisonExportRequestStrict(req: unknown): CollectionComparisonExportRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Comparison export request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_EXPORT_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<CollectionComparisonExportRequest>;
  if (!r.collection_id || typeof r.collection_id !== 'string' || r.collection_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('collection_id is required', 'MISSING_COLLECTION_ID');
  }
  if (!r.format || !['html', 'csv', 'json'].includes(r.format)) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`Invalid export format '${r.format}'. Must be 'html', 'csv', or 'json'`, 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_collection_revision !== 'number' || r.expected_collection_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_collection_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }
  if (!r.expected_dependency_digest || typeof r.expected_dependency_digest !== 'string' || r.expected_dependency_digest.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_dependency_digest is required', 'MISSING_DEPENDENCY_DIGEST');
  }
  if (!r.resolved_member_revisions || typeof r.resolved_member_revisions !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('resolved_member_revisions object is required', 'MISSING_RESOLVED_REVISIONS');
  }
  const revKeys = Object.keys(r.resolved_member_revisions);
  if (revKeys.length < 2 || revKeys.length > 6) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError(`resolved_member_revisions must contain between 2 and 6 views, found ${revKeys.length}`, 'INVALID_MEMBER_COUNT');
  }

  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : undefined;

  return {
    collection_id: r.collection_id.trim(),
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    format: r.format as ProgressReviewReportFormat,
    expected_collection_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_collection_revision),
    expected_dependency_digest: r.expected_dependency_digest.trim(),
    resolved_member_revisions: r.resolved_member_revisions,
    member_references: Array.isArray(r.member_references) ? r.member_references : undefined,
    privacy_options: r.privacy_options,
    idempotency_key
  };
}

    collection_id: typeof r.collection_id === 'string' && r.collection_id.trim() !== '' ? r.collection_id.trim() : undefined,
    format,

  };
}

export function sanitizeReportReadingTags(rawTags: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(rawTags)) return [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const sanitized: string[] = [];

  for (const item of rawTags) {
    if (typeof item !== 'string') continue;
    const trimmed = item.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    // Allow unicode letters/numbers, dashes, underscores, spaces (max 50 chars)
    const cleaned = trimmed.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_\-\s]/gu, '').slice(0, 50).trim();
    if (!cleaned) continue;
    if (!seen.has(cleaned)) {
      seen.add(cleaned);
      sanitized.push(cleaned);
      if (sanitized.length >= 10) break; // Max 10 tags
    }
  }

  return sanitized;
}

export function validateUpdateReportReadingNoteRequestStrict(req: unknown): UpdateReportReadingNoteRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Update reading note request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_NOTE_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<UpdateReportReadingNoteRequest>;

  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_revision) || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }

  let note: string | null = null;
  if (r.note !== undefined && r.note !== null) {
    if (typeof r.note !== 'string') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('note must be a string or null', 'INVALID_NOTE_TEXT');
    }
    const trimmed = r.note.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 4000) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('note text exceeds maximum length of 4000 characters', 'NOTE_TEXT_TOO_LONG');
    }
    note = trimmed === '' ? null : trimmed;
  }

  if (r.tags !== undefined && r.tags !== null) {
    if (!Array.isArray(r.tags)) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('tags must be an array of strings', 'INVALID_TAGS');
    }
    if (r.tags.length > 10) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Maximum 10 tags permitted', 'TOO_MANY_TAGS');
    }
  }

  const tags = r.tags !== undefined && r.tags !== null ? sanitizeReportReadingTags(r.tags) : undefined;

  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : undefined;

  return {
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' && r.profile_id.trim() !== '' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    expected_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_revision),
    note,
    tags,
    idempotency_key
  };
}

export function validateClearReportReadingNoteRequestStrict(req: unknown): ClearReportReadingNoteRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Clear reading note request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_NOTE_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<ClearReportReadingNoteRequest>;

  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_revision) || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }

  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : undefined;

  return {
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' && r.profile_id.trim() !== '' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    expected_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_revision),
    idempotency_key
  };
}

export function validateSetReportReadingStateRequestStrict(req: unknown): SetReportReadingStateRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Set reading state request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_NOTE_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Partial<SetReportReadingStateRequest>;

  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_revision) || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }

  if (r.reading_state !== 'not_marked' && r.reading_state !== 'read_by_user') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError("reading_state must be either 'not_marked' or 'read_by_user'", 'INVALID_READING_STATE');
  }

  const idempotency_key = (typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== '')
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : undefined;

  return {
    profile_id: typeof r.profile_id === 'string' && r.profile_id.trim() !== '' ? r.profile_id.trim() : undefined,
    reading_state: r.reading_state,
    expected_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_revision),
    idempotency_key
  };
}

}

export function validateProfileReportReadingInboxQueryStrict(req: unknown): ProfileReportReadingInboxQuery {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Reading inbox query must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_QUERY');
  }
  const r = req as Record<string, unknown>;

  let profile_id: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.profile_id === 'string' && r.profile_id.trim() !== '') {
    const trimmed = r.profile_id.trim();
    if (trimmed === 'all' || trimmed === 'default') {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError("Special profile IDs 'all' and 'default' are strictly prohibited", 'INVALID_PROFILE_ID');
    }
    profile_id = trimmed;
  }

  let reading_state: ReportReadingState | 'all' = 'all';
  if (typeof r.reading_state === 'string' && r.reading_state.trim() !== '') {
    const rs = r.reading_state.trim();
    if (rs === 'read_by_user' || rs === 'not_marked' || rs === 'all') {
      reading_state = rs;
    } else {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError("reading_state must be 'read_by_user', 'not_marked', or 'all'", 'INVALID_READING_STATE');
    }
  }

  let tag: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.tag === 'string' && r.tag.trim() !== '') {
    const cleaned = r.tag.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_\-\s]/gu, '').slice(0, 50).trim();
    if (cleaned) {
      tag = cleaned;
    }
  }

  let collection_id: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.collection_id === 'string' && r.collection_id.trim() !== '') {
    collection_id = r.collection_id.trim();
  }

  const allowedFormats: Array<ProgressReviewReportFormat | 'all'> = ['html', 'csv', 'json', 'all'];
  let format: ProgressReviewReportFormat | 'all' | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.format === 'string' && r.format.trim() !== '') {
    const fmt = r.format.trim() as ProgressReviewReportFormat | 'all';
    if (allowedFormats.includes(fmt)) {
      format = fmt;
    } else {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError("format must be 'html', 'csv', 'json', or 'all'", 'INVALID_FORMAT');
    }
  }

  const allowedStatuses: Array<CollectionComparisonReportStatus | 'all'> = [
    'current',
    'historical',
    'unavailable',
    'integrity_failed',
    'unknown',
    'all'
  ];
  let status: CollectionComparisonReportStatus | 'all' | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.status === 'string' && r.status.trim() !== '') {
    const st = r.status.trim() as CollectionComparisonReportStatus | 'all';
    if (allowedStatuses.includes(st)) {
      status = st;
    } else {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError("status must be 'current', 'historical', 'unavailable', 'integrity_failed', 'unknown', or 'all'", 'INVALID_STATUS');
    }
  }

  let from_date: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.from_date === 'string' && r.from_date.trim() !== '') {
    from_date = r.from_date.trim();
  }

  let to_date: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.to_date === 'string' && r.to_date.trim() !== '') {
    to_date = r.to_date.trim();
  }

  let search_term: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.search_term === 'string' && r.search_term.trim() !== '') {
    const trimmed = r.search_term.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 100) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('search_term must not exceed 100 characters', 'INVALID_SEARCH_TERM');
    }
    search_term = trimmed;
  }

  let limit = 20;
  if (r.limit !== undefined && r.limit !== null) {
    const parsedLimit = typeof r.limit === 'number' ? r.limit : parseInt(String(r.limit), 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsedLimit) || parsedLimit < 1) {
      throw new LongitudinalValidationError('limit must be a positive integer', 'INVALID_LIMIT');
    }
    limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Math.floor(parsedLimit)));
  }

  let cursor: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (typeof r.cursor === 'string' && r.cursor.trim() !== '') {
    cursor = r.cursor.trim();
  }

  return {
    profile_id,
    reading_state,
    tag,
    collection_id,
    format,
    status,
    from_date,
    to_date,
    search_term,
    limit,
    cursor
  };
}

export function validateReportCheckInLinkPreviewRequestStrict(req: unknown): ReportCheckInLinkPreviewRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Preview request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_PREVIEW_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof r.report_id !== 'string' || r.report_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('report_id is required', 'MISSING_REPORT_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.slot_id !== 'string' || r.slot_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('slot_id is required', 'MISSING_SLOT_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.plan_id !== 'string' || r.plan_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('plan_id is required', 'MISSING_PLAN_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_collection_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_collection_revision) || r.expected_collection_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_collection_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_COLLECTION_REVISION');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_plan_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_plan_revision) || r.expected_plan_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_plan_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_PLAN_REVISION');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_slot_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_slot_revision) || r.expected_slot_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_slot_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_SLOT_REVISION');
  }

  return {
    report_id: r.report_id.trim(),
    slot_id: r.slot_id.trim(),
    plan_id: r.plan_id.trim(),
    expected_collection_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_collection_revision),
    expected_plan_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_plan_revision),
    expected_slot_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_slot_revision),
    acknowledge_historical_report: Boolean(r.acknowledge_historical_report)
  };
}

export function validateConfirmReportCheckInLinkRequestStrict(req: unknown): ConfirmReportCheckInLinkRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Confirm request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_CONFIRM_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof r.report_id !== 'string' || r.report_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('report_id is required', 'MISSING_REPORT_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.manifest_id !== 'string' || r.manifest_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('manifest_id is required', 'MISSING_MANIFEST_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_report_sha256 !== 'string' || r.expected_report_sha256.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_report_sha256 is required', 'MISSING_REPORT_SHA256');
  }
  if (typeof r.collection_id !== 'string' || r.collection_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('collection_id is required', 'MISSING_COLLECTION_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_collection_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_collection_revision) || r.expected_collection_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_collection_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_COLLECTION_REVISION');
  }
  if (typeof r.plan_id !== 'string' || r.plan_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('plan_id is required', 'MISSING_PLAN_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.slot_id !== 'string' || r.slot_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('slot_id is required', 'MISSING_SLOT_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_plan_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_plan_revision) || r.expected_plan_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_plan_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_PLAN_REVISION');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_slot_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_slot_revision) || r.expected_slot_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_slot_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_SLOT_REVISION');
  }
  if (typeof r.preview_digest !== 'string' || r.preview_digest.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('preview_digest is required', 'MISSING_PREVIEW_DIGEST');
  }
  if (typeof r.idempotency_key !== 'string' || r.idempotency_key.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('idempotency_key is required', 'MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY');
  }

  return {
    report_id: r.report_id.trim(),
    manifest_id: r.manifest_id.trim(),
    expected_report_sha256: r.expected_report_sha256.trim().toLowerCase(),
    collection_id: r.collection_id.trim(),
    expected_collection_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_collection_revision),
    plan_id: r.plan_id.trim(),
    slot_id: r.slot_id.trim(),
    expected_plan_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_plan_revision),
    expected_slot_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_slot_revision),
    preview_digest: r.preview_digest.trim(),
    acknowledge_historical_report: Boolean(r.acknowledge_historical_report),
    idempotency_key: r.idempotency_key.trim()
  };
}

export function validateSoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkRequestStrict(req: unknown): SoftUnlinkReportCheckInLinkRequest {
  if (!req || typeof req !== 'object') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('Unlink request must be a non-null object', 'INVALID_UNLINK_REQUEST');
  }
  const r = req as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof r.link_id !== 'string' || r.link_id.trim() === '') {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('link_id is required', 'MISSING_LINK_ID');
  }
  if (typeof r.expected_revision !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(r.expected_revision) || r.expected_revision < 1) {
    throw new LongitudinalValidationError('expected_revision must be an integer >= 1', 'INVALID_EXPECTED_REVISION');
  }

  const unlink_reason = typeof r.unlink_reason === 'string' && r.unlink_reason.trim() !== ''
    ? r.unlink_reason.trim().slice(0, 500)
    : undefined;

  const idempotency_key = typeof r.idempotency_key === 'string' && r.idempotency_key.trim() !== ''
    ? r.idempotency_key.trim()
    : undefined;

  return {
    link_id: r.link_id.trim(),
    expected_revision: Math.floor(r.expected_revision),
    unlink_reason,
    idempotency_key
  };
}

export interface MethodologyProvenance {
  // Stored session provenance
  methodology_version: string;
  algorithm_version: string;
  qc_version: string;
  hrv_source: string;
  metric_source: string;

  // Output schema provenance
  report_schema_version: string;
  session_metrics_csv_schema_version: string;
  rr_csv_schema_version: string;
  consultation_bundle_schema_version: string;
  llm_pack_schema_version: string;
  snapshot_schema_version: string;

  // Resolution status
  provenance_status: 'stored' | 'exact_registry_match' | 'legacy_unknown';
}

export const CANONICAL_METHOD_VERSION = '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD';

export const METHODOLOGY_REGISTRY: Record<string, Omit<MethodologyProvenance, 'provenance_status'>> = {
  '2.0': {
    methodology_version: '2.0',
    algorithm_version: '2.0',
    qc_version: '2.0',
    hrv_source: 'polar_h10',
    metric_source: 'polar_h10',
    report_schema_version: '1.0.1',
    session_metrics_csv_schema_version: '1.0.1',
    rr_csv_schema_version: '1.0.1',
    consultation_bundle_schema_version: '1.0.1',
    llm_pack_schema_version: '1.0.1',
    snapshot_schema_version: '1.0.1'
  },
  '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD': {
    methodology_version: '1.2.0',
    algorithm_version: '1.2.0-TimeDomain-SampleSD',
    qc_version: '1.2.0',
    hrv_source: 'polar_h10',
    metric_source: 'polar_h10',
    report_schema_version: '1.2.0',
    session_metrics_csv_schema_version: '1.2.0',
    rr_csv_schema_version: '1.2.0',
    consultation_bundle_schema_version: '1.2.0',
    llm_pack_schema_version: '1.2.0',
    snapshot_schema_version: '1.2.0'
  }
};

/**
 * Resolves methodology, algorithm, QC, and report schema versions.
 * Status tags:
 * - 'stored': read directly from database.
 * - 'exact_registry_match': matched against METHODOLOGY_REGISTRY.
 * - 'legacy_unknown': fallback for generic legacy sessions.
 */
export function getSessionProvenance(hrvVersion: string | null | undefined): MethodologyProvenance {
  if (!hrvVersion) {
    return {
      methodology_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      algorithm_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      qc_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      hrv_source: 'legacy_unknown',
      metric_source: 'legacy_unknown',
      report_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      session_metrics_csv_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      rr_csv_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      consultation_bundle_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      llm_pack_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      snapshot_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
      provenance_status: 'legacy_unknown'
    };
  }

  const match = METHODOLOGY_REGISTRY[hrvVersion];
  if (match) {
    return {
      ...match,
      provenance_status: 'exact_registry_match'
    };
  }

  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)+/.test(hrvVersion)) {
    return {
      methodology_version: hrvVersion,
      algorithm_version: hrvVersion,
      qc_version: hrvVersion,
      hrv_source: 'polar_h10',
      metric_source: 'polar_h10',
      report_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      session_metrics_csv_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      rr_csv_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      consultation_bundle_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      llm_pack_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      snapshot_schema_version: '1.0.1',
      provenance_status: 'stored'
    };
  }

  return {
    methodology_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    algorithm_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    qc_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    hrv_source: 'legacy_unknown',
    metric_source: 'legacy_unknown',
    report_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    session_metrics_csv_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    rr_csv_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    consultation_bundle_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    llm_pack_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    snapshot_schema_version: 'legacy_unknown',
    provenance_status: 'legacy_unknown'
  };
}

export interface PackPlan {
  // Pre-generation fields (must be integers)
  estimated_text_characters: number;
  estimated_text_bytes: number;
  estimated_binary_bytes: number;
  estimated_uncompressed_bytes: number;
  estimated_zip_bytes: number;

  // Post-generation fields (must be integers, populated after compilation)
  actual_text_characters?: number;
  actual_text_bytes?: number;
  actual_binary_bytes?: number;
  actual_uncompressed_bytes?: number;
  actual_zip_bytes?: number;

  // General metadata
  candidate_event_count: number;
  exact_duplicate_count: number;
  cluster_count: number;
  full_signal_member_count: number;
  representative_png_count: number;
  event_table_count: number;
  duplicate_derived_files_avoided: number;

  // Plan components
  plannedFiles: string[];
}

/**
 * LEGACY DORMANT COMPATIBILITY ADAPTER ONLY.
 * DO NOT USE FOR SCIENTIFIC AUTHORITY OR ACTIVE PRODUCTION OUTPUTS.
 * Canonical authority is CanonicalPresentationAdapter / CanonicalSessionResult.
 */

import { makeEcgRrAgreementInput, getEcgRrAgreementPresentation, EcgRrAgreementPresentation } from './ecgRrAgreement';
import { getBaselinePresentation, BaselinePresentation } from './baselineModel';
import { getSourceMode, getDriftAnalysis, CardiacDriftAnalysis } from './provenance';

export interface CanonicalParitySummary {
  session_id: string;
  
  // 1. ECG / RR agreement state
  ecg_rr_agreement: {
    status_category: 'available' | 'unavailable' | 'quality_limited' | 'insufficient_data' | 'no_ecg_data' | 'not_evaluated';
    value_percent: number | null;
    display_value: string;
    unit: string;
    eligibility_status: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible' | 'insufficient_data';
    presentation: EcgRrAgreementPresentation;
  };

  // 2. Baseline state
  baseline_state: {
    status_category: 'eligible' | 'not_eligible' | 'insufficient_data' | 'baseline_not_established' | 'incompatible_activity' | 'stale_baseline';
    source: 'personal_activity_specific' | 'personal_global' | 'reference_fallback' | 'unavailable';
    sessions_used: number;
    sessions_required: number;
    availability_reason: string;
    baseline_presentation: BaselinePresentation;
  };

  // 3. Quality state
  quality_state: {
    overall_score: number | null;
    display_score: string;
    hrv_quality_qualification: 'quality_optimal' | 'quality_eligible' | 'quality_limited' | 'quality_unverified' | 'insufficient_data' | 'quality_unknown';
    is_hrv_valid: boolean;
    hrv_invalid_reason: string | null;
    ecg_clipping_seconds: number | null;
    ecg_noise_ratio: number | null;
    acc_motion_severity: string | null;
    monotonicity_status: string | null;
    missing_samples_count: number | null;
    duplicate_timestamps_count: number | null;
  };

  // 4. Provenance
  provenance: {
    source_mode: 'polar_sensor_logger_export' | 'imported_file' | 'sdk_mode' | 'unknown';
    hrv_version: string;
    device_id_masked: string;
  };

  // 5. Data limitations & Wording
  limitations: {
    reliable_text: string;
    limited_text: string;
    warning_text: string;
    limit_reasons: string[];
  };

  // 6. Cardiac Drift Analysis
  cardiac_drift: CardiacDriftAnalysis;

  // 7. Non-diagnostic safety claim
  safety_claim: string;
}

export function maskDeviceId(deviceId: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!deviceId) return '—';
  if (deviceId.length <= 4) return deviceId;
  return deviceId.substring(0, 4) + '****';
}

export function getCanonicalParitySummary(options: {
  session: {
    id: string;
    device_id?: string | null;
    overall_quality_score?: number | null;
    duration_seconds: number;
  } | null | undefined;
  qcMetrics: {
    ecg_rr_consistency?: number | null;
    ecg_rr_match_metrics_json?: string | null;
    ecg_clipping_seconds?: number | null;
    ecg_noise_ratio?: number | null;
    acc_motion_severity?: string | null;
    monotonicity_status?: string | null;
    missing_samples_count?: number | null;
    duplicate_timestamps_count?: number | null;
  } | null | undefined;
  analyticsMetrics: {
    hrv_quality?: string | null;
    hrv_source?: string | null;
    hrv_version?: string | null;
    hr_drift_ratio?: number | null;
    hrv_quality_json?: string | null;
  } | null | undefined;
  signalFiles?: { filename?: string; signal_type?: string }[] | null | undefined;
  trends?: any;
  activityType?: string | null | undefined;
}): CanonicalParitySummary {
  const { session, qcMetrics, analyticsMetrics, signalFiles, trends, activityType } = options;

  const sessionId = session?.id || 'unknown_session';
  const score = session?.overall_quality_score ?? null;
  const displayScore = score !== null ? `${Math.round(score)}%` : '—';

  // 1. ECG/RR agreement
  const agreementInput = makeEcgRrAgreementInput(qcMetrics);
  const agreementPres = getEcgRrAgreementPresentation(agreementInput);

  let agreementCategory: CanonicalParitySummary['ecg_rr_agreement']['status_category'] = 'available';
  if (!qcMetrics || qcMetrics.ecg_rr_consistency == null) {
    agreementCategory = 'no_ecg_data';
  } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'no_ecg_data') {
    agreementCategory = 'no_ecg_data';
  } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'insufficient_data') {
    agreementCategory = 'insufficient_data';
  } else if (agreementPres.availabilityReasonKey === 'quality_limited') {
    agreementCategory = 'quality_limited';
  } else if (agreementPres.availabilityStatus === 'unavailable') {
    agreementCategory = 'unavailable';
  }

  // 2. Baseline state
  const baselinePres = getBaselinePresentation(trends, 'rmssd', null);
  let baselineCategory: CanonicalParitySummary['baseline_state']['status_category'] = 'eligible';
  if (!trends || !trends.personal_baseline_available) {
    if (trends?.baseline_source === 'incompatible_activity') {
      baselineCategory = 'incompatible_activity';
    } else if (trends?.baseline_source === 'stale_baseline') {
      baselineCategory = 'stale_baseline';
    } else {
      baselineCategory = 'baseline_not_established';
    }
  }

  // 3. Quality state & qualification
  let isHrvValid = true;
  let hrvInvalidReason: string | null = null;

  if (!analyticsMetrics || !analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality) {
    isHrvValid = false;
    hrvInvalidReason = 'quality_unknown';
  } else if (analyticsMetrics.hrv_source === 'unavailable') {
    isHrvValid = false;
    hrvInvalidReason = 'legacy_metadata_missing';
  }

  if (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality_json) {
    try {
      JSON.parse(analyticsMetrics.hrv_quality_json);
    } catch (_) {
      isHrvValid = false;
      hrvInvalidReason = 'malformed_metrics_json';
    }
  }

  let hrvQualification: CanonicalParitySummary['quality_state']['hrv_quality_qualification'] = 'quality_eligible';
  if (!isHrvValid) {
    hrvQualification = 'insufficient_data';
  } else if (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_limited') {
    hrvQualification = 'quality_limited';
  } else if (analyticsMetrics?.hrv_quality === 'quality_unverified') {
    hrvQualification = 'quality_unverified';
  } else if (score !== null && score >= 80 && (agreementPres.value ?? 0) >= 80) {
    hrvQualification = 'quality_optimal';
  }

  // 4. Data limitations & Wording
  const limitReasons: string[] = [];
  let reliableText = '';
  let limitedText = '';
  let warningText = '';

  const consistencyRatio = agreementPres.value !== null ? (agreementPres.value / 100) : (qcMetrics?.ecg_rr_consistency ?? null);

  if (!isHrvValid) {
    if (hrvInvalidReason === 'quality_unknown') {
      warningText = 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Качество ВСР неизвестно (quality_unknown). Метрики ВСР недостоверны. Рекомендуется повторный анализ сессии.';
    } else if (hrvInvalidReason === 'malformed_metrics_json') {
      warningText = 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Сериализованные метрики повреждены. Автоматический анализ ВСР недоступен.';
    } else {
      warningText = 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Отсутствуют метаданные ВСР (legacy_metadata_missing). Метрики ВСР недостоверны. Рекомендуется повторный анализ сессии.';
    }
    reliableText = '• Регистрация пульса на доступных участках записи.';
    limitedText = '• Физиологическая интерпретация ВСР невозможна. Требуется повторный анализ записи.';
    limitReasons.push('hrv_quality_invalid');
  } else {
    if (hrvQualification === 'quality_limited') {
      warningText = 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Точность показателей ВСР ограничена качеством записи (Ограничено качеством). Показатели ВСР рассчитаны справочно и не подходят для точного анализа тренда.';
      limitedText = '• Показатели RMSSD/SDNN рассчитаны по зашумленному сигналу (использовать с осторожностью) и исключены из личного baseline.';
      reliableText = '• Общий тренд ЧСС и распределение зон нагрузки.\n• Текущая сессия имеет ограниченное качество ВСР (Ограничено качеством).\n• HRV/ВСР тренды показаны справочно; интерпретация ограничена качеством текущей записи и сопоставимостью условий.';
      limitReasons.push('hrv_quality_limited');
    } else if (score !== null && score >= 80 && consistencyRatio !== null && consistencyRatio >= 0.8) {
      reliableText = '• Базовые показатели ВСР и ЧСС рассчитаны по каноническому протоколу v1.1.\n• Кандидатные ритмические события носят сугубо ознакомительный характер.';
    } else if (score !== null && score >= 50) {
      reliableText = '• Средняя ЧСС может использоваться уверенно.\n• HRV/ВСР тренды показаны справочно; интерпретация ограничена качеством текущей записи.';
      limitedText = '• Точечные показатели ВСР (RMSSD, SDNN) имеют повышенную погрешность из-за шума или пропусков.';
    } else {
      reliableText = '• Средняя ЧСС на стабильных участках записи.';
      limitedText = '• Ограничения по качеству сигнала: сниженный технический индекс качества записи.\n• Показатели ВСР имеют повышенную погрешность.';
      limitReasons.push('low_overall_quality_score');
    }

    if (qcMetrics) {
      if ((qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? 0) > 5) {
        limitReasons.push('ecg_clipping');
        limitedText += `\n• Обнаружен клиппинг сигнала ЭКГ (${qcMetrics.ecg_clipping_seconds!.toFixed(1)} сек) - потеря амплитуды.`;
      }
      if ((qcMetrics.ecg_noise_ratio ?? 0) > 0.1) {
        limitReasons.push('ecg_high_noise');
        limitedText += `\n• Повышенный уровень шума ЭКГ (${(qcMetrics.ecg_noise_ratio! * 100).toFixed(0)}% времени).`;
      }
      if (qcMetrics.acc_motion_severity === 'high') {
        limitReasons.push('acc_motion_high');
        limitedText += '\n• Высокая интенсивность движений (артефакты ускорения) искажает запись ЭКГ.';
      }
      if (consistencyRatio !== null && consistencyRatio < 0.1) {
        limitReasons.push('ecg_rr_mismatch_critical');
        warningText = warningText ? `${warningText}\nВНИМАНИЕ: Низкая согласованность данных ЭКГ и RR (< 10%). Автоматические данные ВСР недостоверны.` : 'ВНИМАНИЕ: Низкая согласованность данных ЭКГ и RR (< 10%). Автоматические данные ВСР недостоверны.';
      } else if (consistencyRatio !== null && consistencyRatio < 0.7) {
        limitReasons.push('ecg_rr_mismatch_moderate');
        limitedText += `\n• Умеренное рассогласование ЭКГ/RR (${(consistencyRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%).`;
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Provenance
  const sourceMode = getSourceMode(signalFiles as any);
  const hrvVersion = analyticsMetrics?.hrv_version || 'unknown';
  const deviceIdMasked = maskDeviceId(session?.device_id);

  // 6. Cardiac Drift
  const driftAnalysis = getDriftAnalysis(session as any, analyticsMetrics as any, activityType);

  // 7. Safety Claim
  const safetyClaim = 'Данный продукт и отчёты предназначены только для спортивного анализа и фитнеса. Не являются медицинским диагнозом и не заменяют консультацию врача. Высокое качество сигнала отражает внутреннюю пригодность данных для расчётов, но не является научным или клиническим подтверждением.';

  return {
    session_id: sessionId,
    ecg_rr_agreement: {
      status_category: agreementCategory,
      value_percent: agreementPres.value,
      display_value: agreementPres.valueString,
      unit: '%',
      eligibility_status: agreementInput.eligibility_status,
      presentation: agreementPres
    },
    baseline_state: {
      status_category: baselineCategory,
      source: baselinePres.source,
      sessions_used: baselinePres.sessions_used,
      sessions_required: baselinePres.sessions_required,
      availability_reason: baselinePres.availability_reason,
      baseline_presentation: baselinePres
    },
    quality_state: {
      overall_score: score,
      display_score: displayScore,
      hrv_quality_qualification: hrvQualification,
      is_hrv_valid: isHrvValid,
      hrv_invalid_reason: hrvInvalidReason,
      ecg_clipping_seconds: qcMetrics?.ecg_clipping_seconds ?? null,
      ecg_noise_ratio: qcMetrics?.ecg_noise_ratio ?? null,
      acc_motion_severity: qcMetrics?.acc_motion_severity ?? null,
      monotonicity_status: qcMetrics?.monotonicity_status ?? null,
      missing_samples_count: qcMetrics?.missing_samples_count ?? null,
      duplicate_timestamps_count: qcMetrics?.duplicate_timestamps_count ?? null
    },
    provenance: {
      source_mode: sourceMode,
      hrv_version: hrvVersion,
      device_id_masked: deviceIdMasked
    },
    limitations: {
      reliable_text: reliableText,
      limited_text: limitedText,
      warning_text: warningText,
      limit_reasons: limitReasons
    },
    cardiac_drift: driftAnalysis,
    safety_claim: safetyClaim
  };
}

/**
 * P5 Pricing Experiment Configuration Contract
 * Models pricing corridors for closed-beta feedback without asserting market certainty.
 */

  billing_model: 'one_time' | 'annual' | 'monthly';

  price_corridor_min_usd: number;
  price_corridor_max_usd: number;
  feature_highlights: string[];
  target_persona: string;
}

  experiment_id: string;
  experiment_version: string;
  disclaimer: string;
  plans: PricingPlanOption[];
  exposure_id?: string;
}

export function getSourceMode(signalFiles: { filename?: string }[] | null | undefined): 'polar_sensor_logger_export' | 'imported_file' | 'sdk_mode' | 'unknown' {
  if (!signalFiles || signalFiles.length === 0) return 'unknown';
  
  const hasEcgOrAcc = signalFiles.some(f => f.filename && (f.filename.toLowerCase().includes('ecg') || f.filename.toLowerCase().includes('acc')));
  const isSensorLogger = signalFiles.some(f => f.filename && f.filename.toLowerCase().includes('sensor_logger'));
  
  if (isSensorLogger) {
    return 'polar_sensor_logger_export';
  }
  
  if (hasEcgOrAcc) {
    return 'imported_file';
  }
  
  return 'imported_file';
}

export function translateFlagTypeRu(type: string): string {
  const t = type.trim();
  if (t === 'candidate_rr_outlier' || t === 'RR outlier') return 'Выбивающийся RR-интервал';
  if (t === 'data_gap' || t === 'Actual missing data') return 'Пропуск данных';
  if (t === 'quality_artifact_ecg_noise' || t === 'ECG high-frequency noise') return 'Шум ЭКГ';
  if (t === 'quality_artifact_baseline_drift' || t === 'Baseline drift') return 'Дрейф изолинии ЭКГ';
  if (t === 'motion_artifact' || t === 'Motion artifact') return 'Артефакт движения';
  if (t === 'sync_issue' || t === 'Timestamp/sync issue') return 'Сбой синхронизации';
  return formatVisibleEnum(t);
}

export interface CardiacDriftAnalysis {
  value_percent: number | null;
  status: 'valid_experimental' | 'not_applicable' | 'invalid_calculation' | 'insufficient_coverage' | 'missing_workload_proxy';
  reasons: string[];
}

export function getDriftAnalysis(
  session: { duration_seconds: number } | null | undefined,
  analyticsMetrics: { hr_drift_ratio: number | null } | null | undefined,
  activityType: string | null | undefined
): CardiacDriftAnalysis {
  if (activityType !== 'cardio') {
    return {
      value_percent: null,
      status: 'not_applicable',
      reasons: ['activity_type_not_cardio']
    };
  }

  if (!session || session.duration_seconds < 600) { // Less than 10 minutes
    return {
      value_percent: null,
      status: 'insufficient_coverage',
      reasons: ['duration_too_short']
    };
  }

  const rawVal = analyticsMetrics?.hr_drift_ratio;
  if (rawVal === null || rawVal === undefined) {
    return {
      value_percent: null,
      status: 'invalid_calculation',
      reasons: ['missing_raw_drift_data']
    };
  }

  if (rawVal < -20 || rawVal > 50) {
    return {
      value_percent: null,
      status: 'invalid_calculation',
      reasons: ['drift_value_out_of_bounds']
    };
  }

  return {
    value_percent: rawVal,
    status: 'valid_experimental',
    reasons: ['missing_workload_proxy']
  };
}

export function validateGuidedIntakePreflightStrict(preflight: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!preflight || typeof preflight !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['Preflight object is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (preflight.schema_version !== SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}, got ${preflight.schema_version}`);
  }
  if (!preflight.preflight_id || typeof preflight.preflight_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid preflight_id');
  }
  if (!preflight.request_fingerprint || typeof preflight.request_fingerprint !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid request_fingerprint');
  }
  if (!preflight.profile_id || typeof preflight.profile_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid profile_id');
  }
  if (!preflight.task_intent || typeof preflight.task_intent !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid task_intent');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(preflight.discovered_members)) {
    errors.push('discovered_members must be an array');
  } else {
    preflight.discovered_members.forEach((m: any, idx: number) => {
      if (!m.name || typeof m.size_bytes !== 'number' || !m.sha256) {
        errors.push(`Invalid member at index ${idx}: name, size_bytes, and sha256 are required`);
      }
    });
  }
  if (!preflight.duplicate_state || typeof preflight.duplicate_state !== 'object') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid duplicate_state');
  }
  if (!preflight.expires_at_utc || isNaN(Date.parse(preflight.expires_at_utc))) {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid expires_at_utc');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateSelfServiceWorkEpisodeStrict(episode: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!episode || typeof episode !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['Episode object is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (episode.schema_version !== SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}, got ${episode.schema_version}`);
  }
  if (!episode.episode_id || typeof episode.episode_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid episode_id');
  }
  if (!episode.profile_id || typeof episode.profile_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid profile_id');
  }
  if (!episode.actor_class || typeof episode.actor_class !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid actor_class');
  }
  if (!episode.lifecycle_state || typeof episode.lifecycle_state !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid lifecycle_state');
  }
  if (!episode.completion_gates || typeof episode.completion_gates !== 'object') {
    errors.push('completion_gates must be an object');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(episode.blockers)) {
    errors.push('blockers must be an array');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(episode.recovery_history)) {
    errors.push('recovery_history must be an array');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateRepeatWorkSeriesStrict(series: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!series || typeof series !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['Series object is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (series.schema_version !== SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Invalid schema_version: expected ${SELF_SERVICE_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION}, got ${series.schema_version}`);
  }
  if (!series.series_id || typeof series.series_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid series_id');
  }
  if (!series.profile_id || typeof series.profile_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid profile_id');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(series.episodes)) {
    errors.push('episodes must be an array');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(series.distinct_session_ids)) {
    errors.push('distinct_session_ids must be an array');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

export function validateRecoveryDescriptorStrict(descriptor: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {

  if (!descriptor || typeof descriptor !== 'object') {
    return { valid: false, errors: ['RecoveryDescriptor object is null or undefined'] };
  }
  if (!descriptor.recovery_id || typeof descriptor.recovery_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid recovery_id');
  }
  if (!descriptor.recovery_class || typeof descriptor.recovery_class !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid recovery_class');
  }
  if (typeof descriptor.data_preserved !== 'boolean') {
    errors.push('data_preserved must be a boolean');
  }
  if (!descriptor.correlation_id || typeof descriptor.correlation_id !== 'string') {
    errors.push('Missing or invalid correlation_id');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}
