FILE: src/shared/timeNormalization.ts
================================================================================
export interface TimeNormalizationOptions {
  commonOriginNs?: number;
  commonOriginMs?: number;
  preserveGaps?: boolean;
}

export function normalizeEcgTimestamps(
  rawPoints: { timeMs: number; ecgUv: number; sensorTsNs?: number }[],
  options?: TimeNormalizationOptions
): [number, number][] {
  const result: [number, number][] = [];
  if (rawPoints.length === 0) return result;

  const nominal_stream_sample_interval = 1 / 130;
  let previous_elapsed = 0;
  let segment_first_timestamp = 0;
  let segment_base = 0;
  let has_valid_sensor_ts = false;

  for (const p of rawPoints) {
    if (p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs)) {
      has_valid_sensor_ts = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (has_valid_sensor_ts) {
    let lastSensorTsNs: number | null = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
      const p = rawPoints[i];
      const ts = p.sensorTsNs ?? 0;

      if (lastSensorTsNs === null) {
        segment_first_timestamp = ts;
        segment_base = options?.commonOriginNs !== undefined ? (ts - options.commonOriginNs) / 1e9 : 0;
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      } else if (ts < lastSensorTsNs) {
        const prevPt = rawPoints[i - 1];
        const observedGapSec = (options?.preserveGaps && p.timeMs !== undefined && prevPt?.timeMs !== undefined && p.timeMs >= prevPt.timeMs)
          ? Math.max(nominal_stream_sample_interval, (p.timeMs - prevPt.timeMs) / 1000)
          : nominal_stream_sample_interval;
        const new_segment_base = previous_elapsed + observedGapSec;
        segment_base = new_segment_base;
        segment_first_timestamp = ts;
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      } else {
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      }

      const elapsed = segment_base + (ts - segment_first_timestamp) / 1e9;
      previous_elapsed = elapsed;

      result.push([elapsed, p.ecgUv]);
    }
  } else {
    const baseOffset = options?.commonOriginMs !== undefined && rawPoints[0].timeMs !== undefined
      ? (rawPoints[0].timeMs - options.commonOriginMs) / 1000
      : 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
      const elapsed = baseOffset + i / 130;
      result.push([elapsed, rawPoints[i].ecgUv]);
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export function normalizeAccTimestamps(
  rawPoints: { timeMs: number; magnitude: number; sensorTsNs?: number; x?: number; y?: number; z?: number }[],
  sampleRateHz = 200,
  options?: TimeNormalizationOptions
): { points: [number, number][]; axes: { x: [number, number][]; y: [number, number][]; z: [number, number][] } } {
  const points: [number, number][] = [];
  const axes = {
    x: [] as [number, number][],
    y: [] as [number, number][],
    z: [] as [number, number][]
  };
  if (rawPoints.length === 0) return { points, axes };

  const nominal_stream_sample_interval = 1 / sampleRateHz;
  let previous_elapsed = 0;
  let segment_first_timestamp = 0;
  let segment_base = 0;
  let has_valid_sensor_ts = false;

  for (const p of rawPoints) {
    if (p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs)) {
      has_valid_sensor_ts = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (has_valid_sensor_ts) {
    let lastSensorTsNs: number | null = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
      const p = rawPoints[i];
      const ts = p.sensorTsNs ?? 0;

      if (lastSensorTsNs === null) {
        segment_first_timestamp = ts;
        segment_base = options?.commonOriginNs !== undefined ? (ts - options.commonOriginNs) / 1e9 : 0;
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      } else if (ts < lastSensorTsNs) {
        const prevPt = rawPoints[i - 1];
        const observedGapSec = (options?.preserveGaps && p.timeMs !== undefined && prevPt?.timeMs !== undefined && p.timeMs >= prevPt.timeMs)
          ? Math.max(nominal_stream_sample_interval, (p.timeMs - prevPt.timeMs) / 1000)
          : nominal_stream_sample_interval;
        const new_segment_base = previous_elapsed + observedGapSec;
        segment_base = new_segment_base;
        segment_first_timestamp = ts;
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      } else {
        lastSensorTsNs = ts;
      }

      const elapsed = segment_base + (ts - segment_first_timestamp) / 1e9;
      previous_elapsed = elapsed;

      points.push([elapsed, p.magnitude]);
      if (p.x !== undefined && p.y !== undefined && p.z !== undefined) {
        axes.x.push([elapsed, p.x]);
        axes.y.push([elapsed, p.y]);
        axes.z.push([elapsed, p.z]);
      }
    }
  } else {
    const baseOffset = options?.commonOriginMs !== undefined && rawPoints[0].timeMs !== undefined
      ? (rawPoints[0].timeMs - options.commonOriginMs) / 1000
      : 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < rawPoints.length; i++) {
      const elapsed = baseOffset + i / sampleRateHz;
      const p = rawPoints[i];
      points.push([elapsed, p.magnitude]);
      if (p.x !== undefined && p.y !== undefined && p.z !== undefined) {
        axes.x.push([elapsed, p.x]);
        axes.y.push([elapsed, p.y]);
        axes.z.push([elapsed, p.z]);
      }
    }
  }

  return { points, axes };
}

export interface ChannelSynchronizationResult {
  is_synchronized: boolean;
  sync_method: 'sensor_clock_ns' | 'phone_epoch_ms' | 'uncalibrated_independent';
  ecg_start_offset_seconds: number;
  acc_start_offset_seconds: number;
  channel_offset_seconds: number;
  common_origin_ns: number | null;
  common_origin_ms: number | null;
  limitations: string[];
}

export function calculateChannelSynchronization(
  ecgPoints: { timeMs?: number; sensorTsNs?: number }[],
  accPoints: { timeMs?: number; sensorTsNs?: number }[]
): ChannelSynchronizationResult {
  if (ecgPoints.length === 0 || accPoints.length === 0) {
    return {
      is_synchronized: false,
      sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
      ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
      acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
      channel_offset_seconds: 0,
      common_origin_ns: null,
      common_origin_ms: null,
      limitations: ['One or both channels are missing points for synchronization']
    };
  }

  const ecgFirstNs = ecgPoints.find(p => p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs))?.sensorTsNs;
  const accFirstNs = accPoints.find(p => p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs))?.sensorTsNs;

  if (ecgFirstNs !== undefined && accFirstNs !== undefined) {
    const commonNs = Math.min(ecgFirstNs, accFirstNs);
    const ecgOffsetSec = (ecgFirstNs - commonNs) / 1e9;
    const accOffsetSec = (accFirstNs - commonNs) / 1e9;
    const deltaSec = (accFirstNs - ecgFirstNs) / 1e9;

    const limitations: string[] = [];
    let prevEcgNs: number | null = null;
    for (const p of ecgPoints) {
      if (p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs)) {
        if (prevEcgNs !== null && p.sensorTsNs < prevEcgNs) {
          limitations.push('Non-monotonic ECG sensor clock reset detected; cross-channel comparison across reset has uncalibrated gap');
          break;
        }
        prevEcgNs = p.sensorTsNs;
      }
    }
    let prevAccNs: number | null = null;
    for (const p of accPoints) {
      if (p.sensorTsNs !== undefined && p.sensorTsNs !== null && !isNaN(p.sensorTsNs)) {
        if (prevAccNs !== null && p.sensorTsNs < prevAccNs) {
          limitations.push('Non-monotonic ACC sensor clock reset detected; cross-channel comparison across reset has uncalibrated gap');
          break;
        }
        prevAccNs = p.sensorTsNs;
      }
    }

    return {
      is_synchronized: true,
      sync_method: 'sensor_clock_ns',
      ecg_start_offset_seconds: ecgOffsetSec,
      acc_start_offset_seconds: accOffsetSec,
      channel_offset_seconds: deltaSec,
      common_origin_ns: commonNs,
      common_origin_ms: null,
      limitations
    };
  }

  const ecgFirstMs = ecgPoints.find(p => p.timeMs !== undefined && !isNaN(p.timeMs))?.timeMs;
  const accFirstMs = accPoints.find(p => p.timeMs !== undefined && !isNaN(p.timeMs))?.timeMs;

  if (ecgFirstMs !== undefined && accFirstMs !== undefined) {
    const isEcgEpoch = ecgFirstMs > 1e11;
    const isAccEpoch = accFirstMs > 1e11;

    if (isEcgEpoch !== isAccEpoch) {
      return {
        is_synchronized: false,
        sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
        ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
        channel_offset_seconds: 0,
        common_origin_ns: null,
        common_origin_ms: null,
        limitations: ['Clock domain mismatch: one channel uses phone epoch while the other uses relative sensor time']
      };
    }

    const commonMs = Math.min(ecgFirstMs, accFirstMs);
    const ecgOffsetSec = (ecgFirstMs - commonMs) / 1000;
    const accOffsetSec = (accFirstMs - commonMs) / 1000;
    const deltaSec = (accFirstMs - ecgFirstMs) / 1000;

    return {
      is_synchronized: true,
      sync_method: 'phone_epoch_ms',
      ecg_start_offset_seconds: ecgOffsetSec,
      acc_start_offset_seconds: accOffsetSec,
      channel_offset_seconds: deltaSec,
      common_origin_ns: null,
      common_origin_ms: commonMs,
      limitations: ['Synchronized via phone epoch; BLE packet arrival jitter may cause ±50-100ms uncertainty']
    };
  }

  return {
    is_synchronized: false,
    sync_method: 'uncalibrated_independent',
    ecg_start_offset_seconds: 0,
    acc_start_offset_seconds: 0,
    channel_offset_seconds: 0,
    common_origin_ns: null,
    common_origin_ms: null,
    limitations: ['Missing sensor timestamp on one or both channels; synchronized comparison unavailable']
  };
}

export function normalizeHrTimestamps(rawPoints: { timeMs: number; hrBpm: number }[]): [number, number][] {
  const result: [number, number][] = [];
  if (rawPoints.length === 0) return result;
  const firstTimeMs = rawPoints[0].timeMs;
  for (const p of rawPoints) {
    const elapsedSeconds = (p.timeMs - firstTimeMs) / 1000;
    result.push([elapsedSeconds, p.hrBpm]);
  }
  return result;
}

export function shouldInterceptRequest(
  details: {
    url: string;
    resourceType: string;
    webContentsId?: number;
    requestHeaders: Record<string, string>;
  },
  port: number,
  mainWebContentsId?: number
): boolean {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(details.url);
    const isProtocolHttp = parsed.protocol === 'http:';
    const isHostnameLoopback = parsed.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
    const isPortMatch = parsed.port === String(port);
    const isApiPrefix = parsed.pathname.startsWith('/api');
    
    const isMainWin = mainWebContentsId !== undefined && details.webContentsId === mainWebContentsId;
    const isAllowedType = details.resourceType === 'xhr' || details.resourceType === 'fetch';
    const isNotNavigation = details.resourceType !== 'mainFrame' && details.resourceType !== 'subFrame';
    
    const hasExistingAuth = !!(
      details.requestHeaders['Authorization'] ||
      details.requestHeaders['authorization'] ||
      details.requestHeaders['AUTHORIZATION']
    );

    return (
      isProtocolHttp &&
      isHostnameLoopback &&
      isPortMatch &&
      isApiPrefix &&
      isMainWin &&
      isAllowedType &&
      isNotNavigation &&
      !hasExistingAuth
    );
  } catch (err) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Validates whether an automated channel transition is permitted.
 * Rules:
 * - Same channel is always permitted (beta -> beta, stable -> stable, etc.)
 * - Forward graduation: beta -> rc, beta -> stable, rc -> stable
 * - Nightly can graduate to any channel
 * - Stable cannot automatically transition to beta/rc without explicit user reconfiguration
 */
export function isChannelTransitionAllowed(
  fromChannel: UpdateChannel | string,
  toChannel: UpdateChannel | string
): boolean {
  if (fromChannel === toChannel) return true;
  if (fromChannel === 'beta' && (toChannel === 'rc' || toChannel === 'stable')) return true;
  if (fromChannel === 'rc' && toChannel === 'stable') return true;
  if (fromChannel === 'nightly' && (toChannel === 'beta' || toChannel === 'rc' || toChannel === 'stable')) return true;
  return false;
}

/**
 * Strict SemVer 2.0 comparison.
 * Returns negative if v1 < v2, 0 if v1 == v2, positive if v1 > v2.
 * Correctly compares prereleases per SemVer 2.0 spec:
 * 1.0.1-beta.11 < 1.0.1-beta.12 < 1.0.1-rc.1 < 1.0.1 < 1.0.2
 */
export function compareSemver(v1: string, v2: string): number {
  if (v1 === v2) return 0;

  const parseSemver = (v: string) => {
    const clean = v.trim().replace(/^v/i, '');
    const [mainAndPre] = clean.split('+');
    const [main, ...preParts] = mainAndPre.split('-');
    const pre = preParts.length > 0 ? preParts.join('-') : null;
    const nums = main.split('.').map(n => parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
    while (nums.length < 3) nums.push(0);
    return {
      major: nums[0],
      minor: nums[1],
      patch: nums[2],
      prerelease: pre ? pre.split('.') : null
    };
  };

  const p1 = parseSemver(v1);
  const p2 = parseSemver(v2);

  if (p1.major !== p2.major) return p1.major - p2.major;
  if (p1.minor !== p2.minor) return p1.minor - p2.minor;
  if (p1.patch !== p2.patch) return p1.patch - p2.patch;

  // Normal release has higher precedence than a prerelease of the same major.minor.patch
  if (!p1.prerelease && p2.prerelease) return 1;
  if (p1.prerelease && !p2.prerelease) return -1;
  if (!p1.prerelease && !p2.prerelease) return 0;

  // Both have prereleases: compare identifier by identifier
  const pre1 = p1.prerelease!;
  const pre2 = p2.prerelease!;
  const len = Math.max(pre1.length, pre2.length);

  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    const id1 = pre1[i];
    const id2 = pre2[i];

    if (id1 === undefined) return -1;
    if (id2 === undefined) return 1;

    if (id1 === id2) continue;

    const isNum1 = /^\d+$/.test(id1);
    const isNum2 = /^\d+$/.test(id2);

    if (isNum1 && isNum2) {
      const n1 = parseInt(id1, 10);
      const n2 = parseInt(id2, 10);
      if (n1 !== n2) return n1 - n2;
    } else if (isNum1 && !isNum2) {
      return -1;
    } else if (!isNum1 && isNum2) {
      return 1;
    } else {
      const cmp = id1.localeCompare(id2);
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}

/**
 * P5 Version & Build Identity Contract
 * Unifies application version, build number, release channel, and schema boundaries.
 */

export interface VersionContract {
  app_version: string;
  build_number: string;
  build_version: string;
  release_channel: 'beta' | 'rc' | 'release';
  channel: 'beta' | 'rc' | 'release' | 'stable';
  candidate_version: string;
  release_family: string;
  target_ga_version: string;
  full_display_version: string;
  database_schema_version: string;
  canonical_protocol_version: string;
  ai_pack_schema_version: string;
  distribution_dir_template: string;
}

export const VERSION_CONTRACT: VersionContract = {
  app_version: '1.0.1',
  build_number: '11',
  build_version: '1.0.1.11',
  release_channel: 'beta',
  channel: 'beta',
  candidate_version: '1.0.1-beta.11',
  release_family: '1.0.1',
  target_ga_version: '1.0.1',
  full_display_version: '1.0.1-beta.11',
  database_schema_version: '1.0.0',
  canonical_protocol_version: '1.1.0',
  ai_pack_schema_version: '2.0.0',
  distribution_dir_template: 'dist/CardioLab_Workstation_v${version}'
};

export function getDistributionDir(versionOrFamily?: string): string {
  // Normalize candidate versions (e.g. '1.0.1-beta.11') to their release family ('1.0.1')
  // ensuring distribution directory maps consistently to dist/CardioLab_Workstation_v1.0.1
  const v = versionOrFamily
    ? versionOrFamily.split(/[-+]/)[0]
    : VERSION_CONTRACT.release_family;
  return VERSION_CONTRACT.distribution_dir_template.replace('${version}', v);
}

export function getNsisInstallerFilename(productName = 'CardioLab Workstation', version?: string): string {
  const v = version || VERSION_CONTRACT.full_display_version;
  return `${productName} Setup ${v}.exe`;
}

export function getPortableFilename(productName = 'CardioLab Workstation', version?: string): string {
  const v = version || VERSION_CONTRACT.full_display_version;
  return `${productName} ${v}.exe`;
}

export function getVersionInfo(gitSha?: string): VersionContract & { git_sha: string } {
  return {
    ...VERSION_CONTRACT,
    git_sha: gitSha || 'development'
  };
}

  safety_snapshot_sha256: string;
  restored_manifest: WorkspaceBackupManifest;
  restored_at_utc: string;
  restarted_db_verified: boolean;
  rolled_back?: boolean;
  rollback_status?: RestoreRollbackStatus;
  rollback_reason?: string;
  rollback_incomplete_details?: string[];
  error?: string;
}

export interface SafetySnapshotInfo {
  filename: string;
  filepath: string;
  size_bytes: number;
  sha256: string;
  created_at_utc: string;
  integrity_status: 'ok' | 'corrupted';
}

/**
 * Validates a member path inside a backup archive against Zip Slip and path traversal.
 * Throws an Error if any rule is violated.
 */
export function validateSafeZipMemberPath(entryName: string): string {
  if (!entryName || typeof entryName !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('MEMBER_PATH_EMPTY: Entry name cannot be empty');
  }

  // Normalize slashes
  const normalized = entryName.replace(/\\/g, '/').trim();

  // Reject empty after trim
  if (normalized.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('MEMBER_PATH_EMPTY: Entry name is blank');
  }

  // Reject absolute paths or leading slashes
  if (normalized.startsWith('/') || /^[a-zA-Z]:/i.test(normalized)) {
    throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Absolute paths are strictly forbidden: ${entryName}`);
  }

  // Reject drive letters or colons
  if (normalized.includes(':')) {
    throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Colons/drive identifiers are forbidden: ${entryName}`);
  }

  // Reject parent directory traversal (..)
  const segments = normalized.split('/');
  for (const segment of segments) {
    if (segment === '..' || segment === '.') {
      throw new Error(`PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Relative traversal "${segment}" is forbidden: ${entryName}`);
    }
  }

  // Reject forbidden characters (null byte, control chars)
  if (/[\0\x01-\x1F\x7F]/.test(normalized)) {
    throw new Error(`INVALID_CHARACTER: Member path contains control characters: ${entryName}`);
  }

  // Restrict to approved top-level prefixes
  const approvedPrefixes = ['manifest.json', 'cardio_lab.db', 'raw_logs/', 'corrupted/'];
  const matchesApproved = approvedPrefixes.some(prefix => 
    prefix.endsWith('/') ? normalized.startsWith(prefix) : normalized === prefix
  );

  if (!matchesApproved) {
    throw new Error(`UNAPPROVED_MEMBER_PATH: Path "${normalized}" is not an authorized backup member`);
  }

  return normalized;
}

# H10 Athlete Cardio Lab

A premium, 100% offline, privacy-safe Cardio and HRV Analytics system designed for Polar H10 raw logs.

---

## 📖 Table of Contents
1. [Overview](#-overview)
2. [Dual-Mode & Multi-User Architecture](#-dual-mode--multi-user-architecture)
3. [Key Features](#-key-features)
4. [Installation & Setup](#-installation--setup)
5. [Running the Application](#-running-the-application)
6. [Testing & Verification](#-testing--verification)
7. [Safety & Privacy Design](#-safety--privacy-design)

---

## 🌟 Overview

The **H10 Athlete Cardio Lab** is a high-performance desktop application for importing, analyzing, and annotation of heart rate (HR), heart rate variability (HRV), electrocardiogram (ECG), and accelerometer (ACC) logs recorded by the **Polar H10** sensor. 

The application is structured to run **completely offline**, ensuring absolute data privacy. It connects to the Polar sensor logs via a read-only mapped drive (`Z:\Polar Logs`) or folder, runs quality control validation, calculates time/frequency HRV metrics (SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50), extracts representative ECG strips, and formats data packages.

---

## 🔄 Dual-Mode & Multi-User Architecture

The system segregates data processing and AI features into three cleanly separated pillars:

1. **Local App Analysis (Mode A)**:
   * Deterministic metrics computed locally (QRS detection, artifact filtering, HR drift, LTTB downsampled ECG graphing).
   * Generates interactive Russian-language HTML/PDF reports and CSV spreadsheets.
   * Multi-user profile mapping to separate family members/athletes.
2. **LLM Pack Mode (Mode B)**:
   * Compiles privacy-safe, offline, model-specific ZIP packages containing aggregated cardio metrics, manifest files, and task prompts.
   * Tailored for manual upload into ChatGPT, Gemini / AI Studio, or local Antigravity models.
3. **LLM Diary Mode (Mode C)**:
   * Imports `.md` or `.txt` subjective responses generated by AI models back into the application.
   * Safe markdown rendering engine that constructs React elements line-by-line using Vanilla CSS without raw HTML execution, strictly validating URLs (strictly `http://`, `https://`, and `mailto:` protocols only).

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **Multi-User Profiles**: Manage profiles with specific parameters (age, resting HR, max HR) to isolate and calculate heart rate training zones.
* **Activity Annotations**: Annotate sessions with activity types (Cardio, Sleep, Mixed, Strength, Recovery, etc.), perceived effort (1-10), sleep quality, custom labels, and tags.
* **Quality Control Coordinator**: Automatic detection of signal clipping, baseline drift, missing/duplicate timestamps, and accelerometer-based motion severity.
* **QRS Detection**: Local correlation index matching QRS R-peaks from raw ECG signals against native Polar R-R intervals.
* **Secure ZIP Pack Compiler**: Privacy scrubber that redacts display names, hex sensor serials, Polar device IDs, and local system folder paths.
* **Duplicate Import Prevention**: Automatically checks file hashes to prevent importing the same LLM report multiple times.

## 🛡️ Safety & Privacy Design

* **Zero External Calls**: No OpenAI, Google Gemini, or telemetry APIs are integrated into the source code.
* **Read-Only Polar Logs**: The raw logs folder `Z:\Polar Logs` is strictly read-only. The ingestion pipeline extracts and copies raw logs into the local AppData folder, never modifying, moving, or deleting source logs.
* **Redaction Filters**: All generated LLM Packages are deeply scrubbed of local home directory paths, athlete names, and device serial numbers to avoid data linkage.


---

## 3. Правила взаимодействия с локальным агентом Antigravity

Компаньон формулирует задачи для автономного агента Antigravity в виде **однофайлового JSON Action Packet**:
`AGENTIC_ACTION_PACKET_<project>_<timestamp>.json`

### Обязательные правила:
1. `owner_interaction_policy: "hard_stop_only"` — агент исполняет план автономно до верификации или реального блокера.
2. `scope_binding: "executor_discovery"` — агент самостоятельно валидирует рабочую ветку и окружение.
3. Отчёт для владельца (`owner_summary_ru`) формируется ровно из 4 секций:
   - `## Что происходит`
   - `## Что уже сделано`
   - `## Что будет дальше`
   - `## Нужно ли что-то от владельца`

Примеры готовых валидных пакетов приведены в каталоге `05_ACTION_PACKET_EXAMPLES/`.

# Форматы данных, транспортные протоколы и алгоритмы управления: H10 Athlete Cardio Lab

## 1. Спецификация Action Packet (v1.2.9 / Ecosystem v1.2.27)

Action Packet — это атомарный JSON-манифест, через который Компаньон формулирует задачу агенту Antigravity.

### Обязательные поля (Required):
- `schema_version`: Строго '1.2.9'
- `ecosystem_version`: Строго '1.2.27'
- `packet_id`: Уникальный ID пакета (формат: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,128}$, пример: packet_h10_athlete_cardio_lab_nextphase_...)
- `project_id`: Идентификатор проекта в Action Bridge ('H10-Athlete-Cardio-Lab')
- `operation`: 'new_work_item' или 'continue_work_item'
- `route`: Авторитетный маршрут пайплайна ('/nextphase', '/auditphase', '/fixcritical', '/fastpatch', '/shipcheck')
- `goal`: Краткое описание цели на русском или английском языке
- `assurance_mode`: 'guarded' (по умолчанию), 'standard', или 'release'
- `owner_approved`: Строго true
- `owner_interaction_policy`: Строго 'hard_stop_only'
- `scope_binding`: Строго 'executor_discovery'
- `technical_task_markdown`: Развёрнутое пошаговое техническое задание в Markdown
- `owner_summary_ru`: Краткий отчёт для владельца ровно из 4 секций (## Что происходит, ## Что уже сделано, ## Что будет дальше, ## Нужно ли что-то от владельца)
- `created_at_utc`: RFC3339 временная метка генерации (UTC)
- `expires_at_utc`: RFC3339 временная метка истечения срока действия (UTC, +4..24 часа)

### Дополнительные поддерживаемые поля (Relaxed Mode):
- `work_item_id`: ID активного рабочего элемента (для continue_work_item)
- `goal_epoch`: Номер итерации в рамках рабочего элемента (int)
- `stage_profile`: Настройки фазы ('full', 'fast', etc.)
- `acceptance`: Список критериев приемки (array of strings)
- `non_goals`: Список того, что явно НЕ входит в скоуп (array of strings)
- `risk_hints`: Список архитектурных рисков для внимания агента
- `audit_dimensions`: Объект с настройками аудита
- Дополнительные метаданные (status, target, tasks, author, version, owner_directive, continuation_reason) сохраняются и передаются агенту.

---

## 2. Транспортный протокол v2 (SQLite & File Bridge)

Транспорт обеспечивает надёжную доставку пакетов без потерь даже при перезапуске сессий IDE.

### База данных transport.sqlite3:
- Таблица action_packets: Хранит поступившие пакеты, статус исполнения (pending -> in_progress -> completed / failed), временные метки.
- Таблица execution_log: Аудиторский лог запуска команд, PID процессов и кодов возврата.

### Файловый мост:
- Помещение JSON пакета в .agy/ или в очередь моста немедленно переводит его в активное исполнение.
- Инжектор inject_action_packet.py валидирует подлинность локального процесса и запускает задачу в Antigravity.

---

## 3. Архитектура циклического супервизора и защита от сбоев

1. **Супервизор циклов (agentic_cyclic_supervisor.py)**: Управляет жизненным циклом агента, предотвращает зависания и перезапускает упавшие задачи.
2. **Процесс-гард (antigravity_process_guard.py)**: Фоновый сторожевой процесс, контролирующий liveness агентов и фоновых тестов.
3. **Telegram-мост (telegram_cycle_bot.py, telegram_durable.py)**: Передаёт уведомления владельцу и позволяет отправлять управляющие директивы в реальном времени.
4. **Принцип неделимого авторитета**: Агент выполняет роль исполнителя (READY_FOR_COMPANION_AUDIT). Окончательный вердикт приёмки (ACCEPTED) выносит исключительно ИИ-Компаньон через Action Packet.

---
